Amah in numei kiangah, \"Pasian in, ‘Huan sunga sing khatpeuh pan na ne kei un,’ hong ci takpi hiam?\" a ci hi.","title":"Mihing Pukna","ref":"2Co 11:3"},"2":{"text":"Numei in gulpi kiangah, \"Huan sunga singte panin a gah ka ne thei ding uh hi;"},"3":{"text":"ahi hangin Pasian in bel, ‘Huan laizanga sing panin a gah na ne kei ding uh a, zong na lawng peuhmah kei ding uh hi; na hih uh leh na si ding uh hi,’ hong ci mah hi,’ a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Gulpi in numei kiangah, \"Na si peuhmah kei ding uh hi,"},"5":{"text":"ahang in tua na nek uh ciangin na mit uh kihong dinga, Pasian tawh kibangin sia le pha na theih ding uh Pasian in thei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jn 8:44;Isa 14:14"},"6":{"text":"Numei in tua singgah a muh ciangin nek dingin limci sa-a, a mit la keei a, pilna zong ngah nuam ahi manin tawmkhat la-in a ne hi. Amah tawh a omkhawm a pasal zong tawmkhat pia-a, a pasal in a ne hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nih un a mit uh kihonga, guaktang ahina uh a kithei tel uh hi; tua ciangin theiteh khuituah uh a amau le amau kituamna-in bawl uh hi.","ref":"1Ti 2:14; Jas 1:14-15;1Jn 2:16"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa le a zi in, tua ni khuadaih hunin huan sunga TOPA Pasian paina huging za uh a, TOPA Pasian muhna pan huan sunga sing lakah bu uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA Pasian in mipa sam a, \"Koi-ah om na hiam?\" ci hi.","ref":"Job 31:33"},"10":{"text":"Amah in, \"Huan sungah na gin ka za-a, guaktang a om ka hi manin lau-in ka bu hi,\" ci-in dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuateh amah in, \"Note guaktang na hilam uh kuan hong gen hiam? Nek loh dinga thu kong piak singkung pan ne na hi uh hiam?\" ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Mipa in, \"Kei tawh om dinga na koih numei - amah in singkung pana singgah tawm hong pia-a ka ne hi,’ a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA Pasian in numei kiangah, \"Bang ahia na hih?\" a ci hi. Numei in, \"Gulpi in hong khema ka ne hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Co 11:3"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA Pasian in gulpi kiangah, \"Hi ci gamtat khin na hi manin, \"Innsate khempeuh le gamsate khempeuh sangin nang hong kihamsiat zaw hi!\" Na gilpi-in na tal dinga na nuntak laiteng leivui na ne ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:15-20; Isa 65:25"},"15":{"text":"Nang le numei kikal le nang suan le khak a le ama suan-le-khakte kikalah kihuatna ka omsak ding hi; amah in na lutang suzan b dinga, nang ama khetul na tu ding hi,\" ci hi.","ref":"Kil 12:17;1Jn 3:8"},"16":{"text":"Amah in numei kiangah, \"Nau na suah natnate ka khangsak mahmah ding hi; na sa mahmah in nau na suak ding hi. Na lunggulhna na pasal aa hi dinga, amah in nang hong uk ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in Adam tungah, \"Na zi thu mangin, ‘Singkung pan ne peuhmah kei in,’ ci-a kong thupiak ne na hi manin, \"Nang hangin leitang kihamsiat hi; na nuntak sung khempeuh gimpi-in na semin na kivak ding hi.","ref":"Ro 8:20-22,Pc 5:29"},"18":{"text":"Nang adingin leitung in lingkungte le kiakte posak dinga lo sunga kungte na ne ding hi.","ref":"Job 31:40"},"19":{"text":"Leivui pana nang hong kila ahi nungsang lei-a na ciah kik mateng na tala khua-ul suahna tawh an na ne ding hi; leivui na hi manin leivui-ah na ciah kik ding hi,\" ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Adam c in a zi min Eve d phuak hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah a nungtate khempeuh nu a suak ding hi.","ref":"1Ti 2:13"},"21":{"text":"TOPA Pasian in Adam le a zi ading savun puan bawlsakin silhsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA Pasian in, \"Tu-in mipa in a sia le a pha thei a, eite khat mah tawh kibang ta hi. Na sanggampa sisan leilak panin kei tungah hong kiko hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in hamsiatna na thuaka, na sanggampa sisan na khutin sang dinga a kamka leitang panin nang hong kihawlkhia hi."},"12":{"text":"Leitang na khawh ciangin nang ading gah hong piangsak nawn kei ding hi. Leitungah cihna ding theilo-a a kawivak pa na suak ding hi,\" ci hi."},"13":{"text":"TOPA tungah Cain in, \"Ka dan thuakna kei thuak zawh zah sangin nasia zaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in leitang panin kei nong hawlkhia a, na omna panin kei hong kisel ding hi; leitungah cihna ding theilo-a a kawivak pa ka suak ding a, hong mu peuhpeuh in kei hong that ding hi,\" ci hi.","ref":"Ph 51:11; Ms 35:19,21,27,33"},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Cain tungah, \"Tua bang hi lo hi. b Mi khatpeuh in Cain a thah leh sagih vei sanga tamzaw in phulakna a thuak ding hi,\" ci hi. Note in kote Pharaoh le a nasemte tungah a namsia nong suaksak uh a, kote thah nading amaute khutah namsau na koih uh hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA kiangah Moses kihei kik in, \"Topa aw, bang hangin hih mite tungah lungkhamna tungsak na hi hiam? Hih bang dinga kei hong sawl na hi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"Pharaoh tungah nangma minin thu gen dinga ka pai nungsang, amah in hih mite tungah lungkhamna tungsaka, nang lah na mite na honkhia kei hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Hotkhiat Nadinga Pasian Thuciam"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Tu-in Pharaoh tunga ka hih ding na mu ding hi: A thahat ka khut hangin amaute a paisak ding hi; a thahat ka khut hangin ama gamsung panin amaute a hawlkhia ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Pasian in Moses kiangah, \"Keimah TOPA ka hi hi;"},"3":{"text":"Abraham tung, Isaac tung le Jacob tungah Thahatpen a Pasian in ka kilanga, ahi hangin TOPA b ka min tawh amaute kiangah ka kitheisak nai kei hi. c"},"4":{"text":"Amaute pemta-a a tenna uh Canaan gam amaute ka piak nading thukhun kip zong ka bawl zo hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banah Egypt-te in sila-a a khawi uh Israel mite thumna ka za zo a, ka thukhun ka phawk zo hi.","ref":"Pk 2:23; 3:14"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel mite kiangah, ‘Keimah TOPA ka hi a, Egypt-te hakkol nuai panin note kong paikhiatpih ding hi. Amaute khuta sila suahna pan kong tankhia dinga, khut zankhiatna le thukhenna vangliatna nasep tawh note kong tan ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Note, ka mi dingin kong la dinga, note’ Pasian ka hi ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA note Pasian Egypt-te’ hakkol nuai pana hong lakhia pa ka hilam na thei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Keimah in Abraham tung, Isaac tung le Jacob tungah kong pia ding hi, ci-a khut zan-a ka ciamsa leitangah note kong puak ding hi. Keimah TOPA ka hi hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 15:18"},"9":{"text":"Moses in hih thu Israel mite tungah ko a, ahi hangin amaute in amau lungkiatna le sila-a a kikhelbawlna hangin a thu a ngai nuam kei uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah,"},"11":{"text":"\"Pai inla Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh kiangah, Israel-te ama gam panin a paikhiatsak nadingin va gen in,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in TOPA kiangah, \"Israel-te in ka thugen hong ngai lo uh ahileh bangci in Pharaoh in pau-awkpi-a ka thugen hong ngai ding ahi hiam?\" d a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le Israel-te tungtang thu TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah gena, Egypt panin Israel-te a paikhiatpih dingun thu a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Hihte amau innkuan e lutangte ahi hi: Israel’ ta upa pen Reuben pana piang ta pasalte Hanoch le Pallu, Hezron le Carmi. Tuate Moses le Aaron mah ahi uh hi.","ref":"Pk 7:4"},"28":{"text":"Egypt ah TOPA in Moses kianga thu a gen lai-in,"},"29":{"text":"ama kiangah, \"Keimah TOPA ka hi hi. Nang tungah kong gen peuhmah Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tungah gen in,\" a ci hi.","title":"Aaron in Moses Tangin Thugen"},"30":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in TOPA tungah, \"Pau-awkpi-a thugen ka hi tawh bang hangin Pharaoh in ka thugen ngai ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"En in, Pharaoh tungah nang Pasian in kong bawla, na sanggampa Aaron na kamsangpa ahi ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Kong sawl khempeuh nang na gen dinga, Aaron in Pharaoh tungah Israel mite ama gam pana a paikhiatsak ding a gen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pharaoh lungtang ka khauhsak dinga, Egypt ah a lamdang limte le nalamdang tampi ka bawl hangin"},"4":{"text":"amah in hong mang lo ding hi. Tua ciangin Egypt tungah ka khut ka nga dinga, a vanglian thukhennate zangin ka khenkhiattuam ka mi Israel-te ka paikhiatpih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt langah ka khut zanin Israel-te ka paikhiatpih ciangin kei TOPA ka hilam Egypt mite in a thei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 3:20"},"6":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in TOPA thupiak bang tektekin a sem uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute Pharaoh tawh a kiho hunin Moses kum sawmgiat pha a, Aaron kum sawm giat le thum a pha hi.","ref":"Tp 34:7; Ns 7:23,30"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah,"},"9":{"text":"\"Pharaoh in note kiangah, ‘Nalamdang khat bawl un,’ hong cih ciangin Aaron kiangah, ‘Na ciangkhut la-in Pharaoh mai-ah lawn in,’ ci in, gul hong suak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Aaron’ Ciangkhut Gul Suak"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh kiangah Moses le Aaron pai uh a, TOPA thupiak bang tektekin a hih uh hi. Aaron in Pharaoh le a uliante mai-ah a ciangkhut lawnsuka gul a suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh in mipilte le aisiamte sama, Egypt mitphial siamte in zong amau siamna tawh tua tawh kibang a hih thei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A ciangkhut tek lawnsuk uh a, gul a suak hi. Ahi hangin Aaron ciangkhut in amaute ciangkhut a valh tum hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hi napi TOPA gensa bangin Pharaoh lungsim khauhsak lai-a amaute thu angai tuan kei hi.","ref":"Pc 41:8; Pk 4:2-5"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Pharaoh lungsim nem nai het lo hi; amah in a mite a paisak nuam kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Zingsangin tui-ah Pharaoh a pai ciangin a kiangah va pai in. Amah tawh kituak dingin Nile gun gei-ah ngak inla, gul a suak na ciangkhut na khutin tawi in.","title":"Sisan Gimna"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama kiangah, ‘ TOPA , Hebrew-te Pasian in nang kiangah kei hong sawla: Sehnel gam sungah kei hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak hen, ci hi. Ahi hangin tu hun dong na mang kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Hih tawh keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding hi: Ka khut sunga ciangkhut tawh Nile guntui ka sat dinga sisan a suak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Nile sunga ngasate si dinga gun a uih ding hi. Egypt mite in guntui a dawn thei kei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 3:18; 4:9; Kil 16:4"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Aaron kiangah, ‘Na ciangkhut la inla Egypt a tuite tung - luite le hawkguamte tung, bualte le tuikholnate tungah na khutzan in’ - tuate sisan a suak ding hi. Egypt mun khempeuh sing tuikuang le thambel sung nangawn ah sisan a om ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 14:21"},"20":{"text":"TOPA thupiaksa bangin Moses le Aaron in a hih uh hi. Amah in Pharaoh le a uliante muh in a ciangkhut lamto in Nile tui sat-a, tui khempeuh sisanin a kilaih hi."},"21":{"text":"Nile sunga ngasate si-a gun namsia lua ahi manin Egypt-te in tui a dawn thei kei uh hi. Egypt mun khempeuhah sisan a om hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin Egypt mitphial siamte in amau siamna tawh tua bang mahin hih uh a, Pharaoh lungsim a khauhsak hi. TOPA cihsa bang tektekin amah in Moses le Aaron thu a ngai kei hi."},"23":{"text":"A ngaih sangsikin kileh in a kumpi inn sungah lut-a, ngaihsutin zong a nei beek kei hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt mite khempeuh in Nile dungah tui dawn ding a to uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in guntui a dawn thei kei uh hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in Nile a sat zawh ni sagih cing khin hi.","ref":"tg 11"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Pharaoh kiangah pai inla ama kiangah, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Kei hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak hen, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in."},"2":{"text":"Amaute na paisak nop kei leh na gambuppi uiphuk zangin ka gimsak ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Nile ah uiphuk a dim ding hi. Tuate na kumpi inn sungah hong kahto in na lupna inndei sung, na lupna tung na uliante le na mite innsung, tua banah na thuk sung le na buhnel mekmanna kuang sungte ah a om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua uiphukte nang tung le na mite tung le na uliante tungah hong kah ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 3:12,18;10:6"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Aaron kiangah, ‘Na khutin na ciangkhut tawi inla luite, hawkguamte, bualte tungah zanin Egypt leitanga uiphukte paikhiasak in,’ ci in,’ a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 7:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Aaron in Egypt a tuite tungah a khut zankhia-a, uiphukte paikhia-in gamsung teng a tuam hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin mitphial siamte in amau siamna tawh tua tawh ki- bang a hih thei uh hi; amaute in zong Egypt leilak ah uiphuk a paikhiasak uh hi.","ref":"Pk 7:11; Ph 78:45"},"8":{"text":"Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron sam a, \"Kei le ka mite tung pan uiphuk a lakmang nadingin TOPA tungah thu ngen un, TOPA biakpiakna pia dingin na mite ka paisak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 9:28; 10:17"},"9":{"text":"Moses in Pharaoh kiangah, \"Nang le na uliante, le na mite inn sungah, Nile sunga om laite lobuang uiphukte a bei nadinga thu kong ngetsak nading hun seh ding hamphatna nang kong pia hi,\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Pharaoh in, \"Zingciang,\" a ci hi. Moses in, \" TOPA kote Pasian, bang kuamah om lo cih na theih thei nadingin na cih bang hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Uiphukte in nang le na innte, na uliante le na mite nusia ding hi; amaute Nile sung bekah a om ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 9:14; Tp 33:26"},"12":{"text":"Moses le Aaron in Pharaoh a nusiat khit uh ciangin Pharaoh tunga a tunsak uiphukte thu TOPA kiangah Moses in a ko hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses nget bangin TOPA in a hih hi. Uiphukte, inn sung, huang sung, lo sungah a si hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute a lomlomin kiciang a gam sungteng a uihsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pharaoh in haksatna bei ta cih a theih ciangin TOPA cihsa bang tektekin a lungtang khauhsak a, Moses le Aaron thu ngai lo hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Aaron kiangah gen in, ‘Na ciangkhut van inla leivui lak sat in,’ tua ciangin Egypt gam sung khempeuh a leivuite cippi suak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in hih uh a, Aaron in a khut zankhia-in ciangkhutin leivui lak a sat ciangin mihingte le ganhingte tungah cippi a tu hi. Egypt gam sunga leivuite khempeuh cippi a suak hi.","title":"Cippi Gimna"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin mitphial siamte in amau siamna tawh cippi omsak a sawm uh hangin a hih thei kei uh hi. Mihingte le ganhingte tawh cippi a om uh hi.","ref":"Pk 9:11"},"19":{"text":"Mitphial siamte in Pharaoh kiangah, \"Hih in Pasian khutma ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi. Ahi hangin TOPA cihsa bang tektekin Pharaoh lungtang khauh a thu a ngai kei hi.","ref":"Pk 7:5; Ph 8:3; Lk 11:20"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Zingsangin tho baih inla tuiphual-a Pharaoh a pai ding na ngak kholin ama kiangah, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Kei hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in;"},"21":{"text":"ka mite na paisak nop kei leh nang le na uliante tung, na mite tung le na inn sungah tho honpi ka sawl ding hi. Egypt mite innah tho dim dinga, a omna uh leitang nangawnah a dim ding hi.","title":"Tho Gimna"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin tua ni-in ka mite tenna Goshen gam mundang tawh ka kilamdangsak ding hi; keimah TOPA tua gamah ka om lam na theih nadingin tua lai-ah tho hon a om kei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei mite le nang mite deidanna a khat ka bawl ding hi. Hih nalamdang lim zing ciangin a tung ding hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 7:5"},"24":{"text":"TOPA in hih bangin sem hi. Kumpipa Pharaoh inn sung le a uliante inn sung le Egypt bupah thohon lompi lengin lut-a, tua gam khempeuh thote in siasak gawp hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron sam a, \"Pai unla hih gam sungah note Pasian tungah biakna va pia un,\" a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in, \"Ahi thei kei ding hi. TOPA kote Pasian tunga ka biakpiakna uh Egypt mite adingin a kihhuai suak ding hi. Amau muhna-ah a kihhuai-in biakpiaknate pia le ung kote suangin hong deng lo ding uh ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"Amah in kote hong thupiaksa bangin TOPA kote Pasian tungah biakpiakna pia dingin sehnel gam sungah nithum lam ka pai uh kul ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 43:32; Pk 3:18"},"28":{"text":"Pharaoh in, \" TOPA note Pasian tungah biakpiakna pia dingin gam sungah kong paisak ding hi; ahi zongin a gamla lua-ah na pai peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Tu-in kei thu hong ngetsak un,\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, \"Nang kong nusiat khit phetin TOPA kiangah thu ka ngen dinga, zing ciangin thote in Pharaoh le a uliante le a mite a nusia ding hi. Mite a TOPA tung-ua biakpiakna pia dinga paisak nop lohna tawh Pharaoh in hong khembawl kik nawn peuhmah kei in,\" a ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Pharaoh nusia in TOPA tungah thu ngena,"},"31":{"text":"TOPA in Moses nget bangin a hih hi: Thote in Pharaoh le a uliante le a mite a nusia hi; tho khat zong a om nawn kei hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi zongin tutung in zong Pharaoh in a lungsim khauh-saka, mite a paisak nuam kei hi.","ref":"tg 12; Pk 4:21"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Pharaoh kiangah pai inla, ‘Hih in TOPA Hebrew-te’ Pasian, cih ahi hi: Kei hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak hen,\"","title":"Gante tunga Gimna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute na paisak nop kei a na letcip lai leh,"},"3":{"text":"TOPA khut in gamsunga na gante uh - na sakolte, na laate, na kala-ohte le na bawnghonte le na tuute le na keelte uh tungah a mulkim huai pulpi a tungsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Israel-te tawh kisai ganhing peuhmah a sih loh nadingin Israel-te’ ganhing le Egypt-te aa deidanna khat ka nei ding hi,’ ci hi,’ va ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 8:1,22"},"5":{"text":"TOPA in hun khat seh a, \"Zing ciangin TOPA in leitang ah hih a sem ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"A zing ciangin TOPA in a sem hi: Egypt-te’ ganhing khempeuh si a, ahi hangin Israel-te neihsa ganhing peuhmah khat beek a si kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Pharaoh in a kantel dingin mite sawla, Israel-te’ ganhingte khat nangawn a sih loh lam a mu hi. Tua hi napi a lungsim nem tuan lo-a, mite pai ding a phal kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah, \"Pum meikhuk panin innking khutdim khat pham inla, Pharaoh muh in Moses in huih lakah lawn hen."},"9":{"text":"Egypt gambup tungah leivuinel suak dinga gamsung khempeuh a mihingte le ganhingte tungah kizelin meimatum naitawm a suak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Meimatum Gimna","ref":"Kil 16:2"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in pum meikhuk pana innking la-in Pharaoh mai-ah a ding uh hi. Moses in huih lakah lawna, mihing tung le ganhing tungah meimatum naitawm a kizelh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute tung le Egypt mi khempeuh tunga meimatumte hangin mitphial siamte Moses mai-ah a ding thei kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Pharaoh lungsim khauhsak-a, TOPA cihsa bang tektek in Moses le Aaron thu a ngai kei hi.","ref":"Pk 4:21"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Zingsangin tho baih inla Pharaoh maituahin ama kiangah, ‘Hih in TOPA Hebrew-te’ Pasian gen ahi hi: Ka mite in kei hong biak theih nadingun paisak in,"},"14":{"text":"ahikeh tu tungin nang tung, na uliante le na mite tungah kong gimsak nading a khauh pen kong tungsak dinga, tua ciangin leitung khempeuh ah kei tawh a kibang khatbeek a om loh lam na thei ta ding hi.","title":"Gialpi Gimna"},"15":{"text":"Ahang in, tu mahmah in ka khut zankhia in, nang le na mite leitung pana hong phiatmang ding pulpi kong tungsak thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka vangliatna le leitung khempeuhah ka min a kitangko theih nadingin hih thu hangin nang kong sangsak to b hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang mahmah in ka mite na langbawla, amaute pai ding na phal kei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi manin tutunga pen zing ciangin, Egypt a kisat-a kipan tu dong gial kiasate sanga a nasia zaw gialpi ka kiasak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Inn-a om lo gamsunga om lai mihing ganhing peuhmah tungah gialpi kia-in amaute si ding uh ahi manin na gahhingte le gam sunga na neih khempeuh hawlin a liah ding omna mun khatah a omsak nadingin tu-in thu pia in, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ro 9:17; Pk 8:10"},"20":{"text":"TOPA kammal a kihta Pharaoh uliante in manlangin a silate uh leh a ganhingte uh a sungah a koih uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA kammal a thudon lote in a silate uh le a ganhingte uh gam sungah a hici omsak uh hi.","ref":"Pn 13:13"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Egypt tung khempeuh - mihing ganhing tung le Egypt-te lo-a po na khempeuh tungah gialpi a kiat nadingin na khut van lamah zankhia in,\" a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in a ciangkhut van lamah a viktoh ciangin TOPA in vanging le gialpi sawla leitungah khua a phiasuk hi. Tua ciangin TOPA in Egypt gam tungah gialpi a zusak hi;"},"24":{"text":"Gialpi kia a, khua a phia tuah kawikawi hi. Egypt minam khata a om a kipan huihpi nasia pen ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Egypt gam bupah lo-a na khempeuh - mihing ganhing a denggawp hi; lo sunga po khempeuh dengzan gawpa, singkung peuhmah a heuh khin hi."},"26":{"text":"Gialpi kiat lohna Israel-te omna Goshen gam bek ahi hi.","ref":"tg 4; Ph 105:32-33; Jos 10:11"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron sam-a, amaute kiangah, \"Tutungin ka khial hi, TOPA a man hi-a, kei le ka mite a khial ka hi uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Gialpi le vanging ka kham ta uh hi, TOPA kiangah thu ngen un. No kong paisak ta ding hi; tu-a ban na omlai ding uh kisam nawn lo hi,\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, \"Khuapi pan ka paikhiat ciangin TOPA kiangah thungenin ka khutte ka zak ding hi. Van ging nawn loin gialpi a kia nawn kei ding hi; tua ciangin leitung pen TOPA aa ahilam na thei thei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi zongin nang le na uliante in Pasian, TOPA na kihta nai kei lai uh hi, cih ka thei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 8:22,38; Ph 24:1"},"31":{"text":"(Pat a pak laitak hi-a, buhmante a vuih laitak ahi manin pat le buhman a kisia hi."},"32":{"text":"Mangbuh le mangbuh-ham min nunung ahi manin a kisia kei hi.)","ref":"Ru 1:22"},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Pharaoh paisan-a, khuapi pua-ah a paikhia hi. Amah in TOPA lamah a khut a zan hi; vanpi ging le gialpi kia khawl a, leitungah guah a bua nawn kei hi."},"34":{"text":"Pharaoh in guah, vanpi ging le gialpi theu ta cih a muh ciangin a mawh kik hi. Amah le a uliante in a lungsim uh a khauhsak uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA in Moses tungtawna a gensa bang tektekin Pharaoh lugsim khauh a, Israel-te pai ding a phal kei hi.","ref":"Pk 4:21"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Pharaoh kiangah pai in, ahang in, amaute lakah hih a piandang ka limte ka bawlbawl theih nadingin,","title":"Kauphe Gimna"},"2":{"text":"na tu na tate uh tungah Egypt mite ka gimbawlzia le amaute laka limte ka bawlzia le keimah TOPA ka hilam na theih nadingun amah le a uliante’ lungsim ka khauhsak hi,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh kiangah Moses le Aaron pai uh a ama kiangah, \"Hih in TOPA Hebrew-te’ Pasian, gen ahi hi: ‘Ka mai-ah kiniamkhiat ding bangtan vei nial lai ding na hi hiam? Kei hong bia dingin ka mite paisak in."},"4":{"text":"Amaute na paisak nop kei leh zing ciangin na gam sungah kauphe kong puak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuate in a kimu thei lo zahin lei maitang tuam ding uh hi. Tuate in na lo sung-ua po peuhmah singkungte a kipan gialpi denbaang a themte nemang ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Na mite le na uliante’ innte khempeuh le Egypt mite’ innte khempeuh dim ding uh a - na pute na pate uh hih gam sunga a ten tung-ua kipan tu dong a muh ngei nai loh uh na ahi ding hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a gen uh hi. Tua ciangin Moses kihei-in Pharaoh a nusia hi.","ref":"Joel 1:4"},"7":{"text":"Pharaoh’ uliante in ama kiangah, \"Hih mipa ei adingin bangtan vei thang hi ding hiam? Gitloh a sawm taktak na hi uh hi. a"},"11":{"text":"Hi thei kei! Pasalte bek pai un; tu tanvei nong nget buangun TOPA va bia un,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Pharaoh kiang pan Moses le Aaron a kihawlkhia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Gamsungah kauphe dim a, gialpi dengawp baang, lo-a po peuhmah a kheuh mang nadingin Egypt gam tungah na khut zankhia in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 7:19"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Egypt tungah a ciangkhut vikkhia-a, TOPA in tua ni sun tawntung le zan tawntung tua gam tungah nisuahna huih a nungsak hi. Zingsang ciangin huih in kauphe a puak hi;"},"14":{"text":"Egypt gam khempeuh dima, gam sung mun khempeuhah tampitak a om hi. A om ngei nai lo, zong a om kik nawn lo ding kauphe gimna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Leilak khempeuh tuamcipin vom liang hi. Tuate in gialpi den gawp baang khempeuh - lo sunga singkung, a gah nei khempeuh a kheuh siang uh hi. Egypt gam khempeuh ah singkung le ankung hing peuhmah a om kei hi.","ref":"Joel 2:1-11,25"},"16":{"text":"Pharaoh in Moses le Aaron manlangin sama, \" TOPA note Pasian tung le note tungah ka mawh zo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tu-in ka mawhna khatvei hong maisak lai unla, sihgimna kei kiang pan a lakkhiat nadingin TOPA , note Pasian tungah thu ngen un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 9:27"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Pharaoh paisan a TOPA tungah thu a ngen hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in tua huih, nitumna huih khauhin kheka, tua in kauphete lenin San Tuipi b sungah a puak hi. Egypt mun khempeuh ah kauphe khat beek a sit kei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Pharaoh lungsim khauhsaka, Israel-te a paisak nuam kei hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Egypt ah khuamial - a kilawng thei zah a khuamial in Egypt a tuam nadingin na khut van lamah zan in,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin a khut van lamah vaan to-a, Egypt gam khempeuh nithum sung khuamial in a tuamcip bikbek hi.","title":"Khuamial Gimna"},"23":{"text":"Kuamah in bangmah mu thei lo-a, a omna mun pan nithum sung kuamah a paikhia thei kei hi. Tua hi napi Israel-te tenna mun khempeuh khua a vak hi.","ref":"Ph 105:28; Kil 16:10"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pharaoh in Moses sama, \"Pai un, TOPA va bia un. Na numei na naupangte uh na tonpih thei uh hi; na tuuhonte uh le na ganhonte bek uh nusia un,\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in, \" TOPA kote Pasian tungah biakpiakna pia ding le meihal biakna pia dingin kote nong phal pelmawh kul hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka ganhingte uh tawh zong ka pai uh kul hi; gan khecin khat zong a kinusia kei ding hi. TOPA kote Pasian, biak nadingin pawlkhat ka zang ding uh a, a mun ka tun matengun TOPA biak nadingin bang kizang lai ding hiam cih ka thei nai kei uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Pharaoh lungsim khauhsaka, amaute pai ding a phal kei hi."},"28":{"text":"Pharaoh in Moses kiangah, \"Ka muhna ah om ke’n! Ka mai na muh ni le na sih ni hi ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Moses in, \"Na cih bang tektekin na mai-ah kong kilaak kik nawn kei ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Heb 11:27"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Pharaoh tung le Egypt tungah gimna khat ka tungsak lai ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in hih lai pan hong paikhiasak dinga, hong paisak ciangin note hong hawlkhia siang ding hi.","title":"Tacilte tunga Gimna"},"2":{"text":"Mipite tungah gen in, numei pasal cih om loin a vengte uh tungah ngun le kham-a kibawl vante a ngen ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"(TOPA in Egypt-te in, mipite tungah deihsakna a neih nading uh lungsim guanin, Moses mahmah zong Egypt ah Pharaoh’ uliante le mite in a sangmuh mahmah uh hi).","ref":"Tp 34:11"},"4":{"text":"Tua hi-a Moses in, \"Hih in TOPA thugen ahi hi: ‘Zankim pawlin Egypt gam ka siksuak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpi tokhom tunga tu Pharaoh tapa upa pena kipan angawi-a om sila numei’ tapa upa pen le ganhonte’ tacil dongin Egypt-a tacil peuhmah a si ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Egypt gam sung khempeuhah kahna nasia - tua bang a om ngei nai lo, a om ngei nawn lo ding a tung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin Israel mite lakah mi ahikeh ganhing tawngin ui khat zong a ham kei ding hi,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin Egypt-te le Israel-te kikalah TOPA in deidanna a neih lam na thei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih na uliante khempeuh uh ka kiangah hong pai ding uh a, ka mai-ah kunin, ‘Nang le nang hong zui mite khempeuh pai un!’ hong ci ding uh hi. A ne ding mi le a tuuno sa zah tawh kizui-in na hih ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Na teel uh gante pen kum khat apha, apa, a melhemna om lo hi dinga tuate tuu ahikeh keel lak pan na la ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuate, tua kha ni sawm le li ni dong na kem ding uh a, tua ni khuamui ciangin Israel mi khempeuh in a go ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sisan pawlkhat la-in tuuno a nekna uh innte’ kongmungte a tung le a pang tuakah a nuh ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ni zan mah in a sa mei-ah hangin lo kha le silngo sawh loh anlum tawh amaute in a ne ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A sa a sial ahikeh tuihuanin na ne kei ding uh a, ahi hangin mei tungah - a lu, a khe le a sungkua-te na hang ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Zingsang dong khamval bangmah na sit kei ding uh a zingsang dong a val a om leh na haltum ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Na nek zia ding uh in: puantualpi kawnggak gaksa, khedap bulhsa le na khut sunguah ciangkhut tawi kawmsa-in na ne ding uh hi. Na nawh nek ding uh hi; tua in TOPA ’ Paisan na ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 16:1,3"},"12":{"text":"\"Tua ni zan mah in Egypt gam nawksuakin, mihing, ganhing tacil peuhmah ka sattuk dinga - Egypt a pasiante khempeuh tungah thukhenna ka tungsak ding hi. A ni masa ni-in na inn sung panun silngo paikhia un, ahang in, ni khat ni pan ni sagih ni ciang silngo kisawh khatpeuh a ne a om leh Israel panin kikhenkhia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A ni masa ni-in asiangtho kikhopna khat nei unla, a ni sagihna ni-in adang khat nei un. Note sep theih ding ahi nek ding an huan ding sim loh hih nite in bangmah sem kei un."},"17":{"text":"\"Egypt pana a pawlpawl a kong paikhiatpih ni tuani mahmah ahi manin Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi bawl un. Tua hi a silngo kisawh na khatpeuh a ne a om leh pemta ahi a, tualsuak ahi zongin Israel mipi panin kikhenkhia ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Silngo kisawh bangmah ne kei un. Na tenna peuhpeuh uhah silngo sawh loh anlum bek na ne ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Israel upate khempeuh sama amaute tungah, \"Pai pah unla, no innkuan ading gan telkhia-in Paisan tuuno go un."},"22":{"text":"Puknah lomkhat khiak unla kuang sunga sisan lakah diahin kongmung tung le a pangtuakah sisan nuh un. Zingsang mateng, note khat beek ama inn kong pua-ah a paikhia kei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Egypt mite satlum dingin gamsung khempeuhah TOPA a pai ciangin kongmung tung le a pangtuaka sisan mu dinga, tua kongvang paisanin, amah in a susiapte na inn sungah tumsak loin no hong kisatlum lo ding hi.","ref":"Mk 14:12-16"},"24":{"text":"\"Nang le na suan-le-khakte adingin hih lamlahnate a kip tawntung thuzek bangin zui un."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in piak dinga hong ciamsa tua leitangah na lut uh ciangin hih ngeina pawi-in bawl un."},"26":{"text":"Na tate un, ‘Hih ngeina-pawi bang deihna-a bawl na hi uh hiam?’ ci-in hong dot uh ciangin,"},"27":{"text":"amaute kiangah, \" TOPA tungah Paisan biakpiakna ahi hi; amah in Egypt-te a satlup lai-in Egypt a om Israel-te’ innte hong hawi hi,’ ci un,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin mipite kunin a bia uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel mite in, TOPA in Moses le Aaron a thupiak bang tektek in a hih uh hi.","ref":"tg 11; Jos 4:6"},"29":{"text":"Zan kim laitakin TOPA in Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh kumpi tokhom tunga tu Pharaoh’ tapa a kipan thong-hawmpi sunga om thong kiate’ tacil le ganhingte’ tacilte dongin a satlum khin hi."},"30":{"text":"Pharaoh le a uliante khempeuh le Egypt-te khempeuh zanin tho uh a, misi om lohna inn khat beek om lo ahi manin Egypt ah kahna nasiapi a tung hi.","ref":"Pk 4:23"},"31":{"text":"Pharaoh in azan azanin Moses le Aaron sama, \"Dingkhia un! A guhte khat beek sutan kei un."},"47":{"text":"Israel mihon buppi in hih pawi a bawl ding uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Note laka teng pemta khat in TOPA Paisan Pawi a bawl nop leh a inn sunga pasal khempeuh in vun a at ding uh hi; tua ciangin gammi khat bangin a kihel thei ding hi. Na tapate uh lakah a suak masa peuhmah tan un."},"14":{"text":"\"Mailam hunah na tapa in hong dot-a, ‘Hih bang cihnopna hiam?’ hong cihleh ama kiangah, ‘ TOPA in khut thahat tawh Egypt-a sila suahna panin hong paikhiatpih hi."},"15":{"text":"Pharaoh in kote paisak ding a nial tentan ciangin TOPA in Egypt a tacil peuhmah mihing ganhing a nihin that khawm hi. Mt 26:15;Pc 9:5"},"33":{"text":"\"Mi khat in dum khat sin loin ahikeh dum khat to-in a sit mangngilh a, tua sungah bawngtal khat ahikeh laa khat a kiat leh,"},"34":{"text":"tua dum neipa in a bei zah a pia pelmawh ding hi; a gan nei pa pia pelmawh dinga, a gansi ama’n a tang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"\"Mi khat bawngtal in midang khat bawngtal a liamsuah-a, a sih leh a nungta lai pen zuak ding uh a, a sum le a gansi pen’ sa a kikimin hawm ding uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi zongin bawngtal pen kisik a zongsang ahilam kithei-a, a neipa in kem loin a khum loh ahileh, a nei pa in ganhing tangin ganhing pia dinga, a gansi pen ama’n tang ding hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Mi khatin bawngtal khat ahikeh tuu khat gu a, go ahikeh a zuak leh bawngtal khat tangin bawng nga le tuu tangin tuu li-in a loh ding hi.","title":"Neihsa Hutna","ref":"2Sa 12:6"},"2":{"text":"\"Guta khat a innluh laitak kimu a, a sih nading zahin a kisat leh tua sisan luanna hangin a satpa a mawh kei hi;"},"3":{"text":"ahi hangin hih thupiang f nisuah khit ahileh sisan luanna hangin amah a khial ahi hi. \"Guta khat in a guksa na a din kik pelmawh ding hi; Lungsim takpi-a a pia nuamte’ biaknate kei tangin na sang ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute tung pana na san ding biaknate in: Kham, ngun le sumsan;"},"4":{"text":"adum, adupsan, a ausan khaute le hoihtak-a kikhuk-a kigan puante; keel mul;"},"5":{"text":"a san-a kinim tuutal vunte le tuipi bawngpi f vunte; singkha sing;"},"6":{"text":"mei-a vak ding olive thau; nilh sathau ding le gimnamtui dingin singnamtuite;"},"7":{"text":"siampi puan le awmtuam-a suan dingin onyx suangte le suang manpha dangte ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin kei ading mun siangtho khat amaute bawlsak in; tua ciangin amaute lakah ka teng ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang kong lah ding lim bang tektekin hih biakbuk le a vanzatte khempeuh bawl in."},"10":{"text":"\"Amaute singkha singkuang - tong nih le alang sau, tong khat le a alang zai, tong khat le alang sang a khat bawlsak in."},"11":{"text":"A sung a pua a tung khempeuh, kham citaktui tawh na luan dinga, a kimkotah kham tawh geihual na bawl ding hi.","title":"Singkuang pi"},"12":{"text":"Kham kual li sung inla, a khe lite pang khatah kual nih apang lang khat ah kual nih mah hen in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciang singkha zawl sui-in a pumtangin khamtui luan in."},"14":{"text":"A puak nadingin singkuangpi pang tuaka a kualte sungah khum in."},"15":{"text":"Zawlte, singkuangpi-a a bilte sungah a om den ding hi; tuate a kilakhia kei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkuangpi sungah nang kong piak ding Tecipanna koih in."},"17":{"text":"\"Kham citak tawh thoihdamna sin b khat bawlin - a sauna tong nih le alang, a zaina c tong khat le alang hisak in."},"18":{"text":"A sin mongte ah sek-a kiseek kham cherub nih bawl in."},"19":{"text":"Among khatah cherub khat bawl inla, a lang khatah a nihna bawl in; a mong tuakah cherub-te sakhatin bawl in."},"20":{"text":"Cherub-te in a khate a tunglamah zakto dinga, tuate tawh a sin a limsun ding hi. Cherub-te khat le khat kimaingat ding uh a, a sin lam nga ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Singkuangpi tungah asin koih inla singkuangpi sungah kong piak ding Tecipanna koih in."},"22":{"text":"Singkuangpi sin tunga cherub nihte kikala Tecipanna tungsanah nang tawh i kituak dinga, Israel-te adinga ka thupiakte khempeuh nang kong pia ding hi.","ref":"Pk 37:1-9"},"23":{"text":"\"Singkha singin sabuai - tong nih asau tong khat azai tong khat le alang asang d khat bawl in."},"24":{"text":"Kham citak tawh luan inla, a gei kimkotah kham geihual bawl in.","title":"Sabuai"},"25":{"text":"A gei kimkotah zapek e cia a pha a geidal khat zong bawl inla zawl pek tungah kham geihual bawl in."},"26":{"text":"Sabuai ading kham kual li bawl inla a khete omna a kiu lite ah tuate hen in."},"27":{"text":"Sabuai puak nading zawlte a len dingin a zawlpek tawh kimatin a kualte om ding hi."},"28":{"text":"A zawl dingin singkha sui inla, kham-in tuate luan in, tuate-in sabuai kipua ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A kuangdaite le a kuang-ukte kham citak tawh bawlin, biakna sunkhiat nadingin beltung le kuangkumte zong tua mah bangin bawl in."},"30":{"text":"Ka mai-ah a tawntunga om dingin hih sabuai tungah ompihna anlum koih in.","ref":"Pk 37:10-16; Ms 4:7"},"31":{"text":"Kham citak meivak tunna khat bawl inla, a bul le a kung sekin seek in; pak tawh kibang hai hi dinga, a ngumte le a pakte sakhata kizomkhawm hi ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Meivak tunna panin a ka guk - a pang khatah thum, a pang langkhatah thum mah mengkhia ding hi.","title":"Meivak Tunna"},"33":{"text":"Ahiang khatah almond pak lim tawh kibang hai thum - a ngum le a pak kithuah om dinga, a zoma hiangah thum mah, a hiang gukte khempeuh tungah meivak tunna panin kakhia ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua hi a meivak tunna tungah almond pak lim kibawl hai li, a ngumte le a pakte kithuah a om ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Meivak tunna pan a kopa a katkhiatna a masa pen nuai-ah a ngum khat omin, a kop nihna nuai-ah a ngum a nihna, a kop thumna nuai-ah a ngum thumna om dinga, a vekin a hiang guk pha ding hi."},"36":{"text":"A ngumte le a hiangte, meivak tunna tawh kham citak kisek khawm sakhat hi ding hi.","ref":"Zec 4:2; Kil 1:12"},"37":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin meivak sagih bawl inla, tuate in a mai-a munte a taan dingin a tungah tung in."},"38":{"text":"Taiteh le a kuangte kham citak hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Meivak tunna le hih a tunga vatzatte khempeuh kham citak talent f khat kizanga kibawl hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Mual tunga hong kilak lim bangbanga tuate na bawl ding thei in.","ref":"Pk 37:17-24; Ns 7:44"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Hoih taka kikhuk adum, a dupsan, a ausan khau tawh kigan puanzak sawm, khutsiamte in a bawl cherub-te tawh biakbuk na bawl ding hi.","title":"Biakbuk"},"2":{"text":"Puanzak khempeuh kikimin - tong sawm nih le giat sau dinga, tong li a zai g ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Puanzak ngate peh inla, adang ngate zong tua mah bangin hih in."},"4":{"text":"Puanzak kimatna mong dungah adumin bilvang bawlin puanzak dangte zong tua bangin na bawl ciat ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Puanzak nga kipehte khatah a bil sawmnga guan inla, a khat penah zong sawmnga mah guanin a bil tuak khat le khat kitangsak in."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kham mekkilh sawm nga bawl inla, biakbuk bupkhat a suah theih nadingin tua puanzakte gawmkhawmna-in zang in.","ref":"Pk 36:8-13"},"7":{"text":"\"Biakbuk tung khuhna puante keelmul hi dinga, a vekpi-in sawm le khat hi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Puanzak sawm le khatte a vekin kikim dinga, tong sawmthum sau-in tong li zai h ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kop khat dingin nga zom inla, a kop dang khat dingin guk zomin. Puanzak a gukna pen puanbuk mai-ah khep nihin na khep ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A kipehkhawm puanzak khat mong zui-in a bil gual inla, puanzak a kop khat pen mong zui-in zong a bil gual in."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin sumsan mekkilh sawm nga bawl inla, puanbuk bupkhat a suah nadingin a bilte ah mekkilh thuahin gak in."},"12":{"text":"Puanbuk puanzak a valkhia a lang pen biakbuk nung lamah kaisuk ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Puanbuk puanzakte a pang tuakah tong i khat tuak sauzaw ding hi; tua aval pen biakbuk pang tuak khuhna hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Puanbuk khuh nadingin a san-a kinim tuutal vun, le tua tunga khuh sawn nadingin tuipi bawngpi a vunte bawl in.","ref":"Pk 36:14-19"},"15":{"text":"\"Biakbuk dingin singkha singpek kitung lem in."},"16":{"text":"Tua singpek tong sawm sau in tong khat le alang zai b ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khat le khat a kibang a khun theih dingin a bulhna azang nih ciat om ding hi. Biakbuk singpek khempeuh hih banga na hih ding ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Biakbuk leitaw-lam ading singpek sawmnih bawl inla,"},"19":{"text":"tuate tun nading a nuai-ah ngun bullen sawmli bawl inla, singpek khat ading bullen nih ciat, azangte ah bullen khat ciat om ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Apang khat lam biakbuk leilu-lam pangah, singpek sawmnih le"},"21":{"text":"ngun bullen sawm nih - singpek khat nuai-ah nih ta na bawl ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A phaitam lam, tua pen biakbuk nitumna lam mongah"},"23":{"text":"a phaitam lam kiute ading singpek nih bawl in."},"24":{"text":"Hih a kiute tuakah alu pan ataw dongin tuate nih paikhawm dinga, sikkual khat sungah kikhum khawm ding hi. A nihin tua bang hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin singpek giat le ngun bullen sawm le guk - singpek khatah nih ciat a om ding hi.","ref":"Pk 36:20-30"},"26":{"text":"\"A khilna singkha zawlte zong bawl in: a singpekte adingin biakbuk pang khatah nga,"},"27":{"text":"apang lang khata ding nga mah le biakbuk phaitam lam, a nitumna lam adingin nga mah bawl in."},"28":{"text":"A laizanga kilhna zawl pen, a singpek kim tanah mong khat pan mong khatah paisuak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Singpekte khamtui luan inla, a khilna zawlte a len dingin kham kualte bawl in. A khilna zawlte zong khamtui luan in.","ref":"Pk 36:31-34"},"30":{"text":"\"Mual tunga nang hong kilak gelna bangin biakbuk lem in.","ref":"Pk 25:9,40; Ns 7:44; Heb 8:5"},"31":{"text":"\"Hoihtaka kikhuk adum, adupsan, a-ausan khau tawh hoihtaka kigan puan, khutsiamte in a bawl cherub-te tawh kizem puanzak khat bawl in."},"32":{"text":"Ngun bullen lite tung ading, khamtui kiluan singkha khuam lite tungah kham vankhaina in khai in."},"33":{"text":"Puanzak a kilhnate-in khai inla, puanzak nungah Tecipanna singkuang koih in. Puanzak in Mun Siangtho Pen panin Mun Siangtho khenkhia ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Mun Siangtho Pen sunga Tecipanna singkuang tungah thoihdamna sin koih in."},"35":{"text":"Biakbuk leilu-lam pang puanzak pua ah sabuai koih inla, tua tung a leitaw-lam pangah a kigalsai-in meivak tunna koih in."},"36":{"text":"\"Puanbuk kongkhak dingin a adum, adupsan, a-ausan khau, limtaka kikhuk-a kigan puan - khut tawh phima kikhui puanzak khat bawl in."},"37":{"text":"Hih puanzak adingin kham kualte le khamtui kiluan singkha khuam nga bawl in. Tuate tun nading sumngo bullen nga sung in.","ref":"Pk 36:37-38"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Singkha singin biakna-tau tong c thum a sang khat dawh in; tua pen a ningkim hi dinga, tong nga sau-in tong nga zai d ding hi.","title":"Meihal Biakna-tau"},"2":{"text":"A kiu lite ah ki neisak ciat-in, a ki le biakna-tau sakhat ahi theih nadingin biakna-tau sumngo-in luan in."},"3":{"text":"Van kizang khempeuh - vutbeelte, vutluahnate le thehna kuangkum, salepna sikkate le meiluahnate sumngo-in bawl in."},"4":{"text":"Tua-a zat dingin sumngo-in len phan inla akiu lite ah sumngo kual li vawh in."},"5":{"text":"Siklen in biakna-tau kim ciang a bat toh theih nadingin tua sikkualte biakna-tau khinta nuaiah omsak in."},"6":{"text":"Biakna-tau a zat ding singkha zawl sui inla, tuate sumngo tawh luan in."},"7":{"text":"Biakna-tau a kipuak ciangin tuate a pang lang tuakah a om nadingin a zawlte sikkual bil sungah khum in."},"8":{"text":"Tua biakna-tau singpek tawh bawl inla, a sung hawmsak in. Mual tunga nang hong kilaksa bang tektek hi ding hi.","ref":"Pk 38:1-7"},"9":{"text":"\"Biakbuk huang neisak in. Hih in Israel-te adingin a kiptawntung khang kivaikhakna thuzek hi ding hi.","title":"Meivak Tunna ading Sathau","ref":"Sp 24:1-3"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Kei tunga siampi nasem dingin Israel-te lak panin na sanggampa Aaron in a tapate Nadab le Abihu, Aleazar le Ithamar na kiangah tonpihsak in.","title":"Siampi Puante"},"2":{"text":"Amah zahtak a baangsak ding le pahtawi nadingin na sanggampa Aaron puansilh siangthote bawlsakin."},"3":{"text":"Amah in kei ading siampi na a sep theih nading le amah a ki-aptuam theih nadingin hih bang nate a bawl dinga pilna ka guat mite tungah Aaron puansilhte a bawlsak dingun gen in."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in hih kizepnate: awmtuam khat, siampi puan-ak khat, puantualpi khat, a kigan puantungsilh khat, dialkhip khat le dial kawnggak khat a bawl ding uh hi. Na sanggampa le a tapate in ka siampi na a sep theih nadingun amaute in hih puansilh siangthote a bawlsak ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuate kham, adum, adupsan, a- ausan khau le hoihtaka kigan puan zangin bawlsak in.","ref":"Pk 31:3,6"},"6":{"text":"\"Siampi puan-ak, kham, adum, adupsan, a-ausan khau le hoihtaka kikhuk-a kigan puan tawh - khutsiamte bawl hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A liangko-a khihkip nadingin a kiu nihte tawh kizomin liangkaih nih nei ding hi.","title":"Siampi Puan-ak"},"8":{"text":"Khutsiamte gat kawnggak zong tua mah bang hi dinga - siampi puan-ak tawh sa khat hi-in, kham le adum, adupsan a-ausan, khau le hoihtaka kikhuk-a kigan puan hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"\"Onyx suang nih la inla, Israel tapate’ minte khuakin gelh in,"},"10":{"text":"amau suah hun tawh kizui-in - suang khat tungah min guk, suang dang khat tungah min guk mah gelh in."},"11":{"text":"Suang manpha at pa in seal a khuak bangin Israel tapate’ minte tua suang nihte tungah khuakin gelh in. Tua ciangin khamin a geivial bawl inla,"},"12":{"text":"Israel tapate mualsuang ahi dingin siampi puan-ak liangkaihna tungah khihkip in. Aaron in phawk tawntungna ahi dingin TOPA mai-ah tua minte a liangko tungah pua ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kham geivialin zem inla,"},"14":{"text":"khau banga kihual kham khainiang kiphek nih bawlin tua suang bulhnate tungah na bulh ding hi.","ref":"Pk 39:2-7"},"15":{"text":"\"Thukhensatnate bawl nadingin awmtuam khat zem in - khutsiampa bawl hi ding hi. Siampi puan-ak bangin: kham, adum, adupsan, a-ausan khau le limtaka kikhuka kigan puan tawh bawl in."},"16":{"text":"A ningkim hi dinga - khap a khat sau-in khap khat zai-in - khep nihin kikhep ding hi.","title":"Awmtuam"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tungah suangmanpha gual li-in suang in. A gual masa pen ah ruby khat, topaz khat, le beryl khat;"},"18":{"text":"a gual nihna ah turquoise khat, sapphire b khat, le emerald khat;"},"19":{"text":"a gual thumna ah jacinth khat, agate khat, le amethyst khat;"},"20":{"text":"a gual lina ah chrysolite khat, onyx khat le jasper c khat hi ding hi. Kham geihualte sungah tuate suang in."},"21":{"text":"Suang sawm le nih hi dinga, khat Israel’ tapate’ min khat gelhna hi-in seal bangin kikhuakin nam sawm le nihte min khat ciat kigelh ding hi.","ref":"Kil 21:12"},"22":{"text":"\"Awmtuam-a dingin khauhual bangin kham citak khainiang kiphek bawl in."},"23":{"text":"Tua adingin kham kual nih bawl inla tuate awmtuam kiu nih ah khihkip in."},"24":{"text":"Awmtuam kiu-a kham kualte ah khainiang nihte khihkip inla"},"25":{"text":"tua khainiang mong langkhat pen siampi puan-ak liangkaihna a ang lampanga, a liangko-a kaisuk pen tawh zom in."},"26":{"text":"Kham kual nih bawl inla siampi puan-ak tawh kizom awmtuam sunglam kiu nihte ah bulh in."},"27":{"text":"Kham kual nih mah bawl inla, siampi puan-ak anglam a, a liangkaih na taw-a apang khuina kiang kawnggak pek tung santakah bulh in."},"28":{"text":"Awmtuam sikkualte le siampi puan-ak sikkualte khaudumin khihkhawm inla, awmtuam pen siampi puan-ak pana kiveikhiat loh nadingin kawnggak tawh khihcip in."},"29":{"text":"\"Mun Siangtho ah Aaron a lut peuhpeuh ciangin TOPA mai-ah phawkdenna ahi, thukhensatna awmtuam tunga Israel’ tapate’ minte a lungtang tungsan takah a pua ding hi."},"30":{"text":"TOPA omna sungah a lut peuhpeuh ciangin Aaron lungtang tung san taka om dingin Urim le Thummim zong awmtuam tungah koih in. A kikek loh nadingin a vang kimkotah gawl-an d bangin a gei zimna kigan ding hi.","title":"Siampi Puan dangte"},"33":{"text":"Puantualpi mong kimkotah adum, adupsan le a ausan khau tawh mangkawlsing gahte bawl inla, tuate kikalah kham longte khai in."},"34":{"text":"Kham longte le mangkawlsing gahte puantualpi mong kimkotah kikalhelh dimdiam ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Aaron in biakna na a sep ciangin tua silh tektek ding hi. Amah a sih loh nadingin Siangtho Mun TOPA mai-ah a sungtum ciang le a pusuah ciangin tua longte gin kiza ding hi."},"36":{"text":"\"Kham citak pek khat bawlin seal tunga a kuaka kigelh bangin: TOPA TUNGAH SIANGTHO ci-in a tungah a kuakin gelh in."},"37":{"text":"Dialkhip tunga khih nadingin khaudum a tungah khih in; tua pen a dialkhip mailamah om ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua pen Aaron taltangah om dinga, Israel-te in bang khatpeuh letsongin a piak uh a, amau ap letsong siangthote a paubanna khat a om leh aman khu ding hi. Amaute a zahtak baangsak ding le a pahtawihuaisak dingin"},"40":{"text":"Aaron tapate ading puantungsilhte, puan-kawnggakte le dialkhipte bawlsak in."},"41":{"text":"Hih puansilhte na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate na silhsak khit ciangin amaute sathau nilh inla siansuah in. Kei ading siampi na a sep theih nadingun siangthosak in.","ref":"Pk 29:7-9"},"42":{"text":"\"Pumpi tuam nadingin kawng pan a phei ciang a ban puan hoih kigan pheituam sungten khat bawl in."},"43":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate kimawhsak-a a sih loh nadingun, Kikhopna Puanbuk-a a pai ciang uh ahi a, Mun Siangtho-a biakna nasem dinga biakna-tau a naih ciang uh ahi zongin amaute in teng pelmawh ding uh hi. \"Hih in Aaron le a suan-le-khakte adingin a tawntunga khang kivai-khakna thuzek hi ding hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Amaute in ka siampi nate a sep theih nadingun nang sep ding hihte ahi hi: Kawkbaanna a nei lo bawngtalno khat le tuutal nih la in.","title":"Siampite Siansuahna"},"2":{"text":"Mangbuh-vui panin silngo sawh loin anlum bawl inla sathau tawh a kihel le tui le sathau tawh a kinuh moh bawl in."},"3":{"text":"Tuate lawh khat sungah koih inla, tua sungah tuate - bawngtal le tuutal nihte tawh piakhawm in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Aaron le a tapate Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah lutpih inla, amaute tui-in sil in."},"5":{"text":"Tua puante la inla puantungsilh, siampi puan-aktualpi, siampi puan-ak Aaron silhsak inla awmtuam tuamsak in. Ama tungah a siampi puan-ak, khutsiamte gat kawnggakin gak in."},"6":{"text":"A lutangah dialkhip khimsak inla, a dialah kumpi lukhu siangtho khusak in."},"7":{"text":"Nilh sathau la inla a lutungah sungin nilhsak in."},"8":{"text":"A tapate paipihin puantungsilhte silhsak inla"},"9":{"text":"amaute dial khimsak in. Hih bangin Aaron le a tapate na kipsak ding hi.","ref":"Ms 18:7; Pk 30:25, 30-31"},"10":{"text":"\"Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah bawngtal na paipih dinga, Aaron le a tapate in a lutungah a khut uh a nga ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA omna Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna mai-ah kigo ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawngtalte sisan pawlkhat la-in, na khutme-in biakna-tau kite nuh inla, a val lai teng biakna-tau bulah sungkhia in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin a gilpituam a thau khempeuh le a sin tuam le a kalte gel a tuam a thau tawh la inla, biakna-tau tungah tuate haltum in."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin bawngtal sa le a vun le a ekte giahphual pua-ah haltum in. Tua in mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 1:4; Heb 13:11"},"15":{"text":"\"Tuutalte khat la-in Aaron le a tapate in a lutungah a khut uh a nga ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Go-in a sisan na la dinga biakna-tau pangte na theh kim ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuutal semnenin a sungkua teng le a khete sawp inla, a lu le a sanen dangte tawh koih khawm in."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakna-tau tungah a tuutal buppi haltum in. Tua in TOPA tungah meihal biakna hi-a, a gim namtui TOPA tunga mei-a hal biakna khat ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuutal a khat pen la-in Aaron le a tapate in a lutungah a khut uh a nga ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Go-in, a sisan pawlkhat la inla Aaron le a tapate taklam bilhual, a taklam khutpi, le a taklam khepi ah nuhsak in. Tua ciangin biakna-tau tung apang khempeuh sisan theh in."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakna-tau tunga sisan pawlkhat le nilh sathau pawlkhat la inla, Aaron le a puansilhte le a tapate le a puansilhte uh tungah theh in. Tua ciangin amah le a tapate le a puansilhte uh sianthosaksa hi ding hi.","ref":"Heb 9:22"},"22":{"text":"\"Hih tuutal panin a thau, a mei thau, a sung thau, a sin tuam, a kalte gel a tuam a thau tawh a taklam phei la in. (Hih in kipsakna tuutal ahi hi)."},"23":{"text":"TOPA mai-a silngo sawh loh anlum lawh panin lum khat le sathau tawh kibawl moh khat le tui tawh kibawl moh khat la in."},"24":{"text":"Hihte a vekin Aaron le a tapate khut sungah koih inla, TOPA mai-ah vei-a biakna-in vei in."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute khut panin lakhia inla, TOPA mai-ah a gim namtui meihal biakna tawh, TOPA tunga meihal biakna bawlna khat ahi dingin biakna-tau tungah haltum khawm in."},"26":{"text":"Aaron kikipsakna tuutal iik na lak khit ciangin vei-a biakna-in \" TOPA mai-ah vei in; tua pen nang tanh ding ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"\"Aaron le a tapate a kikipsakna tua tuutal sate: a kivei a iik le a kipia a pheite siansuah in."},"28":{"text":"Hih in Israel mite tung pana Aaron le a tapate in a kaih den uh ahi ding hi. Hih in, Israel-te in TOPA tungah kilawmtakna biakna b a bawlna panun a piak ding uh siampite satanh ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 7:31,34"},"29":{"text":"\"Aaron puansilh siangthote, a suan-le-khakte, tuate sunga a kikipsak ahi nadingin amau tang ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Ama siampi za a laih a tapa, Kikhopna Puanbuk-ah Mun Siangtho-a biakna nasem dinga a pai ciangin tuate ni sagih sung a silh ding hi.","ref":"Ms 20:26,28"},"31":{"text":"\"Kipsak nadingin tuutal la inla, a siangtho mun khatah a sa huan in."},"32":{"text":"Kikhopna puanbuk lutna-ah Aaron le a tapate in tuutalsa le lawh sunga anlum a ne ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute kipsakna le siansuahna bawlna, thoihdamna biaknate amaute in a ne ding uh hi. Ahi hangin tuate siangtho ahi manin kuamah in a nekpih thei kei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Kipsakna tuutal sa ahi a, anlum khatpeuh ahi zongin zingsang donga a kikhamval leh haltum in. Keimah TOPA amaute Pasian, ka hi hi.","ref":"Pk 25:8; 2Co 6:16"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Gimnamtui hal nadingin singkha singin biakna-tau khat dawh in.","title":"Gimnamtui Biakna-tau"},"2":{"text":"A ningkim hi dinga, tong khat asau, tong khat azai, tong nih a sang a - a kite a tau tawh sakhat hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Atung, apangte le a kite kham citaktui luan inla, a kimkotah kham geihual neisak in."},"4":{"text":"A geihual nuai-a bulh dingin kham kual nih - apang tuakah nih - a zawnna zawlte khumna vanga zat dingin bawl in."},"5":{"text":"Singkha zawl sui inla khamtui luan in."},"6":{"text":"Tecipanna tung sana thoihdamna sin mai - Tecipanna singkuang mai-a puanzak mai - nang tawh i kituah nading munah biakna-tau koih in."},"7":{"text":"\"Aaron in zingsang sima meivakte a puah ciangin biakna-tau tungah gimnamtui a hal pelmawh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in khang sawnsawnte donga TOPA mai-ah gimnamtui maanmaana a kihal theih nadingin nitak khuamui-a mei a vak ciangin gimnamtui a hal kik ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih biakna-tau tungah gimnamtui dang peuhmah ahikeh meihal biakna khatpeuh ahi-a, an-a biakna ahi zongin pia loin tua tungah dawntheih biakna na sung kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Aaron in tua biakna-tau kite tungah kum khatin khat vei thoihdamna a bawl ding hi. Tua in TOPA tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"12":{"text":"\"Israel mite kisim dinga misimna na bawl ciangin mikim in amah a kisim hun ciangin ama nuntakna a tatna TOPA a pia pelmawh ding hi. Tua hi a amaute na sim ciangin amau tungah pulpi a tung kei ding hi.","title":"Thoihdamna Sum"},"13":{"text":"A kisimsate lak-a a pai peuhmah in biakbuk shekel b tawh kizui-in gerah sawm nih a gik shekel lang a liau ding uh hi. Tua thoihdamna pen na nuntakna uh tatna Israel-te adingin TOPA mai-ah, a tawntunga phawkna hi ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"18":{"text":"\"Kisil nadingin sumngo kuangpi khat le a tunna sumngo in bawl in. Amah in thukhun kammal - Thupiak Sawmte suangpekte tungah a gelh hi."},"29":{"text":"Sinai Vum pan, Tecipanna suangpek nihte tawi kawmin Moses a paisuk ciangin, TOPA tawh a kiho mana a maitang atee a hilam a thei kei hi."},"30":{"text":"Aaron le Israel mite khempeuh in Moses a muh uh ciangin a maitang tee-a, a kiangah a pai ngam kei uh hi.","title":"A Tee Moses Maitang"},"31":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in amaute a sam hi; tua ciangin Aaron le mihonpite’ makaite khempeuh ama kiangah kileh kik uh a, amah in amaute a hopih hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Israel-te khempeuh in a kiang va naih uh a, amah in Sinai Vum tunga TOPA in a thupiaksate khempeuh amaute a pia hi."},"33":{"text":"Moses in amaute a hopih khit ciangin a maitang maikhuhna khat a khuh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA omna-ah a hopih dinga a lut ciangin a paikhiat dong tua maikhuhna a hemkhia hi. Tua ni-in na khatpeuh a sem peuhpeuh kithat pelmawh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na tenna khat peuhpeuhuhah Sabbath ni-in mei tawh kei un,\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Moses in Israel mihon buppi tungah, \"Hih in TOPA hong thupiaksa ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Na neihsate uh panin TOPA adingin biakna pia un. A ut peuhpeuh in TOPA tungah biakna-in - kham, ngun le sumngo;","title":"Biakbuk ading Vanzatte"},"6":{"text":"adum, adupsan le a-ausan khau le hoihtaka kigan puan; keelmul;"},"7":{"text":"a san-a kinim tuutal vun le tuipi bawngpi a vunte; singkha sing;"},"8":{"text":"meivak ading olive thau; nilh sathau ading le gim namtui-a zat ding a namtuite;"},"9":{"text":"le siampi puan le a awmtuam-a bulh ding onyx suang le suang manpha dangte a pia thei hi."},"10":{"text":"\"Note lak-a siamna a neite khempeuh hong pai-in TOPA hong thupiaksa a bawl ding uh nate in:"},"11":{"text":"Biakbuk a puanbuk le a khuhna tawh, mekkilhte, sing pekte, a zawlte, khuamte le bullente;"},"12":{"text":"singkuang a zawlte tawh le thoihdamna sin le tua a liah puanzak;"},"13":{"text":"sabuai a khuamte tawh le a na khempeuh, le Ompihna anlum;"},"14":{"text":"mei vak nadinga meivak tunna a vanzatte tawh, khuavak dingin meivakte le meitui;"},"15":{"text":"gim namtui halna biakna-tau le a zawlte, nilh sathau le gim namtui; biakbuk lutna kongpi ading puanzak;"},"16":{"text":"meihal biakna-tau a sumngo siklen tawh a khuamte le a um-le-bel teng; sumngo kuangpi a tunna tawh;"},"17":{"text":"buktual-a puanzakte a khuam le a bullen tawh, le innhuang lutna ading puanzak;"},"18":{"text":"biakbuk ading le bukhuang ading khetphimte, le tuate’ khaute;"},"19":{"text":"Mun siangtho sunga nasep cianga silh dinga kigan puansilhte- siampi Aaron le a tapate in siampi a sep uh cianga a silh uh puan siangthote ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 39:32-41"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses omna panin Israel mipi buppi paikhia uh a,"},"21":{"text":"a utte le utna nei peuhmah va pai-in Kikhopna Puanbuk lamna, nasepna khempeuh le puansilh siangtho-a a zat nate TOPA tungah biakna-in a puak uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Numei pasal cih omlo ut peuhpeuh pai uh a, kham-a kizepna namkim: taute, bilbahte, zungbuhte le kizepnate a puak uh hi. Amaute khempeuh in TOPA tungah vei-a biakna in kham a pia uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute, adum, adupsan, a-ausan khau ahikeh hoihtaka kigan puan, keelmul, asan-a kinim tuutal vun le tuibawngpi vunte, a nei peuhpeuh in a puak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ngun ahi-a sumngo ahi zongin biakna pia peuhmah in TOPA tungah biakna-in pia uh a, nasepna-a kizang ding singkha-sing a nei peuhmah in a puak uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Numei khutsiam peuhmah in a khut uh tawh kheek uh a, a khekte uh - adum, adupsan ahikeh a-ausan khaute le hoihtaka kigan puante a puak uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Khaukheek a siam, a kheek nuam numei khempeuh in keelmul a kheek uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Makaite in siampi puan le a awmtuam tunga suan ding onyx suangte le suang manpha dangte a puak uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute in meivak-a vak ding le nilh sathau ding le paknamtui dingin, a namtuite le olive thaute zong a puak uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel mite numei pasal a ut khempeuh in TOPA in Moses tungtawna amaute sep dinga a thupiaksate khempeuh TOPA tungah utthu-a biakna-in a pia uh hi.","ref":"tg 4-9, Pk 25:1-7; 36:3"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Israel mite kiangah, \"En un, TOPA in Judah beh a, Hur’ tapa, Uri’ tapa Bezalel teel khina,"},"31":{"text":"Pasian Kha in khutsiam-na namkim, siamna, hihtheihna le theihna tawh kidimin -","title":"Bezalel le Oholiab"},"32":{"text":"kham, ngun le sumngote zanga a zep siam, le a geel siam,"},"33":{"text":"suangte at-a bulhin singlam sem ding le siamneltaka van nam tuamtuam bawl dingin teel khin zo hi."},"34":{"text":"Amah in Dan-te beh-a Ahisamach’ tapa Oholiab tawh amaute gel, midangte hilh theih nading siamna a pia hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah in amaute khutsiam mi, a gelpa, adum, adupsan le a-ausan khau le hoihtaka kigan puan zanga khut-a khuite le a gante - amaute khempeuh khutsiam-na le gelsiamna-a picing dingin siamna tawh a dimsak hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Belzalel, Oholiab le mun siangtho lamna ah nasepna khempeuha kizang dinga TOPA in siamna le khutsiamna a piakte khempeuh in TOPA thupiaksa bang tektekin na a sem ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 21:2-6"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Bezalel, Oholiab le TOPA in khutsiamna a piaksa khutsiam mi peuhmah a pai nuamte pai-a a sep nadingun Moses in a sam hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in Moses tung panin, Israel-te in munsiangtho lam nadinga a piakte khempeuh a sang uh hi. Tua hi a mipite in utna tawh zingsang khat khit zingsang khat biakna a puakpuak lai uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin munsiangtho lamna-a sep ding khempeuh a sem khutsiam mi khempeuh in a nasep uh nusia uh a,"},"5":{"text":"Moses kiangah, \" TOPA in sep dinga a thupiakna nasep nadinga kisam zah sanga tamzaw mipite in hong puak uh hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in, \"Numei pasal kuamah in munsiangtho ading biakna bangmah piakbeh nawn kei un,\" ci-in thu pia-a, amaute in tua thu giahphual sung khempeuhah a zasak uh hi. Tua hi a, tua ciangin mipite in adang a puak beh nawn loh nadingun kikham hi;"},"7":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh amau neihkholhsate nasep nadinga kisam zah sangin a tamzaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Nasem mite laka khutsiam mi khempeuh in hoihtaka kikhuk adum adupsan le a-ausan khau tawh khutsiamte in cherubim-a a zep uh puanzak sawmin biakbuk a bawl uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Puanzak khempeuh a kikim hi a - tong sawmnih le giat sau in tong li a zai a hi.","title":"Biakbuk"},"10":{"text":"Amaute in tuate nga peh uh a, adang ngate zong tua mah bangin a hih uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kipehkhawm puanzak kop khatte nawl zui-ah adumin a bilte bawl uh a, tua mah bangin puanzak a kop dang penah zong a bawl uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in puanzak khatah a bil sawmnga zong bawl uh a, a kop khat pena a bil sawmnga mah tawh khat le khat a kigalsai dimdiam in a bawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in kham mekkilh sawmnga bawlin biakbuk bup khat a suah nadingin tuate zangin puanzak kop nihte a peh khawm uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk tungkhum dingin keelmul tawh puanzakte bawl uh a - a vekin sawm le khat ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Puanzak sawm le khatte kikim a - tong sawmthum sau-in tong li a za b hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in puanzakte nga ciangin kop khatin zom uh a, adang gukte a kop dang khatin a zom uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in puanzak kop khat mong gei zui-ah abil sawmnga bawl uh a, puanzak a kop khat pen mong gei zui-ah zong a bawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in puanbuk bup khat suahsak nadingin sumngo mekkilh sawmnga a bawl uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in puanbuk tung khuh nadingin asan-a kinim tuutal vun bawl uh a, tua tunga khuh sawn nadingin tuipi bawngpi c vun a bawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk adingin singkha singin singpek kitungte a bawl uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Singpek khat tong sawm sau-in tong khat le alang ciat zai d a,"},"22":{"text":"a bulh nadingin singpek khatah a zang nih ta a nei hi. Amaute in biakbuk singpekte khempeuh a kibangin a bawl uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in biakbuk leitaw-lam panga dingin singpek sawmnih bawl uh a,"},"24":{"text":"tuate nuai-a om ding ngun bullen sawmli -singpek khatah bullen nih ta -khuam zang khatah khat ciat a bawl uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Apang khat biakbuk leilu lampang adingin amaute in singpek sawmnih,"},"26":{"text":"le ngun bullen sawmli - singpek khat nuai-ah nih ciat a bawl uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute in a phaitam lam mong, tua pen biakbuk a nitumna-lam mongah singpek guk le"},"28":{"text":"biakbuk a phaitam lam kiute adingin singpek nih a bawl uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih a kiu nihte ah a bula kipan a dawn dong nih hi a, sikkual khatin kihen khawm hi; a nih in a kibanga kibawl ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua hi a, singpek giat le ngun bullen sawm le guk - singpek khat nuai-ah nih ta ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Amaute in singkha-sing zawl: biakbuk pangkhata singpekte adingin nga;"},"32":{"text":"apang langkhat adingin nga mah le a nitumna lam biakbuk a phaitam lam kiu-a singpekte adingin zong nga mah a bawl uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute in singpekte kimtanah mong khat pan mong khat a tungsuak dingin a zawl laita a bawl uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Amaute in singpekte khamtui luan uh a, a zawlte khum nadingin kham kualte a bawl uh hi. Amaute in a zawlte zong khamtui a luan uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in hoihtaka kikhuk adum, adupsan le a-ausan khau tawh khutsiamte in Cherubim-a a zep uh puanzak a bawl uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Amaute in tua-a zat ding singkha sing li sui uh a, khamtui a luan uh hi. Amaute in tuate ading kham vankhaite bawl uh a, tuate ading ngun bullen li a sung uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Puanbuk lutna-a dingin amaute in adum, adupsan le a-ausan khau, hoihtaka kikhuka kigan puan tawh - khutkhui siampa khui-in a bawl uh hi;"},"38":{"text":"amaute in tuate ading khuam nga a vankhaite tawh a bawl uh hi. Amaute in khuam dawnte le a gaknate khamtui luan uh a, a bullen ngate sumngo tawh a bawl uh hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel in singkha singkuangpi-tong nih le alang sau, tong khat le alang zai, tong khat le alang sang e khat a bawl hi.","title":"Singkuangpi"},"2":{"text":"Amah in a sung a pua kham citak tui luana, a kimkotah kham geihual a bawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua-a zat dingin kham kual li sunga, a khe lite lang khatah kual nih, a lang khatah kual nih mah a bulh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in singkha zawl sui-a, tuate khamtui a luan hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in tua puak nadingin a panga kualte sungah zawlte a khum hi.","ref":"tg 11, 26 ; Pk 31:2"},"6":{"text":"Amah in tong nih le alang sau, tong khat le alang zai f kham citak tawh kibawl thoihdamna sin a bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a sin mong tuakah kham kiseek cherubim nih a bawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a mong khatah cherub khat bawlin a mong dang khatah a nihna a bawl hi; amah in a mongte gel a sin tawh sakhatin a bawl hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua cherubim-te in a khate uh a tung lamah zaakto uh a, a sin a limsun uh hi. Cherubim-te kimaingat uh a, a sin lam a en uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute g in singkha-sing tawh - tong nih sau, tong khat zai, tong khat le alang a sang h sabuai a bawl uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in kham citak tawh tuate luan uh a, a kimkotah kham geihual a bawl uh hi.","title":"Sabuai"},"12":{"text":"Amaute in a kimkotah zapek i cia a zai a geidal khat zong bawlin a geidal tungah kham geihual a neisak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in sabuai ading kham kual li sung uh a, a khe omna mun a kiu lite ah a bulh uh hi."},"14":{"text":"A kualte, sabuai puakna-a kizang zawlte a len dingin a geidal neh in kikoih hi."},"15":{"text":"Sabuai puak nading zawlte singkha sing kisui hi a, khamtui-in a kiluan hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hi-a, amaute in sabuai-a zat ding nate - a kuangdai-te, a kuang-ukte le dawntheih-a biakna sun nading kuangkumte le a beltungte kham citak tawh a bawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in kham citak tawh meivak tunna bawl uh a, a bul le a kungte a seek uh hi; pak tawh kibang haite a ngumte le a pakpalhte a kung tawh sakhat ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Meivak tunna panin ka guk - pang khatah thum, a pang lang khatah thum kakhia hi.","title":"Meivak Tunna"},"19":{"text":"Hiang khatah almond pakte tawh a kibang hai thumte, a ngumte le a pakte oma, a zomah thum mah omin meivak tunna panin a hiang gukte khempeuh a kibangin a kakhia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hi a, meivak tunna tungah almond pakte tawh a kibang hai li le a ngum le a pakte a om hi."},"21":{"text":"Meivak tunna pana a kopa a kat masakna nuai-ah a ngum khat oma, a kop nihna katna nuai-ah a ngum a nihna mah omin, a kop thumna a katna nuai-ah a ngum a thumna oma - a vekin a hiang guk ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"A hiangte le a ngumte, meivak tunna tawh a vekin sakhat hi a, kham citak kiseek ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 9:2; Kil 1:12"},"23":{"text":"Amaute in meivak sagihte a eksiakna le a kuangdai tawh kham citakin a bawl uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute in meivak tunna le a vanzatte khempeuh kham citak talent a khatin a bawl uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in singkha sing zangin gimnamtui-a biakna-tau a bawl uh hi. Tua pen tong khat sau, tong khat za-in a ningkim hi a, tong nih sang b in - a kite tawh sakhata kibawl ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute in a tung teng le a pang khempeuh le a kite kham citakin luan uh a, a kimkotah kham geihual a bawl uh hi.","title":"Gimnamtui-a Biakna-tau"},"27":{"text":"Amaute in a geihual nuai ah kham kual nih - a kigalsai-in nih tuak - a puak nading a zawlte len dingin a bawl uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute in singkha zawl sui uh a, tuate khamtui a luan uh hi.","ref":"Pk 30:1-5"},"29":{"text":"Amaute in nilh sathau siangtho le pak namtui bawlte bawl - gimnamtui citak zong a bawl uh hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaute c in singkha-sing tawh tong d thum a sang, meihal biakna-tau a bawl uh hi; tong nga sau-in tong nga za e -a, a ningkim ahi hi.","title":"Meihal Biakna-tau"},"2":{"text":"A kiu lite ah ki khat ciat neisak uh a, biakna-tau le a kite sakhatin bawlin, biakna-tau sumngo-in a luan uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in nazatte khempeuh - beelte, vut luahnate, tui thehna kuangkumte, salep-sikka le meiluahnate sumngo tawh a bawl uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in biakna-tau ading a zawl nuai-ah a kimciang a pha to a koih ding sumngo siklen a bawl uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in tua sumngo siklen kiu lite mongah a zawlte len dingin sumngo kualte a sung uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in singkha zawl sui uh a, tuate sumngotui a luan uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in a kualte sungah zawlte a khum uh hi; tua ahi ciangin tua puak nadingin tuate a pangah a om hi. Amaute in singpek tawh a vangin a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Pk 27:1-8"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a nasem numeite’ sumngo limlangte panin sumngo kuangpi le a tunna a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Tp 23:17; 1Sa 2:22"},"9":{"text":"A zomah amaute in hoihtaka kikhuk-a kigan puanzakte tawh ahuang a bawl uh hi. A leitaw-lam pang tong f za khat sau a,","title":"Kisilna Kuangpi Ahuang"},"10":{"text":"khuam sawm nih le sumngo bullen sawm nih tawh, a khuamah ngun vankhai le a gaknate a nei hi."},"11":{"text":"A leilu-lam pang zong tong za khat mah sau-a, khuam sawmnih, sumngo bullen sawmnih a ngun vankhai le a gaknate a khuamte tungah a nei hi."},"12":{"text":"A nitumna-lam panga puanzakte tong g sawmnga zai-a, khuam sawm le a bullen sawm, khuam tungah a ngun vankhai le a gaknate a nei hi."},"13":{"text":"Nisuahna-lam mong nisuak lam manawh zong tong sawmnga mah a zai hi."},"14":{"text":"A lutna pang khat-a puanzakte tong h sawm le nga zai in, khuam thum le bullen thum nei in,"},"15":{"text":"ahuang lutna a khat lam pangah tong sawm le nga asau puanzakte, khuam thum le bullen thum tawh a om hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahuang kimkot-a puanzakte khempeuh hoihtak-a kikhuk-a kigan puan ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A khuamte ading bullen sumngo ahi hi.
