Tua ciangin Aaron tapa siampite in biakna-tau pang khempeuh ah sisan a theh ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in kilawmtakna biakna panin TOPA tungah meihal biakna-a a tawi dingte: a sungkua tuam a thau khempeuh, ahikeh tuate tawh a kizom,"},"4":{"text":"a kalte gel tuate a tuam a kawngbom kianga om a thaute le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khawm ding a sin tuam athaute khempeuh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Aaron tapate in mei tunga om sing kuanglai tung, meihal biakna tungah mei-a hal biakna ahi TOPA a lungkimsak gimnamtui-a biakna-in a pia ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 7:11-34"},"6":{"text":"\"‘Amah in TOPA tungah kilawmtakna biakna-in tuuhonte panin a piak leh anu ahi a, apa ahi zongin a sitbaang lo pia ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in tuuno a piak leh TOPA mai-ah pia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a piak pen lutungah a khut nga dinga Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron tapate in a sisan biakna tau pang khempeuh a theh ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in kilawmtakna biakna panin TOPA tungah meihal-a biakpiakna a tawi dingte: a thau, a cingguh bula atkhiat a meithau khempeuh, a sungkua tuam a thau khempeuh, ahikeh tuate tawh kizom,"},"10":{"text":"a kawngbom kianga a kalte gel tuate a tuam athau le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khawm ding a sin tuam tawh ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Siampipa in tuate TOPA tungah mei-a hal an-a biakna-in biaknatau tungah a hal ding hi.","ref":"Sp 21:6,17"},"12":{"text":"\"‘Ama biakna keel khat ahileh amah in TOPA mai-ah pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in tua gan lutungah a khut nga dinga, Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron tapate in biakna-tau pang khempeuh a sisan theh ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Biakna-a kipiate panin amah in TOPA tungah mei-a hal biakna-a a piak dingte: a sungkuate a tuam athau khempeuh ahikeh tuate tawh kizom,"},"15":{"text":"a kawngbom kianga a kalte gel tuate tunga athau tawh le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khawm ding a sin tuam tawh ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Siampipa in TOPA tungah tuate mei-a hal an-a biakna lungkimsakna gimnamtui-in a hal ding hi. A thau khempeuh TOPA aa ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 1:9; 1Sa 2:16"},"17":{"text":"\"‘Hih in note tenna peuhpeuhah khang sawnsawnte dongin a kiptawntung thuzek hi ding hi: Note in athau ahikeh a sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Mawhna Hanga Biakna"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel tungah: ‘Mi khatpeuh in sawmkhol lopi-in TOPA thupiakte lak pana kikham khatpeuh a khialh khak leh -","ref":"Sp 5:15-18"},"3":{"text":"\"‘Sathau nilhsa siampipa a mawh a, mipite tungah mawhna a tut leh amah in ama hihsa mawhna hanga biakna dingin a sitbaang lo bawngtalno khat TOPA tungah a puak pelmawh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna TOPA mai-ah tua bawngtal a pia ding hi. Amah in tua gan lutungah a khut nga dinga TOPA mai-ah a go ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin sathau kinilhsa siampipa in bawngtal sisan pawlkhat la-in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah a lutpih ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in sisan lakah a khutme diah dinga, mun siangtho puanzak mai, TOPA mai-ah tuate pawlkhat sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in Kikhopna Puanbuk sunga TOPA mai-a om gimnamtui halna biakna-tau kite tungah tua sisan pawlkhat a nuh ding hi. Tua a om lai bawngtal sisan teng Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a meihal biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal panin athau khempeuh hawikhia-in - a sungkuate a tuam athau ahi zongin tuate tawh a kizom,"},"9":{"text":"a kawngbom kianga a kalte gel, tuate tunga athau tawh le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khawm ding a sin tuam tawh -"},"10":{"text":"kilawmtakna biakna-a b a kipia bawngpi c -a, athau kilakhia bang tektek hi ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in meihal biakna-tau tungah tuate a hal ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin bawngtal vun le a sate khempeuh a lu le a khete, a sungkua le a ekte tawh -"},"12":{"text":"tuate pen bawngtal sa a om lai teng giahphual pualam, a siangtho-a kisehsa mun khat vut buakna munah paipih dinga, vutte tungah sing tawh mei cihin a haltum ding hi.","ref":"Sp 5:9; Heb 13:11"},"13":{"text":"\"‘Israel mihon buppi in sawm khol lopi-in TOPA thupiakte lakpan a kham khatpeuh semin a mawh uh leh mihonpi in tua thu a phawkkha kei uh zongin amaute a khial uh ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in a hihsa uh mawhna a phawk uh ciangin tua pawl buppi in Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtalno khat pia ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihonte upate in TOPA mai-a bawngtal lutungah a khut uh nga ding uh a, TOPA mai-ah bawngtal kigo ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin sathau kinilhsa siampipa in bawngtal sisan pawlkhat la-in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah lutpih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in a khutme sisan lakah diahin puanzak maisan-a TOPA mai-ah sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah TOPA mai-a biakna-tau kite tungah sisan pawlkhat nuh ding hi. Amah in sisan a om lai teng Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a meihal biakna-tau bulah sungkhia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in athau khempeuh hawikhia dinga biakna-tau tungah halin,"},"20":{"text":"mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal ahih bang tektekin a hih ding hi. Hici bangin siampipa in amaute adingin thoihdamna bawl dinga amaute a kimaisak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in giahphual pua-ah bawngtal lakhia dinga bawngtal masapen a hal bangin a hal ding hi. Hih in mihonpite ading mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.","ref":"tg 3; Ms 15:25"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Makai khat in TOPA ama Pasian thupiakte lakah a kikham khatpeuh sawmkhol lopi-in hih-a, a mawh ciangin a khial ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama hihsa mawhna amah a kiphawksak ciangin amah in biakna-in a sitbaang lo keel apa khat paipih pelmawh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in keel lutang tungah a khut nga dinga, meihal biaknate kigawhna mun TOPA mai-ah tua a kigo ding hi. Tua in mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna gan sisan pawlkhat a khutme-in la dinga meihal biakna-tau kite nuhin sisan a om lai teng biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah in kilawmtakna biakna thaute a hal bang tektekin athau khempeuh biakna-tau tungah hal ding hi. Hici bangin siampipa in mipa adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga, tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"\"‘Mihonpi sunga pawlmi khat in, TOPA thupiakte in a kham khatpeuh sawmkhol lopi-in a hih khak leh amah a khial ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Ama hihsa mawhna a kiphawksak ciangin a hihsa mawhna hanga biakna dingin a sitbaang lo keel nu khat a paipih pelmawh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in mawhna hanga biakna gan lutungah a khut nga dinga meihal biakna munah a go ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a khutme tawh a sisan pawlkhat la-in meihal biakna-tau kite nuh dinga, a om lai sisan teng biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in kilawmtakna biakna-a athau a hawikhiat bang tektekin athau khempeuh hawikhia dinga siampipa in TOPA a lungkimsak gimnamtui ahi dingin biakna-tau tungah a hal ding hi. Hici bangin siampipa in ama adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"\"‘Amah in a mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuno khat a paipih leh a sitbaang lo anu khat a paipih ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah in tua gan lutungah a khut nga dinga meihal biakna kigawhna munah mawhna hanga biakna-in a go ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a khutme tawh tua mawhna hanga biakna gan sisan pawlkhat la dinga, meihal biakna-tau kite nuhin sisan a om lai teng biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Amah in kilawmtakna biakna tuuno thau a hawikhiat bang tektekin athau khempeuh hawikhia dinga siampipa in TOPA mai a biakna-tau tunga mei-a hal biakna tung sawnah a hal ding hi. Hici bangin ama hihsa mawhna tang dingin siampipa in ama adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga, tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 29:38; Sp 1:4; 9:3"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat in a muhsa ahikeh a theihsa thu khat peuhpeuh ah teci pang dingin tangpi in a sawla, amah in a muhsa bangin a gen nop kei leh tua mawhna a khu ding hi.","ref":"Pn 29:24"},"2":{"text":"\"‘Ahikeh mi khat in asiang lo-a kiseh na khat anin gamsa sisa luang ahikeh anin innsa ahikeh anin leitunga a bokvak ganhing - khatpeuh a lawnkhak leh amah in a theih khak loh hangin anin suaka, a khial ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"\"‘Ahikeh amah in amah a ninsak ding na khatpeuh - mihing nitnate a lawn leh amah in a theikha kei zongin a theih ciangin a khial ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 19:11-16"},"4":{"text":"\"‘Ahikeh mi khat in ngaihsun khol loin na khatpeuh hih dingin a tomlawh khak leh asia-a apha zongin - ngaihsun khol lopi-a kiciamna thu ah - amah in a theikha kei zongin a phawk ciangin tua bang thu-ah akhial ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"\"‘Mi khatpeuh hici bangte khatpeuh a khialh leh a bawlsa mawhna kipulak pelmawh dinga"},"6":{"text":"ama hihsa mawhna dan dingin TOPA tungah mawhna hanga biakna-in ganhon panin tuuno a nu khat ahikeh keel a nu khat paipih ding hi; tua ciangin siampipa in ama adingin a mawhna hanga thoihdamna a bawlsak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 16:21; 26:40"},"7":{"text":"\"‘Amah in tuuno a neih zawh kei leh vakhu nih ahikeh kawl-vakhuno nih, a mawhna dan tangin TOPA tungah pia dinga - khat pen mawhna hanga biakna hi-in, a khat pen meihal biakna ding ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a masapen mawhna hanga biakna-in a piaksak ding siampipa kiangah a puak ding hi. Amah in alu angawng ah hektan dinga bottat loin"},"9":{"text":"mawhna hanga biakna gan sisan pawlkhat, baikna-tau pangte thehin, sisan a omlaite biakna-tau bulah a kitakkhiasak pelmawh ding hi. Tua in mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in ngeina omsa-a hihzia zui-in meihal biakna bangin pia dinga, ama hihsa mawhna tangin ama adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 12:8; 14:21"},"11":{"text":"\"‘Ahi zongin amah in vakhu nih ahikeh kawl-vakhuno nih a neih zawh kei lai leh ama mawhna hanga biakna dingin annel limci ephah a khat sehsawm suah sehkhat mawhna hanga biakna dingin a paipih ding hi. Amah in sathau ahikeh gimnamtui a sawh kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tua in mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in siampipa kiangah paipih dinga siampipa in phawk nadingin khut dim khat pham dinga, biakna-tau tunga TOPA mai-ah mei-a hal biakna tung sawnah a hal ding hi. Tua in mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Hici bangin siampipa in ama hihsa mawhna khatpeuhte tang dingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga, tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi. An-a biakna-a mah bangin biakna-a kipia a omlai teng siampipa aa ahi hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah:"},"15":{"text":"\" TOPA na asiangtho khatpeuh tawh kisai-in mi khat in sawmkhol lopi-in ngongtatin mawhna a hih khak ciangin amah dan piakna-in tuuhon panin tuutal khat, mun siangtho shekel a tawh kizui-in nguntanga a man kiseh a sitbang lo khat TOPA kiangah a paipih ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.","title":"Khialhna hanga Biakna"},"16":{"text":"Amah in a siangtho nate tawh kisai a hih khialhte ditkikna bawl pelmawh dinga a kiseh zah sehnga suah sehkhat gawm behin siampipa tungah a vekin pia khin dinga amah in khialhna hanga biakna bangin tuutal-in thoihdamna bawlsak dinga tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 6:4; 22:14; Ms 5:7"},"17":{"text":"\"Mi khat in, TOPA thupiakte lak panin a kham khat peuh semin a mawh leh amah in a thei kha kei zongin akhial hi a, amah in tua mawhna a khu hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in tuuhon panin aman dinga kiseh zah aman, a sitbaang lo tuutal khat khialhna hanga biakna-in siampipa tungah a paipih ding hi. Hici bangin sawmkhol lo-a, a hih khaksa khialhna tangin siampipa in ama adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga, tua ciangin amah kimaisak ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua in khialhna hanga biakna hi a, TOPA tungah khialhna-sate b hang ahi hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah:"},"2":{"text":"\"Mi khatpeuh in, a vengpa in muanga na a kepsakna ah a khemna ahikeh kepsak lo ahikeh a kigu ahikeh amah a khem suahna tawh TOPA tungah a muanhuai lo a suah leh"},"3":{"text":"ahikeh amah in na kimansuah khat mu in zuau gena, ahikeh amaan lopi-in a tomlawh leh, ahikeh tua bang mihing bawl theih mawhna a bawl leh -"},"4":{"text":"tua in khiala a mawh a suahsak leh amah in a guksa pen ahikeh khema a laksak ahikeh ama kepsa van ahi zongin van kimangsak a muh,"},"5":{"text":"ahikeh zuauthu tawh a tomlawhna khatpeuh a pia kik pelmawh ding hi. A kimin din kik dinga aman zah sehnga suah sehkhat behlapin mawhna hanga biakna a piak ni-in a neipa tungah a vekpi in a pia khin ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in a dantuahna-in siampipa tungah tua pen TOPA tungah ama khialhna hanga biakna dingin tuuhon lak pan aman ding a kisehsa tawh kituak a sit baang lo tuutal khat a paipih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hici bangin siampipa in TOPA mai-ah ama adingin thoihdamna bawlsak dinga, tua ciangin hih bang nate sema, a mawh a suahna tawh kisai-in ama mawhna kimaisak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah:"},"9":{"text":"\"Aaron le a tapate hih thupiak pia in: Meihal biakna ngeinate hihte ahi hi: ‘Meihal biakna, zan khuavakin zingsang dong biakna-tau-a tap tungah om den dinga, biakna-tau laizangah pel loin mei kuangden ding hi.","title":"Meihal Biakna"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in saihadial puan silh dinga, a pumpi tungah saihadial puan sungsilhin, biakna-tau tunga meihal biakna meivute luakkhia-in, tuate biakna-tau pangah a koih ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin a puansilhte suahkhia-in adangte silh dinga, giahphual pua-a a siangtho-a kiseh mun khatah vutte a buakhia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Biakna-tau tungah pel loin mei kuang den dinga; a mit ngei peuhmah kei ding hi. Zingsang simin siampipa in sing cihbeh dinga, mei tungah meihal biaknate gualin tua tungah kilawmtakna biakna c thaute a hal ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Biakna-tau tungah pel loin mei kuang den dinga, a mit ngei peuhmah kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"\"‘Hihte an-a biakna ngeinate ahi hi: Aaron tapate in biakna-tau mai-a TOPA mai-ah tuate a paipih ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Siampipa in annel limci le sathau khut dim khat an-a biakna gimnamtui khempeuh le phawkna khenkhiat gawmin TOPA a lungkimsak gimnamtui ahi dingin biakna-tau tungah a hal ding hi.","title":"An-a Biakna"},"16":{"text":"A omlai teng Aaron le a tapate in ne ding uh a, ahi hangin tuate silngo sawh lohin siangtho munah a ne ding uh hi; amaute in tuate Kikhopna Puanbuk huang sungah a ne ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Silngo tawh a ki-em peuhmah kei ding hi; kei hong kipia mei-a hal biakna panin a tanh dingun ka piaksa ahi hi. Mawhna hanga biakna le khialna hanga biaknate mah bangin a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Aaron suan pasal khempeuh in ne thei ding uh hi. Tua in khang sawnsawnte adingin TOPA tungah mei-a hal biaknate panin ama tanh ding ngeina ahi hi. Tua tawh a kisukha na khatpeuh a siangtho d suak ding hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 2:3; Eze 44:29"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"20":{"text":"\"Hih in Aaron le a tapate in amah e sathau a kinilh ni-a TOPA tunga a paipih ding uh biakna ahi hi: a hunhuna kipuak an-a biakna annel limci panin ephah f khat sehsawm suah sehkhat, zingsangin alang, nitakin alang a pia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hoihtakin mekman inla belpei-in hoihtakin sathau tawh kang in, balnenin g TOPA a lungkimsak an-a biakna gimnamtui dingin paipih in."},"22":{"text":"Ama za a luah sathau kinilh a tapa in a hih ding hi. Tua pen TOPA in a hunhun-a a tanh den hi-a, a kihaltum kiuhkeuh ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Siampi khat in an-a biakna-a a piak peuhmah a kihaltum kiuhkeuh ding hi; a kine peuhmah kei ding hi,\" zong a ci lai hi.","ref":"Pk 29:2; Sp 2:5"},"24":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"25":{"text":"\"Aaron le a tapate tungah: ‘Hihte in mawhna hanga biakna ngeinate ahi hi: mawhna hanga biakna in meihal biakna kigawhna mun TOPA mai-ah kigo ding hi; tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi.","title":"Mawhna Hanga Biakna"},"26":{"text":"Biakna-a a pia tua siampipa in tua a ne ding hi; tua pen Kikhopna Puanbuk huang sung siangtho munah a kine ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua sa tawh a kisukha na peuhmah a siangtho suak dinga, sisan in a puantualpi a theh khak leh siangtho munah a sawp ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Sa kihuanna leibel a kisukham pelmawh ding hi; ahi hangin taubelin a kihuan leh a beel kiatsiangin tui-in a kisawp siang sinsen ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Siampi innkuan sunga pasal peuhmah in a ne thei ding hi; tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi hangin Mun Siangtho ah thoihdamna bawl nadinga Kikhopna Puanbuk-a kipuak sisan kilakna mawhna hanga biakna sa a kine peuhmah kei ding hi; kihaltum pelmawh ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"‘Hihte in a siangtho pen khialhna hanga biakna ngeinate ahi hi.","title":"Khialhna Hanga Biakna"},"2":{"text":"Khialhna hanga biakna pen meihal biakna gawhna munah kigo dinga, a sisanin biakna-tau pang khempeuh kitheh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Biakna-a kipia ding athaute: a mei thau le a sungkuate a tuam athau,"},"4":{"text":"a kawngbom kianga a kalte gel a kimkota athau tawh, le a kalte tawh lakkhiat khawm a sin tuam tawh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Siampipa in TOPA tungah mei-a hal biakna khat dingin tuate a hal ding hi. Tua in khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampi innkuana pasal khempeuh in ne thei ding uh hi; ahi hangin siangtho munah a kine pelmawh ding hi; tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 29:13; Sp 6:18"},"7":{"text":"\"‘Mawhna hanga biakna le khialhna hanga biakna-ah ngeina a kibangin kizang hi: tuate amaute adingin thoihdamna bawlsak siampite aa ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh adingin meihal biakna a piaksak siampipa in a vun tang thei hi."},"9":{"text":"An-a biakna thuk sunga ki-em ahileh sikbel ahikeh beelpei tunga kihuan peuhmah biakna-a a pia siampite aa hi a,"},"10":{"text":"an-a biakna peuhmah, sathau tawh a kihel-a, akeu guak ahi zongin Aaron tapate khempeuh in a kikima a tanh uh ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 2:5; 16:17, 26"},"11":{"text":"\"‘Hihte in, mi khat in TOPA tungah kilawmtakna biakna-a a a piak theih ngeinate ahi hi:"},"12":{"text":"\"‘Amah in lungdamkohna-a a piak ahileh, tua lungdamkohna-a biakna tawh, silngo sawhloh sathau tawh a kimek anpheng, silngo sawh loh sathau-a kizut mohnip le sathau tawh limtaka kimek khawm annel mohpheng-te a pia khawm ding hi.","title":"Kilawmtakna Biakna"},"13":{"text":"Amah in lungdamkohna, kilawm- takna biakna tawh silngo sawh loh anlum tawh biakna piakhawm ding hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA tunga piak dingin biakna a namkimin khat tek a paipih ding hi; tua pen kilawmtakna biakna-a sisan a pia siampipa aa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ama lungdamkohna kilawmtakna biakna sa pen a kipiak ni-in kigai khin ding hi; amah in zingsang dong bangmah a sit kei ding hi."},"16":{"text":"\"‘Ahi ta zongin a biakna pen kiciamna khat ahikeh utthu-a biakna ahileh tua a biakpiakna pen a piak ni-in kigai khin dinga, ahi zongin a kikhamval leh a zing ciangin kine thei lai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A ni thumni dong a val lai biakpiakna sa peuhmah kihaltum ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A ni thum ni-in kilawmtakna biakna sa khatpeuh a kinek leh tua pen kisang lo ding hi. Biakna-a a piapa adingin bangmah in a kisim kei ding hi; ahang in, tua pen anin ahi hi; tua sa a nepa siakhu ding hi.","ref":"Sp 19:5-8; Ms 18:27"},"19":{"text":"\"‘A nin-a kisehsa na khatpeuh tawh a kisawhkha sa a kine peuhmah kei ding hi; pel loin kihaltum ding hi. Sa dang ahileh a sianga kiseh mi peuhmah in ne thei ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin a sianglo mi khatpeuh in kilawmtakna biakna-a TOPA a kipia sa khatpeuh a nek leh tua mipa a mipihte panin kikhenkhia pelmawh ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in a siang lo na khat a lawnkhak leh - mihing siantho-lohna ahikeh ganhing siantho-lohna khat ahikeh a siang lo a kihhuai na khatpeuh - tua khit ciangin kilawmtakna biakna-a TOPA a kipiasa a nek leh tua mipa a mipihte panin kikhenkhia pelmawh ding hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 22:3-7"},"22":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"23":{"text":"\"Israel-te tungah: Bawngte, tuute ahikeh keelte thau ne kei un.","title":"Sathau le Sisan Nek Kikham"},"24":{"text":"Ganhing a sisa-a kimute ahikeh gamsa nek ganhing thaute, nadanga zat dingin kizang thei dinga ahi hangin na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA tungah meihal biakna-a kizang thei ding b ganhing thau a ne peuhmah a mipihte panin a kikhenkhia pelmawh ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na tenna peuhpeuhuah gamsa ahikeh vasa khatpeuh sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Sisan a ne mi khatpeuh a om leh a mipihte panin kikhenkhia pelmawh ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"29":{"text":"\"Israel-te tungah: TOPA tungah kilawmtak-na biakna hong paipih mi khatpeuh in tua laka pawlkhat TOPA tunga biakpiakna-in hong tawi uh hen.","title":"Siampite’ Tanh"},"30":{"text":"Ama khut tektekin TOPA tungah mei-a hal biakna a tawi ding hi; amah in athau a iik tawh tawikhawm dinga, TOPA mai-ah vei-a biakna-in a iik a vei ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Siampipa in biakna-tau tungah a thau hal ding hi, ahi hangin a iik pen Aaron le a tapate tanh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Kilawmtakna biakna a taklam phei siampipa tanh dingin na pia ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Kilawmtakna biakna-a sisan le athaute a pia Aaron tapa in a ma tanh dingin a taklam phei tang ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Israel kilawmtakna biakna panin a kiveisa a iik le a kipiasa a phei ken ka la zo a, tuate siampi Aaron le a tapate in Israel tung pana a tanh den dingin ka pia khin zo hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 29:27; Ms 18:18-19"},"35":{"text":"Hih in, TOPA tungah siampi nasem dinga Aaron le a tapate a kipiak ni-ua, TOPA mai-a meihal biaknate pana kisehkhia amau tanh ding ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Amaute sathau a kinilh ni-in, Israel in khang sawnsawn donga Israel-te tanh den dingin TOPA in amaute tungah a piak ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 8:12, 30"},"37":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin haltumbiakna, an-a biakna, mawhna hanga biakna, khialhna hanga biakna, kipsakna biakna le kilawmtakna biakna ngeinate hihte hi a,"},"38":{"text":"TOPA in Israel-te Sinai Sehnel-gam a TOPA mai-ah biakna hong puak uh hen, ci-a thu a piak ni mah a Sinai Vum tunga Moses tungah a piak ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 1:2; 6:9"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Aaron le a Tapate Kipsakna"},"2":{"text":"\"Aaron le a tapate, a puansilhte uh, nilh sathau, mawhna hanga biakna ding bawngtal, tuutal nih le silngo sawh loh anlum koihna lawh-te tawh hong paipih inla"},"3":{"text":"Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah mipite a vekpi-un kikhawmsak in,\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA in amah a thupiak bangin Moses in hih a, Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah mipite a kikhawm uh hi.","ref":"Pk 29:2-3; 30:23-25,30"},"5":{"text":"Moses in mipite tungah, \"Hih in, TOPA in hih dinga hong thupiak ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate a mai-ah paikhiatpiha tui-in a sil hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in puan tungsilh Aaron silhsaka, puan kawnggakin a gak hi; puantualpi silhsa in siampi puan a silh thuahsak hi. Amah in khutsiamtaka kigan kawnggakin a siampi puan zong a gak hi; tua ciangin ama tungah a kikhihkip hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a tungah awmtuam bulha tua awmtuam ah Urim le Thummim a thuah hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin TOPA in Moses a thu piaksa bangin Aaron lutungah dial khimsaka, a mailam ah kham pek, kumpi lukhu siangtho a bulh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in nilh sathau la-a, biakbuk le a sunga vante khempeuh nilhin tua ciangin a ap hi."},"11":{"text":"Biakna-tau tungah sathau pawlkhat sagih vei thehin biakna-tau le a um a beelte, kisilna kuangpi a tuna tawh a ap nadingin sathau a nilh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in Aaron lutungah nilh sathau pawlkhat sunga a apna-in amah a nilh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Aaron tapate a mai-ah paisaka TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin amaute puantungsilh silhsakin puan kawnggakte-in gak-a, lugaknate a gaksak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal pia a, Aaron le a tapate in tua lutungah a khut uh a nga uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Moses in tua bawngtal go-in a sisan pawlkhat la-a, biakna-tau siansuahna-in a khutme tawh biakna-tau ki khempeuh a nuh hi. Sisan a omlai teng biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia hi. Tua bangin biakna-tau adingin thoihdamna bawlin a ap hi."},"16":{"text":"Moses in a sungkua tuam athau khempeuh, a sin tuam le a kalte gel le tuate thau zong la-a, biakna-tau tungah a hal hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin tua bawngtal avun, asa le a ek-te tawh giahphual pualamah a haltum hi.","ref":"Ph 66:15; Heb 9:22"},"18":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in meihal biakna dingin tuutal pia-a, Aaron le a tapate in tua gan lutungah a khutte uh nga uh hi."},"19":{"text":"tua ciangin Moses in tuutal go-in biakna-tau pang khempeuh sisan a theh hi"},"20":{"text":"Amah in tuutal semnen-a a lu a sanente le athau a hal hi."},"21":{"text":"TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin amah in a sungkuate le a khete tui-in sawpa, tuutal buppi TOPA tungah lungkim-sakna gimnamtui mei-a hal biakna-in biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna-in a hal hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in kipsakna tuutal dingin tuutal dang khat pia-a, Aaron le a tapate in tua gan lutungah a khutte uh nga uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Moses in tuutal go-a, a sisan pawlkhat la-in Aaron taklam bilhualte, a taklam khutpi, a taklam khepite a nuhsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Moses in Aaron tapate zong a mai-ah paisaka, amaute taklam bilhualte, a taklam khutpite uh le a taklam khepite uh sisan a nuhsak hi; tua khit ciangin biakna-tau pang khempeuh sisan a theh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in athaute, a mei thau, a sungkua tuam athau, a sin tuam, a kalte gel le athau le a taklam phei a la hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA mai-a om silngo sawh loh anlum lawh panin anlum pheng, sathau tawh kibawl moh khat, le mohnip khat la a; a thaute pawl a taklam phei tungah hihte a koih hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in hihte khempeuh Aaron le a tapate khutah koih a, vei-a biakna-in tuate TOPA mai-ah a vei hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in amaute khut panin tuate lakhia a, kipsakna-a biakna, lungkimsakna gimnamtui, TOPA tunga mei-a hal biakna-in biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna tung sawnah tuate a hal hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in, TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin kipsakna tuutal-a Moses tanh a iik zong la a, vei-a biakna-in TOPA mai-ah a vei hi.","ref":"Sp 7:31-34; Heb 9:18-22"},"30":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in biakna-tau panin nilh sathau pawlkhat le sisan pawlkhat la a, tuate Aaron le a puansilh tung le a tapate le a puansilhte uh tungah a theh hi. Tuaci in Aaron le a puansilhte le a tapate le a puansilhte uh a ap hi.","ref":"Ms 3:3"},"31":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate kiangah, \"Keimah in, ‘Aaron le a tapate in tuate ne uh hen,’ ci-a thu kong piak a bangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah tua sa huan unla, kipsakna biakna lawh sunga anlum tawh meh un."},"32":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin sa le anlum a omlai teng haltum un."},"33":{"text":"Note hong kikipsakna ni sagih sung bei ding ahi manin, note kipsakna a kimansiang matengin ni sagih sung Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna lawi kei un."},"34":{"text":"Tuni-a kihihte note adingin thoihdamna bawl nadinga TOPA thupiak ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Note na sih loh nadingun Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah ni sagih sung sun tawh zan tawh pel loin om unla TOPA hong sawlte hih un; tua in keima hong thupiaksa ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangiin TOPA in Moses tungtawna a thupiakna khempeuh Aaron le a tapate in a hih uh hi.","ref":"Pk 29:1-37; Tp 11:1"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nigiatna ni-in Moses in Aaron le a tapate le Israel upate a sam hi.","title":"Siampite in Amaute Nasep Pan"},"2":{"text":"Amah in Aaron kiangah, \"Na mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtalno khat le na meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat - a nihin a sitbaang lo la inla tuate TOPA mai ah pia in."},"3":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Israel-te tungah, ‘Mawhna hanga biakna dingin keel a pa khat, meihal biakna dingin a niha kum khat tuak a pha a sitbaang lo bawngno khat le tuuno khat"},"4":{"text":"le TOPA mai-ah an-a biakna tawh biakna a piakkhawm dingin kilawmtakna biakna a -in bawngtal b khat le tuutal khat la un. Ahang in, tuni-in note tungah TOPA hong kilak ding hi, ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 29:43; Eze 43:27"},"5":{"text":"Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah Moses thupiak tua nate la uh a, a kiangah mipi buppi pai-in TOPA mai-ah a ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in, \"Hih in TOPA minthanna note tungah hong kilat theih nadingin na hih dingun TOPA hong thupiak ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Moses in Aaron kiangah, \"Biakna-tau hong naih inla mawhna hanga na biakna le meihal biakna nangmah le mipite adingin biakpiakna bawl in; TOPA thupiaksa bangin mipite adingin biakna pia inla amau adingin thoihdamna bawlsak in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Heb 5:1,3; 7:27"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin biakna-tau ah Aaron pai-a ama mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngno a go hi."},"9":{"text":"A tate in ama kiangah sisan hong paipih uh a, sisan lakah a khutme diahin biakna-tau kite a nuh hi; sisan a om lai teng biakna-tau bulah a sungkhia hi."},"10":{"text":"TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin amah in mawhna hanga biakna pana athau, a kalte le a sin tuamte biakna-tau tungah a hal hi;"},"11":{"text":"amah in a satak le a vun giahphual pua-ah a haltum hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin meihal biakna a go hi. A tapate in amah sisan pia uh a, biakna-tau apang khempeuh a theh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in meihal biakna a lu tawh a bakbakin pia uh a, amah in tuate biakna-tau tungah a hal hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in a sungkuate le a khete sawpa, biakna-tau tunga meihal biakna tung sawnah a hal hi.","ref":"Sp 1:8"},"15":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Aaron in mipite adingin biakna a paipih hi. Mipite mawhna hanga biakna keel la-a, a masa-a a hih bangin go a, mawhna hanga biakna-in a pia hi.","ref":"Sp 4:27-31"},"16":{"text":"Amah in meihal biakna paipih-a, a ngeina omsa bangin a pia hi."},"17":{"text":"An-a biakna zong paipih-a, a khut khat dim pham in zingsang meihal biakna banah biakna-tau tungah a hal hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in mipite kilawmtakna biakna tangin bawngtal le tuutal a go hi. A tapate in amah sisan pia uh a, biakna-tau pang khempeuh a theh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi hangin bawngtal le tuutal thau - a mei thau, a gilpi tuam, a kalte le a sin tuam -"},"20":{"text":"hihte a iikte tungah koih uh a, tua ciangin Aaron in biakna-tau tungah athau a hal hi."},"21":{"text":"Moses thupiak bangin Aaron in vei-a biakna-in TOPA mai-ah a iik le a taklam phei a vei hi.","ref":"Sp 3:1-11"},"22":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Aaron in mipite lamah a khut viikto-a, amaute thupha a pia hi. Amah in, mawhna hanga biakna, meihal biakna le kilawmtakna biaknate pia khina, a kumsuk hi.","ref":"Ms 6:23; Lk 24:50"},"23":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Moses le Aaron a pai uh hi. Amaute a paikhiat uh ciangin mipite thupha pia uh a, mipite khempeuh tungah TOPA minthanna a kilak hi."},"24":{"text":"TOPA omna mun panin mei kuangkhia a, biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna le athau lomte a kangtum hi. Mipite khempeuh in a muh uh ciangin lungnuamin kiko uh a, leilam nga-in a bok uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 18:39"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron tapa Nadab le Abihu te in amau gimnamtui beelte la uh a, a sungah mei koihin gimnamtui a sung uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in ama thupiakna tawh kilehbulhin a thu tawn loin TOPA mai-ah mei a pia uh hi.","title":"Nadab le Abihu Sihna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA omna panin mei kuangkhia a, amaute kangtumin TOPA mai-ah a si uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron kiangah, \"Hih in TOPA thugen ahi hi, amah in: ‘Kei hong naihte lakah, kei a siangtho ka hina ka lak ding hi; mite khempeuh muhna-ah kei hong kipahtawi ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi. Aaron a daidide hi.","ref":"Sp 16:12; Isa 49:3"},"4":{"text":"Moses in Aaron pano Uzziel tapate Mishael le Elzaphan-te sama, amaute kiangah, \"Hih lai-ah hong pai un; mun siangtho mai panin giahphual pua ah na sanggamte uh puakhia un,\" a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amaute pai uh a Moses sawl bangin a puantungsilh mah uh tawh giahphual pualamah a puakhia uh hi.","ref":"Pk 6:22"},"6":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapa Eleazar le Ithamar kiangah, \"Na samte uh gumsak c kei unla na puan uh balkek kei un, na tua cih kei uh leh na si ding uh a, mipi bup tungah TOPA a heh ding hi. Ahi hangin na tanaute uh, Israel innkuan khempeuh, TOPA in mei-a a suksiatna hangin a thum thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna lawi kei un; na lawih uh leh TOPA sathau nilh note tungah baang ahi manin na si ding uh hi,\" a ci hi. Amaute in Moses cih bangin a hih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin TOPA in Aaron kiangah,"},"9":{"text":"\"Nang le na tapate in Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah na pai peuhmah uh ciangin lenggahzu ahikeh a kibilh dang khatpeuh na dawn kei ding uh hi; na dawn uh leh na si ding uh hi. Hih in khang sawnsawnte donga a om den ding thuzek ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"A siangtho le a siangtho lo, asiang le anin na khen tektek ding uh a,"},"11":{"text":"Moses tawna TOPA in amaute a piaksa thukipte khempeuh Israel-te na hilh ding uh hi\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 20:25; Eze 44:21"},"12":{"text":"Moses in Aaron le a omlai a tapate Eleazar le Itharmar-te tungah, \" TOPA mai-a mei-a hal biaknate pana an-a biakna valte la unla silngo sawh loin biakna-tau kiangah ne un; ahang in, a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Mun siangtho khatah ne un, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA mai-a mei-a hal biaknate panin nang le na tapate tanh ahi hi; ahang in, tua bang dingin kei tungah thu hong kipia hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang le na tanute na tapate in a kivei a iik le a kipiasa a phei na ne thei ding uh hi. A siangtho-a kisehna munah tuate ne un; Israel-te kilawmtakna biakna a pana nang le na tate tanh dinga hong kipia ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"A kipiasa a phei le a kivei a iik, mei-a hal biakna lakah athaute tawh TOPA mai-ah vei-a biakna dingin nong tawi ding uh hi. Hih in TOPA hong thupiak bangin nang le na tate in na kaih den ding uh ahi ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 6:14-18; 7:34"},"16":{"text":"Moses in mawhna hanga biakna keel thu a kan ciangin kihaltum khin hi, cih thei-a a om lai Aaron tapa Eleazar le Ithamar tungah heh a amaute kiangah,"},"17":{"text":"\"Bang hangin mawhna hanga biakna mun siangtho huam sungah ne lo na hi uh hiam? Tua in a siangthopen ahi hi; TOPA mai-ah amaute adingin thoihdamna bawla mipite khialhna lakmang nadingin no tunga hong kipia ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Munsiangtho pena, a sisan a kilah loh nungsang kong thupiak bangin tua keel, mun siangtho huam sungah na nek ding uh ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 6:26, 30; 9:3"},"19":{"text":"Aaron in Moses kiangah, \"Tuni-in amaute in amau mawhna hanga biakna le a meihal biakna uh TOPA mai-ah a pia uh hi; ahi hangin tua bang nate kei tungah hong piang hi. Tuni-in mawhna hanga biakna ne hi leng TOPA a lungdam ding hiam?\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"20":{"text":"Moses in hih thute a zak ciangin a lungkim hi.","ref":"Sp 9:12"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron kiangah,","title":"Sa Siang le Sa Nin"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te tungah, ‘Leitunga a nungta ganhingte khempeuh lakah na nek theih ding uh hihte ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"A khecin ciantaka a ka ganhing eknel hai peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"\"‘Ganhing pawlkhat a khecin bek a ka, ahikeh eknel bek a hai om hi; tuate na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Kala-oh in eknel a hai hangin a khecin a ka kei hi; tua pen note adingin a sianglo-a kiseh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Sakikh b in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo hi; tua pen no adingin a siang lo ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Bilpi in eknel a hai hangin a khecin a ka kei hi; tua pen note adingin asiang lo ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuateh vok a khecin kiciantakin a kat hangin eknel a hai kei hi; tua pen note adingin asiang lo ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"A sa na ne peuhmah kei ding uh a, a sisa zong na lawng kei ding uh hi; tuate note adingin a siang lo ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 65:4"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Tuipite le luituite sunga om a nungta ganhingte khempeuh lakah phe le lip a neite peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin tuipite ahikeh luite sunga om ganhing phe le lip a nei lo - tuipek thei ahi a, ahikeh tui sunga a nungta ganhing dangte khempeuh ahi zongin no adingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Note in tuate na kih ding uh ahi nungsang a sa na ne peuhmah kei ding uh a, a sisate na kih pelmawh ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tui sunga a nungta phe le lip a nei lo peuhmah note adingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"\"‘Hihte a kihhuai ahi mana kih a na nek loh ding uh vasate ahi hi: Muvanlai, musane, luimu,"},"14":{"text":"mumeika, musan nam khempeuh"},"15":{"text":"va-ak nam khempeuh"},"16":{"text":"simbu ki nei peuhmah, vabak, tuivakang, musi nam peuhmah,"},"17":{"text":"keising, tuimu, simbupi"},"18":{"text":"simbukang, gun vakang, tui vatawt"},"19":{"text":"gun vapi, tuiva nam peuhmah, huihtun le bak c ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"\"‘A leng thei kheli nei ganhing peuhmah note adingin a kihhuai ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi zongin kha nei-a a khe li-a a pai na nek theih ding uh pawlkhatte: leitungah a zuan nading khe kikhep nei peuhmah."},"22":{"text":"Hihte lakah kauphe nam peuhmah, kaukhup, khuangbai ahikeh kauphe kisau-te ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin kha nei ganhing kheli nei peuhmah na kih ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 14:3-20"},"24":{"text":"\"‘Hihte in note hong ninsak dingte ahi hi; tuate sisa a lawngkha peuhmah nitak mateng a siang lo ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hihte a sisa a tawmkha mi peuhmah a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga amah nitak mateng a siang lo hi ding hi.","ref":"Sp 14:8,47; 15:5"},"26":{"text":"\"‘Ganhing a khecin ka napi ka siang taktak lo a eknel a hai lote note adingin a siang lo ahi hi; tuate khatpeuh a sisa a lawng peuhmah a siang lo ahi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Khe li nei ganhingte lakah a khe bomin cin a nei peuhmah note adingin a siang lo ahi hi; tuate a sisa a lawngkha peuhmah nitak mateng a siang lo ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuate a tawm khatpeuh in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga amah nitak mateng a siang lo hi ding hi. Tuate note adingin a siang lo ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"\"‘Leitunga a bokvak ganhingte lakah note adingin a siang lote in: bui, zusa, tangpi nam khempeuh,"},"30":{"text":"innhik, thankik, tangteuh, saphulip le tawlbawkpi-te ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Leitunga a awmtal ganhing khempeuh lakah note adingin a siang lo hihte ahi hi. Hihte a sisa a lawngkha peuhmah nitak mateng a siang lo ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hihte lakah khatpeuh sisa na khat tungah a kiat leh tua a tukna, a kizang na: sing, puan, savun ahikeh ippi ahi zongin a siang lo a suak hi. Tui-ah diah un; nitak mateng a siang lo hi dinga, tua ciangin a siang ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuate khat leibeel sungah a kiat leh a sunga om na khempeuh a siang lo hi dinga, a beel na sukham pelmawh ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Nek ding an khat tua banga a sianglo beel sungah tui in a buah khak leh a siang lo hi a, tui dawn ding tua bang beel sungah a om khak leh tua tui a siang lo a suak hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua bang ganhing sisa a tukna na khatpeuh a siang lo a suak hi; tua bang thuk ahikeh anbeel pel loin na suksiat ding ahi hi. Tuate a siang lo hi a, a siang lo-a na koih ding uh ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin tuinak ahikeh tuibem kuangzawnte a siang veve hi a, ahi hangin hih ganhing sisate a lawng peuhmah a siang lo ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Ganhing sisa khat a kituh ding khaici tung khatah a kiat leh a sianglai veve hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi hangin a khaici tui-ah a kidiah khitin ganhing sisa tungah a kiat leh no adingin tua khaici a siang lo ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 15:12"},"39":{"text":"\"‘Note nek theih ganhing khatpeuh a sih leh tua a sisa ganhing a lawngkha mi khatpeuh nitak mateng a siang lo hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Ganhing sisa a ne mi khat peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp tektek dinga, nitak mateng amah a siang lo hi ding hi. Tua bang ganhing sisa a tawm peuhmah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga nitak mateng amah a siang lo hi ding hi.","ref":"Sp 17:15; 22:8"},"41":{"text":"\"‘Leitunga a bokvak ganhing peuhmah note adingin a kihhuai hi a; nek loh ding ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Leitungah bokvaka pai ahikeh a awma tal ahikeh kheli-a pai ahikeh khe tampi-a paite ahi zongin na ne kei ding uh hi; tuate kihhuai hi."},"43":{"text":"Hih ganhingte khatpeuhin kibuahsak kei in. Tuate hangin kisiang losak ahikeh tuate hangin nang le nang a siang lo kisuaksak kei in."},"44":{"text":"Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi; keimah siangtho ka hi manin no le no kisiansuahin siangtho un. Leitunga a bokvak ganhing khatpeuh hangin no le no kisiang losak kei un."},"45":{"text":"Keimah note Pasian ahi dingin Egypt pana hong pikhia TOPA ka hi hi; tua ahi manin siangtho un, bang hang hiam cih leh keimah ka siangtho hi.","ref":"Pk 19:6; Sp 19:2"},"46":{"text":"\"‘Hihte in vasate, tui sunga gamta a nungta ganhing khempeuh le leitunga a bokvak a nungta ganhing khempeuh tawh kisai ngeinate ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Note in a nungta ganhingte asiang le asiang lo, a sa nek theih ding le nek theih loh ding na khen ciltel ding uh hi,’ ci un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 10:10"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Nausuah Khita Kisiansuahna"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te tungah: ‘Numei khat gai-a tapa a suah leh khasim a nin neih-a a sian loh bang tektekin ni sagih sung a siang loin kiseh hi."},"3":{"text":"A nigiat ni-in pasalnote a vun ki-atsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in a sisan luanna pan a kisiansuah nadingin ni sawmthum le thum ngak tektek ding hi. Tuanu in a kisiansuahna ni a khen mateng a siangtho na khatpeuh lawng lo dinga, mun siangtho ah a pai kei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in tanu mei a suah leh, a nin neih lai bangin nipi kal nih sung a siang lo hi ding hi. Tua ciangin a si luanna pan siansuah nadingin ni sawmguk le guk sung ngak pelmawh ding hi.","ref":"Pc 17:12; Lk 1:59"},"6":{"text":"\"‘Tapa a nei a tanu a nei zongin a kisiansuahna ni a cin khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a siampipa kiangah meihal biakna dingin kum khat a pha tuuno khat le mawhna hanga biakna dingin kawlvakhu no ahikeh vakhu khat paipih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in tuanu adingin TOPA tungah thoihdamna bawlsak dinga tua ciangin ama sisan luanna panin a siangin kiseh ding hi; hihte in ta numei ahikeh tapasal a suak numei adingin ngeinate ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"\"‘Tuanu in tuuno a neih zawh kei leh vakhu nih ahikeh kawlvakhuno nih khat haltum biak nading, adang khat mawhna hanga biakna dingin a tawi ding hi. Hici bangin siampipa in tuanu adingin thoihdamna bawlsakin, tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 4:26; 5:7"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Kilawhthei Vunnatna tawh Kisai Ngeinate"},"2":{"text":"\"Mi khatpeuh in a vun tungah a kilawh thei vun natna a a suak thei ding a bawk ahikeh a dulh ahikeh a kang liklek a neih leh amah siampipa Aaron ahikeh a tapate b siampite khat tungah a kipaipih pelmawh ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Siampipa in tua vuna meima veel dinga a meima munah mulkang a po-a, meima zong vun sang a thukzaw c ahilam a kilat leh tua in a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi. Siampipa in a veel ciangin amah a siang loin kiseh hi, ci ding hi."},"4":{"text":"A vun meima kanga a vun sanga thukzaw dingin a kilata, a meima sunga mul a kan nai kei leh siampipa in tua cinapa ni sagih sung a tangkoih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A ni sagih ni ciangin siampipa in amah veel dinga a meima kikhel tuan loin a vun ah zong masem tuan lo hi cih a muh leh adang ni sagih sung a tuamin ki-omsak lai ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A ni sagihna ni-in siampipa in veel kik dinga, a meima masem tuan loin a vuai leh siampipa in amah a siang hi, ci-in gen ding hi; tua pen a dulh mawkmawk ahi hi. Mipa in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga tua ciangin amah a siang ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah siampipa tungah kilak a, amah a siang hi, ci-a a kipulak khitin tua a dulh pen a vun tungah a masem leh siampipa tungah pelloin a kilak kik ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Siampipa in amah vel dinga a dulh in a vun tungah ma a sem leh amah siang lo hi, ci-in pulak ding hi; tua in a kilawh thei natna khat ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"\"Mi khatpeuh in a kilawh thei vun natna a vei leh siampipa kiangah kipuak pelmawh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Siampipa in amah veel dinga a vun sungah kangin bawka a multe a kan khita a bawk sungah mathak a om leh,"},"11":{"text":"tua pen vun natna kumlui hi a, siampipa in amah siang lo hi, ci-in a pulak ding hi. Amah a siang losa ahi manin tuam omsak kul lo hi.","ref":"Sp 14:8; Ms 12:10"},"12":{"text":"\"Tua natna a vuntung khempeuh ah a kilawh khit leh siampipa muhna ciangah cinapa a luzang pan a khepek donga vun khempeuh a tuam khit leh,"},"13":{"text":"siampipa in amah veel dinga natna in a pumtuam khin ahileh tua mipa a siang hi, ci-in pulak ding hi. Amah a pumtangin kangkhin ahi nungsang a siang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin ama tungah mathak a kilat peuhpeuh ciangin amah a siang lo ahi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Siampipa in mathak a muh ciangin amah a siang lo ahi hi; amah a kilawh thei natna vei ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua a mathak pen kikhelin a kan leh pel loin siampipa kiangah pai ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siampipa in amah veel dinga, a meima kikhelin a kan leh siampipa in meima vei pen a siang hi, ci-in a pulak ding hi; tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi.","ref":"tg 2,6"},"18":{"text":"\"Mi khatpeuh in vun tungah meimatum vei-in a dama,"},"19":{"text":"a meima-tum veina mun bawkin kanga, ahikeh a sankang a suah leh amah siampipa tungah va kilak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Siampipa in veelsak dinga, vun sahna sanga thukzaw-in, a kilat a, tua sunga a mul a kan khit leh siampipa in amah a siang loin pulak ding hi. Meimatum a omna munah a kitap khit leh a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi hangin siampipa in veelsaka, a sungah mulkang po loin vunsahna sangin thukzaw lo-a, a vuai leh siampipa in amah a tuamin ni sagih sung koih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A vun tung dang a lawh leh siampipa in, amah a siang lo ahi hi, ci-in pulak ding hi; tua pen a kilawh thei ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin masem tuan lo-a, a mundang a lawh tuan kei leh tua in meimatum pawn hi lel a, siampipa in amah a siang hi, ci-in pulak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"\"Mi khatpeuh mei kanga, a katna mathak vun tungah a sankang ahikeh akang liklek a om leh,"},"25":{"text":"siampipa in tua mun etsak dinga, a sunga a multe kang khina, vun sahna sangin thukzaw dinga a kilat leh tua pen meikatna pana kipankhia a kilawh thei natna ahi hi. Siampipa in amah a siang lo ahi hi, ci-in pulak ding hi; tua in a kilawh thei vun natna khat ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin siampipa in a veelsaka a ma-ah a mulkang om loin vun sahna sangin thukzaw lo-a a vuai lel ahileh siampipa in amah ni sagih sung tuam omsak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"A ni sagih ni ciangin siampipa in amah veel kik dinga, a vun dang a lawh leh siampipa in amah a siang lo hi, ci-in pulak ding hi; tua in a kilawh thei vunnatna khat ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin masem tuan lo-a, a vun tungtham a lawh tuan kei leh a dulh lel hi-in a katna pana bawk ahileh siampipa in amah a siangin pulak ding hi; tua pen a katna pana meima pawn lel ahi hi.","ref":"tg 4-5"},"29":{"text":"\"Numei ahikeh pasal khat in a lutang ahikeh a kha ah meima a neih leh"},"30":{"text":"siampipa in a meima veelsak dinga vun sahna sangin thukzaw dingin a kilat-a, a sunga a mul ngatin a naipak mel ahileh siampipa in tua mipa a siang loin pulak ding hi; tua lutang ahikeh kha-a a kilawh thei cithak natna khat ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi hangin siampipa in hih meima namte a veel ciangin vun sahna zah sangin a thukzaw lo ding tawh a kibata, a sungah mulvom a om kei leh siampipa in tua natna nei pen ni sagih sung a tuamin omsak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in meima veelsak dinga, a thak pen in a mundang lawh tuan loin a sungah a mul-naipak a om kei a, vun sahna sangin thukzaw dingin a kilat kei leh"},"33":{"text":"tuapa in a natna mun teng lobuang a mul met dinga siampipa in adang ni sagih a tuamin kem lai ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A ni sagihna ni-in siampipa in a cithak veel dinga a vun dang lawh loin vun sahna sangin thukzaw dinga a kilat leh siampipa in amah a siangin pulak ding hi. Amah in a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah siang hi, ci-a a kipulak khitin a ci thakna in a vun sungah ma a seem leh"},"36":{"text":"siampipa in amah veel dinga a cithakna in a vun sung a lawh khit leh siampipa in a mul naipak a zon ding kisam nawn lo hi; tua mipa a siang lo ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin kikhelna om lo-a, a sungah mulvom po zo hi, ci-a a khentel leh tua cithak a dam khin ahi hi. Amah a siang hi a, siampipa in amah a siangin pulak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"\"Numei khat ahikeh pasal khatin a vun tungah cikang khat a neih ciangin"},"39":{"text":"siampipa in tuate veel dinga, tua mun a kang milmial ahileh, tua pen a lauhuai lo vuntung puakkhamin adulh hi-a, tua mi a siang ahi hi."},"40":{"text":"\"Pasal khat a sam pulhin a lu a tol leh amah a siang ahi hi."},"41":{"text":"Amah a luzang a sam pulh-a, a tal a kolh leh amah a siang hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi hangin a lu kolh-a, ahikeh a taltangah sakang meima a vei leh tua pen a lutung ahikeh a taltanga pokhia a kilawh thei natna ahi hi."},"43":{"text":"Siampipa in amah veel dinga a lutang ahikeh a taltanga meima bawk pen a kilawh thei vun natna tawh kibangin a sankangin a om leh,"},"44":{"text":"tua mi natna vei hi-a, a siang lo ahi hi. A lutanga meima hangin siampipa in a siang loin pulak ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 2:23; Eze 29:18"},"45":{"text":"\"Tua bang a kilawh thei natna a nei mi-in pel loin puansia silh dinga a sam hiatmam a loin, a maitang a nuailam tuamin, ‘Siang lo! Siang lo!’ ci-in a kiko ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua bang natna a vei sung teng amah a siang lo ahi hi. Pel loin amah kia om dinga giahphual pualamah a teng ding hi."},"47":{"text":"\"Puansilh khatpeuh ap in a siatsak leh - samul puan ahikeh saihadial puan khatpeuh,"},"48":{"text":"khau tawh ahikeh samul tawh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan khatpeuh, savun tawh ahikeh savun ahikeh savun tawh a kibawl na khatpeuh -","title":"Ap Thu-a Ngeinate"},"49":{"text":"le puansilh ahikeh savun, ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan nate, ahikeh savun tawh kibawl na khatpeuh a mel eng pian ahikeh san pianin a ap leh pel loin siampipa kilak ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Siampipa in tua ap veel dinga tua a ap na pen ni sagih sung tang koih ding hi."},"51":{"text":"A ni sagihna ni-in tua na veel kik dinga, a ap pen in a puansilh ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan, ahikeh na-a kizang savun pen mundang a lawh leh tua pen a siahuai ap hi a, tua na a siang lo ahi hi."},"52":{"text":"Amah in tua puansilh ahikeh samul tawh ahikeh khau tawh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan na, ahikeh savun kibawl na khatpeuh gial in a sep peuhmah haltum ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua ap pen a siahuai thei hi-a, tua na haltum ding ahi hi.","ref":"Mk 1:44; Sp 14:44"},"53":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin siampipa in a veel ciangin tua ap pen puansilh ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan ahikeh savuna kibawl na a tung daang a lawh kei leh,"},"54":{"text":"amah in tua gial in a sep na pen sawpsak ding hi. Tua ciangin amah in adang ni sagih sung tang koih lai ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Tua na a apna mun a kisawp khit ciangin, siampipa in veel dinga, tua ap in a mel a khek tuan keileh a mundang a lawh loh hangin a siang lo ahi hi. A ap in pang khat ahikeh adang khat a siatsak loh hangin mei-in hal un."},"56":{"text":"Siampipa in tua na a veel ciangin tua na a kisawp khit nungin a apte a vul leh, puansilh ahikeh savun ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan na a siatna mun teng eukhia ding hi."},"57":{"text":"Ahi hangin tua pen puansilh tung ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan na ahikeh savun kibawl na tungah a mundang ah a kilat kik leh tua banga a ap van peuhmah mei-a hal ding ahi hi."},"58":{"text":"Tua puansilh ahikeh a kigan ahikeh a kiphan na, ahikeh savun kibawl na khatpeuh a kisawpsa pen a ap nawn kei leh pel loin kisawp kik dinga tua ciangin a siang hi ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"59":{"text":"Hihte in samul puan ahikeh patpuan a kigan ahikeh a kiphan na, ahikeh savun kibawl na khatpeuh a apna hanga gial in a sepna tawh kisai a siang le a siang lo pulak nading ngeinate ahi hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Kilawhthei Vunnatna pan Sianna"},"2":{"text":"\"Hihte in siampipa mai-ah cinate kipaipihin a kisiansuah hun cianga zat ding ngeinate ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"Giahphual pualam ah siampipa paikhia-in amah veel ding hi. Tua mi a kilawh thei ama vunnatna a a dam khit leh,"},"4":{"text":"mi khat sian nadingin siampipa in a nungta vasa a siang nih leh tamtak sing pawlkhat, a-ausan khau le puknah a lasak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in tua vasate khat, leibeel a tuisiang tungah gosak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in vasa a hing lai pen la dinga, tuisiang tunga kigosa vasa pen sisan sungah tamtak sing, a-ausan khau le puknah tawh diahkhawm ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in tua a kilawh thei natna a vei pen sagih vei theh dinga tua ciangin amah siang hi, ci-in pulak ding hi. Tua ciangin amah in vasa ahing lai pen gamlakah a khah ding hi.","ref":"Mt 8:2-4; Ms 19:6"},"8":{"text":"\"A kisiangsak ding mi pen in pel loin a puan sawpin a mul khempeuh metin tui-in kisil ding hi; tua ciangin amah a siangin kiseh ding hi. Tua teng khit ciangin giahphual sungah lut thei dinga ahi hangin ama puanbuk pua-ah ni sagih sung a om pelmawh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A ni sagihna ni-in a mul khempeuh met pelmawh ding hi; amah in a lu, a khamul, a mitkhu-mul le a mul dang khempeuh met ding hi. Pel loin a puansilhte sawpin kipumsil dinga tua ciangin asiang hi ding hi.","ref":"Sp 11:25; 13:6"},"10":{"text":"\"A nigiat ni-in amah in a sitbaang lo kum khat a pha tuuno apa nih le anu khat, le an-a biakna dingin sathau tawh helsa annel limci ephah b khat sehsawm suah sehthum le sathau bingta c khat tawh a paipih khawm ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in siang hi, ci-a a pulak siampipa in a kisiangsak ding mi le a biaknate Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna TOPA mai-ah a pia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Tua khit ciangin siampipa in tuu-pano khat la dinga sathau bingta khat tawh khialhna biakna-in a piakhawm ding hi; amah in TOPA mai-ah vei-a biakna-in tuate a vei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in tua tuuno, mawhna hanga biakna le meihal biakna gawhna mun siangtho ah a go ding hi. Mawhna hanga biakna mah bangin khialhna hanga biaknate siampite aa hi-a, a siangtho pen ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna sisan pawlkhat la in a kisiangsak ding mi taklam bilhual tung, a taklam khutpi tung le a taklam khepi tungah nuh ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin siampipa in bingta pana sathau la dinga ama veilam khutpek sungah sungin,"},"16":{"text":"a khut sunga sathau lakah a taklam khutme-lai diahin a khutme tawh pawlkhat TOPA mai-ah sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Siampipa in a khutpek sunga a om lai sathau, a kisiangsak ding mi taklam bilhual, a taklam khutpi tung le a taklam khepi tung, khialhna hanga biakna sisan tungah nuh thuah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Siampipa in a khutpek sunga om lai sathau pen a kisiangsak ding mi lutung ah koih dinga ama adingin TOPA tungah thoihdamna a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Pk 29:11"},"19":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin siampipa in, sianlohna pan a kisiangsak ding mi thoihdamna bawlin mawhna hanga biakna a pia ding hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa in meihal biakna go dinga,"},"20":{"text":"an-a biakna tawh biakna-tau tungah piakhawmin ama adingin thoihdamna bawlin, tua ciangin amah a siang ding hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Bangbang ahi zongin amah zawngin hihte a neih zawh keileh amah in a pel loin ama ading thoihdamna bawlna-a vei ding, khialhna hanga biakna adingin tuuno apa khat tawh, an-a biakna dingin annel limci sathau kihelsa ephah d khat sehsawm suah sehkhat, sathau bingta khat tawh,"},"22":{"text":"le ama neih zawh ding vakhu nih ahikeh kawlvakhu nih, mawhna hanga biak nading khat le a khat pen meihal biakna dingin a tawikhawm ding hi.","ref":"Sp 5:7; 12:8"},"23":{"text":"\"A nigiat ni-in amah in a sian nadingin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna TOPA mai-ah siampipa a puak pelmawh ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna dingin tuuno le sathau bingta lakhawm dinga vei-a biakna-in TOPA mai-ah tuate a vei ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in khialhna hanga biakna dingin tuuno go dinga a sisan pawlkhat la-in a kisiangsak ding mi taklam bilhual tung, a taklam khutpi tung le a taklam khepi tungah a nuh ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Siampipa in a veilam khutpek sungah sathau pawlkhat sung dinga,"},"27":{"text":"a taklam khutme-lai tawh a khutpek sunga sathau pawlkhat TOPA mai-ah sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in a khutpek sunga sathau pawlkhat pen khialhna hanga biakna sisan a nuhna mun teng - a kisiangsak ding mi taklam bilhual, a taklam khutpi tung le a taklam khepi tungah a nuhsak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Siampipa in a khutpek sunga a omlai sathaute a kisiangsak ding mipa lutungah nuhsak dinga, TOPA mai-ah thoihdamna a bawlsak ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a kisiangsak ding mi neih zawh bangbang vakhu ahikeh kawl-vakhute biakna-in pia dinga"},"31":{"text":"khat e mawhna hanga biakna, a khat pen meihal biakna-in an-a biakna tawh a piakhawm ding hi. Hici bangin siampipa in a kisiangsak pen tangin TOPA mai-ah thoihdamna a bawlsak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Hihte in a kilawh thei vun natna a vei peuhpeuh, ama sian nadinga biak nading zah a pia zo lo peuhmah kisiansak nading ngeinate ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah,"},"34":{"text":"\"Note neih dinga kong piak Canaan leitang ah na lut uh ciangin tua gama inn khatah ap ka na kaisak leh","title":"Ap pana Siansakna"},"35":{"text":"pel loin a inn neipa siampipa kiangah pai-in, ‘Ka inn sungah apkai tawh kibang khat ka mu hi,’ ci-in gen ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Inn sunga na khatpeuh a siang lo-a a pulak khak loh nadingin siampipa, apkai veel dinga a pai ma-in inn sung a hawma a om nadingin thu a pia ding hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa a sungah lutin veel ding hi."},"37":{"text":"Amah in kawm tunga apkai veel dinga, a-eng pian ahikeh asan pianin ne kuaka, a kawm maitang sahna sangin thuk bunzaw-a, a kilat leh,"},"38":{"text":"inn pua-ah siampipa paikhia dinga ni sagih sung tua inn kongkhak a khakcip ding hi."},"39":{"text":"A ni sagih ni-in siampipa in tua inn veel kik ding hi. A apkai pen in kawm tung dang a lawh leh,"},"40":{"text":"amah in gial in a sepsa suangtumte kalkhia-in khuanawl a siang lo mun khatah paisak ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amah in kawm sunglam khempeuh kiatkhiasak tektek dinga, tua a kikiatkhia a zutna themte, khuapua a sianglo mun khatah buasak ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in hihte suang dangin laih ding uh a, buan thak la-in inn a zut ding uh hi."},"43":{"text":"\"Tua inn a, a apkai suangte kilaihkhia a, kikiatkhia in a kizut thak nungin tua inn ah apkai a kilat kik leh,"},"44":{"text":"siampipa pai-in veel dinga, a inn sungteng apkai in a zelh leh a siasak thei apkai hi-a, a inn a siang lo ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Pel loin tua inn - a suangte, a singte le a zutnate phelkhia-in khuapua a sianglo mun khatah kinawnkhia ding hi.","ref":"Sp 13:51"},"46":{"text":"\"Tua inn a kikhakcip laitaka a sunga lut peuhmah a nitak dong a siang lo hi ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua inn sunga a lum ahikeh an ne peuhmah in pel loin a puansilhte uh a sawp ding uh hi."},"48":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin siampipa a veel dingin pai-a, a kizut kik zawhin a apkai in mundang a lawh kei leh apkai om nawn lo ahi manin amah in tua inn a siang hi, ci-in a pulak ding hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua inn siansuah nadingin amah in vasa nih le tamtak sing pawlkhat, khau ausan le puknahte a tawi ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Amah in vasa khat leibeel sunga kikoih tuisiang tungah a go ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciangin tamtak sing, puknah, khau ausan le vasa a hing lai pen la-in tuate a sisa vasa sisan le tui siang sungah diahin tua inn sung sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Amah in vasa sisan, tuisiang, vasa a hinglai pen, tamtak sing, puknah le khau ausan-te in tua inn a siansuah ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in vasa a hing lai pen khuapua gamlakah khah ding hi. Hici bangin inn adingin thoihdamna bawl dinga tua ciangin a siang ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 13:6; Ph 51:7"},"54":{"text":"Hihte in, a kilawh thei vun natna khatpeuh, cithak,"},"55":{"text":"puansilh ahikeh inn tunga ap a kai ciang"},"56":{"text":"le a bawk a dulh ahikeh vuntung kang liklek-te tawh kisai"},"57":{"text":"a siang le a siang lo ettel cianga zat ding ngeinate ahi hi. Hihte in a kilawh thei vunnatnate le a apkai tawh kisai ngeinate ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 13:2,47-52"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Siantholohna Piangsak Apawtkhiate"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te hopih unla amaute tungah: ‘Pasal khatpeuh in a pumpi panin a pawtkhia a neih leh tua a pawtkhia a siang lo ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A pumpi panin a luang den ahikeh a kang zel zongin tua in amah a siang lo a suaksak hi. Hih in amah pana pawt, a siang lo na in amah a sianlohsak zia ahi hi:"},"4":{"text":"\"‘A natui a pawt mipa lupna a sianglo hi dinga ama tutna na khatpeuh asianglo hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama lupna a lawng peuhmah in a puansilhte sawpin tui-in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A na tui pawt mipa tutna na khatpeuh tunga a tu peuhpeuh in a puansilhte sawpin tui in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng amah asianglo hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"\"‘A pawtkhia a nei mipa a lawngkha peuhmah in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin, tui-in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng asianglo ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"\"‘A natui pawt mipa in mi khatpeuh a cil a phih leh tua mipa in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin, tui-in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng a siang lo hi ding hi.","ref":"Ms 12:14"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Tua mipa a tuanna-a a tutna na khempeuh asianglo hi dinga"},"10":{"text":"ama nuai-a a tutna a lawng peuhmah nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi; tua nate a tawm peuhmah in pel loin a puansilhte sawp dinga tui-in kipumsilin a nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi."},"11":{"text":"\"‘A natui a pawt mipa in a khut silsiang sinsen lopi-in a lawn khak mi peuhmah in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin tui-in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi."},"12":{"text":"\"‘Tua mipa in a lawnkhak leibeel kisukham dinga, singa kibawl na khatpeuh ahileh tui-in kisilsiang kiuhkeuh ding hi.","ref":"Sp 6:28"},"13":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat a natui pawtna pan a kisiansak ciangin, ama sian nadingin ni sagih simto ding hi; amah in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin tui siangin kisil dinga; tua ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A nigiat ni-in amah in pel loin vakhu nih ahikeh kawl-vakhu nih tawi-in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna TOPA mai-ah pai-in tuate siampipa a pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Siampipa in tuate khat mawhna hanga biakna le a khat pen meihal biakna-in pia ding hi. Hici bangin amah in mipa a natui pawtna hangin TOPA mai-ah thoihdamna a bawlsak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 8:33; 14:18-19"},"16":{"text":"\"‘Pasal khatpeuh in a bawtui a teh ciangin tui-in a pumtung khempeuh pumsil pelmawh dinga a nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A bawtui banna puansilh ahikeh savun pel loin tui tawh kisawp dinga, tua pen nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Pasal khat numei khat tawh lumkhawma a bawtui a teh ciangin pel loin amaute gel tui-in kipumsil ding uh a, nitak mateng asianglo hi ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"\"‘Numei khat in a neih ngei sisan a luan ciangin a khasima a nit hun ni sagih sung hi dinga amah a lawngkha peuhmah nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"\"‘A hunin a phak sungteng, a lupna na peuhmah le a tutna nate peuhmah asianglo hi ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ama lupna a lawngkha peuhmah in a puansilh sawpin tui-in kipumsil dinga, a nitak mateng tuapa asianglo hi ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama tutna na khatpeuh a sukha peuhmah in pel loin a puansilh sawpin tui-in kipumsil dinga a nitak mateng tuapa a sianglo hi ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A lupna ahikeh a tutna khatzawsang, mi khatpeuh in a sukkhak ciangin a nitak mateng tuapa a sianglo hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"\"‘Pasal khat in tuanu a luppih a tuanu khasim nin in amah a sukkhak leh tuapa ni sagih sung asianglo hi a; tuapa lupna khatpeuh zong asianglo ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"\"‘Numei khat ama khasim nin neih hun sangin ni tampi sung sisan luang ahikeh a nin neih hun ngeina sanga sawtzaw a neih leh a nin neih hun nite bang tektekin a nin kizoma a pai laisiah amah asianglo hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A nin neih hun sunga mah bangin nin neih a kizop hun sungteng a lupna a sianglo hi dinga, a nin neih hun sung mah bangin a tutna na khatpeuh asianglo hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuate a lawng peuhmah a sianglo hi dinga; tuapa in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin tui-in kisil dinga, nitak mateng asianglo hi ding hi.","ref":"Mt 9:20"},"28":{"text":"\"‘Tuanu ama nin neihna pan a sian zawh ni sagih ciangin asiangin a kiseh ding hi."},"29":{"text":"A nigiat ni-in tuanu in pel loin vakhu nih ahikeh kawl-vakhu nih tawi dinga, tuate Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a siampipa tungah a paipih ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Siampipa in khat mawhna hanga biakna le a khat meihal biakna-in a pia ding hi. Hici bangin amah in tuanu nin neihna hanga sianlohna tang dingin TOPA mai-ah thoihdamna a bawlsak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 14:22"},"31":{"text":"\"‘Note in, amaute laka ka tenna mun a buahsakin a siantholohna pana a sih loh nadingun amaute a sianglosak ding nate panin Israel mite na tuam koih pelmawh ding uh hi,’\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 19:13,20, Eze 5:11"},"32":{"text":"Hihte in, bawtui pawt pasal, a bawtui teh-a asianglo a suak khatpeuh ading,"},"33":{"text":"numei khat in a khasim nin neih hun sung ading, a natui a pawt numei ahikeh pasal ading, le a siang lo numei tawh a lumkhawm mipa adingin ngeinate ahi hi.","ref":"tg 2"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron tapa nihte in TOPA naiha a sih khit nungun TOPA in Moses a hopih hi.","title":"Thoihdamna Ni"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah: \"Na sanggampa Aaron, singkuangpi tunga om thoihdamna sin mai, puanzak liah, Mun Siangtho Pen sungah a ut hunhuna, a lut loh nadingin gen in; tua hi kei leh amah si ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua thoihdamna sin tunga meiipi sungah kei ka kilang hi.","ref":"Pk 25:22; Sp 10:1"},"3":{"text":"\"Mun siangtho huang sunga Aaron lut nading zia hih bang ahi hi: Mawhna hanga biak nading bawngtalno khat le meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat a keng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Saihadial puantungsilh siangtho silhin a pumpi tungah saihadial puan sungsilhte silh dinga, saihadial puan kawnggak tawh gakin saihadial puan khim ding hi. Hihte pen puansilh siangtho ahi hi; tua ahi ciangin hihte a silh ma-in a kipumsil pelmawh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel mipite panin mawhna hanga biak nading keeltal nih le meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat a keng ding hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Aaron in ama mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal pia dinga, amah le a innkuanpihte adingin thoihdamna a bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin keel nihte la dinga Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna TOPA mai-ah pia ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in keel nihte tungah aisan dinga - ai khat TOPA ading hi-in a khat pen mawhpua keel b ading ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Aaron in TOPA adingin ai a tukna keel pen paipihin mawhna hanga biak nadingin a pia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin mawh pua keel adingin ai a tukna pen mawhpua keelin gam sungah khahkhiatna tawh thoihdamna bawl nadingin TOPA mai-ah a hingin kipia ding hi.","ref":"Sp 9:7; Heb 7:27; 9:7,12"},"11":{"text":"\"Aaron in ama mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal pia dinga, amahmah le a innkuanpihte ading thoihdamna bawlin ama mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal a go ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in TOPA mai biakna-tau panin mei-am a dim gim namtui beel le hoihtaka kigawi vui a namtui mahmah gimnamtui khut dim nih la-in puanzak nungah a paipih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in TOPA mai-ah tua gim namtui mei tungah buak dinga, amah a sih loh nadingin tua gimnamtui khu in Tecipanna tung sana thoihdamna sin a khuut ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in bawngtal sisan pawlkhat la-in a khutme tawh thoihdamna sin mai theh ding hi; tua ciangin pawlkhat a khutme-in la dinga thoihdamna sin mai sagih vei a theh ding hi.","ref":"Sp 10:1; Heb 9:7,13,25"},"15":{"text":"\"Tua khit ciangin amah in mipite mawhna hanga biakna-in tua keel go dinga a sisan puanzak nungah paipih in bawngtal sisan tawh a hih bangin tua tawh a hih ding hi: Amah in thoihdamna mai le a sin tung theh ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel-te sianlohna le a lehdonate uh - a bawlsa uh mawhnate hangin hici bangin Mun Siangtho Pen adingin thoihdamna a bawl ding hi. Amah in amaute siantholohna laizanga amaute laka Kikhopna Puanbuk adingin zong hici bang mahin a hih ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mun Siangtho Pen sungah thoihdamna bawl dinga Aaron a luta kipan, ama ading, a innkuante ading le Israel mihon buppi adingin thoihdamna bawl manta-a a pai khiat mateng tua Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah kuamah a om kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 29:36"},"18":{"text":"\"Tua khit ciangin amah TOPA mai-a biakna-tau pan paikhia-in tua adingin thoihdamna a bawl ding hi. Amah in bawngtal sisan le keel sisan pawlkhat la-in biakna-tau kite khempeuh a nuh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in Israel-te sianlohna pan tua biakna-tau siansuah a, ap nadingin a khutme tawh sisan sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"\"Aaron in Mun Siangtho Pen, Kikhopna Puanbuk le biakna-taute thoihdamna bawl a man ciangin tua keel a hinglai pen a paikhiatpih ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in tua a hinglai keel lutungah a khut gel nga dinga, Israel-te gitlohna le a lehdonate khempeuh uh - amaute mawhna khempeuh tua keel lutungah a suan ding hi. Amah in hih nasem dinga a seh mi khat khut tungah tua keel gam sungah a khahmang ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua keel in amaute mawhna khempeuh pua-in gam simtham ah a paipih ding hi; tuaci-in mipa in gamlak ah a khah ding hi.","ref":"Sp 5:5; Isa 53:12"},"23":{"text":"\"Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk sungah Aaron lut dinga, Mun Siangtho Pen sunga a lut ma-in a puansilh saihadial puante suahkhia-in tua munah nusia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah mun siangtho khatah tui-in kipumsil dinga ama puansilh ngeite a silh ding hi. Tua ciangin amah paikhia dinga, amah le mipite thoihdamna bawlna-in ama ading meihal biakna le mipite ading meihal biakna amah mah in a pia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in biakna-tau tungah mawhna hanga biakna thau zong a hal ding hi.","ref":"Eze 42:14; 44:19"},"26":{"text":"\"Tua mawhpua keel-a keel khat a khahpa in pel loin a puansilhte sawpin tui-in kipumsil ding hi; tua khit ciangin a giahphual sungah tum thei pan ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Thoihdamna bawl nadinga Mun Siangtho Pen sunga a sisan kipaipih tua mawhna hanga biakna bawngtal le keel, pel loin giahphual pua-ah kipaikhiatpih ding hi; tuate vunte, a satak le a ekte kihaltum ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tuate a halte in pel loin a puante uh sawpin tui-in a kipumsil ding uh hi; tua khit ciangin giahphual sungah tum thei pan ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"\"Hih in note adingin tawntung thuzek hi ding hi: A kha sagihna a nisawm ni-in note - tualsuak na hi uh a, no lak a teng pemta mi khatpeuh ahi zongin no le no a kidekin bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi. -"},"30":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh tua ni-in na sian nadingun note ading thoihdamna kibawl ding hi. Tua ciangin TOPA mai-ah note na mawhna khempeuh panun na siang ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua in Sabbath khawlni hi-a, no le no na kidek pelmawh ding uh hi; tua in a kipden thuzek khat ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"A pa za laih dingin tulpi dinga sathau kinilh a, kipsakna kipiapa in thoihdamna a bawl ding hi. Amah in a siangtho saihadial puan silhin"},"33":{"text":"Mun Siangtho Pen ading, Kikhopna Puanbuk ading, le biakna-tau ading le siampite ading le mipite khempeuh adingin thoihdamna a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Ms 29:7; Eph 5:26"},"34":{"text":"\"Hih in note adingin a kip den thuzek hi ding hi. Israel mite khempeuh mawhna tangin kum khatin thoihdamna khatvei kibawl ding hi;\" a ci hi. Tua hi a, tua pen TOPA in Moses a thupiak banga kihih ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 9:7,25; Sp 23:26-32"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Sisan Nek Kikham"},"2":{"text":"\"Aaron le a tapate le Israel-te khempeuh tungah gen inla, amaute tungah, ‘Hih in TOPA hong thu piaksa ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"Israel-te khatpeuh in TOPA biakbuk mai-a TOPA tungah biakpiakna khat ahi dingin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah bawngtal b , tuuno ahikeh keel biakna-in"},"4":{"text":"a piak sangsik in giahphual sung ahikeh giahphual pua-ah biakna a piak leh sisan a luangsak khialhna-in kisim ding hi; amah sisan luangsak khin hi-a, a mite panin pel lo kikhenkhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Israel-te in gamlak peuha biakna a piakte uh TOPA mai-ah hong paipih nading uh hih bang ahi hi. Amaute in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a TOPA tung ahi, siampipa tungah paipihin kilawmtakna biakna-in c tuate a pia ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampipa in Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a TOPA biakna-tau ah tua sisan theh dinga a thau pen TOPA lungkimsak gimnamtui-in a hal ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in a kizuakna uh keel limte d tungah a biakpiaknate uh a pia nawn peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Amah na tapa zi ahi hi; amah luppih kei in.","ref":"Sp 20:12"},"16":{"text":"\"‘Na sanggampa zi luppih kei in; tua in na sanggampa selpho ding hi."},"17":{"text":"\"‘Nuta khat a tanu tawh luppih khawm kei in.
