Tua in note adingin Jubilee ahi hi; note khatpeuh innkuante neihsa le amau beh ciatah a ciah ciat ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"A kum sawmngana kum note adingin Jubilee hi ding hi; lo pawi kei unla ama thu-a po ante panin la loin na cin loh uh lenggui panin lo kei un."},"12":{"text":"Ahang in, Jubilee khat hi a, no adingin a siangtho hi ding hi, lolai pana kila tektekte bek ne un.","ref":"Jer 34:8,15,17; Lk 4:19"},"13":{"text":"\"‘Hih Jubilee kumin a kuamahpeuh amau gam ciatah a ciah ciat ding uh hi.","ref":"tg 10"},"14":{"text":"\"‘Na gamsung mi khat tungah leitang na zuak ahikeh na lei leh, khat le khat hamphat na kituh kei un."},"15":{"text":"Na gamsung mi khatpeuh tung panin na lei leh Jubilee kum pan a kum phazah tuatin na lei ding hi. Amah in zong an kum bangzah kila thei lai ding hiam cih tuatin nang hong zuak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"A kum a tam ciangin aman na khangsak dinga, a kum a tawm ciangin aman na khiam ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nang hong zuak taktak pen a an kila ding zah hizaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Khat le khat hamphat kituh loin na Pasian uh kihta zaw un. Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi.","ref":"Sp 19:14,32"},"18":{"text":"\"‘Ka thukipte zui unla, ka thukhamte limtakin mang un, tua hileh na gamuah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitang in gah gahkhia in gilvahtakin na ne ding uh a, tua lai-ah lungmuang takin na teng ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Nang, \"Lo pawi loin i ante la kei lehang a kum sagihna kumin bang i ne ding hiam?\" ci-in nong dong thei hi."},"21":{"text":"Keimah in kum thum sung nek khop ding a kum gukna kumin leitang in gah a gah nadingin thupha kong puak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A kum giatna na pawi laitakun kumlui-a ante na ne ding uh a, a kum kuana anlak hun dong na khom ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 26:10"},"23":{"text":"\"‘Neih den dingin tua leitang na zuak kei ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tua leitang kei aa hi a, note pemta, lo khawhlawhte na hi uh hi."},"24":{"text":"No neihsa banga na let uh leitang khempeuh ah leitang tatna na bawl pelmawh ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 23:4"},"25":{"text":"\"‘Note gammi khat zawngin a neihsa pawlkhat a zuak leh ama kitanaupih penpen pai-in tua gammipa zuaksate a tan ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin tua mipa in a tatsak ding mi a neih kei a, amah hau kikin a tan zo dingin a om leh"},"27":{"text":"a zuak nung kum phazah tuatin a man ding kiciangtan dinga, a val laiteng a zuaknapa tungah a kipia kik ding hi; tua ciangin ama neihsa leitang nei kik thei ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah in a loh nading acing a neih zawh kei leh tua a mun zuaksa pen a leipa khutah Jubilee Kum dong a om ding hi. Jubilee ciangin amah kipia kik dinga, tua ciangin amah ama munah a ciah kik thei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat in kulha ki-um khuapi sungah inn a zuak leh, a zuak nung kum khat sung a tat kik theih nading thu a nei hi. Tua hun sungin tankik thei hi."},"30":{"text":"Kum khat hul sungin a tat kik kei leh tua kulha ki-um khuapi sunga inn pen a leipa le ama suante in a tangden ding uh hi. Tua pen Jubilee hun ciangin kipia kik lo ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi hangin kulha ki-um lo khua neute-a innte ahileh gamsung banga kingaihsun ahi hi. Tuate kitan kik thei dinga, Jubilee ciangin kipia kik ding hi."},"32":{"text":"\"‘Levi-te in amau Levi khuapi sunga amau neihsa innte a tawntungin tat kik theihna thu a nei uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tuaci-in Levi-te neihsa kitan thei hi - tua pen, amau let khuapi sunga inn khatpeuh hi a - Jubilee cianga piak kik ding ahi hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Levi-te khuapi sunga innte pen Israel-te laka amau neihsa ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi hangin amau khuapi gantatna gam a kizuak peuhmah kei ding hi; amau neihden ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 35:1-8"},"35":{"text":"\"‘Na gamsung mi uh no laka teng khat zawngin a kivak zawh kei leh, no lakah a tensuak theih nadingin, pemtate ahikeh hong tam pakte na huh ding bangun huh un."},"36":{"text":"Ama tung panin a met a bangmah la kei un. Tua sangsikin na gammipa no lakah a tensuak theih nadingin Pasian kihtazaw un."},"37":{"text":"A metin sum na leitawi kei dinga, a metin an na zuak kei ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Keimah TOPA note Pasian, Canaan gam hong pia-in note Pasian ahi dingin Egypt pana hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi."},"39":{"text":"\"‘Note lakah gammi khat zawngin note tungah hong kizuak leh sila bangin na semsak kei un."},"40":{"text":"Amah nasema kicial bang ahikeh no laka inn hong nei pakte bangin na bawl ding uh hi; Jubilee Kum a tun mateng na na uh a sem ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin amah le a tate kisuaktasak dinga, amah a behte lakah ciak kikin a pupa gamah a ciah kik ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt pana kong paikhiatpih Israel-te ka nasemte ahi hi; amaute sila-in a kizuak peuhmah kei ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Amaute ngong uk loin na Pasian uh kihta zaw un."},"44":{"text":"\"‘Na sila numei le pasalte uh note kima minamte pan ahi uh hi; amaute panin sila na lei thei uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Note in no laka hong teng pakte le no gam sunga suak amau behte na lei thei ding uh a, amaute no neihsa suak ding uh hi."},"46":{"text":"Note in amaute na tate uh gou na luahsak thei uh a khantawn sila in lah na koih thei uh hi. Ahi hangin na Israel mipihte uh tungah ngong uk kei un."},"47":{"text":"\"‘Note laka teng pak khat ahikeh pemta khat hau-a, no gammi khat a zawna no laka teng pemta khat ahikeh pemta beh a mi khat tungah a kizuak leh"},"48":{"text":"amahmah a kizuak khitin amah kitankhia kik thei ding hi. Ama tanau khat in amah tan thei hi:"},"49":{"text":"A pa sanggampa ahikeh a pa sanggampa tapa ahikeh ama beh sunga sisan a kinaipih khatpeuh in amah tan thei ding hi; tua hi loin amah a hauh leh amah le amah kitan thei ding hi."},"50":{"text":"Amah le amah a leipa in amah a kizuak kuma kipan Jubilee Kum dong a hun tuat ding uh hi. Amah a kikhahkhiat nading sum pen, tua kum sungteng a kicial mipa thaman bulphuhin kituat hi ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Kum tampi in a sap lai leh ama kitatna man ding zah sanga tamzaw a pia ding hi."},"52":{"text":"Jubilee Kum ma kum tawmno in a sap lai leh tua pen tuat khia in a kitatna sum ding a pia ding hi."},"53":{"text":"Amah pen a kumkuma kicialtawm mite banga bawl ding ahi hi; amah a neipa in amah a ngong uk ding na vil pelmawh ding hi."},"54":{"text":"\"‘Hici bang zia-in amah a kitat kei leh zong, Jubilee Kum in amah le a tate a kikhahkhia ding hi;"},"55":{"text":"ahang in, Israel-te pen keima nasem bang ahi hi. Amaute Egypt pana ka paikhiatpih ka nasemte ahi uh hi. Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"1 \"’Milim ahikeh lim khat ahikeh suang siangtho khatpeuh bawltawm loin amai-ah kuna na biak dingun suang kikhuak zong phut kei un. Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi.","title":"Thuman’na Hanga Pahtakman","ref":"Pk 20:4; Tp 5:8"},"2":{"text":"\"‘Ka Sabbath-te tang unla ka munsiangtho zahtak un. Keimah TOPA ka hi hi.","ref":"Sp 19:30"},"3":{"text":"\"‘Note in ka thukipte zui-a kong thu piakte limtaka na man uh leh,"},"4":{"text":"a hunin guah kong puak dinga, leitang in gah gahin lo sunga singkungte a gah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Na buh cil hun uh lenggah lawh hun tawh kizomsuakin, lenggah lawh hun pen lo pawi hun tawh kizomsuak dinga, an na duh peuhpeuh ne-in na gam sunguah lungnuamtakin na ne ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 25:18; Tp 28:1,9"},"6":{"text":"Gamsung kong kilemsak dinga kuamah in hong lauthawngsak loin na lum hithiat ding uh hi. Keimah in gamsung panin gamsa gilote ka nawhkhia dinga, na gamsung uh namsau in a nawkkha kei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na galte uh na delh ding uh a, note mai-ah namsau ma-in a tuk ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Note nga in za khat na delh ding uh a, za khat in tulsawm delhin na mai uah na galte uh namsau in a puk ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 29:11"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Note hong angvanin kong cing dinga, hong ciphasakin kong khangsak dinga note tawh ka thukhun ka kiplet ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Anthak kep nadingin anlui na kepkhiat dongun kumlui an na ne ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Note lakah ka omna mun b ka koih dinga note kong kih kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Note lakah vakin na Pasian uh ka hi dinga, note ka mi na hi ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Keimah TOPA note Pasian, Egypt-te sila a suak nawn lo dingin Egypt pana hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi; na hakkolte uh ka kuaitan-a, ngawng tangsa in kong pai theisak hi.","ref":"Pc 17:6; 2Co 6:16"},"14":{"text":"\"‘Note in ka thu mang loin hih ka thupiakte khempeuh na puaseh uh a,"},"15":{"text":"ka thukipte niala, ka thukhamte kihin, ka thupiakte na puaseh uh a, tua ciangin ka thukhunte na palsat uh leh","title":"Thuman’ lohna hanga Gawtna"},"16":{"text":"note tungah hihte ka tungsak ding hi: Note tungah patauhna, hong vattum ding cinatnate le na khuamuhna uh siasakin na nuntakna uh a khitkang ding cisa natna kong tungsak ding hi. Lo na pawi uh hangin a mawkna hi ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh na galte un a ne ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Na galte un hong zawh nadingun kong maigumsan ding hi; no hong mudahte in hong uk ding uh a, kuama delh lohpi-in na taikek ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"\"‘Hihte khempeuh nungin ka thu nong man kei lailai uh leh na mawhna uh hangin sagih vei dan kong tuaksak beh lai ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na lungkhauh kisak theihna uh ka sumang dinga, na tungua van sik tawh kibangin na nuai-ua lei sumsan ka bangsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Na hatna uh a mawkna-in kizang ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh na leitang hoihte un gah gah loin gam sunga singte a gah kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"\"‘Kei nong langbawl lailai uh a, ka thu nong man nop kei uh leh na mawhnate uh tawh kituakin na thuaknate uh a zah sagih valin ka sahsak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Gamsa gilote kong dosak dinga na tate uh hong tuahsakin na ganhonte uh ne ding uh a, note tawm mahmah in na lampite uh gamkhing a suak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"\"’Hih bang teng hi napi kong thuhilhna na man nop kei uh a nong langbawl lailai uh leh"},"24":{"text":"kei mahmah in note kong langbawl dinga, na mawhnate uh hangin a zah sagih valin kong thuaksak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thukhunte na palsatna uh pulakna-in note tungah namsau kong tungsak ding hi. Note khuapi sungah na nung kik uh ciangin note lakah pulpi kong tungsak dinga, na galte uh khut sungah hong kipia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Anlum hong puakte ka khaktan ciangin numei sawm in thuk khatah anlum em thei ding uh a, teh tektekin a hawm ciipciip ding uh hi. Na ne ding uh a ahi hangin na kham zo kei ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"\"’Hih bang teng hi napi ka thu hong mang lo lai-in kei nong langneih lailai uh leh"},"28":{"text":"tua ciangin ka heh dinga note hong langneihin kei mahmah in note na mawhna uh hangin a zah sagih vei val dan kong tuaksak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in na tanute na tapate uh sa na ne ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Na munsangte uh ka susia dinga, na gimnamtui biakna-taute uh phuk-in, nuntakna a nei lo na milimte uh tungah na luangte uh ka vumsak dinga note kong kih ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Na khuapite uh ka susiamang dinga, na munsiangthote uh a mawkna suaksakin, na biaknate uah lungkimna ka nei kei ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Na leitang uh a mawkna ka suaksak dinga tua lai-a tung na galte nangawn uh a mulkim ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Minamte lakah note kong thehthang dinga, ka namsau dokin note kong delh ding hi. Na gam uh kimawk nusiat dinga na khuapi uh a kisia dikdek ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin na gam uh a kinusiat hun sungteng le na galte uh gam sunga na om hun sungteng uh sabbath kumin tang dinga, nuam a sa ding hi. Tua ciangin leitang tawlnga-in sabbath nuam a sa ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Gam in ama tunga na ten lai-ua na ngahsak loh uh tawlngakna sabbath hunte khempeuh gamkhinga a om sungin a ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 4:27; Ph 74:3-7; Jer 9:11"},"36":{"text":"\"’Note lak pana kinusiakhate ahileh amaute galte leitang ah a lungsim uh ka lauthawngsak mahmah dinga, nahteh huih muta gingin a maute a taisak ding hi. Amaute kuama delh lohpi-in namsau kihta a tai bangin tai ding uh a, a puk ding uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amaute kuamah in delh lo napi namsau kihta a tai bangin khat le khat a kiphupai ding uh hi. Tua bangin na galte uh mai-ah na nang thei kei ding uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Minamte lakah na mangthang ding uh hi; na galte uh leitang in no hong nawmvalh ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Note sung pan galte leitanga omlaite amau mawhna hangin beimang ding uh hi; amau pate mawhna hangin zong amaute beimang ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin amaute in amau mawhna le a pate uh mawhnate a pulak uh leh - amaute, kei langah a zuautatnate uh, kei langa hong langneihnate uh -"},"41":{"text":"amaute a galte uh leitanga ka puak theih nadinga amaute hong langneihsaknate - tua ciangin vun at loh amaute lungsim panin kiniamkhiat-a, a mawhna man uh a piak uh ciangin"},"42":{"text":"Jacob tawh ka thukhun, Isaac tawh ka thukhun, Abraham tawh ka thukhun, ka phawk gige dinga a leitang zong ka phawk gige ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Ahang in, amaute in a gam uh nusia ding uh a, amaute teng loin gamkhinga a om sungin a gam in sabbath-te a tang ahi hi. Amaute in a mawhna man uh a pia ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thukhamte nial uh a ka thukipte a kih zo uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua hi napi in amaute in a galte uh leitanga a om sung nangawnun amaute susiamang ding zahin amaute nial lo kih loin amaute tawh ka thukhun ka pelh kei hi. Keimah TOPA amaute Pasian ka hi hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute Pasian ahi dingin, minamte muhin Egypt pan ka paikhiatpih-a, a pu a pate uh tawh ka thukhun ka phawk gige hi. Keimah TOPA ka hi hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi."},"46":{"text":"Hihte pen TOPA in Moses tawna amah le Israel-te kikala a kipsak thukipte, thukhamte le zuih ding ngeinate ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 7:38; 27:34"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Aate Tatna"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te hopih inla amaute tungah: ‘Mi khatpeuh in TOPA tungah a ki-apsa a kituak zah piak dinga a tuam mahmah in kiciamna a bawla,"},"3":{"text":"tua mipa kum sawmnih le kum sawmguk kikal a upa ahileh mun siangtho shekel a tawh kizui-in nguntang shekel b sawmnga a pia ding hi;"},"4":{"text":"tua ciangin numei ahileh a man dingin shekel c sawmthumin seh in."},"5":{"text":"Tua mi kum nga le kum sawmnih kikal ahileh pasal aitang dingin shekel a sawmnih seh inla numei aitang dingin shekel b sawm seh in."},"6":{"text":"A mi kha khat le kum nga kikal a upa ahileh pasal aitang dingin ngun shekel c nga le numei ahileh ngun shekel d thum seh in."},"7":{"text":"Tua mi kum sawmguk pan a tungsiah ahileh pasal aitang dingin shekel e sawm le nga seh inla numei aitang dingin shekel sawm seh in."},"8":{"text":"A kiciam mipa a kiseh zah pia zo lo dingin a zawn luat leh siampipa kiangah tua mipa kipaipih dinga amah in a piak zawh dinga a kiciamna zah tawh kizui-in a piak zah ding a ciangtansak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 30:13; Ms 18:16"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Ama kiciamna ganhing khat ahileh tua pen TOPA tunga biakna dingin kisang thei a, tua bangin TOPA tunga kipia ganhing a siangtho a suak hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in a ganhing laih ahikeh a hoih lo tangin a hoih, ahikeh a hoih tangin a hoih loin a khek peuhmah kei ding hi; amah in ganhing khat tangin adang khat piak teitei a kul leh a tanga a piak pen tawh a nihin a siangtho a suak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Piak dinga a ciam pen a sianglo ganhing - TOPA tungah biakna-a a kisang thei lote ahileh - siampipa tungah a ganhing kipia dinga,"},"12":{"text":"amah in a hoihna le a hoih lohna tawh kizui-in a seh ding hi. Siampipa in aman a seh zah peuhpeuh aman hipah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"A neipa in a gan a tat nop leh aman zah tungah aman zah sehnga suah sehkhat behlap ding hi."},"14":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat in TOPA tungah a siangtho na-in a inn a ap leh siampipa in a hoihna ahikeh a siatna - a ginatna khen ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa sehna bangbang a kizang hi pah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi khat in a apsa a inn a tat kik nop leh amah in a inn man zah sehnga suah sehkhat piakbeh dinga, tua inn ama aa suak kik ding hi.","ref":"tg 13,20"},"16":{"text":"\"Mi khat in a innkuan leitang uh TOPA tungah a ap nop leh a sunga an piangzah tuatin aman kiseh ding hi - mangbuh-ham ci homer f khat in ngun shekel sawmnga man hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in Jubilee Kum hun laitakin a lo a ap leh a ma-a kisehsa mah kimangpah ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jubilee khitin a lo a ap leh, siampipa in Jubilee kum kik tawh kikal a kum phazah tuatin aman seh dinga, aman-a a seh zah kikhiam ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Lo ap mipa in a tat kik nop leh aman zah sehnga suah sehkhat behlap pelmawh dinga, a lo ama aa suak kik ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin a lo a tan kik lo ahikeh mi khatpeuh tungah a zuak khit leh a kitan kik thei nawn kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua logam Jubilee sunga a kipiakkhiat ciangin TOPA tunga ki-apsa lo mah bangin a siangtho a suak hi; tua pen siampite g aa hi ding hi.","ref":"Ms 18:14"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat in amau innkuan leitang ahi lo a leisa lo khat TOPA tungah a ap kik leh,"},"23":{"text":"siampipa in Jubilee Kum dong aman tuat dinga tua mipa in tua ni mah in a kiseh a man zah TOPA tungah a siangtho-in a pia tektek ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Jubilee Kum sungin a lo pen a leina lo nei mipa tungah kitungsak kik ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Na man peuhmah mun siangtho shekel tawh kizui-in kiseh ding hi; gerah sawmnih shekel khat ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"\"’Bangbang ahi zongin tacil peuhmah TOPA aa ahi khit nungsangin ganhing tacil peuhmah tua bangin a ki-ap thei kei ding hi; bawngtal h ahi a tuu ahi zongin TOPA aa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"A sianglo ganhing khat ahileh aman kiseh zah ah aman zah sehnga suah sehkhat behlapin lei kik thei ding hi. A tat kik kei leh aman kiseh zahin kizuak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 13:2,12"},"28":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin mi khatin bangmah a neih kei a, TOPA tungah a kipumpiak i leh mihing ahikeh ganhing ahikeh innkuan leitang - kizuak ahikeh kitan thei ding hi; tua banga kipumpiak na peuhmah TOPA adingin a siangtho pen ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 6:17-19"},"29":{"text":"\"‘Mihing tua banga suksiat mang j dinga kipum-apsa pen kitan thei lo dinga; pel loin kithat ding hi."},"30":{"text":"\"‘Leitanga piang na khempeuh sawma khat - leitang pana piang gah ahikeh singkung pana gahte TOPA aa ahi hi; TOPA adingin siangtho hi."},"31":{"text":"Mi khat in ama neihsa sawma khat a tat leh aman zah sehnga suah sehkhat piak beh ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Bawng hon le tuuhon pana sawma khat buppi - gancingpa ciangkhut nuai-ah paisakin, a sawm cinna pen peuhmah - TOPA adingin a siangtho hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah in a hoih lo lak pana a hoih tengkhia ahikeh a khek kei ding hi. A khek zenzen leh a ganhing le a khekna a nihin a siangtho suak dinga, a kitan thei kei ding hi,’ ci in,\" a ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Hihte in Israel-te adinga Sinai Vum tungah TOPA in Moses tunga a thupiakte ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 26:46"}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Misimna","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel-te Egypt pana a paikhiat khit uh a kum nihna, a kha nihna a ni masa ni-in Sinai Sehnel gam-a Kikhopna Puanbuk ah TOPA in Moses a hopih hi. Amah in:","title":"Mi Kisimna"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel mipi bup a bawng’ le a innkuan zui-in simin, pasal peuhmah a min uh khat khit khat gual in."},"3":{"text":"Nang le Aaron in kum sawmnih pan a tungsiah, Israel-te khempeuh pasal paltan tum thei ding peuhmah amau kikhenna bangin na sim ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A beh, simin pasal khat ciat, a innkuan lutang pen ciat in nang hong huh ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang hong huh ding mite min hihte ahi hi: Reuben panin, Shedeur tapa Elizur;","ref":"Pk 30:11-16; Kil 7:5"},"6":{"text":"Simeon panin, Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel;","ref":"Ms 25:14"},"7":{"text":"Judah panin, Amminadab tapa Nahshon;","ref":"Pc 29:35"},"8":{"text":"Issachar panin, Zuar tapa Nethanel;","ref":"Pc 30:18"},"9":{"text":"Zebulun panin, Helon tapa Eliab;","ref":"Ms 10:16"},"10":{"text":"Joseph tapate pan: Ephraim panin, Ammihud tapa Elishama; Manasseh panin, Pedahzur tapa Gamaliel;","ref":"Ms 2:18; Ms 10:23"},"11":{"text":"Benjamin panin, Gideoni tapa Abidan;","ref":"Ms 10:24"},"12":{"text":"Dan panin, Ammishaddai tapa Ahi-ezer;","ref":"Ms 2:25"},"13":{"text":"Asher panin, Ocran tapa Pagiel;","ref":"Ms 2:27; 10:26"},"14":{"text":"Gad panin, De-u-el tapa Eliasaph;","ref":"Ms 2:14; 10:20"},"15":{"text":"Naphtali panin, Enan tapa Ahira,\" ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 2:29; 10:27"},"16":{"text":"Hihte mihonpi pana kiseh pupa beh pana makaite ahi hi. Hih pen Enan’ tapa Ahira in biakna-a a piak ahi hi."},"84":{"text":"Hihte pen Israel makaite in biakna-tau sathau a kinilh cianga a ap nading uh biaknate ahi hi: ngun kuangdai sawm le nih, thehna ngun kuangkum sawm le nih le kham sikkeu-kum sawm le nih ahi hi."},"85":{"text":"Ngun kuangdai khat in shekel zakhat le sawmthum ciat khai-a, thehna kuangdai in shekel sawm sagih ciat a khai hi. Mawhna hanga biakna dingin keel apa sawm le nih kizang hi."},"88":{"text":"Kilawmtakna biakna dingin ganhing vekpi gawm, bawngtal sawmnih le li, tuutal sawmguk, keel apa sawmguk le kum khat a pha tuuno apa sawmguk a pha hi. Tua hi-a amah tawh a kiho hi.","ref":"Pk 25:21-22; Ph 80:1"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Meivakte Vak"},"2":{"text":"\"Aaron hopih inla ama kiangah, ‘Meivak sagihte na vak ciangin meivak tunna mailam teng a taan dingin vak in,’ ci in,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Aaron in tua bangin a hih hi; TOPA in Moses a thupiak bang tektekin meivakte, meivak tunna mailam nga-in a vak hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih in meivak tunnate kibawl zia ahi hi: Tua in a bul pan a paakte dongin sek-a kiseek kham ahi hi. TOPA in Moses a lahsa bang lianin meivak tunna kibawl hi.","ref":"Pk 25:36-37"},"5":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"6":{"text":"\"Israel dangte lak panin Levi-te lakhia inla amaute siangsak in.","title":"Levi Mite Tuamkoihna"},"7":{"text":"Amaute na siansak nadingin hicih hih in: Amaute tungah sianna tui theh in; tua ciangin a pum tungua mul khempeuh metsakin a puansilhte uh sawpsak inla amau le amau kisiansuahsak in."},"8":{"text":"Bawngtalno khat tawh an-a biakna, annel limci sathau helsa amaute lasak in; tua khit ciangin mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtalno a nihna na lasak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Kikhopna Puanbuk mai-ah Levi-te paipih inla Israel mipi bup kikhawmsak in."},"10":{"text":"TOPA mai-ah Levi-te na paipih dinga Israel-te in amaute tungah a khut uh a nga ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA na a sep theih nadingun Aaron in Israel-te panin TOPA mai-ah Levi-te vei-a biakna bangin a pia ding hi.","ref":"Sp 8:3"},"12":{"text":"\"Levi-te in bawngtalnote tungah a khut uh a ngak khit uh ciangin, Levi-te adingin thoihdamna bawlna-in TOPA tungah mawhna hanga biakna-in zang unla, a khat pen meihal biakna-in zang un."},"13":{"text":"Aaron le a tapate mai-ah Levi-te dingsak un, tua ciangin amaute vei-a biakna bangin TOPA tungah pia un."},"14":{"text":"Hih bangin Israel dangte panin Levi-te na tuam koih dinga, Levi-te kei aa ahi ding uh hi.","ref":"Ms 3:12"},"15":{"text":"\"Levi-te na siansak khit vei-a biakna bangin na piak khit ciangin amaute Kikhopna Puanbuk ah amau nasep sem dingin a pai ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute Israel mi kei tunga hong kipiasate ahi uh hi. Keimah in tacil, Israel numei pana tapa upa pen tangin amaute ka sang hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel tacil apa peuhmah mihing ahi a ganhing ahi zongin kei aa ahi hi. Egypt ah tacil khempeuh ka vatmai lai-in kei adingin amaute ka tuamkoih hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi a, Israel tapa upa pen khempeuh tangin Levi-te ka la khin zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute adingin thoihdamna na bawl dinga a pai uh ciangin pulpi in Israel-te a vat loh nadingin Israel mite tanga Kikhopna Puanbuk a nasem dingin Israel mite khempeuh lak panin Levi-te Aaron le ama tapate tungah ka pia hi,\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"TOPA in Moses a thupiak bang tektek in Moses, Aaron le Israel mipi bup in Levi-te tungah a hih uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Levi-te in amau le amau kisiangtho sakin a puan uh a sawp uh hi. Tua ciangin Aaron in vei-a biakna bangin TOPA mai-ah amaute pia-a, amaute a siantho nadingun thoihdamna a bawlsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk a Aaron le a tapate ukna nuai-ah amau nasep sem dingin Levi-te a pai uh hi. Tua hi a hih in Levi-te tavuan na piakzia ding ahi hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaute Egypt pan a paikhiat uh a kum nihna a kha masa in Sinai Sehnel-gam ah TOPA in Moses a hopih hi. Amaute in tuuno sa, silngo sawh loh anlum le lokha teh a nekhawm ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in zingsang dong bangmah sit loin a guh khat zong a sutan kei ding uh hi. Amaute in Paisan pawi a bawl uh ciangin a ngeina khempeuh a zui pelmawh ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin a sianga kiseh mi khat in khualzin lo napi Paisan pawi a bawl kei leh tua mi a kisehsa huna TOPA biakna-ah kihel lo ahi manin a mipihte panin kikhenkhia ding hi. Sun ahi a zan ahi zongin meii a kilaptoh peuhpeuh ciangin a dingkhia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Biakbuk tungah meii ni nih ahikeh kha khat ahikeh kum khat a om tan veivei giahphual ah Israel-te om uh a, a dingkhia kei uh hi; ahi hangin a kilaptoh ciangin a dingkhia uh hi."},"23":{"text":"TOPA thupiakna zui-in amaute in giahphual sat uh a, TOPA thupiakna mah zui-in a dingkhia uh hi. Amaute in TOPA thupiak ahi Moses tungtawna ama thupiakna a mang uh hi.","ref":"Pk 13:21; 40:36-38"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah:","title":"Ngun Pengkulte"},"2":{"text":"\"Sek-a kiseek ngun pengkul nih bawl inla, mipite sapkhawmna le giahphual suan nadingin zang in."},"3":{"text":"A nihin a ginkhawm ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna mai-ah mipi bup a kikhawm ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Khat bek a gin ciangin na mai-ah, makaite - Israel bawng’te lutangte kikhawm ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pengkul khatvei a kimut ciangin nisuahna lama phualsat behte a dingkhia ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A nih veina a kimut ciangin leitaw lama giahphual satte a dingkhia ding uh hi. Tua ciangin na Pasian uh TOPA in note hong phawkin na galte panun hong hu ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na lungnop hun uh - no adinga kisehsa pawite le Kha Thak pawi hunte - meihal biakna, kilawmtakna biakna a hun ciangin zong pengkulte na mut ding uh a, tuate no adingin Pasian mai-ah phawkna khat ahi ding hi. Tua in nang le na suante tawh TOPA mai-ah ci tawh tawntung thukhun ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 13:5; Sp 3:2"},"20":{"text":"TOPA in Aaron kiangah, \"Amaute gam ah luah na nei kei ding uh a, amaute lakah tanh zong na nei kei ding uh hi; nangma tanh keimah ka hi-a, Israel-te laka nangma gouluah ka hi hi.","ref":"Tp 10:9; 18:1-2; Jos 13:33"},"21":{"text":"\"Keimah in Levi-te tungah Kikhopna Puanbuka a nasepna uh thukna-in Israel-te sawma khat khempeuh a luah dingun ka pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tu-a kipan Israel-te Kikhopna Puanbuk kiangah a pai peuhmah kei ding uh hi; tua hi keileh amaute in amau mawhna thaman thuakin a si ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kikhopna Puanbuk a nasem ding Levi-te hi uh a, tua tawh kisai mawhsakna peuhmah tavuan a la ding uh hi. Hih in khang sawnsawnte dongin tawntung thuzek khat ahi hi. Amaute in Israel-te lakah gouluah a ngah kei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua tangin Israel-te in TOPA tungah biakna-a a piak uh sawma khat Levi-te gouluah dingin ka pia hi. Tua pen bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in amaute tawh kisai-in, ‘Amaute in Israel-te lakah gouluah a nei kei ding uh hi,’ ka ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"26":{"text":"\"Levi-te hopih inla amaute kiangah: ‘Israel-te tung panin na gouluah dingun kong piak sawma khat na san uh ciangin, tua sawma khat sehsawm suah sehkhat TOPA biakna-in pia tektek un."},"27":{"text":"Na biakna uh ancilna pana antang ahikeh lenggahtui sukna pana singgah-tui bangin hong kisimsak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Note in zong hici bangin Israel-te tung pana na san uh sawma khat khempeuh TOPA tungah biakna-in na pia ding uh hi. Hih sawma khatte panin TOPA tanhte khenkhia-in siampi Aaron na pia ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in no tunga hong kipia nate, a hoih pen le a siangtho pente TOPA adingin na pia tektek ding uh hi,\" ci in.","ref":"Ne 10:38"},"30":{"text":"\"Levi-te tungah: ‘A hoihpente na piak uh ciangin na ancilna phual le na lenggah sukna muna piangin hong kisimsak ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Nang le na innkuanpihte in a omlai teng mun khatah na ne thei ding uh hi; ahang in, tua pen Kikhopna Puanbuk a na nasep thaman uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuate a hoih pen na piak nak uh leh hih thu ah na mawh kei ding uh hi; tua ciangin Israel-te biakna siangthote na buahsak kei ding uh a, na si kei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 19:8; 22:15"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah:","title":"Sianna Tui"},"2":{"text":"\"Hih in TOPA hong thupiaksa a kisam thukham ahi hi. Israel-te kiangah poina ahikeh sitbaanna a nei lo na a kisemsak nai lo bawngla asan khat hong paipih nadingun gen in."},"3":{"text":"Tua pen siampi Eleazar tungah pia in; tua pen giahphual pua ah kipaipih dinga, ama omna munah a kigo ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi Eleazar in a khutme in a sisan pawlkhat la dinga, Kikhopna Puanbuk mailam pang sagih vei a theh ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ama muh sung mahin bawngla - a vun, a sa, a sisan le a ek kihal ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampipa in tamtak sing pawlkhat, puknah le sawnsan la dinga, a kihal bawngla tungah a lawn ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin siampipa in a puansilhte sawp dinga tui-in a kipumsil ding hi. Tua ciangin amah giahphual sungah lut thei dinga ahi hangin nitak mateng a sianglo ahi ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua a hal mipa in zong a puansilhte sawpin tui tawh kipumsil dinga amah zong nitak mateng a sianglo hi ding hi."},"9":{"text":"\"A siang mi khat in bawngla vuute khawmin giahphual pua a siangtho-a kisehna mun khatah a koih ding hi. Israel mipite in sianna tui-a a zat dingun tuate a kem ding uh hi; tua pen mawhna pana sian nading ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Bawngla’ vuu a khawmpa in zong a puansilhte sawp pelmawh dinga, amah zong nitak mateng a sianglo hi ding hi. Hih in Israel-te le amaute laka teng pemtate adingin tawntung thuzek khat hikhawm ding hi.","ref":"tg 13; Ms 8:7; Heb 9:13"},"11":{"text":"\"Misi luang khatpeuh a lawng peuhmah ni sagih sung a sianglo suak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in amah le amah tua tui-in kisiangsak dinga, tua ciangin a siang ding hi. Ahi hangin a ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in a kisiansak kei leh asiang suak lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Misi luang khat peuhpeuh lawnga amah le amah a kisiangsak lo peuhmah in TOPA biakna-tau buahsak ahi hi. Tua mipa Israel panin kikhenkhia pelmawh ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama tungah sianna tui kitheh nai lo ahi manin amah a sianglo ahi hi; ama sianlohna a tungah baang lai hi.","ref":"Sp 7:20;21:1; Ms 31:19"},"14":{"text":"\"Puanbuk sungah mi khat a sih ciangin zat ding thukham hih ahi hi: Puanbuk sungah a lut peuhmah le puanbuk sunga om peuhmah ni sagih sung a sianglo hi dinga,"},"15":{"text":"a sin kisincip lo na koihna khempeuh a sianglo hi ding hi."},"16":{"text":"\"Gam sunga namsau tawh a kithat mi ahi a, sih ngeina-a si ahi a, misi guh ahikeh han a lawng peuhmah ni sagih sung a sianglo hi ding hi.","ref":"Ms 31:19; Mt 23:27"},"17":{"text":"\"A sianglo mi adingin, siantho nadinga kihal biakna vuu pawlkhat bel sungah koihin a tungah tui siangtho sung in."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin a sianga kiseh mipa in puknah pawlkhat la dinga, tui sungah diahin puanbuk le na zatte khempeuh le tua lai-a om miteng a theh ding hi. Amah in, misi guh ahikeh han ahikeh a kithatsa mi khatpeuh ahikeh sih ngeina-a si mi khatpeuh a lawngkhate pel loin a theh ding hi."},"19":{"text":"A ni thum ni le a ni sagih ni-in a siang mipa in a sianglo mipa theh dinga a ni sagih ni-in amah in siangsak ding hi. A kisiangsak mipa in a puansilhte sawpin tui-in kipumsil dinga tua nitak ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin a sianglo mipa amah le amah a kisiansuah kei leh amah in TOPA munsiangtho buahsak ahi manin mipite panin a kihemkhia pelmawh ding hi. Sianna tui ama tungah kitheh nai lo a; amah a siang nai lo ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Hih in amaute adingin tawntung thuzek khat hi ding hi. \"Sianna tui a kitheh mipa in pel loin a puansilhte sawp dinga, sianna tui a lawngkha mi khatpeuh nitak mateng a sianglo hi ding hi.","ref":"Eze 36:25"},"22":{"text":"A sianglo mipa lawn khak na khatpeuh a sianglo suak dinga, tua na a lawngkha khatpeuh nitak dong a sianglo a suak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 5:2; Hag 2:13-14"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kha masa sungin Israel mihon buppi Zin Sehnel-gam tung uh a Kadesh ah a om uh hi. Tua lai-ah Miriam si-a a kivui hi.","title":"Suangpi Pan-a Tui","ref":"Pk 15:20"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai-ah mipite ading tui om lo a, Moses le Aaron langpang dingin mite a kikhawm uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute Moses tawh kitawng uh a, \"I sanggamte TOPA mai-ah a sih lai-un eite zong a si hizaw ta leng!"},"4":{"text":"Bang hangin kote le ka ganhingte uh hih lai-a si dingin TOPA mipite hih gam sungah hong paipih na hi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Bang dingin Egypt panin hih a lauhuai mun hong tunpih na hi hiam? Hih munah an, thei, lenggui, le mang kawlsing om lo hi. Tua banah tui dawn ding nangawn om lopi!\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pk 14:11; 17:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Mipite lak panin Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna ah Moses le Aaron pai uh a, a mai kunsuk uh ciangin TOPA minthanna amau tungah kilang hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,"},"8":{"text":"\"Tua ciangkhut la inla nang le na sanggampa Aaron in mipite kikhawmsak un. Amaute maitang ah suangpi hopih in, tui hong phulkhia ding hi. Mipite adingin suangpi panin tui na phulkhiasak dinga amaute le amaute’ gante in a dawn ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 17:6; Isa 43:20; Ms 14:5"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama thupiak bang tektekin Moses in TOPA omna panin ciangkhut a la hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah le Aaron in suangpi mai tengah mihonpite kikhawmsak uh a Moses in amaute kiangah, \"No a lehdote aw ngai un, hih suangpi panin no ading tui hong pia taktak buang lo ding ka hi uh hiam?\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in a khut laamto a, a ciangkhutin suangpi nihvei a sat hi. Tui kikhawhkhia a mipite le amau gante in a dawn uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah, \"Israel mipite muhna ah nong muan ding zahun hong muang loin a siangtho-in hong pahtawi lo na hi manun, amaute ka piakna gamah hih mipite na tunpih kei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 27:14"},"13":{"text":"Hihte in Meribah a tuiphual-a, Israel-te in TOPA tawng uh a, amaute laka amah a siangtho-a a kilahna-a thupiang ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Moses in Kadesh panin Edom kumpipa kiangah kamtai sawl a: \"Na sanggampa Israel in: Ko tunga hong tungsa haksatna khempeuh a thu na thei hi.","title":"Israel Paina Edom in Nial"},"15":{"text":"Ka pute uh Egypt ah paisuk uh a, tua lai-ah kum tampi ka teng uh hi. Egypt mite in kote le ka pate uh hong bawlsia uh a,"},"16":{"text":"ahi hangin TOPA tungah ka kiko uh ciangin kote kikona amah in hong za a, van sawltak khat hong paisukin Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih hi. \"Tu-in kote na gamgi kianga khuapi khat Kadesh ah ka om uh hi.","ref":"Pk 2:23; 14:19"},"17":{"text":"Nong hehpihna-in kote na gamsung kantanin hong paisak in. Kumpipa lam lianpi bek zui-in ka pai ding uh a, na gamgi ka tun matengun taklam ahi a veilam ahi zongin ka pial kei ding uh hi,\" a cisak hi.","ref":"Ms 21:22"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin Edom in: \"Hih lai nong kantan thei kei ding uh hi; nong pai teitei uh leh hong kuankhia-in namsau-in kong do ding uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Ms 21:23"},"19":{"text":"Israel-te in: \"Lam lianpi zui bekin ka pai ding uh a, kote le ka ganhonte un na tui uh a dawn leh a man kong pia ding uh hi. Bangmah dang hi loin khe tawh kantanin a pai nuam bek ka hi uh hi,\" ci-in a thuk kik uh hi.","ref":"Tp 2:6,28"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in: \"Na kantan thei kei ding uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng kik leuleu uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute langah a thahat galkap tampi tawh Edom a kuankhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Edom in amau gam kantan ding nial ahi manin amaute panin Israel kiheikhia hi."},"22":{"text":"Kadesh panin Israel mipi bup dingkhia uh a, Hor Vum a tung uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Edom gamgi gei Hor Vum ah, TOPA in Moses le Aaron tungah,","title":"Aaron Sihna"},"24":{"text":"\"A mipihte tawh Aaron kigawmta ding hi; Israel-te ka piak gamah amah a lut kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Meribah tuiphualah note gel in ka thupiak na lehdo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le a tapa Eleazar samin amaute Hor Vum ah paipih in,"},"26":{"text":"Aaron puante suahsak inla a tapa Eleazar silhsak in; ahang in, Aaron a mipihte kiangah kigawm ta ding hi; tua lai-ah amah a si ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"TOPA thupiaksa bangin Moses in hih a; amaute mipite muhin Hor Vum tungah a kahto uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Moses in Aaron puante suahsak a, a tapa Eleazar a silhsak hi. Tua ciangin tua lai mualdawn ah Aaron a si hi. Mualtung panin Moses le Eleazer kumsuk uh a,"},"29":{"text":"mihonpi bup in Aaron sih a theih uh ciangin ama hangin Israel innkuan buppi ni sawmthum sung a thum uh hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Negev a teng Canaan-mi Arad kumpipa in Atharim zuatna lampi zui-in Israel-te pai cih a zak ciangin amah in Israel-te na do a amaute pawlkhat a man hi.","title":"Arad Kisia"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel in TOPA tungah hih kiciamna a bawl hi. \"Nangmah in kote tungah hih mite nong piak ding leh amau khuapite ka susia b dikdek ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"TOPA in Israel thumna ngai-a amaute tungah Canaan-te a pia hi. Amaute in a khuapite uh le amaute a susia dikdek uh hi; tua ahi manin tua mun Hormah c kici hi."},"4":{"text":"Hor Vum panin zinkhia uh a, Edom kimvel dingin San Tuipi d zuatna lampi a zui uh hi. Ahi hangin lamkal ah mipite lungtom uh hi;"},"5":{"text":"amaute in Pasian gensia-in Moses gensia uh a, \"Bang hangin sehnel-gama si dingin Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Anlum lah om kei! Tui lah om kei! A gentak lo hih an lah kih lel ung!\" a ci uh hi.","title":"Sumngo Gul","ref":"Ph 78:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in amaute lakah gul gupha a khah hi; tuate in mite tu uh a, Israel mite tampi a si uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Moses kiangah mite pai uh a,\" Nang kong gensiat uh le TOPA ka gensiat uh ka mawh zo uh hi. TOPA in kote panin gulte a lakkhiatmang nadingin thu ngen in,\" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Moses in mipite adingin thu a ngen hi.","ref":"Tp 8:15"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Gul khat bawl inla khuam tung khatah khai in; gul tuksa mite in en thei ding uh a, a nungta ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in sumngo gul khat bawla, khuam tung khatah a khai hi. Tua ciangin mi khatpeuh gul in a tuka sumngo gul a et nak leh a nungta hi.","ref":"Jn 3:14-15"},"10":{"text":"Israel-te kikhinkhia uh a, Oboth ah giahphual a sat uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Oboth panin dingkhia uh a, nisuahna lampang Moab maingat-a gam sungah a om Iye Abarim ah giahphual a sat uh hi.","title":"Moab-a Zinna"},"12":{"text":"Tua lai panin kikhinkhia leuleu uh a, Zered Kuam sungah giahphual a sat uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua lai panin dingkhia uh a, Amor-te gamgi dunga kikhung sehnel-gama om Arnon dung sukah giahphual a sat uh hi. Arnon pen Moab-te le Amor-te kikal-a Moab gamgi ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua pen bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA Gal Laibu in: \"Suphah a a Waheb le Arnon guamte,","ref":"Ms 33:44; Tp 2:13-14"},"15":{"text":"le b Ar dong a tungsuk Moab gamgi dunga kikhung guam kente,\" na ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lai panin TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Mite a vekun kikhawmsak un, amaute tui ka pia ding hi,\" a cihna mun Beer tuikhuk dong a pai lai uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel in: \"Tuikhuk aw, Phulto in! Tua thu la’n sa un,"},"18":{"text":"kumpi tapate tawhsa mipite uliante tuak uh a, a sikciang le a ciangkhut-a a tawh uh tuikhuk thu,’ ci-in la in a sa uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute sehnel-gam panin Mattanah ah pai uh a,"},"19":{"text":"Mattanah panin Nahaliel ah, Nahaliel panin Bamoth ah,"},"20":{"text":"Bamoth panin Pisgah mual dawn pana kimusuk Moab gamval kuamah a tung uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel in Amor-te kumpipa Sihon kiangah kamtai sawl a:"},"22":{"text":"\"Na gam hong kantansak in. Lo lai ahikeh lenggui lo khatpeuh tawnin ka pai kei ding uh a, tuikhuk khatpeuh a tui zong ka dawn kei ding uh hi. Na gam ka kantan khit matengun kumpi lamlianpi zui-in ka zin ding uh hi,\" a cisak hi.","title":"Sihon le Og Zawhna","ref":"Ms 20:17"},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin Sihon in a gamgi kantanin Israel a paisak nuam kei hi. A galkap khempeuh kikhawmsak a, Israel do dingin sehnel gamah a kuankhia uh hi. Jahaz a tun uh ciangin Israel tawh a kido uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin Israel in namsau tawh amah vat-a, ama gam Arnon panin Jabbok dong laksak uh a, ahi hangin Ammon-te omna ciang bek a la zo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau gamgi ah kulh tawh a ki-um hi."},"25":{"text":"Israel in Amor-te khuapi liante khempeuh, Heshbon le a kimkota khuaneute khempeuh tawh la khawmin a teng uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Heshbon pen, Moab kumpi masazawpa do a, ama tung pana leitang Arnon ciang dong a laksak Amor-te kumpipa Sihon khuapi ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 2:32; 29:7; Ps 135:10-11"},"27":{"text":"Tua hangin la sungah: \"Heshbon ah hong pai unla lam kik ni; Sihon khuapi kipsak ni."},"28":{"text":"\"Heshbon pan mei pawtkhia, Sihon khuapi panin meikuang khat. Tua in Moab a khuapi Ar le, Arnon leitanga teng mite a haltum hi.","ref":"Jer 48:45; Isa 15:2"},"29":{"text":"Moab aw, gimna thuak si cia! Chemosh mite aw, no lah kisia ta uh teh! Amah in a tapate galtai le a tanute galmatin, Amor-te kumpipa Sihon tungah piakhia ta hi.","ref":"Thk 11:24"},"30":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin ko amaute ka lawnthal uh hi; Heshbon kisia ta, lamdung tawntung Dibon dong; Medeba ciang dong a bansa Nophah dong amaute ka sucip uh hi,\" ci-in na kiphuak hi.","ref":"Ms 32:3"},"31":{"text":"Tuaci-in Amor-te gamah Israel a teng hi."},"32":{"text":"Moses in Jazer ah thukansimte a sawl khit ciangin a kima tengte la uh a, tua lai-a teng Amor-te a suankhia uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kihei-in Bashan lampi zui-in pai uh a, Bashan kumpipa Og le a galkap buppi, amaute do dingin Edrei ah a kuankhia uh hi."},"34":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah, \"Amah le a galkap buppi le a gam, nang khut sungah kong pia khin hi, kihta kei in Heshbon a ukpa - Amor-te kumpipa Sihon tunga na hih bangin ama tungah hih in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 3:2"},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute a nungta a om nawn lo dingin amah le a tapate tawh, a galkap buppi a that khawm uh hi. Tua ciangin ama gam a tang uh hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te zinkhia uh a, Jericho c gal Jordan dunga Moab zanglei ah giahphual a sat uh hi.","title":"Balak in Balaam Samsak","ref":"Ms 33:48"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in Zippor tapa Balak in Amor-te tunga Israel gamtatnasa khempeuh mu a,"},"3":{"text":"mi tam mahmah ahi manin Moab-te linglawng uh hi. Hi takpi hi, Israel-te hangin Moab-te a laupha mahmah uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Moab-te in Midian upate kiangah, \"Bawngtal khat in lo sunga lopate a liahmang bangin hih mihon kawivakte in i kima na khempeuh a liakmang ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi. Balak in: \"Egypt panin mihonpi khat hong paikhia uh hi; amaute in leitang tung teng tuam uh a, kei zomah teng uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Hong pai inla hih mite hong hamsiatsak in, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute hat lua mahmah uh ka sa hi. Tua hileh amaute zoin gamsung pan ka hawlkhia thei ding hi, ci-in ka ummawh hi. Tua ciangin Moab-te’ uliante a taam uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Balaam kiangah Pasian pai-a, \"Na ompih hih mite kua ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"10":{"text":"Balaam in Pasian kiangah, \"Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak in hih thu hong khak hi:"},"11":{"text":"Egypt pana hong paikhia mihonpi khat in lei maitang teng tuam uh hi. Hong pai inla amaute hong hamsiatsak in. Tua ciangin amaute do-in ka nawhmang thei kha ding hi,’ hong ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pasian in Balaam kiangah, \"Amaute zui kei in. Hong pai inla hih mite hong hamsiatsak in,\" a ci uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin Balaam in amaute kiangah, \"Balak in a kumpi inn dim kham le ngun hong pia taleh TOPA ka Pasian hong thupiak zah val, aneu ahi a, alian ahi zongin bangmah ka sem thei kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Adangte mah bangin tuzan hih lai-ah taam unla TOPA in kei kiangah bang hong genbeh lai hiam hong dong ning,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 24:13; 1Ku 22:14; 2Kh 18:13"},"20":{"text":"Tua zanin Balaam kiangah Pasian pai a, \"Hih mite nang hong sama hong pai ahi nungsangin amaute zui inla ahi hangin kong gensa bang bekin hih in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 23:5,12,16,26"},"21":{"text":"Zingsangin Balaam tho-a, a laa tutphah vawhin Moab uliante a zui hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah a pai ciangin Pasian heh mahmah a, TOPA vansawltak khat in lampi-ah a pang hi. Balaam ama laa tungah tuanga a nasem nihte a tonpih hi.","title":"Balaam’ Laa"},"23":{"text":"Tua laa in, a khutah namsau dawhkhiatsa-a tawi, lampi-a ding TOPA vansawltak a muh ciangin lampi pan gamlak ah a pial hi. Tua ciangin a laa a sat leuleu hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin TOPA vansawltak na mapai-a, taklam le veilam kihei nading a om lohna mun kawcik khatah a na ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Laa in TOPA vansawltak a muh ciangin Balaam nuai-ah a bok hi, amah hehin a ciangkhutin a sat hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in laa kam honsak-a, Balaam kiangah, \"Kei thumveitak nong sat na zah dingin nang bang hong cih ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Balaam in laa kiangah, \"Kei nong haibawl hang ahi hi! Tua ciangin amah pawnlak munsang khatah a paikhia hi.","ref":"tg 15"},"4":{"text":"Pasian in amah na dawn a, Balaam in, \"Biakna-tau sagih ka dawh khin-a, tau khatah bawngtal khat le tuutal khat ka pia khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA in Balaam kam sungah thu muam-a, \"Balak kiangah pai kik inla amah hih thu pia in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 18:18; Jer 1:9"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama kiangah pai kik a, a biakna gei-ah Moab uliante khempeuh tawh amah a dingkhawm a mu hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Balaam in a thusuak pulak a: \"Balak in Aram panin kei hong paipih a, nisuahna mualte panin Moab kumpipa in hong paipih hi. A pasal in phiat khin ahi manin, TOPA in tuanu a suaktasak hi."},"13":{"text":"A pasal in ama kiciamna khatpeuh ahikeh zuih dinga a ciamna khatpeuh a nial nop leh kipsak thei, beisak thei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin a pasal in tua ni-a kipan bangmah a gen kei leh tua ciangin tuanu a khih kiciamna ahikeh zuih dingte khempeuh a kipsak a suak hi. Note tenna gamah amaute in hong lauthawngsak ding uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin amaute tunga hih ding ka sawmte no tungah ka hih ding hi, ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Canaan Gamgite"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te thu pia inla, amaute kiangah, ‘Note luah dinga hong kipia Canaan gamah na lut uh ciangin hih bangin gamgi na nei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 17:8"},"3":{"text":"\"‘Na leitaw-lam pang uh Edom gamgi dunga Zin Sehnel-gam khenkhat a kihel ding hi. A nisuahna lam ah na leitaw-lam gamgi uh Ci Tuipi c mong panin kipan dinga,"},"4":{"text":"Mom-ai d Cianggek leitaw-lam kantanin Zin dong kizomsuakin Kadesh Barnea leitaw lamah a pai ding hi. Tua ciangin Hazar Addar ah pai-in Azmon dong kizomsuakin"},"5":{"text":"tua lai-ah Egypt Wadi zomin Tuipi e a mong hi ding hi."},"6":{"text":"\"‘Na nitumna-lam gamgi uh Tuipi Lian gei dungdung hi ding hi. Hih in leilu lama na gamgi ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 47:15-17; Ms 13:21"},"10":{"text":"\"‘Nisuahna lama na gamgi ding uh, Hazar Enan panin Shepham dong kikhung ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Shepham pen Riblah dong Ain nisuahna-lam pangah paisuk dinga Kinnereth g Tuipi nisuahna-lam dungah sawi zopsuk ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin gamgi Jordan dungah paisukin Ci Tuipi a mong hi ding hi. \"‘Hih gamgi huamkhak sung teng no gam ding ahi hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 3:17; 2Ku 23:33"},"13":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te kiangah, \"Hih leitang a luah dingte aisan un. TOPA in beh kua le a langte piak dinga thu a piaksa ahi hi,"},"14":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh Reuben-te beh le a innkuante, Gad-te beh le Manasseh-te beh alangte in amau luah ding ngah khin uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih beh nih le a langte in Jericho a a Jordan nisuahna lampang, nisuah-khiatna mun lam a luah dingun ngah khin uh hi,\" ci-in thu a pia hi.","ref":"Ms 32:33"},"16":{"text":"TOPA in Moses kiangah,"},"17":{"text":"\"Hihte in note luah ding gam hong hawmsak dingte min ahi hi: Siampi Eleazer le Nun tapa Joshua."},"18":{"text":"Gam hawm huh dingin beh khat panin makai khat na sehkhia ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amau minte in: Judah beh panin, Jephunneh tapa Caleb;","ref":"Ms 1:4,16"},"20":{"text":"Simeon beh panin, Ammihud tapa Shenuel;"},"21":{"text":"Benjamin beh panin, Kislon tapa Elidad;"},"22":{"text":"Dan beh panin, a makai Jogli tapa Bukki;"},"23":{"text":"Joseph tapa Manasseh beh panin, a makai Ephod tapa Hanniel;"},"24":{"text":"Joseph tapa Ephraim beh panin a makai Shiphtan tapa Kemuel;"},"25":{"text":"Jebulun beh panin a makai Parnach tapa Elizaphan;"},"26":{"text":"Issachar beh panin, a makai Azzan tapa Patiel;"},"27":{"text":"Asher beh panin, a makai Shelomi tapa Ahihud;","ref":"Ms 1:40"},"28":{"text":"Naphtali beh panin, a makai Ammihud tapa Pedahel,\" te ahi uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Canaan gama luah ding leitang hawm dinga TOPA thupiaksate hih mite ahi uh hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jericho b pana kantanna Jordan gungei Moab zangleite tungah TOPA in Moses tungah,","title":"Levi-te ading Khuapite"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel-te in luaha a neih ding uh sung panin Levi-te ten nading khuapite a piak dingun Israel-te thu pia in. Khuapite kima a lonona munte zong amaute pia in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a ten nading uh khuapi le a tuuhon a bawnghonte uh le a ganhing khempeuh uh adingin lonona mun nei pan ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"\"Levi-te na piak khuapite kima lonona mun, khuapi kulh panin pi c tul le zanga a huam ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A khuapi pualam ah nisuahna-lam pang pi d tulthum, leitaw-lam pang pi tulthum, nitumna-lam pang pi tulthum le leilu- lam pang pi tulthum tehin a khuapi a laizangah a om ding hi. Amaute in hih mun teng khuapi lonona munin a nei ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Levi-te na piak uh khuapite lakah guk, mi khatpeuh a thatkha mipa buk nading khuapi hi ding hi. Khuapi sawmli le nih amaute piak thuah lai un."},"7":{"text":"Levi-te a lonona tawh na piakkhawm pelmawh ding uh a vekin khuapi sawmli le giat hi ding hi.","title":"Bukna Khuapi"},"8":{"text":"Israel-te neihsa panin Levi-te na piak uh khuapite no bawng’ ciatciat luah zah tawh kituakin na pia ding uh hi. Khuapi tampi a nei bawng’te tung panin tampi la-in, ahi hangin a tawm neite tungah na tawm lak ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 26:54"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses kiangah,"},"10":{"text":"\"Isreal-te hopih inla amaute kiangah, ‘Jordan kantanin Canaan ah na lut uh ciangin"},"11":{"text":"mi khatpeuh a thatkha mi khat a suahtak theih nadingin, na khuapite panun khuapi pawlkhat teelkhia un."},"12":{"text":"Thu kikhen dingin mihonpite mai-ah a din ma-in mi that khate a sih loh nadingin phulapa panin bukna munah kikoih ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na piak uh hih khuapi gukte note bukna khuapi hi ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Jordan hihlam galah thum, Canaan lam galah thum mah bukna khuapi-in pia un."},"15":{"text":"Sawmkhol lopi a midang khat a that khate tua munah a suahtak theih nadingin hih khuapi gukte, Israel-te pemtate le amau laka a teng mi peuhmah adingin bukna khuapi hi ding hi.","ref":"Pk 21:13; Jos 20:3"},"16":{"text":"\"‘Mi khat in na-a kizang sik khatin mi khatpeuh a si dingin a sat leh amah mi that ahi hi; tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahikeh mi khat in mi thah theih nading suangtum khat a khutah tawi-a, mi khatpeuh a si dingin tupna-a a neih leh amah mi that ahi hi; tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahikeh mi khatpeuh in thah theih nadingin a khut sungah na-a kizang sing khat tawi-a, a sih nadingin mi khatpeuh a sat leh amah mi that ahi hi; tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Sisan phulapa in mi thatpa a that ding hi; amah a tuahkhak ciangin a that ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in sawmkhol lopi-in a sih nadingin suang ahikeh bang khatpeuh in a den a,"},"21":{"text":"ahikeh galbawlin a sih nadingin khuttumin a tup leh tua mipa kithat ding hi; amah mi that ahi hi. Sisan phulapa in mi thatpa a tuah khak ciangin a that ding hi.","ref":"Pk 21:12,14; Sp 24:17"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin galbawl lopi-a mi khatpeuh in midang khat sun vat ahikeh bukbawl loin na khatpeuhin deng"},"23":{"text":"ahikeh amah mu lopi-in a sih theih nading suangtum khat khiatkha a, amah a sih leh tua ciangin amah a galpa hi loin amah liamsak a sawm ahi loh nungsangin"},"24":{"text":"mipite in hih ding ngeina tawh kizui-in amah le sisan phulapa kikalah thu a khen ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Mipi in sisan phulapa panin mi that-a kingawhpa hu pelmawh ding uh a, amah a taina bukna khuapi ah paikiksak ding uh hi. Ahi hangin teci khatbek genna siksanin khat beek a kithat kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 17:6; Mt 18:16; 2Co 13:1"},"31":{"text":"\"‘A si dinga kisehsa mithatpa nuntakna kitatna sum na sang kei ding uh hi. Amah pel loin kithat taktak ding hi."},"32":{"text":"\"‘Bukna khuapi-a a taisa mi khatpeuh, tulpipa a sih ma-in ama neihsa gamah ciah-a a ten nading phalna-in tatna sum na sang kei ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"\"‘Note omna gam na ninsak kei ding uh hi. Sisan luansakna in leitang ninsaka, sisan a kiluansak nasa leitang ah khatpeuh sisan mah a luan kei ngal leh mawhna thoihdamna kibawl thei lo hi."},"34":{"text":"Keimah TOPA Israel-te lakah teng ka hi manin keima omna, note tenna leitang ninsak kei un,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 4:41-43"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph suan-a bawng’te panin Manasseh tapa, Makir tapa Gilead bawng’a innkuan makaite va pai-in Moses le Israel-te innkuan lutangte makaite mai-ah thu a sung uh hi.","title":"Zelophehad Tanute Luahna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in, \" TOPA in kote topa tungah Israel-te in aisan-a a luah ding uh leitang a piak lai-in amah in nang tungah kote sanggampa Jelophehad luah dingte a tanute tungah piak dingin thu hong pia hi."},"3":{"text":"A zenzenin tu-in amaute in Israel beh dangte mah pasalin nei le uh; tua ciangin amau luahte a pu a pate uh luahna panin khenkhia-in amau pasal neihna behte aa ah kigawm ding hi. Tuaci bangin ko luah dinga hong kipiasate hong kilakkhiatsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel-te adingin Jubilee kum ciangin a goutanh uh amau pasal neihna behte aa ah kigawmin amau neihsate ka pute uh minamte luahna panin a kilakhia ding hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in TOPA thupiakna bangin Israel-te tungah, \"Joseph suante bawng’ genna amaan hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih in Zelophehad tanute adingin TOPA thupiak ahi hi: Amaute in amaute pate behte bawng’te a tenpih nak uh leh amau lungkimna khat peuhpeuh tenpih thei uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel-te sungah beh khat pan beh khatah a luahsate uh a kipiasawn thei kei ding uh hi; ahang in, Israel mi peuhmah in ama pute pana a luah ama beh leitang kem ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi peuhmah in a pate luahsa a neih theih nadingin leitang a luahsa Israel beh sunga ta numei peuhmah in a pa beh sunga bawng’ pan - khat teitei tawh a kiteng pelmawh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel behte in amau luah leitang ciat a kep theih nadingun a luahte uh, beh khat le beh khat a kipia sawn thei ding uh hi, ci hi,\" ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"1Ku 21:3"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin Zelophehad tanute a gamta uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Zelophehad tanute - Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah le Noah-te in - a pate lamte a tenpih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in Joseph tapa Manasseh suante bawng’ tenpih uh a, a pate uh beh le bawng’ ah a luahte uh a kipsuak hi."},"13":{"text":"Hihte in Jericho a pana Jordan gun ngahtanna gei, Moab zanglei a, TOPA in Moses tungtawna a piak ngeinate ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 26:46"}}}}},"5":{"info":{"name":"Thupiakkikna","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte in, Jordan nisuahna lam sehnel-gam - tua pen Arabah gam sung - Suph tawh kigalsai, Paran le Tophel, Laban Hazeroth le Dizahab kikal a Israel khempeuh tungah Moses in a gen kammalte ahi hi.","title":"Horeb Nusiat ding Thupiakna"},"2":{"text":"(Seir Vum lam tawna pai-in Horeb pan Kadesh dong ni sawm le ni khat lam ahi hi)."},"3":{"text":"A kum sawmlina, kha sawm le khatna a ni masa pen ni-in Moses in Israel-te tungah amau tawh kisai-a TOPA in a thupiak khempeuh a tangko hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih in Heshbon a mang Amor-te kumpipa Sihon le Ashtaroth a mang Bashan kumpipa Og Edrei a zawh khit ciang ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 21:33-35; 33:38; Jos 13:12"},"5":{"text":"Jordan nisuahna-lam Moab gamgi ah Moses in hih thukham gensiang a kipan hi."},"6":{"text":"Horeb ah TOPA eite Pasian in eite tungah, \"Hih mual ah sawtvei na om khin ta uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Giahphual panin dingkhia unla Amor-te gam mualtung lam manawh un; a gamveng mite ahi Arabah gam sung, mualtung gam, nitumna-lam mualbul, Negev le tuipi dung teng, Canaan mite gam le Lebanon dong, gun lianpi Euphrates ciang dong pai un."},"8":{"text":"En un hih gam note kong pia khin hi. Lut unla TOPA in na pate uh - Abraham, Isaac le Jacob le amaute nunga a suante uh tungah piak dinga a khapsa gam va la un,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pc 12:7"},"9":{"text":"Tua hunin note tungah, \"Kei guak puak dingin note na vangik lua uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuni-in van-a aksi zah a tam dingin TOPA note Pasian in tampi hong phasak khin hi.","title":"Makaite Sehna"},"11":{"text":"TOPA na pate uh Pasian in a zah tulkhatin hong khangsak henla, hong ciamsa bangin thupha hong pia hen!"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin na buainate uh, na vangikte uh le na kitotnate khempeuh uh kei guak in bangci puak zawh ding ka hi hiam?"},"13":{"text":"Na beh ciat panun a pil, thu theitel le a kizahtak mi pawlkhat teel un, note hong uk dingin amaute ka koih ding hi,\" kong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 18:18; Pc 15:5"},"14":{"text":"Note in, \"Hih dinga nong gen hoih hi,\" ci-in nong dawng uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin note beh makai, a pil a kizahtak mite ka la-a, note tungah thu neisak in - a tulte uk, a zate uk, a sawmngate uk le a sawmte uk le minam neute tunga ulian in ka koih hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuateh tua huna na thukhente uh thu ka pia a: Na sanggamte uh kitotnate za unla Israel unau kikal thu ahi a, amau khatpeuh le mikhualte thu ahi zongin siangtakin thu khen un."},"17":{"text":"Thukhenna ah guptuam paihtuam nei loin aneu alian a kibangin a thu uh ngaihsak un, Thukhenna Pasian aa ahi manin mi khatpeuh kihta kei un. Thu khatpeuh haksa lua na sak uh a om leh kei kiang hong tun un; ken ka khen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hunin note hih ding peuhmah kong gen khin hi.","ref":"Pk 18:25"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA eite Pasian in hong thupiak bangin Horeb panin i paikhia-a, Amor-te mualtung gam lam manawhin na muhsa uh a zai le a lauhuai mahmah sehnel-gam i nawka, tua ciangin Kadesh Barnea i tung hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin note kiangah, \" TOPA eite Pasian in ei hong piak ding Amor-te mualtung gam na tung khin uh hi.","title":"Thukante Kisawlkhia"},"21":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in tua gam note hong pia khin hi. Pai to unla TOPA na pate uh Pasian hong gensa bangin la un. Lau kei unla lungkia kei un,\" kong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin note khempeuh ka kiangah hong pai-in, \"A gamsung thu omzia kankhia ding le i tot ding lampi le i tun nading khuate thu hong zasak kik dingin i mai-ah thukante sawl ni,\" nong ci uh hi.","ref":"Ms 13:1-3"},"23":{"text":"Hih ngaihsutna hoih sa ka hi manin; beh khat pan in mi khat, mi sawm le nih ka teel hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute kuanin mualtung gamah pai to uh a, Eshcol Kuam ah tungin va entel uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in tua gam singgah pawlkhat hong vom uh a, hong puasuakin, \" TOPA eite Pasian in hong piakna gam, gam hoih khat ahi hi,\" ci-in hong zasak uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua hi napi note na pai to nuam kei uh a; TOPA note Pasian thupiak na lehdo uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Na puanbuk sunguah phunin, \" TOPA in ei hong mudah hi; eite hong susia ding Amor-te khuta piak dingin Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih hi.","title":"Langah Lehdona"},"28":{"text":"Koi ah pai thei ding i hi hiam? I sanggamte in hong lungmangsak uh hi. Amaute in, ‘Tua lai-a mite eite sangin sangzaw in hatzaw uh hi; a khuapi uh zai mahmah a, a khulhte un van ban hi. Anak-te nangawn ka mu uh hi,’ ci uh hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin note kiangah, \"Kilauthawngsak kei un; amaute kihta kei un."},"30":{"text":"Note mai-ah TOPA note Pasian pai-in Egypt ah note ading hong hihsak bangin na mitmuh un"},"31":{"text":"sehnel gamah hong dosak ding hi. Tua lai-ah, hih mun na tun matengun na lampi tawntung uah pa in a tapa a puak bangin TOPA note Pasian in note hong puak lam na mu zo uh hi,\" kong ci hi.","ref":"Tp 32:10-12"},"32":{"text":"Tua hi napi note in TOPA note Pasian na muang kei uh hi;"},"33":{"text":"Amah note khualzinna lampi tawntung ah na giahphual sat nading mun uh zong ding leh na pai nading uh lampi hong lak dingin zanin mei, sun in meii in note mai-ah a pai hi.","ref":"Ph 106:24"},"34":{"text":"TOPA in na kampau uh a zak ciangin heh in a lipkhaphuai takin kiciam a;"},"35":{"text":"\"Na pute uh tungah piak dinga ka ciamsa hih gam hoih pen, Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb longal hih a gilo khang mite khat beek in a mu kei ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Amah in a lungsim taktak tawh TOPA zui ahi manin amah le ama suante tungah a khe-a a siksa leitang ka pia dinga, amah in a mu ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 14:23; 28-30"},"37":{"text":"Note hangin kei tungah zong TOPA heh a, \"Nang zong tua gam ah na lut tuan kei ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang hong huhpa Nun’ tapa Joshua a lut ding hi. Amah hanthawn in, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in tua gam luah dingin Israel-te a makaih ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tuateh galte in man ding hi, na cih uh naupang neute, - a sia le a pha a thei nai lo na ta neute uh - tua gamah a lut ding uh hi. Amaute ka pia dinga, amaute in tua gam a luah ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Note na hi uh leh, kinung leh hei unla Tuipi San a lam zuatna sehnel gam lam zuan un,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 20:12"},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin note in, \" TOPA tungah ka mawh zo uh hi. Pai toin TOPA eite Pasian hong thupiak bangin do ni,\" na ci uh hi. Tua bangin mualtung gama paitoh a baih ding sa in na galhiam uh tawh na kithawi ciat uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in, \"Amaute kho in, ‘Note hong ompih lo ding ka hi manin kuan toin do kei un. Na galte uh na lel ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 14:41-43"},"43":{"text":"Tua bangin kong gen hangin na ngai kei uh hi. Note in TOPA thupiak na lehdo uh a, na kiphatsakna-un mualtung gamah na kuanto uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua mualte-a teng Amor-te, note langah hong kuankhia uh a; Seir panin Hormah lampi dung tawntung ah khuaipi hon bangin hong delh uh a, hong sattuk uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Note lehtai-in TOPA mai-ah na kah uh hangin amah in note kahna thusim lo-a, na kahna uh a za kei hi."},"46":{"text":"Tua bangin Kadesh ah ni tampi na om uh a, - tua lai-ah na hun khempeuh uh na zang uh hi.","ref":"Job 27:9; Ph 118:12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei hong lah bangin Tuipi San b zuatna lampi zui-in sehnel-gam lam manawhin i kileh kik hi. Sawtveipi tak Seir mualtung gam kimkotin i pai hi.","title":"Sehnel Gamah Vialvak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei kiangah,"},"3":{"text":"\"Hih mualtung gam kimkot ah sawtvei khop na pai ta uh hi; tu-in leilu lamah kihei un."},"4":{"text":"Mite hih bangin thu pia in: ‘Note in Seir a teng Esau suan na sanggamte uh gamgi na nawk ding uh hi. Amaute in note hong kihta ding uh hi; ahi hangin kidawm mahmah un."},"5":{"text":"Kigalneih kha kei un, ahang in, amaute gam khat beek hong pia loin, na khepek tatkhopna nangawn uh kong pia kei ding hi. Esau in a neih dingin Seir mualtung gam teng ka piaksa ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Na nek ding uh an le na dawn ding uh tui ngunin na lei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jos 24:4"},"7":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na khutua na septe uh thupha a pia hi. Hih sehnel-gam zapi a na zin sungun amah in hong cing hi. Hih kum sawmli sung TOPA note Pasian in hong ompih a, bangmah na kisam kei uh hi.","ref":"Tp 8:2-4"},"8":{"text":"Tuaci in Seir a teng i sanggampa Esau suante i nawksuak thei hi. Elath le Ezion Geber pana pai to Arabah lampi panin i kileh a, Moab zuatna sehnel gam lampi dung zui-in i pai hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:26; Tp 1:1"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Moab-te gam khenkhat zong hong pia lo ding ka hi manin amaute va tawng loin hehsak kei un. Lot suante neih dingin Ar ka pia zo hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 19:36-38"},"10":{"text":"(Anak-te tana a tun sang, amaute zaha thahat le a tam - Em-te tua lai-ah teng ngei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Anak-te bangin amaute zong Rephaim-te in kingaihsun-a, ahi hangin Moab-te in amaute Em-te a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Hor-te zong Seir ah teng ngei uh a, ahi hangin Esau suante in a suankhia uh hi. TOPA in a piaksa gama Israel-te -a hih bang tektekun, amau mai-a om Hor-te susia in amau munah a teng uh hi.)","ref":"tg 22; Pc 14:5"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in, \"Tu-in kithawi unla Zered Kuam kantan un,\" hong ci hi. Tua ciangin ei zong tua kuam i kantan hi."},"14":{"text":"Kadesh Barnea i nusiat huna kipan Zered Kuam i kantan dong kum sawmthum le giat pha ta hi. Tua hun ciangin amaute tungah TOPA a kiciamsa bangin galdo thei mite suan le khakte khempeuh giahphual ah a mangthang uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amaute giah-phual panin a siaksiang dongin amaute langah TOPA khut a pang hi.","ref":"Ms 14:29-35; Tp 1:34-35;Ph 106:26"},"16":{"text":"Mite lakah galdo thei teng a sih khit kiuhkeuh ciangin,"},"17":{"text":"\" TOPA in kei kiangah,"},"18":{"text":"\"Tuni-in Ar a Moab kual kantan un."},"19":{"text":"Ammon-te omna na tun uh ciangin Ammon-te tawh kisai leitang khat beek no neih dingin hong pia lo ding ka hi manin amaute lausakin, galbawlin hehsak kei un. Lot suante neih dingin tua gam ka pia khin hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"tg 9; Pc 19:38"},"20":{"text":"(Tua zong, tua lai-a teng Rephaim-te gamin kingaihsun hi; ahi hangin Ammon-te in amaute Zamzum-te ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute thahatin tam mahmah uh a, Anak-te bangin a tun uh a sang hi. TOPA in Ammon-te mai panin maute susia a, amaute in suankhia-in amau munah a teng uh hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA in Seir-te tungah Esau suante adingin a hih bangin hih a, amaute mai panin Hor-te a susia hi. Esau suante in amaute suankhia in amaute munah tuni dong a teng uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Gaza ciang dong khuaneute-a teng Avvi-te ahileh Caphtor a pana paikhia Caphtor-te in susia uh a amaute munah a teng uh hi."},"24":{"text":"\"Tu-in kuankhia unla Arnon Guam kantan un. Tua gam no neihsa dingin lak kipan unla amah va sim un."},"25":{"text":"Tuni mahmah in keimah in van kikhupsin nuai-a minam khempeuh linglawng-sakin note kong kihtasak ding hi. Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian in tua a sepsa bangin note khut sungah amah hong piak nadingin ama lungsim khauhsakin a lungtang a genhaksak hi.","ref":"Pk 4:21; Ms 21:21-22"},"31":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah Sihon le ama gam note piak kong sawm ta hi.
