TOPA eite Pasian in amaute khempeuh ei hong pia hi."},"37":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA eite Pasian hong thupiakna mah bangin Ammon-te gam ahi a Jabbok gundung suksuk ahi zongin, mualtung kimkot a khuapite ahi zongin na va tuh kei uh hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zomin eite kihei-in Bashan zuatna lampi dung zuanin i pai to a, Edrei ah eite do dingin Bashan kumpipa Og, a galkap buppi tawh hong kuankhia hi.","title":"Bashan Kumpipa Og Kizawhna"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah, \"Amah le a galkap buppi le a gam, nang tungah hong pia khin ka hi manin amah kihta kei in. Heshbon ah kumpi-a om Amor mi kumpipa Sihon na hih bangin ama tungah hih in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 21:33"},"3":{"text":"Tua bangin TOPA eite Pasian in eite khut sungah Bashan kumpipa Og le a galkapte khempeuh hong pia hi. Amaute hingkhawi nei loin i satlum khin hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua hunin ama khuapi khempeuh i la khin hi. Argob kual bup, Bashan a Og kumpi gam buppi a - khuapi sawm gukte i lak loh om lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih khuapite khempeuh kulh sangpi in ki-um a, kongpite le a kalhna zawlpite nei in, kulha ki-um lo khuata lian tampi zong a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Heshbon kumpipa Sihon i bawl bangin amaute i susia c kiuhkeuh a - nupi, papi, naupang le khuapi peuhmah i susia d hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin a ganhing khempeuh uh le a khuapite uh pana i laksak vante ei adingin i puakhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuateh tua hunin Jordan nisuahna lama om Amor-te kumpipa tung panin Arnon Guam a kipan Hermon Vum ciang dong i la hi."},"9":{"text":"(Sidon-te in Hermon pen Sirion ci uh a, Amor-te in Senir ci uh hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Mualtung zanglei-a om khuapi khempeuh i la-a, Gilead gam khempeuh, Bashan gam khempeuh Salecah le Edrei ciang dong Bashan a om Og kumpi gama khuapite khempeuh i la hi."},"11":{"text":"(Rephraim mite panin a baanglai Bashan kumpipa Og bek ahi hi. A lupna e sik-a kibawl hi-a, pi sawm le thum val sau a, pi guk a zai f hi. Ammon-te khua Rabbah tua ah om lai hi.)","ref":"Pc 14:5; 2Sa 12:26; Ph 29:6"},"12":{"text":"Tua huna i lak gam sung panin Aroer leilu-lam Arnon Guam ciang Gilead mualtung gam alang a khuapite tawh Reuben-te le Gad-te tungah ka pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Gilead gam a om lai teng le Og kumpi gam ahi Bashan gam khempeuh Manasseh beh a langte tungah ka pia hi. (Bashan gam sunga Argob kual buppi, Rephaim-te leitang hi, kici hi.","title":"Gam Khenna"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh suan Jair in, Argob kual buppi Geshur-te le Maacath-te gamgi dong la-a, ama min tamsakin tu hun ciang dong Bashan pen Havvoth Jair a kici hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuateh Makir tungah Gilead ka pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin Reuben-te le Gad-te tungah Gilead panin a kikhungsuk Arnon Guam ciang (guam laizangah gamgi pai-in) Ammon-te gamgi ahi Jabbok Gunpi dong ka pia hi."},"17":{"text":"A nitumna lam gamgi in Arabah a Jordan hi-a, Kinnereth panin Pisgah mualdung nuai-a om Arabah Tuipi (Ci Tuipi) b dong amaute ka pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hunin note thu kong pia-a, \" TOPA note Pasian in na neih dingun hih gam hong pia hi. Ahi hangin pasal thahat khempeuh galsim dingin kithawi unla, na sanggam uh Israel-te mai ah masa in na kantan uh kul ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin na zite uh, na tate uh le na ganhingte uh (ganhing tampitak na neih lam uh ka thei hi) kong piaksa khuapite ah om phot uh henla"},"20":{"text":"TOPA in note hong khawlsak bangin na sanggamte un zong TOPA note Pasian in Jordan galkhat a amaute a piaksa gam luah in a khawl mateng uh tuaci om phot uh hen. Tua khit ciangin note kong piaksa gam ciat ah na ciah kik thei ding uh hi,\" kong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 32:17"},"21":{"text":"Tua hunin Joshua thu ka pia a: \" TOPA note Pasian in hih kumpi nihte tunga a hihsa na mit mahmah a na muhsa ahi hi. Na pai lai nading kumpi gam khempeuh ah TOPA in a kibangin hih ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute kihta kei in; TOPA na Pasian mahmah in hong dosak ding hi,\" ka ci hi.","title":"Moses Jordan Kantansak Lo","ref":"Pk 14:14; Tp 1:29"},"23":{"text":"Tua hunin TOPA tungah ka thum a:"},"24":{"text":"Thuneipen TOPA aw, na nasempa tungah na liatna le na khut thahatna na laklak khin hi. Vantung ah ahi a leitungah ahi zongin nang hih bangin vangliatna a hih thei bang pasian om ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Kei hong paisak-in Jordan gala gam hoih - tua mualtung gam hoih le Lebanon hong musak in,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Tp 4:22; Pk 15:11; Tp 11:2"},"26":{"text":"Ahi zongin note hangin kei tungah TOPA heh a, ka thu hong ngai lo hi. TOPA in, \"Pha zo, hih thu ah hong hopih nawn kei in."},"27":{"text":"Pisgah dawn ah kah to inla nitumna-lam, leilu-lam leitaw-lam le nisuahna-lam en in. Hih Jordan kantan lo ding na hih nungsangin na mit beekin tua gam en in."},"28":{"text":"Ahi zongin Joshua thu pia in, amah in gun kantanin hih mite makaih dinga na muhna gam luahsak ding ka hi manin hanthawn inla thakhauhsak in,\" hong ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Tuaci-in Beth Peor kiang kuam sungah i om hi.","ref":"Tp 1:37; Ms 27:12"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, tu-in za in; thukipte le thukhamte no kong hilh ding hi. Na pate uh Pasian TOPA in note hong piaksa gam ah lutin la-a na ten theih nadingun zui un.","title":"Thumang Dingin Thu Pia"},"2":{"text":"Note kong thupiak banah behlap kei unla zong dokkhia loin note kong piak TOPA note Pasian thupiakte zui un."},"3":{"text":"Baal Peor ah TOPA sepsa na mitun na mu zo uh hi. TOPA note Pasian in Peor a Baal nung a zui peuhmah susia a,"},"4":{"text":"ahi hangin TOPA note Pasian a lenkip khempeuh tuni dong na nungta uh hi."},"5":{"text":"En un, note luta na lak ding uh gam ah na zuih theih nadingun TOPA ka Pasian in kei hong thupiak bangin thukipte le thukhamte kong hilh zo hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih in minamte tungah pilna le theihtelna hong lak dinga, hih thukip a za khempeuh in, \"Hih minam liante a pil le a theitel mi taktak ahi hi,\" hong cih nadingun limtakin zui un."},"7":{"text":"TOPA eite Pasian tungah thu i nget peuhpeuh ciangin i kiangah a om bangin, amau pasiante a kianga om bang minam lian om ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Tuateh tuni-a note mai-a kong khun thukham teng banga amaan thukip le thukham a nei ding zah-a lian bang minam dang om ahi hiam?","ref":"2Sa 7:23; Isa 55:6"},"9":{"text":"Kidawm tapeuh un, na nuntak laitengun na mit ua na muhsate uh na mangngilh loh nading uh le na lungsim uh tawh a kipelh loh nadingin no le no kikem cinten un. Na tate uh hilh unla amau zong a tate uh hilhsawn uh hen."},"10":{"text":"Horeb a TOPA note Pasian mai ah na din lai-un amah in kei tungah, \"Mite in ka thugenna za-a, leitungah a nuntak laitengun kei hong zahtak theih nading uh le a tate uh a hilhsawn theih nadingun ka mai-ah mite kikhawmsak in,\" hong cih ni mangngilh kei un."},"11":{"text":"Mual kuang in vante dong mahmah bana meiivom le khuamial sahpi a om laitakin note in hong naihin mualbul ah na ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin meikuang lak panin TOPA in note hong hopih hi. Kam pauna awte na zak uh hangin bangmah lim na mu kei uh hi; aw bek ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Note tungah hih thukhun, Thupiak Sawm hong genkhia-in na zuih nadingun thu hong pia-a, tua ciangin suangpek nih tungah a gelh hi."},"14":{"text":"Jordan na kantan khit uh ciangin na neih ding uh gam ah na zuih ding uh thukipte le thukhamte note kong hilh dingin TOPA in kei lam hong lak hi.","ref":"Pn 4:23; Eph 6:4; Pk 34:28"},"15":{"text":"Horeb a meikuang lak pan TOPA in note hong hopih ni-in na khat peuhpeuh lim na mu kei uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin"},"16":{"text":"note hong siasak ding na khatpeuh tawh a kisun milim bawl loin lim na seek kei ding uh a - numei lim ahi a pasal lim ahi zongin,","title":"Milim Biakna Kikham"},"17":{"text":"leitunga om ganhing khatpeuh lim ahi a, huih laka leng vasa khatpeuh lim ahi zongin"},"18":{"text":"leitham a bokvak ganhing khatpeuh lim ahi a, tui sunga om ngasa khatpeuh lim tawh ahi zongin a kisun lim na seek loh nadingun kidawm mahmah un."},"19":{"text":"Tuateh vanlam entoin - vantunga na khempeuh - ni, kha, aksite na muh uh ciangin vankikhupsin nuai-a minamte khempeuh tungah TOPA note Pasian in a piak nate lamah kihei-in bia-in kun kha kei un."},"20":{"text":"No na hi uh leh TOPA in hong la in, sik haltuina pummei, Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih a, ama gouluah dingin tu-a na om bangun hong omsak hi.","ref":"Pk 20:4-5; Tp 5:8; 1Ku 8:51"},"21":{"text":"Note hangin kei tungah TOPA heh-a, kiciam takpi khin ahi manin Jordan gun kan loin TOPA note Pasian in na luah dingun hong piak gam hoih ah ka lut kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Hih gam ah kei ka si ding hi; Jordan ka kantan kei ding hi; ahi hangin note in na kantan ding uh a, tua gam hoih na la ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in no tawh a bawl thukhun na mangngilh khak ding uh kidawm un; TOPA note Pasian in a kham na khatpeuh tawh a kisun lim bawl kei un."},"24":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian in a haltum mei, a aam Pasian ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 12:29; Tp 1:37; 3:25"},"25":{"text":"Tu le ta nei in tua gamah na ten khit nungun - kiheisanin, lim khatpeuh bawlin TOPA note Pasian mit ah gitlohna na sep uh a, amah na hehsak uh leh"},"26":{"text":"Jordan kantan a na lak ding uh gamah na mangthang pah ding uh hi, cih note langah ka teci dingin van le lei tuni-in ka sam hi. Tua lai-ah sawtvei teng loin hong kisusia taktak ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"TOPA in minamte lakah hong thehthang ding a, TOPA hong hawlkhiatte, minamte lakah tawmtawm bek na om ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Note in tua laiah mihing in a bawl, khua mu thei lo, khua za thei lo, a ne thei lo, a gimnam za thei lo sing le suang pasiante na bia ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua lai panin na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh TOPA note Pasian na zon ciang bekun na mu ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Note tungah hih na khempeuh hong tungin na lungdon khit uh a ni nunung ciangin TOPA note Pasian kiangah na kileh kik ding uh a, ama thu na mang ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA note Pasian in mi a lainat Pasian ahi manin amah in note hong nusia lo dinga hong susia loin kiciamna tawh a kipsak uh, na pute uh tawh a thukhun a mangngilh kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 30:18-19; 2Ku 17:2,17; 2Kh 15:4"},"32":{"text":"Pasian in mihing a bawl ni-a kipan, note hun mapek tuma hunte kan un; vante mong khat panin mong khat dongah dong un. Hih zah a lian na khatpeuh piang ngei in, hih bang na khatpeuh a kiza ngei peuhmah hiam?"},"33":{"text":"Note zaksa bangin mei kuang lakah Pasian a a pauna aw za-a nungta kua om peuhmah hiam?","title":"in Pasian Hi"},"34":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in zia-etnate, lim piandangte le a lamdangte, gal, a thahat khut le khut zankhiatna tawh ahikeh a lipkhaphuai sepna tawh na muh mahmah un no ading Egypt ah na khempeuh a sep bangin, pasian khatpeuh in na semin minam khat pan minam dang khat lakkhiat sawm ngei ahi hiam?","ref":"Tp 5:24-26; 7:19"},"35":{"text":"Note in, Pasian ahi TOPA , amah longal adang a om loh lam na theih nadingun hih na khempeuh no hong kilak ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Amah in note hong sek nadingin van panin ama aw hong zasak hi. Leitung ah a mei lianpi hong laka, meikuang lakah ama kammal na za uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Amah in na pute uh a it manin amau nunga a suante uh teelin ama Ompihna le a lian mahmah thahatna tawh Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih a,"},"38":{"text":"na mai panun no sanga a lianzaw, a hatzaw minamte hawlkhia-in amau gamah hong puak-a, na luah dingun hong pia ahi manin, tuni-in hici bangin na om uh hi.","ref":"Pk 19:9,19; Tp 10:15;1Sa 2:2"},"39":{"text":"Tuni-in tunga van le nuai-a lei ah TOPA in Pasian ahina note lungsim ah theicianin ciamteh un. Adang khat beek a om kei hi."},"40":{"text":"Note le no nunga na tate uh tungah thu hoih in, TOPA note Pasian in na neih den dingun hong piak leitangah sawtpi na ten theih nadingun, tuni-a kong piak ama thukipte le a thupiakte zui un."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Jordan nisuahna lamah khuapi thum a sehkhia hi."},"42":{"text":"Mi khat in a ma-in sawmkhol lo napi a vengpa a thah khak leh tua lai-ah tai thei ding hi. Hih khuapite khatpeuh ah tai-in a nuntakna a hon ding hi.","title":"Bukna Khuapi"},"43":{"text":"Tua khuapite hihte ahi hi: Reuben-te adingin sehnel-gam mualtung zanga om Bezer; Gad-te adingin Gilead a om Ramoth; le Manasseh-te adingin Bashan a Golan ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 35:6-34; Tp 19:1-14"},"44":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te mai-a a lui thukham hih ahi hi."},"45":{"text":"Hih ngeina, thukipte le thukhamte, Egypt panin a paikhiat uh ciangin Moses in amaute a piak hi-a,","title":"Thukham Thupatna"},"46":{"text":"Egypt pana a paikhiat nungun Moses le Israel-te in a zawh uh Heshbon a kumpi a sem Amor-te kumpipa Sihon gam sung ahi, Jordan nisuahna lama om Beth Peor kianga kuam sunga a om laitakun a gen ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Amaute in Bashan kumpi Og gam Jordan nisuahna lama Amor-te kumpi nihte gam a laksak uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Hih gam Arnon Guam kil-a om Aroer panin Siyon b vum (tuapen Hermon) dong kikhungsuk a,"},"49":{"text":"Jordan nisuahna lam Arabah gam khempeuh huamkha-in Pisgah mualdung nuai-a Arabah c Tuipi dong ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te khempeuh samin: \"Israel-te aw, za un, thukipte le thukhamte tuni-in note zakin kong genkhia hi. Tua ciangin amah in:","ref":"Pk 19:5"},"6":{"text":"\"Keimah in na salsuahna uh Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi.","ref":"Sp 26:1"},"7":{"text":"\"Note in ka mai-ah a pasian dang na nei kei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Note in tunga van ahi a, nuai-a lei ahi a, leinuai tui sungah ahi zongin a om na khatpeuh tawh kisunin lim na bawl kei ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuate bia in na kun kei ding uh hi; ahang in, keimah TOPA note Pasian a aam Pasian ka hi hi. Kei hong mudah a pate uh mawhna hangin khang thum khang lina dongin a tate tungah ka thuka,"},"10":{"text":"ahi hangin kei hong it a, ka thupiakte a zuite tungah khang tul dongin ka itna ka lak hi.","ref":"Pk 34:7"},"11":{"text":"\" TOPA note Pasian min na zangkhial kei ding uh hi, ahang in, TOPA in ama min a zangkhialte a mawhsak pelmawh ding hi."},"12":{"text":"\" TOPA note Pasian hong thupiaksa bangin Sabbath ni siangthotakin tang un."},"13":{"text":"Niguk sung na semin na sep ding teng uh sem un,"},"14":{"text":"a ni sagihna ni ahi leh TOPA note Pasian Sabbath ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in na nasemnu, na nasempate uh no mah banga a tawlngak theih nadingun no na hi uh a, na tanu na tapate uh ahi zongin, na nasemnu, na nasempate uh ahi a, na bawngtal, na laa le na ganhingte khatpeuh ahi a, no huang sunga om mikhual khatpeuh ahi zongin na na sem kei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Note Egypt ah sila na hina uh le TOPA note Pasian in tua lai pana a thahat khut le a zankhiat ban tawh hong paikhiatpih ahilam phawk un. Tua ahi manin TOPA note Pasian in Sabbath ni na tan dingun thu hong pia hi.","ref":"Pc 2:2; Heb 4:4"},"16":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hong piakna gamah sawtpi nungta-in na nopsak theih nadingun TOPA note Pasian hong thupiak bangin na nu le na pa pahtawi in.","ref":"Sp 19:3; Eph 6:2-3"},"17":{"text":"\"Tual that kei in."},"18":{"text":"\"Angkawm kei in.","ref":"Mt 5:27-30; Jas 2:11"},"19":{"text":"\"Gu kei in.","ref":"Sp 19:11"},"20":{"text":"\"Na vengpa langah a maan loin teci pang kei in.","ref":"Mk 10:19"},"21":{"text":"\"Na vengpa zi deihgawh kei in. Na vengpa inn ahi a, a leitang ahi zongin; a nasemnu ahi a, a nasempa, a bawngtal, a laa le na vengpa tawh kisai na khatpeuh ahi zongin deihgawh kei in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 20:1-17"},"22":{"text":"Hihte, TOPA in mualtung a mei le khuamial sahpi sung meikuang lak panin a kikhawm mipi bup tungah a tangko hi a; bangmah dang a genbeh kei hi. Tua ciangin suangpek nih tungah gelhin tuate kei hong pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Meikuang in mual kanga, khuamial lakah awging na zak uh ciangin na beh makaite uh le na upate uh ka kiangah hong pai uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuateh note in, \" TOPA note Pasian in a minthanna le a thupina eite hong lak khin a, meikuang lak panin ama aw i za hi. Pasian in mite hopih ta leh mite a nuntak lai veve lam tuni-in i mu hi."},"25":{"text":"Bang hangin tu-in, eite si zenzen ding i hi hiam? Hih mei lianpi in eite hong hultum dinga TOPA eite Pasian aw za lai lehang i si ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahang in, a si thei mihing, eite zak bangin mei sungah a nungta Pasian aw za a, a hing lai kiza ngei ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"A kiang nai unla TOPA eite Pasian thugen khempeuh ngai un. Tua ciangin TOPA eite Pasian in nang tunga hong gen peuhmah ko tungah hong gen in. Kote in ngai-in ka mang ding uh hi,\" na ci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:33; 18:16"},"28":{"text":"Kei kianga nong genna uh TOPA in na za a, TOPA in kei tungah, \"Hih mite in nang tungah hong gen uh ka za hi. Hong gen khempeuh uh a hoih hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute le a tate uh adingin a hoih den theih nadingin hong kihta dingin a lungsim uh kei tungah hong kinga uh henla ka thupiakte zui den le uh ka deih hi.","ref":"Ph 81:8,13"},"30":{"text":"\"Pai inla a puanbuk uah ciahkiksak in."},"31":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute neih dinga ka piak ding gamah a zuih dingun na hilh ding thupiakte, thukipte le thukhamte kong piak theih nadingin nang hih lai-ah om in,\" hong ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA note Pasian in hong thupiakte limtakin sem unla veilam ahi a taklam ahi zongin pial kei un."},"33":{"text":"Na lak ding uh gamah daupai-in na khanto nadingun TOPA note Pasian hong thupiakna lampi ah kalsuan un.","ref":"Tp 17:11,20; Jos 1:7; Jer 7:23"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thupiakte, thukipte le thukhamte, note in Jordan kantanin na lak ding uh gamah na zuih dingun kong hilh dinga TOPA note Pasian hong piak ahi hi.","title":"Note Pasian It Un"},"2":{"text":"Tua in note le na tate uh le amau khita suak a tate uh tawh hih kong piak thukipte le a thupiakte zui-a TOPA note Pasian kihta in na nuntak uh sawtpi nuam nasak nading uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel aw za un, na pate uh Pasian TOPA in hong ciamsa bang tektek in bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna gamah tampitak pha a nuam na sak theih nadingun thu na man ding uh limtakin ngaihsun un."},"4":{"text":"Israel aw za in: TOPA eite Pasian, TOPA in khat b ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian na lungsim khempeuh, na hinna khempeuh na hatna khempeuh un it un."},"6":{"text":"Tuni-a kong piak hih thupiakte na lungsimun vom un."},"7":{"text":"Na tate uh limtakin ciamtehsak un. Inn ah na om uh ciang; lam na pai uh ciang, na lup uh ciang, na thawh uh ciangin amaute genpih un."},"8":{"text":"Tuate na khutuah lim bangin hen unla na taltang uah suang un."},"9":{"text":"Na inn kongkhuamte le na kongpite uh tungah tuate gelh un.","ref":"Mt 22:37; Tp 11:18; Eph 6:4"},"10":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na pate uh, Abraham, Isaac, le Jacob tungah note piak dinga a ciamsa gam - gamzaipi, note phuh loh a etlawm mahmah khuapite,"},"11":{"text":"note khol loh na hoih khempeuh tawh a dim innte, note tawh loh tuikhukte le na suan loh uh lenggui le olive huante omna ah hong puakin - tuate ne a na kham uh ciangin"},"12":{"text":"salsuahna gam Egypt pan hong paikhiatpih TOPA na mangngilh khak ding uh kidawm un.","ref":"Tp 8:10"},"13":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian kihta unla ama na bek semin ama min ah kiciam un."},"14":{"text":"Note kim-a om midangte’ pasiante nung zui kei un;"},"15":{"text":"na zuih uh leh note laka om TOPA note Pasian a aam Pasian hi a, a hehna in note hong kangin, lei maitang panin hong susia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Massah a na hih bangun TOPA note Pasian zia-et kei un."},"17":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thupiaknate ngeinakipte le thukipte limtakin zui un."},"18":{"text":"Note adingin a hoih nading le TOPA kiciama na pute uh tunga a ciam gam hoih na luah theih nadingun TOPA muhna ah a hoih le amaanin gamta unla,"},"19":{"text":"TOPA gensa bangin na mai-ua galte khempeuh tuancilmang un."},"20":{"text":"Mailam hunah na tapate un, \" TOPA note Pasian in hong thupiak, ngeinakipte thukipte le thukhamte bang a deihna hiam?\" ci-a hong dot uh leh"},"21":{"text":"amaute tungah: \"Eite Egypt ah Pharaoh salin i om a, ahi hangin TOPA in khut thahat tawh hong paikhiatpih hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA in eite mitmuhin alian, a lauhuai - a piandang limte le alamdangte - Egypt tung, Pharaoh le a innkuan buppi tungah a tungsak hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah in kiciama i pute tungah piak dinga a khapsa gamah hong puak dingin tua lai panin hong paikhiatpih hi."},"24":{"text":"Eite a tawntungin daupai-a tuni-a bangin i nuntak theih nadingin hih thukipte zui a, TOPA eite Pasian i kihtak nadingin TOPA in thu hong pia hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama hong thupiak bangin TOPA eite Pasian mai-ah hih thukham zuih ding i thupi sim leh, tua in eite thumaanna ahi ding hi,\" ci-in gen un.","ref":"Pk 13:14; Jer 32:39"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na neih ding uh gamah hong puakin na lut uh ciangin, minam tampi - Hit-te, Girgash-te, Amor-te, Canaan-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te - note sangin lianzaw in a hatzaw minam sagihte note mai-ah hawlkhia a,","title":"Minamte Hawlkhiatna"},"2":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in amaute hong pia in na zawh uh ciangin amaute na susia khin kiuhkeuh a ding uh hi. Amaute tawh thu ciam loin na lainat kei ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute tawh na kiteng kei ding uh hi. A tapate uh tungah na tanute uh pia loin, na tapate uh adingin a tanute uh na la kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, amaute in na tapate uh kei hong zuihna panun pialsakin pasian dangte na sem ding uh a, note tungah TOPA hehna kuangin hong susia pah kha ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute hih bangin na bawl ding uh hi: A biakna-taute uh phelkhia-in, a suang siangthote uh dengkham unla Asherah khuamte b phukin a milimte uh mei-in haltum un."},"6":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian tungah a siangtho mite na hi uh hi. TOPA note Pasian in lei maitanga mi khempeuh panin ama mi suakin, ama gou neih dingin note hong telkhia khin hi.","ref":"Pk 23:32; Tp 14:2; 31:3"},"7":{"text":"Midangte sangin note na tamzawk mahmah manun TOPA in note hong ittuama hong teel hi lo hi, ahang in minam khempeuh lakah a tawmpen na hi uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in salsuahna gam panin hong tan-a, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh vangliatna panin a thahat khut tawh hong paikhiatpihna in, TOPA in note hong it man le na pute uh tungah kamciamin a thuciamna a zuih hang ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA note Pasian pen Pasian ahilam thei un; amah a muanhuai Pasian hi-a, amah it-in a thupiak a zuite tungah ama itna thukhun khang tulkhat dongin a kiplet hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah a mudahte a hileh amaute maitang mah ah kisiatna in thuk kika; amah a mudahte a maitang-a, a thuk kik ding a ziakai kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tuni-a kong piak, thupiakte, thukipte le thukhamte na zuih nadingun limtakin ngaihsun un."},"12":{"text":"Hih thukhamte na thupi sim uh a, tuate limtaka na zuih uh leh TOPA note Pasian in na pute uh tawh a thuciam bangin note tawh a itna thukhun a kiplet ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in note hong it-in thupha hong pia dinga hong pungsak ding hi. Amah in na pute uh tungah note piak dinga a ciamsa gamah na naubu gahte uh, na leitang ua ankungte - na antangte uh, zuthak le sathau - na ganhonte un note, na tuuhon te un note thupha a pia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Midangte sangin note thupha hong kipiazaw dinga; na mite uh numei ahi a pasal ahi zongin ta nei lo om loin na ganhingte uh zong a ciing a om kei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"TOPA in natna namkim panin hong suaktasak ding hi. Egypt a na theihsa uh natna nasiapite hong thuaksak lo dinga, ahi hangin no hong mudahte a thuaksak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note hong piaksa mite khempeuh na susia pelmawh ding uh hi. No aa in thang suak ding ahi manin hehpihhuai sa kei unla a pasiante uh na sem kei un.","ref":"Tp 28:1-14; Pk 23:26; 15:26"},"17":{"text":"No le no in, \"Hih minamte ei sangin thahatzaw uh hi. Bangci nawhkhiat zo ding i hi hiam?\" na ci kha ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute kihta peuhmah kei un; TOPA note Pasian in Pharaoh le Egypt tunga a bawl khempeuh limtakin ciamteh un."},"19":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note hong paikhiatpihna - zia-etna lianpite, a tuampian limte le a lamdangte, a thahat khut le a kizankhia bante na mit mahmah uh tawh na muhsa uh ahi hi. TOPA note Pasian in tu-a na kihtak uh mite khempeuh tungah tua mah bangin a sem ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua tham loin TOPA note Pasian in no muhlohna muna a bu a suakta sunte nangawn a manthan nadingun tunpi a sawl ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Note laka om TOPA note Pasian in a lian mahmah le a kihtakhuai Pasian ahi manin amaute kilauthawngsak kei un."},"22":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note mai panin minamte tawmtawmin a nawhkhia ding hi. Thakhatin a veka nawhkhiatpah ding hong kiphal kei ding hi. Kihawlkhia khin pah leh note kimah gamsa tam lua ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA note Pasian in no tungah amaute hong pia dinga, amaute a kisuksiat khit matengin siatna lianpi sung a denna ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amau kumpite note khut sungah hong pia dinga, van kikhupsin nuai panin amaute min na phiatkhia ding uh hi. Note langah mi khat beek pang zo lo dinga; amaute na susia ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"A kiseektawm amau pasiante mei ah na khul ding uh hi. Tuate tunga om ngun le khamte enlah loin no adingin zong na la kei ding uh hi; TOPA note Pasian in tuate kih ahi manin note thang hong kisiahna suak kha ding hi."},"26":{"text":"A kihhuai na khatpeuh na inn uh tun kei un, na tut uh leh tuate tawh note suksiat dingin hong kituam koih ding hi. A kihhuai nate suksiat dingin kituam koih ahi manin mudahin kih cihtakin kih un.","ref":"Tp 4:34; Pk 23:28-30; Ph 105:5"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note nungta-in pungin na pate uh tungah kiciamna TOPA in a khapsa gam ah lut a na lak theih nadingun tuni-a kong piak thupiak khempeuh limtakin zui un.","title":"Mangngilh Kei Un"},"2":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in ama thupiakte na zui uh hiam, na zui kei uh hiam cih note lungsim hong sittel nop manin, note hong niamkhiat a kum sawmli sung sehnel-gam lampi ah hong bangci makaih ahi hiam, cih phawk gige un."},"3":{"text":"Amah in note hong niamkhiatin hong gilkialsak a, tua ciangin note gen loh na pate un zong a theih nai loh manna in hong vaka, mite anlum bek tawh nungta loin TOPA kam pana pusuak thu khempeuh tawh a nungta ahilam hong hilh hi."},"4":{"text":"Hih kum sawmli sungin na puansilhte uh patkhia loin na khete uh zong a bawk kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin pa in a tapa a sek bangin TOPA note Pasian in note hong sek ahilam na lungsim un thei un.","ref":"Tp 4:1; Mt 4:4"},"6":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thupiakte zui unla ama lampi tawnin zahtak mahmah un."},"7":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian in gam hoihna mun - luitui le bualtui omna, mualtung le guam sunga ciktui a luanna gam;"},"8":{"text":"mangbuh le mangbuh-ham, lenggui, theikung, mang-kawlsing, olive thau le khuaizu omna gam;"},"9":{"text":"anlum cilbawl lo-a bangmah kisap lohna gam; suangtumte sik hi-a, mualte panin sumsan na tawhkhiat theih nading uh gam ah note hong puak hi.","ref":"Tp 11:9-12; Jer 2:7"},"10":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in gam hoih hong pia ahi manin an ne in na kham uh ciangin amah phat un."},"11":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian na mangngilh khak ding uh le tuni-a kong piak ama thupiakte, a thukhamte le a thukipte na zuih loh khak ding uh kidawm un."},"12":{"text":"Tua hi kei leh, ne in na kham khit uh ciang, inn hoih lamin na ten khit uh ciang,"},"13":{"text":"le na bawng honte uh le na tuuhonte uh khangin tampitak a phak khit ciang, na ngun na khamte uh kibehlapin na neihsa uh a pun ciangin"},"14":{"text":"na lungsim uh kiphasakin na salsuahna uh Egypt gam panin note hong paikhiatpih TOPA note Pasian na mangngilh kha ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in, a lauhuai sehnel-gam zaipi kantan in tui om lohna keugaw gam sung gul gupha le mom-ai lakah note hong makaih hi. Amah in a sak suangtumpi panin no adingin tui phulkhiasak hi."},"16":{"text":"Sehnel-gam ah na pate un a theih ngei loh uh na nek dingun manna hong pia-a, a tawpna ah note hoih nadingin hong zia-etin hong niamkhiat hi."},"17":{"text":"No le no in, \"Ka vangliatna le ka khut thahatna tawh kei ading hauhna hizah hong piangkhia hi,\" na ci thei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah in tuni-a mah bangin na pute uh tungah kiciamin a thukhun lenkip-a, na hauh theihna uh hong pia TOPA note Pasian ahilam phawk un.","ref":"Tp 6:10-12; Pn 10:22; Hos 2:8"},"19":{"text":"Note in TOPA note Pasian na mangngilh khak zenzen uh a, pasian dangte nung zui-in tuate bia-a na kun uh leh note hong kisuksiat taktak nading tuni-in note langah teci-in ka om hi."},"20":{"text":"TOPA in note mai-ah minamte a suksiat bangin TOPA note Pasian in ama thu na man kei uh leh note zong hong susia ding hi.","ref":"Tp 4:26; 30:18"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, za in. Note in Jordan kantanin van a ban kulh a nei khuapi lian mahmahte a teng, no sanga a lianzaw a thahatzawte a suankhia ding na hi ta uh hi.","title":"Israel’ Thumaanna Hang Hilo"},"2":{"text":"A mite a tunsang, a thahat - Anak-te ahi hi! Amaute thu na theihsa uh hi-a, \"Anak-te langah kua pang zo ding hiam?\" a kicih na zaksa uh ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin tuni-in TOPA note Pasian a haltum mei bangin note mai-ah pai taktak ahilam telcian un. Amah in amaute susia dinga, note mai-ah amaute hong zawhsak ding hi. Tuateh TOPA in hong ciamsa bangin amaute hawlkhia dinga, manlangin a phiatmang ding hi.","ref":"Ms 13:22,28,32-33"},"4":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note mai-ah amaute a hawlkhiat khit ciangin, \"Eite thumaanna hangin hih leitang a nei dingin hih lai ah TOPA in eite hong puak hi,\" kici kha kei un. Hi peuhmah lo hi, hih minamte a gitlohna uh hangin TOPA in note maiah a hawlkhiat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thumaanna hang uh le na cihtakna hangun amaute’ leitang la-in a nei hi loin, hih minamte gitlohna hangin TOPA note Pasian in na pate uh, Abraham, Isaac le Jacob tunga a kiciamna a tangtunsakna-in note mai panin amaute a hawlkhia ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin theitel un, note thumaanna hangin TOPA note Pasian in na neih dingun hih gam hoih hong pia hi lo hi ahang in, note ngawngkhauh mite na hi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Sehnel gamah TOPA note Pasian phin-a, na hehsak uh ciamteh unla mangngilh ngei kei un. Egypt na nusiat ua kipan hih lai na tun dong uh TOPA na langpan niloh uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Horeb ah TOPA na thangpaisak uh a note susia ding zahin a heh hi.","title":"Kham Bawngno"},"9":{"text":"TOPA in note tawh a bawl thukhun suangpek - tua suangpek la dingin mualtungah ka paitoh lai-in, mualtungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli ka om a; an ne loin tui lah ka dawn kei hi."},"10":{"text":"TOPA in Pasian khutme-a kigelh suangpek nih hong pia hi. Tuate tungah mualtunga mipi kikhop ni-a meikuang pana TOPA in a tangko thupiak khempeuh a om hi.","ref":"Ph 106:19"},"11":{"text":"Sun sawmli le zan sawmli a cin ciangin TOPA in thukhun suangpek ahi, suangpek nih kei hong pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Egypt pana na paikhiatpih na mite kisiagawp khin uh ahi manin hih lai panin paisuk meng in, ka thupiaknasa panin amaute pialkhia pak uh a, amaute ading a kisung milim a bawl uh hi,\" ci-in hong gen hi.","ref":"Pk 32:7-8; Thk 2:17"},"13":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Hih mite a ngawngkhauh mi ahi takpi lam ka mu khin hi!"},"14":{"text":"Amaute susia-a, a min uh van kikhupsin nuai pan ka phiatkhiat theih nadingin ka ut bangbangin hong tasak in. Tuateh amaute sangin tamzaw-a, a hatzaw minam khat kong suaksak ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 32:10"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin mual kuanglaipi mah panin kihei-in ka paisuk hi. Tua hunin thukhun suangpek nih ka khutte gelah a ka tawi hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka khuadak ciangin TOPA note Pasian tungah na mawh lam uh ka mu hi; no mahmah in bawngno lim suna kisung lim khat na bawl khin uh hi. TOPA in note hong thupiaksa lampi pan na kiheikhia khin pak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin suangpek nihte ka la-a, ka khutte panin lawnkhia-in, note mitmuhin ka sunen hi.","ref":"Pk 32:15"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin na bawlsa uh mawhna le TOPA muhna ah a sia-a na gamtatna te khempeuh un amah hehsak lua ahi manin an ne lo tui dawn loin sun sawmli le zan sawmli TOPA mai-ah khatvei ka khupbawh kik leuleu hi."},"19":{"text":"Note suksiat nading khopin TOPA heh ahi manin ama hehna le a thangpaihna ka kihta hi. Ahi hangin TOPA in ka thu hong ngai kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Aaron suksiat nading khopin ama tungah TOPA heh a, ahi zongin tua hun laitakin Aaron ading zong ka ngetsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua note mawhna - na bawlsa uh bawngno ka la-a mei-ah ka khul hi. Tua ciangin ka sunen-a, leivuinel bangin ka gawivui khit ciangin, mual pana luangsuk lui sungah avui ka lawn hi."},"22":{"text":"Note in zong Taberah, Massah le Kibroth Hattaavah ah TOPA na hehsak uh hi.","ref":"Ms 11:3; Pk 17:7"},"23":{"text":"Kadesh Barnea pan TOPA in hong sawlkhiat ciangin, \"Pai to unla, note kong piaksa gam va luah un,\" hong ci hi. Ahi hangin note in TOPA note Pasian thupiak langpanin na lehdo uh hi. Amah muang loin a thu zong na mang kei uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Note kong theih a kipan TOPA langpangin na lehdo uh hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in note ka susia ding hi ci khin ahi manin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung TOPA mai-ah khupbawhsa in ka om hi."},"26":{"text":"TOPA kiangah thu ka ngen a, \"Thuneipen TOPA aw, na vanglianpi-in na mite na tankhia-a, a thahat khut tawh Egypt pana na paikhiatpih nangma gouluah dingte susia kei in."},"27":{"text":"Nangma nasem Abraham, Isaac le Jacob-te phawk in. Hih mite lungsim khauhna, a gitlohna uh le a mawhna uh awlmawh kei in."},"28":{"text":"Tua hi kei leh kote nong paikhiatpihna gamte in, ‘ TOPA in amaute a khapsa gam ah tun zo kei, amah in amaute mudah a, sehnel gamah thah dinga a paikhiatpih ai ve maw!’ ci ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute nangma mite hi a, na vanglianpi le na ban zankhiat tawh na paikhiatpih nangma gouluahte ahi hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Pk 32:11; Tp 4:20; 1Ku 8:51"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin TOPA in kei kiangah, \"A masa pen tawh a kibang suangpek nih khuakkhia inla mualtung ka kiangah hong pai to in. Singkuang to b khat zong lem in.","title":"A Masa Pen Bang Suangpek"},"2":{"text":"Keimah in suangpekte tungah, na suktapsa a masa pen suangpekte tunga thute mah ka gelh ding hi. Tua ciangin singkuang sungah koih in,\" hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkha singkuang khat ka bawla, a masa pen tawh a kibang suangpek nih khuakkhia in suangpek nihte tawisa in mual tungah ka paito hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA in ama-a, a gelhsa mualtunga mipite na kikhop ni-ua meikuang lakah no tunga a tangkosa Thupiak Sawmte mah hih suangpekte tungah a gelh hi. TOPA in tuate kei hong pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin mualtung pan kong ciahsuk-a, TOPA hong thupiaksa bangin ka bawlsa singkuang sungah suangpekte ka koih hi; tu-in tuate tuaci om lai hi.","ref":"Pk 20:1; 40:20"},"6":{"text":"(Jaakan-te tuikhukte panin Moserah ah Israel-te a zin uh hi. Tua lai-ah Aaron si-a kivui-in a tapa Eleazar in a siampi za a luah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua lai panin Gudgodah ah zin uh a, luitui omna gam Jotbathah dong a zinsuak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin TOPA in, Levi behte in tuni donga a sep uh bangin TOPA thukhun singkuang pua ding, TOPA mai-ah dingin biakna nasem ding le ama mina thupha a pia dingin amaute a sehtuam hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hangin Levi-te in amau sanggamte lakah tanh ahi-a luah ahi zongin nei lo uh a; TOPA note Pasian hong gensa bangin amaute’ luah in TOPA ahi hi.)"},"10":{"text":"Tu-in a masa a ka hih bangin, mualtungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli ka om khin a, hih hunin zong TOPA in ka thu hong ngai hi. Note suksiat ding ama deihna hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Pai inla a maute piak dinga a pate uh tunga ka khapsa gamah luta a lak nadingun lampi ah amaute makaih in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 34:28"},"12":{"text":"Israel aw, tu-in ahileh TOPA note Pasian in note tungah bangdang hong ngen loin: TOPA note Pasian kihta a, ama lampite zui-in amah it a, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh TOPA note Pasian na sem-a,"},"13":{"text":"note hoih nadingin tuni-a note kong piak TOPA thupiakte le thukipte na zuih ding bek uh hi lo ahi hiam?","title":"Kihta Un"},"14":{"text":"Vante le a sang pen vante nangawn, leitung le a sunga omte khempeuh TOPA note Pasian aa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi napi TOPA in na pute uh aituam bawlin amaute it a, tuni-a na om bangun minamte khempeuh tung pekah amau suan note hong teel hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na lungsim uh vun-at unla na ngawng uh khauhsak nawn kei un."},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian ahileh pasiante’ Pasian, topate’ Topa, thahatin a kihtakhuai, kuamah deidan a nei lo, golhsum a sang lo a lian mahmah Pasian ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in pa neilote le meigongte panpihin, pemtate it a, an pia in puansilh a guan hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua hi a note zong Egypt a pemta hi ngei na hi manun pemtate na it ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian kihta unla a na sem un. Amah kiplet unla ama minin kiciam un."},"21":{"text":"Amah pen note’ phat, na mit uh tawh na muh uh a lian a kihtakhuai a lamdang nate a bawl, note Pasian ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Egypt a, paisuk na pute uh a vekin sawm sagih pha hi, tua hi-a tu-in TOPA note Pasian in vana aksi zahin hong tamsak khin hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian it unla, ama hong ngetna, a thukipte, a thukhamte, le a thupiakte zui tawntung un.","title":"Itin A Thu Mang Un"},"2":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hong sektatnate a mu lo le a sinkha lo na tate uh hopih ka hih loh lam tuni-in thei un. Tuate in amaute in ama thupina a khut hatna a zankhiat a ban;"},"3":{"text":"Egypt gam sunga Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le gambup tunga a bawl na lamdangte;"},"4":{"text":"Egypt galkapte tung, a sakolte uh le a sakollengte uh tunga a septe, note hong nungdelh laitakun amaute San Tuipi a tui in a tupmangna le TOPA in amaute a siatmangsaknate ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih mun na tun mateng uh sehnel gamah no adingin a septe na tate un mukha lo uh a,"},"6":{"text":"tuateh Reuben-te, Eliab’ tapate Abiram le Dathan tunga a hih, Israel khempeuh laizang lian ah leitung kamka-a, amau innkuan bup le a puanbukte uh tawh amau neihsa a ganhing khempeuh uh a nawmvalhna, a mu na tate uh hi lo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA bawlsa na lianpi khempeuh mita mu note na hi uh hi.","ref":"Ms 16:1-35; Tp 5:24"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin note Jordan kantanin pai-a, tua gam na lak zawh nading uh, hatna na neih theih nading un tuni-a kong thupiakte khempeuh zui un,"},"9":{"text":"tua pen na pute uh tung le amau suante tungah piak dingin TOPA kiciamnasa gam - bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna ah sawtveipi na nuntak theih nadinguh ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Note luta na luah ding uh gam pen, anteh huan ah ankungno suanin, khe in tui na buah na uh note hong pai khiatna Egypt gam bang hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in Jordan kantan-a na lak ding uh gam in mual le guam om-a, van panin guahtui a ngak leitang ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in tua gam kema; TOPA note Pasian mit in kum kipat a kipan kum bei dong a tawntungin a mitsuanna leitang ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin note in muanhuaitakin tuni-a kong thupiakte na man uh a - TOPA note Pasian it-in, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh ama na nasep uh leh"},"14":{"text":"tua ciangin note in an la-in zuthak le sathau na kaihkhop theih nadingun na gamuah sikhiau guah le tukguah ka zusak tuak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Na ganhonte uh adingin lopaang ah lopa kong pia dinga, note in ne-in na tai ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:29; Joel 2:23; Ph 104:14"},"16":{"text":"Pasian dangte bia-a kun dingin note hong kizolkhiat khak ding kidawm un."},"17":{"text":"Tua hileh TOPA hehna no tungah kuangin guah haang in lei in bangmah a gahsuah loh nadingin amah in vante khakcip dinga, TOPA in note hong piaksa gam hoih panin na mangthang pah ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih ka thugente na lungsim uh le na ngaihsutna-uah kiplet unla; na khutuah lim bangin henin na tal-uah suang un."},"19":{"text":"Na tate uh hilh un; inn ah na om uh ciang, lam na pai uh ciang, na lup uh ciang, na thawh uh ciangin na tate uh genpih un."},"20":{"text":"Na inn kongkhak mung tung uh le na kongpite uh tungah tuate gelh un."},"21":{"text":"Tua in leitung tungsan ah vante a om laisiah TOPA in na pute uh piak dinga a khapsa gam ah no le na tate uh na pun theih nading uh ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 4:9-10; 6:6-8"},"22":{"text":"Keimah in note zuih dinga kong piak hih thupiakte khempeuh limtakin zui a - TOPA note Pasian it in, ama lampi khempeuh tawna, amah na letkip uh leh -"},"23":{"text":"tua ciangin TOPA in na mai panun hih minamte khempeuh nawhkhia dinga, no sangin tamzaw-a, a hatzaw minamte na suankhia zo ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Na khe un na sikna peuhpeuh uh: sehnel- gam panin Lebanon ciang le Eupharates Gun panin nitumna tuipi b ciang dong no aa hi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"No langah kuamah a pang zo kei ding hi. TOPA note Pasian in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin, gambup a note paina peuhpeuh ah note kihtakna le lauthawngna a omsak ding hi.","ref":"Pc 15:18; Tp 7:24; 9:1"},"26":{"text":"En un, tuni-in note mai-ah thupha le hamsia ka koihkhawm hi -"},"27":{"text":"tuni-a kong piak TOPA note Pasian thupiakte na man uh leh thupha hi in;"},"28":{"text":"tuni-a kong thupiak TOPA note Pasian thupiakte mang loin na kiheisan uh a, na theih loh uh pasian dangte na zuih uh leh hamsia na lawhtak ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note lut-a na lak ding uh gamah TOPA note Pasian in note hong puak khit ciangin Gerizim Vum tungah thuphate na tangko ding uh a, Ebal Vum tungah hamsiate na tangko ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Na theihsa bangun hih mualte Jordan galkhat lampi c nitumna-lam, ni a tumna a Moreh singkung lianpite kiang, Gilgal gei mahmah a Arabah a teng Canaan-te gam sunga om ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"Note in TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gam ah lutin na luah nadingun Jordan kantan ding na hi ta uh hi. Note in tua gam la khinin na ten uh ciangin,"},"32":{"text":"tuni-a note mai-a kong lui thukip le thukham khempeuh na mang taktak ding uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte in TOPA na pate uh Pasian in na neih dingun hong piakna gamah - na nuntak sung tengun kidawmtaka na zuih pelmawh dingun hong piak thukipte le thukhamte ahi hi.","title":"Biak Nading Mun Khat"},"2":{"text":"Na suankhiat ding uh minamte in a biak uh pasiante omna mun, mualdawn sangte, mualneute le singhiangpha nuaite khempeuh na susiamang ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A biakna-taute uh phelkhia in, a suang siangthote uh dengzan in, Asherah khuamte mei-in haltum un; amau pasian limte phukpai unla tua muna a minte uh phiatkhia un.","ref":"Tp 4:9-10; Ms 33:52"},"4":{"text":"Amau biak bangin TOPA note Pasian na bia kei ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA note Pasian in na beh khempeuh uh lakah ama Min koihin a ten nadingin a teelna mun na zong ding uh hi. Tua munah pel loin na pai ding uh a;"},"6":{"text":"tua lai-ah meihal biakna le biakpiaknate, sawma khatte le citpiakte, piak dinga na kam ciamsate uh le utthu-a biaknate , bawnghonte le tuuhonte tacilte na puak ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note thupha hong piakhin ahi manin no khut tunga piang peuhmah TOPA note Pasian omna mun tua lai-ah na innkuanun na ne ding uh a, nuam na sa ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note luah dinga hong piakna mun le khawlmun tung nai lo na hi manun"},"9":{"text":"tuni-in hih lai-ah i gamtat bangin ama hoihsak bangin kuamah a gamta kei ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jordan na kantan ding uh a, TOPA note Pasian in na luah dingun hong piakna gamah na teng ding uh hi; tua ciangin amah in lungmuangtaka na ten theih nadingun na kim na pam-ua galte panin note hong tawlngasak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian in ama Min a ten nading mun teel dinga - tua lai-ah note kong thupiakte: na meihal biaknate uh biakpiaknate, na sawma khatte uh le citpiakte, le TOPA tunga na kamciamsa uh na neihsa uh a hoih pente khempeuh na puak ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuateh nang le na tanute na tapate un, na nasemnute na nasempate le amau adingin tanh le luah a nei lo note khua sunga Levi-te tawh TOPA note Pasian mai tua lai munah nuam na sa khawm ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Note lungkimna mun peuhpeuh ah na meihal biakna uh na piak khak ding uh kidawm un."},"14":{"text":"Na beh sung panun TOPA in a teel nading mun bekah tuate pia unla, kong thupiak na khempeuh tua lai-ah hih un."},"15":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin khuapi sung mun khat peuhpeuh ah na ganhingte uh goin, sazuk le sanang sa nek bangin TOPA note Pasian in thupha hong piakna tawh kizui-in na duh zahzah uh na ne thei ding uh hi. Thukham hanga ninte le a siangte in a ne thei tuak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin a sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh a; lei lakah tui bangin bua un."},"17":{"text":"Note in na an uh sawma khat ahi a, na zuthak uh le na sathau uh ahi zongin na bawnghon na tuuhonte uh tacilte ahi a, piak dinga na kamciamsate uh ahi zongin utthu-a biakna na piakte uh le na citpiakte uh, no khuapi sungah na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua sangsikin TOPA note Pasian in a teel nading mun, TOPA note Pasian mai-ah - note, na tanute na tapate, na nasemnute na nasempate le no khua sunga Levi-te tawh ne-in - no khuta piang na peuhmah TOPA note Pasian mai-ah nuam na sa ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Na gam-uah na ten laisiah uh Levi-te na thusimloh khak ding uh kidawm un."},"20":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note hong ciamsa bangin na gam uh hong keksakin sa na duh luat uh leh, \"Sa ka duh uh hi,\" ci le uh cin na duh zahzah uh na ne ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Note omna panin TOPA note Pasian in a Min koih nadinga a teelna mun a gamlat luat leh TOPA hong piaksa bawnghon le tuuhon panin na go thei ding uh a, na omna khuapi sungah tuate laka na duh zahzah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Sanang le sazuk sa nekin ne lel un. Thukham in a nitsakte le a siangte in ne thei tuak ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin sisan pen nuntakna ahi manin a sisan na nek loh ding uh tel un, tuateh a nuntakna a sa tawh na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"A sisan ne peuhmah kei un; tui bangin lei lakah buakhia un."},"25":{"text":"No le no khita na tate uh aa in a hoih theih nadingin tuate ne kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA muhna ah a maan a gamta na suak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 15:18"},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin na apsa uh nate le piak dinga na kamciamsa peuhmah uh la unla TOPA in a teel nading munah paipih un."},"27":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian biakna-tau ah na meihal biaknate uh a sisan le a sa piakhawm un. Na biakpiakna uh sisante TOPA note Pasian biakna-tau pangah kisung pelmawh dinga, a sa na ne thei ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"No le no khita na tate uh aa in a hoih tawntung dingin hih no kong piak ngeinate khempeuh limtakin mang un, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA note Pasian muhna ah a hoih a maana gamta na suak ding uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Note in sima na suankhiat ding uh minamte note mai-ah TOPA note Pasian in hong sukmangsak ding hi. Ahi hangin amaute nawhkhia-a, amau gamah na ten uh ciang"},"30":{"text":"le note mai-ah amaute a kisuksiat khit ciangin a pasiante uh thu kana nomau kithangsiah in, \"Hih minamte in a pasiante uh na bangci sep uh hiam? Ei zong hih sam dih ni,\" na cih khak ding uh kidawm un."},"31":{"text":"Amaute biak bangin TOPA note Pasian na bia peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau pasiante biakna ah TOPA deih loh a kihhuai na namkim a hih uh hi. Amau pasiante tungah biakpiakna-in a tanute a tapate nangawn uh mei-in a hal uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Kong thupiak khempeuh sem un; behlap kei unla lah khiam kei un.","ref":"Tp 4:2"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lakah kamsang ahi a, mang mana thu magen khat ahi zongin hong kilanga, a piandang lim le a lamdang hong lakin","title":"Pasian Dangte Biakna"},"2":{"text":"tuateh a gensa lim le a lamdangte hong tuna, \"Adang pasiante zui-in (na theih ngei loh pasiante) tuate bia ni,\" a cih leh"},"3":{"text":"tua kamsangpa ahikeh mang-manpa thu na ngai peuhmah kei ding uh hi. TOPA note Pasian in na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh un amah na it uh hiam, cih a muhkhiat nadingin hong zia-et ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na zuih pelmawh ding uh le na zahtak pelmawh ding uh TOPA note Pasian ahi hi. Ama thupiakte zui-in mang unla; ama na semin amah lenkip un."},"5":{"text":"Tua kamsangpa ahikeh mangmanpa kithat pelmawh ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Egypt gama hong pai khiatpih na sal suahna uh gam pana hong tankhia TOPA note Pasian langdo in thu a hilh hi; amah in zuih dinga TOPA note Pasian in hong thupiak lampi pan note heikhiat ding a hanciam ahi hi. No laka gitlohna na siaksiang pelmawh ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 8:2,16; 2Ku 23:3"},"6":{"text":"Na sanggampa tektek, na tanu na tapa tektek, na it na zi tektek le na kithuahpih na lawmpa tektek in hong zolsimin, \"Va pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,\" (nang na hi-a, na pate ahi zongin a theih ngei loh pasiante,"},"7":{"text":"na kim na pam uh a nai a gamla, lei mong khat pan mong khata om pasiante)"},"8":{"text":"hong cih leh mang loin a thugen zong ngai kei un. Hehpih kei un. Amah hawi loin zong dal kei un."},"9":{"text":"Amah pel loin thah ding ahi hi. Nang in amah na that masa dinga, tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh hi pan ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah suangin denglum un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in note salsuahna Egypt gam pana hong paikhiatpih TOPA note Pasian panin pialsak ding a hanciam ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel khempeuh in za in lau ding uh a, no lakah kuamah in tua bang gitlohna a bawl nawn kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na ten nadingun hong piak khuapite khatpeuh ah"},"13":{"text":"note lakah tua bang migilo khangin amau khuapi sungah mite lam khialh nadingin, \"Eite pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,\" (na theih ngei loh uh pasiante) ci-a a makaih khialh lam na zak uh leh"},"14":{"text":"pel loin a thu kan unla sittelin siangtakin a thu kantel un. Tua thu a maan hi a, note lakah hih a kihhuai na a kisem khin takpi ahileh"},"15":{"text":"tua khua-a teng mi khempeuh namsau in na that taktak ding uh hi. A mite le a ganhingte susia khawm kiuhkeuh a un."},"16":{"text":"Note in a vante uh lawkin khua laizang tual-awng ah na khawm ding uh a, a khuapi le a sunga van khempeuh TOPA note Pasian tungah meihal biakna bangin a bupin haltum kiuhkeuh un. Tua mun a siasa in om den dinga a kilam kik ngei nawn kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"TOPA hehluatna a dam kik nadingin tua a kikoihdak nate b note khut sungah khat beek a kimu kei ding hi; tua hileh amah in na pute uh tungah kiciamin a khap bangin note hong lainatin hong khuatuah dinga, hong pungsak ding hi,"},"18":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh note in TOPA note Pasian thu na mang uh a, tuni-a kong piak ama thupiakte khempeuh zui-in ama mitmuh ah thumaanin na gamta uh hi.","ref":"Jos 8:28; Ms 25:4; Tp 7:25-26"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note in TOPA note Pasian tate na hi uh hi. Misi hangin no le no kikuikek kei unla, na talsam uh zong met kei un,","title":"An-nin le An-siang"},"2":{"text":"ahang in, note in TOPA note Pasian misiangtho na hi uh hi. Lei maitang tunga om mi khempeuh lak panin TOPA in a gou neih manpha dingin note hong teel hi.","ref":"Sp 21:5; Ro 8:14; Tp 7:6"},"3":{"text":"A kihhuai na khatpeuh ne kei un."},"4":{"text":"Na nek theih ding uh ganhing hihte ahi hi: bawng, tuu, keel,"},"5":{"text":"sazuk, sanang, zukzil, sathak, saza, zuksial le gamtuu c ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in a khecin niha ka eknel hai ganhing peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi zongin a khecin ka in eknel hai taleh kala-oh, bilpi ahikeh gam bilpi d na ne kei ding uh hi. Tuate in eknel a hai uh hangin a khecin uh ka lo a; no adingin thukham in a ninsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Vok in zong khecin ka a neih hangin eknel hai lo ahi manin a nin ahi hi. A sa lah ne loin a sisa zong na lawng kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 11:2-45; Eze 4:14"},"9":{"text":"Tui sunga nungta ganhing, lip le phe a nei khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin lip le phe a nei lo peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi; tuate anin ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Vasa, a siang peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin na nek loh dingte uh: muvanlai, musane, lui mu,"},"13":{"text":"mupi, mumeika, musi nam peuhmah,"},"14":{"text":"va-ak nam peuhmah,"},"15":{"text":"simbutal, chikchili, vakang, pengpelep nam peuhmah"},"16":{"text":"keising, simbupi, simbukang"},"17":{"text":"sehnel-gam simbu, tui mu, tui vatawt,"},"18":{"text":"gun vakang, vasa zo nei nam peuhmah huihtun le bak-te ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"A lengthei a hon om insects khempeuh no adingin anin ahi hi; tuate ne kei un."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin kha nei ganhing a siang peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A sisa a na muh peuhmah uh ne kei un. Na khua sungua teng pemtate na pia thei ding uh a, amaute in a ne thei ding uh hi; gamdang mite tungah zong na zuak thei ding uh hi. No na hi uh leh TOPA note Pasian misiangtho na hi uh hi. A pi nawizu-in keelno huan kei un.","ref":"Pk 34:26"},"22":{"text":"Kum simin na lo panun a piang khempeuh panin sawm ah khat tuam koih tangtang un."},"23":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian na zahtak den nading uh na theih na’ngun, na an uh, na zuthak uh, na sathau uh sawma khat le na tuuhon na bawnghonte uh tacilte, ama Min a ten nadinga a teel nading mun a TOPA note Pasian mai-ah ne un.","title":"Sawma Khat"},"24":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua mun gamla lua a, TOPA note Pasian inlah thupha hong piak khita, na sawma khat na puak zawh kei leh (TOPA in a Min a koih nadingin a teelna mun a gamlat luatna hangin)"},"25":{"text":"tua ciangin na sawma khat ngun tawh khek unla tua ngun tawi-in TOPA note Pasian in a teel nading munah va paipih un."},"26":{"text":"Tua nguntang: bawng, tuu, zu ahi a dawn dinga kibilh khatpeuh ahi zongin na ut peuhpeuh leina in zang un. Tua ciangin nang le na innkuanpihte in TOPA note Pasian omna ah ne-in nuam na sa ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tuateh na khua sungua teng Levi-te in tanh ding le luah ding nei lo uh ahi manin phawk loin om kei un.","ref":"Sp 27:30"},"28":{"text":"Kum thum a cin simin tua kuma piang sawma khat khempeuh puak unla na khua sunguah khol un;"},"29":{"text":"tua in na khua sungua teng Levi-te (amau neihsa tanh le luah a nei lote) le pemtate pa nei lote, meigongte hong pai-in ne-a a kham theih nading uh leh na khut uh tawh na sepsa khempeuh uh TOPA note Pasian in thupha hong piak theih nading ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 15:10; 26:12"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum sagih a cin simin leiba na maisak pelmawh ding uh hi.","title":"Leiba Maisak ding Kum"},"2":{"text":"A hih zia ding hih bang ahi hi: Mi a leitawisakte peuhmah in a mipih Israel-te leitawisa teng a maisak ding hi. TOPA in leiba maisak nadinga a seh hun kitangko khin ahi manin a mipih Israel-te ahi-a, a sanggampa ahi zongin a piak dingin a sik nawn kei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamdang mite tungah na sik thei ding uh a ahi hangin na sangampa in nang tunga hong bat leiba peuhmah na maisak pelmawh ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi ta zongin TOPA note Pasian in luaha na neih nadingun hong piaksa gamah thupha tampitak hong pia ding ahi manin, note lakah a zawng a om kei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua pen TOPA note Pasian ama thu hoih takin mang-a, tuni-a kong piak thupiakte khempeuh limtaka na zuih uh leh cihna ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahang in TOPA note Pasian in hong ciamsa bangin thupha hong pia dinga, minam tampite sum leitawisakin note in kuama tungpan sum na leitawi kei ding uh hi. Minam tampi na uk ding uh a, kuamah in no hong uk kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 31:10; 23:20; 28:12-13,44"},"7":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hong piak ding gama khuapite a, na sang gamte uh lakah mizawng khatpeuh a om leh na sanggampa uh tungah na lungsim uh khauhsakin hum tentan kei un."},"8":{"text":"Tua sangsikin ama kisap bangbang leitawi lel un."},"9":{"text":"Hih gitloh ngaihsutna ngaihsun in, \"A kum sagihna leiba maisak ding kum nai ta,\" ci-in a tasam na sanggampa midang bawlin bangmah na piak loh khak ding kidawm un. Na tua cihleh TOPA tungah nang hong khia thei dinga mawhna bawl na suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama tungah cingh in pia ziahziah inla lungsit pi-in pia kei in; tua hangin TOPA note Pasian in na sepna khempeuh le na khut suak peuhmah ah nang thupha hong pia ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua gamah mizawng a om den ding hi. Tua ahi ciangin na gamua na sanggamte uh le mizawng le a tasamte tungah na cingh un, ci-in thu kong pia hi.","ref":"Sp 25:8-38; Mt 26:11; 1Jn 3:17"},"12":{"text":"Na Hebrew mipihte numei ahi a pasal ahi zongin hong kizuak-a, kum guk sung na a sep khit leh a kum sagihna kumin khahkhia-in na suaktasak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuateh amah na khah ciangin khuthawm guakin paikhiasak kei in.","title":"Nasemte Khahna"},"14":{"text":"Na tuuhon pan, na ancilna le na lengtui-sukna panin tampitak tawh huh in. TOPA note Pasian hong piak thupha tawh kizui-in amah pia in."},"15":{"text":"Note zong Egypt ah sila hi-in TOPA note Pasian in hong tatkhiat ahilam phawk un. Tua hangin hih thupiak no kong pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin na nasempa un nang le na innkuanpihte a it man le ama adingin hoih sazaw a, \"Hong nusia nuam ke’ng,\" a cih leh"},"17":{"text":"tua ciangin siktul khat la-in, kongkhak sunglam ah a bil vuhsak in, tuateh amah a khantawnin na nasem a suak ding hi. Na nasemnu zong tua tawh a kibangin hih in."},"18":{"text":"Na nasempa khah ding haksa ngaihsut kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh a kicialte thaman zah nihin kum guk sung na a sem khin zo hi. Tua hileh TOPA note Pasian in na sepna peuhpeuh ah thupha hong pia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na bawnghonte le na tuuhonte ah apa a piang masa peuhmah TOPA note Pasian adingin khenkhia un. Bawng pa a piang masa pen nasem dingin koih kei unla na tuu tacilte uh a mul met kei un."},"20":{"text":"Nang le na innkuanpihte in kum simin TOPA note Pasian in a teel nading munah na nek ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Ganhing Tacilte"},"21":{"text":"Ganhing in poina nei-a, a mittaw, a khebai ahikeh nasia a liamsa ahileh TOPA note Pasian tungah biakpiakna-in na nei peuhmah kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Na khua sunguah na ne ding uh hi. Thukham hanga ninte le a siangte in sazuk le sanang sa nek bangin a ne thei tuak ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin a sisan na ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi; leilakah tui bangin buakhia un.","ref":"Pk 13:2"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abib kha tang unla TOPA note Pasian hong paisanna pawi bawl un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Abib kha sungin Egypt pan zanin hong paikhiatpih hi.","title":"Paisan"},"2":{"text":"Tuuhon pan ahi a bawnghon pan ahi zongin TOPA in a Min ten nadinga a teel nading munah Pasian biakna-in TOPA note Pasian tungah na pia ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Silngo kisawh anlum tawh na meh kei ding uh a, ahi hangin, hingimna anlum ahi - silngo sawh loh anlum nisagih sung na ne ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt pana na paikhiat uh, na khantawntungun na phawk theih nadingun - kinawhsa-in Egypt na nusia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Na gam sung khempeuh uah ni sagih sung na neihsate uh lakah silngo kimu kei hen. Ani masa ni nitak-a biakpiakna sa khatpeuh a zingsang dong omsak kei un.","ref":"Pk 12:2; 34:25"},"5":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note hong piak khua khatpeuh ah a Min ten nadinga a teel nading mun"},"6":{"text":"longal mundang ah Paisan biakpiakna na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua lai-ah Egypt pana na paikhiat ni uh phawkna-in a Paisan biakpiakna na bawl uh ciangin nitak nitum khit hi pelmawh ding hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian teel nading munah hangkeu unla ne un. Zingsang ciangin na puanbukuah ciah kik un."},"8":{"text":"Niguk sung silngo sawh loh anlum ne unla a ni sagihna ni-in TOPA note Pasian kiangah mipi kikhawm unla na sem kei un."},"9":{"text":"Ankung ah phiaukawi na tah ni-ua kipan nipikal sagih sim to un."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian hong piaksa thupha tawh kizui-a na piak ding zah uh utthu-a biakna tawh TOPA note Pasian’ Nipikal Pawite bawl un.","title":"Nipikal Pawite"},"11":{"text":"Tuateh ama Min ten nadinga a teel nading mun TOPA note Pasian mai-ah - nang, na tanu na tapate, na nasemnu na nasempate, no khua sunga om Levi-te le no laka teng pemtate, pa nei lote le meigongte in nuamsa un."},"12":{"text":"Egypt ah sila-a na om lam uh phawk unla hih thukipte limtakin zui un.","ref":"Sp 23:15-22; Ms 28:26-31"},"13":{"text":"Na ancilna uh le na lengtui-sukna panun a piang teng na kaihkhop khit uh ciangin ni sagih sung Biakbuk Pawi bawl un."},"14":{"text":"Pawi na bawl uh ciangin - nang, na tanute na tapate, na nasemnute na nasempate le no khua sunga teng Levi-te, pemtate, pa nei lote le meigongte tawh nuamsa un.","title":"Biakbuk Pawite"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in a teel nading munah ni sagih sung TOPA note Pasian Pawi na bawl ding uh hi. TOPA note Pasian in na khawhsa khempeuh uh le na khutua na sepsa khempeuh uh thupha hong pia dinga, na nuamna uh a kim ding hi.","ref":"Sp 23:34"},"16":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in a teel nading mun ama mai-ah: Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi, Nipikal Pawite le Biakbuk Pawite ah kum simin na mite khempeuh uh pel loin thumvei a kilak ding uh hi. TOPA mai-ah kuamah khutguakin kilak lo dinga;"},"17":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in thupha hong piak zah tawh kizui-in piak ding na keng ciat ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 23:33-43; Ms 29:12-39"},"18":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding khua simah na beh kimun thukhente le uliante na seh ding uh a, amaute in mite thu siangtakin a khen ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Thutang kawikaih loin gup le paih zong a nei kei ding uh hi. Golhsum in mipilte mit tawsak a, thumaan kawnghek ahi manin, golhsum sang kei un.","title":"Thukhente"},"20":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gam ah tengin na luah theih nadingun thutang bekbek zui un.","ref":"Pk 23:2,8; Tp 1:17"},"21":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian adingin na dawhsa biakna-tau banah Asherah khuam a phuhbeh kei unla"},"22":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian muhdah suang siangthote zong phut kei un.","title":"Pasian Dangte Biakna"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in kihhuai sa ding ahi manin ama tungah bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin a poi, a melhem khatpeuh biakna-in zang kei un."},"2":{"text":"TOPA in note hong piak khuate khatah note laka teng numei ahikeh pasal khat in TOPA note Pasian muhna ah a thukhun palsatin gitlohna a bawl a kimuh a"},"3":{"text":"ka thupiak tawh kilehbulhin pasian dangte, vana ni, kha, aksite ahi zongin bia-in a kuna,"},"4":{"text":"hih thu no omna ah hong kitut leh siangthotakin kantel pelmawh un. Hih thu amaan ahi-a, Israel sungah hih a kihhuai na a kisem khin takpi ahileh,"},"5":{"text":"hih asia-a gamta numei ahikeh pasal, khuapi kongpi ah paipih in tua mi denglum un."},"6":{"text":"Mi nih ahikeh thum theihpihna-in kithat dinga ahi hangin mi khatbek theihpihna-in kuamah a kithat kei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Tecite khat a that masa in pang pelmawh dinga, tua ciangin mi khempeuh hi pan ding hi. Note lak pan pelloin gitlohna na beimangsak ding uh hi.","ref":"Ms 35:30; Tp 13:6-11; Mt 18:16"},"8":{"text":"Note khen dingin a haksa lua - sisan kisuahna, thu kituhna ahikeh kilaina - thu na zum uh hong tun leh TOPA note Pasian teel nading munah amaute puak un."},"9":{"text":"Siampi ahi Levi-te kiangah pai unla tua huna zum-a om thukhente khensak un. Amaute thu dongin thukhen-satna hong pia ding uh hi.","title":"Thukhen Zumte"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in a teel nading muna amaute hong piak thukhensatna bangin na sem pelmawh ding uh hi. Amaute in no hong lamlah bangin na khempeuh kidawmtakin hih un."},"11":{"text":"Amaute hong hilh thukham le amaute hong piak thukhensatna bangin gamta un. Amaute hong gen bangin vei lam ahikeh ziat lam ah pial kei un."},"12":{"text":"Thukhenpa ahi-a TOPA note Pasian mai-ah dingin nasem siampipa ahi zongin a simmawhpa kithat pelmawh ding hi. Israel panin gitlohna na beimangsak pelmawh ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hileh mi khempeuh in za-in lau ding uh a, a kisimmawh kik nawn kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gam ah lutin luah a na ten khit uh, \"I kim i pama om minam khempeuh bangin ei hong uk ding kumpi khat koih ni,\" na cih uh ciangin,"},"15":{"text":"note hong uk dingin TOPA note Pasian teelsa kumpi bek koih un. Amah note sanggamte lak pan hi pelmawh ding hi. No hong uk dingin Israel-te sanggam ahi lo gamdang mi koih kei un.","title":"Kumpipa"},"16":{"text":"Tua banah kumpipa in ama aituamin sakol tampitak a nei thei kei ding hi, tua bang hileh TOPA in, \"Tua lampi tawnin na kileh kik nawn kei ding uh hi,\" ci khin ahi manin sakol leithuah dingin Egypt ah mite a kilehsak kik kha ding hi."},"17":{"text":"A lungsim lam khialsak ding ahi manin zi tampi a nei kei ding hi. Amah in ngun le kham a tamlua a zonthuah kei ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 8:5, 19-20; 1Ku 10:26"},"18":{"text":"Amah kumpi-gam kumpi tokhom ah a tut ciangin Levi-te ahi siampite tung panin a kila thukham bu khat ama adingin laizial khatah a teikhia ding hi."},"19":{"text":"TOPA ama Pasian, a zahtak theih nading le a thukham kammalte le a thukipte limtakin a zuih theih nadingin amah le tua omkhawmin a nuntak sungteng a sim ding hi;"},"20":{"text":"ama sanggampa sangin a hoihzaw in kingaihsun lo-a, thukham panin veilam ahikeh taklamah a pial loh nading ahi hi. Tua hileh amah le ama kumpi sepna Israel gam, amah le a suan a khakte in sawtpi a uk ding uh hi.","ref":"Jos 1:8"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi-te ahi siampite - Levi beh’ buppi in - Israel tawh tanh ahi a luah ahi zongin a nei peuhmah kei hi. TOPA tungah mei-a hal biakna dingin a kipiate in a kivak ding uh hi; amau luah tua ahi hi.","title":"Siampite le Levi-te Ading Biaknate"},"2":{"text":"Amau sanggamte lakah luah nei lo uh a; amau tungah a ciamsa bangin amau luah in TOPA ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Bawngtal ahikeh tuu in mite in biakna a piak ciangin siampite kaih: aliang, apangte gel le a sungkua ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Note in amaute tungah na an uh gahmasate, na zuthakte uh na sathau uh le na met masak uh tuumul na pia ding uh hi;"},"5":{"text":"ahang in, na behte khempeuh panun TOPA mina dingin nasem niloh dinga TOPA note Pasian in amaute le amaute suante a teelsa ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 7:28-34; Ms 18:12; Tp 10:8"},"6":{"text":"Levi-te khat Israel gam mun khata khuapi khatpeuh-a a tenna panin lal a, TOPA in a teel nading munah thumaantaka a va tun leh"},"7":{"text":"TOPA omna tua lai-a a mipih Levi-te khempeuh tawh a kibangin TOPA ama Pasian minin na sem thei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a innkuan van neihte zuakin sum a ngah khin zongin amaute kaih bangbang a ngah ding hi.","ref":"Ne 12:44,47"},"9":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gamah na lut uh ciangin tua lai-a minamte hih a kihhuai nate cing kei un."},"10":{"text":"No lakah biakna-in a tanu ahi-a a tapa ahi zongin mei sungah b a khul, aisan, khongkhai, mangsan, aitawi,","title":"Kihhuai Gamtatnate"},"11":{"text":"mibum a zang, sikha hopih, vankah le misi thu dong khat beek omsak kei un."},"12":{"text":"Hihte a hih peuhmah TOPA in kih a, hih a kihhuaite a sep manun TOPA note Pasian in tua minamte na mai panun a nawhkhiat ding ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Note na hi uh leh TOPA note Pasian mai-ah na paubaang kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 12:31; Sp 18:24"},"14":{"text":"Na suankhiat ding uh minamte in aisanin khongkhai uh hi. Ahi hangin TOPA note Pasian in tua banga na sep ding uh hong phal lo hi."},"15":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in nomau sanggamte lak panin no ading kei bang khat kamsang hong khangsak ding hi. Ama thu na ngai pelmawh un.","title":"Kamsang"},"16":{"text":"Horeb ah mipi na kikhop ni-un, \" TOPA eite Pasian aw hong zasak loin a meikuang lianpi zong hong musak nawn kei un, ka si kha ding uh hi,\" na cih ni-un TOPA note Pasian tunga na nget uh hih mah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Amaute gen a hoih hi."},"18":{"text":"Amau sanggamte sung panin amau ading nang tawh a kibang kamsang khat ka khangsak dinga; a kam ah ka thute guanin amah ka thupiak peuhmah amaute tungah a gen ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kamsangpa in ka thu gente kei mina a gen, a sang lo peuhmah kei mahmah in amah samin ka mawhsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin kamsang khat in kei thupiak lohpi-in kei minin thu khatpeuh a gena, ahikeh kam sangin adang pasiante minin thu a gen leh kithat pelmawh ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 51:16"},"21":{"text":"Nang le nang in, \" TOPA gen loh thupuak bangci theih ding i hi hiam?\" na ci thei hi."},"22":{"text":"Kamsang khat in TOPA thu genin a tun kei-a, a maan kei leh TOPA gen hi lo hi. Tua kamsangpa thu sansat ahi hi. Amah kihta kei un.","ref":"Jer 28:9"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in a gam uh note hong piak minamte a suksiat khit, amaute hawlkhia-in amau khuate le innte ah na ten uh ciangin","title":"Bukna Khuapi"},"2":{"text":"note in na neih dingun TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gam laizang ah khuapi thum na sehkhia tuam ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na luah dingun hong piak ding gam sehthum suah unla, mi thatte peuhmah khuapi ah a tai theih nadingin lampi sialin tua khuate ah tungsak un.","ref":"Tp 12:29"},"4":{"text":"Midang khat a that - sawmkhol lo le kilungnoplohna om ngei lopi-a a vengpa a that kha, tua khuapi-a a taite tawh kisai ngeina hih ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Gentehna-in, mi khat a vengpa tawh singphuk dingin tulakah kuan a, singphukin a hei a vik ciangin a heitang kikhongin a vengpa kha-in si hi. Tua mipa hih khuapite khat peuhpeuh ah tai-in a nuntakna hu thei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua hi kei leh amah in kilungsim neihna nei loin sawm khol lopi-a a vengpa a hihkhak hi-a, amah a sihsak huai lo hi napi, a sisan phu a la nuampa heh lua-in amah nungdelha, a kikal a gamlat-luatna hangin pha-in that kha thei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih thu hangin khuapi thum na sehtuam dingun thu kong pia hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na pute uh tungah kiciamin a gambuppi amau tungah piak dingin a khap bangin na gam uh hong keksak leh"},"9":{"text":"tuni-a kong piak thukhamte khempeuh limtakin zui a, TOPA note Pasian itin ama lampi na zuih tawntungna uh hang ahi manin - tua khuapite banah a dang khuapi thum mah na sehkhia lai ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na luah dingun hong piak gamah mawhpengte sisan a kiluansak khak loh nading le sisan suahsakna hanga na mawh khak loh nadingun hih banga na hih ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 21:1-9"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin mi khat in a vengpa mudah a, amah pangsimin bawhin that-a, tua ciangin hih khuapi thumte ah a tai leh"},"12":{"text":"ama khua sung upate in khuapi panin amah puak kik ding uh a, a si dingin a sisanphu a la nuampa tungah a ap ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah a kihehpih kei ding hi. Note aa in ahoih theih nadingin Israel panin mawhpeng sisan luansakna na beimangsak pelmawh ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na neih dingun hong piak nading gamah, nang luah dinga na ngahna-ah no ma-a omsate phuhsa na vengte uh kigisuang khin kei un."},"15":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh mawhsak nading ahikeh khialhsak nadingin teci khat bek kicing lo hi. Teci nih ahikeh thum genna tawh a thu, thukho in kisang pan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Mi khat in elna tawh mi khat gamtakhialin mawh hi, ci-a teci a pan leh","title":"Tecite"},"17":{"text":"a kitawng mi nihte siampite le tua huna zum ngak thukhente mai TOPA omna ah ding pelmawh ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Thukhente in kiciantakin thu khen ding uh a, tecipa a zuau a hina a kitel-a, a sanggampa langah zuau teci pang ahileh"},"19":{"text":"a sanggampa tunga hih a sawm bangbangin amah mawh khusak un. Note lak panin gitlohna na beimangsak pelmawh ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Midangte khempeuh in hih thu za-in lau ding uh a, note lakah tua bang gitlohna a kihih ngei nawn kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hehpih loin: nuntakna tangin nuntakna, mit tangin mit, ha tangin ha, khut tangin khut, khe tangin khe hi ding hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na galte uh sim dingin kuana, note sangin a lianzaw galte, sakolte le lengte na muh uh ciangin lau kei un, bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt pana hong paikhiatpih to TOPA note Pasian in hong ompih ding hi.","title":"Galkuanna"},"2":{"text":"Gal sim dinga na kuan uh ciangin siampipa a mai-ah pai-in galkapte tungah thu a gen ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in, \"Israel aw, za in, tuni-in na galte uh do dingin a kuan ding na hi ta uh hi. Lungsi kei unla lau kei un; amaute mai-ah linglawngin patau kei un."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian in na galte uh hong zosak dingin amaute langkhatah pangin note hong dopih dingin hong tonpih hi,\" a ci ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Uliante in galkapte tungah; \"Inn thak lama a ap nai lo a om hiam? Ciahsak un, amah gal sungah si-in midang khatpeuh in a inn na ap kha ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Lenggui suana a nekha nai lo a om hiam? Ciahsak un, amah gal sungah si-in midang khatpeuh in ne kha ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Lawm dong khina zipi nai lo a om hiam? Ciahsak un, amah gal sungah si-in midang khat in a pi kha ding hi,\" ci-in a gen ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin uliante in, \"A lau a, a lungsi dedu na om uh hiam? A sanggamte lungkiasak kha ding ahi manin amah ciahsak un,\" a cih beh lai ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Uliante in galkapte tungah thugen a man khit uh ciangin amaute a uk ding a seh ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 24:5; Thk 7:3"},"10":{"text":"Khuapi khat sim dinga na kuan khiat uh ciangin a mite tungah kilem ding gen masa un."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in hong san theih uh a, a kongpite uh hong hon uh leh a sunga om mi khempeuh na nasem uh suak ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute kilem ding ut loin kido a kul leh a khuapi umcih un."},"13":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in note khut sungah hong piak ciangin a sunga om mi khempeuh namsau-in that un."},"14":{"text":"Numei, naupang, ganhingte le khuapi sunga na peuhmah gal-vanlak in no adingin na la thei ding uh hi.
