Amah in, \"Tuanu ka tenpih nuam kei hi,\" a cih leh"},"9":{"text":"a sanggampa zi meigongnu upate mai-ah pai to dinga, a khedap kaih a langkhat kaihkhiatsakin a maitang cilphih dinga,\" a sanggampa innkuanpih gui a zomto nuam lote a kihici bawl ahi hi,\" a ci ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel sungah tua mipa gui Khedap Kisuahsakte Innkuan, ci-in kithei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mi nih a kilai-a khatpa a zi in huhin a lawmpa a hutna-in a lawmpa kilaipihpa a zahmawhte ah a matsak leh"},"12":{"text":"tuanu khut na sattansak ding uh hi. Amah na hehpih peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Na ip sunguah tawisuang nih - a kikim lo azaang le agik nei kei un."},"14":{"text":"Na inn sunguah tehna nam nih - aneu le alian nei kei un."},"15":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hong piak nading gamah na khansau theih nadingun a man le a kician khaina le tehna na nei pelmawh ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian in hih banga gamta peuhmah le a man lo-a sem peuhmah a kih hi.","ref":"Sp 19:35-37; Pn 11:1"},"17":{"text":"Egypt pan na paikhiat lai-un lampi-a, Amalekte hong bawlna phawk un."},"18":{"text":"Note gimin na cihmawh laitakun, na khualzinna-uah hong dawntuah uh a, a nunga vai nunung khempeuh hong ngawngtan uh hi; amaute in Pasian a kihta kei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in la-a na luah dingun hong piakna gamah na kim na pamua galte khempeuh panin note hong tawlngaksak ciangin van kikupsin nuai panin Amalekte a kiciamtehna na phiatkhia ding uh hi. Mangngilh kei un!","ref":"Pk 17:8; Ph 36:1; 1Sa 15:2-3"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in na luah dingun hong piak nading gamah lutin la-a na ten uh ciangin,","title":"Gahmasate le Sawma Khat"},"2":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gam leihoih pana piang gahmasa pawlkhat la-in lawh sungah koih un. Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian in a Min ten nadingin a teel nading munah paipih unla,"},"3":{"text":"tua huna zumngak siampipa kiangah, \" TOPA in i pute tungah eite piak dingin a ciamsa gam ka tunna tuni-in TOPA na Pasian tungah ka pulakkhia hi,\" na ci ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Siampipa in na khut panun a lawh hong sang dinga TOPA note Pasian biakna-tau mai-ah a ngasuk ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian mai-ah, \"Ka pa a vak kawikawi Aram-te hi-a, mi tawmkha tawh Egypt ah paisukin tua lai-ah teng uh a, tua pan tampi pha-in a vanglian minam lianpi khat a suak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin Egypt-te in kote hong bawlsia uh a, na haksa hong semsakin hong thuaksiasak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA ka pate uh Pasian tungah ka kiko uh a, TOPA in ka aw uh hong za-in ka gentheihna uh, hong kinengniam a ka nasepte uh hong mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in a thahat khut le a kizankhia ban tawh a lauhuai mahmah le a piandang limte le a lamdangte tawh Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih mun ciang hong puakin hih gam - bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gam hong pia hi,"},"10":{"text":"tu-in TOPA aw, keimah nong piaksa leihoih-a piang gahmasa nang kong puak hi,\" na cikhia ding uh hi. TOPA note Pasian mai-ah na lawh koihin ama mai-ah na kunsuk ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA note Pasian in nang le na innkuanpihte hong piaksa na hoih khempeuh, Levi-te le no laka om pemtate tawh nuam na sa khawm ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"A kumthumna sawm ah khat piak kumin na khawhsa khempeuh panun sawma khat na tuam koih khit uh ciangin Levi-te, pemtate, pa nei lote le meigongte in no khua sungah ne in a kham theih nadingun amaute na pia ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian kiangah, \"Nong thupiak khempeuh tawh kituakin ka inn panin tanh siangtho ka khenkhia khina Levi-te, pemtate, pa neilote le meigongte ka pia khin hi. Na thupiakte panin pial loin tuate khatpeuh zong ka mangngilh kha kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka khakhun sungin tua tanh siangtho ka ne kei-a, ka nit sungin zong tuate khatpeuh khenkhia loin misi an piakin zong ka zang kei hi. TOPA ka Pasian thu kong mang hi. Kei nong thupiak peuhmah ka sem khin hi."},"15":{"text":"Na tenna mun siangtho van panin hong ensuk inla, na mi Israel le ka pute uh tungah kiciam-a na khapsa, bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gam thupha hong pia in,\" na ci ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuni-in TOPA note Pasian in hih thukipte le thukhamte na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh limtaka na zuih dingun thu hong pia hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuni-in TOPA note Pasian ahina, ama lampi tawnin a thukipte, a thupiakte le a thukhamte zui-in ama thu na man ding uh na pulak khin uh hi.","title":"Thupiakte Zui Un"},"18":{"text":"Tua banah tuni-in TOPA in hong ciamsa bangin note ama mi, ama gou na hi uh a, a thupiak khempeuh na zuih dingun hong gen khin hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in a bawlsa minamte khempeuh tung pekah a kiphatzaw, a minthangzaw, a kipahtawizaw in hong koih dinga, ama hong ciamsa bangin TOPA note Pasian mi siangtho na suak ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 7:6; 28:1,13,44; 4:7-8"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses le Israel upate in mipite thupia uh a: \"Tuni-a no tungah kong piak, thupiakte khempeuh zui un.","title":"Ebal Vum Tunga Biakna-tau"},"2":{"text":"Note in Jordan kantan khinin TOPA note Pasian hong piak ding gam na tun uh ciangin suangtum lianpi phutin a tung na zutmai ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"TOPA na pate uh Pasian, in note hong ciamsa bang tektekin TOPA note Pasian in note hong piak ding bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gamah lut dingin na kantan khit uh ciangin tuate tungah hih thukham kammalte gelh un."},"4":{"text":"Tuateh tuni-a kong thupiak bangin Jordan na galkah khit uh ciangin Ebal Vum tungah hih suangte phut unla, zutmai un."},"5":{"text":"Tua munah TOPA note Pasian biakna-tau ding, suang biakna-tau khat dawh un. Tuate bawlna ah sik vanzat khat beek zang kei un."},"6":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian adingin lopaanga suangte in biakna-tau na dawh ding uh a, tua tungah TOPA note Pasian meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua munah kilawmtakna biaknate a bawl unla, tuate ne in TOPA note Pasian omna ah nuamsa un."},"8":{"text":"Tuateh na phuhsa uh hih suangte tungah hih thukham malte khempeuh siang sinsenin na gelh ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pk 20:25; Tp 26:9; Jos 8:31"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses le Levi siampite in Israel khempeuh tungah, \"Israel aw, dai dide in na ngai un! Tu-in note TOPA note Pasian mi na suak khin uh hi."},"10":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thu mang unla, tuni-a note kong piak thupiakte le thukipte zui un,\" a ci uh hi.","title":"Ebal Vum Pan hamsiatnate"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni mah in Moses in mite thu pia a:"},"12":{"text":"Jordan na galkah khit uh ciangin: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph le Benjamin behte in, Gerizim Vum tungah dingin mipite thupha a pia ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuateh Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan le Naphtali behte in Ebal Vum tungah dingin a hamsiat ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Levi-te in Israel mipi khempeuh tungah aw ngaihtak tawh:"},"15":{"text":"\"A kikhuak kuak ahi a, a kisung ahi zongin lim khatpeuh a bawlte -khutsiamte bawl TOPA in a kih milim a koih simte in hamsiatna thuak ta uh hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Israel mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 20:4; 34:17"},"16":{"text":"\"A nu le a pa a pahtawi lote in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 21:17"},"17":{"text":"\"A vengte kigisuang khinte in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 22:28"},"18":{"text":"\"Mittawpa lam a pialsakpa in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 19:14"},"19":{"text":"\"Pemtate, pa nei lote le meigong numeite’ thutang a lehheisakte in hamsiatna thuak ta uh hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 10:18; 24:19"},"20":{"text":"\"A pa’ zi a luppihte in a pa lupna daisak ahi manin hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 18:7; Tp 22:30"},"21":{"text":"\"Ganhing khatpeuh a luppihte in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 18:23"},"22":{"text":"\"A sanggamnu, a pa tanu, a nu’ tanu a luppih peuhmah in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"\"A sungnu a luppihte in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"\"A vengpa a that simte in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"\"Mawhpeng khat thah nadingin golhsum a sangte in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 23:7-8"},"26":{"text":"\"Hih thukham kammalte lenkip loin a phikhate in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mipi khempeuh in, \"Amen!\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Gal 3:10"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thu kimtakin manga, tuni-a kong piak ama thupiakte khempeuh limtakin na zuih uh leh TOPA note Pasian in leitunga minam khempeuh tung pekah hong koih ding hi.","title":"Thuman’na hanga Thuphate"},"2":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thu na man uh leh hih thuphate khempeuh no tungah hong tungin hong zui ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Note khuapi sungah thupha hong kipia in khuaneu ah thupha hong kipia ding hi.","ref":"Pc 39:5"},"4":{"text":"Note sul pana gahte le na leitang ua ante, na ganhonte-na bawnghonte uh note le na tuuhonte uh pung ding hi.","ref":"Pc 49:25"},"5":{"text":"Na seng uh le na annel mekna kuang uh thupha kipia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sungtum ciangin thupha hong kipia dinga, na pusuah ciangin thupha hong kipia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 121:8"},"7":{"text":"TOPA in note langa pang galte note mai-ah hong zawhsak ding hi. Amaute lam khat pan hong kuan ding uh a, nang kiang pan lam sagihin a taikek ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA in na an salte le na khuta na sepsa peuhmah tungah thupha hong tungsak ding hi. TOPA note Pasian in note hong piak ding gamah thupha hong pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hong thupiakte zui-in ama lampi na tot nak uh leh amah tomlo-a a kiciamsa bangin ama misiangtho dingin TOPA in hong kipsak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitung a om mi khempeuh in note, TOPA ’ mina hong kisap lam thei-in hong kihta ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA in note piak dingin na pate uh tunga a ciamsa gamah - na sul panua gahte, na ganhonte uh note, na leitang pan un a piang ante - tungtawnin na dau uh a paisak mahmah ding hi.","ref":"Pk 19:6; 1Kh 7:14"},"12":{"text":"TOPA in vantungte le na tampi a kholna inn hongin na gamuah guah a hunin zusak dinga na khut uh tawh na septe khempeuh uh thupha a pia ding hi. Minam tampite na leitawisak ding uh a, ahi hangin no kuama tungpan na leitawi kei ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"TOPA in a meidawn hi loin a lutangin hong bawl ding hi. Tuni-a note kong piak TOPA note Pasian thupiakte na thupi sim uh a, limtaka na zuih uh leh a tawntungin nuainungpen loin na tungnungpen ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuni-a kong piak thupiakte khatpeuh panin veilam ahi a taklam ahi zongin pial kei unla, adang pasiante zui loin a na zong sem kei un.","ref":"Sp 26:4; Tp 5:32; 15:3,6"},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in TOPA note Pasian thu mang loin tuni-a kong piak thupiakte le thukipte limtakin na zuih kei uh leh hih hamsiatnate khempeuh in note hong pha in no tungah hong tu ding hi:"},"16":{"text":"Note khuapi ah hong kihamsiat in, khuaneu ah hong kihamsiat ding hi.","title":"Thuman’lohna Hanga Hamsiatna"},"17":{"text":"Na seng uh leh na annel mekna uh kuang a kihamsiat ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Note sul pana gahte kihamsiat dinga, na leitang ua ante, na bawnghonte uh note le na tuuhonte uh note a kihamsiat ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Na sungtum ciangun hong kihamsiat dinga, na pusuah ciangun hong kihamsiat ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Note in amah a nusia-in a sia-a na gamtatna uh hangin na khut uh tawh na sepna khempeuhuah TOPA in hamsiatna, taina, buaisakna hong sawl dinga, na kisiat matengun siatpahna hong tungsak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Note neih dinga na lutna uh gam panin hong siatsak khit matengin TOPA in natnate in hong pulsak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA in note na manthan matengun, hong vat dinga, thazawm nat, cisa nat, cibawk natna, pol nading zaha nisa, guahtui haang, singno taam le maibuak tawh note hong pulsak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Note lutunga om van in sumngo hi dinga, note nuai-a om lei in, sik ahi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"TOPA in na gamuah guahtui, leivui le a vuikhu suaksak dinga, na kisiat khit matengun van panin tuate hong zusak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in na galte uh mai-ah note hong lelsak ding hi. Amau lam manawhin lam khat in na kuan uh hangin amau kiang pan lam sagihin na taikek ding uh a, leitung kumpi gamte khempeuh ah cikzethuai mahmah na suak ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Na luangte uh huih lak vasate le leitung ganhingte an suak dinga, tuate kuamah in a nawhkhia kei ding hi."},"27":{"text":"TOPA in note a kidamsak thei lo natna - Egypt meimatum, pumsung natna, meima gulut, le cithak natna in hong bawlsia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"TOPA in note haina, mit khuamuhlohna, le lungsim buaina-in hong bawlsia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Suntangpi in mittaw bangin miallak na zawt ding uh hi. Na hihna peuhpeuh uh na zo kei ding uh a, kuama hut lohin, ni khat khit ni khat hong kinuainetin hong kilawk ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Numei khat tawh a teng dingin na kiciam uh hangin midang khat in na la-in a taipih ding hi. Inn khat na lam uh hangin a sungah na tengkha kei ding uh hi. Lenggui na suan uh hangin a gah na nopsakpih man kei ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Na muh tangpi un na bawngtal uh hong kigawhsak hangin bangmah na ne kha kei ding uh hi. Na phal lohpi-un na laa uh hong kisut dinga hong kipia kik nawn kei ding hi. Na galte tungah na tuute hong kipiaksak dinga, tuate kuamah in a hu kei ding hi."},"32":{"text":"Na tanu na tapate uh minam dang tungah kipia dinga, nisimin amaute mitpaat liangin na enen ding uh a, na khut khat nangawn uh na liik zo kei ding uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Na theih loh uh mite in no gama piang na sepsate uh ne ding uh a, note in bangmah na neih loh uh hangin na nuntak laisiah uh hong kinengniamin hong kikhelbawl ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Na muhte un hong haisak ding hi."},"35":{"text":"TOPA in a kidamsak thei lo a na valval meimate na khuk uh le na khe uhah hong veisakin tuate na khenuai panun na sipzang dongun a kizelsak ding hi."},"36":{"text":"TOPA in note le no hong uk dinga na koih uh kumpite, note le na pate un na theih loh uh minamte tungah hong hawlkhia ding hi. Tua lai-ah sing le suang pasian - pasian dangte na bia ding uh hi."},"37":{"text":"TOPA in note hong hawlkhiat nading munmun ah minamte khempeuh huat, simmawh le ciamnuihna na suak ding uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Lo ah khaici tampitak na vawh uh hangin kauphe in gai ding ahi manin tawmkha bek na la ding uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Lenggui suanin na khawh uh hangin lung in ne ding ahi manin lenggahzu dawn loin lenggah zong na la kha kei ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Gam sung khempeuh ah olive kung na neih uh hangin olive gah pulh ding ahi manin a thau na zang kha kei ding uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Tanute, tapate na neih uh hangin sala pai ding uh ahi manin na kem kha kei ding uh hi."},"42":{"text":"Kauphe honpi in na singkung uh le na gamua ankung khempeuh a gai ding hi.","ref":"Joel 1:4; Mic 6:15"},"43":{"text":"No laka pemtate no tungah khangtoin sang semsem ding uh a, ahi hangin no na kiamsuk semsem ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Amah in nang hong leitawi dinga ahi hangin nang amah na leitawi kei ding hi. Amah lutang suak dinga nang a meidawn na suak ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Hih hamsiate khempeuh no tungah hong tung ding hi. TOPA note Pasian’ thu mang loin ama hong piak thupiakte le thukipte zui lo na hi manun note na kisiat matengun tuate in hong nungdelhin hong pha ding hi."},"46":{"text":"Nang le na suan le khakte adingin tuate lim le a lamdang hi tawntung ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Note in na daupai hunun lungnuamtak le lungkimtakin TOPA note Pasian na sem lo na hi manun,"},"48":{"text":"gilkial dangtak hun, puan neih loh hun le kitangsap hunin note langkhatah TOPA sawl na galte uh na, na sem ding uh hi. Amah in note hong suksiat khit matengin na ngawnguah sik hakkol hong vawh ding hi."},"49":{"text":"TOPA in a gamlapi, leimong panin note langkhatah a kampau uh na telloh uh minam"},"50":{"text":"a kihtakhuai - uhamte a zahtak lo, khangmoite a hehpih lo minam khat muvanlai leilut bangin hong kuansak ding hi."},"51":{"text":"Amaute in na kisiat khit matengun na ganhonte uh note le na gamua piang ante a valhtum ding uh hi. Amaute in na kisiat khit matengun na ante uh, zu thak ahi-a, sathau ahi zongin, na bawnghonte uh note ahi a, na tuuhonte uh note ahi zongin hong nusiat tuan kei ding uh hi."},"52":{"text":"Na muan uh kulh muanhuai sangpipite a puk matengin na gamsung khempeuh ua khuapite khempeuh hong umcih ding uh hi. TOPA note Pasian in hong piak ding gama khuapi om khempeuh amaute in hong umcih ding uh hi."},"53":{"text":"Amaute hong umcih sungin na galte un no hong bawlsiatna na thuakna un TOPA note Pasian in no hong piaksa na sul panun a gah na tanu na tapate uh sa na ne ding uh hi."},"54":{"text":"Note laka mi lungneem a cikzia thei pente nangawn in a sanggampa ahi a, a it a zi ahi a, a nungtasun a tate ahi zongin khuatuah lo dinga,"},"55":{"text":"a nek kimlai a tate sa kuamah a hawm kei ding hi. Tua in na galte un na khuapi khempeuh uh a umcih sungin a thuaksiatna uh hanga nek ding a neih lai sun ahi hi."},"56":{"text":"Note lakah mi lungneem a cikzia thei pen numeite - lungneem lua le cikzia lua kisa-in a khenuai le lei a kisukkhak ding nangawn a ut lote in - a it a pasal le ama tanu’ tapate,"},"57":{"text":"a sunga piang a ta le a naulamh a pia nuam kei ding hi. Ahang in, na galte un na khuapite uh hong umcihin hong thuaksak uh lungdonna hun sungah tuate a neksim dinga a sawm ahi hi."},"58":{"text":"Hih laibu sunga kigelh hih thukham kammalte limtakin na zuih kei uh a, a minthang a lipkhaphuai min - TOPA note Pasian na zahtak kei uh leh"},"59":{"text":"TOPA in no le na suante uh tungah a lauhuai pulpi - sawtveipi a haksa tuahsiatna le a nasia natsaute hong tungsak ding hi."},"60":{"text":"Note in na kihtak uh Egypt natna khempeuh no tungah hong tungsak dinga, note tungah belh den ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Note na siat matengun TOPA in hih Thukham Laibu sungah a kiciamteh lo natna le tuahsiatna namkimte zong no tungah hong tungsak ding hi."},"62":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thu na man loh manun vana aksi zahin na tam uh hangin tawm no bek na om ding uh hi."},"63":{"text":"Note daupai-in tampi na phak uh ciangin TOPA a lungkim bang tektekin note hong susia dinga na kisiat uh ciangin amah a lungkim ding hi. Note lut-a na neih ding uh gam panin hong kibulkalh ding hi."},"64":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in leimong khat pan mong khat dong minamte lakah note hong thehthang ding hi. Tua lai-ah note in no genloh na pate un zong a theih loh pasian dangte - sing le suang pasiante na bia ding uh hi."},"65":{"text":"Tua minamte lakah na lupna khop genloh na khepek nuai tatna khop zong na mu kei ding uh hi. Tua lai-ah TOPA in na lungsim uh patausakin, lungzuangin na mit uh ngui-in, na lungsim uh a beisak ding hi."},"66":{"text":"Na lunghimawh den ding uh a, sun tawh zan tawh lauthawng in na nuntakna uh na khamuang kei ding uh hi."},"67":{"text":"Zingsangin, \"Nitak hi tapeuh leh!\" na ci ding uh a, nitak in, \"Zingsang hi tapeuh leh!\" na ci ding uh hi; - tua pen na lungsim uh launa tawh dimin na mit mahmah un a muh nate hang ahi hi."},"68":{"text":"Note na zin kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi, ka cihna Egypt ah TOPA in tembaw in hong puak kik ding hi. Tua lai-a na galte uh tungah silanu le silapa dingin na kizuak uh hangin kuamah in hong lei kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 4:27"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte in TOPA in amaute tawh Horeb ah a bawlsa thukhun banah Moab ah Israel-te tawh a bawl nadinga Moses a thupiak thukhun kammalte ahi hi.","title":"Thukhun Thaksuaksakna","ref":"Tp 5:2-3"},"2":{"text":"Moses in Israel-te khempeuh samin amaute tungah: TOPA in Egypt ah Pharaoh tung, a uliante khempeuh tung le a gam khempeuh tungah a hihsate khempeuh na mit-un na mu khin uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Na mit mahmah un tua bawlsiatna lianpite, a tuampian limte le a lamdang alian mahmahte na mu khin uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin tuni mahmah dong TOPA in theihtelna lungsim ahi a, muhna mit ahi a, zakna bil ahi zongin hong pia nai kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Sehnel gam sunga kong makaih kum sawmli sungin na puansilh uh patkhia lo-a, na khedap kaihte uh zong a sia kei hi."},"6":{"text":"Note in anlum ne loin zu le a kibilh dang khatpeuh ahi zongin na dawn kei uh hi. TOPA note Pasian ka hilam na theih nadingun hih bangin ka hih hi.","ref":"Dt 8:4; Isa 6:10; Ro 11:8"},"7":{"text":"Hih mun na tun uh ciangin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon le Bashan kumpipa Og, eite do dingin hong kuankhia-a, ahi hangin amaute i zo hi."},"8":{"text":"Amau gam i laksaka, Reuben-te, Gad-te le Manasseh beh - alangte luah dingin i pia hi.","ref":"Ms 21:21-24,33-35; 32:33"},"9":{"text":"Note na hihna peuhpeuh uah na daupai nadingun hih thukhun kammalte limtakin zui un."},"10":{"text":"Tuni-in na makaite uh leh na mapite uh, na upate uh le na uliante uh, Israel midangte khempeuh,"},"11":{"text":"na zite uh le na tate uh tawh, na sing uh hong ehsak na tui uh hong tawisak na giahphual ua teng pemtate tawh - na vekpi un note Pasian TOPA mai ah na ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian tawh thukhun a bawlkhawm dingin tuni-in hih munah na ding uh hi, tuni mahmah in TOPA in no tawh thukhunna bawlin kiciamna tawh kipsak ding hi;"},"13":{"text":"amah in na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, Jacob le note tunga hong ciamsa bangin amah note Pasian ahi theih nadingin tuni-in note ama mi dingin hong kipsak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Keimah kiciamin, kaw bawl hih thukhun hih TOPA note bek tawh abawl hi lo-in,"},"15":{"text":"tuni-in Topa mai hih muna ding note le tuni-a om lote tawh zong a bawl ka hi hi."},"16":{"text":"Note mahmah in Egypt a i nuntakzia hih mun i tun nadinga, gamte i kantanzia na thei uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Note in amaute lakah sing le suang ahi a, ngun le kham tawh ahi zongin a kibawl milimte le lim kihhuaite na mu khin uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-in note lakah numei ahi-a pasal ahi zongin, bawng’ ahi-a beh ahi zongin kuamahpeuh TOPA eite Pasian panin kiheikhia-a, tua minamte pasiante a biak loh nadingun na lungsim uh kiciansak un; note lakah tua banga gukha zung na khak loh nadingun kiciantakin om un.","ref":"Tp 28:36; Heb 12:15"},"19":{"text":"Tua bang mite in hih kiciamna kammal a zak ciangin amah le amah kici in, \"Keima thu-in ka tatsuak hangin ka suakta veve ding hi,\" ci-in kingaihsun kha ding hi. Hih in tui a ngah leitang tung le a keu a leitang tungah siatna a tungsak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ama mawhna TOPA in maisak nuam lo dinga; ama thangpaihna le a hazatna in tua mipa langah a kang ding hi. Hih laibu sunga hamsiatna khempeuh ama tungah tu dinga, TOPA in a min van kikhupsin nuai panin a phiatkhia ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Hih Thukham Laibu sunga hamsiatna thukhun khempeuh tawh kizui-in haksatna a tuak dingin Israel beh khempeuh panin TOPA in amah a tang koihkhia ding hi.","ref":"Tp 9:14; Ph 74:1; 79:5"},"22":{"text":"Mailam a khang ding na tate uh le gamlapi pana hong pai gamdang mite in tua gama tung siatna le TOPA in a tuahsak natnate a mu ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Gambuppi pen ci le kaat kangvam hi dinga - bangmah kisuan loin bangmah sel lo-a, a tungah anteh sawlbawk a po kei ding hi. Tua in TOPA in heh lua-a a lotthal Sodom le Gomorah, Admah le Zeboim-te siatna tawh kibang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Minam khempeuh in, \"Bang hangin TOPA in hih gam hici bawl ahi hiam? Bang hangin hici lawmlawma heh ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 19:8; 22:8-9; Zep 2:9"},"25":{"text":"A dawnna pen, \"Hih mite in TOPA , a pate uh Pasian thukhun, amaute Egypt pan a paikhiatpih lai-a, amaute tawh a bawl thukhun a nusiat hang uh ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute paikhia uh a, a theih loh uh pasiante, amaute a piak loh pasiante bia in tuate mai-ah kun uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih gam tungah TOPA hehna kuanga, amah in hih laibu sunga hamsiatna khempeuh a tungah a tunsak ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"A hehluatna le a thangpaihna lianpi tawh TOPA in amau gam panin amaute bulkalh a, tu-a a om bangun amaute gamdangah a nawhgawp ahi hi,\" kici ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 14:15; 2Ku 17:23; Da 9:11, 13-14"},"29":{"text":"Thusimte pen TOPA note Pasian aa hi a, ahi hangin hong kilak hih thute eite le i tate aa hi-in, hih thukham thute khempeuh i zuih theih nading ahi hi.","ref":"2Ti 3:16"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note mai-ah ka koih thuphate le hamsiatnate khempeuh, TOPA in minamte laka hong thehthangna peuhpeuh ah na lungsimun kenga,","title":"lama Kihei Khita Daupaina"},"2":{"text":"note le na tate un TOPA lam zuan kik-a, tuni-a kong thupiakna tawh kizui-in na khempeuh ah na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh ama thu na man uh leh,"},"3":{"text":"tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian in note hong khuatuah dinga hong thehthangna minamte khempeuh lak panin hong khawm kikin na mailam hun b uh a ngei hong bangsak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Van kikhupsin nuai a gamla penpen gam nangawn ah hong kihawlkhia zongin tua lai pan TOPA note Pasian in hong khawmin hong puak kik ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in na pate uh neihsa gamah hong puak dinga, tua ciangin tua gam na tang ding uh hi. Amah in na pate uh sangin hong daupaisak zaw in hong tamzawsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh un it thei a, na nuntak nadingun note le na suante uh lungsim vun hong atsak ding hi."},"7":{"text":"No hong mudah a hong bawlsia na galte uh tungah TOPA note Pasian in hih hamsiatna khempeuh a tungsak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Note in TOPA thu na mang kik ding uh a, tuni-a kong gen ama thupiakte khempeuh na zui ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA note Pasian in na khutun nasep khempeuh uh, na sul panun a gah, na ganhonte uh note le na leitang panun a piang ante khempeuh ah a daupai pen hong suaksak ding hi. Na pate uh tungah a lungkim bangin TOPA note tungah lungkim kik dinga,"},"10":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian thu mangin Thukham Laibu sunga kigelh ama thupiakte le a thukipte na zuih uh a, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na hinna khempeuh uh tawh TOPA note Pasian lamah na kihei nak uh leh hong daupaisak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 11:26; Ph 126:4; Jer 32:39"},"11":{"text":"Tu-in, tuni-a note kong thupiak note adingin haksa lua lo a, na hih lah ding uh hi lo hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Tua thupiakte la dingin vantungah kua kah to in tuate banah thu i man theih nadingin kua hong tangko ding hiam?\" ci-a na dot theih nadingun van ah a om kei hi.","title":"Nuntakna ahikeh Sihna Kipia"},"13":{"text":"\"Tua thupiakte la dingin kua in tuipi kantanin thu i man theih nadingin kua hong tangko ding hiam?\" ci-a na dot nadingun tuipi galah zong a om tuan kei hi."},"14":{"text":"A om kei hi, na kiang mahmah ah om a; a thu na man theih nadingin na kam sung le na lungtangah a om hi."},"15":{"text":"En un, tuni-in note mai-ah nuntakna le daupaina, sihna le kisiatna ka koih hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA note Pasian itin ama lampite tawna ama thupiakte, a thukipte le a thukhamte na zuih dingun thu kong pia hi. Tua hileh note nungta in na pung semsem ding uh a, TOPA note Pasian in luta na luah ding uh gamah thupha hong pia ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin thumang loin na lungsim uh pialkhia a, pasian dangte beelin bia-a na kun uh leh,"},"18":{"text":"note tungah tuni-in kong genkhia hi, na kisia taktak ding uh hi. Jordan kantanin na neih ding uh gamah sawtvei na nungta kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 8:19"},"19":{"text":"Tuni-in note langkhatah teci a pang dingin van le lei samin note mai-ah nuntakna le sihna thuphate le samsiatnate ka koih hi. Tu-in note le na tate uh na nuntak theih nading uh le"},"20":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian itin, a aw ngai-in amah na letkip theih nadingun nuntakna teel un. Ahang in, na nuntakna uh TOPA hi a amah in na pate uh Abraham, Isaac le Jacob tungah piak dinga a ciamsa gam no tungah kum tampi hong pia ding hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses pusuakkhia in Israel khempeuh tungah:","title":"Joshua in Moses Laih Ding"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in kei kum za le sawmnih ka upa ta hi; note kong makaih thei nawn kei ding hi. TOPA in kei tungah, ‘Jordan na kantan kei ding hi,’ hong ci khin hi."},"3":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian mahmah in note hong pi-in hong kantanpih ding hi. Amah in note mai-ah hih minamte susia in amaute gam laksakin na tang ding uh hi. TOPA gensa bangin Joshua in note hong kantanpih ding hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA in amaute gam tawh a suksiat khawm Amor-te kumpipa Sihon le Og-te tungah a hih bangin amaute tungah a hih ding hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA in amaute no tungah hong pia dinga, note in kong thupiaksate amaute tungah na sem pelmawh ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Hat unla hang un. TOPA note Pasian in hong tonpih ahi manin amaute hangin lauin linglawng kei un; amah in hong nusia loin hong taisan ngei lo ding hi,\" ci-in hih thute a gen hi.","ref":"Tp 3:23,26; 7:2; Jos 10:25"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in Joshua sam a, Israel khempeuh mai ah, \"Hat inla hang in, TOPA in a pute uh tungah amaute piak dingin a ciamsa gamah hih mite na lutpih pelmawh dinga, amaute luah dingin tua gam na hawmsak pelmawh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA mahmah na mai-ah pai-in hong ompih ding hi; amah in nang hong nusia ngei loin hong taisan ngei kei ding hi. Lau kei inla lungkia kei in,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci in Moses in hih thukham gelh a, TOPA thukhun singkuang a pua Levi tapa siampite le Israel upate khempeuh tungah a pia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in amaute thu pia-a: \"Leiba kimaisak kum ahi kum sagih a cin sim, Biakbuk Pawi hun a tun ciangin,","title":"Thukham Simna"},"11":{"text":"ama teel nading mun TOPA note Pasian mai-ah Israel khempeuh a kilah hun ciangin amaute mai-ah amaute zakin hih thukham na sim ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Nupi, papi, naupang le na khua sungua teng pemtate in za-in TOPA note Pasian thu ngai-a, amah kihtakzia ding thei-in hih thukham kammalte limtaka a zuih theih nadingun - mipite kikhawmsak un."},"13":{"text":"Hih thukham a thei nai lo a tate un za pelmawh ding uh a, Jordan kantana na neih ding uh gam ah na ten laiteng uh TOPA note Pasian kihtakzia ding a thei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 4:15; Tp 15:1; Jos 8:34-35"},"14":{"text":"TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Tu-in na sih ni ding nai ta hi. Joshua sam inla amah za ka piak nading mun Puanbuk ah nang zong hong om in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Kikhopna Puanbuk ah Moses le Joshua a va om uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Puanbuk-a meii khuampi ah TOPA kilanga, Puanbuk kongvang tungah meii a kitung hi.","title":"Israel Lehdo ding Genkholhna"},"16":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA in Moses kiangah, \"Na pate tawh na tawlnga ta dinga, hih mipite a lut nading uh gama gamdang pasiante tungah a kizuak pah ding uh hi. Amaute in kei hong taisanin amaute tawh ka bawl thukhun a palsat ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin amaute tungah ka heh dinga amaute nusia-in amaute panin ka maitang ka sel dinga, a kisia ding uh hi. Amaute tungah vangsiatna le haksatna tampi tungin tua ni ciangin amaute in, ‘I Pasian in hong ompih nawn lo ahi manin hih vangsiatnate ei tungah hong tung hi lo ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin pasian dangte lamah amaute a kiheina uh gamtatsiate hangin ka maitang ka selsan taktak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 33:9"},"19":{"text":"\"Tu-in nang mahmah in hih la gelh inla Israel-te hilh in; amau langah ka teci ahi thei dingin amaute sasak in."},"20":{"text":"A pute uh tungah kiciama ka khapsa bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna gamah ka tunsak hun ciang, amaute in ne-in a tha hoih khit uh ciangin kei hong nialin ka thukhunte palsat ding uh a, pasian dangte lamah kihei-in a bia ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute tungah vangsiatnate le haksatnate tampi a tun ciangin amau suante in hih la mangngilh nai lo ding uh ahi manin amaute langkhatah teci hi ding hi. Keimah in amaute tungah kiciama ka piak nading gamah ka puak ma nangawnin a sep dingun a sawm kholhsa uh ka thei hi,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in tua ni-in hih la gelh a Israel-te a hilh hi."},"23":{"text":"TOPA in Nun’ tapa Joshua tungah hih thupiak pia a: \"Keimah kiciama amaute ka khapsa gamah Israel-te tunpih ding na hi manin hat inla hang in, keimah in kong ompih ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jos 1:6"},"24":{"text":"Moses in laibu khat sungah hih thukham kammalte a kipatna pan a bei ding a gelh khit ciangin,"},"25":{"text":"TOPA thukhun singkuang a pua Levi-te tungah:"},"26":{"text":"\"Hih Thukham laibu la unla, TOPA note Pasian thukhun singkuang pangah koih un. Note langkhatah teci ahi dingin tua lai-ah a om ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Note na ngawng khauh lam uh le na lehdo theih lam uh kong thei hi. Ka nuntak lai no tawh ka om khawm lai nangawnin TOPA langah lehdo na hi uh leh ka sih khit ciangin na lehdo zawsan ding uh hi!"},"28":{"text":"Na beh upate uh le na ulian khempeuh uh mai-ah hih kammalte ka gen theih nading le amaute langkhatah teci a pang dingin van le lei ka sap theih nadingin ka mai-ah amaute hong kikhawmsak un."},"29":{"text":"Ka sih khit ciangin note kisiathang gawpin kong thupiaksa panin na pialkhiat ding uh lah teltakin ka thei hi. Mailam hun ciangin TOPA muhna ah a sia-in gamta ding uh a, na khut uh tawh na bawlsate uh hangin amah hehsak ding na hih manun note tungah vangsiatna hong tung ding hi,\" ci-in hih thupiakte a pia hi.","ref":"Tp 4:26"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Moses in hih lamalte a patna pan a tawpna dong kamngah a Israel mipi bup zakin:"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vante aw, na ngai un kong gen ding hi; Leitung aw, ka kammalte na za in.","ref":"Tp 4:26; Isa 1:2"},"2":{"text":"Ka hilhna guahmal bangin kia henla, ka kammalte daitui bangin taak hen; lopa sel tungah guahphin bang henla, singno dawngte tunga guahzu bang hen.","ref":"Isa 55:11"},"3":{"text":"TOPA min ka tangko ding hi. Oh, eite Pasian liatna phat un!","ref":"Pk 33:19; Tp 3:24"},"4":{"text":"Amah Suangpi hi a, a nasepte kicingin a lampi khempeuh thutang ahi hi. A muanhuai, a khial lo Pasian, thudikin thutang hi.","ref":"Tp 7:9; 2Sa 22:31"},"5":{"text":"Ama tungah amaute a siattat uh hangin a maizum nading uh hi a, ama tate hi nawn loin lungsim kawi le lungsim khel khang mite a ahi uh hi.","ref":"Dt 31:29"},"6":{"text":"A hai, a pil lo mite aw, TOPA na thuk kik nading uh hih bang lam mah hiam? Amah note hong bawl hong siam, hong Piangsakpa b na Pa uh hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 74:2; 116:12; Tp 1:31; Isa 63:16"},"7":{"text":"Tanglai hunte phawk unla; sawtpek lai-a khangte ngaihsun un. Na pa dong lecin hong gen dinga, na upate uh dong lecin hong ciangen ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 44:1; Job 8:8; Pk 13:14"},"8":{"text":"Sangpen Pa in minamte amau luah ding pia a, mihing khempeuh a hawmsak lai-in Israel’ tapate c a phazah tawh kizui-in mite ading gamgi a phuhsak hi."},"9":{"text":"TOPA ’ tanh ama mite hi a, ama luahdinga a tanh Jacob ahiman ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 10:16"},"10":{"text":"Sehnel leitang gam kolh lakpi a thum duldul leikeu munah amah mu hi. Amah dalin kema; amit nauta bangin cinga,","ref":"Jer 2:6; Ph 17:8; Zec 2:8"},"11":{"text":"a bu tokin, a note tungah kha a zap, a note man dingin a kha a zak, a khaveng tungah a note a pua zel muvanlai tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pk 19:4"},"12":{"text":"TOPA bek in amah pi-a; pasian dang in a ompih kei hi.","ref":"Tp 4:35; Isa 43:12"},"13":{"text":"Leitang asannate ah amah tuangsak a, lo pana gahte in a vak hi. Suangpi pana khuaizu le meisuang heng pana sathau,","ref":"Tp 8:8; Job 29:6"},"14":{"text":"bawnghon le tuuhon panin tuuno le keelno vakthaute le nawitui le nawithau-khal, Bashan tuutal limcipente le mangbuh vui tualpenin amah a vak hi. Nang in a phuan seuhseuh lenggah sisan na dawn hi.","ref":"Ph 81:16"},"15":{"text":"Jeshurun d hong thau ta in hong lehpeek ta a, an hau in, gik lihliahin a mam pingpeng hi. Amah a bawlpa Pasian nusia-in, ama Honpa Suangpi a nial hi.","ref":"Tp 31:20; Isa 1:4,28"},"16":{"text":"Amaute in a gamdang pasiante uh a hazasak uh a, amau milim kihhuaite in a hehsak uh hi.","ref":"1Co 10:22"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian ahi lo dawite- a theih ngei loh uh pasiante, a piangtawm pasiante na pate uh kiktak loh pasiante tungah biakna a pia uh hi.","ref":"Tp 28:64; Thk 5:8"},"18":{"text":"Note ta-a hong nei Suangpi na taisan uh a, no hong senkhia Pasian na mangngilh uh hi.","ref":"Ph 106:21; Isa 17:10"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in hih mu a, a tanute a tapate in hehsak ahi manin amaute a nolh hi.","ref":"Jer 44:21-23"},"20":{"text":"Amah in, \"Amaute pan ka maitang ka sel ding hi; amaute lungsim kawi khangmite hi uh a, a muanhuai lo tate ahi manun a tawpna ah bang a suak uh hiam, ka en ding hi.","ref":"Tp 31:17,29"},"21":{"text":"Amaute in pasian ahi lo tawh hong hazasak uh a, kimanna nei lo a milim un hong hehsak uh hi. Kei zong tuate mahin mihing a hi lote ka engsak dinga; bangmah a thei lo minamte-in amaute ka hehsak ding hi.","ref":"Ro 10:19"},"22":{"text":"Ka thangpaihna in mei tawhkuang khin ahi manin sihna e leinuai gam dong a kang hi. Tua in leitung le a ante hultum dinga, mualte bulpite a kuangsak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"\"Amaute tungah tuahsiatna ka sungvum dinga, amaute langkhatah ka thaltang ka kap ding hi.","ref":"Tp 29:21; Ph 18:14"},"24":{"text":"Kialpi-in amaute ka zuukmang dinga, a haltum natna le sihtheihna pulpi ka tungsak ding hi; amaute lang khatah a hahiam gamsate le leivui laka awmtal a gupha ngante ka sawl ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:22"},"25":{"text":"Namsau in kongzing lakah amaute ta nei loin omsak dinga, a inn uh launa in a uk ding hi. Nungakte le tangvalte naungekte le samkangte a simang ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute ka thehthang dinga, mihing kiphawk khakna panin ka phiatmang ding hi, ka ci hi.","ref":"Tp 4:27"},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin lah a galte un a galte uh phinin, ‘Ko khut mah a gualzo hi; hih khempeuh TOPA sepsa hi kei,’ ci-a a theihkhialh ding ka lau zel hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:13"},"28":{"text":"Amaute ngaihsutna nei lo minam hi uh a, amaute sungah thu theihkakna a teng kei hi.","ref":"Isa 1:3; 27:11"},"29":{"text":"Amaute pil tapeuh in hih thu theitel uh henla, a tawpna ah bang suak ding cih thei le uh maw!","ref":"Ph 81:13"},"30":{"text":"Suangpi in amaute tungah zuak kei henla, TOPA in amaute piakhia lo hileh bangci in mi khat in tul khat nungdelhin, mi nih in tulsawm lausak ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Sp 26:8; Ph 44:12"},"31":{"text":"Ahang in, i galte nangawn in a theih mah bangun amau’ suangpi le ei Suangpi a kibang kei hi.","ref":"Pc 49:24"},"32":{"text":"Amau lenggui Sodom pan le Gomorrah a lote pana pai ahi hi. A lenggahte uh gu tawh kidima, a lenggah bawkte uh khaatna tawh kidim hi.","ref":"Tp 29:18"},"33":{"text":"A zu uh gulpite gu hi a, sihtheihna sokval gu ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"\"Hihte koihkhol gige-in ka vankholna ah sincip lo ka hi hiam?"},"35":{"text":"Phulakna kei aa hi a;ka thukkik ding hi. TOPA nasempa Moses thupiaksa bangin amaute susiamang kiuhkeuh hi."},"13":{"text":"Joshua in a haltum Hazor longal mual neute tunga om khuapite khempeuh Israel in khat beek a hal kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel in hih khuapite a van kinusiate le ganhingte khempeuh puakhiamang uh a, ahi hangin a husang khat beek hawi loin mihing khempeuh a susiamang kiuhkeuh uh hi."},"15":{"text":"TOPA in ama nasempa Moses thu pia a, Moses in Joshua a thupiak bangin Joshua in a hih hi; TOPA in Moses a thupiakte sep loh a, a nusiat khat beek a om kei hi.","ref":"Pk 34:11; Ms 33:50-52"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in hih gambuppi: Mualtung gam teng, Negev khempeuh, Goshen kual buppi, nitumna lam mualbulte, Arabah le Israel mualliante a mualbulte uh tawh,"},"17":{"text":"Halak Vum pan Seir lam manawh a kikhung to, Hermon Vum nuaisan a om Lebanon Kuam sunga Baal Gad ciang dong a la hi. A kumpite khempeuh man-a, sattukin a that hi."},"18":{"text":"Joshua in hih kumpite khempeuh a do hun sung sawtveipi ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon a teng, Israel-te tawh kilem nading thuciam a bawl Hiv-te longal a vekpi in sim-a, a lak ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in Moses a thupiaksa bangin lainat loin a vekpi un susia mang a a cimansak theih nadingin Israel-te do dingin TOPA in amaute lungsim a khauhsak ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 14:17;Jos 9:3;10:41"},"21":{"text":"Tua hun mahin Joshua pai-a mualtung gama om: Hebron, Debir le Anab pan, Judah-te mualtung gam khempeuh pan le Israel mualtung gam khempeuh a Anak-te a susia hi. Joshua in amaute le a khuapite uh a susiamang kiuhkeuh hi."},"22":{"text":"Israel gam sungah Anak-te khat zong om nawn lo a; Gaza, Gath le Ashdod ah a om laisunte bek a om uh hi."},"23":{"text":"TOPA in Moses a lah bang tektekin Joshua in tua gam khempeuh la-a, amau beh khenna tawh kizui-in a luah dingun Israel tungah a pia hi. Tua ciangin tua gamah gal a veng ta hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte in Israel-te zawhsa Jordan nisuahna lama amau laksa kumpite gam hi-a, Arnon Kuam panin Hermon Vum dong le Arabah nisuahna lampang khempeuh tawh ahi hi.","title":"Zawhsa Khuapi Phazah","ref":"Tp 3:8"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon a kumpi sem Amor-te kumpipa Sihon. Amah in Arnon Guam siik tunga om Aroer pan - guam laizang pan - Amon-te gamgi ahi Jabbok Gunpi ciang dong a uk hi. Hih sungah Gilead kimkhat kihel hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in Arabah nisuahna-lam Kinnereth c Tuipi panin Arabah Tuipi (Ci Tuipi) d dong, Beth Jeshimoth ciang le tua ciang leitaw-lam pangah Pisgah mualdung kikhungsuk nuaisan dong zong a uk hi.","ref":"Jos 11:2; 13:20;Thk 11:19"},"4":{"text":"Tua pen Ashtaroth le Edrei a kumpi sem Rephai-te kumpi nunungte laka khat Bashan kumpipa Og gam ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in Hermon Vum, Salacah, Bashan gam khempeuh Geshur le Maacah mite gamgi ciang dong le Gilead kimkhat Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gamgi ciang dong a uk hi.","ref":"Ms 21:21,33;Tp 1:4;3:10"},"6":{"text":"TOPA nasempa Moses le Israel-te in amaute a zo uh hi. Tuateh TOPA nasempa Moses in amaute leitang Reuben-te tung, Gad-te tung, le Manasseh beh alangte tungah a neih dingun a pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih a nuai-ate in Jordan nitumna lama Joshua le Israel-te zawhsa kumpi gamte hi a, Lebanon Kuam sunga Baal Gad panin Seir lama a kikhungto Halak Vum ciang hi-in (Israel behte amau beh kikhenna tawh kizui-in Joshua in a luah dingun a piak -"},"8":{"text":"mualtung gam teng, nitumna lam mualbul, Arabah mual kikhungsuk, sehnel-gam le Negev ciang - Hit-te, Amor-te, Canaan-te Periz-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te gamte ahi hi):"},"9":{"text":"Jericho kumpi — khat Ai kumpi (Bethel kianga) — khat"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem kumpi — khat Hebron kumpi — khat"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth kumpi — khat Lachish kumpi — khat"},"12":{"text":"Eglon kumpi — khat Gezer kumpi — khat"},"13":{"text":"Debir kumpi — khat Geder kumpi — khat"},"14":{"text":"Hormah kumpi — khat Arad kumpi — khat"},"15":{"text":"Libnah kumpi — khat Adullam kumpi — khat"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah kumpi — khat Bethel kumpi — khat"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah kumpi — khat Hepher kumpi — khat"},"18":{"text":"Aphek kumpi — khat Lasharon kumpi — khat"},"19":{"text":"Madon kumpi — khat Hazor kumpi — khat"},"20":{"text":"Shimron Meron kumpi — khat Acshaph kumpi — khat"},"21":{"text":"Taanach kumpi — khat Megiddo kumpi — khat"},"22":{"text":"Kedesh kumpi — khat Carmel a Jokneam kumpi — khat"},"23":{"text":"Dor kumpi (Naphoth Dor) a — khat Gilgal a Goyim kumpi — khat"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah kumpi — khat a vekpi in kumpi sawmthum le khat ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 6:2, 10:33"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua kum tamta in tekta ahi ciangin TOPA in ama kiangah, \"Nang lah tek mahmah ta, lak ding gam lah zai mahmah lai hi.","title":"Lak Lai ding Gam"},"2":{"text":"Lak ding a samlai gamte:Philistia le Geshur kualte khempeuh,"},"3":{"text":"Egypt nisuahna Shihor Gun panin leilu lama Ekron gam dong, a vekpi-in Canaan-te aa in kisima (Avvim-te gam ahi - Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath le Ekron-te a uk Philistia-te gam ngate hi a;)"},"4":{"text":"a leitaw lam panin Canaan-te gam khempeuh, Sidon-te gama Arah panin Gebal-te b huam sung, Amor-te kual a Aphek dong bana;"},"5":{"text":"nisuahna panin Lebanon khempeuh Hermon Vum nuai sana Baal Gad panin Lebo c Hamath ciang dong ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 2:23; Thk 3:3;Am 2:10"},"6":{"text":"\"Mualtung kuala tengte adingin Lebanon pan Misrephoth Maim ciang, tua muna teng Sidon-te khempeuh kei mahmah in Israel-te mai pan ka nawhkhia ding hi. Keimah in nang kong lamlahsa bangin a luah dingun hih gam tuam khenkhiat inla,"},"7":{"text":"beh kua le Manasseh beh alangte tungah hih gam a luah dingun hawmsak in,\" a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Manasseh d alang dang khatte, Reuben-te le Gad-te in Jordan nisuahna lamah TOPA ’ nasempa Moses in amaute piak dinga a sehsa bangin amaute in luahna a ngah khin uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Arnon Guam siik tunga om Aroer pan, le guam laizanga khuapi pan le Medeba mualtung zang buppi, Dibon ciang dongah kikhunga,","title":"Jordan Nisuahna Gam Khenna"},"10":{"text":"Heshbon a kumpi a sem Amor-te kumpipa Sihon khuapi teng, Ammon-te gamgi pua ciang dong a huam hi."},"11":{"text":"Gilead Geshur le Maacah mite gam, Hermon Vum khempeuh le Bashan khempeuh Selecah dong zong huama -"},"12":{"text":"tua in Bashan kumpi Og kumpi-gam bup ahi hi; amah pen Ashtaroth le Edrei ah kumpi a semsa, Rephaim-te laka a suakta lai sun ahi hi. Moses in amaute zo in a gam uh a laksa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin Israel-te in Geshur le Maacah mite nawhkhia lo uh a, tua ahi ciangin tuni dong amaute Israel-te lakah teng den uh hi.","ref":"Tp 2:36;3:11;Jos 12:4"},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah in amaute a ciamsa bangin TOPA Israel Pasian tungah mei-a hal biaknate Levi behte goutanh ahi nungsang amaute gouluah a pia kei hi.","ref":"Dt 18:1-2"},"15":{"text":"Moses in Reuben beh abawng’- bawng’te tungah a piakte in:"},"16":{"text":"A gamgi uh Arnon Guam siik-a Aroer pan le guam laizanga khua pan, a mualtung zanga"},"17":{"text":"Medeba gal panin Heshbon le mualtung zanga khuapite khempeuh, Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,"},"18":{"text":"Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Sibmah, kuam mual tunga Zereth Shahar"},"20":{"text":"Beth Peor, Pisgah mualdung suk teng le Beth Jeshimoth -"},"21":{"text":"mualtung zanga khua khempeuh le Heshbon a uk Amor-te kumpipa Sihon ukna gam khempeuh ahi hi. Moses in tua gama teng - Sihon a beel ukpite - Midian-te gam-ukte, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur le Reba-te amah tawh a zawh khawmsa ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Gal sunga a kithatte banah Israel-te in Beor’ tapa aisanpa Balaam namsau-in a that uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Reuben-te gamgi, Jordan gun pang ahi hi. Hih khuapite le khuaneute Reuben-te in a bawng’bawng’un a luah uh hi.","ref":"Ms 21:23; 31:8;32:37"},"24":{"text":"Moses in Gad-te beh a bawng’-bawng’te tungah a piakte in:"},"25":{"text":"Jazer gam, Gilead khuapi khempeuh, Rabbah kianga Ammon-te gam Aroer dong,"},"26":{"text":"le Heshbon pan Ramoth Mizpah le Beonim ciang le Mahanaim pan Debir gam ciang,"},"27":{"text":"le kuam sungah, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth le Zaphon, Heshbon a kumpi Sihon ukna gam om lai teng (Jordan nisuahna-lam panga Kinnereth Tuipi mong ciang) a ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Hih khuapite le a khuaneute Gad-te in a bawng’ bawng’un a luah uh hi.","ref":"Ms 21:32;34:11"},"29":{"text":"Hih in Moses in Manasseh beh a langte tungah a piaksa hi-a, tua pen Manasseh innkuante suan alang, a bawng’bawng’te tungah a piak ahi hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua gam Mahanaim panin kikhunga, Bashan huamin, Bashan kumpipa Og ukna - Bashan a Jair-te tenna khempeuh, khua sawmguk,"},"31":{"text":"Gilead kimkhat, le Ashtaroth le Edrei (Bashan a Og kumpipa khuapi) ciang ahi hi. Hih in Manasseh tapa Makir suante ading hi-a - Makir tapate alangte in a bawng’bawng’a a tanh ding uh ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Hih in Jordan galkhat Jericho nisuahna-lam Moab zanglei ah Moses a om lai-a amaute luah dinga a piak ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi hangin Moses in Levi behte tungah gouluah a pia kei hi; amah in amaute a khapsa bangin TOPA , Israel Pasian amau gouluah ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 18:20"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in hihte siampi Eleazar in, Nun’ tapa Joshua le Israel-te a beh-a bawng’ lutangte tungah a ngah dingun Canaan gam a phacia tawh kizui-in a luah dingun a sehkhiat ahi hi.","title":"Jordan Nitumna - lam Gam Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in Moses a thupiak bangin amau luah dingte beh kua le alangte tungah aitelna-a kipia ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Moses in beh nih le alangte luah ding Jordan nisuahna-lam ah a piaksa ahi manin a om laite lakah Levi-te luah ding pia lo hi,"},"4":{"text":"ahang in,Manasseh le Ephraim Joseph’ tapa nihte beh nih a suak uh hi. Levi-te in gam, tanh nei lo uh a, ahi hangin ten nading khuapi le a tuuhonte uh le a bawnghonte uh tat nading lonona gam bek kipia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuaci-in Israel-te in Moses tunga TOPA thupiak bang tektekin gam a hawm uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tu-in Judah mite Gilgal a Joshua lam manawhin pai uh a, Keniz-te Jephuneh’ tapa Calep in, \"Kadesh Barnea ah TOPA in Pasian mipa Moses tungah nang le kei thu a gensa na thei hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA nasempa Moses in a gam thu va kan dingin Kadesh Barnea pana hong sawlin kei kum sawmli ka upa ta hi. Kei muhna bangin ama kiangah thu ka zasak a,","title":"Hebron, Caleb Kipia"},"8":{"text":"ahi hangin ka paipih ka sanggamte in mipite lausakin a lungsisak uh hi. Ken ka hileh TOPA ka Pasian ka lungsimneih zahin ka zui hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tua ni-in Moses kei tungah hong kiciam a, ‘ TOPA ka Pasian na lungsim neih zahin zui na hi manin na khe a na siikna mun peuhpeuh nang goutanh hi dinga, na tate in a tangden ding uh hi,’ b hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 13:30"},"10":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin tu-in TOPA in hong khapsa bang tektekin sehnel gama Israel a vakvak hun sung kum sawmli le kumnga kei hong nungtasak hi. Tua ahi ciangin tuni-in kei hih lai-ah kum sawmgiat le nga ka pha ta hi!"},"11":{"text":"Moses in kei hong sawlkhiat lai zahin ka tha a hat lai hi; tua hun lai mah bangin tu-in galsim a kuan thei lai dingin ka hat lai hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua huna TOPA hong khapsa gam hih mualtung teng tu-in kei hong pia in. Tua huna nang mahmah in na zaksa bangin tua lai-ah Anak-te om-a, a khuapite uh zai-in kulhin ki-um hi; ahi hangin TOPA in kei hong huh dinga ama cih bang tektekin amaute ka hawlkhia zo ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Joshua in Jephuneh’ tapa Caleb thupha pia-a, a luah dingin Hebron a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Keniz-te Jephunneh’ tapa Calep in TOPA , Israel Pasian a lungsim neihzahin zui ahi manin Hebron a tang hi."},"15":{"text":"(Hebron pen Anak-te laka mi lian pen Arba tama Kiriath Arba kicisa ahi hi.) Tua ciangin tua gamah gal a veng ta hi.","ref":"Jos 22:6-7; Thk 1:20"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah beh a bawng’bawng’te sehtanh, Edom gam dongah kikhungsuk a, leitaw-lam pekpek Zin sehnel-gam dong ahi hi.","title":"Judah Sehtanh"},"2":{"text":"A gamgi uh leitaw lamah, Ci Tuipi c leitaw-lam mong panin kipana,"},"3":{"text":"Mom-ai d Ciangpi leitaw lam kantanin Zin ah kizom suaka Kadesh Barnea leitaw lamah a paisuak hi. Tua ciang Hezron dung tawnin Addar lamah kikhungto-a, Karka a kualkhum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Azmon dungah pai-in Egypt Wadi zoma, tuipi ah tawp hi. Hih in amaute e leitaw-lam gamgi ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Nisuahna gamgi pen Ci Tuipi dung Jordan gun tun dong ahi hi. Leilu-lam gamgi, tuipi gei Jordan tun panin kipana,","ref":"Pc 14:3"},"6":{"text":"Beth Hoglah ah paito in Beth Arabah leilu-lam zoma Reuben’ tapa Bohan’ Suangtumpi a sun hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin gamgi Achor Kuam panin Debir ah paito-a, Gilgal lam manawhin leilu lamah kihei-a, kuam leitaw lama Adummim Ciangpi a maingat hi. En Shemesh Tuite dungah kizomsuak a En Rogel ah suakkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ben Hinnom Kuam dong Jebus-te khuapi (tua pen Jerusalem) leitaw-lam dungah zui-in a paito hi. Tua lai panin Rephaim Kuam leilu-lam monga om Hinnom Kuam nitumna-lam mualneu dawnah a kahto hi."},"9":{"text":"Mualneu dawn panin gamgi, Nephtoah Tuinakte lam maingatin Ephron Vum a khuapite ah suakkhia-a Baalah (tua pen Kiriath Jearim) lam manawhin a paisuk hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Baalah panin Seir Vum lamah kawiphei a Jearim Vum (tua pen Keslon) dung leilu lamah paisukin Beth Shemesh zomsuka Timnah ah a galkah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuateh Ekron leilu-lam dung zui a, Shikkeron lamah kihei phei-in Baalah Vum dung kantana Jabneel a ban hi. Tuipi ah gamgi a tawp hi.","ref":"Jos 7:24; 18:17;1Kh 13:6"},"12":{"text":"A nitumna-lam gamgi Tuipi lian a dungdung ahi hi. Judah mite, a bawng’te uh tawh kizui-in a kimkot ua gamgite hihte ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 34:6"},"13":{"text":"TOPA in Joshua a thupiakna tawh kizui-in amah in Jephunneh’ tapa Caleb tungah Judah - Kiriath Arba tua pen, Hebron sungah tanh khat a pia hi. (Anak pu Arba ahi hi.)"},"14":{"text":"Hebron panin Caleb in Anak suante ahi - Anak mite thum - Sheshai, Ahiman, le Talmai a hawlkhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua lai panin Debir (a masa in Kiriath Sepher kici) mite do dingin a kuan hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuateh Caleb in, \"Kiriath Sepher sim-a, a la zo pa ka tanu Acsah tawh ka tengsak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Caleb sanggampa Kenaz’ tapa Othniel in a la zo hi; Tua ciangin Caleb in a tanu Acsah tawh amah a kitengsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ni khat tuanu Othniel kiangah pai-in a pa tungah lo khat a nget dingin amah b a hah sawl hi. Amah laa tung pan a tuahkhiat ciangin Caleb in, \"Nang ading bang kong hihsak ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuanu in, \"Kei hong angvan tuam diak in. Negev ah leitang nong piak khit nungsang, tuikhukte zong hong pia in,\" ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin Caleb in tuikhuk tungnung le tuikhuk nuainungte a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah beh in a bawng’bawng’a, a luah ding uh hih ahi hi:"},"21":{"text":"Negev sunga om, Edom tawh gamgi lampang leitaw-lam a nehpen Judah behte khuapite: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (tua pen Hazor)"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, Iim, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziglak, Madmannah, Sansanah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shillim, Ain le Rimmon - a vekpi in khuapi sawmnih le kua le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Nitumna-lam mualbul ah: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, le Gederah (ahikeh Gederothaim) c - a khuapi sawm le li le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"37":{"text":"Zenan, Hadshah, Migdal Gad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,"},"39":{"text":"Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah le Makkedah - khuapi sawm le guk le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"42":{"text":"Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Aczib le Mereshah - khuapi kua le a khuaneute ahi hi.","ref":"1Kh 6:59"},"45":{"text":"Ekron a kimkot a tengte le a khuaneute tawh,"},"46":{"text":"Ekron nitumna lam, Ashdod a khua vengte khempeuh, a khuaneute tawh;"},"47":{"text":"Ashdod a kimkota tengte le a khuaneute le Gaza, a kimkota tengte le a khuaneute, Egypt Wadi dong le Tuipi Lian gei ciang dong ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 34:6"},"48":{"text":"Mualtung gamte: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (tua pen Debir),"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon le Giloh - khuapi sawm le khat le a khuaneute ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 10:42;Thk 10:1"},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kiriath Arba (tua pen Hebron) le Zior - khuapi kua le a khuaneute ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 25:14"},"55":{"text":"Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah le Timnah - khuapi sawm le a khuaneute ahi hi.","ref":"Thk 10:12; 1Kh 11:31"},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Maarath, Beth Anoth le Eltekon - khuapi guk le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"60":{"text":"Kiriath Baal (tua pen Kiriath Jearim) le Rabbah - khuapi nih le a khuaneute ahi hi."},"61":{"text":"Sehnel-gam ah: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,"},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Ci Khuapi le En Gedi - khuapi guk le a khuaneute ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 8:15"},"63":{"text":"Judah in Jerusalem a teng Jebus-te a hawlkhia zo kei hi; tuni dongin Jebus-te tua lai-ah Judah mite tawh a tengkhawm uh hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph sehtanh in Jericho tuite nisuahna-lam Jericho a Jordan d panin kipana, tua lai pan paito-in sehnel-gam kantan-a, Bethel mualtung gam sungah a lut to hi.","title":"Ephraim le Manasseh-te Sehtanh"},"2":{"text":"Bethel (tua pen Lud) e panin pai lai-a, Ataroth a Ark-te gam kantan in,"},"3":{"text":"nitumna-lam ah Japhlet-te gam lamah sukpai-a, Beth Horon Nuainung kual Gezer dong bansukin tuipi ah a tawp hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuaci-in Joseph suante Manasseh le Ephraim-te in amau gouluah a ngah uh hi.","ref":"Jos 18:5"},"5":{"text":"Hih in Ephraim-te a bawng’bawng’a a gam uh ahi hi. Amaute luahna gamgi, Beth Horon Tungnung nisuahna lama om Ataroth Addar panin pai-a,"},"6":{"text":"tuipi a zom hi. Micmethath panin leilu-lam manawhin Taanath Shiloh dong nisuahna-lam manawhin kualto a, nisuahna-lam Janoah dongah a kantan hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Janoah panin Ataroth le Naarah dong tuaksuk-a, Jericho nawkin Jordan ah a suakkhia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah panin gamgi in nitumna lam manawh a Kanah Kuampi ah tungin tuipi ah a tawp hi. Hih in Ephraim behte in a bawngbawng’ a, a luah uh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua in Manasseh-te luah sung panin Ephraim-te adinga kikhenkhia khuapite le a khuaneute khempeuh zong a huam hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in Gezer a tengsa Canaan-te a hawlkhia kei uh hi; tuni dong Ephraim mite lakah Canaan-te teng uh a, ahi hangin zawhthawh thu in na kisemsak hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joseph tacil Manasseh ahi manin hih sehtanh a ngah hi-a, tua pen, Manasseh tacil Makir ading ahi hi. Tua ciangin amaute in puan khat phah uh a, a van lakte uh panin kual khat ciat a lot uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ama nget kham kualte - kizepna, awh theih le Midian kumpite silh a dupsante le a kala-oh ngawng-ua khainiangte simlohin kham shekel b tul khat le zasagih a khai hi."},"27":{"text":"Gideon in tua khamte awmtuam in bawla, ama khuapi Ophrah ah a koih hi. Keimah in nomau si le sa ka hi hi, thei un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 29:14"},"3":{"text":"A sanggamte in Shechem khuamite tungah a gensawn uh ciangin Abimelech zuih ding lamah puk uh a, \"Amah i sanggampa ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in Baal-Berith biakinnpi panin ngun shekel c sawm sagih pia uh a, Abimelech in ama nungzui mi ngoltolte cialna-in a zang hi."},"5":{"text":"Ophrah-a, a pa inn ah amah pai-a, Jerub-Baal tapa a sanggam pasal sawm sagihte suangtumpi khat tungah a that hi. Amaute in olive kung kiangah, ‘Ka kumpi uh hong hi in,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 11:29; Jn 4:20"},"9":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin olive kung in, ‘Mite le pasiante a kipahtawi khawmna ka thaute nusia in singkungte uk ding ka hi hiam?’ ci-in dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"\"Tua zomah singkung in theikung kiangah, ‘Hong pai-in ko kumpi hong hi in,’ ci hi."},"11":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin theikung in, ‘A hoih a khum ka gah nusia-in, singkungte uk ding ka hi hiam?’ ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin singkungte in lenggui kiangah, ‘Hong pai-in ka kumpi uh hong hi in,’ ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin lenggui in, ‘Mite le pasiante a lung nuamsak khawm ka zu nusia in singkungte uk ding ka hi hiam?’ ci hi.","ref":"Thn 2:3"},"14":{"text":"\"A nunung penin singkung khempeuh in thangling kung kiangah, ‘Hong pai inla ka kumpi uh hong hi in,’ ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"\"Thangling kungin singkungte kiangah, ‘Na kumpi dingun sathau nong nilh nop takpi uh leh ka liim ah hong bu un; Tp 27:25"},"26":{"text":"Tu-in Ebed’ tapa Gaal a sanggamte tawh Shechem ah kikhin uh a, khua sung mite in amah a muang uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute lo ah kuanin lenggah lo uh a, cilin amaute pasian biakinn ah pawi a bawl uh hi. A nek a dawn kawmun Abimelech a hamsiat uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ebed’ tapa Gaal in, \"Ama nasem i suah nadingin Abimelech kua hi-a, Shechem kua ahi hiam? Amah Jerub-Baal tapa hi-in a huhpa Zebul hi lel lo hiam? Shechem’ pa Hamor’ na sem un! Bang hangin Abimelech’ nasem suak ding i hi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Hih mite kei khut sung hong tung leh maw! Abimelech kiangah, ‘Na galkap buppi samkhia in,’ ka ci ding hi,\" a a ci hi.","ref":"2Sa 15:4"},"30":{"text":"Ebed’ tapa Gaal in tua banga a gen khuapi ukpipa Zebul in a zak ciangin a heh mahmah hi."},"31":{"text":"Amah in Abimelech kiangah kamtai sawlsim a, \"Ebed’ tapa Gaal le a sanggamte Shechem ah hong pai uh a, nang langah khuapi a sosak uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tu-in nang le na mite hong kuan unla lopaangte ah na buksim un."},"33":{"text":"Zingsang nisuah ciangin khuapi sim unla, Gaal le a mite no do dinga hong paikhiat ciangin na hih nop bangbangun hih un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 10:7"},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin Abimelech le a galkapte zanin kuankhia uh a, pawl li kisuahin Shechem kiangah panmun a la uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tu-in Abed’ tapa Gaal paikhia-in khuapi kongpi lutna ah a din laitak tektek in Abimelech le a galkapte a buksimna panun a paikhia uh hi.","ref":"Ph 32:7; Jer 49:10"},"36":{"text":"Gaal in amaute a muh ciangin Zebul kiangah, \"En sin, mualdawn pan mite hong paisuk!\" a ci hi. Amaute in kulh muanhuai sing siatnelh uh a, a sunga om mite a halkhum uh hi. Amau leh amau kikalhnelhin tausang khum dawnah a kah to uh hi."},"52":{"text":"Tausang ah Abimelech paito in a va busim gawp hi. Ahi hangin a hal dingin tausang a manawh laitakin,"},"53":{"text":"numei khat in angawina suang a tungnung pen khiatsuk-a, a lu kha-in a luguh a kitam hi."},"54":{"text":"Amah in a galhiam puapa sam mengmeng a, \"Amaute in, ‘Amah numei thahsa hi,\" a cih theih lo nadingin na namsau dok inla kei hong that in,\" a ci hi. Jerub-Baal’ tapa Jotham hamsiatna amau tungah a tu hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abimelech khit ciangin Israel honkhia dingin Issachar mipa, Dodo tapa Puah, Puah tapa Tola a khang hi. Tua ciangin amah nungak bit ahi hi. Hih thu panin Israel-te ngeina pianga"},"40":{"text":"kum simin Gilead-te Jephthah’ tanu phawkna-in Israel numeinote nili a paikhia uh hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim mite in a galhatna uh khawmin Zaphon galkah uh a, Jephthah kiangah, \"Bang hangin Ammon-te do-a na kuanin na dopih dingin ko hong zawn lo na hi hiam? Bang dinga kei hong sim dingin tuni-a hong kuan na hi uh hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 19:5"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jephthah in Gilead mite kaikhawmin Ephraim a do hi. Tua huna a thah uh Ephraim-te tul sawmli le nih a pha hi.","ref":"Thk 3:28"},"7":{"text":"Jephthah in Israel kum guk sung a makaih a hi. Amah in Israel kum giat sung a makaih hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hillel’ tapa Abdon si-a, Amalek-te mualtung gam sung Ephraim a Pirathon ah kivui hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA mit ah Israel-te a sia-in gamta leuleu uh a, tua ciangin TOPA in kum sawmli sung Philistia-te khut sungah a pia hi.","title":"Samson Suahna","ref":"Thk 2:11; 14:4"},"2":{"text":"Dan-te bawng’ panin Zorah ah Manoah min nei mi khat oma a zi tasel hi-in ta a nei kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuanu kiangah TOPA ’ vansawltak kilangin, \"Nang a tasel na hi-a, ta na nei kei hi; ahi hangin nau paii in tapa khat na nei ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-a kipan zu ahi-a a kibilh khatpeuh ahi zongin na dawn kei dinga, asiang lo khatpeuh na ne kei ding hi;"},"5":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh nau paii-in tapa na nei ding hi. Mipa kiang a tun uh ciangin, \"Ka zi a hopih nang na hi hiam?\" a ci hi. \"Hi mah ing\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah in, \"Na kammalte a tangtun ciangin, naupang nuntakna le a sepzia ding bangci dan hi ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"13":{"text":"TOPA vansawltak in, \"Ka gensa khempeuh na zi in a hih pelmawh ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Lenggui pana piang peuhmah ne lo dinga, zu ahi-a a kibilh dang khat ahi zongin dawn loin asianglo peuhmah a ne kei ding hi. Amah ka thupiaksa peuhmah a hih pelmawh ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Manoah in TOPA vansawltak kiangah, \"Nang adingin keelno khat kong bawl khit matengun na khawl in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Thk 6:19"},"16":{"text":"TOPA vansawltak in, \"Kei nong kho ta zongin na an kong neksak kei ding hi. (Manoah in TOPA vansawltak ahilam a thei kei hi.)"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah in TOPA vansawltak kiangah, \"Na thugen a maana hong tangtun ciangin kong pahtawi theih nadingin na min bang ahi hiam?\" ci-in a teldot hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in, \"Bang hangin ka min hong dong na hi hiam? Tua in theihbanloh b ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng kik hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Manoah in keelno khat le an-a biakna la khawmin suangpi tung khatah TOPA a pia hi. Amah khangto in TOPA in thupha pia a,"},"25":{"text":"Zorah le Eshtaol kikala Mahaneh Dan-a a om sungin TOPA Kha in amah thathawhsak ding a kipan hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Timnah ah Samson paisuk-a tua lai-ah Philistia nungak khat a mu hi.","title":"Samson Zineihna"},"2":{"text":"A ciah ciangin a nu le a pa kiangah, \"Timnah ah Philistia numei khat ka mu hi; ka zi dingin hong laksak un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 21:21"},"3":{"text":"A nu le a pa in, \"Ei tanau sung le i mipih khempeuh lakah lak theih ding numei om lo ahi hiam? Tuanu kei tawh kituak mahmah hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 24:4; Pk 34:16"},"4":{"text":"(A nu-le-pate hih pen TOPA kiang pan ahilam a thei kei uh hi; amah in Philistia-te a mawhsak nading a zon laitak hi-a; tua hunin Philistia-te in Israel a uk laitak ahi hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Samson a nu le a pa tawh Timnah ah a paisuk khawm uh hi. Ahi hangin humpinelkai luanghawm sunga a lak ahilam a gen kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in numei en dingin a pa a paisuk hi. Tuateh Samson in zineipa hih ngeina bangin tua lai-ah pawi a bawl hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah a kilaak ciangin a pawl ding mi sawmthum kipia hi."},"12":{"text":"Samson in amaute kiangah, \"Thubukteh khat hong gen ningin hih pawi ni sagih sungin a dawnna na gen theih uh leh saihadial puan silh sawmthum le puansilh kop sawmthum kong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"No a khiatna na theih kei uh leh saihadial puan silh sawmthum le puansilh kop sawmthum nong pia ding uh hi,\" a ci hi. Ka na uh hong sut nuama hong sam na hi hiam?\" a ci uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Samson zi kidiksa-in a ang kidenna a, \"Kei hong mudah teh! Hong it taktak kei teh. Tua ciangin amah kihei phei-in a va tu hi.","title":"Boaz in Ruth Tenpih","ref":"Pc 18:1"},"2":{"text":"Boaz in khuapi upa sawm sama, \"Hih lai-ah tu dih un,\" ci-a a tu uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin tanaubul-tankhiapa kiangah, \"Moab pana hong ciah kik Naomi in i sanggampa Elimelech neihsa leitang neuno khat a zuak hi."},"4":{"text":"Kei ngaihsutna ah hih thu nang tunga tut ding hi-in ka um hi. Amah in, \"Tu ciang dong TOPA in hong huh khin hi,\" a cihna-in a min Ebenezer b a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Philistia-te guallel uh a, Israel gam a va sim ngam nawn kei uh hi. kei hong taisanin pasian dangte na a sep bangun nang tungah a hih uh ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in amaute thu ngai in; ahi hangin limtakin vauhilh inla, amaute a uk kumpipa in amaute tunga a sepzia ding theisak in,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"10":{"text":"Samuel in, kumpi a ngen mite tungah TOPA gente khempeuh a gen hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in, \"No hong uk kumpipa in hih bangin sem ding hi: Amah in na tapate uh sakol le sakolleng nasem in koih dinga sakolleng mai-ah a taisak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Pawlkhat a tulte uksakin pawlkhat a sawmngate uksak dinga, adangte a lo khosakin an lasak dinga a omlaite galhiam bawlsakin a sakollengte a vawhsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in na tanute uh gimnamtui bawl, an huan le moh emin a zang ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in na lo uh, na lenggui huan uh le na olive huan hoihpente uh la-in amah a cingte a pia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in na an uh le na lenggah kaihkhopsate uh sawm ah khat la-in ama uliante le amah a cingte a pia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na nasemnute na nasempate uh le na bawnghonte d uh le na laate uh a hoihpente ama zat dingin a la ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in na tuuhonte uh sawm ah khat la dinga note mahmah a sila na suak ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni hong tun ciangin na teelsa uh kumpipa panin hong honkhia in ci-in na kiko ding uh a, tua ni ciangin TOPA in hong dawng lo ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 14:52; Tua ciangin Samuel in Israel mite kiangah, \"Na khua ciat uah na ciah kik phot un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Thk 11:11"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hunin Benjamin pan Aphiah’ tapa Becorath, a tapa Zeror, a tapa Abiel, a tapa Kish min nei mite muan Benjamin-te khat a om hi.","title":"Samuel in Saul Sathau Nilh"},"2":{"text":"Amah in Saul min nei tapa khat nei a, Israel-te lakah amah tawh a kikim om loin - a dangte sangin a liangko tungsiahin a sangzaw hi.","ref":"1Sa 10:23; 14:51; 1Kh 9:39"},"3":{"text":"Tu-in Saul’ pa Kish laate mang a, Kish in a tapa Saul kiangah, \"Nasemte khat tonpih inla i laate va zong un,\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ephraim mualtung gam teng le Shalisha kual kim teng a phaksuak uh hangin a mu kei uh hi. Bang nei i hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 14:3; 2Ku 8:8"},"8":{"text":"Nasempa in, \"En dih in, ke’n ngun shekel a sehli suah sehkhat ka nei hi. TOPA in ka pa a ompih bangin nang zong hong ompih ta hen."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin kei hong kithah loh nadingin ka nuntak sung teng bek kei tungah TOPA hong migit bang hi loin"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in David galte leitang pan a khenkhiat ciang nangawnin ka innkuanpihte le na itna khenkhia kei in,\" a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David innkuan tawh thukhun khat bawla, \"David galte tungah TOPA in thuk ta hen,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuateh Jonathan in David a pumpi a it zahin it ahi manin amah a itna thuciam a kipsak thuah lai hi.","ref":"1Sa 25:22"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, \"Zing ciang Kha Thak pawi ahi hi.
