Ama tungah, ‘En in, thaltangte nang omna mun hih lampang ah tu hi, ka cih leh hong pai in; TOPA nuntakna-ah ka kiciam hi, a suakta na hi dinga lau nading om lo ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin naupang tungah, ‘En ou, thaltang na khenah tu ei,’ ka cih leh TOPA in nang hong sawlkhia hi ding ahi manin na paikhiat kul ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuateh ciamteh in eite gel thu kikupna-ah - nang le kei kikalah i teci TOPA ahi tawntung hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 31:50; 1Sa 19:2"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin lopaang ah David bu a, Kha Thak pawi hun a tun ciangin kumpipa an ne dingin a tu hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama tutna ngei kawm lamah a tu hi. Ama a mai sanah Jonathan tu-a, Saul zomah Abner tu-in, David tutna a awng hi."},"26":{"text":"Saul in, \"David in thukham tawh kituak lo a nin khatpeuh sema, ama tungah bang khatpeuh piang hi ding hi - amah a nin suak taktak hi,’ ci-in ngaihsun ahi manin tua ni-in Saul in bangmah a gen kei hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin a zingciang tua kha a ni nih ni-in David mun a awng leuleu hi. Tua ciangin Saul in a tapa Jonathan kiangah, \"Bang hangin zan le tuni-in an nekna ah Jesse tapa hong pai lo ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 7:20-21;15:5"},"28":{"text":"Jonathan in, \"David in Bethlehem a pai dingin kei tungah phalna limtakin hong ngen hi."},"29":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Ka innkuanpihte in khua sungah biakpiakna bawl ding uh a, ka sanggampa in tua lai-a om dingin hong vaikhak cinten ahi manin hong paisak in. Na lung a kim leh ka sanggamte tawh kimu dingin hong ciahsak in,’ hong ci hi. Tua hangin kumpipa sabuai-a hong pai lo ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"30":{"text":"Jonathan tungah Saul thakhatin hehpah a, \"Nang a lehtat le a lehdo numei’ tapa! Nang mahmah le ta-a hong nei na nu maizum nadingin Jesse’ tapa a pawl na hilam thei lo na hi hiam?"},"31":{"text":"Jesse’ tapa leitungah a hin laisiah nang na hi a na kumpi-gam ahi zongin a kip kei ding hi. Tu-in kei kiangah hong paisak in, a sih pelmawh kul ding hi!\" a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Jonathan in a pa kiangah, \"Bang hangin amah kithat ding ahi hiam? Amah’n bang hih ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi hangin Saul in amah that dingin teipi-in a khawh hi. Tua ciangin Jonathan in a pa in David that nuam ahilam a theitel hi."},"34":{"text":"Sabuai panin Jonathan hehsa-in a dingkhia hi; a pa in David a bawlna zumhuai sa-in dah-a, tua kha a ni nih ni-in tua lai ah an a ne kei hi."},"35":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin David tawh kimu dingin lopaang ah Jonathan a paikhia hi. Amah in naupangno khat tonpih a,"},"36":{"text":"naupang kiangah, \"Va tai inla ka thaltang kapte va zong in,\" a ci hi. Naupang a tai laitakin amah khengin thaltang khat a kap hi."},"37":{"text":"Jonathan thaltang tukna munah naupang a tun ciangin Jonathan in a nung panin sama, \"Nang khenah thaltang a tu na?\" a ci hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin, \"Manlang ou! Pai mengmeng ou! Khawl kei ou!\" ci-in a awng hi. Naupang in thaltang tawma a pu kiangah a kileh kik pah hi."},"39":{"text":"(Jonathan le David bekin a theih uh hih thute naupang in bangmah a thei kei hi.)"},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jonathan in a galvante naupangpa pia a, \"Pai inla khua sungah na pua kik in,\" a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Naupang a paikhiat khit ciangin suangtum leitaw lampang pan David paikhia a, Jonathan mai-ah leilam nga-in thumvei a kunsuk hi. Tua ciangin kinamin kikah tuak uh a - ahi hangin David a nak kah zaw tham hi."},"42":{"text":"Jonathan in David kiangah, \"Khat le khat i kilawmtakna TOPA minin i kiciam khina, ‘Nang le kei kikal le nang suante le kei suante kikal ah i teci TOPA ahi hi,’ tua ahi manin lungnuamtakin pai in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in paisan-a, Jonathan khua sungah a ciah kik hi.","ref":"1Sa 1:17;2Sa 1:26;Pn 18:24"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siampi Ahimelech omna Nob ah David a pai hi. Ahimelech in a muh ciangin linga, \"Nang kia bek maw? Kuamah tawh hong ton lo maw?\" ci-in a dong hi.","title":"Nob ah David"},"2":{"text":"David in siampi Ahimelech kiangah, \"Kumpipa in na khat hih dingin hong sawla, \"Na nasep ding le na lamlahna kuamah theisak kei in,\" hong ci hi. Ka mite tawh mun khata kituah dingin ka gen hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi in tu-in nang bang na nei hiam? Anlum nga hiam na muh khat peuhpeuh hong pia in,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mt 12:4; Sp 24:8-9"},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin siampipa in David tungah, \"Kong piak ding anlum mawkmawk ka nei kei hi; ahi zongin mite numei panin a kidaam zawh leh - hih lai-ah a ki-apsa anlum pawlkhat a om hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"David in, \"Ka paikhiat mawkmawk uh ciangin zong kote numei tawh ka kisawhkha kiuhkeuh kei uh hi. Kong kuankhiat b un a siangtho lo pasalte’ nate c nangawn a siangtho ahi hi. Tuni-in kisiangtho ngel lo dia!\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampipa in a kilakkhiat ni-a anlum a lumlai tawh a kilaih TOPA mai pana kilakhia Ompihna anlum longal adang om lo ahi manin a ki-apsa anlum amah a pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ni-in tua lai-ah Saul nasemte, TOPA mai-a kiziakaisak khat a om hi; amah Saul tuucing makaipa Edom-te Doeg ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 22:9,22"},"8":{"text":"David in Ahimelech kiangah, \"Hih lai-ah teipi ahikeh namsau na nei na? Kumpipa nasepna kinawh lua ven, ka namsau le ka galhiam dangte hong keng kei veng aw?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"9":{"text":"Siampipa in, \"Elah Kuam sunga na thah Philistia-pa Goliath’ namsau hih lai-ah om mah; puanin kitun a siampi puan nungah om hi. Na deih leh tua la in, tua longal hih lai-ah namsau dang om lo hi,\" ci-in a dawng kik hi. David in, \"Tua sanga hoihzaw om kenteh; hong pia mai sin,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:51"},"10":{"text":"Tua ni-in Saul kiang panin David tai-a Gath kumpipa Achish kiangah a tung hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin Achish nasempa in a kiangah, \"Hih gam kumpipa David hi lo ahi hiam, amaute in lamsa-in la sa uh a: \"‘Saul in a tultulin that, David in a tul sawmsawmin that’ ci-in la-a a sakpa uh hi lo hiam?\" a ci hi.","title":"Gath ah David","ref":"1Sa 18:7; 29:5"},"12":{"text":"David in hih kammalte a lungsimin phawk gige-a, Gath kumpipa Achish a kihta mahmah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute muhna-ah mihai kineih a, amau khut sunga a om sungteng mihai bangin na sem-a, kongpi kongkhakte kuipawl gawpin a khamul tungah a ciltui a kaisak hi."},"14":{"text":"Achish in a nasemte kiangah, \"Huapa en sin! Mihai hi lo hiam? Bang dinga hih lai-ah hong tun laizang?"},"15":{"text":"Ka mai-ah hih banga gamta dingin hihpa nong puak uh, mihai kisam ka hi hiam? Hih mipa ka innah hong lut loh phamawh ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in Gath nusia a, Adullam suanghawm ah a suakta hi. A sanggamte le a pa innkuanpihte in ama thu a zak uh ciangin a kiangah a paisuk uh hi.","title":"Adullam le Mizpah ah David"},"2":{"text":"A lungdongte ahi a, leiba bate ahi zongin lungkimlohna a nei khempeuh a ma kiangah kikhawm uh a, amah makai a suak hi. Amah tawh mi zali bang a om uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 25:13; 2Sa 23:13"},"3":{"text":"Tua lai panin Moab a Mizpah ah David pai-a Moab kumpipa kiangah, \"Pasian in kei ading hong sepsak ding ka theih matengin ka nu le ka pa hong pai-in no tawh nong tengkhawmsak zo ding hiam?\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute Moab kumpipa kiangah nusia-a, suang-hawm sungah David a om laisiah amaute tawh a omkhawm uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin kamsangpa Gad in David kiangah, \"Suanghawm sung ah teng kei in; Judah gam ah pai in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin David paikhia a, Hereth tulakah a pai hi.","ref":"1Sa 24:11; 1Kh 21:9;2Kh 29:25"},"6":{"text":"Saul in David le a mite a omna a kitheih lam a za hi. Tuateh a khuta teipi tawisa-in Gibeah mualtung a makeng kung nuai-ah Saul tu-a a kimkotah a uliante khempeuh a ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Saul in amaute kiangah, \"Benjamin mite aw, ngai un! Jesse tapa in na lote uh le na lenggui lote uh hong pia ding ahi hiam?","title":"Saul in Nob Siampite That"},"8":{"text":"Bang hangin note khempeuh in hong sawmsim na hi uh hiam? Ka tapa in Jesse’ tapa tawh thukhun a bawl lai-in kuamah in nong gen kei uh hi. Note khat beek in kei nong thudon kei uh a, ka tapa in tuni donga a hih bangin ka nasempa kei buksim dingin a sawl lai-in kuamah in nong gen kei uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 8:14;18:3;Thk 4:5"},"9":{"text":"Ahi hangin Saul uliante tawh a ding khawm Edom-te Doeg in, \"Nob-a Ahitub’ tapa Ahimelech kiangah Jesse’ tapa a pai lam ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahimelech in ama adingin TOPA thu dotsak a, lam-an le Philistia-pa Goliath’ namsau a pia hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:51; 21:7"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ahitub’ tapa siampi Ahimelech le Nob a siampi sem a pa’ innkuanpih buppi samsak a, amaute kumpipa kiangah a pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Saul in, \"Ahitub’ tapa aw, na ngai in,\" a ci hi. Amah in, \"Ka ngai hi, ka topa aw,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"13":{"text":"Saul in, \"Bang hangin nang le Jesse’ tapa in kei hong langpang simin tuni-in amah bangin kei hong lehdoin hong pansim nading anlum le namsau pia in, ama ading Pasian tungah thu dotsak na hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahimelech in kumpipa kiangah, \"Na nasemte khempeuh lakah kumpipa makpa, nang hong cingte ukpa David sanga kizahtakzaw no innkuan sungah amah banga muanhuai kua om ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Ama adingin Pasian thu ka dotsak tua ni a masa pen ahi hiam? Hi kei! Na nasempa in hih thupiang buppi thei kha lo ahi manin kumpipa in na nasempa ahi-a, a pa innkuante ahi zongin mawhsak kei in,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin kumpipa in, \"Ahimelech aw, nang le na pa innkuan bup na si taktak ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a kianga om amah cingte thu pia a; \"Amaute in zong David pawlpih uh ahi manin kihei unla TOPA siampite that un. Amah a taisim hi napi amaute in kei hong ko kei uh hi,\" a ci hi. Ahi hangin kumpipa uliante in TOPA siampite sat dingin a khut uh a liik nuam kei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Doeg kiangah, \"Nang kihei inla siampite satlum in,\" ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ahi ciangin Edom-pa Doeg kihei a amaute a satlum hi. Tua ni-in siampi puanpak silh sawmgiat le nga a that hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in tua siampite khua Nod a om numei, pasal, naupang, naungeek le a bawng, a laa, a tuu-te dongun namsau in a that hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:18,31;15:3"},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin Ahitub’ tapa, Ahimelech tapa Abiathar suakta a, David pawl dingin a tai hi.","ref":"Ms 13:31"},"21":{"text":"Amah in TOPA siampite Saul in a thah lam David a ko hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in Abiathar kiangah, \"Tua ni-a Edom-te Doeg a om ciangin Saul tungah ko mah inteh, ka cih hi. Na pa innkuan bup sihna kei hang ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei kiangah om in; lau kei in; nang thah dinga hong zongte kei hong zongte mah ahi hi. Kei tawh na bitkhawm ding hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David tungah, \"En in, Philistia-te in Keilah sim uh a, a ancilna munte uh a luhsak uh hi,\" ci-in a kigen ciangin","title":"David in Keilah Hon"},"2":{"text":"amah in TOPA kiangah, \"Kuanin Philistia-te ka sim ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. TOPA in, \"Kuan in, Philistia-te sim inla Keilah honkhia in,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin David mite in, \"Hih Judah gamah eite i lau hi. Philistia-te do dingin Keilah ah kuan lehang i lauzaw lai ding hi!\" a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"David in khatvei TOPA dong kik a, TOPA in, \"Keilah ah kuansuk in, Philistia-te na khutah kong pia ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le ama mite Keilah ah pai-in Philistia-te sim uh a, a ganhonte uh a hawlsak uh hi. Amah in Philistia-te supna lianpi thuaksak-a, Keilah mite a honkhia hi."},"6":{"text":"(Tu-in Ahimelech’ tapa Abiathar in Keilah a David kiangah a tai lai-in siampi puan a taipih hi.)","ref":"Jos 8:7"},"7":{"text":"Keilah ah David a pailam Saul tungah kigena amah in, \"Pasian in kei tungah amah hong piakhin ahi manin kongpi kalhna zawl nei khuapi ah David amah le amah thong sunga kikhum ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tuateh Saul in, Keilah ah paisukin David le a mite umciha a sim dingin a galhatna khempeuh a kikhawmsak hi.","title":"Saul in David Nungdelh"},"9":{"text":"Saul in amah a sawm lam David in a theih ciangin siampi Abiathar kiangah, \"Siampi puan hong paipih in,\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"David in, \" TOPA Israel’ Pasian aw, Keilah ah Saul hong pai sawma kei hangin khuapi suksiat a sawm lam teltakin ka za hi."},"11":{"text":"Keilah khua mite in ama tungah kei hong ap ding uh hiam? Na nasempa in ka zaksa bangin Saul hong kuansuk ding hiam? TOPA Israel’ Pasian aw, na nasempa tungah hong gen in,\" a ci hi. Tuateh TOPA in, \"Hong kuan ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"David in, \"Keilah khua mite in kei le ka mite Saul tungah hong ap ding uh hiam?\" a ci kik hi. Tuateh TOPA in, \"Hong ap ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 22:2;25:13"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin David le zaguk bang a pha a mite Keilah panin paikhia uh a, mun khat khit mun khat ah a kikhinkhin uh hi. Saul kiangah, Keilah panin David suakta khin hi, ci-a a kigen ciangin tua lai-ah a pai nawn kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Sehnel-gam mun muanhuaite le Ziph Sehnel-gam mualkuam lakah David a om hi. Saul in nisimin amah a zon hangin Pasian in ama khutah David a pia kei hi.","ref":"Pn 32:7"},"15":{"text":"Ziph Sehnel-gama om Horesh ah David a om laitakin amah that dingin Saul a kuan lam David in a thei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuateh Horesh a David kiangah Saul tapa Jonathan pai-a, Pasian sunga tha a lak dingin a hanthawn hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in, \"Kihta kei in, ka pa Saul in nang tungah a khut khat zong hong nga kei ding hi. Israel tungah kumpi na hi dinga, kei nang zom ka hi hi. Hih thu ka pa Saul nangawn in a theihsa ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"A nih un TOPA mai-ah thukhun a bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin Jonathan inn ah ciah a, David Horesh ah a om lai hi."},"19":{"text":"Gibeah a Saul kiangah Ziph-te paito uh a, \"Jeshimon leitaw-lam Hakilah mualtung Horesh a mun muanhuai sung kote lakah David bu hi lo ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Tu-in, kumpipa aw, na ut hunhunin hong paisuk lecin kumpipa khuta piak ding ko mau thuthu ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 26:1"},"21":{"text":"Saul in, \"Kei nong panpih manun, TOPA in thupha hong pia hen."},"22":{"text":"Pai unla, na kithawi beh lai un. David koi lai-ah pai mun pena tua lai-ah kua’n mu hiam. Amaute in kei tungah amah pilvang mahmah hi, hong ci uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in bukna-a a zat munte khempeuh va theikhia unla thu kician a taktak tawh kei kiangah hong pai kik un. Tua ciangin no kong zui dinga; tua kualah amah a om leh Judah bawng’te khempeuh lakah amah ka mukhia teitei ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng kik hi.","ref":"1Sa 22:8"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute Ziph zuanin Saul mai-ah a pai uh hi. Tua laitakin David le a mite Jeshimon leitaw-lam Arabah sunga om Maon Sehnel-gam ah a om uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Saul le a mite in a zon lam uh, David kiangah a kigen ciangin suangpi ah paisukin Maon Sehnel-gam ah a om hi. Hih muna a om lam Saul in a zak ciangin David delhin Maon Sehnel-gam ah a pai hi.","ref":"Jos 15:55; 1Sa 25:2"},"26":{"text":"Saul in mualpang khat zui a, David le a mite in a pang lang khat zui-in Saul a pelhkhia mengmeng uh hi. Saul le a galkapte in David le a mite a mat dekdek laitakun,"},"27":{"text":"Saul kiangah kamtai khat tunga, \"Manlangin hong pai in! Philistia-te in i gam hong lokgawp uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in David delh nawn loin Philistia-te do dingin a kuan hi. Tua hangin hih mun Sela Hammahlekoth b ci uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua lai panin David paito a En Gedi mun muanhuai sungah a teng hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Philistia-te a delhna pan Saul a ciah kik ciangin ama kiangah, \"En Gedi Sehnel-gam ah David om hi,\" ci-in kigen hi.","title":"David in Saul Nuntakna Hawisak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Saul in Israel khempeuh pana kitengkhia mi tulthum tonpiha, Sathak Kenpi kianga om David le a mite zong dingin a kuan uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 23:28-29;26:2"},"3":{"text":"Amah lampi dunga tuu-khawkte a tung hi. Tua lai-ah kawhawm khat om a, tua sungah Saul a tawlnga hi. David le a mite tua suanghawm tawng pekah a om uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mite in, \" TOPA in nang hong hopih lai in, ‘Na galpa na ut bangbanga na bawl theih dingin na khut sungah kong pia ding hi,’ c a cih tuni tektek ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin David awmtal a, a phawk loh kalin Saul puantualpi mong a atkhiatsak hi.","ref":"1Sa 25:28-30"},"5":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin ama puanmong a tankhiatsak David a kisuangtaak mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"A mite kiangah, \"Ka pu TOPA sathau nilhsa ahi manin tua banga TOPA sathau nilhsa tungah ka hih ding ama langah ka khut ka liik ding ahi zongin TOPA in kham hi,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"David in hih kammalte-in a mite tai-a, amaute in Saul a do ding uh a phal kei hi. Tuateh suanghawm panin Saul a paikhia hi.","ref":"1Sa 26:11; 2Sa 24:10"},"8":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin suanghawm sung panin David pusuakkhia a, \"Ka topa kumpipa!\" ci-in Saul a sam hi. Saul in a nunghei ciangin David kunsuk a, leitungah a khupbawhsuk hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in Saul kiangah, \"Bang hangin mite in, ‘Nang siat nading David in zong hi,’ a cih ciangin a thu uh ngai na hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni-in suanghawm sungah TOPA in nang ka khut sungah hong piak lam na mitin na mu khin hi. Pawlkhat in nang that dingin hong kun uh hi. Ahi hangin nang kong hawi lai a, ‘Ka pu TOPA sathau nilhsa ahi manin ama tungah ka khut ka liik kei ding hi,’ ka ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka pa aw, hih ka khut sunga na puantualpi mong en in! Na puan mongkiu ka atkhiat hi napi kong that kei hi. Tu-in hong theitel inla nang tungah khial loin kong lehdo loh lam theician in. Nang tungah kong khialh loh hangin kei hong that nuamin nong beng niloh hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang le kei kikalah TOPA in thu khen ta hen. Kei tunga na khialhnasa khempeuh phu TOPA in hong la hen, ken ka hileh na tungah ka khut ka nga kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Khangluite in, ‘A gilote mah gilo,’ a cih bang ahi hi; tua ahi ciangin nang tungah ka khut ka nga kei ding hi.","ref":"Pc 16:5"},"14":{"text":"\"Israel kumpipa kua langah pangin hong kuankhia na hi hiam? Kua ahi hiam na delh? Ui sisa khat maw? Uili khat maw?"},"15":{"text":"Eite thukhenpa TOPA hi henla i kikal thu amah’n khen ta hen. Ka thu hong ngaihsutsak henla, hong lenkip hen; na khut pana hong hutna tawh ka thu khensiang ta hen,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:43; Ph 35:1,23"},"16":{"text":"David in hih teng a gen a man ciangin Saul in, \"Ka tapa David, nang aw mah ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Tuateh nakpi-in a kap hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in, \"Kei sangin na thumaan zaw hi. Hoihtakin nong bawl hangin ke’n a sia-in kong bawl hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei tungah a hoih nong bawlna tu-in nong gen khin hi; TOPA in na khut sungah kei hong pia napi kei nong that kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi khat in a galpa a muh ciangin nasak loin khahkhong ahi hiam? Kumpipa lukhunga a teipi le a tuithawl koi-ah om ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Saul in David aw ahilam thei a, \"Ka tapa David aw, nang aw ahi hiam?\" a ci hi. Isa 2:12,17;5:15"},"29":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang ka meivak na hi hi; TOPA in ka khuamial khuavak a suaksak hi."},"30":{"text":"Nang huhna hangin galdo-in d ka kuankhia thei hi; ka Pasian tawh kulh ka kan thei bek hi."},"31":{"text":"\"Pasian adingin ama lampi hoih-kim a; A nunung penin, Judah a Negev sunga Beersheba ah a paisuak uh hi.","ref":"Jos 13:9"},"8":{"text":"Gambuppi ah a pai kim khit uh - kha kua le ni sawmnih a bei ciangin Jerusalem ah a tung kik uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Joab in kumpipa tungah galkapte a phazah zasak a; Israel sungah mi cingtaak namsau tawi thei tul zagiat pha in Judah sungah tul zanga a pha hi."},"10":{"text":"David in galsim thei mite a sim khit ciangin kisuangtak mahmah a, amah in TOPA kiangah, \"Ka hihsa ah ka khial mahmah hi. A haihuai na khat ka sem khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"A zing ciang zingsang David a thawh ma-in David thumupa, Gad tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"12":{"text":"\"David kiangah pai inla, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Na teel ding thum kong pia hi. David in, \"Mite tunga pulpi a bei nadingin TOPA tungah biakna-tau khat ka dawh theih nadingin na ancilna mun hong lei ding ka hi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"22":{"text":"Araunah in David kiangah, \"Ka topa kumpipa in na lungkim bangin la inla pia in. Hih lai ah meihal biakna dingin bawngtalte oma, hih lai-ah a sing dingin ancilna vante le bawngtal hakkolte a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, Araunah in hihte khempeuh kumpipa kong pia hi, \" TOPA na Pasian in nang hong sang ta hen,\" zong a ci lai hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi hangin kumpipa in Araunah kiangah, \"Hi lo hi, a man kong pia tektek ding hi. Tua ciangin David in ancilna phual le bawngtalte lei-a, tuate man dingin ngun shekel a sawmnga a pia hi.","ref":"Mal 1:13-14"},"25":{"text":"David in tua lai ah TOPA ading biakna-tau khat dawh a, meihal biaknate le kilawmtakna b biaknate a pia hi. Tuanu a pangah lum leh ka kumpipa uh a khua lum ding hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Israel gam sung teng nungakno melhoih khat zong uh a Shunam-te Abishag mu in kumpipa kiangah a puak uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Nungakno melhoih mahmah a, amah in kumpipa kemin cinga kumpipa in a luppih zo nawn kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in a nu Haggith tapa Adonijah amah le amah kikausiphumin, \"Kumpi ka suak ding hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amai-a tai ding mi sawmnga, sakol-lengte le sakolte a tawh a kithawisak hi."},"6":{"text":"(A pa in, \"Bang hangin na ut banga ta na hi hiam?\" ci-in a tai ngei kei hi. Amah zong a mel hoih mahmah a Absalom zoma suak ahi hi.)","ref":"2Sa 3:4; 15:1"},"7":{"text":"Adonijah in Zeruiah tapa Joab le siampipa Abiathar hih thu donga amaute in a thukimpih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin siampi Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, kamsangpa Nathan, Shimei le Rei b le David cing tuamte in Adonijah a pawlpih kei uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 20:25; 23:8; 1Ku 2:22, 28"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Adonijah in En Rogel kiang Zoheleth Suangpi ah tuu, bawng le bawngno vakthaute biakna-in a pia hi. Amah in a sanggamte khempeuh, kumpi tapate le kumpi ulian ahi Judah mi khempeuh sam napi"},"10":{"text":"ahi hangin kamsang Nathan ahi-a, Benaiah ahi-a, a cing tuamte ahi a, a sanggampa Solomon ahi zongin a sam kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiangah, \"I topa David theih loh kalin Haggith tapa Adonijah kumpi a suah lam za lo na hi uh hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin tu in nangma nuntakna le na tapa Solomon nuntakna na hotkhiat theih nadingin ngaihsutna khat kong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi David kiangah lut inla, ‘Ka to kumpipa aw, na nasemnu tungah: \"Kei khita kumpi sem ding na tapa Solomon hi a, ka kumpi tokhom ah a tu taktak ding hi,\" ci-in hong kiciam hi lo na hi hiam? Bang hangin tu-in Adonijah kumpi suak ta ahi hiam?’ ci-in gen in."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa tawh na kihoho laitakin kei hong tumin na gensate kong kipsak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tekta kumpipa va mu dingin inndei sungah Bathsheba lut-a, Shunam-te Abishag in a na kem hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa mai-ah Bathsheba kunsukin a khukdin hi. Kumpipa in, \"Bang deih na hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuanu in ama kiangah, \"Ka topa aw, TOPA na Pasian lo-in na nasemnu keima tungah: ‘Kei khita kumpi suak ding na tapa Solomon hi a, ka kumpi tokhom ah a tu ding hi,’ ci-in nangmah nong kiciam hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin tu-in Adonijah kumpi suak khin a, tua thu nangmah ka to kumpipa in na thei kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah in ganhon tampitak, bawngno vakthau le tuute go a, kumpipa tapa khempeuh, siampi Abiathar le galkap mangpa Joab sam napi na nasempa Solomon a sam kei hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka to kumpipa khitteh kumpi tokhom tungah kua tu ding cih a theih nadingun Israel khempeuhte’ mit nang tung hong tu hi, ka to kumpipa aw."},"21":{"text":"Tua hi kei leh ka to kumpipa a pate tawh tawlnga dinga a kisialkhawm phetin kei le ka tapa Solomon mawhna neite bangin hong kibawl pah ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"tg 13,30; Tp 31:16; 1Ku 2:10"},"22":{"text":"Tuanu kumpipa tawh a kihoho laitakin kamsangpa Nathan a tung hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuateh amaute in kumpipa kiangah, \"Kamsangpa Nathan hih lai-ah om hi,\" ci-in a gen uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa mai-ah amah pai-a leilam nga-in a kunsuk hi."},"24":{"text":"Nathan in, \"Ka to kumpipa aw, nang khitah Adonijah kumpi suakin na kumpi tokhoma tu dingin na pulak mah ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Tuni-in amah paisuk khinin biakna-in ganhon tampi, bawngno vakthau le tuute a pia hi. Kumpipa tapa khempeuh, galkap mangte le siampi Abiathar a sam khin hi. Tu mahmah in amaute in amah tawh nekhawm dawn khawm uh a, ‘Kumpi Adonijah khansawt hen!’ ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin na nasempa kei, le siampi Zadok, le Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, le na nasempa Solomon hong sam lo hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka to kumpipa in ama nasemte hong theisak loin ka to kumpipa khitah a tokhoma tu ding na hihsa ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David in, \"Bathsheba hong tumsak un,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah kumpipa omna-ah lutin a mai-ah a ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kiciam a: \"Ka lungkhamna khempeuh pana hong hukhiapa TOPA nuntakna lo-in ka cih inah","title":"David in Solomon Kumpi Suaksak"},"30":{"text":"TOPA Israel Pasian ah kiciama nang tungah: Kei khitin na tapa Solomon kumpi suak dinga ka kumpi tokhom keima munah a tu ding hi, ka cihsa tuni-in ka tungsak taktak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin Bathsheba niamtakin lei lamah kunsuk a, kumpipa mai-ah khukdin sa in, \"Ka topa Kumpipa David nungta tawntung hen!\" a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Kumpi David in, \"Siampi Zadok, kamsang Nathan le Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hong lutsak un,\" a ci hi. Amaute kumpipa mai a tun uh ciangin"},"33":{"text":"amah in amaute kiangah: \"Na topa nasemte tonpih unla ka laa tungah ka tapa Solomon tuangsakin Gihon ah paipih suk un."},"34":{"text":"Tua lai-ah siampi Zadok le kamsangpa Nathan in Israel kumpi dingin sathau a nilh ding uh hi. Pengkul mut unla, \"Kumpi Solomon khansawt hen!\" ci-in awng un."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tawh tonto unla amah ka kumpi tokhom ah tu-in kei munah a mang ding hi. Israel le Judah a ukpa dingin amah ka seh khin hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 10:1; 2Sa 15:10"},"36":{"text":"Jehoiadah tapa Benaiah in, \"Amen! Tua ciangin amaute in pengkul mutin mi khempeuh in, \"Kumpipa Solomon khansawt hen,\" ci-in a awng uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Tuateh mi khempeuh in a nung zui to uh a, tamngai mut kawmin nuam a sa mahmah uh hi; amaute awging in lei a lingsak hi."},"41":{"text":"Adonijah le a ompih a lenglate khempeuh a pawi bawl uh a man kuanun hih thu a za uh hi. Pengkul ging a zak ciangin Joab in, \"Khuapi sunga gamlumnate khempeuh bang ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"42":{"text":"Amah a paupau laitakin siampi Abiathar tapa Jonathan a tung hi. Tuateh kumpipa a lupna tungah kunin bia-a,"},"48":{"text":"‘Tuni-in kei za laih ding ka tokhom tunga tu ka mita hong musak TOPA Israel Pasian kiphat ta hen,’ \" a ci hi.","ref":"tg 37; 1Ku 3:6"},"49":{"text":"Tua tak ciangin Adonijah lenglate khempeuh lauthawngin dingto uh a, a kikhen-thang uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Ahi hangin Adonijah in Solomon kihta a, biakna-tau kite a pom hi."},"51":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon kiangah, \"Adonijah in Kumpipa Solomon kihta a biakna-tau kite a pom hi. Amah in: ‘Kumpipa Solomon in a nasempa namsau-a hong thah loh nadingin tuni-in hong kiciam hen,’ ci hi,\" ci-in kigen hi.","ref":"1Ku 2:28"},"52":{"text":"Solomon in, \"Amah mi gina ahina a lah theih nak leh a samzang khat zong lei lakah kia lo dinga; ahi zongin ama sungah siatna a kimuh leh a si ding hi,\" ci-in a thuk kik hi."},"53":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa Solomon in mi sawla biakna-tau pan a lasuk uh hi. Tuateh Adonijah pai-in Kumpipa Solomon mai-ah kun-a, Solomon in, \"Na inn ah ciah in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:21-25; 1Sa 14:45"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David in a sih kuan ciangin a tapa Solomon thu a vaikhak hi.","title":"David in Solomon Thu Vaikhak"},"2":{"text":"Amah in, \"Leitung mi khempeuh lampi zui-in a paikuan ta ka hi hi. Tua ahi ciangin kihatsak inla, kipasalsak in."},"3":{"text":"TOPA na Pasian in hong kalh thute zui in: A lampite tawn inla hong thukipte le thuneihnate, a thukhamte le hong kalh thute Moses Thu kham sunga kigelh bangin kem in; tua hileh nasepna peuh le na paina peuh ah na lawhcing ding hi."},"4":{"text":"tua hileh TOPA in: ‘Nangma suante in a nuntakzia uh a kidop uh a, a lungsim khempeuh uh leh a hinna khempeuh uh tawh ka mai-ah muanhuaitakin a kalsuan uh leh Israel-te kumpi tokhom ah mi khat a tut loh hun a om kei ding hi,’ ci-in kei tunga hong thuciam a zui ding hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:13,25"},"5":{"text":"\"Tu-in nang mahmah in Zeruiah tapa Joab in kei tungah hong bawlna - Israel galkap mang nihte Ner tapa Abner le Jether tapa Amasa-te tunga a gamtatna na thei hi. Amah in amaute that-a, gal kido hun bangin gal kilem hunin a sisan uh luangsaka kawnga a kawnggak le khe-a a khedap ah amaute sisan a bangsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Nangma pilna bangin amah thuk inla, lungnuam takin a lu-a sam kangsa in hankhuk a sung zuansak kei in.","ref":"2Sa 2:18; 20:10"},"7":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin Gilead a Barzillai tapate tungah migi inla na sabuai-a an nete lakah an nesak in. Na sanggampa Absalom kiang pana ka tai lai-in ka kiangah hong dinpih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Tuateh Mahanaim ah ka paini-a a khaa mahmah a kei hong hamsiatpa Bahurim pana Benjamin-te Gera tapa Shimei nang tawh a om lam zong phawk in. A lu-a a samkang sisan tawh hankhuk ah puak in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Sa 16:5-13"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin David a pate tawh khawlkhawm ta a, David Khuapi ah a kivui hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in Israel tungah kum sawmli sung uk a - Hebron ah kum sagih om leh Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le thum sung a om hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon a pa David tokhom tungah tu-a, ama ukna kiptakin a kiphut kip hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiangah Haggith tapa Adonijah a pai hi. Bathsheba in ama kiangah, \"Lemthu-a hong pai na hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, \"Lemthu-a hong pai hi mah ing,\" ci hi.","title":"Solomon Tokhom Kikipsak"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in, \"Na khat kong gen nuam hi,\" a cih beh lai hi. Tuanu in, \"Hong gen in,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in, \"Na theihsa bangin kumpi-gam kei aa ahi hi. Israel khempeuh in kei kumpi in hong mu uh hi. Hong nial kei in,\" a ci hi. Tuanu in, \"Nong ngen thei hi,\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin, \"Nong hehpihna-in Kumpipa Solomon tungah ka zi dingin Shunam-te Abishag na ngetsak lecin - amah’n nang hong nial lo ding hi,\" ci-in a zom lai hi.","ref":"1Ku 1:3"},"18":{"text":"Bathsheba in, \"Hoih mahmah hi, kumpipa tungah nang adingin kong gensak ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"19":{"text":"Bathsheba in Adonijah tangin Kumpipa Solomon hopih dingin a pai ciangin tuanu muakin kumpipa dingto a, ama lamah kunin a kumpi tokhom ah a tu hi. Amah in kumpipa nu adingin tokhom khat kipuaksak-a a taklam ah a tu hi.","ref":"Ph 45:9; 1Ku 15:13"},"20":{"text":"Amah in, \"Nang tungah na neuno khat kong ngen nuam hi, hong nial kei in,\" a ci hi. Ama kumpi-gam ding zong hong ngen khawm pah vet ve - tuateng banah amah ka u ahi hi - hi hi, ama ading le siampi Abiathar le Zeruiah tapa Joab ading tawh ngen vet lecin!\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"2Sa 12:8"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA lo-in Solomon kiciam a, \"Hih ngetna in Adonijah luang a sawng kei tak leh Pasian in a nasiazaw in kei hong tuaksak hen!\" a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua hi-a tu-in TOPA - ka pa David tokhom tungah kiptakin hong tusak a, ama hong ciamsa bangin kumpi-gam hong phuhsakpa nuntakna lo-in ka cih inah - tuni-in Adonijah kithat ding hi!\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu pia-a, amah in Adonijah sattukin a si hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:11;8:18"},"26":{"text":"Siampi Abiathar kiangah kumpipa in, \"Anathoth a na lote ah ciah kik in. Tua ciangin Solomon in Benaiah kiangah, \"Pai inla amah va sattuk in,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA puanbuk ah Benaiah tum a, Joab kiangah, \"Kumpipa in, ‘Pusuak hen,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi. Benaiah in kumpipa kiangah, \"Joab in hih bangin hong dawng hi,\" ci-in a zasak hi.","ref":"Pk 21:14"},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Benaiah thu pia a, \"Ama cih bangin hih in. Sattuk suk inla vui in, tua bangin Joab in kei le ka pa innkuan tungah mawhpengte sisan tunga a khialhnate siangsak in."},"32":{"text":"TOPA in ama luansak sisan ama tungah a thuk ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa David theih loh in mi nih sima namsau in a that hi. Kong mang ding hi,’ na ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Bang hangin TOPA tungah na kiciamna zui loin kong thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"Kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, \"Ka pa David tunga na khialhna khempeuh na lungsimin na thei hi. Ahi hangin kei naupangno khat ka hi a, ka mawh puakte koici sep ding cih ka thei kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Na teelsa mi sim zawh loh a tampite lak hih lai-ah na nasempa ka om hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na mite uk nading le akhial le amaan khentel theih nadingin khentheina lungsim kei hong guan in. Ahang in, hih nangma mi tampitakte kua in uk zo ding ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Solomon in hih a ngetna hangin Topa a lungkim hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Pasian in ama kiangah, \"Nang in hih nong ngen hi, khansawt nading ahi a, neih le lam ahi-a, na galte sih nading ahi zongin hong ngen loin thu khentheihna tawh thutanga uk theih nading hong ngen na hi manin"},"12":{"text":"nong nget mah kong pia ding hi. Nang tawh a kibang a om ngei nai lo leh a om ngei nawn lo dingin pilna le thutheihtelna lungsim nang kong pia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua banah na nuntak hun sung teng kumpite lakah na kibatpih a om loh nadingin nong nget khak loh - hauhna le pahtawina kong pia ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuateh ka lampite tawna, na pa David hih bangin ka ngeina kipte le ka thupiakte na man leh khansawtna zong kong pia ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon khanglo a - a mang ahilam a thei hi. Amah Jerusalem ah ciah kik a, Topa thukhun singkuangpi mai-ah dingin meihal biaknate le kilawmtakna biaknate b a pia hi. Amah tawh ka omkhawm sungun ta khat ka nei hi.","title":"Pilna tawh Thukhenna"},"18":{"text":"Ka ta suah zawh a nithum ni-in hih nu in zong ta khat mah a nei hi. Ko guak bek ka om uh a; inn sungah kuamah dang om loin kote gel bek ka hi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"\"Zanin tuanu in a tapa nenkha in a si hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin zankim laitakin amah tho-a, na nasemnu ka ihmut kalin ka panga ka tapa a la hi. Amah in a angah koih-a a tapa sisa kei angah a koih hi."},"21":{"text":"A zingsang ciangin ka tapa nawi pia dingin ka tho a - amah na si mawk hi! Ahi hangin zingsang khuavak ah limtaka ka et ciangin tua pen kei sunga suak tapa hi lo hi,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Numei khat pen in, \"Hi kei! A hing pen kei tapa hi-a, a si pen nang aa ahi hi,\" a ci hi. Ahi hangin a masa pen in, \"Hi kei! A si pen nang aa ahi hi; a hing pen kei aa hi,’ ci teitei hi. Tua bangin kumpipa mai-ah a kisel uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Hih pen in, ‘A hing pen kei tapa hi, nang tapa a si hi,’ ci a, hua pen in, ‘Hi kei! Tua ciangin amaute in namsau khat kumpipa a pia uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin mah in: \"Naupang a nungta pen tumnih suah unla, alang khat pia in, alang adang khat pen pia un,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"26":{"text":"Tapa a hing pen’ nu in a tapa khuatuah a, kumpipa kiangah, \"Ka topa aw, nong hehpihna-in naupang a hing pen amah pia in! Amah that kei in!\" a ci hi. Ahi hangin a khat pen in, \"Nang na hi-a, kei ka hi zongin a nei i om tuam kei ding hi. Tum nih suah in!\" a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a thukhenna pia a, \"Naupang a nungta pen a masa numei pia un. Amah that kei un; tuanu ama nu ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Israel khempeuh in kumpipa thukhenna a zak uh ciangin kumpipa lamdang a sa uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Pasian tung panin thutanga gam-uk nading pilna a neih lam amaute in a mu uh hi.","ref":"tg 9,11-12; Col 2:3"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Solomon in Israel khempeuh a uk hi.","title":"Solomon’ Uliante le Ukpite"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi-a hihte in ama ulianpite ahi hi: Zadok tapa Azariah-siampi;","ref":"1Kh 6:10"},"3":{"text":"Shisha tapate Elihoreph le Ahijah - thuvanpite; Ahihud tapa Jehoshaphat - thu ciamteh;","ref":"2Sa 8:16"},"4":{"text":"Jehoiada tapa Benaiah - galkap mangpipa, Zadok le Abiathar - siampite;"},"5":{"text":"Nathan tapa Azariah - gamkhen uliante ukpipa; Nathan tapa Zabud - siampipa le kumpipa thukuppihpa;"},"6":{"text":"Ahishar - kumpi inn ukpa; Abda tapa Adoniram - aana-a nasemte ukpa ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Solomon in Israel gamsung bupah kumpipa le kumpi innkuante kivakna lamsang a sik ding gamkhen uk sawm le nih zong a nei hi. Tua gamkhen ah amah bek ukpi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Judah le Israel mite tuipi gei-a sehnel zahin tam a; amaute in ne-in dawnin a lungdam uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hi a Solomon in Gunpi b panin Philistia-te gam, Egypt gamgi ciang dong kumpi gamte khempeuh a uk hi. Amaute in bangmah a kisam a omsak kei uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute in a kilawm mun ah lengkai sakol le sakol dangte ading amau tanh zah ciat mangbuh-ham le buhtu zong a puak uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian in Solomon tungah pilna le a lian mahmah thumuhna, le a zai mahmah theihtelna tuipi gei-a sehnel banga sim theih loh zah a pia hi."},"30":{"text":"Nisuahna lama mite khempeuh pilna sangin Solomon pilna lianzaw a, Egypt pilna khempeuh sangin a lianzaw hi.","title":"Solomon Pilna"},"31":{"text":"Amah midang khatpeuh sangin pilzaw a, Ezrah-te Ethan, Mahol tapate Heman, Calcol le Darda-te sangin a pilzaw hi. Amah in gamsate le vasate, a bokvak ganhingte le ngasate thu zong a hilh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ama pilna a za leitunga kumpite khempeuh in a sawl uh ahi minam khempeuh panin mite, Solomon pilna ngai dingin a kuan uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:12"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A pa David za luah dingin Solomon sathau kinilh khin hi cih Tyre kumpipa Hiram in a zak ciangin David tawh a kilawmta den uh ahi manin Solomon kiangah a palaite a sawl hi.","title":"Biakinn Ding Kiginkholhnate"},"2":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram tungah hih thu a puak kik hi:"},"3":{"text":"\" TOPA in ka pa David khenuai-ah a galte a koihsak mateng, ama kimkot khempeuha a galte tawh kidodo ahi manin ama Pasian, TOPA Minin biakinnpi a lam theih loh lam na thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in TOPA ka Pasian in ka kimkot ah tawldamna hong pia ta a, hong langpang le hong siasak a om kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka pa David kianga TOPA in, ‘Nang’ muna tokhom a ka tutsak na tapa in ka Min a dingin biakinnpi khat a lam ding hi,’ ci-a a gensa bangin TOPA ka Pasian Min ading biakinnpi khat lam ka sawm hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:13; 1Kh 17:12;22:9"},"6":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin Lebanon a tamtakte kei adingin a kiphuk nading thu pia in. Sidon mite zah a singphuk siam ko lakah khat beek a om loh lam na thei hi,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Hiram in Solomon thupuak a zak ciangin lungkim mahmah a, tuni-in TOPA kiphat ta hen, ahang in, hih minam lianpi a uk dingin amah in David tungah tapa pil khat a pia khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hiram in Solomon thu zasak a: \"Kei nong thupuak ka ngah a, tamtak le takluangte na deih zahzah kong sik ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ka mite in Lebanon pan tuipi dong hong talkaihsuk ding uh a, tuipi tungah phongin bawlin nang deihna munmun ah kong taisak suk ding uh hi. Tuateh ka kumpi innkuante nek ding an nong sik ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ezr 3:7; Eze 27:17"},"10":{"text":"Hih bangin Hiram in Solomon deih tamtakte khempeuh le taksing-luangte puaka,"},"11":{"text":"Solomon in Hiram tungah a kumpi innkuante an dingin mangbuh cor a tul sawmnih, tuate banah olive thau gawisa tambong b tul sawmnih mah a piak thuah hi c . Hiram le Solomon kikalah lungnuamtaka kinaina om a, amaute gel in thuciamna khat a bawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in Israel buppi ah - pasal nasemte tul sawmthum aana in a la hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in amaute kha khatin tulsawm a kikhelin Lebanon ah puaka, tua pen amaute Lebanon ah kha khat omin inn ah kha nih a om theih nading uh ahi hi. Biakinnpi kawm sung ah bangmah a kithun loh nadingin biakinnpi pualam kimkot ah tawitawm a bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Biakinnpi lamna-in suangkhuka seksa bek kizanga biakinnpi lam laitakin sek, sekkhu ahikeh sik vanzat ging khatpeuh a huang sungah kiza lo hi.","ref":"Pk 20:25; Tp 27:5"},"8":{"text":"A sual nuainung pen m a lutna biakinnpi leitaw lamah om a; tua panin a laita a kahtohna le a thumna ah kahlei a om to hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua bangin amah in innkam le a tung dapna tamtak pek zangin biakinnpi lam a mansiang hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua teh amah in biakinnpi kimkot ah inndeite a neisak hi. Tuate a sanna tong nga ciat hi-a, tuate biakinnpi ah tamtak zawlin kibawm-sak hi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"12":{"text":"\"Hih na lamlam biakinn tawh kisai-in ka thukipte zui-in, ka ngeinate na palsat kei a, ka thupiakte zui-in tuate na man leh, na pa David tunga ka thuciamte nang tungtawnin ka tangtungsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuateh Israel-te lakah tengin ka mi Israel ka nusia kei ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Solomon in tua bangin biakinnpi lama a zosiang hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in a kawm sunglamte tamtak pekin dapa, biakinnpi sual panin a tungdap dong khawk neisaka, biakinnpi sual dingin taksing pek a phah hi."},"16":{"text":"Biakinnpi phaitam lam tong a sawmnih ciang sual panin inntung dap dong tamtak pekin deisuak a, a biakinnpi sungah mun sungnung bawl a Mun Siangtho Pen ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih inndei mai-a innkhanpi tong sawmli b a sau hi."},"18":{"text":"Biakinnpi sung tamtak sing hi a, umgah le pakpalh limte kikhuak ahi hi. Amah in a sunglam kham citakin luana, tamtak biakna-tau zong a luan hi."},"21":{"text":"Solomon in biakinnpi sung kham citakin tuama, mun siangtho sungnung mai kantanin kham a kituam kham khainiang a khung hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin a sunglam khempeuh khamin a tuam hi. Amah in mun siangtho sungnung pena biakna-tau zong kham in a tuam hi."},"23":{"text":"Mun siangtho sungnungah olive sing-in cherub kop khat bawla tong d sawm tuak a sang hi."},"24":{"text":"A masapen cherub kha langkhat tong nga sau-a, a langkhat pen zong tong nga mah a sau hi - a kha dawn le a kha dawn kikal tong sawm ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua cherub-te a golna le a lim kibanga kibawl ahi manin cherub nihna zong tong sawm mah a pha hi."},"26":{"text":"Cherub-te a sanna tong sawm a pha tuak hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in cherub-te biakinn sungtawng pen ah koiha a khate a zaksak hi. Amah in kum sagih sung a lam hi.","ref":"Heb 8:5"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi zongin Solomon in a kumpi-inn lam a zawh siang nadingin kum sawm le thum a beisak hi.","title":"Solomon in Ama Kumpi-inn Lam"},"2":{"text":"Amah in Lebanon Tulak Kumpi-inn lama a dung tong zakhat, a vai sawmnga a sanna sawmthum e hi a, tamtak khuam gual lite in a kinawtngil tamtak zawlpite a pua hi."},"3":{"text":"Gual khatah sawm le nga a om khuampi sawmli le nga tungah kilam inndei tungsan teng tamtak singa kitungkhuh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A tawhlette a sangpi ah thumthumin ki-omsak a, khat le khat kigalsai dimdiam hi."},"5":{"text":"Kongkhak khempeuh in sikli nei kongmung nei a; a mailam ah omin thumthumin a kigalsai f dimdiam hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:10; 10:17; 2Kh 8:1"},"6":{"text":"Amah in tong sawmnga sau tong sawmthum zai g talaap khat a lam hi. Huram pen sumngo nasep peuhmah siam pha mahmah a, a sep zawh zong sawtpi ahi hi. Kumpi Solomon kiangah amah pai-a a kisawl khempeuh a sem hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Kizepnate","ref":"Pk 31:2-5; 2Kh 2:14"},"15":{"text":"Amah in sumngo khuampi nih sunga, tong sawm le giat sangin a pum kimkot a tong sawm le nih a pha ciat hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in khuampi dawna bulh ding khuam luzepna sumngo nih sunga tua khuam luzepna tong nga b tuak a pha hi."},"17":{"text":"A khuam luzepna tungah a kuala khai ding a kihuihek-a kiphan khainiang bawla, khuam luzepna khat adingin sagih ta ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"A khuampite c dawna khuam luzepna dingin mang kawlsinggah bawl-a a kiphante khat ciangin gual nih d a umsak hi. Khuam luzepna a kibangin a bawl hi."},"19":{"text":"A laapkaih a khuampi ludawn zepnate unok pak bangin bawla tong e li a sang hi."},"20":{"text":"Khuampite ludawn zepna tung tuakah a kiphante zomin kuangkum limte zomsak a, tua banah a kimkotah mang kawlsing gah zanih a gual hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in khuampite biakinnpi mai laapkaih ah a phut hi. Leitaw lama khuampi Jakin f ci a, leilu lama pen Boaz g a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"A dawna khuam luzepna unok pak tawh kibang hi. Tua bangin khuampite a mansiang hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:17; 2Kh 3:16-17; 4:13"},"23":{"text":"Amah in daal sungin Tuipi bawl a, a bemsak hi; a gei khat pan a gei khat tong sawm h pha a, tong nga a sang hi. A gei kimkot tong sawmthum i a pha hi."},"24":{"text":"A geivial nuai-ah umgah-in umcihsak a - tong khat ah sawmta a om hi. Umgahte gual nih pha-a a Tuipi tawh a sunkhawm pah ahi hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:13; 1Kh 18:8; Jer 52:17"},"25":{"text":"Bawngtal sawm le nih tungah Tuipi kitunga, thum leilu-lam nga in, thum nitumna-lam nga a, thum leitaw-lam nga-in thum nisuahna-lam a nga hi. Tuate tungah Tuipi kinga a, a laizang lam nungngat dimdiam uh hi."},"26":{"text":"A sahna zapeek j cia hi-a, a geivial hai geivial tawh kibangin unok pakpalh tawh kibang hi. A sungah tambong tul nih k a ta hi.","ref":"2Kh 4:2-5; Jer 52:20"},"27":{"text":"Amah in a kikhin thei sumngo dinna sawm bawla, tong li sau in tong li zai-a, tong thum l a sang ciat hi."},"28":{"text":"A dinna bawlzia hih bang ahi hi: Tuate in a pang ah khawk nei-a, a tung lamin kibulh hi."},"29":{"text":"A khawk dingtote a kikalah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte le cherub-te lim a tuang a - tuate a tung lam te ah zong a om uh hi; humpinelkai le bawngtalte tung le nuai-ah seka kiseek pakkual lim a om hi."},"30":{"text":"A dinna khat in sumngo pei li le peizawl te nei-a, apang kim ah pakkual lim kisung tuikuang khat omna, nanna li a nei ciat hi."},"31":{"text":"A dinna sunglam ah a bemin tong khat m thuk avang khat a om hi. Avang bemna tong khat le alang n ahi hi. Avang gei kimkot kikhuak hi. A dinna khawkte ahileh bem loin kiu li a nei hi."},"32":{"text":"A khawkte nuai-ah a peite om-a a peizawlte a dinna ah a kibelhcip hi. A peite khat a zaina tong khat le alang ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"A peite sakolleng pei banga kibawl hi a; a peizawl, a peikual, a peikal le a pei vangdapte daal kisung vive ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"A dinna khat in letna li nei-a a kiu ciat panin a mengkhia hi."},"35":{"text":"A tunna dawn ah tong lang o a thuk vialbem khat a om hi. A dinna dawn ah a nanna le a khawkte a kibelhcip ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Amah in a nannate mai le a khawk tungah cherub-te, humpi-nelkaite, le nisuh kung limte suai kuak a, a kimkota a awnna mun ah pakkual lim a suai hi."},"37":{"text":"Hih in a dinna sawmte a bawlzia ahi hi. Tuate khempeuh a kibanga kisung hi-a, a phacia le a pianzia kibang kim hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in sumngo tuikuang sawm bawla, a sungah tambong sawmli p ta-in, a gei zaina tong li hi-a, a tunna khat tungah kuangpi khatta a kitung hi."},"39":{"text":"Amah in biakinnpi leitaw-lam ah tuikuangpi tunna nga koih a, leilu-lam ah nga a koih hi. Amah in biakinnpi leitaw-lam pang, nisuahna-lam kiu ah Tuipi a koih hi."},"40":{"text":"Amah in tuikuangpite, vutluahnate le tuithehna kuangte zong a bawl hi. Tua bangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon adingin TOPA biakinnpi sunga sep ding teng a mansiang hi:"},"41":{"text":"khuampi nihte; khuampi nih dawna kuang tawh a kibang khuam lubawk nih; khuampi nih dawna kuang tawh a kibang a lubawk zepna a kiphan nihte;"},"42":{"text":"a kiphan nihte ading mangkawlsing gah zali (khuampite dawna kuangkum tawh a kibang a kiphan zepna ading mangkawlsing gah gual nih);","ref":"tg 20"},"43":{"text":"tui kuangpi sawm le a dinna sawm;"},"44":{"text":"Tuipi le a nuai-a a dinna bawngtal sawm le nihte;"},"45":{"text":"beelte, vutluahnate le tuithehna kuang-ukte ahi hi. TOPA biakinnpi ah vanzat dingin Huram in Kumpi Solomon adinga a bawl hih vanzatte khempeuh sumngo nawtngil vive ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 27:3"},"46":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jordan zanglei a Succoth le Zarethan kikal a beellei omna ah tuate a sungsak hi."},"47":{"text":"Hih nate gikna tam lua mahmah ahi manin Solomon in a teh vet kei hi; sumngo gikna kiseh thei vet lo hi.","ref":"1Kh 22:3"},"48":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi sunga vanzatte khempeuh zong a bawl hi: kham biakna-tau; Ompihna anlum luina kham sabuai;"},"49":{"text":"kham citak meivak tunna (mun siangtho sungnung mai a taklam ah nga, a veilam ah nga); khama kibawl pakte, meivak le taitehte;","ref":"Pk 25:31-38"},"50":{"text":"kham citak tawh kibawl kuangte, meivak khau tehtanna, thehna kuang-ukte, kuangte le gimnamtui veinate; le Mun Siangtho Pen ahi inndei sungnung pena kong khakpi le biakinnpi kongkhakpi ading kham kawmhekte zong a bawl hi."},"51":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi-a nasep ding khempeuh a man ciangin a pa David in a apsa ngun le kham vanzatte khempeuh a sungah tum a TOPA biakinnpi gou kholna sungah tuate a koih hi.","ref":"2Kh 4:6,10-5:1; 2Sa 8:11"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon in David Khuapi Zion panin ama omna Jerusalem ah TOPA thukhun singkuangpi puato dingin Israel upate, beh lutangte khempeuh, Israel innkuan a ukpite khempeuh a khawm hi.","title":"Biakinnpi ah Singkuangpi Kitun"},"2":{"text":"Israel mite khempeuh a kha sagihna Ethanim kha pawikham hun in Kumpipa Solomon kiangah a kikhawm uh hi.","ref":"Sp 23:34; 2Sa 5:7"},"3":{"text":"Israel upate khempeuh a tun khit uh ciangin siampite in thukhun singkuangpi lakhia uh a,"},"4":{"text":"TOPA thukhun singkuangpi le Kikhopna Puanbuk le a sunga vanzat siangtho khempeuh a puato uh hi. Siampite le Levi-te in tuate puato uh a,"},"5":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon le ama gei-a kikhawm Israel mi buppi in singkuangpi mai-ah tuu le bawngtalte tam pia lua uh ahi manin kisim zo lo-a, kiciamteh thei lo hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampite in TOPA thukhun singkuangpi pua in biakinnpi-a munsiangtho sunga koih nading mun Mun Siangtho Pen a cherub-te kha nuai santak ah a koih uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Cherub-te in singkuangpi koihna mun tungah a khate uh zaakin singkuangpi le a zawnna zawlte a khate-un a liahsuk uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A zawlte sau lua ahi manin mun siangtho sungnung mai Mun Siangtho panin a mongte kimu thei a, ahi zongin Mun Siangtho pualam panin a kimu thei kei hi; tua hi a tuate tuni dongin tua lai-ah a om lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel-te Egypt panin a paikhiat khit ua TOPA in amaute tawh Horeb a, a bawl thukhun suangpek nih longal singkuangpi sungah adang bangmah a om kei hi.","ref":"Pk 25:13-15,21; Tp 10:2-5"},"10":{"text":"Mun Siangtho pan siampite a paikhiat uh ciangin TOPA biakinnpi sungah meiipi a dim hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA biakinnpi sungah ama minthanna dim ahi manin meiipi hangin siampite in a biakna uh a sem thei nawn kei uh hi.","ref":"Pk 40:34-35"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in, \" TOPA in meii mialpi lakah ka teng ding hi, ci hi;"},"13":{"text":"a tawntunga na ten nading mun biakinn thupi mahmah khat kong lamsak takpi hi,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Israel mihonpite tua lai-ah a dindin laitakun kumpipa kilehhei kawikawi-in amaute thupha a pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in: \"Ka pa David tungah ama kama a thuciam, ama khuta a tangtung-sakpa TOPA Israel Pasian kiphat ta hen. ama tungah na kamin na kiciam a, tuni-a bang lianin na khutin na tangtungsak hi."},"25":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA , Israel Pasian aw, na nasempa ka pa David tungah: ‘Nang in ka mai-ah na hih bangin na tapate in amau nasepnate khempeuh ah kidawmin a kalsuan uh leh ka mai-a Israel kumpi tokhom tunga tu ding mi a kitasam ngei kei ding hi,\" ci-a na thuciam lenkip in."},"26":{"text":"Tua hi a Israel Pasian aw, tu-in na nasempa ka pa tungah na thuciam hong tangtungsak in.","ref":"2Sa 7:25"},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin leitungah Pasian teng takpi ding ahi hiam? (Ahi hangin amah’n a khem ahi hi.)"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian mipa amah tawh kileha, a inn ah ne-in a dawn hi.","ref":"Tp 13:3"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in sabuai a um laitakun amah a pikik kamsang putekpa tungah TOPA thu a tung hi."},"21":{"text":"Judah pana pai Pasian mipa tungah amah kiko in, \"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘ TOPA kammal na thusim kei a, TOPA na Pasian in hong thupiaksa na zui kei hi."},"22":{"text":"Na nek na dawn loh nadinga hong genna munah anlum ne in tuisik na dawn hi. Tua kum pen Judah kumpi Asa a kum sawmnih le sagih a cinna kum ahi hi. Amah in a kitanaupihte ahikeh a lawmte pasal khat zong a siit kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuaci-in kamsangpa Jehu tungtawnin Baasha langah TOPA in a gensa thu bangin Zimri in Baasha innkuan buppi a sumaimang hi -"},"13":{"text":"man a nei lo amau milimte tawh TOPA Israel Pasian phinin a hehsak nadingun Baasha le a tapa Elah bawlsa mawhnate le Israel mawhna a bawlsakna uh hang ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 32:21; 1Sa 12:21"},"14":{"text":"Elah in a uk sungin a thupiang dangte le ama sep khempeuh Israel kumpite khangthu ciamtehna laibu sungah kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Asa a kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin Zimri in Tirzah ah ni sagih sung a uk hi. Philistia-te khuapi khat ahi Gibbethon gei ah galkapte in giahphual a sat uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Zimri in kumpipa sawmsimin amah that hi, cih a zak uh ciangin tua giahphual mah ah galkap mangpa Omri, Israel uk kumpi dingin a tangko uh hi.","title":"Israel Kumpi Zimri"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Omri le a ompih Israel-te khempeuh Gibbethon panin nung kik uh a, Tirzah a umcih uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Zimri in khuapi a kilak khit lam a muh ciangin kumpi-inn sunga inn muanhuai sungah tumin a kimkot a kumpi-innte mei in a halin si hi,"},"19":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh amah in TOPA mit-ah gamtatsia-in Jeroboam’ lampite zui-in mawhnate bawl a Israel zong a khialhsak hang ahi hi.
