TOPA in Nun tapa Joshua tunga a genna tawh kizui-in amah in a tapa upa pen Abiram luang manin a bulpite phum a, a tapa a tum pen Segub luang manin a kongpite a tung hi.","ref":"Jos 6:26"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Gilead a Tishbe a panin Tishbe-te Elijah in Ahab tungah, \"A na ka sep TOPA , Israel Pasian nuntakna lo-in ka gen hi, hong tung ding kum tawmkhate sungah kei thu loin daitui ahi a, guahtui ahi zongin a om kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Va-akte in Elijah Vak","ref":"2Ku 3:14; Lk 4:25; Jas 5:17"},"2":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Elijah tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"3":{"text":"\"Hih mun nusia inla nisuahna lamah kihei in, Jordan nisuahna lama Kerith Kuampi ah va bu in."},"4":{"text":"Lui neu panin tui na dawn dinga, nang hong vak dingin va-akte ka sawl khin hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 8:7"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah TOPA gensa bangin a hih hi. Amah Jordan nisuahna lama Kerith Kuampi ah pai a, tua lai-ah a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Va-akte in anlum le sa zingsang in, tuateh anlum le sa nitakin puak uh a, lui neu panin tui a dawn hi."},"7":{"text":"Gam sungah guah zu lo ahi manin tua zawh a sawt loin luineu a kang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama tungah TOPA thu tunga:","title":"Zarephath a Meigongnu"},"9":{"text":"\"Sidon a Zarephath ah paipah vingveng inla tua lai-ah va om in. Nang an hong puak dingin meigongnu khat thu ka pia khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Zarephath ah amah a pai hi. A khuapi kongpi a tun ciangin meigongnu khat in singkang a na tom hi. Amah in tuanu sama, \"Hai khatin ka dawn ding tui nong pia diam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuanu a la dingin a pai laitakin amah sama, \"Tuateh nong hehpihna-in anlum tawmkha hong puak in,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuanu in, \" TOPA na Pasian nuntakna lo-in kong gen hi, anlum khat beek ka nei kei hi - beel sungah annel khut dim khat bek oma thawl sungah sathau tawmno khat a om hi. Inn a ka puak ding singkang tawmkha a tom ka hi hi, kei le ka tapa nek ding bawlin ne khin le-ung - a si ta ding ka hi uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"2Ku 4:2"},"13":{"text":"Elijah in tuanu kiangah, \"Lau kei in. Inn ah ciah inla na gensa bangin hih in. Ahi hangin na neih sunsun tawh kei ading anlum moh neu khat bawl masa inla kei hong puak in, tua ciangin nang ading le na tapa ading bang khatpeuh bawl in."},"14":{"text":"Ahang in TOPA , Israel Pasian in, ‘ TOPA in leitungah guah a piak mateng annel beel sungah annel a bei kei dinga, sathau thawl a keu kei ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuanu paikhia, a Elijah gensa bangin a hih hi. Tua ciangin Elijah ading le numeinu le a innkuante ading nisimin an a om den hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, Elijah tunga TOPA thugenna tawh kizui-in annel beel le an kitalawi lo a, sathau thawl zong a keu kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Hun tawmvei khit ciangin inn neinu tapa a ci na hi. Amah gim semsem a, a tawpna ah a huu a bei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuanu in Elijah kiangah, \"Pasian mipa aw, kei tungah bang lungkim-lohna nei na hi hiam? Ka mawhnate hong phawksak kik ding le ka tapa that dinga hong pai na hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 3:13; Lk 5:8"},"19":{"text":"Elijah in, \"Na tapa hong pia in,\" ci-in a dawng hi. Amah in tuanu ang panin la-a, ama omna inn tung dei-ah puato-in, a lupna ah a sial hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA kiangah kiko in, \" TOPA ka Pasian aw, ka omna meigongnu tung nangawn ah a tapa sisakin dahluatna tungsak na hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin naupangno tungah amah thumvei kizankhia in TOPA tungah, \" TOPA ka Pasian aw, hih naupangno nuntakna ama tungah kilehkiksak in!\" ci-in a kiko hi.","ref":"2Ku 4:34; Ns 20:10"},"22":{"text":"TOPA in Elijah kikona za a, naupangno nuntakna ama tungah kileh kikin a nungta hi."},"23":{"text":"Elijah in naupangno domin inndei panin innpi sungah a puasuk hi. Amah in a nu pia-a, \"Na tapa nungta hi, en in!\" a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin numei in Elijah kiangah, \"Tu-in Pasian mipa na hilam le na kam pana TOPA kammalte thutak ahilam ka thei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jn 3:2; 16:30; Ph 119:43"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hun sawtpi khit, kum thum ciangin Elijah tungah TOPA thu tunga: \"Pai inla nang mahmah Ahab tungah va kipia in, tuateh guah kong zusak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Elijah le Obadiah"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ahab tunga kipia dingin Elijah a kuan hi. Tua laitakin Samaria ah kialpi nasia mahmah a,"},"3":{"text":"Ahab in ama kumpi inn ukpa Obadiah a sam hi. (Obadiah pen TOPA thu um a kipia zo khat ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Jezebel in TOPA kamsangte a thahthah lai-in Obadiah in kamsangte za khat kemin, suanghawm nih sungah sawmnga ta in sel-a, an le tui a puak hi.)"},"5":{"text":"Ahab in Obadiah kiangah, \"Gam sunga ciktuite le kuamte omna khempeuh ah va pai in. I sakolte le laate nuntaksak nading lopa pawlkhat beek na mu thei kha ding hi; tua hileh i ganhingte khat beek thahlup kul lo ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a zon kim theih nadingun gam hawm uh a, Ahab mun khat lamah pai-in, Obadiah a mun khat lamah a pai hi.","ref":"2Ku 9:7; Ne 7:2; Isa 16:3"},"7":{"text":"Obadiah a paipai laitakin Elijah tawh a kituak hi. Obadiah in amah thei-a, lei lakah bok in, \"Ka topa Elijah aw, nang taktak mah na hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 1:8"},"8":{"text":"Amah in, \"Ka hi hi, pai inla na pu kiangah, ‘Elijah hiah om hi,’ va ci in,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Obadiah in, \"Na nasempa Ahab thah dinga nong piak nadingin bang khialhna nei ka hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"TOPA na Pasian nuntakna lo-in ka cih inah nang hong zong dinga ka pu in a sawl loh minam le kumpi gam khat zong a om kei hi. Minam khat ahi-a kumpi-gam khat ahi zongin tua lai-ah nang kong mu kei uh hi, a cih uh leh hong muh lohna uh a kiciamsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka pu kiangah pai a, ‘Elijah hiah om hi,’ ci-a gen dingin tu-in nong sawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Nang kong nusiat kalin TOPA Kha in nang koi-ah hong puak ding cih ka thei kei hi. Kei pai-in Ahab kiangah va gen lenga, amah in nang hong mu kei leh kei hong that ding hi. Tua hi napi na nasempa in lah ka neutunga kipan TOPA ka biaksa ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ka topa aw, Jezebel in TOPA kamsangte a thah lai-in ka hihte za hi lo na hi hiam? TOPA kamsangte za khat suang hawm nih ah sawmnga tuakin ka sel a, an le tui ka puak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tuateh tu-in nang in kei pai-a, ‘Elijah hiah om hi,’ ci-a ka pu kianga gen dingin nong sawl hi. Amah in kei hong that ding hi!\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Elijah in, \"Ama na ka sep Thahatpen TOPA nuntakna lo-in ka cih inah tuni-in Ahab kiangah kei mahmah ka va kipia taktak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 17:1"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ahab tawh kimu dingin Obadiah pai-in gen a, Elijah tawh kimu dingin Ahab a pai hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in Elijah a muh ciangin, \"Nang, Israel a lungkhamsakpa nang na hiam?\" a ci hi.","title":"Carmel Vum ah Elijah","ref":"Jos 7:25; 1Ku 21:20"},"18":{"text":"Elijah in, \"Ke’n Israel ka lungkhamsak kei hi. Nang le na pa innkuan na hi uh hi. Nang in TOPA thupiakte taisanin Baal-te na zui uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in Carmel Vum ah kei tawh kimu dingin Israel khempeuh sam in. Tuateh Jezebel sabuai-a an ne Baal kamsang zali le sawmngate le Asherah kamsang zalite hong tonpih uh hen,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Jos 19:26; 1Ku 16:31,33"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ahab in Israel khempeuh tungah thu paisak a, Carmel Vum ah kamsangte a kikhawmsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Mipite mai-ah Elijah pai-in, \"Ngaihsutna nih kikal ah bang tanvei lungsim laklawhin om niloh ding na hi uh hiam? TOPA pen Pasian ahileh amah zui unla; Baal pen Pasian ahileh lah amah zui un,\" a ci hi. Ahi hangin mite in bangmah a gen kei uh hi.","ref":"Jos 24:15; 2Kum 17:41; Mt 6:24"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elijah in amaute kiangah, \" TOPA kamsangte lakah kei bek ka om lai hi, ahi hangin Baal in kamsang zali le sawmnga a nei hi."},"23":{"text":"Kote adingin bawngtal nih hong la un. Amaute in khat teel uh henla, semnenin singtungah koihin mei-in hal kei uh hen. Ke’n a khat pen sa bawlin singtungah ka koih dinga mei-in ka hal kei ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin no na pasian min uh sam unla ken TOPA min ka sam ding hi. Mei-a a dawng pasian pen-Pasian ahi hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in na gen hoih mah ei!\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 19:10; 1Kh 21:26"},"25":{"text":"Elijah in Baal kamsangte kiangah, \"Tam mahmah na hi uh ciangin bawngtal khat teel unla bawl masa un. Na pasian min uh sam unla ahi zongin mei vak kei un,\" a ci hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a kipia bawngtal la-in a bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin zingsanga kipan sun dong Baal min a sam uh hi. Amaute in, \"Baal aw, ko hong dawng in,\" ci-in a kiko uh hi. Ahi hangin a kidawng kei hi; khat beek in a dawng kei hi. Tuateh amau dawhsa biakna-tau kimkotah a lam uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Sun ciangin Elijah in amaute a selnoh hi. Amah in, \"Nak ot lai dih un! Amah pasian hi taktak hi! Thu nak ngaihsut lua, buai lua ahikeh khualzin hi kha ding hi. A ihmut laitak hi a, phot a kul hi kha ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute nak ot semsem uh a, amau ngeina bangin namsau le teipi-in a sisan luan dongin a kikui uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Sun kim khin a, amaute in nitak biak piak hun dongin a kamsanna mah uh zom lai uh hi. Ahi hangin kidawng lo a, kuamah in dawng loin, khat beek in a thusim kei hi.","ref":"Sp 19:28; Hab 2:19"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elijah in mite khempeuh tungah, \"Kei kiangah hong pai un,\" a ci hi. Amaute a kiangah pai uh a, amah in a kisiasa TOPA biakna-tau a puahpha hi."},"31":{"text":"TOPA thu a tun lai-a, \"Na min Israel hi ding hi,\" a cihna Jacob suan beh sawm le nihte beh khat aitangin suang khat, suang sawm le nih Elijah in a la hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua suangte tawh TOPA minin biakna-tau khat dawha, a kimkot ah khaici seah a nih a ta zo ding hawkguam khat a to hi."},"33":{"text":"Amah in sing cianga bawngtal atnenin singtungah a sia hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, \"Tui beelpi li dim unla biaknate le singte buak un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 19:10; 2Ku 17:34; Col 3:17"},"34":{"text":"Amah in, \"Khat vei hih kik un,\" ci a, amaute in a hih kik lai uh hi. Amah in, \"A thumveina hih un,\" ci-in thu pia-a amaute in a thumveina a hih uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Biakna-tau kimkotah tui luanga hawkguamte nangawn a dim hi."},"36":{"text":"Biak piak hun ciangin kamsang Elijah mailam ah paikhia in thu ngen a: \" TOPA , Abraham, Isaac le Israel Pasian aw, Israel sungah nang Pasian na hina le kei nangma nasem hi-in nangma sawlna tawh hihte sem ka hilam tuni-in kitheisak in."},"37":{"text":"Hong dawng in TOPA aw, hong dawng in tua hileh hih mite in TOPA aw, nang Pasian na hilam le nang in amaute lungsim na hei kik lam a thei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 16:28; Jos 4:24"},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA meikuang kia in a biak piaknate, singte, suangtumte le leihoihte kangtum a, hawkguam sunga tuite nangawn a liaksiang khin hi.","ref":"Sp 9:24; 1Kh 21:26; 2Kh 7:1"},"39":{"text":"Mi khempeuh in hih a muh uh ciangin khuptuk suk uh a, \" TOPA -amah Pasian hi ei! TOPA -amah Pasian hi ei!\" ci-in a kiko uh hi.","ref":"tg 24; Ph 46:10"},"40":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elijah in, \"Baal kamsangte man un. Khat beek khahsuah kei un!\" ci-in amaute thu a pia hi. Amaute in tuate man uh a, Kishon Kuam ah puaksakin tua lai-ah a golum uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Tuateh Elijah in Ahab kiangah, \"Guah tampi ging kiza ta hi, pai inla ne in dawn in,\" a ci hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ne a dawn dingin Ahab paikhia-a, Elijah ahileh Carmel mualdawnah kahtoin a khukte gel kikalah a lu omsaka, lei lamah a kunsuk hi."},"43":{"text":"A nasempa kiangah, \"Pai inla tuipi lam va en sin aw,\" a ci hi. Tuateh amah paito-in a en hi. Amah in, \"Tua lai-ah bangmah om kei,\" a ci hi. Elijah in sagih vei, \"Pai kik in,\" a ci hi."},"44":{"text":"A sagih veina ah a nasempa in, \"Tuipi pan khuttum cia-a neu meii khat hong kaiito hi,\" ci-in a zasak hi. Tua ciangin Elijah in, \"Pai inla Ahab kiangah, ‘Guah in hong khak ma-in na sakolleng vawh inla paisuk in,’ va ci in,\" a ci hi."},"45":{"text":"Tua sungtengin meii kai-in van voma, huih kipei-in guahpi zu a, Jezreel ah Ahab a sakolleng ah tuangin a pai hi."},"46":{"text":"Elijah tungah TOPA vangliatna tunga, a puantualpi a kawnggakin gaka, Jezreel lampi tawntungah Ahab mai-ah a na tai hi.","ref":"2Ku 3:15; 4:29"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Ahab in Jezebel kiangah Elijah hihna khempeuh le kamsangte khempeuh a thahzia a gen hi.","title":"Horeb ah Elijah Tai"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jezebel in Elijah kiangah, \"Zing ciang tu bang hunin amaute khat bangin nang kong bawl kei tak leh tua sanga nasiazaw in pasiante in kei hong bawl ta hen,\" a ci dingin thupuak a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Elijah lau a -a a nuntak nadingin a tai hi. Judah a Beersheba a tun ciangin tua lai-ah a nasempa nusia-a,"},"4":{"text":"amah guak sehnel-gam ah ni khat lam a pai lai hi. Amah poding kung phung khat tunga, a nuai-ah tu-in a sih nading thu a ngen hi. Amah in, \"Kicing ta hi, TOPA aw, ka nuntakna la in; ka pu ka pate sangin ka hoih zaw kei hi,\" a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah sing nuai-ah lumin a ihmu hi. Tua khit phetin vansawltak khat in amah lawnga, \"Tho inla ne in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 11:15; Jn 4:8; Pc 31:21"},"6":{"text":"A kimkot a et leh a lukhung gei-ah meiholsa tunga ki-em anlum moh le haitung khatah tui a na om hi. Amah in ne-in dawna a lumsuk kik hi.","ref":"Pc 16:7"},"7":{"text":"TOPA vansawltak a nihveina pai kik a, amah lawng in, \"Na pai nading gamla lua hi, tho inla ne in,\" a ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tho-a, ne-in a dawn hi. An in a tha khauhsak a Pasian mual Horeb a tun matengin sun sawmli le zan sawmli a pai hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua lai-a suanghawm sungah amah pai-in zanin a giak hi. Tuateh Elijah tungah TOPA thu tunga: \"Elijah aw, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 3:1; 34:28"},"10":{"text":"Amah in, \" TOPA , Thahatpen Pasian adingin ka aam mahmah hi. Israel-te in thukhun nial uh a, na biakna-taute phelkhia mangin na kamsangte namsau-in a that uh hi. Kei kia bek a omlai sun ka hi-a, tu-in kei zong thah hong sawm uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Elijah Tungah Kilang","ref":"1Ku 18:4,22"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Paikhia in, TOPA omna mual TOPA in nawk ding ahi manin tua tungah ding in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin a lian a thakhauh mahmah huihpi in mualte semkham in, TOPA mai-a suangtumte pilhzansak a, ahi hangin huih lakah TOPA a om kei hi. Huih nun khit ciangin zin linga, ahi hangin zinling ah TOPA a om kei hi.","ref":"Pk 24:12"},"12":{"text":"Zinlin khit ciangin mei kuanga, ahi hangin meikuang sung ah TOPA a om kei hi. Meikuang khit ciangin awneema a huau khiankhian khat a om hi."},"13":{"text":"Elijah in tua a zak ciangin a puantualpi in a mai khuh a paikhia-in suanghawm gongah a ding hi. Tua ciangin aw khat in, \"Elijah aw, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Zec 4:6"},"14":{"text":"Amah in, \" TOPA , Thahatpen Pasian adingin ka aam lua mahmah hi. Israel-te in na thukhunte nial uh a, na biakna-taute phelkhia mangin na kamsangte namsau in that uh a, tu-in kei zong thah hong sawm uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Ro 11:3"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Nong paina lampi ah ciah kik inla Damascus Sehnel-gamah pai in. Tua lai-ah na tun ciangin Aram kumpi dingin Hazael sathau nilh in."},"16":{"text":"Israel uk dingin Nimshi tapa Jehu zong sathau nilh inla nang za laih a kamsang dingin Abel Meholah pana Shaphat tapa Elisha sathau nilh in."},"17":{"text":"Hazael’ namsau pana suaktate Jehu in that dinga, Jehu namsau pana suaktate Elisha in a that ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi napi Baal mai-ah a khukdin ngei lo, a muk uh tawh amah a tawp ngei lo - Israel sungah tul sagih ka sit lai hi,\" a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua lai panin Elijah paikhia-a, Shaphat tapa Elisha a mu hi. Amah in bawngtal kap sawm le nih tawh lo a khawh laitak hi-a, amah in a kap sawm le nihna a hawl laitak ahi hi. Ama kiangah Elijah paito-a a puantualpi lawnin amah a khuh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elisha in a bawngtalte nusia-in Elijah a nungdelh hi. Amah in, \"Ka nu le ka pa mangpha khakin hong namsak phot in, tua khit ciangin nang kong zui ding hi,\" a ci hi. Elijah in, \"Pai kik in, nang bang hong cih ka hi hiam?\" ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Elisha Sapna","ref":"2Ku 2:8,14; Mt 8:21-22; Lk 9:61"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elisha in amah nusia in a pai kik hi. Ama zat bawngtalte la-in a go hi. Amah in sa huan nadingin a lo khawhna vante cih a, mite pia-in, amaute in a ne uh hi. Tua ciangin Elijah zui dingin kuankhia-a a nasem a suak hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Aram kumpipa Ben-Hadad in a galkap khempeuh a khawm hi. Kumpi sawmthum le nih a sakolte uh le a sakollengte uh tawh kopin amah kuanto a, Samaria umcihin a sim hi.","title":"Ben-Hadad in Samaria Sim"},"2":{"text":"Amah in khuapi sungah kamtaite sawlin Israel kumpipa Ahab kiangah, \"Ben-Hadad in,"},"3":{"text":"‘Na ngun le na khamte kei aa hi a, na zi hoihpente le na tate kei aa ahi hi,’ ci hi,\" a cisak hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in, \"Ka to kumpipa aw, na cih bang tektek ahi hi. Kei le ka neihsa khempeuh nang aa ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Kamtaite pai kik a, \"Ben-Hadad in, ‘Na ngun le na khamte, na zite na tate a la ding mi kong sawl ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin zing ciang tu hunin na kumpi-inn sung le na uliante inn sung a pheklek dingin ka uliante kong sawl ding hi. Amaute in na van man nei khempeuh manin a puamang ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in gam sunga upate khempeuh samin amaute kiangah \"En dih un, hih mipa in bangzah taka buaina zong ahi hiam! Ka zite le ka tate, ka ngun le ka khamte hong vaikhak ciangin ka nial kei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 5:7"},"8":{"text":"Upate le mipi khempeuh in, \"A thu ngai kei inla hong kalhte zong thukim kei in,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Ben-Hadad kamtaite kiangah, \"Ka to kumpipa kiangah, ‘Na nasempa in na kalh masak khempeuh a hih ding hi, a hih hangin hih ngetna ka hih zo kei ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,\" a ci hi. Amaute ciah uh a, a dawnna Ben-Hadad a puak kik uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ben-Hadad in Ahab tungah thu dang khat puaka, \"Samaria leitang ka mite khutdim khat ciat kipia leh a cintak leh pasiante in a nasiazaw in kei hong bawl hen,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 19:2"},"11":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in, \"Ama tungah, ‘Galvan suahkhiapa bangin galvan tawh a kithawisa pa kisathei kei hen,’ ci un,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Pn 27:1"},"12":{"text":"Ben-Hadad le kumpite in amaute puanbuk a sungah zu a dawn laitakun hih thupuak za uh a amah in, \"Galsim dingin kithawi un,\" ci-in a mite thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin amaute khuapi sim dingin a kithawi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua sung tengin Israel kumpipa Ahab kiangah kamsang khat pai-in, \" TOPA in, ‘Hih galkap hon tampitakte na mu hiam? Tuni-in na khut sungah kong pia dinga, tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a zasak hi.","ref":"tg 28; Pk 6:7"},"14":{"text":"Ahab in, \"Ahi zongin hih kua in sem ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Kamsangpa in, \" TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Gam sunga galkapmang ulian khangmoi-te in sem ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi. \"Tua ahileh kua in galsim pan masa ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Kamsangpa in, \"Nang na pan ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Ahab in Ben-Hadad Zo","ref":"Thk 1:1"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ahab in gam sunga galkapmang khangmoi uliante khawm a 232 a pha hi. Tua ciangin a om lai Israel khempeuh khawma 7,000 a pha hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in Ben-Hadad le amah a huh kumpi 32 te puanbuk sungah zu a kham laitak uh sun hunin a kuankhia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Gam sunga galkapmang khangmoi uliante a kuankhia masa uh hi. Tua laitakin Ben-Hadad in a sawl thukante in, \"Samaria pan mite hong kuankhia uh hi,\" ci-in a zasak uh hi.","ref":"tg 12"},"18":{"text":"Amah in, \"Amaute lemthu gen dinga hong kuan uh ahileh na hingmat ding uh a, amaute galsim dinga hong kuan uh ahileh na hingmat ding uh hi,\" ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuapi panin galkapmang khangmoi uliante kuankhia uh a amaute nungah galkap honpi in zui-in"},"20":{"text":"amau kisikpih ciat a satpai uh hi. Tua hun ciangin Aram-te taikek uh a Israel-te in a nungdelh uh hi. Ahi hangin Aram kumpipa sakol nungzangah tuangin sakol tuangte pawlkhat tawh a suakta uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel kumpipa kuankhia-a, sakolte le sakollengte zogawpin Aram-te tungah supna lianpi a tungsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua nung ciangin Israel kumpipa kiangah kamsangpa pai-in, \"Na dinmun khosak zaw in, bang hih pelmawh kul cih mu in, bang hang hiam cih leh mai khal ciangin Aram kumpipa in nang hong sim kik ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Sa 11:1"},"23":{"text":"Tua sung tengin a uliante in Aram kumpipa a ngaihsutpihna uh gen uh a, \"Amau pasiante mualtung pasiante ahi hi. Tua hangin amaute ei adingin thakhauh lua uh hi. Ahi hangin zanglei ah do lehang amaute sangin i thahat zaw taktak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Hi cih in: Kumpite amau dinmun panin hemkhia inla ulian dangte in laih in."},"25":{"text":"Na taansa galkap tawh a kibang galkap mah dingsak inla - sakol tangin sakol, sakolleng tangin sakol-leng dingsak kik in - tua bangin zanglei ah Israel i do zo pan ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute sangin i hatzaw taktak ding hi,\" a ci uh hi. A cih bangun amah thukima, tua bangin a sem hi.","ref":"1Ku 14:23; Ro 1:21-23"},"26":{"text":"A ni kum khuakhal ciangin Ben-Hadad in Aram-te kaikhawma, Israel sim dingin Aphek ah a kuanto hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel-te zong kikai-khawm uh a, lam-an guangin amaute do dingin a kuankhia uh hi. Israel-te in amaute galkhat ah keelhon no nih bangin giahphual sat uh a, Aram-te in ahileh gamsung teng a tuamcip uh hi.","ref":"Thk 6:6; 1Sa 13:6; 2Ku 13:17"},"28":{"text":"Pasian mipa paito in Israel kumpipa kiangah, \" TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Aram-te in TOPA pen mualte pasian bek hi-a, mualkuam pasian hi lo hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh ahi manin hih galkap hon tampitak na khut sungah kong pia dinga, keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute in a kigalsai-in ni sagih sung giahphual sat uh a, a ni sagihna ni-in gal a kido uh hi. Israel-te in ni khat sungin Aram-te khegalkap tul zakhat thatlum uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A omlaite Aphek khuapi ah suakta uh a, tua lai-ah tul sawmnih le tul sagih kulh in a cipnelh hi. Tua ciangin khuapi sungah Ben-Hadad tai-a, inndei sungnung ah a bu hi."},"31":{"text":"Ama uliante in, En in, Israel kumpi innkuante in mi hehpih thei hi, ci-in ka za uh hi. I kawngah ippi puan tengin i lu ah khauhual vialin Israel kumpipa kiangah va pai ni. Amah in na nuntakna hong hawisak kha thei ding hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pc 37:34"},"32":{"text":"Amaute in a kawnguah ippi tengin, a lu-uah khauhual khimsa in Israel Kumpipa kiangah va pai uh a, \"Na nasempa Ben-Hadad in, ‘Nong hehpihna-in hong nungtasak in,’ hong ci hi,\" a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in, \"Amah nungta lai ahi hiam? Amah ka sanggampa ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"33":{"text":"Mite in lim hoihin la uh a, a kam gen dawng pahin, \"Hi e, na sanggampa Ben-Hadad hi,\" a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in, \"Pai unla hong paisak un,\" a ci hi. Ben-Hadad a paikhiat ciangin Ahab in a sakolleng tungah a kahtosak hi."},"34":{"text":"Ben-Hadad in ama kiangah, \"Na pa tung pana ka pa in a laksak khuapite nang kong pia kik ding hi. Ka pa in Samaria a, a hih bangin Damascus ah na sumbuk huangte na bawl ding hi,\" ci-in a pia hi. Ahab in, \"Hih thu tawh kisai-in thukimna bawl in, nang kong khah ding hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin thukimna bawl a, amah a ciahsak hi.","ref":"Pk 23:32"},"35":{"text":"Kamsangte tapate khat in TOPA thupiakna tawh a lawmpa kiangah, \"Na hiam tawh kei hong sat in,\" a cih hangin mipa in a nial hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangpa in, \" TOPA thu mang lo na hi manin kei tawh na kikhen phetin humpi khat in nang hong that ding hi,\" a ci hi. Tuateh mipa a paikhiat ciangin humpi tuaka amah that hi.","title":"Kamsangpa in Ahab Mawhpaih","ref":"1Ku 13:24"},"37":{"text":"Kamsangpa in midang khat mu a, \"Nong hehpihna-in kei hong sat in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin mipa in amah sat-a a liam hi."},"38":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangpa pai-a, kumpipa ngakin lam gei-ah a ding hi. A mit tungsiah a lu tunin a mel a sel hi."},"39":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama omna a nawk ciangin kamsangpa in amah sam-a, \"Na nasempa gal haksatna ah ka kuana, mi khat in kei kiangah galmatsa khat hong paipih in, ‘Hih mipa cing in, amah na khahsuah leh amah nuntakna tangin nang nuntakna hi dinga, tua ahikeh ngun talent khat a na pia pelmawh ding hi,’ hong ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Na nasempa hih lai, hua lai-ah ka manlah kalin mipa na mang hi,\" a ci hi. Israel kumpipa in tua pen nangma thuak ding thukhenna ahi hi. Nang le nang thu a kikhen khin na hi hi,\" a ci hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangpa in a lu tunna a mit pan lakhiavat a, Israel kumpipa in kamsangte khat ahilam a thei hi."},"42":{"text":"Amah in kumpipa kiangah, \" TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘A si b dinga ka sehsa mi khat na khahkhia hi. Tua ahi ciangin ama nuntakna tangin nang nuntakna hi dinga, ama mite tangin nangma mite ahi ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"43":{"text":"Israel kumpipa heh kawmin maimialsa in Samaria kumpi-inn ah a ciah hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit a sawt loin Jezreel-te Naboth lengguilo tawh kisai thu khat a piang hi. Tua lengguilo Jezreel sung hi a, Samaria kumpipa Ahab kumpi-inn tawh a kinai hi.","title":"Naboth’ Lenggui-lo"},"2":{"text":"Ahab in Naboth kiangah, \"Na lengguilo ka kumpi-inn tawh kinai ahi manin anteh sawlbawk huan dingin kei hong pia in. Tua tangin lengguilo hoihzaw khat ahikeh na deih zawk leh a man zahzah tawh kong lei ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Naboth in, \"Ka pate gou ka luah hi-a, TOPA in nang kong piak ding a phal kei hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"4":{"text":"Jezreel-te Naboth in, \"Ka pate gou ka luah nang kong pia kei ding hi,\" ci ahi manin Ahab heh kawmin maimialsa in a inn ah a ciah hi. A lupna tungah lumin nuaka an a ne nuam kei hi.","ref":"1Ku 20:43"},"5":{"text":"A zi Jezebel sungtumin, \"Bang hanga maimialkeei na hi hiam? Bang dinga an ne lo na hi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in tuanu kiangah, \"Jezreel-te Naboth kiangah, ‘Na lengguilo hong zuak in, na deih zawk leh zong tua tangin mun dang ah lenggui lo khat kong pia ding hi,’ ka ci hi. Ahi hangin amah in, ‘Ka lengguilo kong pia kei ding hi,’ hong ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"A zi Jezebel in, \"Israel tungah kumpi sem hi buang lo na hiam? Tho inla an ne in! Kilungnuamsak in. Jezreel-te Naboth lengguilo nang kong ngahsak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 8:14"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Ahab minin laikhak gelh-a, a seal tum-in Naboth khuapi ah amah tawh a tengkhawm upate le uliante a khak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua laikhak sungah: \"Antan ni ding khat zasak unla mite lak a thupina munah Naboth tusak un."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah tawh kigalsai-in mibang lo nih tusak unla amah in Pasian le kumpipa hamsiat hi cih teci pangsak un. Tua ciangin paikhiatpih unla suangin denglum un,\" ci-in a gelh hi.","ref":"Ns 6:11; Pk 22:28; Sp 24:15-16"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naboth’ khuapi a teng upate le uliante in Jezebel in amaute lai a khakna sunga a gelhsa bangin a hih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in antan ding zasak uh a, mite lak a thupina munah Naboth a tusak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin mibang lo nih hong pai uh a, amah tawh kigalsai in a tu uh hi; mite mai-ah Naboth mawhsak uh a, \"Naboth in Pasian le kumpipa hamsiat hi,\" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah khuanawl ah paikhiatpih in suangin a denglum uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jezebel thu zasak uh a: \"Naboth suangin kideng khina si ta hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 9:26; Isa 58:4"},"15":{"text":"Jezebel in Naboth suangin kidenglum khin hi, cih thu a zak phetin Ahab kiangah, \"Ding inla Jezreel-te Naboth in nang hong zuak nop loh lenggui-lo la-in tang in. Amah nungta nawn lo hi, si ta hi,\" a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahab in Naboth sih a zak ciangin tho-a paisuka, Naboth lengguilo la-in a tang hi.","ref":"1Sa 8:14"},"17":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin Tishbe-te Elijah tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"18":{"text":"\"Samaria a uk Israel kumpipa tawh kimu dingin paisuk in. Amah tu-in ama tanh ding a la dingin apaina Naboth lengguilo ah a om hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama kiangah, ‘ TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Mi khat thatin a van laksak hi lo na hi hiam?’ ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah, ‘ TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: Naboth sisan uite in a liahna munah uite in nang sisan zong a liak ding uh hi - hi hi, nangma aa!’ ci in,\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahab in Elijah kiangah, \"Ka galpa aw, kei hong mu zo mah teh!\" a ci hi. Amah in, \"Nang hong mu zo mah ing, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA mitah a gilo dingin na kizuak hi."},"21":{"text":"Nang tungah siatna kong tungsak ding hi. Nasuan na khakte kong hultum dinga, Israel-a om Ahab pana pasal peuhmah - sila ahi a sila lo ahi zongin ka beisak khin ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Na innkuan, Nebat tapa Jeroboam innkuan le Ahijah tapa Baasha innkuan ka bangsak ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in kei hong phinin nong hehsak a, Israel mawhna na bawlsak hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 12:30; 14:10; 15:29"},"23":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin Jezebel tawh kisai-in zong TOPA in: ‘Uite in Jezreel kulh a phungah Jezebel a netum ding uh hi,’ ci hi."},"24":{"text":"\"Ahab tawh kisai-a khuapi sung a site uite in ne ding uh a, gam sunga site huihlak vasate in kivakna-in a nei ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"(A zi Jezebel in kun-a, Ahab gamtat banga TOPA mit ah gitloh gamtat dinga amah le amah a kizuak mi khat beek a om ngei nai kei hi."},"26":{"text":"TOPA in Israel mai-ah a hawlkhiat Amor-te bangin milimte nung zui-in gamtatsia penin a gamta ahi hi.)","ref":"Pc 15:16"},"27":{"text":"Ahab in hih thute a zak ciangin a puan balkeka ippi silhin an a tang hi. Ippi silhin kiniamkhiat takin avak khiankhian hi.","ref":"Pc 37:34; 2Sa 3:31; 2Ku 6:30"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Tishbe-te Elijah tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"29":{"text":"\"Ka mai-ah Ahab a kiniamkhiat lam na phawk hiam? Amahmah kiniamkhiat ahi manin hih siatna ama hun sungin ka tungsak kei ding hi, ahi hangin a tapa hunin a innkuan tungah ka tungsak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 9:26"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aram le Israel kikal ah kum thum sung gal kidona a om kei hi.","title":"Ahab Langah Micaiah in Thugenkhol"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin a kumthumna ah Israel kumpipa tawh kimu dingin Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat a paisuk hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in a uliante tungah, \"Ramoth Gilead ei aa hi napi bangmah cih loin Aram kumpipa tung pan i lak kik loh lam na thei uh hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 4:43"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Ramoth Gilead nong simpih ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiangah, \"Nang tawh a kibang ka hi hi, ka mite nang mi hi-a, ka sakolte nangma sakol ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"2Ku 3:7"},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jehoshaphat in zong Israel kumpipa kiangah, \"A masa penin TOPA thu dong in,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in kamsangte kikhawmsak a - mi zali khawng - amaute kiangah, \"Ramoth Gilead sim dingin ka kuan ding hiam, ahikeh ka thuak lel ding hiam,\" ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, \"Kuan in, Topa in kumpipa khutah hong pia ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 18:19"},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jehoshaphat in, \"Hih lai-ah i dot theih ding TOPA kamsang khat om lo hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"8":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \" TOPA thu i dot theih ding mi khat om lai hi, ahi hangin amah ka mudah hi, bang hang hiam cih leh kei tawh kisai a hoih khat beek genkhol ngei lo-a a sia bekbek a gen hi. Amah Imlah tapa Micaiah ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi. Jehoshaphat in, \"Kumpipa in tua bang ci kei in,\" ci-in a dawng kik hi.","ref":"Isa 5:20"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in a uliante khat sam-a, \"Imlah tapa Micaiah hong sampak dih un,\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in a kumpi puan uh silhin Samaria lutna kongpi kianga ancilna phualzanga, kumpi tokhom tungah tu uh a, amaute mai-ah kamsang khempeuh in kam a sang uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua laitakin Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kite bawl a, \" TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Aram-te a kisiat khit matengin hihte tawh na piik ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"Tp 33:17"},"12":{"text":"Kamsang dangte khempeuh in a kibangin kam a sang uh hi. Amaute in, \" TOPA in kumpipa khutah hong pia ding ahi manin Ramoth Gilead simin gualzo in,\" a ci uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Micaiah sam dinga pai kamtaipa in a kiangah \"En in, kamsang dangte khempeuh in mi khat gen bangin kumpipa zawh dingin a gen uh hi. Nang zong amaute aa tawh kibang sak inla a gum lamin pau lel in,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin Micaiah in, \" TOPA nuntakna lo a ka cih inah TOPA in kei tunga hong gen bek ama tungah ka gen thei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 22:18"},"15":{"text":"Amah a tun ciangin kumpipa in, \"Micaiah, Ramoth Gilead sim dingin ka kuan ding uh hiam; ahikeh ka thuak lel ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. \" TOPA in kumpipa khutah hong pia ding hi; sim in na zo ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Bangmah dang gen loin thutak na gen nadingin TOPA minin bangzah vei hong kiciamsak ding ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Micaiah in, \"Israel khempeuh mualtungah a cing om lo tuu bangin a kithehthang ka mu a, TOPA in, ‘Hih mite pu nei lo ahi uh hi. Amaute inn ciatah lungnuamin ciah uh hen,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 27:17; Mt 9:36"},"18":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Amah in kei tungah a hoih khat beek gen ngei lo-a a sia bek gen hi, ci-a hong gen hi lo ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Micaiah in, \"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA thugen za un: TOPA a kumpi tokhom tungah tu a, ama mihonpite khempeuh a taklam le a veilam a kimkotah a ding ka mu hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in, ‘Ramoth Gilead sima a sih nadingin kua in Ahab va zol ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi. \"Khat in khat gena, adang khat in a tuam khat a gen hi.","ref":"Job 1:6; Isa 6:1; Da 7:9"},"21":{"text":"A nunung penin kha khat a mai-ah pai-in TOPA mai-ah dinga, \"Ke’n amah ka zol ding hi,’ ci hi."},"22":{"text":"\" TOPA in, ‘Bangci bangin?’ ci-in a dong hi. \"Amah in, ‘Ka paikhia dinga, ama kamsangte khempeuh kamah kha zuau ka va suak ding hi,’ ci hi. \" TOPA in pai inla hih in, amah zol lecin na zo ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Thk 9:23; 2Th 2:11"},"23":{"text":"\"Tua hi a tu-in TOPA in na kamsangte khempeuh kam ah kha zuau a koih khin hi. TOPA in na thuak ding gimna khentat khin hi,\" ci-in a thugen a zom lai hi.","ref":"Eze 14:9"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah paito in, Macaiah maitang a beng hi. Amah in, \"Nang hopih dingin kei kiang pan amah hong pai ciangin TOPA kiang pana a a kha in koi lampi pen tawn ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi.","ref":"tg 11; Ns 23:2"},"25":{"text":"Micaiah in, \"Inn tawngnung sungah na buk ni ciangin na mu khia ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"1Ku 20:30"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in, \"Micaiah paipih unla khuapi ukpa Amon le kumpipa tapa Joash kiangah puakkik un,"},"27":{"text":"‘Kumpipa in: Bittaka kong tun kik mateng hih pa thong sungah khumin anlum le tuisik longal bangmah pia kei un, ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"28":{"text":"Micaiah in, \"Bittaka nong kileh tak leh, TOPA in kei tungah thu a gen lo hi ding hi,\" a cikhia hi. Tua ciangin, \"No mite khempeuh aw, ka thugen ciamteh un!\" a cih beh lai hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat, Ramoth Gilead ah a kuanto uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Ka melsel in gal sungah va kuan ningin nang na kumpi puante silh in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in a mel sela gal sungah a kuan hi.","title":"Ramoth Gilead ah Ahab Kithat","ref":"2Kh 35:32"},"31":{"text":"Tua laitakin Aram kumpipa in a sakolleng ukte sawmthum le nih thu pia-a, \"Israel kumpipa longal aneu alian khatpeuh tawh kido kei un,\" a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Sakolleng ukte in Jehoshaphat a muh uh ciangin, \"Israel kumpipa hi taktak hi,\" ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi. Tua ciangin amah sim dingin a kihei uh hi, ahi zongin Jehoshaphat a kiko khiat ciangin"},"33":{"text":"sakolleng ukte in Israel kumpipa ahi lohlam thei uh a, amah a delh nawn kei uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Ahi hangin mi khatin a thal kekin mawk lot a, Israel kumpipa kidalnate kikal a kha hi. Kumpipa in a sakol-leng hawlpa kiangah, \"Kidona sung panin leng hawlkhia in, hong paikhiatpih in. Ka liam hi,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"35":{"text":"Sun niloh nasiatakin gal kido-a, kumpipa a sakolleng tungah kingamsa in Aram-te lam nga-in a om hi. A liamma panin sakolleng sungah a sisan luanga tua ni nitak in a si hi."},"36":{"text":"Ni tum laitakin galkap khempeuh lakah: \"A kuamahpeuh amau khuapi ciat, amau gam ciat ah!\" kitangko hi.","ref":"2Ku 14:12"},"37":{"text":"Tua bangin kumpipa si-a Samaria ah kipua in tua lai-ah a kivui hi."},"38":{"text":"Amaute in a sakolleng Samaria a bual (a kizuakte kisilna) b ah sil uh a, TOPA thu in a pulaksa bangin uite in a sisan a liak uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahab uk sunga thupiang dangte, ama sepsa khempeuh kumpi inn lama saiha tawh a tuam, le khuapite kulh-a a umte Israel kumpite khangthu ciamtehna laibu sungah kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"40":{"text":"Ahab a pate tawh tawlnga khawm hi. A tapa Ahaziah in luah a kumpi a suak hi.","ref":"2Kh 9:17; Am 3:15"},"41":{"text":"Israel kumpi Ahab a kumlina kumin Asa tapa Jehoshaphat Judah kumpi a suak hi."},"42":{"text":"Jehoshaphat kumpi a suahin kum sawmthum le nga pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih le nga sung a mang hi. A nu min Azubah hi-a Shilhi tanu ahi hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoshaphat"},"43":{"text":"Na khempeuh ah a pa lampite zui-in, tuate a pialsan kei hi; TOPA mitah amaanin na a sem hi. Ahi zongin munsangte kihemkhia loin mite in tua lai-ah biakna pia uh a gimnamtui a hal uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in zong Israel kumpipa tawh kilemna a bawl hi."},"45":{"text":"Jehoshaphat uk sunga thupiang dangte, a matutnate le a galkapte thahatnate Judah kumpite khangthu ciamtehna laibu sungah kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"46":{"text":"Amah in gam sunga pasal kizuakte’ biakbuknote, a pa Asa man’ khita om laite nangawn a beisak hi."},"47":{"text":"Tua ciangin Edom ah kumpi om lo-a, kumpipa nuai-a pa in a uk hi."},"48":{"text":"Tu-in Jehoshaphat in kham zongin Ophir a pai nading sumbuk tembawpite c bawla, ahi hangin tuate a paikhia ngei kei hi - tuate Ezion Beber ah kisia hi."},"49":{"text":"Tua hun teh Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Ka mite na mite tawh tonsak in,\" a cih hangin Jehoshaphat in a nial hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:26"},"50":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jehoshaphat a pate tawh tawlnga khawma, amaute tawh a pa David khuapi ah kivuikhawm hi. A tapa Jehoram in a za a luah hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:31-21:1"},"51":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in a uk a kum sawm le sagihna kumin Samaria ah Ahab tapa Ahaziah Israel kumpi suaka, Israel ah kum nih sung a mang hi."},"52":{"text":"Amah in a nu le a pa tot lampi le Israel mawhna bawlsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam lampite tawn ahi manin TOPA mitah a sia-in a gamta hi.","title":"Israel Kumpi Ahaziah"},"53":{"text":"Amah in a pate hihsa bang tektekin Baal na semin bia-a, TOPA , Israel Pasian phinin a hehsak hi."}}}}},"12":{"info":{"name":"2 Kumpite","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab a sih khit ciangin Moab in Israel a lehdo hi.","title":"Ahaziah tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in Samaria a, a inndei tungnung a vathangheng panin Ahaziah kia-a a liam hi. Tua ahi ciangin tu-a na lupna na kan nawn kei ding hi. Na si taktak ding hi!\" hong ci hi,’ ci un,\" a ci uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"No tawh kimu dinga hong pai-a hih thu hong gen mi a bangci khat ahi hiam?\" ci-in amaute a dong hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Amah in samul puan silh-a, a kawngah savun kawnggak a gak hi,\" a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in, \"Tishbi-te Elijah ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in galkap sawmnga a uk galkap bupa a mi teng tawh Elijah kiangah a sawl hi. Amah in, \"Pasian mipa aw, kumpipa in, ‘Hong paisuk hen!’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 18:25; 2Ku 6:14"},"10":{"text":"Elijah in, \"Kei Pasian mipa ka hihleh van panin meikuang hong kiasuk henla nang le na mi sawmngate hong kangtum hen!\" ci-in a ukpa a dawng hi. Amah in, \"Pasian mipa aw, na nasemte keima nuntakna le hih mi sawmngate nuntakna hong thusimsak in!"},"14":{"text":"En in, van panin meikuang kia-a, a masa bu nih le amau mite khempeuh a kangtum uh hi. Tuateh mi sawmnga sawl uh a, ni thum sung a zon uh hangin a mu kei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Jericho a om Elisha kiangah amaute hong kilehkik uh ciangin amaute kiangah, \"Pai kei un hong ci hi lo ka hiam?\" a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Khuapi mite in Elisha kiangah, \"En in, kote topa aw, na muh mah bangin hih khuapi omna mun a hoih hi, ahi hangin tui hoih lo-a, leitang ah bangmah a piang kei hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in, \"Kuang-uk thak khat hong la unla a sungah ci koih un,\" a ci hi. Amaute in, \"Talkolhpa aw, paito in, Talkolhpa aw, paito in,\" ci uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah kihei-in amaute en a, TOPA minin a hamsiat hi. Tu-in nang bang hong kihihsak ding hiam? Nang tangin kumpipa ahi a galkap mangpa tung ahi zongin kong gensak ding uh a om hiam?’ ci in,\" a ci hi. Tuanu in, \"Ka mipihte lakah inn nei khat hi buang ing,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"2Ku 8:1"},"14":{"text":"Elisha in, \"Tuanu ading bang kisepsak ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Gehazi in, \"Pha hi, a pasal lah tekta a, ta pasal a nei kei hi,\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elisha in, \"Tuanu sam in,\" a ci hi. A pa in nasem khat kiangah, \"A nu kiangah va gen in,\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Nasempa in amah domin a nu kiangah a puak khit ciangin, a nu in a angah sun dong tawi-in, tuateh amah si hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuanu kahto a, Pasian mipa lupna ah sialin, kong khaknelhin a paikhia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tuanu in a pasal sam-a, \"Pasian mipa kiangah pai mengmengin kong kileh kik theih nadingin hehpihna in nasemte khat laa tawh hong sawl dih in,\" a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuapa in, \"Bang hangin tuni-in pai ding na hi hiam? Kha Thak lah hi lo a Sabbath ni zong a hi kei hi,\" a ci hi. Tuanu in \"Phamawh kei,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 10:10; 1Kh 23:31; Ph 81:3"},"24":{"text":"Amah in laa tutphah vawhin a nasempa kiangah, \"Masa in; kong gen kei leh kei cihna-in ol paisak tuan kei in,\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuanu paikhia a, Carmel Vum a Pasian mipa omna a tung hi. Pasian mipa in tuanu a galmuh ciangin amah in a nasempa Gehazi kiangah, \"En in! Hua lai-ah Shunem numei hong pai hi!"},"26":{"text":"Amah dawn dingin va tai inla, ‘Na dam hiam? Na pasal a dam hiam? Na naupang a dam hiam?’ ci-in va dong dih in,\" a ci hi. Tuanu in, \"Dam kim ung,\" a ci hi."},"27":{"text":"Mualtung a Pasian mipa kiangah tuanu a tun ciangin a khete a len hi. Amah sawnkhia dingin Gehazi pai hi, ahi hangin Pasian mipa in, \"Tuaci omsak lel in! Lungzinna mahmah khat nei hi, ahi hangin TOPA in kei kiang panin sel-a bang hong im hiam cih hong gen nai lo hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 1:15"},"28":{"text":"Tuanu in, \"Ka topa aw, tapa hong ngen ka hi hiam?’ Ka lametnate sangkhai dah in’ hong ci hi lo ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"29":{"text":"Elisha in Gehazi kiangah, \"Na kawng gakin na puantualpi gak inla ka ciangkhut tawi-in va tai in. Naupang maitangah ka ciangkhut va nga in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 7:19; 1Ku 18:46"},"30":{"text":"Ahi hangin naupangno’ nu in, \" TOPA nuntak na le nangma nuntakna lo in ka cih inah nang kong paisan kei ding hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Elisha dawn dingin Gehazi kileh kik a, ama kiangah, \"Naupang khanglo tuan lopi,\" a ci hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua inn ah Elisha a tun ciangin ama lupna tungah naupang a sisa in a na lum hi."},"33":{"text":"A sungah lut-a, amau gel bek a sungah omin kong khaka TOPA tungah thu a ngen hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ciangin lupna tungah kahto a, naupangno kam le ama kam, a mit le ama mit, a khut le ama khut sutuahin a tungah a bok hi. Tua ciangin a ne thei kei uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Elisha in, \"Annel tawm hong la dih un,\" a ci hi. Beel sungah kha a, \"Mite nek dingin lui in,\" a ci hi. TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Amaute in ne ding uh a, a khamval lai ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Zakhat Vakna"},"44":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute mai-ah lui-a, amaute in ne in TOPA thu mah bangin a khamval lai uh hi.","ref":"Lk 9:13; Jn 6:12"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in Aram kumpipa’ galkap mangpa Naaman ahi hi. Amah in a nasemte nih tungah pia-a amaute in Gehazi mai-ah tuate a puak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Mual ah Gehazi a tun ciangin nasemte tung pan tua nate la-a, inn sungah a koih hi. Gehazi in, \"Na nasempa koimah ah ka pai kei hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin Elisha in ama kiangah, \"Mipa nang tawh kituak dingin sakolleng pan a kumin ka kha nang tawh om hi lo a hi hiam? Amaute Jordan ah paisuk uh a, sing a phuk uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute khat in sing a phuk laitakin a heitang tui sungah a kiasak hi. Lengtui sukna phual pan maw?\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuanu kiangah, \"Bang thu ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Kumpipa in kamtai ma paisak a, ahi hangin ama tun ma-in Elisha in upate kiangah, \"Hih mithatpa in ka ngawng tan dingin mi hong sawl mu lo na hi uh hiam? Ama nungah a pu’ khe ging hi lo ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"33":{"text":"Amaute kiangah a gengen laitakin kamtaipa ama kiang a tung suk ta hi. Tuateh kumpipa in, \"Hih siatna TOPA kiang pan ahi hi. TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Zingciang tu bang hun pawlin annel seah khat a shekel khat b le mangbuh-ham seah nih c ciang shekel khatin Samaria kongpi ah kizuak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa a ban ah a kingapna ulianpa in Pasian mipa kiangah, \"En in, TOPA in vantung tuidalnate nangawn a hong zongin hih thu piang thei ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi. Amaute in, \"Bang dinga i sih dong hih lai-ah om ding i hi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Khuapi sungah pai ni cileng - tua lai-ah kialpi tunga, i si ding hi. Hih lai-ah om den lehang lah i si veve ding hi. Amaute in hong hingkhawi uh leh a nungta; hong thah uh leh lah a si hi ni,\" ci-in khat le khat a kikum uh hi.","title":"Umcihna Kikhaangto","ref":"Sp 13:45-46; Ms 5:1-4"},"5":{"text":"Amaute khuamial lai pi-in tho uh a Aram-te giahphual ah a pai uh hi. Kileh kikin puanbuk dang khatah lut leuleu uh a, tua pan na pawlkhat la-in tuate zong a sel uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute khat le khat kiho uh a, \"I hihzia man lo hi. Pai pahin hih thu kumpi innah va zasak ni,\" a kici uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute pai uh a, khuapi kongpi cingte samkhia-in, \"Ko teng Aram-te giahphuala pai ka hi uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin a omlai sunte pana a baanglaite adingin thu ngen in,\" ci-in a gen uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 16:12"},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah uliante Isaiah kiang a tun uh ciangin,"},"6":{"text":"Isaiah in amaute kiangah, \"Na pu uh kiangah gen un: ‘ TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Na zaksate uh hangin lau kei un - Assyria kumpipa khutnuai mite kampaute in kei hong simmawh zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai un! Tuateh a tapa Josiah in a kumpi za luah a kumpi a suak hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah kumpi a suahin a khan kum giat pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le khat sung a uk hi. Lau kei inla lungkia kei in.","ref":"Jos 1:6-9; 1Ku 3:9-12"},"14":{"text":"\" TOPA biakinnpi adingin haksapi-a ka khop kham talent a tul zakhat, ngun talent b tul zasawm le sumngo le sik teh zawhloh le sing le suangte ka khol khin hi. Nang in tuate na behlap thei hi."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah in nasem tampi: suang-atte, lei inn lam siamte, sing inn lam siamte banah nasep namkim a siam:"},"16":{"text":"kham, ngun, sumngo le sik nasep siamte - khutsiam sim zawh loh na nei hi. Tu-in kipan ta in, TOPA in nang hong ompih ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"tg 11; 2Kh 2:7"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel makaite khempeuh in a tapa Solomon a huh nadingun David in thu a pia hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, \" TOPA note Pasian, no tawh omkhawm hi lo ahi hiam?
