A makai-in Judah teel-a, tuateh Judah innkuan panin kei innkuan teel-a, ka pa tapate panin Israel khempeuh a uk kumpi dingin kei a lungkim hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka tapate khempeuh - TOPA in tampi hong piakte sungah - TOPA kumpi-gam kumpi tokhom ah tu-in Israel a uk dingin ka tapa Solomon a teel khin hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in kei tungah, ‘Na tapa Solomon ka tapa dingin ka teel khina, kei ama aa hi ding ka hi manin amah in ka inn le ka huangte a lam ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in ka thupiakte le ka thukhamte, tu huna a kizuih bangin kiheisan loin a zuih nak leh a kumpi-gam ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:13"},"8":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin tu-in TOPA mai-a kikhawm Israel khempeuh muhna le eite Pasian zaka kong sawl inah: Note in hih gam hoih nei-in note suante dongah goutanh-a a neihsuak theih nadingun TOPA note Pasian thupiakte khempeuh limtakin zui un.","ref":"Tp 4:1; 6:1"},"9":{"text":"Tuateh nang ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa’ Pasian thei in, TOPA in lungsim khempeuh zonga ngaihsutna zui-a gamtatnate theitel ahi manin na lungsim neihzahin ki-ap inla lungsim utsa in ama na sem in. Amah na zon leh na mu ding hi; amah na taisan leh amah in a tawntungin nang hong nolh ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA in mun siangtho ding biakinnpi khat lam dingin nang hong teel khin ahi manin ngaihsun in. Hat inla na sem in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 16:7; 2Kh 15:2"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon tungah biakinnpi talaap, a innpite, a van koihna inndeite, a tungnung khente, a sungnung inndeite, le thoihdamna munte a geelna a pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in Kha in a lungsima a guat khempeuh - biakinnpi tualte, a kimkota inndeite, TOPA biakinnpi goukholnate le a ki-ap nate kholnate geelna amah a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in siampite le Levi-te khenna lahna le TOPA biakinnpi sunga biakna nasep nading khempeuh le nasepna-a zat ding nate khempeuh, a zatzia ding khempeuh lahnate a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in nasepna tuamtuama zat ding kham vanzatte khempeuh a gikna a tuamin koih a, nasepna a tuamtuam a zat ding ngun vanzatte gikna tuam koih in:"},"15":{"text":"kham meivak tunnate le meivakte gikna, meivak tunna le a meivak khat gikna; meivak khat tunna a zatna tawh kizui-in, ngun meivak tunna le a meivak ciat a gikna,"},"16":{"text":"anlum apna kham sabuaite a gikna ciat; ngun sabuaite ading ngun gikna;"},"17":{"text":"kham citak sikkeu-kate, tuithehna kuang-ukte le sikkeu-ka bulneite a gikna; kham kuang khat a kham gikna ciat; ngun kuang khat a ngun gikna ciat;"},"18":{"text":"le gimnamtui biakna-tau ding kham siangsa giknate a pia hi. Amah in kham cherub-te in a khate uh zalin TOPA thukhun singkuangpi a liah nadingin a geelna zong a pia hi.","ref":"Pk 25:18-22"},"19":{"text":"David in, \"Hihte khempeuh lai-a kigelh ahi hi, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA khut in kei hong ompih a, geelna khempeuh a neng a tawngin kei hong theitelsak hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 25:9; 1Ku 6:38"},"20":{"text":"David in a tapa Solomon kiangah zong, \"Hat inla hangin na sem in. Pasian, TOPA keima Pasian in nang hong ompih ahi manin kihta kei inla lungkia kei in. Amah in TOPA biakinnpi sep a kizawh matengin hong lawhsamsak loin hong taisan kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Pasian biakinnpi-a nasem dingin siampite le Levi-te a khenkhenin om khin uh a, khutsiamna a nei peuhmah in amau utthu-in nasep khempeuh hong huh ding uh hi. Uliante le mite khempeuh in na sawl peuhpeuh hong mang ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 35:25-36:5; Tp 31:6"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi David in a kikhawm buppi tungah: \"Pasian in a teelsa ka tapa Solomon khangmoi-in a pumpi-in tuahkhak a nei nai kei hi. Hih nasep a lian mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh inn thupi lah mihing ading hi loin TOPA Pasian ading ahi hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Lam nadinga Kipiate"},"2":{"text":"Ka hih theihna lamcinin ka Pasian biakinnpi ding - kham zat nading ah kham, ngun zat nading ah ngun, sumngo zat nading ah sumngo, sik zat nading ah sik, sing zat nading ah sing, hihte banah phuh dingin Onyx, suang dum-eng, suang mel tuamtuamte le suang hoih a namkim le suangpak - hihte khempeuh tampitak ka khol khin hi."},"3":{"text":"Tuate banah keima Pasian biakinnpi adingin ka apsa, keima goukholna-a ngun le khamte ka Pasian biakinnpi adingin ka pia-a, hih biakinn siangtho adingin ka khol peuhmah:"},"4":{"text":"kham talent b tulthum (Ophir kham) le a kisiangsaksa ngun talent c tulsagih hi a, tuate innkawmte tunga luan ding,"},"5":{"text":"kham zatna le ngun zatnate-a zat ding le khutsiamte in a sep ding uh nasepnate a zat ding ahi hi. Tu-in TOPA tungah tuni-in no utthu-in kua teng ki-ap nuam na hi uh hiam?\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin innkuan makaite, Israel beh uliante, a tulte a ukte le a zate a ukte le kumpipa na a semte a ukte amau utthu-in a kipia uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian biakinnpi lam nadingin kham talent d tulnga le daric e tulsawm, ngun talent f tulsawm, sumngo talent g tulsawm le tulgiat le sik talent h tul zakhat a pia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Suang manpha a nei peuhmah in Gershon-te Jehiel kepna mun TOPA biakinnpi goukholna ah a pia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"A makaite un a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amau utthu-a TOPA tunga a kipiakna uh hangin mipite a nuam uh hi. Kumpipa David zong a nuam lua mahmah hi.","ref":"1Ku 8:61; 1Kh 26:21; 2Co 9:7"},"10":{"text":"A kikhawm mipi bup omin David in TOPA phat a, \"Kote pa Israel Pasian TOPA aw, tawntung pan a tawntung dongin nang hong kiphat hen.","title":"David Thungetna"},"11":{"text":"TOPA aw, leitung le vantunga na khempeuh nang aa ahi manin liatna le vangliatna nang aa hi-a, minthanna ukzawhna le thupina nangma aa ahi hi. TOPA aw, kumpi-gam nangma aa hi a; na khempeuh lutangin hong kitawisang hi.","ref":"Ph 24:8; Ph 24:8; Kil 5:12-13"},"12":{"text":"Hauhna le pahtawina nang tung panin hong pai hi a; na khempeuh a ukpa nangmah na hi hi. Na khut sungah na khempeuh tawisang nading le hatsak nading hatna le vangliatna a om hi.","ref":"2Kh 1:12; 2Kh 20:6; Ro 11:36"},"13":{"text":"Kote Pasian aw, tu-in nang tungah lungdam kong ko uh a, a minthang na min ka phat uh hi."},"14":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin cinghtaka hong pia thei dingin kei kua hi a, ka mite kua ahi hiam? Na khempeuh nangmah pana hong pai hi-a, nang khut pana hong pai bek hong pia ka hi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Kote le ka pute khempeuh uh nang muhna-ah pemta le mikhual ka hi uh hi. Leitungah ka nuntak hun uh lametna om loin niliim tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"TOPA kote Pasian aw, na Min Siangtho ading biakinnpi lam nadingin kong piak uh a tampite nangma khut pana hong pai mah hi a, nangma aa vive ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, nang in lungsim na zia-et lam ka thei-a, cihtakna ah na lungkim hi. Hih nate khempeuh ka utthu-in thumaantakin kong pia hi. Tua ciangin hih lai-a om na mite in utna tawh nang hong piakzia lung nuamtakin ka mu khin hi."},"18":{"text":"TOPA ka pate uh Abraham, Isaac le Israel Pasian aw, na mite lungsim ah hih utna omsak den inla amaute nang tungah muanhuaisak in."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka tapa Solomon na thupiakte a kisapnate le na thukipte ah a lungsim khempeuh in semsak zo inla ka topsaksa inn lianpi lamna ah ki-ap zosak in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 22:14"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin David in a kikhawm mipi buppi tungah, \" TOPA note Pasian phat un,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh in TOPA a pate uh Pasian phat uh a; TOPA le kumpipa mai-ah kunin a khupbawh uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A zing ciangin TOPA biakna pia in ama tungah meihal biakna-in: bawngtal tulkhat, tuutal tulkhat, le tuuno a nu tulkhat tawh dawntheih-a biakna, biakna dangte tampitak Israel khempeuh aitangin a pia uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute in tuani-in TOPA omin ne-in dawn uh a nuam a sa uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in David tapa Solomon a nihveina kumpipa-in sang uh a, TOPA mai-ah gam uk dingin sathau nilhin, tuateh siampi dingin Zadok sathau a nilh uh hi.","title":"Solomon Kumpi Suak","ref":"1Ku 8:62; 1Kh 23:1"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA kumpi tokhom a pa David munah kumpi in Solomon a tu hi. Amah lamzangin Israel khempeuh in a thu a mang uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Uliante le mi thahatte khempeuh in Kumpi David tapate tawh Kumpi Solomon tungah a tokaina-un a kiciam uh hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in Israel khempeuh muhna-ah Solomon tawisang a, ama ma-a Israel kumpite khat beek tua banga kumpi thupina a piak a om nai kei hi.","ref":"1Ku 1:28-53; 3:13"},"26":{"text":"Israel khempeuh a uk kumpi, Jesse tapa David ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in kum sawmli sung Israel uk a - Hebron ah kumthum omin Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le sagih a om hi.","title":"David Sihna"},"28":{"text":"Amah a tek hoih bek laitakin si-a, hauhna le pahtawina ngahin sawtpi a nungta hi. A tapa Solomon in a za luah a kumpi a suak hi."},"29":{"text":"Kumpi David in a uk sung a kipatna pan a tawpna dong thumupa Samuel ciamtehna sung, kamsangpa Nathan ciamtehna sung le thumupa Gad ciamtehna sunga kigelh hi a,"},"30":{"text":"ama ukna a vangliatna, ama tunga thupiang khempeuh le Israel tung le adang kumpi-gamte a, a sepnate aneng atawngin kigelh khawm ahi hi."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"2 Khangthute","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David tapa Solomon in a kumpi-gam kiptakin a uk hi, ahang in, TOPA ama Pasian in amah ompiha, a liansak mahmah hi.","title":"Solomon in Pilna Ngen","ref":"Pc 39:2; 1Ku 2:12,26; 1Kh 29:25"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in Israel khempeuh tung - a tulte a ukte tung le a zate a ukte tung, thukhente tung le Israel sunga makaite khempeuh, innkuan lutangte tungah thu gena -"},"3":{"text":"tuateh Solomon le mipi buppi Gibeon a munsang ah a pai uh hi; ahang in, TOPA nasempa Moses in a lam Kikhopna Puanbuk Pasian aa tua lai-ah a om hi."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in David in Kiriath Jearim panin a om nadinga a bawlsa munah singkuangpi a puakto khin hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Jerusalem ah tua koih nading puanbuk a zak khitsa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin Hur tapa, Uri tapa Bezalel in a bawlsa sumngo biakna-tau Gibeon-a TOPA biakbuk mai-ah om a; Solomon le amah tawh a kikhawm mipite in amah thu a va dong uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kikhopna Puanbuk sung TOPA mai-a sumngo biakna-tau ah Solomon paito a, tua tungah meihal biakna tulkhatte a lui hi.","ref":"Pk 36:8; 38:2"},"7":{"text":"Tua zanin Solomon tungah Pasian kilang a, \"Nang kong piak ding na deih peuhpeuh hong ngen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 7:12"},"8":{"text":"Solomon in Pasian kiangah, \"Ka pa David tungah na migitna lianpi na lak khina, ama munah kei kumpi-in nong koih khin hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA Pasian aw, ka pa David tungah na khapsa kipsak in, ahang in, leivui zaha tam mipi tungah kei kumpi nong suaksak khin hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih mite ka makaih theih nadingin pilna le theihna hong pia in, ahang in, hihzah a tam na mite kua in uk thei ding ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Pasian in Solomon tungah, \"Hih in nangma lungsim deihna ahi neih le lam, hauhna ahikeh pahtawina, na galte sih nadingte nong nget loh nungsang, khansauna zong hong ngen loin kumpi kong suahsakna ka mite uk nadingin pilna le theihna hong ngen na hi manin"},"12":{"text":"tua pilna le theihna nang hong kipia ding hi. Tuateh nang ma le nang nunga kumpite in tua bang a neihloh, neih le lam, hauhna le pahtawina zong kong pia ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:25"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Gibeon a munsanga Kikhopna Puanbuk mai panin Jerusalem ah Solomon a pai hi. Tuaci-in Israel tungah a uk hi."},"14":{"text":"Solomon in sakolte le sakol-lengte zonbeh a; sakolleng tulkhat le zali le sakol a tulsawm le tulnih nei a, tuate sakolleng khuapite le ama omna Jerusalem ah a koih hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in Jerusalem ah ngun le khamte suang zatin zanga tamtak singte mualbula theiba singte bangin a tamsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Solomon sakolte b Egypt pan le Kue c pana kila hi a - kumpi sumbawlte in tuate Kue pana a lei uh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in Egypt panin leng khat ngun shekel d zaguk in la uh a, sakol khat za le sawmnga-in e a la uh hi. Amaute in Hit-te le Aram-te kumpite khempeuh tungah zong tuate a puakkhia uh hi."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA Min dinga biakinnpi lam ding le ama ading kumpi inn lam ding thu a pia hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Ding Kiginkholhnate"},"2":{"text":"Amah in van pua dingin mi tulsawm sagih, mual kawma suang at ding tul sawmgiat le tuate makaih dingin tulthum le zaguk aana-in a lasak hi.","ref":"tg 18; 2Kh 10:4"},"3":{"text":"Solomon in Tyre kumpipa Hiram f tungah: \"Ka pa David ten nading kumpi inn lam nadingin tamtak luang na puak bangin kei hong puak in."},"4":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA ka Pasian Min dingin biakinnpi khat lam ka sawm hi; tuapen ama tungah ap in, ama mai-ah a namtui gimnamtui hal nading, a ki-apsa anlum koihden nading, zingsang sim nitak sim le Sabbath ni sim, Kha Thak ni sim le a kisehsa TOPA kote Pasian pawi hun simin meihal biaknate bawl nading ahi hi. Hih in Israel adingin a kizomden biakna ngeina khat ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"\"Adang pasiante khempeuh sangin kote Pasian lianzaw ahi manin ka lam ding biakinnpi a lian mahmah ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi zongin vante, a sangpen vante nangawnah amah ta thei lo ding ahi manin ama biakinnpi ding kua in lamsak thei ding ahi hiam? Tua ahi ciangin ama mai-ah biakna hal nading mun khat cih loh biakinnpi lam dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi manin Judah le Jerusalem ah ka pa David in a zatsa keima khutsiamte tawh a semkhawm dingin ngun le kham le sik lamsang a siam, le a dupsan, a-ausan le adum puan gan siam, khuak-a a gelh ngei mi khat hong puak in."},"8":{"text":"Tua lai-a na mite singluang at a siam lam thei ka hi manin Lebanon pan tamtak sing, taksing le Algum a singluangte hong puak in."},"9":{"text":"Ka lam ding biakinnpi lianin thupi ding ahi manin sing tampi hong sik inla, ka mite in na mite tawh na semkhawm ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Keimah in sing nasem singphuk nangma nasemte adingin mangbuh gawisa bem b tul sawmnih mangbuh-ham bem tul sawmnih, lenggah zu bath c tul sawmnih, le olive thau bath tul sawm nih ka pia ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tyre kumpipa Hiram in Solomon laikhak thuk a: \" TOPA in ama mite it ahi manin amaute’ kumpi hong suaksak hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"1Ku 10:9; 2Kh 9:8"},"12":{"text":"Tuateh Hiram in: \"Van le lei a bawl TOPA Israel Pasian kiphat hen! Amah in TOPA biakinnpi ding le ama kumpi inn ding a lam dingin thutheihna le theihkak-na a nei tapa pil khat Kumpi David a pia hi.","ref":"Ph 33:6; 102:25"},"13":{"text":"\"Mi khutsiam mahmah Huram-Abi nang kiangah kong sawl hi,"},"14":{"text":"amah a nu Dan pan hi a, a pa Tyre pan ahi hi. Amah ngun le kham, sumngo le sik, sing le suang, le adupsan le adum, le a-ausan le saihadial puan hoih zem a kisinsa ahi hi. Amah mualgelh a siamsa hi-a a suaih dinga kipia lim peuhmah a hih theisa ahi hi. Amah in nangma mi ka topa David na pa khutsiamte tawh na a sem khawm ding hi.","ref":"Pk 31:6; 1Ku 7:13"},"15":{"text":"\"Tu-in ka topa in a khapsa mangbuh, mangbuh-ham le olive thau le lenggahzute, na nasemte khak inla,"},"16":{"text":"na kisap singluangte khempeuh Lebanon ah phukin tuate phongin kong bawl ding uh a Joppa dung tuipi tungah kong lamsuksak ding uh hi. Tua panin Jerusalem ah tuate na la to thei ding hi,\" a cihbeh lai hi.","ref":"Jos 19:46;Jnh 1:3"},"17":{"text":"Solomon in a pa David simsa Israel sunga pemta khempeuh sim hi; amaute 153,600 a pha uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in amaute lakah 70,000 van pua dingin seh a mual kawma suang seek dingin 80,000 sehin mite nasep vana a makaih dingin 3,600 a seh hi.","ref":"1Ku 5:1-16"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in a pa David tunga TOPA a kilaakna mun Jerusalem a Moriah Vum ah TOPA biakinnpi lam a kipan hi. Tua mun pen Jebus-te Araunah d ancilna David gelnasa mun ahi hi.","title":"Solomon in Biakinnpi Lam"},"2":{"text":"Amah in ama uk zawh a kumlina a kha nihna a ni nihna ni-in lam a kipan hi.","ref":"1Kh 21:18; Ns 7:47"},"3":{"text":"Pasian biakinnpi lam nadingin Solomon in a bul a phah (tehna lui tong cianga tehin) adung tong sawmguk sau-a, avai tong sawmnih a zai e hi."},"4":{"text":"Biakinnpi mai-a innliim a inn cia mah zai-a tong f sawmnih sau in, tong g sawmnih mah a sang hi. Amah in a sunglam kham citakin a luan hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in inndeipi sung taksing lum bekbek dap-a, kham hoihtak tawh tuamin nisuh lim le khainiang limin a zem hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in suang manpha-in biakinnpi a zem hi. Tuateh a kham zatte Parvaim kham ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in inntung dapna zawlte, kongmung-te, kawmte le biakinnpi kongpite khamin luan a, a kawmte tungah cherub-te a tuangsak hi.","ref":"Pc 3:24; 1Ku 6:29-35; Eze 40:16"},"8":{"text":"Amah in Mun Siangtho Pen lam a, a dunglam biakinnpi vai tawh kizui-in tong sawmnih sau-in tong sawmnih a zai hi. Amah in a sunglam kham hoih talent h zaguk in a luan hi."},"9":{"text":"Kham siktukkilhte shekel i sawmnga khai ahi hi. Amah in inn tungnunglam zong khamin a luan hi.","ref":"Pk 26:32-33"},"10":{"text":"Mun Siangtho Pen sungah singin cherub lim nih bawla, tuate khamin a luan hi."},"11":{"text":"Cherub-te kha a kizak kimin tong sawmnih a hi hi. A masa pen cherub kha khat tong j nga sau a, biakinnpi kawm banin a kha langkhat zong tong nga mah sau a, cherub dang khat kha a ban hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua mah bangin a nihna cherub kha khat tong nga sau a, biakinnpi kawm langkhat banin a kha langkhat zong tong nga mah sau a cherub masapen kha a ban hi."},"13":{"text":"Hih cherub-te khate in tong sawmnih sung a khak hi. Amaute a khe un ding uh a, innpi k sunglam a nga uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in adum, adupsan le saihadial puan hoihin puanzak bawl a, a tungah cherub-te a tuangsak hi.","ref":"1Ku 6:1-29"},"15":{"text":"Amah in biakinnpi mai-ah tong sawmthum le nga asau a , khuampi phut-a, tuate a luzepna tong nga tuak ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in khainiangte phana b tuate khuampi dawnah a vial hi. Mangkawlsing gah zakhat bawl a tua khainiangte ah a gual hi."},"17":{"text":"Amah in tua khuampite biakinnpi mai leitaw lamah khat phut in, leilu lamah khat a phut hi. Leitaw lama pen Jakin c ci a, leilu lama pen Boaz d ci-in min a vawh hi.","ref":"1Ku 7:15, 17,20"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah in a dung tong sawm nih a vai tong sawm nih, a sanna e tong sawm a pha sumngo biakna-tau khat a dawh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Vanzatte"},"2":{"text":"Amah in daal sungin Tuipi bawl a, a bemsak hi; a geivial pan a geivial khat dong tong sawm pha a, tong f nga a sang hi. A gei kimkot tong g sawmthum a pha hi."},"3":{"text":"A geivial nuai-ah bawngtal limte in umcih a - tong h khatah sawm ta a om hi. Bawngtalte gualnih in Tuipi tawh a kisung khawm ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 27:1-2; 2Ku 16:14"},"4":{"text":"Bawngtal sawm le nih tungah Tuipi kinga-a, thum leilu-lam nga-in, thum nitumna-lam nga-a, thum leitaw-lam nga-in, thum nisuahna-lam a nga hi. Tuate tungah tuipi kinga a, kinungngat dimdiam in a om hi."},"5":{"text":"A sahna zapek i khat hi a, hai bangin geivial nei a, unok pak tawh kibang hi. Bath j tulthum a ta hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kisil nading kuangpi sawm bawl-a, leilu-lam ah nga koiha, leitaw-lam ah nga a koih hi. Tuate sungah meihal biakna vanzatte kisawp sianga, Tuipi ahileh siampite kisilna-a zat ding ahi hi.","ref":"1Ku 7:23-26, 38-51"},"7":{"text":"Amah in a kigeelsa bangin kham meivak tunna sawm bawl-a, biakinnpi sung leitaw-lam pangah nga koihin, leilu-lam pangah nga a koih hi.","ref":"Pk 25:31,40"},"8":{"text":"Amah in sabuai sawm bawl-a, biakinnpi sung leitaw-lam pangah nga koihin leilu-lam pangah nga a koih hi. Amah in tuithehna kham kuang-uk zakhat zong a bawl hi.","ref":"Pk 25:23; Ms 4:14"},"9":{"text":"Amah in siampite inntual le inntual zapi umin inntual kongkhakte bawla, a kongkhakte sumngo a luan hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in leitaw-lam pang leitaw nisuahna lam kiu ah Tuipi a koih hi.","ref":"1Ku 6:36; 2Ku 21:5"},"11":{"text":"Amah in beelte, vutluahnate le tuithehna kuang-ukte zong a bawl hi. Tua ciangin Pasian biakinnpi sunga dingin Kumpi Solomon in a bawlsakte Huram in bawl khin ta a:","ref":"1Ku 7:14"},"12":{"text":"Khuampi nihte; khuampi dawna a zepna kuang-uk lim nihte; khuampi dawna a zepna len banga kiphan le kuang-uk lim nihte;"},"13":{"text":"len phan banga kiphan kop nihte adingin a kibawl mangkawlsing lim zalite (khuampite ludawn zepna-in len banga kiphan khatah mangkawlsing gah gualnih ta ahi hi);"},"14":{"text":"tuikuangpite le a tunnate;"},"15":{"text":"Tuipi le a nuai-a a tuna bawngtal sawm le nihte;"},"16":{"text":"beelte, vutluahnate, sathukna sikkeukate le vanzat kisam khempeuh ahi hi. TOPA biakinnpi-a zat ding Kumpi Solomon adinga Huram-Abi in a bawl na khempeuh sumngo nawtngil vive ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Jordan zanglei-a om Succoth le Zarethan k kikala beellei ah kumpipa in hihte a sungsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Solomon bawl hih nate khempeuh tam lua ahi manin sumngote gihna zah kithei zo lo hi."},"19":{"text":"Solomon in Pasian biakinnpi sunga vanzat khempeuh zong bawl a: kham biakna-tau; Ompihna anlum koihna sabuaite;"},"20":{"text":"a kigeelsa bangin biakbuk sungnung sunga meivak ding kham meivakte le a tunnate;","ref":"Pk 25:31"},"21":{"text":"kham kibawl pak le meivakte le taitehte (tuate kham citak ahi hi);"},"22":{"text":"tuithehna kuang-ukte, sikkeu liangsaute le biakna veinate; le kham a kibawl biakinnpi kongkhakte: Mun Siangtho Pen paina inn sungnung kongpite le innpi kongkhak-te ahi hi.","ref":"Sp 10:1; Ms 7:14"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi-a sep ding khempeuh a zawh khit ciangin a pa David in a apsa nate - ngun le kham le vanzatte khempeuh - le Pasian biakinnpi sunga a koih gou khempeuh a sungah a tum hi.","ref":"2Sa 8:11; 1Ku 6:14"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in David Khuapi Zion pan TOPA thukhun singkuangpi puato dingin Israel upate, beh a lutangte khempeuh le Israel-te innkuan ukpi-te Jerusalem ah a kikhawmsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi-a a kha sagihna sung pawikham hunin Israel mi khempeuh kumpipa kiangah a kikhawm uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi ah Singkuangpi Kipua"},"4":{"text":"Israel upate khempeuh a tun khit uh ciangin Levi-te in singkuangpi lakhia uh a,"},"5":{"text":"singkuangpi le Kikhopna Puan-buk le a sunga vanzat siangtho khempeuh a puato uh hi. Levi siampite in tuate puato uh a;"},"6":{"text":"Kumpi Solomon le ama kianga kikhawm mipi khempeuh in singkuangpi mai-ah tuu le bawngtal tam pia lua uh ahi manin kiciamteh zo loin zong a kisim zo kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampite in TOPA thukhun singkuang a om nading mun biakinnpi sunga inndei sungnung a Mun Siangtho Pen ah pua uh a, cherub-te khanuai sanah a koih uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Cherub-te in singkuangpi omna mun tungah a khate uh zak uh a, singkuangpi le a zawnna zawl a khuh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih zawlte saulua-in biakbuk sungnung mai panin a mongte kimu thei a, ahi hangin Mun Siangtho panin a kimu thei kei hi; tua hi-a tua lai-ah tuni dong a om lai hi."},"10":{"text":"Egypt pan Israel-te a paikhiat nungun TOPA in amaute tawh thukhun a bawlna mun Horeb a Moses in a koih suangpek nih longal singkuangpi sungah adang bangmah a om kei hi.","ref":"Tp 10:2; Pc 3:24; Kil 11:19"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mun Siangtho panin siampite a paikhia uh hi. Tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh kua pawl cih om loin amau le amau a ki-ap ciat uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tumtheih tum Levi-te khempeuh - Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun le amaute tapate le a tanaute uh - biakna-tau nisuahna lam pangah dingin, saihadial puan hoih silh uh a, daltuahte, harp-te le lyre-te a tum uh hi. Amaute pengkul mut siampi 120 tawh a kithuah uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lasate le pengkul mutte aw khata gingin TOPA tungah lungdam ko ding le a phat dingin a kigawm uh hi. Pengkulte, daltuahte le a dang tumtheihte kipawlkhawm uh a, a aw uh sangsakin: \"Amah hoih hi; ama itna kip tawntung hi,\" ci-in TOPA phatna a sa uh hi. Tua ciangin TOPA biakinnpi meii tawh kidim a,","ref":"1Kh 15:24; 25:1"},"14":{"text":"Pasian biakinnpi TOPA minthanna tawh kidim ahi manin siampite in a biakna nasep uh a sem thei kei uh hi.","ref":"Pk 29:43; 2Kh 7:2"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Solomon in: \" TOPA in meii mial lakah ka teng ding hi, ci hi;"},"2":{"text":"keimah in a lian biakinnpi khat ka lam khin hi, na tenden nading mun khat ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi a kikhawm buppi tua lai-ah a din laitakun kumpipa nunghei-in amaute thupha a pia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in: \"Ka pa David tungah a kama a ciamsa a khutin a tangtungsak TOPA Israel Pasian kiphat ta hen. Ahang in,"},"5":{"text":"amah in, ‘Ka mite Egypt pan ka paikhiatpih a kipan ka Min om nadingin biakinnpi lam nading Israel behte khatpeuh ah khuapi khatpeuh ka teel kei a, ka mi Israel tunga makai dingin zong khatpeuh ka teel tuan kei hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin tu-in ka Min om nadingin Jerusalem ka teela ka mi Israel-te uk dingin David ka teel khin ta hi,’ ci hi."},"7":{"text":"\"Ka pa David in TOPA , Israel Pasian Min adingin biakinnpi khat lam ding lungsimin a nei hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in ka pa David kiangah, ‘Ka Min adingin biakinnpi lam ding lungsim nei na hi manin na lungsimin hih na ngaihsut a pha hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin biakinnpi a lam ding nang hi loin, na si le sa ahi na tapa hizaw hi - ka Min adingin biakinnpi lam ding pa amah ahi hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 10:7; Ns 7:46"},"10":{"text":"\" TOPA in a thuciamsa a kiplet hi. Ka pa David za ka luah a, TOPA ciamsa bang tektekin Israel kumpi tokhom tungah ka tu a, TOPA Israel Pasian Min adingin biakinnpi ka lam khin hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in Israel mite tawh a bawl TOPA thukhun kikoihna singkuangpi tua lai-ah ka koih khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA biakna-tau mai-a kikhawm Israel mipi bup mai-ah Solomon dinga a khutte a zak hi."},"13":{"text":"Tu-in amah in tong a nga a sau tong nga a zai tong b thum a sang sumngo tau khat bawlin inntual puanung pen laizangah a koih hi. Amah tau tungah dingin a kikhawm mipi buppi mai-ah khukdina vantung lamah a khut zanto in:","title":"Solomon’ Apna Thungetna"},"14":{"text":"\" TOPA Israel Pasian aw, vantung ahi a leitung ahi zongin nang bang Pasian a om kei hi - nang in na nasemte tawh na itna thukhun na lungsim neih zahin na hihna a zomsuakpa na hi hi."},"15":{"text":"Nang in na nasem ka pa David tungah na thuciam na lenkip hi; na kamin na ciama, na khutin tuni-a bangin na tangtungsak hi.","ref":"Tp 7:9"},"16":{"text":"TOPA Israel Pasian, tu-in na nasem ka pa David tunga na ciamsa, ‘Nang in ka mai-a na hihsa bangin na tapate in kidawm a, ka thukhamte tawh kituakin a kalsuan nak uhleh ka mai-a Israel kumpi tokhom tunga tu ding na kisam ngei kei ding hi,’ na cihsa lenkip in."},"17":{"text":"Tua hi-a TOPA Israel Pasian aw, tu-in na nasem David tunga na kammal tangcingsak in.","ref":"2Sa 7:13,15; 1Ku 2:4"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin leitungah mite tawh Pasian teng khawm takpi ding ahi hiam? Vante, a sang pen vante nangawn ah nang na ta zo kei hi. Hih ka lamsa biakinnpi lah neuzaw tham a!"},"19":{"text":"Tua hitaleh TOPA ka Pasian aw, na nasempa in na lainat ding hong ngetna le hong thumna thudon in. Na omna ah na nasempa hong kikona le hong thungetna na za in."},"20":{"text":"Na Min na koih nading na cihna mun hih biakinnpi lam sun le zanin hong en in. Hih mun lam nga-a na nasempa thungetna hong za in."},"21":{"text":"Na nasempa le na mi Israel-te in hih mun lam nga-in hong thumna uh za in. Nangma tenna vantung panin za inla, na zak ciangin a mawhna uh maisak in."},"22":{"text":"\"Mi khat a vengpa tungah khialin kiciamna a kisap a, hih biakinnpi sung na biakna-tau mai-ah a kiciam ciangin"},"23":{"text":"vantung panin na za inla na sem in. Na nasemte kikal ah thu khen inla a khialpa mawhpaih in ama gamtatna ama lutungah tusak in. Mawhpengpa mawh-paih kei inla ama mawhpenna kipsak in.","ref":"Pk 22:11; Isa 3:1"},"24":{"text":"\"Na mi Israel-te nang tungah hong mawhna uh hangin gal khatpeuh in a zawh a, nang kiangah hong kileh kikin hih biakinnpi sunga na mai-ah na min pulakin thu hong ngenin hong thum uh leh"},"25":{"text":"tua ciangin vantung panin na za inla na mi Israel a mawhna maisakin amaute pate tunga na piaksa gamah amaute puak kik in.","ref":"Sp 26:17"},"26":{"text":"\"Nang tungah na mite hong mawhna uh hangin vante kikhakin guah a zuk kei-a a mawhna uh hangin gimna na thuaksak a, amaute hih mun lam nga-in na min hong pulak uh leh,"},"27":{"text":"tua ciangin van panin na za inla na nasemte, na mi Israel mawhna maisak in. Amaute nuntakna lampi man hilh inla na mite luah dinga na piaksa leitang ah guah zusak in.","ref":"1Ku 17:1"},"28":{"text":"\"Hih gamah kialpi ahi-a pulpi ahi zongin a tuna, ahikeh ankung cinghteekna, ankung maibuakna, kaukhup, kauphe tunna ahikeh amau khuapite galte khatpeuh in umciha, haksatna, natna khatpeuh a tuah uh a"},"29":{"text":"na mi Israel-te khatpeuh in thungetna ahi-a thumna ahi zongin hong bawl uh a - ama lungsim gimna kithei-in hih biakinnpi lamah a khut hong zak uh leh -"},"30":{"text":"tua ciangin na tenna mun vantung panin na za in. Maisak-in ama lungsim na theihsa ahi nungsang ama sepsa khempeuh tawh kizui-in ama tungah tungsak in, (ahang in, nang bek in mihing lungsim khempeuh na thei hi),"},"31":{"text":"tua ciangin ka pate uh na piaksa gamah a ten laitengun nang hong kihta in na thu hong mang ding uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 16:7"},"32":{"text":"\"Na mi Israel-te tawh a kisaikha lo ahi hanga na min liatna le na khut thahatna le na ban zankhiatna - hanga mun gamla pana hong pai gamdang mite hong pai-in hih biakinnpi lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin,"},"33":{"text":"na mi Israel-te theih bangin hih ka lamsa na inn in na Min a puak lam leitung mi khempeuh in thei-a, nang hong kihtak nadingin na tenna mun vantung panin na za inla gamdang mite hong nget peuhpeuh pia in.","ref":"2Kh 7:14"},"34":{"text":"\"Na sawlna peuhah a galte uh sim dingin na mite a kuan uh ciangin na teelsa khuapi le nangma Min-a kilamsa biakinnpi lam nga-a thu hong nget uh ciangin"},"35":{"text":"amaute thungetna le thumna vantung panin za inla amaute thu panpih in."},"36":{"text":"\"Mawhna bawl lo mi khatbeek om lo ahi manin - amaute nang tungah hong mawh uh ciangin - amaute tungah nang heh-a a galte uh tungah pia-in a nai a gamla amaute gamah sal-in a kaih uh ciangin;"},"37":{"text":"saltangin a omna uh gamah a lungsim uh kikhel-a amau saltanna gamah kisikin, ‘Ka mawh zo uh hi. Ka takhial khin uh a, gilo in ka gamta khin uh hi,’ hong cih uh a;"},"38":{"text":"amaute sal-in a kikaihna gamah a lungsim khempeuh uh le a hinna uh tawh nang tungah hong kihei kik uh a, a pate uh na piaksa leitang lam, na Min a ka lamsa biakinnpi lam nga-in thu hong nget uh leh;"},"39":{"text":"tua ciangin na omna mun vantung panin amau thungetna le amau thumnate za in, amaute thu panpih in. Tua teh nang tungah hong mawh na mite maisak in."},"40":{"text":"\"Tu-in ka Pasian aw, na mit hong hakin hih muna thunget-nate na bil hong ngat in.","ref":"1Ku 8:22-53"},"41":{"text":"\"Tu-in TOPA Pasian aw, ding inla na khawlna munah hong pai in, nang le na thahatna singkuangpi pai ta un. TOPA Pasian aw, na siampite in hotkhiatna silh uh henla, nangma hoihna-ah na misiangte nuamsa uh hen."},"42":{"text":"TOPA Pasian aw, na sathau nilhpa nolh kei in. Na nasempa David tunga na ciamsa itna lianpi phawk gige in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 132:8-10"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon a thunget a man ciangin van panin meikuang hong paisuk-a, meihal biakna le biakna-a kipiate hultumin TOPA minthanna biakinnpi sungah a dim hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Apna"},"2":{"text":"TOPA biakinnpi sungah TOPA minthanna dim ahi manin a sungah siampite a lut thei kei uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel khempeuh in meikuang hong tuaksuk le biakinnpi tungsana TOPA minthanna a muh uh ciangin suangphah tungah leilam nga-in kunsuk uh a TOPA bia-in lungdam ko uh a: \"Amah hoih hi; ama itna kip tawntung hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pk 29:43; 40:35; 2Kh 5:14"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le mite khempeuh in TOPA mai-ah biakna a pia uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuateh Kumpi Solomon in bawngtalpi tul sawmnih le tul nih le keel tul za le tul sawmnih biakna piak khatin a pia hi. Tuaci-in kumpipa le mite khempeuh in Pasian biakinnpi a ap uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Siampite amau panmun ah pang uh a, tua mah bangin Levi-te zong TOPA tumtheih vante tawh panmun a la uh hi. Tua tumtheihte pen, Kumpi David in TOPA phat nadinga a bawl hi a, amah in lungdam a koh ciangin tuate zangin, \"Ama itna kip tawntung hi,\" a ci uh hi. Levi-te tawh kigalsai-in siampite in pengkul mut uh a, Israel-te khempeuh a ding uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 15:16; 2Kh 5:12-13"},"7":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi tual laizang teng ap a, tua lai-ah meihal biaknate le kilawmtakna biakna a thau a pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama bawlsa sumngo biakna-tau ah meihal biaknate, an-a biaknate le a thaute a ta zo kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun mahin Solomon in ni sagih sung pawi bawla, Israel khempeuh amah tawh omkhawmin - a kikhawm mihonpite, Lebo b Hamath pan Egypt Wadi dong a dim hi."},"9":{"text":"A nigiatna ni-in mipite a kikhawm uh hi, ahang in, amaute in ni sagih sung biakna-tau pawi pawl khin uh a, pawibawlna-in adang ni sagih sung a zang lai uh hi."},"10":{"text":"A kha sagihna a ni sawmnih le thumna ni-in TOPA in David le Solomon le ama mi Israel tungah a hoih a bawlnate hangin lungnuamtak le kipaksa in amaute inn ah a ciahsak hi.","ref":"Sp 23:36"},"11":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi le kumpi in lam man khina, TOPA biakinnpi sung le ama kumpi inn sungah hih dinga a ngaihsut khempeuh a man khit ciangin,"},"12":{"text":"zanin ama tungah TOPA kilang a: \"Na thungetna ka za-a keimah biak piakna biakinnpi mun dingin hih lai ka teel khin hi.","title":"Solomon tungah Kilang","ref":"Tp 12:5"},"13":{"text":"\"Guah omloh nadingin vante ka khakcip ciang, gamsung a netum dingin kauphete thu ka piak ciang, mite lakah pulpi ka tunsak ciang,"},"14":{"text":"ka mina kilo ka mite amau mah kiniamkhiatin thu hong nget uh a, ka maitang hong zongin amaute a gitlohna panun a kihei uh leh tua ciangin vantung panin ka za dinga a mawhna uh maisakin a gam uh ka damsak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tu-in ka mitte hakin hih muna thungetna-a kigente ka bil ka ngat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lai-ah ka Min a om den nadingin hih biakinnpi teel khinin ka ap khin hi. Ka mitte le ka lungsim tua lai-ah a tu tawntung ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 6:27,37,40"},"17":{"text":"\"Nang adingin ahileh na pa David hih bangin ka mai-ah na kalsuan a, kong thupiak khempeuh hih in ka thukipte le ka thukhamte na zuih leh,"},"18":{"text":"na pa David tawh thu khungin, ‘Israel a uk ding mi na kisam kei ding hi,’ ka cih bangin na kumpi tokhom ka kipsak ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:4; 2Kh 6:16"},"19":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin kihei-in nang a kong piak thupiakte le thukipte na b taisan a pasian dangte na sem dingin paikhia-a tuate na biak leh"},"20":{"text":"tua ciangin amaute ka piaksa ka leitang panin Israel ka botkhia dinga ka Min a ka apsa hih biakinnpi kong nolh ding hi. Mite khempeuh lakah thugentehna le ciamnuihna ka suaksak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua hi-a tu-in hih biakinnpi hoih a kisak mahmah hangin a tawnkha mi khempeuh in mulkim lua-in, ‘Bang hangin TOPA in hih gam le hih biakinnpi tungah hih bangin na sem ahi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Mite in, ‘Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Egypt pana a paikhiatpih TOPA a pate uh Pasian taisan uh a, pasian dangte kawi-in amaute na semin bia uh a - tua ahi manin amaute tungah hih siatna khempeuh a tung ahi hi,’ ci-in dawng ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon in TOPA biakinnpi le ama kumpi inn lam a zawh khit kum sawmnih a bei ciangin","title":"Solomon Sep Dangte"},"2":{"text":"Hiram c in amah a piak khuaneute Solomon in lam kik a, tuate ah Israel-te a teng uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hamath Zobah ah Solomon pai-in a la hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in sehnel-gam sungah Tadmor le Hamath a vankholna khuapite khempeuh zong a lam hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in Beth Horon Tungnung le Beth Horon Nuainung, kulh a ki-um khuapite in lampha a, kulhte, kongpite le a kalhna zawlte neisakin,"},"6":{"text":"tuate tawh Baalath le a khuapite khempeuh le a sakollengte le a sakolte d koih nading khuapite - Jerusalem sung, Lebanon sung le ama ukna gam sung khempeuha, a lam nop khempeuh a lam hi."},"7":{"text":"Hit-te, Amor-te, Periz-te, Hiv-te le Jebus-te pana kinusia mite khempeuh (hih mite Israel-te hi lo hi)"},"8":{"text":"in gam sunga om lai amau suante, Israel-te suksiat lohte hi uh a - Solomon in aana-a a lak tuni donga om laite ahi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi hangin Solomon in a nasepna ah Israel-te sila in a khawi kei hi; amaute a galkapte, a galkap bute a ukte, sakollengte le sakol tuangte a ukte in a koih hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute Kumpi Solomon zum nasem uliante hi uh a - mite a uk ulian zanih le sawmnga a pha hi."},"11":{"text":"Solomon in David khuapi panin a lamsa kumpi inn ah Pharaoh tanu a paipih hi; ahang in, amah in, \"Israel kumpipa David kumpi innah ka zi a teng kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA singkuangpi tunnasa munte a siangtho hi,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Solomon in innliim mai-a a dawhsa TOPA biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna pia uh hi;"},"13":{"text":"Moses thupiakna tawh kizui-in Sabbath-te, Kha Thakte le kum sima kibawl pawi thumte - Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi, Nipikal Pawite, Biakbuk Pawite le nisima a kisam bangin TOPA tungah meihal biakna a pia hi."},"14":{"text":"A pa David ngeinakipte zui-in siampite amau sik nading munah a pawlpawlin seh a, phatna lamah Levi-te makaisakin nisim a kisapna tawh kizui-in siampite a huhsak hi. Amah in kongpi tuamtuamte adingin kongpi cingte zong a seh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian mipa David thupiaksa ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in siampite le Levi-te tungah a thupiakna thu khatpeuh le vanmanpha koihna tawh kisai-ah amaute a ngentel mahmah uh hi.","ref":"Ms 28:3; 1Kh 25:1; Ne 12:24,36"},"16":{"text":"TOPA biakinnpi a bulpi a kiphuha kipan a mansiang dong Solomon geelsa zui-a kisemkhia ahi hi. Tuaci-in TOPA biakinnpi a kizo hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Edom a tuipi gei-a om Ezion Geber le Elath ah Solomon a pai hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuateh Hiram in tuipi thu a thei ama mite uksakin tembawte a sawl hi. Hihte le Solomon mite Aphir ah paikhawm uh a, kham talent zali le sawmnga e pua-in Kumpi Solomon kiangah a tun uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:10-28; 2Kh 9:9"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sheba kumpinu in Solomon minliatna a zak ciangin thudot-na haksa kengin amah zia-et dingin Jerusalem ah a pai hi. Tua ciangin amaute Jerusalem ah a ciah kik uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:19; 35:5; 2Kh 13:15"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Oded’ tapa Azariah tungah Pasian Kha a tung hi.","title":"Asa Puahphatna"},"2":{"text":"Amah Asa tawh kimu dingin paikhia a, \"Asa le Judah le Benjamin-te khempeuh aw, ka thugen na ngai un. TOPA tawh na om khawm uh ciangin amah in note hong ompih hi. Amah na zon uh leh note in na mu ding uh hi, ahi hangin amah na taihsat uh leh amah in hong taisan ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel-te sawtveipi Pasian maan tawh sung omlo uh a, a hilh ding siampi khat tawh zong om loin thukham loin a om uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute a lungdon uh ciangin TOPA Israel Pasian lam nga in amah zong uh a, amaute in mu uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in zinsuk zintohna lungmuanhuai lo a, tua hangin tua gama teng mite buai mahmah uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Pasian in lungdonna namkim tawh amaute lauthawngsak ahi manin minam khat in adang khat, khuapi khat in adang khat a kisu ciat uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang na hileh na pahtakman sang ding na hi manin hat inla tawpsan peuhmah kei in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jos 1:7,9; Jas 4:8"},"8":{"text":"Asa in hih kamsangpa Odeb tapa c Azariah thugenkholhte a zak ciangin a kilungkhauhsak hi. Amah in Judah le Benjamin gam buppi le Ephraim mualtung gama, a laksa khuapi khempeuh panin a kihhuai milim khempeuh a phiatkhia hi. Amah in TOPA biakinnpi innliim mai-a TOPA biakna-tau a puahpha hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Judah le Benjamin khempeuh le Ephraim, Manasseh le Simeon pana amaute lakah a teng mite khempeuh a kaikhawm hi; ahang in, TOPA amaute Pasian in amaute a ompih lam a theih uh ciangin Israel panin tampitak in amah a beel uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 11:16-17"},"10":{"text":"Asa kumpi a suah zawh a kum sawm le ngana a kha thumna sungin amaute Jerusalem ah a kikhawm uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hunin amaute in gal sunga a puak kikte uh panin bawnghon pan bawngtalpi za sagih le tuu le keel tul sagih TOPA tungah biakna-in a pia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in a lungsim uh le a hinna khempeuh un TOPA a pate uh Pasian a zon nadingun thukhun khat a bawl uh hi."},"13":{"text":"TOPA Israel Pasian a zong lo khempeuh aneu alian, a numei a pasalin kithat ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute ngaihtaka kikona, otna le pengkulte le sakite tawh TOPA tungah a kiciam uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Judah-te khempeuh a lungsim neih zahun kiciam uh ahi manin tua kiciamna hangin a nuam uh hi. Amaute in lawptakin Pasian zong uh a, amah a mu uh hi. Tua ciangin TOPA in amaute a kim a pam panun a tawlngasak hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpi Asa in a pi Maacah zong kumpinu hihna panin a hemkhia hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tuanu in a muhthadahhuai Asherah khuam khat a bawl hi. Asa in tua khuam phukin sattan gawpa Kidron Kuam sungah a haltum hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel panin munsangte a phiat loh hangin Asa in a nuntak sungteng a lungsim buppi TOPA tungah a ap hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah le a pa in a apsa ngun le kham vanzatte Pasian biakinnpi sungah a puak hi."},"19":{"text":"Asa a man khit kum sawmthum le nga dong gal dang a om nawn kei hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asa kumpi a suah zawh kum sawmthum le guk kumin Israel kumpipa Baasha, Judah sim dingin kuanto a, Judah kumpipa Asa gamah kuamah paikhia loin kuamah a lut theih loh nading dalna-in kulhin Ramah a um hi.","title":"Asa’ Hun Nunungte","ref":"Jer 41:9"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Asa in TOPA biakinnpi le ama kumpi inn a, goukholna-a om ngun le khamte lakhia-in tua huna Damascus uk Aram kumpipa Ben-Hadad tungah a khak hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in, \"Na pa le ka pa kikalah thukimnasa a om bangin nang le kei kikal ah zong thukimna khat omsak ni. En in ngun le kham kong khak hi. Israel kumpipa Baasha kei kiang panin a nungkik nadingin amah tawh na thuciamna pel in,\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa Asa tawh Ben-Hadad thukima, Israel khuapite langah a galkap mangpa a kuansak hi. Amaute in Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim a le Naphtali vankholna khuapi khempeuh a zo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Baasha in hih thu a zak ciangin Ramah a lam khawla, a nasep a nusia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Asa in Judah mi khempeuh kuansaka, amaute in Ramah panin Baasha zat kimlai suangte le singluangte a puamang uh hi. Amah in tuate tawh Geba le Mizpah a lam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Judah kumpipa Asa kiangah thumupa Hanani pai a: \" TOPA nangma Pasian tungah kinga loin Aram kumpipa tungah kinga na hi manin Aram kumpipa galkapte na khut panin a suakta hi."},"8":{"text":"Cush-te b le Libya-te in sakolleng le sakol tungtuang c galkap thahat tampi nei uh hi lo ahi hiam? Tua hi napi TOPA tungah na kingak ciangin amah in amaute nang khut sungah hong pia hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, ama tungah a lungsim khempeuh tawh a ki-apte a thahatsak dingin TOPA mitin leitung bup a en kawikawi hi. Amaute in gimnamtui le paknamtui tuamtuam tawh tuamin lang’ tungah sial uh a, amah pahtawina-in meiphualpi khat a cih uh hi.","ref":"Pc 50:2; 2Kh 21:19"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ama tapa Jehoshaphat in a kumpi za luah a, Israel langah a kithakhauhsak hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoshaphat"},"2":{"text":"Amah in kulha ki-um Judah khuapite khempeuh ah galkapte omsak a, Judah sung le a pa Asa in a laksa Ephraim khuapi sungah khuapi cingte a koih hi.","ref":"1Ku 15:23-24"},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in a neu lai-in a pa David zuihsa lampi tawn ahi manin TOPA in amah a ompih hi. Amah in Baal thu dong loin"},"4":{"text":"Israel-te gamtatnate sangin a pa’ Pasian zongin a thupiakte a zuizaw hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA in ama ukna nuai-ah a kumpi-gam kipsak a; neihsa tampi nei-in a kipahtawi nadingin Judah khempeuh in Jehoshaphat letsong a puak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"TOPA lampite ah a lungsim a pia hi; tua tham loin amah in Judah panin munsangte le Asherah khuamte a phiatkhia hi."},"7":{"text":"A kumpi suah zawh a kum thumna kumin a uliante Ben-Hial, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel le Micaiah-te Judah khuapite ah thuhilh dingin a sawl hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute tawh Levi-te ahi - Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah - le Tob- Adonijah - le siampite ahi Elishama le Jehoram a paikhawmsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA Thukham Laibu keng uh a Judah gam sung khempeuhah hilhin; Judah khuapite khempeuh ah pai kawikawi uh a, mite a hilh uh hi.","ref":"Tp 6:4-9; 2Kh 15:3; 19:8"},"10":{"text":"Amaute in Jehoshaphat a do loh nadingun Judah gam kimkot a kumpi-gam khempeuh ah TOPA kihtakna a tung hi."},"11":{"text":"Philistia-te pawlkhat in letsong le siahin ngun puak uh a, Arab-te in ganhon: tuutal tul sagih le za sagih le keel tul sagih le za sagih amah a puak uh hi.","ref":"Pc 35:5"},"12":{"text":"Jehoshaphat vanglian semsem a; Judah sungah kulhte le van koihna khuapite lamin"},"13":{"text":"Judah khuapite ah huhna tampi a puak hi. Amah in galdo siamsate zong Jerusalem ah omsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute a innkuan kuanun a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Judah pan, 1,000 a uk galkap mangte: Galkap mangpa Adnah, Galkap mi 300,000 tawh;","ref":"2Sa 24:2"},"15":{"text":"azom, galkap mangpa Jehohanan, galkap mi 280,000 tawh;"},"16":{"text":"azom TOPA nasem dingin a kipia Zicri tapa Amasiah, mi 200,000 tawh;"},"17":{"text":"Benjamin pan: A thahat galkappa Eliada thal le lum tawi mi 200,000 tawh;","ref":"Ms 1:36"},"18":{"text":"azom, Jehozabad galhiam tawi mi 180,000 tawh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Hihte in Judah gam buppi-a kulha ki-um khuapite a, a omsakte banah kumpipa nasemte ahi uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 11:10; 25:5"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in neih le lam hau-a a kipahtawi hi; tu-in amah mahin kitenna hanga kizopna Ahab tawh a bawl hi.","title":"Micaiah in Ahab Langah Thugenkhol"},"2":{"text":"Kum tawmvei khit ciangin Samaria a Ahab kiangah hawh dingin a paisuk hi. Ahab in amah le a tonpihte tuu le bawng tampi na gawh a, Ramoth Gilead sim dingin a na kun hi."},"3":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Ramoth Gilead nong simpih ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, \"Pasian in kumpipa khut sungah hong pia ding ahi manin kuan un,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jehoshaphat in, \"Hih lai-ah i dot theih dingin TOPA kamsang khat beek om lo ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"7":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \" TOPA thu i dotsak theih ding mi khat om lai hi, ahi hangin amah ka muhdah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei tawh kisai a hoih khat beek genkhol ngei lo-a a sia hi tawntung hi. Amah Imlah tapa Micaiah ahi hi,\" a ci hi. Jehoshaphat in, \"Kumpipa in tua bang ci kei in,\" ci-in a dawng kik hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in a uliante khat sama, \"Imlah tapa Micaiah hong sampak dih un,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in a kumpi puante uh silhin Samaria lutna kongpi kianga ancilna phual zangah kumpi tokhomin tu uh a, kamsang khempeuh in amaute mai-ah kam a sang uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tu-in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sikkite bawla, \" TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Aram-te a kisiat khit matengun hihte in amaute na pik ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"11":{"text":"Kamsang dangte khempeuh in a kibangin kam a sang uh hi. Amaute in, \" TOPA in kumpipa khutah hong pia ding ahi manin Ramoth Gilead simin gualzo in,\" a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Micaiah sam dinga pai kamtaipa in ama kiangah, \"En in kamsang dangte khempeuh in mi khat gen bangin kumpipa zawh nadingin a gen uh hi. Nang zong amaute aa thukimpih inla a gum lamin pau in,\" a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin Micaiah in, \" TOPA nuntakna lo a ka cihinah, ka Pasian in kei tunga hong gen bek ama tungah ka gen thei hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 22:18,20,35"},"14":{"text":"Amah a tun ciangin kumpipa in, \"Micaiah aw, Ramoth Gilead sim dingin ka kuan ding uh hiam, ahikeh ka thuak lel ding uh hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, \"Amaute na khut sungah hong kipia ding hi, sim inla gualzo in,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Bangmah dang gen loin thutak bek gen dingin TOPA minin bangzah vei hong kiciamsak ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Micaiah in, \"Israel khempeuh mualtung ah a cing om lo tuu bangin a kithehthang ka mu a, TOPA in, ‘Hih mite pu nei lo ahi uh hi. Amau inn ciatah lungnuamin ciah uh hen,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ms 27:17; Eze 34:5-8"},"17":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Amah in kei tungtangah a hoih khat beek gen ngei lo-a a sia bek gen hi, ci-a hong gen hi lo ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Micaiah in genbeh lai-a, \"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA thugen za un: TOPA a kumpi tokhom tungah tu-a vantung mihonpite a taklam le a veilamah a ding uh ka mu hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in, ‘Ramoth Gilead sima, a sih nading mun tua lai-ah kua in Israel kumpipa Ahab va zol ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi. \"Khat in khat gena adang khat in a tuam khat a gen hi.","ref":"Da 7:9"},"20":{"text":"A nunung penin kha khat a mai-ah pai-in TOPA mai-ah dinga, ‘Ke’n amah ka zol ding hi,’ ci hi. \" TOPA in, ‘koi ci zia-in,’ ci-in a dong hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Amah in, ‘Ka va pai dinga ama kamsangte khempeuh kam ah kha zuau ka va suaksak ding hi,’ ci hi. \" TOPA in, ‘Pai inla hih in, amah zol lecin na zo ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Job 1:6; Jn 8:44"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin tu-in TOPA in na kamsangte khempeuh kam ah kha zuau a koih khin hi. TOPA in na thuak ding gimna a kipsak khin hi,\" a ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah paitoin Micaiah maitang a beng hi. Amah in, \"Na tunga thugen dingin TOPA pana kha a in cikin kei hong paisan ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi.","ref":"Jer 20:2; Mk 14:65; Ns 23:2"},"24":{"text":"Micaiah in, \"Inn sung tawngah na buk ni ciangin na theikhia ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in, \"Micaiah paipihin khuapi ukpa Amon le kumpipa tapa Joash kiangah puak unla"},"26":{"text":"‘Kumpipa in: bittaka kong tun kik matengin hih pa thong sungah khumin anlum le tuisik longal bangmah pia kei un, ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"27":{"text":"Macaiah in, \"Bittaka nong tun kik tak leh, TOPA in kei tungah thu a gen lo ahi hi,\" a cikhia hi. Tua ciangin, \"No mite khempeuh aw, ka thugen ciamteh un,\" a cihbeh lai hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat Ramoth Gilead ah a kuanto uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel kumpipa in Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Ken ka mel selin gam sungah va kuan ningin, nang na kumpi puante silh in,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa a mel selsa-in gal sungah a kuan hi.","title":"Ramoth Gilead ah Ahab Kithat"},"30":{"text":"Tua laitakin Aram kumpipa in a sakolleng ukte thu pia-a, \"Israel kumpipa longal aneu alian khatpeuh tawh kido kei un,\" a ci hi."},"31":{"text":"Sakolleng ukte in Jehoshaphat a muh uh ciangin,\" Hih in Israel kumpipa ahi hi,\" ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi. Tua ciangin amah sim dingin a kihei uh hi. Ahi zongin Jehoshaphat kikokhia a TOPA in amah a huh hi. Pasian in ama kiang pan amaute kaikhia hi,"},"32":{"text":"ahang in, sakolleng ukte in amah Israel kumpipa ahi loh lam a muh uh ciangin a delh nawn kei uh hi."},"33":{"text":"Ahi hangin mi khat in a thal kekin mawk lot a, Israel kumpipa kidalnate kikal a kha hi. Kumpipa in a sakolleng hawlpa kiangah, \"Kidona sung pan leng hawlkhia in hong paikhiatpih in; ka liam hi,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"34":{"text":"Sun nilohin nasiatakin gal kido a, Israel kumpipa a sakolleng tungah kingam in Aram-te lam nga-in nitak dong a om hi. Ni tum ciangin a si ta hi.","ref":"1Ku 22:29-36; 2Kh 13:14"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem a, a kumpi inn ah Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bittakin a tun kik ciangin"},"2":{"text":"amah dawn dingin Hanani tapa thumupa Jehu paikhia-a, kumpipa kiangah, \"Migilote huhin TOPA a mudahte it a ding na hi hiam? Hih thu hangin, TOPA thangpaihna nang tungah tung zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin gamsung panin Asherah khuamte na phiatkhia a Pasian zon ding na lungsimin ngaihsun na hi manin nang sungah a hoih pawlkhat om sam hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 17:6; 32:25; Ph 139:21-22"},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem ah Jehoshaphat teng a, Beersheba panin Ephraim mualtung gam mite lakah paikhia kikin a pate uh Pasian TOPA lamah amaute a hei kik hi."},"5":{"text":"Gam sunga kulha ki-um Judah khuapite ah thukhente a koih ciat hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat in Thukhente Seh"},"6":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, \"Note mihing adingin thukhen hi loin TOPA adingin thukhen na hi manun bang khatpeuh na hihna uhah limtakin ngaihsun un, thukhenna na piak laitakun amah no tawh omkhawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA kihtakna no tawh om ta hen. TOPA eite Pasian tawh thutang lo, mi deidanna le golh-sum lakna omkhawm lo ahi manin kidawmtakin thu khen un,\" ci-in a gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem ah zong TOPA thukham a zuisak ding le kitotnate a vengsak dingin Levi-te pawlkhat, siampite le Israel innkuan lutangte a seh hi. Tuateh Jerusalem ah amaute a teng uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in amaute tungah, \"Note in TOPA kihta in muanhuaitak le na lungsim khempeuh un na na sem pelmawh ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Khuapi sunga teng na gam mite panun note mai-ah hong kitun thu khatpeuh - sisan kisuahna ahi-a, thukham tawh kisai thupiakte, thukipte ahikeh ngeina khunsate ah, TOPA tungah amaute a mawh loh nadingun vauhilh un, tua hi kei leh note le na sanggamte uh tungah thangpaihna hong tung ding hi. Hih bangin hih un na mawh kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 17:8-13; 2Kh 17:8-9"},"11":{"text":"\" TOPA tawh kisai na khatpeuh ah siampi makai Amariah in note hong uk dinga, kumpipa tawh kisai na khatpeuh ah Judah beh a makaipa Ishmael tapa Zebadiah in note hong ukin, note mai-ah Levi-te ulianin na a sem ding uh hi. Hangtakin na sem un, hoihtaka nasemte TOPA in hong ompih ta hen,\" ci-in thu a pia hi.","ref":"1Kh 28:20"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thu khit ciangin Moab-te le Ammon-te, Meunnin-te b pawl khat tawh Jehoshaphat do dingin a kuan uh hi.","title":"Jehoshaphat in Moab le Ammon-te Zo","ref":"1Kh 4:41"},"2":{"text":"Mi pawlkhat pai uh a Jehoshaphat kiangah, \"Nang hong sim dingin Edom c pan le Tuipi d galkhat panin galkap tampitak hong kuan hi. Tuate Hazazon Tamar (tua pen En Gedi) ah om khin ta uh hi,\" ci-in a ko uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Jehoshaphat patau a TOPA dot ding khensatin Judah khempeuh antan ding a tangko hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA tungah huhna zong dingin Judah mi khempeuh a kikhawm uh hi; hi takpi hi, Judah khuapi khempeuh panin amah zong dingin a kuan ciat uh hi.","ref":"Pc 14:7"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA biakinnpi huang sung inntual thak mai, Judah le Jerusalem pana mipite kikhopna sungah Jehoshaphat dingin:"},"6":{"text":"\" TOPA ka pate uh Pasian aw, vantung a om Pasian nang hi lo na hi hiam? Minamte kumpi-gam khempeuh nangma uk ahi hi. Thahatna le vangliatna nangma khutah oma, kuamah in nang hong nang zo kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Kote Pasian aw, nang in na mi Israel mite mai panin hih gama teng mite hawlkhia-in na lawmpa Abraham suante neih den dingin na piaksa hi lo ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Tua sungah amaute tengin nangma Min in biakbuk lam uh a,"},"9":{"text":"‘Eite tungah tuahsiatna ahi, namsau-a thukhenna ahi-a, pulpi ahi a kialpi ahi zongin hong tun leh nangma omna na Min a kilam hih biakinnpi mai-ah dingin ka lungdonna uh kong ko ding uh a nang hong za-in kote nong honkhia ding hi,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:39; 1Kh 29:11-12; Isa 41:8"},"10":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin tu-in Moab le Seir Vum pana mite, Israel-te Egypt pana a paikhiat lai-un amaute sim dingin na phal kei hi; tua ciangin amaute in kiheisan in a nusia kei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"En in, kote in luah a ka neih dingun nong piaksa panin kote hong nawhkhiatna tawh hong thuk dingin amaute hong kuan uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Kote Pasian aw, amaute tungah thu khen lo ding na hi hiam? Hih kote hong sim galkap tampitakte maingat dingin vang ka nei kei uh hi. Ka cih nading uh ka theih loh manun nangmah kong mitsuan uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 25:15; 83:1-12"},"13":{"text":"Judah mite khempeuh a zite a tate uh le a tanaute uh tawh TOPA mai tua lai-ah a ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Asaph suante Levi-te khat, Mattaniah tapa, Jeiel tapa Benaiah tapa Zechariah tapa Jahaziel a kikhawm mipite lakah adin laitakin a tungah TOPA Kha a tung hi.","ref":"2Kh 15:1"},"15":{"text":"Amah in, \"Kumpipa Jehoshaphat le Judah le Jerusalem a tengte khempeuh aw, ngai dih un! Kumpipa in Aaron suan siampite in hihte TOPA biakna-tau ah a lui dingun thu a pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in bawngtalte go uh a, siampite in a sisan la-in biakna-tau tung a theh uh hi; tua zomah tuutalte go uh a, a sisan biakna-tau tung a theh uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kumpipa le a kikhawm mipite mai-ah mawhna hanga biakna keelte paipih uh a, amaute in tuate tungah a khut uh a nga uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampite in tua keelte go uh a, kumpipa in Israel khempeuh adingin meihal biakna le mawhna hanga biakna-a piak dingin thu pia khin ahi manin Israel khempeuh aitangin mawhna hanga biakna-in biakna-tau tungah tuate sisan a theh uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in David le kumpipa’ thumupa Gad le kamsangpa Nathan sehsa bangin TOPA biakinnpi sungah daltuahte, harp-te, lyre-te tawh TOPA thupiaksa bangin Levi-te a omsak hi; hih pen TOPA in ama kamsangte tawna a thupiak ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin David’ tumtheihte tawh Levi-te dingin siampite a pengkulte uh tawh a ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah in biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna piak ding thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawm mihonpi in biakpiaknate le lungdamkoh biaknate puak uh a, a lungsim ua utna a neite in meihal biaknate a puak uh hi.","ref":"Pk 35:22; Heb 13:15-16"},"32":{"text":"A kikhawm mihonpi in a puak uh meihal biaknate: bawngtal sawm sagih, tuutal zakhat le tuuno a pa zanih pha a - a vekpi in TOPA tungah meihal biakna ding ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Biakna-a kipia a ki-ap ganhing peuhmah a gawmin bawngtal zaguk le tuu le keel tulthum ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua hi-a meihal biaknate a vun hawk dingin siampite a tawmlua uh hi; tua ahi ciangin a nasep uh a man mateng uh siampi dangte a ki-ap khit matengun amau sanggam Levi-te in amaute a huh uh hi, ahang in, siampite hih sangin amau le amau ki-apna ah Levi-te a ngentelzaw uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Meihal biakna a tamluat banah kilawmtakna biakna a thaute le meihal biaknate tawh a kipiakhawm dawntheih-a biaknate zong hi lai hi. Tua bangin TOPA biakinnpi a biakna nasepte a kikipsak kik hi.","ref":"Sp 3:16"},"36":{"text":"Hih bangin manlangtaka kihih ahi manin Pasian in a mite adingin hih bang a piansaknate hangin Hezekiah le mipi khempeuh a lungdam uh hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah in Israel le Judah khempeuh ah kam paisak a, Ephraim le Manasseh ah zong lai khakin, Jerusalem a TOPA biakinnpi ah pai-in TOPA Israel Pasian tungah Paisan pawi bawl dingin amaute a sam hi.","title":"Hezekiah in Paisan-pawi Bawl"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa le a uliante le Jerusalem a om kikhawm mi buppi in Paisan pawi bawl hun ding a kha nihna kha dingin a khensat uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Siampite a kicing ding zah ki-ap zo nai lo uh a, Jerusalem ah mite kikhawm zo den lo uh ahi manin amaute in hun manin pawi a bawl zawh lohsa uh ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa le a kikhawm mipite geelkhawmna ah man le kilawm hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in Beersheba pan Dan ciang dong Israel buppi ah tangko sawlin, Jerusalem ah mite pai-in TOPA Israel Pasian tungah Paisan pawi bawl dingin sap dinga a khensat uh ahi hi. Amah in a tawntung adingin a apsa munsiangtho hong zuan un. Note panin a hehluatna a kiheimang theih nadingin TOPA note Pasian na sem un."},"9":{"text":"TOPA note Pasian hehpih siamin khuatuah thei ahi manin TOPA lamah na kihei uh leh na sanggampate uh le na tate uh a mante in khuatuah ding uh a, hih gamah hong kileh kik ding uh hi. Ama lamah na kihei uh leh amah in hong lehngatsan kei ding hi,\" ci-in kigelh hi.","ref":"Tp 30:2-5; Mic 7:18"},"10":{"text":"Ephraim le Manasseh sung khuapi khat pan khuapi khatah laitaite pai uh a, Zebulun dong a tung uh hi, ahi hangin mite in amaute zahpihin a nuihsan uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hi napi Asher, Manasseh le Zebulun a mi pawlkhat kiniam-khiatin Jerusalem ah a pai uh hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA kammal zui-in kumpipa le a uliante thupiaksa a tangtun nadingin Judah sungah zong Pasian khut in kigawm khawm nopna lungsim a guan hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:16; Jer 32:39"},"13":{"text":"A kha nihna sungin Silngo - sawhloh Anlum Pawi bawl dingin mihon tampitak Jerusalem ah a kikhawm uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in Jerusalem sunga biakna-taute phelkhia uh a, gimnamtui-taute hemmangin Kidron Kuam sungah a pai uh hi.","ref":"Ms 28:16; 2Kh 28:24"},"15":{"text":"Amaute in a kha nihna a nisawm le lina ni-in Paisan tuuno a go uh hi. Siampite le Levi-te maizum uh a amau le a mau ki-ap tawmin TOPA biakinnpi ah meihal biakna a puak uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Pasian mipa Moses Thukham sunga kilak bangin a panmun ngei uh a luah uh hi. Levi-te in amaute a piak uh sisante siampite in a theh uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Mihonte lakah amau le amau a ki-ap nai lo tampi om a, biakna ngeina-in a sianglo khempeuh adingin Levi-te in Paisan tuunote a gawhsak kei uh leh a tuuno uh TOPA tungah a pia thei kei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua a kisiansuah lo tampite a tampen Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar le Zebulun pana paite hi a, tua hi napi a kigelhsa tawh kilehbulhin Paisan a ne uh hi. Ahi hangin Hezekiah in amaute adingin thu ngen a, \"A hoih TOPA aw,"},"19":{"text":"a lungsima Pasian zong peuhmah - TOPA amaute Pasian aw - munsiangtho ngeina tawh kituakin amah a sian loh hangin maisak in,\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA in Hezekiah ngetna za a, mite a damsak hi.","ref":"2Kh 7:14"},"21":{"text":"Jerusalem a om Israel mite in ni sagih sung Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi gualnuamtakin bawl uh a, tua hun sungin Levi-te le siampite in TOPA phatna tumtheihte tawh thuahin nisimin TOPA tungah la a sa uh hi. b"},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in TOPA nasepna hoihtaka a lak thei Levi-te khempeuh tungah hanthawnna kam a gen hi. Tua ni sagihte sung teng amaute in amau tanh dinga kiseh ciat ne uh a, kilawmtakna biaknate c pia-in TOPA a pate uh Pasian a phat uh hi.","ref":"Tp 12:15,17; 13:6"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kikhawm mihonpi bup in ni sagih sung pawi bawl lai ding thukim uh a, tua ciangin amaute in adang ni sagih sung gualnuamtakin pawi a bawl lai uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in a kikhawm mipi adingin bawngtal tulkhat le tuu le keel tul sagih sik a, uliante in bawngtal tulkhat le tuu le keel tulsawm a sik uh hi. Siampite tampitak amau le amau a ki-ap uh hi."},"25":{"text":"A kikhawm Judah mi buppi - siampite le Levi-te tawh, Israel pana kikhawmte, Israel pana pemtate le Judah a teng pemtate khempeuh tawh a gualnuam khawm uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon huna kipan hih bang om ngei nai lo ahi manin Jerusalem a lungnopna a lian mahmah hi."},"27":{"text":"Mite thupha pia dingin siampite le Levi-te ding uh a, amaute thungetna ama munsiangtho - vantung ah tunga Pasian in a za hi.","ref":"Ms 6:23; Tp 26:15"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh a ven ciangin tua lai-a om Israel-te, Judah-te’ khuapite ah pai uh a, suang siangthote satzanin Asherah khuamte a phuk uh hi. Amaute in Judah le Benjamin sung le Ephraim le Manasseh sung khempeuh ah munsangte le biakna-taute a susia uh hi. Amaute in tuate khempeuh a suksiat khit uh ciangin Israel-te amau neihsa khuapite ah a ciah kik uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:4; 2Kh 32:12"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in siampite le Levi-te a khenkhenin seh a - siampite le Levi-te amau nasepna ciat - meihal biaknate le kilawmtakna biaknate a , biakna nasep le lungdamkohnate le TOPA tenna kongpite ah phatna late a sa dingte a seh hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in zing le nitaka meihal biaknate ading, Sabbath-te, Kha Thakte le TOPA Thukham sunga kigelh a kisehsa pawite adingin ama neihsa panin a pia hi.","title":"Biakna-a Piakte"},"4":{"text":"TOPA Thukham ah siampite le Levi-te amau le amau a ki-ap theih naidngun Jerusalem a teng mite in amau ngah dinga kilawm zah a piak nadingun thu a pia hi."},"5":{"text":"Thupiakna a suahkhiat khit phetin Israel-te in a an panun gahmasate, zu thak, sathau le khuaizu le lo-a piang khempeuh phaltakin a pia uh hi. Amaute in na khempeuh-a sawma khat, tampitak a puak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Judah khuapite a teng Judah-te le Israel-te in zong a ganhonte uh le a tuuhonte uh sawma khat le TOPA amaute Pasian tunga ki-ap a siangtho nate sawma khat puak uh a, a lompi in a ciang uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in hih nasep a kha thumna-in kipan uh a, a kha sagihna-in a man uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah le a uliante pai-in a lompite a muh uh ciangin TOPA phatin Israel mite thupha a pia uh hi.","ref":"Tp 14:28"},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah in siampite le Levi-te kiangah a lompite thu a dong hi;"},"10":{"text":"Zadok innkuan pana siampi uk Azariah in, \"Mite in TOPA biakinnpi ah a kiseh nate a puak-ua kipan kote in ka nek ding uh a cingin ka ngah uh a, khol ding tampi ka nei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA in a mite thupha pia a, hizah tak aval ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah in TOPA biakinnpi sungah vankholna inndei bawl dingin thu pia-a a kibawl hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a kisehte, sawma khat le a ki-ap letsongte muanhuaitakin a puak uh hi. Levi-te khat Conaniah in hih nate uk-a, a sanggampa Shimei ama zoma zalian ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa Hezekiah le Pasian biakinnpi uk ulianpa Azariah sehna tawh Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath le Benaiah-te Conaniah le a sanggampa Shimei nuai-ah a encik ding ahi uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 35:9"},"14":{"text":"Nisuahna Kongpi cingpa Levi-te Imnah tapa Kore in Pasian tunga kipia utthu-a biaknate, TOPA tungah piak dinga kisehte le a ki-apsa letsongte zong uk ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah le Shecaniah-te in khuapite sunga siampite muanhuaitakin huh ding uh a, amau siampi naseppihte tungah a khenkhen zui-in a moi a hamin amau ngah ding ciat a kibangin a hawmsak ding uh hi.","ref":"Jos 21:9-19; 2Kh 29:12"},"16":{"text":"Tua banah, khang ciamtehna sungah a min a kiciamteh kum thum le a tungsiah pasalte - amau hih theihna tawh kizui-in amau khena amau kisapna munah a nisim nasep a sem TOPA biakinnpi sungah a lut peuhmah tanh pia uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuateh amaute in khangthu ciamtehna sunga amau innkuan siampi-a kiciamtehte le tua mah tawh kibanga kiciamteh Levi-te kum sawmnih pan a tungsiahte amau khena a nasepna uh tawh kizui-in a pia ciat uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute in a taneute uh, a zite uh, le mihon buppite tanute, tapate - amaute khangsimna sungah min kiguala kiciamteh peuhmah a helkhawm uh hi. A tuaci sep manin a lamzang hi."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah in muanhuaitakin a sep khempeuh a zawh khit ciangin Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib kuanin Judah a luh hi. Amahmah in zawh sawmin kulh a ki-um khuapite a umcih hi.","title":"Senacherib in Jerusalem Linglawngsak"},"2":{"text":"Sennacherib kuanin Jerusalem sim a sawm lam Hezekiah in a muh ciangin,"},"3":{"text":"khuapi pua-a luang tuinakte panin tui khaktan ding thu a uliante le a galkap uliante kikuppih a, amaute in amah a huh uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Mi thahat tampi khawm uh a gam sunga a luangkhia tuinakte le luite khempeuh a khaktan uh hi. Amaute in, \"Bang hangin Assyria kumpite b hong pai-in tui tampi mu ding uh ahi hiam?\" a ci uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin kulh kitapna munte khempeuh le a tunga tausangte bawlin na nakpi-in a sem uh hi. Amah in a omsa pen pua-ah kulh khat cianbeh a, David Khuapi dinkipna leicialte c a cianbeh lai hi. Galhiamte le lumte zong tampitak a bawl beh hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:24; 1Kh 11:8; Isa 22:8"},"6":{"text":"Amah in mite a uk dingin galkap mangte seh a, khuapi kongpi mai-a tual-awng ah amaute kikhawmsakin hanthawn a:"},"7":{"text":"\"Hat unla hang un. Assyria kumpipa le ama ompih galkap honpi sangin eite hong ompihpa vanglianzaw ahi manin kihta kei unla lungkia kei un."},"8":{"text":"Amah a ompih ci-le-sa galhiam hi beka ei hong ompih ahileh eite hong huh i galte hong dosak ding TOPA eite Pasian ahi hi,\" ci-in thu a gen hi. Tuateh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah gennasa panin mite a lungmuang uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua khit Assyria kumpipa le a galkapte khempeuh in Lachish a umcih uh ciangin Jerusalem ah a uliante sawl-a, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah le tua lai-a om Judah mi khempeuh adingin hih thu khak a:"},"10":{"text":"\"Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib gen hih ahi hi: A ki-umcih Jerusalem ah na om uh bang bulphuha kimuang na hi uh hiam?"},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah in, ‘Assyria kumpipa khut panin TOPA eite Pasian in eite hong hon ding hi,’ ci-in hong makaih khial-a, gilkial dangtakin hong sisak ding ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Hezekiah mahmah in pasiante munsangte le biakna-taute phiatkhia in Judah le Jerusalem tungah, ‘Note in biakna-tau khat mai-ah bia-in tua tungah biaknate na hal pelmawh ding uh hi,’ ci hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"2Kh 31:1"},"13":{"text":"\"Kei le ka pate in gamdanga mite khempeuh tungah ka hihsate uh thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua minamte’ pasiante in kei khut panin a gam uh hukhia thei ngei uh ahi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"Ka pa in a siatsaksa hih minamte’ pasiante khempeuh kua pen in kei panin a mite honkhia thei ahi hiam? Kei khut sung panin note Pasian in bangci-in hukhia zo ding hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in hih bangin Hezekiah kikhemsakin kimakaih-khialsak kei un. Amah um kei un, minam ahikeh kumpi-gam khat pasian khatpeuh in a mite kei khut panin ahi-a, ka pate khut panin ahi zongin a hukhia thei kei uh hi. Na pasian un kei khut panin note hong hu zo ngel ve!\"a cisak hi.","ref":"Pk 5:2; Da 3:15"},"16":{"text":"Sennacherib uliante in TOPA Pasian le a nasem Hezekiah langkhatah a uangzaw thamin kam a pau uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa in TOPA Israel Pasian engkona laikhakte zong gelh a, ama langkhatah: \"Adang gammite pasiante in ka khut panin amau mite a hutzawh loh bang tektekin Hezekiah pasian in zong a mite kei khut panin a hukhia zo kei ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute lau uh a, khuapi a lak theih nadingun amaute a linglawngsak dingin kulh tunga om Jerusalem mite tungah Hebrew pau-in nakpi in a genkhia uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in amau bawltawm - mihingte khuta kibawl leitung midangte pasiante thu bang lelin Jerusalem a Pasian thu a gen uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih thu tawh kisai-in Kumpi Hezekiah le Amoz tapa kamsangpa Isaiah thungenin van tungah a kiko uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA in Assyria kumpipa giahphual-a om galkapte le makaite le uliante khempeuh a susiamang ding vansawltak khat a sawl hi. Tua ciangin amah lungkia-in a gamah a nungkik ta hi. Tuateh ama pasian biakinn sungah a pai ciangin a tapate pawlkhat in namsau-in amah a thatlum uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:35-37"},"22":{"text":"Tuaci-in Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib khut pan le a dangte khempeuh khut panin TOPA in Hezekiah le Jerusalem mite a honkhia hi. Amah in amaute a mun citeng panin a don hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi tampi in Jerusalem ah TOPA adingin biaknate puak uh a, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah adingin letsong manphate a puak uh hi.
