Amah in TOPA tungah thu ngen-a, amah in dawngin lim piandang khat a lak hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin Hezekiah lungtang kiphasak a, amah a kilak migitna a dawng nuam kei hi; tua ahi ciangin TOPA thangpaihna ama tung le Judah tung le Jerusalem tungah a tu hi.","title":"Hezekiah’ Kiphatsakna, Matutna le Sihna"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Hezekiah in a lungsim kiphatsakna kisik-a, Jerusalem mite zong a kisik uh hi; tua ahi ciangin Hezekiah a nuntak sungin TOPA thangpaihna amaute tungah a tung kei hi."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah hau mahmah in kipahtawi mahmah a, a ngun a kham le a suangmanphate, gimnamtuite, lumte le van manpha namkim koih nading vankholnate a bawl hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in an, zu thak le sathau khol nading innte zong a lam hi; tuateh ganhon namkim khum nadingin ganbuk bawl a, tuuhonte adingin tuubukte a lam hi."},"29":{"text":"Pasian in hauhna tampitak pia ahi manin amah in khuaneute lam a tuuhonte le ganhonte tampitak a ngah hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:12"},"30":{"text":"Gihon tuinak tungnung khaktan in khekhia a, hawkguam to-in David Khuapi nitumna lamah a luangsakpa Hezekiah mah ahi hi. Amah in a nasepna khempeuh a zo hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi hangin a gamsungua piang lim piandang thu a dong dingin Babylon gam-ukte in palai a sawl uh ciangin, ama lungsim-a om khempeuh a theih nadingin a zia-etna-in Pasian in amah a nusia hi.","ref":"Tp 8:16; Isa 39:1"},"32":{"text":"Hezekiah uk sunga a sepsa dangte le a ki-ap zawhna dangte Judah le Israel kumpite laibu sunga Amoz tapa kamsangpa Isaiah mangmuhna sungah kigelh hi."},"33":{"text":"Hezekiah a pate tawh tawlnga khawm a David suante han omna mualtung ah a kivui hi. Amah a sih ciangin Judah khempeuh le Jerusalem a mite in a pahtawi uh hi. Tuateh a tapa Manasseh in a kumpi za luaha kumpi a suak hi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh kumpi a suahin kum sawm le nih pha-a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga le nga sung a uk hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Manasseh"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in Israel-te mai pana a nawhkhiat minamte’ kihhuai gamtatnate amah in zui-a, TOPA muhna-ah a sia-in a gamta hi."},"3":{"text":"A pa Hezekiah in a phiatmangsa munsangte lam kik a; Baal biakna-taute zong dawhin Asherah khuamte a bawl hi. Aksi honte khempeuh tungah kunin tuate a bia hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Jerusalem ah ka Min a omden ding hi,\" a cihna TOPA biakinnpi sungah biakna-taute a dawh hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA biakinnpi tualte gel ah aksi honte khempeuh biak nading biakna-tau a dawh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in Ben Hinnom Kuam sungah biakna-in a tapate mei sungah a halin khongkhai-in. ai san a, ai tawi-in, sikhate le vankahte thu a dong hi. Amah in TOPA muhna ah a sia tampitak sem-a a heh nadingin a phin hi.","ref":"Sp 18:21; 19:31; 1Sa 28:13"},"7":{"text":"Amah in a kikhuaksa milimte la-in Pasian biakinnpi sungah koih hi; tua mun pen Pasian in David le a tapa Solomon tungah, \"Hih biakinnpi sung le Jerusalem sung pen Israel behte khempeuh pana ka teelkhiat hi-a ka Min ka koih tawntung nading ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Moses tungtawna ka thupiakte, thukhamte, thukipte, le thukhote - amaute tawh a kisai na pate un limtaka a zuih uh leh amaute ka piaksa leitang, Israel-te khe ka lawisak ngei kei ding hi,\" a cihsa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuaci-in Manasseh in Judah le Jerusalem a mite lam khialsak a, amaute in Israel mai-a TOPA in a siatsak minamte sangin a siazaw in a gamta hi.","ref":"2Ku 21:1-10; Jer 15:4"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in Manasseh le a mite hopih napi amaute in a thudon kei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in amaute langah Assyria kumpipa galkap mangte puaka, tuate in thong sungah Manasseh khumin, a nak ah sikawi thuah uh a sumngo kolte bulhsakin Babylon ah a paipih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah lungdong lua-in TOPA a Pasian angvanna zong a, a pate Pasian mai-ah a kiniamkhiat mahmah hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuateh amah in ama tungah thu ngen a, tua ciangin ama maibiakna in TOPA kiheisakin a thumna a ngaihsak hi; tua ahi ciangin a kumpi-gam Jerusalem ah a puak kik hi. Tua ciangin TOPA in Pasian ahilam Manasseh in a thei hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:26; 1Pe 5:6"},"14":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin amah in Gihon tuinak nitumna lam Ngasa Kongpi lutna dong David Khuapi kulh puanung pen ciang kik a, Aphel mual umcihsak in; a sangzaw thamin a bawl hi. Amah in kulha ki-um Judah khuapite khempeuh ah galkap mangte a omsak kim hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in gamdang pasiante hemkhia-a, TOPA biakinnpi pan a kikhuak milimte lakhia in biakinnpi mualno tunga ama dawhsa biakna-tau khempeuh le Jerusalem sunga kidawh biakna-taute khempeuh phelkhiamang in; khuapi pualam ah a paikhia khawm hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA biakna-tau a ngeina bangin dawh kik-a a tungah kilawmtakna biaknate b le lungdamkohna biaknate pia-in, Judah in TOPA Israel Pasian na a sep nadingun a gen hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi ta zongin mite in munsangte ah biakna pia kawmkawm uh a, ahi hangin TOPA amaute Pasian tung bek ahi hi.","ref":"tg 3-7; Sp 7:11-18"},"18":{"text":"Manasseh in a uk sung a sep dangte Pasian tungah a thungetna le TOPA Israel Pasian mina thumute genna kammalte Israel c kumpite khangthute sungah kigelh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ama thungetna, a lutna hangin Pasian in a lungsim a khekna le a mawhnate khempeuh le a muanhuai lohna le amah a kiniamkhiat ma-in munsang bawla Asherah khuamte le milimte a koihna phual thute khempeuh thumute d ciamtehna sungah kigelh hi."},"20":{"text":"A pate tawh Manasseh tawlnga khawm a, a kumpi inn ah kivui hi. Tuateh a tapa Amon in a kumpi za luah a kumpi a suak hi.","ref":"2Ku 21:17-18"},"21":{"text":"Amon kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le nih pha a, Jerusalem ah kum nih sung a uk hi."},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh sepsa bangin TOPA muhna ah a sia in a gamta hi. Amon in Manasseh bawlsa milim khempeuh bia in tuate tungah biakna a pia hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Amon"},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin a pa bangin TOPA mai-ah kiniamkhiat lo a, Amon in a khialhna a khangsak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amon uliante in amah sawmsim uh a, a kumpi inn sungah a suam uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin gammite in Kumpi Amon langa a sawmsim khempeuh that uh a, ama munah a tapa Josiah kumpi in a koih uh hi."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah kumpi a suahin kum giat pha a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum le khat sung a uk hi.","title":"Josiah Puahphatte"},"2":{"text":"TOPA mit ah a maanin gamta-a a pa David lampite zui-in veilam ahi-a taklam ahi zongin a pial kei hi.","ref":"2Ku 22:1-2; 1Kh 3:14; 2Kh 29:2"},"3":{"text":"Ama uk a kum giatna, a khangmoi lai mah in a pa David Pasian zon ding a kipanpah hi. A kum sawm leh nihna sungin Judah le Jerusalem a munsangte, Asherah khuamte, a kikhuak milimte le a kisung limte siaksiang ding a kipan hi."},"4":{"text":"Ama lamlahna nuai-ah Baalte biakna-taute kiphelzan a, tuate tunga om gimnamtui halna-taute satnenin Asherah khuamte, milimte le nate limte a gawizan hi. Hihte sunen a, tuate tunga biakna a piate hante tungah a theh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in amaute biakna-taute tungah a siampite uh guhte hal-a, tua bangin Judah le Jerusalem a hahsiang hi."},"6":{"text":"Manasseh, Ephraim le Simeon khuapite Naphtali sung le tuate kim a, a siasate dongin"},"7":{"text":"biakna-taute le Asherah khuamte phelkhiagawp a, a milimte gawivui-in Israel gamsung tenga gimnamtui-a biakna-tau khempeuh a satnen hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem ah a ciah kik hi.","ref":"Sp 26:30; 1Ku 13:2; 2Kh 31:1"},"8":{"text":"Josiah in a uk a kum giatna in gamsung teng le biakinnpi siansuah dingin Azaliah tapa Shaphan le khuapi ukpa Maseiah sawl a, TOPA ama Pasian biakinnpi puah dingin thu ciamtehpa Joahaz tapa Joah tawh a sawlkhawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute tulpi Hilkiah kiangah pai uh a, kongkhakpi cing Levite in Manasseh, Ephraim le Israel a baanglai khempeuh le Judah le Benjamin khempeuh le Jerusalem a tengte khempeuh tunga a don uh Pasian biakinnpi-a kipuak sumte amah a pia uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in TOPA biakinnpi a nasepte cing dinga kisehte tungah a ap uh hi. Hihte pen biakinnpi a ngei a bangsak dinga a puahphate tungah a piasawn uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in zong Judah kumpite suksiat inn kisiate puah nading - suangseeksa le a peh nading le innkam ding singte lei nadingin khutsiamte le inn lamte tungah a piasawn uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 33:4-7; 35:8"},"12":{"text":"Mite in kiciantakin na a sem uh hi. Amaute tungah lamlak dingin Merari pan Levi-te suan Jahath le Obadiah le Kohath suante pan Meshullum le Zechariah ahi hi. Levi-te - tumtheih tum siamte khempeuh -"},"13":{"text":"in vanpuate cingin nasepna khempeuh a uk uh hi. Levi-te pawlkhat thuvante, laigelhte le kongkhak cingte ahi uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 12:15"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA biakinnpi sunga kipuaksa sumte a lakkhiat khiat laitakun siampi Hilkiah in Moses tungtawna kipiasa TOPA Thukham laibu a mu hi."},"15":{"text":"Hilkiah in thuvanpipa Shaphan tungah, \" TOPA biakinnpi sungah Thukham Laibu ka mu hi,\" a ci hi. Amah in Shaphan a pia hi.","title":"Thukham Laibu Kimu","ref":"2Ku 22:8; Ezr 7:6; Ne 8:1"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shaphan in kumpipa kiangah laibu paipih in: \"Na uliante in amau tungah a kisawlsate peuhmah a sepsan laitak uh ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA biakinnpi sunga sumte piakhia uh a nasepna vaante le nasemte tungah kipia hi,\" ci-in a zasak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin thuvanpipa Shaphan in kumpipa kiangah, \"Siampi Hilkiah in laibu khat kei hong pia hi,\" ci-in a ko hi. Tuateh kumpipa omin Shaphan in tua laibu a sim hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in kammalte a zak ciangin a puante a balkek hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Micah a tapa Abdon, thuvanpipa Shaphan le kumpipa sawltakpa Asaiah-te tungah:"},"21":{"text":"\"Pai unla hih a kimusa laibu ah kei ading, a baanglai Israel-te ading le Judah adingin bang kigelh hiam, TOPA hong dotsak un. I pate in TOPA thu a zuih lohna uh hangin ei tunga hong kisung TOPA hehna a lian hi; amaute in hih laibu sunga kigelhsa khempeuh tawh kizui-in na a sem kei uh hi,\" ci-in thu a pia hi.","ref":"2Kh 29:8; Ta 2:4; Eze 36:18"},"22":{"text":"Hilkiah le kumpipa in amah b tawh a sawlte, Hasrah c tapa Tokhath d tapa biakinn puan kempa Shallum zi kamsangnu Huldah hopih dingin a pai uh hi. Tuanu Jerusalem Gamkhen Nihna ah a teng hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuanu in amaute kiangah, \" TOPA Israel Pasian gen hih ahi hi: Kei kianga nang hong sawlte tungah,"},"24":{"text":"‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in hih mun le a mite tungah gimna ka tungsak dinga - tua gimna pen Judah kumpipa oma kisim hih laibu sunga kigelhsa hamsiatna khempeuh ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong nusia uh a, pasian dangte tungah gimnamtui halin amau khutin a bawlsa e teng uh tawh kei hong hehsak uh ahi manin hih mun tungah ka hehna ka sung dinga a kimitsak nawn kei ding hi,’ ci hi."},"26":{"text":"TOPA thu dong dinga note hong sawl Judah kumpipa kiangah, ‘Na zaksa uh thute tawh kisai-in TOPA Israel Pasian gen hih ahi hi:"},"27":{"text":"Hih mun le a mite tunga thu kigensa na zak ciangin na lungsimin dawng a Pasian mai-ah nang mahmah kiniamkhiat na hi man le ka mai-ah nangmah kiniamkhiatin na puante balkekin ka muhna ah kap na hi manin na thugen ka za khin hi, TOPA in cikhia hi."},"28":{"text":"Tu-in na pate omna ah nang kong gawm ding a, lungnuamtakin na kivui ding hi. Hih mun le a tunga tengte tunga ka tunsak ding gimnate khempeuh na mit in a mu kei ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in kumpipa tungah tuanu dawnna a puak kik uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 12:7; 32:26; 35:20-25; 2Ku 22:8-20qs*"},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Judah le Jerusalem upate khempeuh a khawmsak hi."},"30":{"text":"TOPA biakinnpi ah amah tawh Judah mite, Jerusalem a mite, siampite le Levi-te - aneupen pan alianpen dong mi khempeuh a paikhawm uh hi. Amah in TOPA biakinnpi sunga kimu Thukhun Laibu sunga thute khempeuh amaute zakin a sim hi."},"31":{"text":"A khuampi gei-ah kumpipa dinga, TOPA zui-in a lungsim neihzah le a hinna khempeuh tawh a thupiakte, zuih ding ngeinate le a thukipte zui-in hih laibu sunga thukhun thute a man nading - TOPA thukhun a mai-ah thaksuaksak hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jerusalem le Benjamin sunga omte khempeuh tua tungah a kiciamsak hi. Jerusalem mite in Pasian thukhun tawh kituakin a pate uh Pasian a zui uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:1-3; 2Kh 23:16"},"33":{"text":"Israel-te neihsa gam khempeuh panin Josiah in a kihhuai milimte khempeuh paikhia-a Israel sunga omte khempeuh TOPA amau Pasian na a semsak hi. Amah in a nuntak laiteng a pate Pasian ahi TOPA a zuikhial kei hi.","ref":"tg 3-7; Tp 18:9"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah in Jerusalem ah TOPA Paisan-pawi bawl-a a kha masa pen a ni sawm le lina ni-in Paisan tuuno kigo hi.","title":"Josiah in Paisanpawi Bawl"},"2":{"text":"Amah in siampite amau nasepna mun ah seh a, TOPA biakinnpi sunga amaute nasepna ah a hanthawn hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in Israel khempeuh lam a lak TOPA tunga a ki-apsa Levi-te tungah: \"Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon lamsa biakinnpi sungah a siangtho singkuangpi koih un. Na liangko un na pua kei ding hi. Tu-in TOPA note Pasian le ama mi Israel na sem un."},"4":{"text":"Israel kumpipa David le a tapa Solomon in lamlahna a gelhsa bangin a khenkhenin a innkuan zui-in kithawikhol ciat un.","ref":"Pk 12:1-30"},"5":{"text":"\"Na gam mipihte uh a khentuam-te minautang ahi manin Levi-te pawlkhat tawh mun siangtho ah dingkhawm un."},"6":{"text":"Na gam mipihte uh adingin Paisan tuunote go unla, no le no ki-apin tuunote sa bawl unla Moses tunga TOPA thupiak bangin sem un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 11:44"},"7":{"text":"Tua lai-a om minautangte khempeuh in Paisan pawi-a biakna-a a zat ding uh tuu le keel a kigawmin tul sawmthum Josiah in sik a, bawngtal tulthum zong a sik lai hi - a vekpi in kumpipa neihsate pan ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"A uliante in zong amau utthu-in mipite le siampite le Levi-te tungah a khenkhia uh hi. Pasian biakinnpi a, a saipite ahi Hikiah, Zechariah le Jehiel-te in Paisan pawi-a biakna gante tulnih le zaguk le bawng zathum siampite a pia uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Conaniah in zong a sanggamte Shemaiah, Nethanel le Levi-te makaite Hashabiah, Jeiel, le Jozabad-te tawh Paisan pawi-a biakna gan tulnih le zaguk le bawngtalpi zanga Levi-te a sik uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 31:12-13"},"10":{"text":"Kikhop nading kithawi khina, kumpipa thupiaksa bangin siampite amau munah dingin, Levi-te amau khenkhen ah a om dimdiam uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Paisan tuunote kigo a, Levi-te in ganhingte vunte a hawk laitakun, amaute a kipia sisante siampite in a theh uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in Moses laibu sunga kigelh bangin, a innkuan zui-a a khenkhena om mite in meihal biakna-a a piak dingun a kipia dingte a tuamkoih uh hi. Amaute in bawngte zong a kibangin a hih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A kigelkholsa bangin amaute in Paisan gante mei-ah hang uh a, a siangtho biaknate, beelte, taubeelpi-te le sikbeelpite in huan uh a, mipite khempeuh tungah manlangin a lui uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hihte khit ciangin amaute le siampite ading a bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Aaron suan siampite in meihal biakna le sathaute zan hun dongin a hal uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin Levi-te in amau ading le Aaron siampigui-te adingin sa a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Pk 12:2-11; 29:13; 2Kh 29:22,34"},"15":{"text":"David, Asaph, Heman le kumpipa thumupa Jeduthun-te gualhsa munah Asaph suan tumtheih siamte a om uh hi. Kongpi cingte tangin a lawmte un bawlsak khin uh ahi manin amaute in a omna uh a laih ding uh a kisam kei hi.","ref":"1Kh 25:1"},"16":{"text":"Tuaci-in Kumpi Josiah thupiak bangin Paisan pawi bawl nading le TOPA biakna-tau tungah meihal biakna piak nadingin tua hunin TOPA nasep nading buppi kimansiang hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hunin tua lai-a Paisan pawi a bawl Israel-te in Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi ni sagih sung a bawl uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Kamsang Samuel huna kipan Israel sungah tua bangin Paisan pawi a kibawl ngei nai kei hi; tuateh Josiah bawl bangin siampite, Levi-te le Jerusalem mite tawh tua lai-a omkhawm Judah le Israel khempeuh tawh Paisan-pawi a bawl khawm Israel kumpi khat beek a om nai kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Josiah kumpi a suah zawh a kum sawm le giatna kumin hih Paisan pawi kibawl hi."},"20":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh khit Josiah in biakinnpi a ngei a batsak khit ciangin Euphrates gei-a Carchemish ah do dingin Egypt kumpipa Neco kuanto a, amah tawh gal kido dingin Josiah a kuankhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi hangin Neco in ama tungah kamtai sawl a, \"Judah kumpipa aw, nang le kei kikalah i kitot nading bang om ahi hiam? Tu hunin nang sim dinga hong kuan hi loin ka galte innkuan sim ding ka hizaw hi. Pasian in ka kinawh ding hong gen khin hi; kei hong ompih Pasian na langpanna khawl in; na khawl kei leh nang hong susia ding hi,\" a cisak hi.","title":"Josiah Sihna","ref":"1Ku 13:18; Isa 10:9"},"22":{"text":"Ahi zongin Josiah kileh kik nuam lo a, gal sungah amah tawh kido dingin a meel a seel hi. Amah in Pasian thupiak Neco gensa ngai nuam lo a, Megiddo zanglei ah amah tawh kido dingin a kuan hi.","ref":"1Sa 28:8; 2Kh 18:29"},"23":{"text":"Thal tawite in Kumpi Josiah kap uh a, amah in a uliante kiangah, \"Hong paikhiatpih un; ka nak liam mahmah hi,\" a ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a leng sung pan amah lakhia uh a, leng dang khatah koihin Jerusalem ah puak uh a, tua lai-ah a si hi. Amah a pate hanah kivui-a, Judah le Jerusalem khempeuh ama hangin a thum uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 22:34"},"25":{"text":"Jeremiah in Josiah tamlawhnate phuaka, numei le pasal lasate in a taamlawh uh ciangin tuni dong Josiah a kahtap uh hi. Hihte Israel ah tang ngeina suaka tamlawhna ah a kigelh hi."},"26":{"text":"Josiah in a uk sung thupiang dangte le TOPA Thukham sunga kigelh tawh kizui-in ki-ap a, a septe -"},"27":{"text":"a nasep khempeuh a kipatna pan a tawpna dong Israel le Judah kumpite laibu sungah kigelh hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuateh a gam mite in Josiah tapa Jehoahaz la in Jerusalem ah a pa tangin kumpi a suaksak uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:28-30"},"2":{"text":"Jehoahaz a kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le thum hi-a, Jerusalem ah kha thum sung a uk hi."},"3":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Jerusalem ah a kumpi za kiasak a, Judah tungah ngun talent b zakhat le kham talent c khat, siah in a kipiasak hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoahaz"},"4":{"text":"Egypt kumpipa in Jehoahaz sanggampa Eliakim, Judah le Jerusalem kumpi suaksak a, Eliakim min Jehoiakim in a kheksak hi. Ahi hangin Neco in Eliakim sanggampa Jehoahaz la-in Egypt ah a paikhiatpih hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:31-34"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le nga hi-a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung a uk hi. Amah TOPA a Pasian muhna ah a sia-in gamta hi."},"6":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar amah sim dingin kuanto-a Babylon a paipih dingin kol a bulh hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoiakim"},"7":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in TOPA biakinnpi d sunga vanzatte zong Babylon ah la a, tua lai-a ama biakinnpi ah a koih hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:13; Jer 26:1; 35:1"},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakim uk sunga a sep dangte a kihhuai na a sepnate le amah pana kimu a ginatlohnate khempeuh Judah le Israel kumpite laibu sungah kigelh hi. Tuateh a tapa Jehoiachin in a kumpi za a luah hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:36-24:6"},"9":{"text":"Jehoiachin kumpi a suahin kum sawm le giat e hi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum le ni sawm sung a uk hi. Amah TOPA muhna ah a sia-in gamta hi."},"10":{"text":"Khuakhal hun ciangin kumpi Nebuchadnezzar in amah vaikhak a, TOPA biakinnpi pana van manphate tawh Babylon ah puakhawmin, Jehoiachin pano f Zedekiah, Judah le Jerusalem kumpi a suaksak hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Jehoiachin","ref":"Jer 22:25; 37:1; Eze 17:12"},"11":{"text":"Zedekiah kumpi a suahin kum sawmnih le khat hi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm le khat sung a uk hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA ama Pasian muhna ah a sia-in gamta a, TOPA kammal a genpa kamsang Jeremiah mai-ah a kiniamkhiat kei hi.","title":"Judah Kumpi Zedekiah"},"13":{"text":"Amah Pasian mina a kiciamsak Nebuchadnezzar zong a lehdo hi. Pasian in amaute khempeuh Nebuchadnezzar tungah a pia khin hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in Pasian biakinnpi pan, TOPA biakinnpi goukholnate le kumpipa le a uliante goukholna-a vante aneu alianin Babylon ah a pua hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian biakinnpi hal uh a, Jerusalem kulh phelkhia-in; kumpi-inn khempeuh haltum uh a, tua lai-a na manpha peuhmah a susia uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in namsau pana suakta a baanglaite Babylon ah sal-in kai a, Persia kumpi-gam in vang a neih matengin amaute amah le a tapate nasem a suak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"A gam in Sabbath tawlngakna nuamsa a; Jeremiah in TOPA kammal a gen a tangtun nadingin kum sawm sagih a cin dipdep matengin a kinusiat hun sungteng leitang a tawlnga hi.","ref":"Ezr 1:1-3; Jer 25:11"},"22":{"text":"Persia kumpipa Cyrus kumpi a suah a kum masapenin, Jeremiah gen TOPA kammal a tangtun theih nadingin TOPA in Persia kumpipa Cyrus lungsim hei-a a kumpi-gam sung tengah tangkosakin lai-in zong koihsaka tua lai sungah:"},"23":{"text":"\"Persia kumpipa Cyrus gen hih ahi hi: \"‘ TOPA vantung Pasian in leitung kumpi-gam khempeuh kei hong pia khina, Judah gam Jerusalem ah ama ading biakinnpi khat a lam dingin kei hong seh hi. Sumbeite kumpi sumkholna panin kipia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinnpi pan lakhia a Babylon a, a puak ngun le khama kibawl Pasian inn a vanzatte Jerusalem biakinnpi a, amau mun ciat ah kipuak kik ding hi; tuate Pasian inn sunga a omna ngei tekah kikoih ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 29:2; Ezr 1:7; Hag 2:3"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin tu-in, Euphrates-Gal ukpipa Tattenai le Shethar-Bozenai le nang, tua gam ulian amaute lawmte na kihemkhia ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Hih Pasian biakinnpi nasep nawngkaisak kei un. Jew-te ukpipa le Jew upate amau omna mun ngei ah Pasian inn lamsak kik un."},"8":{"text":"Tua ban ah hih Jew upate in Pasian inn na lam nadingun thukip kong pia hi: Nasep a kibansap loh nadingin hih mite zat khempeuh Euphrates-Gal leitang siahkholna kumpi sum kholna pan a vekin kipia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"A kisam peuhmah - vantung Pasian tunga meihal biakna-a piak dingin bawngtalno, tuutal, tuupano, le mangbuh, ci, zu, sathau, Jerusalem a siampite nget bangbang - nisimin kibansam loin kipia pelmawh ding hi,"},"10":{"text":"tua pen amaute in vantung Pasian a lungkim nadingin a piak theih nading uh le kumpipa le a tapate a cidam nadingun thu a ngetsak theih nading uh ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 9:20; Ezr 7:23"},"11":{"text":"Tua ban lai-ah hih thukip a khel khatpeuh a om leh a innkhuam khat kibot dinga, a tungah amah kihencipin kikhai ding hi. Hih a bawl mawhna hangin ama inn ninkholna kisuaksak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih thukip a khel ding le Jerusalem a biakinnpi a susia dingin a khut a liik khatpeuh, ama Min ten nading a bawl Pasian in lawnthal ta hen. Keimah Darius in thukip kong pia hi. Keima piak bang tektekin kisem ta hen.","ref":"Tp 12:5; Da 2:5"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa Darius thukip a kikhak bang tektekin Euphrates-Gal ukpipa Tattenai le Shethar-Bozenai le amaute a huhte in a sem uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua bangin kamsangpa Haggai le Iddo suante Zechariah thuhilhna zui-in Jew upate in inn lam zom uh a, ama uh a telh mahmah uh hi. Amaute in Israel Pasian thupiakna le Persia kumpite - Cyrus, Darius le Artaxerxes thukipna bangin biakinnpi lam a mansiang uh hi.","title":"Biakinnpi Mansiangna le Apna"},"15":{"text":"Kumpi Darius in a uk a kum gukna Adar kha a nithumna ni-in biakinnpi kizosiang hi.","ref":"Ezr 5:1; Zec 4:9"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mipite - siampite, Levi-te le adang sal suaktate khempeuh in lungnuam-takin Pasian inn apna pawi a bawl uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Hih Pasian inn ap nadingin amaute in bawngtal zakhat, tuutal zanih, tuuno apa zali le Israel beh’ khat ciangin keel apa khat ta - mawhna hanga biakna-in Israel-te khempeuh in keel apa sawm le nih a pia uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuateh Jerusalem a Pasian nasepna ah Moses Laibu a kigelhsa tawh kizui-in siampite amau khen omna munah semsakin Levi-te amau pawl sepna mun mah ah a semsak kik uh hi.","ref":"Ms 3:6; 1Ku 8:63"},"19":{"text":"A kha masa a ni sawm le nilina ni-in salsuaktate in Paisanna pawi a bawl uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Siampite le Levi-te amau le amau kisiansuah uh a thukham kalh bangin a vekun a siang uh hi. Levi-te in sal suakta khempeuh, amaute sanggam, siampite le amau mahmah adingin Paisan tuuno a go uh hi.","title":"Paisan Pawi"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin amau’ Gentile vengte tawh a nin a sepna uh hanga amau le amau a kikhenkhiate in TOPA Israel-te Pasian a zon theih nadingun amaute khempeuh tawh salsuahna pana a ciah kik Israel-te khempeuh in an a nekpih khawm uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute in ni sagih sung Silngo-sawhloh Anlum Pawi lungnuamtakin pawi a bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te Pasian, Pasian inn lam nasepna ah a huh dingin TOPA in Assyria kumpipa ngimna heisak-a, amaute a lungnuamsak hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciang Persia kumpipa Artaxerxes in a uk laitakin Seraiah tapa Ezra, Azariah tapa Seraiah, Hilkiah tapa Azariah,","title":"Jerusalem ah Ezra Pai"},"2":{"text":"Shallum tapa Hilkiah, Zadok tapa Shallum, Ahitub tapa Zadok,"},"3":{"text":"Amariah tapa Ahitub, Azariah tapa Amariah, Meraioth tapa Azariah,"},"4":{"text":"Zerahiah tapa Meraioth, Uzzi tapa Zerahiah, Bukki tapa Uzzi,"},"5":{"text":"Abishua tapa Bukki, Phinehas tapa Abishua, Eleazar tapa Phinehas, siampi makai Aaron Eleazar-"},"6":{"text":"hih Ezra pen Babylon pana paito ahi hi. Amah, TOPA Israel Pasian in a piaksa Moses Thukham a thei mahmah sia khat ahi hi. TOPA ama Pasian khut in amah ompih ahi manin a nget khempeuh kumpipa in a pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Artaxerxes in a uk a kum sagihna kumin Israel-te pawlkhat, siampite, Levi-te, lasate, kongpi cingte le biakinnpi nasemte tawh Jerusalem ah a paito khawm uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 8:1"},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa uk a kum sagihna kum, a kha ngana-in Jerusalem ah Ezra a tung hi."},"9":{"text":"A kha masapen a ni masapen ni-in Babylon panin khualzin kipankhia-a a hoih ama Pasian khutin ompih ahi manin a kha ngana a ni masapen ni-in Jerusalem ah a tung hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA Thukham sin ding, tang ding, ama thukipte le thukhamte Israel-te laka hilh dingin amah a kipia khin zo hi.","ref":"Tp 33:10"},"11":{"text":"Israel-te adingin TOPA thupiakte le thukipte tawh kisai a, laisiampa siampi Ezra - siapa tungah Kumpi Artaxerxes in a laikhak hih ahi hi:"},"12":{"text":"a Artaxerxes, kumpite’ kumpipa, Siampi Ezra, vantung Pasian Thukham siapa tungah: Kong hopih hi.","title":"Ezra tunga Kumpi Artaxerxes Laikhak","ref":"Eze 26:7; Da 23:7"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in ka kumpi gam sungah om Israel-te, siampite, Levi-te zong a ut peuhpeuh, Jerusalem a nang hong zui nuamte a pai theih nading uh thukip ka pia hi."},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa le ama thudot mi sagihte in na khut sunga om na Pasian Thukham tawh kisai-in Judah le Jerusalem a thupiang kan dingin nang kong sawl uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua banah Jerusalem a teng kumpipa le a thudotte in Israel Pasian tungah utthu-a a piak uh ngun le khamte tawh gawmin puak unla,"},"16":{"text":"Babylon gamkhen pana kingah ngun le khamte khempeuh leh mite le siampite in Jerusalem a amau Pasian biakinnpi dinga utthu-a a piakte uh tawh gawmkhawm un."},"17":{"text":"Hih sumte tawh Jerusalem a note Pasian biakinnpi-a biakna-tau ah piak dingin bawngtalte, tuutalte le tuuno apate, an-a biaknate le dawntheih-a biakna bekin na zang ding uh hi.","ref":"Est 1:14"},"18":{"text":"A val lai ngun le khamte note Pasian deih bangin nang le na sanggam Jew-te in a hoih pen dinga na ngaihsut bangun na hih ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Na Pasian biakinnpi sunga biak nadingin nang tunga hong kipia sawn vanzatte khempeuh Jerusalem a Pasian tungah pia in."},"20":{"text":"Tuateh na Pasian biakinnpi dinga kisam dang khatpeuh piak nop na neih leh kumpi sumkholna panin na zang thei ding hi.","ref":"Ezr 6:4"},"21":{"text":"Tu-in kumpipa keimah Artaxerxes in Euphrates-Gal gama sumkem khempeuh tungah siampi Ezra, vantung Pasian Thukham, siapa in no tungah hong nget peuhpeuh -"},"22":{"text":"ngun talent a zakhat ciang, mangbuh cor b zakhat ciang, lenggahzu bath c zakhat ciang, olive thau bath d zakhat ciang le ci a deih zahzah hong sik nadingun thu ka pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Vantung Pasian biakinnpi dingin vantung Pasian deih zahzah kihih ta hen. Bang hangin kumpipa le a tapate gam tungah thangpaihna tung zenzen ding ahi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"Note in siampite, Levi-te, lasate, kongpi cingte, biakinnpi nasemte le hih Pasian inn a nasem dangte tungah siah, mangmu le a sap peuhpeuh lak nading thu na neih loh lam uh zong kong theisak hi.","ref":"Ezr 6:10"},"25":{"text":"Tuateh nang Ezra in nangma neihsa na Pasian pilna tawh kizui-in, Euphrates-Gal a om mite na Pasian thukham a thei khempeuh, thutanga a uk ding thu vaihawmte le thukhente seh in. A thei lote na hilh ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Na Pasian thukham le kumpipa thukham a mang lo peuhpeuh sihna, hawlkhiatna, neihsa matsakna ahikeh thong kiatsakna dan kithuaksak pelmawh ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Jerusalem a TOPA ’ inn a kizahtak theih nadingin hih banga kumpipa lungsim a guan i pate Pasian TOPA kiphat ta hen. Amah in"},"28":{"text":"kumpipa le a thudotte le a vanglian kumpipa uliante mai-ah ama angvanna hoih kei hong ngahsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA ka Pasian khut in kei hong ompih ahi manin ka lungsim thakhauh a, Israel panin kei hong zui ding makai ka khawm hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:12; Ezr 5:5"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Kumpi Artaxerxes hun lai-a Jerusalem pana kei hong zui innkuan lutangte le amau tawh a kiciamteh khawmte ahi hi:","title":"Ezra Tawh a Ciahkik Innkuan Makaite Min","ref":"Ezr 7:7"},"2":{"text":"Phinehas suante pan Gershom, Ithamar suante pan Daniel; David suante pan Hattush,"},"3":{"text":"ama suante pan Shecaniah; Parosh suante pan Zechariah le amah tawh kiciamteh khawm mi 150;","ref":"Ezr 2:3"},"4":{"text":"Pahath-Moab suante pan Zerahiah tapa Eliehoenai le amah tawh pasal 200;","ref":"Ezr 2:6"},"5":{"text":"Zattu e suante pan Jahaziel tapa Shecaniah le amah tawh pasal 300;"},"6":{"text":"Adin suante pan, Jonathan tapa Ebed, le amah tawh pasal 50;"},"7":{"text":"Elam suante pan, Athaliah tapa Jeshaiah-te amah tawh pasal 70;"},"8":{"text":"Shephatiah suante pan Michael tapa Zebadiah le amah tawh pasal 80;"},"9":{"text":"Joab suante pan Jehiel tapa Obadiah le amah tawh pasal 218;"},"10":{"text":"Bani f suante pan Josiphiah tapa Shelomith le amah tawh pasal 160;"},"11":{"text":"Bebai suante pan Bebai tapa Zechariah le amah tawh pasal 28;"},"12":{"text":"Azgad suante pan Hakkatan tapa Johanan le amah tawh pasal 110;"},"13":{"text":"Adonikam suante pan a nung paite min, Eliphelet, Jeuel, le Shemaiah le amah tawh pasal 60;","ref":"Ezr 2:13"},"14":{"text":"Bigvai suante pan Uthai le Zaccur amaute tawh pasal 70 ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahava lam manawha luang hawkguam ah amaute khawmin tua lai-ah ni thum ka tam uh hi. Mipite le siampite lak ka etcian ciangin Levi-te ka mu kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin a makaite Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan Zechariah le Meshullam, laisiam Joiarib le Elnathan-te","title":"Jerusalem-a Ciahkikna"},"17":{"text":"Casiphia-a makaipa Iddo kiangah amaute ka paisak hi. Amaute in eite Pasian inn a nasem ding hong puak nadingun Casiphia a biakinnpi nasemte ahi Iddo le a tanaute kiangah a gen ding uh ka hilh hi."},"18":{"text":"A migi Pasian khut in eite hong ompih ahi manin amaute in Israel’ tapa Levi, a tapa Mahli suante panin a ngaihsut siam Sherebiah tapate le a sanggampate pasal 18;"},"19":{"text":"le Hashabiah, Merari suante panin Jeshaiah tawh a sanggam pasalte le a panote mi 20 hong tonpih uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute in biakinnpi nasemte - David le a uliante in Levi-te a huh dingin a kipsaksa mi 220 zong hong tonpih uh hi. Hihte khempeuh amau min ciatun a kiciamteh hi.","ref":"1Kh 9:2; Ezr 2:43"},"21":{"text":"Tua mun Ahava Hawkguam gei-ah kote Pasian mai-ah ko le ko ka kiniamkhiat theih nading uh le kote le ka tate uh ka neihsa khempeuh uh tawh bittaka khual ka zin theih nading uh nget nadingin antan ding ka tangko hi."},"22":{"text":"Kote in kumpipa kiangah, \"A migi kote Pasian khut in amah a en peuhpeuh ompih a, ahi hangin amah a taisante tungah a hehna a tung hi,\" ci-a ka gensa uh ahi manin lampi ah galte pana hong hu ding galkapte le sakol-tuangte kumpipa tungah ka nget ding ka maizum hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin an tangin kote Pasian tungah hih thu ka ngen uh a, amah in kote thungetna hong dawng hi.","ref":"Tp 31:17; Ne 2:9"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampi mapite sawm le nih tawh Sherebiah, Hashabiah le amaute sanggamte sawm ka khenkhia a,"},"25":{"text":"kumpipa ama thudotte, a uliante le tua lai-a om Israel-te khempeuh in Pasian inn dingin a kidong biakna-a kipia ngun, kham le vanzatte tehkhia-in amaute tungah ka ap hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute tungah tehkhia a ka ap ngun talent a 650, ngun vanzatte talent b 100 a gik, kham talent c 100,"},"27":{"text":"kham kuangkum daric d 1,000 man 20, le dal kizut kham zaha manpha vanzat nih ahi hi.","ref":"Ezr 7:15"},"28":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, \"Note le hih vanzatte TOPA tungah hong ki-ap khawm ahi hi. Hih ngun le khamte TOPA i pate Pasian tungah utthu-a biakna kipia ahi hi."},"29":{"text":"Jerusalem a TOPA inn a inndei tuam sungah siampi mapite le Levi-te le Israel innkuan makaite mai-ah na teh hun matengun limtakin cing un,\" ka ci hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin siampite le Levi-te in ngun le kham le a siangtho vanzat a kitehsate, Jerusalem a eite Pasian inn-a puak dingin a sang uh hi."},"31":{"text":"A kha masa pen a ni sawm le nih ni-in Ahava Hawkguam panin Jerusalem zuan dingin ka dingkhia uh hi. Kote Pasian khut in hong ompih a, lampi tawntungah galte le pansimna panin hong dal hi."},"32":{"text":"Tuaci-in Jerusalem ka tung uh a ni thum sung ka tawlnga uh hi."},"33":{"text":"A ni lina ni-in kote Pasian inn ah Uriah tapa siampipa Meremoth khut ah ngun, kham le a siangtho vanzatte ka tehkhia uh hi. Amah Phinehas tapa Eleazar tawh hi-a, Levi-te Jeshua tapa Jozabad le Binnui tapa Noadiah tawh zong ahi uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Na khempeuh a malin simin kiteh a, tua hunin a gihna zah lian a kiciamteh hi.","ref":"Ne 3:4; 11:16"},"35":{"text":"Saltanna pan a suakta a ciah kikte in Israel Pasian tungah haltum biakna-in: Israel khempeuh aitangin bawngtal sawm le nih, tuutal sawm kua le guk, tuuno apa sawm sagih le sagih le mawhna hanga biakna-in keel apa sawm le nih pia uh hi. Hihte khempeuh TOPA tungah meihal biakna ahi hi."},"36":{"text":"Amaute in kumpipa khut nuai-a nasemte le Euphrates-Gal a ukpite tungah kumpipa thupiakte zong gen uh a, tua ciangin amaute in mite le Pasian inn a huh uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 7:21"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih nasepte a man khit ciangin makaite kei kiangah hong pai in, \"Israel mite, siampite le Levi-te kigawm in a kihhuai-a gamta: Canaan-te, Hit-te, Periz-te, Jebus-te, Ammon-te, Moab-te Egypt-te le Amor-te bangin gamta uh a gamvengte panin a tuam om kei uh hi.","title":"Kitenthukna Thu-a Ezra Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"Amaute mahmah le a tapate un amau tanute a zi dingun pi uh a, amau kima om mite tawh a minam siangtho uh a helzau uh hi. A uliante le a makaite un hih bang muanhuai lohna-in a makaih uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Pk 22:31; 1Ku 9:20; Ezr 6:21"},"3":{"text":"Hih thu ka zak ciangin ka puan-tungsilh le ka puantualpi balkekin ka sam le ka khamul botgawpin cih nading thei loin ka tu mawk hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin sal-a om hi mite muanhuailohna hangin Israel-te Pasian thu za-a a ling peuhmah ka kimah hong kikhawm uh hi. Tuaci-in nitak biakpiak hun dong tua lai-ah ka tucip hi.","ref":"Ms 14:6; Ezr 10:3"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitak biakpiak hun teh ka puansilh le ka puantual kikheksa in ka zahlakna mun panin ka tho a, khukdinin TOPA ka Pasian lamah khut zakin"},"6":{"text":"thu ka ngen a: \"Ka Pasian aw, ka lu uh sangin ka mawhna uh sangzaw a, ka khialhnate un vantungte ban ahi manin ka mai zum lua-in ka Pasian lamah ka mai kong ngat ngam kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka pute uh khanga kipan tuni dong ka khialhna uh a lian mahmah hi. Ka mawhnate uh hangin kote le ka kumpite uh le ka siampite un namsau thuakin salin kikai-a gamdang kumpite khutlum thuakin tuni dong ka tuaci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 28:64; 2Kh 28:9"},"8":{"text":"\"Hih bangin tu-in, hun tomkha sung bek TOPA kote Pasian in nong hehpih-a a sibaang hong omsakin na mun siangtho ah panmun kip nong pia hi; tua ciangin kote Pasian in ka mit uh nong vaksak a, ka saltanna panun tawmkha nong kolsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Kote sila ka hi uh hangin ka Pasian un ka salsuahna panun nong nusia kei hi. Amah in Persia kumpipa muhna ah a migitna hong laka: Amah in Pasian inn lam kik nading le a kisiate puahkik nading a thakin nuntakna hong pia-a, Judah le Jerusalem a i kidal nading kulh khat hong pia hi.","ref":"Ne 9:36; Ph 13:3"},"10":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin kote Pasian aw, hihte khit ciang tu-in bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi hiam? Na nasem kamsangte tungtawna na piak"},"11":{"text":"‘Note luta na neih ding uh gam in a sunga tengsate nitsaksa ahi hi. A kihhuai amau gamtatna ahi siantholohna mong khat pan a mong khat dong kidim khin hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na tanute uh amau tapate zi dingin kha kei unla, na tapate uh zi dingin amau tanute pi kei un; amau phattuam nading le amau mavan nading cikmah hunin zong kei un; tua hileh na tha uh hatin leitanga piang gah hoihte na ne thei ding uh a, a luah tawntung dingun na tate uh na nusiat ding uh hi,’ na cih ka thusim kei uh hi.","ref":"Tp 11:8; Ph 103:17"},"13":{"text":"Ko tunga hong tungsa gitlohna le khialhna lianpite ka bawl thaman uh hi a, tua hi napi kote Pasian in ka mawhna uh tawh a kituak zah sanga tawmzaw in dan nong tuaksak a, hih bangin a baanglai-in nong omsak hi."},"14":{"text":"Na thukhamte palsat kikin tua banga kihhuai a bawlte tawh kiteng thuk lai ding ka hi uh hiam? A baanglaite, a suakta om lo zah a suksiat dingin ko tungah heh ding hi lo na hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"TOPA Israel-te Pasian aw, nang na thumaan hi! Kote tuni dong a baanglai-in hong kinusia hi. Kote ka mawhna uh hangin khat beek na mai-ah a ding thei lo ding hi napi, a mawhpi mahin na mai-ah kong om uh hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Ne 13:27; Ph 130:3"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ezra in thu ngena mawhna pulaakin kap-a Pasian inn mai-ah a kilot laulau laitakin Israel mipi tampitak - numei pasal le naupangte - a kimkotah a kikhawm uh hi. Amaute zong kah cihtakin a kap uh hi.","title":"Mipite Mawhna Pulakna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Elam suante khat Jahiel tapa Shecaniah in Ezra kiangah, \"I kimkota midang numeite i tenpihna hangin i Pasian tungah i muanhuai kei hi. Ahi hangin a tuacipi mahin Israel-te adingin lametna om lai hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in nang ka topa uh le eite Pasian thupiakna a kihtate ngaihsutna tawh kizui-in hih numei te le a tate uh khakkhiat nading eite Pasian mai-ah thukhun i bawl ding hi. Thukham tawh kituakin kibawl ta hen."},"4":{"text":"Tho in; hih thu nang khutah a om hi, nang kong huh ding uh hi, hangtakin sem in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:9"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ezra tho a, siampite le Levi-te makaisakin ngaihsutna a kipiasa banga, sem dingin Israel-te khempeuh a kiciamsak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian inn mai panin Ezra kihemkhia a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan omna inndei ah a pai hi. Tua muna a om lai-in zong saltangte muanhuai lohna hangin an ne lo tui dawn loin a thumthum lai hi.","ref":"Tp 9:19; Ne 5:12; 13:25"},"7":{"text":"Judah le Jerusalem a sal suakta khempeuh Jerusalem ah a kikhop nadingun tangkona khat a suaksak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ni thum sunga maitang a laak lo peuhmah uliante le upate khensatna zui-in a vante kimatsak dinga, sal suakta mihonpi lak panin amah kihawlkhia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum sungin Judah le Benjamin a mi khempeuh Jerusalem ah a kikhawm khin uh hi. A kha kuana a ni sawmnihna ni-in mi khempeuh Pasian biakinnpi mai-a tual-awng ah hih thu hang le guah tui hangin lungdong ngeungau-in a tu uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ezra ding to-in amaute kiangah, \"Note na muanhuai kei uh hi; Israel khialhna behlapin gamdang numeite na tenpih uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA na pate uh Pasian tungah na mawhna uh pulakin ama deih na sem un. Na kim na pam-ua mite le na gamdang zite uh tawh no mahmah kikhenkhia un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ezr 1:5; 7:2; Ne 9:2"},"12":{"text":"Mihon buppi in, \"Na thugen a maan hi! Na gen bangin ka hih ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin hih lai-ah mi tam mahmah a guah zuk hun ahi hi; tua hi-a a pua ah ka ding zo kei uh hi. Tua banah hih thu ah nak mawh lua khin ka hi manun ni khat ni nih sunga hih zawh pak ding thu hi lo hi."},"14":{"text":"Mihon buppi tangin ka uliante uh semsak in. Hih thu hangin i Pasian hehluatna eite tungah a bei mateng, gamdang numei a tenpih peuhmah a kiseh hunin amau khuapi ciat-a upate le thukhente tawh paikhawm uh hen,\" ci-in ngaihtakin a dawng uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Asahel’ tapa Jonathan le Tikvah tapa Jahzeiah-te bekin Levi-te Meshullam le Shabbethai thukim pihna tawh hih thu a nial uh hi.","ref":"Jos 6:5; 2Kh 29:10; Ne 11:16"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thu omsa bangin sal suaktate in a hih uh hi. Hih munah Eliashib in Pasian inn huang sunga inndei khat Tobiah a sikna hanga na hoih lo a piang khat ka phawk hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka lungkim lo lua mahmah a, Tobiah-te inn sung vanzat khempeuh inndei pualam ah ka lawnkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Inndei sung siansuah dingin thu ka pia a, tua khit ciangin Pasian inn sung vanzat teng, an-a biaknate le gimnamtui tawh tuate ka koih khawm hi.","ref":"2Kh 29:5"},"10":{"text":"Levi-te tanh dinga kisehte amau kipia lo-a, nasepna-a nasem Levi-te le lasate khempeuh amau lo ciatah a ciah kik uh zong ka phawkkhia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin uliante tai-in amaute kiangah, \"Bang hangin Pasian inn kithusim lo ahi hiam?\" ci-in ka dong hi. Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh ka kaikhawm a, amau mun ciatah ka pangsak hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah-te khempeuh in an pan sawma khat, lenggahzu thak le sathau, vankholna inndei ah a puak uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Siampi Shelemiah, laithei Zadok le Levi-te khat a min Pedaiah, vankholna inndei ka uksak a, Mattaniah’ tapa, Zaccur tapa Hanan amaute ka huhsak hi, bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite a muantakin kingaihsun hi. A sanggamte uh tunga amau tanh ciat a piakkhiat ding uh amau nasep ahi hi.","ref":"Ne 10:39"},"14":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, hih thu-ah kei hong phawk gige inla, ka Pasian inn le a sunga nasepnate ah muanhuaitaka ka sepsate maimangsak kei in.","ref":"2Ku 20:3; Ne 5:19"},"15":{"text":"Tua hun laite in Judah gam ah, Sabbath ni-in lenggah cilna ah lenggah a cil, lenggahzu, lenggah, theigah le van nam khempeuh laate suana van nawn mi ka mu hi. Amaute in Sabbath ni-in hihte khempeuh Jerusalem ah a puak uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin tua ni-a an a zuak uh ka vauhilh hi."},"16":{"text":"Jerusalem a teng Tyre mite in ngasa le sumbuk-van namkim Jerusalem ah puak uh a Sabbath ni-in Judah-te tungah a zuak uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Judah uliante kiangah, \"Hih nasep uh gitlohna bang ahi hiam - Sabbath ni-in zehphi hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"18":{"text":"Eite Pasian in hih tuahsiatna khempeuh ei tung le Jerusalem tungah a tunsak nadingin na pute un zong tua bangin sem uh hi lo ahi hiam? Tuni-in note in Sabbath ni-a zehphitna tawh Israel tungah a nasiazaw thangpaihna na tungsak uh hi,\" ci-in ka tai hi.","ref":"Pk 20:8; Jer 44:23"},"19":{"text":"Nitaklam, Sabbath kipat ma, Jerusalem kongpite a liap ciangin kongpite khaksakin Sabbath a bei ma-in a hon dingun thu ka pia hi. Sabbath ni-in van a kitumpih theih loh nadingin kongpite ah keima mite ka pangsak hi."},"20":{"text":"Khatvei nihvei bang sumbukte le van namkim zuakte Jerusalem pualam ah a giak uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute ka vauhilh a, \"Bang hangin zan ciangin kulh bulah giak na hi uh hiam? Na hicih lai uh leh no tungah khut kong nga ding hi,\" ka ci hi. Tua ni-a kipan amaute Sabbath ni-in hong pai nawn kei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin Levi-te amau le amau kisiansuah uh a, Sabbath a kisianthosak theih nadingin pai-a kongpite a cin nadingun thu ka pia hi. Ka Pasian aw, hih thu ah zong hong phawk inla, a lian mahmah na itna tawh kizui-in kei tungah na lainatna hong lak in."},"23":{"text":"Tua tham loin tua hun lai-in Ashdod, Ammon le Moab pana numeite a tenpih Judah mite ka mu hi."},"24":{"text":"A tate uh alang Ashdod pau le adangte pau-in pau uh a, Judah pau-a a pau zia ding a thei kei uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Amaute tai-in ka hamsiat hi. Pasalte pawlkhat te sat-in a humsam uah manin ka bawhsak hi. Pasian minin ka kiciamsaka, \"Note in na tanute uh amaute na tenpihsak kei ding uh a, a tanute uh zong no le na tapate uh zi dingin na pi tuan kei ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Israel kumpipa Solomon mawhna zong hih bangte a tenpih hangmah hi lo ahi hiam? Minamte tampi lakah amah bang kumpi a om kei hi. A Pasian in amah it a, Pasian in Israel-te khempeuh kumpi a suaksak hi; ahi hangin gamdang numeite in amah nangawn a khialsak uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Gamdang numei tenpihna tawh note in zong a lauhuai gitlohna bawlin eite Pasian tungah na muanhuai lohna uh tu-in i vekin za pelmawh ding hi lo i hi hiam?\" ka cisak hi.","ref":"Ezr 10:24; Ne 2:10"},"28":{"text":"Siampi Eliashib’ tapa Joiada’ tapate khat Haron-te Sanballat makpa ahi hi. Tuateh amah ka hawlkhiamang hi."},"29":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, amaute in siampite zum, siampi’ thukhun le Levi-te ninsak uh ahi manin amaute ciamteh gige un.","ref":"Ms 25:13; Ne 1:8; Mal 2:4"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin gamdang nate tawh a kizom siampite le Levi-te ka siansuahsak a, amaute nasepna ciatah na sem dingin ka seh hi."},"31":{"text":"A kiseh huna cih ding sing le biakna le gahmasa-a biakna ding zong ka vaihawmsak hi. Ka Pasian aw, hong angvan inla hong phawk in.","ref":"Pc 8:1; Ne 1:8"}}}}},"17":{"info":{"name":"Esther","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in India pan Cush a dong a kizalhsuk gam neu 127 a uk Xerxes b huna thupiang ahi hi.","title":"Kumpinu Vashti Zakia"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunin Kumpi Xerxes a kumpi tokhom tungah tu-in a kumpi khua Susa panin uk a"},"3":{"text":"ama uk zawh a kum thumna kumin a uliante le a zum nasem liante adingin pawi a bawl hi. Tua lai-ah Persia le Media galkap makaite, uliante le gamneu uk uliante a om uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:15; Ezr 4:6; Est 2:8"},"4":{"text":"Amah in a kumpivang’ minthanna a nopci ziahzuahna le ama liatna ni 180 sungtak a lak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua banga a lah hun a bei ciangin kumpi innpi kianga huan gei-ah Susa khuapi sunga om a neupen pan a lianpen dong mi khempeuh tawh pawi a bawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua huan ah suangkang khuampite tungah ngunkual kivawha a kang le a dupsan nate a kikhai puandum le puankangte a kikhung hi. Tua lai-ah suangmanpha, porphyry, suangpek, kep manpha-nu le suang manpha dang tawh hoihtaka kizem suangphah tungah ngun le khama kibawl lupnate a om hi."},"7":{"text":"Kham hai tuamtuamte in lenggahzu kihawma, tuate khat le khat a kibang kei hi. Kumpi lenggahzu kicing mahmah a, deih zahzahin kizang hi."},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in a zuhawmte tungah amau duh zahzah piak dingin hilhkhol ahi manin kumpipa thupiak bangin lenglate in amau duhzah ciat a dawn uh hi.","ref":"Eze 23:41"},"9":{"text":"Kumpinu Vashti in zong Kumpipa Xerxes inn sungah numeite pawi a bawlpih hi,"},"10":{"text":"A ni sagihna ni, Kumpi Xerxes in lenggahzu dawna nuam a sak mahmah ciangin ama nasem cilgehte sagih thu pia a - Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha Zethar le Carcas-te samin,"},"11":{"text":"Kumpinu Vashti a mel hoih takpi ahi manin mite le a uliante et dingin kumpi lukhu khusakin a lah nadingun thu a pia hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah a cingte in kumpipa thupiak a gen uh hangin Kumpinu Vashti a pai nuam kei hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa a lung so-in a heh mahmah hi."},"13":{"text":"Thukham le a maana thu khenna tawh kisai a siamte kumpipa in a dot ngeina ahi manin, hun theisiam mipilte hopih a,"},"14":{"text":"amah le amah tawh a kithuah - Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena le Memucan ama gam sunga, a sangpen le kumpipa tawh a kithuah tuamdiak Media le Persia ulian sagihte zong a hopih hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:19; 1Kh 12:32; Ezr 7:14"},"15":{"text":"Amah in, \"Upadi tawh kizui-in Kumpinu Vashti bangcih kul ding ahi hiam? Kumpipa Xerxes in cilgehte a thupiak a piaksak thupiakna mang nuam lo hi,\" a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le uliante om mahin Memucan in, \"Kumpinu Vashti a khial ahi hi. Kumpipa tung bek hi loin Kumpi Xerxes ukna sunga gamneute a uliante khempeuh tungah zong a khial hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, kumpinu gamtatna numei khempeuh in thei ding uh a, tua ciangin a pasalte uh thusim loin, ‘Kumpi Xerxes in ama mai-ah Kumpinu Vashti a kipuak ding thu pia napi, a pai nuam kei hi,\" ci ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni mahmah in kumpinu thu a za Persia le Media numei uliante in kumpipa uliante tungah tua tawh kibangin gamta ding uh hi. Kizahtaklohna le kisimmawhna a bei ngei kei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin kumpipa na lungkim leh kumpi thupiakna khat suaksak inla a kingen kik thei lo Persia le Media-te upadi sungah gelh in, Kumpi Xerxes omna ah Vashti tum ngei nawn lo ding hi, kici hen. Tuanu omna kumpi inn sunga om ding tuanu sanga hoihzaw khat zong koih in."},"20":{"text":"Tuateh kumpipa thupiakna ama gam sung khempeuh ah a zaksak ciangin numei khempeuh a neupen pan a lianpen dong in a pasalte uh zahtak ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa le a uliante in hih ngaihsutna lungkim uh a, Memucan gen bangin kumpipa in a hih hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in a gam sung mun khempeuh ah lai paisaka pasal peuhmah ama innkuan sungah a ukpa hi ding hi, ci-in amau gama om amau lai ciat, a minam kam ciat un zasak uh a, amau pau ciatin a tangko uh hi.","ref":"Ne 13:24; 1Ti 2:12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua khit Kumpipa Xerxes a hehna a daih ciangin Vashti gamtatnasa le ama tunga a thupiaksate a phawk kik hi.","title":"Esther Kumpinu Suak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa cingte in, \"Kumpipa ading nungak bit melhoih zongsak in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in amaute gam ciatah a teel ding mi sehsakin tua a teel uh nungak melhoihte khempeuh kumpipa tenna Susa ah kipuaksak in. Tuate, kumpipa cilgehpa, numeite ukpa kemsak in; amaute a mel hoih nadingun kizemsak in."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa lungkimna penpen Vashti tangin kumpinu suaksak in,\" ci-in ngaihsutna a gen uh hi. Hih ngaihsutna kumpipa tungah gen uh a amah in a zui hi.","ref":"1Ku 1:2; Est 7:10"},"5":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin kumpipa khua Susa ah Benjamin beh Kish tapa, Shimei tapa, Jair tapa Mordecai kici Jew mi khat a om hi,"},"6":{"text":"amah pen Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem pan sal-a a kaih, Judah kumpi Jehoiachin a a matna-a a matkhawm ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mordecai in Hadassah kici sanggam khat a nei hi. Tuanu in nu le pa nei lo a amah’n kemin a khansuahsa ahi hi. Hih nu Esther zong kici a, a duang hoih in a ngaihbaang hi; a nu le a pa a sih ciangin Mordecai in a tanu banga a kep ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 9:1; 2Ku 24:15; Da 5:13"},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiakna le thukhauh a kitangko khit ciangin kumpi khua Susa ah numei tampi kipuak-a Hegai kikemsak hi. Esther zong kumpi inn ah kipuak-a, numeite omna inn ukpa Hegai a kikemsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Numeino in amah lungkimsak a amah’n a angvan hi. A mel hoih nadingin mel hoihna za pia-in an lim nono in a vakpah hi. Kumpi inn sungah a kiteeltuam numei sagih sehkhia a, amah le a nasemte omna mun hoih penah a omsak hi.","ref":"Ne 1:1; Da 1:5"},"10":{"text":"Esther in ama minam le a pianna beh le phung thu a laakhia kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Mordecai in tuate a pulak ding a kham hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah numeite omna innhuang nai-ah Esther bangci a, ama tungah bang piang cih a thei dingin nisimin a kileh kawikawi hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa Xerxes kiangah a kilah dong ama hun a tun ma-in a kipuah ding hun kha sawm le nih hi-a, myrrh thau-in kha guk sung kizutin paknamtui le gimnamtui-in kha guk sung kipuah ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hi a hih bangin kumpipa kiangah a va kilak hi. Numei kepna inn panin kumpipa inn ah a kem dingin ama deih peuhpeuh a kipia hi."},"14":{"text":"Nitak ciangin tua lai-ah kipaisaka a zingsang ciangin numei kepna-a kumpipa zinote a uk cilgehpa Shaashgaz cinna numei kepna inn ah a kiciahsak hi. Kumpipa a lungkima a minin a sap kei ngal leh a kiangah a kipaisak nawn kei hi.","ref":"Pn 27:9"},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa kiangah Esther (Mordecai in a pano Abihail’ tanu a kep) a pai ding hun a tun ciangin numei kepna a cing kumpipa cilgehpa Hegai hihsak zah val bangmah a ngen thuah kei hi. Tua hi a Esther a mu peuhpeuh in a angvan uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Kumpi Xerxes in a uk a kum sagihna a kha sawmna Tebeth kha in amah kumpi inn ah kipaipih hi.","ref":"Est 9:29; Ph 45:14"},"17":{"text":"Tu-in kumpipa in numei dangte sangin Esther iplahzaw a, ama angvanna ngahin nungak dangte sangin a lungtungzaw tham hi. Tua ciangin kumpi lukhu khusak a, Vashti tangin kumpinu a suaksak hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuateh kumpipa in pawi lianpi khat Esther pawi, a uliante le a zum nasem uliante tawh a bawl hi. Kumpi gamneu khempeuh ah zum khak nading thu thangsak a, kumpipa tawh kituak letsong a hawmkhia hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:15; Est 1:7,11"},"19":{"text":"Nungakbitte a nihveina a kikaikhop hunin kumpipa kongpi ah Mordecai a tu hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin Esther in Mordecai hilhkholhsa bangin a nualamte thu le a minam a im khinkhian hi; ahang in amah a kikhansuah lai-a Mordecai lahsa bangin a zui suaksuak lai hi.","title":"Kisawmsimna Mordecai in Genkhia","ref":"Est 4:2; 5:13"},"21":{"text":"Kumpipa kongpi gei-ah Mordecai a tuttut lai-in kongkhak cing kumpi nasem zalian nih Bigthana b le Teresh heh uh a, Kumpipa Xerxes thah a sawm uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin Mordecai in tua sawmsimna thei a, Esther tungah ko-in amah in Mordecai genin gena kumpipa a ko sawn hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua thu kikana, a taktak ahilam a kitheih ciangin zum nasem uliante gel khuampi c dawnah kikhai hi. Hihte khempeuh hih kumpipa omin gam tangthu ciamtehna bu sungah a kiciamteh hi.","ref":"Est 6:2"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih thute khit ciangin Kumpi Xerxes in Agag-te Hammedatha tapa Haman pahtawi a, lamto in ulian dang khempeuh sangin pahtawina tokhom a pia hi.","title":"Haman in Jew-te Siatsak Sawmsim"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiaksa ahi manin kumpi kongpi sunga nasem kongpi tawna a pai peuhmah in zahtakin a khukdin uh hi. Ahi hangin Mordecai khukdin loin a zahtakbawl kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi kongpi-a nasemte in Mordecai kiangah, \"Bang hangin kumpipa thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?\" ci-in a dong uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ni khat khit ni khat amah a paupih uh hangin a thukim ding a nial hi. Tua ahi ciangin amah Jew mi ahilam amaute tungah genkhin ahi manin Mordecai gamtatna ahi ding mah hiam, cih Haman tungah a gen uh hi.","ref":"Pc 39:10; Da 3:12"},"5":{"text":"Mordecai khukdin loin amah zahtak lo cih a muh ciangin Haman a heh mahmah hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua banah Mordecai mipihte thu a theih khit ciangin Mordecai guak thahtaak a sa kei hi. Tua sangsikin Haman in Xerxes kumpi-gam sung khempeuh a om Mordecai mipihte - Jew-te khempeuh suksiat nading lampi a zong hi.","ref":"Ph 83:4; Pn 16:25"},"7":{"text":"Kumpi Xerxes in a uk a kum sawm le nihna a kha masapen ahi Nisan kha a kipan pur (tua pen aisanna) zangin a ni a kha ding teelna-in Haman omin ai a lawn uh hi. Tua ciangin a kha sawm le nihna, Adar kha ah ai a tu a hi.","ref":"Sp 16:8; Ezr 6:15; Est 9:24"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Haman in Kumpipa Xerxes kiangah, \"Na kumpi-gam sung gamneu tuamtuamte ah kithehthangin a tuam om mi pawlkhat a om hi. Amaute ngeinate adangte aa tawh kibang lo a, kumpipa thukhamte a mang nuam kei uh hi; amaute khahkhong ding kumpipa deihpen ahi kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Kumpipa na lungkim leh amaute suksiat nading thukip bawl inla, tua tawh kisai nasem dingte adingin na sumkholhna ah talent b tulsawm ka pia ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Est 7:4; Da 6:13; Ns 16:20"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a seal tupna zungbuh suahkhia a, Jew-te galpa, Hagag-te beh Hammedatha tapa Haman a pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa in Haman kiangah, \"Na sum nang kem inla na mi gente na lungkim bangin hih in,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kha masapen a ni sawm le thumna ni-in kumpi zum lai-atte a kikaikhawm uh hi. Amaute in Haman thupiakna khempeuh a gamgama, amau kam ciatin gelhkhia uh a, kumpipa ukna sunga gamkhen tuamtuama gam-ukte tung, le mi tuamtuama uliante tungah a pia uh hi. Hihte Kumpi Xerxes in ama min mahmah a kigelh lai hi-a a zungbuh seal a tup ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Kumpipa gam sung khempeuhah kha sawm le nihna Adar kha a ni sawm le thumna ni, ni khat bek sungin Jew-te a khangmoi, a khangham, numei le naupangnote thatin kisumaimang dinga a neihsate uh kilaksak ding hi, cih thu laitaite a kipuaksak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ni-in a baihsa-a a om theih nadingin hih thupiakna lai gam khempeuh ah upadi bangin dal khat ciat kipuak hi - tua pen a gam sung mite theihkimsak nading ahi hi.","ref":"2Ku 21:8"},"15":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiakna tawh kintakin laitaite a kuankhia uh hi; hih thupiakna kumpipa khua Susa pana kihawmkhia ahi hi. Kumpipa le Haman zu dawn dingin tukhawm uh a, ahi hangin Susa khua sung a buai mahmah hi.","ref":"Est 1:10; 8:15"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kihihsa thu Mordecai in a theih ciangin a puan balkek-a vut khusa in khuapi sungah taikhia-in, nasiatakin nakpipi-in a kap hi.","title":"Esther Huhna Mordecai in Ngen"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin kumpipa kongpi ciangdong bek a pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh puan hampi silhsa in kuamah a sungah kilutsak lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiakna lai a tunna gam peuhpeuh ah Jew-te lakah nakpi-a thumna le an tanga kahna le tauna a om hi. Mi tampi in puanhampi silhin vut a khu uh hi.","ref":"Ph 30:11; Eze 27:30"},"4":{"text":"Esther nasem numeite le cilgehte in Mordecai thu a gen uh ciangin amah zong a lungzing mahmah hi. Puan hampi tangin a silh ding puan a khak hangin a sang nuam kei hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Esther in amah a cing dingin a kiseh cilgehpa Hathach sama, Mordekai lungdonna le ahang a thei dingin a sawl hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kongpi mai tual-awnga om Mordecai kiangah, Hathach a pai hi."},"7":{"text":"Mordecai in ama tunga thupiang khempeuh, Jew-te suksiat nadinga Haman in kumpipa sumkholna sunga a piak dinga a ciam sum phazah nangawn a gen hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute kibeimangsak nadingin Susa pana kihawmkhia laidal khat Esther a lah dingin amah pia-a, a thu teng teltaka a gen ding le kumpipa kiangah amah na pai-a, amah le a mipihte adingin lainatna a nget ding a sawlna a gensak hi.","ref":"Est 3:9; 7:4"},"9":{"text":"Hathach kilehkik a, Mordecai gensa teng Esther tungah a zasak hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Mordecai tungah a gen ding amah hilh a,"},"11":{"text":"\"Kumpipa nasemte khempeuh le kumpi-gam sunga mite kuama sap lohin kumpi huang sungah a va pai leh: kumpipa in upadi khat nei a, tua banga a va paite thah ding ahi hi. A tangkai diaka kumpipa in a kham ciangkhut ama lamah a na khak leh amah a kithat kei ding hi, cih thu a theihsa uh ahi hi. Ahi hangin kei hong kisap loh ni sawmthum pha ta hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 125:3; Da 2:9"},"12":{"text":"Esther kammalte Mordecai tungah a kizaksak ciangin,"},"13":{"text":"\"Kumpi inn sungah na om hangin Jew-te lakah nang guak a suakta tuan dingin kingaihsun kei in."},"14":{"text":"Ahang in, hih huna bangmah hih lo-a na daihcip leh Jew-te suahtak nading munkhat panin hong om veve dinga ahi hangin nang le na pate innkuan na kisia ding uh hi. Hih kumpi inn sung na tunna zong hih bang huna kimang dingin a tung na hihmeel kua-in thei ahi hiam,\" ci-in a dawn kikna a khak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin Esther in:"},"16":{"text":"\"Pai inla, Susa sunga om Jew-te khempeuh kaikhawmin kei adingin an na tang un. Sun taleh zan taleh ni thum sung an ne tui dawn na om kei un. No mah bangin kei le ka nasem numeite in zong ka na tang ding uh hi. Hih banga i hih khit ciangin upadi tawh a kituak kei kha zongin ka sih le ka sih kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi,\" ci-in a thuk kikna Mordecai a khak hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:3; Est 5:1"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Mordecai in Esther lahsa teng khempeuh kengin a kuankhia hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nithumna ni-in Esther in a kumpi puantual silhin kumpi inntual sunglam kumpipa innpi mai-ah a ding hi. Innpi sungah innsung lutna lam nga-in kumpipa a tokhom tungah a tut laitak ahi hi.","title":"Kumpipa tungah Esther Ngetna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in huang sungah Esther ding a muh ciangin a lungkima a khut sunga a tawi kham ciangkhut ama lam ngatin a tawi hi. Tua ciangin Esther in zuana a ciangkhut dawn a lawng hi.","ref":"Est 4:11; Eze 16:13"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa in, \"Kumpinu Esther aw, bang a hiam? Bang hong ngen na hiam? Nong nget peuhpeuh kumpi-gam phellang dong kong pia ding hi,\" ci-in a dong hi.","ref":"Est 7:2; Da 5:16; Mk 6:23"},"4":{"text":"\"Kumpipa na lungkim leh ama adingin ka kiginsa pawi tuni-in Haman tawh hong simkhawm un,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Esther hong nget ka hihsak theih nadingin Haman hong paipih pak un,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Esther bawlsa pawi sim dingin kumpipa le Haman a pai uh hi.","ref":"Est 6:14"},"6":{"text":"Lenggahzu a dawn laitakun kumpipa in Esther kiangah, \"Nong nget bang ahi hiam? Kumpi-gam phelkhat dong nangawn hong kipia ding hi,\" ci-in a dong kik hi.","ref":"Est 1:10; 7:2"},"7":{"text":"Esther in, \"Kong nget nop, kong thum nop in:"},"8":{"text":"Kumpipa in nong angvan zawh a, kong ngetna lungkimin kong thumna nong tangtunsak leh zing ciangin kumpipa le Haman in ka pawi hong sim lai un. Tua ciangin kumpipa dotna kong dawng ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ni-in Haman lungdam-a, ki-angtangsakin a paikhia hi. Ahi hangin kumpipa kongpi-ah amah a pai ciangin Mordecai ding beek lo-a, kihtakna lim a lah loh ciangin a heh lua mahmah hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua hi napi Haman ki-ip tentansa in inn ah a ciah hi. A lawmte le a zi Zeresh samkhawm a,","title":"Mordecai tunga Haman Hehluatna","ref":"Pn 14:17"},"11":{"text":"a hauhna, a tapate, a munmuna kumpipa pahtawina, kumpi nasemte khempeuh tunga a kitawisangnate hangin a kisial hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Tua teng bek hi lo hi,\" Haman in, \"Kumpinu Esther in kumpipa tawh pawisim dinga a sapkhawm kei bek ka hi hi. Haman in hih ngaihsutna hoih sa-a, gui-awk khuampi a phutsak hi.","ref":"Est 6:4; 7:9"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua zanin kumpipa a ihmu thei kei hi; tua ciangin ama kumpi suahna khangthu bu la-a a sim dingun thu a pia hi.","title":"Mordecai Kipahtawi"},"2":{"text":"Tua lai-ah kumpipa nasem lian kongvang cingte gel - Bigthana le Teresh in Kumpipa Xerxes suamsim ding a sawm uh Mordecai in a genkhiat, a kiciamtehna a mu hi.","ref":"Da 6:18"},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Hih thu ah Mordecai, bang pahtawina, bang lungdamlahna kipia ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Amah cingte in, \"Amah bangmah kipia lo hi,\" a ci uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in, \"Hih huang sungah kua om ahi hiam?\" a ci hi. Tua hun laitak, huang pualam pan Mordecai khailup nadinga a phuhsa gui-awk khuampi ah Mordecai khailup nading thu a gen dingin Haman a va tum laitak lian ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah a cingte in, \"Huang sungah Haman ding hi,\" a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in, \"Hong tumsak un,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"6":{"text":"Haman a tum ciangin Kumpipa in, \"Kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa bangci pahtawi leng hoih ding hiam?\" ci-in Haman a dong hi. Tua laitakin Haman in, \"Kumpipa in kei sanga a pahtawi nop zawk kua om peuhmah ding hiam?\" ci-in amah dingin a kivawhpah hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah, \"Kumpipa pahtawi noppa,"},"8":{"text":"kumpipa silh puantualpi silhsakin, kumpipa tuanna sakol ah tuangin kumpipa lukhu khusak in."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa ulianpen khat puantualpi le sakol apsak in. Amaute in kumpipa pahtawi noppa puan silhsakin khuapi sung lampite ah sakol tungah tuangsak inla ama mai-ah tangko paisak in. Hih in kumpipa pahtawi noppa kibawl nading ahi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa in Haman kiangah, \"Tu mahmah in pai inla, puantualpi le sakol va la-in, kumpipa kongpi-a tu Mordecai tungah tu-a na ngaihsutna nong gen bangin hih in, \"Hoih na saksate khatbeek sit kei in,\" ci-in thu a pia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Haman in puantualpi le sakol a la hi. Puantualpi Mordecai silhsak a, sakol tungah tuangsakin khuapi sung kongzingte ah paipihin a mai-ah tangkosaka, \"Kumpipa pahtawi noppa hih bangin kibawl hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 41:42"},"12":{"text":"Tua zawh ciangin kumpipa kongpi ah Mordecai a ciah kik hi. Haman ahileh lungsi pipi-in lutunsa in a inn ah ciah vingveng a,"},"13":{"text":"a zi Zeresh le a lawmte tungah ama tunga thupiang khempeuh a ko hi. A thudotte le a zi Zeresh in, \"A mai-a na guallelh kipatna pa Mordecai Jew mi taktak ahi nungsang ama langah na pang zo kei ding hi - a sia taktak ding hi ta teh!\" a cihuan uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 15:30"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in amah a hopihpih laitakun kumpipa’ cilgehpa tunga Esther bawlsa pawi sim dingin Haman a paikhia pah hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:15; Est 5:10"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa le Haman in Esther tawh an umkhawm uh a,","title":"Haman Kikhailum"},"2":{"text":"a ni nihna lenggahzu a dawnkhawm laitakun kumpipa in, \"Kumpinu Esther aw, nong gennop bang ahi hiam? Ka mipihte hong thahsak kei in - kong thum nop hih ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, kei le ka mipihte susia in ngawngtan ding le suk maimang dingin hong kizuak khinzo hi. Numei pasal mi sila dinga hong kizuak hileh bangmah ka gen kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang lelin kumpipa lungzinsak tak ka sa kei hi,\" a a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa Xerxes in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, \"Amah kua hiam? tua banga hih ngam mipa koi-ah om hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"6":{"text":"Esther in, \"Ka langpa le ka galpa, hih mi zumhuaipa Haman ahi hi,\" a ci hi. Ka innkuanpihte siatna ka muh ding bangci thuakzawh ding ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa Xerxes in Kumpinu Esther le Jew mi Mordecai kiangah, \"Haman in Jew-te a do manin a neihsate Esther tungah ka pia khina, amah gui-awk khuampite ah kikhailum khin hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in Jew-te adingin hoih pen dinga na ngaihsut thukip dang khat kumpipa minin gelhin kumpipa seal zungbuh in tum in - ahang in, kumpipa mina thupiakna kigelh seal zungbuh kitumsa khat kimawk dawhkik thei lo hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"9":{"text":"A kha thumna Sivan kha a ni sawmnih le thumna ni-in kumpi thuvante a kisam pah hi. Amaute in Mordecai thupiakna khempeuh Jew-te tungah gelhkhia uh a, gam tampi ukte, ukpite le India pan Cush c dong gam 127 a uliante tungah a hawm pah uh hi. Tua hi-a Susa khuapi ah lungnuamtakin pawi a kibawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Jew-te adingin tua hun lungdam ni, gualnop ni, kipahni le kipahtawi ni ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiakna a tunna gam teng le khuapi tengah Jew-te lungnuam in kipakin pawi bawlin a ai uh hi. Ahi hangin amau vante a sukha kei uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 4:6; Est 5:11; Ph 127:3"},"11":{"text":"Kumpi khua Susa a kithatte tua ni mahin kumpipa tungah a kizasak hi."},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, \"Jew-te in kumpi khua Susa ah mi zanga le Haman tapate sawm a that khin uh hi. Amah in amaute tungah tua mite pawi bawl ni le lungnop ni-in zanga khat le khat an kikholhin mizawngte letsong piakni-a a zat dingun a gelh hi.","ref":"Ph 30:11-12"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jew-te in Mordecai gelh bangin a zatsa uh zomsuak uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahang in Jew-te khempeuh galpa Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman in Jew-te sugawpin a siatsak nading pur (tua pen aisanna) in ai san-a siatsak ding a sawmsim hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin tua sawmsimna kumpipa tung a tun ciangin a Haman in Jew-te tungah gitloh a sawmnate ama lutungah lehtuksakin amah le a tapate gui-awk khuam tungah kikhai hen ci-in lai gelh-a, a hawmkhia hi."},"26":{"text":"(Tua ciangin pur kammal pan la in hih nite Purim kici ahi hi) Hih laikhak sunga kigelh khempeuh hang le amaute tunga piangsa le a muhsate uh hangin"},"27":{"text":"Jew-te in amaute le a suante uh leh amaute a pawlpihte in a kipelh ngei lo ngeina-in nei uh a, kum simin hih ni nihte tangin hih dinga kigelhsa bang le a kisehsa hunte a zang uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Hih nite kiphawk den dinga, a gamgam, a khuapi a khuapi ah akhang akhangin a innkuankuanin kizang ding hi. Hih Purim nite in Jew-te in pawi bawl den ding uh a, amau suante tungah a kiciamteh tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Est 3:7; Ph 7:16"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Abihail tanu Kumpinu Esther in Jew mi Mordecai tungah a thuneihpenna tawh Purim tawh kisai laikhak nihna a kipsak nadingin a gelh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tuateh Mordecai in Xerxes kumpi-gam 127 a om Jew-te tungah lai khak a - thu hoih le thu kician"},"31":{"text":"Jew mi Mordecai le Kumpinu Esther in amaute a thupiaksa bangin hih Purim nite a sehsa hunin a tan nadingun gelh a, amaute ciat in na kipsakin amau suante in amau hun ciatin an tangin taamlawh hunin a zang uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Hih Purim tawh kisai zuih ding ngeinate Esther thupiakna in kipsaka, ciamtehna sungah a kigelh hi.","ref":"Est 2:15"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Xerxes in a ukna gam khempeuh tuitung leitung dongin siah a kai hi.","title":"Mordecai Liatna"},"2":{"text":"Ama vangliatna le a thahatna khempeuh, le kumpipa in a laptoh Mordecai liatna teng Media le Persia kumpite khangthu ciamtehna laibu sungah a cingin kigelh lo ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Kumpi Xerxes zomin Jew mi Mordecai a lianpen hi-a, Jew-te lakah amah lian penin a lawm Jew-te tampi in amah a tawisang uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a mipihte hoih nadingin nasem a, Jew-te khempeuh a gualzawh nadingin kam a pau hi.","ref":"Pc 41:40; Est 8:15"}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz gamah Job min nei mi khat a teng hi. Hih mipa thutangin a pau baang kei hi; amah in Pasian kihta a gamtat hoih lo a pel hi.","title":"Thumapi"},"2":{"text":"Amah in ta pasal sagih le ta numei thum nei a,"},"3":{"text":"tuu tul sagih, kala-oh tul thum, bawngtal kap zanga le laa zanga, le nasem tampitak a nei hi. Nisuahna gam mite khempeuh lakah a lian pen ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"A tapate in amau inn ah a banbanin pawi bawl zel uh a, a nek a dawn khawmpih dingun a sanggam numei thumte a sam uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Pawi bawl vial khat a kikhit ciangin Job in amaute samin a siansuah hi. Zingsang tungin amaute khat ciat adingin meihal biakna piaksak a, \"Ka tate in mawhna bawla a lungsim uah Pasian a samsiat khak uh leh,\" cih a ngaihsutna ahi hi. Hih pen Job in a hunhunin ngeina-a a neih ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 8:20; 1Ku 21:10"},"6":{"text":"Ni khat TOPA mai-ah vansawltakte a va om uh a, amaute tawh Satan b zong a paikhawm hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?\" a ci hi. Satan in TOPA kiangah, \"Leitung mun khempeuh ah vakin ka vaksuk ka vaktohna pan hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","title":"Job Kizia-etna Masapen","ref":"Job 2:1; Ph 109:6; Lk 22:31; Pc 3:1; 1Pe 5:8"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Ka nasempa Job na ngaihsun kha ngei hiam? Leitungah amah tawh kibang kuamah a om kei hi; amah thutangin paubaang lo a, Pasian a kihta gamtatsia a pel mi khat ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 25:12"},"9":{"text":"Satan in, \"Job in a mawkna-in Pasian kihta ahi hiam?\" ci-in dawng a,"},"10":{"text":"\"Amah le a innkuanpihte le a neihsa khempeuh kimkotah dai kai zo hi lo na hi hiam? A khuta a septe thupha na pia a, a tuuhonte le a bawnghonte mun tengah kizel hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin na khut zanin a neihsa khempeuh suksak lecin na maitangah hong hamsiat taktak ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Tua ahileh pha hi, ama neihsa khempeuh nang thu hihen; ahi hangin mipa tungah na khutme zong na nga kei ding hi,\" a ci hi. Tua ciangin TOPA ’ omna pan Satan a pai khia hi.","ref":"Job 2:6; Lk 4:6; 1Co 10:13"},"13":{"text":"Ni khat Job tanute le tapate a sanggam upenpa uh inn ah pawi bawlin zu a dawn laitakun,"},"14":{"text":"Job kiangah kamtai khat tunga, \"Lo kho kimlai bawngtalte le a kianga gamta laate"},"15":{"text":"Sabe mite in hong simin tuate hawlmang khin uh hi. Amaute in nasemte namsau-in that uh a, nang hong ko dinga suakta kei kia bek ka hi hi!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 36:24; Job 9:24"},"16":{"text":"A gengen laitakin kamtai dang khat tunga, \"Vantung pan Pasian meikuang hong kiasukin tuute le nasemte kangtum a, nang hong ko dinga suakta kei kia bek ka hi hi!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 10:2; Ms 11:1"},"17":{"text":"A gengen laitakin kamtai dang khat mah tung lai a, \"Chaldea mite pawlthum in hong sim uh a kala-ohte manin a paipihmang uh hi. Amaute in nasemte namsau-in ban uh a, nang hong ko dinga suakta kei kia bek ka hi hi!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 11:28; Job 9:24"},"18":{"text":"A genkhin nai loin kamtai dang khat mah hong tung lailai a, \"Na tanute le na tapate in pawi bawl uh a, na tapa upa pen inn ah zu a dawn laitakun"},"19":{"text":"sehnel-gam lam pan huih khauh khat nungvatin, inn pumpi mutpai hi. Inn in puknelha, amaute si khin uh hi; nang hong ko dinga suakta kei kia bek ka hi hi!\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua takteh, Job ding to-a a puantualpi balkekin a lu a mettol hi. Tua ciangin leitual ah boksukin bia a,","ref":"Pc 37:29"},"21":{"text":"\"Ka nu sung pan guaktangin ka suaka, guaktang mah in ka ciah a kik ding hi. TOPA in hong pia a, TOPA mah in lakhia khin hi; TOPA min kiphat hen,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ru 1:21; 1Th 5:18"},"22":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh ah Pasian mawh sakna tawh Job a mawh kei hi.","ref":"Job 2:10; Ph 39:1"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A nidang khatin TOPA mai-ah vansawltakte b va om uh a, ama mai-ah Satan zong ama thu in amaute tawh va omkhawm hi.","title":"Job Kizia-etna Nihna"},"2":{"text":"Tuateh TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?\" a ci hi. Satan in TOPA kiangah, \"Leitung mun khempeuh ah vakin ka vaksuk ka vaktohna pan ka hi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Pc 6:2; Job 1:6; Pc 3:1"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Ka nasempa Job na ngaihsun kha ngei na? Tua hi-a bangmah thu om lopi in amah susia dingin kei nong kut hangin a cihtakna a lenkip cinten hi,\" a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Satan in, \"Vun tangin vun!\" ci-in dawng a, \"Mi khat in a nuntakna tangin a neih khempeuh pia mah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin na khut zanin a sa le a guhte suksak lecin na maitang ah hong hamsia taktak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"TOPA in Satan kiangah, \"Tua ahileh hoih mahmah hi. Amah nang thu hi hen; pel loin a nuntakna hawisak in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 1:12; 2Co 12:7"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA omna pan Satan paikhia a, Job a khenuai pan a luzang dong meima na valval in a gimsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in leibel kitam them khat la-in vut lakah a tutsa in amah le amah a kikiat hi.","ref":"Job 42:6; Mt 11:21"},"9":{"text":"A zi in, \"Na cihtakna len tentan lailai na hiam? Pasian hamsiat inla si mai ve!\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Amah in, \"Numei hai c khat bangin lah na pau a; Pasian tung panin a hoih sang hi lo i hi hiam? Hihte khempeuh ah a kam paunate panin Job a mawh kei hi.","ref":"Job 1:21; Ta 3:38; Job 6:24; Jas 1:12"},"11":{"text":"Job lawmte thum, Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuh mi Bildad le Naamath mi Zophar-te in ama tunga gimna thu khempeuh a zak uh ciangin a veh ding kithukim uh a, a hehnem ding le a lungkhauhsak dingin a inn panun a kuankhia uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah a galmuh uh ciangin a thei lai mialmial uh hi; amaute kapkhia pah lualua uh a, a puantual uh balkekin a lutunguah leivui a kitheh uh hi.","title":"Job Lawmte Thum"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in sun sagih le zan sagih sung leitual ah amah a tutpih uh hi. Ama thuakna nasia lua cih mu uh ahi manin khat beek in a hopih kei uh hi.","ref":"Pc 25:2; 50:10; Jos 7:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin Job kamka a, a suah ni a hamsiat hi.","title":"Job Pau"},"2":{"text":"Amah in:","ref":"Jer 15:10"},"3":{"text":"\"Ka suah ni le ‘Pasalno khat suak ei!’ a kicih ni zan beimang hen;","ref":"Job 10:18"},"4":{"text":"Tua ni - khuamial tunga; Pasian in tua hun don nawn kei hen; tua ni-in khuavak tang kei hen."},"5":{"text":"Khua mial henla khua in nimnelh d lai hen; a tungah meiipi in kainelh hen; a vakna khuamialpi in tuamcip hen.","ref":"Job 10:21"},"6":{"text":"Tua zan - khuamial sahpi in mancip hen; kum sunga nite lakah kilo kha nawn kei hen. a vak lo ding sun khuavak ngak henla, a suak tung nizang mu kei hen;","ref":"Job 41:18"},"10":{"text":"Ahang in, gimna ka muh loh nadingin kei hong kipaiina sulgong a khak kei hi."},"11":{"text":"\"Bang hangin a siasa in suak hoh lo a, ka suah phetin sipah hoh lo ka hiam?","ref":"Job 10:18"},"12":{"text":"Bang hangin kei hong tawi ding khuk om a, hong kivak nang nawi om se hiam?","ref":"Isa 66:12"},"13":{"text":"Tua hi leh tu-in lungnuamtakin ka lum hithiat khin ding hi;","ref":"Job 17:13"},"14":{"text":"tu-a a kisiasa munte amaute adingin a bawl, leitung kumpite le thudotte,","ref":"Job 15:28; Job 12:17"},"15":{"text":"a inn uh ngun le kham tawh a dim gam-ukte tawh ihmu in ka tawlnga khin ding hi.","ref":"Job 12:21; 15:29"},"16":{"text":"Ahi kei leh bang hangin a hun tung nai lo a suak naungek bang, khuavak a mukha lo naupang bangin lei sungah hong kiselcip hoh lo hiam?","ref":"Ph 58:8; Pn 2:4"},"22":{"text":"amaute hankhuk a tun ciangin lungkim mahmahin a lungnuam dingte bang dinga nuntakna kipia se ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 7:16; Thn 4:3"},"23":{"text":"Bang hangin a lampi ding a kiselsak, Pasian in a umcip ding mipa, mihingin kipiangsak se hiam?","ref":"Pn 4:19"},"24":{"text":"Ahang in, khuisat an in ka nei hi; ka tauna tuiluang a bang hi.","ref":"Ph 5:1; Ph 42:3-4"},"25":{"text":"Ka kitaktak kei tung hong tung hi. Ahi zongin kua ki-ip zo mawk ding hiam?","ref":"Job 32:20"},"3":{"text":"Mi tampi na lamlahnate khutkha bankhate na thakhauhsaknate ngaihsun dih in.","ref":"Job 29:23; Job 26:2"},"4":{"text":"Na thugente in a muktute phong a, khuk zawte na thakhauhsak hi.","ref":"Job 29:11"},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in nang tungah gimna hong tunga, na lungkia hi; tuate in nang hong su a, na lungmang hi.","ref":"Jos 1:9; Job 6:14"},"6":{"text":"Na biakna-mina pen, na ngaihmuanna, na paubaan lohna, na lametna hi lo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 27:3; Pc 6:9"},"7":{"text":"\"Tu-in ngaihsun in: Mawhpeng kimlai kua sia ngei ahi hiam? A hehna mutin a mangthang uh hi.","ref":"Pk 15:10; Job 41:21; Job 40:13; Isa 25:7"},"10":{"text":"Humpinelkaite thamvakin hawk thei ta leh, humpinelkai lianpite ha zong kitan zo hi.","ref":"Ph 22:13; Ph 58:6"},"11":{"text":"Sa mat ding nei loin humpinelkaite mangthang a, humpinelkai note a kithehthang uh hi.","ref":"Job 27:11; Job 5:4"},"12":{"text":"\"Kei tungah thu khat hong kitun sim a, tua hong kihuau ka bilin ka za hi.","ref":"Job 32:13; Job 26:14; 33:14"},"13":{"text":"‘Zankim laitak, mite ihsip hunin lungsim patauhna mangte manin,","ref":"Job 33:15"},"14":{"text":"launa le linna in kei hong mancip-a, ka guh khempeuh a lingsak hi.","ref":"Job 21:6; Jer 23:9"},"15":{"text":"Kha khat in ka mai hong mut hiauhiau a, ka khuasik mul suak hi.","ref":"Da 5:6; Mt 14:26"},"16":{"text":"Tawpta napi, bang hiam ka gen thei kei hi. Milim bang khat ka mai-ah hong dinga, hong huau khiankhian aw khat ka za hi."},"17":{"text":"Pasian sangin mihing thumaanzaw thei ding ahi hiam? 15:35"},"8":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin kei hi leng, Pasian tungah ka ngen kik dinga a mai-ah ka thu ka nga ding hi.","ref":"Job 8:5; Ph 35:23"},"9":{"text":"Amah in teh theih loh a lamdangte, sim zawh loh a nalamdangte a bawl hi.","ref":"Ph 78:4; a vanglian mite ukcipna pan amaute a hu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua hi-a a zawngte in lametna nei uh a; thutanlohna in a kam a cip hi.","ref":"Job 20:19; Ph 107:42"},"17":{"text":"\"Pasian in a sittel mite, thupha ngah ahi hi;
