Pasian lauhuainate in kei hong do uh hi.","ref":"Job 7:20; Ph 38:2; Job 21:20; 34:6; Job 9:34; 30:15"},"5":{"text":"Gamsung laate lopa nona ah ham uh hiam, ahikeh an tamna munah bawngtal ham ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 30:7; Job 24:6; Isa 30:24"},"6":{"text":"An limlote cisawh lohin kine hiam, ahikeh aktui dakang in limna nei ahi hiam? b","ref":"Job 33:20"},"7":{"text":"Tuate ka lawng nuam kei hi, tua bang ante in ka ci nasak hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Ka ngetna ngah thei ding hi leng a Pasian in ka lamet bang hong sang ding hi in,","ref":"Job 14:13"},"9":{"text":"Pasian in kei hong sucip nuam ding hi henla a khut zanin kei hong that mai leh!","ref":"Job 19:2; Ms 11:15; Ph 31:22"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin Siangtho Pa’ thute ka nial lohna - ka thuak sahpi hangin ka nuam ding hi - cih ka kihehnem lai veve ding hi.","ref":"Job 2:11; Ph 38:17; Jer 4:19"},"11":{"text":"\"Lametna ka neih lai nadingin ka tha hat nawn ahi hiam? Ka lungduai zawh nadingin bang lamen lai ding ka hi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Kei in suang thahatna nei ka hi hiam? Ka satakte sumngo ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 26:2"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in zawhna in hong taisat nungsang kei le kei kihuh zo lai ka hi hiam?"},"14":{"text":"\"Lametna bei mipa in Thahatpa a kihta kei zongin a lawmte it ding kisam hi.","ref":"Job 4:5; Ph 38:11"},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka sanggamte a kimuang thei lo lui pana letkhia tuisam luanglet bang uh a,"},"16":{"text":"nin a khalhnelh vuk, vuk a tui cianga a khang,","ref":"Ph 147:18"},"17":{"text":"ahi hangin khua keu hun cianga a luang nawn lo, ni a sat cianga a luanna ah a kangcip luitui bang lel na hi uh hi.","ref":"Job 24:19"},"18":{"text":"Khualzin mite a lampi panin pial uh a; gam simthamah tungin kisia uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tema khualzinte in tui zong uh a, Sheba sumbuk khualzinte in lamenin en uh hi.","ref":"Pc 25:15; Pc 10:7"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in a muan mahmah uh hangin lungdong uh hi. Tua phual tung uh a, cimawh uh hi.","ref":"Jer 14:3"},"21":{"text":"Tu-in note in zong tua mah bangin nong huh theih nading uh om lo hi; a kihtakhuai pawlkhat mu le uh cin na lau uh hi.","ref":"Ph 38:11"},"22":{"text":"‘Kei tangin na khatpeuh na piaksak un, note neihsa panin bang khatin kei hong tan un,","ref":"Job 33:24"},"23":{"text":"ka galte khut pan hong hukhia un, kei hong nengcipte gamtatna panin hong tankhia un,’ hong ci ngei ka hi hiam?"},"24":{"text":"\"Hong hilh le uh cin ka daipah ding hi; ka khialhnasa mun hong lak dih un.","ref":"Job 2:10; Job 19:4"},"25":{"text":"Amaan kammalte thuakhak mahmah hi! Ka kam in a sia a pha khentel thei lo hi, na ci uh hiam?","ref":"Job 27:4; Job 12:11"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihing in leitungah nasep haksa sep ding nei hi lo ahi hiam? Ama nite a kicial nasempa aa tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 14:14; Sp 25:50"},"2":{"text":"Silate in nitak niliap hun a ngaklah bang ahikeh a thacialte in thaman a ngaklah bangin","ref":"Job 14:1"},"3":{"text":"kei zong a mawkna-in kha tampi ka ngak a, lunggimna zan kei tungah hong tung hi."},"4":{"text":"Ka lup ciangin, ‘ka thawh ma bangtan a sawt tam?’ ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Zan sawt mahmah a khuavak mateng ka kigawigawi hi.","ref":"Tp 28:67"},"5":{"text":"Ka pumpi in than le meimakhem bek puansilhin nei-a, ka vun kitamin a naiphual hi.","ref":"Job 17;14; Tp 28:35"},"6":{"text":"\"Ka nite, siamgante siamphei sangin kinawh zaw a, lametna om loin a mong tung pahpah hi.","ref":"Job 9:25; Job 13:15"},"7":{"text":"Pasian aw, ka nuntakna husan khat bek ahilam hong phawk in; ka mit in lungnopna mu kik nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Ph 78:39; Job 10:20"},"8":{"text":"Tu-a kei hong mute in hong mu nawn kei ding uh hi; kei nong zong dinga ka na om nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 20:9"},"9":{"text":"Meiilum kaite thengin a manthan bangin, han b sung tungsate, a kileh kik kei hi.","ref":"Job 3:25"},"10":{"text":"Amah a inn ah ciah kik ngei lo dinga, a omna mun in a thei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 18:21; Ph 37:10"},"11":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin ka sip dide thei kei hi; ka lunggim manin ka paukhia dinga, ka lungkham manin ka phun ding hi.","ref":"Job 9:35; 13:13"},"12":{"text":"Kei nong cin dingin tuipi, ahikeh tuipi ganhing lianpi ka hi hiam?","ref":"Isa 1:14; Job 38:8-11"},"13":{"text":"Lum leng ka nuamtuam dinga, ka lupna ah ka lungkhamna bei inteh ci-a ka ngaihsut ciang nangawnin","ref":"Job 19:27"},"14":{"text":"ka mangin nong linthawn a, mangmuhna-in nong lausak hi;"},"15":{"text":"tua hi-a hibang pumpi a ka om sangin kitawlsanin si leng ka utzaw hi.","ref":"Job 6:9; Kil 9:6; 1Ku 19:4"},"16":{"text":"A nungta tawntung ding lah hi lo ing a, ka nuntakna ka cimtak hi. Ka nuntakna in khiatna nei kei; hong hicisak hoh in.","ref":"Job 9:21; Ph 39:13"},"17":{"text":"\"Hizah taka na bawl ding, hizahta a na lunghimawh ding,","ref":"Job 4:19; Ph 8:4"},"18":{"text":"zingsang simin na sittel ding le a hun sima na zia-et dingin mihing bang hi lel ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 73:14; Job 23:10; Ph 17:3"},"19":{"text":"Tomcik sung beek hong pelh loin, tomcik sung khat beek kei guak hong omsak lo ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:18"},"20":{"text":"Mihing encikpa aw, a mawh khinsa ka hileh, nang tung bang hong bawl ka hi hiam? Bang hangin kei muitum a hong nei na hi hiam? Na vangik suak ka hi hiam? a","ref":"Job 35:6; Job 6:4"},"21":{"text":"Bang hangin ka thupalsatnate hong maisakin, ka mawhnate hong maisak lo na hi hiam? Ahang in, leivui lakah ka lum baih ta ding hi; kei nong zong dinga, ahi hangin ka om nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 9:28; Job 10:9; Ph 7:5; Job 3:13"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bildad","ref":"Job 18:1; 25:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Tua bangte bangtanvei gengen lai ding na hi hiam? Na kammalte huihsia nung hi lel hi.","ref":"Job 11:2; 18:2; 2Kh 36:16"},"3":{"text":"Pasian in thutang lehzat ahi hiam? Thahatpa in thumaan lehzat ahi hiam?","ref":"Pc 18:25"},"4":{"text":"Na tate ama tungah a khialh ciangin amau mawhna dan amaute thuaksak hi.","ref":"Job 1:19"},"5":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian zongin, Thahatpa tungah na thum ding leh,","ref":"Job 5:8; 9:15"},"6":{"text":"siangthoin na thutan nak leh, tu nangawnin amahmah nang tangin tho dinga na mun manah hong koihkik ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:24"},"7":{"text":"Na kipat tungin a zawng ding na bat hangin mailam ah na dau pai ding hi.","ref":"Job 21:13; Jer 29:11"},"8":{"text":"A khang masate dong lecin a pate uh sinsa na theikhia ding hi;"},"9":{"text":"ahang in, eite zandiaka suak hi hanga bangmah i thei kei hi; tuateh i leitung hun lah niliim bang bek ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 47:9; 2Kh 10:6"},"10":{"text":"Hong genin hong hilh thei buang lo ding uh ahi hiam? Amaute theihsa sung pan hong gen thei buang lo ding uh hiam?","ref":"Pn 1:8; Pn 2:1-2"},"11":{"text":"Ciknawng om lohna ah laiphai kungte sang po zo ahi hiam? Tui loin pumpeng khang thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 40:21; Isa 19:6; 35:7"},"12":{"text":"A khansan laitakin a kivat kei zong lopa sangin keu baihzaw hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:26"},"13":{"text":"Pasian a mangngilh mite nuntakna tua bang ahi hi; tua bangin Pasian mangngilhte lametna mangthang hi.","ref":"Ph 19:17; 37:38; Job 6:9; Pn 10:28"},"14":{"text":"Tua ama kimuanna kisia baih a, b ama kingakna pangpaan ahi hi.","ref":"Job 27:18; Isa 59:5"},"15":{"text":"A pangpaan tungah a kingak hangin a kikek hi; a tungah bawm a, ahi hangin tua in a khoh kei hi.","ref":"Mt 7:26"},"16":{"text":"Amah ni-onna munah limtaka tui kibuak singno huan sung tengah a zung a kha kawikawi;","ref":"Ph 80:11; Jer 11;16"},"17":{"text":"suang kiciangte kikalah a zung a kha, suang laka a zung khak nading a zong singkung tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin a mun pan a kibawhkhiat ciangin tua mun in theikha nawn lo a, ‘Nang kong mu ngei kei hi,’ ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua singkung hinna keucip mang a, tuateh tua lei hoih munah singno dangte a po takpi hi. c","ref":"Ph 119:90"},"20":{"text":"\"Pasian in sitbaang lo mi nilkhia loin, gitlohna a semte khut a thakhauhsak kei takpi hi.","ref":"Job 1:1; Pc 18:25"},"21":{"text":"Na kam dimdimin hong nuisak dinga, lungnuamin hong awngawngsak ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:22; Job 35:10; Ph 47:5"},"22":{"text":"Maizumna in na galte, tuam dinga, mi gilote buk a om nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 27:7; Job 18:6"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Hihi, hih in thumaan ahilam ka thei hi. Ahi hangin Pasian mai-ah mihing bangci thumaan thei ding hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Mi khat amah tawh kisel nuam taleh kam tul khat lakah kam khat zong a dawng thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 40:5; Job 10:2; 37:19"},"4":{"text":"Ama pilna thukin a vangliatna zai hi. Kua in amah nialin gimthuak loin suakta ngei hiam?","ref":"Job 11:6"},"5":{"text":"Amah in mualte a theihloh kalun khin a, a heh suakin a lumlet hi.","ref":"Ph 18:7; Mt 17:20"},"6":{"text":"Amah in leitung a omna panin lok a, a khuampite a lingsak hi.","ref":"Job 26:14; Isa 2;21"},"7":{"text":"Ni hopih a, a tang kei hi; amah in aksi tangte a khakcip hi.","ref":"Isa 34:4; Isa 13:10; Jer 4:23"},"8":{"text":"Amah kia in vantungte zalh a, tuipi hualte tung a tawn hi.","ref":"Pc 1:1,8; job 38:16; Ph 77:19"},"9":{"text":"Amah,Khawlei-uikai, Zawlzawng, Seguk le leitaw-lam aksite a bawlpa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 32:22; Pc 1;16"},"10":{"text":"Amah in kuama tehzawh loh a lamdang, simzawh loh a nalamdangte a bawl hi.","ref":"Tp 6:22; Job 5:9"},"11":{"text":"Kei kiangah hong baanga, amah ka mu thei kei hi. Kei kiang hong nawk ciangin amah ka thei thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 23:8-9"},"12":{"text":"Amah in bawtkhiamang leh kua in kham thei hiam? Kua in a kiangah, \"Bang hih na hiam?\" ci thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Ms 23:20; Job 11:10; Tp 32:39"},"13":{"text":"Pasian in hehna dok kik lo hi; Rahab galkapte nangawn a khe phungah kun uh hi.","ref":"Ms 14:18; Job 10:15; Job 26:12"},"14":{"text":"\"Tua ahileh ken amah bangci nial theih ding ka hi hiam? Amah ka nial zawh nading kammal bangci muh thei ding ka hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Mawhpeng ka hi kha zongin, amah ka dawng kik thei kei ding hi; ka Thukhenpa tungah hong lainat nading ka thum thei bek hi.","ref":"Job 8:5"},"16":{"text":"Ken amah samin hong dawng ta leh zong, ka thu hong zaksak nuamin ka um kei hi.","ref":"Job 13:22"},"17":{"text":"Amah in huihpi hong zialnelhsakin a thu om lopi-in ka liamna a khangsak ding hi.","ref":"Job 16:12; Ph 83:15; Job 16:14"},"18":{"text":"Kei hong husangsak man loin lungkhamna bek hong zensak ding hi.","ref":"Job 7:19"},"19":{"text":"Thatang hat thu hileh amah hat mahmah hi! Thutan zawhthu hileh kua in amah a sam zo ding hiam?","ref":"Ne 9:32; Jer 49;19"},"20":{"text":"Kei mawhpeng hi ta leng zong ka kam in kei hong mawhpaih hi; kei a paubaang lo hi ta leng zong, tua in kei mawh nei hong ci ding hi."},"21":{"text":"\"A paubaang lo ka hi ta zongin, kei le kei ka kithupisak kei a, ka nuntakna ka thusim kei hi,","ref":"Ms 11:15; Job 10:1; 34:6"},"22":{"text":"A vekpi in kibang hi; tua ahi manin, ‘A paubaang lote le a gilote susia khawm hi,’ ka ci hi.","ref":"Job 3:19; Eze 21:3"},"23":{"text":"Satna in manlanga a sihsak ciangin mawhpengte lungmanna zahpih lel hi.","ref":"Job 24:1; Ph 64:4"},"24":{"text":"Gam khat migilote khut sung a tun ciangin, amah in thukhente mit a tunsak hi. Tua pen amah ahi kei leh kua hi ding hiam?","ref":"Job 12:9; Isa 41:20"},"25":{"text":"Laitaipa sangin ka nite kinawhzaw a, lungnopna loin a lengmang pah hi.","ref":"Job 7:6; Job 10:10"},"26":{"text":"Amaute phaikung gunkuang bangin tolh uh a, muvanlai sa bawhsuk a bang uh hi.","ref":"Job 24:18; Ph 46:3; Job 39:29"},"27":{"text":"‘Ka phunnate mangngilhin, ka maipuak khelin nuihmai ning,’ ci ta leng,","ref":"Job 7:11"},"28":{"text":"kei a mawhpengin hong seh tuan lo ding uh cih thei ka hi manin, ka thuaknate khempeuh ka kihta lai hi.","ref":"Pk 34:7"},"29":{"text":"A mawh a hong kimusa ka hi nungsang, bang hanga a mawkna-in kibuaisak lai ding ka hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 37:33"},"30":{"text":"Saban b in kei le kei kisil leng a, ka khutte tangalin sil ta leng,","ref":"Mal 3:2; Job 17:9"},"31":{"text":"buandiim khuk sungah nong sawnkhia dinga, ka puan nangawn in kei hong kih ding hi.","ref":"Ph 35:7; Na 3:6; Job 7:20"},"32":{"text":"\"Amah ka dawn theih dingin kei bangin amah mihing hi lo a, thukhen zumah khat le khat kimaituah theih ding ahi kei hi.","ref":"Ms 23:19"},"33":{"text":"Kote kikalah thukhensat ding khat beek om henla, a langnih tuakin a khut nga in,","ref":"1Sa 2:25"},"34":{"text":"kei tung pan Pasian cianggolh hong paihsak ding khatpeuh om henla, ama linthawnna in kei hong lausak nawn lo ding hileh","ref":"Job 21:9"},"35":{"text":"tua ciangin amah kihta loin ka genkhia ding hi; ahi zongin tu-in ka hi ding bang ka hi thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 7:15"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka nuntakna mahmah ka cimtak hi; tua ahi manin ka ututin ka phun dinga ka lunggimna ka genkhia ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Pasian kiangah: Kei hong mawhpaih kei inla nong mawhsakna hong gen in, ka ci ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:3"},"3":{"text":"Kei hong kinengniam a, na bawlsate kisimmawhbawlin migilote ngimna na maitaipih ciangin na lungkim ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:22; Pc 1:26"},"4":{"text":"Ci-le-sa mit nei na hi hiam? Mihing muh bangin mu na hi hiam?","ref":"1Sa 16:7"},"5":{"text":"Na nite mihingte aa bang, ahikeh na kumte mihingte aa bang ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 36:26; Ph 39:5"},"6":{"text":"Ka khialhnate zongin bang hangin ka mawhna hong sulzuih na hi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Mawhna ka neih loh lam, na khut panin hong honkhia zo kuamah a om loh lam, thei hi lo na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 6:29"},"8":{"text":"\"Na khut in kei hong geelin nong bawl hi. Tu-in kei hong susia zel ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Pc 2:7; 2Sa 14:14"},"9":{"text":"Tungman bangin kei nong seek lam phawk in. Tu-in leivui hong suaksak zel ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 4:9; Job 7:21"},"10":{"text":"Nawitui bangin kei nong sungkhia a, nawikhal bangin nong khalsak a,"},"11":{"text":"vun le satakin nong tuam a, guh le thagui-in hong khuituah hi lo na hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 139:13"},"12":{"text":"Hong nungtasakin, migitna nong lak a, nangma huaina sungah kei ka nungta hi.","ref":"Pc 2:7"},"13":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin hih in na lungsima na selsiah hi a, hih pen na lungsim ahilam ka thei ta hi:","ref":"Job 23:13"},"14":{"text":"Ka mawh leh nong vil gige a, ka mawhna dan pan nong pengsak kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:27"},"15":{"text":"Ka khialhkhak leh thuak mah ning! Mawhpenga ka om nangawnin ka lu ka phong thei kei hi; ahang in, ka mai zum lua a, gim thuakna sungah a ka kia hi.","ref":"Job 9:13; Ph 25:16"},"16":{"text":"Ka lu phongkaang pan leng humpinelkai bangin nong gem khiankhian a, a kihtak huai na vangliatna nong tungsak hi.","ref":"Ph 7:2; Job 5:9"},"17":{"text":"Kei hong langpan ding teci thak nong puak a, kei tungah na heh semsem hi. Kei lamah na hatna a hualhualin hong tung hi.","ref":"2Ku 21:10; Ru 1:21; Job 5:7"},"18":{"text":"\"Bang hangin sul sung pan hong pusuakkhiasak peuhmah na hi hiam? Kuama hong muh ma-in si leng ka ut hi.","ref":"Job 3:8; Job 3:26"},"19":{"text":"Mihinga piang vet lo, ahikeh sul sung panin han a zuanpah hizaw leng maw!","ref":"Job 3:3; Jer 15:10"},"20":{"text":"Ka hun tomno beikuan ta hi lo ahi hiam? Tomno sung nuam ka sak theih nadingin kei kiang pan kihemkhia in.","ref":"Job 7:7"},"21":{"text":"Kuamah a kileh kik nawn lohna mun, khuamial le niliap b thukpi in a tuamcipna mun,","ref":"2Sa 12:23; Job 3:5"},"22":{"text":"zan khuamial penpenna mun, niliap thukpi, khuavak nangawn khuamial tawh a kibatna mun ka tun ma-in tomvei sung ka lungnop nadingin kei hong nusia in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:9"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naamath mi Zophar in dawng a:","title":"Zophar","ref":"Job 2:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Na kampau khempeuh hong kidawng lo ding sa na hiam? Hih kamtampa mawh kipengsak ding hiam?","ref":"Job 8:2; Pc 41:6"},"3":{"text":"Ciakciakna in mite daisak tuam ding sa na hi hiam? Simmawhna kam na pau ciangin hong kitai lo tuam ding sa na hiam?","ref":"Eph 4:29; Job 12:4"},"4":{"text":"Pasian kiangah, ‘Ka upnate genbaang lo a, na muhna ah ka siangtho hi,’ na ci hi.","ref":"Job 9:21; Job 10:7"},"5":{"text":"Tazen teh, nang langah Pasian kamka-in hong pau ek leh ut siing!","ref":"Pk 20:19"},"6":{"text":"Tua hileh pilna thusimte nang tung hong pulakin, pilna maan in pang nih a neih lam hong gen ding hi. Pasian in na mawhna pawlkhat nangawn a mangngilh lam thei in.","ref":"Job 9:4; Ezr 9:13"},"7":{"text":"\"Pasian thusimte lam teh thei na hi hiam? Vanglianpa thu gensiang thei ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 5:9; Thn 3:11"},"8":{"text":"Vantungte sangin amaute sangzaw uh hi - nang bang hih thei na hi hiam? Hankhuk c thukna sangin amaute thukzaw uh hi - nang bang thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Pc 15:5; Eph 3:18"},"9":{"text":"Leitung sangin amaute sauzaw uh a, tuipi sangin zaizaw uh hi.","ref":"Eph 3:19-20"},"10":{"text":"\"Amah hong pai-in thong sungah hong khum henla, thukhen zumkhat sam leh kua in amah nang zo ding hiam?","ref":"Job 9:12"},"11":{"text":"Amah in zuauphuak mite phawk vilvel hi; tuateh gamtat hoih lo a muh ciangin ciamteh lo sa na hiam?","ref":"Job 10:4"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin gamsung laate mihing d a suah theih loh bangin mihaipa mipil suak thei lo hi."},"13":{"text":"\"Hi taleh ama tungah na lungsim apin, ama lamah na khut zankhia lecin,","ref":"1Sa 7:3; Ph 78:8; Pk 9:29; Job 5:8"},"14":{"text":"na khut sunga om mawhna koihkhia-in, na buk sungah gamtat hoih lo tumsak kei lecin,","ref":"Jos 24:14; Ph 101:4"},"15":{"text":"tua ciangin zum loin na lu na phong to dinga, lau loin kiptakin na ding ding hi.","ref":"Job 22:26"},"16":{"text":"Na lungkhamnate na mangngilh kiuhkeuh dinga, tuisik luangmang a bang ding hi.","ref":"Jos 7:5"},"17":{"text":"Na nuntakna sun laitak sangin vakzaw dinga, khuamialna zingsang a bang ding hi.","ref":"Job 22:28; Job 17:12"},"18":{"text":"Lametna om ahi manin nang na bit ding hi; na kim na pam na khuadakdak dinga, lungmuangin na tawlnga ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Kuama lausak lohin na lum hithiat dinga, mi tampi in nang hong maivil ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 45:14"},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin migilote in hong en ngam lo ding uh a, suakta loin amaute lametna pen kha-awhna suak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 28:65; Job 8:13"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"No mihingte le pilna a sihkhawm ding lunghei neih huai lo hi.","ref":"Job 15:8; 17:10"},"3":{"text":"Ahi zongin note aa zah lungsim ka nei hi; note sangin ka niamzaw tuan kei hi. Hihte khempeuh kuan thei lo ding sa na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 13:2"},"4":{"text":"Ka lawmte in kei hong nuihsan zongin, Pasian ka ko a, ama’n hong dawng hi; thumaan le paubaang lo hi napi kimawk nuihsat lailai!","ref":"Pc 38:23; Ph 91:15; Job 6:29"},"5":{"text":"Lunghimawhna a nei lo mite in a khe tala tukte tuah bangin tuahsiatna a nuihsan uh hi.","ref":"Ph 17:5; Ph 123:4"},"6":{"text":"Guta buluhte buk kinawngkaisak lo a, Pasian a hehsakte’ buk kibitsak hi- amaute in a pasiante uh a khutun a tawi uh hi.","ref":"Job 5:24; Job 9:24"},"7":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin gamsate dong un, amaute in hong hilh ding uh hi; ahikeh huihlak vasate dong un, amaute in hong gen ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 35:11; Mt 6:26"},"8":{"text":"ahikeh leitung hopih un, tua in hong hilh ding hi; ahikeh tuipi sunga ngasate kigensak un."},"9":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh in, TOPA khut in hihte a sepsa ahilam a thei lo om ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 1:3; Job 9:24"},"10":{"text":"A nungta ganhing peuhmah nuntakna le mihing khempeuh naksuk naktohna ama khut sungah om hi.","ref":"Da 5:23; Pc 2:7"},"11":{"text":"Leii in an a ciap bangin bil in thu sittel hi lo ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Khanghamte lakah pilna kimu hi lo ahi hiam? Sawtpi nuntakna in hong theitelsak hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"1Ku 4:2; Job 17:4"},"13":{"text":"\"Pilna le vangliatna Pasian aa ahi hi; thukuppihna le theihtelna ama aa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 9:4; Pn 21:30; Ms 23:19"},"14":{"text":"Ama phelkeksate kilam kik thei nawn lo a, thonga a khiatsa mipa kikhahkhia thei lo hi.","ref":"Job 16:9; Job 9:3"},"15":{"text":"Tui a khaktan ciangin guah haanga, tuate a khah ciangin leitung a tuamcip hi.","ref":"Tp 28:22; Pc 7:24"},"16":{"text":"Thahatna le gualzawhna ama aa hi a, a kikhemte le a khempa ama aa hikhawm hi.","ref":"Job 9:4; 2Kh 18:22"},"17":{"text":"Thudotte hawkkhia-in pimanga, thukhente a haisak hi.","ref":"Job 19:9"},"18":{"text":"Amah in kumpite khihna kolkhau phelkhia a, amau kawngah dialkaih b a tengsak hi.","ref":"Ph 107:14; Job 34:18"},"19":{"text":"Amah in siampite hawkkhia in pimanga, a tengtulte a lawnthal hi.","ref":"Tp 24:15"},"20":{"text":"Amah in thu kidong mi muanhuaite sipsak dide a, upate thupilna a lakmangsak hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in mi nampite mindaisak a, a thahatte guallelsak hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah in khuamialna sunga thuthukte mukhia a, niliap thukpi khuavak suaksak hi.","ref":"1Co 4:5; Job 3:5"},"23":{"text":"Amah in minamte liansak a, amaute a susia hi; minamte khangsaka amaute a thehthang hi.","ref":"Ph 2:1; Pk 34:24"},"24":{"text":"Leitung makaite ngaihsut theihna lakkhiatsak a, lampi omlohna gamlak ah vakvaisak hi.","ref":"Ph 107:40"},"25":{"text":"Mei lo in khuamial zawt uh a, zukham bangin a hoisak dawidawi hi.","ref":"Tp 28:29; Ph 107:27"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Hihte khempeuh ka mitin ka mu khina ka bilin ka za khin a, ka thei khin hi.","ref":"Job 9:24"},"2":{"text":"No theihte ken zong ka thei hi. No sangin ka niamzaw tuan kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Vanglianpa tawh ka kiho nuam a, Pasian tawh ka thu ka kikum nuam hi.","ref":"Job 5:17:40:2; Job 5:8; 9:14-20"},"4":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin zuauthu-in nong melhbawl uh hi; note navekun kimanna nei lo zato siamte na hi uh hi.","ref":"Ph 119:69; Job 6:15"},"5":{"text":"Note na vekun dai tapeuh dih un! Mipil na tangzaw ding uh hi.","ref":"Thk 18:19; Pn 17:28"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in ka thugen za unla, ka muka ka thumna ngai dih un."},"7":{"text":"Pasian tangin kam gilo pau ding na hi uh hiam? Ama adingin zuauphuak ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 12:16"},"8":{"text":"Amah angvan sawm na hi uh hiam? Pasian tangin phutsak sawm na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Note hong sittel leh gina takpi ding na hi uh hiam? Mi na khem bangun amah khem thei ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 9:3"},"10":{"text":"A simthamin mi na deidan vial uh leh hong tai taktak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 19:15"},"11":{"text":"Ama thupina in nang hong lausak lo ding ahi hiam? Amah kihtakna nang tungah hong tu lo ding hiam?","ref":"Job 31:23; Pk 3:6"},"12":{"text":"Na thu tomlaknate uh, vut paunak hi a; na kihutnate uh lah tungman kihutna ahi hi.","ref":"Ne 4:2-3"},"13":{"text":"\"Na dai unla kei hong gensak dih un; tua ciangin a piang bangbang a piang hi mai hen.","ref":"Job 7:11; Job 9:21"},"14":{"text":"Bang hangin kei le kei a lauhuai munah kikoih in, ka nuntakna ka khutah koih ka hi hiam?","ref":"Thk 9:17"},"15":{"text":"Amah’n kei hong thah leh zong amah ka lamen lai hi; a maitang ah ka ngaihsutna ka puak taktak a ding hi.","ref":"Ph 23:4; Job 5:8"},"16":{"text":"Ama mai-ah pasian nei lote pai ngam lo uh ahi manin hih in kei kihutna hong lehsuah ding hi.","ref":"Ph 30:5"},"17":{"text":"Ka kammalte limtakin ngai dih un; ka gente na bil uh na dawh dih un."},"18":{"text":"Tu-in ka thu sung dingin ka kithawi zo hi; ka thu ka zawh ding ka thei hi.","ref":"Job 23:4; 37:19"},"19":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh kei langah pang thei ding ahi hiam? A tuacih theih leh pau loin ka si ding hi.","ref":"Job 40:4; Job 3:13; 9:15"},"20":{"text":"\"Pasian aw, hih thunih bek hong pia in, tua ciangin nang kong buksan kei ding hi:"},"21":{"text":"Kei tung pan gamlapi ah na khut dokkik inla, na lauhuainate-in hong linthawn nawn kei in.","ref":"Pk 9:3; Job 6:4"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin hong hopih in, kong dawng ding hi; Ahikeh ken hong hopih ning in nang hong dawng in.","ref":"Job 9:35; Job 9:16"},"23":{"text":"Mawhna le khialhna bangzah bawl khin ka hi hiam? Ka mawhna le ka thupalsatnate hong lak in.","ref":"1Sa 26:18; Job 7:21; 9:21"},"24":{"text":"Bang hangin na mai selin na gal banga hong ngaihsun na hi hiam?","ref":"Tp 32:20; Job 16:9"},"25":{"text":"Huih mutsa singteh khat gawt ding na hi hiam? Anvai keu khat nungdelh ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Sp 26:36; Job 21:18"},"26":{"text":"Ahang in, kei langdona a hoih lo tampi na gelh khin a, ka neu lai-a ka mawhnate nong luahsak hi.","ref":"Job 18:7"},"27":{"text":"Ka khete sikkolpi in na hen hi; ka khekhap na ciaptehna tawh ka paina khempeuh ah naitakin nong encik hi.","ref":"Pc 40:15; Job 10:14"},"28":{"text":"Tua hi-a amuat na khat le nget nek puan bangin mi khat a beibei hi.","ref":"Ph 39:11; 102:26"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei sunga suak mihing ni tawmno sung nungta-in lungkhamna tawh kidim hi.","ref":"Pc 3:17; Job 10:20"},"2":{"text":"Amah pak bangin palh a, a vulmang hi; niliim pai tawh kibanga, a kip kei hi.","ref":"Ph 103:15; Job 4:20"},"3":{"text":"A tuaci mi b khat mitkhah loin en na hiam? Na mai-ah thu kikhen dingin amah tun ding na hiam?","ref":"Ph 8:4; 144:3; Job 7:18"},"4":{"text":"A siang lo panin a siangah kua in tun thei ahi hiam? Kuamah in tun thei kei!","ref":"Job 4:17; Job 9:30"},"5":{"text":"Mihing nite kiseh khin hi; a kha phazah na ciangtan-a, ama khansak theih loh dingin na ciangtan khin hi.","ref":"Job 17:26"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin a kicial mi bangin ama hun a tun mateng kimuhmawhbawl inla amah guak omsak lel in.","ref":"Ph 39:13; Job 7:19"},"7":{"text":"\"Singkung khat in lametna nei buang hi. Kiphuktan taleh meng kikin sel pelmawh dinga, a mengthakte a si kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 19:10; Ph 52:5; Isa 6:13"},"8":{"text":"A bulte lei sungah teek dinga, lei hoih lakah a bulsum a si ding hi;","ref":"Isa 11:1; 53:2"},"9":{"text":"tua hi napi tui gimnamin sel a, singkungno bangin sel to hi.","ref":"Job 29:19; Job 26:4; Eze 34:27"},"10":{"text":"Mihing ahileh si-a, lei sungah kivui hi; a huu a nunung pen sanga a om nawn kei hi.","ref":"Job 10:21; 13:19"},"11":{"text":"Tuipi pan tuite a manthan bang ahikeh guntui kiamkiama tuinuai a keu bangin,","ref":"2Sa 14:14"},"12":{"text":"mite a kisial khit nak leh a tho kik nawn kei hi; vante a om nawn loh mateng mite khanglo nawn lo ding ahikeh a ihmutna pan a kithosak kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 104:26; Ns 3:21"},"13":{"text":"\"Han c sungah kei hong sel tapeuh inla, na hehna a dam mateng kei hong selcip hoh ve! Kei adingin hun khat hong sehsak inla, kei hong phawk tapeuh in!","ref":"Job 7:9; Ph 30:5; Job 6:8"},"14":{"text":"Mi khat si leh a nungta kik ding hiam? Haksapi-a ka nasepna pan hong kithaksuaksak d ding hun ka ngak ding hi.","ref":"Job 7:1; 2Ku 6:33"},"15":{"text":"Nong sam dinga, kong dawng ding hi; na khuta na bawlsa a nungtate na ngaih hun om ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:22; Job 10:3"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka khekhap na sim takpi dinga, ahi hangin ka mawhna nong sulzuih nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 10:4; 1Co 13:5"},"17":{"text":"Ka thupalsatnate ip khat sungah seal kikhencip ding hi; ka mawhna nong khuhsak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:34; Jer 32:10"},"18":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin damdama cim mual a manthan bang le suangtum a omna pan a kikhin bang,","ref":"Eze 38:20; Job 18:4"},"19":{"text":"tui in suangtum a nekmang bang le tuizeu in leihoih a nawkmang bangin mihing lametna na susia hi.","ref":"Pc 7:23; Eze 13:13"},"20":{"text":"Khatvei-a cinkhin dingin amah na zo a, tuateh amah om nawn lo hi; ama maipuak na khela na sawlmang hi.","ref":"Job 4:20; Job 7:10"},"21":{"text":"A tapate kipahtawi taleh amah’n a thei kei hi; amaute kiniam koih taleh amah’n a mu kei hi.","ref":"Job 21:21"},"22":{"text":"Ama pumpi natna bek thuak a, amah guak mah a thum hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 38:7; Job 21:21"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Teman mi Eliphaz in dawng a:","title":"Aliphaz","ref":"Job 4:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Mipil khat in a cihnopna kithei lopi in mi dawng ngei ahi hiam, ahikeh nisuahna huih-sa in a gilpi vahsak ding hiam?","ref":"Pc 41:6"},"3":{"text":"Kimanna nei lo kammalin mi sel a, phattuamna om lopi kampau ahi hiam?","ref":"Ne 4:2-3"},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang, biakna-mi hih ding na sumai-a, Pasian tunga ki-ap ding na dal hi.","ref":"Job 25:6"},"5":{"text":"Na mawhna in na kam manlangsak a; khembawlna leii na zang hi.","ref":"Job 11:6; Job 5:13"},"6":{"text":"Na kam in kei hong mawhpaih loin nang hong mawhpaih hi; na langkhatah na muk in teci pang hi.","ref":"Job 9:15"},"7":{"text":"\"Nang bek mihing a piang kisa na hi hiam? Mualte pianma-in hong kibawl khia khin ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 38:21; 1Sa 2:8"},"8":{"text":"Pasian vaihawmna zasim na hi hiam? Nang bek pilna nei na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 29:4; Isa 9:6; Job 12:2"},"9":{"text":"Kote theih loh bang thei na hi hiam? Kote neih zawh loh bang thugil nei na hi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Na pa sang nangawn-a upazaw khangham-a samkangte ko lamah pang uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 10:6; Job 12:12"},"11":{"text":"Pasian in nang hong hehnem a kamkhuma hong hopihnasa kicing sa nai lo na hiam?","ref":"Pc 37:35; Tp 8:3"},"12":{"text":"Bang hangin na lungtang in hong pimang a, mit sat khapkhap in","ref":"Job 11:13"},"13":{"text":"Pasian tungah tua bang hehluatna kam na muk panin paukhia na hi hiam?","ref":"Pn 29:11; Ph 94:4"},"14":{"text":"\"Numei pana piangkhia peuhmah a siantho nading ahikeh a thumaan nadingin mihing bang sa mawk na hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Pasian in ama misiangthote muang loin ama mitah vantungte nangawn siangtho lo ahileh,","ref":"Job 5:1; Job 4:18"},"16":{"text":"gitlohna tui banga a dawn, a siahuai, bangmah a man lo mihing nak ginat kei zaw na’n cia!","ref":"Job 20:12; Pk 5:2"},"17":{"text":"\"Ken zong hong gencian ning, na ngai dih in; ka muhsate hong gensak dih in;","ref":"Job 4:8"},"18":{"text":"Hih in mipilte thugen hi a, a pate uh tung pana a ngahte uh a ip hetloh uh hi a","ref":"Tp 32:7"},"19":{"text":"(tua in amaute tung bekah a gam uh kipia in, amaute lakah pemtate a om ma-a kipia ahi hi):","ref":"Pc 12:1"},"20":{"text":"Migilo in a nuntak sung thuaksiatna tuak a, a nuntak kum tawntung ngongtatna a thuak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 8:22"},"21":{"text":"Patauhna aw a bil ah gingden a, a nuamsa a bat laitakin buluhte in luh ding uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 3:11"},"22":{"text":"Khuamial pan suahtak nading lametna om lo a, namsau-a thah dingin ciamtehsa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 5:14"},"23":{"text":"Musanete a an dingin - a vak kawikawi hi a, a tungah khuamial a tunpah ding lam a thei hi.","ref":"Ph 109:10"},"24":{"text":"Lungdonna le lungtawlna in amah linthawn hi; galsim dinga kithawisa kumpipa bangin tuate in a lungsim a zen hi.","ref":"Isa 8:22"},"25":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in Pasian lamah a khuttum liika, a Thahatpa langkhat ah kiphasak in,","ref":"Ph 44:16; Job 11:8"},"26":{"text":"ama langah a sah a khauh lum tawi-in khauhtakin a do hi."},"27":{"text":"\"A maitang thau-in a kawng sa dimin pek khilkhel zawzen zongin","ref":"Thk 3:17"},"28":{"text":"kuama ten lohna inn siasa tawh a kidim khuapi siasa ah a teng ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:9"},"29":{"text":"Amah hau nawn lo dinga, a neihsate kip loin a neihsate zong leitungah a kizel nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 3:15"},"30":{"text":"Amah khuamial pan a suakta kei ding hi; ama mengte meikuang in hultum dinga, Pasian kam pana huu in amah pimang ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:14; Job 8:19; 16:7; Pk 15:10; Isa 40:23"},"31":{"text":"Man nei lo khat muangin amah le amah kikhem kei hen, ahang in, bangmah a lawhtak kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 31:5; Isa 30:12; Job 20:7"},"32":{"text":"Ama hun a tun ma-in a cingin kipia dinga, ama hiangte a meng nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Thn 7:17"},"33":{"text":"A gah a min ma-a kizuutkhia lenggah bang dinga, a pakte a pulh khin olive kung bang ding hi.","ref":"Hab 3:17; Job 4:20"},"34":{"text":"Ahang in, Pasian neilote tawh a kipawlte tasel ding uh a, golhsum lak nuam sate puanbuk mei in a hultum ding hi.","ref":"Pk 23:8; Heb 10:27"},"35":{"text":"Amaute in buaina paii in gitlohna suakkhia uh hi; amaute’ sul in khemna a piangsak hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 5:7"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Hih bang thute tampi ka za khin hi; na vek un a lunggim huai hehnemte hi lel uh teh!","ref":"Job 6:15; Ph 69:20"},"3":{"text":"A mawkna-in na mutmutna kamte uh bei ngei lo ding hiam? Hong nasak bang kammal tawh kei hong busimsim lai ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 6:26"},"4":{"text":"Note kei dinmunah om le uhcin kei zong no pau bangin ka pau thei ding hi; note ka lu hong peisanin note langah kam hoih nono ka pau thei mah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka kam in note hong hanthawn thei ding hi; ka muk panin hong hehnemin kong nuamtuamsak ding hi.","ref":"Job 29:25"},"6":{"text":"\"Pau taleng lah ka natna nuamtuam tuan lo a; ki-iip taleng zong a damsiang tuan kei hi.","ref":"Job 6:3"},"7":{"text":"Hi takpi hi, Pasian aw, kei nong patkhiasak a; ka innkuan bup nong gamsak hi.","ref":"Thk 8:5; Job 1:19"},"8":{"text":"Kei nong hencip khin a - tua mah kei teci a suak hi; ka gawn’na dingto-in kei langah teci a pang hi."},"9":{"text":"Pasian in kei hong doin, hehin kei hong balkham a, a ha hong gawisan hi; ka langpa in a mitin hong sal gemgam hi.","ref":"Job 12:14; Job 30:21; Ph 35:16; Job 13:24"},"10":{"text":"Mite kamka-in kei hong zahnuihsan uh a; hong zahpihna-un ka paang hong bengin, kei langkhatah kipawl uh hi.","ref":"Ph 22:13; Isa 50:6; Job 11:3; Ph 27:3"},"11":{"text":"Pasian in migilote tungah kei hong pia a, a kheltatte kepcip dingin hong lawnkhia hi."},"12":{"text":"A nuamsa kimlai kei hong nuaizan a; ka gawlah hong manin hong nencip hi. Muitum in hong nei a;","ref":"Job 9:17"},"13":{"text":"a thalkapte in kei hong umcih uh hi. Hehpih peuhmah loin ka kalte sunlet uh a, leilakah ka sinkha luangkhia hi.","ref":"Job 20:24"},"14":{"text":"Amah in kei hong liamsuah kikkik a, galhangpa bangin kei hong ngongbawl hi.","ref":"Job 9:17; Joel 2:7"},"15":{"text":"\"Ka vuntungah puanhampi ka khui-a, ka taltang leivui lakah ka phum hi.","ref":"Pc 37:34; Job 2:8"},"16":{"text":"Ka kahkahna-in ka mai san a, ka mitkhu bawk in ka mit a liah hi;","ref":"Job 2:7; 17:7"},"17":{"text":"tua hi napi, ka khutte ngongtat lo a, ka thungetna a siangtho hi.","ref":"Isa 55:7; Job 6:28"},"18":{"text":"\"Leitang aw, ka sisan vukcip kei in; ka kikona kikhawlsak kei tapeuh hen!","ref":"Pc 4:10; Job 19:24; Ph 5:2"},"19":{"text":"Tu nangawn in vantungah ka teci a om hi; ka tangdingpa a sangna ah om hi.","ref":"Pc 31:50; Job 22:12"},"20":{"text":"Kei hong thumsakpa ka lawm a hi-a, tua kawmkawmin Pasian tungah ka khitui ka sungkhia hi;","ref":"Ta 2:19"},"21":{"text":"Mi khat in a lawmpa ading a thumsak bangin mi khat tangin amah in Pasian tungah a thumsak hi.","ref":"1Ku 8:45"},"22":{"text":"\"A kileh kik nawn lo dingin khual ka zin ma-in kum tawmkhat sung bek lah hong bei ding hi.","ref":"Job 10:21"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"‘Ka lungsim kitamkham a, ka nite kitomsakin hankhuk in kei hong ngak ta hi.","ref":"Ph 88:3-4"},"2":{"text":"Mi zahkohte in hong umcih taktak uh hi; amaute hong langneihna mitkhah loin ka en pelmawh ding hi.","ref":"Job 6:14; 11:3"},"3":{"text":"Pasian aw, nong kalh kiciamna hong pia in. Kua dangin kei adingin bitna hong piaksak ding hiam?","ref":"Ph 35:2; Pn 6:1"},"4":{"text":"Amaute theihtelna lungsim na khaksak hi; tua ahi ciangin amaute na gualzosak kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 12:12"},"5":{"text":"Mi khat in pahtakman a deih manin a lawmte a lehbawl leh ama tate mit in khua a mu kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 22:15; Job 11:20"},"6":{"text":"\"Pasian in mi khempeuh tungah thusia gentehna hong suaksak khin a; tua mite mai-ah kei hong kicilphih hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:7; Ms 12:14"},"7":{"text":"Ka dahna hangin ka mit maang a; ka guhteng khempeuh niliap bang hi.","ref":"Job 16:8; Job 2:12"},"8":{"text":"Mi thutangte in lamdang sa uh a; a pasian-milote langah mawhpengte a ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hi taleh a thumaante in amau lampite lenkip ding uh a, amau khut siangthote a thahat toto ding hi.","ref":"Ph 84:7"},"10":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin na vekun hong pai dih un, hanciam lailai un, no lakah mipil ka mu kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 12:2"},"11":{"text":"Ka nite bei ta in, ka ngimnate maimang ta a, ka lungsima ka lunggulhnate om nawn lo hi.","ref":"Job 7:6"},"12":{"text":"Hih mite in zanhun sun suaksak uh a; amaute in khuamial lakah, ‘Khua vak dek ta hi’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Isa 50:11; Job 5:17"},"13":{"text":"Ka inn dinga ka lamet hankhuk a hi-a, khuamial lakah ka lupna phahin","ref":"2Sa 14:14; Ph 139:8"},"14":{"text":"siatna kiangah, ‘Ka pa na hi hi,’ ka cih a, thante kiangah, ‘Nu aw, ahikeh sanggamnu aw,’ ka cihleh","ref":"Job 13:28; Job 4:19"},"15":{"text":"ka lametna koi-ah om lai hiam? Kua in kei ading lametna mu thei lai ding hiam?","ref":"Ph 31:22"},"16":{"text":"Sihna b kongpite ah a paisuk diam? Leivui lakah i tuaksuk khawm diam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 7:9; Pc 2:7"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bildad","ref":"Job 8:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Na paupau khawl hun nei lo ding na hiam? Khawl hun thei lecin ko kong pau thei pan ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 8:2"},"3":{"text":"Bang hangin bawnghon bangin hong ngaihsun a, mihai banga hong seh na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 12:7; Ph 73:22"},"4":{"text":"Na hehna hangin nang le nang a kibalnen na suak hi; nang tangin leitung kinusia ding ahi hiam? Ahikeh suangtumte a omna pan kilikkhia ding ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"\"A gilopa’ meivak kisukmitsak hi; ama mei kuanglai mit hi.","ref":"Job 21:17; Job 12:25"},"6":{"text":"A puanbuk khuavak mial a; a kianga meivak a mit hi.","ref":"Job 5:14; Job 11:17"},"7":{"text":"A kalsuan ziauziauna kithakiasak a, ama tupnate in amah sawnpuk hi.","ref":"Ph 18:36; Job 15:6"},"8":{"text":"A khe in len sungah sawnpai a, a kekna vang zongin a vak kawikawi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thang in a khetul ah mana, thangkhau in gakcip hi.","ref":"Pn 5:22"},"10":{"text":"Amah siahna khaukual leitungah kisin khinkhian a, a lampi ah thang kisiah hi.","ref":"Pn 7:22; Ph 140:5"},"11":{"text":"A kim a pam ah lauhuaina in amah panga, a kalsuanna citengah a sulzuih hi.","ref":"Job 15:21"},"12":{"text":"Tuahsiatna in amah ngaklah a; a puk cianga a siat nading lauhuaina in amah ngak gige hi.","ref":"Job 15:23"},"13":{"text":"Tua in a vun khenkhat ne mang a, sihna tacil in a khut a khete a nawmvalh hi.","ref":"Zec 14:12"},"14":{"text":"A puanbuk muanhuaina pan amah kibalzan a, lauhuaina’ kumpipa lam zuanin kipaikhiatpih hi.","ref":"Job 8:22; Job 15:24"},"15":{"text":"Mei in a puanbuk tenden c a; a tenna tung tengah kaatkuang kitheh hi.","ref":"Job 20:26; Pc 19:24"},"16":{"text":"A nuai-ah a thaguite keucip a, a tunga hiangte a keugaw hi.","ref":"Isa 5:24"},"17":{"text":"Amah kiphawkna leitung panin mangthang a; leitungah min a nei kei hi.","ref":"Tp 32:26"},"18":{"text":"Khuavak panin khuamial ah amah kihawlkhia a, leitung panin kidelhkhia hi.","ref":"Job 5:14; Job 11:20"},"19":{"text":"Ama mite lakah suan le khak ahikeh gui nei lo a, a tenna ah a khuasuak kuamah a om nawn kei hi.","ref":"Ph 21:10; 37:28; 2Ku 10:11"},"20":{"text":"Nitumna-lam mite ama hangin lauthawng uh a, nisuahna-lam mite linglawng uh hi.","ref":"Ph 37:13"},"21":{"text":"Migilote tenna tua bang hitakpi a; Pasian a theilote mun tua bang ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 57:20"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Bang tanvei hong bawlsia in kammal tawh hong gawizan ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 13:25"},"3":{"text":"Kei sawmvei nong simmawh ta uh hi; maizum het loin kei nong do uh hi.","ref":"Job 20:3"},"4":{"text":"A lamkhial takpi ka hileh zong, ka khialhna kei guak tungah tusak mai un.","ref":"Job 6:24"},"5":{"text":"Kei tungah no le no na kitawisang uh leh ka thuaknate kei langah pangsak mai un;"},"6":{"text":"tua ciangin Pasian in kei hong mawhsak a ka kimkotah thang hong siah ahilam thei un.","ref":"Job 6:29; Job 10:3; 18:8"},"7":{"text":"\"‘Mawh khin ta’ng ei! ci-in ka kiko zongin, kuama dawnna ka za kei hi; hong huh ding mi ka sap hangin thutanga khen a om kei hi.","ref":"Job 30:20; Job 30:24"},"8":{"text":"Ka paisuak theih loh nadingin ka lampi khaktan khin hi; amah in ka lampi khuamialin a tuamcip hi.","ref":"Ta 3:7; Job 3:26"},"9":{"text":"Hong kipahtawina hong hawkkhiatsak a ka lu panin ka kumpi lukhu a lakhia hi.","ref":"Pc 43:28; Job 12:17; Job 2:8"},"10":{"text":"Ka manthan dong a munmun panin hong balkhia a; ka lametna singkung bangin a bulkalh hi.","ref":"Job 12:14; Job 7:6; 14:7"},"11":{"text":"Amah kei tungah heh lua mahmah a, ama galin hong sim hi.","ref":"Job 13:24"},"12":{"text":"Kei sim dingin a galkapte hong kuan hi; amaute in kei langah kulhkenbawlin hong umcih uh a ka puanbuk kimkot ah giahphual a sat uh hi.","ref":"Job 16:10; Job 3:23"},"13":{"text":"\"Amah in ka sanggamte kei kiang panin pemkhiasaka, ka meltheih khempeuh kei aa in midangpi suakkhin kiuhkeuh hi.","ref":"Ph 69:8; Job 16:7; 42:11"},"14":{"text":"Ka tanaute paimang khin uh hi; ka lawmte in hong mangngilh khin uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 15:12; Job 12:4"},"15":{"text":"Ka lenglate le ka nasem numeite in mikhual-in hong ngaihsun uh a, pemta bangin hong bawl uh hi.","ref":"Pc 14:14"},"16":{"text":"Ka nasempa samin keima kamin thum taleng hong dawng lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka zi in ka husan namsia sa-in, ka sanggamte tektek adingin ka kihhuai hi.","ref":"Ph 38:5"},"18":{"text":"Naupangnote nangawn in hong simmawh uh a, hong muh khak uh ciangin hong zahnuihsan uh hi.","ref":"Job 16:10"},"19":{"text":"Ka kinaipih ka lawmte khempeuh in hong kih uh a, ka it teng ka langah pang khin uh hi.","ref":"Job 6:14; 30:10; Jn 13:18"},"20":{"text":"Kei bangmah hi loin guh le vun bek ka hi hi; ka hani a bek tawh ka suakta lai hi.","ref":"Job 2:5"},"21":{"text":"\"Kei hong hehpih un lawmte aw, hong hehpih un; Pasian khut kei tungah kinga zo hi.","ref":"Job 6:14; Thk 2:15"},"22":{"text":"Pasian hong hih bangin bang dia hong delh na hi uh hiam? Ka sa khamzo nai lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 13:25; Ph 14:4"},"23":{"text":"\"O, ka thugente kiciamteh henla, tuate laizial tungah kigelh leh","ref":"Pk 17:14; Ph 40:7"},"24":{"text":"tuate haknaw pek tungah b sikzumin kikhuakin ahikeh a omden dingin suang tungah kigelh zen leh!","ref":"Jer 17:1"},"25":{"text":"Kei hong Tanpa c a nuntak lam ka thei a, ni tawpni ciangin leitung d ah a din ding zong ka thei hi.","ref":"Pk 6:6; 1Sa 14:39"},"26":{"text":"\"Ka vun khempeuh a kisiat khit e ciang nangawnin f ka satakin Pasian ka mu ding hi;","ref":"Ms 12:8; Mt 5:8"},"27":{"text":"Kuamah dang ahi lo - kei mahmah in ka mitin amah ka mu ding hi. Ka sunga ka lungsimin nak ngaklah lua si’ng!","ref":"Lk 2:30; Ph 42:1"},"28":{"text":"\"‘Ama sungah lunghimawhna zung a om nungsang bang i ci mawhmat zo ding hiam?’ na cih uh leh g","ref":"Job 13:25"},"29":{"text":"thangpaihna in namsau-a danpiakna hong tun ding ahi manin no mahmah in namsau kihta un, tua ciangin thukhenna h a om lam na thei pan ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 15:22; Job 27:13-23"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Naamath mi Zophar in dawng a:","title":"Zophar","ref":"Job 2:11"},"2":{"text":"\"Ka lunghimawhnate in hong dawngsak nuam hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ka ki-ip zo nawn mahmah kei hi.","ref":"Ph 42:5"},"3":{"text":"Kei hong pahtawi loin nong taina ka za a, ka tel sinsenna in kei hong dawngsak nuam hi.","ref":"Job 19:3"},"4":{"text":"\"Tanglai pekpek - leitung ah mi i a ki-omsak a kipan,","ref":"Tp 4:32"},"5":{"text":"a gilote nopsak hun a tom lam le pasian nei lote lungnop hun tomkha sung ahilam na thei taktak hi.","ref":"Ph 94:3; Ta 1:20; Job 8:12"},"6":{"text":"A kiphatsakna in vantungte bana a lutang in meiite a nawkkha zongin,","ref":"Job 33:17; Isa 14:13-14"},"7":{"text":"ama ek bangin amah a mangthang den ding hi; amah a mu ngeisate in, ‘Amah koi-ah om hiam’ ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 4:20"},"8":{"text":"Mang bangin amah lengmang dinga, kimu kik nawn lo ding hi; zana mumang bangin maimang ding hi.","ref":"Job 27:20"},"9":{"text":"Amah a mu mittang in mu kik nawn lo dinga, ama omna mun in amah a mu kik nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 7:8"},"10":{"text":"Mizawngte na a sutte a tate in loh kik pelmawh dinga; a neih a lam te ama khutin a pia kik pelmawh ding hi.","ref":"Job 3:15"},"11":{"text":"A khangmoi lai guhte a ngek lai pi mah in amah tawh leivui suakkhawm ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:26; Job 17:16"},"12":{"text":"\"A kam ah gitlohna khuma, a leii nuai ah selin","ref":"Job 15:16; Ph 10:7; 140:3"},"13":{"text":"sekhia nuam loin a kam sungah muammuam ta leh"},"14":{"text":"a an nekte a gilpi ah a thuk suak lai dinga; ama sungah gul hangsan gu a suak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 20:17"},"15":{"text":"A valhsa a hauhnate sekhia dinga; Pasian in a gilpi zangin luakhia khinsak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 18:25"},"16":{"text":"Amah in gul gilo gu teep dinga; amah mualtan hate in a that ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:32; Tp 32: 24"},"17":{"text":"Amah in khuaizu le bawngnawi khal a luanna gun le luite a lungnoppih kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 36:8"},"18":{"text":"Amah in a thalawhsate nek lohin pia kik pelmawh dinga; a sumbawlna-a a mette a lungnoppih kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:5; Ph 109:11"},"19":{"text":"Ahang in, amah in mizawngte nengniam a, khasiat loin a nusia hi; ama lam lohpi innte a laksak hi.","ref":"Job 5:16; Isa 5:8"},"20":{"text":"\"A lunggulhna bei thei lo a, a gou ding bangmah a khol thei kei hi.","ref":"Pn 11:4"},"21":{"text":"A khamval bangmah om lo a; a hauhna sawt a khom kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 7:8"},"22":{"text":"A cih theih pen hun laitakin a tungah lungdonna tung ding a; a lungkham pen hun, a tungah tung ding hi.","ref":"Thk 2:15; Job 21:17"},"23":{"text":"A gilpi a dip khit ciangin Pasian in ama hehna kuangin bi dinga, a tungah haksatna a zusak ding hi.","ref":"Ta 4:11; Ph 78:30-31"},"24":{"text":"Sik galhiam panin taikhia ta leh sumngo thaltang in amah kaplet ding hi.","ref":"Isa 24:18; Job 15:22"},"25":{"text":"Amah in a sin pana a tee daldal thaltang pak a nunglam pangah a dokkhia ding hi. A tungah launa tung dinga;"},"26":{"text":"khuamial bikbek in ama gou dingin a ngak hi. A kizaap lo mei in amah kangtum dinga a buk sunga a om laite haltum ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:14; Job 15:34; Job 18:15"},"27":{"text":"Vantungte in ama khialhna pholak ding a; ama lang khatah leitung in a do ding hi.","ref":"Tp 31:28"},"28":{"text":"Tuikhang in a inn taimang dinga, Pasian thangpaihna ni-in tuizeute a in a taimang ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:31; Job 21:17"},"29":{"text":"Tuate pen Pasian in migilote ngah dinga a sehsa ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 15:20"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Ka kammalte limtakin ngai un; hih pen kei nong hehnepna uh hisak un.","ref":"Job 13:17"},"3":{"text":"Ka gen laitak na thuak keikai unla, ka pau khit ciangin hong zahpih pan un.","ref":"Job 6:14; 11:3"},"4":{"text":"\"Kei mawhsakna mihing khat tung ahi hiam? Bang hangin lungtom lo ding ka hi hiam?","ref":"Job 7:11; Job 6:3"},"5":{"text":"Kei hong en unla, lamdang sa un; na khut pekun na kam uh hum un.","ref":"Thk 18:19"},"6":{"text":"Hih thu ka ngaihsut ciangin kei hong lausak a, hong pumlinsak hi.","ref":"Pc 45:3"},"7":{"text":"Bang hangin migilote nungtata lai-in khansau-a vanglian lailai uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:24"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in a kim a pam-ua a tate uh a khantoh lam mu uh a, a suan a khakte uh a mitun mu uh hi.","ref":"Ph 17:14; Mal 3:15"},"9":{"text":"A innte uh muanhuai-a launa a om kei hi; amaute in Pasian cianggolh a thuak kha kei uh hi.","ref":"Job 5:24; Job 9:34"},"10":{"text":"A bawngtalte uh lanlo ngei lo a; a bawngpite un no nei denin tolh ngei lo hi.","ref":"Pk 23:26"},"11":{"text":"Amaute in a tate uh tuuhon bangin sawlkhia uh a; a tanote uh lam uh hi.","ref":"Ph 78:52"},"12":{"text":"Amaute in khuangta le harp tumin la sa uh a; tamngai aw tawh nuam sa uh hi.","ref":"Pc 4:21"},"13":{"text":"A nuntak sung uh cihtheihna-in zang uh a, a sih uh ciangin lungnuam b takin han c a zuan uh hi.","ref":"Job 8:7; Job 24:19"},"14":{"text":"Tua hi napi, Pasian tungah, ‘Ko hong nawngkaisak kei in! Na lampi thei nuam kei ung.","ref":"Job 4:17; Tp 32:15"},"15":{"text":"A na ka sep dingun a Thahatpa kua ahi hiam? Ama tungah thu ngen le ung bang ngah ding ka hi uh hiam?’ci uh hi.","ref":"Job 5:2"},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin amau cihtheihna amau khutah om lo hi; tua ahi ciangin migilote ngaihsutna le kei aa kigamla hi."},"17":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi migilopa’ meivak bangzah vei mit ta ahi hiam? Amaute tungah tuahsiatna bangzah vei tung ta a, Pasian in ama hehna bangzah vei tuaksak ta hiam?","ref":"Job 18:12; Job 20:22,28"},"18":{"text":"Amaute bangzah vei huih mutleng buhtu bang a, huihpi in a letmang buhsi bang uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 13:25; Pn 10:25"},"19":{"text":"‘Pasian in mi khat thuak ding, a tapate ading a kholsak hi,’ kici hi. Amah in a theih nadingin ama tung mah ah kithuk pah hen!","ref":"Pk 20:5; Jer 25:14"},"20":{"text":"Ama siatna ama mit mah in mu pah hen; Thahatpenpa thangpaihna amah kidawnsak pah hen. a","ref":"Pk 32:33; Job 20:28"},"21":{"text":"Ahang in, a kiciangtansaksa zahkhate a bei khit cianga a nusiat a innkuanpihte bang awlmawh nawn ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 14:5; Job 14:22"},"22":{"text":"\"A sangpen thu nangawn a khen khit nungsang, mi khatpeuh in Pasian tungah pilna hilh thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 4:18; Ph 82:1; Job 35:11"},"23":{"text":"Mi khat a thahat pen laitakin si a, lungmuangtakin a tawlnga hi;","ref":"Job 3:13"},"24":{"text":"a pumpi b sadim phitphet a, a guhte in guhtui a hau hi."},"25":{"text":"Midang khat khakham veisapi in si a, hoih a kici khat beek a sinkha ngei kei hi.","ref":"Job 10:1"},"26":{"text":"Amaute a kibangin leivui lakah lumtuak uh a, than in pumtuam tuak hi.","ref":"Job 17:16; Job 7:5; 24:20"},"27":{"text":"\"Kei nong khialhsak nadingun na tupna uh, na ngaihsutnate uh hoihtakin ka thei khin hi."},"28":{"text":"Note in, ‘Tu in miliante inn koi-ah om a, migilote tenna puanbuk koi-ah om ahi hiam?’ na ci uh hi.","ref":"Job 1:3; Job 8:22"},"29":{"text":"Khualzin mite dong ngei lo na hi uh hiam? amau hong gen - tuahsiat hun ciangin migilote peng zawsop a,","ref":"Job 31:3"},"30":{"text":"thangpaihna hun panin c amah kihukhia hi, ci-a hong gente uh thusim lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Job 20:22"},"31":{"text":"Kua in a mai-ah a gamtatna va langgen ahi hiam? a gamtatsa a thuk kik kua ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 34:11"},"32":{"text":"Amah han lamah kipua a, a hankhuk kicingsak hi.","ref":"Isa 14:18"},"33":{"text":"Mualkuam a leihoih ama adingin khum a; mi khempeuh in amah zui-in, ama mai-ah simzawh loh mihonpi pai khin d hi.","ref":"Job 3:22; Job 3:19"},"34":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin thu gina lo peuhin kei hong hehnem zo ding na hi uh hiam? Zuauthu longal nong dawn nading uh bangmah om nawn lo hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Teman mi Eliphaz in dawng a:","title":"Eliphaz","ref":"Job 4:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Mi khat in Pasian phatuamsak thei ahi hiam? Mipil khat nangawn in amah phatuamsak thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Lk 17:10; Job 7:17"},"3":{"text":"Note thumaanna in Thahatpenpa tungah bang phatuamsak ahi hiam? Na nuntakna paubaang kei leh amah in bang lawhtak ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 143:2"},"4":{"text":"\"Na biakna-mina dingin amah in nang hong tai a, nang hong thuaksak sa na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:3; 19:29"},"5":{"text":"Na gitlohna a liat hang hi lo ahi hiam? Na mawhnate a bei theih loh hang hi lo ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"A thu om lopi in na sanggampa tung panin kiciamna na mawk nget a; mi puan hawkkhiatsakin a guaktangin na nusia hi.","ref":"2Ku 4:1; Pk 22:27"},"7":{"text":"A gimte tui pia loin gilkialte an na pia kei a","ref":"Mt 10:42; Job 29:12"},"8":{"text":"nang leitang a teng mi vanglian- mi zahtak khat hi napi tuate na dek tentan hi.","ref":"Job 12:19; Isa 3:3"},"9":{"text":"Meigongte khutguakin na hawlkhia a, pa nei lote hatna na sutan hi.","ref":"Job 24:3; Job 6:27"},"10":{"text":"Tua hangin na kimkotah thang hong kisiah a, tua hang mahin launa lianpi in thakhatin nang hong phawng a,","ref":"Job 18:9; Job 15:21"},"11":{"text":"tua hang mahin na muh theih lohin khua mialvat a, tua hang mahin tuikhang in nang hong tuum hi.","ref":"Job 5:14; Pc 7:23"},"12":{"text":"\"Vantung a sannate ah Pasian om hi lo ahi hiam? En dih ve, aksi sangpente nak san na lawmlawm e!","ref":"Job 11:8"},"13":{"text":"Tua hi napi, ‘Pasian in bang thei hiam? Tua zaha khuamial lakah thu khen thei ding hiam?","ref":"Ph 10:11; 59:7; Ph 139:11"},"14":{"text":"Amah meii sahpi in tuamcip hi, tua ahi ciangin vante khumzangah a pai kawmin eite hong mu thei lo ding hi,’ na ci lai hi.","ref":"Job 26:9; Job 37:18"},"15":{"text":"Migilote totsa lampi lui mah tawn lai na hi hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Amau hun a cin ma-in amaute kipuamang hi; amau bulkipte tuikhang in nawtmang hi.","ref":"Job 15:32; Pc 7:23"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in Pasian kiangah, ‘Ko hong nawngkaisak kei in! A Thahatpenpa in ko tungah bang hih thei hiam?’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Job 21:15"},"18":{"text":"Tua a cihpa uh, na hoih tawh amaute inn a dimsakpa hi lai hi, tua ahi ciangin migilote ngaihsutna le kei aa kigamla hi.","ref":"Job 12:6"},"19":{"text":"\"A thumaante in amaute siatna a muh uh ciangin lungdam uh hi; a mawhpengte in amaute zahpihin,","ref":"Ph 5:11; Job 21:3"},"20":{"text":"‘I galte kisia takpi a a hauhna teng uh mei in kangtum khin hi,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Ph 18:39; Job 15:30"},"21":{"text":"\"Pasian tung ki-ap lel inla, amah tawh kilem in; hi bang lamin na daupai zaw ding hi.","ref":"Isa 26:3; Job 8:7"},"22":{"text":"A kama hong lamlahna mang inla na lungsim sungah ama kammalte kemcing in.","ref":"Tp 8:3; Job 6:10"},"23":{"text":"A Thahatpa lamah na kihei kik leh na ngeina hong bangsak ding hi. Na puanbuk pan gamlapi ah gitlohna na paihmang a,","ref":"Isa 31:6; Job 11:14"},"24":{"text":"na khamvuite leivui-in ngaihsunin, na Ophir khamte gun suangtum bangin ngaihsun lel lecin,","ref":"Job 28:6"},"25":{"text":"tua ciangin a Thahatpenpa na kham hong hi dinga, na ngun deih pen hong hi ding hi.","ref":"Job 31:24"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Thahatpenpa sungah nuam na sa taktak dinga, Pasian lamah na dakto ding hi.","ref":"Job 11:15; 33:26"},"27":{"text":"Ama tungah thu na ngen dinga, amah in hong za ding hi; tuateh na kiciamna na tangtun ding hi.","ref":"Job 5:27; Ms 30:2"},"28":{"text":"Na lungsim khentatna kitangtungsak dinga, na lampi ah khuavak a tang ding hi.","ref":"Job 33:28"},"29":{"text":"Mite in mi a niamsak ciangin, ‘Amaute phong to un!’ na ci a, tua ciangin amah in a tukpa a honkhia ding hi.","ref":"Est 5:12; Ph 18:27"},"30":{"text":"Amah in mawhpeng lo pa khat nangawn hukhia dinga, na khut sianthona hanga amah a kihonkhia hi ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 1:18s; 2Sa 22:21"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Tuni nangawnin ka phunna a kha veva hi; tautau taleng a khut a gik veve b hi.","ref":"Job 7:11; Ph 6:6"},"3":{"text":"Amah ka muh nading thei tapeuh leng; ama omna ah pai thei hoh leng!","ref":"Tp 4:29"},"4":{"text":"A mai-ah ka thu ka tun dinga, ka kam dimdimin ka gen ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:18; Job 9:15"},"5":{"text":"Ama gen ding thu ngaihsunin hong dawn nading ka theikhia ding hi.","ref":"Job 11:5"},"6":{"text":"Amah in a vanglianpi tawh kei hong langdo tam? Hi kei, kei hong langbawlin thu hong bawl lo ding hi.","ref":"Job 9:4; Job 6:4"},"7":{"text":"Tua lai-ah mi thuman khat in a thu a tun thei ding hi; tuateh ka thukhenpa kiang panin hong kihukhia den ding hi.","ref":"Pc 3:8; Job 1:1"},"8":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin nisuahna-lam pai taleng tua lai-ah amah na om lo hi; nitumna-lam pai taleng lah amah ka mu tuan kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Leilu lamah na a sep lai-in amah ka mu kei hi. leitaw lamah a kihei ciangin amel amang ka thei tuan kei hi.","ref":"Job 9:11"},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin amah in ka kalsuannna thei a; kei hong zia-et khit ciangin kham ka bang ding hi.","ref":"Job 27:6; Ph 7:9"},"11":{"text":"Ama khekhap ka zui cinten a, pialkhia loin a lampi ka tawn hi.","ref":"Ph 17:5"},"12":{"text":"A kama hong thupiakte ka zuikhial kei a; ka nisim an sangin a kam pana kammalte ka kemcingzaw hi.","ref":"Mt 4:4"},"13":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin amah bek ding hi, kua in nial zo ding hiam? Amah in a lungkim peuhpeuh sem hi.","ref":"Job 10:13; Isa 55:11"},"14":{"text":"Amah in kei langah thukip tungsak a, tua bang ngimna tampi a khol lai hi.","ref":"1Th 3:3"},"15":{"text":"Tuate hangin ama mai-ah ka lau hi; hihte khempeuh ka ngaihsut ciangin amah ka kihta hi.","ref":"Pc 45:3; Job 24:14"},"16":{"text":"Pasian in ka lungsim zawmsak a; Thahatpenpa in kei hong lauthawngsak hi.","ref":"Tp 20:3; Pk 3:6"},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin khuamialna, ka maitang a tuam a sah khuamialna in kei hong daisak tuan kei hi.","ref":"Job 3:6"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Bang hangin Thahatpenpa in a thukhen hun ding seh lo ahi hiam? Bang hangin amah a theite in tua nite mu lo uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:23; 14:5; Job 15:20; Ns 1:7"},"2":{"text":"Mihingte in gamgi suangte a khin uh hi; a guksa uh tuuhonte a cing uh hi.","ref":"Pk 20:15"},"3":{"text":"Amaute in tagahte’ laanote nawhmangsak uh a, a kamciam tangun meigongte bawngtal a laksak uh hi.","ref":"Job 6:27"},"4":{"text":"Lampi ah a tasamte sawnpai uh a, leitunga mizawngte thatang hatthu in a busak uh hi.","ref":"Job 29:16; Job 30:25"},"5":{"text":"Sehnelgama gamsung laate bangin mizawngte in nasemin a an ding uh zongtawm uh a; gam tulsa panin a tate uh an ding a ngah uh hi.","ref":"Pc 16:12"},"6":{"text":"A gan an ding uh lopaang ah zong uh a, migilote lenggui ah a sangh kaikhawm uh hi.","ref":"Job 6:5; Ru 2:22"},"7":{"text":"Puansilh nei loin, zan ciangin guaktangin om uh a; a silh ding uh bangmah nei loin khuadam a thuak uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Mualtung guahte in amaute kawtgawpsak a, belh ding nei loin suangtumte a kawi tentan uh hi.","ref":"Da 4:25; Thk 6:2; Ta 4:5"},"9":{"text":"Pa nei lo naupangte a nu ang pan kibotkhia a; mizawngte tanote leiba tangin kilaksak hi.","ref":"Tp 24:17; Job 29:17; Ph 14:4"},"10":{"text":"Puansilh ding nei loin, amaute guaktangin vak uh a; buhphalte pua napi gialkial lailai uh hi.","ref":"Tp 24:12-13; Sp 19:9"},"11":{"text":"Leicialte a lakah olive gah gawi uh a, lenggah sukna ah lenggah cil napi a dangtak lailai uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:2"},"12":{"text":"Khuapi sung panin a sikuana humhamna le a liamsa a huh ding ngente aw kiza hi. Ahi hangin Pasian in khat beek a mawhsak kei hi.","ref":"Job 12:19; Job 9:23"},"13":{"text":"\"Khuavak lampi a thei lo ahikeh a lampi ah zong a om lo a langdo pawlkhat a om hi.","ref":"Job 38:15; Job 17:12"},"14":{"text":"Sun khuavak a bei ciangin mi thatpa tho a, mizawngte le a tasamte a that hi; zan ciangin gutate bangin a gukhia hi.","ref":"Isa 3:15; Ph 10:7"},"15":{"text":"Angkawmte mit in khuamui ding vil a, ‘Kuama mit in hong mu kenteh,’ ci-in ngaihsun a, a maitang a sel hi.","ref":"Pn 7:8-9; Ph 10:11"},"16":{"text":"Mite in khuamial lakah inn tokham uh a, ahi hangin sun ciangin a sungah a kikhakkhum uh hi; khuavak sungin bangmah a sem nuam kei uh hi.","ref":"Pk 22;2"},"17":{"text":"Amaute khempeuh aa in, khuamial bikbek amau zingsang b ahi hi; khuamial c lauhuaina tawh a kilawmta uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi napi amaute tui maitang tunga tuiphuan suak uh a, amau lenggah lo ah kuamah a kuan loh nadingin amau tanh leitang a kihamsiat hi.","ref":"Job 5:3"},"19":{"text":"Guah kan hun le nisa in vuktui a hupkang bangin, mawhna a nei mite hankhuk d in a bawhkhia mang hi."},"20":{"text":"Naubu in amaute mangngilh a, than in pawi an-in a nei hi; migilote kiphawkkha nawn lo a, singkung bangin kitan uh hi.","ref":"Job 18:17"},"21":{"text":"Amaute, taselte le numei ta nei lote tungah kivak ding uh a, meigongte a hehpih kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 22:9"},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pasian in ama vang tawh thahatpa lakkhiatsak a; amaute a khantoh uh hangin nuntakna dingin khamuanna a nei kei uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in amaute lungmuang takin tawlngasak a, ahi hangin amaute lampi a encik gige hi.","ref":"2Kh 16:9; Job 10:4"},"24":{"text":"Hun tomcik sung amaute kitawisang a, tua ciangin a mangthang uh hi; amaute kiniamkhiat a, adangte khempeuh bangin a kikaikhawm hi; amaute buhvui bangin a ki-atkhia hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:35; Job 3:29; Isa 17:5"},"25":{"text":"Hih bang hi lo hileh ka khialhna kua in hong mawhmat thei a, ka kammalte bangmah loin khiam thei ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 6:28"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shuh mi Bildad in dawng a:","title":"Bildad","ref":"Job 8:1"},"2":{"text":"\"Gam-ukna le kihtakna Pasian aa ahi hi; amah in vantung a sangna ah thupiakna a bawl hi.","ref":"Job 9:4; Ph 47:9; 2Kh 20:6"},"3":{"text":"Ama galkapte a phazah kisim zo ding ahi hiam? ama khuavak kua tungah tang lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Mt 5:45"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Pasian mai-ah kua thumaan thei peuhmah ding ahi hiam? Numei sunga suak mi peuhmah bangci siantho thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 4:17"},"5":{"text":"Ama mit ah khapi nangawn tangpha sa lo a, aksite nangawn siangtho sa zo lo ahileh","ref":"Job 31:26; Job 4:18"},"6":{"text":"tuate sangin tangteel bang lel mihing tapa - than ahi mihing, nak neu zawk tham lo ding ahi hiam!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 4:19; Ph 80:17"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"A hat lo mi na huhna a bang ci! A zaw ban na hotkhiatna a bang ci!","ref":"Job 6:12; Job 4:3"},"3":{"text":"A pil lo mi khat na thuhilhna hi ve! Na thumuhna lian pen nong laakkhiat maw!","ref":"Job 34:35"},"4":{"text":"Hih na gen thute kua hong gensak ahi hiam? Job 1:3; Job 4:4"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin tu-in kei sanga nauzaw, a pate uh ka tuucing uite zah-a ka neumuhte in kei hong ciam nuih uh hi."},"2":{"text":"Amaute thakia khin uh ahi manin amaute khut hatna kei adingin banga kimang nawn ding ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Taksapna le gilkialna hangin ngui gawp uh a, a kikhulsa leitang, leigawtak lakah zanin a vak kawikawi b uh hi.","ref":"Isa 8:21; Job 41:13"},"12":{"text":"Ka taklam ah behte d in hong doin, ka khe a ka awk nading thang kam uh a, kei langkhatah hong umcihin kulhken a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Ph 109:6; Job 16:10"},"13":{"text":"Ka lampi tosia uh a; huih let bangin ka ginatna beimang a, meii bangin ka ngaihmuanna a theng’ hi.","ref":"Pk 3:6; Job 3:25"},"16":{"text":"\"Tu-in ka nuntakna damdamin bei ta a, ka thuakna nite in hong gakcip hi.","ref":"Job 3:24"},"17":{"text":"Zanin ka guhte pailet-a hong tum ngutngut natna in khawl hun a nei kei hi.","ref":"Tp 28:35"},"18":{"text":"Ama vangliatna ah Pasian kei f adingin puansilh tawh kibang a; ka puantualpi ngawng bangin kei hong hen hi.","ref":"Job 9:4"},"19":{"text":"Amah in kei buanlak hong denna a, leivui le vut ka suak hi.","ref":"Pc 3:19"},"20":{"text":"\"Pasian aw, nang tungah kong ko a, nong dawng kei hi; Mizawngte dahpih hi lo ka hiam?","ref":"Lk 19:41; Job 24:4"},"26":{"text":"Tua hi napi, a hoih lamen leng siatna hong tung hi; khuavak ka zon ciangin khuamial hong tung hi.","ref":"Job 3:6"},"27":{"text":"Ka sunga hong lok den lah a khawl ngei kei hi; ka thuakna nite in kei hong maituah hi.","ref":"Ph 38:8"},"28":{"text":"Kei hong kivomsak a ahi hangin ni in hong vomsak ahi kei hi; mihon omna ah dingin huhna ngenin ka kiko hi.","ref":"Job 17:14; Job 19:7"},"29":{"text":"Ngiate sanggampa ka suak a, simbute pawlpa ka hi hi.","ref":"Ph 44:19; Ph 102:6"},"30":{"text":"Ka vun vomin polkhia a; ka pumpi nattunin sa velval hi.","ref":"Ta 3:4"},"31":{"text":"Ka harp awging thumna hi a, ka tamngai awging kahna ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 8:8; Pc 4:21"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Lunggulh luatna tawh nungakno khat en lo dingin ka mit tawh thukhun ka bawl hi.","ref":"Pk 20:14; Pn 4:25"},"2":{"text":"Tunga Pasian panin mihing in bang ngah a, a sangna-a Thahatpenpa panin amah in a luah bang ahi hiam?","ref":"Ms 26:55; Job 16:19"},"3":{"text":"Migilote aa in kisiatna, amaan lo-a gamtate aa in tuahsiatna hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 34:22"},"4":{"text":"Ka lampite mu loin ka kalsuan simin sim lo ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"\"A khial lamin ka kalsuan a, zuauphuak dingin ka nawh kalsuan leh -","ref":"Job 15:31"},"6":{"text":"Pasian in kei amaan tawikhaina-in hong teh ta hen. Job 5:15"},"23":{"text":"Ahang in, Pasian pana kisiatna ka kihta a, ama thupina ka kihtak manin tua bang na ka sem thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 10:3; Job 13:11"},"24":{"text":"\"Muan penin kham ka neih a, ahikeh kham citak kiangah, ‘Ka ngaihmuanna nang na hi hi,’ ka cih leh","ref":"Job 22:25;
