Ama aw in a thawnkik ciangin bangmah iip kik lo hi.","ref":"Pk 20:19"},"5":{"text":"Piandangdangin Pasian’ aw ging hi; theihtel zawh loh nalianpite a bawl hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:10; Job 5:9"},"6":{"text":"Amah in vuk kiangah, ‘Leitungah kia in,’ ci a, khuapi guah kiangah, ‘Um-a beel-a buak bang in,’ci hi.","ref":"Tp 28:12"},"7":{"text":"Ama bawlsa mite in ama nasep a theih nadingun, mi khempeuh amau sepna e ciat panin a khawlsak hi.","ref":"Ph 104:19-23"},"8":{"text":"Ganhingte in a belh ding uh zongin, a kua sunguah om uh hi.","ref":"Job 28:26"},"9":{"text":"A kuapi panin huihpi nungkhia a, huih mutna panin a vot paikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 50:3; Ph 147:17"},"10":{"text":"Pasian huusan in tuikhal piangsak a, tui zaipipi a khalsak hi.","ref":"Job 39:29-30"},"11":{"text":"Amah in meiite lakah tuikhu guang a, tuate lakah a khuaphia tangsak hi.","ref":"Job 26:8; Job 28:26"},"12":{"text":"Ama thupiakna bangin tuate lei maitang tungah kihei kawikawi uh a, ama sawl peuhpeuh sem uh hi.","ref":"Ph 147:16"},"13":{"text":"Amah in mihingte dan tuahsakna ahikeh leitang f tui buahna le ama itna lahna-in meii a zang hi.","ref":"Pc 7:4; 1Ku 18:45"},"14":{"text":"\"Job aw, hih na ngai dih ve; khawl inla Pasian nalamdang bawlte ngaihsun dih in.","ref":"Job 32:10; Job 5:9"},"15":{"text":"Pasian in meiite bangci uk a, khuaphia bangci tansak cih na thei hiam?","ref":"Job 36:30,32"},"16":{"text":"Amah in meiite bangci bangin bawmsak lingleng cih na thei hiam, theihna kicingtaka a bawl nalamdangte na thei hiam?","ref":"Job 36:29"},"17":{"text":"Leitaw-lam huih nuai-ah leitang a sip dide lai-a na puan nuai-ah khua-ul kai neinaipa,"},"18":{"text":"a kisung sumngo limlang banga khauh vanpi a zal lai-in huh thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Tp 28:23"},"19":{"text":"\"Ama kianga ka thu gen ding uh, hong hilh in; Ka khuamialna uh hangin thu sun zia ding ka geel thei kei uh hi.","ref":"Ro 8:26"},"20":{"text":"Ka gennop amah’n hong genkhol ding ahi hiam? A kivalhtum dingin kua in va ngen ding ahi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Huih in tuate a mutsiang khit ciangin vantung a, a tang ni kuamah in a en thei kei hi.","ref":"Thk 5:31"},"22":{"text":"Leilu lamah kham nopcitna tawh amah hong paikhia hi; a kihtak huai thupina tawh Pasian hong pai hi.","ref":"Ph 19:5; Pk 24:17"},"23":{"text":"Thahatpenpa, eite theih zawh le ama vangliatna, eite tawisang zawh hi lo hi; amah thutangin a thumaanna lian hangin a nengniam kei hi.","ref":"Job 5:9; Job 4:17"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin mite in amah zahtak mahmah uh hi; ahang in, amah in a lungsim a sunga pil a kisate thudon lo hi.","ref":"Job 5:13; Eph 5:15"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in huihpi lakah Job dawnga, Amah in:","title":"in Thugen","ref":"Pk 14:21; Job 11:5"},"2":{"text":"\"Bangmah thei lopi-a thugen, ka thuhilhna a mialsak kua ahi hiam?","ref":"1Ku 22:5; Job 34:35"},"3":{"text":"Kipasalsakin na kawng gak in; ke’n kong dong dinga, nang nong dawng ding hi."},"4":{"text":"\"Leitung bulpi ka phuh lai-in nang koi-ah om na hi hiam? Na theih leh hong gen dih in."},"5":{"text":"A thei takpi na hi leh! A phacia ding kua in ciamteh hiam? Kua in a tungah tehna khau kai ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 102:25; Jer 31:39"},"6":{"text":"Zingsang aksite in la sakhawm uh a, van sawltakte b khempeuh lungdamin a kiko laitakun -","ref":"Pc 1:16; 2Ku 22:19"},"7":{"text":"a khuambulte bang tungah kiphut a, ahikeh a innkiu suang kua in phut ahi hiam?","ref":"Pn 8:25; Job 26:7"},"8":{"text":"\"Tuipi in sul a phutkhap lai,","ref":"Pc 1:9-10"},"9":{"text":"a puan dingin meii ka bawl lai le khuamial sahpi-a ka tuam lai,","ref":"Pc 1:2"},"10":{"text":"a om nading ciangtansak a, a kongpite le a kalhnate a munciatah ka thuah lai,","ref":"Ne 3:3; Job 7:12"},"11":{"text":"‘Hih ciang pai inla hih ban kal kei in, na hual hatte tawp nading mun hih lai ahi hi,’ ka cih lai-in kua in tuipi kongkhak khak ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 65:7; Ph 33:7"},"12":{"text":"\"Nang in zingsang khuavak tungah thupia-in a hikeh phalvak tungah a ma mun ding lak na hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 57:5; Ph 74:16"},"13":{"text":"leitung a mongah manin migilote a sinkhiat ding hilh ngei na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 8:22; Ph 104:35"},"14":{"text":"Leitung in buan tunga seal kinen tawh kibang hi; a kilatkhiatzia puansilh tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pk 28:11"},"15":{"text":"Migilote khuavak kinial a, a sanga a lik uh amaute ban kitansak hi.","ref":"tp 28:29; Pc 17:14"},"16":{"text":"\"Tuipi nak ahikeh tuipi taw zangtamah khualzinin pai ngei na hi hiam?","ref":"Pc 1:7"},"17":{"text":"Sihna kongpi nang hong kilak ta ahi hiam? Sihna liim c kongpi na mu ta hiam?","ref":"Job 33:22"},"18":{"text":"Leitung a phacia na telcian nai hiam? Hihte khempeuh na theih leh hong gen in.","ref":"Job 28:24"},"19":{"text":"\"Khuavak kipatna lampi bang ahi hiam? Tuateh khuamial omna mun koi lai ahi hiam?","ref":"Pc 1:4"},"20":{"text":"Amau omna munah na puak thei ding hiam? Amau tenna lampi na thei hiam?","ref":"Job 24:13"},"21":{"text":"Tua hunin suak khin ding na hi teh thei takpi mah niteh! Nang kum tampi nungta khin hi ve cin!","ref":"Job 15:7"},"22":{"text":"\"Vuk kholna sal ah lut khina, gialte kholna sal mu khin na hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 105:32"},"23":{"text":"Tuate lungkham hun cianga ding le gal-a kido hun ciang adingin ka sit ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 27:5"},"24":{"text":"Khuaphelep kikhenkhiatna mun bang hi a, nisuahna huih leitungah a kikhenkhiatna mun koi lai pan ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 28:24; Job 27:21"},"25":{"text":"Kua in guahtui luan nading hawkguam to a, kek kiat nading lampi sialin","ref":"Job 28:26"},"26":{"text":"kuama tenlohna gam, mi khat beek a tenlohna sehnel-gam tui buak a,","ref":"Job 36:27"},"27":{"text":"leitang tulsa gamsimtham a lungkimsak nadingin lopa selsak ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 28:26"},"28":{"text":"Guahtui in pa nei ahi hiam? Daitui malte’ pa kua ahi hiam?","ref":"2Sa 1:21"},"29":{"text":"Kua naubu pan vukte suakkhia ahi hiam? Kua in vantung pan tuikhalte senkhia a,"},"30":{"text":"Bang hunin tuite suang bangin sak a, tuithukte maitang khal ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 37:10"},"31":{"text":"\"A melhoih d segukte henkhawm thei na hi hiam? Zawlzawng henna khau phel thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:9"},"32":{"text":"Amau hun e ciat zui-in aksi honte puakkhia thei-in khualei-uikai f le a tate pikhia thei na hi hiam?","ref":"2Ku 23:5; Pc 1:16"},"33":{"text":"Vante thukhamte thei na hi hiam? Pasian g ukna leitungah phut thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 148:6"},"34":{"text":"\"Nang in meiite otsanin tuikhang tawh kituam thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 5:10"},"35":{"text":"Kektangte a lampi zui-in puak thei na hi hiam? Amaute in, ‘Kote hih lai-ah ka om uh hi,’ hong ci uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 36:32"},"36":{"text":"Kua in lungtang a ah pilna koih a, ahikeh lungsim b ah theitelsak ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:4"},"37":{"text":"Kua in meiite sim theihna pilna nei ahi hiam?"},"38":{"text":"Leivuite sak thei in, lei themte a kimat khawm ciangin kua in vantunga tuibelpite sawnpai thei ahi hiam?","ref":"1Ku 18:45; Jos 3:16"},"39":{"text":"\"Nang humpinelkai pite ading sa betsak thei in"},"40":{"text":"humpinelkaite a kua ah ahikeh gamphatna ah sa a pan ciangin, tuate gilvahsak na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 37:8; Pc 49:9"},"41":{"text":"A note in Pasian a koh uh ciangin an zonga a leng kawikawi va-akte an a sikpa kua ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 147:9; Pc 1:30; 8:7"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Mualtung sathakte a suah hun thei na hi hiam? Sanangpite a no a suah ciangin va vil na hi hiam?","ref":"Tp 14:5"},"2":{"text":"A paii sung kha phazah sim na hi hiam? A suah hun uh thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Pc 31:7-9"},"3":{"text":"Amaute opsakin a no a suak uh hi; tasuah natna a thuak kha nawn kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A note uh khanpha in, gam sungah hat uh hi; a pite nusia uh a, zuan kik nawn lo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"\"Gamsung laate kua in khah ahi hiam? A khau kua in sut ahi hiam?","ref":"Pc 16:12"},"6":{"text":"Ama inn dingin gamtak lak ka pia-a, a ten nadingun sih omna zangte ka pia hi.","ref":"Job 24:5"},"7":{"text":"Khuasung gamlumna nuihsan bek a, leeng hawlte otna a za kei hi.","ref":"Job 5:22; Job 3:18"},"8":{"text":"Mualno dungte ah gamta a, singhing lohing a zong hi.","ref":"Isa 32:20"},"9":{"text":"\"Gam bawngtalte in nang na sem nuam ahi hiam? Zanin na gan-ankuang gei-ah giak nuam ding hiam?","ref":"Ms 23:22; Pc 42:27"},"10":{"text":"Lokalhna ah gam bawngtal a khau-in kai zo na hi hiam? Na nungah mualkuamte kho ding ahi hiam?"},"11":{"text":"A hat luatna hangin a tungah na kinga ngam ding hiam? Na nasep haksa amah na nusiat ding hiam?","ref":"Job 40:16"},"12":{"text":"Na antang pua in an cilna phualah a khawm dingin na muang thei diam?"},"13":{"text":"\"Kala-oh vasate in a khate nuamtakin zaap hiathiat uh hi, ahi hangin tui vapi khate le a khavengte tawh kitehkak thei lo hi.","ref":"Zec 5:9"},"14":{"text":"A pite leitungah tui uh a, sehnel lakah lumsakin"},"15":{"text":"khe khatpeuh in tuate a sikkhak ding le gamsate in a tuatkhak ding ngaihsun lo uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 14:9"},"16":{"text":"Ama aa ahi lo bangin a note ngong khoi a; a sepna a mawkna-a hih na a awlmawh kei hi.","ref":"La 4:3"},"17":{"text":"ahang in, Pasian in pilna guan loin ahikeh ngaihsut-siamna a pia kei hi.","ref":"Job 21:22"},"18":{"text":"Tua hi napi tai dinga a khavengte a zaak ciangin sakol le a tunga tuangpa a nuihsan bek hi.","ref":"Job 5:22"},"19":{"text":"\"Sakol hatna nang piaksa sa a, ahikeh a ngawngmul nang posak sa na hi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Nang in kauphe bangin tuansak a, a lauhuai dingin phitsak na hi hiam?","ref":"Joel 2:4-5; Job 41:25"},"21":{"text":"Amah in nakpipi in lei khuat a, a hatna suangin gal sungah dianggawp hi."},"22":{"text":"Launa nuihsan bek a, bangmah a kihta kei hi; namsau mai-ah a dual tuan kei hi.","ref":"Job 5:22"},"23":{"text":"Thaltang bawm, atee zialzial teipi le tulzum in a pang sat lengleng hi.","ref":"Na 3:3; Isa 5:28"},"24":{"text":"Lauthawng kawm le lawp lua-in leitang ne a, pengkul a kimut ciangin a omkhong thei kei hi."},"25":{"text":"Pengkul a kimut nak leh phit in a ham hi. Amah in gamlapi panin gal gimnam za a, galkap mangpa otna le gal awging thei hi.","ref":"Jos 6:5; Jer 8:5"},"26":{"text":"\"Nang pilna hangin simbu lengin leitaw lamah a kha zal ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 8:7"},"27":{"text":"Nang thupiakna mangin muvanlai sanglen a, a sangpi ah bu tom ahi hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Amah kenbangah teng a, zan ciangin tua lai-ah a giak hi; ama kulh muanhuai suang hengkawm ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 49:16"},"29":{"text":"Tua lai pan an zong dingin kuankhia a, a gamlapi panin a mitin mukhia thei hi.","ref":"Job 9:26"},"30":{"text":"A note sisanin kivak uh a, ganhing kithahna munah amah a om hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Mt 24:28"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in Job kiangah:"},"2":{"text":"\"Thahatpenpa a mawhsak mipa in amah bawlpha ding ahi hiam? Pasian mawhsakpa in amah dawng hen!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 9:15"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in TOPA dawng a:"},"4":{"text":"\"Ka cin zo kei hi - bang hong ci dawn thei ding ka hi hiam? Ka kam ka hucip ding hi.","ref":"Job 42:6; Thk 18:19"},"5":{"text":"Khatvei ka pau khin a, dawn nading om lopi ahi hi - nihvei ka pau hangin bangmah ka gen nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Job 9:3; Job 9:15"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin huihpi lakah TOPA in Job dawng a:","ref":"Pk 14:21"},"7":{"text":"\"Kipasalsak inla, na kawng gak in; thu kong dong dinga nong dawng ding hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Ka thutan’na bangmah lo suaksak na hi hiam? Nang a thutang na kisuahsak nadingin kei hong mawhpaih na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 15:25; Job 2:3"},"9":{"text":"Nang in Pasian’ ban bang ban nei in, ama aa bangin na aw in van gingsak thei ahi hiam?","ref":"2Kh 32:8; Isa 6:8"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahileh minthanna le thupina tawh nang le nang kizem inla, pahtawina le zahtakna kisilhsak dih in.","ref":"Ph 45:3"},"11":{"text":"Na thangpaihna suahkhia inla a kiphasakte enin niamkhiat gawp dih in,","ref":"Job 20:28; Ph 18:27"},"12":{"text":"A kiphasak peuhmah en inla, amah niamkhiatin a gilote a dinna munah tuancil dih in.","ref":"Ph 10:4; Ph 60:12"},"13":{"text":"Amaute leivui tawh vuikhawm inla; hankhuk ah a mai uh vukcip in.","ref":"Ms 16:31-34; Job 4:9"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin na khut taklam in nang hong hon zo hi, ci-in ka taksang ding hi.","ref":"Pk 15:6"},"15":{"text":"\"Bawngtal banga lopa a ne nang tawh kong bawlkhawm behemoth a ngaihsun dih in.","ref":"Isa 11:7; Job 9:9"},"16":{"text":"A kawngguh ah bang hatna nei-in a gilpi ah bang sagolh vangliatna nei ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 39:11; Job 41:9"},"17":{"text":"Taamtak bangin a mei b pek a, a phei sagolhte gaktakin kiphan hi."},"18":{"text":"A guhte sumngo sungvang banga, akhut akhete siktawn bang hi."},"19":{"text":"Pasian sepsate lakah a tuam pian pen hi napi amah a bawlpa in, a namsau-in a zo hi.","ref":"Job 41:33; Pc 3:24"},"20":{"text":"Mualte in amau pana piangte amah puak a, gamsate khempeuh a kiangah kimawl uh hi.","ref":"Ph 104:14; Ph 104:26"},"21":{"text":"Tui-unok kung nuai-ah lum a, nawng sung pumpeng lakah a bu hi.","ref":"Pc 41:2"},"22":{"text":"Tui-unok kungte in a liim in sel a, lui gei-a gialhek kungte in umcih hi.","ref":"Ph 1:3"},"23":{"text":"Tui a khangawp hangin a patau kei hi. Jordan khang in a kam ciang nawk ta leh ngaihmuang lai hi.","ref":"Isa 8:7; Jos 3:1"},"24":{"text":"Kua in a sikkawi-in c man zo a, thang siahin a nak pheh zo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"2Ku 19:28"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Nga thang in Leviathan d kai zo in khau-in a leii hensak zo ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Am 4:2"},"2":{"text":"A nak sungah khau khumin sikkawi-in a khaguh sunlet thei ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 40:24; Eze 19:4"},"3":{"text":"Na lainat ding hong ngengen ding ahi hiam? Kamdamin nang hong hopih ding ahi hiam?","ref":"1Ku 20:31"},"4":{"text":"A khantawnin na sila dinga na lak dingin nang tawh thuciam bawl ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Pk 21:6"},"5":{"text":"Vasa noh bangin amah no-in, na numeinote adingin khau na khih zo na diam?"},"6":{"text":"Sumbawlte in van tawh hong khek ding ahi hiam? Sumbukte lakah hawmthang ding uh ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"A vun ah ngapi-thal thun zo in, nga-teipi in a lu na bun zo ding hiam?","ref":"Job 40:24"},"8":{"text":"A tungah na khutin va su lecin, a baihlohna thei in hih nawn kei niteh!","ref":"Job 3:8"},"9":{"text":"Amah thuzawh ding lametna in khialhna ahi hi; a muhin mukha bek leng zong hong deepgawp pah hi.","ref":"Job 40:16"},"10":{"text":"Amah phong ngam ding zaha hang kuamah a om kei hi. Tua ahileh kei langah kua pang thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 3:8; 2Kh 20:6"},"11":{"text":"Kei thuk pelmawh dingin kua in kei hong pia hiam? Van kikupsin nuai-a na khempeuh kei aa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 34;33; Job 3:11"},"12":{"text":"\"Ama guh le tang, a hatna le a pum pianzia a kilawmna ka gen lo thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 40:18; Job 39:11"},"13":{"text":"Kua in a puan tungnung hawkkhiatsak thei hiam? Kua in a kamkaih bulh dingin naih ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 30:11"},"14":{"text":"A kihtakhuai a hate a kigualh diudeuna a kam vangte kua in phensak ngam ding hiam?","ref":"Ph 22:13"},"15":{"text":"A nungzang ah lumphaw kigak cinten a gualgualin om e a,","ref":"Job 40:17"},"16":{"text":"khat le khat kizomin kicih bikbek ahi manin a kikal ah huih a thawl kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute khat le khat kimat bikbek uh hi; a vekun kimat bikbek a, a kikhenkhia thei kei hi."},"18":{"text":"A hechiai in khuavak thehkhia ziahziah a; a mitte zingsang nisuak tunga nizang bang hi.","ref":"Job 3:9"},"19":{"text":"A kam panin selkang kuang luangkhia a, mei-ek le mei-sii kikhawhkhia hi.","ref":"Da 10:6"},"20":{"text":"Pumpeng kicih tunga tuilum beela tui so bangin a nak vang panin meikhu suakkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 10:17"},"21":{"text":"A husan in meihol tawhkuang a, a kam panin mei kuang zalzal hi."},"22":{"text":"A ngawng ah hatna oma, a mai-ah lausakna masuan hi."},"23":{"text":"A satak kithuapnate kigak phitphet a, amaute kipin a kitaangsak thei kei hi."},"24":{"text":"A awm suang bangin sak a, angawina suangphah bangin a sak hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah a thawh ciangin thahatte lausak a; a khesik ging mai-ah amaute nung kik uh hi.","ref":"Job 3:8"},"26":{"text":"Namsau in kisat ta leh bangmah in vei lo a, teipi, thaltang le tulzumte in zong a bun zo kei hi.","ref":"Job 8:18"},"27":{"text":"Amah in sik, buhkung tawh kibangsak a, sumngo, singmuat tawh kibangsak hi."},"28":{"text":"Thaltang in amah taisak zo lo a, sailungtangte ama adingin buhvai bang hi.","ref":"Ph 91:5"},"29":{"text":"Khetbuka sat lah buhphal a sat bang a, tulzuma khawh lah nuihsan lel hi.","ref":"Job 5:22"},"30":{"text":"A khecin belpei hiam bang a, buan lakah lokaihna hama bang hi,"},"31":{"text":"Amah in tui thukna lokin beelpeipi solai bangsaka, kizutna thawl bangin tuipi lokgawp hi.","ref":"Eze 32:2"},"32":{"text":"Ama nungah tuihual kang dendan a, tuipi samkang nei kisa hi."},"33":{"text":"Leitungah ama kimpih khat beek om lo a - kihtak a nei lo ganhing ahi hi.","ref":"Job 40:19"},"34":{"text":"Amah in a kiphasakte khempeuh en niam a, a kisatheite khempeuh tungah kumpipa ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 18:29; Job 28:8"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin Job in TOPA dawng a:","title":"Job"},"2":{"text":"\"Na khempeuh na hih theih lam ka thei hi; na geelna kuama dal theih hi lo hi.","ref":"Pc 18:14; 2Kh 20:6"},"3":{"text":"‘Pilna loin kua in ka thuhilhna sel ahi hiam?’ ci-in nong dong hi. Kei theih dingin a lamdang lua mahmah ka theihtel loh nate ka genkhia khin takpi hi.","ref":"Job 5:9"},"4":{"text":"\"Tu-in kong gen ding hi, na ngai in; ken kong dong dinga, nang nong dawng ding hi,’ nong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Na thugen ka bilin ka za a, ahi hangin tu-in ka mitin nang kong mu khin hi.","ref":"Thk 13;22"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin kei le kei ka kisimmawh a, kisikin vut le vai ka khu hi,\" ci hi.","ref":"Pk 10:3; Job 34:33"},"7":{"text":"TOPA in Job tungah hih teng a gen khit ciangin Teman mi Eliphaz tungah, \"Nang le na lawmte gel tungah ka heh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh note in ka nasempa Job bangin kei thu amaanin na gen kei uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin bawngtal sagih le tuutal sagih kengin ka nasempa Job kiangah pai unla no mahmah in meihal biakna na bawl un. Ka nasempa Job in thu hong ngetsak leh ama thungetna ka sang dinga, note haina zahin kong thuaksak kei ding hi. Kong sap uh ciangin hong dawng a in!"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nangma hatna sungah kumpipa nuamsa hi. Nangma piak gualzawhnate nuam sa mahmah ei!","ref":"2Sa 2:10"},"2":{"text":"Ama lungsim deihna amah na pia a’ a mukte hong ngetna na deek kei hi.","ref":"Selah"},"3":{"text":"Thupha tampi tawh amah na muak-a, a lutungah kham citak kumpi lukhu na khusak hi.","ref":"Zec 6:11"},"4":{"text":"Amah in nuntakna hong ngena ama nite a tawntungin na sawtsak den hi.","ref":"Ph 10:16"},"5":{"text":"Na piaksa gualzawhnate tawnin ama minthanna lian mahmah a; nang in thupina le nopcitna ama tungah na khusak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tawntung thuphate amah na pia khin takpi a, nangma ompih lungnopna-in na kipaksak zo hi."},"7":{"text":"Kumpipa in TOPA muang ahi manin, Sangpen Pa itna kip hangin amah a kiling kei ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:5"},"8":{"text":"Nangma khut in na galte khempeuh len dinga; na khut taklam in nang hong dote a man ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:10"},"9":{"text":"Na kilat hun ciangin amaute pummei na bangsak ding hi. TOPA thangpaihna in amaute nawmvalh dinga, ama mei in amaute a hultum ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:22"},"10":{"text":"Amau suante leitung pan na siasak dinga, amau khangsawnte mihing panin na phiatmang ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:18"},"11":{"text":"Nang tungah gitloh a sawmsim uh zongin, a sawm uh gitloh geelna a lawhcing thei kei ding hi;","ref":"Ph 2:1; Job 10:3"},"12":{"text":"ahang in, thal keksa tawh amaute na ngim ciangin na lehtaisak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 23:27"},"13":{"text":"TOPA aw, na thahatna ah hong kitawisang hen; kote in la sa in na hatna ka phat ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 18:1"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pasian, ka Pasian, bang hangin kei hong taisan na hi hiam? Bang hang kei nong hotkhiat nading pan gamla a, ka tauna kammalte pan gamla na hi hiam?","ref":"Job 6:15; Job 3:24; Ph 10:1"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasian aw, sunin kong kiko hangin nong dawng kei a, zan in ka dai tuan kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hi napi nang Siangtho Pa in na tu a, Israel b phatna nang na hi hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:22"},"4":{"text":"Ka pate un nang hong muang uh a; amaute in hong muang uh ahi manin na hukhia hi.","ref":"Ph 78:53"},"5":{"text":"Amaute nang tung hong kiko uh a, a kihonkhia hi; amaute in nang hong muang uh a a zahlak kei uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 5:20"},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin kei tangtel ka hi-a, mihing ka hi kei hi; mite in hong simmawhin hong hua uh hi.","ref":"Job 4:19"},"7":{"text":"Kei hong mu khempeuh in hong zahko in; hong engko in, hong lupeisan uh a;","ref":"Mk 15:29"},"8":{"text":"\"Amah in TOPA muang hi; TOPA in amah hukhia hen, ama sungah nuamsa ahileh amah in amah hukhia hen,\" hong cihsan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua hi napi sul sung pan kei nong lakhia a; kanu ang pan nangawnin nang nong muangsak hi.","ref":"Job 10:18"},"10":{"text":"Ka suah a kipan nang tungah kong kinga a; ka nu sul a kipan ka Pasian na hi khin hi.","ref":"Ph 71:6; Isa 46:3"},"11":{"text":"Lungkhamna hong nai a, hong huh ding omlo ahi manin gamla ah hong omsan kei in.","ref":"Ph 10:14"},"12":{"text":"Bawngtal tampi in kei hong um uh a; Bashan bawngtal hatte in kei hong umcih uh hi.","ref":"Tp 32:14"},"13":{"text":"A samat balzana hawk humpinelkaite in a kam uh zapi in hong katsan uh hi.","ref":"Eze 22:25; Ta 3:46"},"14":{"text":"Tui bangin hong kisungkhia a, ka guh khempeuh a kilawi khin hi. Ka lungtang khuainun suak a; a sungah tuisuakmang khin hi.","ref":"Ph 6:2; Jos 7:5"},"15":{"text":"Ka thahatna belpei bangin keucipin ka dangtung ah ka leii belh a; nang in sihna leivui lakah kei a nong sial hi.","ref":"Isa 45:9; Ph 137:6; Job 7:21"},"16":{"text":"Uite in kei hong um uh a; migilo hon in kei hong umcihin, amaute in ka khut le ka khete a sunlet b uh hi.","ref":"Php 3:2; Isa 51:9"},"17":{"text":"Ka guhte khempeuh ka sim thei a; mite in hong en gega in hong awibek uh hi.","ref":"Ph 25:2; Lk 23:35"},"18":{"text":"Amaute in ka puansilhte hawm uh a, ka puan a hawm nadingun ai a lawn uh hi.","ref":"Mt 27:35; Mk 9:12"},"19":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA aw, nang gamla om lua kei in; ka Thahatna aw, hong huh dingin hong kuan meng in.","ref":"Ph 18:1"},"20":{"text":"Namsau panin ka nuntakna hu inla; uite vangliatna pan a manpha ka nuntakna hukhia in.","ref":"Job 5:20; Ph 35:17"},"21":{"text":"Humpineikaite kam pan kei hong hukhia inla; gam bawngtal kite panin kei hong hon c in.","ref":"Job 4:10; Ms 23:22"},"22":{"text":"Ka sanggamte tungah na min ka pulak dinga; a kikhawm mipi lakah nang kong phat ding hi.","ref":"Ph 26:12"},"23":{"text":"TOPA a kihta note aw, amah phat un! No Jacob suante khempeuh aw, amah pahtawi un! No Israel suante khempeuh aw, amah zahtak un!","ref":"Ph 33:2; Ph 50:15"},"24":{"text":"Ahang in, a thuaksiapa thuakna simmawh lo neu-et lo a; amah panin a maitang sel loin, huh dinga a kikona a ngaihsak zaw hi.","ref":"Ph 19:12; Ph 102:17; Ph 13:1; Job 24:12"},"25":{"text":"Kikhawm mi tampitak lakah ka phatna thubulpi nang panin hong pai a; nang d hong kihtate mai-ah ka kiciamnate ka tangtungsak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 26:12"},"26":{"text":"Mizawngte in ne in taii ding uh a; TOPA a zongte in amah a phat ding uh hi - na lungtangte uh hing den ta hen!","ref":"Ph 107:9; Ph 40:16"},"27":{"text":"Leimong khempeuh dongin phawk kik in, TOPA lamah kihei ding uh a, minam innkuante khempeuh ama mai-ah a kun ding uh hi;","ref":"Ph 2:8"},"28":{"text":"ahang in, kumpi-gam TOPA aa hi a, amah in minamte a uk hi.","ref":"Ph 47:7"},"29":{"text":"Leitung mihau khempeuh in pawibawlin bia ding uh a; amau le amau a nungta dingin a kikem thei lo - leivui ah a paisukte khempeuh ama mai ah a khukdin ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 45:12; Ph 89:46"},"30":{"text":"Khangsawnte in na sem ding uh a; mailam a khangsawnte tungah Topa thu a kigen ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Aman sem khinzo ahi manin a suak nai lote tungah ama thumaanna amaute in a tangko ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 5:8; Lk 18:31"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in tuucin-a hong cingpa hi-a, bangmah ka kisam kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 34:9"},"2":{"text":"Lonona ah kei hong lumsak a, tuidam kiangah kei hong pi-in","ref":"Ph 36:8"},"3":{"text":"ka hinna tha hong dim kik hi. Ama min hangin thumaanna lampite ah kei hong makaih hi.","ref":"Ph 19:7; Ph 25:11; Ph 5:8"},"4":{"text":"Sihna e liim guam sung nangawn ka tawn zongin kei tawh omkhawm na hi manin siatna peuhmah ka kihta kei ding hi; na khetbuk le na ciangkhut in kei hong khamuangsak hi.","ref":"Job 3:5; Ph 16:8; Ph 3:6"},"5":{"text":"Ka galte ompi-in ka mai ah sabuai nong lui hi. Ka lu sathau nong nilh a; ka hai a dimlet hi.","ref":"Job 36:16; Ph 16:5"},"6":{"text":"Ka nuntak sung tawntung hoihna le itna in hong zui taktak dinga tuateh TOPA ’ inn ah ka teng denta ding hi.","ref":"Ne 9:25"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitang le a sunga teng khempeuh, leitung le a tunga tengte TOPA aa ahi hi,","ref":"Pk 9:29; 1Co 10:26"},"2":{"text":"ahang in amah in tuipite tungah leitung phuta tui tungah a kipsak hi.","ref":"Ph 104:3"},"3":{"text":"TOPA ’ mual ah kua kahto thei ahi hiam? A mun siangtho ah kua ding thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 2:6; Ph 15:1"},"4":{"text":"Khut siangtho le lungsim siang a nei mi, ama hinna milim lam a ngat lo ahikeh zuauthu-a a kiciam lo mi a ding thei hi.","ref":"2Sa 22:21; Eze 18:15"},"5":{"text":"Amah in TOPA tung panin thupha ngah dinga, ama Honpa Pasian panin diksakna a ngah ding hi.","ref":"Tp 11:26; Ph 17:2"},"6":{"text":"Nang hong zong na mai hong zong khang mite tua bang ahi uh hi, Jacob’ b Pasian aw.","ref":"Selah"},"7":{"text":"No kongpite aw, na lute uh laamto un; no tanglai kongpite aw, minthang Kumpipa a tumtheih nadingin kilaamto un.","ref":"Ph 118:19; Pn 44:4; Zec 9:9"},"8":{"text":"Hih minthang Kumpipa kua a hiam? A thakhauh a thahat TOPA , galsimna ah a thahat TOPA ahi hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:11"},"9":{"text":"No kongpite aw, na lute uh laamto un, no tanglai kongpite aw, minthang Kumpipa a tumtheih nadingin tuate laamto un."},"10":{"text":"Hih minthang Kumpipa amah kua ahi hiam? A Thahatpen TOPA - amah minthang Kumpipa ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 1:11; Selah"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang tungah ka hinna kong laamto hi;","ref":"Ph 143:8"},"2":{"text":"keima Pasian aw, nang kong muang hi. Kei hong maizumsak kei inla, ka galte kei tungah gualzosak kei in."},"3":{"text":"Nang sungah lametna a neite khat beek kimaizumsak ngei lo dinga, ahi hangin a thu om lopi-a a zuautatte a kimaizumsak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 22:5"},"4":{"text":"TOPA aw, nangma ziate kei hong lak inla na lampite kei hong hilh in;","ref":"Job 34:32"},"5":{"text":"nangmah Pasian, keima Honpa na hi-a, sun niloh a ka lametna na hi manin na thutak ah hong pi inla kei hong hilh in.","ref":"Ph 32:20; Ph 31:3"},"6":{"text":"Na lainatna lian le na itna liante tanglai pek pan ahi manin phawk in, TOPA aw."},"7":{"text":"Ka khangno lai-a ka mawhnate le ka lehtatnate ciamteh kei in; TOPA aw, nang hoih na hi manin na itna tawh kizui-in kei hong phawk in.","ref":"Job 13:26; Ph 6:4"},"8":{"text":"TOPA hoih in thutang hi; tua ahi manin mawhneite ama lampite a lak hi.","ref":"Ph 92:15"},"9":{"text":"Amah in a kiniamkhiatte amaanin pi-a, amaute ama lampi a hilh hi.","ref":"Ph 23:3"},"10":{"text":"Ama thukhun sawlnate a zuite adingin TOPA ’ lampite khempeuh itna le muanhuaina ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 103:18; Ph 18:25"},"11":{"text":"Nangma min na khualna-in TOPA aw, ka khialhnate a liat hangin hong maisak in.","ref":"Pk 9:16; Pk 34:9"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahileh TOPA a kihta kua ahi hiam? Amah in ama adingin a teelsaksa lampi a lak ding hi.","ref":"Job 1:8"},"13":{"text":"Amah a dam sung teng daupaina-in zang dinga, ama suante in leitang a luah ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 30:15; Ms 14:24"},"14":{"text":"TOPA in amah a kihtate muang a; a thukhun amaute a theisak hi.","ref":"Pn 3:32; Pc 17:2"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in thang panin ka khete hong sutsak lel ding ahi manin amah ka mitsuan gige hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:12"},"16":{"text":"Lungzuang in kei guak gim thuak ka hi manin kei lam hong nga inla hong hehpih in.","ref":"Ph 68:6; Ms 6:25; Ph 6:4"},"17":{"text":"Ka lungsim buainate kibehlaplap hi; ka lungtawlna panin hong suaktasak in.","ref":"1Ku 1:29"},"18":{"text":"Ka thuaksiatna le ka lungdonna en inla, ka mawhna khempeuh lakhia mang in.","ref":"2Sa 16:12"},"19":{"text":"Ka galte khang mahmah in hong muhdahna uh a nasiat mahmah lam mu in!","ref":"Ph 3:1; Ph 35:19"},"20":{"text":"Ka nuntakna hong cingin hong hu in; nang hong beel ka hi manin hong maizumsak kei in."},"21":{"text":"Ka lametna nang sungah om ahi manin ka lungsim cihtakna le ka thutangna in kei hong dal hen."},"22":{"text":"Pasian aw, amau lungkhamna khempeuh panin Israel tankhia in!","ref":"Ph 130:8"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Genbaang lo a nungta ka hi manin, dik hong tangsak in TOPA aw; lunghiang loin TOPA kong muang hi.","ref":"1Sa 24:15; Ph 15:2; Ph 22:4"},"2":{"text":"Hong zia-et in TOPA aw, kei hong sin dih in, ka lungtang le ka lungsim hong sittel in;","ref":"Ph 66:10; Tp 6:6"},"3":{"text":"nangma itna ka mai-ah om tawntung ahi manin, na thutak ah ka kalsuan den hi.","ref":"Ph 6:4; Ph 40:11"},"4":{"text":"Zuauthei mi tawh tukhawm loin kineihsiamte tawh ka kikhawl kei hi.","ref":"Ph 1:1; Ph 28:3"},"5":{"text":"Asia-a gamtate kikhopna ka kih a, mi gilote tawh ka tutkhawm ding ka nial hi.","ref":"Ph 139:21"},"6":{"text":"Mawhpengin ka khut ka sil a, na biakna-tau kimkotah ka pai hi TOPA aw,","ref":"Ph 73:13"},"7":{"text":"ngaihtakin nang phatna ka tangko a, na sepsa a lamdang khempeuh ka gengen hi.","ref":"Isa 42:12; Jos 3:5"},"8":{"text":"Na tenna inn, na minthanna tenna mun ka it hi, TOPA aw.","ref":"Ph 122:6; Pk 29:43"},"9":{"text":"Ka hinna mawhneite tawh, ka nuntakna sisan suah mite tawh lakhawm mang kei in;","ref":"Ph 5:6"},"10":{"text":"amaute khut in gitloh sawma, a ziatlam khut uh golhgukte tawh a kidim hi.","ref":"Ph 21:11; Job 36:18"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin kei kawkbaang loinka nungta hi; hong tankhia inla kei hong lainat in.","ref":"Ph 31:5"},"12":{"text":"Lei taamna ah ka ding hi; mi tampitak kikhopna ah TOPA ka phat ding hi.","ref":"Ph 27:11; Ph 22:25"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in ka khuavak le ka hotkhiatna ahi hi - kua lau ding ka hi hiam? TOPA ka nuntakna kulh muanhuai ahi hi - kua lau ding ka hi hiam?","ref":"2Sa 22:29; Ph 9:9"},"2":{"text":"Ka sa a nawmvalh dingin migilote hong kuan uh ciang, ka galte le ka langte in kei hong sim uh ciangin, amaute kimuktu in a puk ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Galkap honin kei hong umcih zongin ka lunglau kei ding hi; ka langah gal in hong do zongin tua ciang nangawnin ka kimuang lai ding hi.","ref":"Pc 4:7; Job 4:6"},"4":{"text":"TOPA thu khat ka donga ka zon hih ahi hi: ka nuntak sung tawntung TOPA inn sungah ka ten theih nading, TOPA mel hoihna enin ama biakinnpi ah amah ka zon theih nading ahi hi.","ref":"Lk 10:42; Ph 23:6"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, lungkham hunin ama tenna sungah lungmuangin kei hong kemin, a biakbuk liim sungah kei hong seel dinga, suangpi khat tungah kei hong koih to ding hi.","ref":"Ph 12:7; Ph 17:8; Ph 40:2"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin hong umcih galte tungsan ah ka lu kitawisangin lungdamna aw tawh kiko-in a biakbuk ah biakna ka pia dinga; la sakin TOPA tungah tumtheih ka tum ding hi.","ref":"Ph 22:12; Ezr 3:13; Ph 33:2"},"7":{"text":"Kong sap ciangin ka aw za in, TOPA aw; kei hong lainat inla hong dawng in.","ref":"Ph 5:3; 18:6; Ph 4:1"},"8":{"text":"Ka lungtang in, \"Ama b mai zong sin!\" hong ci hi. TOPA , na maitang kong zong ding hi.","ref":"1Kh 16:11"},"9":{"text":"Na maitang hong seelsan kei inla na nasempa hehsa-in hong nawhkhia kei in; kei hong huhpa nang na hi hi. Hong nolh kei inla zong hong taisan kei in, ka Honpa Pasian aw.","ref":"Tp 31:17; Ph 2:5; Tp 4:31; Ph 37:28; Ph 18:46"},"10":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa in hong taisan uh zongin, TOPA in kei hong sang ding hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA aw, na zia hong hilh inla; kei hong nuainette hangin lampi tang ah kei hong pi in."},"12":{"text":"Ka galte deihna ah kei hong puak kei in; teci zuaute kei langah pang uh a, ngongtatna huu a sangkhia uh hi.","ref":"Tp 19:16"},"13":{"text":"Hih thu ah ka kimuang lailai hi: A nungtate gamah TOPA hoihna ka mu ding hi.","ref":"Pk 33:19"},"14":{"text":"TOPA ngak in; kihatsakin kilungkhauhsak inla TOPA ngak in.","ref":"Ph 33:20"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima Suangpi TOPA aw, nang kong sam hi; keilam ah na bil ngongsak kei in. Ahang in dai dide in na om leh gum sunga kiasuksate ka bang ding hi.","ref":"Tp 1:45; Est 4:14; Job 33:18"},"2":{"text":"Na Mun Siangtho Pen lamah ka khutte lamto-in, nong huh ding kong nget bangin hong lainatin kong kikona hong za in.","ref":"Ph 5:7; Ph 63:4; Ph 17:1"},"3":{"text":"Migilote le a gitloh gamtatte, a vengte kamnemin hopih napi amau lungsim ah huatna a kholte tawh hong kaikhia khawm kei in.","ref":"Ph 12:2"},"4":{"text":"Amaute gamtatnasate le a gamtatsiate uh thuk kik in; a khutun a sepnate uh thuk inla amaute tawh kituakin amau tungah tusak in.","ref":"Ph 62:12; Ta 3:64"},"5":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA nasepte a khuta a sepsate a thusim loh nungsangun amaute phelkhia dinga, a lam kik ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:12"},"6":{"text":"Hong lainat ding ngenin ka kikona hong za khin ahi manin TOPA kiphat ta hen.","ref":"Pc 24:27"},"7":{"text":"TOPA in ka hatna le ka lum ahi hi; ka lungsim in amah muanga, keimah hong kihuh hi. Ka lungsim nuamin dianga, la sakin ama tungah lungdam ka ko ding hi.","ref":"Ph 18:1; Ph 13:5; Tp 16:15; Ph 33:3"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in ama mite’ thahatna hi-a, ama sathau-nilhpa adingin hotkhiatna kulhpi ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 18:1; Pk 15:2"},"9":{"text":"Nangma mite hon inla na gouluahte thupha pia in; amaute tuucin-a cingpa hi inla, tonpih tawntung in.","ref":"1Kh 16:35; Pk 1:31"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi thahatte aw, TOPA aa ci un, minthanna le thahatna TOPA aa ci un.","ref":"2Sa 1:19; Ph 8:1"},"2":{"text":"Ama min tawh kituak minthanna pen TOPA aa ci un; ama a sianthona’ thupina ah TOPA bia un.","ref":"1Kh 16:29"},"3":{"text":"TOPA awging tuite tungah om a, Pasian minthanna vanpi in ginga, tui thahatte tungah TOPA vanpi ging hi.","ref":"Job 37:5; Pk 15:10"},"4":{"text":"TOPA awging vanglian a, TOPA awging thupi hi.","ref":"Ph 68:33"},"5":{"text":"TOPA awging in tamtak singte ekkham a; TOPA in Lebanon tamtakte a tennen hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in bawngno bangin Lebanon zuansak a, gam bawngtalno bangin Sirion b a diangsak hi.","ref":"Ph 114:4; Tp 3:9; Job 39:9"},"7":{"text":"TOPA awging khuaphia-in tang hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA awnging in sehnel-gam lok-a; TOPA in Kadesh Sehnel-gam a lok hi.","ref":"Ms 13:26"},"9":{"text":"TOPA in tawsaw singte c huihek a, tulakte hawkkhia-in a kolhsak hi. Ama biakinnpi sungah mi khempeuh in, \"Minthanna!\" ci-in kiko uh hi.","ref":"Ms 13:32; Ph 26:8"},"10":{"text":"Tuikhang tungah Kumpi tokhomin TOPA tu d a; Kumpi tokhom ah TOPA kumpi-in a tu tawntung hi.","ref":"Pc 6:17; Pk 15:18"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in a mite thahatna guana; TOPA in a mite lemna tawh thupha a pia hi.","ref":"Ph 18:1; Sp 26:6"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong tawisang ding hi, a thuknate panin kei nong laamto a, ka galte kei tungah kisial sak lo na hi manin","ref":"Job 11:8; Ph 22:17"},"2":{"text":"keima Pasian TOPA aw, hong huh dingin kong sama, kei nong damsak hi.","ref":"Ph 5:2; Ms 12:13"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, hankhuk f panin kei nong lakhia-to a; gum sunga kia ding kimlai kei nong hawilai hi.","ref":"Ph 16:10; Ph 28:1"},"4":{"text":"No ama misiangte aw, TOPA la sak un; ama min siangtho phat un.","ref":"Ph 16:3; Pk 3:15"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, ama hehna tomno sung bek hi-a, ahi hangin ama angvanna nuntak sungteng ahi hi; kahna zan khat sung hi kha dinga zingsang in nuamna hong tung hi.","ref":"Job 14:13; 2Sa 15:13; 2Co 4:17"},"6":{"text":"Ngaihmuang ka kisak ciangin, \"Ka kiling ngei kei ding hi,\" ka ci hi."},"7":{"text":"TOPA aw, kei nong angvan ciangin ka mualpi g kiptak na dingsak a; na maitang na sel ciang ahileh ka lungmang hi.","ref":"Tp 31:17"},"8":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong sam hi; Topa tungah lainatna ngenin kong kiko a:"},"9":{"text":"\"Keima siatna h le gum sunga ka paisukna ah bang phatuamna om a hi hiam? Leivui in nang hong phat ding ahi hiam? Na muanhuaina amah in tangko ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 33:18; Ph 6:5"},"10":{"text":"TOPA aw, hong za inla kei hong lainat in; TOPA aw, kei hong huh in,\" kong ci hi.","ref":"Ph 4:1"},"11":{"text":"Ka thumna, lamna na suaksak a; ka puanhampi puan suahkhia-in lungnopna nong silhsak hi,","ref":"Pk 15:20; Est 4:1"},"12":{"text":"tua hangin ka lungsimin la kongsak a, ka dai om kei hi. Keima Pasian TOPA aw, lungdam kong ko tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Ph 44:8"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong bel khinzo hi; hong maizumsak ngei kei in; na thumaanna-in hong hukhia in.","ref":"Ph 7:1; Ph 5:8"},"2":{"text":"Na bil kei hong ngat inla hong hu dingin hong pai meng in; ka bukna suangpi le kei hong hon kulhpi muanhuai hong hi in.","ref":"Ph 6:8; 2Sa 22:3"},"3":{"text":"Nangmah ka suangpi le ka kulhpi na hi nungsang, nangma min na khualna-in hong makaihin hong pi in.","ref":"Ph 18:2; Ph 23:2"},"4":{"text":"Keima belh nang na hi manin kei hong kisiahna thang panin hong khahkhia in.","ref":"Ph 9:9; 1Sa 28:9"},"5":{"text":"Nangma khut sungah ka kha kong ap hi; thutak Pasian TOPA aw, keimah hong tankhia in.","ref":"Lk 23:46; Isa 45:19"},"6":{"text":"Kimanna nei lo milim belte ka mudah a; TOPA kong muang hi.","ref":"Tp 32:21; Ph 4:5"},"7":{"text":"Ka thuaksiatna mu khinin ka hingimna thei khin na hi manin na itna sungah nuamin ka kipaak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 13:3"},"8":{"text":"Galpa tungah kei nong pia kei a, mun nuam ah ka khe na dingsak zaw hi.","ref":"Tp 32:30; 2Sa 22:20"},"9":{"text":"Ka lungdong ta hi TOPA aw, kei hong lainat in; dahna-in ka mit ngui a, ka hinna le ka pumpi bah ta hi.","ref":"Ph 4:1; Ph 6:7; Ph 63:1"},"10":{"text":"Ka nuntakna lunggimna in valhtum a, mauna in ka nuntak sung kumte gai ta hi; ka thuaksiatna a hangin ka thahatna kiam-a ka guhte zaw hi.","ref":"Ph 25:18"},"11":{"text":"Ka galte khempeuh hangin ka inn vengte simmawh ka suaka, ka lawmte aa-in gimneih ka suak hi - kongzinga kei hong mute in hong taisan uh hi.","ref":"Ph 38:11"},"12":{"text":"Kei a sisa bangin amaute in hong manggilh uh a; Ph 103:12; Pn 28:13; Selah"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi manin a pasian-mi peuhmah in muh theih a na om sungin nang tungah thu hong ngen ta uh hen; tua hileh tuihat a khan ciangin amaute a bankha peuhmah kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 69:1"},"7":{"text":"Ka bukna mun nang na hi hi; ahi hangin TOPA a zongte na hoih bangmah a tasam kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 23:1"},"11":{"text":"Ka tate aw, hong pai-in ka thu ngai un; TOPA kihtakzia note kong hilh ding hi.","ref":"Ph 66:16; Ph 32:8"},"12":{"text":"A nuntakna it a ni hoih tampi a mu nuam peuhmah in,","ref":"Thn 3:13"},"13":{"text":"gitlohna panin na leii uh kem unla, zuau genna panin na muk uh kem un.","ref":"1Pe 2:23"},"14":{"text":"Gitlohna kiheisan unla na hoih sem un; amau lungkhamna khempeuh panin amah in hukhia hi.","ref":"Ph 145:19"},"18":{"text":"Lungtang kitamkhamte kiangah TOPA nai a, a lungsim kitamzante honkhia hi.","ref":"Ph 51:1"},"19":{"text":"A thumaan mi in lungkhamna tampi nei thei hi, ahi hangin TOPA in tuate khempeuh panin a hukhia hi;","ref":"Ph 25:17; amah a beelte khat beek a kimawhpaih kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 6:6"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, kei hong langpangte langpan inla, ka langa hong dote do in.","ref":"Pk 14:14"},"2":{"text":"Lum le lum neu la inla, tho in kei hong huh in."},"3":{"text":"Kei hong delhte langkhatah teipi le teikhawh a lek in. Ka hinna kiangah, \"Na kihotkhiatna keimah ka hi hi,\" ci in.","ref":"Ms 25:7; Job 8:18; Ph 27:1"},"4":{"text":"Ka nuntakna a zongte maimawlin maizumsak in; ka siat nadinga sawmsimte lungmangin ciah kik uh hen.","ref":"Ph 25:3"},"5":{"text":"TOPA vansawltak in a nawhmang amaute huihmut leng buhvai bang uh hen;","ref":"Job 13:25"},"6":{"text":"TOPA vansawltak in a delh amaute lampi mialin nal ta hen."},"7":{"text":"A thu om lopi-in a len uh hong siahsim leh a thu om lopi-in kei gum hong siah nungsangun","ref":"Ph 7:4; Job 9:31"},"8":{"text":"amaute theih kholh lohin siatna in pha henla - amau hong siahna lenthang in vialcipin a siat nadingun gum sungah kia uh hen.","ref":"Isa 47:11; Ph 7:15"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA sungah ka hinna lungnuam dinga, ama hotkhiatna sung nuam ka sa ding hi.","ref":"Ph 2:11"},"10":{"text":"Ka nuntakna buppi-in lamdang sa in, \" TOPA aw, nang bang kua om ahi hiam? Nang in amaute adingin a hatluate panin mizawngte na hukhia-a, amaute a lawkte panin mizawngte le a tasamte na hukhia hi,\" a ci ding hi.","ref":"Ph 18:17"},"11":{"text":"A hiam gamh tecite maipaikhia uha, a thu bangmah ka theih loh nate hong dong uh hi.","ref":"Pk 23:1"},"12":{"text":"A hoihte, a hoih loin hong thuk uh a, khavapi-in ka hinna nusia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hi napi amaute a cinat uh ciangin ippi puan ka silh a, kiniamkhiatin an ka tang hi. Amau siatmangsakna panin ka nuntakna hu inla hih humpinelkaite panin a manpha ka nuntakna hukhia in.","ref":"Ph 6:3; Ph 22:21"},"18":{"text":"A kikhawm mi tampi lakah lungdam kong ko dinga, mihon tampitakte lakah nang kong phat ding hi.","ref":"Ph 22:25; Ph 42:4"},"19":{"text":"A thu om lopi-in kei tungah ka galte kisialsak kei inla, thu om lopi-in kei hong mudahte kimitsin simsak kei in.","ref":"Ph 9:13; Ph 38:19"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in lem thu lah gen loin gam sungah daitaka omte mawhsiat ding bek a sawm uh hi.","ref":"Ph 38:12"},"21":{"text":"Kei hong nehphensanin, \"Awi bek si’ng! Awi bek si’ng! Eima mit mahmah in mu ta hang ei!\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Ph 40:15"},"22":{"text":"TOPA aw, hih na mu khin ta hi; dai nawn kei in. Kei hong gamla omsan kei in, Topa aw,","ref":"Pk 3:17; Ph 10:1"},"23":{"text":"Ka kihut nadingin khanglo inla tho ta ve! Kei adingin do in, keima Pasian Topa aw.","ref":"Ph 17:13; 1Sa 24:15"},"24":{"text":"Keima Pasian TOPA aw; nangma thumanna ah kei dik hong tangsak inla kei tungah amaute kisialsak kei in.","ref":"Ph 22:17"},"25":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Awi bek si’ng, i deih bang lian hi ei!\" ci-in ngaihsunsak kei inla, \"Amah valhtum ta hang ei!\" cisak kei in."},"26":{"text":"Kei lungdonna hangin a kisatheite khempeuh maizumin kibuaisakgawp henla; kei tunga amau le amau a kisangsakte khempeuh maizumna le maimawlna kisilhsak hen.","ref":"Ph 4:1; Job 8:22; Job 19:5"},"27":{"text":"Kei diktanna ah nuam a sate nuamin kipakin awng uh hen, amaute in a tawntungin, \"A nasempa hoihna ah nuam a sa TOPA kitawisang hen,\" ci uh hen.","ref":"Ph 9:4; Ph 147:11"},"28":{"text":"Sun thapai-in ka leii in na thumaanna le na phatnate a gen ding hi.","ref":"Ph 5:8; Ph 71:15"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilopa mawh nei hihna b tawh kisai ka lungsim ah thu khat suak a: Pasian kihtakna ama mit ah a om kei hi.","ref":"Ph 21:16; Job 23:15"},"2":{"text":"Ahang in, a khialhna kimukhia ding le a mawhna hua dingin amah le amah kiphat lua hi.","ref":"Tp 29:19"},"3":{"text":"Ama kampaute gilo-in zuauthu hi a; pil nading le na hoih sep a khawl ta hi.","ref":"Ph 94:8"},"4":{"text":"A lupna tung nangawn ah siatna geelgeel a; mawhna bawlin, khialhna a nolh kei hi.","ref":"Isa 65:2; Ph 52:3"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, na itna in vante bana, na muanhuaina in huih khua ban hi.","ref":"Ph 57:10"},"6":{"text":"Nangma thumaanna, a kho muallianpite tawh kibang a, na thutangna tui thukpi tawh kibang hi. TOPA aw, nang in mihing le ganhing na kem tuak hi.","ref":"Ph 68:15; Pc 1:2; Ne 9:6"},"7":{"text":"Na itna kip c a manphatna kiseh zo lo pi! a khete a tal kei hi.","ref":"Tp 6:6; Tp 32:35"},"32":{"text":"A thumaante bukin migilote boka, amaute nuntakna mahmah a zong uh hi.","ref":"Ph 11:5"},"33":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in amaute vangliatna sungah, a thumaante nusia lo dinga, thukhenna ah a kimawhpaihsak kei ding hi."},"34":{"text":"TOPA ngak inla ama lampi tawn in, amah in gam luah dingin nang hong tawisang dinga, migilote a hepkhiat ciangin na mu ding hi.","ref":"Ph 27:14"},"35":{"text":"Leihoihna-a po singkung hing tawh a kibang a khanpha mi gilo a tatsia khat ka mu hi;","ref":"Job 5:3"},"36":{"text":"ahi hangin mangpah-a a om nawn kei hi; i khuta i septe ei adingin kipsak hen - hihi, ka khut ua ka septe uh kipsak in.","ref":"Isa 26:12"}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sang Penpa liahna sunga tengte Thahatpenpa c liim ah a khawl ding hi.","ref":"Pk 33:22; 1Ku 8:37"},"4":{"text":"Amah in a khate in nang hong khuh dinga, ama khate nuai-ah bu-in; ama muanhuaina in na lumpi le na lumta hi ding hi.","ref":"Ru 2:12; Tp 32:10"},"5":{"text":"Zana lauhuaina ahi a, suna leng thaltang ahi zongin","ref":"Job 5:21"},"6":{"text":"mial laka leng natna lauhuaite ahi a, suntangpi-a a siasak gimnate ahi zongin na kihta kei ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Na gei ah tulkhat pukin, na taklam ah tulsawm a puk zongin nang hong neh kha kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na mitin na en lel dinga, migilote dan thuakna na mu ding hi.","ref":"Ph 37:34"},"9":{"text":"Nangmah in Sang Penpa - keima bukna TOPA mah - na tenna na hisak leh"},"10":{"text":"tua ciangin na tungah siatna hong tung lo dinga, na puanbuk gei-ah vangsiatna hong tung kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahang in nang adingin ama vansawltakte thu pia dinga na lampi tengah hong cingsak ding hi;","ref":"Ph 34:7"},"12":{"text":"na khe suang tungah na tah khak loh nadingin amaute in a khutun hong dom ding uh hi.","ref":"Mt 4:6"},"13":{"text":"Humpinelkai le mualtan na tuan dinga; humpinelkai lianpi le gulpi na tuancil ding hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Amah in kei hong it ahi manin amah ka hu ding hi; amah in ka min thei ahi manin amah ka dal ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in kei hong sam dinga, ka dawng ding hi; lungkham hunin amah ka ompih dinga amah hu-in ka pahtawi ding hi.","ref":"2Sa 2:30"},"16":{"text":"Nuntak sawtna-in amah ka lungtaisak dinga ka hotkhiatna amah ka lak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 50:23"}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat dingin hoih a, Sang Penpa aw, na minphatna sa in","ref":"Ph 9:2"},"2":{"text":"zingsangin nangma itna zan ciangin na muanhuaina","ref":"Ph 55:17"},"3":{"text":"zang sawm kivawh lyre le harp tumin, kihualtaka tangko dingin a hoih hi.","ref":"Ph 71:22"},"4":{"text":"Nangma nasepnate in kei hong kipaksak ahi manin na khuta na sepsate lungnuamin la ka sak hi. TOPA aw.","ref":"Ph 8:6"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, na nasepte lian na lawmlawm e! na ngaihsutna thuk na mahmah e!","ref":"Job 36:24; Ph 40:5"},"6":{"text":"Ngaihsutna nei lote in thei lo uh a, mihaite in a theitel kei uh hi;","ref":"Ph 73:22"},"7":{"text":"migilopa ngaihsutna lopa bangin selkhia a, gamtatsiate a khanpha uh zongin amaute kisusia den ding hi.","ref":"Ph 37:2"},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA aw, nang hong kitawisang tawntung hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA aw, na galte mangthangin nangma galte mangthang taktak ding uh a; a gamtatsiate khempeuh a kithehzak taktak ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 45:5; Ph 68:1"},"10":{"text":"Gam bawngtal khat aa bangin keima ki a na tawisang a; ka tungah sathau hoih pente hong kisung khin hi.","ref":"Ph 23:5"},"11":{"text":"Kei hong galbawlte kizawhna ka mitin mu a; a gilo ka galte taikekna ka bilin ka za khin hi.","ref":"Ph 54:7"},"12":{"text":"A thumaante nisuh kung bangin khanpha ding uh a, Lebanon a tamtak bangin khang ding uh hi;","ref":"Ph 72:7; Ph 1:3"},"13":{"text":"TOPA inn sungah kisuanin, eite Pasian huang sungah a khanpha ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 135:2"},"14":{"text":"A upat khit dongun gahlai ding uh a, nosuakin hing kiuhkeuhsa in,","ref":"Jn 15:2"},"15":{"text":"\" TOPA thutang hi; amah ka Suangpi hi-a, amah ah gitlohna a om kei hi,\" ci-in tangko ding uh hi."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in uk a, thupina-in kituam hi; TOPA thupina-in kituam a, hatna in a kituam hi. Leitung buppi kiptakin kiphut kip a, a kiling thei kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 40:10; Ph 24:2; 1Kh 16:3"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai pek pan na tokhom a kipsa hi a; nang a tawntunga omdensa na hi hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:16"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, tuipite kikhaangto uh a, tuipite in a aw uh sangsak uh hi; tuipite in a tuihual kilokpite sangsak uh hi.","ref":"Ph 96:11; Ph 46:3; Job 9:8"},"4":{"text":"Tui lianpi hawk sanga a thahatzaw; tuipihual kisatte sangin zong a thahatzaw - a sangna a om TOPA a thahat hi.","ref":"Ph 65:7; Ph 18:4"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, na ngeina kipte kho a; bei ni a nei lo dingin sianthona in na inn a zem hi."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Phu a lapa Pasian, TOPA aw, phu lapa Pasian aw, tangkhia in.","ref":"Pc 4:24; Tp 33:2"},"2":{"text":"Leitung thukhenpa aw, thoto in; a kisatheite amau tawh kituakin thuk in.","ref":"Pc 18:25; Ph 31:23"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, a gilote bang tanvei, bang tanvei a gilote nuamsa lai ding uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 13:2"},"4":{"text":"Amaute in ki-uatsakna kam bungkhiakhia uh a; a gilo-a gamta khempeuh a kisialsial uh hi.","ref":"Jer 43:2; Ph 52:1"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, amaute in na mite suzan uh a; na gouluahte a nengniam uh hi.","ref":"Ph 44:2; Ph 28:9"},"6":{"text":"Amaute in meigongnute le pemtate golum uh a; pa nei lote a that uh hi.","ref":"Tp 10:18"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in, \" TOPA in mu lo hi; Jacob Pasian in phamawh sa kei,\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Job 22:14; Pc 24:12"},"8":{"text":"No, mite laka bangmah phawk lote aw, thusim un; no mihaite aw, cik ciangin pil ding na hi uh hiam?"},"9":{"text":"Bil khua a zasakpa in za lo ding ahi hiam? mit khua a musakpa in mu lo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Pk 4:11"},"10":{"text":"Minamte a sektatpa in dan tuaksak lo ding ahi hiam? Mite thu a hilhpa in theih loh nei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Pk 35:34"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in mihing ngaihsutnate thei a; amaute a mawkna ahilam a thei hi.","ref":"Ph 139:2; 1Co 3:20"},"12":{"text":"TOPA aw, na thukham hilhin na sektat mi thupha ngah hi a;","ref":"Job 5:17; Tp 8:3"},"13":{"text":"migilote adingin gum a kitawhsak matengin lungkham huna dingin suahtakna na guan hi.","ref":"Ph 7:15; Ph 86:7"},"14":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in ama mite nolh lo dinga; ama gouluahte a taisan ngei kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 31:6"},"15":{"text":"Thumaanna tungah thukhenna kibulphuh kik dinga, tuateh a lungsima thutang khempeuh in a zui ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 97:2; Ph 7:10"},"16":{"text":"Migilote langah kei adingin kua ding ding ahi hiam? Asia-a gamtate langah kei adingin kua ding ding ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"TOPA in kei hong huh lo hi leh dai dide-in sihna sungah ka teng khin tham ding hi.","ref":"Ph 124:2"},"18":{"text":"\"Ka khe tal ei,\" ka cih ciangin TOPA aw, na itna in kei hong lenkip hi.","ref":"Tp 32:35"},"19":{"text":"Ka sungah lunghimawhna a tam luat ciangin nong khamuanna in ka hinna a nuamsak hi.","ref":"Thn 11:10; Job 6:10"},"20":{"text":"Thukipte pansan a gimna a tun - a kisiasa kumpi tokhom tawh nang kipawl thei ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Jer 22:30; Ph 58:2"},"21":{"text":"Thumaan langkhat ah amaute kipawlkhawm uh a, mawhpengte a si dingin a mawhpaih uh hi.","ref":"Ph 56:6; Pc 18:23"},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA ka kulhpi hong suak a, ka Pasian ka belh suangpi hong hi hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah in amau mawhnate bangin thuk kik dinga, a gitlohna uh hangin a susia ding hi; eite Pasian, TOPA in amaute a susia ding hi.","ref":"Pk 32:34; Ph 9:5"}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hong pai un, TOPA tungah nuamna la sa ni, I hotkhiatna Suangpi tungah nakpi in kiko ni.","ref":"Ph 5:11"},"2":{"text":"Ama mai-ah lungdamkohna tawh pai-in, tumtheih le la tawh amah ngaih takin phat ni.","ref":"Ph 100:2; Ph 81:2"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in a lian Pasian hi a, pasiante khempeuh tunga Kumpi lian ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 48:1; Ph 96:4"},"4":{"text":"Ama khut sungah leitung thukpite om a, mualdawnte ama aa ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 63:9"},"5":{"text":"Tuipi ama bawlsa ahi manin ama aa hi-a, ama khutin leikeute a bawl ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 1:9"},"6":{"text":"Hong pai un, amah bia in kun ni, eite hong Bawlpa TOPA mai-ah khukdin ni;","ref":"2Sa 12:16; Ph 100:3"},"7":{"text":"ahang in, amah eite Pasian hi-a, ama gankhawk sunga mi ama cinna nuai-a tuuhon i hi hi. Tuni-in ama aw na zak uh leh","ref":"Ph 74:1"},"8":{"text":"Meribah a a na hih bang uh leh sehnel-gam Massah b a na om ni-ua na hih bangun na lungsim uh khauhsak kei un;"},"9":{"text":"tua lai-ah na pate un ka nasepte mu khin napi kei hong zia-et in hong sin uh hi.","ref":"Ms 14:22"},"10":{"text":"Tua khangte tungah kum sawmli sung ka heh a, \"Amaute lungsim lampialsate hi uh a, ka lampi a thei kei uh hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Tp 8:6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin hehsa in ka kiciam a, \"Amaute ka khawlna ah a lut ngei kei ding uh hi,\" ka cikhia hi.","ref":"Ms 14:23; Tp 1:35"}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lathak khat TOPA sak un; leitung khempeuh aw, TOPA la sak un.","ref":"Ph 33:3"},"2":{"text":"TOPA la sak unla ama min phat un; nisimin ama hotkhiatna tangko un.","ref":"Ph 68:4; Ph 27:1"},"3":{"text":"Minamte lakah ama minthanna pulak unla, mi khempeuh lakah a nasep piandangte pulak un.","ref":"Ph 8:1; Ph 71:17"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in TOPA lian a, a phattak pen ahi hi; pasiante khempeuh khengin kihtak ding ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 95:3"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in minamte’ pasian khempeuh milimte hi-a, TOPA in ahileh vante a bawl hi.","ref":"Sp 19:4; Pc 1:1"},"6":{"text":"Ama mai-ah nopcitna na le thupina om a; a munsiangtho sungah hatna le minthanna a om hi.","ref":"Ph 21:5; Ph 29:1"},"7":{"text":"Minamte innkuante aw, TOPA ahi ding bangin hisak un, TOPA tungah a minthanna le a thahatna bangin hisak un.","ref":"Ph 22:27"},"8":{"text":"Ama min tawh kituakin TOPA minthangsak un; biakna kengin ama huang sung hong zuan un.","ref":"Ph 65:4"},"9":{"text":"Ama sianthona c a thupina tawh kituakin TOPA bia unla leitung khempeuh ama mai-ah ling un.","ref":"Ph 93:5; Ph 33:8"},"10":{"text":"Minamte lakah, \" TOPA in uk hi,\" ci un. Leitung kiptakin kikhosak a kikhin thei lo hi; amah in guptuam paihtuam nei loin minamte thu a khen ding hi.","ref":"Ph 97:1; Ph 24:2; Ph 67:4"},"11":{"text":"Vante nuam uh henla, leitung kipak hen; tuipi le a sunga omte khempeuh kithawn uh hen;","ref":"Ph 97:1"},"12":{"text":"lote le a sunga omte in nuamsa uh hen. Tua ciangin tulak a singkungte khempeuh in nuamna la sa ding uh a;"},"13":{"text":"TOPA hong pai-a, leitung thukhen dingin hong pai ahi manin amaute in a mai-ah la a sa ding uh hi. Amah in thumaanin leitung buppi thu khen dinga, thutakin mite thu a khen ding hi.","ref":"Kil 19:11; Ph 7:11; Ph 86:11"}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in uk hi, leitung kipak henla; a gamla-a tuipi geite nuam uh hen.","ref":"Ph 96:11; Est 10:1"},"2":{"text":"Meiipite le khuamial sahpi in amah umcih a; ama tokhom bulpi in thumaanna le thutang ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 19:9; Ph 89:14"},"3":{"text":"Ama mai-ah meikuang pai-a, a kim a pama galte a kangtum hi.","ref":"Isa 9:19; 2Sa 22:9"},"4":{"text":"A khuaphiate in leitung taana, leitung in mu-in a ling hi.","ref":"Job 36:30"},"5":{"text":"TOPA , leitung khempeuh Topa mai-ah khuainun bangin mual liante a tuisuak hi.","ref":"Jos 3:11; Ph 46:2"},"6":{"text":"Vante in a thumaanna tangko uh a, ama minthanna mi khempeuh in mu uh hi.","ref":"Ph 50:6; Ph 19:1"},"7":{"text":"Bawltawm milim bia a milimte a kisakheihpih khempeuh kimaizumsak ding hi - no pasiante khempeuh aw amah bia un!","ref":"Sp 26:1"},"8":{"text":"TOPA aw, na thukhennate Zion in za-in nuam a, Judah khuaneute a kipak uh hi.","ref":"Ph 48:11; Ph 9:2"},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA aw, leitung khempeuh tungah nang Sang Penpa na hi-a; pasiante khempeuh tung pekah hong kitawisang hi.","ref":"Job 34:29; Ph 47:9"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in ama tunga muanhuaite kemin migilote khut panin amaute hukhia ahi manin amah a itte in gitlohna mudah uh hen.","ref":"Ph 31:23; Job 28:28"},"11":{"text":"A thumaante khuavak in taan a, a lungsima a thutangte lungnopna in a taan hi.","ref":"Ph 11:5; Ph 7:10"},"12":{"text":"No a thumaante aw, TOPA sungah lungdam unla ama min siangtho phat un.","ref":"Job 22:19"}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in a piandang nate bawl ahi manin lathak khat amah sak un; a taklam khut le a ban siangtho in ama ading hotkhiatna a sem khin hi.","ref":"Ph 96:3; Jos 4:24; Ph 44:3"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in ama hotkhiatna kitheisak khin a, minamte tungah ama thumaanna a laakkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 52:10; Ph 67:2"},"3":{"text":"Amah in Israel innkuante tungah a itna le a muanhuaina phawk khin zo hi; leimongte khempeuh dong in eite’ Pasian hotkhiatna a mu khin uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 16:15"},"4":{"text":"Leitung khempeuh aw, lungnuamin TOPA tungah kiko un, tumtheih tumin lungnopna la sakhia zuahzuah un;","ref":"Ph 20:5"},"5":{"text":"harp tumin TOPA tungah gingsak unla, la awging le harp thuahkhawmin","ref":"Ph 33:2; Isa 51:3"},"6":{"text":"pengkulte le tuutal kite gingkhiasak unla - Kumpipa ahi TOPA mai-ah lungdamin awng un.","ref":"Pk 19:13; Ph 2:6"},"7":{"text":"Tuipi le a sunga om khempeuh le leitung le a tunga teng khempeuh kithawn hen.","ref":"Ph 93:3; Ph 24:1"},"8":{"text":"Gunte in a khut uh bengin mualte in lungdamin la sakhawm uh hen;","ref":"2Ku 11:12; Ph 148:9"},"9":{"text":"Leitung thukhen dingin TOPA hong pai ahi manin ama mai-ah amaute in la sa uh hen. Amah in leitung buppi thumaanin thu khen dinga, guptuam paihtuam nei loin mite thu a khen ding hi.","ref":"Ph 96:10"}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in uk hi, minamte ling uh hen; amah cherub-te kikal kumpi tokhom ah a tu hi, leitung kiling hen.","ref":"1Kh 16:31; Pk 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Zion ah TOPA lian a; minam khempeuh tungah amah kitawisang hi.","ref":"Pk 15:1"},"3":{"text":"A lipkhaphuai na min lianpi amaute in phat uh hen - amah siangtho hi.","ref":"Pk 15:11"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa a thahat hi, amah in thutang it hi - deihsaktuam neihlohna na kipsak a; Jacob ah thumaan le thutangin na sem khin hi.","ref":"1Ku 10:9; Ph 98:9"},"5":{"text":"Eite Pasian TOPA tawisang unla a khengakna ah bia un; amah siangtho hi.","ref":"Pk 15:2"},"6":{"text":"Ama siampite lakah Moses le Aaron kihel uh a, ama mina kilote lakah Samuel kihel hi; amaute in TOPA sam uh a amah in dawng hi.","ref":"Pk 28:1"},"7":{"text":"Amah in meii khuampi panin amaute hopih a; amaute in ama piak ngeina kipte le thukipte a zui uh hi.","ref":"Pk 13:21"},"8":{"text":"Kote Pasian TOPA aw, amaute na dawnga; amau tatkhialhna a dan na piak hangin, Israel-te b adingin mawhna a maisak Pasian na hi hi.","ref":"Sp 26:18; Pk 22:27"},"9":{"text":"Eite Pasian, TOPA siangtho ahi manin, i Pasian TOPA tawisangin ama mual siangtho ah bia un."}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Leitung khempeuh TOPA tungah lungdamin kiko un.","ref":"Ph 98:6"},"2":{"text":"Kipaktakin TOPA bia un; lungnopna late tawh a mai-ah hong pai un.","ref":"Tp 10:12; Ph 95:2"},"3":{"text":"TOPA in Pasian ahilam thei un. Eite hong bawlpa amah hi-a, eite ama a aa i hi hi; eite ama mi, a gankhawk sunga a tuute i hi hi.","ref":"Job 10:3"},"4":{"text":"Lungdamkohna tawh ama kongpite ah lut unla, phatna tawh a huang sungah tum un; ama tungah lungdam ko-in a min phat un.","ref":"Ph 42:4; Ph 116:17"},"5":{"text":"A hang in, TOPA hoih a, ama itna kip tawntung hi; ama muanhuaina khang tawntungin kizom den hi."}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na itna le na thutang la-in ka sa ding hi; TOPA aw, phatna la nang kong sak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 33:1"},"2":{"text":"Paubaang lo-a ka nuntak nadingin ka kidawm ding hi - cik ciangin kei kiangah hong pai ding na hi hiam? Lungsim paubaang loin ka inn sungah ka kalsuan ding hi.","ref":"Pc 17:1; 1Ku 3:14"},"3":{"text":"A sia na khatpeuh ka mitsuan lo ding hi. Upna neilote nasepte ka mudah hi; amaute in kei hong beel kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 16:18; Ph 5:5"},"4":{"text":"A lungsim kawi mi kei tawh kigamla dinga; gitlohna tawh ka kisawhkha kei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 3:32"},"5":{"text":"A vengte a gensia sim peuhmah ka daisak dinga; kiphatsak mithah a, lungsim kisatheite ka thuak kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 20:16; Ph 10:5"},"6":{"text":"Gam sunga mi muanhuaite tungah ka mit tu dinga, kei tawh tengkhawm thei ding uh hi; paubaang lo a kalsuan mi in ka na a sem ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 119:1"},"7":{"text":"Khemna a zang mi khat beek ka inn ah teng lo dinga; zuauphuakte khat beek ka mai-ah a ding kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gam sunga migilote khempeuh zingsang simin ka daisak dinga; gilo-a gamta khempeuh TOPA ’ khuapi panin ka khenkhia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 5:3"}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw ka thungetna hong za in; kong huh ngetna nang kiang hong tung hen.","ref":"Pk 2:23"},"2":{"text":"Ka lungdon hunin na maitang hong selsan kei in. Na bil kei lam hong ngat inla; kong sap ciangin manlangin hong dawng in.","ref":"Ph 22:24; 2Ku 19:16"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, ka nuntak nite meikhu bangin manga; ka guhte mei-am kuanglai bangin a sa hi.","ref":"Ph 37:20; Ta 1:13"},"4":{"text":"Ka lungtang maibuakin lopa bangin ka vul a; ka an nek ding ka mangngilh hi.","ref":"Ph 37:2; 1Sa 1:7"},"5":{"text":"Ka nak tau luat manin ka kiam a, guh le vun bek ka hi hi.","ref":"Ph 6:6"},"6":{"text":"Sehnel simbu ka banga, kisiatnate laka simbu om ka bang hi.","ref":"Job 30:29"},"7":{"text":"Ka lupsa-in ka hak gega a, innkhum dawna vasa tangtuan ka bang hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka galte in sun niloh in hong phin uh a, kei hong langneihte in ka min hamsiatna-in a zang uh hi.","ref":"Ph 42:10"},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, vut an in ka nei a, ka dawn zong khitui tawh a kihel hi;","ref":"Ph 6:6"},"10":{"text":"na thangpaihna a liatluat manin hong domkangin na pam nong denna hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka nuntak sung nite lah nitaklam niliap bang a; lopa bangin ka vul ta hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:15"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA aw, nang kumpi tokhom ah na tu tawntung a; khang tawntungin hong kitheihna kip den hi."},"13":{"text":"Zion angvan hunta ahi manin hong thoin amah na khuatuah ding hi; hun ciangtan zah cingta hi.","ref":"Ph 77:7; Pk 13:10"},"14":{"text":"Ahang in, na nasemte in suangtumte nangawn it uh a, ama leivuite nangawn a hehpih uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte in TOPA min kihta ding uh a, leitung kumpite khempeuh in na minthanna a zahtak ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in Zion lam kikin a minthanna tawh a kilang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 51:18"},"17":{"text":"Amah in a hawmsuakte thungetna dawng dinga; amaute thumna a simmawh kei ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 8:29"},"18":{"text":"A kipiangsak nai lote in TOPA a phat theih nadingun mailama khanglai dingte adingin:","ref":"Ph 22:31; Ro 4:24"},"19":{"text":"\" TOPA in a sangna-a a mun siangtho panin ensuk a; van panin leitung ensuk in,","ref":"Ph 53:2"},"20":{"text":"amah in thongkiate tauna za dinga, si dinga kimawhpaihte a khahkhia ding hi,\" ci-in kigelh hen.","ref":"Ph 68:6"},"21":{"text":"Mite le kumpi-gamte TOPA bia dingin a kikhop hun ciangin","ref":"Ph 22:27"},"22":{"text":"Zion ah TOPA min kipulakin, Jerusalem ah amah phatna a kigenkhia ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ka khangtung laitakin ka tha kiasak a; ka nuntak hun a a khiam hi.","ref":"Ph 39:5"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin: \"Ka Pasian aw, ka nuntak kimtanin kei hong lamang kei in; nang kumte khang tawntungin a kizomsuak ding hi.","ref":"Pc 21:33"},"25":{"text":"A tungin leitung bulpi na phut a vante na khuta na bawlsa ahi hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute mangthang ding uh a, nang na om den ding hi; amaute khempeuh puan bangin patkhia ding hi. Ka galte tungah gualzo-in ka en ding hi.","ref":"Tp 33:29; Ph 54:7"},"8":{"text":"Mihing i muan sangin TOPA belh hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Isa 2:22; Ph 2:12"},"9":{"text":"Gam-ukte i muan sangin TOPA belh hoihzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Minamte khempeuh in kei hong umcih uh hangin TOPA minin amaute ka khaktan hi.","ref":"Ph 37:9"},"11":{"text":"Amaute in ka kim ka pam ah hong umcih uh hangin TOPA minin amaute ka khaktan hi.","ref":"Ph 88:17"},"12":{"text":"Amaute in khuaipi hon bangin kei hong pumtuam uh hangin linglak kang bangin manlangin a simang uh hi; TOPA minin amaute ka khaktan hi.","ref":"Tp 1:44; Ph 58:9; Ph 37:9"},"13":{"text":"Kei hong kithalsawnin ka puk dek hangin TOPA in kei hong huh hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA ka thahatna le ka zaila hi a; keima hotkhiatna a suak zo hi.","ref":"Pk 15:2; Ph 62:2"},"15":{"text":"Gualzawhna le lungdama kikona in a thumaante puanbuk sung thawn a: \" TOPA khut taklam in a thahat nate sem khin ta!","ref":"Job 8:21"},"16":{"text":"TOPA khut taklam a sangin kilamto a; TOPA khut taklam in a thahat nate sem hi!\" ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei si loin ka nungta dinga, TOPA sepsa ka tangko ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:3"},"18":{"text":"TOPA in nasiatakin hong taihilh hangin sihna hong thuaksak zen lo hi.","ref":"Jer 31:18; Ph 86:13"},"19":{"text":"Thumaanna kongpite kei hong hon in, lutin TOPA tungah lungdam kong ko ding hi.","ref":"Ph 24:7; Ph 100:4"},"20":{"text":"Hih in TOPA kongpi hi-a, thumaan mite lut theih nading ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Kei hong dawng na hi manin lungdam kong ko ding hi. Keima hotkhiatna na hi ta hi.","ref":"Ph 27:1"},"22":{"text":"Inn lamte nolh suangin innkhum nang suang suak zo hi.","ref":"Isa 8:14"},"23":{"text":"TOPA in hih sem khin a, eite mitmuh in a piandang hi.","ref":"Mt 21:42"},"24":{"text":"Tu-ni TOPA bawlsa ahi hi; eite’n nuamsa in kipak ni.","ref":"Ph 70:4"},"25":{"text":"TOPA aw, kote hong honkhia in; TOPA aw, kote zawhna hong pia in.","ref":"Ph 28:9"},"26":{"text":"TOPA mina hong paipa thupha ngah ahi hi. na thukhamte tawh kituakin ka nuntakna hong hawi in.","ref":"Ne 9:27"},"157":{"text":"Hong bawlsia ka galte tampi hi-a, ahi hangin na ngeinakipte ka kiheisan kei hi.","ref":"Ph 7:1; Ph 44:18"},"158":{"text":"A muanhuai lo mite in na thu mang lo uh ahi manin amaute enin ka kih hi.","ref":"Pk 32:19"},"159":{"text":"Na thusehte ka itzia mu inla; Ph 37:24"},"166":{"text":"TOPA aw, na hotkhiatna ka ngak a, na thupiakte ka zui hi."},"167":{"text":"Na ngeinakipte it lua ka hi manin tuate ka mang hi."},"168":{"text":"Ka lampi khempeuh thei khin na hi manin na thusehte le na ngeinakipte thu ka mang hi.","ref":"Job 10:4"},"169":{"text":"TOPA aw, ka kikona na mai hong tung hen; na thu tawh kizui-in theihtelna hong guan in.","ref":"Job 16:18","title":"ת Taw"},"170":{"text":"Kong ngetnopna na mai-ah hong tung hen; na thuciam bangin kei hong hukhia in.","ref":"1Ku 8:30; Ph 3:7"},"171":{"text":"Na thukipte nong hilh manin ka muk pan phatna luanglet hen.","ref":"Ph 94:12; Ph 37:24"},"174":{"text":"TOPA aw, na hotkhiatna ka ngai-a, na thukham ah nuam ka sa hi."},"175":{"text":"Nang hong phat thei dingin hong nungtasak inla na thukhamte in kei hong khuangkhoh sak in."},"176":{"text":"Tuu mang bangin lam ka khial khin hi. Israel in ci ta hen -","ref":"Ph 129:1"},"2":{"text":"mite in hong sim ciangin eite lamah TOPA hong pang lo hileh,"},"3":{"text":"eite tungah amaute hehna a kuan ciangin amaute in hong hingvalh khin ding uh hi;"},"4":{"text":"tuikhang in eite hong tuumcipin tuizeu in eite hong taimang dinga,","ref":"Ph 88:17; Ph 18:4"},"5":{"text":"tui kilok in eite hong nawkmang khin ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute ha-a hong petzansak lo TOPA kiphat ta hen."},"7":{"text":"Thangsiahpa’ thanga vasa suakta bangin eite i suakta hi; thang kisutan khin a eite i suakta hi."},"8":{"text":"Eite huhna ahileh lei le van Bawlpa, TOPA min ah a om hi.","ref":"Pc 1:1; 1Sa 17:45"}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA a muangte, a kiling zolo a kip tawntung Zion Vum tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Ph 46:5"},"2":{"text":"Mualliante in Jerusalem a umcih bangin TOPA in ama mite tu le a tawntungin a umcih hi.","ref":"1Kh 21:15; Ph 32:10"},"3":{"text":"A thumaan mite in a khut uh gitlohna-in zangkha ding uh ahi manin a thumaante a kipia gam ah migilote kumpi ciangkhut ki-omsak den lo ding hi.","ref":"Ph 89:22"},"4":{"text":"TOPA aw, mi hoihte, a lungsima thutangte tungah na hoih sem in.","ref":"Ph 119:65; Ph 36:10"},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin lampi kawi-a pialte ahileh TOPA in a gamtatsiate tawh a delhkhia khawm ding hi. 1Ku 8:29"},"3":{"text":"Kong sap ciangin nong dawng a; hong hangsansakin, nong lungkhauhsak hi.","ref":"Ph 118:5; Pn 28:1"},"4":{"text":"TOPA aw, leitung kumpite khempeuh in, na kam pana thute a zak uh ciangin nang hong phat uh hen."},"5":{"text":"TOPA minthanna lian ahi manin amaute in TOPA lampite la in sa uh hen.","ref":"Ph 21:5; Ezr 3:11; Ph 51:11"}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kei hong pheklekin nong thei khin hi.","ref":"Ph 17:3; Ph 44:21"},"2":{"text":"Ka heksuk, ka hektohna na thei hi; a gamlapi panin ka ngaihsutna nong tel hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:27; Ph 94:11"},"3":{"text":"Ka pusuahna le ka lupna nong tel a; ka lampite khempeuh na theihsa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 31:4"},"4":{"text":"Ka leii tungah kammal khat beek a omma-in teltakin na thei hi, TOPA aw.","ref":"Heb 4:13"},"5":{"text":"Ka nung ka ma ah nang, nong huai-a; ka tungah na khut na nga hi.","ref":"2Sa 25:16"},"6":{"text":"Tua bang theihna kei adingin lamdang lua a, sang lua ahi ciangin ka ban zo kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Nangma Kha pan koi ah pai thei ding ka hi hiam? No, sisan luangsak mite paikhiamang dih un!","ref":"Ph 5:6; Ph 59:2"},"20":{"text":"Amaute in gitloh sawmin nang thu gen uh hi; na langte in na min zangkhial uh hi.","ref":"Ph 65:7"},"21":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang hong mudahte mudahin, nang langa pangte kih hilo ka hi hiam?","ref":"2Kh 19:2; Ph 26:5"},"22":{"text":"Amaute muhdahna sim loh bangmah ka nei kei hi; amaute ka galte in ka sim hi."},"23":{"text":"Pasian aw, kei hong pheklek inla, ka lungsim thei in; hong zia-et inla ka lunghimawhnate thei in.","ref":"Job 31:6"},"24":{"text":"Ka sungah langbawlna lampi khatpeuh a om kha hiam cih mu inla, tawntung lampi ah kei hong kha in.","ref":"Jer 25:5; Ph 5:8"}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, mi tatsiate pan hong hukhia inla mi ngongtatte panin hong dal in;","ref":"Ph 17:13; Ph 86:14"},"2":{"text":"amaute in a lungsimun siatna sawmsim uh a, nisimin gal kidona a sosak uh hi.","ref":"Ph 36:4"},"3":{"text":"Amaute in gulpi aa bangin a leii uh hiamsak uh a; amaute muk ah mualtan gu a om hi.","ref":"Selah"},"4":{"text":"TOPA aw, migilote khut panin hong kem inla; kalhelh hong sawm mi ngongtatte panin hong dal in."},"5":{"text":"Mi kiphasakte in thang hong siah uh a; amau lenthang khaukualte zakin ka lampi dungah thang a siah uh hi.","ref":"Job 34:30; Job 18:8; Selah"},"6":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang tungah, \"Ka Pasian na hi hi,\" kong ci hi. TOPA aw, nong lainat ding kong ngetna hong za in.","ref":"Ph 16:2; Ph 28:2"},"7":{"text":"Thuneipen TOPA , kei hong hu a thahatpa, gal kido ni-a ka lutang liahpa aw -","ref":"Ph 68:20"},"8":{"text":"migilote deihna pia kei in TOPA aw; amau ngimnate gualzosak kei in; tua hi kei leh kiphasak ding uh hi.","ref":"Selah"},"9":{"text":"Kei hong umcihte’ lutangte, a muk uh gensa lungkhamnate in tuam ta hen."},"10":{"text":"Amaute tungah mei-am lai zu henla; meikhuk sungah kikhulin a tho nawn lo dingin buannawi lakah kilawn hen.","ref":"Ph 11:6"},"11":{"text":"Gam sungah gensiat hatte kikipsak kei henla; siatna in mi ngongtatte sabetin beng hen.","ref":"Ph 35:21"},"12":{"text":"Mizawngte adingin TOPA thutang a kip lam le a tasamte thu a letkip lam ka thei hi.","ref":"Ph 35:10"},"13":{"text":"Thumaante in na min phat ding uh a, a thutang mite na mai-ah nungta taktak ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 16:11"}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong sam hi; kei kiangah hong pai meng in. Nang kong sap ciangin ka aw hong za in.","ref":"Ph 22:19; Ph 4:1"},"2":{"text":"Na mai-ah ka thungetna gim namtui bangin hong kilui henla; ka laptoh khutte nitak biakpiakna bang hen.","ref":"Lk 1:9; Pk 29:39"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, ka kam a cing khat omsak inla; ka muk kongkhak cing in.","ref":"Ph 34:13; Ph 12:2"},"4":{"text":"Siatna hihte tawh gilo khawm dingin siatna ah ka lungsim, kaisak zo kei inla; amaute limsakte kei hong nesak kei in.","ref":"Jos 24:23; Pn 23:1-3"},"5":{"text":"Thumaan mi a in kei hong sat hen - tua in migitna ahi hi; ama’n kei hong tai hen - tua in ka lutungah sathau ahi hi. Tua hi napi, ka thungetna in siatna bawlte langpan gige hi;","ref":"Pn 9:8"},"6":{"text":"a gam-ukte uh kenbang pan kisawnkhiasuk dinga, tua ciangin migilote in ka thugente a hoih lam thei ding uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 25:12"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Mi khat in lo kho a, lei a kalhkhap bangin ka guhte uh hankhuk b gongah a kithehthang hi,\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 129:3; Ms 16:30"},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin Thuneipen TOPA aw, mit khah loin nang kong en a; nang sungah kong bu hi - kei hong sisak kei in."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong siahna thangte pan le siatna bawlte siah thangte panin kei hong kem in.","ref":"Ph 38:12"},"10":{"text":"Kei suakta a ka khen’ khit ciangin amau lenthangte sung mah ah migilote puksak hi.","ref":"Ph 7:15"}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA tungah ngaihtakin ka kiko a; TOPA tungah lainatna ngenin ka aw ka sangsak hi.","ref":"Ph 30:8"},"2":{"text":"Ama mai-ah ka lungkimlohna ka sungkhia a; ama mai-ah ka lungkhamna ka ko hi.","ref":"Ph 64:1"},"3":{"text":"Ka sungah ka kha a zawm ciangin ka lampi a thei nangmah na hi hi. Belh nading ka nei kei a; kuamah in ka nuntakna a thusim kei hi.","ref":"Jer 25:35"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, nangmah kong sam hi; \"Nangmah ka belh, a nungta gamah keima tanh na hi hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Job 28:13"},"6":{"text":"Ka kikona hong ngai in, kong kisam mahmah hi; kei adingin hong delhte hat lua uh ahi manin amaute pan hong hu in.","ref":"Ph 17:1; Jer 31:11; Ph 25:20"},"7":{"text":"Na min ka phat theih nadingin thong sung panin hong khahkhia in. Tua ciangin kei tungah nong hoihna hangin a thumaante ka kimah hong kikawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 7:17; 2Kh 6:41"}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, kong thungetna za in, nong lainat ding ngena kong kikona hong za in; na muanhuaina le na thumaanna in kei hong suaktasak in.","ref":"Ph 71:2"},"2":{"text":"A nungta khat beek na mai-ah a thumaan om lo ahi manin na nasempa, thukhenna hong thuaksak kei in."},"3":{"text":"Gal in kei hong delh-a, lei lakah hong sikzan hi; amah in sawtpi-a site bangin khuamial lakah hong tengsak hi.","ref":"Ph 107:10"},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka sunga ka kha thazawm a; ka sunga ka lungsim cimawh hi.","ref":"Ph 30:7"},"5":{"text":"Tanglai hunte ka phawk a, na sepsate lungngaingai-in na khuta na sepsate ka ngaihsunsun hi.","ref":"Ph 77:6"},"6":{"text":"Ka khutte nanglam ah kong zakkhia a; leikeu bangin ka hinna nang duhin a dangtak hi.","ref":"Pk 9:29; Selah"},"7":{"text":"TOPA aw, hong dawng mengmeng in; nang hong lunggulhin ka kha a zawm hi; na maitang hong selsan kei in nong selsan leh gum sunga kiasukte ka bang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 142:3; Ph 22:24"},"8":{"text":"Nangmah hong muang ka hi manin zingsang in na itna kip thu kei hong puak hen. Ph 59:9; Ph 27:1; Pc 15:1"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, na thudon dingin mihing bang hi-a, nang ngaihsut dingin mihing tapa bang ahi hiam?","ref":"Heb 2:6"},"4":{"text":"Mi in huusan khat tawh kibang a; a nuntak hun niliim kikhinkhin tawh kibang hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:15"},"5":{"text":"TOPA aw, na vante khenkham inla hong paisuk in;
