Kulh vanna mun om lo dinga, sal-a kikai zong om loin, kongzing ah lungdong a kahna zong a om kei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 14:4; 2Ku 25:11; Isa 24:11"},"15":{"text":"Hih bang thu tawh a kituak mite thupha ngah hi-a; amaute Pasian, TOPA ahi mite thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 28:3"}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Keima Pasian Kumpipa, nang kong tawisang ding hi; a tawntungin na min ka phat den ding hi.","ref":"Ph 2:6; Ph 54:6"},"2":{"text":"Nisimin nang hong phatin a tawntungin na min ka tawisang den ding hi.","ref":"Ph 34:1"},"3":{"text":"TOPA lian hi, a phattak pen ahi hi; ama liatna kuamah in teh thei lo hi.","ref":"2Sa 24:4; Job 5:9"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat in khang dang khat tungah na nasepte phat ding uh a; amaute in nangma nasep thahatte a gen ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 22:3; Ph 71:16"},"5":{"text":"Amaute in na thupina a liatna le a thanna gen ding uh a, na nasep d lamdangte ka lungngaingai ding hi.","ref":"Ph 96:6"},"6":{"text":"Amaute in na nasepna a mulkimhuaite a vangliatna gen ding uh a, ke’n bel na nasepna lianpite ka tangko ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:3"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in na hoihna kicingte ai ding uh a, na thumaanna lungnuamtakin sa ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 138:5"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in mi hehpih siamin khuatuah nuam a, heh hakin itna a hau hi.","ref":"Ph 86:15; Ph 86:5"},"9":{"text":"Mi khempeuh tungah TOPA hoih a; a bawlsa khempeuh a khuatuah hi.","ref":"Ph 103:13-14"},"10":{"text":"TOPA aw, na bawlsa khempeuh in nang hong phat ding uh a; na misiangte in hong tawisang ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in na kumpi-gam minthanna genkhia ding uh a, na thahatna zong gen ding uh hi,"},"12":{"text":"tua in na nasepna thahatte le na kumpi thupi na le minthanna mi khempeuh in a theih nading ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 103:19"},"13":{"text":"Na kumpi-gam pen tawntung kumpi-gam hi-a, na kumpi ukna zong khang tawntungin a kip hi. A thuciam khempeuh ah TOPA muanhuai-a, a bawlsate khempeuh a it hi, e","ref":"Tp 7:9"},"14":{"text":"TOPA in a pukte khempeuh lenkipin a kunsukte a phongto hi.","ref":"Ph 37:17; 1Sa 2:8"},"15":{"text":"Mit khempeuh in nang hong mitsuan uh a, a hunhunin amaute an na pia hi."},"16":{"text":"Na khutpek na zal-a a nungta peuhmah amau lunggulhin na taiisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama lampi khempeuh ah TOPA thumaan a, a bawlsate khempeuh a it hi.","ref":"Pk 9:27"},"18":{"text":"TOPA in amah a sam khempeuh, thutak-a amah a sam khempeuh a nai hi.","ref":"Ms 23:11"},"19":{"text":"Amah in amah a kihtate deihna tangtungsak a; amaute kikona za-in a honkhia hi.","ref":"Ph 31:22"},"20":{"text":"TOPA in amah a it khempeuh cinga, migilote ahileh a susia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 1:6; Ph 94:23"},"21":{"text":"Ka kam in TOPA phatna a gen ding hi. A nungta peuhmah in a tawntungin a min siangtho phatden uh hen.","ref":"Ph 71:8; Ph 65:2"}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat un. a Ka hinna aw, TOPA phat in."},"2":{"text":"Ka nuntakna khempeuhin TOPA ka phat ding hi; ka nuntak laiteng ka Pasian phatna ka sa ding hi.","ref":"104:23; Ph 105:2"},"3":{"text":"Kuamah a hon thei lo kumpitapate, a si mihingte muang kei in.","ref":"Ph 118:9; Ph 60:11"},"4":{"text":"Amaute kha a paikhiat ciangin lei ah ciah kik uh a; tua ni mah in amaute ngimna bangmah suak lo hi.","ref":"Pc 3;19; Ph 33:10"},"5":{"text":"Ama huhpa-a Jacob Pasian a nei mi, a lametna ama Pasian, TOPA ah a nga mi thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 33:18"},"6":{"text":"Amah leitung le vantung, tuipi le a sunga om peuhmah a Bawlpa - tua TOPA a tawntungin muanhuai den hi.","ref":"2Kh 2:12; Tp 7:9"},"7":{"text":"Amah in a kinengniamte’ thu lenkip-a, a gilkialte an a pia hi. TOPA in thongkiate khahkhia in,","ref":"Ph 103:6; Ph 107:9"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in mittawte khua musak a, TOPA in a kunsukte phongto in TOPA in a thumaante a it hi.","ref":"Pn 20:12; Ph 38:6; Tp 7:13"},"9":{"text":"TOPA in pemtate cinga, pa nei lote le meigongte vakin migilote lampi ahileh a maimangsak hi.","ref":"Sp 19:34; Pk 22:22"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in uk tawntung a, Zion aw, na Pasian in khang tawntungin uk hi. TOPA phat un.","ref":"Pc 21:33"}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat un. b Eite Pasian phatna-a lasak hoih mahmah a, amah phat dingin kilawma nuam mahmah hi!","ref":"Ph 135:3"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in Jerusalem lam-a; Israel saltaangte a kaikhawm hi.","ref":"Ph 51:18; Ph 106:47"},"3":{"text":"Amah in lungsim tamkhamte damsak a, amau liammate a tunsak hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in aksite a phazah ding ciangtan a, a min vawh ciatin sam hi.","ref":"Pc 15:5"},"5":{"text":"I Topa lian hi, vangliatna ah thahat a, ama theihtelna kiciangtan lo hi.","ref":"Pk 14:31; Ph 145:3"},"6":{"text":"TOPA in a kiniamkhiatte huh a migilote ahileh leilak a denna hi.","ref":"2Kh 33:23; Ph 37:9-10"},"7":{"text":"Lungdam koin TOPA la sak un; Harp tumin i Pasian tungah gingsak un.","ref":"Ph 42:4; Ph 98:5"},"8":{"text":"Amah in meiite tawh huih khua tuam a, leitung ah guah zusakin mualte tungah lopa posak hi.","ref":"Job 26:8; Job 28:26"},"9":{"text":"Amah in ganhonte le va-aknote a ham ciangin an a sik hi.","ref":"Pc 8:7; Pc 1:30"},"10":{"text":"Ama lungkimna, sakol hatna hi lo a, ama nopsakna mihing khete zong hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA nopsakna ahileh amah kihta a, ama itna kip a lamente tung ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 33:18; Ph 119:43"},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, TOPA tawisang in; Zion aw, na Pasian phat in,"},"13":{"text":"ahang in, amah in na kongpi zawlte khauhsak a, nang sunga om na mite thupha pia hi.","ref":"Tp 33:25; Sp 25:21"},"14":{"text":"Amah in na gamgite lemna pia-a, mangbuh hoih penin nang hong taisak hi.","ref":"Sp 26:6; Tp 32:14"},"15":{"text":"Amah in a thupiakna leitung ah sawl-a; a thu manlangtakin a tai hi.","ref":"Job 37:12"},"16":{"text":"Amah in tuumul bangin vuk phalh a, vut bangin vukkhalte a thehthang hi.","ref":"Ph 148:8; Job 37:12"},"17":{"text":"Amah in suangtang bangin a gialtang hong khiatsuk hi. Ama vuk-huih kua in nang zo ding hiam?","ref":"Pk 9:22-23"},"18":{"text":"Amah in thu pia a tuate a tuisuak hi; a huihdamte tok-a tui a luang hi.","ref":"Ph 33:9; Ph 50:3"},"19":{"text":"Amah in Jacob tungah a thu laakhia a, Israel tungah a thukhamte le a thukipte a laakkhia hi.","ref":"Ph 78:5; Tp 33:4"},"20":{"text":"Amah in minam dangte adingin hih na sem lo a; amaute in a thukhamte a thei kei uh hi. TOPA phat un.","ref":"Tp 4:7-8; Ph 33:2"}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat un. a Vante panin TOPA phat un, tunglam asannate ah amah phat un;","ref":"Ph 19:1"},"2":{"text":"ama vansawltakte khempeuh aw, amah phat un, ama vantung mihonpi khempeuh aw amah phat un,","ref":"1Ku 22:19"},"3":{"text":"Nipi le khapi aw amah phat un, no, a tang aksite khempeuh aw amah phat un."},"4":{"text":"No a sangpen vante le huihkhua tunglam a tuite aw amah phat un.","ref":"Tp 10:14; Pc 1:7"},"5":{"text":"TOPA in thu pia-a amaute piang ahi manin ama min phat uh hen.","ref":"Ph 145:21"},"6":{"text":"Amah in amau mun tekah a tawntungin omsak den hi; amah in a mangthang ngei lo ding thukip amaute a pia hi.","ref":"Jer 33:25"},"7":{"text":"No tuipi ganhing lianpite le tuipi lian thuknate,","ref":"Tp 33:13"},"8":{"text":"no, khuaphia le gial, vuk le meiite, ama thu a mang huihpite,","ref":"Pk 9:18; Job 37:11-12"},"9":{"text":"no mualliante le mualneute khempeuh, nek theih kungte le tamtakte khempeuh,"},"10":{"text":"no gamsate le inn sate khempeuh, ganhing neute le a leng vasate,"},"11":{"text":"no leitung kumpite le minamte khempeuh, leitunga kumpitapate le thukhente khempeuh,","ref":"Ph 102:15"},"12":{"text":"nungakte le tangvalte, naupangte le khanghamte khempeuh aw, leitung panin TOPA phat un.","ref":"Ph 33:2"},"13":{"text":"Ama min bek kitawisang ahi manin amaute in TOPA phat uh hen; ama thupina lei le vante tunglam ah a om hi.","ref":"Ph 113:2"},"14":{"text":"Ama lungsim tawh a kituak Israel misiangte khempeuh phatna ki b khat a mite adingin a khangkhiasak hi. TOPA phat un.","ref":"Ph 26:19"}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat un. c TOPA lathak khat sak un, misiangte kikhopna ah amah phatna-in nei un.","ref":"Ph 33:2; Ph 1:5"},"2":{"text":"Amaute a Bawlpa tungah Israel nuam hen; amau kumpipa tungah Zion mite kipaak uh hen.","ref":"Job 10:3; Ph 10:16"},"3":{"text":"Amaute lamin a min phat uh henla khuangta le harp amah tum uh hen.","ref":"Pk 15:20; Ph 57:8"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, a mite tungah TOPA lungtai a, a kiniamkhiatte hotkhiatna a khusak hi.","ref":"Ph 35:27; Ph 132:16"},"5":{"text":"Hih pahtawina ah misiangte nuam uh henla amau lupna tungah lungnuamin la sa uh hen.","ref":"Job 35:10"},"6":{"text":"Amaute kam panin Pasian kiphat henla a langnih a hiam namsau a khut uh tawh tawi in","ref":"Ph 66:17; Ne 4:17"},"7":{"text":"minamte tungah phu la uh henla, mite tungah dan pia-in,","ref":"Ms 31:3; Ph 81:15"},"8":{"text":"a kumpite uh khekol in henin a uliante uh sikkol bulhsak uh henla","ref":"2Sa 3:34; 2Kh 33:11"},"9":{"text":"amaute thuak dinga kigelhsa thuaksak uh hen. Hih in ama misiangte khempeuh minthanna ahi hi. TOPA phat un.","ref":"Ph 145:10"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA phat un. d Ama munsiangtho sungah Pasian phat un; ama thahatna vante ah amah phat un.","ref":"Ph 112:1; Ph 148:1"},"2":{"text":"A vangliatna nasepte hangin amah phat un; tehpih bei ama liatna hangin amah phat un.","ref":"Tp 3:24"},"3":{"text":"Pengkul ging tawh amah phat unla, harp le lyre in amah phat un,","ref":"Ms 10:2; Ph 57:8"},"4":{"text":"khuangta le lamna-in amah phat unla khausaite le tamngai-in amah phat un;","ref":"Pk 15:20; Ph 45:8"},"5":{"text":"daltuahte tumin amah phat unla a thawn kik daltuah tawh amah phat un.","ref":"2Sa 6:5"},"6":{"text":"A huusang peuhmah in TOPA phat uh hen. TOPA phat un."}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Paunakte","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon’ paunakte:","title":"Thupatna: Athu le Ngimna"},"2":{"text":"Pilna le sektatna ngah nading, thu laigilte theihtel nading;"},"3":{"text":"kisekin kidawmin nungta a, thumaan thutang tawh kilawm kituaka sep nading;","ref":"Pn 8:5"},"4":{"text":"mimawlte kidopsak nading, khangmoite tungah theihna le theihkakna piak nading -","ref":"Pn 8:12; Pn 22:17"},"7":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in theihna kipatna hi-a, mihaite a in ahileh pilna le sektatna a thusim kei uh hi.","ref":"Pn 9:7-9"},"8":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na pa hong lamlahna ngai inla na nu hong hilhna nusia kei in.","title":"Pilna Pom dinga Kalhnate Zolna Zuih loh ding Vauhilhna","ref":"Tp 21:18"},"9":{"text":"Amaute na lu a kilawmsak gualzawhna pakkhi hi-in, na ngawng zepna khi ahi ding hi.","ref":"Pn 3:21-22"},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, mawhneite in hong zol leh amau zolna zui kei in."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Ko hong zui in; mi khatpeuh sisan suah dingin va pang ni, mi ommuang khat va busim ni;","ref":"Ph 10:8"},"12":{"text":"hankhuk b bangin va hingvalh ni, gum sunga lawmkhiat va bangsak ni;","ref":"Ph 35:25"},"13":{"text":"tua hileh na manpha namkim ngahin vansuh tawh i inn i dim ding hi;"},"14":{"text":"ko hong pawl inla, sumbawm nei khawm ni\" - hong cih uh leh"},"15":{"text":"ka tapa aw, amaute zui kei inla, amaute’ lampi tawn kei in;","ref":"Pc 49:6"},"16":{"text":"ahang in, a khe uh a mawh dingin manlang a, sisan suah dingin kinawh hi.","ref":"Pn 6:18"},"17":{"text":"Vasate muh tangpi-a lenthang kam a mawknapi hi lo hiam!"},"18":{"text":"Hih mite amau sisan suah ding ngaka bok hi lel a; amau le amau kibuksim uh hi lel hi.","ref":"Ph 71:10"},"19":{"text":"Amaan lo a ngah a sawm mi khempeuh tawpna hih bangte hi-a; tua bang a ngahte a nuntakna un sawng hi.","ref":"Pn 11:19"},"20":{"text":"Kongzing ah pilna nakpi-in kiko-a, tual-awng ah a aw sangsak hi;","ref":"Job 28:12","title":"Pilna Nolh loh ding Vauhilhna"},"21":{"text":"kongzing c gamlumna munah kikokhia a, khuapi kongpite ah thu genin:"},"22":{"text":"\"No mimawlte d aw, bang tanvei mawl sawm lai na hi uh hiam? Misimmawhte in bang tanvei simmawhna nuamsa in, mihaite in theihna mudah lai ding hiam?","ref":"Pn 6:32"},"23":{"text":"Kong thuhilhna thupisim hi lecin ka lungsim na tungah hong sungin, ka ngaihsutnate nang kong theisak ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi hangin kong sap lai-in nong nial uh a, ka khut ka zan lai-in kuamah in nong awlmawh loh nungsangun,","ref":"Isa 65:12; 1Sa 8:19"},"25":{"text":"kongthumuapna khempeuh thusim loin kong taihilhna na man’ loh nungsangun,"},"26":{"text":"kei zong na tuahsiatna uh kong nuihsan lel dinga; vangsiatna in note hong phak ciang -","ref":"Ph 2:4; Tp 28:36"},"27":{"text":"vangsiatna in huihpi banga hong phak ciang, tuahsiatna in pingpei banga hong zialmang ciang, lungkhamna le lungdonna in hong tuamcip ciangin, kong simmawhbawl lai ding hi.","ref":"Ph 18:18"},"28":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin amaute in kei hong sam ding uh a, ka dawng kei ding hi; kei hong zong ding uh a, hong mu kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 27:9"},"29":{"text":"Amaute in theihna mudah in, TOPA kihtak ding a teel loh nungsangun,"},"30":{"text":"ka kuppihna sang loin ka taihilhna a nawlkhin nungsangun,","ref":"Job 21:14"},"31":{"text":"amau gamtatna gah ne ding uh a, amau geelsimnate gah kham ding uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:16"},"32":{"text":"Mimawlte in amau mottatna sihlawh ding uh a, mihaite in a thudonlohna uh sihlawh ding uh hi;"},"33":{"text":"ahi hangin ka thu a ngai peuhmah siat ding launa nei loin lungmuangin om hithiat ding uh hi,\"a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 112:8"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka kammalte na san a, ka thupiakte na sungah na khol leh,","title":"Pilna hang Phattuamnate","ref":"Pn 1:8"},"2":{"text":"pilna lamah na bil ngatin, na lungsimin theihtel na sawm leh,","ref":"Pr 22:7"},"3":{"text":"thuthuk samin, awngin theihtelna na sap leh,","ref":"Jas 1:5"},"4":{"text":"ngun bangin na zon a, a kisel gou bangin na zon leh,","ref":"Job 3:21"},"5":{"text":"tua ciangin TOPA kihtakna na thei pan dinga, Pasian theihna na mu ding hi.","ref":"Tp 4:6"},"6":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in pilna pia-a, a kam panin theihna le theihtelna a pusuak hi.","ref":"Job 9:4"},"7":{"text":"Amah in a thutang mi adingin gualzawhna kholsak-a, a kawkbaang lo-a kalsuan mi adingin lum ahi hi;","ref":"Pc 6:9"},"8":{"text":"amah in thutangte gamtatna cinga, ama tunga muanhuaite’ lampi a hu hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:9"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin thumaan thutang le a kilawm a kituak lampi hoih bang hiam cih na theitel ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahang in na lungsim ah pilna hong lut dinga, na hinna in theihna nuam a sa ding hi.","ref":"Pn 14:33"},"11":{"text":"Theihkakna in nang hong hu dinga, theihtelna in nang hong cing ding hi.","ref":"Pn 4:6"},"12":{"text":"Pilna in migilote lam pan, thu lehgen mite pan,","ref":"Pn 4:5"},"13":{"text":"lampi tang nusia a, khuamial lampi a tawnte pan,","ref":"Pn 4:19"},"14":{"text":"khialna bawl nuam sate le gilo-a lehtatna-a pan,","ref":"Pn 5:16"},"17":{"text":"a neulawm nusia a, Pasian a mai-a a thuciam a thusim lo numei panin zong hong honkhia ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahang in, tuanu inn in sihna ah hong pi a, a lampi in misite khate lam zuan hi.","ref":"Pn 5:5"},"19":{"text":"Tuanu kianga paite kuamah kileh kik lo-in, nuntakna lam a tawn kei uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua bangin mihoihte lampi na zui dinga, a thumaante lampi na tawn ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahang in, thutangte leitungah teng dinga, a kawkbaang lote, a teng den ding uh hi;","ref":"Ph 37:29"},"22":{"text":"ahi zongin migilote leitung panin kibotkhia dinga, a muanhuai lote a kibalsat ding hi.","ref":"Ph 5:4; Tp 28:36"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, kong hilhna mangngilh kei inla, ka thupiakte na lungsim ah kem in.","title":"Pilna hanga Phattuam Thuahnate","ref":"Ph 44:17"},"2":{"text":"tuate in na khan kum tampi sotin na dau paisak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 11:21"},"3":{"text":"Itna le muanhuaina khahsuah kei in; na ngawng kimkotah vial inla; na lungtang pek tungah gelh in.","ref":"Pk 13:9"},"4":{"text":"Tua hileh Pasian le mihing muhna ah angvanna le minpha na ngah ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:26"},"5":{"text":"Na lungsim khempeuhin TOPA muang inla, nang theihtelna tungah kinga kei in;","ref":"Ph 4:5"},"6":{"text":"na gamtatna khempeuh ah amah phawk in, tua hileh na lampi tangsak b ding hi.","ref":"Ph 5:8"},"7":{"text":"Nang kimuhna ah pil kisa kei in; TOPA kihta inla, gitlohna peel in.","ref":"Pn 26:5; Pk 20:20"},"8":{"text":"Hih in na pumpi adingin thamalhna hi dinga, na guhte adingin malhna hi ding hi.","ref":"Ph 38:3; Job 21:24"},"9":{"text":"Na hauhna le na ankung khempeuh-a gahmasa-in TOPA pahtawi in;","ref":"Pk 22:29"},"10":{"text":"tua hileh na saal dimlet dinga, na lenggah sukna beel ah zuthak a dimlet ding hi.","ref":"Ph 144:13"},"11":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, TOPA hong sekna thusim lo kei inla, ama hong taihilhna hehsan kei in,","ref":"Job 5:17"},"12":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh pa in a pahtak tapa a sek bangin TOPA in a itte sek a hi.","ref":"Tp 8:5; Pn 13:24"},"13":{"text":"Pilna mu a, theihtelna a ngahpa thupha ngah ahi hi;"},"14":{"text":"tua in ngun sangin met theizaw a, kham sangin a gahsuahzaw hi.","ref":"Job 28:15"},"15":{"text":"Ruby sangin manphazaw a; nang deihtheih khatpeuh tawh kiteh thei lo hi.","ref":"Job 28:18"},"16":{"text":"A taklam khut ah khansauna om a; a veilam khut ah hauhna le pahtawina a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama lampi nuam a, a lampi khempeuh kilemna ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah a pom mi adingin nuntakna singkung hi-a, amah a lenden mi in thupha a ngah ding hi.","ref":"Pn 2:12"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in pilna tawh leitung bulpi phut a, ama theihtelna tawh a mun takah vantungte a koih hi.","ref":"Pn 8:27"},"20":{"text":"Ama theihna-in tuithukte kikhen a, meiite in daitui a kiasak hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, akip thukhenna le theihkakna len inla, tuate en gige in;","ref":"Pn 1:8-9; Pn 4:20-22"},"22":{"text":"tuate nang adingin nuntakna hi dinga, na ngawng a kilawmsak kizepna hi ding hi.","ref":"Pn 1:8-9"},"23":{"text":"Tua hileh lungmuangin na nungta dinga, na muktu kei ding hi;","ref":"Pn 1:33; Ph 37:24"},"24":{"text":"na lup ciangin na lau kei dinga; na ihmut a nuam ding hi.","ref":"Ph 91:5"},"25":{"text":"Bingtuahsiatna kihta kei inla migilote tunga tung tuahsiatna zong kihta kei in,"},"26":{"text":"ahang in nang khamuanna TOPA hi dinga, thanga awk lo dingin na khe a kem ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:5; Job 5:19"},"27":{"text":"Nang hih zawh ding ahileh huh tuakte huh ding lungsit kei in."},"28":{"text":"Tu-a na neih gige pi mah - na vengpa kiangah, \"Hong pai kik in; zing ciang hong pia ning,\" ci kei in.","ref":"Sp 19:13"},"29":{"text":"Nang hong muanga na kianga teng na vengpa nat nadingin sawmsim kei in.","ref":"Zec 8:17"},"30":{"text":"Nang hong nasak lo mipa tungah a thu om lopi-in mawhsak kei in."},"31":{"text":"A ngongtat mi eng kei inla a gamtatzia zong teel kei in;"},"32":{"text":"ahang in, a lehtat mi TOPA in kih a, a thutang mi a muang hi.","ref":"Ph 101:4; Job 29:4"},"33":{"text":"TOPA in migilote’ inn hamsiat-a, a thumaante innsung thupha a pia hi.","ref":"Ph 37:22"},"34":{"text":"Amah in a kiphasak mi simmawhte simmawh a, a kiniamkhiatte a hehpih hi.","ref":"Ph 18:25-27"},"35":{"text":"Mipilte in pahtawina luah uh a, mihaite ahileh kimaizumsak hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapate aw, pate lamlahna ngai unla, thusimin theihtelna ngah un.","title":"Pilna mah Thupipen","ref":"Job 8:10"},"2":{"text":"Sinna picing kong pia hi; kong hilhna nawlkhin kei un."},"3":{"text":"Ka nu ta neihsunin ka pa inn ah naupang moi-a ka om lai-in"},"4":{"text":"amah in, \"Na lungsim neih zahin ka thute lenkip inla, ka thupiakte zui lecin na nungta ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:4; Pn 7:4"},"5":{"text":"Pilna ngahin theihtelna ngah in; ka thugente mangngilh kei inla, pialkhiatsan kei in.","ref":"Pn 2:12"},"6":{"text":"Pilna pialsan kei lecin ama’n hong dal dinga, amah it lecin ama’n nang hong cing ding hi.","ref":"Pn 2:11"},"7":{"text":"Pilna thupipen ahi manin pilna zong in. Na neih khempeuh b na bei lawh zongin theihtelna zong in.","ref":"Pn 23:23"},"8":{"text":"Pilna thupisak in, nang hong tawisang ding hi; amah pom in, nang hong pahtawi ding hi.","ref":"Pn 3:18"},"9":{"text":"Na lutang ah kilawmna pakkhi hong khimsak dinga, a thupi kumpi lukhu hong khusak ding hi,\" hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ngai-in ka thugen sang in; na khan sawt ding hi.","ref":"Ph 34:11; Tp 11:21"},"11":{"text":"Na pil nading lammaan ah kong pi a, lamtang kong zuisak hi.","ref":"2Sa 22:37"},"12":{"text":"Na pai ciangin na kalsuanna hong dal om lo ding hi. na tai ciangin na kimuktu kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 18:7"},"13":{"text":"Lamlahna lenkip inla khahsuah kei in; na nuntak nading ahi manin limtakin cing in.","ref":"Pn 3:22"},"14":{"text":"Migilote’ lampi tawn kei inla, mikheltatte’ lampi zui kei in.","ref":"Ph 1:1"},"15":{"text":"Tua lampi pel inla, tawn kei in; tua pan kiheikhia inla, nang lampi ah pai in."},"16":{"text":"Migilote a sia khat a bawl mateng ihmu thei lo uh a, mi khatpeuh a puksak matengun a ihsip kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 6:4"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in gitlohna annekin nei uh a, ngongtatna zudawnin a nei uh hi.","ref":"Pc 49:5"},"18":{"text":"Thumaan mite’ lampi ahileh ni suak tung nizang banga, sun nitang a bat dong a tangpha semsem hi.","ref":"Job 22:28; 2Sa 23:4"},"19":{"text":"Ahi hangin migilote’ lampi khuamial thukpi banga; amau in a muktusak a thei kei uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka thugen thusim inla, ka kammalte limtakin ngai in.","ref":"Ph 34:11"},"21":{"text":"Mitkhah loin en gige inla na lung sungah kem in;"},"22":{"text":"a mute adingin tuate nuntakna hi-a, mihing khat pumpi bup adingin damna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 3:8"},"23":{"text":"Lungtang in nuntakna nak ahi manin na khempeuh sangin lim kep zaw in.","ref":"2Ku 10:31; Pn 10:11"},"24":{"text":"Na kam panin thukawi paukhia kei inla; na muk panin kam hoih lo pau kei in."},"25":{"text":"Na mailam tangtakin en inla na mailam mah mitsuan gige in.","ref":"Job 31:1"},"26":{"text":"Na zuih lampi maihtam a inla, a kipte bek tawn in.","ref":"Heb 12:13"},"27":{"text":"Taklam le veilam ah pial kei inla, gitlohna lampi tawn kei in.","ref":"Sp 10:11"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka pilna thusim inla, ka thu laigilte limtakin ngai in;","title":"Angkawmna Thu Vauhilhna","ref":"Pn 1:8; Pn 4:30"},"2":{"text":"tua hileh kidop na siam dinga, na muk in theihna a kem thei ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahang in angkawmnu’ muk khuaizu-a diahsa banga, a kampau sathau sangin zolzaw hi;","ref":"Ph 55:21"},"4":{"text":"ahi zongin a tawpna ah tuanu, sinkha bangin kha-a, langnih a hiam namsau bangin hiam hi.","ref":"Thn 7:26"},"5":{"text":"Amah sihna lam manawhin paisuk a, tangtakin hankhuk b a zuan hi.","ref":"Ph 9:17"},"6":{"text":"Nuntakna lampi ngaihsun lo-a; a lampi a kawi hangin a thei kei hi.","ref":"Ph 9:13"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka tapate aw, tu-in ka thu ngai un; ka genna pan pial kei un.","ref":"Pn 1:8-9"},"8":{"text":"Tuanu gamlapi ah peel unla, a inn kongkhak kiang tawn kei un,"},"9":{"text":"tua hi kei leh na thahatpenna uh midangte na pia ding uh a, na hun om lai teng uh a kheltatpa na pia kha ding uh hi;"},"10":{"text":"tua hi kei leh gamdang mite in nang neihsa-in pawi bawl ding uh a, gimpi-a na sepsate in midang khat a hausak ding hi.","ref":"Pn 29:3"},"11":{"text":"Na nuntakna nunung lam, na guhtui a kan ciangin na mau ding hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Bangci in sektatna mudahin, kibawl phat ding pampaih ka hiam!","ref":"Pn 12:1"},"13":{"text":"Ka siate thu ka mang kei-a, lam hong lakte thu ka ngai kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu inlah mi kikhawm honpi bup lakah kisiatna dawn ka tungta hi,\" na ci ding hi.","ref":"Pn 1:24-27; Pn 31:3"},"15":{"text":"Nangma tuibeel pan le nangma tuiluang khuk panin dawn in."},"16":{"text":"Kongzingte ah na tuinakte letkhia-in, na luituite tual-awng ah letkhia ding ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Nang kia aa bek hi henla, mikhualte tawh neikhawm kei in."},"18":{"text":"Na tuikhuk in thupha ngah henla, na moi lai-a na zi tawh nuamsa in.","ref":"Zai 4:12-15"},"19":{"text":"A ithuai sazukpi, a hehpih siam sazuk tal- a nawite in tai den inla a itna in na lung kuai den hen."},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, bang hangin angkawmnu khat matcipsa-in om na hi hiam? Bang hangin midang khat zi’ angkawi ding na hi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in mi khat nuntakna mu khin kiuhkeuh a, a lampite khempeuh a sittel hi.","ref":"Job 10:4"},"22":{"text":"Migilopa, ama gamtatna hoih lo ah awk a, a mawhna khaute in gakcip hi.","ref":"Ph 9:16; Ms 32:23"},"23":{"text":"Amah in a kisek zawhlohnate sihlawh dinga, ama hailuatna in pimang ding hi.","ref":"Job 34:21-25"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na vengpa tangin mawhlawh tawi dingin na om a, midang khat tangin kiciamna khut beng-a","title":"Haina Thu Vauhilhna","ref":"Pn 17:18"},"2":{"text":"na kampausa ah awkin, na kampaute in hong mat leh"},"3":{"text":"tua ciangin ka tapa aw, na vengpa khut sung tungkhin na hi manin, na suahtak na’ngin: Pai-in nang mahmah kiniamkhiat in; na vengpa tungah thum tentan in."},"4":{"text":"Lusu kei inla ihmu kha kei in."},"5":{"text":"Sabengpa khut panin suakta sanang bang, thangsiahpa’ thang pana suakta vasa bangin, nang le nang kisuahtak in.","ref":"2Sa 2:18; Ph 91:3"},"6":{"text":"Thadahpa aw, miksi kiangah pai-in a nuntakzia ngaihsunin pil in!","ref":"Pn 20:4"},"7":{"text":"Tua in makaipa, a cingpa ahikeh a ukpa nei lo hi;"},"8":{"text":"tua hi napi anlak hunin an kaikhawm a, khuakhal lai-in an a khol hi.","ref":"Pn 10:4"},"9":{"text":"Nang thadahpa aw, bang tanvei lum lai ding na hiam? Na lupna pan cik ciangin tho ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Pn 24:30-34"},"10":{"text":"Tomkha ihmut sung, tomkha mengmet sungin, tomkha khut zepa khawl sungin -","ref":"Pn 24:33"},"11":{"text":"misuampa bangin zawnna hong tung dinga, galhiam tawipa a bangin taksapna in hong pha ding hi.","ref":"Pn 20:13"},"12":{"text":"Misia, mi tatkhelpa zuauphuakin vak kawikawi a,"},"13":{"text":"a mit phoisakin a kheginin lak a, a khutmete tangsakin","ref":"Isa 58:9"},"14":{"text":"a lungsim ah khem a sawmsimpa - amah in kitotna piangsak den hi.","ref":"Ph 140:2"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi manin siatna in bing phak dinga, a kibawlpha thei lo dingin thakhatin a kisia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 55:15; Pn 14:32"},"16":{"text":"TOPA in a muhdah na guk om a, kihuai a sak na sagih om hi,"},"17":{"text":"tuate in: Kihihsakna mit, a zuauthei leii, mawhpeng sisan a luangsak khut,","ref":"Job 41:34; Pn 12:22; Tp 19:10"},"18":{"text":"gitloh a sawm lungtang, gitloh hih dinga kinawh khete,","ref":"Job 15:31"},"19":{"text":"zuauthu gen-a teci pangte le sanggamte laka mi helhotpa ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 19:16; Pn 15:18"},"20":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na pa thupiakte zui inla, na nu hong hilhte nawlkhin kei in.","ref":"Pn 3:21","title":"Angkawmna Thu Vauhilhna"},"21":{"text":"Na lungtang ah khihden inla, na ngawng kimkot ah gakden in.","ref":"Tp 6:8"},"22":{"text":"Na paina peuh ah hong pi-in, na ihmut ciangin hong vil dinga; na khanlawh ciangin hong hopih ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Hih thupiakte meivak hi-a, hih hilhna khuavak hi-in, kipuahphat nadinga kisekna in nuntakna lampi hi-in,","ref":"Pn 10:17"},"24":{"text":"numei zuautatte panin nang hong kem dinga, uklah zi’ kamkhum panin nang hong kem ding hi.","ref":"Pc 39:8"},"25":{"text":"Ama melhoihna iplah kei inla, hong zawlmitna khenglah kei in;"},"26":{"text":"ahang in, numei kizuaknu in anlum khat zahin na man kiamsak dinga, angkawmnu in na nuntakna mahmah a sialnek ding hi.","ref":"Pn 7:22"},"27":{"text":"Mi khat in a puan kangsak loin mei-am pom thei ding ahi hiam?"},"28":{"text":"Mi khat in a khe kangdulhsak loin meiholsa tungah pai thei ding ahi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Midang khat zi a luppihpa tua tawh a kibang hi-a; tuanu a lawngkha peuhmah in dan tuak loin a om kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"A puksi dektak gutapa in a gilpi puah nading a guk leh tua gutapa a kisimmawh kei hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua hi napi amah a kimat leh a inn-a a neihsa teng a bei zongin a zah sagih in a loh pelmawh ding ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 32:1-14"},"32":{"text":"Ahi hangin angkawmpa in thukhentelna a thei lo hi-a, tua banga gamta mi amah le amah kisusia ahi hi."},"33":{"text":"Ama lawhtak vuakna le minsiatna hi-a, a maizumna a veng ngei kei ding hi;","ref":"Pn 5:9-14"},"34":{"text":"ahang in, hazatna in pisalsa khat hehna khangsak a, a phu a lak ciangin a lainat kei ding hi.","ref":"Pc 34:7"},"35":{"text":"Amah in a tanga sum piak sang loin, golhsum tampitak a piak hangin a nolh ding hi."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka thute kem inla, ka thupiakte na sungah khol in.","title":"Angkawmnu Thu Vauhilhna"},"2":{"text":"Ka thupiakte kem lecin na nungta ding hi; kong hilhte na mit nauta bangin cing in.","ref":"Pn 4:4"},"3":{"text":"Na khutmete ah vial in; na lungtang pek tungah gelh in.","ref":"Pn 3:3"},"4":{"text":"Pilna kiangah, \"Ka sanggamnu na hi hi,\" ci inla, theihtelna na tanau-in man in;"},"5":{"text":"amaute in angkawmnu panin nang hong kem ding uh a, uklah zi kamzol panin hong kem ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 31:9"},"6":{"text":"Ka inn tawhlet a vathangheng vangah ka khuadak hi;"},"7":{"text":"mimawlte lak, tangvalnote lakah thukhenteltheihna a nei lo khangno khat ka mu hi.","ref":"Pn 1:22"},"8":{"text":"Amah tuanu innkiu lampi ah paisuk a, tuanu inn lam manawhin a pai hi;"},"9":{"text":"tua hunin ni tumta a, khua mui-in khua mialta hi.","ref":"Job 24:15"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kizuak numei bangin a kizem numei khat ngim siamna khat neisa-in amah dawn dingin a kuankhia hi."},"11":{"text":"(Tuanu suahngalin thumang lo-a, inn ah a om hithiat ngei kei hi;"},"12":{"text":"kongzing lak, tual awngte le mun kiu teng ah mi a buk hi.)"},"13":{"text":"Tuanu in amah mancipin tawpa, maingaltakin:","ref":"Pc 39:12; Pn 1:20"},"14":{"text":"\"Ka innah kilawmtakna biakna a ka bawl a; tuni-in ka thuciam ka tangtun hi.","ref":"Sp 7:1-18"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in nang muak dingin kong pusuak hi; kong zon leh kong mu ta hi!"},"16":{"text":"Ka lupna Egypt pana puangial hoihin ka tuam khin hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka lupna, myrrh, aloes le cinnamon gimnamtuite in ka namsak khin hi.","ref":"Pc 37:25"},"18":{"text":"Hong pai in, zingsang dong itna tui dawnkhawm ni; eigel kia in itna nuamzat ni!","ref":"Pc 39:7"},"19":{"text":"Ka pasal inn ah om lo hi; khual gamlapi-a zin ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A sum-ip dimin sum pua-a, khaliik mateng inn ah hong ciah lo ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Zolna kam in amah lampialsak a, ama kamnel in a khem zo hi."},"22":{"text":"Amah a kigawh nading mun zuan bawngtal bang, thaltang in a sin a sutlet dong a awk nading khaukual b zuan sazuk c bang","ref":"Job 18:10; Job 15:22"},"23":{"text":"vasa in thang a bawh bangin bawh a, a nuntakna bei nading ahilam a thei kei hi.","ref":"Pn 6:26"},"24":{"text":"Tua hi-a ka tapate aw, tu in na ngai un; ka thugen thupisim un.","ref":"Pn 1:8-9"},"25":{"text":"Tua numei lam ngaihsun kei unla, a lampi pialsan un."},"26":{"text":"Tuanu in mi tampitak liamsuah a, a thahte mi thahat ngentang ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Ama inn han d lam zuatna lam lianpi hi-a, sihna inndei sung tunna ahi hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in hong sam hi lo hiam? Theihtelna in a aw sangsak hi lo hiam?","title":"Pilna In Sam"},"2":{"text":"Lampi dunga asanna mun teng, lamkabom tengah panmun la-in;"},"3":{"text":"khuapi sung zuatna kongpite gei, a sung lutna ah tuanu nakpi-in kiko a:","ref":"Pn 7:6-13"},"4":{"text":"\"No mihingte aw, kong sam hi; minam khempeuh tungah ka aw ka sangsak hi."},"5":{"text":"No mimawlte aw, kidop siamna ngah un, no mihaite aw, theihtelna ngah un.","ref":"Pn 1:22"},"6":{"text":"Ngai un, a manpha nate kong gen hi; thumaan gen dingin ka kamka hi."},"7":{"text":"Ka muk in gitlohna kih ahi manin ka kam in thumaan gen hi.","ref":"Jn 8:14"},"8":{"text":"Ka kammal khempeuh thutang hi-a, thukawi le thu kitukalh khat beek a om kei hi."},"9":{"text":"A theisiamte adingin thumaan vive hi a, theihna neite adingin khialhna a om kei hi."},"10":{"text":"Kong lamlahna ngun tangin teel unla, kham tangin theihna teel un,","ref":"Job 28:17"},"11":{"text":"ahang in, ruby sangin pilna manphazaw a, na deih theih na khat beek tehpih ding om lo hi.","ref":"Job 28:7-19"},"12":{"text":"\"Keimah pilna in, kidop siamna tawh ka tengkhawm a, theihna le theihkaknate ka nei hi.","ref":"Pn 1:4"},"13":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in gitlohna muhdahna hi-a: kei in kisaktheihna, ki-uatsakna, gitloh-gamtatna le kampau-kawi ka mudah hi.","ref":"Pk 20:20"},"14":{"text":"Thu kikuppih le amaana thukhenna kei aa hi-a; theihtelna le vangliatna kei aa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 9:4"},"15":{"text":"Kei tungtawnin kumpite in uk uh a, gam-ukte in thutangin ngeina a bawl uh hi.","ref":"Ph 2:10"},"16":{"text":"Kumpi tapate le leitunga e upna nei ulian khempeuh in kei tungtawnin uk uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Kei hong itte ka it a, kei hong zongte in hong mu uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 16:11"},"18":{"text":"Hauhna le pahtawina, hauhna kip le daupaina kei aa ahi hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:13; Tp 8:18"},"19":{"text":"Kham siangsa sangin kei gah hoihzaw a, ngun hoih pen sangin kei gahsuah hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Job 28:17-19; Pn 3:13-14"},"20":{"text":"Thutang lampi zui-in thumaanna lampi ka tawna,","ref":"Ph 5:8; Pn 15:6"},"21":{"text":"kei hong itte hausakin amaute goukholna ka dimsak hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA in tanglai-a a nasepte f a sep ma, a nasepte sung panin kei g hong piangkhiasak masa hi."},"23":{"text":"Leitung a om ma, atung pek pan, a tawntungin kei a sehsa h ka hi hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuipi a om ma, tuinakte pan tui a luan ma-in kei ka suak khin hi;"},"25":{"text":"mualneute le mualliante a mun dingah a kikoih ma,","ref":"Job 38:6; Job 15:7"},"26":{"text":"leitung le a tunga lote, leitang vuite khatpeuh a bawl ma-in kei hong kisuaksak zo hi.","ref":"Ph 90:2"},"27":{"text":"Vantungte a mun ah a koih lai tuithuk tunga muhtawp a ciamteh lai,","ref":"Job 26:7; Job 22:14"},"28":{"text":"tunglam ah meiite koiha, tuithuk nakte a kipsak lai,","ref":"Job 36:29"},"29":{"text":"tuite in ama thupiakna val a kal loh nadingin tuipi gamgi a khun lai le leitung bulpi ding a ciamteh lai-in, tua lai-ah kei ka om khin hi.","ref":"Pc 1:9"},"30":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in a gei-ah khutsiampa in ka om hi. Nisimin nuam ka sa mahmah a, ama ompihna ah kipak tawntungin,","ref":"Pn 3:19-20"},"31":{"text":"ama leitung buppi ah kipakin mihingte lak nuam ka sa hi."},"32":{"text":"\"Tua hi-a ka tapate aw, ka thu ngai un; ka lampi a zuite thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 7:24; 2Sa 22:22"},"33":{"text":"Kong lamlahna ngai inla pil in; thusim lo kei in."},"34":{"text":"Ka thu ngai-a ka kongkhakte nisimin vila, ka kongvang ah a ngak mi thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"1Ku 10:8"},"35":{"text":"Ahang in kei hong zong peuhmah in nuntakna mu hi-a, TOPA angvanna a ngah hi.","ref":"Ph 9:6; Job 33:26"},"36":{"text":"Kei hong zong lo mi ahileh amah le amah kinasak hi-a, kei hong mudah khempeuh sihna it ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 15:32; Job 28:22"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pilna in khuampi sagihte sui khin a; a inn lam khin hi;","title":"Pilna le Haina Sapna","ref":"Eph 2:20-22"},"2":{"text":"Amah in sasem khinin, zu leih khin a; a sabuai zong phah khin hi."},"3":{"text":"A innteng numeite sawlkhia khin a, khuapi sung bosangpenna mun tengah a kikosak hi.","ref":"Pn 1:20"},"4":{"text":"\"Thu khentel thei lote kiangah, \"Mimawl khempeuh hih lai-ah hong paisak un!\"","ref":"Pn 1:22"},"5":{"text":"\"Hong pai-in ka an ne unla, ka leihsa zu dawn un.","ref":"Ph 42:2"},"6":{"text":"Na haina nusia lecin na nungta ding hi; theihtelna lampi tawn in.","ref":"Pn 8:35; Pn 3:1-2"},"7":{"text":"\"Mi simmawhte a puahpha peuhmah engkona sam hi-a; migilote a tai peuhmah engkona kitut ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 23:9"},"8":{"text":"Mi simmawh khat tai kei in, hong mudah ding hi; mipil khat tai lecin hong it ding hi.","ref":"Pn 15:12; Ph 141:5"},"9":{"text":"Mipil khat lamlak lecin pil semsem dinga; thumaan mi khat hilh lecin a theihna behlap ding hi.","ref":"Pn 1:5,7"},"10":{"text":"\" TOPA kihtakna in pilna kipatna hi-a, Siangtho Pa theihna in theihtelna ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahang in, kei tungtawnin na khan sawt dinga, na nuntak kum kibehlap ding hi.","ref":"Pc 15:15"},"12":{"text":"Na pil leh pilna pahtakman na sang dinga; mi na simmawh leh nang guak in na thuak ding hi,\" ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Numei Hai nak pau-a; amah kisek thei loin theihna nei lo ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"A inn kongkhak ah tu-in, khuapi bosangpen tutphah ah tu-a,","ref":"Eze 16:25"},"15":{"text":"amau santek-a pai tua lai tawnte a sam hi.","ref":"Pn 1:20"},"16":{"text":"Thu a khentel thei lo mite kiangah, \"Mimawl khempeuh hih lai-ah hong pai un!\"","ref":"Pn 1:22"},"17":{"text":"\"Guksim tui khum a, an neksim lim diak hi!\" ci hi.","ref":"Pn 20:27"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute in tua lai-ah misite om a, ama lenglate hanthukpi a sungah om ahilam a thei kei uh hi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon’ paunakte: Tapa pil in a pa lungnuamsak a, tapa hai in ahileh a nu dahsak hi.","title":"Solomon’ Paunakte","ref":"Pn 15:20"},"2":{"text":"Amaan lo-a ngah goute in man nei lo a, thumaanna in ahileh sihna panin hukhia hi.","ref":"PN 13:11; Pn 11:4"},"3":{"text":"TOPA in a thumaante gilkialsak lo a, migilote deihluatna a khaktansak hi.","ref":"Pn 13:25"},"4":{"text":"A thadah khut in, mi zawngsak a, a thanuam khut in ahileh hauhna a tun hi.","ref":"Pn 6:6-8; Pn 12:24"},"5":{"text":"Nipi lai-a an khawmpa tapa pil hi-a, anlak huna lumpa ahileh a zahlak tapa ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 24:30-34"},"6":{"text":"A thumaante in thupha khu uh a, migilote b kam in ngongtatna bekbek a gen hi.","ref":"Pn 12:13"},"7":{"text":"A thumaante phawkna thupha hi dinga, migilote min ahileh a muat ding hi.","ref":"Job 18:17"},"8":{"text":"Lungpil mi in thupiak sang thei a, mihai kamtam in ahileh siatna a thuak hi.","ref":"Job 33:33"},"9":{"text":"A citak mi pai hiathiat a, thukawi bawl mi ahileh a kiphawkkhia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 37:24"},"10":{"text":"Mi mitsiik-atpa in lungkhamna tuak a, mihai kamtam in siatna tuak hi.","ref":"Ph 35:19"},"11":{"text":"Thumaan mite kam nuntakna tuikhuk hi-a, migilote kam ahileh ngongtatna in a tuam hi.","ref":"Pn 17:9"},"12":{"text":"Muhdahna in kitotna piangsak a, itna in ahileh khialhna khempeuh khuhcip hi.","ref":"Pn 17:9"},"13":{"text":"Thu theikakte muk ah pilna kimu a, thukhentel lo pa nungzang in ciangduai a thuak hi.","ref":"Tp 25:2"},"14":{"text":"Mipil in theihna khol a, mihai kam in ahileh siatna a sam hi.","ref":"Ph 59:12"},"15":{"text":"Mihaute hauhna in amau kulh nei khuapi hi-a, mizawngte siatna ahileh zawnna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 18:11; Pn 19:7"},"16":{"text":"A thumaante thaman nuntakna hi a, migilote sumtum ahileh dantuahna ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 30:15; Pn 11:18-19"},"17":{"text":"Sektatna a thusim mi nuntakna lampi tawn hi-a, kipuahphat ding a awlmawh lo mi in ahileh midangte lam khialsak hi.","ref":"Pn 6:23"},"18":{"text":"A muhdahna a imte mi zuauphuak hi-a, mi gensiat hat peuhmah mihai ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 31:18"},"19":{"text":"Thu tampi genna ah mawhna kihel teitei a, a kam ip theite a pil ahi hi.","ref":"Job 1:22"},"20":{"text":"A thumaan mite leii ngun hoih pen hi-a, migilote lungsim ahileh man nei lo hi."},"21":{"text":"A thumaan mi muk in tampi vak a, mihaite ahi uh leh thukhenna a theih loh manun si uh hi.","ref":"Pn 5:22-23"},"22":{"text":"TOPA thupha in hauhna tun a, lunghimawhna a behlap kei hi.","ref":"2Kh 25:9"},"23":{"text":"Mihai in tatsiat nuamsa a, theihtelna nei mi in ahileh pilna a pakta hi.","ref":"Pn 2:14; Ph 37:4"},"24":{"text":"Migilo in a kihtak pen tuak dinga, a thumaante a deihdeih uh kipia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Huihpi in a nawk ciangin migilote mangthang a, a thumaante ahileh kiptakin ding den hi.","ref":"Ph 20:8"},"26":{"text":"Ha adingin lenggahtui thuk le mit adingin meikhu bangin a sawlpa adingin thadahte tua bang ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 13:17"},"27":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in nuntakna sotsak a, migilote nuntak kum a khiapsak hi.","ref":"Tp 11:9; Job 15:32"},"28":{"text":"A thumaante mailam hun lungnopna hi-a, migilote lametna ahileh a guaksuak hi.","ref":"Est 7:10"},"29":{"text":"TOPA lampi in thumaan mi belh hi-a, a tatsiate adingin ahileh kisiatna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 21:15"},"30":{"text":"A thumaante kibulkalh ngei lo dinga, migilote in ahileh ten nading mun a ngah zo kei ding uh hi"},"31":{"text":"A thumaan mi kam panin pilna suakkhia a, kamsia pauna leii a ki-attan ding hi.","ref":"Ph 52:4"},"32":{"text":"A thumaan mi muk in a kilawm thei a, migilo kam in ahileh thukawi bek thei hi.","ref":"Ph 59:7"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in tawisuang maan lo kiha tehna maan lian ahileh a lungkim hi.","ref":"Pn 16:11"},"2":{"text":"Kisaktheihna in hong maimawlsak a, kiniamkhiatna ahileh pilna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 18:12"},"3":{"text":"A citakte a cihtakna un makaih a, a muanhuai lote ahileh a zuautatna un susia hi.","ref":"Pn 13:6"},"4":{"text":"Thangpaih hunin hauhna in man nei lo a, thumaanna in ahileh sihna panin a hu hi.","ref":"Job 20:20; Pn 10:2"},"5":{"text":"Kawkbaanna om lo thumaanna in a mau adingin lamtang sialsak a, migilote ahileh amau gitlohna in a puksak hi.","ref":"Pn 5:21-23"},"6":{"text":"A thutangte’ thumaanna in a maute hu-a, a muanhuai lote ahileh amau lunggulhna hoih lo ah a awk uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilo khat a sih ciangin ama lametna mangthang a, a vangliatna pana ki-ummawh teng a guaksuak hi.","ref":"Job 8:13"},"8":{"text":"Thumaan mipa lungkhamna pan kihu a, ama tangin migilopa tungah tung hi.","ref":"Pn 21:18"},"9":{"text":"Pasian nei lopa kam in a vengpa susia a, theihna tungtawnin a thumaanpa suakta hi."},"10":{"text":"Thumaan mipa a daupai ciangin khuapi lungnuam a; migilo a manthan ciangin lungdam a kikona a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Thutang mi khat’ thupha tungtawnin khuapi kitawisang a, migilo kam hangin khuapi kisia hi."},"12":{"text":"Thu khencian thei lopa in a vengpa nuihsan a, thu theitelpa ahileh a ki-ip thei hi.","ref":"Job 6:24"},"13":{"text":"Mi kamtamte in thusim tehkha teitei a, a muantak mi in ahileh thu im hi.","ref":"Pn 20:19; Pn 10:14"},"14":{"text":"A kimakaih lo minam puk a, mi tampi thudot in gualzawhna kician a tun hi.","ref":"Pn 20:18; 2Sa 15:34"},"15":{"text":"Mel theih loh mi mawhna a puaksakpa in thuak pelmawh dinga, kiciamna-a khut beng nuam lopa a suakta ding hi.","ref":"Pn 17:18"},"16":{"text":"A dik numei kizahtak a, a hiamgamh pasal in ahileh hauhna bek a ngah hi.","ref":"Pn 31:31"},"17":{"text":"A migipa amahmah phattuamna hi-a, a kheltatpa ahileh amahmah siatna kitun ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilopa thalawh thaman in khemna hi-a, thumaanna a vawhpa in ahileh pahtakman at teitei hi.","ref":"Pk 1:20"},"19":{"text":"A thumaan taktak mi in nuntakna ngah a, gitlohna a delhpa in a sihlawh hi.","ref":"Tp 30:15; 1Sa 2:6"},"20":{"text":"TOPA in mihing lungsim lehtatte kih a, kawkbaang lo-a nungtate a pakta hi.","ref":"Pn 3:32; 1Kh 29:17"},"21":{"text":"Hih thu telcian in: Migilote in dan tuak loin a om kei ding hi; a thumaan mite ahileh a suakta ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 16:5"},"22":{"text":"A kidawm thei lo numei melhoih, vok naka kham nakbah bat tawh kibang hi."},"23":{"text":"A thumaante lunggulhna a hoih bekbek suak a, migilote lametna ahileh thangpaihna bek ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi khat in pia ziahziah napi, a tamzaw ngah a, adang khat cil tentan napi zawng semsem zaw hi."},"25":{"text":"A cingh mipa a daupai dinga, midang a thamalhsakte amau kithamalhsak ahi hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:17; Pn 22:9"},"26":{"text":"Antang kholkhol te kihamsiat a, a zuak nuamte thupha kikhusak hi."},"27":{"text":"A hoih zongte in deihsakna mu uh a, gitlohna a zongte tungah gitlohna mah a tung ding hi.","ref":"Ph 7:15-16"},"28":{"text":"A hauhna a muang peuhmah puk dinga, thumaanna ahileh singteh pha hing tawh kibang ding hi.","ref":"Job 31:24-28; Ph 52:8"},"29":{"text":"A innkuan tungah lunghimawhna a tun mi kihawmkhai dinga, mihaite, mipilte nasem a suak ding hi.","ref":"Pn 14:19"},"30":{"text":"Thumaanna gah in nuntakna singkung hi-a, mihing lungsim zo mi mipil ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 2:9"},"31":{"text":"Thumaante in leitung ah thaman sang uh ahileh a pasian-milote le mawhneite in tam sanzaw ngel ve!","ref":"Jer 25:29"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sektatna a it peuhmah theihna it hi a, puahphatna mudahte mihai ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 5:11-14"},"2":{"text":"Mi hoih in TOPA angvanna ngah a, zuauphuak mi ahileh TOPA in a mawhpaih hi.","ref":"Job 32:26; 2Sa 15:3"},"3":{"text":"Gitlohna tawh mi khat kikipsak thei lo a, thumaan mite lah a kibulkalh thei kei hi.","ref":"Pn 10:25"},"4":{"text":"A nampi gamtat zi in a pasal’ kumpi lukhu hi-a, a daisak zi ahileh a pasal guhsung muat tawh kibang hi."},"5":{"text":"A thumaante’ ngimna thutang a, migilote ngaihsut piakna zuaupi ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Migilote thugen sisan ngakin bok-a, a thutangte kampau in ahileh amaute hukhia hi."},"7":{"text":"Migilote kilawnthalin om nawn lo uh a, a thumaante’ inn ahileh a kip bikbek hi."},"8":{"text":"Mi khat a pilna tawh kituakin kiphat a, mi lungsim kawite ahileh kineu-et hi."},"9":{"text":"Nek ding nei lopi mi lian banga om sangin, kuama phawk khak loh-a nasem neih hoihzaw hi."},"10":{"text":"Thumaan mi in a ganhingte sapna thudon a, migilote in ahileh a doppenna uh khelbawlna suak hi."},"11":{"text":"Ama leitang a nasempa in an tampi nei dinga, sunmang peuh a geelgeelte thu khentel thei lo ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 28:19"},"12":{"text":"Migilote in mitatsiate van lawkding sawma, mi thumaante zung in gah a gah hi."},"13":{"text":"Migilopa, mawhna a dim ama thugen mah ah awk-a, mi thumaanpa ahileh lunghimawhna pan a suakta hi.","ref":"Ph 59:12; Pn 21:23"},"14":{"text":"Mi khat a muka a gah panin na hoih tawh kidima, a khuta na a sep laisiah pahtakman ngah tektek hi.","ref":"Pn 13:2"},"15":{"text":"Mihai khat lampi ama aa in aman tawh kibanga, mipil in ahileh mi thungaihsutpihna a ngai hi.","ref":"Pn 14:12; Pn 9:7-9"},"16":{"text":"Mihai in a hehna kilangsak paha, a kidawm thei mi in a ki-engkona awlmawh lo hi.","ref":"Job 5:2"},"17":{"text":"Thutak teci in thumaanin teci panga, zuau tecipa in zuauthu a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Kamkhauh in namsau bangin sunlet a, mipilte kampau in ahileh a damsak hi.","ref":"Ph 55:21; Pn 15:4"},"19":{"text":"Thutak gen muk kip dena, thuzuau gen leii ahileh tomvei sung bek kimang hi."},"20":{"text":"Gitloh sawmsimte lungsim ah zuauthu tenga, lemna a khangsakte ahileh a lungnuam hi.","ref":"Ro 14:19"},"21":{"text":"A thumaante in siatna tuak lo uh a, migilo ahileh a thuakkhop buaina in bawm hi.","ref":"Job 4:7"},"22":{"text":"TOPA in zuau genna muk kih a, mi thutakte a pakta hi.","ref":"Pn 11:20"},"23":{"text":"A kidawm thei mi in a theihna kem khinkhian a, mihaite lungtang in a haina pholaklak hi.","ref":"Ph 38:5"},"24":{"text":"A thanuam khutte in uk dinga, thadahna in ahileh mi sila a suaksak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:4"},"25":{"text":"Lunghimawhna in mi lunglelsak a, migit kam in ahileh ama lungtaisak hi.","ref":"Pn 15:13"},"26":{"text":"A thumaan mi kilawmtakdan siam a a migilo lampi in ahileh amaute lam pialsak hi.","ref":"Ph 95:10"},"27":{"text":"Mi thadah in a samatsa haang b nuam lo a, mi thanuamte neihsate ahileh manpha hi."},"28":{"text":"Thumaanna lampi ah nuntakna om a; tua lampi dungah siattheihna om lo hi.","ref":"Tp 30:15"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tapa pil in a pa lamlahna thusim a, mi simmawhte in ahileh taihilhna a ngai kei uh hi.","ref":"Pn 12:1"},"2":{"text":"Mihing in a muk gah pana na hoihte nopsakpih a, mi muanhuai lote in ahileh ngongtatna bek nuam sa uh hi."},"3":{"text":"A kam a kem zote a nuntakna kem hi-a, a mawk paute ahileh a kisia ding hi.","ref":"Pn 10:6; Job 1:22"},"4":{"text":"Thadah mi in lunggulh mahmah napi bangmah ngah lo a, thanuamte deihna ahileh cingtakin kipia hi.","ref":"Pn 21:25-26"},"5":{"text":"Thumaante in zuauthu mudah a, migilo in ahileh maizumna le mindaina a tun hi.","ref":"Ph 119:128"},"6":{"text":"Thumaanna in a citak mi cinga, gitlohna in mimawhpa a lawnthal hi.","ref":"Pn 11:3"},"7":{"text":"Mi khat zawng napi ahau kineih om a, mi dang khat hau mahmah napi, a zawng kineih om hi.","ref":"Kil 3:17; 2Co 6:10"},"8":{"text":"Mi khat a hauhna in a nuntakna tankhia thei a, mizawng khat in ahileh a kitawnna kam a za kei hi.","ref":"Pn 15:16"},"9":{"text":"A thumaante’ khuavak tangpha a, migilote’ meivak ahileh kisumit hi.","ref":"Job 18:5"},"10":{"text":"Kisaktheihna in kitotna bek piangsak a, pilna ahileh mi ngaihsutpihna a sang thei mi sungah kimu hi.","ref":"Pn 10:2"},"11":{"text":"A maan lo sum kiamkiam a, tawmtawma kholte’ sum khangkhang hi."},"12":{"text":"A tungpak lo lametna in lungsim nasak a, lunggulhna tangtunna ahileh nuntakna singkung ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 10:11"},"13":{"text":"Lamlahna a simmawh mi in thuak dinga, thupiakna a zahtak mi ahileh pahtakman kipia hi.","ref":"Ms 15:31"},"14":{"text":"Mipilte hilhna in nuntakna tuikhuk hi-a, sihna thang panin mi khat kipelhsak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:11; Pn 14:27"},"15":{"text":"Theihtelna hoih in angvanna lawhtak a, muanhuai lohna lampi ahileh haksa c hi."},"16":{"text":"A kidawm thei mi peuhmah theihna tawh gamta a, mihai in ahileh a haina pholak hi."},"17":{"text":"Migilo kamtaipa in buaina tuak a, a muantak palai in damna a puak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:26; Pn 25:13"},"18":{"text":"Sektatna a awlmawh lo mi tungah zawnna le maizumna tunga, puahphat ding a thudon peuhmah kipahtawi hi.","ref":"Pn 1:7"},"19":{"text":"Lunggulhna tangtutna in lungtaina hi-a, mihaite in ahileh gitlohna kiheisan ding kih uh hi.","ref":"Pn 10:11"},"20":{"text":"A pilte tawh kikhawlte pil a, mihaite kithuahpihpa in natna thuak hi.","ref":"2Kh 10:8"},"21":{"text":"Kamsiatna in mimawhpa delh a, daupaina ahileh a thumaante’ pahtakman ahi hi.","ref":"2Sa 3:39; Ph 32:10"},"22":{"text":"Mi hoihpa in a tate’ tate gouluah ding nusiat a, mawhneipa hauhna ahileh a thumaan mi adingin kikhol hi.","ref":"Est 8:2"},"23":{"text":"Mizawngpa lo ah an tampi piang thei a, ahi hangin thutan lohna in a siakmang hi."},"24":{"text":"Ciangduai a zang lo mi a tapa mudah hi-a, a tapa a it mi in limtakin sek hi.","ref":"2Sa 7:14"},"25":{"text":"A thumaante in a lungkim zah ne a, migilote ahileh gilkial uh hi."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Numei pil in a inn lama, numei hai in ahileh ama khut mah in a inn phel hi.","ref":"Rut 3:11"},"2":{"text":"Thutanga kalsuan mi in TOPA kihta a, thukawi lampi tawnpa in ahileh amah a simmawh hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihaite kampau in a nungzangah ciangduai tusak a, mipilte muk in ahileh amaute dal hi.","ref":"Pn 10:14; Pn 10:13"},"4":{"text":"Bawngtal om lohna ah gankuang hawm a, ahi hangin bawngtal hatna hangin an tampitak kila hi.","ref":"Ph 114:14"},"5":{"text":"A thutak teci in zuau gen lo a, teci maan lo in ahileh zuau a phuak hi.","ref":"Ph 12:2"},"6":{"text":"Mi simmawhte in pilna a zon hangin bangmah mu lo a, thu saikak-theite in theihna mu ziau hi.","ref":"Pn 9:9"},"7":{"text":"Mihai tawh kithuah kei in, ama muk pan theihna na mu kei ding hi."},"8":{"text":"A kidawm thei mi’ pilna, ngaihsunsun-a gamtatna hi-a, mihaite haina ahileh khemna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 15:28"},"9":{"text":"Mihaite in mawh maisakna zahpih a, a thutangte lakah deihsakna kimu hi."},"10":{"text":"Lungtang in ama khaatna thei tek a, kuamah dangin a lungnoppih thei kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilote’ inn kisusia dinga, a thutangte’ buk ahileh a gina semsem ding hi.","ref":"Job 8:22; Ph 72:7"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat adingin amaan hileh kilawm lampi khat om a, ahi hangin tua in a tawpna ah sihna a tun hi.","ref":"Pn 12:15; Pn 16:25"},"13":{"text":"Nuih kawm nangawnin lungsim na thei a, lungnopna zong dahna-in kikhum thei hi.","ref":"Thn 2:2"},"14":{"text":"Muanna nei lo mi a gamtatna bangin kithuk dinga, mi hoih in ahileh pahtakman sang ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 15:7"},"15":{"text":"Mimawl in na khatpeuh um a, a kidawm thei mi in a kalsuan nading a ngaihsun hi."},"16":{"text":"Mipil in TOPA kihta-in gitlohna peel a, mihai in ahileh ngaihsun khol loin amtat hi.","ref":"Pk 20:20; 1Sa 25:25"},"17":{"text":"A hehbaihte hai gamtat a, a gitloh pilte kimudah hi.","ref":"2Ku 5:12"},"18":{"text":"Mimawhte in haina luah a, a kidawmtheite ahileh theihna kikhusak hi."},"19":{"text":"Mi hoihte a omna ah mi hoih lote kun in, thumaan kongpite ah migilote kun ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 11:29"},"20":{"text":"Mizawngte, a vengte nangawn in pel uh a, mihaute in lawm tampi nei uh hi.","ref":"Pn 19:4,7"},"21":{"text":"A vengpa a simmawhte a mawh hi-a, a tasamte tunga migite thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 11:12"},"22":{"text":"Gitloh sawmsimte lamkhial hi lo hiam? Hoih a sawmte in ahileh itna le muanhuaina lawhtak a hi.","ref":"Pn 4:16-17"},"23":{"text":"Nasep haksa khempeuh metna hi-a, kamsik lel pen zawnna bek ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Mipilte hauhna amau lukhu hi-a, mihaite haina in ahileh haina mah a suah hi."},"25":{"text":"A thutak teci in nuntakna honkhia a, teci zuau in ahileh zuau a phuak hi.","ref":"Pn 12:17"},"26":{"text":"TOPA a kihta mi, kulh muanhuai nei hi-a; a tate adingin bukna hi ding hi.","ref":"Pn 18:10; Ph 9:9"},"27":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in nuntakna tuikhuk hi-a, sihna thangte panin mi khat kipelhsak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:11; Ph 18:5"},"28":{"text":"Gammi tamna in kumpipa’ minthanna hi a, a uk ding mi om kei leh kumpitapa kisia hi.","ref":"2Sa 19:7"},"29":{"text":"A lungduai mi, theihtelna lianpi nei hi-a, a lungtom mi ahileh a haina pulak lel ahi hi.","ref":"2Ku 5:12; Thn 7:8-9"},"30":{"text":"Lungnopna in pumpi adingin nuntakna hi-a, enna in ahileh guhte a muatsak hi."},"31":{"text":"Mizawngte a nengcipte, amaute a Bawlpa simmawh hi-a, a tasamte tungah migi peuhmah Pasian pahtawi ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 17:5; Tp 24:14"},"32":{"text":"Tuahsiatna a tun ciangin migilote tavai uh a, thumaante in ahileh sihna nangawn ah bukna nei lai uh hi.","ref":"Ph 34:21"},"33":{"text":"Thu theikakte lungsim ah pilna giak a, mihaite lak nangawn ah amah le amah a kitheisak a hi.","ref":"Pn 2:6-10"},"34":{"text":"Thumaanna in minam tawisang a, mawhna ahileh mi khatpeuh adingin mindaina ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 11:11"},"35":{"text":"A pil nasempa tungah kumpipa lungkima, a zumhuai nasempa in ahileh thangpaisak hi.","ref":"Est 8:2"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kamnem a dawnna in thangpaihna daisak a, kamkhauh in ahileh hehna sosak hi.","ref":"1Ku 12:7"},"2":{"text":"Mipilte leii in theihna phata, mihaite kam in ahileh haina phulkhiasak hi.","ref":"Pn 25:15"},"3":{"text":"Mun khempeuh ah TOPA mit om a, misia le mipha a encik hi.","ref":"2Kh 16:9"},"4":{"text":"A damsak thei leii nuntakna singkung hi-a, a khem thei leii in ahileh lungsim a suzan hi.","ref":"Pn 12:18"},"5":{"text":"Mihai in a pa sekna nial-a, puahphatna a thusim mi ahileh pilvangna lak ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 10:17"},"6":{"text":"A thumaan mi inn ah gou tampitak om a, migilote sumtum in amaute lungkhamsak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:16"},"7":{"text":"Mipilte muk in theihna thehzak a, mihaite lungsim in a tua cih kei hi.","ref":"Pn 10:13"},"8":{"text":"Migilote biakpiakna TOPA in kih a, a thutang mite thungetna in amah lungkimsak hi.","ref":"Ph 51:17"},"9":{"text":"Migilote zuih lampi TOPA in kih a, thumaan a delhte a it hi.","ref":"Pn 6:16"},"10":{"text":"Lampialte khauhtakin sek kul a, puahphat a ut lote si ding hi.","ref":"Pn 1:31-32"},"11":{"text":"Sihna le suksiatna b , TOPA mai-ah kilangin om ahileh - mihingte lungsim kilangzaw ngel ve!","ref":"1Sa 2:3"},"12":{"text":"Mi simmawhpa in kipuahphat ding hehsan hi; mipilte thu dong lo ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Lungsim-nopna in maitaisak a, lungsim-natna in ahileh lungsim a suzan hi.","ref":"Pn 12:25"},"14":{"text":"Theihkakna lungsim in theihna zonga, mihaite kam ahileh haina-in kivak hi.","ref":"Pn 18:15"},"15":{"text":"A kinengcipte nuntak hun sung gimna vive hi-a, a lungtai mite pawi bawlbawl ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Hauh mahmah a buai sangin tawmkha nei a TOPA kihtak hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Ph 37:16-17"},"17":{"text":"Kimuhdahpipi a bawngno vakthau sa nek sangin ki-it diamdiam a anteh meh nek hoih zaw hi.","ref":"Pn 17:1"},"18":{"text":"Lungtom mi in kiselna khangsak a, lungduai mi in kitotna daisak hi.","ref":"Pn 6:6-19; Pc 13:8"},"19":{"text":"Zongzawte lampi ling in khak a, a thutangte lampi ahileh lam lianpi ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 22:5"},"20":{"text":"Tapa pil in a pa lungnuamsak a, mihai in ahileh a nu a thusim kei hi.","ref":"Pn 10:1"},"21":{"text":"Thukhentel thei lo mi in hai nuamsa a, thu theitel mi ahileh thutangin a gamta hi.","ref":"Pn 2:14"},"22":{"text":"Kikupna om loin geelnate tangtung lo a, thu kuppih tampi tawh tuate kizo zo hi.","ref":"Pn 11:14"},"23":{"text":"Ahi liana dawnna in mite lungnuamsak hi - a hun lian tawh kituaka kampau nak hoih sem ve!","ref":"Pn 12:14; Pn 25:11"},"24":{"text":"Mipilte adingin nuntakna lampi paito a, hankhuk c manawha paisuk nading panin a kem hi."},"25":{"text":"TOPA in kiphasakte inn phelkek a, meigong numeite kigi bittakin kepsak hi.","ref":"Tp 19:14"},"26":{"text":"TOPA in migilote ngaihsutna kih a, lungsim siangthote aa ahileh lungkimpih hi.","ref":"Ph 18:26"},"27":{"text":"A huaiham mi in a inn sung lungkhamsak a, golhsum a mudah mi a nungta ding hi.","ref":"Pk 23:8"},"28":{"text":"A thumaante lungtang in a dawn kik nading khingkhaikhai-a, migilote kam panin ahileh thusia phulkhiakhia hi."},"29":{"text":"Migilote kiang panin TOPA gamla a, ahi hangin a thumaante thungetna a za hi.","ref":"Job 15:31"},"30":{"text":"Maitaisa-a etna in lungsim nuamsak a, thuthak hoih in guhte damsak hi.","ref":"Pn 25:25"},"31":{"text":"Nuntakna a pia taihilhna a ngaipa, mipilte tawh kikhawl thei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 9:7-9"},"32":{"text":"Sektatna a awlmawh lopa amah le amah kithusim lo hi-a, kipuahphat a sawm mi ahi leh theihtelna ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 1:7; Pn 12:1"},"33":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in pilna a hilh-a, pahtawina ma-in kiniamkhiatna om masa hi.","ref":"Pn 16:18"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungsima geelna mihing aa hi-a, leii a dawnna ahileh TOPA tung pana pai ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihing in a lampite khempeuh ah mawhpeng kisa a, TOPA in ahileh lungsima sawmnate a khingkhai hi.","ref":"Pn 12:15; 2Kh 6:30"},"3":{"text":"Na sep peuhmah TOPA tungah ap in tua hileh na geelna na zo ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:20"},"4":{"text":"TOPA in na khempeuh a tawpna ding bawl a - migilote nangawn siatna ni adingin a bawl hi.","ref":"Pk 9:16; 2Kh 34:24"},"5":{"text":"Lungsim kiphasak khempeuh TOPA in kih hi. Hih thu tel in: Dan tuak loin a om kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 40:4"},"6":{"text":"Itna le muanhuaina tawnin mawhna maisiang a, TOPA kihtakna tawnin mihing in gitlohna a peel hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihing khat lampite in TOPA a lungkimsak ciangin a galte nangawn amah tawh kilemin tengkhawmsak hi."},"8":{"text":"Thutang lo a tampitak ngah sangin, thumaan-a tawmno ngah hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 15:16"},"9":{"text":"Mihing in a maban ding geelkhol a, ahi zongin TOPA in a kalsuanna uk hi."},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa mukte in thusuak bangbang genkhia a, a kam in thutang a lehhek kei hi.","ref":"Pn 17:7"},"11":{"text":"Amaan tawikhaina le tehnate TOPA pan hi-a, ip sunga tawisuang khempeuh ama bawlsa ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 11:1"},"12":{"text":"Thumaanna tawnin kumpi tokhom kikipsak ahi manin kumpite in amaan lo gamtatna a kih uh hi."},"13":{"text":"A thumaan mukte ah kumpite lungtai uh a, thutak a gente manpha sa uh hi.","ref":"Pn 22:11"},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa thangpaihna in sih nading thupuakpa hi-a, mipil in ahileh a thangpaihna daisak hi.","ref":"Pc 40:2; Pn 25:15"},"15":{"text":"Kumpi khat a maitai ciangin kinuntak lawh a; ama angvanna in guah a paii tukmeii tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pc 40:2; Pn 19:12"},"16":{"text":"Kham sangin pilna ngah ding hoihzaw tham a, ngun sangin theihtelna teel ding hoihzaw tham si!","ref":"Job 28:15"},"17":{"text":"A thutangte’ lam lianpi in gitlohna peel a; ama lampi a kem mi in, a nuntakna kem ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 19:16"},"18":{"text":"Kisiatna ma-in kiphatsakna masa a, pukna ma-in kihihsakna lungsim masa hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:42; Est 17:12"},"19":{"text":"A kiphasakte tawh vansuh hawm sangin lungsim niamkhiat a, kinengniamte lak a om hoihzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Lamlahna a thusimte a daupai a, TOPA a muang mite thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 32:10"},"21":{"text":"Lungsim pilte thu khaikak thei kici a, kamkhum in lamlahna b behlap hi."},"22":{"text":"Theihtelna a nei mi adingin nuntakna tuikhuk hi-a, haina in ahileh a haite dan tuaksak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:11"},"23":{"text":"Mipilpa a lungsim in a kampau makaih a, a muk in lamlahna a behlap c hi.","ref":"Job 15:5"},"24":{"text":"Kamkhum in khuaizu pheng hi-a, hinna adingin khumin guhte damna ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 14:27"},"25":{"text":"Mi khat adingin amaan dinga kilawm lampi khat om a, ahi hangin tua in a tawpna ah sihna tun hi.","ref":"Pn 12:15; Est 3:6"},"26":{"text":"Nasempa ankam-limna in ama ading na semsak a, a gilkialna in nasemin sawlsawl hi."},"27":{"text":"Migilo in gitloh sawma, ama kampau, a hultum thei meikuang bang hi.","ref":"Jas 3:6"},"28":{"text":"Lungsim kawite in kitotna piangsak a, gensiatna in lawmta khen hi.","ref":"Pn 14:17; Pn 17:9"},"29":{"text":"Mi ngongtat in a vengpa zolin a hoih lo lam totpih hi.","ref":"Pn 1:10"},"30":{"text":"A mit phoisakte thu kawi bawlnuam hi-a; a muktukte gitloh sawm ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 6:13"},"31":{"text":"Samkang in thupina lukhu hi-a, thumaana nuntakna hanga kingah ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 20:29"},"32":{"text":"Galhang khat sangin lungduai khat hoihzaw a, khuapi khat a zopa sangin a lungsim a uk zopa hoihzaw hi."},"33":{"text":"Angkawmah ai a kisan hangin a khentatna peuhmah TOPA aa ahi hi.","ref":"Jos 7:14"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kiselsa-in inn dima pawi a bawl sangin kilem diamdiamin daitaka an kangkeu nek hoihzaw hi."},"2":{"text":"Nasem pil in tapa gina lo uk dinga, unau khat bangin goutanh a ngah ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Sik huantuina ah ngun kizia-et in, pummei ah kham kizia-et a, TOPA in ahileh lungsim a zia-et hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:17"},"4":{"text":"Migilo in kampau gilo ngai-a, zuautheite in mi a nasak leii a thusim uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mizawngte a simmawh mi in amaute a Bawlpa simmawh hi-a; siatna tunga kisathei peuhmah dan tuak loin a om kei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 14:31; Eze 25:3"},"6":{"text":"Khanghamte adingin tate’ tate kumpi lukhu hi-a, nu-le-pa ahileh a tate angtanna ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihai in kisaktheihna kamte b a zat ding kilawm lo hi - gam-uk khat in zuau a gen ding kilawm kei zaw ngel ve!","ref":"Pn 16:10"},"8":{"text":"Golhsum, a pia mi adingin ai hi-a; a kiheina peuhpeuh ah mavang hi.","ref":"Pk 23:8"},"9":{"text":"Khialhna a maisakte itna a khangsak hi-a, khialhna a hih teiteite lawmta khenkhen ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 16:28"},"10":{"text":"Mihai khat khauteepa za vei sat sangin thu theikak mi khat khatvei taihilh phatuamzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Migilo in lehdo bek sawm a, hehpihna nei lo ulian khat ama langah kisawl ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihai khat tawh a haitat laitaka kituah sangin vompi a no kilaksak tawh kituah hoihzaw hi."},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in a hoih, gitlohna tawh a thuk leh thusia in a inn lawi ngei lo ding hi.","ref":"Pc 44:4"},"14":{"text":"Kitot kipatna in tuicinna keh tawh kibanga; kisel ma-in khawl zawk ding ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Mawhnei mi khahkhongna le mawhpeng khat mawhpaihna - TOPA in kih tuak hi.","ref":"Ph 94:21; Pk 23:6-7"},"16":{"text":"Mihai in pilna ngah ding a lunggulh loh nungsang ama khuta sum om bang phatuam ahi hiam?","ref":"Pn 23:23"},"17":{"text":"Lawm khat in hong it tawntung a, sanggam pen haksat huna dinga suak ahi hi.","ref":"2Sa 15:21"},"18":{"text":"Thukhentel thei lo mi in kiciamna-in a khut benga, a vengpa ngaih muangsak hi.","ref":"Pn 6:1-5"},"19":{"text":"Kitot uukte mawhna it hi-a; kongpi sangpi-a bawlte kisiatna sam ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Lungsim kawi nei mi a daupai lo a; zuauthu gente in lungkhamna tuak hi."},"21":{"text":"Tapa hai neite dah mahmah a; mihaipa hangin a pa lungnuam lo hi.","ref":"Pn 10:1"},"22":{"text":"Lungtaina in zatui hoih hi-a, lungsim tapzanna in guhte keusak hi.","ref":"Pk 12:46"},"23":{"text":"Migilo in thutang a lehhek nadingin golhsum sang sim hi.","ref":"Job 34:33; Pk 18:21"},"24":{"text":"Thu-theikak mi in pilna enkawm gige a, mihaite mit ahileh leimong dongin vak kawikawi hi."},"25":{"text":"Tapa hai a pa adingin lungkhamna hi-a, a pianna nu adingin khaatna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 10:1"},"26":{"text":"Mawhpeng mi khat dan tuahsak hoih lo a, amau cihtakna hangin uliante sat zong hoih lo hi.","ref":"Ph 94:21"},"27":{"text":"Theihna nei mi pau mengmeng lo a, theihtelna nei mi ki-ip thei hi.","ref":"Pn 14:29"},"28":{"text":"Mihaite nangawn dai dide-in om leh apil kisa a, pau loin om leh thutheikak kisa hi.","ref":"Job 2:19"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A tangtat mite a huaiham hi-a, mantaka kikhensa thu a tokbuai hi."},"2":{"text":"Mihai in theihtelna nuamsa lo a, ama ngaihsut bek gen leh nuam sa hi.","ref":"Pn 12:23"},"3":{"text":"Gitlohna hong tun ciangin simmawhna in zui-a, maizumna hong tun ciangin mindaina in zui hi."},"4":{"text":"Mihing kampaute tui thukpi hi-a, pilna khuk ahileh lui luanglai ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 18:16"},"5":{"text":"Migilote guptuam hoih lo a, mawhpengte thutang taansak zong hoih lo hi.","ref":"Pn 24:23-25; Ph 82:2"},"6":{"text":"Mihai muk in kitotna tun a, a kam in sat thuaksak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:14"},"7":{"text":"Mihai kam ama siatna hi-a, a hinna adingin a mukte thang ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 64:8"},"8":{"text":"Mi gensiate kampau an lim mahmah tawh kibang a, mihing sungtawng ah tumsuk pah hi.","ref":"Pn 26:22"},"9":{"text":"A nasep sem nuamlopa, a susiapa sanggam ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 28:24"},"10":{"text":"TOPA ’ min pen tausang muanhuai hi-a; thumaante in beelin galmuang uh hi.","ref":"Ph 61:3; Ph 20:1"},"11":{"text":"Mihaute hauhna amau kulh muanhuai nei khuapi hi-a; kuama kal zawh loh kulhin ngaihsun uh hi.","ref":"Pn 10:15"},"12":{"text":"Mihing lungsim kisiat ma-in kiphatsakna masa a, pahtawina ma-in kiniamkhiatna masa hi.","ref":"Pn 11:2"},"13":{"text":"Ngai nai lopi-a dawng kik pa ama haina le maizumna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 20:25"},"14":{"text":"Mihing lungsim in a cinatna thuak zo napi, lungsim kitamzan kua in thuak zo ding hiam?","ref":"Pn 15:13"},"15":{"text":"Thu theikak mi lungsim in theihna ngah a; mipilte bil in theihna a zongkhia hi.","ref":"Pn 15:14"},"16":{"text":"Letsong in a piapa lampi hong a, miliante kiang a tun hi.","ref":"Pc 32:13"},"17":{"text":"A thulangpa mai pai-in a kidot masiah thu sung masa pen amaan tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Ai teelna in kitotna vengsak a, kilangneih-luatnate beisak hi."},"19":{"text":"Kulha ki-um khuapi lak sangin sanggam kinuak lep haksazaw a, a kitotnate uh a kikalhcip khuapi kongkhakte tawh kibang hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:28"},"20":{"text":"Mi, ama kampau gah panin gilvah a; a muka a genna panin a tai hi.","ref":"Pn 12:14"},"21":{"text":"Leii in nuntakna le sihna vang nei a, a leii it mi in a leii gah ne ding hi.","ref":"Ph 12:4; Pn 13:2-3"},"22":{"text":"Zi a mu mi, na hoih mu hi-a, TOPA ’ angvanna ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 12:4; Job 33:26"},"23":{"text":"Mizawngte in lainat nadingin thum uh a, mihaupa in kamkhauhin a dawng hi."},"24":{"text":"Kithuahpih tampi a neite kisia thei a, ahi hangin sanggam sangin a kicianzaw lawm a om hi.","ref":"1Sa 20:42"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thukawi bawl mihai khat sangin, a kalsuanna a kawkbaang lo mizawng khat hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 28:6"},"2":{"text":"Theihna nei lopi-in aamna hoih lo a, kinawh lua-a lamhaihna zong hoih tuan lo hi.","ref":"Pn 29:20"},"3":{"text":"Mihing haina in a nuntakna siasak a, tua hi napi a lungsim in TOPA ngawh lai hi.","ref":"Ph 14:1; Jas 1:13-15"},"4":{"text":"Hauhna in lawm hausak a, mizawngte ahileh a lawmpa in taisan hi.","ref":"Pn 14:20"},"5":{"text":"Teci maan lo in dan tuak loin om lo dinga, zuau phuakpa zong suakta lo ding hi.","ref":"Ph 56:7; Tp 19:19"},"6":{"text":"Mi tampite in gam-ukpa mai-et uh a, letsong a pia mi peuhmah ama lawm ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 29:26; Pn 17:8"},"7":{"text":"Mizawngpa a tanaute khempeuh in taisan uh hi - a lawmte in pelzaw san lo ding hiam! Amah thumin nungdelh ta leh, muhkhakin a om lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A pilpa in a hinna it a; theihtelna a paktate a daupai hi."},"9":{"text":"Teci maan lo in dan tuak loin om lo dinga, zuau phuakte mangthang ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 19:19"},"10":{"text":"Mihaite a noptat ding kilawm lo a - sila in uliante a uk ding siazaw tham hi!","ref":"Pn 26:1"},"11":{"text":"Mi khat a pilna in lungduaisak a, langpanna, kimuhmawhbawlna in ama minthanna ahi hi.","ref":"2Ku 5:12"},"12":{"text":"Kumpipa lungsona in humpinelkai hawk banga, a angvanna ahileh lopa tunga daitui bang hi.","ref":"Pn 20:2; Est 1:12"},"13":{"text":"Tapa hai, a pa kisiatna hi-a, kitot hat zi in inn kehkeh tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pn 10:1"},"14":{"text":"Innte le hauhna nu le pa pana kiluah hi-a, a thukhual zi ahileh TOPA pan ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 18:22"},"15":{"text":"Thadahna in ihmumu sak a, a polhteh mi gilkial ding hi.","ref":"Pn 10:4"},"16":{"text":"Lamlahnate a mang mi, a nuntakna kem hi-a, a lampi a awlmawh lote, si ding hi.","ref":"Pn 16:17"},"17":{"text":"Mizawngte tunga migite TOPA a leitawisak hi-a, ama sepsa hangin pahtakman a pia ding hi.","ref":"Tp 24:14"},"18":{"text":"Lametna a om lai-in na tapa sek in; a sih nading lamah awi-am kei in.","ref":"Pn 13:24"},"19":{"text":"A lungso mi in dan tuak pelmawh dinga; hukhia lecin na hut kik kul ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Thu kuppihna ngai inla, kilamlahna sang in; tua hileh a tawpna ah na pillawh ding hi.","ref":"Pn 4:1; Pn 12:15"},"21":{"text":"Mihing lungsim in tampi geel-a, ahi zongin TOPA ngaihsut mah taksuak hi.","ref":"Ph 33:11"},"22":{"text":"Mihing lunggulh a bei ngei lo itna a hi-a, zuauphuak khat hih sangin zawn hoihzaw hi."},"23":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna in nuntakna tun a, a tuaci mi, lungkimtak tawlnga in, lungkhamna in sukha lo ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi zongzaw in ankuang sawkin; a kam nangawn a tun zo kei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 26:15"},"25":{"text":"Mi simmawh khat sat le cin, mimawlte in kidop siamna sin ding uh a, thu thei mi khat taihilh le cin, theihna ngah ding hi.","ref":"Pn 9:9"},"26":{"text":"A pa aa sut-a, a nu a hawlkhia tapa, maizumna le mindaina tun ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 28:24"},"27":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, lamlahna na ngaih nawn kei leh theihna panin na pial ding hi.","ref":"Pn 1:8"},"28":{"text":"Amaan lo teci in thutang simmawh a, migilo in thusia a nawmvalhsuk hi."},"29":{"text":"Dan piaknate pen mi simmawhte ading le, satna pen mihaite nungzang ading kibawlkhol ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 25:2"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu in mi simmawhsak a, zucil in mi kilaisak hi; tuate lamkhialhsak peuhmah a pil lo ahi hi.","ref":"1Sa 25:36; Pn 31:4"},"2":{"text":"Kumpipa thangpaihna, humpinelkai hawk tawh kibang a; amah a hehsakte in a nuntakna tanlawh hi.","ref":"Pn 19:12; Est 7:7"},"3":{"text":"Kisel ding a kidaam mi, mite in pahtawi a, a hai peuhmah lah a kitawng pahpah hi.","ref":"Pc 13:8"},"4":{"text":"Mi zongzaw in lokhawh hunin kho lo a; anlak hunin a lak ding bangmah a om kei pah hi.","ref":"Pn 6:6"},"5":{"text":"Mihing lungtupte tui thukpi hi-a, a theitel mi in ahileh tuate a dimkhia hi.","ref":"Ph 18:16"},"6":{"text":"Mi a tamzaw in itnakip nei-in kigen ciat uh a, ahi zongin mi muanhuai kua in mu zo ding hiam?","ref":"Ph 12:1"},"7":{"text":"A thumaan mi, kawkbang loin nungta a; ama nunga a tate in thupha ngahlawh uh hi.","ref":"Ph 26:1; Ph 37:25-26"},"8":{"text":"Thukhen dingin kumpipa a tokhom ah a tut ciangin gitlohna khempeuh a mit in haihkhia hi.","ref":"1Ku 7:7; Pn 25:4-5"},"9":{"text":"Kua in, \"Ka lungsim a siangtho-in ka kem a; mawh nei loin ka siang hi,\" ci thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 15:14; 1Ku 8:46"},"10":{"text":"Tawisuang kikim lo le tehna kikim lo - a nihin TOPA in kihkhawm hi.","ref":"Pn 11:1"},"11":{"text":"Naupang nangawn a gamtatzia panin a sianthona le a thumaanna kithei hi.","ref":"Ph 39:1"},"12":{"text":"Khuazakna bilte le khuamuhna mitte - tuate gel TOPA bawl ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 94:9"},"13":{"text":"Ihmut nuamsa kei in na zawng ding hi; hak gega in na khamval ding hi.","ref":"Pn 6:11"},"14":{"text":"A leite in, \"Hoih kei, hoih kei,\" ci uh a, a paikhiat ciangin lah a vanlei kisialhpih hi."},"15":{"text":"Kham omin ruby tampi om hi; theihna tawh a pau muk ahileh suang manpha takpi ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Khualmi khat tangin mawhlawh tawi nadinga a piak puansilh la inla, uklah numei tawh a kiciamna ahileh a kiciamna man dingin koih in.","ref":"Pn 27:13"},"17":{"text":"Zuauna tawh ngah an khum a, a nung ciangin kam sungah suangtang dim hi.","ref":"Pn 9:17"},"18":{"text":"Hong ngaihsutpih thei ding zongin geel inla; makai na neih ciang bekin galsim pan in.","ref":"Pn 11:14"},"19":{"text":"Mi gensiatna in muanna beisak ahi manin a kamtam luate peel in.","ref":"Pn 11:13"},"20":{"text":"Mi khat in a nu hiam, a pa hiam a hamsiat leh kawhawm mial sungah a meivak kisumit ding hi.","ref":"Pn 30:11; Pk 21:17"},"21":{"text":"Acila gouluahna ngahpah, a tawpna ah thupha hi lo hi."},"22":{"text":"\"Na khialhna hong thuk na ve’ng,\" ci kei in. TOPA ngak in, ama’n hong hu ding hi.","ref":"Isa 37:20"},"23":{"text":"TOPA in tawisuang kikim lo kih a, tehna maan lo in amah lungkimsak lo hi.","ref":"Tp 25:13"},"24":{"text":"Mi khat kalsuannate TOPA uk ahi hi; kua in ama lampi theitel thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 90:12; Pn 19:21"},"25":{"text":"Na khatpeuh mawk-appak a, a kiciamna nung ngaihsut mihing adingin thang suak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:19"},"26":{"text":"A pil kumpi in migilote haihkhia a, an cilna lengpei a hualsak hi."},"27":{"text":"TOPA meivak in mihing kha a zonga, a sungtawng dong zongkhia hi.","ref":"Ph 119:105; Pn 16:2"},"28":{"text":"Itna le muanhuaina in kumpipa humbit a; itna tungtawnin a tokhom kip hi.","ref":"Pn 16:12"},"29":{"text":"Khangnote minthanna in a thahatna uh hi-a, putekte thupina in a samkang uh ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 16:31"},"30":{"text":"Vuakna le liamma in gitlohna siangsak a, satna in a sungtawng dong khuahsiang hi.","ref":"Ph 51:2; Isa 1:5"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA khut sungah Kumpipa lungtang om a, tuilaak bangin a lungkimnana ah hei kawikawi hi.","ref":"Est 5:1"},"2":{"text":"Mi khat in a gamtatna khempeuh maan a sak hangin, TOPA in a lungsim khingkhai hi.","ref":"Pn 16:2"},"3":{"text":"TOPA in kithoihna sangin thumaan thutanga sep, sang thei zaw hi."},"4":{"text":"A kihisak mitte le kiphatsakna lungtang, migilote’ meivakte mawhna ahi hi!","ref":"Job 41:34"},"5":{"text":"Lopthopna in zawnna a tut laisiah a citakpa geelna in metna tun hi.","ref":"Pn 10:4"},"6":{"text":"Leii-a zuauna tawh hauhna in a lengmang pak tuikhu le sihtheihna thang b ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 10:2"},"7":{"text":"Migilote thumaanin gamta nuam lo ahi manin, amau ngongtatna in amaute talkaih mang ding hi.","ref":"Pn 11:5"},"8":{"text":"A kisuangtaakte lehtat uh a, mawhpengte ahileh a tangin gamta uh hi.","ref":"Pn 2:15"},"9":{"text":"Kitot hat zi tawh inn khata tenkhawm sangin, innkhum tung kiu khata ten hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 19:13"},"10":{"text":"Migilote in thusia deih uh a, a vengte in ama tung panin lainatna a ngah kei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Misimmawh khat dan a kituahsak ciangin, mimawlte in pillawh uh a; mipil khat lam a kilah ciangin theihna a ngah hi.","ref":"Pn 19:25"},"12":{"text":"Thumaan Pa c in migilote inn ciamteh a, a gilote a siasak hi.","ref":"Pn 14:11"},"13":{"text":"Mi khat in mizawngte kikona za nuam loin a bil a humsan leh amah zong kiko dinga a kidawng kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 29:12"},"14":{"text":"Letsong kipiaksim in hehna damsak a, puan nuai ah sel-a golhsum piaksim in thangpaihna lianpi a daisak hi.","ref":"Pc 32:20"},"15":{"text":"Thutanga a kisep khit ciangin a thumaante lungnuam a, a gilote lauthawng hi."},"16":{"text":"Theihtelna pana lampialpa, misi hon lakah a tawlnga ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Nopsakna khelahte zawng dinga; zu le sathau haite a hau ngei kei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Migilote in a thumaan mite kitatna man suak dinga, mi muanhuai lote mi thutangte adingin tatna man a suak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 11:8"},"19":{"text":"Kitot hat le a gilo zi tawh tenkhawm sangin gam sunga ten hoihzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Mipilte inn sungah an lim le sathau kikhol a, mihaipa in ahileh a neih zahzah valhtum pahpah hi."},"21":{"text":"Thumaanna le itna a delh mi in, nuntakna, daupaina d le pahtawina a mu hi.","ref":"Mt 5:6"},"22":{"text":"Mipil in mi thahatte khuapi sim-a, amau muan, kulh muanhuai a kaipuk hi.","ref":"Pn 8:14"},"23":{"text":"A kam le a leii a kem thei mi, vangsiatna pan a kikem ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 34:13; Pn 10:19"},"24":{"text":"A kiphasak le a ki-uangsakte - a min, \"Misimmawh\" hi-a; kiphasak khengvalin a gamta hi.","ref":"Jer 43:2"},"25":{"text":"Mi zongzawte khut in na sem nuam lo ahi manin a deihluatna, ama sihna hi ding hi.","ref":"Pn 13:4"},"26":{"text":"Sun thapai-in amah in a tamzaw deih lai a, a thumaante in ahileh siit nei loin piakhia hi.","ref":"Sp 25:35"},"27":{"text":"Migilote’ kithoihna kihhuai hi - ngimna hoih lo tawh a puakte nak kihhuai zaw ngel ve!","ref":"1Ku 14:24"},"28":{"text":"Teci zuau mangthang dinga, a thu a ngai peuhmah kisusia den a ding hi.","ref":"Isa 29:21"},"29":{"text":"Migilote hanhah gemgam a, mi thutang in a gamtat nading a ngaihsun hi."},"30":{"text":"TOPA langkhatah pilna, thugil le ngimna a tangtung zo kei hi.","ref":"2Kh 13:12"},"31":{"text":"Galsim ni adingin sakol kiciil khin a, gualzawhna ahileh TOPA aa ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 33:12-19"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hauh mahmah sangin min hoih deihhuai zaw a; ngun le kham sangin mite sangmuhna hoihzaw hi."},"2":{"text":"A zawng le a hau in neihkhawm nei uh hi; amaute khempeuh a Bawlpa, TOPA ahi hi.","ref":"Job 31:15"},"3":{"text":"A kidawm thei mi in lauhuaina mu-in bu a, mimawl in ahileh phusuakin a thuak hi.","ref":"Pn 14:16; Pn 27:12"},"4":{"text":"Kiniamkhiatna le TOPA kihtakna in hauhna, pahtawina le nuntakna a tun hi.","ref":"Pn 10:27"},"5":{"text":"A gilote lampi ah lingte le thangte om a, a nuntakna a kem mi in ahileh tuate gamlapi-ah a pel hi."},"6":{"text":"Naupang khat a pai nading lampi ah pantah b lecin, a tek dongin a pial nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Eph 6:4; Tp 6:7"},"7":{"text":"A haupa in a zawngpa uk a, a leitawipa in a leitawinapa nasem a suak hi."},"8":{"text":"Gitlohna a vawhte in lungkhamna at a, ama hehna ciangduai kisuksiatsak ding hi.","ref":"Hos 8:7"},"9":{"text":"A hawmsem mi in mizawngte a an hawm ahi manin amah thupha kipia a suak hi.","ref":"Pn 11:25; Tp 14:29"},"10":{"text":"Misimmawhte hawlkhia lecin, kiselna om loin, kitotna le ki-engkona bei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 26:20"},"11":{"text":"Lungsim siang a itte le a kamsiamte in kumpipa lawmin a nei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 16:13"},"12":{"text":"TOPA mit in theihna vil gige a, mi muanhuai lote kammalte ahileh a lawhsamsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Zongzawte in, \"A pualam ah humpi om!\" ahikeh \"Kongzing ah hong kithat kha inteh!\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Pn 26:13"},"14":{"text":"Angkawmnu kam in gum thukpi hi-a; TOPA thangpaihna nuai-a om mi tua sungah a kia ding hi.","ref":"Pn 5:3-5"},"15":{"text":"Naupang lungsim ah haina a lomin om a, sekna ciangduai in tuate ama tung pan nawhkhiamang ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Hauh beh nadingin mizawngte a nengniamte le mihaute letsong piate - a nih in a zawng ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Mipilte thugente thusim inla ngai in; kong hilhte na lungsim ah kivawh in.","title":"Mipilte’ Thugente","ref":"Pn 2:2"},"18":{"text":"Na lungsim ah vom lecin na lungkim dinga, na kama na zatpah ding ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"TOPA na muan theih nadingin tuni-in nang mahmah kong hilh hi."},"20":{"text":"Keimah in nang adingin thu kuppihna le theihna kamvui sawm thum c ,"},"21":{"text":"nang hong sawlpa tungah hoihtaka na dawn theih nadingin tumaan le a muantak hong hilh in gelh khin hilo ka hi hiam?","ref":"Thn 12:10"},"22":{"text":"Zawng tah ci-in mizawngte zawhthawhbawl kei inla, thukhen zum ah a tasamte nopneh kei in.","ref":"Pk 23:6"},"23":{"text":"Amaute tangin TOPA dinga, amau van a sutte ama’n a sut ding hi.","ref":"Job 29:16; Est 8:1"},"24":{"text":"Mi lungtomte lawmin nei kei inla, a heh baihte tawh kikhawl kei in;"},"25":{"text":"a gamtat zuikha-in nangmah thang kisiah na suak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Kiciamna-in na khut beng kei inla, leiba lohsak dingin kiciam kei in;","ref":"Pn 6:1-5"},"27":{"text":"a dit nading nei kei lecin na zat kimlai na lupna kidokkhia ding hi.","ref":"Pn 11:15"},"28":{"text":"Na pute phuhsa tanglai kigisuangte khin kei in.","ref":"Tp 19:14"},"29":{"text":"Nasep a siam mi na mu hiam?
