Kumpipa na sem dinga; mi mawkmawk na a sem kei ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 11:28"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gam-ukpa tawh ankuang na um ciangin, na mai-a om d limtakin en inla"},"2":{"text":"anhai mi na hileh na gawl temta in ngim in;"},"3":{"text":"Khemna an ahi manin anlimte iplah kei in."},"4":{"text":"Hauh nop manin patliangin na sem kei in; pilvangin kithadopzaw in."},"5":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin hauhna a kha po-in vanlam ah lengkhia ding ahi manin, a bei pah theih hauhna mitsuan kei in.","ref":"Pn 27:24"},"6":{"text":"A iksiikte an neksak loin a anlimte iplah dah in;"},"7":{"text":"ahang in, a tuacite in a man a ding tuat ciltel hi. \"Ne in, dawn in\" hong cih hangin hong nekngaih taktak hi lo hi."},"8":{"text":"Tawmkha na neksun na luakhia dinga na kamsiam paih teng a mawkna suak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihaipa hopih kei in na pil thugente thusim lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Tanglai-a kigisuangte khin kei inla, pa neilote’ lo keksak kei in,","ref":"Tp 19:14"},"11":{"text":"ahang in amaute Huhpa thahat hi; nang langah amah pang ding hi.","ref":"Pk 22:22-24"},"12":{"text":"Lamlahnate na lungsim ah bulh inla, theihna lamah na bil ngat in.","ref":"Pn 2:2"},"13":{"text":"Naupang sek ding khiam kei in; ciangduai-a na sat hangin si lo ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Ciangduai-in dan pia inla; sihna b pan a hinna hon in.","ref":"Pn 13:24"},"15":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na lungsim a pil leh ka lung a nuam ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Na muk in thumaan a gen ciangin, ka lungsimtawng kipaak ding hi.","ref":"Pn 27:11"},"17":{"text":"Na lungsimin mimawhte eng kei inla, TOPA kihtakna aam tawntung zaw in.","ref":"Ph 37:1"},"18":{"text":"Mailam ah nang ading lametna om takpi a, na lametna a mongbei kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 9:18"},"19":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, ka thu ngai-in pil inla lampi maan ah na lungsim khosak in."},"20":{"text":"Zu tampi a dawnte le sa uangnekte tawh umkhawm kei in,","ref":"Isa 5:11"},"21":{"text":"ahang in, zukhamte le anhaite zawng uh a, a ihmut-haina un puansiapi a silhsak hi.","ref":"Pn 21:17"},"22":{"text":"Na pianna na pa thu ngai inla, na nu a tek ciangin simmawh kei in."},"23":{"text":"Thutak lei inla zuak kei in; pilna, sektatna le theihtelna ngah in.","ref":"Pn 4:7"},"24":{"text":"A thumaan mi a pa lungnuam mahmah a; ta pil nei pa a ta tungah lungkim hi."},"25":{"text":"Na nu le na pa lungnuam henla; na pianna nu kipaak hen!","ref":"Pn 10:1"},"26":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, na lungsim hong pia inla ka lampite mitsuan gige in,","ref":"Ph 18:21"},"27":{"text":"ahang in a kizuaknu gum thukpi hi-a, uklah zi in dum kawcik ahi hi."},"28":{"text":"Misuampa bangin mi buksim a, pasal lakah mi muanhuai lo khangsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Kua in gimna thuak hiam? Kua in dahna thuak hiam? Kua kisel hiam? Kua lungkim lo hiam? A kul lopi-in kua liam hiam? Kua mitsan gega hiam?"},"30":{"text":"Zupeng uapte, zu helna phual zuante ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 5:11"},"31":{"text":"Hai sungah damdama kisung, a phuan seuhseuh, a san kilkel zu en kei in."},"32":{"text":"A tawpna ah gul bangin hong tuin ngan bangin gupha hi."},"33":{"text":"Na mit in nalamdangdang mu dinga na lungsim ah a buaihuai na a tuamtuam na ngaihsun ding hi."},"34":{"text":"Tuipi lai-a lum na bang dinga, tembaw mung dawna lum na bang ding hi."},"35":{"text":"\"Hong sat uh hang lah liam ke’ng! Hong vuak uh hang lah na sa ke’ng! Zu ka dawn kik theih nadingin cikciang ka navak kik tam?\" na ci ding hi.","ref":"Pn 20:1"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilote eng kei inla, amaute tawh kikhawl nuam kei in;","ref":"Pn 3:31-32"},"2":{"text":"ahang in a lungsim un ngongtat ding sawmsim a, a mukte-un mi buaisak nading bek gen uh hi.","ref":"Ph 10:7"},"3":{"text":"Pilna-in inn kilam a, theihtelna tungtawnin kip hi;","ref":"Pn 14:1"},"4":{"text":"theihna tungtawnin a inndeite, a manpha gou melhoih tuamtuam tawh kidim hi.","ref":"Pn 8:21"},"5":{"text":"Mipil in vanglianpi nei a, theihna nei mi in thahatna a khangsak hi;"},"6":{"text":"ahang in, galsim nadingin makai, gualzawh nadingin thukuppih tampi na kisam hi.","ref":"Pn 11:14"},"7":{"text":"Mihai adingin pilna sang lua a; kongpi-a kikhopna ah gen ding a nei kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Gitloh a sawmsim mi, a phuangkhiapa in kingawh ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Hai phuangkhiatna mawhna hi-a mi simmawhpa mite in kih hi."},"10":{"text":"Lungkham hunin na lung aneu leh a hat het lo na hi ve!"},"11":{"text":"Sihna lam zuana kipaipihte hukhia inla; a kigo dinga kikaite lehkaih in."},"12":{"text":"\"Hih thu thei kei ung,\" na cih khak uh leh lungsim khingkhaipa in thei lo ding hiam? Na nuntakna a cingpa in thei lo ding hiam? Mikim a gamtatna tawh kizui-in thuk lo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"1Sa 2:3"},"13":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, khuaizu ne in, lim hi; khuailu-a khuaizu khum na sa ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Na hinna adingin pilna a khum lam zong thei in; pilna mu le cin mailam ah nang adingin lametna om a, na lametna a mongbei kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 119:103"},"15":{"text":"Thu palsat khat bangin a thumaan mipa’ inn bukin bok kei inla a tenna mun luh kei in;"},"16":{"text":"ahang in a thuman mi khat sagih vei a puk zongin tho kik a, migilote ahileh vangsiatna in a pusuaksak hi.","ref":"Job 5:19"},"17":{"text":"Na galpa a puk ciangin awi lua kei inla; a kimuktuk ciangin kilungnuamsak kei in;","ref":"Ob 12"},"18":{"text":"na tua cih leh TOPA in hong mu dinga, lungkim loin ama tunga a thangpaihna damsak kha ding hi.","ref":"Job 31:29"},"19":{"text":"Migilote hangin lunglel kei in, amaute eng kha kei in,","ref":"Ph 37:1"},"20":{"text":"ahang in migilopa in mailam ah lametna nei lo a, migilote’ meivak kisukmitsak ding hi.","ref":"Job 18:5"},"21":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, TOPA le kumpipa kihta inla, a lehdote pawl kei in,","ref":"Rom 13:1-5"},"22":{"text":"ahang in tuate gel in amaute tungah siatpakna tungsak ding hi, a tunsak theih uh siatna kua in thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 73:19"},"23":{"text":"Hihte zong mipilte gen thuthuk ahi hi: Thukhenna ah deidan neih a hoih kei hi:","ref":"Pn 1:6; Pk 18:16","title":"Mipilte Genbehlai Thute"},"24":{"text":"A khialte tungah, \"Nang mawhpeng na hi hi,\" a ci peuhmah - mite in hamsiat in minamte in langgen ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin a mawhte mah mawh tangsakte tuahpha dinga, ama tungah hauhna thupha tampi a tung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Limtaka kidawnkikna in muka kitawp tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"A pualama na nasep zo photin na lokhawh zo phot inla; tua khit ciangin na inn lam in."},"28":{"text":"A thu om lopi in na vengpa langah teci pang kei inla, zuauthu genna-in na muk zang kei in."},"29":{"text":"\"Kei hong bawl bangin amah bawl ning; ama sepsa mahin amah thuk kik ning,\" ci kei in.","ref":"Pn 20:22"},"30":{"text":"Zongzawte lo gei-ah ka pai a, thu khentel theilopa lenggui huan ka nawk hi;","ref":"Pn 6:6-11"},"31":{"text":"mun khempeuh ah lingkungte selto a, leitung teng kiakin tuamin suang kulhte kicim khin hi."},"32":{"text":"Ka tuahkhakte ka lungsim ah ka bulh a, ka muhsa panin thu khat ka sinkhia hi:"},"33":{"text":"Tomkha sung ihmut, tomkha sung lusuk, tomkha sung khawla khutzep sungin -","ref":"Pn 6:10"},"34":{"text":"misuampa bangin na tungah zawnna hong tung dinga, galphawn a bangin taksapna hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Pn 10:4"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah’ mite tei, Solomon’ paunak dangte ahi hi:","title":"Solomon’ Paunak Dangte","ref":"Pn 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Thu ipna in Pasian minthanna hi-a; thu zonkhiat in kumpite minthanna ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 16:10-15"},"3":{"text":"Vante sanga leitung a thuk bangin kumpite lungsim a kizongkhia thei kei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ngun panin a ek lakhia leng ngunsekpa adingin b vanzat suak a;"},"5":{"text":"kumpipa mai panin migilote hawlkhia leng thumaanna tungtawnin a tokhom kip ding hi.","ref":"Pn 20:8; Pn 16:12"},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa mai ah kitawisang kei inla, mi liante lakah mun la kei in;"},"7":{"text":"amah in ulian khat mai-ah hong niamkhiat sangin, \"Hiah hong tu to ou,\" hong cih ding hoihzaw hi. Na mita na muh peuhpeuh"},"8":{"text":"thukhenzum tun c pahpah kei in; na vengpa in hong maizumsak leh a tawpna ah bang lawh ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Mt 5:25-26"},"9":{"text":"Na vengpa tawh na thuneih na kinial leh midang in nang hong muanga hong koh thusim genkhia kei in;"},"10":{"text":"tua hi kei leh hong zapa in hong maizumsak dinga, na minsiatna bei ngei lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A hun liana kampau tuah, ngun pek tunga kham apple gah tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pn 15:23"},"12":{"text":"Thu a ngai mite tungah mipil khat taihilhna in, kham bilbah ahikeh kham citak kizepna tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Ph 141:5"},"13":{"text":"Thupuak muanhuai in a sawlte adingin anlak huna vuktui vot tawh kibang a; a pute lungsim thaksuaksak hi.","ref":"Pn 10:26"},"14":{"text":"Letsong a piak lohpi a kisialhpihpa guah a paii lo meii le huih bang ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Lungduaina tawh gam-ukpa kithuzawh thei a, kamnem in guh a tansak thei hi.","ref":"Thn 10:4; Pn 15:1"},"16":{"text":"Khuaizu na muh leh na kham dong bek ne in - tamlua leh na lua ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Na vengte inn ah hawh mun lua kei in - na hawh mun luat leh hong mudah ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 12:18"},"18":{"text":"A vengte langah a maan lo teci pangte, khetbuk, namsau le thaltang hiam tawh kibang hi."},"19":{"text":"Lungkham huna mi muanhuai lo muankhak, hatok le khebai tawh kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Lunggim mi khat zaka lasapa, ahikeh khuadam ni-a puansuahpa ta-ngal laka zuthuk sun tawh kibang hi."},"21":{"text":"Na gal a gil a kial leh a nek ding an pia inla; a dang a tak leh a dawn ding tuisik pia in."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin hih lecin a luzangah mei-am a vumsak na hi dinga, tuateh TOPA in pahtakman hong pia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 18:8; Mt 5:44"},"23":{"text":"Leilu-lam huih in guah a puak bangin mi helhotna leii in heh mai a suaksak hi."},"24":{"text":"Kitot hat zi tawh inn khata tenkhawm sangin inntung kiu khata ten hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 21:9"},"25":{"text":"Gamlapi pana thupha in a hingimte adingin tuivot tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pn 15:30"},"26":{"text":"Mi thumaan khat in migilo khat a zuihkhak, tuinak buan le tuikhuk nin tawh kibang hi."},"27":{"text":"Khuaizu tam nek luat hoih lo a, hong pahtawi nadingin pahtawi-theihna zon zong hoih lo hi.","ref":"Pn 27:2"},"28":{"text":"Amah ki-uk zo lo mi khat, a kulh kicimsa khuapi tawh kibang hi."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nipi lai-a vuk kia le an lak huna guahzu bangin mihaite pahtawi a kilawm kei hi.","ref":"1Sa 12:17; Pn 19:10"},"2":{"text":"Kawlgit patau le phialphiah kawilen bangin a thu om lopi-a hamsiat tangtung lo hi.","ref":"Tp 23:5"},"3":{"text":"Sakol sat kul a, laa kamkaih kulin, mihai nungzang adingin ciangduai a kul hi.","ref":"Ph 32:9; Pn 10:13"},"4":{"text":"Mihaite amau haina tawh kizui-in dawng kei in, na dawn leh amah tawh kibang na suak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 36:21"},"5":{"text":"Mihai ama haina bangin dawng lecin ama’ mit ah pil kisa kha ding hi.","ref":"Pn 3:7"},"6":{"text":"Kamtai dinga mihai khat sawlna in a sawlpa khe a kitansak ahikeh ngongtatna tui dawna dawn tawh kibang hi."},"7":{"text":"Mihaite paunak gen in khebaipa khebaina lam tawh kibang hi."},"8":{"text":"Mihai khat pahtawi in sailung khau a sailungtang hen tawh kibang hi."},"9":{"text":"Mihaite paunak gen le zukhampa khuta ling om kibang hi."},"10":{"text":"Mihai khat ahikeh a tuahpeuh tha a cial mi, a banliamsak thal tawipa tawh kibang hi."},"11":{"text":"Ui in a luak a nek kik bangin mihai in a haina a hih kik hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah pil a kisa mi na mu hiam? amah sangin mihai adingin lametna om zaw hi.","ref":"Pn 3:7; Pn 29:20"},"13":{"text":"Mi zongzaw in, \"Lampi ah humpi om kong lakah humpi gilo kawivak!\" ci hi.","ref":"Pn 22:13"},"14":{"text":"Kawmhek tungah kongkhak a kihei bangin, a lupna tungah zongzawpa a kiheihei hi.","ref":"Pn 6:9"},"15":{"text":"Mi zongzaw in ankuang sawkin; a kam a tut ding a tha dah lua hi.","ref":"Pn 19:24"},"16":{"text":"Limtaka dawng thei mi sagih sangin mi zongzawpa amah pil kisazaw hi."},"17":{"text":"Mi kitawng tuaka a va kikausiphumpa ui a bila manpa tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Singkhuah-am le sihtheihna thaltang a mawk lot mihaipa le"},"19":{"text":"a vengte khem a, \"Ka ciamnuihna hi lel e,\" a ci pa kibang hi."},"20":{"text":"Singkhuah loin mei mit a, gensiatna om kei leh kitotna dai hi.","ref":"Pn 22:10"},"21":{"text":"Meihol in mei amsak a, singkhuah in mei a kuansak bangin kitot hat mi in, kiselna phuang hi.","ref":"Pn 14:17"},"22":{"text":"Gensiatna kamte an limpen tawh kibang a, mihing sungtawng ah tumsuk hi.","ref":"Pn 18:8"},"23":{"text":"Lungsim gilo napi kam zol daldalte cim a -a kizut leibeel bang ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"A lungsim siate a kamin kiphelh a, a lungsim, khemna tawh a dim hi.","ref":"Ph 41:6"},"25":{"text":"A kam a khum hangin um kei in; a lungsim ah kihhuaina sagih a dim hi.","ref":"Ph 28:3; Jer 9:4"},"26":{"text":"Ama lungsim sia khemna tawh a kisel zawh hangin ama gitlohna, mipi mai-ah a kipholak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Mi khat in gum a tawh leh tua sungah amah kia dinga, suangtum a khuk leh tua suangtum in amah kha kik ding hi.","ref":"Est 6:13; Est 2:23"},"28":{"text":"A zuauthei leii in amah liamsakte mudah a; maitang phat kam in mi a siasak hi.","ref":"Ph 12:3"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingciang kimasialhpih kei in, ahang in ni khat in bang piang ding cih na thei kei hi.","ref":"Mt 6:34; 1Ku 20:11"},"2":{"text":"Nang kamin kiphat kei inla, midang kiphatsakzaw in; nang muk hi loin midang khatpeuh hizaw hen.","ref":"Pn 25:27"},"3":{"text":"Suangtum gik a, sehnel vangik ahi hi; mihai khat hehsakna tuate gel sangin gikzaw hi.","ref":"Job 6:3"},"4":{"text":"Hehna gamhtat a, lungsona in hong tuamcip hi, hazatna kua’n thuak zo ding hiam?","ref":"Ms 5:14"},"5":{"text":"A simthama itna sangin a langtanga taihilhna hoih zaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Lawm khat in hong liamsak leh hong deihsakna hi thei-a; gal khat in hong biangtawp leh hong lehbawlna ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 141:5"},"7":{"text":"A gilvahte in khuaizu kih a, a gilkialte in akha nangawn khum sa hi."},"8":{"text":"A inn pana vakthapmangte a bu haih vasa bang ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 16:2"},"9":{"text":"Paknamtui le gim namtui in mihing lungsim nuamsak a, i lawmte khat in deihsaktaka hong kuppihna pan nopna hong phul hi.","ref":"Est 2:12"},"10":{"text":"Na lawmpa mangngilh ke’n la, na pa’ lawmpa zong mangngilh kei in; tuahsiatna in hong vat ciangin na sanggampa inn ah pai kei in - gamlapi a om sanggampa sangin i kianga om innvengpa hoihzaw hi."},"11":{"text":"Ka tapa aw, pil inla, ka lung nuamsak in; tuateh kei hong simmawhbawlte ka dawng thei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 10:1; Pc 24:60"},"12":{"text":"A kidawm thei mi in launa mu in bu-a, mimawl in ahileh phusuakin thuaklawh hi.","ref":"Pn 22:3"},"13":{"text":"Khualmi khat tangin mawlawhtawi nadinga a piak puansilh la inla, uklah numei tawh a kiciamna ahileh tua adingin koih in.","ref":"Pn 20:16"},"14":{"text":"Mi khatin a vengpa zingkhangpi in aw ngaihtak tawh thupha a piak leh a hamsiatin kisang ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Kitot hat zi in guahciin ni-a inn kehkeh tawh kibanga;","ref":"Est 1:18"},"16":{"text":"tuanu khoh in - huihpi khoh ahikeh khut a sathau pham tawh kibang hi."},"17":{"text":"Sik in sik mah hiamsak a, mi in mi mah hiamsak hi."},"18":{"text":"Theikung cingte in a gah ne dinga, a pu a kemte kipahtawi ding hi.","ref":"1Co 9:7"},"19":{"text":"Tui in maitang a leng kik bangin mihing lungsim in a mi mah leng kik hi."},"20":{"text":"Sihna le suksiatnate a in phazosak hun nei lo a, mihing mit zong tuaci hi.","ref":"Pn 30:15-16; Thn 1:8"},"21":{"text":"Sik huantuina ah ngun, pummei ah kham kizia-et a; mihing ahileh a ngah phatna pan kizia-et hi.","ref":"Pn 17:3"},"22":{"text":"An suk bangin mihai khat sum ah na suk hangin a haina na kolhsak kei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Na tuuhonte omzia hoihtakin thei inla, na bawnghonte hoihtakin kem in;"},"24":{"text":"ahang in, hauhna kipden lo a, kumpi lukhu zong khang tawntungin a kipsuak kei hi.","ref":"Pn 23:5"},"25":{"text":"Lopa keu kihahsiangin a thak po a; mualtunga lopate a kikhop ciangin"},"26":{"text":"tuuhonte in puansilh hong guan ding uh a, keelte in na lo man hong pia ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Nang le na innkuanpih kivak nading le na nasem numeinote kham dingin keelnawi tampi na nei ding hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Migilote kuama delh lohin tai-a, mi thumaante ahileh humpinelkai bangin kihtak a nei kei hi.","ref":"Ph 138:3"},"2":{"text":"Gam khatah kilehdona a om ciangin gam-uk tampi a nei hi-a, theihtelna le theihna nei mi khat ahileh gam khat a uk zo hi."},"3":{"text":"Mizawngte b a nuainet gam-ukpa ankungte a hawkmang guah tawh kibang hi."},"4":{"text":"Thukham a thusimlote in migilote pakta a, thukham zuite’n ahileh amaute dal hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi tatsiate in thutang theitel lo uh a, TOPA a zongte in ahileh a cingin theitel sinsen uh hi."},"6":{"text":"A lungsim kawi mihau khat sangin kawkbaang lo-a gamta mizawng khat hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 19:1"},"7":{"text":"Thukham a zuipa thu theikak tapa hi-a, ahi hangin anhaite tawh kithuahpa in, a pa mindaisak hi."},"8":{"text":"Summet sangsak lua-a a hau totote, a zawngte tungah a migi ding midang khat ading a kholsak ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Thukham a za nuam lo peuhmah a thungetna nangawn kihhuai hi.","ref":"Ph 109:7"},"10":{"text":"Mi thutang khat gitlohna lam a zuisakpa ama thang mah ah awk dinga, kawkbaanna om lopa in ahileh gou hoih a ngah ding hi.","ref":"Ph 57:6"},"11":{"text":"Mihaupa ama mitin pil kisa thei dinga, ahi zongin thu theikak mizawngpa in amah a teltheih ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Mi thumaante a gualzawh ciangin kithalawp mahmah a; migilote vang a liat ciangin mite bu uh hi.","ref":"Job 24:4"},"13":{"text":"A mawhnate a impa daupai lo a, pulaaka a tawpsan peuhmah ahileh kilainat hi.","ref":"Ph 32:1-5"},"14":{"text":"TOPA a kihta tawntung mi thupha ngah hi-a, a lungtang khauhsakte ahileh a lungkham hi."},"15":{"text":"Mi cimawhte a uk migilo in humpi hawk le vompi hang mi delh tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"Thumaan lo-a gam ukpa thukhentel thei lo hi-a, amaan lo-a ngah a mudah mi ahileh khansawt nuam a sa ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tualthah khialhna hanga lunggim mi a sih mateng taitai ding hi; kuamah in huh kei hen."},"18":{"text":"Kawkbaang lo a nungtate kihonkhia dinga, a lungsim kawi mi ahileh thakhatin puk ding hi.","ref":"Jer 39:18; Est 6:13"},"19":{"text":"Ama leitang a kho mi in an tampi nei dinga, sunmang sansanpa zawng teitei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 12:11"},"20":{"text":"A muanhuaite thupha tampi kipia dinga, hauhpah a sawmte dan tuak loin a om kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Deihsak tuam neih hoih lo hi - anlum them khat hang nangawnin mi khial thei hi.","ref":"Ph 94:21; Eze 13:19"},"22":{"text":"A iiksiik mi a haupah nuam hi-a, zawnna in a ngak lam a phawk kei hi."},"23":{"text":"Maitang phat mi sangin a taihilh mi a nung ciangin kipaktazaw ding hi.","ref":"Pn 27:5-6"},"24":{"text":"A nu ahikeh a pa neihsa suta, \"Khialhna hi kei,\" a cipa - amah a siasakpa tawh kipawl ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 19:26; Pn 18:9"},"25":{"text":"A huaiham mi in kiselna sosak hi; TOPA a muang mi ahileh a daupai ding hi.","ref":"Pn 14:17"},"26":{"text":"Amah le amah kimuangte mihai hi a, pilna tawh kalsuan mi ahileh kisuaktasak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 4:5"},"27":{"text":"Mizawngte tunga a piate bangmah tasam lo dinga, amau a kimuhmawh-bawlte ahileh hamsia tampi khu ding hi.","ref":"Tp 24:19; Ph 109:17"},"28":{"text":"Migilote vang a liat ciangin mite bu a, migilote a manthan ciangin ahileh a thumaante khangto ding hi.","ref":"Job 20:19"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tamveipi taihilh khita lungkhauh teiteite thakhatin kisia ding uh a - a kibawl thei nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 32:9; 2Kh 36:16"},"2":{"text":"Mi thumaante a khantoh ciangin mite nuam uh a, migilote’n a uk ciangin mite tau uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 11:20; Pn 30:22"},"3":{"text":"Pilna a it mi in a pa lungdamsak a, numei kizuakte tawh a kikhawlte ahileh a neihsa a mawkzat bei ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 5:8-10"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa in thutang tawh a gam kipsak a, golhsum-a huaihampa ahileh a khenkham ahi hi.","ref":"Pn 8:15-16"},"5":{"text":"A vengte a maitang phatte a khe awk nading lenthang kam ahi hi.","ref":"Job 32:21"},"6":{"text":"Migilopa a mawhna mah ah awk a, a thumaanpa ahileh nuamin la a sa thei hi.","ref":"Job 5:13"},"7":{"text":"Mi thumaan in mizawngte tungah thutang a bawl ding khual a, migilo in tua bang deihsakna a nei kei hi.","ref":"Pn 31:89"},"8":{"text":"Mi simmawhte in khuapi sosak a, mipilte in ahileh hehna a vengsak hi.","ref":"Pn 11:11"},"9":{"text":"Mihai khat le mipil khat zum ah a kikhiat leh mihaipa hehin selpho a, kilem thei lo uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Sisan suah nuamte in mi citakte mudah a, a thutangte thah a sawm uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihai in a hehna teng pulak khin a, mipil in ahileh amah le amah ki-ip zo hi.","ref":"Job 15:13"},"12":{"text":"Gam-ukpa in zuauthu a ngaih leh a ulian teng migilo suak khin hi.","ref":"Job 34:30"},"13":{"text":"Mizawngpa le minuainetpa in a kibangin a neih tuak uh hih ahi hi: TOPA in mit khuamuhna pia tuak hi.","ref":"Pn 22:2"},"14":{"text":"Kumpipa in mizawngte thu kilawm-kituakin a khensak leh a tokhom kip tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Ph 72:1-5"},"15":{"text":"Bawlphatna ciangduai in pilsak a, ama thu-a gamta naupang in a nu mindaisak hi."},"16":{"text":"Migilo khangto semsem leh mawhna tam semsem a, thumaan mi in ahileh amaute pukna mu ding hi.","ref":"Ph 91:8"},"17":{"text":"Na tapa sek lecin hong lungnuamsak dinga, na hinna taiisak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Kilaakna om lohna ah mite phengtat uh a, thukham zuipa ahileh thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 1:1-2"},"19":{"text":"Kama gen bekin nasem khat kibawlpha thei lo a; a theitel zongin zui tuan lo ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A pheng paupau mi na mu ngei hiam? Ama ading sangin mihai khat adingin lametna om zaw hi.","ref":"Pn 19:20"},"21":{"text":"Mi khat in a inntengpa a neu tungin a hawmthawh bawl leh a tawpna ah dahna a a tun ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Mi heh khat in kitotna sosak a, a lungsopa in mawhna tampi a bawl hi."},"23":{"text":"Mi khat a kiphatsakna in niamkhiat a, a lungsim kiniamkhiat mi ahileh pahtawina a ngah hi.","ref":"Est 5:12; Pn 11:2"},"24":{"text":"Guta a pawlpihpa, a galpa hi pah a; amah kiciam ahi manin bangmah a genkhia ngam kei hi.","ref":"Sp 5:1"},"25":{"text":"Mihing kihtakna thang kikamsa suak dinga, TOPA a muang peuhmah kihumbit ding hi.","ref":"Pn 16:20"},"26":{"text":"Mi tampi in gam-ukpa maipha zong uh a, ahi hangin TOPA tung pan bekin mihing in thutang ngah hi.","ref":"Pn 19:6; Pn 16:33"},"27":{"text":"Mi thumaante in zuauthu kih a, migilote in mi thutang kih hi."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakeh’ tapa Agur thugente - thusuak b khat: Hihpa in Ithiel tung, Ithiel le Ucal c tungah a gen ahi hi:","title":"Agur Thugente"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing lakah thuthei-lopen ka hi hi; mihing theihtelna ka nei kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Pilna ka sin nai kei a, Siangtho Pa theihna lah ka nei kei hi.","ref":"Pn 9:10"},"4":{"text":"Kua vantung ah kahto in hong kumsuk khin ahi hiam? Kua in a khut kuak sungah huih khawm ngei ahi hiam? Kua in a puantualin tui tun thei ahi hiam? Kua in leimongte khempeuh phutkip ahi hiam? Ama min bang hi-a, a tapa min bang hiam? Na theih leh hong gen dih in!","ref":"Tp 30:12; Isa 40:12; Kil 19:12"},"5":{"text":"\"Pasian kammal peuhmah melhem lo a; ama sunga bute adingin lum ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 12:6"},"6":{"text":"Ama kammalte behlap kei in, na behlap leh hong taihilh dinga, zuauphuak na suak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 4:2"},"7":{"text":"\" TOPA aw, nang tung pan na nih kong ngen hi; ka sih ma-in hong nial kei in."},"8":{"text":"Zuau genna le khemna tawh hong kigamlasak in; zawnna ahi-a hauhna ahi zongin hong pia kei inla, ka nisim an bek hong pia in.","ref":"Mt 6:11"},"9":{"text":"Tua hi kei leh, hau lua leng nang hong kitheihmawhbawl in, ‘ TOPA kua hiam’ ka ci kha ding hi; zawng leng lah guta in ka Pasian min kong daisak kha ding hi.","ref":"Tp 8:12"},"10":{"text":"\"Nasempa khat a pu tungah gensia kei in, nang hong hamsiat in mawh na khu kha ding hi."},"11":{"text":"\"A pate uh hamsiat in a nute uh thupha a pia lo mi om hi;","ref":"Pn 20:20"},"12":{"text":"tua bang mite amau mit-a siang a kisate hi-a, a nitna uh lah a siang tuan kei hi;","ref":"Pn 16:2; Jer 2:23,25"},"13":{"text":"tua mite kiphasak mahmah uh a, vandak vuauvuau-in mi neumuh uh hi;","ref":"2Sa 22:28"},"14":{"text":"lei pana mizawngte le mihing laka a tasamte valhtum nadingin a ha uh namsaute hi a, amaute khaguh ah temta kiphut hi.","ref":"Am 8:4; Job 19:22; Ph 57:4"},"15":{"text":"\"Vot in tanu nih nei hi; amaute in, ‘Hong pia in! Hong pia in!’ ci-in kiko uh hi. \"Kham hun a nei lo na thum om a, ‘Phazo!’ a ci ngei lo li om hi;","ref":"Pn 27:20"},"16":{"text":"tuate in: hankhuk a , aciing sul, tui tasam leitang le ‘Phazo’ a ci ngei lo mei ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"\"Pate simmawh a, nute thuman ding a awlmawh lote’ mit, kuam sunga va-akte in khelkhia-in, musanete in ne ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 15:23"},"18":{"text":"\"Lamdang ka sak luat na thum om a, ka theihtel loh li om hi;"},"19":{"text":"tuate in: huihkhua-a muvanlai lampi, suangpi tunga gul lampi, tuipi vumte tunga tembaw lampi le nungak le tangval paina lampi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"\"Angkawmnu gamtatzia hih ahi hi: An ne in a muk nul a, ‘Khialhna bangmah ka bawl kei hi’ ci hi.","ref":"Pn 5:6"},"21":{"text":"\"Leitung a lingsak na thum om a, a kithuak zo lo li om hi,"},"22":{"text":"tuate in: nasem khat kumpi suak, mihai ankham,"},"23":{"text":"kuama ngaih loh numei khat pasal nei, nasem numei a pi mun suankhia ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"\"Leitung ah neu mahmah napi a pil lua mahmah na lite:"},"25":{"text":"Miksite a hat het lo ganhing hi napi, nipi lai-in an khol uh hi;","ref":"Pn 6:6-8"},"26":{"text":"Sakikhte b vanglian het lo napi suangheng ah kua bawl uh hi.","ref":"Ph 104:18"},"27":{"text":"Kauphete in kumpi nei lo napi athuang athuangin gamtakhawm uh hi.","ref":"Pk 10:4"},"28":{"text":"Innhik, khutin kiman zo napi kumpite innte sungah kimu hi."},"29":{"text":"\"A pai ciangun thupisuak thum om a, a kalsuan tawh kilawm li om hi:"},"30":{"text":"gamsate laka thahat pen, bangmah a kihta lo humpinelkai;"},"31":{"text":"a kihisaka pai aklui, keeltal le a kimkot a galkap om c kumpipa ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"\"Haitatin nang le nang kitawisang ahikeh gitloh na sawm khak leh na khutin na kam hum ou!","ref":"Job 29:9"},"33":{"text":"Ahang in, bawngnawi toktok leng thawhbat suak a, nak nuai leng sisan a luan bangin hehna so leh kiselna piang hi.\""}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Lemuel thugente - a nu hilhsa thusuak d khat in:","title":"Kumpi Lemuel Thugente","ref":"Pn 22:17"},"2":{"text":"\"Ka tapa aw, ka sunga piang ka tapa aw, ka kiciamna e tapa aw,","ref":"Thk 11:30"},"3":{"text":"na thahatna numeite tungah zang kei inla, kumpipa susia nuampa tungah na thatang pia kei in.","ref":"Tp 17:17"},"4":{"text":"\"Lemuel aw, kumpite hih dinga kilawm lote - kumpite in zu dawn loin, gam-ukte in zucil lunggulh lua kei hen,"},"5":{"text":"dawn le uh thukham’ thukipte mangngilhin, a kinuainette hamphatna khempeuh tansak kha ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 16:12"},"6":{"text":"A si dekdekte zucil pia inla a lunggimte zu pia in;","ref":"Pc 14:18"},"7":{"text":"dawn uh henla a zawn lam uh mangngilh in, a gentheihna uh phawk nawn kei uh hen.","ref":"Est 1:10"},"8":{"text":"\"Amau thu a gen thei lote tangin gensak inla, neih a nei lote hamphat nadingin pang in.","ref":"1Sa 19:4"},"9":{"text":"A kilawm a kituakin kampau-in thu khen in; azawngte le a tasamte hamphatna gupsak in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pn 24:23"},"10":{"text":"f A nampi gamtat zi kua in mu zo hiam? Ruby suang sangin manphazaw tham hi.","ref":"Ru 3:11","title":"Khupna: A Nampi Gamtat Zi"},"11":{"text":"A pasal in muang mahmah a, a manpha bangmah a tasam kei hi.","ref":"Pc 2:18"},"12":{"text":"Amah in a pasal tungah a nuntak sungteng siatna tun loin thuhoih a tun hi."},"13":{"text":"Amah in samul le khau teelin lawptakin na sem hi.","ref":"1Ti 2:9-10"},"14":{"text":"Amah sumbawl tembaw tawh kibang a, gamlapi panin an a pua hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah khuamial lai pi-in tho a, a innkuanpihte ading an bawlin a nasem numeite sep ding teng a hawmsak hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah’n lo hoih zongin lei-a; ama thalawhsa-in lenggui a suan hi."},"17":{"text":"Nasep hahkat mahmah a, a nasepna adingin a bante khauh hi."},"18":{"text":"A sumbawlna met sa a, zanin a meivak a mit kei hi."},"19":{"text":"A khutin mui tawi-a, a khutmete in muikung a len hi."},"20":{"text":"Mizawngte huai-in a tasamte a zam hi.","ref":"Tp 15:11"},"21":{"text":"A innkuanbup puansan guan zo ahi manin vuk a kiat hangin a innkuante ading a lunghimawh kei hi."},"22":{"text":"A lupna tuam ding bawl-a; saihadial puan hoih le puan dupsante a silh hi."},"23":{"text":"Khuapi kongpi a gamsung upate lakah a pasal a tut ciangin kizahtak hi.","ref":"Pk 3:16"},"24":{"text":"Amah in saihadial puante khui-in zuaka, sumbukte tungah puan kawnggakte puak den hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah thahatin zahtakbaang a; mailam hun ding a nuihsan lel hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah pil kampau-a a muanhuai lamlahna a gen hi.","ref":"Pn 10:31"},"27":{"text":"Amah in a innkuan sung vana, zawntatna an a ne kei hi."},"28":{"text":"A tate tho-in, ama tungah thupha ci uh a; a pasal in zong tuamah ci-in:"},"29":{"text":"\"Numei tampi in na thupite sem taleh tuate khempeuh na khup hi,\" ci-in a phat hi."},"30":{"text":"Ngaihbaanna in hong khem thei a, mel hoihna lah mual pah hi; TOPA kihta numei ahileh phat ding ahi hi."},"31":{"text":"A thalawhsa pahtakman pia unla, ama sepsa hangin khuapi kongpi ah amah kipahtawi hen."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Thuhilhna","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem kumpipa David tapa Siapa a thugente:","title":"Na khempeuh Amawknapi","ref":"Pn 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Siapa in, \"A mawknapi! A mawknapi! Bangmah hi peuhmah lo a mawknapi! Na khempeuh a mawknapi ahi hi,\" a ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihing in sun nisa nuai-ah gimpi-in na a sepna hangin bang lawhtak ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 2:11,22"},"4":{"text":"Khang khat tungin khang khat bei-a, ahi hangin leitung kibangden hi.","ref":"Job 8:19"},"5":{"text":"Ni suakin ni tum-a a suah nading lamah kuan kik pah hi.","ref":"Ph 19:5-6"},"6":{"text":"Leitaw-lam manawh in huih nunga, leilu lamah nung kikin, suk nun zel to nun zel-a, a zuihna ngei teng mah zui-in nungnung hi."},"7":{"text":"Luite khempeuh tuipi sungah luang-a, tuipi a dim ngei tuan kei hi. Luite a luankhiatna a nak mah ah kilehkik hi."},"8":{"text":"Na khempeuh lunggimhuai-a, mihing gen zawh hi lo hi. Mit in a muh cim ngei lo-a, bil in a zak cim ngei lo hi.","ref":"Pn 27:20"},"9":{"text":"Ahisa mah hi kik-a, a kisemsa mah a kisem kik ding hi; sunni nuai-ah a thak bangmah om lo hi.","ref":"Thn 2:12"},"10":{"text":"\"En sin uh! Hih a thak hiveh! a kici thei ding khat beek om ahi hiam? Sawt pekpek-a a om khinsa mah hi-a, ei hun ma-a a na om khinsa ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Sawt pekpeka te mihing in phawk zo nawn lo a, a piang lai dingte zong a piang nai lote in a phawk kha kei ding hi.","ref":"Pc 40:23"},"12":{"text":"Keimah, Siapa in Jerusalem a Israel-te kumpipa ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Van kikhupsin nuai-a pilna tawh a kisemsa khempeuh guizuiha zonkhiat ding ka nak ngaihsut mahmah hi. Pasian in mihing tunga a suat van gik si e!","title":"Pilna Amawknapi"},"14":{"text":"Sunni nuai-a a kihihsa khempeuh ka mu khin ta-a; a vekpi-in a mawknapi, huih nungdelh lel ahi hi.","ref":"Job 28:3; Thn 2:16"},"15":{"text":"A kihuiheksate kitangsakthei lo a; a om lopi a kisim thei kei hi.","ref":"Thn 7:13"},"16":{"text":"Kei kia-in ka ngaihsuna, \"En in, ka khan khin a, kei ma-a Jerusalem a ukte khatpeuh sangin ka pilzaw hi; pilna le theihna tampitak ka tuakkha khin hi,\" ka ci hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei mahmah in pilna a theihtelna le haina a haitatna ka ngaihsun kak-a, ahi hangin hih zong huih nungdelh lel mah ahilam ka theikhia hi.","ref":"1Ku 3:12; Thn 2:3"},"18":{"text":"Ahang in, pilna tam semsem leh dahna khang semsem-a; theihna khang semsem leh lunggimna tam semsem hi.","ref":"Thn 12:12"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lungsim sungah, \"Hong pai dih in a hoih na muh khiat nadingin nopsakna tawh nang kong zia-et ding hi,\" ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Ahi hangin tua zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.","title":"Nopsaknate Amawknapi"},"2":{"text":"\"Nuihna in haina ahi hi. Tua hileh nopsakna a khiatna bang ahi hiam?\" ka ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Zu-a gualnopna le haina kawicip kawmin - ka lungsim pilna tawh a makaih dingin kei mahmah ka hanciam hi. Van kikhupsin nuai-ah mihingte tomvei a nuntak sungin bang sem leh manpha ding hiam, cih ka thei nuam hi.","ref":"Thk 9:13; Thn 7:4"},"4":{"text":"Nasep lianpi ka sem hi: Kei ading innte lamin lengguite ka suan hi."},"5":{"text":"Huan le khawlmun nuamte ka bawl a, tuate sungah singgah kung namcin ka suan hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua singhalhte tui buah nadingin bualtuite ka bawl hi."},"7":{"text":"Sila numei le sila pasal ka lei-a, ka inn sunga suak adang sila zong ka nei hi. Kei ma-a Jerusalem a om khatpeuh sangin tuuhon le bawng hon tam ka nei zaw hi."},"8":{"text":"Kei mahmah in kumpite le gamte neihsa gou ngun le kham tampitak ka khol hi. Pasal lungsim nopna dingin mihing a lung nuamsak ding - lasa numei, lasa pasal le pasal lungsim nopna dingin zi tampi koihna a zong ka nei hi."},"9":{"text":"Kei ma-a Jerusalem a omsate sangin nakpi in ka lianzaw tham hi. Hihte khempeuh ah ka pil ngei-in ka pil hi."},"10":{"text":"Ka mit iplah khempeuh panin ka kidaam kei hi; ka lungsim nopsakna ka nial kei hi. Ka nasep khempeuh ah nuam ka sa a, hih in ka gimna khempeuh hanga ka pahtakman ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua hi napi ka khuta ka sepsa khempeuh ka et phat kik ciangin haksapi a ka sepnate khempeuh a mawknapi, huih nungdelh lel ahi hi; sunni nuai-ah hamphatna bangmah a om kei hi.","ref":"Thn 1:3"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin pilna, haina le haitatna ka ngaihsun leuleu hi. Kumpite zalaihte in a ma-a semte sepsa zah val bang sem thei ahi hiam?","title":"Pilna le Hainate Amawknapi","ref":"Thn 1:9"},"13":{"text":"Khuamial sangin khuavak a hoihzawk bang tektekin haitatna sangin pilna a hoih zawk lam ka mu hi.","ref":"Thn 7:11-12"},"14":{"text":"Mihaipa in khuamial sunga a pai laitakin mipilpa in a lutangah mit nei a, ahi hangin a nih un a kibanga a tuah ding uh ka thei hi.","ref":"Ph 49:10"},"15":{"text":"Tuateh ka lungsim ka ngaihsun a, \"Mihaite tuah mah kei zong ka tuak ding hi. Tua ciangin ka pil manin bang lawhtak ding ka hi hiam?\" ka ci hi. Ka lungsim sungah, \"Hih zong a mawknapi hi ei!\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Thn 6:8"},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, mihaite mah bangin mipilte sawt a kiphawk tuan kei ding hi; mailam hunah a nihun kimangngilh ding hi. Mihaite mah bangin mipilte zong a si pelmawh ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 112:6; Thn 1:11; Ph 49:10"},"17":{"text":"Tua hi-a sunni nuai-ah gimpi-a nasep in hong khasiasak lel ahi manin nuntakna ka mudah hi. Tuate khempeuh a mawknapi hi a, huih nungdelh lel ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Kei nunga piang dingte adingin ka nusiat pelmawh ding ahi manin sunni nuai-a haksapi-a sepsa na khempeuh ka mudah hi.","title":"Haksapi-a Nasep Amawknapi"},"19":{"text":"Tua hi-a, kua in amah a pil ahikeh a hai ahih ding lam thei ahi hiam? Tua hi napi sunni nuai-a hanciamna le siamna tawh ka sep khempeuh tungah amah in uk ding hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin sunni nuai-ah haksapi a ka nasepte khempeuh hangin ka lungkiat ding kipan hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahang in, mi khat in a pilna a siamna le a theihna tawh na sem dinga, a sem lo mipa adingin ama neihsa khempeuh a nusiat ding hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah hi-a, vangsiatna lianpi khat ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Mihing in haksapi in sunni nuai-ah thatang sanin na a sep man bang ngah ahi hiam?"},"23":{"text":"A nuntak sunga ama nasep, natna le dahna ahi hi; zan nangawnin a lungsim a tawlnga kei hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi khatin, ne-in dawnin na a sepna ah a lungkimna zah val a hoihzaw bangmah a sem thei kei hi. Hih zong Pasian khutsuak hi, cih ka mu hi;"},"25":{"text":"ahang in, amah loin kua in an ne-in nuamsa thei ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Pasian in amah a lung kimsakpa tungah pilna, theihna le lungnopna pia-a, mawhneipa ahileh Pasian a lungkimsakpa tungah a ap ding hauhnate kaikhawmsakin a kholsak hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah hi-a, huih nungdelh lel mah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 39:6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na khempeuh in hun nei ciat hi, van kikhupsin nuai-a piang khempeuh amau hunhun-a piang hi-a:","title":"Na Khempeuh in Hun Neiciat","ref":"Thn 8:6"},"2":{"text":"suah hun omin sih hun om a, suan hun omin bawhkhiat hun om a,","ref":"Isa 28:24"},"3":{"text":"thah hun omin damsak hun om a, phelkhiat hun omin lam hun om a,","ref":"Tp 5:17"},"4":{"text":"kah hun omin nuih hun om a, thum hun omin lam hun om a,"},"5":{"text":"suangte thehthang hun omin tuate khop kik hun om a, kikawi hun omin kikhah hun om a,"},"6":{"text":"zon hun omin mansak hun om a, kep hun omin paihmang hun om a,"},"7":{"text":"balkek hun omin phop hun om a, daih hun omin pau hun om a,"},"8":{"text":"it hun omin muhdah hun om a, kido hun omin kilem hun om hi."},"9":{"text":"Na sempa in gimpi-a na a sepna panin bang lawhtak ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Pasian in mihing tungah a suat vangik ka mu ta hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in na khempeuh amau hun ciat-a a melhoih dingin a bawl ahi hi. Amah in mihingte lungsim a tawntunga ding zong guan napi amaute in Pasian nasepsa a kipatna pan a mong dong a lamteh thei tuan kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Mihingte adingin a nuntak sungun na hoih sema a lungdam ding uh sanga hoihzaw bangmah ka thei kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Mihing peuhmah in ne thei dawn thei-a a nasepna khempeuh ah a kham a ngahna - hih in Pasian letsong ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Pasian sepsa khempeuh a kip tawntung ding ahilam ka thei a; bangmah kibehlap thei loin bangmah a kilakhia thei kei hi. Mihing in amah a zahtak theih nadingin Pasian in tuaci-in a bawl ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 2:3; 5:7; Ph 34:12"},"15":{"text":"A omte a om ngei khinsa hi-a, a om lai dingte zong a om ngeisa mah hi-in, Pasian in a om khinsa mah mangkik a ding hi.","ref":"Thn 6:10; Thn 1:9"},"16":{"text":"Tuateh sunni nuai-ah nadang ka mu lai hi: Thukhenna munah - gitlohna om a, thutang omna munah - gitlohna a om hi."},"17":{"text":"Ka lungsim sungah, \"Pasian in thumaante le migilote tungah thu a khen tuak ding hi, ahang in sepna ding hun omin bawl nading hun om ding hi,\" ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.","ref":"Job 19:29"},"18":{"text":"Kei zong, \"Mihing in, amaute ganhing tawh kibang ahilam a muh theih nadingun Pasian in amaute sittel hi."},"19":{"text":"Mihingte tuah le ganhingte tuah a kibang hi-in, a nih un a kibang tuah ding ngak uh a: Khat a sih bangin a khat zong a si hi. A vekpi in huu sang b ciat uh a; ganhing sangin mihing a tungnun zawkna a om kei hi. Na peuhmah a mawknapi ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"A vekpi-in a mun kibangah pai uh hi; a vekin leivui pan pianga, tuateh leivui mah ah ciah kik hi."},"21":{"text":"Mihingte kha a kahtoh lam le ganhingte c kha lei sungah a tuahsuk lam kua in thei ahi hiam?\" ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.","ref":"Ph 73:22; Thn 12:7"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin mi khat in ama nasep nuam a sak ding sanga hoih zaw bangmah ka mu kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua in ama tanh ahi hi. Ahang in, ama nungah bang piang ding cih a en dingin amah kua in theisak thei ding ahi hiam?"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka et kik leh sunni nuai-a apiang kinetniamna khempeuh ka mu a: A kinengniamte khitui - a huh ding kuamah a neih loh lam; a nengniamte vanglian uh a- tuateh a hehnem ding kuamah a neih loh lam uh ka mu hi.","title":"Netniamna, Nasepna, Lawmtanna","ref":"Ph 12:5; Ta 1:16"},"2":{"text":"A nungta lai mihingte sangin, a si khinsa misite lungdam zaw hi ka cikhia hi.","ref":"Job 3:17"},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin hih gel sangin a piang nai lo sunni nuai-a a kigamta gitlohnate a mukha lote hoihzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuateh mi khat in a vengte engin na nakpi-a kisem ahilam ka mu hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi a, huih nungdelh lel mah ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 1:14"},"5":{"text":"Mihai in a khutte zep a, amah mah kisiatsuah hi.","ref":"Pn 6:10"},"6":{"text":"Gimpi-in sema khutdim nih ngah a huih nungdelhna sangin daitaka khutdim khat ngah hoihzaw hi."},"7":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah a mawknapi pawlkhat ka mu leuleu hi:"},"8":{"text":"Mi khat amah kia om a; tapa ahi a, sanggampa ahi zongin a nei kei hi. Gimpi-a nasep khawl hunnei loin, ama hauhna a mit dim tuan lo hi. Amah in, \"Kua ading gimpi-in na sem-a, bang hangin ka ututin ta lel lo ka hi hiam?\"ci-in kidong hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah hi-a a gentheihhuai nasep ahi hi!"},"9":{"text":"Khat sangin nih hoihzaw hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amau sepna ah a hoih ngah kik uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Mi khat a tuk leh a lawmpa in phong thei hi! Ahi hangin mi khat tuka a phong ding a nei lo pa hehpihhuai si!"},"11":{"text":"Mi nih lumkhawm leh zong a khua uh lum ding hi. Ahi hangin mi khatguak bangci-in a khua lum thei ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat kizothawh thei napi, nih hileh amau le amau kihu thei uh hi. Zang thum kihual khawm khau tat pak lo hi."},"13":{"text":"A kivauhilh thei nawn lo, tek le hai a thuah kumpipa sangin mizawng khangno khat hoihzaw hi."},"14":{"text":"Khangno khat a thongkiatna panin kumpi suak thei a, ama kumpi-gam sung mahmah ah a zawngsa-a suak hi thei hi.","title":"Madawkna Amawknapi"},"15":{"text":"Sunni nuai-a lampai-a nungta peuhmah in kumpite zalaih ding khangnopa a zuih uh ka mu hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute ma-a mite simzawhlohin tam hi. Ahi hangin amau nunga piangte kumpipa zalaihpa tungah a lungkim kei uh hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi a, huih nungdelh lel mah ahi hi."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian inn ah na pai ciangin kidawmin gamta in. A khialh lam uh a thei lo mihaite biakna sangin thu ngai dingin a kiangah pai lecin hoihzaw hi.","title":"Pasian Kihta In"},"2":{"text":"Pasian mai-ah na khatpeuh na gen ciangin kam paukhiat ding manlang kei inla, na lungsimin nawh ngaihsut kei in. Pasian vantungah om a, nang leitunga om na hi hi; tua ahi ciangin na kam tawmsak in.","ref":"Thk 11:35"},"3":{"text":"Lunghimawhna tampi a om ciang in manga a kimat bangin, kam tampi a kipau ciangin, mihaipa haina kilangkhia hi.","ref":"Thn 10:14"},"4":{"text":"Pasian tungah na kiciam ciangin tangtungsak hak kei in. Amah mihaite tungah lungdam lo hi, na kiciamna tangtun in."},"5":{"text":"Kiciamna tangtungsak loh sangin, kiciam loh hoihzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Na kam tawh mawhna sung kitunsak kei in. Biakinnpi thupuakpa kiangah, \"Ka kiciamna ka khial hi,\" ci kei in. Bang hangin na thugenna ah Pasian hehin na khut a na sepsa susia ding ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Mang tampi mat le kam tampi pau a mawknapi ahi hi. Tua ahi ciangin Pasian kihta-in om in.","ref":"Tp 23:21"},"8":{"text":"Gam sungah mizawngte kinengniam a, thumaan le thutang a kinial na muh leh lamdang sa kei in; ahang in, ulian khat amah sanga lianzaw khat in ena, amaute gel tungah a sangzaw dang om lai hi."},"9":{"text":"Gam sunga piangte mi khempeuh in tanga; lo panin kumpipa bek in metlawh hi.","title":"Hauhna Amawknapi"},"10":{"text":"Sum iplah peuhmah in sum a deihzah nei ngei lo a; hauhna iplah peuhmah a ngahzah tawh a lungkim ngei kei hi. Hih zong a mawknapi ahi hi."},"11":{"text":"Nate a khanna tawh ki zui-in, tuate a ne ding a khang hi. Tua ahileh a neipa in a mitin a muh nuam a sak longal, ama adingin bang phatuam ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Nasempa khat in tawm ne in tam ne taleh a ihmut nuam a, ahi hangin mihaupa a hauhletna in a ihmusak thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 20:20"},"13":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah a dahhuai mahmah gitlohna khat ka muh in: hauhna in a neipa nasak a,","ref":"Thn 6:1-2"},"14":{"text":"vangsiatna hangin hauhna maimanga, tapa a neih ciangin ama ading bangmah a nusiat kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Mihing a nu sung pan guaktangin suahkhia a, a suahkhiat bangin a paikhia ding hi. A khut sungah a sepsa bangmah a pua thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 1:21; Ph 49:17; Thn 1:3"},"16":{"text":"Hih zong a dahhuai gitlohna mah ahi hi: Mi khat a suah bangin pai kik hi, huih adingin gimpi-a na a sep nungsang bang lawhtak ahi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"A nuntak hun sung lawhsamin, lunggimin hehsa-in khuamial lakah an a ne hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khat in sunni nuai-ah Pasian piak tomkha a nuntak hun sungin gimpipi-a a sepsate ne-in dawnin kham a ngah ding ama adingin hoih hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi - ahang in, ama lawhtak hih ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua tham loin mi khatpeuh Pasian in neihsa lamsa pia-a a hauhna nuamtakin a zatsak leh ama lawhtak tua mah ahi ciangin sang henla a nasepna ah nuamsa hen - hih in Pasian letsong ahi hi."},"20":{"text":"Pasian in a lungsim lungkimna tawh kem ahi manin a nuntak sung nite a ngaihsun kha kei hi.","ref":"Job 31:2; Thn 2:24"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah gitlohna adang khat ka mu a, mite tungah a gik mahmah hi:"},"2":{"text":"Pasian in mi khat a lungsima a deih teng a kim nadingin hauhna neihsa lamsa le minphatna pia-a ahi hangin Pasian in amah nopsasak loin ama tangin midang khat in nopsak lawh hi. Hih in a mawknapi hi-a a dahhuai gitlohna ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 5:13,19"},"3":{"text":"Mi khat in ta za khat nei-in kum tampi nungta thei hi; amah bang tanvei nungta taleh ama daupaina a nopsakpih kei a, a kivui ding banga a kivui kei leh amah sangin lamhzui naungeek hoihzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"A khiatna nei loin paikhia a, khuamial ah ciah kikin ama min khuamial sungah kikhupcip hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua in ni mukha loin bangmah a theih loh hangin tua mipa sangin sawtvei tawlnga zaw a -"},"6":{"text":"amah kum tul khat zahnih nungta ta leh ama daupaina nuam a sakpih kei hi.A vekun a paina mun uh kibang hi lo ahi hiam?"},"7":{"text":"Mi khempeuh gimpih a kama ding bek hi napi, a ankam limna in phazo sak hun nei lo hi.","ref":"Pn 27:20"},"8":{"text":"Mihai khat sangin mipil khat a hamphatzawkna bang ahi hiam? Mizawng khat in midangte mai-ah a omzia ding a theih hangin bang phatuam ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 2:15"},"9":{"text":"Ankam limna zon kawikawi sangin mita muhna hoihzaw hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi a, huih nungdelh mah hi lel hi."},"10":{"text":"A piangkhiasa peuhmah min kivawhsa hi-in, mihing bang hiam cih a kitheisa hi a; amah sanga hatzaw khat a to ngam kuamah a om kei hi.","ref":"Thn 3:15"},"11":{"text":"Thu tam semsem leh khiatna nei lo semsem hi; tua in mi khatpeuh bang ci phattuamsak hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Mihing khat in a khiatna nei lo hun tomkha sung niliim banga a khenkhen sungin, mihing khat nuntak nadingin a hoih kua in thei ding ahi hiam? Amah a sih khit ciangin sunni nuai-ah bang piang ding cih ama tungah kua in gen thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"1Kh 29:15; Job 14:2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paknamtui hoih sangin minpha hoihzaw a, suahni sangin sih ni hoihzaw hi.","title":"Pilna","ref":"Pn 22:1"},"2":{"text":"Mi khempeuh tawpna, sihna hi a, a nungta laite in a lungsimah ciamteh ding ahi manin pawibawlte inn a hawh sangin a dahte inn a hawh hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Thn 2:14"},"3":{"text":"Nuihna sangin dahna hoihzaw hi, bang hang hiam cih leh lungtang adingin dahmai a hoih hi.","ref":"Pn 14:13"},"4":{"text":"Mipilte lungsim a dahte inn ah om a, ahi hangin mihaite lungsim nopna inn ah a om hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite lasak ngaih sangin, mipil khat hong taina thusim hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 13:18"},"6":{"text":"Beltaw nuai-a lingkung puak zuahzuah bangin mihaite nuih puak zuahzuah hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 58:9"},"7":{"text":"Amaan lo-a ngahna in mipilpa haisak a, golhsum in lungsim nawngkaisak hi.","ref":"Pk 18:21"},"8":{"text":"Thu khat a kipatna sangin a tawpna hoihzaw a, kiphatsakna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw hi.","ref":"Pn 14:29"},"9":{"text":"Mihaite lungtang ah hehna teng ahi manin na hehna zah dongin lungtom kei in.","ref":"Pn 14:29; Mt 5:22"},"10":{"text":"\"Bang hangin tanglai mite, hihte sangin hoihzaw hiam?\" ci kei in, ahang in, hih bang dotna pilvai lo hi.","ref":"Ph 77:5"},"11":{"text":"Gouluah khat bangin pilna hoih a, ni a mute a hampha ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 2:13; Thn 11:7"},"12":{"text":"Sum in hong liah bangin pilna in hong liah hi, ahi hangin theihna a hoihzawkna in: pilna in a neipa nuntakna hutsak hi."},"13":{"text":"Pasian nasepsate ngaihsun dih in: a kawisaksate kua in mamsak thei ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 2:24"},"14":{"text":"Hun a hoih ciangin, lungdam in; hun a siat ciangin ngaihsun in: Pasian in ni khat le nidang khat a kibanga a bawl ahi hi. Tua ahi ciangin mi khat in a mailam thu ding bangmah a mukhia thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 1:21"},"15":{"text":"Hih a mawknapi a ka nuntak sungin, hihte gel ka mu khin hi: a thumaan mi a thumaanna ah mangthang a, a gilo mi a gilosapi mahin sawtpi a nungta hi."},"16":{"text":"Thumaan lua kei inla lah pil lua kei in - bang hangin nang le nang kisusia ding na hi hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Gilo lua kei inla lah hai kei in - bang hangin sihhun ma-in si ding na hi hiam?"},"18":{"text":"A khat lencipin a khat pen zong khah tuan loh ding hoih hi. Pasian a kihta peuhmah in a uanglua khempeuh pel uh hi. a"},"19":{"text":"Pilna in, khuapi khat sunga gam-uk sawm sangin mipil khat vangliansak zaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Leitungah a maana gamta a mawh ngei lo a thumaan mi kuamah a om kei hi.","ref":"2Kh 6:36; Ph 14:3"},"21":{"text":"Mi thugen peuhmah thusim pahpah kei in, tua hi kei leh na nasempa hong hamsiatna na za kha ding a -"},"22":{"text":"na lungsim sungah nang zong midangte tamveipi na hamsiat lam na thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh pilna tawh ka sittel hi-a, \"Pil ka sawm hi,\" ahi hangin hih in kei theih zawh loh ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 1:17"},"24":{"text":"Bangbang ahi zongin pilna gamla lua a, a thuk penpen ahi hi - kua in mukhia thei ding ahi hiam?"},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin theihtelna lamah ka lungsim ka hei a, pilna le nate ngimna le kheltatna a telhakna le haina a haihuaizia telkan ding le a zongkhia dingin ka lungsim ka hei hi.","ref":"Job 28:3"},"26":{"text":"Thang nam khat ahi numei, a lungsim thang kamsa hi-a, a khut sikkhainiang ahi numei, sihna sangin a khaat zawk lam ka phawk hi. Pasian a lungkimsakpa numei panin suakta dinga, ahi hangin mawhneipa tuanu thangah a awk ding hi.","ref":"Pk 10:7; Pn 2:16-19"},"27":{"text":"Siapa b in, \"En un, ka muh khiat hih ahi hi: Nate a ngimna theih nadingin na khat tungah adang khat ka gawma -"},"28":{"text":"ka zonzon lai mahin ka mu tuan kei hi - pasal tul khat lakah a thutang khat ka mu a, numei khempeuh lakah numei thutang khat zong ka mu kei hi."},"29":{"text":"Hih bekbek ka mu hi: Pasian in mite a thutang dingin bawla, ahi hangin mite in ngimna tampi a zongkhia uh hi."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipilpa tawh kibang kua hiam? Nate ahi bang liana a thei kua ahi hiam? Pilna in mite maitaangsak a, a maipuakzia khengsak hi."},"2":{"text":"Pasian mai-ah kiciam khin na hi manin ken kong cih inah kumpipa thupiak mang in."},"3":{"text":"Kumpipa omna mun pan paikhia baih lua kei in. Amah in a lungkimna bangbang hih ding ahi manin thusia lamah pang kei in.","title":"Kumpipa Thu Man’na"},"4":{"text":"Kumpipa thu a sangpen ahi manin ama kiangah,\"Bang hih na hiam?\" kua in ci thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 10:4"},"5":{"text":"Ama thupiakna a mang peuhmah in siatna thuak lo dinga, lungsim pil in a hun leh a paizia thei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahang in, mi khat haksatna ama tungah a gik hangin na khempeuhah a hun leh a paizia om hi.","ref":"Thn 3:1"},"7":{"text":"Mailam thu kuamah in a theih loh nungsang, ama tunga piang ding kua in gen thei ding ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Huih khumcip nading vaang a nei kuamah om lo-a, a tua mah bangin a sih ni ding tungah vaang a nei kuamah a om kei hi. Gal kikap hun laitakin kuamah a kitawpsak loh mah bangin gitlohna gilo-a gamtatna a khahkhia kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Sunni nuai-a kibawlsa peuhmah ka ngaihsutsut ciangin hih teng ka mu hi. Mi khat in ama b siat nadingin midangte a uk hun om hi."},"10":{"text":"Tuateh migilote hanah a kivui hi - tuate mun siangtho ah sung tumin pusuak uh a a gamtatna uh hangin khuapi sungah phatna c a ngah uh hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 1:11"},"11":{"text":"Mawhna thukhenna khat manlangin a kisep khiat loh ciangin mite lungsim in siatna bawl ding a sawm hi."},"12":{"text":"Migilo khat in zavei dong mawhna bawl napi a nuntak veve hangin Pasian mai-ah siangtho a Pasian kihta mite a hoih zawk ding lam ka thei hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua hi napi migilote in Pasian a kihtak loh manun a ma uh vang lo dinga, nilim tawh a kibang a nuntak hun uh zong a kisawtsak kei ding hi.","ref":"Tp 12:28; Thn 3:14"},"14":{"text":"Leitunga piang a mawknapi pawlkhat om lai hi: migilopa ngah dinga kilawm a thumaan mipa in ngah a, a thumaan mipa ngah dinga kilawm migi lopa in ngah hi. Hih zong a mawknapi mah hi, ka ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua hi-a mihing adingin sunni nuai-ah ne-in dawna gualnuama om kana hoihzaw om lo ahi manin gualnopna ka phat hi. Tua ciangin Pasian in sunni nuai-a a dam hun dinga a piak sung teng a nasepna ah amah in nuam a sa ding hi.","ref":"Job 21:7"},"16":{"text":"Pilna le leitunga mihingte nasepna theih sawmin - sun le zana ihmu lo lianga a om uh ka ngaihsunsun a -"},"17":{"text":"tua ciangin Pasian sepsa khempeuh ka mu hi. Sunni nuai-a a piang khempeuh kuama theihtel zawh ding hi lo hi. Ama sepsa khempeuh i zonkhiat nop hangin mihing in a khiatna theikhia zo lo hi. Mipil khat in thei a kisak hangin a thei siang taktak thei kei hi.","ref":"Job 28:3"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh ka ngaihsun kikkik a, thumaante le mipilte in a sep khempeuh Pasian khutsuak hi-a ahi hangin amau tuah ding itna hiam muh dahna hiam cih kuamah in a theih loh lam a tawpna ah ka mukhia hi.","title":"Mi Khempeuh Mong"},"2":{"text":"Mi khempeuh - a thumaante le migilote, a sia d le a pha, a nin le a siang, biakna a pia le a pia lote in a kibangin mong a nei ciat uh hi. Mi hoihpa tunga tung bangbang mawh neipa tungah tunga a kiciampa tunga tung bangbang a kiciam ngamlo pa tungah tung hi.","ref":"Thn 10:14; Job 9:22"},"3":{"text":"Sunni nuai-a a piang peuhmah gitlohna ahi hi: tuate khempeuh a mong uh kibang ciat hi. Tua tham loin mihing lungtang gitlohna vive hi a, a nuntak lai mah un a lungsim uh hai-a tua nung ciangin sihna lam zuan uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A nungta laite laka a om peuhmah in lametna e nei a - humpinelkai sisa khat sangin a nungta lai ui khat nangawn hoihzaw hi!","ref":"Job 9:22; Jer 11:8"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, a nungta laite in a sih ding lam uh thei a, ahi hangin a site in bangmah thei lo hi; amaute in pahtakman nei nawn lo uh a, amaute kiciamtehna nangawn kimangngilh hi.","ref":"Thn 1:11"},"6":{"text":"Amaute itna, amaute muhdahna le amaute hazatna beimang khin ahi nungsang; sunni nuai-a a piang peuhmah bangmah a tangkha nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 21:21"},"7":{"text":"Pasian na nasepna hong angvanna ahi manin: pai in lungkimtakin na an ne inla lung nuamtakin na zu dawn in."},"8":{"text":"Puanpak silh den inla na lu sathau nilh tawntung in."},"9":{"text":"Pasian hong piaksa sunni nuai-a a mawknapi na nuntak hun sung - a mawknapi na hun khempeuh, na it na zi tawh a nuam theithei in zang in. Hih in na nuntak sunga na lawhtak hi-a, sunni nuai-ah gimpi-a na thalawhsa ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Na pai nading hankhuk f ah sep ding om lo, geel ding om lo, theihna pilna lah om tuan lo ahi manin khuta sep ding na muh peuhpeuh na tha neih zahin sem in.","ref":"Ms 6:20; 1Sa 10:7"},"11":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah adang pawlkhat ka mu lai hi: Tai kidemna ah a manlangte in zo kim lo a, a thahatte in gal zo kim loin tua mah bangin a pilte in an kham kim lo uh a, a teite hau kim loin lai siamte a ki-angvan kim kei hi; ahi hangin, amaute khempeuh tungah ahunlem hunin a tung kim hi.","ref":"Job 32:13; Thn 2:14"},"12":{"text":"Tua banah, ama hun tun ding kuamah in a thei kei hi. Len gilo-in ngasa a kimat bang, thangin vasa a kimat bangin gitloh hunah mite awk a, lamet loh laitakin amau tungah a tung hi.","ref":"Pn 29:6; Ph 73:22"},"13":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah ka lungsim hong khoih mahmah pilna gentehna khat zong ka mu hi:"},"14":{"text":"Khatvei lai-in mi tawmkha a tenna khuapi neu khat om hi. Tua khua a do dingin kumpi vanglian khat kuana, a kimkotah galkap tampitak a umcihsak hi.","title":"Haina Sangin Pilna Hoihzaw"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in tua khuapi sunga teng khat zawng napi pila ama pilna hangin tua khuapi a hu zo hi. Ahi hangin tua mizawngpa kuamah in a phawk kha kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin, \"Hatna sangin pilna hoihzaw hi,\" ka ci hi. Ahi hangin mizawngpa pilna kisimmawh a, ama kampaute a kithu simsak nawn kei hi.","ref":"2Sa 20:22; Est 6:3"},"17":{"text":"Mihaite ukpa kikona sangin a gingkhia lo mipilte kampau thusim zawk ding ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Galhiamte sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ahi hangin mawhneipa in na hoih tampitak a susia hi.","ref":"Thn 2:13"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tho sisa in paknamtui a namsiatsak bangin, haina neuno khat in pilna le pahtawina leek zo hi."},"2":{"text":"Mipil’ lungsim taklam ah awn-a, ahi hangin mihai lungsim veilam ah awn hi."},"3":{"text":"Mihaite in ngaihsut nei loin a lampai kawm nangawnun amau haitatna miteng a lak uh hi.","ref":"Pn 13:16"},"4":{"text":"Gam-uk khat nang tungah a heh leh na dinmun nusia kei in; daih khikhena in khialhna lianpi daisak thei hi.","ref":"Thn 8:3; Pn 16:14"},"5":{"text":"Sunni nuai-ah gitlohna khat ka mu-a, gam-ukte pana ngaihsut khialhnate pawl ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Mihaite dinmun sang tampi-ah kikoih a, mihaute in dinmunniam a ngah uh hi.","ref":"Pn 29:2"},"7":{"text":"Silate sakol tungah tuang uh a, gam-ukte sila bangin a khe-un a pai uh ka mu hi.","ref":"Pn 19:10"},"8":{"text":"Gum tote, gum sungah kia thei a; kulh tovangte gul in tu thei hi.","ref":"Ph 57:6; Est 2:23"},"9":{"text":"Suangtum tote tuate mah in liam thei uh a; singtum ekte tuate mah in liamsuah thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Hei kungh a, kitat hiam kei leh thatang san ding kisam a, ahi hangin siamna in hong zosak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Gul in a kikhim ma-in hong tuk leh a khimpa adingin metna om lo hi.","ref":"Ph 58:5"},"12":{"text":"Mipilpa thugen zaknophuai a, ahi hangin mihaipa ama kam in valhtum hi.","ref":"Pn 10:32"},"13":{"text":"A kam patna haihuai a; a kamtawpna gitlohna suakin -"},"14":{"text":"mihaipa in kam tampi pauthuah hi. Kuamah in hong tung ding theikhol lo a - ama nunga piang ding kua in genthei ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 5:3; Thn 9:1"},"15":{"text":"Mihai nasep in amah gimsak a; khuapi zuatna lampi a thei kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Nasem a khat kumpi-in nei a, zingsanga pawi bawl gam-uk a nei gam aw, gimna na thuak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 3:4-5"},"17":{"text":"Nampite kumpi in nei a, ahun manin ne a - kham nading hi loin hat nadingin a ne uliante a nei gam aw, thupha ngah na hi hi.","ref":"Tp 14:26"},"18":{"text":"Mi khat a thadah leh a innsun kuai a, a khut a zawt leh a inn keh hi.","ref":"Pn 20:4"},"19":{"text":"Nuih nadingin pawi kibawl hi-a, zu in nuntak nuamsakin, ahi hangin na khempeuh suma kilei ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 14:18"},"20":{"text":"Na lungsim nangawn ah kumpipa phuisam kei in, ahikeh na lupna inndei ah mihaupa hamsiat kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh huihlak vasa khat in na thugen puak thei dinga, vasa leng khat in na thugen va ko thei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 22:28"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuite tungah na anlum lawn lecin ni tampi khit ciangin na mu kik na ding hi.","title":"Tuite Tungah Anlum","ref":"Isa 32:20; Tp 24:19"},"2":{"text":"Leitungah bang siatna piang ding cih thei lo na hi manin khen sagih khen giat dong suahin mi tungah pia in."},"3":{"text":"Meiite ah tui dim leh, leitungah guah buasuk hi. Singkung khat leilulam ahikeh leitawlam a puk nading munah puk a, a pukna munah lumcip pah hi."},"4":{"text":"Huih nunzia a cing peuhmah in suan lo dinga; meiikaizia a cing peuhmah in a at kei ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Huih paina lampi le a nu sungah pumpi bangci kibawl a cih na theih loh bangin na khempeuh Bawlpa Pasian nasepna na theitel kei ding hi.","ref":"Jn 3:8"},"6":{"text":"Na Khaici zingsangin vawh in, nitak in zong vawh inla na khutte zawsak in, ahang in hih pen maw, hua pen maw, a nih-in hoih tuak ding maw, cih na thei kei hi.","ref":"Thn 9:10"},"7":{"text":"Khuavak nuam a, mit in ni a muh ciangin nuamsak hi.","title":"Na Khangmoi Lai-in Hong Piangsak Pa Phawk In","ref":"Thn 7:11"},"8":{"text":"Mihing khat a nuntak sung kum tampi ahi zongin tuate khempeuh nuamtakin zang ta hen. Ahi hangin amah in khuamial ni ding thei ta hen, ahang in, tuate tampi pha ding hi. Hong tung ding na peuhmah a mawknapi ahi hi.","ref":"Thn 12:1"},"9":{"text":"Khangmoipa aw, na moi lai-in lungnuam inla, na khangno hun sungin na lungsim nopsak bangin om in. Na lungsim hong pina le na mita na muh bang zui in; ahi hangin Pasian in na khempeuh ah thu hong khen ding ahilam thei in.","ref":"Job 19:29"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahitak ciangin na lunghimawhna beisak inla, na pumpi adingin na lungkhamna paikhia in; ahang in, khangmoina le kithatang-muanna a mawknapi ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 94:19; Thn 2:24"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na lungkham ding hun hong tun ma, \"Amaute ah nuam sa ke’ng\" na cih ding kum in hong phak ma,","ref":"2Sa 19:35"},"2":{"text":"ni le khuavak, khapi le aksite mialin, guahzu khina meii ah kileh kikma na khangno hunin nang hong Piangsakpa phawkin; ;"},"3":{"text":"tua hun pen inn ngakte lingin, mi thahatte a maikun ciang, angawite tawm uh ahi manin a khawl ciang, kongvangneu a khuadakte muhna a mial ciang;"},"4":{"text":"kongzinga kongkhakte kikhakin angawina a gin nawn loh ciang; vasa ham in mite phawng napi a hamte uh a ginngaih nawn loh ciang;","ref":"Jer 25:10"},"5":{"text":"mite in khosang kihta-in lamdung lauhuai a sak ciang; almond kung pak ta in kauphe amah le amah tuan dinga, a deih bangmah a om nawn loh ciang ahi hi. Tua ciangin mipa a tawntung inn ah pai ta dinga, a thumte in kong zing zui ta ding uh hi.","ref":"Thn 11:8; Job 10:21; Jer 9:17"},"6":{"text":"Ngun khauhual a kitah ma, kham kuang-uk a kitap ma, tuikhuk ah tuibeel kia-a a kitapzan ma tuibem a lengpei a kitap ma"},"7":{"text":"le hong kuankhiatna leivui ah a ciah kik ma, a piapa Pasian kiangah kha a ciah kik ma-in amah phawk in.","ref":"Job 20:8"},"8":{"text":"Siapa b in, \"A mawknapi! A mawknapi! na khempeuh a mawknapi hi\" a ci hi.","ref":"Thn 1:1; Thn 1:2"},"9":{"text":"Siapa a pil bek hi loin a theihna mi tungah zong a hawmsawn hi. Amah in ngaih sunsunin zongkhia a, paunak tampi a banbanin gual hi."},"10":{"text":"Siapa in thumaan bekbek zongkhia a, a gelhsate thumaanin thutang hi.","title":"Thukhupna"},"11":{"text":"Mipilte thugente gan-ciangkhut tawh kibanga, a kammal khopte uh a kikhenkip siktukkilhte bangin - Tuucingpa khat piak ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Ka ta aw, hihte banah theih beh ding tampi om lai hi. Laibu tampi kibawl taleh bei hun nei lo a, tampitak simna in pumpi a gimsak hi.","ref":"Thn 1:18"},"13":{"text":"Tu-in a vekin i za khin hi; hitakah thukhupna a om hi: Pasian kihta inla a thupiakte zui in, ahang in mihing masuanpi in hih ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 4:2; Tp 4:6"},"14":{"text":"Ahang in, a sia ahi-a a pha ahi zongin a kihihsimte nangawn - a kisem khempeuh tungah Pasian in thu a khen ding hi.","ref":"Job 34:21"}}}}},"22":{"info":{"name":"Zailate’ Zaila","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon zailate’ zaila."},"2":{"text":"Ka zunngek in a mukin hong tawp hen aw mubang nong ngaih ningzu sangin cilzaw e.","title":"Ngaihno"},"3":{"text":"Na duang zunna gimsi nam in duangtham zen e, na sakmin theibang ka lawh leh paknamtui gimsi hong laang ve e. Lianute’n mubang hong ngaih mah ding hi e!","ref":"Zai 4:10; Thn 7:1; Ph 45:14"},"4":{"text":"Uaikai loin kaitui bang hong zawl inla Vaimang in a zaalna saunuam sung hong tun hen aw. Na khavang in sinlai tangbang damsak e; mubang nong ngaih ningzu sang’n pakzaw nu’ng e. Sengual’n lambang hong paak pawh lailawm nah e!.","ref":"Ph 45:15; tg 2","title":"Ngaihno"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem lianute aw, ka sakmel puanbang dum tahal, Kedar limbuk le Solomon puankhai bang ngaihbaang hiuhiau lai hi’ng e.","ref":"Zai 2:14; 4:3"},"6":{"text":"Ka sakmel puanbang dum tahal, nuihsiamin hong lel kha na cia, tangni kata dum hi’ng e. Ka tun vontawi tang laizomte’n ka kungtung lungsit uh e, lenghuante hong zunsak uh e; keima kungtung duang kizun la’ng e.","ref":"Ph 69:8"},"7":{"text":"Hong lel dih aw, duangzen zunngek aw, na tengkhawite koikuam sawlbang hei hiam aw, sunkim tangni a kat lai-in na tuute tawh koi kuam tullim na bel hiam ci’ng e. Na tanggualte tengkhawite siangah zehzum lianu zil ding ka hiam aw?","ref":"Zai 3:1-4; Pc 24:65"},"8":{"text":"Lianu zatam lai-a duang kikhaipen aw, na thei kei leh tengkhawi tuute nuaciang sulbang na zui inla, tuucingte limbuk siangah na lengkeel note tawh bual ve aw.","title":"Sengualte"},"9":{"text":"Ka zunngek aw Pharoah lengkai kolsa-la khat pianzil siam hong sa’ng e.","title":"Sannem"},"10":{"text":"Na bengbah in na laangmai etlawmsak e, na ngawng le awhkhi nunsan kilawmkhawm e."},"11":{"text":"Na bengbah ding kham tawh buhbang bawl le’ng a, a zep nading ngun khainiang in khil le’ng e.","ref":"Zai 5:13; Isa 61:10"},"12":{"text":"Vaimang in laikuang a um lai, ka duang zunna gimsi leng’n kuamteng zel e.","title":"Ngaihno","ref":"Zai 4:11-14"},"13":{"text":"Ka sannemno, anglai nunkhum nihgel kala ka sannemno myrrh thawl khai dungzil sa’ng e.","ref":"Pc 37:25"},"14":{"text":"Ka sannemno ka kungtungah En Gedi lenggui huana henna pallai dungzil sa’ng e.","ref":"Zai 2:3,17;1Sa 23:29"},"15":{"text":"Ka ngaihno duang kikhai ningniang aw! Duang kikhai kim zo sam cia! Na maimit in khuva maimit pianzil hi e.","ref":"Zai 4:7; 7:6; Zai 14:1","title":"Sannem"},"16":{"text":"Ka sannemno, sakduang kikhai kim si cia! Etin lawm si cia! I laikhun zong khawhlo bang dum dildial e.","title":"Ngaihno"},"17":{"text":"I saunuam innkamte aw tamtak gil aw, takcim innsun kizungtuah san singseng e.","title":"Sannem","ref":"1Ku 6:9"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sharon ling pal duang ka zila, phaikuam unok pallai ka zil hi e.","title":"Ngaihno","ref":"Zai 5:13"},"2":{"text":"Lingse kawma unok pal zil, lia zatam kal-a ka zunngek aw e.","title":"Sannem"},"3":{"text":"Tanggual lakah ka sannemno taampi tulsing zing kawma apple tulsing dungzil e. Tutbang khawlin alim sawlbang bel nuam si’ng e, gah thei bang ka ciap khum zungzung e.","title":"Ngaihno","ref":"Zai 1:14; Zai 4:16"},"4":{"text":"Nunnop zilna saulim nuai-ah kei hong pi ve’n, mu bang ngaihno khaidial tung ciangah a laam hi e.","ref":"Es 1:11; Ms 1:52"},"5":{"text":"Zawlgau vei sawlbang vul hi’ng e, lenggah keu tawh ka zaitha zaamsak inla, apple gah thei tawh ka duangtham zenkimsak aw.","ref":"Zai 7:8"},"6":{"text":"Veilam banzal tangkhamin sambang zal ing, ziatlam banzal tawh mawngbang hong kawi hi e.","ref":"Zai 8:3"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem lianute aw, zangkuam khisa le zuksial ngenin tong hong lel ing. Anbang itna a nian masiah: phawngin thelbang thosak kha na cia.","ref":"Zai 5:8; Zai 3:5; 8:4"},"8":{"text":"Na ngaidih ve! Ka sannem aw! Khaubang hong ciah galsialbang va don ve aw. Muallian zui hong zuang vadiang e, mualneu kanin pheiphung khai valian e.","ref":"tg 17"},"9":{"text":"Ka sannem in khisano le zuksa talno dungzil hi e. Maimit suan vaw! Kawmpalhemah hong ding ven, tawhlet pan gal in don ve’n, vathangheng pan maimit hong suan hi e.","ref":"tg 17; Zai 8:14"},"10":{"text":"Ka sannem in ka siangah tong hong lel ven, \"Ka zunngek duang kikhai ningniang aw zuangtho inla sangsul bang hong zui ve aw."},"11":{"text":"En dih vaw lawm! Phalbi daidam meii bang theng e, tulguah luang zong lenmual hem lam kai ta e."},"12":{"text":"Pakte hong palh san singseng e, simlei tualah, zaila’n naubang awi hi e; gamleng khuva’n zaila-in hong khim hi e."},"13":{"text":"Khangthei in gah masa suang ve’n, lenggah gimsi nam viauviau hong laang ta e. Zuang tho-in sulbang hong zui ve aw, ka zunngek ka duangzenno aw\" ci e.","ref":"Isa 28:4; Jer 24:2; Zai 7:12"},"14":{"text":"Lumsuang thepa ka khuvano, mual hema bu khinkianno aw e, na laangmai nel hong hil ve aw, na tongnem hong luan ve aw; na tongdam lah ningbang khum sa’ng, na laangmai lah ngaihbang hiuhiau hi e.","ref":"Pc 8:8; Zai 1:15; Zai 1:5","title":"Sannem"},"15":{"text":"Gam ngiate hong matsak aw, gam lenggah teng ngianote’n zubang siasak zota aw, i lenggah teng a pallun laitak hi e.","ref":"Thk 15:4; Zai 1:6; Zai 7:12"},"16":{"text":"Ka sannemno kei aa hi e, kei zong ama lianem ka hi e; unok pallun a lai ah e, tuu tawh sawlbang heikhawm e.","title":"Ngaihno"},"17":{"text":"Muikhua zinlai taikhua val ma’n mualphok lum suang palnena khisano le zuksano bang, ka sannem aw ka siang sulbang heinawn aw.","ref":"Zai 4:6; tg 8; tg 9; Zai 1:14"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zan khawsawt laikhun tungah e, gelgel ing e, lunga ka gulh ka laikuai khimzin tuanglam zawtmawh hi ta’ng e.","ref":"Zai 5:6; Isa 26:9"},"2":{"text":"Zuangtho ning e vangkhua tuallai tuanglam dung le tual-awng teng; ka sinlai kuai va vai ning ci’ng e. Ka sinlai kuai ka vai hang hambang vaihpih zo ta’ng e."},"3":{"text":"Vangkhua vil a kualvialte tawh dawnbang tuakin, \"Mubang ka ngaih ka zunnelno koi kuam sawlbang hei a hiam?\" ci’ng e.","ref":"Zai 5:7"},"4":{"text":"Amau’ nua ciang ka siat nua’n e lunglai kuai tawh dawnbang tuak ing e. Mimbang pianna ka tun saunuam kei hong paii lam gialbang kiatna ka tunnu siangsung ka tut dong khah lo sialbang kai ing e.","ref":"Zai 6:9; Zai 8:2"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem lianute aw, zangkuam khisa le zuksial ngenin tong hong lel ing: Anbang itna a nian masiah phawngin thelbang thosak kha na cia","ref":"Zai 2:7; Zai 8:4"},"6":{"text":"Paknamtui le myrrh gimsi tuibang gawma lunta gimnam viauviau in keugaw gam vaivut kitungsaka maciang a suan singta vontawi kua pen ahiam aw?","ref":"Zai 1:3; 4:6,14; Pk 30:34; Zai 8:5"},"7":{"text":"Maimit suan aw! Solomon taalbuk, Israel-te’ gualtung kikhai tang ngalliam sawmgukte’n kulh,"},"8":{"text":"lalkhelhna a gualtung tuangte’n, kheelah namtem paibang kuah dimdiam uh e, khimzing nuaiah namtem tawi ve’n sang le lal veng a hiam aw.","ref":"Job 15:22; Ph 91:5"},"9":{"text":"Vaimang Solomon a taalbuk aw e, lungdeiha giabang a zun aw, Lebanon taamtak gilno tawh e, lungdeih buhbang a bawlsa hi e."},"10":{"text":"A khuam dingin ngun khuam tung ve’n kham citak tuala a phah hi e. Vaimang tokhom silhpuan dupsan, khiangkawi khak siam Jerusalem lianute banzal hi e,"},"11":{"text":"Zion lianute aw e, hong tualsuak vevua, Vaimang Solomon tuklu a sawnkai nel aw etin lawm e, maimit suan ciat ve ni e, angkawi tawh tuibang a gawm ni’n tunnu’n tuklu nel suansak a, sinlung tangbang a dam ni hi e.","ref":"Isa 4:4"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka zunngek aw duang kikhai aw! Duang kikhai ngi-ingei aw e! Khipdial hema na maimit gel gam khuva maimit dungzil e. Na besam phial singseng aw e, Gilead Vum pan lengkeel hon tualkum zil e.","title":"Sannem","ref":"Zai 1:15; 5:12; Mic 7:14"},"2":{"text":"Na tuhate pak singseng e, tuute besam met khit lima damtui-a bual dungzil e. Kop in peng e, mala tuam kai om lo e."},"3":{"text":"Na mukte aw san hiuhiau e, na tongsuah ngaihbaang sa’ng e. Laangmai khuhna dialvang kawma na khosan lihleh aw e mangkawlsing angno zil e","ref":"Zai 5:16; Zai 6:7"},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng kitung et-a lawmno tang ngalliamte’n siallum tul khat a khaina, khotaka dawh David tausang a tee ziahziah dungzil e.","ref":"Zai 7:4"},"5":{"text":"Na anglai a nunkhum nihgel unok pallak heikhawm helhel zuksa pengno dungzil e","ref":"Zai 7:3"},"6":{"text":"Taikhua val ma khim zin’ lai teng, myrrh paak mual ah khawl ve ning e gimnamtui lakah va bual ding hing e.","ref":"Zai 2:17"},"7":{"text":"Ka zunnelno ningniang aw e, duang kikhaikim zo sam cia, zubang na siat zata a lel om lo e.","ref":"Zai 1:15"},"8":{"text":"Ton dih ni e ka thai lianu Lebanon pan, pheiphung suankhawm ve ni e. Sangsa limlian humpinelkaite kua le gialbem-te sawlbang heina Amana mualkhum dawn le Senir kuidawn pan, Hermon kuivum pan lungtai tualkum khawm le’ng e.","ref":"Zai 5:1"},"9":{"text":"Laizom lianu ka thai lianem, ka sinlung lai hong kuai ve cia; khatvei hemlam maimit nong paih leh na awhkhi san suangmanpha in duangtham hong zenlua sa’ng e.","ref":"Pc 41:42"},"10":{"text":"Laizom lianu ka thai lianem aw, mubang nong ngaih nuam zungzung e! Ningzu khum’n sing zo lo a, na duang zunna gimsi leng zong gimtui zata sing zo om lo e."},"11":{"text":"Ka thai lianu na muk panin khuailu-zu khum bang takkhia-a na leii dang pan bawngpi nunkhum le khuaizute taakkhawm e. Na silhpuan gimsi namno, Lebanon gim nam hi e.","ref":"Ph 19:10; Zai 5:1; Hos 14:6"},"12":{"text":"Laizom lianu ka thai lianem; deihzun khanghuan umtuan aw e, siktui luansiam samtuinak umtuam no aw e.","ref":"Pn 5:15-18"},"13":{"text":"Na khanghuan aw tulsing namcih gahthei minlun-mangkawlsing le henna le nard tulsing in ban lo e;","ref":"Zai 6:11; 7:12; Zai 1:14"},"14":{"text":"gimnamtui sing liibang cin’na nard le safteron, calamus le cinnamon, myrrh le aloes le gimnamtui teng tuibang kigawm na aw e.","ref":"Zai 3:6"},"15":{"text":"Khanghuan dung zui siktui dam luan Lebanon pan phul hi ngeingei cia."},"16":{"text":"Zuang hong tho aw mal huihkhi aw sim huihkhi tawh hong laang khawm ve aw! Ka khanghuan teng hong sem unla, huan sung gimsi’n zeel hen aw. Ka sannem in a huan thangbang vil henla, deih ciibang tel thei minlun teng vaciam dih hen aw.","title":"Ngaihno"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Laizom lianu ka thai lianem, khanghuan thangbang veh khin ta’ng e; ka myrrh le ka gimnamtui hambang huai khin zo ta’ng e. Ka khuailu-zu le ka khuaizu, sung nekin nei khin ta’ng e. Ka ningzu le bawngpi nunkhum phawi loh dawn khat suah ing e. Nene unla dawndawn vevua ka sengual ngaihte aw e; sunggil dipna’n dawndawn vevua, ka sannemno teng aw e.","title":"Sengualte","ref":"Zai 4:11; Isa 55:1"},"2":{"text":"Laikhun tung sambang zal tahal, sinlung maimit sing maw’ng e. Ngai dih sin aw! Ka sannem in kot hong kiu ve’n, \"Kot hong hon aw ka laizom ka zunngek aw, ka khuvano lelbaang lo aw e. Ka sumlu teng zingdai nom’n tuam ve’n, ka besam dong nomsak lawm aw\" hong ci e.","title":"Ngaihno"},"3":{"text":"Ka silhpuan baat suahkhin ta’ng e. baat kik lai ding ka hiam aw? Ka pheiphung teng sil khin ta’ng e, buan ka baang kiksak diam aw?"},"4":{"text":"Ka sannem in banzal hong khak awngvang panin lia ka sinlai hong zen lua sa’ng e."},"5":{"text":"Zuangtho ing e ka sannem kot hon dingin, ka namsak a ka banzal myrrh gimsi tawh, khutme’ myrrh gimsi’n kot kalhna dong namsak e."},"6":{"text":"Ka sannem kot ka hon leh nuaciang sia-in sul na hei khin zo tah e. Lenmual hemah kaitah lawm aw. Nuaciang hong siat’ sinlai thalbang hong do e. Sangbang vai hang mela muh cih om lo e. Malbang koh hal tong hong dawng kik om lo e.","ref":"Zai 6:1; Zai 6:2; Zai 3:1"},"7":{"text":"Vangkhua vila vangkhuapi kim vialte in dawnbangin hong tuak uh e. Lia duangah banzal hong nga ven, sansin ka duang hong bual e; kawmpal dawna galvilte’n ka silhpuan-tual hawk ta e!","ref":"Zai 3:3"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem lianute aw hong ngen ing e , ka sannem dawnbang na tuah leh a siang bang na lel ding ua? ‘Zawlgau vei-in sawlbang vul’ ci’n lel ve aw.","ref":"Zai 2:7; 3:5; Zai 2:5"},"9":{"text":"Lianu zatam lai-a duang kikhaipen aw, na senngaihno duang kikhai tuam diak hiam aw? Hih zahta a ko tung nong nget na senngaihno duang kikhai tuam diak hiam aw?","title":"Sengualte"},"10":{"text":"Ka sannemno san hiuhiau in zaitha hat a, tanggual tul sawm alai ah e tehpih ding melin ma’ng e.","title":"Ngaihno","ref":"Ph 45:2"},"11":{"text":"A sumlu a besam aw kil thiuhtheuh e, kham citak tawh khaituah ing e, akva dum dungzil sa’ng e."},"12":{"text":"A maimit aw khuva maimit, siktui piau nunkhum-a bualsa suangmanpha zunkhitsa dungzil e.","ref":"Zai 1:15; Pc 49:12"},"13":{"text":"A biangno aw gimsi khahkhia gimsi zaamsak khanghuanno bang e. A muk siusiau myrrh gimsi a kidiahna unok pallunno bang e.","ref":"Zai 1:10; 6:2; Zai 2:1"},"14":{"text":"Kham cianggolh sun a banzalno chrysolite suangngo a zunnel hi e. A sakduang aw vuisai halep zunnel tunga sapphire phum dungzil e."},"15":{"text":"A pheiphung aw suangngo khuampi kham citak tunga gel hiam ci’ng e, A laangmai aw pianin dang e, Lebanon mual cedar tulsing hoihpen dungzil e.","ref":"1Ku 4:33; Zai 7:4"},"16":{"text":"A tongsuah aw khum zungzung e. sakduanga ngaih a baangno aw e. Kei ka senngaih hih bang hi e, khanpih ka lawm gual hi e Jerusalem lianute aw e.","ref":"Zai 7:9"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lianu zatam lai-a duang kikhaipen aw, na sannem heina koi kuam hiam aw? Tong hong lel aw na sannem heina sangbang vaipih nuam ung e?","title":"Sengualte"},"2":{"text":"Gimsi pak nam viauviau huan ah ka sannem vailo a kuan hi e. Khanghuan ah tuute cing kawmin unok pallai khawm hi e.","ref":"Zai 5:13; Zai 4:12; 5:6","title":"Ngaihno"},"3":{"text":"Kei pawh ka ngaihno aa hi’ng e, ka sannem zong kei aituam hi e; unok pal huan a lai-ah e, tuu tawh sawlbang heikhawm e.","ref":"Zai 7:10"},"4":{"text":"Duang kikhai cia ka zunngek aw, Tirzah le Jerusalem dungzil in ngaihbaang ve cia, dialkhai nuai-a lal nawh honte bang etlawm ve cia.","title":"Sannem","ref":"Jos 12:24, Ph 48:2; tg 10"},"5":{"text":"Maimit hong suansuan lo aw, sinlai hong zen lua hi e. Na besam lah lengkeel hon gual Gilead pan tualkum zil e."},"6":{"text":"Na tuhate pak singseng e, tuute besam met khit lima damtui-a bual dungzil e. Kopin peng e, mala tuamkai om lo e"},"7":{"text":"Laangmai khuhna dial vang kawma na khosan lihleh aw e, mangkawlsing angno zil e.","ref":"Zai 4:3"},"8":{"text":"Vaimang angkawi sawmguk omin thaike sawmgiat in hong pawmin, lianu zatam melmak lai ah,"},"9":{"text":"duang kikhaikim ka khuvano pianin dang diak se hi e, tunnu vontawi malkhai lianu tunnu zozam nelkaai no hi cia. Lia zatamte’n maimit suan e, luntawita zilnu ci a; vaimang thai le thaikete’n zong lambang pakkim ciat uh e.","ref":"Zai 1:15; 5:2; Zai 3:4"},"10":{"text":"Zingdam solno suak dungzila, tung solkha pi banga kilawm tung sunni tangpha dungzila, tungciang si-al bawm khawl dungzila, pheiphung khaisiam kuata vontawi ahiam aw?","title":"Sengualte"},"11":{"text":"Gamkuam a tulsingnote thangbang vil ding le lenggui in dawn a suang ta hiam, mangkawlsingte a pallun hiam ci’n khanghuan ah vailo kuan ing e.","title":"Sannem","ref":"Zai 7:12"},"12":{"text":"Lunga ka gel theih ma-in aw, vaimang kolsa lengte le sengual lakah bual kisa ve’ng e."},"13":{"text":"Sul hong hei vaw sul hong hei ven Shulam lianemnu aw e; sakmel laangmai nibang et na’ng sulbang hong hei nawn ve aw.","title":"Sengualte"},"14":{"text":"Mahanaim a lamsai et bang, Shulam lanu bang hang maimit suan ding na hiam aw?","title":"Sannem","ref":"Pk 15:20"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vaimang vontawi lianu aw e, na kengdap le na pheiphung, etin lawmkhawm e! Na pheiphung aw etin lawm ven banzal siamte suangmanpha zun dungzil ke’n sa’ng e.","ref":"Ph 45:13"},"2":{"text":"Na laaibu kuak kiukeu aw e, ningzu loihloh ningbelno aw e. Na kawnggekin sutmel nei e, mangbuh sunvum unok pal um dungzil e."},"3":{"text":"Na ang nunkhum nihgel aw e a ta helhel zuksano peng dungzil e.","ref":"Zai 4:5"},"4":{"text":"Na ngawng in lah vuisai halep tausang dungzil e. Na maimit in Bath-Rabbim kongpi nena Heshbon bualte zil e. Na nak lah Lebanon tausang Damascus lam nga tawh teh’ng e.","ref":"Ph 144:12; Zai 4:4; Ms 21:26; Zai 5:15"},"5":{"text":"Na tuklu a na khuklu in Carmel Vum sang a sun e. Na besam in vaimang silhpuansan zil ven, na besam zun abawk in e vaimang sinlung kolbulh e.","ref":"Isa 35:2"},"6":{"text":"Na duang kikhai ngi-ingei in aw, lungsung sawlbang damsak e, na lungtaina kei aa’n zong na tailawh e.","ref":"Zai 1:15"},"7":{"text":"Na sakduang tumsing mam aw e na nunkhum in a gah lunlai zil sa’ng e.","ref":"Zai 4:5"},"8":{"text":"\"A gah haithei bang lo dingin, gam tumsing kung va kai ning\" ci’ng e. Na nunkhumte gamleng bang bawkpha henla na husan in apple gimsi zil henla,","ref":"Zai 2:5"},"9":{"text":"ningzu khumpen zil dingin na tongsuah khum den hen aw.
