Ka sannem siang’ ningzucik luangden henla, a muk a ha tuam den leh ci’ng e.","ref":"Zai 5:16","title":"Ngaihno"},"10":{"text":"Ka sannem in hong tang khin e ka kungtung ah a sinlai nunbang belh e."},"11":{"text":"Hong leng dih aw ka sannem aw, gam tulta lak va tuanleng a, vangkhaw neu ah ning ne lo taikhua valsak leng ci’ng e."},"12":{"text":"Zumei tuanin lenggui huan ah kuan leng a lenggui in dawn a suan a leh, a pal ngum a palhkhiat a, mangkawlsing a pallun a leh tua munzang ah itna cinteng hong pia le’ng ci’ng e","ref":"Zai 1:6; Zai 2:15; Zai 4:13; 6:11"},"13":{"text":"Zawl-ai in gimsi laangsak e, saudawng nena haithei minlun, amin apuam liibang cing e, ka sannemno adingin gawltuam ing e.","ref":"Pc 30:14; Zai 4:16"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nang ka tang laizom, tunnu anglai nunkhum luaihpih hi lecin maw! Kongzing lai-ah hong mu-in kong tawptawp zong’ singta’n nuihsiam in hong lel lo ding hi e."},"2":{"text":"Siambang sinsak tunnu saunuam ah hong pi nuam ing e. Ningzu khum le ka mangkawlsing niing na nian’ dongin hong tulh nuam ve’ng e.","ref":"Zai 3:4"},"3":{"text":"Veilam banzal tangkhamin sambang zal ing, ziatlam banzal tawh mawngbang hong kawi hi e."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem lianute aw hong ngen ing e: Anbang itna a nian’ masiah phawngin thelbang thosak kha na cia.","ref":"Zai 2:7; 3:5"},"5":{"text":"A gam vangla keugaw gam pan a sannem tunga kingam maciang hong suan kua ta lia vontawino hiam ci’ng e. Na tunnu’n naubang hong paiina, apple tulsing lim nuai a mimbang na pianna mun zawlah tanglo bang hong phong hi’ng e","title":"Ngaihno","ref":"Zai 3:6; Zai 3:4"},"6":{"text":"Na sinlung sung’h nunbang in hong belh inla, na banzal ah mangmawh ding hong zun ve aw; anbang itna hiambang hatte kha pham zahin, a aamna zong zalna kulsin zil hi e. Kam meikuang bangin kang ven, kammeipi kuang bang alh e.","ref":"Ms 5:14"},"7":{"text":"Anbang itna siktui tampi’n buak mit zolo a, khawkhang guntui’n tai siang thei lo e. Itna lei na’ng gou le gamh i pholh zongin, gualin nuihsiamin hong leel lel ding hi e."},"8":{"text":"I tuai lianu moi lua lai e ang nunkhum gel mom lo lai hi e. Singta’n it tongdam hong kha leh i tuai lianu koi bang i lelsak diam aw?.","title":"Sengualte"},"9":{"text":"I tuai lianu kawmpal hi leh, ngun tausangpi a tung giabang zun ni e. I tuai lianu dawngkot hi leh, cedar tamtak gil tawh zun ni e."},"10":{"text":"Kei pawh kawmpal kiciang hi’ng e ka nunkhum gel tausang bang hi e. Tanggual maimit ka duang baang ve’n ka ngaih kibaanna zong ka hi e,","title":"Ngaihno"},"11":{"text":"Solomon in Baal Hamon ah gam lenggui huan zun hi e. Lenggah hambang a huai ni ciang ngun shekel tulkhat ciat a kai e.","ref":"Thn 2:4; Isa 7:23"},"12":{"text":"Ka lenghuan bel kei thu hi e, a ngun shekel tulkhat bel nang huai ding hi e, Solomon aw, nguntang zanih singgah khawmte thaman ding hi e.","ref":"Zai 1:6"},"13":{"text":"Khanghuan a tengte aw e huan cing sengual ngaihteng tawh, tongdam mal zinbang hong khak dih lai ve aw!","title":"Sannem"},"14":{"text":"Sensan ka sannem laitual hong leeng inla, tumtai namcin a pona’ tang ii tungah, khisano le zuksialno bang ka siang hong tualbual ve aw.","ref":"Pn 5:19; Zai 2:8,17; Zai 2:9","title":"Ngaihno"}}}}},"23":{"info":{"name":"Isaiah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah-te hun sunga Judah le Jerusalem tawh kisai Amoz tapa Isaiah in a mangmuhna ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Vante aw, za un! Leitung aw, ngai in! TOPA in gen khin zo hi. \"Tate ka khoi a, khang lian khin uh hi, ahi hangin amaute in kei hong lehdo uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:26; Isa 24:5","title":"A Lehdo Minam"},"3":{"text":"Bawngtal in a pu thei hi, laa in a neipa’ gan ankuang thei a ahi hangin Israel in thei loin ka mite in a theitel kei uh hi.","ref":"Pc 42:27; Tp 32:28"},"4":{"text":"Ah! Amawhdim minam khialhna netcip mite a gilote suante siatna-a ka piaksa tate ahi uh hi. Amaute in TOPA taisan uh a; Israel Siangtho Pa simmawhin amah nungngatsan uh hi.","ref":"Isa 9:17; Ph 14:3; Tp 32:15; Pn 30:9"},"5":{"text":"Bang hangin note hong kisat beh lailai ding ahi hiam? Bang hangin lehdo lailai na hi uh hiam? Na lutang buppi liam khin a, na lungsim buppi gimlua khin hi.","ref":"Pn 20:30; Isa 31:6"},"6":{"text":"Na khepek nuai-a kipan na sipzang dong a damna mun om lo a - liamna sidup le meima naiphual bek omin kihah lo, kitun loin sathau lah a kinuh kei hi.","ref":"Isa 53:5; 2Sa 14:2"},"7":{"text":"Na gam uh kilawi ta a, na khuapite uh mei-in kihaltum hi. Gamdang mite in na muhtang un na gam uh hong sut uh a, khualmite in susia khin ta uh hi.","ref":"Sp 26:16; 2Ku 18:13"},"8":{"text":"Zion Tanu, lenggui lo-a bukkhel bang, tangmai huan a hampheng bang le a ki-umcih khuapi bangin kinusia ta hi.","ref":"Job 27:18"},"9":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in eite tawmno khat hong sit lo hileh Sodom tawh kibang khinin Gomorrah tawh i kibang khin ding hi.","ref":"Pc 19:24"},"10":{"text":"Sodom gam-ukte aw, TOPA kammal za un; Gomorrah mite aw, i Pasian thukham ngai un!","ref":"Pc 13:13"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Tua zahta-a tam na biakpiakna uh - kei adingin banga kimang ahi hiam?\" ci hi. \"Tuutalte le ganhing vakthaute’ thaute tawh meihal biaknate ka kham lua ta hi. Bawngtalte, tuunote le keelte sisan tawh ka lungkim kei hi.","ref":"Ph 50:8; 1Sa 15:22"},"12":{"text":"Kei tawh kimu dinga nong pai ciangun ka inntualte hih banga tuancil dingin kua in hong sawl hiam?"},"13":{"text":"A khiatna nei lo biaknate hong kengkeng nawn kei un! na gimnamtui uh ka kih hi. Kha det nite, Sabbath-te le kikhopna thupite - na gitloh kikhopnate uh ka thuakzo nawn kei hi.","ref":"Pn 15:8; 1Ku 14:24; 1Kh 23:31"},"14":{"text":"Na Khadet pawite uh le na pawi tuamtuamte uh ka hinna-in ka mudah hi. Tuate kei adingin vangik suak a; tuate pua-in ka gim hi.","ref":"Ph 11:5; Job 7:12"},"15":{"text":"Na khut uh zakin thu na nget uh ciangin ka mai kong selsan hi; thu tampi na nget uh hangin ka ngai tuan kei ding hi. Na khutte uh sisan tawh kidim hi;","ref":"Tp 31:17; Tp 1:45"},"16":{"text":"sil unla no le no kisiangsak un! Na gamtatsiate uh ka muhna ah sem nawn kei un! Na bawlbawl uh khialhnate tawpsan unla,","ref":"Mt 27:24"},"17":{"text":"thumaan sin un! Thutang zong un, a kinengniamte a hanthawn un. Pa nei lote hu unla, meigongte thu gensak un.","ref":"Ph 34:14; Pk 22:22"},"18":{"text":"\"Tu-in hong pai un, kikumkhawm dih ni,\" TOPA in ci hi. \"Na mawhnate uh ausan bangin a san hangin vuk bangin a pak ding hi; kheisan bangin a san hangin tuumul bangin ngo ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:25; Ph 51:7; Isa 55:7"},"19":{"text":"Note in utin thu na man uh leh na gamsungua piang a hoih pen na ne ding uh a;","ref":"Tp 30:15-16"},"20":{"text":"ahi hangin hong langpanga nong lehdo uh leh namsau in hong nawmvalh ding hi,\" Ahang in, TOPA kam in a gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Job 15:22"},"21":{"text":"En dih un, bangci banga a muanhuaisa khuapi numei kizuak suak zawzen ahi hiam! Khatvei lai-in thutang tawh kidim hi; ama sungah thumaanna teng a, tu-in lah tualthatte bekbek teng ta!","ref":"Jer 2:20; Pn 6:17"},"22":{"text":"Na ngunte sumngo-ek suaka, na zucil pente tui kihelin peeng ta hi.","ref":"Ph 119:119"},"23":{"text":"Na gam-ukte a lehdote suakin gutate tawh kipawl uh hi; amaute in golhsum iplah uh a, a mawk piak dingte nungzuih uh hi. Amaute in pa nei lote panpih lo uh a, meigongte thu a sang kei uh hi.","ref":"Pk 23:8; Isa 10:2"},"24":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Topa, Thahatpen TOPA , Israel-te Thahatpen Pa in: \"Ah, ka galte panin ka honkhia dinga kei mahmah in ka galte phu ka la ding hi.","ref":"Pc 49:24; Tp 32:43"},"25":{"text":"Note langkhatah ka khut liik-in na saam-ek teng uh ka siaksiang mang dinga, na siantholohnate uh ka hemkhia mang ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:63; 2Kh 29:15"},"26":{"text":"Hunlui lai bangin na thukhente uh omsakin na thudotte uh a tunglai ka bangsak ding hi. Tua teng khit ciangin nang Thumaanna Khuapi, A Muanhuai Khuapi hong kici ding hi,\" cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 4:3"},"27":{"text":"Thutangin Zion kitankhia dinga, ama sunga kisikkik mite thumaanin kitankhia ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 30:15"},"28":{"text":"Ahi hangin a lehdote le mawh neite kisia khawm ding uh a, TOPA a taisante a mangthang ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 9:5"},"29":{"text":"\"Nuam na sak mahmah uh tawsaw kung siangthote hangin na maizum ding uh hi; na deihtel uh huante hangin na zahlak ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 57:5; Isa 65:3"},"30":{"text":"Note tui a om lo huan bangin, a tehpulhsa tawsaw na bang ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 1:3"},"31":{"text":"Mi thahatpa lee suak dinga ama nasep mei-ek suakin a nihin kangtum khawm dinga tua mei kuamah in a phelh zo kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 4:4"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Judah le Jerusalem tawh kisai Amoz tapa Isaiah muhna ahi hi:","title":"’ Mual","ref":"Isa 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Ni nunungte ah TOPA ’ biakinnpi mual, mualliante laka a lian pen bangin kikipsak dinga; mual neute tungah kisangsakin minamte khempeuh in a zuan zuahzuah ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 65:9; Ph 102:15"},"3":{"text":"Mi tampite pai-in, \"Hong pai un, TOPA ’ mual tung Jacob Pasian inn ah va paito ni. Amah in a lampite i zuih theih nadingin eite hong hilh ding hi,\" ci ding uh hi. Zion panin thukham hong paikhia dinga, Jerusalem panin TOPA kammal hong paikhia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 45:23; Tp 33:19; Isa 1:10; Lk 24:47"},"4":{"text":"Amah in minam khat le khat kikal ah thu khen dinga, mi tampi kitotna a vengsak ding hi. Amaute in a namsaute uh tu in sek ding uh a, a teipite uh tem mukkawi-in a sek ding uh hi. Minam khat in minam khat tungah namsau liik nawn loin galsim dingin zong a kisin nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 49:10; Joel 3:10; Ph 46:9"},"5":{"text":"Jacob innkuante aw hong pai un, TOPA khuavak sung ah kalsuan ni.","ref":"Isa 60:1"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah in na mite, Jacob innkuan na nusia khin hi. Amaute Nisuahna lam pana dawivaite tawh kidim uh a, Philistia-te bangin ai sanin, lawkite tawh kikhutlet uh hi.","title":"’ Ni","ref":"Jer 12:7; 2Ku 16:7"},"7":{"text":"Amau gamah ngun le kham dim a, a goute uh a bei ngei kei hi. Amaute gamsung sakol tawh kidim a, sakolleng a bei ngei kei hi.","ref":"Tp 17:17; Ph 17:14; Pc 41:43"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in a gam uh milimte tawh dimsak uh a, a khutun a bawlsate uh a khutmete uh bawlsate a bia uh hi.","ref":"Isa 17:8"},"9":{"text":"Tua bangin mite kiniamsak sukin mihingte kiniamkhiat hi - amaute a maisak kei in.","ref":"Ne 4:5"},"10":{"text":"TOPA kihtakna le a mulkimhuai ama thupina panin suangheng ah lut unla leihawm ah bu un.","ref":"Ph 145:12; Na 3:11"},"11":{"text":"Mite kiliatsakna mitte kiniamkoih dinga, mite kiphatsakna kiniamsak ding hi; tua ni ciangin TOPA bek kitawisang ding hi.","ref":"Job 40:11; Ph 46:10"},"12":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in a kisathei le a kiliansak khempeuh, a kitawisangte khempeuh (tuateh amaute a kiniam koih ding hi),","ref":"Ph 76:12"},"13":{"text":"a sang, a kisangsak Lebanon tamtakte khempeuh le Bashan tawsawte khempeuh","ref":"Thk 9:15"},"14":{"text":"muallian kuite khempeuh le mualneu sangte khempeuh,"},"15":{"text":"tausangpi peuhmah le kulh muanhuai peuhmah,","ref":"Isa 30:25"},"16":{"text":"sumbawl tembawpi b peuhmah le tembaw hoih peuhmah a niamkoih ding ni khat sehkhol zo hi.","ref":"Job 13:6"},"17":{"text":"Mite kiliatsakna kiniamsak dinga, mite kiphatsakna kiniamkoih ding hi; tuani-in TOPA kia bek kitawisang dinga,","ref":"2Sa 22:28"},"18":{"text":"milimte a maimang kiuhkeuh ding hi.","ref":"Tp 9:21"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in ama thupina nopcitna tawh leitung lingsak dinga, a kipat ciangin amah kihta-in mihingte suangpi heng kawm le leihawm vang sungah a tai ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 145:12; Job 9:6; Thk 6:2"},"20":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mite in a biak dingua a bawl uh ngun milimte le kham milimte, buite le bakte tungah a lot ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 7:19-20"},"21":{"text":"TOPA in ama thupina nopcitna tawh leitung lingsak dingin a kipat ciangin amah kihta-in amaute suanghawmpi sung le ken sangpi hawm sungah a tai ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 33:10; Pk 33:22"},"22":{"text":"Nak vanga huusang bek mihing muang nawn kei un. Kil 2:28; 8:10; Isa 34:4; Lk 10:18"},"13":{"text":"Na lungsim ah, \"Van ah ka kahto ding hi; Pasian aksite tunglam ah ka tokhom ka sangkhan ding hi; mual siangtho d sanpenna mun mihonpi kikhopna vum tungah ka kumpi tokhomin ka tu ding hi.","ref":"Eze 28:2"},"14":{"text":"Meiite tunglam pekah ka kahto ding hi; kei le kei Sangpen Pa in ka kibawl ding hi,\" na ci hi.","ref":"Isa 47:8; 2Th 2:4"},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin hankhuk sung, gum thukpi sungah nang hong kipuaksuk ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Nang hong mute in hong sal gega kawmin na pianzia ngaihsunsunin, \"Leitung a lokgawppa, kumpi-gamte a lingsakpa,"},"17":{"text":"leitung sehnel-gam suaksak a, a khuapite a lawnthalpa le a saltangte inn a, a ciahsak nuam lopa hihpa hi lo ahi hiam?\" ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Joel 2:3"},"18":{"text":"Minamte kumpite khempeuh amau han sung ciatah a lum hithiat uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang na hankhuk pua lamah a kideih lo singhiang bangin hong kilawnkhia-in; namsau-a kisunlet suang dum sunga a tuaksuksa misi luangte in nang hong khuhcip uh hi. Khe a kituancil mi siluang bangin","ref":"Isa 22:16-18; Jer 41:7-9"},"20":{"text":"amaute tawh na kivui khawm kei ding hi, ahang in, na gam na susia a, na mite na that hi. A tatsiate suan-lekhakte a kilo kha nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 21:10"},"21":{"text":"A pute uh mawhna hangin a tapate uh kigawh nading mun bawlkhol in; a leitang uh a luah ding le a khuapite un leitung a tuam dingin amaute a tho kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 20:5; Sp 26:39"},"22":{"text":"\"Amaute langkhatah ka pang ding hi,\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Tuanu min le a omlaite, a ci a nam le a suan a khakte, Babylon panin a kikhenkhia ding hi,\" TOPA in a cikhia hi.","ref":"1Ku 14:10"},"23":{"text":"\"Tuanu, simbute giahna mun le nawngpi lak ka suaksak dinga, siatna tawh ka phiatsiang ding hi,\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 34:11-15; Zep 2:14"},"24":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA kiciam khin a, \"Ka gensa bangin piang dinga ka sehsa bangin a kho takpi ding hi.","title":"Assyria Langah Genkholhna","ref":"Ns 4:8"},"25":{"text":"Ka gam sungah Assyria mite ka gawizan dinga, ka mualte tungah ka tuancilgawp ding hi. Ka mite panin ama hakkol kilakhia dinga, amau liangko panin a van a kihemkhia ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:5,12; Isa 9:4"},"26":{"text":"Hih in leitung buppi ading ngimna ahi hi; hih in minam khempeuh tunga kizankhia khut ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 23:9"},"27":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA sehsa ahi manin kua in khaktan thei ding ahi hiam? A khut zankhia khin hi, kua in dok kik thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"2Kh 20:6; Isa 43:13"},"28":{"text":"Hih in Kumpi Ahaz sih kuma thusuak ahi hi:","ref":"2Ku 16:20; Isa 13:1"},"29":{"text":"Philistia-te khempeuh aw, no hong kisatna ciangkhut a kitan manin lung nuam kei un; tua gul zung panin ngan hong mengto dinga, agah a lengthei gulpi gupha hong hi ding hi.","title":"Philistia-te Langah Genkholhna","ref":"2Kh 26:6"},"30":{"text":"A zawngte lak pana a zawngpente in lonona mu ding uh a, a tasamte lungmuangin a lum hithiat ding uh hi. Ahi hangin kialpi tawh na zung ka susia dinga tua in na suahtaksakte a that ding hi.","ref":"Isa 3:15; 7:21-22; Isa 8:21; 9:20"},"31":{"text":"Kongpi aw, kap vangvang in! Khuapi aw, ku vangvang in! No Philistia-te khempeuh aw tuisuakmang un! Leilu panin meikhu meii-in kai-a a gualguala tangkai a om kei hi.","ref":"Jer 1:14"},"32":{"text":"Tua minam kamtaite tungah bang a kici dawn ding hiam? \" TOPA in Zion kipsak khin a, gimna thuak a mite in a sungah bukna a mu ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 87:2,5; Isa 44:28"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab tawh kisai thusuak: Moab a om Ar kisia hi, zan khat thu-in kisusia hi! Moab a om Kir kisia hi, zan khat thu-in kisusia hi!","title":"Moab Langah Genkholhna","ref":"Isa 11:14; Jer 48:24,41; 2Ku 3:25"},"2":{"text":"Biakinnpi ah Dibon paito a, a munsangte ah a kap dingin kuan to hi; Moab-te in Nebo le Medeba kah vangvang uh hi. Lu peuhmah kimet tol a, khamul peuhmah a kimetmai hi.","ref":"Sp 21:5"},"3":{"text":"Lamdungah ippi puan silh uh a; innkhum tung le tual-awng ah a vekun khupbawhsa in kap vangvang uh hi.","ref":"Jer 48:38"},"4":{"text":"Heshbon le Elealeh kapkhia a, Jahaz lamdung tengah amau awging kiza hi. Tua ahi ciangin Moab galhiam tawite kapkhia uh a, a lungsi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka lungsimin Moab ka kahkhia hi; a kidelh khia galtaite Zoar ciang dong, Eglath Shelishiyah ciangdong a tai uh hi. Amaute a kah kawmkawmun Luhith paina lampi dong a paito uh hi; Horonaim lampi ah amaute kisiatna tamlawhin a nei uh hi.","ref":"Jer 48:5"},"6":{"text":"Nimrim tuite kangcip a, lopa a keu hi; anteh sel teng bei a, lohing khat beek a om kei hi.","ref":"Isa 19:5-7; Jer 48:34"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in a gawlgawl uh a hauhnate uh le a kholsate uh Gialhek Lui galah kahpih mang uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute kahkhiatna awging in Moab gamgi dung teng thawn hi; amau kahkahna in Eglaim dong bana, amau tamlawhna in Beer Elim dong a ban hi.","ref":"Ms 21:16"},"9":{"text":"Dimon a tuite sisan tawh kidim a, ahi hangin Dimon b ah a tamzaw ka tungsaklai ding a - Moab galtaite tung le a gamua om laite tungah humpinelkai ka laangsak ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 17:25"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sela pan sehnel-gam kantanin Zion Tanu vuma om gam-ukte tungah siah dingin tuunote khak un."},"2":{"text":"A bu pana kiphawngkhia a leng kawikawi vasa bangin Moab numeite Arnon ngahmunte ah a om uh hi.","ref":"Pn 27:8"},"3":{"text":"\"Kote thu hong hilh unla thu hong khensatpih un. Sun in na liim zan bangsak in Delhkhiatte sel-in galtaite hek kei un.","ref":"1Ku 18:4"},"4":{"text":"A kidelhkhia Moab-te no tawh omkhawmsak unla; amaute a susia dingte panin liah un.\" Mi nuainetpa om nawn loin, kisiatna a bei ding hi; leitungpanin a tatsiapa a bei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 9:4"},"5":{"text":"Itna tawh kumpi tokhom kikipsak dinga; muanhuaina tawh a tungah mi khat tu-in - David innkuan c pan hi dinga - thutang zonga thukhenpa thumaan manlanga a zangpa hi ding hi.","ref":"Da 7:14; Mic 4:7; Lk 1:32; Isa 9:7"},"6":{"text":"Moab-te kiphatsakna - ki-uangsaka kisaktheihna le kiliatsakna - ama kihisakna le a kimisakna i za khin hi, ahi hangin ama kisialhpihte a hawmpi ahi hi.","ref":"Am 2:1; Ob 1:3"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi manin Moab-te kap vangvang uh a, amaute in Moab a kahhuan vangvang uh hi. Kir Hareseth mite d adingin taamlo-in dah un.","ref":"2Ku 3:25; 1Kh 16:3"},"8":{"text":"Heshbon lote lah tulta a, Sibmah lengguite zong teekta hi. Minamte’ gamukte in hun khat lai-a sehnel-gam lamah Jazer dong bana a zaam lenggui hoihpente tuancil khin uh hi. Amaute mengkhia a tuipi dongah zaamkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 5:2; Isa 5:2; Job 8:16"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Sibmah lengguite adingin Jazer kah bangin ka kap hi. Heshbon aw, Elealeh aw, khitui-in hong buakkawt veng aw! na singgah minte tung le na anlakphate tungah lungdamin a kiko na khawl khin hi.","ref":"Jer 40:20"},"10":{"text":"Na singno lei pana nuamna le lungnopna beimangta hi; lenggui lo ah kuamah lasa in kiko nawn lo a; kuamah kikosak nawn lo ka hi manin lengtui sukna-ah kuamah in zu a sukkhia nawn kei hi.","ref":"Thk 9:27; Job 24:11"},"11":{"text":"Harp bangin ka lungsimin Moab ka taamlawh a, keima sungah Kir Hareseth ka taamlawh hi.","ref":"Isa 15:5; Isa 63:15; Hos 11:8"},"12":{"text":"Munsang tungah Moab a kilat ciangin hawmsuak bek a, a biakbukno ah thungen dingin a pai ciangin a lawhsam hi.","ref":"Isa 15:2; Jer 48:29-36"},"13":{"text":"Hih in Moab tawh kisai TOPA genkhiatsa kammal ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin tu-in TOPA in: \"Kiciamna in a letcip nasempa in a sim banga kisim kum thum sungin Moab’ thupina le a mi tampite kisimmawh dinga, a omlai sunte tawm mahmahin a thanem ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 21:17; 25:10; Jer 48:42"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Damascus tawh kasai thusuak: \"En un, Damascus sawtvei khuapi hi nawn lo dinga, a kisia lompi suak ding hi.","title":"Damascus Langah Thusuak","ref":"Jer 49:23; Ns 9:2; Am 1:3; Zec 9:1"},"2":{"text":"Aroer khuapite kinusia dinga, ganhon giah nadingin kinusia in, tuate kuamah in a phawng kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 7:21; Eze 25:5; Jer 7:33; Mic 4:4"},"3":{"text":"Ephraim kulh muanhuaite mangthang dinga, Damascus a kumpi vangliatnate bei-in Aram a, a baanglaite Israel-te minthanna a bang ding uh hi,\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"tg 4; Isa 7:8,16"},"4":{"text":"\"Tua ni ciangin Jacob minthanna bei dinga, a pumpi thauna a gawngtaam ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:16"},"5":{"text":"An lapa in ankung dinglai a lak khit tawh kibang dinga, Rephaim Kuam sunga ansang khop bangin - a khutin an a la ding hi.","ref":"Jer 51:33, Joel 3:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua hinapi, olive kung a kisat ciangin a hiang paipi dawnah olive nih le thum a kihawi bangin a gahpha ansang vui li vui nga a om lai ding hi,\" TOPA , Israel-te Pasian in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 27:12; Isa 24:13"},"7":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mite in amaute a Bawlpa en ding uh a, Israel-te Siangtho Pa lamah a mit uh a hei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 10:20"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in khuta bawlsa biakna-tau lamen loin amau khutmete bawlsa gimnamtui taute le Asherah khuamte a a thusim kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:8"},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Israel-te hanga kinusia a khuapi muanhuaite uh, a kinusia sephih sawlbawk lak a bang ding hi. A vekin a kilawi khin ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Na Honpa Pasian na mangngilh khin hi; na kulh muanhuai Suangpi na phawkkha kei hi. Tua ahi ciangin singno a hoih pen suanin gamdang lenggui na suan zongin,","ref":"Ph 68:19; Isa 12:2"},"11":{"text":"na suan ni mahin posak pahin, na suan ni zingsang mah in na paksak pah zongin natna le damsak theih loh a na thuak ni-in bangmah na kaikhawm tuan kei ding hi.","ref":"Job 4:8; Hos 8:7"},"12":{"text":"Oh, minam tampite ototna aw - amaute tuipi ging bangin a awngawg uh hi! Oh, mite awng zuahzuah uh a - tuipi lianpi hawk bangin a hawk uh hi!"},"13":{"text":"Tui kilok hawkte bangin mite a hawk uh zongin amah in a tai ciangin gamlapi ah taimang uh a, mualtunga huihlet ansi leng bangin kihawlkhia a, huihpi mut lopa leeng a bang uh hi.","ref":"Ph 9:5; Job 21:18"},"14":{"text":"Nitakin hong lausak uh!
