Hih in eite hong buluhte tanh ei aa hong sutte vankhol ahi hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:35"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cush b gunte dunga a khazap c ging zuahzuah","title":"Cush’ Langah Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"tuipi tui tungah singteh gunkuang in thupuaka a sawl gam in gimna thuak ta hen. Kamtaite aw, a tunsang a cinel mite, a nai a gamla-a a kikihtate, kam lamdang zanga galphuang minamte a gam uh gunte in a khenkhapte kiangah manlangin va pai un.","ref":"Pk 2:3; Pc 10:8-9; 2Kh 12:3; tg 7"},"3":{"text":"Leitung mite khempeuh, leitunga tengte khempeuh aw, mualtung ah dialkhai a kikhai ciangin na mu ding uh a, pengkul a kimut ciangin na za ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:26"},"4":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah, \"Nitang sunga a lum hiuhiau bang le anlak nisa-a daitui a paii meii bangin dai dide in ka tenna munah ka om ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 26:19; Isa 26:21"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, anlak hun ma a pakteng a pulh khit ciangin a pak teng lenggah min a suah ciangin singheuhna tem in a meng teng heuhkhia dinga, phukin a hiang zaam teng a lakhiamang ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Mualtung vasate le gamsate an dingin amaute kinusia dinga; vasate in khuakhal sung ne in gamsate in phalbi sung a ne ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin Thahatpen TOPA tungah letsong kipuak dinga, a tunsang a cinel mite pan, a nai a gamla-a a kihtakte pan pautuam zang galphuang minam pan le a gam uh gunte in a khenkhapte panin Thahatpen TOPA min omna mun Zion Vum ah letsong a kipuak ding hi.","ref":"Pc 41:14; Hab 1:7; Ph 68:31"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt tawh kisai thusuak: En in, Egypt lam manawhin a manlang meii tungah TOPA hong tuang hi. Ama mai-ah Egypt milimte ling uh a, Egypt-te lungsim a beimang hi.","title":"Egypt’ Thu Genkholhna","ref":"Pk 12:12; Jer 43:12; Ph 18:10; 104:3;Kil 1:7; Jos 2:11"},"2":{"text":"\"Egypt-te do dingin Egypt-te mah kilok ding uh a - a sanggampa in a sanggampa do-in, a vengpa in a vengpa do dinga; khuapi in khuapi do-in, kumpi-gam in kumpi-gam mah a do ding hi.","ref":"Thk 7:22; Mt 10:21,36"},"3":{"text":"Egypt-te a lungsim uh bei dinga, amaute ngimna a mawkna ka suaksak ding hi; amaute in milimte le misite’ kha, vankahte le aisante thu a dong ding uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 10:13; Isa 8:19; 47:13"},"4":{"text":"A kheltat topa khut sungah Egypt mite ka pia dinga, a kihtakhuai kumpi khat in amaute a uk ding hi,\" Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 20:4; Jer 46:26"},"5":{"text":"Guntuite kang dinga, gun nuai hulin a keugaw ding hi.","ref":"Jer 51:36"},"6":{"text":"Hawkguamte namsia dinga Egypt gama luite kiamkiamin a keucip ding hi. Pumpengte le phaite vulgawpin gunpiau a om,","ref":"Pk 7:18; Isa 15:6"},"7":{"text":"Nile gun dunga singnote zong a vulgawp ding hi. Nile gun dunga lo kipawi peuhmah keugaw dinga, huih in lenmangin a om nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 23:3"},"8":{"text":"Ngasa bengte thumin taamlo ding uh a, Nile sunga ngathang siahte khempeuh, tuitunga lenkhakte a thanem khin ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 47:10; Hab 1:15"},"9":{"text":"Anthul khauhual nasemte lungkia ding uh a, saihadial puan hoih gante a lametna uh a bei ding hi.","ref":"Pn 7:16; Eze 27:7"},"10":{"text":"Puan tawh kisai nasem peuhmah lungneu ding uh a, sum thalawh khempeuh a lungsim uh a na ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Zion uliante bangmah man loin hai uh a, Pharaoh thulak mipilte in a kimanna om lo thu a lak uh hi. Bangci in Pharoah tungah, \"Kei mipil khat ka hi a, tanglai kumpite nungzui khat ka hi hi,\" ci thei na hi hiam?","ref":"Pc 41:37"},"12":{"text":"Tu-in na mipilte koi-ah om uh hiam? Thahatpen TOPA in Egypt tunga a tunsak dinga a ngimna kilaksak dih in.","ref":"1Co 1:20"},"13":{"text":"Zoan uliante mihai suakta uh hi. Memphis a makaite kikhem hi; Egypt innkiu suangte in a mite uh lam khialhpih khin uh hi.","ref":"Jer 2:16; Eze 30:13,16"},"14":{"text":"TOPA in amaute tungah lung-apna kha buak a; zukhampa a luak lakah a hoi daidai bangin amaute in a sepnasa khempeuh ah Egypt a hoisak daidai uh hi.","ref":"Mt 17:17"},"15":{"text":"Egypt in a lu ahikeh a mei, nisuh hiang ahikeh pumpeng - bangmah a cih thei kei hi.","ref":"Isa 9:14"},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt mite numei tawh a kibang ding uh hi. Thahatpen TOPA in amaute langah a khut viikin a laptohna hangin lau-in a ling ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuateh Judah gam in Egypt mite lausak dinga, amaute langa Thahatpen TOPA geelna hangin Judah mi a kici peuhmah a kihta ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 11:15; 14:24"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt khuapi ngate in Canaan kam zang ding uh a, Thahatpen TOPA tung kiciamin thu a ciam ding uh hi. Tuate lakah khat Kisiatna Khuapi b kici ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt laizang ah TOPA tungah biakna-tau khat om dinga a gamgi ah TOPA tunga suangphuh khat a kiphut ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua in Egypt gam sungah Thahatpen TOPA tunga lim le teci hi ding hi. Amaute a nengniamte hangin TOPA tungah a kiko uh ciangin amah in amaute honpa khat puakin hu dinga, amaute a suaktasak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt mite tungah TOPA kilak dinga tua ni ciangin amaute in TOPA a telcian ta ding uh hi. Amaute in biakpiakna le an-a biakna in bia ding uh a; TOPA tungah kiciamin a kiciamna uh a tangtun ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA in pulpi tawh Egypt vat dinga, amaute vatin a vatna a damsak ding hi. Amaute TOPA lam ah kihei ding uh a, amah in a thumna uh dawngin a damsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 45:14"},"23":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Egypt pan Assyria paina lampi khat a om ding hi. Assyria-te Egypt ah pai-in, Egypt-te Assyria ah a pai ding uh hi. Egypt-te le Assyria-te in a bia khawm ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin leitung ah Egypt-te tawh kibangin Israel-te le Assyria-te zomin a thumna leitung thupha khat ahi ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in amaute thupha pia dinga, \"Ka mi Egypt-te, ka khutsuak Assyria-te ka innluah Israel-te in thupha ngah ta hen,\" a ci ding hi."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Assyria kumpipa Sargon in a galkap mang lianpenpa sawlin Ashdod sima a lak kumin -","title":"Egypt le Cush’ Langah Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in Amoz tapa Isaiah tungtawnin thu gen hi. Ama kiangah, \"Na ippi puan suahkhia inla na khedap kaih zong suah in,\" a ci hi. Amah in a cih bangin hih a, a guaktangin a kheguakin a pai kawikawi hi.","ref":"1Sa 19:24; Mic 1:8;Zec 13:4"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in, \"Egypt le Cush c tungah lim le a siahil ahi dingin ka nasempa Isaiah a guaktangin a khe guakin kum thum sung a pai bang tektekin"},"4":{"text":"Egypt galmatte le Cush koltangte a moi a hamin - Egypt maizum nadingin guaktang le kheguakin tawbo dawksa in Assyria kumpipa in a paipih mang ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Cush a muangte le Egypt a kisaktheihpihte lau-in a maizum ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin tui gei-a tengte in, \"Ei muan mite, Assyria kumpipa pana hong huh ding hong hukhia ding ci-a i belhte bang suak ta uh hiam, en dih un! Bang ci suahtak thei nawn ding i hi hiam?’ ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:21; Jer 30:15-17; Mt 23:33"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a sehnel-gam tawh kisai thusuak: Pingpeite in leitaw-lam a kantan bangin sehnel-gam pan - a lauhuai gam panin a sim ding khat hong kuan hi.","title":"Babylon’ Langah Genkholhna","ref":"Isa 13:21"},"2":{"text":"A kihtakhuai mangmuhna khat kei hong kilak a: Migilopa in lehhek a, a luhpa in a luh hi. Elam aw sim in, Media aw umcih in! Ama piansak taunate khempeuh ka beisak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 60:3; Isa 33:1"},"3":{"text":"Hih bangin na sa-in ka gawnggawp a, numei nausuak nat bangin natna in hong tun hi; ka zak thu hangin ka genthei a, ka muhte hangin ka lung mang hi.","ref":"Ph 48:6"},"4":{"text":"Ka lungsim hema, launa in hong lingsak hi; ka ngaklah nidial kei tungah launa a suak hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in sabuai gualin sualphah puan phah uh a, ne in a dawn uh hi! No uliante aw, tho un lumte sathau nuh un!","ref":"2Sa 1:21"},"6":{"text":"Topa in kei tunga hong gen hih ahi hi: \"Pai inla galvil khat omsakin a muhte gensak in.","ref":"2Ku 9:17"},"7":{"text":"Sakollengte a sakolte tawh laa tunga tuangte ahikeh kala-oh tuangte a muh ciangin beltakin, belcingtakin vil hen,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"tg 9"},"8":{"text":"Tuateh galvilpa a kiko a, \"Ka topa aw, ni khat khit ni khat galvilna-tau tungah ka ding hi; zan simin ka vilna munah ka om hi."},"9":{"text":"En in, sakolte kaih sakolleng-in mi khat hong pai hi. Amah in dawng kik a: ‘Babylon puk khin, puk khin ta! A pasiante limte khempeuh lei lakah kitamzan ta!’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 51:8; Kil 14:8; 18:2"},"10":{"text":"Ka mite, ka ancilna phuala cilsate aw, Israel Pasian tung pan, Thahatpen TOPA tung pana ka zaksa kong gen hi.","ref":"Jer 51:33"},"11":{"text":"Dumah b tawh kisai thusuak: Seir panin mi khat in kei hong sam a, \"Galvilpa aw zanhun bang tan om lai hiam? Galvilpa aw zanhun bang tan om lai hiam?\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pc 25:14","title":"Edom’ Langah Genkholhna"},"12":{"text":"Galvilpa in, \"Zan zong hi ta a, zingsang hidek ta hi; nong dot nop uh leh hong dong un; hong kileh kik unla hong dong lai un,\" ka ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Arabia tawh kisai thusuak: Dedan mi khualzin honte Arabia gamlak a giahphual satte aw,","title":"Arabia’ Langah Genkholhna"},"14":{"text":"a dangtakte adingin tui puak un; no Tema a tengte aw, galtaite adingin an puak un.","ref":"Pc 25:15"},"15":{"text":"Amaute namsau pan, a kidoksa namsau panin thal keksa pan le gal husa pana taite ahi uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa in kei tungah hong gen hih ahi hi: \"Kiciamna in a letcip nasempa banga kisim kum khat sungin Kedar galkap honpi a bei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Thal tawi a omlai sunte, Kedar galhangte, a tawm ding hi,\" TOPA Israel Pasian in gen khin hi.","ref":"Ph 120:5; Isa 16:14"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangmuhna Kuam tawh kisai thusuak: Nang bangin hong lungkhamsak a, na vekun innkhum tungah kahto na hi uh hiam?","title":"Jerusalem’ Thu Genkholhna","ref":"Isa 13:1"},"2":{"text":"A gamlum den khua aw, thubuai tawh a gamlum den khuapi aw, na mi thahte uh namsau thah hi lo a, gal sunga si zong hi tuan lo hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:3; Isa 10:4"},"3":{"text":"Na makaite khempeuh uh tai khawm khin uh a; thal zat lohin kiman khin hi. Hong kiman note khempeuh galte gamlapi-ah a om lai-a a taite tawh thong ah hong kikhum khawm hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin, \"Ka kiang pan kihemkhia un, kah cihtak hong kapsak lel un. Ka mite kisiatna hangin kei hehnep hong sawm kei un,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Isa 15:3; Jer 33:1"},"5":{"text":"Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in Mangmuhna Kuam sungah gamlumna, tuatcil-gawpna lungkham nading ni khat nei a, kulhte cimsakgawpin mualte tunga kiko nading ni khat a nei hi.","ref":"Ta 1:5; Zep 1:15"},"6":{"text":"Elam-te in sakolte le sakollengte a tuangte tawh thaltang bawm pua uh a, Kir-te in a lum sin uh a hong uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Na deih pen uh kuamte sakolleng dim a, khuapi kongpite ah sakol-tuangte kipangsak hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:1-2"},"8":{"text":"Judah galdalnate kihawkkhiamang hi. Tuateh Tulak Kumpi inn a galhiamte lam na en a,","ref":"1Ku 7:2"},"9":{"text":"David Khuapi galdalnate mun tampi a kisiat na mu a, Bual Nuainung ah tui na cing hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:4"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem a innpite a phazah na sima, kulh cianbeh nadingin innte na phelkhia hi."},"11":{"text":"Tui om nadingin kulhte gel kikala Bual Lui puahin, tui bempi na bawla, ahi hangin a bawl Pa thusim loin tanglai peka a geel Pa lah na awlmawh kei hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:4; 2Kh 32:4; 2Ku 19:25"},"12":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in ippi puan silhin sam botkhia-a a kap dingin hong sam ding hi.","ref":"Joel 1:13; Hoel 2:17"},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin en in, tua lai-ah lungnopna le nopsakna, bawng gawhna le tuu gawhna, zu dawnna le sa nekna a om ding hi! \"Zing ciang si ding i hi manin ne in dawn ni!\" na ci uh hi.","ref":"Isa 56:12; Lk 17:26-29"},"14":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in ka zakin hong laak khin a: \"Na sihni matengun hih mawhna a kimaisak kei ding hi,\" Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 5:9; 13:11; 26:21"},"15":{"text":"Hih in Topa, Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Pai inla, kumpi innsung saipa - neihsa kempa Sheba kiangah:","ref":"2Ku 18:18"},"16":{"text":"Hih lai-ah bang hih a, nang thu-in hankhuk khuatin a sangna munah na hankhuk ding to a, suangpi sungah na khawlmun ding na khuak nadingin kua in phalna hong pia ahi hiam?","ref":"Mt 27:60"},"17":{"text":"Kidawm in, nang mi thahatpa aw, TOPA in hong lencipin hong lawnkhiamang ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in bawlung bangin gak takin hong hual dinga gam zapi ah hong lawn ding hi. Tua lai-ah na si dinga na sakol-leng tampitak kisusia in - na pu inn na zahlaksak ding hi!","ref":"Isa 17:13"},"19":{"text":"Na zum panin kong suankhia dinga, na dinmun panin nang hong kizakiasak ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:7"},"20":{"text":"\"Tua ni ciangin ka nasempa Hilkiah tapa Eliakim ka sam ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Na puantualpi amah silhsakin nang konggak in amah ka gak dinga, na thuneihna amah ka suan ding hi. Amah, Jerusalem a tengte le Judah innkuante pa a suak ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama liangko tungah David innkuante tunga tawhtang ka koih dinga ama honte kuamah in khak thei loin, ama khakte kuamah in a hong thei kei ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A kip muna vankhaina bangin amah ka khenkip dinga; a pa innkuan adingin pahtawina tutphah a ahi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Ama innkuan sung minthanna ahi; a suan a khak, a naihuai khempeuh - tui-um beelsuan kuang-le-keu inn vanzat khempeuh ama tungah a kikhai ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in, \"Tua ni ciangin a kipna muna vankhai in khoh lo dinga; kikhongkhia-in kia dinga a tunga kikhaite a kiphukta ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhin hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tyre tawh kisai thusuak: Tyre kisia khina inn le tembaw khawlna om nawn lo ahi manin Tarshish tembawte aw, kap vangvang un! Cyprus b gam panin amaute tungah thu a tung hi.","title":"Tyre’ Thu Genkholhna","ref":"Pc 10:4; 1Ku 10:22"},"2":{"text":"No tuikulh mite, no Sidon sumbukte - tuipi tunga khualzina haute aw, dai dide un."},"3":{"text":"Tui lianpi tungah Shihor antang hong pai hi; Nile c an lakte Tyre phiangsiah suak a, tua mun minamte sumbuk phualpi a suak hi."},"4":{"text":"Sidon aw, nang, tuipi mun muanhuai tuipi aw, maizum in; ahang in, tuipi in gen khin a: \"Keimah in nausuahnat thuakin nau ka suak ngei kei hi; tapa vakin tanu zong ka khansuah ngei kei hi,\" a ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Egypt ah thu a tun ciangin Tyre pana a thuzak un amaute a buaisak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tuikulh a teng mite aw, Tarshish lam kantan unla kah cihtakin kap un."},"7":{"text":"Hih in note kipahpih a lui lua mahmah khuapi, gamlapi pan zuana na va tenna uh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Kumpi lukhu a khusakpa, a sumbawlte uliante vive ahi, a sumbawlte leitunga kithei thamte, hih Tyre tunga thupiang kua geel ahi hiam?","ref":"Eze 28:5"},"9":{"text":"Minthanna hanga kiphatsakna khempeuh niamsakin leitunga kithei tham khempeuh niamkhiat ding Thahatpen TOPA geel ahi hi.","ref":"Job 40:11"},"10":{"text":"Tarshish Tanu aw, Nile luan zui-in a na gam kantanin pai in; nang khawlmun ding om nawn lo hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA in tuipi tungah a khut zan khin ta a, a kumpi-gamte uh a kilingsak hi. Amah in a kulh muanhuaite a kisiat nadingin Phoenicia b tawh kisai thu a pia khin hi.","ref":"Ph 46:6; Isa 25:2; Zec 9:3-4"},"12":{"text":"Amah in, \"Sidon Tanu Ngak Bit aw, na nuamsa nawn kei ding hi, tu-in na kisiazan hi! \"Cyprus c kantanin paito ta lecin tua lai nangawn ah khawl nading na mu kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Kil 18:22; Isa 47:1"},"13":{"text":"Babylon-te d gam en dih in, tu-in hih mite bangmahin kisim nawn lopi! Assyria-te in sehnel-gam - ganhingte omna suah khin uh a, amau ki-umcihna taute a sangsak uh hi; amaute mun muanhuai kalkhia in na kisia a suah uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tarshish tembawpite aw, na mun muanhuai uh kisia khin ta hi; kap ngutngut un!"},"15":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin kumpi hun tan khat ahi kum sawm sagih sung Tyre a kiphawkkha kei ding hi. Ahi hangin hih kum sawm sagihte a bei ciangin numei kizuakte la in:","ref":"Jer 25:22"},"16":{"text":"\"Numei kizuakte kimangngilh ta hi; harp khat la-in khuapi sung tengah vak kawikawi unla note hong kiphawk nadingin limtakin harp tum kawmin la tampi sa un,\" a cih bangin Tyre tungah a tung ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Kum sawm sagih a bei ciangin TOPA in Tyre a thudon ding hi. Tuanu kizuakin a kawmte kiang panin kileh dinga, leitung bupa kumpi-gam khempeuh tawh sum a bawl khawm ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua hi napi a summet teng le a thalawhsa teng TOPA adingin a kituam koih ding hi; tuate kholtuamin kitang neih thei lo ding hi. A summette, TOPA mai-a omte in kicingtaka a nek ding uh le puan hoih nono a silh nadingun kipia ding hi."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En un, TOPA in leitung, gamtul suaksakin a beisak ding hi; leimaitang susia in a sunga tengte thehthang dinga -","title":"in Leitung A Suksiatna"},"2":{"text":"mi mawkmawkte le siampite, nasempa le a pu, naucingnu le a pi, a leipa le a zuakpa, a kawmpa le a kawmnapa, a leitawipa le a leitawinapa, a kibang ding hi.","ref":"Eze 7:12"},"3":{"text":"Leitung kisia kiuhkeuh dinga a kisusiamang ding hi. Hih thu TOPA gensa ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Leitung vulin keucip a, leitung thanemin vulgawp a, leitunga kitawisangte a thanem uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:12"},"5":{"text":"Leitung, a mite in ninsak a, amaute in thukham mang loin ngeina-kipte zui lo uh a, tawntung thukhun a palsat uh hi.","ref":"Pc 3:17; Ms 35:33; Isa 10:6; 59:12"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hamsiatna in leitung kangtuma a tunga tengte in amau khialhna a thuak pelmawh ding uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin leitunga tengte kangtum uh a, tawmno bek a om lai hi.","ref":"Isa 1:31"},"7":{"text":"Zuthakte keucip in lenggui a vul hi; a gualnuam khempeuh a tau uh hi.","ref":"Joel 1:10-12"},"8":{"text":"Gualnopna khuanggingte dai khipkhep a, nopsakna gamlumna bei-in harp tawh lungnuam a lasakna lah a dai dide hi.","ref":"Isa 5:12; Hos 2:11"},"9":{"text":"Amaute in zu dawn kawmin la sa nawn lo uh a, a zucil dawnte uh khazaw a sa uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:11,22; Isa 5:20"},"10":{"text":"Khuapi kisiasa a hawmin om a, inn sima kongvangte a kikalh bikbek hi."},"11":{"text":"Zu duhin lamdungah kiko uh a; lungnopna khempeuh lungzinna suakin gualnopna khempeuh leitung panin a kinawhmang hi."},"12":{"text":"Khuapi a siasa in kinusia a, a kongpite a kikhawhkham zangawp hi.","ref":"Isa 19:18"},"13":{"text":"Olive kung a kisat khit ciang le lenggah lak khita asangh a kinusiat bangin leitung le minamte tungah a kihih ding hi.","ref":"Isa 16:6"},"14":{"text":"Amaute lungdamin kiko ding uh a, a aw uh a sangsak ding uh hi; nitumna lam pan TOPA thupina a thangsak ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 12:6"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tuipi tuikulhte a nisuahna lam mite in; TOPA min thangsakin; TOPA Israel-te Pasian min a tawisang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 66:19; Mal 1:11"},"16":{"text":"Leimongte panin: \"Thuman Pa minthang ta hen,\" ci-a la kisa eite in i za hi. Ahi hangin, \"Beimang ta’ng ei! Bei mang ta’ng ei! Gimna hong tung ei! Mi khemte in hong lehkhem ei! Mi khemte in khemna tawh hong lehkhem uh ei!\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Isa 28:5; Ph 48:10; 65:8"},"17":{"text":"Leitung mite aw, launa gum le thang in note hong ngak hi.","ref":"Lk 21:35; Jer 48:43"},"18":{"text":"Launa aw za-a a tai peuhmah gum sungah kia ding uh a; gum sung pan a kahkhia to peuhmah thangah a awk ding uh hi. Vante-a tui kongpite kihong a, leitung bulpi a kilok hi","ref":"Job 20:24; Pc 7:11; Ph 18:7"},"19":{"text":"Leitung khangkhamin a themthemin kikhen dinga, nakpipi in a kising ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Zukham bangin leitung hoi dinga huihpi mut bukno bangin suk-awn to-awn ding hi; a lehdo mite mawhna gikpi in nen tukin - a tho kik ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 19:14; Isa 1:2,28; 43:27; Ph 46:2"},"21":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin TOPA in tunga vante a vangliatna le nuai-a leitunga kumpite dan a thuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:12, 2:12"},"22":{"text":"Thongkiate dumpi sungah a kigawmkhawm bangin amaute kikhum khawm dinga, thong sungah kikalhnelhin ni tampi khit ciangin dan a a kithuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:4; 42:7,22; Eze 38:8"},"23":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in Zion Vum le Jerusalem panin a upate mai-ah thupi takin uk ding ahi manin khapi mial dinga, ni a maizum ding hi.","ref":"Heb 12:22; Kil 22:5; Isa 13:10"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, ka Pasian na hi hi; muanhuaina kiciantakin tanglai peka na geelsa nate a piandang nate bawl khin na hi manin nang kong tawisang dinga, na min ka phat ding hi.","title":"Kiphat Hen","ref":"Ph 98:1"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah in khuapi, ninlompi na suaksak a, kulha ki-um khua susia-in gamdangte mun muanhuaite khuapi a hi nawn lo dingin na bawla; a kilam kik ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 17:1; Isa 13:22"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi manin mi thahatte in nang hong pahtawi ding uh a, a cikzia thei lo minamte’ khuapite in nang hong zahtak mahmah ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 6:2; Ph 22:23; Isa 13:11"},"4":{"text":"Mizawngte adingin bukna na hi a, a tasamte lungdon cianga bukna mun, huihpi pana kidalna le nisa pana niliim na hi hi. Ahang in a cikzia thei lo husan in kulh a mut gawp huihpi tawh kibanga","ref":"Isa 4:6; 17:10; Isa 14:30; Ph 55:8"},"5":{"text":"sehnel-gam nisa tawh a kibang hi. Meiilum in nisa a dialhsak bangin gamdangte gamlumna na daisak a, tua ciangin a cikzia thei lo mite sip dide hi.","ref":"Jer 51:55"},"6":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA in hih mual tungah mi khempeuh adingin an lim mahmah, zu gei mahmah - an limpen nekna le zu cilpen dawnna pawi a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Mt 8:11; 22:4; Pn 9:2"},"7":{"text":"Amah in hih mual tungah mi khempeuh khuhin a vialcip, minamte khempeuh a kituamnate susia ding hi,","ref":"2Co 5:15-16; Eph 4:18"},"8":{"text":"sihna a valhtum den ding hi. Thupipen TOPA in maitang khempeuh pana khitui teng nulsak dinga, leitunga ama mi khempeuh minsiatna a beisak ding hi. TOPA gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Hos 13:14; Kil 7:17; Mt 5:11; 1Pe 4:14"},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin amaute in, \"Hih in eite Pasian hi takpi hi; amah i muanga, amah’n hong hon hi. Hih in TOPA , amah i muanpa ahi hi; ama hotkhiatna ah nuamsa-in kipak ni,\" a ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 40:9; Ph 20:5; Isa 33:22; Isa 35:2,10"},"10":{"text":"Hih mualtung ah TOPA khut a kinga ding hi; ahi hangin nindum sungah buhtu a kisikcip bangin ama nuai-ah Moab-te a kisikcip ding hi.","ref":"Isa 2:2; Am 2:1-3"},"11":{"text":"Tuipekpa in tuipekin a khut a van bangin a sungah a khut uh a van ding uh hi. Pasian in amaute kiphatsakpih khut siamna a a niamkhiatsak ding hi.","ref":"Job 40:12; Isa 5:25"},"12":{"text":"Amah in a kulh muanhuaite uh zong nuaikhiatsakin a niamsak ding hi; amah in tuate lei tawh kicinin nuaikhiat dinga leivui a suaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Judah gamah hi la a kisa ding hi: Khuapi muanhuai khat i nei hi; Pasian in kulhte le a kanhte dingin hotkhiatna a bawl hi.","title":"Pahtawina La","ref":"Isa 14:32"},"2":{"text":"A thumaan minamte - upna a nei den minam lut nadingin kongte hong un.","ref":"Isa 54:14; 58:8"},"3":{"text":"Lungsim kippa in nang hong muang ahi manin lung nuamtakin kem ta in."},"4":{"text":"A tawntungin TOPA muangun, ahang in TOPA , tua TOPA tawntung Suangpi ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 49:24"},"5":{"text":"Amah in a sangna-a tengte niamkhiat a, khuapi sangpi a khiasuk hi; leidongin tamsak a, dengkhamin leivui a suah hi."},"6":{"text":"A kinengniamte’ khete, mizawngte khekhapte ahi - khete in a tuancil ding hi."},"7":{"text":"A thumaante lampi tamkim a; Thutang Pa aw, a thumaante lampi na nelsak hi.","ref":"Isa 42:16"},"8":{"text":"Hihi, TOPA aw, na thukham b zui-a kalsuan dingin nang kong ngak uh hi: kote lungsim deihna in a tawntunga nangma min phawkna ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 56:1; Ph 37:9; Isa 12:4"},"9":{"text":"Zan ciangin nang kong ngaihsunsun a, zingsang ciangin ka kha in nang hong ngai hi. Leitung ah na thukhenna hong tun ciangin leitung mite in thumaan a thei pan uh hi.","ref":"Ph 63:1; 78:34; Mt 6:33"},"10":{"text":"A tatsiate tungah hehpihna a kilah hangin, thumaan a thei thei kei uh hi; thutanna gamah tatsia dingin a kuan laitakun TOPA thupina a thusim tuan kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 22:12-13"},"11":{"text":"TOPA aw, na khut sangpi in na viktoh hangin amaute in a mu kei uh hi. Na mite adingin na deihluatna musak inla amaute maizumsak in; na galte a kangtum dingin meikuangsa koih khol in."},"12":{"text":"TOPA aw, ko adingin lemna na kipsak zo hi; ka sepzawhte khempeuh uh ko adingin nangma sepsa ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 119:165; Isa 9:6; Ph 68:28"},"13":{"text":"TOPA kote Pasian aw, nang lo pasian dangte in hong uk uh hangin kote in nangma min bek ka pahtawi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:8; 10:5,11; Isa 63:7"},"14":{"text":"Tu-in amaute si uh a, a nungta nawn kei uh hi; a paisa khate a tho nawn kei uh hi. Amaute dan na thuaksak a, na siasak mang hi; amaute kiciamtehna khempeuh na phiatmang hi.","ref":"Tp 4:28"},"15":{"text":"Minam khat nong liansak hi, TOPA aw; ko minam nong liansak hi. Nangmah bek in minthanna na ngah hi; gamgite khempeuh nangma sotsa ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2"},"16":{"text":"TOPA aw, amaute lungdongin nangmah hong zuan uh hi; amaute na sek ciangin thu ngenin a phun thei mialmial bek uh hi. c","ref":"Hos 5:15"},"17":{"text":"Numei gai lai nausuak kuan na sa-in kizia a, a kah bangin kote zong nangma mai-ah kong kiko uh hi, TOPA aw."},"18":{"text":"Ko zong nau ka paii uh a, na sa-in ka kizia uh hi; ahi hangin huih bek ka suakkhia uh hi. Kote in leitungah hotkhiatna ka puak kei uh hi; leitunga mite tungah bangmah ka semkhia kei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Ahi hangin na misi te uh nungta dinga, a pumpite uh a tho ding hi. No leivui laka tengte aw, khanglo unla nuamin kiko un. Na daitui uh zingsang daitui tawh kibang hi; leitung in a misite a hingkhia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 25:8; Eze 37:1-14; Da 12:2"},"20":{"text":"Ka mite aw, pai un, na inndei sunguah lut unla kong kikhaknelh un; ama thangpaihna a bei matengin tawlkhat sung bu phot un.","ref":"Pk 12:23; Ph 30:5; Isa 54:7-8; Ph 91:1,4"},"21":{"text":"En un, leitung mite amau mawhna dan thuaksak dingin a tenna pan TOPA hong paikhia hi. Leitung in ama tunga sisan luannate sin lo dinga; ama thahsate a selcip nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Mic 1:3"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin TOPA in ama namsau - a hiam mahmah, a lian le a vanglian ama namsau in, a kitholhkhia gulpi Leviathan a kual gulpi Leviathan daan thuaksak dinga, tuipi ganhing lianpi a that ding hi.","title":"Israel-te Hutkhiatna","ref":"Isa 34:6; 66:16; Ph 74:13; Kil 12:9"},"2":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin - \"A gahpha lenggui lo la-in sa un:"},"3":{"text":"Keimah TOPA in ka vil tawntung a; tui ka buak den hi. Kuamah in a siatsak loh nadingin sun le zanin ka vil hi.","ref":"Isa 58:11; Ph 91:4"},"4":{"text":"Ka heh kei hi. Lingkungte le thangling kungte in kei hong maituah ta leh amaute phu in gal sungah ka pai teitei dinga; amaute khempeuh mei-in ka hal ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahikeh kei kiang hong zuanin hong bu uh hen; keimah tawh kilemna bawl uh hen, hi hi, keimah tawh kilemna bawl uh hen.","ref":"Isa 25:4; Job 22:21; Ro 5:1; 2Co 5:20"},"6":{"text":"Hong tung ding tua ni ciangin Jacob in zungkha dinga, Israel selkhia-in pak dinga, leitung khempeuh ah a gah a dim ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:10; Isa 37:31"},"7":{"text":"Amah a satte sat bangin TOPA in tuanu sat ahi hiam? Amah a thatte thah bangin amah in tuanu that sam ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Kidona a hanga saltang amah tawh a mawh khawmte - nisuahna huih nun ni bangin ama huih hat in tuanu a delhkhia hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in biakna-tau suangte khempeuh suangkang satvui bangsak a, Asherah gimnamtui-tau ahikeh khuamte b a po lai a omsak nawn loh ciangin hihte hangin Jacob khialhna kimaisakin a mawhna a kipaihsakna gah ahi ding hi.","ref":"Pk 34:13; Ph 78:38"},"10":{"text":"A muanhuai khuapi a hawmin om a, a teng mi tampi in sehnel-gam bangin a taisan uh hi; tua lai-ah bawngnote gamta in tua lai mah ah giak uh a, a hiangte a hawkmai uh hi.","ref":"Isa 32:14; Jer 26:6; Isa 17:2"},"11":{"text":"A hiang mengte a keu ciangin kitan a numeite pai-in singin a cih uh hi. Ahang in, hih mite in a theitel kei uh hi; tua ahi ciangin amaute a Bawlpa in amaute khuatuah lo a, amaute a Piangsakpa in amaute a angvan kei hi.","ref":"Tp 32:28; Tp 32:18"},"12":{"text":"Israel-te aw, tuani ciangin TOPA in Euphrates c - luanglai panin Egypt Luipi - dong hong cilkhia in khatkhatin hong khawm ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Tuateh tua ni ciangin pengkul lianpi khat a ging ding hi. Assyria a, a mangthangte le Egypt ah sala kikaite hong pai-in Jerusalem-a mual siangtho tungah TOPA a bia ding uh hi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ephraim-a zukhamte kisaktheihpih a minthang a mel hoih lei hoihna kuam, lutunga kikhusak pakkual le - zudawnna hanga a khua uh a niamsakte tungah gimna tungta hen!","title":"Ephraim’ Gimna","ref":"tg 3; Isa 9:9; tg 4"},"2":{"text":"En un, Topa in a vanglian a thahatpa khat a nei hi. Amah in huihpi, gialpi le a mutsia thei huih bang, guahciin le tuikhang let bangin leitung a denna suk ding hi.","ref":"Isa 29:6"},"3":{"text":"Ephraim’ zukhamte kisaktheihpih pakkual, khepek nuai-ah a kituancil ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Leihoihna kuam lutunga kikhusak tua a vul pak, a mel hoih a minthanna, anlak hun ma-a thei min tawh kibang ding a - mi khatpeuh in a muh phetin lo pahin a valh pah tawh kibang ding hi.","ref":"Hos 9:10; Na 3:12"},"5":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Thahatpen TOPA , a baanglai a mite adingin minthanna lukhu, a melhoih pakkual hi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9"},"6":{"text":"Amah in thukhen dinga tute tungah amah thutang kha hi-in kongpi-a galte a lehnawhte tungah hatna bulpi hi ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:8"},"7":{"text":"Hihte zong zu hangin pai buatbuat uh a, zucil hangin a hoihoi uh hi: Zucil hangin siampite le kamsangte pai buatbuat uh a, zu in haisakin zucil a hoipih dangdang uh hi. Mang a muh laitakun hi buatbuat uh a, thu a khensat ding uh ciangin a muktu uh hi.","ref":"Isa 22:13; Isa 56:10-12; Isa 15:15; 24:2; Isa 29:11; Hos 4:11"},"8":{"text":"Sabuai tung khempeuh luak dima, nin omlohna mun khat beek a om kei hi.","ref":"Jer 48:26"},"9":{"text":"\"Amah in hilh a sawm kua ahi hiam? Amah in a thupuak kua tungah telgen sawm ahi hiam? Ang tawh kikhen khin phet nawi goih lai naupangnote tung ahi hiam?","ref":"tg 26; Isa 30:20; Isa 53:1; Ph 131:2; Heb 5:12-13"},"10":{"text":"Ahang in, tua pen: khat sep khit teh khat, khat sep khit teh khat, uk khat tungah uk khat, a uk khat tungah uk khat hih lai-ah tawm khat hua lai-ah tawm khat cih bang lel ahi hi,\""},"11":{"text":"Tua ahileh hoih mahmah hi, gamdang mite muk le kamtuam dang tawh Pasian in a mite hopih ding a,","ref":"1Co 14:21*"},"12":{"text":"amaute tungah, \"Hih in khawlmun ahi hi, a gimte khawl ta hen,\" ci a, \"Hih in tawlngakna mun ahi hi\" ci napi amaute in a ngai kei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA kammal amaute tungah, khat sep khit teh khat, khat sep khit teh khat uk khat tungah uk khat, uk khat tungah uk khat; hih lai-ah tawm khat hua lai-ah tawm khat a cih suak lel a - amaute pai-in a tawtolh nading uh, liamin thangah awka a kimat nading uh a suak hi.","ref":"Mt 21:44; Isa 8:15"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin no Jerusalem a hih mite a uk mi simmawhte aw, TOPA kammal za un.","ref":"Isa 1:10"},"15":{"text":"No mi kiphasakte in, \"Sihna tawh thukhun khatah i lut khin a, hankhuk b tawh thuciam i bawl khin hi. Siatna tuihual in hong nawk ciangin hong sukha lo ding hi, ahang in zuauphuahna i beel a, zuauthu c ah i bu hi,\" na ci uh hi.","ref":"Isa 9:15; Isa 29:15"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Thupipen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"En un, a kizia-etsa, inn bulpi dinga a muanhuai, suang manpha suangtum khat Zion ah ka nga khin hi; a muang mi peuhmah a zahlaak ngei kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 118:22; Ns 4:11, Jer 51:26"},"17":{"text":"Keimah in thutanna khaukhai ka suaksak dinga, thumaanna saval-bawk ka suaksak ding hi; zuauphuaka na bukna uh gialpi in nuaimang dinga, na bukna mun uh tui in a tuum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:16; 2Ku 21:13"},"18":{"text":"Sihna tawh na thukhun uh a mawkna suak dinga; hankhuk tawh na thuciam uh a kip kei ding hi. Siatna tuihual in hong nawk ciangin note hong sattuk ding hi.","ref":"tg 15; Da 8:13"},"19":{"text":"Hong nawk sialsialin note hong taimang ding hi; zingsang khat khit zingsang khat sun le zanin hong nawk den ding hi.\" Hih thupuak theihtelna in lauthawngna ngentang hong tun ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:2"},"20":{"text":"Na khekhuan nadingin lupna tomlua dinga, na kituam nadingin puanza neu lua ding hi.","ref":"Isa 59:6"},"21":{"text":"Perazim Vum a, a hih bangin TOPA ding to dinga, Gibeon Kuama a heh bangin amah heh in - ama nasep, a nasep lamdang semin ama bawl, a bawl a piandang a bawl ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:12; Lk 19:41-44"},"22":{"text":"Na ciamnuih bawlna na tawp kei leh na sikkhainiang a gikzaw ding hi; Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in gam buppi kisiat nading thukhensat-na kei tungah hong gen khin hi."},"23":{"text":"Ngai inla ka aw za in: limtak ngai-in ka thugen za in."},"24":{"text":"Lokhopa in ankungno suan nading lo a khawh ciangin kho zom denden ahi hiam? A leikhalte velkhamin lei hoihte zelh niloh ahi hiam?","ref":"Thn 3:2"},"25":{"text":"Lei maitang a maihtam khit ciangin caraway vawhin, cummim theh hi lo ahi hiam? Mangbuhte ama munah d suanin mangbuh-ham ama lei e ah, mangbuh-man a lo ah tuh hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Pk 9:32"},"26":{"text":"A Pasian in lamlak a thumaan lampi a hilh hi.","ref":"Isa 94:10"},"27":{"text":"Buhcilna set-in caraway kicil lo a, Cummin tungah lengpei a kihual kei hi; ciangkang-in caraway kisatkhia a, cianggolhin cummin kisatkhia hi.","ref":"Job 41:30; Isa 10:5"},"28":{"text":"Anlum-a bawl dingin antang kigawizan a tuaci in kuamah in a cil denden kei hi. Amah in ancilna lengpei a tungah a hawl hangin a sakolte in a gawi kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 21:10"},"29":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh zong Thahatpen TOPA pana pai hi in, a lamlahna lamdangin a pilna thupi diak hi."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ariel, David tenna khuapi Ariel tungah gimna tung ta! Kum khat tungah kum khat gawm toto unla, a kot paipai na pawite uh bawl toto un.","title":"David’ Khuapi’ Gimna","ref":"2Sa 5:7; Isa 1:14"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi taleh zong Ariel ka umcih ding hi; tua khua thumin taamlo dinga kei adingin biakna-tau tap suangpek a ahi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Na kimkotah giahphual ka sat dinga; tausang-in hong ki-umcihin nang langah umcihna ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Lk 19:43-44; 2Ku 25:1"},"4":{"text":"Hong kiniamkhiatin, leitual panin na pau ding hi; leivui lak pan na phun mualmual ding hi. Lei sung pan sikha’ aw bangin ging khia dinga; leivui lak pan hong huau siausiau ding hi.","ref":"Isa 8:19; Isa 26:16"},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin na gal tampite leivui tawh kibang dinga, a kheltat honpite huihlet ansi leng a bang ding uh hi. Thakhatin","ref":"Isa 17:13"},"6":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA vanging, zinling le awging lianpi-in, pingpei le huihpi le a hultum meikuangin hong pai vat ding hi.","ref":"Mt 24:7; Ph 83:13-15"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ariel a do minam khempeuh mihon tampite, amah le a mun muanhuai do-a a umcihte zana mangmat bang, zana mangmuh bang dinga -","ref":"Mic 4:11-12; Zec 12:9"},"8":{"text":"gilkial khat in a mangin an ne napi a khanlawh ciangin a gil a kiallai veve bang; dangtak khat in a mangin tui dawn napi a khanlawh ciangin gimsa-in khang lo a, a dangtak a phattuam loh tawh kibang ding hi. Zion Vum a do minam honpi khempeuh tua tawh kibang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 73:20; Isa 17:12-14; 54:17"},"9":{"text":"Kiphawngsak unla lamdang sa un, na mit uh tun unla khua mu kei un; zu dawn lopi-in zu kham unla, zucil dawn lopi-in hoi un.","ref":"Jer 4:9; Isa 6:10"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in hong ihsipsak zo a: na mitte khakcipin (kamsangte); na lu a tuncip zo hi (thumu kholte).","ref":"Ph 69:23; Isa 6:9-10; 1Sa 9:9"},"11":{"text":"No adingin hih in mangmuhna bangmah hi lo a, laizial sunga kizialcip bang ahi hi. Tua hi a laisim thei mi khat tungah tua laizial pia-in ama kiangah, \"Hehpihna-in hih sim dih in,\" ci lecin, \"Kibelhcip hi, sim thei keng,\" ci-in hong dawng ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahikeh a sim thei lo mi khat laizial pia in, \"Hih sim dih in,\" ci lecin, \"Ka sim zia ding thei keng,\" ci-in hong dawng ding hi.","ref":"Isa 8:16"},"13":{"text":"Topa in, \"Hih mite in a kam uh tawh kei hong nai uh a, a muk un kei hong pahtawi uh hi; ahi hangin a lungtang uh kei tawh kigamla hi. Amaute in kei hong biakna uh mihingte b hilhsa ngeina-a kibawl hi lel hi.","ref":"Ph 50:16; Eze 33:31"},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih mite a lamdang sanga a lamdang zaw ka lak lai ding hi; a pilte pilna ka mangthangsak dinga, a teite teina ka mangsak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 49:7"},"15":{"text":"A ngimna uh TOPA panin a thuk mahmahna ah sel dingin pai uh a, khuamial sungah na semin, \"Eite kua’n hong mu ding hiam? Eite kua’n hong thei ding hiam?\" ci-a a ngaihsunte in gimna thuak ta hen.","ref":"Isa 28:15; Job 22:13; Ph 94:7"},"16":{"text":"Bel seekpa, a tungman banga ngaihsut bangin nate na lumlet uh hi! A kibawl penin a bawlpa kiangah, \"Ama bawlsa ka hi kei hi\" ci in, Beel in a seekpa tungah, \"Bangmah na thei kei hi,\" ci thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 9:12"},"17":{"text":"Hun tomno sungah Lebanon, lo leihoih suakin, tua lo leihoih pen tulak tawh kibang hi lo hiam?","ref":"Ph 84:6; Isa 32:15"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin bilngongte in laizial-a thute za ding uh a, lungzinna le khuamialna ah mittawte in a mu ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"A kiniamkhiatte khatvei TOPA sungah lungnuam kik ding uh a; a tasamte Israel-te Siangtho Pa sungah a lungnuam ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"A kheltat mite mangthang ding uh a, mi simmawhte kilang nawn loin gitlohna mit a nei khempeuh -"},"21":{"text":"mi mawhna zonga kammal khat tawh zum sunga mi thangsiahte le mawhpengte thutangna zuau teci panna tawh a lakkhiatsakte khempeuh kisusia mang ding hi.","ref":"Am 5:10,15; Isa 32:7"},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Abraham tankhiapa TOPA in Jacob innkuante tungah: \"Jacob a maizum nawn kei ding hi; amaute’ mai a daang nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:23; Jer 30:6,10"},"23":{"text":"Amaute in ka khuta ka bawlsa a tate uh amaute lakah a muh uh ciangin ka min siangthosak ding uh a; Jacob’ Siangtho Pa Sianthona kipsanin Israel-te Pasian a kihta ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 49:20-26; Isa 5:19"},"24":{"text":"Lungsim vakzaute in theitel ta ding uh a; mi phunhatte in a kihilhna sang thei ta ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 26:7"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Thumang lo tate in gimna ngah ta hen,\" TOPA in cikhia a, \"amaute kei ngimna lo ngimna a neite, kei’ Kha tawh kop lo a kipawlna a phuante, mawhna tungah mawhna a suangsawnte;","title":"Thumanglo Minam’ Gimna","ref":"Isa 29:15; Isa 8:12"},"2":{"text":"kei hong dong loin Egypt a paisukte; Pharaoh huhna beel ding le Egypt liahna a zongte ahi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 36:9"},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pharaoh hutna note maizumna hi dinga, Egypt liim in note zahlakna hi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 20:4-5; 36:6"},"4":{"text":"Amaute in Zoan ah ulian nei uh henla amau thupuakte Hanes ah tung ta leh","ref":"Isa 19:11"},"5":{"text":"amau adingin huhna ahi a, hamphatna ahi zongin a pia thei mihing in kimanna nei loin maizumna le zahlakna hi lel ahi manin tuate peuhmah kimaizumsak ding hi.","ref":"tg 7; 2Ku 18:21; Jer 37:3-5; 2Ku 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Negev-a ganhingte tawh kisai thusuak: Humpinelkaite le humpinelkai nute, mualtante le gul lengtheite omna haksatna le lungdonna mun kantanin amaute thupuakte in laa nungzangah a hauhnate uh pua in, a goute uh kala-oh thuvum ah pua uh a, bangmah metna a pia lo minam tung, amau huhna kimanna a nei lo","ref":"Isa 13:1; Pk 5:10,21; Isa 15:7; 2Ku 18:21"},"7":{"text":"Egypt-te tungah a puak uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin amah Sep Awl Rahab ka ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Tu-in pai inla,suangpek tungah gelhsak-in, hong tung lai ding hunah teci a hi tawntung thei dingin laizial tungah khuaksak in.","ref":"Tp 27:8; Jos 24:26-27; Isa 8:1"},"9":{"text":"Hihte in a lehdo mite, a zuauphuak tate, TOPA lamlahna a ngai nuam lo tate ahi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:10"},"10":{"text":"Amaute in thumute tungah, \"Mang mu nawn kei un!\" ci uh a, kamsangte tungah, \"Ko ading thumaan mangmuhna mu nawn kei un! Thu-nuam hong gen unla, hong khembawl un.","ref":"1Ku 22:8; Eze 13:7"},"11":{"text":"Hih lampi nusia in hih lampi pan pial unla, Israel-te Siangtho Pa tawh hong kimaituahsak nawn kei un,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"tg 21; Pn 3:6"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel-te Siangtho Pa in, \"Note in hih thu nialin nuainetna tungah na kinga uh a, zuauphuahna suang na hi manun no adingin","ref":"Isa 5:19; Isa 5:24; Isa 5:7"},"13":{"text":"hih mawhna a khangkhamsa, lawtkhia-in a cim dektak kulh sangpi thakhat thu-a cimzuah tawh a kibang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 62:3; 1Ku 20:30; Isa 29:5"},"14":{"text":"Leibeel bangin kitamkham dinga man theih om loin kitamnenin a themte lakah meikhuk-a mei-am lak nading, tuikhuka tui suah nadinga man theih ding a kimu kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 2:9; Jer 19:10-11"},"15":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA , Israel’ Siangtho Pa gen ahi hi: \"Kisikna le tawlngakna in note hotkhiatna hi a, daihna le muanna note hatna ahi hi; ahi hangin note na tuaci kei uh hi.","ref":"Pk 14:14; Jos 1:13; Isa 32:17; Isa 8:6; 42:24"},"16":{"text":"Note in, ‘Hi lo hi, sakolin ka tai ding uh hi,’ na ci uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin manlangin na tai takpi ding uh hi! Note in, ‘Sakol hat tungah ka tuang ding uh hi,’ na ci uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin note hong delhpa zong a hat semsem ding hi!","ref":"Isa 31:1,3"},"17":{"text":"Note, mualdawna kiphut dialkhai khuam bang le mualtunga dialkhai banga hong kinusiat matengin mi khat tawnna hangin tul khat na taikek ding uha mi nga tawnna hangin na vekun na taikek ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 26:8; Tp 28:25; Isa 1:8"},"18":{"text":"Tua hi napi TOPA in note hong hehpih nuam lailai in; ama hong khuatuahna hong lak lailai hi. Ahang in, TOPA in a thutang Pasian ahi hi. Amah a ngak zote khempeuh thupha ngah ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 42:14; Isa 25:9; Ta 3:25"},"19":{"text":"No Zion mite, Jerusalem a tengte aw, na kap nawn kei ding uh hi. Huhna ngenin na kiko uh ciangin hong hehpih mahmah hi! Amah in a zak phetin hong dawng ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Topa in note lungkhamna anlum le sinkhamna tui hong piak ciangin na siate uh bu nawn loin na mit mahmah uh tawh amaute na mu ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Taklam ah kihei-in vei lamah na kihei uh zongin na nung panin na bil un, \"Hih lampi hi, tawn un,\" a cih na za ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin nguna kiluan na milimte uh le khama kizut na milim sunte uh na ninsak ding uh a, numeite nin siakna puan bangin tuate lawnmang in, \"Mangthang ou!\" na ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 74:9; Isa 29:24; Am 8:11"},"23":{"text":"Lei sunga na vawhsa khaici adingin guah zong hong zusak dinga, gam sunga an piangte gahpha in a tam mahmah ding hi. Tua ni ciangin na ganhonte uh lonona zapi ah a gamta ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Lokho bawngtalte le laate in kawbia le kangkui-a kitok ngi-ingei gan-an a ne ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Kingawng-atna a nasiat mahmah ni-in tausangte a puk ciangin mual sangte le mualsang vumte tung khempeuh ah luituite a luang ding hi."},"26":{"text":"TOPA in a mite liamma tunsakin a gimpiakna-mate a damsak ciangin ni bangin khapi tang dinga, ni sagih sunga a tan zahin ni a zah sagih in a tangzaw ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:5; 60:19-20; Kil 21:23"},"27":{"text":"En in, TOPA Min, a hehna meikuangsa in hong pai a, meikhu sahpi meii-in hong kaii hi. Thangpaihna tawh a muk kidim a, a leii lah a haltum mei ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 59:19; Isa 10:5; Job 41:2"},"28":{"text":"Ama husan ngawng ciang a pha luitui khang tawh kibang hi. Amah in haihna-in minamte siatna haih a, amaute a makaihna a khaguh uah a bulh hi.","ref":"Isa 11:4, Isa 8:8"},"29":{"text":"Tuateh note in pawi siangtho na bawl ni zan bangun la na sa ding uh hi; Israel Suangpi, TOPA mual tungah tamngai tumsa-in na pai uh bangin na lungnuam ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 25:6; Pc 49:24; Isa 12:1"},"30":{"text":"TOPA in a thupi ama aw mite zasak dinga, a hehsa a khut, a haltum mei, meiipi kai, huihpi le gialpi-in a musak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 9:12; 10:25"},"31":{"text":"TOPA ’ aw in Assyria susia gawp dinga; a sik ciangkhut in amaute a sattuk ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:5,12; Isa 11:4"},"32":{"text":"TOPA in danpiakna ciangkhutin amaute a sat simin, gal sungah amaute a khutin a do bangin khuangte le harp-te tumging tawh a kituak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:15; Eze 32:10"},"33":{"text":"Topheth a kibawlphat zawh sawt ta hi; tua in kumpipa adingin a baihsa a om ahi hi. Tua meikhukpi a thuk le a zai-a kibawl hi a, mei le sing a kicingtakin kikoihkhol hi; luiluang tawh a kibang kaat kuanglai TOPA husan a kitawhkuang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:31; Pc 19:24; Kil 9:17"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt huh nading deiha a paisukte, sakolte tungah kinga-in sakolleng tampite le a sakol-tuangte uh thahatna muanga Israel-te siangtho Pa en lo ahikeh TOPA tung pana huhna a zong lote tungah gimna tung ta hen.","title":"Egypt Tunga Kingate’ Gimna","ref":"Isa 2:7"},"2":{"text":"Tua hi napi amah zong pil a, gimna a tungsak thei hi; amah in a kammal a dokkik kei hi. A kheltatte innkuante le migilote a huhte langah a pang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 45:7; Ms 23:19"},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Egypt mite mihing hi-a, Pasian hi lo uh hi; amaute sakolte ci-le-sa hi-a, kha ahi kei hi. TOPA in a khut a zankhiat ciangin, a huhpa muktu dinga a kihuhpa a puk ding hi; a nih un a mangthangkhawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 28:9; Isa 30:16; Isa 9:17,21"},"4":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah hong gen hih ahi hi: \"Humpinelkai humham in, humpinelkai lianpi a sa nek tungah bok a - amah nawhkhia dingin tuucing buppi a kikaihkhop uh hangin amau otna in lausak loin, amau husa in a nawngkaisak zawh loh bangin, Zion Vumte le a sannate ah galdo dingin Thahatpen TOPA hong kuansuk ding hi.","ref":"Am 3:8; Isa 42:13"},"5":{"text":"Vasa a bu tung sanah a lamlam bangin Thahatpen TOPA in Jerusalem a dal ding hi; amah in dalin hu dinga, amah in ‘paisanin’ a suaktasak ding hi,\"","ref":"Ph 91:4; Pk 12:23"},"6":{"text":"Nakpi taka a lehdo Israel mite aw, ama kiangah kileh kik un."},"7":{"text":"Ahang in, tua ni ciangin note khempeuh in mawhna tawh a dim khut in a bawlsa ngun le kham milimte na nial ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:20; 30:22"},"8":{"text":"\"Assyria lah mi tawi loh namsau-in puk dinga, mihing aa ahi lo namsau khat in a valhtum ding hi. Namsau mai-ah amaute tai ding uh a, a tangvalte uh zawhtawh thu-in na kisemsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:25; 37:7"},"9":{"text":"Amaute mun muanhuai launa hangin puk dinga a galte uh dialkhai a muh uh ciangin a galkap mangte uh a tai ding uh hi.\" a meikuang Zion-a om pa Jerusalem-a pummei neipa TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 10:17; Mal 4:1"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"En in, thumaana tawh kumpi khat in uk dinga, gam-ukte in thutangin a uk ding uh hi.","title":"Thumaanna Kumpi-gam","ref":"Eze 37:24; Isa 9:7"},"2":{"text":"Amaute huih pana kidalna, huihpi pana bukna bangin, sehnel-gam luitui bang le keugaw gama suangpi liim a bang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 4:6; Ph 23:2; 107:35; Jer 31:9"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin mite in amaute mitsinsan nawn lo ding uh a, amaute gen a zate in a ngai ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 29:18; Tp 29:4"},"4":{"text":"Lungtom mite lungsim in thei in tel dinga, dang-awkte dangnalin a pau sensen ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Mihaite, mi nampi kici nawn lo dinga micingtak lote nakpi in a kizahtak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 25:25"},"6":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mihaite hai pau uh a, gitloh ding bek a ngaihsun uh hi. A pasian-milohna na bek sem a TOPA tawh kisaite ahi lo lamin a thehzak hi; a gilkialte a hawmpi-in nusia a, a dangtakte tui dawn ding a pia nuam kei hi.","ref":"Pn 19:3; Isa 9:16"},"7":{"text":"Mi cingtak lopa sepzia kheltatna bek hi-a, a tasamte in thutanga a ngetna nangawn khemna tawh a suksiat nadingin gitloh ding bek a sawm hi.","ref":"Jer 5:26-28"},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin mi thupi in na thupite mah ngim a, nasep thupi ah a kip hi.","ref":"Pn 11:25"},"9":{"text":"A om hithiat numeite aw, tho unla ka thugen ngai un. Awlmawh a nei lo tanute aw, kong gen dingte za un!","title":"Jerusalem Numeite"},"10":{"text":"Kum khat valzek khit ciangin bangmah a awlmawh lote na ling ding uh hi; lenggah kila thei lo dinga an lak hun hong tung kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"No a om hithiat numeite aw, ling un; no awlmawh nei lo tanute aw, lau-in ling un! Na puante uh hawkkhia unla, na kawnguah ippi puan teng un.","ref":"Isa 47:2; Isa 3:24"},"12":{"text":"Logam hoihte lenggui gahphate le","ref":"Na 2:7; Isa 16:9"},"13":{"text":"thangling le lingkung in a ponelh ka mite’ leitang adingin na dip uh hum un - hi hi, lungdamna innte khempeuh le hih khuapi a kipahpihte khempeuh adingin thum un."},"14":{"text":"Mun muanhuaite kisusia in, a gamlum khuapi kilawi ding hi; mualbote le tausangte gamkhing suak den dinga, laate gamtatna mun le bawnghonte lonona mun a suak ding hi;","ref":"Isa 34:13"},"15":{"text":"eite tungah a sangna pan Kha a kibuak mateng, sehnel-gam, logam hoih a suah mateng le logam hoihte tulak a bat matengin a tuaci om den ding hi.","ref":"Joel 2:28; Ph 107:35; Isa 29:17"},"16":{"text":"Sehnel-gamah thutang teng dinga, logam hoih ah thumaanna teng ding hi.","ref":"Ph 48:1"},"17":{"text":"Thumaanna gah lemna hi dinga; thumaanna hangin daihna le kimuanna a om tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Ph 119:165; Jas 3:18"},"18":{"text":"Lungmuangtaka tenna mun, inn muanhuai le bangmah in nawngkaisak lo-a khawlna munah ka mite a teng ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:4, 26:1"},"19":{"text":"Gialpi in tulak dengzanin khuapi a kimaihtam kiuhkeuh zongin,","ref":"Isa 24:10; 27:10"},"20":{"text":"luidung ah na khaici uh tuh a, na bawngtalte uh le na laate uh note utnana-a a khah note thupha ngah mahmahte na hi ding uh hi.","ref":"Thn 11:1"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hong kisusia nai lo mi susiapa aw, gimna thuak ta in! Kuama lehhek nai loh mi lehhekpa aw, gimna thuak ta in! Na suksiat nawn loh ciangin nang hong kisusia ding hi. Mi na lehhek nawn loh ciangin nang hong kilehhek ding hi!","title":"Lungdonna le Huhna","ref":"Hab 2:8; Isa 21:2"},"2":{"text":"TOPA aw, ko hong hehpih in, nang kong lamen uh hi. Zingsang simin kote hong hatsak inla, ka lungdon uh ciangin hong honkhia in.","ref":"Isa 5:30; 25:9"},"3":{"text":"Vanah na aw a gin ciangin mite a taikek uh hi; na dinkhiat ciangin minamte kithehthang uh hi.","ref":"Ph 68:1; Isa 59:16-18"},"4":{"text":"Minamte aw, na van lakte uh, kauphenote in an a kaihkhop bang ahi hi; kauphe honpi bangin mite in a bawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Joel 1:4"},"5":{"text":"A sangna munah TOPA teng ahi manin a kitawisang hi; amah in thumaan le thutang tawh Zion a dimsak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 97:9"},"6":{"text":"Note hunin amah bulkip kician hi dinga, hotkhiatna le pilna le theihna kholna munpi hi ding hi; TOPA kihtakna in hih gou a kholna tawhtang ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"En un, a pasal galhangte uh lamdung ah kap uh a; kilemna thupuate nakpi-in a kap uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:37"},"8":{"text":"Lam lianpite lah hawmmang a, lampi tungah khualzin a om kei hi. Thuciamna kipalsatin a tecite b lah kisimmawh a kuamah a kizahtak kei hi.","ref":"Thk 5:6;Isa 35:8"},"9":{"text":"Leitang thumin c a tulgawp hi, Lebanon maizumin a vul hi; Sharon, Arabah tawh kibang a, Bashan le Carmel a teh uh pulh hi.","ref":"Isa 3:26; Isa 2:13; 24:4; 1Ku 18:19; Na 1:4"},"10":{"text":"\"Tu-in ka ding dinga, tu-in ka kitawisang ding hi; tu-in ka kilaamto ding hi.","ref":"Ph 12:5; Isa 2:21"},"11":{"text":"Buhvai na paii uh a, buhtu na hingkhia uh hi; na husan uh no hong hultum mei ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 7:14; Isa 59:4; Isa 1:31"},"12":{"text":"Leikang hal bangin mite kihal dinga; lingkung vatsa bangin mei-ah kikhul ding hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Gamlapi-a om note in ka hihsa za un; gamla-a om note in ka vangliatna thei un!","ref":"Ph 49:1"},"14":{"text":"Zion-a mawhneite lau uh a; pasian-neilote a ling kauhkauh uh hi: \"Eite kua a haltum mei tawh teng khawm thei ding i hi hiam? Eite kua a kuang tawntung mei tawh tengkhawm thei ding i hi hiam?\"","ref":"Isa 30:30"},"15":{"text":"Thumantakin kalsuana thumaan genpa, mite’ na suh ding ut lo a golhsum sang nuam lopa, mi thah ding ngimna za nuam lo a, gitloh ding sawmna a mu nuam lopa -","ref":"Pn 15:27"},"16":{"text":"hihpa in asannate a teng dingpa, mun muanhuaina mual bukna-a a neipa ahi hi. A anlum ding kipuak dinga tui a kisam kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 25:4"},"17":{"text":"Kumpipa mel hoihna na mitin na mu dinga, gam zapi-a kiphah gam na en ding hi.","ref":"Isa 6:5; Isa 26:15"},"18":{"text":"Na mangngilh mawh uh a masa launate: \"Kumpi ulianpenpa koi-ah om ahi hiam? Siahdongpa koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tausang cing -ukpa koi-ah om ahi hiam?\" ci-in na lungsimun na ngaihsunsun ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 17:14"},"19":{"text":"Tua a kiphasak mahmah mite kam lamdang zanga theihloh pau-a pua bualbualte, na mu nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 28:11; Jer 5:15"},"20":{"text":"Pawite i bawlna khuapi Zion en dih un; lungnuama kitenna a kisuankhia lo ding puanbuk khat; a khetphimte kibot ngei loin a khaute a kitat ngei lo ding Jerusalem na mit un na mu ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua lai-ah TOPA in eite Thahat Pa, hi ding hi. Tua mun, gun zaipite le lui lianpite omna tawh kibang ding hi. Tuate tungah gal gunkuang kihot nawn lo dinga tembaw hat zong a pai nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:18, 48:18"},"22":{"text":"Ahang in, eite thukhenpa TOPA hi a, thukham piapa TOPA hi-in eite kumpipa TOPA ahi hi; eite hong hon dingpa amah ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 89:18"},"23":{"text":"Na puankhai khaute uh kol ta hi: puankhai khuam khihkip zolo-in puankhaite a kizal kei hi. Tua ciangin galvanlak tampi kihawm dinga, khebaite nangawn in vanlak a puakhia ding uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 7:8,16"},"24":{"text":"Zion-a tengte kuamah in, \"Ka ci na,\" ci lo dinga, tua lai-a tengte mawhnate a kimaisak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:26; Jer 50:20; 1Jn 1:7-9"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No minamte aw, hong naih unla ngai dih un; no mihingte aw, limtakin ngai un! Leitung le a sunga om khempeuh, lei pumpi le a sunga piang khempeuh zasak un;","title":"Minamte Tungah Thukhenna","ref":"Ph 49:1; Tp 32:1"},"2":{"text":"Minamte khempeuh tungah TOPA heh hi; amaute’ galkapte khempeuh tungah thangpai hi. Amah in amaute susia khin kiuhkeuh d dinga; amaute thah dingin pia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:25"},"3":{"text":"A kithat amau mite kilawnkhia dinga, a misiluangte uh a uihto lualua ding hi. Mual liante amau sisanin kawt khin pikpek ding hi.","ref":"Joel 2:20"},"4":{"text":"Vante a aksite khempeuh kia dinga laizial bangin vanpi a kizial ding hi; Lenggui pana a tehvul a pulh bang le theikung pana a gahvuai a pulh bangin aksi honpi khempeuh kia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:13; Eze 32:7-8; Isa 15:6; Mt 21:19"},"5":{"text":"Ka namsau in vante ah dawnin kham khin a; en un, a mite ka siatsak kiuhkeuhsa Edom ah thukhenin a tuaksuk hi.","ref":"Jer 46:10; Am 1:11-12, Mal 1:4; Isa 24:6"},"6":{"text":"TOPA namsau sisan ah kidiahin, tuunote le keelte sisan le tuutal kalte pana a thaute in a kituam hi. Ahang in, TOPA in Bozrah ah kithoihna khat nei a, Edom ah kithahna lianpi a om hi.","ref":"Tp 32:41; Pc 36:33; Isa 30:25"},"7":{"text":"Gam bawngtalte, bawngtalnote le bawngtal lianpite amau tawh a pukkhawm ding hi. Amaute leitang sisanin kawt dimdem dinga sathau in leivuite a tawtkim ding hi.","ref":"Ph 68:30"},"8":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in Zion mawhsakte a thuksak ding, dan a tuahsak ding kum khat, a phu lak ding ni khat a nei hi.","ref":"Isa 63:4"},"9":{"text":"Edom luite kultar suak dinga, a leivuite kaat kuanglai suakin; a leitang kultar kuang a suak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Sun le zanin mit lo dinga a khu tawntung ding hi. Khang khat pan khang khat dongin gam simtham suak dinga khat beek in a tawnkha nawn kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Sehnel-gam simbu a le simbupi b te in a tang ding uh hi. Simbu liante c le va-akte in tua lai-ah bu a tom ding uh hi. Pasian in Edom tungah a siatna khausai le a hawmsuakna saval a khaisuk ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 21:13; Ta 2:8"},"12":{"text":"Kumpi gam a kicih theih nadingin a uliante in bangmah nei lo ding uh a, a kumpi tapate uh a mangthang khin ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:11-12, Jer 27:20"},"13":{"text":"Amualbote thangling in tuum dinga a kulh muanhuaite lakhai le lingvom in a tuum ding hi. Tua mun, ngiate anzonna mun suak dinga, simbute’ bu suak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:22; 32:13; Ph 44:19; Jer 9:11"},"14":{"text":"Sehnel gam ganhingte le ngiate kisutuahin sathakte khat le khat a kizawn ding uh hi; tua lai-ah zana gamta ganhingte zong giak ding uh a, a khawlmun ding uh a zong ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 13:22; Kil 18:2"},"15":{"text":"Simbupi in bu tomin tui dinga, keuhsakin a note a kha liim nuai-ah a kem ding hi. Musite zong tua lai-ah a nupa kopin a omkhawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 14:13"},"16":{"text":"TOPA laizial sung en inla sim in: Hihte khat beek kimansuah lo dinga lawmsam khat beek a om kei ding hi. Ahang in, ama kama a thupiaksa hi a, a Kha in amaute a kaikhawm ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:8; Isa 1:20"},"17":{"text":"Amah in a tanh ding uh a sehsak ding hi; ama khutin amau tanh ding ciat a hawmsak ding hi. Amaute in nei tawntung ding uh a, tua lai-ah khang khat khit khang khat a teng den ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 17:14"}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sehnel-gam le gamgawtak a nuam ding hi; gamsimthamte lungnuamin a palhkhia ding uh hi. Mualheuh-pak bangin","title":"Tatkhiatna hanga Lungnopna","ref":"Isa 27:10; 41:18-19; Isa 51:3"},"2":{"text":"a pak uh kakhia dinga; nuam lua mahmah in lungdamin kiko ding uh hi. Lebanon minthanna kipia dinga, Carmel le Sharon thupina a kipia ding hi; amaute in TOPA ’ minthanna le Pasian thupina a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Zai 2:1; Isa 25:9; 55:12; Isa 32:15; Zai 7:5; Pk 16:7; Isa 4:5"},"3":{"text":"A thazaw khutte khauhsak unla, a zaw khukte kipsak un;","ref":"Job 4:4; Heb 12:12"},"4":{"text":"A lauthawng mite tungah, \"Kihatsak un, lau kei un; na Pasian uh hong pai dinga phula dingin hong kuanin a siangtho dantuahsakna tawh note hong hon ding hi,\" ci un.","ref":"Isa 40:2; Zec 1:13; Isa 7:4; Isa 62:11; Isa 1:24"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin mittawte mit kihonsak dinga bengngongte’ bil a kivaksak ding hi.","ref":"Mt 11:5; Jn 9:6-7; Isa 29:18"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin khebaite sazuk bangin diang ding uh a, a pau thei lote lungdamin a awng ding uh hi. Gamsimtham ah tui phulkhia dinga sehnel-gam ah lui a luang ding hi.","ref":"Mt 15:30; Jn 5:8-9; Mt 9:32-33"},"7":{"text":"A sa mahmah sehnel, bualtui suak dinga, leigawtakte ciktui phulna a suak ding hi. Khatvei lai-a ngiate lupna munah lopa, pumpeng le mau a po ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:10; Isa 13:22; Job 8:11"},"8":{"text":"Tua lai-ah lam lianpi om dinga, Sianthona lampi a kici ding hi. A sianglo mite in tua a tung tawn lo ding uh a; tua Lampi tawnte ading tua bang ahi ding hi; a tatsia mihaite in tua tung a tawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 4:3; 1Pe 1:15; Isa 52:1"},"9":{"text":"Tua lai-ah humpinelkai om loin, tua tungah sasialne ganhing khatpeuh a pai kei ding hi; tua munah tuate a kimu kei ding hi. Ahi hangin tatsate bek tua lai-ah pai ding uh a,","ref":"Isa 30:6; Isa 34:14; Isa 51:11; 62:12"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in tatman a piaksate hong ciah kik ding uh hi. Amaute lasa kawmin Zion ah a lut ding uh hi; amaute lutungah a tawntungin lungnopna khu ding uh hi. Nopsakna le kipahna tawh kidim ding uh a, dahna le khuisatna beimang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:27; Isa 25:9; Ph 51:8; Isa 51:3; Isa 51:11; Kil 7:17"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in a uk zawh a kum sawm le lina kumin Assyria kumpipa Sennacherib in Judah khuapi muanhuaite khempeuh simin a la hi.","title":"Sennacherib in Jerusalem Sim"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Assyria kumpipa in Lachish panin Jerusalem a om kumpi Hezekiah kiangah a galkap mang lianpa tawh galkap tampitak a sawl hi. Puan sawppa Lo zuatna lampi a Bual Tungnung tuinak ah galkap mangpa a khawl ciangin"},"3":{"text":"kumpi inn ukpa Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, thuvanpa Shebna le thu ciamtehpa Asaph tapa Joah a kiangah a pai uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:1; Isa 22:20-21"},"4":{"text":"Galkap mang lianpa in amaute kiangah, \"Hezekiah kiangah, ‘Hih in kumpi lian, Assyria kumpipa gen ahi hi: Hih na lungmuanna uh bang bulphuh na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Note in galsiamna le galkap tha ka nei uh hi, na ci uh hi - ahi hangin a hawmpi-a thu gen na hi lel uh hi. Kei hong lehdo dingin note in kua suang na hi uh hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Tu-in en un, note in a tungah a kingap uh ciangin suna a liamsak thei bek pumpeng ciangkhut them ahi Egypt a suang na hi ta zen uh hi. Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh lah amah suang khempeuh tungah tua mah bangin ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua hi-a no zong, \"Kote in TOPA ka Pasian ka suang uh hi,\" na cih uh leh - amah pen Hezekiah in a munsangte le a biakna-taute phelkhiatsakin Judah le Jerusalem tungah, \"Hih biakna-tau mai-ah na biak uh kul ding hi,\" a cih pa hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"2Ku 18:4; Isa 30:2,5"},"8":{"text":"\"‘Tu-in hong pai-in Assyria kumpipa ka pu tawh thu kiciamna bawl un: A tunga tuang ding mi na neih nak uh leh sakol tulnih no kong pia ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt sakolte sakol tuangte suangin ka pu galkap mangte lakah a neu pen khat nangawn bangci zawh thei ding na hi uh hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tua tham loin hih gam sima a susia dingin TOPA loin hong pai ka hi hiam? TOPA mahmah in hih gam do a pai dingin hong gen ahi hi,\" ci-in gen un,\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Eliakim, Shebna le Joah in galkap mang lianpa kiangah, \"Thei lel ka hi manun na nasemte tungah Aram pau-in hong gen in. Kulh tunga mite zakin Hebrew pau-in hong hopih kei in,\" a ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin mangpa in, \"Ka pu in nang le na pu tung bekah hih thu gen dingin hong sawl hi lo a, kulh tunga tute - no tawh a kibangin amau ek ne a, a zun uh a dawn khawmte tungah gen dinga hong sawl hi lo ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkap mangpa dingto in Hebrew pau-in awngkhia a, \"A lian mahmah kumpi, Assyria kumpipa kammalte za un!"},"14":{"text":"Hih in kumpipa’ thugen ahi hi: Hezekiah kikhemsak kei un. Amah in note hong hu zo lo ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Hezekiah in, ‘ TOPA in eite hong hu taktak dinga, hih khuapi Assyria kumpipa khut sungah a kipia kei ding hi,’ ci-a hong zolna tawh na TOPA uh muang kha kei un."},"16":{"text":"\"Hezekiah thu ngai kei un. Assyria kumpipa gen hih ahi hi: Kei tawh kilemna bawlin kei kiangah hong paikhia un. Tua hileh a kuamah peuh in amau lenggui, amau theikung ciat panin ne ding uh a, amau tuikhuk ciat panin a dawn ding uh hi;"},"17":{"text":"keimah hong pai-in no aa tawh a kibang leitang - an le zuthak leitang, anlum le lenggui lei ah kong paipih matengin a tua ci ding hi."},"18":{"text":"\"Hezekiah in, ‘ TOPA in eite hong hu ding hi,’ ci-a hong genna tawh kimakaih khialsak kei un. Assyria kumpipa khut panin minamte pasian khatpeuh in kua hu zo ngei ahi hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Hamath le Arpad pasiante koi-ah om hiam? Sepharvaim’ pasiante koi-ah om hiam? Amaute in ka khut panin Samaria suahtak zo ahi hiam?"},"20":{"text":"Hih gamte’ pasiante khempeuh kua in ka khut panin honkhia thei ahi hiam? Tua ahileh ka khut panin TOPA in Jerusalem bangci hut thei ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Ahi hangin mite dai khipkhep uh a, a dawnna bangmah a gen kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in, \"Dawng kei un,\" ci-in thu a pia hi.","ref":"Pn 9:7-8"},"22":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa inn ukpa Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, thuvanpipa Shebna, Asaph tapa thuciamtehpa Joah-te a puante uh balkeksa-in Hezekiah kiangah pai uh a galkap mangpipa thugen teng a ko uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:17-37; 2Kh 32:9-19"}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Hezekiah in hih thu a zak ciangin a puante balkek a ippi puan silhin TOPA biakinnpi ah a pai hi.","title":"Jerusalem Hut ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in kumpi inn ukpa Eliakim, thuvanpipa Shebna, le siampi makaite in a vekun ippi puan silhsa in Amoz tapa kamsangpa Isaiah kiangah a sawl hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Hezekiah in, ‘Tuni lungdon ni, tai thuak ni, mindai ni, nau suak ding tha nei lo-a a suakkhia zo lo bang i hi hi."},"4":{"text":"A pu Assyria kumpipa in a sawl galkap mangpa in a nungta Pasian a simmawhna kammalte TOPA note Pasian in za dinga, TOPA note Pasian in a zaksate hangin amah tai ding hi. Tua ahi ciangin a suakta a omlai sunte pana a baanglaite adingin thu ngen un,’ ci hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 7:8"},"5":{"text":"Isaiah kiangah kumpi Hezekiah uliante a tun uh ciangin amaute kiangah"},"6":{"text":"Isaiah in, \"Na pu uh kiangah, ‘ TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: Na zaksate uh hangin lau kei un - tua Assyria kumpipa kam a gensawnte in kei hong daisak ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Ngai un, amah in thuzaksaknate a zak ciangin a gamah ciah a tua lai-ah namsau-in ka satpuk nadingin a sungah kha khat ka guan hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 7:4"},"8":{"text":"Galkap mangpipa in Assyria kumpipa thu a zak khit ciangin Lachish nusia-in nung kik a, kumpipa in Lipnah a sim a mu hi.","ref":"Ms 33:20"},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Sennacherib in, Egypt kumpipa, Cush a mi Tirhakah amah sim dingin a kuanna thu a za hi. Hih thu a zak ciangin amah in Hezekiah tungah kamtai sawl a,"},"10":{"text":"\"Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kiangah: Na muanpa ‘Assyria kumpipa khut sungah Jerusalem kipia lo ding hi’ a ci na pasian in nang hong khem hi."},"11":{"text":"Hi takpi hi, Assyria kumpite in gam khempeuha a hihsa a suksiat kiuhkeuh lam na za khin hi. Tua ciangin TOPA biakinnpi ah paito in TOPA mai-ah a zal hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuateh Hezekiah in TOPA tungah thu ngen a:","title":"Hezekiah’ Thungetna"},"16":{"text":"\"Thahatpen Cherub-te kikala tu TOPA Israel Pasian aw, leitung kumpi gam khempeuh tungah nang bek Pasian na hi hi. Leitung le vantung na bawl khin hi."},"17":{"text":"TOPA aw, na bil hong ngat inla hong za in; TOPA aw, hak inla hong mu in; Sennacherib in a nungta Pasian a zahkona kammalte khempeuh za in."},"18":{"text":"\" TOPA aw, Assyria kumpite in amaute gam le a mite a siatsakna a maan ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in pasian ahi lo amau pasiante mihing khuta kibawl sing le suang hi lel ahi manin meikhuk ah pai-in a susia uh hi."},"20":{"text":"TOPA kote Pasian aw, tu-in leitunga kumpi-gam khempeuh in TOPA aw, nang bek Pasian b na hilam a theih nadingun ama khut panin hong hukhia in,\" a ci hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Amoz tapa Isaiah in Hezekiah tungah thu puaka: \"Hih in TOPA Israel-te Pasian gen ahi hi: Assyria kumpipa tawh kisai kei tungah thu nong ngetna hangin"},"22":{"text":"hih in ama tungah TOPA gensa kammal ahi hi: \"Zion Tanu Bit in nang hong simmawhin hong zahko hi. Jerusalem Tanu in na tai laitakin a lu hong peisan hi.","title":"Sennacherib Pukna"},"23":{"text":"Na zahko a na daisak kua ahi hiam? Tuateh nang in, ‘Ka sakolleng tampite-in asanna mualdawnte le Lebanon mualdawn kui ah ka kahto khin hi; a tamtak sangpente a takkung hoih pente ka phuk khin hi. Ka khepekte nuai tawh Egypt luite khempeuh ka keusak hi,’ na ci hi.","ref":"Tp 11:10"},"26":{"text":"\"Za nai lo na hi hiam? Sawtpi-a ka kipsaksa ahi hi. A tapa Esarhaddon in a kumpiza a luah hi."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Hezekiah a ci na in a si dektak hi. Kei hong itin siatna khuk panin nong kem hi; ka mawhnate khempeuh na nungngatsan hi.","ref":"Isa 43:25"},"18":{"text":"Ahang in, hankhuk a in nang hong phat thei lo a; sihna in nang hong phatna sa thei lo hi; tua kuakhuk sunga paisukte in na muanhuaina a lamen thei kei uh hi.","ref":"Thn 9:10; Ph 6:5; 88:10-11"},"19":{"text":"A nungtate, a nungtate - bek in tuni-a kei hih bangin amaute in nang hong phat thei uh hi; pate in amau tate tungah na muanhuaina a gen ding uh hi,","ref":"Tp 6:7; Ph 118:17"},"20":{"text":"TOPA in kei hong hon dinga, i nuntak laiteng TOPA biakinnpi sungah khausai tumtheihte in la i sa ding hi.","ref":"Ph 116:2"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin Isaiah in, \"Theinai su inla meimatum nuh lecin a dam ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Hezekiah in, \" TOPA biakinnpi-a ka paitoh nading bang lim hi ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong khin hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:31"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin Baladan tapa Babylon kumpipa Merodach Baladan in Hezekiah cinatna le a dam kikna za ahi manin lai a khak hi.","title":"Babylon pan Thupuak"},"2":{"text":"Hezekiah in thupuakte lungkimtakin na muaka a van koihna sunga a neih khempeuh - ngun, kham, gimnamtui, sathau manpha, a galvan khempeuh le a goute lakah a kimu thei peuhmah a lak hi. Hezekiah in kumpi innsung le a gam sungah amaute a lah loh bangmah a om kei hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:15; 2Kh 32:31"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpi Hezekiah kiangah kamsangpa Isaiah va pai-in, \"Tua mite koi panin hong pai hi a, bang gen uh ahi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Ahang in, amah in, \"Ka nuntak laiteng kilemna le ngaihmuanna a om ding hi,\" ci-in a ngaihsun hi.","ref":"2Ku 20:12-19; 2Kh 32:26"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hehnem un, ka mite hehnem un, note Pasian in hong ci hi.","title":"Pasian’ Mite Hehnepna","ref":"Isa 12:1; 49:13"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem tungah awnemin gen unla ama tungah tangko un. Tuateh, \"Bang kiko ding ka hiam?\" ka ci hi. \"Mi khempeuh lopa tawh kibang a, amau minthanna khempeuh gamlak pak tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Job 14:2"},"7":{"text":"TOPA huu in amaute mut ahi manin lopate vulin pakte a pulh hi. No Jerusalem d a thupha puakte aw, na aw uh sangsak unla awng un, sangsak un, lau kei un; Judah khuapite tungah, \"Note Pasian hiah om hi,\" ci un.","ref":"Isa 52:7-10, Ro 10:15; Isa 25:9"},"10":{"text":"En un, a Lianpen TOPA vanglian-in hong pai-a, a bante in ama adingin a uk hi. En un, a pahtakman hong kenga a lohkikna hong keng hi.","ref":"Kil 22:7"},"11":{"text":"Tuucingpa bangin a tuuhonte vaka, tuunote a ang sungah khawmin amaute dawm mahmah in pua dinga; a no neite damdamin a masuan hiathiat ding hi.","ref":"Eze 34:23; Mic 5:4; Ms 11:12; Tp 26:19; Pc 33:13"},"12":{"text":"Kua in a khutkuakin tuite teh a, vante a zapekin ciamteh ahi hiam? A kilok lo milim khat a phuhsak dingin khutsiam mi khat a zong hi.","ref":"1Sa 5:3"},"21":{"text":"Thei nai lo na hi uh hiam? Za nai lo na hi uh hiam? Atung-a kipan hong kigen lo ahi hiam? Leitung a kiphuh khit nungsang theitel pah lo na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Ph 19:1; Ro 1:19; Isa 48:13"},"22":{"text":"Amah leitung kimvel tungsana tupa hi a, leitunga mite kauphe tawh a kibang hi. Amah in vante, tungzakpuan bangin zala, ten nading puanbuk bangin a zal hi.","ref":"Ph 104:2; Job 22:14; Job 36:29"},"23":{"text":"Amah in kumpite bangmah lo suaksak a, hih leitung gam-ukte bangmah lo dongin a kiasak hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute a gina-in kisuan khinphet, amaute a gina-in kivawh khitphet, amau in lei sungah zung kha khinphetin amah in mutin vul uh a, ansi bangin pingpei in lenmang hi.","ref":"Isa 41:16"},"25":{"text":"\"Kei kua tawh hong teh ding na hi uh hiam? Amah gim loin tawl lo dinga ama theihtelna kuamah in a lamteh thei kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 90:2; Isa 37:16; Isa 44:12; Ph 147:5"},"29":{"text":"A gimte tha guana a thanemte’ vangliatna a khangsak hi."},"30":{"text":"Khangnote nangawn gimin tawl uh a, khanglaite muktu in a puk uh hi;","ref":"Isa 9:17; Jer 6:11; 9:21"},"31":{"text":"ahi hangin TOPA tungah lametna a neite a tha uh a dim kik ding hi. Minamte ama khutah apin ama mai-ah kumpite uksak hi. Amah in a namsau tawh amaute leivui suaksak a, a thalin huih muta leng buhvai a bangsak hi.","ref":"Ezr 1:2; Isa 45:1,13; 2Sa 22:43; Isa 40:24"},"3":{"text":"Amah in a khe uh tawh a pai nailohna uh munah amaute delh a, bangmah a ci kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A tunga kipanin a khangkhangin samkhia a, lam tawntunga a tonpih kua a hiam? A tungin amaute a ompih keimah TOPA ka hi a - a tawpna lah keimahmah ka hi hi.\""},"5":{"text":"Tuikulhte in mu khinin lau uh a; leimongte a ling uh hi. Amaute kei lam manawhin hong pai-in","ref":"Eze 26:17-18; Isa 11:12"},"6":{"text":"khat le khat kihuh ciat uh a, a sanggampa kiangah, \"Kihatsak in,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Jos 1:6"},"7":{"text":"Khutsiampa in kham seekpa hanthawn a, sek neu-a a nelsakpa in sekpi-a a hampi satpa a hanthawn hi. Sumtui luanpa in, \"Hoih hi,\" ci-a a kilok lo dingin siktukkilhin milim kilhcip hi.","ref":"Isa 40:19; 1Sa 5:3"},"8":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin nang ka nasem Israel aw, kong teelsa Jacob aw, ka lawmpa Abraham suante aw,","ref":"2Kh 20:7;Jas 2:23"},"9":{"text":"leimong panin note kong pikhia-a a gamlapen kiu panin kong sam hi. ‘Nang ka nasempa,’ kong ci-a nang hong teel khinin kong nolh kei hi.","ref":"Isa 11:12; Tp 7:6"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin lau kei un, note tawh ka omkhawm hi; Na tha uh hong dimsakin kong huh ding hi; note Pasian ka hi manin kilungneusak kei un. a thumaan ka taklam khutin kong len gige ding hi.","ref":"Isa 43:2,5; Ro 8:31; tg 13-14; Isa 44:2"},"11":{"text":"\"No tunga hehte khempeuh maizumin a zahlak taktak ding uh hi; no hong langneihte bangmah hi loin a mangthang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 45:24; Pk 23:22; Isa 29:8"},"12":{"text":"Na galte na zon hangin amaute na mu kei ding hi. Note langa galphuang nuamte bangmah lo bang hi ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahang in, keimah in TOPA note Pasian na khut taklamun hong lena note kiangah, Lau kei un, kong huh ding hi, hong cipa ka hi hi.","ref":"Isa 42:6; 45:1; tg 10"},"14":{"text":"Tangtel lel Jacob aw, aneu Israel aw, keimahmah in hong huh ding ka hi manin kihta kei in,\" note Tanpa, Israel-te Siangtho Pa, TOPA in a cikhia hi.","ref":"Pc 15:1; Job 4:19; Pk 15:13"},"15":{"text":"\"En un, note a thak a hiam, ha tampi a nei buhcilna-in kong bawl ding hi. Mual liante cilin na tuanvui ding uh a, mual neute buhvai na suah ding uh hi.","ref":"Mic 4:13; Pk 19:18"},"16":{"text":"Na haih ding uh a, amaute huihin lenin huihpi in a mutmang ding hi. Ahi hangin TOPA sungah note na lungnuam ding uh a, Israel-te Siangtho Pa sungah na minthang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 40:24; Isa 45:25"},"17":{"text":"\"Mizawngte le a tasamte in tui a zon uh hangin bangmah a om kei hi; a dang uh taka a leii uh a keu hi. Ahi hangin keimah TOPA in amaute ka dawng ding hi; keimah Israel-te Pasian in ka nusia kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 43:20; Isa 30:19; Tp 31:6"},"18":{"text":"Keugawtak lak mualsang ah gunte ka luangsak dinga, kuam sungah ciktui ka phulsak ding hi. Sehnel-gam bualtui ka suaksak dinga, leikeu, ciktui ka suaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:25; Isa 43:19; Isa 35:7"},"19":{"text":"Sehnel-gam ah tamtak, singkha, mui le olive-te ka posak ding hi. Gamtulte ah tak, hiangpa le taksan ka posak khawm ding hi;","ref":"Isa 35:1; Isa 60:13"},"20":{"text":"tua pen mihingte in TOPA khut in hih bawl khin a, Israel-te Siangtho Pa in a piansak ahi hi, ci-in mu a, ngaihsun thei in a theihtel nading uh ahi hi.","ref":"Ezr 7:6; 8:31; Job 12:9, Pk 6:7; Isa 29:24"},"21":{"text":"\" TOPA in, \"Na thu uh sung un,\" a ci hi. Jacob-te Kumpipa in, \"Na deihna uh puak un,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"\"Na milimte uh sungtum unla, bang piang ding hiam, hong gensak un. Kote in ngaihsun-a a tawpna ah a piang ding ka theih nadingun a beisa huna piangte hong gen uh hen. Ahikeh kote in nang pasiante na hilam"},"23":{"text":"ka theih nadingun a piang ding nate hong telgen unla mailama piang dingte hong gen uh hen. Kote lungneu a ka lau nadingun a sia a pha khat teitei bawl dih un.","ref":"Isa 46:10; Jn 13:19; Isa 42:9; 44:7-8; 45:3; Jer 10:5"},"24":{"text":"Note, bangmah ahi lote nuai-a na hi manun na nasepte un kimanna a nei peuhmah kei hi; note hong teelte a kihhuai uh hi.","ref":"Ph 115:8"},"25":{"text":"\"Leilu panin mi khat ka kithawisaka hong kuan zo hi - kei min lo in nisuahtohna panin khat hong kuan hi. Amah in leisan le leikang pawi bangin gam-ukte cilzan dinga, beelseekpa in buan a cil bangin a cil ding hi.","ref":"2Sa 22:43"},"26":{"text":"Ka theih nadingun a tungin kua in hong gen a, ahikeh ‘Amah thumaan hi’ ka cih theih nadingun kua in hong magen hiam? Hih thu kuamah in gen lo, kuamah in magen lo, no kiang panin kuamah in kam khat beek a za kei hi.","ref":"Hab 2:18-19"},"27":{"text":"Zion tungah a gen masapen keimah ka hi a, ‘En in, hih lai-ah amaute a om hi,’ ka ci hi. Jerusalem a thu hoih a puak kamtaipa ka pia hi.","ref":"Isa 40:9 ; Isa 40:9"},"28":{"text":"Ka et hangin khat beek om lo a - amaute lakah ka thu hong kuppih ding khatbeek om loin, amaute lakah ka dot cianga hong dawng ding khatbeek a om kei hi.","ref":"Isa 40:9"},"29":{"text":"En in, a vekpi un a khial khin uh hi! Amaute in bangmah ahi lo na tampi a sem uh hi; a milim sunte uh huih le buaina bek ahi hi.","ref":"tg 24; Jer 5:13"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Hih lai-ah ka letkip, ka lungkimna, ka telsa ka nasempa a om hi. Ama tungah ka Kha ka koih dinga, amah in minamte tungah thutang a puak ding hi.","title":"’ Nasempa","ref":"Isa 20:3, Isa 43:10; 1Pe 2:4,6; Pc 49:10; Isa 9:7"},"2":{"text":"Amah in lamlian dungah a aw sangsakin awng lo, kiko lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"A kisat liamsa pumpeng kuaitan loin, a tang kiukiau meivakkhau a mutmit kei ding hi. Muanhuaina tawh thutang a pusuah khia ding hi;","ref":"Isa 36:6; Ph 72:2; 96:13"},"4":{"text":"Leitungah thutang a kipsak khit mateng ngaklah loin a lungkia kei ding hi; tuikulhte in ama thukham a lamen ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 2:4"},"5":{"text":"Vante piangsakin tuate a zalpa, leitung phah a, a sung pana piangkhia khempeuh a piangsakpa leitung mite tungah huu a guanpa le a tunga lampai khempeuh nuntakna a piapa - Pasian TOPA in:","ref":"Ph 24:2"},"6":{"text":"\"Keimah TOPA in thumaanna tawh nang kong sam khin hi; na khut ka lenkip ding hi. Nang hong kemin mite adingin thukhun Gentile-te adingin khuavak kong suaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 43:1; Isa 26:3, 49:8"},"7":{"text":"Mittawte mit honsak ding, thong sung pan le thong hawmpi sunga khuamial laka tute a khahkhia ding na hi hi.","ref":"Ph 107:10,14"},"8":{"text":"\"Keimah TOPA ka hi hi; tua in ka min ahi hi! Ka minthanna midang khat tungah ahikeh hong kiphatna milimte tungah ka pia kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 3:15; Isa 48:11; Pk 8:10"},"9":{"text":"En in, a ma-a nate piang khin a, a thak nate kong genkhia hi; amaute mihingin a pian ma-un note tungah kong zasak khin hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 41:22"},"10":{"text":"Tuipi sunga paisukte le tuipi sunga omte, no tuikulhte le a sunga tengte khempeuh aw, leimongte panin amah phat unla, lathak khat TOPA sak un.","ref":"Isa 11:11; Isa 49:6","title":"Phatna La"},"11":{"text":"Sehnel-gam le a khuapite, Kedar mite tenna-a tengte lungdamin a aw uh sangkhaisak un. Sela mite lungdamin lasa uh henla; mual liante dawn panin awngsak un.","ref":"Isa 32:16; Isa 52:7"},"12":{"text":"TOPA minthanna amaute gensak unla tuikulhte ah amah phatna tangkosak un.","ref":"Ph 26:7; 66:2"},"13":{"text":"Mi thahatpa bangin TOPA kuankhia a, galhangpa bangin deihluatna sosak dinga; galphawnna aw khatvei kiko in a galte a zo khin ding hi.","ref":"Isa 9:6; Isa 26:11; Hos 11:10; Isa 66:14"},"14":{"text":"Sawtveipi ka dai khikhe khin a; kei le kei kidek tentanin ka kidaisak hi. Ahi hangin tu-in numei nausuak bangin kiko khia-in ka tungnak hathat hi.","ref":"Ph 50:21; Pc 43:31"},"15":{"text":"Mualliante le mualneute ka mangthangsak dinga anteh-sawlbawk khempeuh ka keucipsak ding hi; gunte tuikulh ka suaksak dinga, bualte ka keucipsak ding hi.","ref":"Eze 38:20; Isa 50:2"},"16":{"text":"Keimah in mittawte a theih ngei lohna munah ka pi dinga, a tawt nai lohna lampi ah lam ka hilh ding hi; amaute mai-ah khuamial khuavak ka suaksak dinga, aham lampite ka nelsak ding hi. Ka sep ding nate hihte ahi hi; amaute ka nusia kei ding hi.","ref":"Lk 3:5"},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin milimte a muangte, milim tungah, \"Nang kote pasian na hi hi,\" a cite, kilehkiksakin a maizum mahmah ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 97:7;Isa 1:29; 44:11"},"18":{"text":"\"No bilngongte aw za un; no mittawte aw en unla mu un!","ref":"Isa 35:5","title":"Mittaw a Bilngong Israel"},"19":{"text":"Ka nasempa lo kua mittaw a, kamtai-a ka sawlpa bangin kua bilngong ahi hiam? Kei tunga hong kiciampa bangin kua mittaw a, TOPA ’ nasempa bangin kua mit taw ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 44:26; Isa 26:3"},"20":{"text":"Na tampitak na muh khit hangin na thusim kei hi; Na bilte vak napi bangmah na za kei hi,\"","ref":"Jer 6:10"},"21":{"text":"Ama thumaanna khualna-in a thukham liansaka minthansak ding TOPA lungkimna hi.","ref":"tg 4; 2Co 3:7"},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin hih mite a kibuluh neihsa a kisutte hi uh a, amaute khempeuh duma thang kisiah ahikeh thong sunga kiselte ahi uh hi.
