Amaute a hu ding a om lo a kiluhgawpte suak uh a, kuamah in, ‘Hong khak kik un,’ a cih loh van kisutte a suak uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:13"},"23":{"text":"Mailam hunah hih thu a ngai ding ahikeh a thusim cinten ding kua na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Isa 48:18"},"24":{"text":"Kua in suhgawp dingin Jacob pia a, a buluhte tungah Israel pia ahi hiam? A tunga i mawhnapa TOPA hi lo ahi hiam? Ahang in, amaute in a lampi zui lo uh a; a thukham a mang kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 30:15"},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amaute tungah a hehna kuanglai le a gal ngongtat a sungkhia hi. Meikuang in tuamcip napi amaute in a theitel kei uh hi; amaute kang napi ngaihsutin a nei kei uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 22:13; 2Ku 25:9"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahi hangin, tu-in hih in TOPA gen ahi hi - Jacob aw, note hong piangsak amah hi a, Israel aw, note hong bawl amah hi: \"Note hong tankhin ka hi manin lau kei un; na minun kong sam khin a; note kei aa na hi uh hi.","title":"Israel-te’ Honpa Bek","ref":"Isa 44:21; Isa 44:2,6"},"2":{"text":"Tui na ngahtan uh ciangin no tawh ka om dinga; gunte na ngahtan uh ciangin hong tai kei ding hi; meikuang lak kantanin na pai uh ciangin hong hul kei ding hi; meikuang in nang hong kang kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 8:7; Tp 31:6,8; Isa 29:6; 30:27; Ph 66:12; Da 3:25-27"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, keimah in TOPA note Pasian Israel Siangtho Pa note Honpa ka hi hi; nangmah tatna-in Egypt ka pia a, nang tangin Cush a le Seba ka pia hi.","ref":"Ph 3:8; Isa 41:20; Pn 21:18; Isa 20:3"},"4":{"text":"Ka muhna ah manpha in kong pahtawi nungsang le nang kong itna hangin nang khekna-in mite ka pia dinga, na nuntakna khekna-in mihingte ka pia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Hong ompih ka hi manin lau kei in; nisuahna panin na tate kong puak dinga, nitumna panin nang kong kaikhawm ding hi.","ref":"Isa 44:2; Jer 30: 10-11; Isa 41:8; Isa 24:14; Zec 8:7"},"6":{"text":"Leilu-lam kiangah, ‘Amaute piakhia un,’ ci in, leitaw-lam kiangah, ‘Amaute lehkaih kei un,’ ka ci ding hi. Gamlapi panin ka tapate, leimongte panin ka tanute -","ref":"Ph 107:3"},"7":{"text":"ka minthan nadinga ka piansakte, sutuah a ka bawlte, ka mina kilote peuhmah hong puak un,’ ka ci ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:5; Jas 2:7"},"8":{"text":"Mit nei napi mittawte, bil nei napi bengngongte pikhia un.","ref":"Isa 6:9-10"},"9":{"text":"Minam khempeuh kikaikhawm in, mite kikhawm hi; amaute kua pen in hih thu genkhol a, a piangsa nate hong tangko ahi hiam? Midangte in za uh a, \"Hih thu man hi,\" a cih theih nadingun, amaute a man a hilam uh a lak dingin teci kipuaksak un.","ref":"Isa 41:26"},"10":{"text":"\"Note ka teci na hi uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia a, \"kei in amah ka hilam thei-in um a nong theihtel nadingun kong teelsa ka nasempa na hi hi. Kei om ma-in Pasian kibawl lo a, kei om khitin zong khat beek a om tuan kei hi.","ref":"Pk 6:7; Isa 41:8-9; Tp 4:35; Jer 14:22"},"11":{"text":"Kei, keimah TOPA longal honpa dang a om kei hi.","ref":"Isa 45:21"},"12":{"text":"Keimah kong kilaaka, kong honkhia-a, kong tangko khin hi, note lakah kei bek ka om a, gamdang pasiante a om kei hi. Keimah Pasian ka hilam note ka teci na hi uh hi,\" TOPA in a cikhia hi.","ref":"Tp 32:12; Ph 81:9; Isa 44:8"},"13":{"text":"Hi hi, tangtawnga kipan kei amah ka hi hi. Ka khut panin kuamah in a hukhia thei kei hi. Na ka sep ciangin kua in hong phelkik thei ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 90:2; Isa 14:27"},"14":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi - note hong Tanpa, Israel-te Siangtho Pa in: \"Note tangin Babylon ah ka paisak dinga Babylon mite a khempeuh amaute kisaktheihpih a tembawte un ka taimangsak ding hi.","title":"Pasian Lainatna le Israel Muanhuailohna","ref":"Pk 15:13"},"15":{"text":"Keimah TOPA , note Siangtho Pa, Israel a Piangsakpa, note kumpipa ka hi hi,\" a ci hi."},"16":{"text":"TOPA cih hih ahi hi - amah tuipi kantana lampi sialpa, tuihat kantana lampi bawlpa,","ref":"Isa 51:10"},"17":{"text":"sakolte le sakollengte, galkapte le kihutnate khempeuh nawhkhia a, a tho kik nawn lo dingin tua lai- ah a lumsak, meivak khau sukmit banga sumitpa:","ref":"Ph 118:12; Isa 1:31, Pk 14:9; Job 13:25"},"18":{"text":"\"A tungsa nate mangngilh un, a beisate tungah na lungsim uh tengsak kei un."},"19":{"text":"En un, na a thak ka bawlbawl ta hi; tu-in a mengkhia ta hi phawk lo na hi uh hiam? Sehnel-gam ah lampi ka sial dinga gamtul ah luite ka luangsak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 17:6; Ms 20:11; Ph 126:4"},"20":{"text":"Gamsate - ngiate le kala-oh vasate in kei hong pahtawi ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh sehnel-gam ah tui ka pia a, gamtul ah luite luangsakin,","ref":"Isa 48:21"},"21":{"text":"tua pen kei mahmah in ka bawlsa, ka teelsa ka mite in kei phatna a tangko theih nadingun amaute dawn dinga ka piak ahi hi.","ref":"Mal 3:17; Ph 102:18; 1Pe 2:9"},"22":{"text":"Tua hi napi Jacob aw, note in kei nong sam kei uh a, Israel aw, kei adingin no le no na kigimsak kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 30:11"},"23":{"text":"Meihal biakna dingin tuu nong puak kei uh a, na kithoihnate uh tawh nong pahtawi kei uh hi. An-a biakna-in vangik kong suan kei a, gimnamtui hong ngenin kong kicimtaksak kei hi.","ref":"Am 5:25; Zec 7:5-6"},"24":{"text":"Kei adingin kawltu namtui khatpeuh nong leisak kei a, na biakna sathaute in nong taisak nai kei hi. Ahi hangin na mawhnate-un vangik nong suan uh a, na tatkhialhnate-un nong gimsak uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:14; Mal 2:17"},"25":{"text":"Kei mahmah ka kikhualna-in na thupalsatnate uh hong paihsak keimah, kei mahmah in na mawhnate uh ka ciamteh nawn kei hi.","ref":"Ns 3:19; Eze 36:22; Jer 31:34"},"26":{"text":"A beisa thu kei adingin en kik dih un, thu kikumkhawm dih ni, mawhpeng na hihna thu sung dih in.","ref":"Isa 1:18; Isa 41:1;50:8"},"27":{"text":"Na pa masa pen uh mawh a; na thu sungte un kei hong lehdo uh hi.","ref":"Isa 9:15; 28:7"},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na biakinnpi ua thuneipite ka mindaisak dinga Jacob tungah siatna b tungsakin, Israel ka zahlak sak ding hi.","ref":"Jer 24:9"}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin ka nasempa Jacob aw, ka teelsa Israel aw, tu-in ngai in.","title":"Teelsa Israel","ref":"Jer 30:10"},"2":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi - naubu sungah hong sutuah in hong bawla hong huh dingpa in: Ka nasempa Jacob aw, ka teelsa Jeshurun aw, lau kei un.","ref":"Ph 139:13;149:2; Tp 32:15"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, leigawtak tungah tui ka sung dinga, leikeu tungah lui ka luangsak ding hi; nangma suante tungah ka Kha ka sung dinga, na tu na tate uh tungah thupha ka pia ding hi.","ref":"Joel 3:18; Isa 32:2; Joel 2:28; Isa 61:9; 65:23"},"4":{"text":"Amaute lonona-a lopate bangin - selkhia ding uh a, luiluang gei-a po gialheek kung a bang ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 23:40; Job 40:22"},"5":{"text":"Khat in, ‘ TOPA aa ka hi hi,’ ci dinga, adang khat amah le amah Jacob minin a kisam ding hi; adang khat lai in a khut tungah, ‘ TOPA aa’ ci-in gelh dinga Israel min a kiphuah ding hi.","ref":"Ph 116:16"},"6":{"text":"TOPA cih hih ahi hi - Israel-te Kumpipa le Tanpa, Thahatpen TOPA in: Keimah a masapen le keimah a nunungpen ka hi hi; Keimah longal Pasian dang a om kei hi.","title":"Milimte hilo","ref":"Tp 6:4; 1Kh 17:20"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahileh kei tawh kibang kua ahi hiam? Amah kigenkhiasak un. Amah kipulaksak unla ka mai-ah hong koihkhia un; tanglai-a ka mite ka kipsak nungsangin bang piang khin a, bang piang lai ding ahi hiam, genkholhsak un.","ref":"Isa 41:22,26"},"8":{"text":"Ling kei un, kihta kei un. Hih thu sawtpi-in genkhol khin hi lo ka hi hiam? Note ka teci na hi uh hi. Kei lo Pasian dang om ahi hiam? Om lo hi, Suangpi dang a om kei hi; khat beek ka thei kei hi,\"","ref":"Tp 4:35"},"9":{"text":"Milim bawlte khempeuh bangmah hi lo uh a, a khol uh goute in man a nei kei hi. Tuate adinga kampaute mittaw hi a; amau maizumna a thei lo uh ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 41:24; Isa 1:29; "},"10":{"text":"Amah bangmah a lawhtaksak lo pasian lim bawlin milim sung kua ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 41:29; Jer 10:5"},"11":{"text":"Amah a pawlpihte le amah kimaizumsak dinga; milim bawl khutsiamte lah mihing lel mah ahi uh hi. Amaute a vekpi un kikaikhawmsak unla panmun lasak un; amaute kibing phawnin kilausak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:29"},"12":{"text":"Sikseekpa in a na zatte khat la a, mei-am lakah a khul hi; sekin lim khat seeka a khut hatna-in a seek hi. Amah a gil kialin a tha zaw hi; tui dawn loin a bah hi.","ref":"Ns 17:29; Isa 40:28"},"13":{"text":"Sing sep siampa in khau-in teh a, a bawlzia ding ciamteh hi; singnawtna-in nawtngil a, compass-te in a teh hi. Mihing limin geel a, biakbukno a koih dingin mihing minthanna khempeuh a kimin a bawl hi.","ref":"Isa 41:7; Ph 115:4-7"},"14":{"text":"Amah in tamtak ahikeh siasing ahikeh tawsaw phukin a lak hi kha ding hi. Amah in gammang singte lakah khangsakin ahikeh taksing suana, guahtui in a khangsak hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua in mihingte singcih ding hi a; amah in pawlkhat la in mei-a awi dingin zanga, mei tawhin anlum a emna hi. Ahi hangin pasian dingin khat zemin a bia hi; milim khatin bawla a mai-ah a kun hi.","ref":"2Kh 25:14"},"16":{"text":"A singte alang mei-in cih a; a tungah a an ding huanin, sa haangkeu in a khamtakin a ne hi. Amahmah in mei awi a, \"Ah! Ka khua lum tah ei; mei mu ta’ng ei!\" a ci hi."},"17":{"text":"A omlaite ama pasian dingin milim khatin bawl a; a mai-ah kunin a bia hi. Tua milim tungah thu ngena, \"Nang ka pasian na hi hi; hong hon in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1ku 18:26"},"18":{"text":"Amaute in bangmah thei lo uh a; bangmah a theitel kei uh hi; khua muh theih loh nadingin a mitte uh kibelh a, a theihtel theih loh nadingun a lungsim uh kikhaksak hi."},"19":{"text":"Khat beekin ngaihsun lo uh a, khat beek in, \"Alang mei-in ka cih khin a; a am tung nangawn ah anlum ka em a, sa hangkeu-in ka ne khin hi; a val laite-in a kihhuaina bawl ding ka hi hiam? Singbek khat mai-ah kun buang ding ka hi hiam?\" cih nading theihna le theihtelna nei buang lo uh ahi hiam?","ref":"Tp 27:15"},"20":{"text":"Amah vut-in kivaka, a lungsim khemna in amah makaih khial a; amah le amah kihon thei loin, \"Ka taklam khut sunga na zuaupi hi lo hiam?\" zong a ci thei kei hi.","ref":"Isa 59:3-4,13"},"21":{"text":"\"Israel aw, ka nasempa na hi manin, Jacob aw, hih nate ciamteh in; nang kong bawl khin a, ka nasempa na hi hi; Israel aw, nang kong mangngilh kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 46:8; Zec 10:9; tg 1-2; Isa 49:15"},"22":{"text":"Keimah in thupalsatnate meii bangin ka phiatmang khin a, na mawhnate zingsang meiilum bangin ka thengsak zo hi. Nang kong tankhia khin hi, hong ciah ta in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 55:7"},"23":{"text":"Hih in TOPA sepsa ahi manin vante aw lungdamin la sa un; nuai-a lei aw, nakpi in kiko in. No mualliante, no tulak le singkungte khempeuh aw, TOPA in Jacob tankhia khin a, Israel sungah amah kiminthangsak khin ahi manin la sakhia zuah un.","ref":"Ph 148:7; Isa 61:3; Ph 98:8"},"24":{"text":"\" TOPA gen hih ahi hi - naubu sungah nang hong sutuah nangma Tanpa in: Keimah TOPA , na khempeuh a bawlpa, amah kia-a vantungte a phahpa, kei guaka leitung a zalhkhiapa,","title":"Jerusalem ah Mi Teng Ding","ref":"Isa 42:5"},"25":{"text":"kamsang zuaute’ limte tangtungsak loin ai sante mihai a suaksakpa, mipilte theihna lawnthalin bangmah lo a suaksakpa,","ref":"Ph 33:10; 1Co 1:27"},"26":{"text":"a nasemte kammalte semkhia in, a kamtaite thugente a tangtungsakpa, Jerusalem tungah ‘Mi hong teng ding hi’ ci a, Judah khuapite tungah, ‘Amaute kilam ta ding hi,’ ci a, tuateh tua a siasate, ‘A ngei ka bangsak ding hi,’ a cipa,","ref":"Zec 1:6; Isa 55:1; Isa 49:8-21"},"27":{"text":"tuithukte tungah, ‘Keu in, na luite ka kangsak ding hi,’ a cipa,","ref":"Isa 11:15"},"28":{"text":"Cyrus tungah, ‘Amah ka tuucingpa hi a, ka lungkimna khempeuh kimsakin, Jerusalem tungah, \"Kilam kik in,\" ci a, biakinnpi tungah, \"Na bulpi kiphut ding hi,\" a cipa ka hi hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:22"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in ama mai ah minamte nuaisiaha kumpite a gal van uh a hawkkhia ding le kongpite a kikhak loh nadingin ama mai ah kongkhakte a hong dinga a taklam khut ka let, a sathau nilhpa Cyrus tunga TOPA in a gen ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 73:23"},"2":{"text":"Na mai-ah ka pai dinga, mualliante a maihtamin sumngo kongpite ka sutan dinga a kalhna sikzawlte ka attan ding hi.","ref":"Pk 23:20; Isa 40:4"},"3":{"text":"Note mina hong sam TOPA Israel-te Pasian keimah ka hilam na theih nadingun khuamialna goute le mun simthama kikhol hauhnate nang kong pia ding hi.","ref":"Jer 50:37; Jer 41:23"},"4":{"text":"Ka nasempa Jacob, ka teelsa Israel ka cihna-in na minun kong sama, nong theih loh uh hangin pahtawina za min note kong pia hi.","ref":"Isa 41:8-9; Ns 17:23"},"5":{"text":"Keimah TOPA ka hi-a, adang kuamah a om kei hi; keimah longal Pasian dang a om kei hi. Nang nong theih loh hang in, kong thakhauhsak ding hi,","ref":"Isa 44:8; Ph 18:31; Ph 18:39"},"6":{"text":"tua pen nisuahna pan nitumna mun dong mite in kei longal adang kuamah a om loh lam a theih nading uh ahi hi. Keimah TOPA ka hi-a, adang a om kei hi.","ref":"Isa 11:9"},"7":{"text":"Khuavak ka bawla, khuamial ka piangsak hi, ka daupaisak a, tuahsiatna ka piangsak hi; hihte khempeuh keimah TOPA hih ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 31:2; Am 3:6"},"8":{"text":"\"Tunglam a vante aw, thumaanna zusak un; meiite buaksuksak un. Leitung zapi-in kihong henla, hotkhiatna phultosakin thumaanna tawh pokhawm hen; keimah TOPA in ka piansak ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"\"Amah a Bawlpa tawh a kitawngpa tung, leituala leibeel themte laka leibeel them khat tungah gimna tung ta hen. Tungman in beelseekpa tungah, ‘Nang bang bawl na hi hiam?’ ci thei ahi hiam? Na nasep in, ‘Amah in khut a nei kei hi,’ ci thei ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Job 15:25"},"10":{"text":"A pa tungah, ‘Nang bang ta nei na hi hiam,’ ahikeh a nu kiangah, ‘Nang bang hingkhia na hi hiam?’ a cipa in gimna thuak ta hen."},"11":{"text":"\" TOPA gen hih ahi hi - Israel-te Siangtho Pa amah Bawlpa in: Hong tung ding nate tawh kisai-in, ka tate thu tawh kisai ahikeh ka khuta ka sepsate hong dong na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Isa 1:4; 51:13"},"12":{"text":"Leitung a piangsakpa keimah ka hi a, a tunga mihing a piangsakpa keimah ka hi hi. Keima khutin vantungte ka zalkhia a, amau aksi honpite ka gual hi.","ref":"Pc 2:1; Isa 42:5; Ne 9:6"},"13":{"text":"Ka thumaanna-in Cyrus b ka khangsak dinga: a lampite khempeuh ka tangsak ding hi. Ka khuapi a lampha dinga ka saltangte a khah ding hi; ahi hangin tua pen thaman ading ahikeh pahtakman hi lo ding hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in ci hi,\"","ref":"Isa 41:2; Ph 26:12; Isa 40:4"},"14":{"text":"TOPA gen hih a hi hi: Egypt gama na piangte, Cush c a sumbuk vante le Sabean mi tunsangte - na kiangah hong pai ding uh a, nang aa ahi ding uh hi. Amaute in nang hong nungzuih ding uh a, sikkhau khihsa-in nang kiang hong zuan ding uh hi. Amaute na mai-ah kun ding uh a, hong thumin, ‘Nang tawh Pasian om takpi a, adang a om kei hi; pasian dang a om kei hi’ ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 14:1-2"},"15":{"text":"Israel-te Honpa le Pasian aw, amah le amah a kisel a man Pasian nangmah na hi hi.","ref":"Ph 44:24"},"16":{"text":"Milim bawlte khempeuh kizumsak, kizahlaksak ding hi; amaute zahlakin a paikhia khawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 44:9,11"},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in tawntung hotkhiatna-in Israel a honkhia ding hi; khang tawntungin note hong kimaizumsak, hong kizahlaksak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Ro 11:26; Pc 30:23"},"18":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA cih hih ahi hi - Vante a piangsakpa amah Pasian ahi hi; amah in leitung zemin bawla kipsak hi; a hawma om dingin piangsak lo a, mihing ten nadingin a sutuah hi - Amah in: \"Keimah TOPA ka hi a, adang a om kei hi.","ref":"Pc 1:2; Pc 1:26; Isa 42:5; tg 5"},"19":{"text":"Keimah in khuamialna mun khatpeuh panin a simthamin thu ka gen kei a; Jacob suante tungah, ‘A mawkna-in kei hong zong un,’ ka ci kei hi. keimah TOPA in thutak ka gen hi; thumaan bek ka genkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 41:8; 2Kh 15:2"},"20":{"text":"\"No minamte pana a taimangte aw, kikaikhawmin kigawm unla hong pai un. A hon thei lo pasiante tungah thu ngen a, sing milim a pua kawikawite bangmah a thei lo uh ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 46:6-7"},"21":{"text":"Bang piang ding hiam genkhia-in thu sung un - amaute kikumkhawmsak un. hih thu sawt pekin kua in genkhol a, hun beisa lai-in kua in genkhia ahi hiam? a genkhia keimah TOPA hi lo ka hi hiam? Keimah Pasian longal a thumaan Pasian le Honpa dang kuamah a om kei hi; kuamah om lo hi, keimah ka hi hi.","ref":"tg 5; Ph 46:10"},"22":{"text":"\"No leimongte a omte khempeuh aw, keimah longal Pasian dang om lo ahi manin kei lamah kihei-in kihonkhia un.","ref":"Hos 13:4"},"23":{"text":"Kei mahmahin keimah ka kiciam khina, a kidokkik nawn lo ding kammal khat cihtakna tawh ka kamin ka genkhia khin hi: Keima mai-ah khuk khempeuh khukdin dinga, kei tungah lei peuhmah a kiciam ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 22:16; Isa 55:11; Heb 6:13; Ro 14:11*; Php 2:10-11"},"24":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘ TOPA sung bekah thumaanna le thahatna om hi’ hong ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi. Ama langa a heh khempeuh ama kiangah pai ding uh a, a kimaizumsak ding hi. Isa 41:11","ref":"Jer 33:16"},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA sunga om Israel suante khempeuh lakah thumaan kimu dinga a ki-angtangsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:16"}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bel kunsuk a, Nebo a kulsuk hi; amau milimte vangik a pua ganhingte in a pua hi. A kipua milimte vangik mahmah a, a gimte’ vangik a suak hi.","title":"Babylon’ Pasiante","ref":"Isa 21:9; Jer 50:2; 1Sa 5:2"},"2":{"text":"Amaute kulsukin kunsuk uh a amau le amau kivanzangsak thei loin galmat a suak dingin a paikhia uh hi.","ref":"Thk 18:17-18"},"3":{"text":"\"No Jacob innkuante, hong kipaii a kipan kong don a, na suahua kipan kong puak no a omlai Israel innkuante khempeuh aw, ka thu ngai un.","ref":"tg 12; Isa 48:12; Ph 22:10; Isa 1:9"},"4":{"text":"Tekin na sam kan dong nangawn keimah in amah ka hi a, nang hong pom dingpa ka hi hi. Nang kong bawl khina kong pua ding hi; hong pomin kong hu ding hi.","ref":"Ph 71:18; Isa 43:13; Ph 18:35"},"5":{"text":"\"Nang in kei kua tawh hong tehin ahikeh a kikimin hong seh na hi hiam? Nong tehkak theih dingin kua tawh a kibangin hong seh na hi hiam?","ref":"Isa 40:18,25"},"6":{"text":"Pawlkhatte in ipte sung pan kham sungkhia-in a tehna ah ngun teh uh a, kham seekpa cialin pasianin bawlsak uh a, a mai-ah kunin a bia uh hi.","ref":"Isa 40:19; Isa 44:17"},"7":{"text":"A liangko-uah kisuanto-in pua uh hi; a omna munah koih uh a tua lai-ah a kitung hi. Tua mun panin a tangkhia thei kei hi. Khatpeuh in a sap hangin tua in dawng lo a; a haksatna panin a hon thei kei hi.","ref":"tg 1; 1Ku 18:26; Isa 44:17; 45:20"},"8":{"text":"\"No a lehdote aw hih thu ciamteh un, na lungsimuah belhsak unla na lungtanguah giaksak un."},"9":{"text":"Sawtpek lai-a a piangsa nate phawk un; keimah Pasian ka hi a, adang a om kei hi; keimah Pasian ka hi a, kei tawh kibang khat beek a om kei hi.","ref":"Tp 32:7; Isa 45:5,21"},"10":{"text":"A kipat cil pan a tawpna dong ka gen khola, tanglai huna kipan hong tung lai dingte ka genkhol hi. Keimah in: Ka ngimna kip dinga, ka lungkimna khempeuh ka sem ding hi, ka ci hi.","ref":"Isa 45:21"},"11":{"text":"Nisuahna panin sasial ne vasa khat ka sam a, a gamlapi panin ka ngimna a tangtungsak ding mi khat ka sam hi. Ka gen khitsa ka piangkhiasak dinga; ka ngimsa ka sem ding hi.","ref":"Isa 25:1; Jer 44:28"},"12":{"text":"No lungsim khauhte thumaanna tawh kigamlate aw, ka thugen ngai un.","ref":"Jer 2:5; tg 3"},"13":{"text":"Ka thumaanna note kiang nai-ah kong puak hi, gamlapi-ah a om kei hi; ka hotkhiatna a ziakai nawn kei ding hi. Hotkhiatna Zion tungah, ka thupina Israel tungah ka pia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 85:9; Isa 44:23"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon Tanu Bit aw, tuaksukin leivui lakah tu in; Babylon mite a tanu aw, tutphah loin leitual ah tu in. Nang a moi ahikeh a ngeek hong kici nawn lo ding hi.","title":"Babylon Pukna","ref":"Isa 23:12; Jer 51:33; Tp 28:56"},"2":{"text":"Angawina suangin an nel gawi in, na lukhuhna lakhia in. Na nik singten inla na khe guakin luite ngaptan in.","ref":"Pk 11:5; Mt 24:41; Pc 24:65; Isa 32:11"},"3":{"text":"Guaktang na hina kipholak dinga, na maizumna kidawk ding hi. Keimah in phu ka la dinga; khat beek ka hawi kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Eze 16:37; Na 3:5; Isa 34:8"},"4":{"text":"Eite’ Tanpa - ama min Thahatpen TOPA - Israel-te Siangtho Pa ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"\"Babylon mite Tanu aw, khuamial lakah pai-in pau loin tu in; nang, kumpi-gamte’ kumpinu hong kici nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:10; Isa 13:19"},"6":{"text":"Ka mite tungah ka heh a, ka gouluah ka ninsak hi; amaute na khut sungah kong pia-a, nang lainatna na lak kei hi. A khanghamte tung nangawn ah hakkol gik mahmah na suan hi.","ref":"Tp 13:15; Isa 14:6"},"7":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Tawntung kumpinu ka hi hi! - ka zom tawntung ding hi’na ci hi. Ahi hangin hih nate ngaihsun loin nang tunga hong tu kik ding zong na ngaihsun kei hi.","ref":"tg 5; Tp 32:29; Isa 42:23,25"},"8":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin no awlmawh a nei lo nuamtaka tu hithiat ganhingte, ‘Kei bek ka hi hi, kei lo kuamah om kei, ka meigong ngei kei dinga, ka tate ka sihsuah kei ding hi’ a ci note in ngai un.","ref":"Isa 45:6; Zep 2:15; Kil 18:7"},"9":{"text":"Hihte gel - tate sihsuahna le meigonna in thakhat thu ni khat sungin no tungah hong tung ding hi. Na aisan siamna le na mibum siamna tampi tangin tuate nang tungah a cingtakin hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:18; 1Th 5:3; Kil 18:8-10; Na 3:4"},"10":{"text":"Na gitlohna muangin, ‘Kuamah in hong mu kenteh’ na ci hi. ‘Kei bek ka hi hi, kei lo kuamah om kei’ na cih ciangin na pilna le na theihna in hong makaih khial hi.","ref":"Ph 52:7; 62:10; Isa 29:15; Isa 5:21; 44:20"},"11":{"text":"Siatna lianpi no tungah hong tung dinga, bangci beisak ding cih na thei kei ding uh hi. Na tungah tuahsiatna hong tung dinga, tat nading man na piak hangin na mangsak thei kei ding hi; theihkholh lohin dongpi na tuakvat ding hi.","ref":"1Th 5:3"},"12":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin na neu tunga kipan na sep, mibumna le aisannate ah kipin om den in. Na tangtun kha thei dinga na lausak kha thei ding hi.","ref":"tg 9; Pk 7:11"},"13":{"text":"Nang hong kikuppihnate khempeuh in nang hong patgawpsak ding hi! Na aksi-ensiamte le kha simin aksi enzui-a thu magente, na tunga hong tung gimnate panin kihonkhiasak in.","ref":"Isa 57:10;Jer 51:58; Isa 44:25"},"14":{"text":"Amaute buh bulsum bang takpi uh a, mei in kangtum ding hi. Amau le amau nangawn meikatna panin a kihon thei kei ding uh hi. Khatpeuh khualum nadingin hih lai-ah meihol om lo a, awi dingin mei a om kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Na neu tunga kipan na sum zonpih na nasep khawmpihte in hong seppih theih tua ciang bek ahi hi. Amaute amau khialhna ciatin pai uh hi; nang hong hon thei ding khat beek a om kei uh hi.","ref":"Kil 18:11; tg 13; Isa 44:17"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No Jacob inkuan, Israel mina kilo, Judah suan pana piangte - TOPA minin tomlo a, Israel Pasian min lo napi thumaan thutaka ding lote -","title":"A Lungkhauh Israel","ref":"Pc 17:5; Isa 58:2; Jer 4:2"},"2":{"text":"no le no khuapi siangtho tualsuak ka hi uh hi, a kici Ama min Thahatpen TOPA ahi Israel Pasian tunga kingate aw, hih thu ngai un:","ref":"Isa 47:4; Mic 3:11; Ro 2:17"},"3":{"text":"A masa nate sawt pekin kong gen khin a, ka kamin hong zasakin tuate kong theisak khin hi; tua ciangin ka gamtang pah a, tuate hong tung hi.","ref":"Isa 41:22; Isa 45:21"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, note na lungkhauh lam uh, na ngawng thagui uh sik ahilam, na taltang uh sumngo ahilam ka thei hi.","ref":"Tp 31:27; Pk 32:9; Ns 7:51"},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi manin hih nate sawtveipi in kong gen khin zo hi; note in, ‘Ka milimte uh sep ahi hi; ka sing milimte uh le a kisung ka pasiante un thu a piak ahi hi,’ na cih theih loh nadingun tuate a pian ma-in no tungah kong zasak khol khin hi.","ref":"Jer 44:15-18"},"6":{"text":"Hih nate na za khin uh hi; a vekin en dih un. Sang nai lo ding na hi uh hiam? \"Tu-a kipan mailam hun ah a thak nate, na theih loh uh a kisel nate kong gen ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:22"},"7":{"text":"Tu-in amaute kipiangsak khina, a sawtvei nai kei hi; tuni ma-in tuate na za nai kei uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin, ‘Hi mah ei, ka theihsate hi ei,’ na ci thei kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 45:21; Pk 6:7"},"8":{"text":"Na za ngei nai kei uh a zong na theitel ngei nai kei uh hi; khanglui hun lai-in na bil uh a kihong kei hi. Mi muantak na hi lo lam uh kong thei a; na suah tungua kipan lehdote hong kici hi.","ref":"Isa 1:3; Tp 29:4; Tp 9:7,24; Ph 58:3"},"9":{"text":"Ka min ka khualna-in ka thangpaihna diah in; kei hong kipahtawina ka khualna-in note kong thahmang loh nadingin note panin ka ki-ip hi.","ref":"Ph 78:38"},"10":{"text":"En in, ngun siansak na bang zo kei uh zongun note kong siangsak hi; gimna pummei-in note kong zia-et hi."},"11":{"text":"Keimah ka kikhualna, keimah ka kicihna-in hih ka sem hi. Kei le kei kiminsiasak buang ding ka hi hiam? Ka minthanna midang tungah ka pia kei ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 12:22; Tp 32:27; Isa 42:8"},"12":{"text":"\"Jacob aw, ka thu ngai in, kong sapsa Israel aw: Amah keimah ka hi hi, ka cihpa a masapen le a tawpnapen ka hi hi.","ref":"Isa 46:3; Isa 43:13; Isa 41:4; Kil 1:17; 22:13","title":"Israel Kikhah"},"13":{"text":"Ka khutin leitung bulpite ka phut a, ka khut taklamin vante ka zal hi; amaute ka sapkhawm ciangin a vekun a dingkip khawm uh hi.","ref":"Pk 20:11"},"14":{"text":"\"Note khempeuh hong kikhawm unla ngai un: Hih nate milimte a koi pen in hong genkhol ahi hiam? TOPA koppih mipa in Babylon tungah ama sawmna semkhia dinga, a khutin Babylon mite a a langpan ding hi.","ref":"Isa 43:9"},"15":{"text":"Keimah, kei tektekin ka gen khin hi; hi hi, amah ka sam khin hi; keimah in ka paipih a, a nasepna a zo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 45:1"},"16":{"text":"Ka kiang hong naih unla hih thu ngai dih un: \"Ka zaksak masa pena kipan a simthamin ka gen kei hi; tua hun mah in pianga, tualai ah kei ka om hi.\" Tua hi a tu-in Thupipen TOPA in ama Kha tawh kei hong sawl hi.","ref":"Isa 41:1; Isa 45:19; Zec 2:9,11; Isa 11:2"},"17":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi - nangma Tanpa Israel Siangtho Pa in: \"Kei mah TOPA na Pasian - nang ading a hoihpen hong hilhpa, na pai nading lampi hong lakpa ka hi hi.","ref":"Isa 43:14; 49:7; Isa 28:9; Ph 32:8"},"18":{"text":"Ka thupiakte na thusim nak leh na lungmuanna gunpi bang dinga na thumaanna tuipihual a bang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 119:165; Isa 45:8"},"19":{"text":"Na suan na khakte sehnel bang dinga na tate sim zawh loh sehnel tang zah a pha ding hi; keima mai-ah amaute min kiphiat loin zong a kisusia kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:5; 66:22"},"20":{"text":"Babylon paisan un, Babylon mite taisan un! Lungdamna tawh kiko-in, leimongte dongin puak unla, \" TOPA in a nasempa Jacob tankhia khin hi,\" ci-in tangko un.","ref":"Isa 49:13; Isa 52:9; 63:9"},"21":{"text":"Amah in sehnel-gam kantanin a mite a paipih ciangin, a dangtak kei uh hi; amah in amaute adingin suangpi panin tuiluang bawl a; amah in suangpi khangkhamsak a, tui a phulkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 41:17; Isa 30:25; Pk 17:6"},"22":{"text":"\"Migilote adingin lungnopna a om kei hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No tuikulhte aw, ka thugen ngai un; a gamla-a om minamte aw, hih thu za un: Ka suah ma-in TOPA in kei hong sam khin hi; ka suaha kipan ka min a lawhsa ahi hi.","title":"’ Nasempa","ref":"Isa 44:24; 46:3"},"2":{"text":"Amah in ka kam, namsau tathiamsa bangsak a, a khut liim nuai-ah kei hong liah hi; thaltang nawt ngilsa hong suaksak a, a thaltang bawm sungah hong sel khinkhian hi.","ref":"Isa 11:4; Ph 91:1; Tp 32:23; Zec 9:13"},"3":{"text":"Kei kiangah, \"Nang, ka thupina kilat nading ka nasempa Israel na hi hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 44:23; Zec 3:8"},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin kei in, \"A thu om lopi-in na ka sem hi; ka thahatna kimanna nei loin ka zang a, bangmah ka lawhtaak kei hi. A tuacipi mah TOPA khut muangin ka sema, ka pahtakman Pasian kiangah om hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Isa 35:4"},"5":{"text":"Tua hi-a tu-in TOPA - naubu sungah ama nasem dingin hong bawl a, Jacob ama kiang tunpihin amahmah in Israel a kaikhawmpa, TOPA mitmuhin kei hong kipahtawi nading le ka thahatna ka Pasian ahi nadingin,","ref":"Isa 43:4; Ph 18:1"},"6":{"text":"amah in: \"Jacob behte ciahpih kik ding le ka kepsa Israel-te puak kik ding a sempa na hina nang adingin neu lua hi. Ka hotkhiatna leimongte dongin na puak theih nadingin Gentile-te adingin zong khuavak kong suaksak ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9; Jn 11:52; Ns 13:47*; Lk 2:32, Jn 1:9"},"7":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi - Israel-te Tanpa le Siangtho Pa - a minamin simmawh a, a kih uh gam-ukte’ nasempa tungah: \"A muanhuaipa TOPA - nang hong teelpa Israel-te Siangtho Pa hangin kumpite in nang hong muh uh ciangin dingto ding uh a, kumpi tapate in nang hong muh uh ciangin a kunsuk ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 48:17; 1Co 1:9; Isa 14:1; Isa 52:15"},"8":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Kong angvan hunin kong dawng dinga, hotkhiatna ni-in nang kong huh ding hi; Keimah in note hong kemin mite adingin thukhun kong suaksak dinga, leitang hong puahphasakin kuama tenlohna mun kong luahsak dinga,","title":"Israel Puahkikna","ref":"Ph 69:13; 2Co 6:2*; Isa 26:3; Isa 42:6; Isa 44:26; Isa 60:21"},"9":{"text":"thongkiate tungah, ‘Hong paikhia un’ ci-in khuamial sunga omte tungah, ‘Suakta un,’ ka cisak ding hi. \"Amaute in lampi gei-ah an ne in mualneu tunga pawnlak khempeuh ah lonona a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 42:7; Lk 4:19; Isa 41:18"},"10":{"text":"Amaute gilkial lo dangtak loin sehnel-gam nisa in a kang kha kei ding hi. Amaute a khuatuahpa in makaih dinga, ciktuite gei-ah a pi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 33:16; Isa 35:7"},"11":{"text":"Ka mualliante khempeuh lampi ka suaksak dinga, ka lam lianpite ka sangsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:16; 40:4"},"12":{"text":"En un, amaute gamlapi panin- pawlkhatte leilu-lam pan, pawlkhatte nitumna-lam pan, pawlkhatte Aswan a kual pek pan hong pai ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 43:5-6"},"13":{"text":"Vante aw, lungdamin awng un, leitung aw, nuam in; mualliante aw, la sa-in awngkhia un! Ahang in, TOPA in a mite hehnem ta in, gim thuak mite khuatuah ta ding hi.","ref":"Isa 44:23; Isa 40:1; 2Co 1:4; Ph 9:12"},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin Zion in, \" TOPA in kei hong nusia khin a, Topa in kei hong mangngilh khin hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 9:10; 71:11"},"15":{"text":"Nu khat in a anga a tawi naungeek mangngilh thei a, a sunga piang a ta khuatuah lo thei ahi hiam? Amah in a mangngilh kha zongin ken nang kong mangngilh kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 44:21"},"16":{"text":"En in, ka khutpekte ah nang kong gelh kuak zo a; na kulhte ka mai-ah a om den hi.","ref":"Ph 48:12-13; Isa 62:6"},"17":{"text":"Na tapate hong kihei kik uh a, nang hong siasakte in hong paisan ta uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Dakto inla na kimkot en in; na tapate kikhawmin nang hong zuan uh hi. TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, amaute khempeuh kizepna-in na nei dinga, mothak bangin amaute kizepna-in na nei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 60:4; 43:5; Ro 14:11*; Isa 52:1"},"19":{"text":"\"Nang kisia-in hong kilawi a, na gam gamkhing a suak zongin tu-in na mite adingin nang na neu lua dinga, nang hong nawmvalhte gamlapi ah a om ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 54:1,3; Zec 10:10; Isa 1:20"},"20":{"text":"Note dah le kah hun sunga na neih uh na tate un na zakzakun, ‘Hih mun ko adingin neu lua; ka ten nading uh mundang hong piakbeh in’ kici lai ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 54:1-3"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin na lungsimin, ‘Hihte kua hong neihsak hiam? Kei taselin ka tangkhat a, hong kinolhin sal ka suak hi. Hihte a khansuah kua ahi hiam? Kei guak hong kinusia den a, ahi zongin hihte - amaute koi pan hong pai uh ahi hiam?’ na ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 1:8"},"22":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"En un, Gentile-te ka khut ka van dinga, mite lamah ka dialkhai ka laamto ding hi; amaute in na tapate tawi-in na tanute liangko mualsuanin hong puak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 15:2; Isa 11:10; Isa 11:12; Isa 60:4"},"23":{"text":"Kumpite, nang hong don na pate suak ding uh a, amaute zite nang hong cing na nute a suak ding uh hi. A maitangun lei si-in na mai-ah kun ding uh a; na khe-a leivuite a liak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding uh hi. Kei sungah lametna a neite a zahlak kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 60:3, 10-11; Isa 60:16; Ph 72:9; Mic 7:17"},"24":{"text":"Galhangpa tung panin kua in sutkhia thei dinga, a lungngolpa a tung panin kua in galmatte hukhia zo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Mt 12:29; Lk 11:21"},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Galhangpa tung panin galmatte kilakhia dinga, a lungngolpa tung panin kisutkhia taktak ding hi; nang hong langbawlte ka langbawl dinga, na tate ka honkhia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2"},"26":{"text":"Nang hong nengniamte amaute sa amau mah ka nesak dinga, amau sisan zukham bangin ka khamsak ding hi. Tua ciangin mihing peuhmah in keimah, TOPA , note Honpa, note Tanpa, Jacob Thahat Pa ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 9:4,20; Kil 16:6; Isa 25:9; Isa 48:17"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Na nu ka sawlkhiatna kimakna lai koi-ah om ahi hiam? Ahikeh ka leibatna kua tungah hong zuak ka hi hiam? Na mawhnate uh hangin nang hong kizuak ahi hi. Na khialhnate uh hangin na nu uh a kiciahsak ahi hi.","title":"Israel Mawhna le Nasempa’ Thuman’na","ref":"Ne 5:5; Mt 18:25; Tp 32:30; Isa 52:3"},"2":{"text":"Kong pai ciangin bang hangin mi khat beek om lo ahi hiam? Kong sap ciangin bang hangin hong dawng khat beek om lo ahi hiam? Nang hong tan zo lo dingin ka ban tom lua ahi hiam? Nang hong hu zo lo dingin thahatna nei lo ka hi hiam? Khatvei tai ziau leng tuipi ka keusak a, gunte sehnel-gam suakin; tui om loh manin a sunga ngasate dangtakin si uh a, a uih uh hi.","ref":"Ms 11:23; Pc 18:14; Pk 14:22; Jos 3:16"},"3":{"text":"Vantung, khuamial ka silhsak a, a khuh nadingin ippi puan ka bawl hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Kil 6:12"},"4":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in a gimte thamalhsak nadingin a kihilhsa leii hong guan hi. Zingsang simin kei hong phong a, a kihilhsa bangin thungai dingin ka bil a phong hi.","ref":"Pk 4:12; Ph 5:3; 119:147; Isa 28:9"},"5":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in ka bil hong honsak a, amah lehdo nawn loin; ka nungngatsan nawn kei hi.","ref":"Isa 35:5; Mt 26:39; Jn 14:31"},"6":{"text":"Kei hong satte ka nung ka dawh a; ka khamul a hong mante ka paang ka dawh hi; hong simmawhte le hong cilphihte ka lehngatsan kei hi.","ref":"Isa 53:5; Mt 27:30"},"7":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in kei hong huh ahi manin hong kimaizumsak kei ding hi. Tua ahi ciangin meisah suang bangin ka mai ka ngat a, kei hong maizumsak loh ding ka thei hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1; Eze 3:8-9; Isa 28:16"},"8":{"text":"Kei dik hong tangsakpa ka kiangah om hi. Kua in kei hong siattut ding ahi hiam? Khat le khat kimaituah nung! Hong mawhsak kua ahi hiam? Amah hong maituah sak un.","ref":"Isa 43:26"},"9":{"text":"Kei hong huhpa Thupipen TOPA ahi hi. Kei hong mawhpaih ding kua ahi hiam? Amaute khempeuh puansilh bangin patkhia dinga; nget in a netum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:10; Ro 8:1, 34"},"10":{"text":"TOPA kihta-a a nasempa thumang no lakah kua ahi hiam? Khuamial sunga lam pai, khuavak nei lo mi in TOPA min muang henla, ama Pasian tungah kinga hen.","ref":"Isa 49:3; Ph 107:14"},"11":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in, nomau mei vakin nomau meikuang a kidette aw, nomau tawhkuangsa mei - nomau meitang mahah pai-in kalsuan un. Ka khut pana na ngah ding uh hih ahi hi: Gawtna thuakin na lumsuk ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 26:18; Jas 3:6; Pn 26:27; Isa 65:13-15"}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No thumaan delha TOPA a zongte aw, ngai un: Note hong ki-eukhiatna suangpi, hong kitawhkhiatna suangkuak en un;","title":"Zion Ading Tawntung Hotkhiatna","ref":"Isa 17:10"},"2":{"text":"Na pa uh Abraham le na suahna uh Sarah en dih un. Amah ka sap lai-in amah kia bek hi a, amah thupha pia-in tampi ka phasak hi.","ref":"Pc 12:2"},"3":{"text":"TOPA in Zion hehnem taktak dinga, ama kisiatna khempeuh khuatuahna mitin a en ding hi; ama sehnel-gamte Eden bangsak dinga, a gamtulte TOPA huan bang ding hi. Ama sungah lungnopna le kipahna, lungdamkohna le lasakna awging a om ding hi.","ref":"Isa 40:1; Isa 52:9; Isa Pc 2:8; Isa 25:9; 66:10; Jer 17:26"},"4":{"text":"\"Ka mite aw, ka thu ngai un; ka minam aw, ka thu za in: Kei tung panin thukham pusuakkhia ding hi; minamte tungah keima thutanna khuavak a suak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka thumaanna hong kinawh mahmahin ka hotkhiatna hong pai laitak hi a, ka khut in minamte tungah thutang a puak ding hi. Tuikulhte in kei hong en ding uh a, ka khut sep ding lamenin a ngak ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 49:10; Ph 37:9"},"6":{"text":"Daktoin vante ento unla, nuai-a leitung zong en un; vante meikhu bangin mang dinga, leitung puan bangin paatkhia-in a tunga tengte tho bangin a si ding uh hi. Ahi hangin ka hotkhiatna kip tawntung dinga ka thumaanna a bei ngei kei ding hi.","ref":"Mt 24:35; 2Pe 3:10; Ph 102:25-26; Ph 119:89; Ph 89:33"},"7":{"text":"\"Thumaan thei a, a lungsimah ka thukham a vomte aw, ka thugen ngai un: mite kosiatna kihta kei unla amaute engkona hangin patau kei un.","ref":"Mt 5:11; Ns 5:41"},"8":{"text":"Ahang in, nget in puan a nek bangin amaute netummang dinga; siim in samul a nek bangin amaute a valh ding hi. Ahi hangin ka thumaanna bei ngei lo dinga, khang tawntungin ka hotkhiatna a kip den ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 50:9; Isa 14:11; tg 6"},"9":{"text":"Khanglo in, khanglo in! TOPA ban aw, thahatna puan silh in; a beisa nite bang, tanglai peka khanghunte bangin khanglo in. Rahab a atnenpa ganhing lianpi a sunletpa nang hi lo na hi hiam?","ref":"Isa 52:1; Ph 74:13; Job 9:13"},"10":{"text":"Tatkhiatsate kantan theih dingin tuipi keusak a, tui thukpi tuite a keusakpa, tuipi sunga lamsialpa nang hi lo na hi hiam?","ref":"Pk 14:22, 15:13; Job 36:30"},"11":{"text":"TOPA tatsate a kileh kik ding uh hi. La sa kawmin amaute Zion ah lut ding uh a; amau lutungah a bei ngei lo lungnopna a khu ding uh hi. Kipahna le lungnopna tawh kidimin dahna le khuisatna a mangthang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 35:9; Ph 109:28; Jer 33:11; Kil 7:17"},"12":{"text":"\"Kei, kei mahmah note hong hehnempa ka hi hi. Mihing hi lel a, mihing tapate ahi lel, lopa bang lelte a kihta nang kua na hiam?","ref":"2Co 1:4; 1Pe 1:24; Ph 118:6"},"13":{"text":"Nang hong Bawlpa TOPA - vante zala leitung bulpite a phutpa a mangngilh nang, mi nengniamte thangpaihna hangin lauthawngsa-a nungtapa, siatna bek tupa nei pa nang kua na hiam? Ahang in, mi nengniamte thangpaihna koi-ah om ahi hiam?","ref":"Ph 104:2; Isa 48:13; Isa 17:10; 45:11; Isa 7:4; Isa 9:4"},"14":{"text":"Thong kia-a kunte kikhahkhia baih ta ding hi; amaute thong hawmpi sungah si lo ding uh a, anlum zong a kitasam kei ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahang in keimah in nangma Pasian TOPA , tuihualte a hawk nadingin tuipi a lawkgawppa - a min Thahatpen TOPA ka hi hi.","ref":"Isa 13:4"},"16":{"text":"Na kam sungah ka thute ka guang khina, ka khut liimin nang kong sung hi - vante a munah a omsakpa, leitung bulpite phuta, Zion tungah, ‘Note ka mite na hi uh hi,’ a cipa keimah ka hi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 18:18; Isa 59:21; Isa 48:13; Jer 7:23"},"17":{"text":"Khanglo in, khanglo in! Jerusalem aw, tho in, nang in ama thangpaihna ahi - mite a amsak hai a tawdat dongin TOPA khut panin na dawna na kham khin hi.","ref":"Isa 52:1; Job 21:20; Ph 75:8; Ph 60:3","title":"’ Thangpaihna Hai"},"18":{"text":"Tuanu sunga piang tapa khempeuh amah lam a hilh ding khat beek om lo a; ama khoisa tapa khempeuh a khuta len ding khat beek a om kei hi.","ref":"Ph 88:18"},"19":{"text":"Hih tuahsiatnate a thuapin hong tungta - kua in hong hehnem ding hiam? Kisiatna le maimanna, kialpi le namsau - hong tung hi kua in hong dahpih thei a ding hiam?","ref":"Isa 47:9; Isa 14:30"},"20":{"text":"Na tapate bah khin uh a; lam lian bul tengah lenthanga awk sanang bangin lum uh hi. TOPA thangpaihna le na Pasian taina tawh amaute kidim uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:25; Jer 14:16; Job 40:11"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin zu hi lo napi a khama hingimpa aw, hih thu za in.","ref":"Isa 14:32, 29:9"},"22":{"text":"Hih in na Pasian Thupipen TOPA ama mite a hupa gen ahi hi: \"En in, nang hong hoisak hai na khut panin ka lakhia khin hi; tua hai panin ka thangpaihna haipi na dawn kik ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:25; tg 17; Jer 25:15"},"23":{"text":"No hong gentheisaka no tungah, ‘No tung ka tot theih nadingin na khupbawh unla lampi-a kitawn lamlian bangin na nungzang uh na dawh un,’ hong cite khut sungah ka koih ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Zec 12:2; Ph 66:12"}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khanglo in, khanglo in, Zion aw, thahatna puanin silh in. Khuapi siangtho Jerusalem aw, na thupina puan silh in. Na sungah vunat lohte le a kihhuaite lut kik lo ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 51:9; Ph 110:3"},"2":{"text":"Na leivuite singkhia in; Jerusalem aw, tho inla kumpi tokhom ah tu in. Saltang Zion Tanu aw, na ngawnga khainiangte panin kisuahtak in.","ref":"Isa 29:4; Ph 81:6"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in: \"Note bangmah loin hong kizuaka, sum loin hong kitankhia ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 45:13"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, Thupipen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"A masa in ka mite a nungta dingin Egypt ah paisuk uh hi; a nunung lamah Assyria in amaute a nengniam hi.","ref":"Pc 46:6"},"5":{"text":"\"Tu-in hih lai-ah bang nei ka hi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Ka mite bangmah loin ka paipihmang a, amaute a ukte in simmawh uh hi,\" b TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Ni thapai-in ka min kigendai den hi.","ref":"Eze 36:20"},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka mite in ka min a thei ding uh hi; tua ahi ciangin a genkholpa kei ka hilam amaute in a thei ding uh hi. Hihi, tua in keimah ka hi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 49:23; Isa 10:20"},"7":{"text":"Mual liante tunga thupha a puakte, lemna a va tangkote, thuthak hoih a va puakte, hotkhiatna va tangko a, Zion tungah, \"Na Pasian kumpi in mang hi,\" a va cite khe melhoih na lawmlawm e!","ref":"Eph 6:15; Ph 93:1"},"8":{"text":"Ngai un! Na galvilte un a aw uh sangsakin; lungnopna aw a tangko khawm uh hi. Zion ah TOPA a ciah kik ciangin amau mit mahmah un tua a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 62:6; Isa 59:20"},"9":{"text":"TOPA in mite hehnem khin a, Jerusalem tankhia khin ahi manin, nang a kisiasa Jerusalem aw, lungnopna late sakhia khawm un.","ref":"Lk 2:25; Ph 98:4"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in minamte khempeuh muhin a khut siangtho zankhia dinga, leimongte khempeuh in eite Pasian hotkhiatna a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 66:18; Ph 44:3; Isa 11:9"},"11":{"text":"Kihem un, kihem un , tua lai panin paikhia un! A sianglo na lawng kei un! No TOPA ’ beel le kuang puate aw, tua panin paikhia unla kisiangthosak un.","ref":"Isa 48:20; 2Kh 36:10"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin note mai-ah TOPA pai-in Israel-te Pasian note nung dal ahi manin note nawhsa-in na dingkhia kei ding uh a, lauthawng sa-in na pai kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Mic 2:13; Pk 14:19"},"13":{"text":"En un, ka nasempa in pilvang takin a a sem ding hi; amah kisangsakin kilaamto dinga sangtakin a kitawisang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1","title":"Nasempa Thuakna le Minthanna"},"14":{"text":"Ama b hangin mi tampi a lauthawng bang tektekin - mi zong sun nawn loin amel kisiagawp a, mihing zong bang loin a pianzia a kisiazaw lai hi -","ref":"2Sa 10:4"},"15":{"text":"tua ahi ciangin minam tampite c siangsak dinga ama hangin kumpite pau loin a om ding uh hi. Ahang in, amaute in a kigenkhol lo nate mu ding uh a, a zak kholh loh uh thute a tel ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 14:7; 16:14-15; Ro 15:21*"}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kote thupuak kua in um a, kua kiangah TOPA khut kilak ahi hiam?","ref":"Ro 10:16*"},"2":{"text":"A laingek mengkhia bangin a mai-ah amah khangto a, lei keuna-a a bulsel mengkhia bang ahi hi. Eite iplah dingin melhoihna ahikeh thupina nei lo a, amah i deih nadingin kilawmna peuhmah a langkhia kei hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:26; Isa 11:10; Isa 52:14"},"3":{"text":"Mihingte in amah simmawhin nial uh a, dahna thuak mipa le haksatna thei mipa ahi hi. Mite in mu nuam loin a mai uh a humsan mipa bangin amah kisimmawh a, eite in zong i thusim tuan kei hi.","ref":"Tp 31:17; Ph 22:6"},"4":{"text":"Amah in eite natna thuakin i dahnate pua takpi hi; Tua hi napi Pasian in amah satin gimsak hi, ci-in i ngaihsun hi.","ref":"Jn 19:7; Pc 12:17; Ru 1:21"},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin eite tatsiatna hangin amah kisunlet a, i tatkhialh nate hangin amah kisatnim hi; eite in lungnopna i ngah nadingin amah in dan thuaka, ama liammate hangin eite i dam hi.","ref":"Ro 4:25; Ph 34:18; 1Pe 2:24-25"},"6":{"text":"Eite khempeuh tuu bangin lam i pial khin a, eima utna ciatah i pial hi; TOPA in eite khempeuh mawhna ama tungah a suan hi.","ref":"Ph 95:10; 1Pe 2:24-25; 1Sa 8:3; Pk 28:38"},"7":{"text":"Amah kinengniamin kihingimsak napi a kam a kek kei hi; a kigo ding tuu bangin amah kipaipih a, a mul metpa mai-ah a ham lo tuu bangin a kam a kek kei hi.","ref":"Isa 49:26; Mk 14:61; Ph 44:22"},"8":{"text":"Netniamna d le thukhenna tawh amah kipaipihmang hi. Tua hi-a ama suante kua in gen thei ahi hiam? Ahang in, a hingte gam pan amah kikhenkhia in; ka mite mawhnate hangin amah a kisat e hi.","ref":"Da 9:26"},"9":{"text":"Amah ngongtat loin zuauthu zong gen lo napi, migilote tawh kivuikhawm a, mihaute tawh a sikhawm hi.","ref":"Isa 42:1-3; 1Pe 2:22*; Mt 27:57-60"},"10":{"text":"Tua bangin kisatnima a kithuaksak ding lah TOPA deih hi a, TOPA in ama nuntakna khialhna hanga biakna-in a bawl f hangin amah in a suan le khakte mu in a nuntak hun sotsak dinga ama gamsungah a khut sungah TOPA deihna a pung ding hi.","ref":"Isa 46:10; Ph 22:30"},"11":{"text":"A hinna in a thuak khit ciangin, nuntakna g khuavak mu dinga a lungkim h ding hi; a thumaan ka nasempa in, ama theihna i tawh mi tampi dik tangsak dinga, amaute mawhna a puaksak ding hi.","ref":"Ro 5:18-19; Pk 28:38"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin a mi liante j lakah tanh ka pia dinga, amah in mi thahatte k tawh vanlakte a hawm ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in sihna sungah a nuntakna sungkhia a, mimawhte tawh a kisimkhawm hi. Ahang in, amah in tampite mawhna pua a, a khialte adingin thumsak hi.","ref":"Php 2:9; Lk 11:22; Mt 26:28, 38-39, 42; Lk 22:37*; Ro 8:34"}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Tasel numei, ta a nei ngei lo nu aw, la sa in; nau suah nat a thuak ngei lo nu aw, la sakhia-in lungdamin awng in. Bang hang hiam cih leh pasal nei numei’ tate sangin a kinusia numei tate a tamzaw hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi.","title":"Mailama Zion Minthan Nading","ref":"Isa 66:7; Gal 4:27"},"2":{"text":"\"Na puanbuk mun khan in, na puanbuk zapi in zal inla khiam kik nawn kei in; na khaute sausak inla, na khetphimte kipsak in."},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, veilam le taklam ah na kiphalh dinga; nangma suante in minamte suankhia in, a kilawi khuapite ah a teng ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 49:19"},"4":{"text":"\"Kihta kei un; na maizum kei ding uh hi. Na zahlak khak ding uh lau kei un; hong kimaizumsak lo ding hi. Na khangmoi lai-a na maizumna na mangngilh dinga, na meigon lai-a mawhsaknate na phawk kha nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 28:16; Jer 2:2; Isa 51:7"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, nang hong Bawlpa na pasal hi a - ama min Thahatpen TOPA ahi hi - Israel-te Siangtho Pa nang hong Tanpa hi a; amah leitung khempeuh’ Pasian kici hi.","ref":"Jer 3:14; Isa 48:17; Isa 6:3"},"6":{"text":"A kimasa zi, a lungsim a dong ngeungau bang - a kima lel dinga khangmoi lai pi-a kitenpih zi bangin, TOPA in nang hong sam kik ding hi,\" na Pasian in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 62:4,12"},"7":{"text":"\"Tomkha sung nang kong nusia a, ahi hangin hong khuatuah lua-in kong la kik ding hi.","ref":"Isa 26:20"},"8":{"text":"Heh lua-in tomno sung kong lehngatsan a, ahi hangin tawntung migitna-in nang kong khuatuah ding hi,\" nang hong Tanpa TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 60:10; Isa 1:15; Ph 102:13; Isa 14:1"},"9":{"text":"\"Hih in kei adingin, Noah tuite in leitung a tuam nawn kei ding hi, ci a ka kiciam Noah hun lai a bang ding hi. Tua bangin tu-in nang tungah a heh lo dingin ka kiciam khina, nang kong tai kik nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 12:1"},"10":{"text":"Mualliante kilokin mualneute kikhin taleh, nang kong itna kip kiling lo dinga, ka lemna thukhun zong a kikhin kei ding hi,\" nang hong khuatuah TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Ph 46:2; Kil 6:14; Ph 89:34;Isa 42:6; tg 8"},"11":{"text":"\"Huihpite in nawkgawpa a kihehnem lo khuapi aw, turquoise a suangin kong lam dinga na bulpi sapphire b in ka lam ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:32; 28:2; 1Kh 29:2; Isa 28:16"},"12":{"text":"Na kulh dawnvang Ruby ka hisak dinga na kongpite a tee daldal Jewel hisakin na kulh khempeuh suang manpha ka hisak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na tapate khempeuh TOPA in hilh dinga, na tate lungnopna lian mahmah ding hi.","ref":"Jn 6:45*; Heb 8:11; Isa 48:18"},"14":{"text":"Thumaanna-in nang hong kikipsak dinga, ukcipna tawh na kigamla ding hi; bangmah na kihta kei ding hi. Gamlapi ah launa kikhinkhia dinga, nang kiang hong tung kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 26:2; Zep 3:15"},"15":{"text":"Khatpeuh in nang hong sim leh, kei sep ahi kei ding hi; nang hong sim peuhpeuh nang tungah hong kipumpiak ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"\"En in, meihol zaapkuang a, a kizat nading muna hiam a suah sikseekpa keima piansak ahi hi. A siasak dingin a susiapa a piangsak keimah ka hi hi;","ref":"Isa 44:12, 10:5; Isa 13:5"},"17":{"text":"Nang do nadingin hiam a seek peuhmah mavang lo dinga, nang hong mawhsak leii peuhmah na zothal ding hi. Hih in TOPA nasemte luah hi dinga, hih in kei pana amau luah thumaanna hi ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 29:8; Ph 17:2"}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"No a dangtakte khempeuh aw, hong pai un, tui hong zuan un; no sum nei lote aw, hong pai-in lei unla ne un! Hong pai unla sum pia lo man nei loin bawngnawi le lenggahzu lei un.","title":"A Dangtakte Sapna","ref":"Jn 4:14; 7:37; Jer 2:13; Kil 3:18; Hos 14:4; Mt 10:8"},"2":{"text":"Anlum leina loin bang hangin sum zanga, gilvahna ding lopi-in na sem na hi uh hiam? Ngai un, ka thu ngai-un, anlim ne un, na hinna un anlim pen ne-in a tai ding hi.","ref":"Ph 22:26; Hos 8:7; Isa 1:19"},"3":{"text":"Na bil uh hong ngat unla kei hong zuan un; na nuntak theih nadingun ka thu ngai un. David tungah a muanhuai itna ka ciam bangin note tawh tawntung thukhun ka bawl ding hi.","ref":"Sp 18:5; Ro 10:5; Ns 13:34*; Isa 54:8"},"4":{"text":"En un, mite tungah amah teci suaksakin mite makai le ukpa ka hisak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Note in na theih loh uh minamte na sam ding uh a, TOPA note Pasian Israel-te Siangtho Pa in note hong thupisak khin ahi manin note hong thei lo minamte in kintakin note hong zuan taktak ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 12:6; Isa 60:9; Isa 2:3"},"6":{"text":"A kimuh theih lai-in TOPA zong un, amah a nai lai-in sam un.","ref":"Ph 32:6; 2Co 6:1-2"},"7":{"text":"Tatsiapa a gamtat nusiasak unla, a gilopa a lungsim kheelsak un; TOPA lamah kiheisak le uh cin amah in lainat dinga, eite Pasian lamah na kiheisak uh leh amah in a mawhna maisak pha mahmah ding hi.","ref":"Isa 32:7; 59:7; Isa 44:22; 54:10; Isa 1:18; 40:2"},"8":{"text":"\"Ahang in, no ngaihsutte kei ngaihsutna hi lo a, no zialetongte kei zialetongte a hi kei hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Php 2:5; 4:8; Isa 53:6; Mic 4:12"},"9":{"text":"\"Leitung sangin vante a sanzawk bangin no zialetongte sangin kei zialetongte sangzaw a, no ngaihsutnate sangin kei ngaihsutna sangzaw hi.","ref":"Ph 103:11; Isa 40:13-14"},"10":{"text":"Khaici vawhpa khaici ding le a ne pa anlum ding a piansak theih nadingin vantung panin guah le vuk kiasuka, leitung buakkawtin kungnote mengin selsak loin a kileh loh bangin","ref":"2Co 9:10; Ph 67:6"},"11":{"text":"ka kam pana pusuaksa ka kammal zong tua bang ahi hi; a hawmin kei kiangah hong kileh lo dinga, ahi hangin ka deih bangin tungsakin ka sawlna ah lawhcing ding hi.","ref":"Tp 32:2; Isa 45:23; Isa 44:26"},"12":{"text":"Gual nuamin na kuankhia ding uh a, lungnuamin hong kipaikhiatpih ding hi; note mai-ah mualliante le mualneute la sa in awng ding uh a, lo lai-a singkung khempeuh in khut beng ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 98:4; Ph 65:12-13; Ph 98:8"},"13":{"text":"Lingkung tangin takkung po dinga thangling kung tangin muikung a po ding hi. Hih in a tawntunga TOPA kiphawkna a kisusia ngei lo a kipden lim hi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:6; Isa 63:12"}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Ka hotkhiatna nai mahmah ta a, ka thumaanna hong kilaak pah ding ahi manin thutang zang unla amaanin gamta un.","title":"Midangte ading Hotkhiatna","ref":"Ph 85:9; Jer 23:6; Isa 1:17; Isa 26:8"},"2":{"text":"Hih bangin gamta in hih thu lenkip a, Sabbath siasak loin tang a, gitlohna bawl lo dingin a khut a kem zote thupha ngah ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 20:8,10; Ph 119:2"},"3":{"text":"Ama thu-a TOPA a pawl gamdang mipa in, \" TOPA in a mite panin kei hong khenkhia taktak ding hi,\" ci kei hen. Tuateh cilgeh khatpeuh in, \"Kei singkungkeu hi lel ing,\" ci-in phun kei hen.","ref":"Pk 12:43; Tp 23:3; Ns 8:27"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Ka Sabbath tangin ka lungkimna tel a, ka thukhun a kiplet cilgehte -","ref":"Pk 31:13"},"5":{"text":"amaute tungah ka biakinnpi sung le a kawmte tungah tanute le tapate sanga a hoihzaw phawkdenna le minte ka pia ding hi. Amaute tungah a mang nawn lo ding a kip tawntung min ka pia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama nasem ding, TOPA min a it ding, amah a bia ding, Sabbath tangin a siasak lo ding, ka thukhun a kiplet, TOPA pawlin a beel gamdang mite -","ref":"Isa 60:7,10; 61:5"},"7":{"text":"tuate ka mualsiangtho ah ka paipih dinga, ka thungetna inn sungah ka lungnuamsak ding hi. Ka inn minam khempeuh thungetna inn a kicih nadingin, amaute meihal biakna le a biakpiaknate uh ka biakna-tau tungah a kisang ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 2:2; Ro 12:1; Heb 13:15; Mt 21:13*; Mk 11:17*"},"8":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA - a kikhenthang Israel-te a kaikhawmpa in: \"A kikaikhawmsa banah a omlaite amaute kiangah ka kaikhawm lai ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:12; Jn 10:16"},"9":{"text":"Lo sunga om ganhing khempeuh hong pai un, tulaka om ganhing khempeuh hong pai unla nawmvalh un!","ref":"Jer 12:9","title":"Migilote, Pasian’ Mawhsakna"},"10":{"text":"Israel galvilte a mit uh taw a, amaute khempeuh in bangmah a thei kei uh hi; amaute khempeuh a ham thei lo ui hi uh a, a tawng thei kei uh hi; lup bek si uh a, mang manmanin ihmut nuamsa uh hi.","ref":"Na 3:18"},"11":{"text":"An a hai mahmah uite hi uh a, kham hun a nei kei uh hi. Amaute, theihtelna a nei lo tuucingte ahi uh hi; a vekun amau tum ciatin pai uh a, amau met nading a zong ciat uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:3; Isa 53:6"},"12":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Hong pai un, zu kong lup ding hi! I gilpi dimin zucil dawn ni. Zing ciang pen tuni mah bang dinga nuamzaw lai tham ding hi,\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Sp 10:9; Lk 12:18-19"}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thumaante mangthang napi, a lungsima ngaihsun kuamah a om kei hi; a thutak mite kilamang napi, siatna panin a kihemkhia ahilam kuamah in a tel kei hi.","ref":"Isa 42:25"},"2":{"text":"Thutanga kalsuante lemna ah lut uh a; a sih uh ciangin khawlna a mu uh hi.","ref":"Da 12:13"},"3":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin no numei aisante’ tapate angkawm le kizuakte suan le khakte aw, hih lai-ah hong pai un!","ref":"Isa 1:21"},"4":{"text":"Kua ciamnuih na hi uh hiam? Kua zahnuihsanin kamka in kua leiiphensan na hi uh hiam? Note a lehdote’ tate, zuauphuakte’ suan le khakte hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Tehno kungte lak le singhiang nuai tengah numei pasal kilunggulhna-in na kangtum uh a; kuam thukpi sung le suanghawm sungah na tate uh kithoihna-in na nei uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 16:4; Sp 18:21"},"6":{"text":"Kuam sunga suangmaite note tanh milimte ahi hi; amaute diakdiak no aituam ahi hi. Hihi, tuate tungah dawntheih biakna na sung in, an-a biakna na pia uh hi. Hih nate hangin ka lungsim khiam tuan ding ka hi hiam?","ref":"Jer 3:9; Jer 5:9,29"},"7":{"text":"Munsangna le mual sangpi ah na lupna na bawl a; tua lai-a paito in kithoihna na pia hi.","ref":"Jer 3:6; Jer 13:27"},"8":{"text":"Kongkhakte le kongkhak mungte liah ah na dawibiakna limte na koih hi. Kei hong nusia-in na lupna na hawkkhia a, a tungah kahto in zapi-in na hong hi; a lupna na itte tawh thukimna na bawl a, amaute guaktang hihna na mitsuan hi.","ref":"Eze 23:18"},"9":{"text":"Olive thau kengin Molech a ah na pai a, na paknamtuite na kinuh phapha hi. Na tangmite b gamlapi ah na sawl a, hankhuk c dongah na tuaksuk hi!","ref":"1Ku 11:5; Eze 23:16,40; Isa 8:19"},"10":{"text":"Na paina lampi teng hangin na gima, ahi hangin, ‘Lametna bei ta hi’ na ci kei hi. Na hatna uh na thaksak kik uh a, tuaci-in na bah kei uh hi.","ref":"Jer 2:25; 18:12"},"11":{"text":"\"Kei tunga na khialh nading, nong mangngilh nading le na lungsim nangawna nong ngaihsut lohna zah dong dingin lau a na kihtak kua ahi hiam? Daitaka sawtveipi ka om manin kei hong kihta lo hilo na hi hiam?","ref":"Isa 42:23; Jer 2:32; 3:21; Pn 29:25; Ph 50:21"},"12":{"text":"Na thumaanna le na nasepnate kipholaak dinga, na phattuampih kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 29:15; Mic 3:2-4,8"},"13":{"text":"Huhna ngenin na kiko ciangin na kaihkhop milimte kihonsak ve! Tuate khempeuh huih in len khiamang dinga husan bek in tuate a mutmang ding hi. Ahi hangin kei hong beel mi-in leitang luah dinga ka mual siangtho a nei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 40:7,24; Ph 118:8; Ph 37:9; Isa 65:9-11"},"14":{"text":"\"Zik un, zik un, lampi sial un! Ka mite’ lampi a khakte hemkhia un,\" kici ding hi.","title":"Lunggimte Hehnepna"},"15":{"text":"Ahang in, a sang, a sangpen Pa - a nungta tawntung ama min siangthopa gen hih ahi hi: \"A sangna le a sianthona munah ka tenga, ahi hangin lungsim niamte le lunggimte a lungkhauhsak dingin a lungsim niamte le a lunggimte tawh ka tengkhawm hi.","ref":"Isa 52:13; Tp 33:27; Job 16:19; Ph 34:18; 51:17; 147:3; Isa 61:1"},"16":{"text":"Mihing huu ka piansaksa hi a - ka mai-ah mihing lungsim gim ding ahi manin ka mawhsak suak kei dinga, ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.","ref":"Pc 2:7"},"17":{"text":"Ama huaiham mawhna hangin ka heh lua-a; amah dan thuaksakin hehin ka lehngatsan hangin, ama nopsak bangin a gamta veve hi.","ref":"Isa 56:11; Isa 1:15; Isa 1:4"},"18":{"text":"Ama lampi ka muh khit hangin amah ka damsak ding hi; amah lam ka hilh dinga hehnem in,","ref":"Isa 30:26; Isa 61:1-3"},"19":{"text":"a thum Israel-te muk panin phatna ka piangsak ding hi. Lemna, a nai a gamla-a omte tungah lemna,\" TOPA in ci a, \"Amaute ka damsak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ns 2:39; Eph 2:17"},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin migilote, khawl hun nei lo, tuipi kilok tuihual in nin le buan a laptoh tawh kibang uh hi.","ref":"Job 18:5-21; Ph 69:14"},"21":{"text":"\"Migilote adingin lungnopna a om kei hi,\" ka Pasian in a ci hi."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Na aw neih zah sit loin awng in. Pengkul bangin na aw ngaihsak in. Ka mite tungah amaute lehdona le Jacob innkuante tungah a mawhna uh genkhia in.","title":"A Dik Antanna","ref":"Isa 40:6; Pk 20:18; Isa 48:8; Isa 57:12"},"2":{"text":"Amaute amaana gamta minam le Pasian thupiak a mangngilh lo bang kekin ni khat khit ni khat kei hong zongin ka lampi a thei nuam bangin a om uh hi. Amaute in thutanga thukhensatna hong ngen uh a, Pasian a kiangua pai ding a lawp tawh kibang uh hi.","ref":"Isa 48:1; Tit 1:16; Jas 4:8; Isa 29:13"},"3":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘Bang hangin nang muh lohin an tang ka hi uh hiam? Nang theih lohin bang hangin kote kiniamkhiat ka hi uh hiam?’ ci uh hi. \"Tua hi napi na antan ni-un no nopsak bangin na na sem uh a, na nasemte khempeuh uh na nuaisiah uh hi.","ref":"Sp 16:29; Pk 10:3"},"4":{"text":"Na antanna uh kitotna le kilaina-in bei a, khat le khat khuttuma kitupna-in na zang uh hi. Tuni-a bangin an na tang uh a, a sangna-ah na aw uh hong kizak ding na lamen kei uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 21:9-13; Isa 59:6; Isa 59:2"},"5":{"text":"Kei teel antanna in mi khat amah le amah ni khat sung kiniamkhiat lel ding ahi hiam? Pumpeng bangin a lu kun a ippi puan silhin vut laka lup lel kei deih antan nam ahi hiam? TOPA san theih ding ni khat sung antan na cih uh tua ahi hiam?","ref":"Zec 7:5; 1Ku 21:27; Job 2:8"},"6":{"text":"\"Kei teel antan hih bang nam ahi hi: A thutang lo khainiangte kolsak nading le hakkol khaute phel nading, a kinengniamte khah nading le hakkol peuhmah suktan nading hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Joel 2:12-14; Jer 34:9; Isa 9:4"},"7":{"text":"Gilkial mite an vaka mizawng kawivakte omna guana guaktanga omte na muh uh ciangin puan guana, note si le sa taktak ahi mite na kiheisan lohna uh hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Eze 18:16; Job 31:19-20; Pc 29:14; Lk 10:31-32"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin na khuavak uh phalvak bangin suakkhia dinga, na damsakna uh kilangkhia pah ding hi; tua ciangin na thumaanna a uh na mai-uah pai dinga, TOPA minthanna in note nungah hong dal ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:26; Isa 26:2"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA na sam ding uh a amah’n hong dawng ding hi; huhna na ngen ding uh a, amah in: Hiah ka om hi, hong ci ding hi. \"A kinengniamte hakkol paih mangsak in, khutme in mi kawk lo a, mi nat nading kampau loin","ref":"Ph 50:15; Ph 12:2"},"10":{"text":"gilkialte tangin nangmah kizang a, a kinengniamte gil na vahsak leh tua ciangin khuamial lakah na khuavak tangin note zan hun sun tawh a kibang ding hi.","ref":"Tp 15:7-8; Isa 42:16"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in hong makaih tawntung ding hi; keugawgam ah na kisapna hong kicingsak dinga, na guh na tang a khauhsak ding hi. Kicingtaka tui a ngah huan tawh na kibang dinga, tui a kang ngei lo ciktui na bang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 48:14; Ph 72:16; Zai 4:15; Jn 4:14"},"12":{"text":"Na mite un, tanglai-a kisia khuapite lam kik ding uh a, tangtawnga kisia bulkipte a zomto ding uh hi; Note, Kulh Kicimsa Puahkikte, Ten nadinga Lampi Puahphate, hong kici ding hi.","ref":"Isa 49:8; Isa 44:28; Ne 2:17"},"13":{"text":"\"Sabbath palsat loh nadingin na khe na kep a, ka ni siangtho ni nang nopsak bangin zang lo-a, Sabbath ni a deihhuai ni le a pahtawi huai TOPA ni siangtho hi ci a, nang deih bang zui loin nang nopsak bangin gamta lo a, na mot paupau kei leh","ref":"Ph 84:2,10"},"14":{"text":"tua ciangin TOPA sungah lungnopna na mu dinga, leitung a sangnate ah hong khaangto-in na pa Jacob luahte-in kong vak ding hi,\" TOPA kam in cikhia khin hi.","ref":"Job 22:26; Tp 32:13; Ph 105:10-11"}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A honkhia zo lo dingin TOPA khut tom lua lo a, a za lo dingin a bengngong lo hi.","title":"Mawhna, Kipulakna le Tatkhiatna","ref":"Ms 11:23; Isa 50:2"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin na khialhnate in na Pasian kiang panin hong khenkhia khin hi. Amah in hong zak loh nadingin na mawhnate in ama maitang a liah hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, na khutte sisanin nin a, na khutmete khialhna-in a nin hi. Na kam un zuauthu gen a, na leii un gitlohna nate a gen ziahziah hi.","ref":"Isa 1:15; Ph 7:3"},"4":{"text":"Kuamah in thutang zong lo a, kuamah in citakin a thu a sung kei hi. Amaute in kisel mawkmawkna muangin zuau a gen uh hi; haksatna paii-in gitlohna a suakkhia uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:23; Isa 44:20"},"5":{"text":"Thangtom tui op uh a, maimom khau a phan uh hi. Amaute tui a ne peuhpeuh si dinga, khat a kitap ciangin thangtom khat a keuh ding hi."},"6":{"text":"A maimom khau uh puan in kimang lo a; amau bawlsa tawh a kituam thei kei uh hi. A nasep uh gitloh nasep hi-a, a khutun gamhtatna bek a sem hi.","ref":"Isa 28:20; Isa 58:4"},"7":{"text":"A khe uh mawhna bawl dingin manlang a, mawhpengte sisan luansak ding a kin uh hi. A ngaihsut uh gitloh ngaihsutna hi a; amau lampi ah kisiatna le siatna sul a pai hi.","ref":"Pn 6:17; Mk 7:21-22; Ro 3:15-17*"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in lemna lampi thei lo uh a; amau lampi-ah thutang a om kei hi. Amaute lamkawi-ah kihei khin uh a, amaute a zui peuhpeuh in lemna a thei kei hi.","ref":"Ro 3:15-17*; Isa 57:21"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin eite thutang tawh i kigamla a, thumaanna in eite hong ban kei hi. Eite in khuavak i zon hangin khuamial bekbek ahi hi; A tanphatna i zon hangin a mial bikbek ah i pai hi.","ref":"Isa 5:30"},"10":{"text":"Mittaw bangin kawm zui teng i zawtzawt a, mittang nei lo bangin lampi i zawt hi. Khua khalvak-a pai bangin suntangpi-in i muktu a; a thahatte lakah misi i bang hi.","ref":"Tp 28:29; Isa 8:15; Ta 3:6"},"11":{"text":"Eite khempeuh vom bangin i humham a; kawl vakhu bangin i thum ngutngut hi. Thutang i zon hangin khatbeek i mu kei a; i kihut nading a gamla mahmah hi.","ref":"Isa 38:14; Eze 7:16"},"12":{"text":"Ahang in, nangma muhna-ah ka mawhna uh tam a, ka mawhna un kote langah teci a pang hi. I mawhnate ei tungah omden a, i tatkhialhnate i thei hi;","ref":"Ezr 9:6; Isa 3:9; Ph 51:3"},"13":{"text":"Lehdona le kitheihmawhbawlna-in TOPA i langpan a, Pasian i nungngatsan hi. Netniamna le lehdona tawh kisatsuahin i lungsim ah zuauthu i paii hi.","ref":"Isa 46:8; Tit 1:16; Isa 5:7; Mk 7:21-22"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin thutang kithalsawn kik a, thumaan a gamla hi; lampite ah thutak muktu a, thudik a tum thei kei hi.","ref":"Isa 1:21; Isa 48:1"},"15":{"text":"Koimah ah thutak kimu lo a, gitlohna a pel peuhmah a kiman zawsop hi. TOPA in en a, thutang mu lo ahi manin a lungkim kei hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in khat beek a om loh lam mu a, amau tanga ngetsak ding khat beek a muh loh ciangin lunghimawh a, ama khutin ama hotkhiatna semin, ama thumaanna in amah lenkip hi.","ref":"Ph 98:1; Isa 45:8,13"},"17":{"text":"Amah in thumaanna awmdalin bulh a, a lu ah hotkhiatna sik lukhu a khu hi; amah in phulakna puan silh a, deihluatna-in kituama puantualpi-in a nei hi.","ref":"Eph 6:14; 1Th 5:8; Isa 63:3; Isa 9:7"},"18":{"text":"Amaute sepnasa tawh kizui-in, amah in thuk kik dinga, ama galte tungah thangpai-in a langte dan a thuaksak ding hi; tuikulh mite amau thuak ding bangin a thuk ding hi.","ref":"Mt 16:27"},"19":{"text":"Nitumna lamah mite in TOPA min kihta ding uh a, nisuahkhiatna lamah ama minthanna a zahtak mahmah ding uh hi. Ahang in, TOPA huu in a mut tuikhang vat tawh kibang zui-in a amah hong pai ding hi.","ref":"Ph 113:3; Isa 11:4"},"20":{"text":"\"A mawhna uh a kisik Jacob-te kiangah Zion ah Tanpa hong pai ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ro 11:26-27*; Job 19:25; Isa 52:8"},"21":{"text":"\"Kei adingin ahi leh hih in amaute tawh ka thukhun ahi hi\" TOPA in a ci hi. \"Note sunga om ka Kha le note kam tunga ka guansa kammalte na kam uh tawh kikhenkhia lo dinga, na tate kam, a suan le khakte kam tawh tu le a tawntungin a kikhenkhia kei ding hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Na khuavak hong tung zo-a, tho inla tang in; TOPA minthanna nang tungah hong suak ta hi.","title":"Zion Minthanna","ref":"Eph 5:14; Isa 4:5"},"2":{"text":"En in, khuamial in leitung tuama, khuamial sahpi in mite a tuam hi; ahi hangin nang tungah TOPA hong suakin ama minthanna nang tungah kilang hi.","ref":"Col 1:13"},"3":{"text":"Minamte in na khuavak hong zuan ding uh a, kumpite in na phalvak tangpha hong zuan ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 45:14; Kil 21:24; Isa 49:23"},"4":{"text":"\"Dakto inla en kawikawi in: A vekpi-un kikaikhawmin nang hong zuan uh hi; gamlapi pan na tapate hong pai uh a, na tanute ong khuttawi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 11:12"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin enin na maitaang dinga na lungtang kisai-in lungnuamin a khang ding hi; tuipi tunga hauhnate na tungah hong kipuak dinga, minamte hauhna in nang hong zuan ding hi.","ref":"Pk 34:29; Isa 35:2; Tp 33:19"},"6":{"text":"Midian-te le Ephah-te kala-oh note, kala-oh honte in na gam a tuam ding hi. Kham le gim namtui pua-in TOPA phatna tangko-in Sheba a om khempeuh hong pai ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 25:2,4; Isa 42:10"},"7":{"text":"Kedar tuuhonte khempeuh nang kiangah hong kipuak dinga, Nebaioth tuutalte in nang na semin, ka biakna-tau ah biakna-in kisang dinga, keimah in a minthangsa ka biakinnpi ka zem ding hi.","ref":"Pc 25:13; Hag 2:3,7,9"},"8":{"text":"\"Meii lakah leng a, a bu zuan kawlvakhu tawh a kibang kuate ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 49:21"},"9":{"text":"Tuikulhte in kei lam hong en takpi uh a; Tarshish a tembawpite in makaih hi; amah in thupina nang hong pia khin ahi manin, Israel-te Siangtho Pa na Pasian le TOPA a pahtawi dingin a ngun a kham uh tawh na tapate uh a gamlapi panin hong puak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 2:16; Ph 22:23; Isa 55:5"},"10":{"text":"\"Gamdang mite in na kulhte uh ciang kik ding uh a, a kumpite un na na uh sem ding uh hi. Hehna-in nang kong sat hangin, kong angvanna-in ka khuatuahna kong lak hi.","ref":"Isa 14:1-2; Isa 49:23; Kil 21:24; Isa 54:8"},"11":{"text":"Mite in minamte hauhna hong puak theih nading - a kumpite un makaihin a gualzawhna tawh a gualguala hong lut nadingun na kongpite uh honsa-in om den dinga, sun le zanin a kikhak ngei kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 149:8; Isa 62:10; Kil 21:25"},"12":{"text":"Ahang in, nang na a sem lo minam ahikeh kumpi-gam peuhmah mangthang dinga; a kisiamang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2"},"13":{"text":"\"Lebanon minthanna - taksing, hiangpa sing le taksan singte khempeuh, ka mun siangtho a kilawmsak dingin na kiangah hong tung dinga; ka khepek ngakna mun ka minthangsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 35:2; Isa 41:19; 1Kh 28:2; Ph 132:7"},"14":{"text":"Nang hong nengniamte’ tapate na mai-ah kunsa-in hong pai ding uh a; nang hong simmawhte khempeuh na khephungah bokin TOPA khuapi, Israel-te’ Siangtho Pa’ Zion hong ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2; Isa 1:26; Heb 12:22"},"15":{"text":"\"Hong kimudahin hong kinusia a, kuamah in khualzinna-in hong tot loh hangin a kisathei den le khang tawntunga nuamsa-in kong bawl ding hi.","ref":"Isa 33:8; Isa 4:2; Isa 65:18"},"16":{"text":"Minamte’ nawi na dawn ding uh a, kumpi nawitui-in na kivak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin TOPA keimah note Honpa note Tanpa, Jacob Thahatpen Pa ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 49:23; 66:11-12; Isa 59:20"},"17":{"text":"Sumngo tangin kham, sik munah ngun kong puak ding hi. Sing tangin sumngo, suang munah sik kong puak ding hi. Na gam-ukpa uh lemna ka suaksak dinga, na ukpa uh thumaanna ka suaksak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 85:8; Isa 66:12"},"18":{"text":"Na gam sungah ngongtatna kiza nawn lo dinga, na gamgite ah siatna le suksiatna om loin, na kulhte Hotkhiatna ci-in, na kongpite Phatna na ci ding hi.","ref":"Isa 26:1; Isa 61:11"},"19":{"text":"TOPA pen a tawntunga na khuavak hi-in, Na Pasian, na minthanna hi ding ahi manin, sunin na khuavak ni hi nawn lo dinga, khapi tanna in nang hong tan nawn kei ding hi;","ref":"Kil 22:5; Zec 2:5; Kil 21:23"},"20":{"text":"Na ni tum kik ngei nawn lo dinga, na khapi a mang nawn kei ding hi; TOPA na khuavak hi tawntung dinga, na dahna nite a bei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 35:10"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin na mite khempeuh thumaan ta ding uh a, amaute in tua gam a nei den ding uh hi. Ka thupina a kilat nadingin, amaute ka khuta ka sep ka suansa pana selte hi ding uh hi.","ref":"Kil 21:27; Ph 37:11,22; Isa 52:1; Mt 15:13"},"22":{"text":"Note a tawmpen tul khat na pha ding uh a, a neu penpen minam thahat na suak ding uh hi. Keimah TOPA ka hi hi; a hun ciangin hih thu manlangtakin ka sem ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 5:19"}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mizawngte tungah lungdamna thu hilh dingin TOPA in kei sathau hong nilh khin ahi manin Thupipen TOPA ’ Kha kei tungah a om hi. Amah in lungsim kitamte khui kik ding, sal-a kimante suahtak nading le thong a kiate a khahkhiat nading tangko ding,","title":"Angvan Kum","ref":"Mt 11:5; Lk 7:22; Ph 45:7; Isa 11:2; Isa 57:15; Isa 42:7; 49:9"},"2":{"text":"TOPA angvan kum le eite Pasian phulak ni tangko-a, a thumte khempeuh hehnemin,","ref":"Lk 4:18-19*; Isa 34:8"},"3":{"text":"Zion-a om a dahte huhin - amau lutungah vut tangin kumpi lukhu a khusak ding, thumna tangin nuamna sathau, le lungkiatna kha tangin phatna puan a pia dingin kei hong sawl zo hi. ama thupina a kilat nadingin amaute, TOPA suansa thumaanna tehno kungte, kici ding hi.","ref":"Isa 3:23; Isa 1:6; Isa 60:20-21; Ph 1:3"},"4":{"text":"Amaute in tanglai-a kisiasate bawlpha in, a maimangsate a ding kiksak ding uh hi; amaute in khuapi kisiate puah kikin, khang tampi a maimangsa khuapite a puahpha ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 49:8; Eze 36:33; Am 9:14"},"5":{"text":"Pemtate in na tuuhonte uh cing ding uh a; gamdang mite in na lo uh le na lenggui lote uh a kho ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:1-2"},"6":{"text":"Tuateh note, TOPA ’ siampite hong kici dinga, Pasian’ nasemte ci-in hong kilo ding hi. Minamte neihsa-in na kivak ding uh a, amaute hauhna na kisaktheihpih ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 19:6; 1Pe 2:5; Isa 60:11"},"7":{"text":"Ka mite in amau maizumna tangin a zahnih tang ding uh a, amaute mindaina tangin amau luahna nuam a sa ding uh hi; tua ciangin amau gamah a zah nih luah ding uh a, tawntung nopsakna amau aa hi ta ding hi.","ref":"Isa 40:2; Isa 60:21; Isa 25:9"},"8":{"text":"Ahang in, keimah TOPA in thutang ka it a; mite neihsa suhna le khialhna ka mudah hi. Ka muanhuaina hangin amaute pahtakman ka pia dinga, amaute tawh tawntung thukhun ka bawl ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Minamte lakah amaute suan le khakte kitangtheih dinga, amau suante mite lakah a kitang theih ding hi. Amaute a mu peuhmah in TOPA thupha piaksa minam ahilam a tel ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 43:5"},"10":{"text":"TOPA sungah nuam ka sa mahmah a, ka Pasian sungah ka kha a kipak hi. Ahang in, zi neipa in siampipa bangin a lu a zep bang le, suangmanpha-in monu a kizep bangin amah in hotkhiatna puante kei hong silhsak khin a, thumaanna puantualpi-in kei hong zem khin hi.","ref":"Isa 49:18; Ph 132:9"},"11":{"text":"Ahang in, lei hoih in mengkhiasakin, huan in khaici a posak bangin Thupipen TOPA in minam khempeuh mai-ah thumaanna le phatna a phulkhiasak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 85:11"}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion’ thumaanna phalvak bangin tang a, Jerusalem’ hotkhiatna meisel kuang a bat matengin, Zion ka khualna-in ka dai kei dinga, Jerusalem ka khualna-in ka dai om kei ding hi.","title":"Zion’ Minthak","ref":"Isa 1:26; Ph 67:2; Ph 50:21"},"2":{"text":"Minamte in na thumaanna mu ding uh a, kumpi khempeuh in na minthanna a mu ding uh hi. TOPA kam in nang hong phuah ding minthakin nang hong kisam ding hi.","ref":"Isa 52:10; tg 4, 12; Isa 1:6"},"3":{"text":"TOPA khut sungah nang, thupina lukhu na hi dinga na Pasian khut sungah kumpi kilawmna lukhu na hi ding hi.","ref":"Zec 9:16; 1Th 2:19"},"4":{"text":"Amaute in nang, Nusiatsa hong ci nawn loin, na min Gamkhing a ci nawn kei ding uh hi. Ahi hangin, nang tungah TOPA lungkim a, na leitang inlah pasal nei ta ding ahi manin nang Hephzibah b hong kici in, na leitang Beulah c kici ding hi.","ref":"Isa 54:6; Jer 32:41; Zep 3:17; Jer 3:14; Hos 2:19"},"5":{"text":"Tangvalno khat in nungakno khat a tenpih bangin, na tapate a in nang hong tenpih ding uh a, zineipa a mo tungah a kipah bangin nang tungah na Pasian a kipak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 65:19; Zep 3:17"},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na kulhte tungah galvilte ka koih khin a, amaute sun le zanin a gamdai ngei kei ding hi. TOPA a sam note, mawkkhawl tawm kei unla,"},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem a kipsak mateng le tuanu leitung phatna a suahsak matengin amah khawlsak kei un.","ref":"Tp 26:19"},"8":{"text":"A khut taklam le a khut thahatna-in TOPA kiciam khin a: \"Na antangte uh na galte uh an dingin ka pia kik ngei nawn kei dinga, note sepsa zu thak gamdang mite in a dawn kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi;"},"9":{"text":"ahi hangin an late in ne-in TOPA phat ding uh a, lenggah kaikhawmte in ka mun siangtho huang sungah a dawn ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 1:19; Tp 12:7; Sp 23:39"},"10":{"text":"Pusuak un, kongpite ah pusuakkhia un! Mite pai nading lampi sial un. Zik un, lam lianpi zik un! Suangte khukkhia un! Minamte adingin dialkhai khaito un.","ref":"Isa 60:11; Isa 11:16; 57:14"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in leimongte dongin tangko khin a: \"Zion Tanu tungah gen un, ‘En in, na Honpa hong pai ta! En in, a pahtakman hong kenga, a ditkikna hong tonpih hi,’ ci un,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute, Mi Siangtho, TOPA Tatsate kici dinga, nang, Zonkhiat, nusiat ngei nawn loh Khuapi, hong kici ding hi.","ref":"tg 4, Pc 32:28; 1Pe 2:9"}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Edom-a Bozrah pan hong pai a puan kheisan-a kidiahpa kua ahi hiam? Thupina puanin silh a alian mahmah hatna tawh mai nawtpa kua ahi hiam? \"A hon zo dinga thahat, thumaan genpa keimah ka hi hi,\"","title":"Pasian Phulakna le Tatkhiatna Ni","ref":"2Kh 28:17; Am 1:12; Isa 45:24; Isa 46:13"},"2":{"text":"Bang hangin na puante lenggah cilpa aa bangin san ahi hiam?","ref":"Pc 49:11"},"3":{"text":"\"Keimah kia in lenggah cilna ka cil khin a, minamte kuamah in hong ompih kei hi. Hehsa in amaute ka cilgawp a, ka thangpai-in ka tuancilgawp hi; amaute sisan in ka puante theh a; ka puansilh khempeuh ah ka baangsak hi.","ref":"Kil 14:20; 19:15; Isa 22:5; Kil 19:13"},"4":{"text":"Ka lungsimin phulak ni ka ngaihsun a, kei hong kitatkhiatna kum lah a tungta hi.","ref":"Jer 50:15"},"5":{"text":"Ka khuadak hangin hong huh ding khat beek om lo a, hong panpih ding khat beek om loin hong linglawngsak hi; tua ciangin ka hotkhiatna nasep ka khut in sem a, ka thangpaihna in keimah hong kipsak hi.","ref":"Isa 41:28; Ph 44:3; Isa 59:16"},"6":{"text":"Hehsa-in minamte ka tuancilgawp a; thangpaihna tawh ka amsakgawp a, tua ciangin a sisan uh lei lakah ka buakhia hi.","ref":"Ph 108:13; Isa 29:9; Isa 34:3"},"7":{"text":"Eite adingin TOPA in a sepnasa tawh kizui-in ama migitna le a sepnasa hangin phathuai hi - hihi, Israel innkuante adingin na hoih tampi a bawlnasate, ama khuatuahna le a migitna tampi tawh kizui-in TOPA migitna ka gen ding hi.","title":"Phatna le Thungetna","ref":"Pk 18:9; Isa 54:8"},"8":{"text":"Amah in, \"Amaute, ka mite hi takpi a, kei tunga hong khial lo ding tapate ahi uh hi,\" a ci hi; tua ahi ciangin amaute Honpa a suak hi.","ref":"Isa 51:4; Isa 25:9"},"9":{"text":"Amaute lungdonna khempeuh lungdonpih a, ama ompihna vansawltak in amaute a hon hi. Ama itna le a lainatna hangin amaute tankhia a; amaute laamtoin tanglai nite khempeuh ah a tonpih den hi.","ref":"Tp 7:7-8; Tp 1:31, 32:7"},"10":{"text":"Tua hi napi amaute in lehdo uh a, ama Khasiangtho a dahsak uh hi. Tua ciangin amah kihei-in amaute gal suak a, amah mah in amaute a do hi.","ref":"Ph 78:40; Ph 106:40; Jos 10:14"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama mite in tanglai nite, Moses le a mite hun a phawk b kik uh hi - amaute le a tuute uh, tuucingpa tawh tuipi kantana a paipihpa koi-ah om ta ahi hiam? Amaute lakah Khasiangtho a omsakpa;"},"12":{"text":"Moses khut taklam-a om dingin a minthang a khut vangliatna a sawlpa, amaute mai-ah tui kikhensak a, amah a kitheih den nading a ngahpa,","ref":"Pk 14:21-22; Isa 11:15"},"13":{"text":"tuithukte kantana a makaihpa, koi-ah om ahi hiam? Gamlaka sakol bangin amaute a muktu kei uh hi;","ref":"Tp 32:12; Jer 31:9"},"14":{"text":"Zanglei zuansuk bawnghon bangin TOPA Kha in amaute tawldamsak hi. Nangma min na thansak nadingin hih bang zia-in na mite na makaih hi."},"15":{"text":"Vantung panin hong ensuk inla, a siangtho a minthang sangpi-a om na tokhom panin hong mu in. Na deihluatna le na liatna koi-ah om ahi hiam? Na lungnemna le na khuatuahna kote tung panin kidokkik ta ahi hiam?","ref":"Tp 26:15; Ph 80:14; Ph 123:1; Isa 9:7; Jer 31:20; Hos 11:8"},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang kote Pa na hi a, Abraham in kote hong thei loin, Israel in kote hong phawk khak loh hangin TOPA aw, nang kote Pa, tang lai-a kipan na min kote Tanpa na hi hi.","ref":"Pk 4:22; Isa 41:14;44:6"},"17":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong zahtak loh nadingun bang hangin na lampi pan hong pialsak-a, ka lungsim uh khauhsak na hi hiam? Na nasemte, nangma gouluah minamte nong khualna-in hong kihei kik in.","ref":"Pk 34:9; Ms 10:36"},"18":{"text":"Na mite in hun tomno sung nangma munsiangtho nei uh a, ahi hangin tu-in ka galte un na munsiangtho tuancil ta uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:26; 11:17; Ph 74:3-8"},"19":{"text":"Tanglai-a kipan kote nang aa ka hi uh hi; ahi hangin amaute na uk ngei loh, nang min-a a kisam ngei lote ahi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 43:7"}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangma mai-ah mualliante a kilin nadingin vantungte balkekin hong kumsuk ve!","ref":"Ph 144:5; Mic 1:3"},"2":{"text":"Mei in selkang kuangsak a tui a so bangin, hong paisukin na galte tungah na min kitheisak inla na mai-ah minamte lingsak in.","ref":"Ph 99:1"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, ka lamet loh uh a mulkimhuai nate na bawl lai-in nong paisuk a, na mai-ah mualliante a kiling hi.","ref":"Ph 65:5"},"4":{"text":"Tanglai-a kipan, amah a ngakte cihna-a na a sepsak nang longal Pasian khat beek kiza lo a, bil in zong za kha loin mit khat beek in a mu ngei kei hi.","ref":"Isa 43:10-11"},"5":{"text":"Na lampi phawkin lungtaitakin thumaana na a semte na huh hi. Ahi hangin ka mawh ngitnget uh ciangin nang na heh hi.
