Kote bang ka kici hotkhiat thei ding uh hiam?","ref":"Isa 10:4"},"6":{"text":"Kote khempeuh a siang lo mipa ka bang uh a, thumaana ka sep khempeuh uh puanninte tawh a kibang hi; kote khempeuh nahthel keu ka bang uh a, ka mawhnate un huih bangin kote hong mutleng mang hi.","ref":"Sp 5:2; Isa 46:12; Jer 4:12"},"7":{"text":"Kote na maitang nong selsan a , ka mawhna hangun hong patkhiasak na hi manin kuamah in na min hong sam loin pom hong sawm a om kei hi.","ref":"Tp 31:18; Isa 1:15; 54:8"},"8":{"text":"Tua hi napi TOPA aw, nang kote Pa na hi lai veve hi. Nang beelseekpa hi-in kote tungman ka hi uh a; na khuta nong bawlsa ka hi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 63:16; Isa 29:16; Isa 19:25"},"9":{"text":"TOPA aw, nak heh lua kei inla ka mawhnate uh ciamteh tawntung kei in. Kote khempeuh nangma mi ka hi manun kong thum uh hi, ko lam hong nga in.","ref":"Isa 57:17; Isa 43:25"},"10":{"text":"Na khuapi siangthote sehnel-gam suak ta a; Zion nangawn sehnel-gam suakin Jerusalem gamkhing a suak hi.","ref":"Isa 1:26"},"11":{"text":"A siangtho a minthang ka biakinnpi uh, ka pate un nang hong phatna mun, mei in kangtum ta a, ka gou koih khempeuh uh kisia ta hi.","ref":"Ph 74:3-7; Ta 1:7,10"},"12":{"text":"TOPA aw, hihte khempeuh nungin nang ki-ip lailai ding na hi hiam? Nang dai khikhe-in dan hong thuaksaksak lai ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 83:1"}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Kei hong kan lote tungah kei le kei ka kilaak a; kei hong zong lote in hong mu uh hi. Ka min hong sam lo minam khat tungah, ‘Hiah ka om hi, hiah ka om hi,’ ka ci hi.","title":"Thukhenna le Hotkhiatna","ref":"Ro 10:20*; Eph 2:12"},"2":{"text":"Sun nilohin a paupeng mite tungah ka khut ka zan hi, tua mite pen amau ngaihsutna zui-a lampi hoih lo a tawnte","ref":"Ph 81:11-12"},"3":{"text":"huan sungah kithoihna-in biakna pia-a leisek biakna-tau ah gim namtui halin ka maitang tekteka hong hehsakte;","ref":"Job 1:11"},"4":{"text":"han lakah tu-a zan thapai-in thungena a dap zan hahhahte; voksa nete le amau beel sunga sa siang lo tui a koihte;"},"5":{"text":"‘Nang a dingin siangtho lua ka hih manin kihemkhia inla, hong neh kei in!’ a ci mite ahi uh hi. Tua bang mite ka nak vang sungah meikhu hi uh a, sun niloh a kuang den mei ahi uh hi."},"6":{"text":"\"En in, ka mai-ah gelhsa-in a om hi: Daitakin ka om nawn kei dinga, cingtakin ka thuk ding hi;","ref":"Ph 50:3; Ph 79:12"},"7":{"text":"amaute ang sungah note mawhna le na pate uh mawhnate ka thuk khawm ding hi,\" TOPA in ci hi \"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in mualliante tungah kithoihna hal uh a, mualneute tungah ka min daisak uh ahi manin amau sepsate thaman a cingin amau ang sungah, teh in ka thuk ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 20:5; Pn 10:24"},"8":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Lenggah bom ah lenggah tui om lai a, mite in, ‘Tuate sungah a hoih pawlkhat om lai, susia dah un,’ a cih bangin, ka nasemte ka khualna-in tua bangin ka hih dinga a vekun ka susia khin kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 54:17"},"9":{"text":"Ka mualliante a nei dingin Jacob pan le Judah panin suan le khak ka piangkhiasak dinga; ka teelsa mite in tuate luahin, tua lai-ah ka nasemte a teng ding uh hi.","ref":"Am 9:11-15; Isa 45:19"},"10":{"text":"Kei hong zong ka mite adingin Sharon in, tuuhon gamtatna mun suak dinga, Achor Kuam, bawnghon giahna mun a suak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 35:2"},"11":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin TOPA a taisan ka mual siangtho a mangngilh nang, Kam-etna a sabuai phah a, Sehkholhna adingin zuhelsa hai a sungpa,","ref":"Tp 29:24-25; Isa 1:28; Ph 137:5; Isa 5:22"},"12":{"text":"ken, namsau adingin nang kong sehkhol dinga, hong ngawngtan dingte dawhin na vekun na kun ding uh hi; ahang in, kong sap hangin nong dawng kei uh a, kong gen hangin na ngai kei uh hi. Kei muhin gitlohna na sem uh a, kei hong lungkimsak lote na teel uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 27:1; Pn 1:24-25; Isa 41:28; 2Kh 36:15-16;Jer 7:13; Isa 1:24; 66:4"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Thupipen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Ka nasemte in ne ding uh a, note na hi uh leh na gilkial ding uh hi; ka nasemte in dawn ding uh a, note na hi uh leh na dangtak ding uh hi; ka nasemte nuamsa ding uh a, note na hi uh leh hong kimaizumsak ding hi;","ref":"Isa 1:19; Isa 33:16; Isa 60:5; Isa 44:9"},"14":{"text":"Ka nasemte in amau lungsima pusuakkhia lungdamna la sa ding uh a, note na hi uh leh na lunggim man uh leh na lungsim uh a kitapna hangin tau-in na kapkhia ding uh hi.","ref":"Mt 8:12"},"15":{"text":"Ka mite in hamsiatna-a zat dingin na min uh na nusia ding uh a; Thupipen TOPA in note hong thatin, ahi hangin ama nasemte mindang a pia ding hi.","ref":"Zec 8:13"},"16":{"text":"Leitungah thupha a ngen peuhmah in thutak Pasian suangin a hih ding hi; leitungah a kiciamte in thutak Pasian ah tomlo ding hi. Ahang in, a beisa-a lungkhamnate kimangngilhin ka mit panin kisel ta ding hi.","ref":"Tp 29:19; Ph 31:5; Isa 19:18; Job 11:16"},"17":{"text":"\"En un, a thak vante le lei thak khat ka piangsak ding hi. A masa nate kiphawk nawn loin lungsimin zong a kingaihsun kha kei ding hi.","title":"A Thak Vante le Lei Thak","ref":"Isa 66:22; 2Pe 3:13; Isa 43:18"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin, Jerusalem nopsakna-in ka piangsak dinga a sunga tengte nuamsa ding uh ahi manin ka piansaksa sungah nuamsa-in kipak tawntung un."},"19":{"text":"Jerusalem tungah ka lungnuam dinga, ka mite laka om nuam ka sa ding hi; tua sungah kahna le kikona aw kiza nawn lo ding hi.","ref":"Isa 25:8; Kil 7:17"},"20":{"text":"\"Tua sungah naupang a ngeklai-a si om nawn lo dinga, putek a nuntak ding tan a nungta lo a om kei ding hi; kum za khat nungta-a site, a khansih in kingaihsun ding hi; kum za pha a lo-a site hamsia thuakin kiseh ding hi.","ref":"Thn 8:13"},"21":{"text":"Amaute in inn lamin a sungah teng ding uh hi, lengguite suan ding uh a, a gah a ne ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 32:18; Isa 37:30"},"22":{"text":"Amaute lamsa inn sungah midangte teng nawn lo dinga, amau suansate midangte in a ne kei ding hi. Ahang in, singkung khat a hin tan mah ka mite nungta ding uh a; ka teelsate in amau sepsa nuamtakin sawtpi a ne ding uh hi.","ref":"Tp 28:30; Ph 21:4; 91:16; Isa 14:1"},"23":{"text":"Amaute, amaute le a suan a khakte uh TOPA thupha piak ahi manin, a mawkna-a nasep suak loin, khasiat nading lelin ta a nei kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Ns 2:39; Isa 49:4; Jer 16:3-4"},"24":{"text":"Amaute hong sap ma-in ka dawng dinga; amaute a paupau laitakun ka na za ding hi.","ref":"Da 9:20-23; 10:12"},"25":{"text":"Keivom le tuuno gamta khawm dinga, humpinelkai in bawngtal bangin buhtu a ne ding hi; ahi hangin gulpi an ahileh leivui mah hi ding hi. Ka mual siangtho tung khempeuh ah amaute a kiliamsak a kisusia a om kei ding uh hi,\" TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:6; Pc 3:14; Mic 7:17"}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Vantung ka tokhom hi a, leitung ka khe-ngakna ahi hi. Kei adingin na lam ding uh inn koi lai-ah om ahi hiam? Ka tawlngak nading mun koi lai ahi hiam?","title":"Thukhenna le Lametna","ref":"1Ku 8:27; Mt 5:34-35; 2Sa 7:7"},"2":{"text":"Hih nate khempeuh ka khut in a bawlsa hi a, tua ciangin tuate na-a hong om hi lo ahi hiam?\" TOPA in ci hi. \"Ka thupi ngaihsut hih mipa ahi hi: kiniamkhiatin a lungsimin kisika ka thu hanga a lingpa ahi hi.","ref":"Ns 7:50*; Isa 57:15"},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin bawngtalin biakna a piapa mi thatpa tawh kibanga, tuuno khat go-a biakna a pia peuhmah ui ngawngtanpa tawh kibang hi; an-a biakna a pia peuhmah vok sisan piapa tawh kibanga, tuateh phawkna-a gimnamtui a hal peuhmah milim biapa tawh kibang ahi hi. Amaute in amau deih zia le tong teel khin uh a, amaute hinna in a kihhuaite nuam sa uh hi;","ref":"Sp 2:2; Isa 57:17"},"4":{"text":"tua ahi ciangin amaute ka bawlsiat nadingin haksatna ka teel dinga amaute kihtak pen amau tungah ka tungsak ding hi. Ahang in, ka sap ciangin kuamah in hong dawng lo uh a, ka gen ciangin kuamah in a ngai kei uh hi. Amaute in kei muhin gitlohna sem uh a, kei hong lungkimsak lo nate a teel uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pn 10:24; Pn 1:24; Jer 7:13; Isa 65:12"},"5":{"text":"No ama thu hanga lingte aw, TOPA kammal za un: \"Na sanggamte un keima min hangin hong mudahin hong hawlkhia uh a, ‘Na lungnopna uh i muh theih nadingin TOPA kiminthangsak hen!’ ci uh hi. A tua cih uh hangin amaute a kimaizumsak ding hi.","ref":"Lk 13:17"},"6":{"text":"Khuapi pana husa za unla, biakinnpi pana gamlumna za un! Tua in, TOPA in a galte amau thuak dinga kilawma a thuhna awging ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 65:6; Joel 3:7"},"7":{"text":"\"Tua nu in nausuahnatna a thuak ma-in nau suaka, a tungah natna a tun ma-in tapa khat a nei hi.","ref":"Kil 12:5"},"8":{"text":"Tua bang na kua in za ngei ahi hiam? Tua bang na kua in mu ngei ahi hiam? Ni khatin gam khat suakkhia thei a, tomkha sungin minam khat piangkhia thei ahi hiam? Tua hi napi Zion inlah nausuahnatna a thuakphetin a tate a suak pah hi.","ref":"Isa 64:4; Isa 49:21"},"9":{"text":"Ta suah hun tungsak napi ta suaksak lo ka hi hiam?\" TOPA in a ci hi. \"Ka suahsak ding ciangin a sul khakcip ka hi hiam?\" note Pasian in a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 37:3"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem a it note khempeuh aw, amah tawh nuamsa unla, ama hangin kipak un; ama hanga a thum note khempeuh aw, amah tawh nuamsa khawm un.","ref":"Tp 32:43, Ph 26:8"},"11":{"text":"Ahang in, ama angah hehnepna nawi na teepteep ding uh a, na gilvah ding uh hi; a nawi gau mahmah nuam na sa ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 60:16"},"12":{"text":"Ahang in, hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Gun bangin ama lungnopsakna ka khangsak dinga, minamte hauhna lui khang ka bangsak ding hi; a khutin hong tawi-in a nawi na teep ding uh a, a khuk tungah na diang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 48:18; Isa 60:4"},"13":{"text":"Nu khatin a ta a hehnep bangin, nang kong hehnem dinga; Jerusalem tungtang thu ah nang hong kihehnem ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 40:1"},"14":{"text":"Hih thu na muh uh ciangin na lungsim uh nuam dinga, lopa bangin na nosuak ding uh hi; ama nasemte tungah TOPA khut kilang dinga ahi hangin a galte tungah a hehna a lak ding hi.","ref":"Joel 2:23; Isa 54:17; Isa 10:5"},"15":{"text":"En un, mei tawisa-in TOPA hong pai a, ama sakollengte pingpei tawh kibang hi. A hehna in a thangpaihna hong puaksuk dinga, amah in meikuangin a taai ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:31; Ph 68:17; Ph 9:5"},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA in mi khempeuh tungah mei le namsau-a thahna tawh thu khen dinga, TOPA thahsa mi tampi ahi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 27:1; 30:30; Isa 10:4"},"17":{"text":"\"Huante sunga pai dingin amaute kisiansuah a, amau le amau a kisiangsakte, voksa, zusa le a kihhuai nate ne a, a laizang a pena a zuite - amaute a beimang khawm ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"18":{"text":"\"Tua hi-a amaute sepna le a ngaihsutnate uh hangin keimah hong pai-in b minamte khempeuh le pau khempeuh ka kaikhawm dinga, ka minthanna a mu ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 59:19"},"19":{"text":"\"Amaute lakah lim khat ka omsak dinga a suakta lai pawlkhat minamte - Tarshish-te tung, Libya mite c tung le Lydia (thalkap siama minthang)-te tung, Tubal-te le Grecce-te tung le ka vang neihna le ka minthanna a za nai lo a gamla-a om tuikulhte tungah ka sawl ding hi. Amaute in minamte tungah ka minthanna a tangko ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuateh amaute in minamte khempeuh tung panin TOPA tunga biakna-in Jerusalem a ka mual siangtho ah sakol tung, sakolleng tung, leng tung, laa-sakol tung le kala-oh tungah na sanggamte khempeuh uh hong puak ding uh hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi. \"Israel-te in TOPA biakinnpi ah thukham ngeina-in a siangtho beelte in an-a biakna a puak bangun amaute in hong puak ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuateh amaute pawlkhat siampi ding le Levi-te dingin ka tengkhia ding hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 19:6; Isa 61:6; 1Pe 2:5,9"},"22":{"text":"\"Ka bawl ding athak vante le lei thak ka mai-ah a kip den bangin, note le na suan na khakte uh min a kip ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"23":{"text":"Kha Thak khat pan adang khatah, Sabbath khat pan adang khatah mihing khempeuh hong pai-in ka mai-ah a kun ding uh hi,\" TOPA in ci hi."},"24":{"text":"Tuateh amaute paikhia-in kei hong lehdo misiate luang a en ding uh hi; amaute than a si kei dinga, amaute mei zong mit loin mihing khempeuh in a kih ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."}}}}},"24":{"info":{"name":"Jeremiah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin gam Anathoth a siampite lakah khat ahi Hilkiah’ tapa Jeremiah thugente ahi hi."},"2":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Amon’ tapa Josiah in a uk, a kum sawm le thumna kumin Jeremiah tungah TOPA thu tunga"},"3":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim in a uk-a kipan Judah kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawm le khatna kum, a kha ngana, Jerusalem mite sal-a a paikhiat dong ama tungah thu a tung hi.","ref":"Jos 21:18; 1Kh 6:60; Jer 52:15"},"4":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga,"},"5":{"text":"\"Sul sunga kong bawl ma-in nang kong thei a khin hi, na suah ma-in kong seh khin zo a; minamte tungah kamsang dingin kong teel khin zo hi,\" hong ci hi.","title":"Jeremiah Kisam","ref":"Isa 49:1; tg 10"},"6":{"text":"\"Ah, Thupipen TOPA , ka genzia ding ka thei kei hi; naupangno khat ka hi lel hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Pk 4:10; 1Ku 3:7"},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in kei kiangah, \"‘Naupangno khat ka hi lel hi,’ ci kei in. Kong sawlnate kiangah pai-in kong thupiak peuhpeuh na gen pelmawh ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute kihta kei in, nang kong ompih dinga kong hu ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 15:20; Eze 2:6"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in a khutin hong zamphei a, ka muk hong lawnsakin kei kiangah, \"Tu-in ka thute na kamah ka koih khin hi."},"10":{"text":"En in, minamte le kumpi-gamte tungah a botkhia ding le a phelkhia ding, a susia ding le a zogawp ding, a lam ding le a suan dingin tuni-in nang kong sawl hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 18:7-10"},"11":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga, \"Jeremiah aw, bang na mu hiam?\" hong ci hi. \"Almond singhiang khat ka mu hi,\" ci-in ka dawng hi."},"12":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Ka kammal a tangtun ding a vil b gige ka hi manin maantakin na mu hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 44:27"},"13":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tung kik a: \"Bang na mu hiam?\" hong ci hi. \"Leilu-lam pana hong awnsuk a solai beel khat ka mu hi,\" ci-in ka dawng hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Leilu-lam panin leitunga teng mi khempeuh tungah siatna kisungkhia suk ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Leilu-lam kumpi-gama mite khempeuh ka sam ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Amaute kumpite hong pai ding uh a, Jerusalem lutna kongpite, khuapi umna kulhte le Judah gam khuapite ah a kumpi tokhom uh a phut ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:31; Jer 4:16; 9:11"},"16":{"text":"Ka mite tungah thukhenna ka genkhia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute giloin hong taisan uh a, pasian dangte tungah gimnamtui halin amau khut bawlsa a bia uh hi.","ref":"Jer 4:12; Tp 28:20; Jer 7:9"},"17":{"text":"\"Nang kithawi in! Ding inla kong thupiak khempeuh amaute tungah va gen in. Amaute mai-ah lauthawng kei in, na lauthawng leh amaute mai-ah kong lauthawngsak ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-in nang gambuppi - Judah kumpite, a uliante, a siampite le a gam mite langah a pang dingin kulha ki-um khuapi, sik khuampi le sumngo kulhpi kong suaksak khin hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang hong sim ding uh a, nang hong ompihin hong hu ding ka hi manin amaute in hong zo kei ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 50:7; Jer 20:11; Eze 2:6"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga,","title":"Israel in Pasian Taisan"},"2":{"text":"\"Pai inla Jerusalem-te zakin va tangko in: \"Na khangno lai-a nong kipiakna, mothak banga kei nong itna, sehnel-gam kantan le gamtaak sunga nong zuihnate ka phawk hi.","ref":"Isa 38:4; Eze 16:8-14,60; Tp 2:7"},"3":{"text":"TOPA tungah Israel siangtho a, a lak gahmasa pen ahi hi; amah a ne peuhmah a mawh suak uh a, amaute tungah siatna a tung hi,’ va ci in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 41:11; Jer 50:7"},"4":{"text":"Israel innkuana bawng’te khempeuh, Jacob innkuante aw, TOPA thugen za un."},"5":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Na pate un kei tungah bang khialhna mu a, kei kiang panin gamlapi gammang uh ahi hiam? Amaute in kimanna nei lo milimte nung zui uh a, amau mahmah kimanna nei lo a suak uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 17:15"},"6":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘Egypt panin eite hong paikhiatpih sehnel-gam le dum lak, lei keuna le khuamialna a mun, kuama pai ngeilohna-a hong makaih TOPA koi-ah om ahi hiam?’ ci-in a dong beek kei uh hi.","ref":"Hos 13:4; Tp 8:15; 32:10"},"7":{"text":"A gah le a sunga piangte na nek theih nadingun lei hoihna munah note kong puak hi. Ahi hangin note nong pai uh a, ka leitang ninsakin gouluahna a kihhuai na suaksak uh hi.","ref":"Ms 13:27; Tp 8:7-9; Ph 106:34-39"},"8":{"text":"Siampite in ‘ TOPA koi-ah om hiam?’ ci-in a dong beek kei uh hi. Thukham zangte in kei hong thei lo uh a, makaite in kei hong lehdo uh hi. Kamsangte in Baal minin thu gen uh a, kimanna a nei lo milimte a zuizui uh hi.","ref":"Jer 4:22; Jer 23:13"},"9":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin note kong mawhsak-a, kong mawhsak lai ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Tuateh na tate uh tate ka mawhsak lai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Kittim b tuipi gei kantan unla va en dih un; Kedar c ah mi sawl unla naicik ah kan dih un; hih bang na a piang ngei hiam, mu un:","ref":"Pc 10:4; Pc 25:13"},"11":{"text":"Minam khat in a pasiante a kheng ngei hiam? (Tuate lah pasiante a hi peuhmah kei hi.) Ahi hangin ka mite in amau d minthanna bangmah man lo milimte khekna-in hong nei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 37:19; Jer 16:20"},"12":{"text":"Vantungte aw, lauthawng mahmah unla, lau lua-in ling un,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"13":{"text":"\"Ka mite in mawhna nih a bawl khin uh hi; amaute in a nungta tuinak keimah hong taisanin tui a vung thei lo a kitamsa tuikhuk a to uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Mi nasem ding le sal dingin Israel a suak ahi hiam? Tua ahileh bang hangin galmat-a om ahi hiam?","ref":"Pk 4:22"},"15":{"text":"Humpinelkaite hawk uh a, amah a ngik uh hi. Amaute in a gam, gamsimtham suah uh a; a khuapite kangtumin a kinusia hi.","ref":"Jer 4:7; 50:17; 2Ku 25:9"},"16":{"text":"Memphis e le Tahpanhes mite nangawn in na lu f ua kumpi lukhu a metkhia uh hi.","ref":"Isa 19:13"},"17":{"text":"Na Pasian uh TOPA in lampi ah hong makaih lai-in amah na taisan manun hihte no tungah hong tung hi lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 1:28; Jer 17:13; Jer 4:18"},"18":{"text":"Shihor g a tui dawn lel dingin Egypt ah pai na hi uh hiam? Tuateh Gunpi h a tui dawn lel dingin Assyria ah pai na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Jos 13:3; Isa 30:2; Isa 7:20; Hos 5:13"},"19":{"text":"Na gitlohna un note dan hong tuaksak dinga; na nungtolhna un hong tai ding hi. Tua ahi ciangin na Pasian uh TOPA hong taisanin nong kihtak loh uh ciangin gitlohna hi-a, kha velval ahilam ngaihsun unla tel un,\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 3:11,22; Hos 5:5; Jer 19:4; Job 20:14"},"20":{"text":"\"Sawtpek lai-in na hakkol na kuaitan a, hong kihenna khaute bottatin, ‘Nang na ka sem kei ding hi,’\" na ci hi. Hi takpi hi, mualsang tung teng le singlian nuai tengah numei kizuakte bangin na lum kawikawi uh hi.","ref":"Sp 26:13; Tp 12:2"},"21":{"text":"Note, a kiteltel a cidam a muantak lenggui paipi banga kong suan na hi uh hi. Bangci in kei hong langpangin a sia thei gam-lenggui suak mawk na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Pk 15:17; Ph 80:8"},"22":{"text":"Vuttui tawh kisil-in, saban tampitak na zang zongin ka mai-ah na khialhna om lai veve hi,\" Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 51:2"},"23":{"text":"\"Bangci in, ‘Ka kihhuai kei hi; Baal nung ka delh kei hi,’ ci thei na hi hiam? Kuam sunga na gamtatnate en in; na sepsa ngaihsun pha in. Nang, a kawi taitai kala-oh nu na banga,","ref":"Pn 30:12; Jer 9:14; Jer 7:31"},"24":{"text":"gamlak nuam a sa gamsung laanu a huk laitaka huih dik vatvat, kuama kham zawh loh na bang tazen hi. Atal khatpeuh in gimpi-in a zon kul lo a, a huk hunin a mu lel ding hi.","ref":"Jer 14:6"},"25":{"text":"Na khedap siat dong, na dangkeu dongin tai kei in. Ahi hangin nang, ‘Phamawh kei! Gamdang pasiante ka it hi, amaute nung ka zui teitei ding hi,’ na ci hi.","ref":"Tp 32:16"},"26":{"text":"\"Guta khat a kimat cianga a zum bangin Israel innkuan - amaute, a kumpite uh, a uliante uh, a siampite uh le a kamsangte uh a zum ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 48:27; Jer 32:32"},"27":{"text":"Amaute in singtawng kiangah, ‘Ka pa na hi hi’ ci uh a, suangtum kiangah, ‘Nang sung pana piang ka hi hi,’ ci uh hi. Amaute in hong maingat loin hong nungngatsan uh hi; tua hi napi a lungkham uh ciangin, ‘Hong pai-in ko hong hon in!’ ci zel uh hi.","ref":"Jer 3:9; Jer 18:17; Ph 14:3; Isa 26:16; Hos 5:15"},"28":{"text":"Nomau bawlsa na pasiante uh tu-in koi-ah om ahi hiam? Na lungkham uh ciangin hong hot theih leh kihonsak un! Ahang in, Judah aw, khuapi na neih zahzah uh pasian na nei uh hi."},"29":{"text":"\"Bang hangin kei hong mawhsak na hi uh hiam? Note khempeuh in kei nong lehdo uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 5:1; 6:13; Da 9:11"},"30":{"text":"\"Na mite a mawkna-a dan pia ka suak hi; amaute a kibawlpha nuam kei uh hi. Humpinelkai gilkial bangin na namsaute un na kamsangte uh a liakmang khin hi.","ref":"Ns 7:52; 1Th 2:15"},"31":{"text":"\"Tu khanghun a note aw, TOPA thu ngaihsun dih un: \"Israel tungah sehnel-gam suak ngei a, khuamial mahmah gam suak ngei ka hi hiam? Bang hangin ka mite in, ‘Ka ututun ka vak thei uh hi. Nang kiangah hong pai nawn kei nung,’ ci uh ahi hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Nungak khat in a kizepna suangmanphate mangngilh a, mothak khat in a mothak puante mangngilh ahi hiam? Tua hi napi ka mite in sim zawh loh ni tampi sung kei hong mangngilh khin uh hi.","ref":"Isa 57:11"},"33":{"text":"Na itte uh zol ding na siam uh hi. Numei siapente nangawn in no tung pan hong sin thei lai uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Mawhpeng mizawngte inn luhin na mat khak ngei loh hangin nuntakna sisan na puantunga baang, mite in a mu uh hi. Tua hi napi hihte khempeuh tangin,","ref":"Pk 22:2; 2Ku 21:16"},"35":{"text":"‘Ka mawhpeng hi; kei tungah amah a heh kei hi,’ na ci lai hi. Ahi hangin, ‘Ka mawh kei hi,’ ci na hih manin nang tungah thu kong khen ding hi.","ref":"1Jn 1:8,10; Jer 25:31"},"36":{"text":"Bang hangin na lampite khelin tua zahta tung mawk na hi hiam? Assyria na maizumpih bangin Egypt na maizumpih ding hi.","ref":"Jer 31:22; Isa 30:2-3,7"},"37":{"text":"TOPA in nang muante nolh khin a; amaute in nang hong huh lo ding uh ahi manin, nang zong khut lukhuksa in tua mun na paisan ding hi.","ref":"Jer 37:7; 2Sa 13:19"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Mi khat in a zi ma-in tuanu in zong amah nusia henla pasal dang khat tawh kiteng leh amah tuanu kiangah kileh kik ding ahi hiam? Tua gam teng a ninsak suak khin hi lo ahi hiam? Ahi hangin nang, lawmpa dang tampi tawh a kiteng khin numei paktat na bang hi - hong kileh kik peuhmah ding na hi hiam? TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 2:20,25; Hos 2:7"},"2":{"text":"\"A sangna munte ento dih in; hong kibuangawp lohna mun om ahi hiam? Lampi gei-ah na lawmpate na ngaka, sehnel-gama zin kawikawite a tawh na kibang hi. Na paktatna le na gitlohna-in leitung na ninsak hi.","ref":"Pc 38:14; Isa 1:21; Jer 2:7"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin khuapi guah zu lo a, guahsia zong a zu tuan kei hi. Tua hi napi na paktat mithah lailai a; zuma na mai san ding na nial lai hi.","ref":"Sp 26:19; Jer 14:4"},"4":{"text":"Tu mahmah in zong, ‘Ka Pa , ka neutunga kipan ka lawmpa,","ref":"tg 19; Jer 2:2"},"5":{"text":"heh denden ding na hi hiam? Na thangpaihna zom den keii ding na hi hiam?’ nong ci hi. Hih bangin pau napi na hih theih gitlohna khempeuh na sem hi,\" a ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpipa Josiah hun laitakin TOPA in kei tungah, \"A muanhuai lo Israel gamtatna na mu hiam? Mualsang dawn khempeuh le singliim nuai khempeuh ah tuanu pai-in tua lai-ah ang va kawm hi."},"7":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh a sep khit ciangin kei lamah hong kihei kik inteh ci-a ka ngaihsut hangin hong kihei kik lo a, a muanhuai lo a sanggamnu Judah in a mu hi.","title":"Amuanhuai Lo Israel"},"8":{"text":"Ama angkawmnate hangin a muanhuai lo Israel makna laipi ka pia a, ka hawlkhia hi. Tua hi napi a muanhuai lo a sanggamnu Judah lau lo lailai a; amah zong kuankhia-in a angkawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Israel adingin a bawl mawhna neucik tawh a kibat hangin, amah in leitang ninsaka, singtawng le suangtum tawh a angkawm hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih bang teng hi napi a muanhuai lo a sanggamnu Judah, a lungsim neihzahin kei lam hong kihei loin, a kineih bek ahi hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"11":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"A muantak lo Judah sangin a muanhuai het lo Israel thumaan zaw hi."},"12":{"text":"Pai inla leilu lamah hih thupuak tangko in: \"‘A muantak lo Israel aw, hong kileh kik in,’ TOPA in cikhia hi. ‘Lainat siampa ka hi manin kong talgawmsan nawn kei ding hi,’ TOPA in cikhia hi. Ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 6:2"},"13":{"text":"Na khialhna phawk tapeuh in- TOPA na Pasian na langdona, niliim nuai tengah gamdang pasiante tunga na angvanna na thehthang a, ka thu nong mang kei hi,’ ci-in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 2:25"},"14":{"text":"Keimah na pasal ka hi hi. A muantak lo Israel aw, hong ciah kik in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Khuapi simah khatta kong teel dinga, bawng’ simah nihta hong teelin Zion ah kong puak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka lungsim banga note theihna le theihtelna tawh note hong mapi dingin tuucingte kong pia ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin gam sungah khan cihtakin khangin na tam mahmah ding uh hi, TOPA in ci a, kuamah in, ‘ TOPA thukhun singkuang,\" a cikha nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute lungsim ah lut ngei nawn loin zong phawkkha nawn lo ding uh a, kigoih loin adang khat beek a kibawl nawn kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin amaute in Jerusalem, TOPA Tokhom ci ding uh a, TOPA min pahtawi dingin Jerusalem ah minam khempeuh a kikhawm ding uh hi. Amaute in a lungsim gitloh-tentenna uh a zui nawn kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin Judah innkuante in Israel innkuante zom ding uh a, a nih un na luah dingun na pate uh tunga ka piaksa gam ah leilu-lam gam panin a paikhawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Hos 2:19; Jer 11:8"},"19":{"text":"Keimahmah in, \"‘Lungdam lua-in tapate bangin ka bawl dinga, minam khatpeuh luah a nopcipen le a deihhuaipen nang kong pia ding hi,’ ka ci hi. ‘Pa’ hong ci-in nong zuihna pan kihei lo ding kong sa hi.","ref":"Isa 63:16"},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin Israel innkuan aw, a pasal tunga a muanhuai lo numei khat bangin kei tungah na muanhuai kei khin hi?\" TOPA in a cikhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Khosangte ah kikona khat kiza a, Israel mite kahna le ngetna ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lampi uh pialsan khin uh a, amaute Pasian TOPA manggilh khin uh hi.","ref":"Isa 57:11"},"22":{"text":"\"A muantak lo mite hong kihei kik un; na nungtolhna uh kong damsak ding hi,\" a ci hi. \"Nang TOPA kote Pasian na hi manin nang kong zuan na ding uh hi.","ref":"Hos 6:1"},"23":{"text":"Mualneu le mualliante tunga milim biate gamlum henhanna zuaupi taktak hi a; TOPA eite’ Pasian sung bekah Israel-te hotkhiatna a om takpi hi."},"24":{"text":"I neu lai-a kipanin i pate sepsa gahte, a tuuhon - a ganhonte uh, a tanu a tapate uh a zumhuai a pasiante un valhtum khin hi.","ref":"Hos 9:10"},"25":{"text":"Maizumin lumcip ni, i maizumna-in kikhuh ni. Eite le i pate i nih in TOPA i Pasian tungah i mawh khin zo hi; i neu tunga kipan tuni dong TOPA eite Pasian thu i mang kei hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Thk 10:10; Eze 2:3"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Israel aw, nong kileh kik leh, kei kiangah hong kileh in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Ka muhna panin a kihhuai na milimte uh hemmang-in gammang nawn lo-a,"},"2":{"text":"thumaan thutang le a maan lampi ah tomlo in, \" TOPA nuntakna ka lo hi\" ci-a na kiciam nak uh leh tua ciangin amah in minamte thupha pia dinga amaute ama sungah a minthang ding uh hi,\" ci hi.","ref":"Tp 10:20; Isa 65:16; Pc 22:18"},"3":{"text":"TOPA in Judah mite le Jerusalem mite tungah a gen hih ahi hi: \"Na lotulte uh kal unla linglakah vawh nawn kei un.","ref":"Hos 10:12; Mk 4:18"},"4":{"text":"No Judah mite le Jerusalem mite aw, TOPA tungah no le no vun ki-at unla, na lungtang vun uh at un, na tua cih kei uh leh na gitloh gamtatnasate uh hangin ka heh suakin mei bangin kuang dinga - kuama phelh theih lohin a kang ding hi.","ref":"Pk 32:22; Zep 2:2; Am 5:6"},"5":{"text":"Judah ah zasak unla, Jerusalem ah tangko in: ‘Gamsung bupah pengkul va mut un! Nakpi in awng unla: ‘Na vekun kikaikhawm un! Kulh nei khuapite ah tai ni!’ ci un.","ref":"Jer 5:20; Jos 10:20; Jer 8:14","title":"Leilu Panin Siatna"},"6":{"text":"Zion a pai nadingin dialkhai khai un! A suakta dingin manlangin tai un! Ahang in, leilu panin siatna hong tungsak a, a lauhuai siatna lianpi ahi hi,\" ci un.","ref":"Jer 1:13-15; 50:3"},"7":{"text":"Humpinelkai khat a kua panin paikhia khin a, minamte a susiapa kuankhia khin hi. Na gam uh susia dingin, a omna mun nusia khin hi. Na khuapite uh kuamah teng loin kisiacip ding hi.","ref":"Jer 6:26; Isa 1:7"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ippi puansilh unla kapin taamlo un, ahang in, TOPA hehluatna eite tawh kipelh nai lo hi.","ref":"Isa 22:12; Jer 7:29; Jer 30:24"},"9":{"text":"\"Tua ni ciangin kumpipa le a uliante in a cih nading uh thei loin, siampite lau mahmah ding uh a, kamsangte a lauthawng ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"1Sa 17:32; Isa 29:9"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin, \"Ah, Thupipen TOPA aw, ka gawluah namsau kitah napi, ‘Lungnopna na ngah ding uh hi’ ci-in hih mite le Jerusalem-te khem cihtakin a khem na hi hi\" ka ci hi.","ref":"2Th 2:11; jer 14:13"},"11":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin hih mite le Jerusalem a mite tungah, \"Sehnel gama munsangte panin ka mite tungah"},"12":{"text":"huihsa mahmah khat nung dinga, ahi hangin ansi zaapna le siansakna ahi kei hi; kei a kiang pana nung huih a khauh lua mahmah hi. Tu-in amaute tungah ka thukhenna ka zasak hi,\" kici ding hi.","ref":"Jer 1:16"},"13":{"text":"En un! Amah meii bangin hong kuankhia-a, a sakollengte pingpei bangin hong pai in, a sakolte, muvanlai sangin a manlang zaw uh hi. Gimna hong tung ei! A kisia hi ta hang ei!","ref":"Isa 19:1; Isa 5:28; Tp 28:49; Hab 1:8"},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, na lungsim a gitlohna sawp inla, suakta in. Na gitlohna lungsimte bang tanvei kemcip lai ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Jas 4:8; Ph 6:3"},"15":{"text":"Thuzaksakna aw khat in, Dan panin Ephraim mualneute pana siatna a tang ko hi.","ref":"Jer 8:16; Jer 31:6"},"16":{"text":"\"Hih thu minamte tungah gen inla, Jerusalem tungah tangko in: \"Gamlapi panin a umcih ding galkap hong kuana, Judah khuapite langkhatah galphuangin a kiko uh hi.","ref":"Eze 21:22"},"17":{"text":"Tuanu in kei hong lehdo ahi manin, amaute in lo hon bangin a kimkotah mite a umcih uh hi.’ ci in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 5:23; 2Ku 25:1,4"},"18":{"text":"\"Na gamtatna le na sepnate nang tungah hong tu ahi hi. Hih in na tuah ding dan ahi hi. Bang a ci khaat tazen tam! Na lungtang bang hong ci vutlet tam!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 2:19"},"19":{"text":"Lunggim si’ng! Lunggim lua si’ng! Lunggimin ka kilumlet hi. Oh, ka lungsim gim lua! Ka sungah ka lungtang kisai-a, ka om hithiat thei kei hi. Ahang in, pengkul aw ka za a; gal husa ka za hi.","ref":"Jer 20:9; Ms 10:2"},"20":{"text":"Siatna nungah siatna in nungzuih a, gambuppi kisia ta hi. Tomkha kalin ka puanbukte kisia a, thakhatin ka kidalna a kisia hi.","ref":"Ph 42:7; Jer 10:20"},"21":{"text":"Galsimna bangtan vei mu lai-in pengkul aw bangtan vei ka za lai ding hiam?","ref":"Ms 2:2; Jos 6:20; Jer 6:1"},"22":{"text":"\"Ka mite hai uh a; kei hong thei lo uh hi. Amaute naupang thu thei lo hi uh a; theihtelna a nei kei uh hi. Amaute gitloh siam uh a, a hoih sep ding a thei kei uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 10:8; Jer 2:8; Ro 16:19"},"23":{"text":"Leitung ka en a, lim le meel nei loin a hawmpi hi a; tua teh vantungte ah khuavakte a om kei hi.","ref":"Pc 1:2"},"24":{"text":"Mualliante ka en a, kiliing damdamin; mualneute a kivei kawikawi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka en a, mi a om kei hi; vana vasa peuhmah lengmang khin uh hi.","ref":"Jer 9:10; Zep 1:3"},"26":{"text":"Ka en a, logam hoihte kolhmang khin hi; TOPA mai, a hehluatna mai-ah a khuapi khempeuh kisia khin hi.","ref":"Jer 12:4; Jer 12:13"},"27":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Gambuppi kisia dinga, ahi zongin ka susia khin sam kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 5:10,18; 30:11"},"28":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin leitung thum dinga, tunga vante a mial ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka gensa hi-a ka khiam kei ding hi; ka khensatsa ka dok kik kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 5:30; 50:3; Ms 23:19; Jer 23:20; 30:24"},"29":{"text":"Sakol-tuangte le thal tawite aw ging hangin khuapi peuhmah tai kek uh hi. Pawlkhatte gampha lakah lut uh a; pawlkhatte suangtum lakah kahto uh hi. Khuapi khempeuh hawm a; kuamah a teng kei hi.","ref":"Jer 6:23; 1Sa 26:20"},"30":{"text":"A gamh khinpa aw, bang cih ding na hiam? Bang hangin puan ausan silhin khama kizem na hi hiam? Bang hangin na mitte zemin liapsak na hi hiam? Nang le nang a mawkna-a kizem na hi ta hi. Na lawmpate in hong ma ta uh a, hong thah sawm uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 9:30; Ta 1:2; Ph 35:4"},"31":{"text":"Numei nausuak kuan kiko bang khat ka za a, a tacil suak dinga tau khat - Zion tanu husam liangin kiko a, a khutte zaakin, \"Tazen aw! gim lua si’ng ei, ka nuntakna mithatpa tungah kipia ta hi,\" ci-a kiko khat ka za hi.","ref":"Jer 13:21; Isa 1:15; Ta 1:17; Ta 2:21"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem kongzingte ah vaksuk vakto-in, en kawikawi-in ngaihsun kawm unla mun-awng teng zong un. Thumaana gamta, thutak a zong mi khat bek na muh uh leh hih khuapi mawhna ka maisak ding hi.","title":"Thutang Khat Beek Om Lo","ref":"Eze 22:30; Jer 14:14; Pc 18:24"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in, ‘ TOPA nuntakna ka lo hi,’ ci-in a kiciam uh hangin tu nangawnin a khialpi-a tomlo ahi uh hi.","ref":"Jer 4:2; Sp 19:12"},"3":{"text":"TOPA aw, na mitte in thutak zong hi lo ahi hiam? Amaute na sat hangin na sa lo uh a, na gawigawp hangin a kibawlpha nuam tuan kei uh hi. A maitang uh suang sangin sakzawsak uh a, a kisik nuam kei uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 16:9; Isa 9:13; Jer 7:26; 19:15"},"4":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA lampi thei loin amau Pasian deihna thei lo uh ahi manin a gina lo, a hai hi lel uh hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.","ref":"Pn 10:21: Jer 8:7; Jer 4:22"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin a makaite uh kiangah pai-in ka hopih ding hi; amaute in TOPA lampi thei-in Pasian deihnate a thei takpi uh hi,\" ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Ahi hangin amaute in kiciamna khat tawh hakkol sutanin, kikhihna khaute a sutat uh hi.","ref":"Ph 2:3"},"6":{"text":"Amaute hong lehdona lian lua-a, tam vei nungtolh mun lua ta uh ahi manin tulaka humpinelkai khat in amaute luh dinga, sehnel-gama keivom khat in susiagawpin a paikhia peuhpeuh a balzan dingin amau khuapi kiangah gialbem khat bokin a ngak ding hi.","ref":"Hos 13:7"},"7":{"text":"\"Bang hangin na mawhna uh hong maisak ding ka hi hiam? Na tate un kei hong mangngilh khin uh a, pasian a hilo pasian tawh a kiciam uh hi. Amaute kisapna teng ka piak hi napi, amaute in angkawm teitei uh a, numei paktatte inn ah a honin a om uh hi.","ref":"Tp 32:21; Jos 23:7; Jer 13:27"},"8":{"text":"Amaute sakol tal gilvah, midangte’ zi a hamsan huthutte ahi uh hi.","ref":"Eze 22:11"},"9":{"text":"Hih thu hangin dan thuaksak lo ding ka hi hiam? TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Keimah in tua bang minamte hih banga phu ka lak ding mah hilo ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 9:9"},"10":{"text":"\"Tuanu’ lenggui lote ah pai-in siasak inla ahi hangin susiamang sam kei in. Hih mite TOPA tawh kisai lo uh ahi manin tuanu’ hiangte heuhkhiatsak in.","ref":"Jer 4:27; Am 9:8"},"11":{"text":"Kei tungah Israel innkuante le Judah innkuante a muanhuai peuhmah kei uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 3:20"},"12":{"text":"TOPA thu ah zuau phuak uh a, \"Amah in, bangmah hih kei! Ei tungah bangmah natna hong tung kei inteh; namsau le kialpi tuak kei ni.","ref":"Jer 14:13"},"13":{"text":"Kamsangte lah huih bang hi lel uh a, amau sungah thu a teng kei hi; amau gente amau lutungah tu ta hen,\" ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Mite in hih bang ci khin uh ahi manin, ka thute na kam sungah mei ka suaksak dinga, singkhuah ahi hih mite a kangtum ding uh hi,","ref":"Jer 1:9"},"15":{"text":"Israel innkuante aw,\" TOPA in cikhia hi, \"A gamla a minam khat - a kampau na theih loh uh tanglai mite, a thugen na tel zawh loh uh mite kong kuansak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute thaltang bawm, han kihongsa bang hi a; amaute khempeuh a thahat galhang ahi uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute in na an laksate uh le na ante uh hong gaihsak ding uh a, na tanu na tapate uh hong gaihsakin, na tuuhon na ganhonte uh hong gaihsak ding uh a, na lenggahte uh le na theigahte uh hong gaihsak khin ding uh hi. Na muan uh kulh-a ki-um khuapi, namsau-in a susia ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 26:16; Jer 8:16; Tp 28:32; Tp 28:31; Ms 16:14; Tp 28:33; Sp 26:25"},"18":{"text":"TOPA in kong cihinah, \"Tua hi napi tua ni ciangin note kong susiamang khin kei ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuateh mite in, ‘Bang hangin TOPA eite Pasian in hihte khempeuh sem ahi hiam?’ ci-a hong dot uh ciangin note in, ‘Note in kei hong taisanin na gamua midangte’ pasiante’ na nasep uh bangin tu-in no gam lopi-ah midangte na na sem ding uh hi, ci-in na gen ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Tp 28:48; Jer 4:27"},"20":{"text":"Hih thu Jacob innkuante tungah gen unla, Judah-te tungah tangko un:"},"21":{"text":"No mihai bangmah a ngaihsun thei lo mite; mit nei napi khua mu lote, bil nei napi khuaza lote aw, hih thu za un:","ref":"Jer 4:22; Isa 6:10; Eze 12:2; Mt 13:15; Mk 8:18"},"22":{"text":"Kei hong kihta lo ding na hi uh hiam? TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Ka mai-ah ling lo ding na hi uh hiam? Tuipi gamgi dingin sehnel ka bawl a, a kantan theih loh dingin, dai-a kimang den ding ahi hi. Tuihualte a kilok hangin phukhia zo lo uh a; a hawk uh hangin a kantan thei kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 64:2; Pc 1:9; Ph 46:3"},"23":{"text":"Ahi hangin hih mite lungkhauhin lehdo-nopna lungtang nei uh a; lampialin a paikhiamang uh hi.","ref":"Tp 21:18; Ph 14:3"},"24":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Tuk guah le sikhiau guahte a hunin hong zusaka, an lak huna an hong lasakpa, TOPA eite Pasian kihta ni,’ a kici kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 147:8; Pc 8:22; Ns 14:17"},"25":{"text":"Na sepsa uh khialhnate in hihte khaktan a; na mawhnate un a hoihte khaktan hi."},"26":{"text":"Ka mite lakah migilote om uh a, vasa thangsiah bangin mite thangsiahin man uh hi.","ref":"Ph 10:8; Mic 7:2"},"27":{"text":"Vabawm ah vasa a dim bangin, amaute inn khemna tawh kidim a; amaute hau-in vanglian uh a,","ref":"Jer 9:6; Jer 12:1"},"28":{"text":"thau-in a zol uh hi. Gitloh gamtatna ah a hun bek thei lo uh a; pa nei lote thu zawhpih dingin panpih loin, mizawngte thumaanna a hutpih kei uh hi.","ref":"Tp 32:15; Isa 1:23; Jer 7:6"},"29":{"text":"Hih thu hangin dan tuaksak lo ding ka hi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Keimah mah in tua bang minam’ hih bangin phu ka lak ding mah hi lo ahi hiam?"},"30":{"text":"\"Gam sungah a dipkuat huai, patauhhuaina piang khin hi:"},"31":{"text":"Kamsangte in zuauthu genin siampite in amau thuneihna bangin uk uh a, ka mite in hih bang nuamsa uh hi. Ahi hangin a tawpna hong tun ciangin bang na cih ding uh hiam?","ref":"Ta 4:13"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin mite aw, na suahtak nadingun tai un! Jerusalem taisan un! Tekoa ah pengkul mut un! Beth Hakkerem tungah dialkhai khai un! Ahang in, leilu-lam panin gimna hu lianpi le a lauhuai suksiatna hong kuankhia hi.","title":"Jerusalem Ki-umcih","ref":"Ne 3:14; Jer 4:6"},"2":{"text":"A melhoih mahmah a ngek ngi-ingei Zion Tanu ka susia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 9:14"},"3":{"text":"Tuanu langah tuucingte a tuuhonte uh tawh pang uh a; a kimkotah a puanbuk uh lamin, amau neihsa ciat a cing ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 25:4; Lk 19:43"},"4":{"text":"\"Tuanu do dingin kithawi un! Ding un sun laitakin va sim un! Ahi hangin alasai, khua khingta a, nitak niliap saupi liap keii ta hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ding un, va zan simin a kulh muanhuaite uh va susia ni! \" ci ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Sing phuk unla Jerusalem sim nadingin phungin ciang un. Hih khuapi netniamna tawh kidim hi; dan kituaksak pelmawh ding hi.","ref":"Tp 20:19-20"},"7":{"text":"Tuikhuk panin tui a phulkhiat bangin tuanu sung panin gitlohna a phulkhia hi. Tuanu sungah ngongtatna le siatna kiza den a, a cinatna le a liammate ka mu den hi.","ref":"Ph 55:9"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem aw, kidawm in, na kidop kei leh nang kong kiheisan dinga, kuama ten loh nadingin na gam ka hawmsak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Israel a baanglaite lenggah lawh bangin lokhia kiuhkeuh unla; mi khat in lenggah a kaihkhop bangin a hiangte tungah na khut uh van kik un,\" hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Kua hopih in vauhilh thei ding ka hi hiam? Kua in ka thu ngai ding hiam? A zak theih loh nadingun a bilte uh a bing a hi. Amaute tungah TOPA kammal zak thadahhuai-a, nuam a sa kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 42:20; Ns 7:51; Jer 20:8"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA thangpaihna tawh ka kidim a, ka thuak zo nawn kei hi. \"Lamdunga naupangte tung le a kikaikhawm khangnote tungah ka hehna ka sungkhia hi; zite le pasalte pitek luate le putek luate tawh kiman khawm ding hi.","ref":"Jer 7:20; Jer 9:21; Ta 2:21"},"12":{"text":"Tua gama teng mite tungah ka khut ka zankhiat ciangin a inn a lote uh le a zite uh midangte tungah kipia ding hi.\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 8:10; 38:22; Tp 28:30"},"13":{"text":"\"Aneupen pan alianpen dong a vekpi-un met nading ah huaiham uh a; kamsangte le siampite in a vekun a kibangin zuau a phuak uh hi.","ref":"Jer 8:10"},"14":{"text":"Amaute in ka mite liamma a nasia lo bangin tunsak uh a, kilemna om nai lopi, ‘Kilemna, kilemna,’ a ci uh hi."},"15":{"text":"A muhthadahhuai-a a gamtatna uh maizum beek lo uh ahi hiam? Neukha zong maizum lo uh a, kisuannazia ding nangawn a thei kei uh hi. Tua ciangin a puksate lakah puk uh a, amaute dan ka thuaksak ciangin a kilawnsuk ding hi,\" TOPA in a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 3:3; 8:10-12"},"16":{"text":"TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: \"Lamkabomte ah dingin en unla, tanglai lampite dong un, lam hoih koi pen hiam cih dongin tawnpah un, tua ciangin na hinna un tawldamna a mu ding hi. Ahi hangin, ‘Tua lampi tawn dah ni,\" na ci uh hi.","ref":"Ph 119:3; Mt 11:29"},"17":{"text":"Note hong vil ding mi ka koih a, ‘Pengkul aw ngai un!’ ka ci hi. Ahi hangin, ‘Ka ngai kei ding uh hi,’ na ci uh hi.","ref":"Eze 3:17; Jer 11:7-8; 25:4"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin minamte aw, za un; tecite aw, amau tungah bang piang ding hiam, thei un."},"19":{"text":"Leitung aw, za in; keimah in amaute sawmna gah ahi siatna, hih mite tungah ka puak ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thute ngai loin ka thukham a nial uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:2; Jer 22:29; Jos 23:15"},"20":{"text":"Bang dingin Sheba pana gimnamtui le gamlapi pana sing namtui thusim ding ka hi hiam? Na meihal biaknate uh kisang thei lo a, nong biakpiaknate un kei hong lungkimsak kei hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 30:23; Am 5:22; Isa 1:11; Mic 6:7-8"},"21":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Hih mite mai-ah a maikhak ka koih ding hi. Tuate tungah pate le tapate a kibangin kimuktu ding uh a; vengte le lawmte a mangthang ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."},"22":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"En un, leilu-lam panin galkap kuan khat hong kuan uh a; leimongte panin minam lian khat kithawithawi ta hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in thal le teipi tawi uh a; gilo-in kuamah a lainat kei uh hi. Tua hi napi kei le kei in, \"Hih in kei cinatna hi a, ka thuak pelmawh ding mah ahi hi,\" ka kici hi.","ref":"Mic 7:9"},"20":{"text":"Ka puanbuk kisia ta a; a khau teng kitat khin hi. Ka tapate in hong taisan uh a, adang a om nawn kei hi; tu-in ka puanbuk lam ding ahihkeh ka bukna hong bawlsak ding om lo hi.","ref":"Jer 4:20; Jer 31:15"},"21":{"text":"Tuucingte in ngaihsutna nei lo uh a, TOPA dotzia ding a thei kei uh hi; tua ahi ciangin mazang lo uh a, a tuuhonte uh a kithehthang hi.","ref":"Isa 56:10; Jer 23:2"},"22":{"text":"Ngai un! Thu hong kizasak hi - leilu-lam gam panin alian mahmah husa khat hong ging hi! Tua in Judah khuapite hawmsakin se-alte gamtatna a suaksak hi.","ref":"Jer 9:11"},"23":{"text":"TOPA aw, mihingte nuntakna ama aa ahi loh lam ka thei hi; ama kalsuannate ama kilamlah ding ahi kei hi.","title":"Jeremiah Thungetna","ref":"Pn 20:24"},"24":{"text":"TOPA , kei hong bawlpha in, thutangin hong bawl inla - hehsa-in hong puahpha kei in, heh lecin bangmah lo ka suak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 6:1; 38:1; Jer 30:11"},"25":{"text":"Nang hong thei lo minamte tung le nangma mina kilo ngei lo mite tungah na thangpaihna sungkhia in. Ahang in, amaute in Jacob valhtum uh a, amah valhtum kiuhkeuh hi; ama tenna gam a nusia khin uh hi.","ref":"Zep 3:8"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Jeremiah tunga tung TOPA thu ahi hi:","title":"Thukhun Kipalsat"},"2":{"text":"Hih thukhunna-a thute ngai inla Judah mite tung le Jerusalem-a tengte tungah gen in."},"3":{"text":"Amaute tungah hih in TOPA Israel-te Pasian gen hi a: ‘Egypt pan - sik-haltuina pummei panin na pute uh ka paikhiatpi lai-in amaute tungah ka thupiaksa ahi -"},"4":{"text":"hih thukhunna-a thute a mang lo peuhmah in hamsiatna thuak ta hen,’ ci in. ‘Ka thu hong mang unla kong thupiak khempeuh sem un; tua hileh note ka mi na suak ding uh a, keimah note Pasian ka hi ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin na pute uh tunga, tu-a na neihsa uh - bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gam piak dingin tomlo-a ka ciamsa ka tangtungsak ding hi,\" hong ci hi. Keimah in, \" TOPA , Amen,\" ci-in ka dawng hi.","ref":"Pk 24:8; Jer 7:23"},"6":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Hih thu khempeuh Judah khuapite le Jerusalem kongzingte ah tangko inla: ‘Thukhun thute ngai unla zui un."},"7":{"text":"Na pute uh Egypt pan ka paikhiatpih a kipan tuni dong, \"Ka thu hong mang un,\" ci-a ka vauhilh kikkik ahi hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka thu ngai loin zong a thusim kei uh hi; tua sangsikin amau lungtang khauhna a zuizaw uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute zuih dingin thu ka piak hangin a zuih nop loh uh thukhun hamsia khempeuh amau tungah ka tungsak hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei tungah, \"Judah mite le Jerusalem a tengte lakah sawmsimna khat a om hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in ka thu mang nuam loin a pute uh mawhna lamah kihei khin uh hi. Amaute in pasian dangte na sem dingin a zui uh hi. Israel innkuante le Judah innkuante in a nihun a pute uh tawh ka bawl thukhun a palsat khin uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Amaute tungah gimna ka tungsak dinga, amaute a suakta kei ding uh hi. Amaute in kei hong ko in a kiko uh zongin a thugen uh ka ngai kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Judah khuapite le Jerusalem a mite, gimnamtui a halna uh a pasiante uh kiangah pai-in va ko ding uh a, ahi hangin gimna in a vat ciangin tuate in a hu thei kei ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Judah aw, nang in khuapi na neih zahzah pasian na nei a; Jerusalem kongzing pha zahzah a zumhuai Baal pasian biakna hal nadingin biakna-tau na dawh hi.","ref":"Eze 22:25; Thk 2:12-13"},"14":{"text":"\"Hih mite adingin ngetna le thumsakna khatpeuhpeuh ahi zongin nei kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute lungdongin hong sap uh ciangin ka ngai kei ding hi.","ref":"Pk 32:10"},"15":{"text":"\"Ka lawmnu in tampi tawh gitlohna a sep khit nungin ka biakinn ah bang hong hih nawn ding ahi hiam? Sa apna in na dantuah ding uh kipelhsak thei tuan ding hiam? Gitlohna na bawl uh ciangin na lungnuam a uh hi.\"","ref":"Jer 7:9-10"},"16":{"text":"TOPA in nang, a hing kiuhkeuh a gah tawh a kilawm mahmah olive kung hong ci hi. Ahi hangin huihpi hat mahmah khat hawkin mei-in hong hal dinga, na hiangte a kitan ding hi.","ref":"Ph 1:3; Jer 21:14; Isa 27:11; Ro 11:17-24"},"17":{"text":"Nang hong suan Thahatpen TOPA in nang tungah gimna a tunsak ding a khentat khin hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Israel innkuante le Judah innkuante in gitlohna bawlin Baal tunga gimnamtui halna tawh kei hong hehsak uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:2; Jer 12:2"},"18":{"text":"Tua hun lai-in TOPA in amau septe kei hong lak ahi manin, amau hong sawmsimnate hong laak-a ka thei hi."},"19":{"text":"A kigo dinga kipaipih hiathiat tuuno bang ka hi-a; amaute in kei theih lohin hong sawmsimin, \"Singkung le a gah susia khawm ni, ama mihing tenna leitang pan hemkhia-in a min kiphawksak nawn kei ni\" ci uh hi.","title":"Jeremiah Kisawmsim","ref":"Jer 18:18; 20:10; Isa 53:8"},"20":{"text":"Ahi hangin Thahatpen TOPA aw, nang in thumaanin thu na khena, lungsim le ngaihsutna na entel hi; nang tungah ka thu hong suan khin ka hi manin amaute tunga na phulakna kei hong musak in.","ref":"Ph 58:10"},"21":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin hong that nuama, ‘ TOPA minin thu hilh kei in, na hilh leh ko khutlumin na si ding hi,’ hong ci Anathoth mite tawh kisai-in TOPA thugen hih ahi hi -"},"22":{"text":"tua ahi ciangin Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Amaute dan ka thuaksak ding hi. A tangvalte uh namsau in si ding uh a, a tanu a tapate uh kialpi-in a si ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute a baanglai nangawn a om kei ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh amaute dan ka piak kumin Anathoth mite tungah tuahsiatna ka tungsak ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang tungah thu kong tut ciangin na thumaan tawntung hi. Tua hita leh na thutang thu kong kikuppih nuam lai hi: Bang hangin migilote daupai uh ahi hiam? Bang hangin upna nei lo khempeuh nuamtakin om uh ahi hiam?","title":"Jeremiah Lungkimlohna","ref":"Ezr 9:15; Jer 5:27-28"},"2":{"text":"Amaute nangma suansa hi uh a, amaute in zungkha-in khangin a gah uh hi. A kamun hong gen den napi a lungsim uh tawh na kigamla hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua hita leh TOPA aw, kei nong thei a; hong mu-in kong ngaihsutna nong sittel hi. A kisehsat ding tuu bangin amaute kaikhiagawp in! A kigawh ding uh ni ngakin tangkoihkhia in!","ref":"Jer 17:18"},"4":{"text":"Bangtan vei gamsung vuaigawpin a lo sunga lopate vulgawp lai ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh tua gama tengte gilo uh a, vasate le gamsate mangthang khin ta uh hi. Tua tham loin mite in, \"Ei tunga piangte hong mu kei na’nteh,\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 4:28; Jol 1:10-12; Jer 4:25"},"5":{"text":"\"Mite tawh tai kidem a, nang hong bahsak uh ahileh sakol bangci dem theih ding na hi hiam? Gamsung b a nopna ah kimuktu na hileh Jordan gei-a c gampha lakah bang suak ding na hi hiam?","title":"Pasian Dawnna"},"6":{"text":"Na sanggamte le na innkuanpihte - amaute nangawn in nang hong lehhek uh a; nang hong langpangin nakpi-in awng uh hi. Hong phatgen uh hangin muang kei in.","ref":"Pn 26:24-25"},"7":{"text":"\"Ka inn ka nusia-a ka gouluahte ka phiatmang ta hi; Ka it ka mite, tuanu galte khut sungah ka pia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:1; Jer 17:4"},"8":{"text":"Ka gouluahte kei tungah tulaka humpinelkai bang uh hi. Tuanu in kei hong hawksana, tua ciangin ka mudah hi.","ref":"Hos 9:15"},"9":{"text":"Ka gouluah dingte kei tungah sasial ne vasa gial khat, sasial ne vasa dangte in a kimkot pan a tuk nainai uh bang hi lo hiam? Pai-in gamsa gilote khawm inla, a valhtum ding hong puak in.","ref":"Isa 56:9"},"10":{"text":"Tuucing tampi in ka lenggui lo susia ding uh a, ka lo a tuancilgawp ding uh hi; a nuam mahmah ka lo a kikhul lotul a suaksak ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 23:1"},"11":{"text":"Lotul kisuaksakin lei gawtakgawp a, ka muhna-ah kinusia-in a kem ding om lo ahi manin gambuppi kinusiacip hi.","ref":"Isa 42:25; Jer 23:10"},"12":{"text":"TOPA namsau in gammong khat panin mong khat dong a vatmai nadingin sehnel-gam khosang khempeuh panin a susiate hong kuan ding uh a; khat beek a suakta kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 47:6; Jer 3:2; Jer 7:10"},"13":{"text":"Amaute in mangbuh a vawh uh hangin lingkungte at ding uh a; amaute a hahkat luat uh hangin bangmah a lawhtak kei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin TOPA hehluatna hangin maizumna bek na kaikhawm ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 4:26"},"14":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi, \"Ka mi Israel-te ka piak gouluah a matsak ka veng migilote; amaute leitang panin ka botkhia dinga, amaute laka Judah innkuante ka botkhia ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka bawhkhiat khit ciangin amaute khuatuah kikin ama gam a luahna munuah ka puak kik ciat ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuateh ka mite omzia a sin ding uh a, Baal tunga kiciamzia ding ka mite nangawn a hilh bangun - ‘ TOPA nuntakna lo-in,’ ci-a na kiciam uh leh - tua ciangin ka mite lakah amaute ka kipsak pan ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin minam khat peuhpeuh in ka thu a ngaih kei leh ka botkhia kiuhkeuh dinga, ka susia ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 60:12: Jer 4:2"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah hong gen hih ahi hi: \"Pai-in puan kawnggak khat lei-in na kawng gak inla, tui tawh kisawhkhasak kei in,\" hong ci hi.","title":"Puan Kawnggak"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA hong lamlah bangin puan kawnggak khat lei-in ka kawng ka gak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu a nih veina kei tungah hong tunga:"},"4":{"text":"\"Na kawnggak lei-in na kawng gak inla tu mahmah in Perath a ah pai-in tua lai-a suang heng sungah sel in,\" hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Perath ah ka pai-a TOPA hong gensa bangin ka sel hi.","ref":"Pk 40:16"},"6":{"text":"Ni tampi nungin TOPA in kei tungah, \"Tu mahmah in Perath ah pai inla tua lai-ah sel-a kong sawl kawnggak la in,\" hong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin Perath ah ka pai-a kawnggak tokhia in ka selna mun pan ka lakhia hi, ahi hangin na kisia khina, a kizang thei kiuhkeuh kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"9":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi. \"Tua tawh kibangin Judah kiphatsakna le Jerusalem kiphatsakluatna ka susia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih a gilo mite in ka thu ngai nuam lo uh a, amau lungtang khauhna zui-in a na semin a biak uh pasian dangte a zuite hih kawnggak tawh kibangin - kimanna a nei kiuhkeuh kei ding uh hi!"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin kawnggak pen mihing kawng kimkot ah a kigak bangin Israel innkuan bup le Judah innkuan bup ka mi ding, ka minthan nading, hong kiphat nading le hong kipahtawi nadingin ka kawnga ka gak ahi hi. Ahi hangin amaute in thu a ngai kei uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Sp 26:19; Jer 7:26"},"12":{"text":"\"Amaute kiangah gen in: ‘Hih in Israel Pasian TOPA gen ahi hi: Savun- um peuhmah zu na dim ding hi,’ Tuateh amaute in, ‘Savun-um peuhmah zu dip ding kote in thei lo ka hi uh hiam,’ hong cih uh leh"},"13":{"text":"amaute kiangah, ‘ TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Keimah in hih gama teng khempeuh le David tokhom a tu kumpite, siampite, kamsangte Jerusalem a teng khempeuh tawh zu ka khamsak ding hi.","title":"Savun Zu-umte"},"14":{"text":"Khat le khat ka kisuzansak dinga pate le tapate zong a kibangin ka kisusak ding hi, TOPA in cikhia hi. Amaute hehpih lo, lainat lo, khuatuah loin ka susia ding hi, ci hi, ‘va ci un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 51:17; Jer 16:5; Eze 5:10"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in gen khin ahi manin kisathei kei unla za-in thusim un.","title":"Saltang dinga Tona"},"16":{"text":"Note tungah khuamial hong tunsak ma, khuamialna mualneute tungah na kimuktuk ma-un na Pasian uh TOPA min thangsak un. Khuavak na lamet uh hangin amah in khuamial sahpi suaksakin khuamial bikbekin a kheng hi.","ref":"Jos 7:19"},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin thu na ngaih kei uh leh na kiphatsakna uh hangin ka kapsim dinga; khitui luangin kah cihtakin ka kap ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA tuuhonte salin kikai ding hi.","ref":"Mal 2:2; Jer 9:1; Jer 14:18"},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa le kumpipa’ nu kiangah, \"Na minthanna kumpi lukhute uh na lutung panun kia ding ahi manin, na kumpi tokhom panin tuakkhia un,\" ci-in gen un.","ref":"Isa 22:17"},"19":{"text":"Negev a khuapite kikhakcip dinga kuamah in a hong kei ding hi. Judah-te khempeuh salin kikai dinga, kipaipihmang kiuhkeuh ding hi.","ref":"Jer 20:4; 52:30"},"20":{"text":"Dakto unla leilu-lam pana hong paite en dih un. Nang hong kipia tuuhonte, note kisaktheihpih tuute koi-ah om ta ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 6:22; Hab 1:6; Jer 23:2"},"21":{"text":"Nang kipawlpih dinga a tuam vilvela na koihte nang tungah TOPA in hong uksak ciangin bang gen ding na hi hiam? Numei nausuak kuan bangin na sa velval lo ding na hi hiam?","ref":"Jer 38:22; Jer 4:31"},"22":{"text":"\"Bang hangin hici-in kei tungah hong tung hiam?\" ci-in na kingaihsut leh - na mawhna tampite hangin na niksing hong kibalkeksaka, na pumpi hong kibawlsia ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 20:4"},"23":{"text":"Ethiopia-te b in a vun uh khek thei ahi hiam? Kamkei in agial khek thei ahi hiam? Gitlohna-a zongsangsa note in zong a hoih na bawl thei kei ding uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 6:36"},"24":{"text":"Sehnel-gam huih in buhvai a mutleng bangin keimah in note kong thehthang ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Hih in nangma tanh dinga ka sehsa ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei nong mangngilh a, pasian maan lote na muang hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Job 20:29; Mt 24:51; Isa 17:10"},"26":{"text":"Na zahmawh a kimuh nadingin na niksing na maitang khuh dongin kong lemtohsak ding a —","ref":"Ta 1:8; Eze 16:37"},"27":{"text":"na angkawmnate le huk lua-a na tau huthutnate zummawh-a na kizuaknate a kidawkkhia ding hi. Mualneute tung le lolaite ah, a kihhuai-a na gamtatnate ka mu khin hi. Jerusalem aw, gimna nak thuak na nicia! Bangtan vei ninnin lai ding na hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Hos 8:5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in guahhaanna tawh kisai Jeremiah tunga tung TOPA thu ahi hi:","title":"Guahhaan’na, Kialpi, Namsau","ref":"Isa 5:6"},"2":{"text":"\"Judah thum hi, a khuapite maimang kuankuan ta hi; amaute in a gam uh kah uh a, Jerusalem panin kahna gingkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 3:26; Jer 8:21"},"3":{"text":"Uliante in a nasemte uh tui tawi dingin a sawl uh hi; amaute in tuikhuk a zuat uh hangin tui a mu kei uh hi. Amaute tui dim loin a ciah uh hi; lungkhamin cimawh uh a, a lu uh a khuh uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:31"},"4":{"text":"Gam sungah guah zu lo ahi manin leitang a khangkham hi; lokhote cimawhin a lu uh a khuh uh hi.","ref":"Jer 3:3"},"5":{"text":"Lopa om lo ahi manin gam sunga sazuk nangawn in a no suaktung nusia liang hi."},"6":{"text":"Gamsung laate khosang ah ding uh a, se-al bangin a kamnak saisai uh hi; lonona om lo ahi manin a hakzo kei uh hi.\"","ref":"Job 39:5-6"},"7":{"text":"TOPA aw, ka mawhnate un kote langah teci a pang ta zongin nangma min hangin bang khatpeuh hong hihsak in. Ahang in, kote nungtolhna lian mahmah a, nang tungah kong mawh khin ta uh hi.","ref":"Hos 5:5"},"8":{"text":"Israel’ lametna, a lungdon huna Honpa aw, bang hangin ka gam sunguah midang suaka, zan khat bek a taam khualzinpa tawh kibang na hi hiam?","ref":"Jer 17:13; Ph 46:1"},"9":{"text":"Bang hangin mi cimawh bang le a hon zo nawn lo galhangpa bang na hi hiam? TOPA aw, kote tawh nang na omkhawm a, na minin kote hong kilo hi; kote hong nusia kei in!","ref":"Isa 50:2; Ph 27:9"},"10":{"text":"Hih mite tawh kisai-in TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Amaute in pai kawikawi nuamsa mahmah uh a; a khe uh a dek zo kei uh hi. Tua ciangin TOPA in amaute sang lo a; tu-in a gitlohnate uh ciamtehin a mawhnate uh hangin dan a tuaksak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 119:101; Jer 2:25; Jer 6:20; Am 5:22; Hos 9:9; Hos 8:13"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei tungah, \"Hih mite nopsak nading hong ngen nawn kei in."},"12":{"text":"An a tan uh hangin amau kikona ka ngai kei dinga, meihal biakna le an-a biakna hong piak uh hangin ka sang kei ding hi. Tua sangsikin amaute namsau, kialpi le pulpi in ka susia ding hi,\" hong ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin, \"Ah, Thupipen TOPA , kamsangte in,’ Note in namsau mu loin kialpi na thuak kei ding uh hi. Hih munah tawntung lungnopna kong pia ding hi, cici mai uh hi,\" ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei tungah, \"Kamsangte in kei minin zuauthu a gen uh hi. Amaute ka sawl kei a, zong ka hopih kei hi. Amaute in note tungah a maan lo mangmuhna, aisanna, milim biakna a le amau lungsima suakte hong gen uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin kei mina kamsangte tungah TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Amaute in ka sawllohpi-in, ‘Namsau le kialpi in hih gam a sukha kei ding hi,\" a ci ding uh hi. Tua kamsangte tektek kialpi le namsau-in a si ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tuateh amaute thugenna mite namsau le kialpi hangin Jerusalem kongzingte ah a kilawnkhia ding hi. Amaute, a zite a tanu a tapate uh a vui ding khat beek a om kei ding hi. Keimah in amaute thalawh tuahsiatna, amau tungah ka buaksuk ding hi.","ref":"Jer 5:12-13; 27:14"},"17":{"text":"\"Amaute tungah hih thu gen in: \"Ka ta nungak bit ka mite - nakpitakin kisat a, nak liam mahmah ahi manin ka mitte sun le zanin kan hun nei lo khitui tawh kidiah den hen.","ref":"2Ku 19:21; Jer 8:21; Jer 9:1"},"18":{"text":"Gamsung ah pai leng namsau-a kithatte ka mu a; khuapi sungah pai leng lah kialpi-a puksite ka mu hi. Kamsangte le siampite amau theihlohna gamah a paimang ta uh hi, ‘va ci in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:10"},"19":{"text":"Nang in Judah a nial kiuhkeuh mah na hi hiam? Zion a nolh mah na hi hiam? Bang hangin kote a kidamsak thei lo dingin hong hingimsak na hi hiam? Kilemna ka lamet uh hangin hoihna hong tung lo a, dam hun ka lamet uh hangin lauhuaina bek a om hi.","ref":"Jer 7:29"},"20":{"text":"TOPA aw, kote in ka gitlohna uh le ka pate uh khialhna ka thei uh a; nang tungah a mawh taktak mah ka hi uh hi.","ref":"Jer 3:13; Da 9:7-8"},"21":{"text":"Nangma min na khualna-in kote hong nolh kei inla, a minthang na tokhom min neusak kei in. Kote tawh na thukhun phawk inla palsat kei in.","ref":"Jos 7:9; Jer 3:17; Pk 2:24"},"22":{"text":"Kimanna a nei lo minamte’ milimte in guah zusak thei ahi hiam? Vante in amau thu-in khuapi guah zusak thei ahi hiam? A zusak kei hi, nangma zuksak ahi hi; TOPA kote Pasian aw. Tua ahi ciangin hihte khempeuh nangma hihsa ahi manin nangma sungah lametna ka nei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 135:7; Isa 43:10"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Moses le Samuel ka mai-ah hong ding zawzen uh zongin hih mite lamah ka lungsim a nga tuan kei ding hi. Ka muhna panin amaute hawlkhia in! Paikhiasak in!"},"2":{"text":"Amaute in nang kiangah, ‘Koi-ah pai ding ka hi uh hiam?’ hong cih uh leh amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘A si dinga kisehsate sihna ah, namsau thuak dinga kisehsate namsau ah, kialpi thuak dinga kisehsate kialpi ah, sala kaih dinga kisehsate sal ah,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 43:11; Jer 14:12"},"3":{"text":"Amaute tungah suksiatna nam li ka tungsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia a, thah nading namsau, a tuahmang dingin ui, a susia ding le a nemang dingin huihlak vasate le leitunga ganhingte ka sawl ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Hezekiah tapa Manasseh in Jerusalem a, a bawl thu hangin leitunga kumpi-gamte khempeuh, amaute ka mudahsak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:25"},"5":{"text":"\"Jerusalem aw, kua in nang hong hehpih ding ahi hiam? Kua in nang hong kah ding ahi hiam? Na omzia dong dingin kua hong baang ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 51:19"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah in kei nong nolh khin zo hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Nang na nungtolhtolh hi. Tua hi-a na tungah ka khut hong nga-in kong susia ding hi; kong khuatuah thei nawn kei hi.","ref":"Jer 6:19; Zep 1:4; Jer 7:20; Am 7:8"},"7":{"text":"Na gamsung khuapi kongpite ah buhhah ciangka tawh amaute ka hah ding hi. Amaute in a lampi uh khek lo uh ahi manin sihna le siatna ka tungsak ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 28:22; Jer 1821"},"8":{"text":"Keimah in tuipi a sehnel sangin nupi meigong ka tamsakzaw ding hi. Ta khanglai nei nupite tungah suntangpi-in siatna ka tungsak dinga; amau tungah thakhatin lungkhamna le launa ka tungsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 47:9; Jer 6:4; Job 18:11"},"9":{"text":"Ta sagih a nei nupi, khakham vei-in a husam ding hi. Suntangpi-in ama ni tum dinga; tuanu zahlaakin a mindai ding hi. A nungta lai sunte a galte uh mai-ah namsau a thah dingin ka koih ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"1Sa 2:5; Jer 7:19; 2Ku 25:7; Jer 21:7"},"10":{"text":"Kalasai, nu aw, gambuppi mi tawh kilangneih a, mite mawhsak dingin ta a nong neih sese! Sum leitawi loin ba lo napi mite in kei hong hamsiat lai uh hi.","ref":"Job 3:1; Jer 1:19; Sp 25:36"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Thu hoih nadingin nang kong hu taktak dinga; haksat hun le lungdon hunin na galte nang tungah kong thumsak taktak ding hi.","ref":"Jer 40:4"},"12":{"text":"\"Mi khat in sik - leilu-lam pana sik - ahikeh sumngo sutan zo ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 28:14"},"13":{"text":"Na gam sungtengua na mawhna khempeuh hangin na hauhna uh le na goute khempeuh uh aman piak lohin galvanlakin ka pia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 44:12"},"14":{"text":"Note langah a kuang ding ka hehna mei kitawh ding ahi manin, note theihlohna gamsung a khatah sila kong suaksak ding hi,\" hong ci hi."},"15":{"text":"TOPA aw, na theitel hi; hong phawk inla hong veh in. Kei hong bawlsiate tungah phu hong laksak in. Nang a lungduai na hi hi - kei hong lakhia kei in; nangma ai-in mawhsakna ka thuak lam ngaihsun in.","ref":"Jer 12:3; Pk 34:6"},"16":{"text":"Na thute hong tun ciangin ka ne hi; na min vom ka hi manin TOPA Thahatpen Pasian aw, tuate ka nopsakpih a, ka lungsim ah nuam ka sa hi.","ref":"Eze 3:3; Kil 10:10; Jer 14:9"},"17":{"text":"A gualnuam mite lakah ka tu ngei kei-a, amaute tawh ka gualnuam khawm kei hi. Hih mite nang lamah kiheisak inla, amau lamah nang kihei peuhmah kei in."},"20":{"text":"Keimah in hih mite adingin kulh, khuapi umna sumngo kulh kong suaksak ding hi; nang hong hu-in hong suaktasak dingin hong ompih ka hi manin amaute in nang hong do uh hangin hong zozo lo ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Keimah in migilote khut panin kong honkhia dinga mi kheltatte khut panin kong tankhia ding hi,\" hong ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Gimna Ni"},"2":{"text":"\"Hih mun ah zi pi kei inla, tanu tapa zong nei kei in,\" hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, hih gama suak tanute le tapate thu le amaute nu numeite le amaute pa pasalte thu tawh kisai TOPA gen hih ahi hi:"},"4":{"text":"\"Amaute sih-natna in a si ding uh hi. Amaute kuamah in kah loin kuamah in zong vui lo dinga, leilakah a ki-ek nusiat ding hi. Amaute namsau le kialpi-in simang ding uh a, a misiluangte uh huihlak vasate le leitung ganhingte an a suak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 83:10"},"5":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Misite inn ah lut kei in; vakahin na dahpih lam zong va lak kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite tung panin ka thupha ka itna le ka hehpihna ka dok kik khin hi, \" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Hih gam ah ulian uneu a si ding uh hi. A kivui a kikah om loin amaute hangin khat beek in a pumpi uh kuiliam lo ding uh a, a sam uh a met kei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Misi kahte - a nu si, a pa site nangawn - hehpihna-in kuamah in an lui lo dinga, hehnepna-in tuisik zong a suah kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 15:5; Eze 9:5-6"},"8":{"text":"\"Tuateh pawi kibawlna inn ah ne-in dawnin a muitual dingin lut kei in."},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, TOPA Israel-te Pasian gen hih ahi hi: Note theih hun sung na muh tektekun hih mun ah lungdamna le kipahna awte le zineipa le mo awte ka beisak ding hi.","ref":"Kil 18:23"},"10":{"text":"\"Hihte khempeuh hih mite tungah na gen ciangin amaute in, ‘Bang hangin TOPA in hihzah lawmlawma alian gimna a tunsak dingin khensat ahi hiam? Eite in bang khialhna bawl i hi hiam? TOPA eite Pasian tungah bang mawhna bawl i hi hiam?\" ci-in hong dot uh leh"},"11":{"text":"amaute tungah TOPA in, ‘Na pate un kei hong taisan uh a, pasian dangte zui-in a na semin bia uh hi. Kei hong taisan uh a, ka thukham zui lo uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin, note na pate uh sangin na uangzaw lai uh hi. En un, ka thu nong man tangun na lungsim gitlohna uh na zui tentan teitei uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih gam panin note le na pate un zong a theih ngei loh uh gam ah kong lawnkhia dinga, hong angvan nawn lo ding ka hi manin tua lai-ah sun le zanin pasian dangte’ na na sem ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Tp 29:24"},"14":{"text":"\" TOPA in, \"Bangbang ahi zongin mite in, ‘Egypt panin Israel-te a paikhiatpih TOPA nuntakna lo-in’ ci-a a kiciam tangun,"},"15":{"text":"‘Israel mite leilu lam pan le eite hong hawlkhiatna gam khempeuh panin hong paikhiatpih TOPA nuntakna lo-in,’ ci-in a kiciam hun uh hong tung ding hi,’ ci hi. Ahang in, a pute uh ka piaksa gamah amaute ka pi kik ding hi.","ref":"Jer 23:7-8; 24:6"},"16":{"text":"\" TOPA in, ‘Ahi hangin tu-in nga mante tampi ka kuansak a, amaute a man ding uh hi. Tuate nungah sabengte tampi ka kuansak dinga, amaute in muallian mualneute tung khempeuh le suangheng sungte a bengmang ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute paina khempeuh ka mu a, kei muhna panin amaute kisel thei loin amaute mawhnate zong a sel thei tuan kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute gitlohna le a mawhna uh a zah nihin ka thuk ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in nuntakna nei lo, a zumhuai milim bawltawmin ka gamsung ninsak uh a, a kihhuai a milimte uh tawh ka gouluahna mun teng a dim khin uh hi,\" hong ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka thahatna, ka kulh muanhuai le ka lungdon huna ka bukna TOPA aw, leimongte panin minamte nang kiangah hong pai uh a, \"Ka pate un pasian maan lo le kimanna a nei lo, a hoih a bawl thei lo milimte longal bangmah a nei kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 46:1; Ph 4:2; Isa 40:19"},"20":{"text":"Mihing in ama pasian ding bawltawm thei ahi hiam? Bawltawm thei napi tuate pasian ahi kei hi!\" a ci ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin amaute ka hilh dinga - hih hunin ka vangliatna le ka thahatna amaute ka hilh ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ka min TOPA ahilam a thei ding uh hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Judah’ mawhna a lungtang satak pek tung le a biakna-tau kite tungah sikzumin kikui kuakin suang hiamin kikhuak hi.","ref":"Pk 27:2"},"2":{"text":"A tate nangawn un singlim nuai le mualsang tunga a biakna-taute uh le Asherah khuamte a ciamteh thei lai uh hi.","ref":"Jer 2:20; 2Kh 24:18"},"3":{"text":"Na gamsung khempeuh uha mawhna hangin gam sunga ka mualpi le na neih na lam b na goute khempeuh uh, na munsangte uh tawh galvanmat ka suaksak khin ding hi.","ref":"Jer 15:13; Jer 26:18; Mic 3:12"},"4":{"text":"Na mawhna uh hangin kong piaksa gouluahna na taan ding uh hi. A khan kimtan ciangin a neihsate beimang dinga, a tawpna ah mihai ahilam kilangsak ding hi.","ref":"Lk 12:20"},"12":{"text":"Eite munsiangtho omna mun ahileh a tunga kipan a kitawisang a minthang tokhom omna ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 3:17"},"13":{"text":"Israel-te lamet TOPA aw, nang hong taisan khempeuh kimaizumsak ding hi. Nangmah hong taisante leivui laka lai kigelh a suak ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a nungta ciktui ahi TOPA a taisan khin uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:28; Ph 69:28"},"14":{"text":"TOPA aw, kong pahtawipa nang na hi manin, hong damsak in, tua hileh ka dam ding hi; hong honkhia in tua hileh ka suakta ding hi.","ref":"Isa 30:26"},"15":{"text":"Amaute in kei tungah, \" TOPA thugen koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tu-in tangtungsak in,’\" hong cici uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Nangma tuucinna sung panin ka taikhia kei a; siatna ni ka deih loh lam lah na theihsa ahi hi. Ka kama pusuakkhia peuhmah na telsa ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Siatna ni cianga ka bukna na hi hi, kei hong lausak kei in.","ref":"Jer 16:19; Na 1:7"},"18":{"text":"Kei hong bawlsiate maizumsak inla, ahi hangin kei hong maizumsak kei in; amaute lausak inla, kei hong lausak kei in; amaute tungah siatna ni tungsak inla, siatna athuapthuapin tungsak in.","ref":"Ph 35:1-8"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in kei tungah a thugen hih ahi hi: \"Pai-in Judah kumpite a sungtum a pusuahna tangpite kongpi ah va ding inla: Jerusalem kongpi dang khempeuh ah zong va ding in."},"20":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, \"Judah kumpite le Judah mi khempeuh le Jerusalem khua sungah tenga hih kongpi a tawnte khempeuh aw, TOPA thugen za un.","title":"Sabbath Sianthosak Nading"},"21":{"text":"TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: Sabbath ni-in van na puak loh ding uh le Jerusalem kongpite ah na lutpih loh nadingun kidawm un."},"22":{"text":"Na inn panun van puakhia kei unla Sabbath ni-in bangmah sem loin na pute uh tunga ka thupiak bangin Sabbath ni a siangtho in tang un."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in ahileh ngai loin thusim lo uh a, ngawngkhauhin ka thu ngai loin, zuih zong a sawm tuan kei uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in ka thu nong man uh leh, TOPA in kong cihinah Sabbath ni-in hih khuapi kongpite ah van bangmah na tumpih kei ding uh a, Sabbath ni siangthotakin tangin tua ni-in bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi;"},"25":{"text":"tua ciangin David tokhom tunga a tu kumpite a uliante uh tawh hih khuapi kongpite tawnin hong pai ding uh hi. Amaute le a uliante uh sakolleng le sakol in hong tuang ding uh a, Judah mite le Jerusalem a mite tawh hong tonin hih khuapi ah mi a teng den ta ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Judah khuapite pan le Jerusalem kima khuaneute pan, Benjamin gam le nitumna-lam mualbul pan mualtung gam le Negev panin mite hong pai ding uh a, TOPA inn ah meihal biakna le biakpiaknate, an-a biakna le gimnamtui le lungdamkohna biakna hong puak ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka thu hong mang loin Sabbath ni a siangtho-in na tan kei uh a, Sabbath ni-in Jerusalem kongpi tawnin van puasa in na pai teitei uh leh Jerusalem kongpite ah a kisumit thei lo mei ka tawhkuang dinga, tua in a kulh muanhuai a kangtum ding hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in TOPA tung pana Jeremiah tunga tung thu ahi hi:","title":"Beelseekpa’ Innah"},"2":{"text":"Beelseekpa innah paisuk in, tua lai-ah ka thupuak kong pia ding hi,\" hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin beelseekpa innah ka paisuka lengpei tunga a sep laitak ka tuak hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin beel dinga a bawlsa a khut sunga tungman a kisia hi; tua ciangin beelseekpa in beel dang khat dingin bawl kika ama deih bangbangin a seek hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"6":{"text":"\"Israel innkuante aw, hih beelseekpa hih bangin nang hong hih thei hi lo ka hi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Israel innkuante aw, beelseekpa tungman bangin no zong ka khut sungah na om uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Minam khat ahi a, kumpi-gam khat ahi zongin botkhia-in, khenkhamin, suksiat dingin, hun khat lai-a ka zaksaksa ahi zongin,"},"8":{"text":"tua ka vauhilh minamte a gitlohna panun a kisik uh leh tua ciangin ka khel kik dinga, ka geelsa siatna ka tuaksak kei ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuateh hun dang khatah minam khat ahi a, kumpi-gam khat ahi zongin lam ding le suan dingin ka zasak khin zongin,"},"10":{"text":"ka muhna ah gitlohna a gamtat-a ka thu hong man kei leh, tua ciangin ama adingin bawl ka sawm na hoih ka ngaihsun pha kik ding hi.","ref":"Isa 45:9"},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tu-in Judah mite tung le Jerusalem a tengte tungah gen in, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: En un, note tungah siatna tunsak ding ngimna khat nei dingin ka kithawi hi. Tua ahi ciangin note na vekun na gitlohna panun kihei unla na omzia uh le na nasep uh kibawlpha un,’ ci in."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute in, ‘Khiatna nei kei, ka sawmsa bangun semsuak lel nung; ka vekun komau gitloh lungsim khauhna mah zui lel nung,’ hong ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 17:13; Isa 57:10"},"13":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Minamte lakah kan dih un: Hih bang thu a za a om kha hiam? Gamlapi pana luang tua tuivot kang ngei ahi hiam? a"},"15":{"text":"Tua hi napi ka mite in kei hong mangngilh uh a; amaute lampi le tanglai lampite ah amaute a muktusak kimanna a nei lo milimte tungah gimnamtui a hal lailai uh hi. Tua hi a hong pai un, i kam mahmah tawh nialin a gen peuhmah va thusim kei ni,\" a ci uh hi."},"19":{"text":"TOPA aw, ka thugen hong ngai inla; kei hong mawhsakte thugen za in!","ref":"Ph 71:13"},"20":{"text":"Gitlohna, thu hoiha thuk ding mah ahi hiam? Amaute khialhna maisak kei inla amaute mawhna nang muhna panin phiatkhiatsak kei in; na mai-ah lawnthal inla na heh hun mahin thuaksak pah ek in.","ref":"Jer 10:24"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Pai inla beelseekpa kiangah leibeel khat lei in. Tua lai-ah kong gen thu tangko in,"},"3":{"text":"‘Judah kumpite le Jerusalem mite aw, TOPA thugen za un. Hih in Israel-te Pasian Thahatpen TOPA thugen ahi hi: Ngai un! Hih muna kong tunsak ding siatna pen in a za mite bil a vut ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, amaute in kei hong taisan uh a, hih mun gamdang pasiante omna suahin; a pate uh le Judah kumpite in zong a theih ngei loh uh pasiante tungah kithoihna halin, mawhpengte sisan tawh hih mun a dimsak zo uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in ka thupiak ahi lo ka gen ngei loh, ka ngaihsut khak ngei beek loh Baal biakna-in a tapate uh hal nading Baal adingin munsang a bawl uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin kidawm in TOPA in a geninah: Mite in hih mun Topheth ahikeh Ben Hinnom Kuam ci nawn loin Kigawhna Kuam a cih hun uh hong tung ding hi."},"7":{"text":"\" ‘Hih munah Judah le Jerusalem geelna ka siasak a ding hi. Hih khuapi Topheth ka bangsak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem a innte le Judah-te kumpite, amau innkhum tungah vana aksi honte khempeuh tunga gimnamtui a hal innte le pasian dangte tungah dawntheih-a biakna a sungsate khempeuh hih Topheth mun tawh a kibangin a nin ahi hi, ci in,’ hong ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 2:9; Jer 7:32"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in thu gen dinga a sawlna mun Topheth panin Jeremiah kileh kika, TOPA biakinnpi tual ah dingin mi khempeuh tungah,"},"15":{"text":"‘Hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘Ngai un!
