Amaute in"},"6":{"text":"galvan matin la-in lamang ding uh a, Babylon ah a tun ding uh hi. Tuateh nang Pashhur le na inn a na ompih khempeuh Babylon ah salin hong kikai ding hi. Tua lai-ah nang le na lawmte in zuau kamsanga na genna uh mite khempeuh na si ding uh a, hong kivui ding hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 20:17; Jer 52:27"},"7":{"text":"TOPA aw, kei nong khem c a, kei hong kikhem d ahi hi; kei sangin nang na hatzaw a, kei nong zo hi. Sun nilohin ciamnuihna-in hong kinei a, a kuamahpeuh in hong selnoh uh hi.","ref":"Pk 5:23; Isa 8:11; Job 17:2","title":"Jeremiah Phunna"},"8":{"text":"Ka paukhiat nak leh ngongtatna le siatna ka tangko khia hi. Tua ahi ciangin TOPA kammal ka genkhiatna hangin sun niloh-in hong ki-engko a hong kisimmawh hi.","ref":"Jer 6:7; 2Kh 36:16; Jer 6:10"},"9":{"text":"\"Amah genkha nawn kei ning, ama min lo nawn dah ning ka cih hangin lah ama thu ka lungtang ah mei bangin kuanga ka guh sung hong zen hi. Ka ki-ipipna-in ka gima, gen loin ka om thei peuhmah kei hi.","ref":"Ph 39:3"},"10":{"text":"Hong huau tampi ka za a, \"Kim le pam ah launa bekbek! Amah hek un! Amah hek un!\" hong kici hi. Ka lawmte khempeuh in ka puk ding hong pang gige kawmin, \"Amah i khem zo kha ding hi; khem zo leng amah i zo pah dinga a phu i la zo ding hi,\" kici uh hi.","ref":"Jer 6:25; Isa 29:21; Ph 41:9; Lk 11:53-54; 1Ku 19:2; Jer 11:19"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in a thahat galhangpa bangin kei hong ompih hi; tua ciangin kei hong bawlsiate muktu-in hong zo lo ding uh hi. Amaute gal lelin zahlak gawp ding uh a, amaute thuman’lohna a kimangngilh ngei kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 1:8"},"12":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA aw, nang in a thumaante na encian a, lungsim le ngaihsutna na sittel hi, ka thu nang tung hong tun khin ka hi manin, amaute tunga na phulakna kei hong musak in.","ref":"Jer 17:10; Jer 11:20; Ph 54:7; 59:10"},"13":{"text":"TOPA la sak un! TOPA pahtawi un! Amah in migilote khut panin a kitasamte nuntakna a hu hi.","ref":"Isa 12:6; Ph 97:10; Ph 35:10"},"14":{"text":"Ka suah ni kihamsiat ta hen! Ka nu in kei hong suah ni in thupha ngah kei hen!"},"15":{"text":"Ka pa, thuthak va zasaka, lungdamsak mahmah in, \"Ta khat nei cin, pasal hi ei!\" ci-a a va kopa in hamsiatna thuak ta hen."},"16":{"text":"TOPA in hehpih lo-a a lotthal khuapite tawh tua mipa kibang hen. Amah in zingsangin kahna aw za henla sunin galsimna aw za ta hen.","ref":"Pc 19:25"},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, amah in ka nu gilsung ah hong sisak loin, ka nu, ka hankhuk suaksak lo-a, a gil sungah hong omsak suak kei hi.","ref":"Job 10:18-19"},"18":{"text":"Bang hangin lungkhamna le dahna mu ding le maizumsa-a si dingin ka nu gil pan suakkhia laizang ka hi hiam?","ref":"Ph 90:9; Job 3:10-11"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiangah Malkijah’ tapa Pashhur le Maaseiah’ tapa siampi Zephaniah a sawl ciangin ama tungah TOPA thu a tung hi:","title":"Pasian in Zedekiah Ngetna Nial"},"2":{"text":"\"Babylon kumpi Nebuchadnezzar a in kote hong sim ahi manin ko adingin TOPA thu hong dotsak in. Ko kiang pan amah a nung kik nadingin TOPA in a beisa huna a hih bangin nalamdang khat hong bawlsak kha ding hi,\" a ci hi"},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin Jeremiah in amaute kiangah, \"Zedekiah kiangah gen in,"},"4":{"text":"‘Hih in Israel Pasian TOPA gen ahi hi: Kulh pua a no hong umcih Babylon kumpipa le Babylon mite b na dona uh - na khut sungua galhiamte, no lehdona-in ka zangsak ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute khuapi sungah ka khawm ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei mahmah in hehsa lungsosa thangpai mahmah kawmin a thahat ka khut ka zankhia dinga note kong do ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih khuapi sunga teng - a mihing a ganhingin ka sattukkhawm dinga - amaute a lauhuai pulpi-in a si ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin TOPA in, ‘Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, a uliante le hih khuapi mi - pulpi, namsau le kialpi pana suakta lai sun teng tawh amaute a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar le a galte uh tungah ka pia ding hi. Amah in hehpih lo, lainat lo, khuatuah loin namsau in a that ding hi,’ ci hi."},"8":{"text":"\"Tua banah mipite tungah, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in note mai-ah sihna lampi le nuntakna lampi ka koihkhawm hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih khuapi sunga a om peuhmah namsau, kialpi le pulpi-in a si ding uh hi. Ahi hangin paikhia-a a umcih Babylon mite tungah a lut peuhmah nungta dinga; a nuntakna a suahtak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih khuapi hoih nading hilo a nat nadingin ka khentat khin hi,’ TOPA in cikhia hi. Babylon kumpipa khutah ka pia dinga amah in mei-in a susia ding hi.","ref":"Jer 44:11,27; 52:13"},"11":{"text":"\"Tua tham loin Judah kumpipa innkuante tungah gen inla, ‘ TOPA thugen za un,"},"12":{"text":"David innkuante aw, hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Zingsang simin thutangin thu khen unla, a nengniampa khut panin a kisutgawppa hukhia un; tua hi kei leh na bawlsa uh gitlohna hangin ka thangpaihna mei bangin kuang dinga kuamah in a sumit zo kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 13:18; Jer 22:3; Ph 27:11; Jer 23:2; Jer 10:10; Isa 1:31"},"13":{"text":"Mualkuam zang panin sangtuam a, suangmual zangtam-a om Jerusalem aw, nang kong langpan hi, TOPA in cikhia hi - nang in, \"Eite langkhatah kua pang zo ding hiam, bukna ah kua lut thei ding hiam?\" a cipa na hi hi.","ref":"Ph 125:2"},"14":{"text":"Nangma sepsa tawh kituakin dan kong tuaksak ding hi, TOPA in cikhia hi. Na tulak uh mei in ka hal dinga, tua in note kimkota khempeuh a kangtummang ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 3:10-11; 2Kh 36:19; Eze 20:47"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Judah kumpipa’ kumpi inn ah paisuk inla tua lai-ah hih thupuak tangko in:","title":"Kumpi Gilote Tungah Thukhenna"},"2":{"text":"David kumpi tokhom tunga tu Judah kumpipa aw, nang le na uliante le hih kongpi tawna pai mi khempeuh in TOPA kammal za un."},"3":{"text":"TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Thumaan thutangin nasem un. A kisut gawp mite a nengniamte khut panin hukhia un, pemtate, pa nei lote le meigongte tungah khial loin gamhtat kei unla hih munah mawhpengte sisan luangsak kei un."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, hih thupiakte limtaka na zuih den uh leh David tokhom tunga tupa hih kumpi’ inn kongpite tawnin ama uliante le a mite tawh sakolleng le sakol in a lutkhawm ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin hih thupiakte a zuih kei uh leh TOPA kei le kei ka kiciam hi, hih kumpi’ inn a kisusia ding hi,’ ka ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 17:27; Mic 6:8; Heb 6:13"},"6":{"text":"Ahang in, Judah kumpipa inn tawh kisai TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: \"Nangmah in kei tungah, Gilead na banga, Lebanon mualdawn na bang zongin keimah in sehnel-gam hong bangsakin kuama tenlohna khuapite tawh kong kibangsak ding hi.","ref":"Pc 31:21; Mic 3:12"},"7":{"text":"A susiate amau galhiam ciat uh tawh nang susia dingin kong kuansak ding a, amaute in na tamtak khuam hoihte uh hong phuksakin mei-ah a khul ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 4:7; Isa 10:34"},"8":{"text":"\"Minam tampite hih khuapi nawkin pai ding uh a, khat le khat kidongin, ‘Bang hangin TOPA in hih khuapi lian hici bawl hi ding hiam?’ kici ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tuateh: ‘Amaute in TOPA a Pasian uh thukhun taisan uh a; pasian dangte bia-in a na a sep hang uh ahi hi,\" ci-in kidawng ding hi, ci hi,’ va ci in,\" hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"A sisa kumpipa kah kei unla, a supnate hangin thum kei un; sal-a kikai ama adingin kah cihtakin kap zaw un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah hong kileh kik ngei nawn loin a pianna gam mu kik ngei nawn lo ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahang in, a pa za a laih Judah kumpi-a om, ahi hangin ama omna mun panin a paikhiasa Josiah’ tapa Shallum a thu tawh kisai TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Amah a kileh kik ngei nawn kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in sal-a a pina uh munah si dinga; hih leitung a mu kik nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:31,34"},"13":{"text":"\"A kumpi inn thumaan loin lama a inndei tungnungte thutang loin a lam mi, a gam sunga mite a mawkna-in semsaka, amaute thaman a pia lo mi in gimna thuak ta hen.","ref":"Mic 3:10; Jas 5:4"},"14":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Kumpi inn a lianpi khat ka lam dinga, inndei tungnung tampi ka neisak ding hi,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin kongvang neu zapipi bawla, tamtaksing thuapsawnin asanin a zem hi.","ref":"Isa 5:8-9; 2Sa 7:2"},"15":{"text":"Tamtak tam neih semsemna in nang kumpi hong suaksak ahi hiam? Na pa in nek ding dawn ding nei lo ahi hiam? Amah in thumaan le thutangin na sem a, tua ciangin na khempeuh ah a daupai hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:25"},"16":{"text":"Amah in a zawngte le a kitasamte’ thu panpih a, na khempeuh ah a daupai hi. Tua in kei nong theihna uh a khiatna hi lo ahi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 36:10"},"17":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin na lungsim uh le na mit un, aman lo-a metna bek mitsuana, mawhpengte sisan luansak ding, mi nuainet ding le ngongtat ding bek na sawm uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 56:11; Tp 28:33"},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Judah kumpipa Josiah’ tapa Jehoiakim tawh kisai-in TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Amaute ama adingin thumin: ‘Ka sanggampa tazen aw! Ka sanggamnu tazen aw! A ci kei ding uh hi. ‘Ka pu aw tazen aw! A thupina aw, tazen aw! ci-in a thum kei ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amah laa khat kivui bangin - Jerusalem kongpite pualam ah kikaikhia in a kipai ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"20":{"text":"\"Lebanon ah paito unla kiko khia un, Bashan ah na aw uh kizasak un; na pawlte khempeuh uh kizogawp ahi manin Abarim panin kiko un.","ref":"Ph 68:15; Jer 30:14; Ms 27:12"},"21":{"text":"Awlmawh na neih loh laitakin kong vauhilh hangin, ‘Hong mang kei ning!’ na ci hi. Na neu tungua kipan a tuaci den na hi uh a; ka thu nong mang kei uh hi.","ref":"Jer 3:25; 32:30"},"22":{"text":"Na tuucingte khempeuh huih in lenmang dinga, na pawlte salin a paimang ta ding hi. Tua ciangin na gitlohna khempeuh hangin na mai zumin na zahlaak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 28:64; tg 20; Jer 7:19"},"23":{"text":"No, Lebanon b ah tengin tamtak inn sunga om hithiatte aw, numei nausuah nat bangin natna in note tungah hong bingphawn ciangin bang na ci tau uh tam!","ref":"Jer 4:31"},"24":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, Jehoiakim tapa Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin c ka khut taklam a ka zungbuh na hi zawzen zongin kong suahkhia lai veve ding hi;"},"25":{"text":"Nang hong that nuam na kihtak - Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar le Babylon mite d tungah kong pia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Nang le ta-a hong nei na nu gamdang ah kong nawhkhiamang dinga, na lamh kiatlohna munuah na nihun na sikhawm ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Na ciah kik nopna munuah na ciah kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi,\" a ci khia hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:8"},"28":{"text":"Hih mipa, kuama deih loh beel kitamsa Jehoiachin hi lo ahi hiam? Bang hangin amah le a tate a theih lohna uh gamah kilawnkhia ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 15:1; 17:4"},"29":{"text":"Ka gam, ka gam, ka gam aw, TOPA thu za dih ve!","ref":"Jer 6:19; Mic 1:2"},"30":{"text":"TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: \"Hihpa tasel in ciamteh in a khantawnin a daupai ngei kei ding hi, ahang in, ama suante daupai lo ding uh a, David kumpi tokhom ah khat beek tu loin Judah a uk ngei nawn kei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 3:18; Mt 1:12; Job 18:19; Ph 94:20"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Ka lonona muna tuute susia-a a thehthang tuucingte in gimna thuak ta hen!\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","title":"A Thumaan Hiang"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka mite a cing tuucingte tungah TOPA Israel Pasian in a gen hih ahi hi: \"Note in ka tuuhonte thehthangin na nawhmang uh a, amaute don loin na khoi kei uh hi. Na gamtatsiate uh hangin dan kong tuaksak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka tuuhon a baanglaite ka hawlkhiatna gamte panin ka kaikhawm dinga, amaute gahpha in a khan nading uh amau lonona munah ka puak kik ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute donin a uk ding tuucingte ka koih dinga amaute lau nawn lo, lungkham nawn loin khat beek a mangthang nawn kei ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"5":{"text":"TOPA in: \"David a panin pilna tawh ukin gam sungah thumaan thutangin na a sem ding kumpi ahi thumaan Hiang khat ka khankhiatsak hun hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Isa 11:1; Zec 6:12; Isa 4:2"},"6":{"text":"Ama uk hun sungin Judah kihon dinga Israel ngaihmuangtakin a teng ding hi. Amah a kisap nading min in: TOPA Eite Thumaanna\" ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 33:16"},"7":{"text":"\"Tuatak ciangin TOPA in cikhia hi, ‘Mihing in, Egypt panin Israel mite hong paikhiatpih TOPA nuntak ka lo hi,’ ci nawn lo ding uh a,"},"8":{"text":"ahi hangin amaute in, ‘Gam leilu lam le amaute a hawlkhiatna gamte khempeuh panin Israel suante a paikhiatpih TOPA nuntakna lo-in,’ a cih ding hun hong tung ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute amau gamah teng ta ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 43:5-6; Am 9:14-15"},"9":{"text":"Kamsangte tawh kisai-in: Ka sunga ka lungtang kitam khin a, ka guh khempeuh kiling khin hi. TOPA le a kammal siangthote hangin zu tam a dawn lua zukhampa ka bang hi.","title":"Zuaugen Kamsangte","ref":"Jer 20:8-9"},"10":{"text":"Gamsung ah angkawmte dim uh hi; hamsiatna b hangin gamsung teng gawtakin c , sehnel-gama lonona teng keucip hi. Kamsangte in gitlohna lam zui uh a, a vangliatna uh a maan lopi-in zang uh hi."},"11":{"text":"\"Kamsangte le siampite in pasian nei lo uh a; ka biakinnpi sung nangawnah a gitlohna uh ka mu hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 6:13; Zep 3:4"},"12":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin amaute lampi lam nalna suak a; amaute khuamial sungah kilutsakin tua lai-ah a puk ding uh hi. Amaute dan a kituahsak kumin amau tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 13:16; Jer 11:23"},"13":{"text":"\"Samaria kamsangte lakah a muh thadahhuai hih na ka mu hi: Amaute in Baal minin thu gen uh a, ka mi Israel-te lam a pialpih uh hi.","ref":"Jer 2:8; Eze 13:10"},"14":{"text":"Tuateh Jerusalem-a kamsangte lakah a mulkimhuai pawlkhat ka mu hi. Amaute in angkawmin zuau genin a nungta uh hi. A gitlohna panun kuamah a kikhel loh nadingun migilote a hanthawn zaw uh hi. Amaute kei tungah Sodom tawh kibang uh a, Jerusalem mite Gomorrah tawh a kibang uh hi.\"","ref":"Jer 5:30; Jer 29:23; Eze 13:22; Jer 20:16"},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin kamsangte tawh kisai-in TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Amaute ankhaa ka nesak dinga, gu kisawh tui ka dawnsak ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Jerusalem-a kamsangte tungpanin pasian-milohna gamsung tengah kizel hi.\""},"16":{"text":"Hih in Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"No tunga thu hong gen kamsangte thu ngai kei un, lametna zuau tawh note hong dim uh hi. Amaute in amau lungsima suaktawm thu hong gen uh hi; TOPA kam sung pan hi lo hi.","ref":"Jer 14:14; Jer 9:20"},"17":{"text":"Amaute in kei hong simmawhte tungah, ‘ TOPA in: Lungnopna ngah niteh , ci hi,’ a ci den uh hi. Amaute lungsim khauhna a zui mite tungah, ‘No tungah siatna hong tung lo ding hi,’ a ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 8:11; Jer 13:10; Jer 5:12"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute lakah kua pen TOPA tawh thu kikumin ding ngei a, amah va mu in a thugen va za ahi hiam? Kua in a thugen ngai-in za ahi hiam?","ref":"Ro 11:34"},"19":{"text":"En un, TOPA thangpaihna huihpi kinuai dinga, migilote lutungah pingpei in zialnelh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"A lungsim sunga a tupna teng a tunsak kim matengin TOPA hehna a kileh kik kei ding hi. Hong tung ding hunah kiciantakin na theitel ding uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 23:26; Jer 30:24"},"21":{"text":"Hih kamsangte kei sawl lohpi amau thusuak tawh a taikhia uh hi a; ka hopih lohpi-in thu a gen uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin kei tawh thu kikumin ding khin uh hileh ka mite tungah ka kammalte gen ding uh a, a gitlohna panun kikhelsakin a gamtat hoih lo panun kiheisak ding hi.","ref":"1Ku 22:19"},"23":{"text":"\"Kei in a nai-a omte bek Pasian hi in, a gamla-a omte Pasian hilo tuan ka hi hiam? TOPA in cikhia hi."},"24":{"text":"Kei muh loh dingin mi khatpeuh kawmbu lakah bu thei ahi hiam? TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Leitung vantung dim lo ka hi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Job 22:12-14; 1Ku 8:27"},"25":{"text":"\"Keima mina zuauthu gen kamsangte thugen ka za khin hi. Amaute in,’Mang man ing ei! Mang khat man ing ei!’ ci uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute lungsim sunga suak peuh a gen zuauthei kamsangte lungsim ah hihte bangtan vei suak lai ding ahi hiam?"},"27":{"text":"A pate un Baal biakna hangin ka min a mangngilh uh bangin amaute khat le khat a kikup uh a mangte un ka mite, ka min a mangngilhsak ding sa uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Kamsang mang manpa in a mang gen henla ka kammal nei pa in zong muanhuaitak mahin gen ta hen. Buhtu le buhtang bangci kibat thei ding ahi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"29":{"text":"\"Ka kammal mei tawh kibangin suangtum a satzan sek tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam?\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin,\" TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Kei tung pan hi dinga a upmawh uh thu khat le khat a kiguksaktuah uh kamsangte langah ka pang hi."},"31":{"text":"Hihi, \" TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Amau leii tawh a lumletlet uh hi napi,’ TOPA genkhiat ahi hi,’ a ci kamsangte langkhatah ka pang hi."},"32":{"text":"Hi taktak hi, amaan lo mang thu peuh a gente langkhatah ka pang hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Kei sawl le kei koih hi lo napi amaute in khiatna nei lo zuauna tawh thu hilh uh a, ka mite lam a pialpih uh hi. Amaute in hih mite tungah metna them khat zong a pia kei uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"33":{"text":"Hih mite ahi a, kamsang khat ahi a, siampi khat in ahi zongin, ‘ TOPA thusuak a bang hiam,’ ci-a hong dot ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘Bang thusuak hiam? b Nang kong taisan ding hi,’ TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci in."},"34":{"text":"Kamsang khat ahi a, siampi khat ahi a, midang khatpeuh in ahi zongin hong gen a, ‘Hih in TOPA thusuak ahi hi,’ a cihleh tuapa le a innkuanpihte dan ka tuaksak ding hi.","title":"Thusuak-zuau le Kamsang-zuau"},"35":{"text":"Note in na lawmte uh le na tanaute uh tungah: ‘ TOPA hong dawnna bang ahi hiam?’ ahikeh TOPA in bang gen ahi hiam?’ na ci den ding uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Ahi hangin, ‘ TOPA thusuak na ci kha nawn peuhmah kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh neih kammal amau thusuak hi a, note in eite Pasian, Thahatpen TOPA , a nungta Pasian kammal tawh na kipelhsak uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Kamsangpa tungah: ‘ TOPA hong dawnna bang ahi hiam?’ ahikeh ‘ TOPA in bang hong gen hiam?’ na ci den ding uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Note in, ‘Hih in TOPA thusuak ahi hi,’ na cih uh hangin, TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Hih in TOPA thusuak ahi hi,’ ci kei un ka cih hangin note in, ‘Hih in TOPA thusuak ahi hi,’ na ci teitei uh hi,"},"39":{"text":"tua ahi ciangin note kong mangngilh taktak dinga ka omna panin note le na pate uh kong piaksa khuapi tawh kong lawnkhia khawm ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Keimah in note tungah a tawntung zahlaakna a kimangngilh lo ding maizumna kong tungsak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 20:11; Eze 5:14-15"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Jerusalem pan Babylon ah Jehoiakim tapa Judah kumpipa Jehoiachin c le a uliante, Judah khutsiamte le nasep siamte salin a kaih khit ciangin TOPA biakinnpi mai-a kikoih theigah bawm nih TOPA in hong lak hi.","title":"Theigah Bawm Nih"},"2":{"text":"Bawm khat limci mahmah a, apal hileh kilawm hi. kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar tungah ka pia dinga, amah in note muh tektek in a that ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Amaute hangin Judah pana Babylon a saltangte in: \"Babylon kumpipa in Zedekiah le Ahab, mei-a a Hong tung lai ding hunte ah hih thu na theitel ding uh hi."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Tua hun ciangin Israel bawng’te khempeuh Pasian ka hi dinga, amaute ka mi a hi ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 30:22"},"2":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Namsau-a kithat lo sunte, sehnel-gam ah ki-angvan dinga; Israel ka tawlngasak ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 33:14"},"3":{"text":"A beisa a hunin eite tungah TOPA hong kilang a: \"Keimah in tawntung itna in nang kong it a, a migi itna in nang kong kai zo hi.","ref":"Tp 4:37; Hos 11:4"},"4":{"text":"Nungak bit Israel aw, nang kong lam kik dinga, nang na kilampha ding hi. Ka ihmut a nuam mahmah hi.","ref":"Zec 4:1"},"27":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Israel innkuan le Judah innkuan ah mihing le ganhing suan le khak ka suan hun hong tung ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute ka en dinga, ka bawhkhiatna, ka balzanna, lawnkhia in, susia-a gimna ka thuaksak bang tektek in amaute ka en dinga, lam kikin ka suanpha ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mite in, ‘A pa lenggah thuk nek a ta’ ha kim hi’ ci nawn lo ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 1:10; Ta 5:7; Eze 18:2"},"30":{"text":"Tua sangsikin mi khempeuh amau mawhna hangin a siciat ding uh hi; lenggah thuk a nete - a ma ha mah a kim ding hi.","ref":"Isa 3:11; Gal 6:7"},"31":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Kei mahmah in Israel innkuante le Judah innkuante tawh thukhun thak ka bawl hun hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Heb 8:8-12*; 10:16-17"},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pu a pate a khutuah lenin Egypt panin ka paikhiatpih lai-a amaute tawh ka bawl thukhun bang ahi kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute c pasal d ka hih hangin ka thukhun a palsat uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 54:5"},"33":{"text":"\"Hih in tua hun khit cianga Israel innkuante tawh ka bawl ding thukhun ahi hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Amaute lungsim ah ka thukham ka koih dinga, amaute lungtang tungah ka gelh ding hi. Amaute Pasian ka hi dinga, amaute ka mi hi ding uh hi."},"34":{"text":"Kuamah in a vengte ahi zongin a sanggampa ahi zongin hilhin, ‘ TOPA thei in’ a ci nawn kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a neupen pan a lianpen dongin kei hong thei ta ding uh hi,’ TOPA in ci hi. Ahang in, amaute gitlohnate ka maisak dinga, amawhnate uh ka ciamteh nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Jn 2:27; Isa 54:13; Jer 33:8; Mic 7:19"},"35":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi, suna ni a tangsak amah hi a, zanin kha le aksite a tan nadingin thupia-in tuipi hualte a hawk nadingin a lokpa - a min Thahatpen TOPA ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 1:16; Pk 14:21; Jer 10:16"},"36":{"text":"\"Hih thukipte ka muhna pan a man ciangin Israel suante a minam panun ka mai-ah a mang pan bek ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 89:36-37"},"37":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Tunga om vante a kiteh theih ciang leh leitung bulpi a kizonkhiat theih ciang bekin amau gamtatnasate hangin Israel suante khempeuh ka nial pan ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 33:22; Jer 33:24-26; Ro 11:1-5"},"38":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Kei adingin hih khuapi Hananel Tausang panin Kiu Kongpi dong a kilam phat hun hong tung ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua lai panin Gareb mual lamah tangtakin kiteh to dinga, tuateh Goah lamah a kihei ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Misiluangte le vut kipaihna kuam buppi le Kidron Kuam a locial khempeuh Sakol Kongpi kiu ciang dong TOPA adingin munsiangtho ahi ding hi. Tua khuapi cikmah hunin kisusia loin a kisuankhia ngei nawn kei ding hi.\"","ref":"Jol 3:17; Zec 14:21"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar kumpi a suah zawh a kum sawm le giatna kum Judah gamah Zedekiah kumpi a suah zawh a kum sawmna kumin Jeremiah tungah TOPA thu a tung hi.","title":"Jeremiah in Lo Khat Lei"},"2":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa galkapte in Jerusalem a umcih laitak uh, kamsangpa Jeremiah zong Judah kumpi inn huang sunga a kicin cip laitak ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in amah tua lai-ah thong kiasak a, \"Bang hangin tu-a na hih bangin thu genkhol na hi hiam? Nang in, ‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in hih khuapi Babylon kumpipa khutah ka pia dinga, amah in a la ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Babylon mite a khut panin Judah kumpipa Zedekiah a suakta kei dinga ahi hangin Babylon kumpipa khutah ki-apin amah tawh kimaituahin kiho ding uh a, ama mit mahmah in mu ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Amah in Babylon ah Zedekiah tonpih dinga, ama tungah na ka sep matengin a om tadih ding hi,’ TOPA in ci hi. Babylon mite na do hangin na zo kei ding hi,’ ci hi,\" na ci hi.","ref":"Jer 34:2-3; 38:18,23"},"6":{"text":"Jeremiah in, \" TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"7":{"text":"Na pano Shallum tapa Hanamel kiangah hong pai-in, ‘Anathoth a ka lo hong lei in, bang hang hiam cih leh a lei thei ding lakah ka kinaipih pen nangmah na hi hi,’ hong ci ding hi.","ref":"Sp 25:24-25; Ru 4:3-4; Mt 27:10*"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin, TOPA gensa bang tektekin huang sunga hong kicinna ka kiangah ka sanggampa Hanamel hong pai a, ‘Benjamin gam Anathoth a ka lo hong lei in. Nang adingin bangmah a haksa lua kei hi."},"18":{"text":"Tul tampite tungah na itna na lah hangin pate mawhnate amau nunga a tate uh tungah dan na thuaksak hi. A lian mahmah vanglian Pasian aw, na min Thahatpen TOPA hi a,"},"19":{"text":"na ngimna lian mahmah in, na sepnate thahat hi. Mihingte lampi khempeuh na mu khin a, amau gamtatna le amau sepnate tawh kituakin pahtakman na pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah in Egypt ah a lamdang limte le nalamdangte na laka, Israel-te le mihing khempeuh lakah a kibangin tuni dong na lak lai-a, na min a thang lailai hi."},"21":{"text":"Nangmah in na mi Israel-te Egypt panin limte, alamdangte tawh ahi a, a thahat na khutte zankhia-in a lauhuai mahmah in na lakhia hi."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah in a pute uh tungah piak dinga na ciamsa bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gam amaute na pia hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute hong pai-in tangpah uh a, ahi hangin na thu hong mang loin na thukham zui lo uh a; amau hih dinga na thupiakte a sem kei uh hi. Jer 19:5"},"36":{"text":"Note in hih khuapi tawh kisai-in, ‘Babylon kumpipa tungah namsau, kialpi le pulpi in kipia ding hi,’ na ci uh hi; ahi hangin TOPA Israel Pasian gen hih ahi hi:"},"37":{"text":"Heh lua thangpai lua-a ka nawhkhiatna gam khempeuh panin amaute ka kaikhawm dinga; hih munah maute puak kikin lungnuamtakin ka tengsak ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Amaute keima mi suakin keimah amaute Pasian ka hi ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Amaute hoih nading, amau nunga a tate uh hoih nading le kei hong kihtak tawntung nadingun lungsim khat le gamtatna khat ka guan ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Amaute tawh tawntung thukhun bawlin amaute hoih nading ka bawl den dinga, kei hong taihsat ngei nawn loh nadingun kei kihtakna ka muam ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Amaute tunga na hoih bawl, nuam ka sa dinga ka lungsim khempeuh le ka hinna khempeuh tawh amaute hih gamah ka phut taktak ding hi."},"42":{"text":"\"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: Hih mite tungah tuahsiatna lianpi khempeuh ka tunsak bangin amaute tunga ka ciamsa vangphatna khempeuh ka pia ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Note in, ‘Hih gamah mihing ganhing teng loin a kinusiasa gam tulsapi hi a, Babylon mite tunga kipiasa hi,’ na cih uh hangin hih gamah lote a kilei kik ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin gam, Jerusalem kimkota khuaneute, Judah khuapite, mualtung gam khuapite, nitumna lam zang le kham kicina-te le Negev a te in ngunin lo lei ding uh a, min thu-in, seal tumin teci nei-in kileina a bawl ding uh hi; Amaute ka hopih hangin ngai lo uh a; amaute ka sap hangin hong dawng nuam kei uh hi,’ ci-in va gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 65:12; Jer 7:13; Pn 1:24"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jeremiah in Recab innkuante tungah, \"Hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘Note in na pu uh Jonadab thupiak na mang uh a, ama hong lamlah bangin zui-in hong sawl peuhmah na sem uh hi,’ ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: Recab tapa Jonadab in ka nasem ding mi a kibansamsak ngei kei ding hi,’ ci hi, \" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 15:19; 33:17"}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah a kum lina kumin hih TOPA thu Jeremiah tungah a tung hi:","title":"Jeremiah’ Laizial Jehoiakim in Halsak"},"2":{"text":"\"Laizial khat la inla Josiah kumpi a suah kum nang kong hopih kipata kipan tuni dong Israel, Judah le minam dangte tawh kisai ka gen khempeuh gelh in."},"3":{"text":"Judah mite in amau tunga tunsak dinga ka ngim siatna khempeuh a zak uh ciangin amau gitlohna pan kihei kha ding uh a, tua ciangin amau gitlohna le amau mawhna ka maisak kha ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 18:8; 26:3; Jnh 3:8"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruch sam a, TOPA in ama tungah a gensa khempeuh Jeremiah in sitin Baruch in laizial tungah a gelh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jeremiah in Baruch kiangah, \"Kei hong kikhakcip hi, TOPA biakinnpi ah ka pai thei kei hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin antan ni khatin TOPA inn ah va pai inla laizial sunga na gelh kong sit TOPA kammalte mite zakin va sim in. Amaute tawh a kituah ciangin, \"Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiangah hong pai un,\" a ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute khuapi sung a tun uh ciangin Nethaniah tapa Ishmael le ama ompihte in golum uh a, tuidum sungah a pai uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute lakah mi sawm in Ishmael kiangah, \"Kote hong that kei ve! Tua ciangin amaute teng kia a lawmte uh tawh a that khawm kei uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in ama thahsa khempeuh le Gedaliah a paihkhawmna tuidum pen Kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Baasha a nan nadingin a bawl ahi hi. Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in tua sung misiluang a dimsak hi.","ref":"1Ku 15:22; 2Kh 16:1,6"},"10":{"text":"Mizpah a, a omlai mite - tua lai-a a kinusia kumpipa tanute le a dangte, kumpi cing galkap mangpa Nebuzaradan in Ahikam tapa Gedaliah uk dinga a piakte khempeuh tawh Ishmael in salin a kai hi. Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in amaute salin kai-a Ammon-te omna lamah a paikhiatpih hi."},"11":{"text":"Kareah tapa Johanan le a ompih galkap mangte khempeuh in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bawlsa mawhna a zak uh ciangin"},"12":{"text":"a mite khempeuh uh tonpih in Nethaniah tapa sim dingin a kuan uh hi. Amaute in Gibeon tuikhukpi gei-ah a pha uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ishmael tonpih mite khempeuh in Kareah tapa Johanan le a galkap mangte a tonkhawm a muh uh ciangin a nuam uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ismael in Mizpah pana sal-a a kaihte khempeuh kileh hei-in Kareah tapa Johanan lam a manawh uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin Nethaniah tapa Ishmael le a mite giat Johanan khut panin suakta uh a, Ammon mite lamah a tai uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 2;13; Pn 28:17"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah tapa Johanan le a tonpih galkap mangte khempeuh Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in Mizpah a Ahikam tapa Gedaliah a muansuam khit cianga mana a paikhiatpih: galkapte, numeite, naupangte le zum nasem uliante khempeuh Gibeon pan a ciahpih kik hi."},"17":{"text":"Amaute Egypt zuanin pai uh a, Babylon mite d khut pan a suahtak nadingun Bethlehem gei Geruth Kimham ah a khawl uh hi.","title":"Egypt ah Taina"},"18":{"text":"Babylon kumpite in tua gam uk dinga a koih Ahikam tapa Gedaliah, Nathaniah tapa Ishmael in that ahi manin amaute in a kihta uh ahi hi."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin galkap mangte khempeuh, Kareah tapa Johanan le Hoshaiah tapa Jezaniah e le mi khempeuh - aneupen pan a lianpen dongin"},"2":{"text":"kamsangpa Jeremiah kiang zuanin pai uh a ama kiangah, \"Nong hehpihna-in kong ngetna uh hong za inla TOPA na Pasian tungah hih a baanglaite adingin thu hong ngetsak in. Ahang in, tu-a nong muh bangin hunkhat lai-in ka tam uh hangin tu-in tawmno bek ka om lai uh hi."},"3":{"text":"TOPA na Pasian tungah koi lamah pai dinga bang sem ding ka hi uh hiam, hong gen nadingin thu hong ngetsak in,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Ph 86:11; Pn 3:6"},"4":{"text":"Kamsangpa Jeremiah in, \"Kong za khin hi, nong ngetna uh bangin TOPA note Pasian tungah thu kong ngetsak taktak dinga; TOPA hong gen peuhmah no tungah hong gen kikin bangmah kong im kei ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Jeremiah kiangah, \" TOPA na Pasian in ko tungah nong gen dinga hong sawl peuhmah ka sep kei tak uh leh a thumaan le a muanhuai TOPA kote tungah teci hi ta hen."},"6":{"text":"Nang kong sawlna uh TOPA eite Pasian thu, a hoihlam ahi a, a sialam ahi zongin kote hoih nadingin ka mang ding uh hi, ahang in, kote in TOPA eite Pasian thu ka mang ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 6:3; Jer 7:23"},"7":{"text":"Tua nung ni sawm ciangin Jeremiah tungah TOPA thu a tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in Kareah tapa Johanan le amah tawh a om khawm galkap mangte khempeuh le a neupen pan alianpen dong mi khempeuh a kikhawmsak hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in amaute kiangah, \"Hih in na deihna uh kong ngetsak nadinga nong sawl uh TOPA Israel Pasian thugen ahi hi:"},"10":{"text":"‘Hih gam ah na omsuak uh leh note hong phelkek loin kong lam dinga; hong botkhia loin kong suan ding hi, ahang in, note tungah siatna kong tunsak ka dah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tu laitaka na kihtak uh Babylon kumpipa kihta kei un. Keimah in note hong ompihin ama khut pan kong hu dinga hong hon ding ka hi manin amah kihta kei un, TOPA in cikhia hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in note hong khuatuahin na gam uah a ngei hong batsak kik nadingin keimah in note kong khuatuah ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Ph 106:44-46; Ro 8:31"},"13":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin note in, ‘Hih gamah ka tengsuak kei ding uh hi,’ na cih uh a, TOPA note Pasian thu mang loin,"},"14":{"text":"‘Ut kei ung, gal om lohna, pengkul gin zak lohna, gilkial lohna mun Egypt ah pai-in va teng nung,’ na cih uh leh"},"15":{"text":"a baanglai Judah-te aw, TOPA thugen za un. TOPA Israel Pasian thugen hih ahi hi: ‘Note Egypt ah na pai teitei uh a, tua lai-ah pai-in na va ten uh leh"},"16":{"text":"na kihtak uh namsau in tua lai-ah note hong that veve dinga na lau mahmah uh kialpi in Egypt ah hong nungzuihin tua lai-ah na si veve ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Egypt ah pai teitei a, a tengte khempeuh namsau, kialpi le pulpi-in si ding uh a; amau tungah ka tunsak ding gimna panin kuamah a suakta kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih in TOPA Israel Pasian gen ahi hi: ‘Jerusalem a tengte tungah ka hehna le ka thangpaihna ka buakkhiat bangin Egypt ah na pai uh leh ka thangpaihna kong bua ding hi. Note hong kihamsiatin, hong kilipkhapin, bangmah a kimang lo mawhpaihna thuakte na hi ding uh a; hih mun na mu kik nawn kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Jer 7:20; 29:18; 44:13"},"19":{"text":"\"Judah mi a baanglaite aw, TOPA in, ‘Egypt ah pai kei un,’ hong ci zo hi. Note tuni-in kong vauhilh hi, Hih thu tel un:"},"20":{"text":"sihna khop khialhna a na bawl khin uh hi. TOPA na Pasian uh tungah thungena nong sawl lai-un, ‘ TOPA eite Pasian tungah thu hong ngetsak inla ama hong gen khempeuh hong gen in; ka sem ding uh hi,’ na ci uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tu ni-in kong gen khin hi; ahi hangin TOPA note Pasian in no tunga hong gensak khempeuh na mang kei teitei uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tu-in hih thu tel un: Note pai-a na tun nopna uh munah namsau, kialpi le pulpi-in na si ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Eze 6:11; Hos 9:6"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jeremiah in mite kiangah TOPA amaute Pasian gen khempeuh - TOPA in amaute tungah gen dinga a sawl khempeuh a gen khit ciangin -"},"2":{"text":"Hoshaiah tapa Azariah, Kareah tapa Johanan le a kiphasak mipi khempeuh in Jeremiah kiangah, \"Zuau gen na hi hi! TOPA kote Pasian in nang, ‘Egypt ah pai-in na teng kei un, a ci dingin hong sawl lo hi."},"3":{"text":"Neriah tapa Baruch in kote hong langpangin Babylon mite b in kote hong thah theih nading ahikeh Babylon ah salin hong kaih theih nadingun nang hong sawl ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 26:8; 42:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kareah tapa Johanan’ galkap mangte khempeuh le mipi khempeuh in Judah gama ten ding TOPA thupiakna a mang nuam kei uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A man sangsikun, Kareah tapa Johanan le galkap mangte khempeuh in minamte lakah a kithehthangna panun Judah gam a teng dingin a ciah kik Judah mi a baanglaite khempeuh nangawn a paikhiatpih mang uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amaute in mite khempeuh - nupi, papi, numei naupangte le kumpi cing galkap mangpa Nebuzaradan in Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah tawh a nusiat khawm kumpipa tanute le kamsangpa Jeremiah le Neriah tapa Baruch zong a tonpih khin uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in TOPA thu mang loin Egypt ah lut uh a Tahpanhes dong a tung uh hi.","ref":"Jer 40:12; 44:1"},"8":{"text":"Tahpanhes ah TOPA thu Jeremiah tungah tung a:"},"9":{"text":"\"Suang tumpi pawlkhat la inla Tahpanhes a Pharaoh kumpi inn lutna suangphah ah Jew-te muhin tungman tawh phum in."},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: Kei mah in ka nasem Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar ka vaikhak dinga, hih lai-a suangte ka phumna tung santakah a kumpi tokhom ka phut dinga; amah in a tungah kumpi puanbuk a zal ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah hong kuanin Egypt sim dinga, sihsak dinga sehsate sisakin, sal-a kaih dinga sehsate salin kai-in, namsau thuak dinga sehsate thuaksak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah c in Egypt pasiante biakinnte hal dinga; a biakinnte uh halin a pasiante uh a laksak ding hi. Tuucingpa in a puan a tungah a vialh bangin a tungah Egypt vial dinga, tua panin ngaihmuangtakin a ciah ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Egypt a ni d biakna inn sunga khuampi siangthote sucim dinga, Egypt pasiante biakna innte a haltum ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 15:2; 44:13"}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Egypt khanglam - Migdol, Tahpanhes le Memphis e - Egypt f Khunglam a teng Jew-te khempeuh tawh kisai-in Jeremiah tungah thu tunga:","title":"Milim Biakna Hanga Gimna"},"2":{"text":"\"Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Note in Jerusalem le Judah khuapi khempeuh a ka tunsak gimna lianpi na mu zo uh hi. Amaute gitloh gamtatnasa hangin tuni-in kisia a kuamah a teng kei hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in amaute ahi a, note na hi uh a na pate uh ahi zongin a theih ngei loh uh pasian dangte tungah gimnamtui halin a biakna un kei hong hehsak hi."},"4":{"text":"‘Hih ka muhdah a kihhuai na sem kei un!’a ci kamsangte ka sawl kikkik hi."},"5":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute in ngai loin thusim lo uh a, a gamtatsia uh khel loin pasian dangte tunga gimnamtui hal a tawp tuan kei uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka hehluatna ka sungkhia a; tua in Judah khuapite le Jerusalem kongzingte kangin kisia-a tuni-in kuamah teng loin kilawi hi.","ref":"Jer 7:25; 25:4; 26:5"},"7":{"text":"\"Tu-in Pasian, Thahatpen TOPA Israel Pasian gen hih ahi hi: Bang hangin nupi, papi, naupangte le naungekte dongin, a baanglai om nawn lo zahin Judah tawh kikhenkhia-a no le no tungah gimna lianpi kitun na hi uh hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Bang dinga note pai-in na ten nading mun uh Egypt ah na khut uh tawh na bawlsa uh pasian dangte tunga gimnamtui halna tawh kei hong hehsak na hi uh hiam? No le no kisiasak na hi uh a, no le no kisamsia suakin leitunga minam khempeuh lakah mi muhdah na kisuah uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Note in Judah gam le Jerusalem kongzing laka na pate uh le Judah kumpipate le kumpinute gitlohnate note le na zite uh gitlohnate mangngilh ta na hi uh hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Tuni ciang dong amaute kiniam khiat nuam lo uh a, zong hong zahtak loin note le na pate uh mai-a ka koih ka thukham le ka thukipte a zui kei uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:6-9"},"11":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Keimah in Judah gam khempeuh a susia dingin note tungah gimna kong tungsak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Keimah in Egypt ah lalin ten a sawm Judah a baanglaite ka lakhiamang ding hi. Egypt ah amaute a vekun mangthang ding uh a; namsau-in a sih kei uh leh kialpi-in a si ding uh hi. Amaute a neupen pan alianpen dongin namsau ahikeh kialpi-in a si ding uh hi. Amaute kihamsiatin, kilipkhap dinga bangmaha kimang lo mawhpaihna thuakte hi ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Keimah in Jerusalem dan ka thuaksak mah bangin Egypt a tengte namsau kialpi le pulpi-in dan ka thuaksak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Egypt ah teng dingin a paisa Judah mi a baanglaite ahi a, Judah gamah ciah kikin teng nuam napi a ciah kik thei nawn lote ahi zongin khat beek a suakta kei ding uh a; a gal tai tawmkha lobuang kuamah a ciah kik kei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 21:10; 22:24-27; Am 9:4"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin a zite un pasian dangte tungah gimnamtui a hal lam a thei papi khempeuh, tua lai-a a kithuahpih nupi khempeuh - mipi hon khat - Egypt Khunglam le Tawlam a a teng mite khempeuh in Jeremiah kiangah,"},"16":{"text":"\" TOPA mina ko tungah nong thupuak ka ngai kei ding uh hi!"},"17":{"text":"Hih dinga ka gensa uh ka hih taktak ding uh a: Judah khuapite le Jerusalem kongzingte ah ko le ka pate uh, ka kumpite uh le ka uliante un a hih bang tektekun Vantung Kumpinu tungah gimnamtu halin dawntheih-a biakna ka sungkhia ding uh hi. Tua hun lai-in an lah tampi ka nei uh a lamzangin supna baina lah ka thuak kei uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin Vantung Kumpinu tungah gimnamtui hal le dawntheih-a biakna ka bawl nawn loh ua kipan bangmah nei loin namsau le kialpi-in ka mangthang uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Tp 23:23; Jer 7:18"},"19":{"text":"Tua numeite in, \"Kote in Vantung Kumpinu tungah gimnamtui halin dawntheih-a biakna ka sun uh ciangin ka pasalte un tuanu lim sunin moh ka bawl uh le dawntheih-a biakna ka sun lam uh hong thei lo uh sa na hi hiam,\" a ci uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jeremiah in amah a dawng kik mi khempeuh nupi, papite tungah,"},"21":{"text":"\"Judah khuapite le Jerusalem kongzing lakah note le na pate uh, na kumpite uh le na uliante uh le gam mite in gimnamtui na hal lam uh TOPA in a phawk lo-a ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Na gamtat hoih lote uh le a kihhuai-a na gamtatnate uh hangin TOPA ki-ip zo nawn lo a, na gam un hamsiatna thuakin tuni mahmah in zong kuamah teng loin a kinusiacip hi."},"23":{"text":"Gimnamtui halin TOPA tungah note na mawh uh a, a thu mang loin ama thukham na zui kei uh a, a thukipte le a ngeina gualhsate zui lo na hi manun tu-a na muh bangun no tungah hih gimna hong tung ahi hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 9:9"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jeremaih in numei zong a kihel mite khempeuh tungah, \"No Egypt a om Judah mite khempeuh aw, TOPA kammal za un."},"25":{"text":"Hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA thugen ahi hi: Note le na zite un, ‘Eite in Vantung Kumpinu tungah gimnamtui hal le dawntheih-a biakna piak ding ka kiciamsa bangun ka sem taktak ding uh hi,’ ci-in na kiciam bangun na gamtatna uh tawh na lak zo uh hi. \"Tua ahileh mainawt vet un! Na kiciamsa bangun sem dih un! Na kamciam uh tangtun un!","ref":"Jer 43:7"},"26":{"text":"Ahi hangin Egypt a teng Jew-te khempeuh in TOPA gen za un! TOPA in cikhia hi,’ Egypt a om Judah-te khat beek in, \"Thupipen TOPA nuntakna ka lo hi,\" ci-in ka mina a kiciam nawn loh nadingun ka min lianpi-in ka tom lo khin hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahang in, amaute a hoih nading uh hi loin a nat nadingun ka encik gige hi; Egypt a om Jew-te a vekun a kisiat khit matengin namsau le kialin a mangthang ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Namsau panin suakta a Egypt pan Judah ah a ciah kik tawm mahmah ding hi. Tua ciangin Egypt ah teng dinga a pai a baanglai Judah-te in amau cih le kei cih koi kipzaw hiam cih a thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 31:28; Eze 20:39"},"29":{"text":"\"No tunga kong tunsak ding haksatna a kip takpi lam na theih nadingun hih muna dan kong tuahsak nading lim hih ahi hi,’ TOPA in cikhia hi."},"30":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘Keimah in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah amah a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar tungah ka piak bang tektekin Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh Hophra, amah a that nuam a galte khutah ka pia ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 39:5; 46:26"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Judah kumpi pa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah zawh a kum lina kumin kamsangpa Jeremiah in Meriah tapa Baruch tungah gen a, Baruch in laizial tungah gelhin Jeremiah in sit a:","title":"Baruch tungah Thupuak"},"2":{"text":"\"Baruch aw, TOPA Israel Pasian in nang tungah hong gen hih ahi hi:"},"3":{"text":"Nang in, ‘Gimna ka thuak hi! TOPA in ka natna banah dahna hong behlap a; ka tautauna-in ka bah ngi-ingei a, ka tawlnga thei kei hi,’ na ci hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA in, \"Ama kiangah: \" TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Gam sung buppi a ka lamsate ka phelkhia dinga, ka suansate ka botkhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang in nangma ading na lianpi zong ding na hi hiam? Tuate zong kei in. Ahang in, mi khempeuh tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi; TOPA in cikhia a, ahi hangin na paina peuhpeuh ah na nuntakna kong suaktasak ding hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in kamsangpa Jeremiah tungah minamte tawh kisai-a TOPA thu tung ahi hi.","title":"Egypt Thu Thupuak Khat","ref":"Jer 25:15-38"},"2":{"text":"Egypt tawh kisai-in: Hih in Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah zawh a kum lina kumin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Euphrates Gun gei-a Carchemish ah Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh Neco galkapte sima a zawhsate tawh kisai thupuak ahi hi:","ref":"2Ku 23:29"},"3":{"text":"\"Na lumte uh aneu alian tawh kithawi unla, galsim dingin kuan un!","ref":"Isa 21:5"},"4":{"text":"Sakol van vawh unla, sakol tungtuangte aw, tuang ta un! Sik lukhute khu-in panmun la un! Na teipite uh nawtngil unla, galvan kithuam un!","ref":"Eze 21:9-11; 1Sa 17:5,38"},"5":{"text":"Ka muh bang ahi hiam? Amaute lau-in nung kik uh a, a galhangte uh kizo ta hi. Amaute nunghei loin nawhsatakin tai uh a, akim apam uh launa vive ahi hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 48:44; Jer 49:29"},"6":{"text":"\"Amanlangte taisim thei lo uh a, a thahatte a suakta tuan kei uh hi. Leilu-lama Euphrates Gun gei-ah kimuktu-in a puk uh hi.","ref":"Isa 30:16; Da 11:19"},"7":{"text":"\"Nile banga khang kua hi a, guntui phulto abang kua ahi hiam?"},"8":{"text":"Nile bangin Egypt khanga, guntui phulto bang hi. Tuanu in, ‘Khangin leitung khempeuh ka tuam dinga; khuapite le a sunga teng mite ka susia ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Da 11:10"},"9":{"text":"Sakolte aw, mainawt un! Sakolleng hawlte aw, lunghamsa-in nawh un! Galhangte - Cush a le Put mi lum tawite, thal kamsa-a om Lydia mite aw, mainawt un.","ref":"Jer 47:3; Isa 66:19"},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin tua ni Topa in a galte tunga phulak nading phulak ni hi a, Thahatpen TOPA aa ahi hi. Namsau in a kham mateng valhin a dangtak a kap mateng a sisan dawn ding hi. Ahang in, Topa Thahatpen TOPA in leilu-lam gam Euphrates Gun gei-ah kithoihna-in a nei ding hi.","ref":"Jol 1:15; Tp 32:42; Tp 32:42; Zep 1:7"},"11":{"text":"\"Egypt Tanu Bit aw, Gilead ah paito inla zatui la in. Zatui tampi na zat hangin na dam tuan kei ding hi; nang dam nading a om kei hi."},"12":{"text":"Na maizumna minamte in za ding uh a, na kahna leitung a dim ding hi. Galhangte khat le khat kipalkha ding uh a; a nihun a tukkhawm ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 19:4; Na 3:8-10"},"13":{"text":"Hih in Egypt sim dinga kuan Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar thu, kamsangpa Jeremiah tunga TOPA thupuak ahi hi:","ref":"Isa 19:1"},"14":{"text":"\"Hih thu Egypt ah zasak unla, Migdol ah tangko un; Memphis b le Tahpanhes ah zong tangko-in: ‘Na kimkota mite namsau in valh ahi manin kigalging unla kithawi un,’ va ci un.","ref":"Jer 43:8; Jer 24:8"},"15":{"text":"Bang hangin na galhangte uh kiniam koih ahi hiam? TOPA in phutuk ahi manin amaute ding zo lo uh hi.","ref":"Isa 66:15-16"},"16":{"text":"Amaute kimuktutu ding uh a; khat le khat a kiphupai ding uh hi. Amaute in,’Tho un, i mipihte kiang i leitangah ciah kik ni, hong nengniamte namsau panin kihem ni,’ ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 13:14; Jer 25:38"},"17":{"text":"Tua lai-ah amaute in, ‘Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh a hupi bek hi; ama hun hoih teng tan ta,’ ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 19:11-16"},"18":{"text":"\"A min Thahatpen TOPA kumpipa in, \"Ka nuntakna ka lawh inah\" mualliante lakah Tabor bang le tuipi gei-a Carmel bangin khat hong kuan ding hi.","ref":"Jer 48:15; Jos 19:22"},"19":{"text":"Memphis kinusiacip dinga, kisia-in kuamah teng lo ding ahi manin, Egypt a teng note aw, salin hong kikai ding hi, na van uh guang un."},"20":{"text":"\"Egypt in a melhoih bawngla ahi hi; ahi hangin leilu-lam panin ama langah cippi khat hong leng hi."},"21":{"text":"A galkap cial uliante bawngno vakthau bang hi. Amaute dan thuak hun hi-a, amau tungah gimna tun hun ahi manin amaute zong kihei-in lehtai khawm ding uh a, amau leitang a dinpih tentan kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Job 18:20"},"22":{"text":"Galte mainawtin kuan uh a, gulpi tai ging bangin Egypt a ging ding hi. Amaute tuanu do dingin singphukpa bangin hei kengin a kuan ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Tuanu gamphapi lak ahi hangin amaute in a tulak a tennen ding uh hi, TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Amaute kauphe hon sangin tamzaw tham uh a, a kisim khin zo kei hi.","ref":"Thk 7:12"},"24":{"text":"Egypt Tanu kimaizumsak dinga, leilu-lam mite khutah kipia ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 1:15"},"25":{"text":"Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA in a geninah: \"Keimah in Thebes-te a pasian Amon tung, Pharaoh tung, Egypt le a pasiante le a kumpite Pharaoh tunga kinga khempeuh tungah dan ka tuaksak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Keimah in amaute a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar le a galkap mangte tungah ka pia ding hi. Ahi ta zongin tua nung ciangin a beisa hun bangin Egypt ah mi a teng kik ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Eze 29:11-16; 32:11"},"27":{"text":"\"Ka nasempa Jacob aw, lau kei in; Israel aw, lungneu kei in. A gamla panin nang kong honkhia dinga, nangma suante a saltanna panun ka honkhia taktak ding hi. Jacob in lemna le ngaihmuanna ngah kik dinga, kuamah in a lausak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 41:13; 43:5"},"28":{"text":"Ka nasempa Jacob aw, nang hong ompih ka hi manin lau kei in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Note kong thehthangna minamte khempeuh ka susiamang zongin, nang kong susiamang kei ding hi. Thutang bek tawh nang kong sek dinga, dan thuaksak loin lah kong khahkhong sam kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 8:9-10; Jer 4:27"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Pharaoh in Gaza a sim ma-a Philistia-te tawh kisai kamsangpa Jeremiah tunga TOPA kammal ahi hi:","title":"Philistia-te Tawh Kisai Thupuak","ref":"Am 1:6; Zec 9:5-7"},"2":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Leilu lama tuite a khankhan lam mu in; amaute a letkhia tuizeu suak ding uh hi. Amaute in leitang le a sunga omte, khuapi le a sunga tengte a tuum ding uh hi. Mite kiko ding uh a;","ref":"Isa 8:7; 14:31; Isa 15:3"},"3":{"text":"sakol koptai ging awte, galte sakolleng gingte le a pei kigawi gingte hangin gamsunga tengte khempeuh a kap ding uh hi. Pate in a tate uh don zo lo ding uh a; a khutte uh zawcip ding hi.","ref":"Jer 46:9; Eze 23:24"},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, Philistia-te khempeuh suksiat ding ni tungta a, Tyre le Sidon a huh thei ding a baanglaite khempeuh thahgam hun tungta ding hi. TOPA in Philistia-te le Caphtor b tuipi gei-a om lai sunte a susia ta ding hi.","ref":"Am 1:9-10; Zec 9:2-4; Tp 2:23"},"5":{"text":"Gaza in thum kawmin a lu met dinga; Ashkelon a kidaicipsak ding hi. Zanglei-a baanglaite no le no bang tanvei kiliamsuah lai ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Jer 41:5; Mic 1:16"},"6":{"text":"\"Note kapin, ‘Kalasaih, TOPA namsau bang hun teh a khawl tam maw? Na paii ah kisiat inla; khawlta-in om hithiat in,’ na ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 12:12; Eze 21:30"},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin Ashkelon le tuipi gei sim dinga TOPA in a sawlsa, thu a piaksa ahi ciangin bangci khawl mawk ding ahi hiam?\" ci hi.","ref":"Eze 25:15-17"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moab tawh kisai-in: Hih in Israel Pasian Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Nebo kisia ta ding ahi manin a tungah gimna a tung hi. Kiriathaim kimaizumsakin kila ta ding hi; a kulh muanhuai c kimaizumsakin kicim ding hi.","title":"Moab Tawh Kisai Thupuak","ref":"Ms 32:38; Ms 32:37"},"2":{"text":"Moab kiphat ngei nawn lo ding hi; Heshbon d ah mite in a kiat nading sawmsim ding uh hi: ‘Hong pai un, tua minam beisak ni,’ ci ding uh hi. Madmen e aw, nang zong na dai khikhe ding hi; namsau in hong nungdelh ding hi.","ref":"Ms 21:25"},"3":{"text":"Horonaim pana kikona ngai un, siatna lianpite kisiatna aw ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 15:5"},"4":{"text":"Moab kisuzan dinga, a tanote uh a kapkhia a ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in Luhith lam zuito ding uh a, a paikawmun kahcihtakin a kap ding uh hi; Horonaim lam paisukna ah kisiatna hangin lunggima kahna kiza hi."},"6":{"text":"Tai uau! Na nuntak nadingun tai uau! Sehnel-gamah sawlbawk b bang uau.","ref":"Jer 17:6"},"7":{"text":"Na sepsa le na hauhna na muan nungsang, nang zong salin hong kikai dinga, Chemosh, a siampite le a uliante tawh salin a kikaikhawm ding hi.","ref":"Ph 49:6; Am 2:3; Ms 21:29; Isa 46:1-2"},"8":{"text":"Khuapi khempeuh ah a susiate pai ding uh a, khuapi khat zong a suakta kei ding hi. TOPA in a gensa ahi manin mualkuamte kisusia dinga, mualtung zangte a kisiagawp ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Moab kisusiacip c ding ahi manin ci paih un; a khuapite hawmmang dinga, a sungah kuamah a teng kei ding hi.","ref":"Thk 9:45"},"10":{"text":"\" TOPA ’ na citaka a sem lo mi in hamsiatna thuak ta hen! A namsau sisan luansak na-a a zang lo mi in hamsiatna thuak ta hen!","ref":"1Ku 20:42"},"11":{"text":"\"Moab a neu tunga kipan a omcip hi a, zu tawdat bangin beel khat pan beel khatah kitei loin salin a kikai kei hi. Tua ahi ciangin amah a lim ngei-in lim a, a gimnam a kikhek kei hi.","ref":"Zec 1:15"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Beel sung pan a sungkhia ding mi ka sawl hun hong tung dinga, amaute in amah a sungkhia ding uh hi; a beel hawmsakin, haitungte a dengzan ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel in Bethel a muan lai-ua a maizum bangin, Moab in Chemosh a maizumpih ding hi.","ref":"Hos 10:6"},"14":{"text":"\"Bangci a, ‘Eite galhang mi - galdona-a a hatte i hi hi,’ ci thei na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Ph 33:16"},"15":{"text":"Moab kisusia-in a khuapite kisim dinga; a tangval hoihpente gawh dingin a kipaisukpih ding hi,\" a min Thahatpen TOPA a kici Kumpipa in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 46:18; 51:57"},"16":{"text":"\"Moab kisiat ding nai mahmah ta a, a tuahsiatna manlangin tung ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuanu liatna a thei a kima tengte khempeuh aw amah kah unla, ‘A khauh na sik ciangkhut kitan-a, a minthang na ciangkhut lah a kitan ta mawk a!’ ci un.","ref":"Ph 110:2"},"18":{"text":"\"Debon Tanu a tengte aw, Moab susiapa in nang hong susia dinga, na khuapi umna kulh muanhuaite susia ding ahi manin na minthanna pan hong paisuk inla lei gawtak tungah tu in.","ref":"Isa 47:1"},"19":{"text":"‘No Aroer a tengte aw, lamgei-ah dingin vil gige un. Galtai mite le a suakta numeite kiangah, \"Bang piang ahi hiam?\" ci-in dong un.","ref":"Tp 2:36"},"20":{"text":"Moab kithehthang gawp ahi manin a maizum hi. Thum unla kah un! Moab kisiatna Arnon dungah zasak un.","ref":"Isa 16:7; Ms 21:13"},"21":{"text":"Mualtung zangleite - Holon, Jahzah le Mephaath ah,","ref":"Ms 21:23; Jos 13:18"},"22":{"text":"Dibon, Nebo le Beth Diblathaim ah,","ref":"Jos 13:9,17"},"23":{"text":"Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul le Beth Meon ah,","ref":"Jos 13:17"},"24":{"text":"Kerioth le Bozrah le - anai agamla-a om Moab khuapite khempeuh ah thukhenna tung zo hi.","ref":"Isa 15:1"},"25":{"text":"Moab’ ki d kisuktansak a; a ban kikuaihtansak hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 75:10; Ph 10:15"},"26":{"text":"\" TOPA langah tuanu kiliansak ahi manin zu khamsak un. Ama luak lakah Moab bualsak unla; mite nuihsat suaksak un.","ref":"Jer 25:16,27"},"27":{"text":"Israel note nuihsat suak hilo ahi hiam? Ama thu na gen simin, amah simmawhin na lu na peisansan, amah gutate laka kiman sa na ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 2:26; Jer 18:16; Mic 7:8-10; 2Ku 17:3-6"},"28":{"text":"Moab a tengte aw, na khuapite uh taisan unla, suangkawl lakah teng un. Suangheng vangah kawl-vakhu butom bangin om un.","ref":"Ph 55:6-7"},"29":{"text":"\"Kote in Moab kiphatsakna - ki-uatsakna le kihihsakna, a kisaktheihna le a kiliatsakna le a lungsim liatnate ka za khin uh hi.","ref":"Isa 16:6; Pn 16:18"},"30":{"text":"Ama hiamgamhna a mawkna hi a, a kisaktheihna bangmah lo ahilam ka thei hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 10:3"},"31":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Moab ka kah a, Moab-te khempeuh adingin kikokhia-in, Kir Hareseth mite adingin ka thum hi.","ref":"2Ku 3:25"},"32":{"text":"Sibmah lengguite aw, Jazer kah bangin nang adingin ka kap hi. Na guite tuipi dongin zaama; Jazer tuipi dong ban uh hi. Na gah minzunte le na lenggahte tungah a susiate kipuk uh hi.","ref":"Isa 16:8-9"},"33":{"text":"Moab lote le singno leite panin lungnopna le kipahna a om nawn kei hi. Lenggah sukna panin zu ka kangsaka; lenggah cilte, kuamah lungdamin a awng nawn kei uh hi. A awng uh zongin lungdamna awging hi nawn lo hi.","ref":"Jol 1:12"},"34":{"text":"Amaute kahna aw, Heshbon panin Elealeh le Jazas dong, Zoar panin Horonaim le Eglath Shelishiyah ciang dongah a ging hi, ahang in, Nimrim tuite nangawn kangcip hi.","ref":"Isa 15:4"},"35":{"text":"Moab ah munsanga kithoihna piate le amau pasiante tungah gimnamtui halte ka beisak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 11:13"},"36":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin ka lungsim sungah tamngai mut bangin ka taamlo a; Kir Hareseth mite adingin tamngai bangin ka tamlo hi. A khol uh, a neih a lamteng uh beita hi.","ref":"Isa 16:11; Isa 16:6-12"},"37":{"text":"Mi peuhmah in a lu uh mettol uh a, a khamul uh kiatkhia-in a khut uh kuikek uh a, a kawnguah ippi puan teng uh hi.","ref":"Isa 15:2; Pc 37:34"},"38":{"text":"Keimah in kuama deih loh leibeel bangin Moab sukham ta ka hi manin Moab, inntungkhum khempeuh le mihon kikhopna tual-awng khempeuh ah thumna longal bangmah dang a om kei hi.\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"39":{"text":"\"Amah kinak tap si e! Amaute nak kah si uh e! Moab maizumin nungngatsan tah! Moab ahileh a kima om khempeuh nuihsat le lipkhap suak ta hi,\" a ci hi."},"40":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi \"En un! Muvanlai khat in a kha zalsa in Moab bawhsuk hi.","ref":"Isa 8:8; Tp 28:49; Hab 1:8"},"41":{"text":"Kerioth a kila dinga a kulh muanhuaite kila khin ding hi. Tua ni ciangin Moab galhangte lungsim numei nausuak dingte lungsim bang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 21:3"},"42":{"text":"Moab in TOPA langpan ahi manin minam khat bangin kisusia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 83:4; Isa 16:14"},"43":{"text":"Moab mite aw, launa, dum le thang in note hong pang hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 24:17"},"44":{"text":"\"Keimah in Moab tungah a dan thuak kum tungsak ding ka hi manin lau-a tai peuhmah dum sungah kia-in, dum sung pana kahkhia peuhmah thangah a awk ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"45":{"text":"\"Heshbon liim panin mei khat kuangkhia-a, Sihon laizang panin meikuang khat a kipan hi; tua in Moab-te thaltang kangin, a kiphasakte lutang guh kang ahi manin Heshbon liim a beel galtaite cimawhsa-in a ding uh hi.","ref":"Ms 21:21,26-28; Ms 24:17"},"46":{"text":"Moab aw, gimna nak thuak na nicia! Chemosh mite kisia khin a; na tapate salin kikai khinin na tanute uh galmatin kipaipih hi.","ref":"Ms 21:29"},"47":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi hong tung ding mailam hunah Moab angei kong bangsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. Moab tunga thukhenna hih ciangah beita hi.","ref":"Jer 49:6,39"}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ammon-te tawh kisai-in: TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Israel in tapate nei lo hiam? Innluah ding nei lo ahi hiam? Tua ahileh bang hangin Molech b in Gad neihsa laksak ahi hiam? Bang hangin a mite, a khuapi ah teng uh ahi hiam?","title":"Ammon Tawh Kisai Thupuak"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in genkhia hi, \"Ammon-te tenna Rabbah a kisim nading aw ka ginsak hun hong tung dinga; na kisiasate mualvum suakin a kimkota khuaneute mei-in kihal ding hi. Tua ciangin Israel-te in amau a hawlkhiate a hawlkhia ding uh hi,\" TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Tp 3:11; Jer 4:19; Tp 13:16"},"3":{"text":"\"Ai kisia ta hi! Heshbon aw, kap in. Rabbah a tengte aw, kapkhia un! Ippi puan silhin thum unla; Molech, ama siampite le a ulainte tawh salin kikaikhawm ding ahi manin kulhte sung tengah taisuk taito un.","ref":"Jos 8:28"},"4":{"text":"Bang hangin na mualkuam zangte uh, an tampi pianna mualkuam zangte kisaktheihpih na hi uh hiam? A muanhuai lo tanu aw, nang in na hauhnate muangin, ‘Kua in hong sim ding hiam?’ na ci hi.","ref":"Jer 3:6; Jer 9:23; 1Ti 6:17; Jer 21:13"},"5":{"text":"Na kimkota omte tung panin nang tungah launa kong tungsak ding hi,\" Topa, Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Note na vekun hong kinawhkhia mang dinga kuamah in galtaite a kaikhawm kei ding hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi tua khit mailam hunah Ammon mite angei ka bangsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"tg 39"},"7":{"text":"Edom tawh kisai-in: Hih in Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Teman ah pilna om nawn lo ahi hiam? Thudotte in a ngaihsut siamna uh mangsak ta uh ahi hiam? A pilna uh muat ta ahi hiam?","ref":"Eze 25:12; Pc 36:11,15,34","title":"Edom Tawh Kisai Thupuak"},"8":{"text":"Esau ka tuahsak hun ciangin ama tungah gimna tungsak ding ka hi manin, no Dedan a tengte aw, lehtai unla suanghawm thukpi-ah bu un."},"9":{"text":"Lenggah lo mite no kiangah hong pai uh leh lenggah tawmkha beek nusia lo ding uh ahi hiam? Zanin gutate hong pai leh amau deihzah bek gu ding uh hilo ahi hiam?"},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin Esau ka vunhawktol dinga, amah le amah a kisel theihloh nadingin a bukna munte ka lemkhia ding hi. A tate, a kinaipihte le a vengte mangthang dinga, amah zong a om nawn kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Na tagahte nusia-in amau nuntakna ka hu ding hi. Na meigongte un zong kei hong muang thei uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 10:18; Jas 1;27"},"12":{"text":"Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Dan thuakna hai a dawn lo dinga kilawmte nangawn in pello-a dawn ding ahileh bang hangin nang in dan tuak loin om thei ding na hi hiam? Dan thuak loin na om kei dinga na dawn pelmawh ding hi.\""},"13":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Kei le kei ka kiciama, Bozrah kisia dinga a kilipkhap, a kisimmawh le a kihamsiat suakin a khuapite a kisia den ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA tung pan thupuak ka za khina: Minamte kiangah thupuak khat kisawlin, \"Gal do dingin no le no kikaikhawm un! Gal sim dingin ding un!\" kicisak hi."},"15":{"text":"\"Tu-in minamte lakah kong neusek dinga, mite lakah kong kisimmawhsak ding hi."},"16":{"text":"No suangpi henga tengte, mualsangte tung a luahte aw, a lauhuai na ngaihsut lianpi uh le na lungsim kisaktheihna un no hong khem hi. Muvanlai aa zah-a sangin na bu na tom hangin tua lai panin nang kong kaikhiasuk ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"17":{"text":"\"Edom, mite lipkhap khat suak ding uh a; a tawnkha khempeuh in a liamnate khempeuh hangin mullitin a selpho ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah a khuaveng khuapite tawh a kilotthal bangin tua lai-ah kuamah teng loin mihing ta a om kei ding hi\" TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Pc 19:24"},"19":{"text":"\"Jordan gamphalak panin lono hoihna gamah humpinelkai a paikhiat toh bangin thakhatin a gam pan Edom ka delhkhia ding hi. Hih a ka sepsak ding kua ka teel ding hiam? Kei tawh a kibang kua hi a, kua in kei hong to ngam ding hiam? Tuateh kei langkhatah bang tuucingpa pang thei ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 12:5; Jer 50:44"},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin TOPA in Edom tungah tunsak dingin a ngimsa; le Teman a tengte tungah tunsak a sawmte za in: A ganhon no neute kituahmangsak dinga; amaute hangin amah in amaute lonona mun a susiamang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:5; Isa 14:27; Jer 50:45; Mal 1:3-4"},"21":{"text":"Amaute pukna awging hangin leitung kiling dinga; amaute kah na in Tuipi San a a thawn ding hi.","ref":"Jer 50:46; Eze 26:18"},"22":{"text":"En un! Muvanlai khat sanglen toin Bozrah tungah a kha zalin a bawhsuk ding hi. Tua ni ciangin Edom galhangte lungsim, numei nausuak kuante lungsim bang ding hi.","ref":"Pc 36:33; Hos 8:1; Jer 50:36; Isa 13:8"},"23":{"text":"Damascus tawh kisai-in: \"Hamath le Arpad-te in thusia za uh ahi manin a lungsi uh hi. Amaute khawl hun a nei lo tuipi bangin b a launa uh a kam thei kei hi.","title":"Damascus Tawh Kisai Thupuak","ref":"Isa 10:9; Isa 57:20"},"24":{"text":"Damascus-te thazaw uh a, tai ding a sawm uh hangin patauhna in gakcipa; numei nausuak nat bangin lunggimna le natna in amaute a man hi."},"25":{"text":"A minthang mahmahsa khuapi lian, ka lungkimna khuapi bang hangin kisusiacip ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"A tangvalnote lamdungah tuk taktak ding uh a; a galkapte khempeuh sunin a kidaisak ding hi,\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"27":{"text":"\"Damascus kulhte mei-in ka hal dinga; tua in Ben-Hadad kulh muanhuaite a hultum ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Am 1:4; 1Ku 15:18"},"28":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a sim Kedar le Hazor kumpi gamte tawh kisai-in: TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"Dingin Kedar sim unla, nisuahna lam mite susia un.","ref":"Pc 25:13; Thk 6:3","title":"Kedar le Hazor Tawh Kisai Thupuak"},"29":{"text":"A puanbukte uh le a tuuhonte uh kilaksak khin dinga; a niliimte uh a vante uh le a kala-ohte uh tawh kipuakkhiatsak ding hi. Mite in amaute otsan-in, ‘Na kim na pam uah launa!’ ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 6:25"},"30":{"text":"\"Manlangin taimang un! Hazor a tengte aw, suanghawm thukpi sungah om un,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in note langpan hong sawma; nang tungah sep ding khat a geel hi.","ref":"Thk 6:2; Jer 10:22"},"31":{"text":"\"Ding unla kimuangtaka teng hithiat minam - kongpi ahi a, kalhna zawl ahi zongin a nei lo, amau kia bek a teng minam khat sim in,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Eze 38:11"},"32":{"text":"A kala-ohte uh kikaihsak dinga, a bawnghon tampitakte uh a kiguk mangsak ding hi. Gamlapi muna a omte huih lakah ka thehthang dinga, akim apam panun amaute tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Thk 6:5; Jer 9:26"},"33":{"text":"Hazor, kinusia denin se-alte omna a suak ding hi. Tua lai-ah kuamah nungta lo dinga mihing peuhmah a teng kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:22"},"34":{"text":"Hih in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kumpi a suah tunglama Elam tawh kisai kamsangpa Jeremiah tunga tung TOPA thu ahi hi."},"35":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: \"En un, Elam-te thahat napi a thalpeu uh ka kuaitan ding hi.","title":"Elam Tawh Kisai Thupuak","ref":"Isa 22:6"},"36":{"text":"Keimah in Elam, van kiu lite panin huih lite ka mutsak dinga; huih lite in amaute thehthangin a kihawlkhia Elam-te tun lohna mun a om kei ding hi.","ref":"Da 11:4; tg 32"},"37":{"text":"Amaute a that nuam a galte uh mai-ah Elam ka thehzak dinga; ka hehluatna hanga gimna nangawn amau tungah ka tungsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. Amaute a bei siang matengun namsau-in ka nungdelh ding hi.","ref":"Jer 9:16"},"38":{"text":"Elam ah ka kumpi tokhom ka phut dinga, a kumpipa le a uliante ka susia ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi."},"39":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi mailam hun ciangin Elam a mailam hun angei ka bangsak ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 48:47"}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih in Babylon le Babylon mite b gam tawh kisai kamsang-pa Jeremiah tungtawna TOPA thugen ahi hi:","title":"Babylon Tawh Kisai Thupuak"},"2":{"text":"\"Minamte lakah zasakin tangko unla, dialkhai khai-in bangmah im kei unla, ‘Babylon kila ta ding hi; Bel kimaizumsak dinga, Marduk laugawp ding hi. Tuanu’ milimte kimaizumsak dinga a pasian limte kilausak ding hi.,’ ci-in tangko un.","ref":"Ph 20:5; Sp 26:30"},"3":{"text":"Leilu-lam panin minam khat in tuanu sim dinga, ama gam gamlak a suak ding hi. A sungah kuamah teng loin; mite le ganhingte taikek khawm ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 41:25; Isa 14:22-23; Zep 1:3"},"4":{"text":"\"Tua ni tua hun ciangin Israel mite le Judah mite in khitui tawh TOPA amaute Pasian a zong khawm ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ezr 3:12"},"5":{"text":"Amaute in Zion lam nga-in tua lai zuatna lampi a dong ding uh hi. Amaute in a kimangngilh ngei lo ding tawntung thukhun tawh TOPA kiang zuanin kipawlkhawm ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Ka mite tuu kimansuah hi uh a, amau a cingte in lam khialhpihin mualtungah a vaksak kawikawi uh hi. Muallian mualneu tungah amaute vak kawikawi uh a, amau neihsa khawlmun a mangngilh uh hi.","ref":"Isa 53:6; Mt 9:36; 10:6; Jer 23:32; Jer 3:6; Eze 34:6"},"7":{"text":"Amaute a mu peuh in nawmvalh uh a; a galte un, ‘Amaute a TOPA uh tung, a thumaan amau lonona tung le a pate uh lametna TOPA tungah mawh khin uh ahi manin, eite i khial kei hi,’ ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 2:3; Jer 14:8"},"8":{"text":"\"Babylon panin taikhia un; Babylon mite leitang nusia unla ganhon a makaih keelte bang un.","ref":"Isa 48:20"},"9":{"text":"Ahang in, keimah in leilu-lam gam panin minamte kipawlna lian mahmah khat Babylon sim dingin ka hanthawn ding hi. Amaute in, amaute langah panmun la ding uh a, leilu-lam panin tuanu kizo ding hi.
