Tua pen na khatpeuhin kimang ahi hiam?"},"5":{"text":"Bangmah a cih ma-in kimanna nei lo ahileh mei ah kangin a vom khit ciangin banga kimang peuhmah ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Jn 15:6"},"6":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin Thupipen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: Keimah in mei tawh nadingin tulaka singte lakah lenggui sing kong piak bangin Jerusalem a teng mite ka bawl ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amaute ka lang-et ding hi. Mei sung panin a suakta kha uh zongin mei in a hul veve ding hi. Amaute ka lang-et ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute muanhuai lo uh ahi manin a gam uh gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" hong ci hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"A Muanhuai Lo Jerusalem tawh Tehkakna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Jerusalem a kihhuai gamtatnate hangin maitang salh inla,"},"3":{"text":"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA in Jerusalem tunga a gen ahi hi: Na pu na pate ua kipan na suahna uh Canaan-te’ leitang ahi hi; na pa Amor-te hi a, na nu Hit-te ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Na suah tungin na lai kitan loin na sian nadingin tui in hong kisil lo a, ci inlah kinul loin puan inlah hong kitun lo hi."},"5":{"text":"Nang tungah hihte hih ding zahin kuamah in hong hehpih lo in hong khuatuah lo hi. Na suah-a kipan a kihhuaisa na hi manin lopaang ah hong kipai hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin na kiang kong tawn a, na sisan laka kipekpek hong mu-in; sisan lak a lum kim lai nang tungah, \"Nungta in!\" a kong ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Lo sunga singkung bangin kong khangsak hi. Na lian semsem a, khangtoin suangmanpha b melhoih penpen na suak hi. Na nawi bawk in na mul po ta a, nang lah na guaktangpi na hi lai hi.","ref":"Pk 19:4; Tp 1:10"},"8":{"text":"\"Tua nungin na kiangah kong pai-a nang kong et ciangin it theih tham cingta na hilam kong mu hi; ka puan mongkhat kong zawna na selsim teng kong khuhsak hi. A lipkhaphuai-in nang tungah hong kiciam in, nang tawh thu i ciamkhawm a, nang kei aa na suak hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ru 3:9; Jer 11:10"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Tui in kong pumsil a c , na tunga sisante hong sawpsakin kizutnate in kong zut hi."},"10":{"text":"Hoihtaka kiphan puan kong silhsak a, savun khedap kaih kong bulhsak hi. Saihadial puan hoihte in kong zema, puan man tamte in kong tuam hi."},"11":{"text":"Suang manpha in kong zem a, na banah tau hong bunsakin, na ngawngah khi kong oksak a,"},"12":{"text":"nak bah hong batsakin bilbah kong batsaka na lu ah kumpi lukhu melhoih kong khusak hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin ngun le khamin hong kizem a, na puansilhte saihadial puan hoih le nai puan manpha le hoihtakin kiphana a kizem puan ahi hi. Na annek: buhnel hoih khuaizu le olive thau ahi hi. Na melhoih mahmah a, kumpinu a suak dingin na khang hi."},"14":{"text":"Na melhoihna hangin minamte lakah na minliatna kizel a, kei hong piak thupina in na mel hoihna a kimsak hi. Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"15":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin na mel hoihna na muanga na minliatna kizuakna in na zang hi. Na kianga hong pai peuhpeuh tungah na uukna na uangzat lua a, ama aa d na suak hi."},"16":{"text":"Na puansilh pawlkhat munsangte nopcit nadingin na zanga tua munah na kizuakzuak hi. Hici bang na piang ngei lo tham loin na sep ngei loh ding ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Nang in kei hong piak suangmanpha hoihte keima ngun le khamte la-in pasal limin na bawla, tuate tawh na kizuak hi."},"18":{"text":"Hoihtaka kiphan a kizem na puante la-in tuate na silhsak a, tuate mai-ah ka sathau le ka gimnamtui in na bia hi."},"19":{"text":"Na an dinga kong piak annel hoih, olive thau le khuaizu na nek dinga kong piak te - gimnamtui dingin tuate mai-ah na lui hi. Thu omzia tua bang ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"20":{"text":"\"‘Tua ciangin kei tawh na neih na tanu na tapate paipihin milimte an dingin biakna-in na pia hi. Na kizuakna hawmthawh lai na hi hiam?"},"21":{"text":"Ka tate e go-in milimte biakna-in na pia hi."},"22":{"text":"Na kihhuai gamtatna le na kizuaknasate hangin bangmah silh lo na guaktangin na sisan laka na kipekpek lai hun, na khangno lai nite na phawk nawn kei hi.","ref":"Ph 106:37-38; Hos 2:15"},"23":{"text":"\"‘Gimna thuak ta in! Nang tungah gimna hong tung hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Na gitlohna dang khempeuh na behlapna-in,"},"24":{"text":"mihon khawl theihna mun tengah mun sangtuam bawlin biakbukno na lam hi."},"25":{"text":"Kong zing bul citeng ah biakbuknote na lama na mel hoihna muh thadahhuaina suahin na kiang hong tawn peuhpeuh tungah kitah in na huuk semsem hi."},"26":{"text":"A lan mahmah Egypt-te tawh na kituah ciangin na luppih a, na huuk semsemna in kei hong hehsak hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na langah ka khut zanin na gamgi ka khiam ding hi; na huukluat gamtatna in a linsak Philistia tanu nang hong hua na galte tungah kong piakhia ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Na hihnasa ah lungkim zo nai lo na hi manin Assyria mite tawh zong lumkhawm dingin na zol hi; tua khit nangawnin na lungkim zo nai kei lailai hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin sumbuk nasem ahi Babylon f mite na zol sawnsawn a, ahi hangin hihte nangawn tawh zong na lungkim zo tuan nai kei hi.","ref":"Eze 24:6"},"30":{"text":"\"‘Gina kei na lawmlawm cia, hih banga na gamtat ciangin numei khohlah kizuakte banga gamta na hi maw! Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"31":{"text":"Lamkabom citengah bosang bawlin mihon omna tual-awng tengah biakbuknote na bawl uh ciangin thaman ngen lo na hi manin numei kizuakte tawh na kibang kei uh hi.","ref":"Isa 52:3; Jer 3:3"},"32":{"text":"\"‘Mi ang a kawmsanpa zi na hi hi! Na pasal sangin khual mite na deihzaw hi."},"33":{"text":"A kizuak peuhmah in a kizuak man a ngah hi; ahi hangin na itte khempeuh tungah letsong pia-in na lunggulhte mun khempeuh pan hong pai nadingin golhsum na pia zawsop hi."},"34":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin nang kizuakna midang aa tawh a kilehbulh hi. Nang angvanna kuamah in hong delh kei hi. Nang in aman na piazaw a, nang tungah kuamah in hong pia lo ahi manin na kinak lehbulh mahmah uh hi.","ref":"Pc 30:15; Hos 8:9-10"},"35":{"text":"\"‘Tua ahi ciangin nang a kizuaknu aw, TOPA thugen za in!"},"36":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi! Na hauhna g khempeuh sungkhia in, na lawmpa tungah na guaktang hina na lahna-in a kihhuai milimte khempeuh bia-in tuate tungah na tate uh sisan na pia hi."},"37":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na itte, nuam na kisakpihte, le na muhdahte na itte tawh a kibangin ka kaikhawm dinga na kimkot ah omsakin amaute mai-ah na puan kong hawkkhiatsak dinga na selsim khempeuh a mu ding uh hi."},"38":{"text":"Angkawm le sisan a luangsak numeite bangin thukhenin dan kong tuaksak ding hi. Ka hazat hehna a ka thangpaih luatna sisan phulakna nang tungah kong tusak ding hi."},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin na itte tungah kong ap dinga amaute in na bosangte phelkhia-in na milim biakbuknote a susia ding uh hi. Na puan hong hawkkhiatsakin na kizepna manphate hong laksak ding uh a, na guaktangpi in hong nusia ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Amaute in mipite hong dosak ding uh a, suang in hong dengin namsau-in hong semnen ding uh hi."},"41":{"text":"Na innte haltum ding uh a, numei tampite muhin dan hong tuaksak ding uh hi. Na kizuakna pan kong khawlsak dinga na itte sumin na guai nawn kei ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin nang tunga ka thangpaihna damta dinga, haza a ka hehluatna a kam ta ding hi; ka dai dide dinga ka heh nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 19:5"},"43":{"text":"\"Na khangno lai nite na phawk nawn lohna hangin hihte tawh keimah hong hehsak lua na hi manin na hihsate nangma lutungah kong tusak pelmawh ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Na gamtatna kihhuaite khempeuh behlapin huuk lua hi lo na hi hiam?","ref":"Pk 15:2"},"44":{"text":"\" ‘Paunak a bulh mi peuhmah in hih paunak \"Tanu in a nu sun,\" cih nang tungah a bulh ding uh hi."},"45":{"text":"Nang in a pasal le a tate a simmawh na nu’ tanu taktak na hi hi. A pasalte uh le a tate uh a simmawh na sanggamnute’ sanggamnu taktak na hi hi. Na nu Hit-te hi a, na pa Amor-te ahi hi."},"46":{"text":"Na u nu Samaria, na omna leilu-lam ah a tanute tawh tenga; na naunu na omna leitaw lama a tanute tawh a teng Sodom ahi hi."},"47":{"text":"Amaute nungah pai-in a kihhuai a gamtatnate uh ciing bek loin na paina khempeuh ah amaute sangin na uangzaw hi."},"48":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in ka nuntakna ka lo hi, na sanggamnu Sodom le a tanute in nang le na tanute hihte a hih ngei nai kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 49:4; Mt 10:15"},"49":{"text":"\"‘Na sanggamnu Sodom mawhna hih ahi hi: Amah le a tanute kiphasakin, khamvalin ne-in kuamah thudon loin om uh hi; a zawngte le a tasamte huh lo uh hi."},"50":{"text":"Amaute kiphasak mahmahin ka mai-ah a kihhuai na sem uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin na muhsa bangin amaute ka maimangsak hi."},"51":{"text":"Samaria in nang gamtatsia zah lang a gamta kei hi. Nang in amaute sangin a kihhuai na tam na semzaw a, na hihsa hih nate khempeuh in na sanggam numeite thumaan tawh kibangsak hi."},"52":{"text":"Na sanggam numeite diktansakna guan na himanin na zahlakna nang thuak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute mawhna sangin nang aa a siahuaizaw hi. Tua ahi ciangin na sanggamnute amaan tawh kibangsak na hi manin maizumpi in na zahlakna nangmah in thuak ta in.","ref":"Isa 1:10; Jer 3:11"},"53":{"text":"\"‘Bangbang ahi zongin Sodom le a tanute le Samaria le a tanute a ngeina ka bangsak dinga, nang aa zong tuate mah ka bangsak ding hi."},"54":{"text":"Tua in na gamtatnasate hanga na zahlakna le na maizumnate in - amaute a hehnem ding hi."},"55":{"text":"Tua ciangin na sanggamnute, Sodom le a tanute a ngei uh bang kik dinga; nang le na tanute zong na ngei uh na bang kik ding uh hi."},"56":{"text":"Na gitlohnate hong kipholak ma"},"57":{"text":"na kiphatsak hun lai-in na sanggamnu Sodom na gen kha ngei beek kei hi. Tu nangawnin Edom a tanute a vengte khempeuh le Philistia-te tanute - na kimkota omte nang hong simmawhte khempeuh in nang hong zahpih uh hi."},"58":{"text":"Na hukluatna le a kihhuai na gamtatnate a banbanin na tuak ding hi, TOPA in cikhia hi."},"59":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi. Ka kiciamnate thusim loin ka thukhun na palsatna tawh kizui-in nang tungah kong tungsak ding hi."},"60":{"text":"Ahi zongin na khangno hun lai-a nang tawh i thukhun phawk kawmin nang tawh a tawntung adingin thukhun ka bawl lai ding hi."},"61":{"text":"Tua ciangin na paizia phawkin nang sanga uzaw nu le nang sanga nauzaw nu - na sanggam numeite na ngah ciangin na mai zum ding hi. Na tanu dingin amaute kong pia dinga ahi hangin nang tawh i thukhun bulphuh a kong piak ahi kei ding hi."},"62":{"text":"Tua ciangin nang tawh thu ka khung dinga keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding hi."},"63":{"text":"Na hihsate khempeuh kong thoihdam khit tua hun ciangin na kiphawk kik dinga nang hangin na mai zumin kiniam khiatin na kam na kek nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Muvanlai Nih le Lenggui Khat"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, tehkakna khat gelhkhia inla Israel innkuante tungah gentehna khat gen in."},"3":{"text":"Amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Muvanlai golpi, a kha za mahmah in a khavengte sau a, a mel tuamtuamin a gial bialbual khat Labanon ah va tu hi. Tamtak dawn khat tuah a,"},"4":{"text":"a dawnngek sutanin sumbukte gamah lenpih a, sumbukte khuapi ah a suan hi."},"5":{"text":"\"‘Amah in na gamua khaici pawlkhat pua in lei hoihna ah tuh hi. Nahkai sing bangin tui tamna munah suana,"},"6":{"text":"pokhia-in zaam a, ahi hangin azung a nuai-ah a om hi. Tua ciangin lenggui suak a, a hiang mengkhia in a teh pha mahmah hi.","ref":"Tp 8:7-9"},"7":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin muvanlai dang khat, gol mahmah in a kha za deda a, a mul pha mahmah khat a om hi. Lenggui in a kisuanna mun panin ama lamah zungkha a, tui a ngah nadingin a hiangte ama lamah a zaam hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua lenggui a hiang mengin agah gah a, lenggah hoih a suak dingin lei hoihna mun tui tamna gei-a kisuan ahi hi,’ ci in.","ref":"Job 18:19; Eze 31:4"},"9":{"text":"\"Amaute tungah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: A khanpha zo diam? A vul nadingin zungbawhin a gahte zutkhiat loin om ding ahi hiam? A mengthak khempeuh a vulgawp ding hi. Tua lenggui botkhia dingin mi thahat ahikeh mi tampi kisam lo ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A mun dangah kisuan leh zong a gahpha zo ding hiam? Nisuahna huih in a mut ciangin vulgawp lo ding hiam - a kisuanna mun a pona ah a vulgawp ding hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 42:10; Hos 12:1"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga,"},"12":{"text":"\"A lehdo thei innkuante tungah, ‘Hih nate a khiatna na thei uh hiam?’ ci-in dong in. Amaute tungah: ‘Babylon kumpipa Jerusalem ah pai-a, a kumpipa le a uliante kaikhia-in Babylon ah tonpih kik hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa innkuan sung pan khat la-in thuciam bawlpiha a kiciamsak hi. Gam makaite zong paikhiatpih mang hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua pen a kumpi gam kiamin ding kik zo nawn lo-a a omlai sunte in a thuciam uh a zuih nading uh deihna ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin kumpipa in amah lehdo a, Egypt ah palai sawlin sakol le galkap tampi a ngensak hi. A lawhcing na diam? Tua banga nasempa a suakta zo ding hiam? A thuciam palsat napi suakta veve ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Jer 52:3; Eze 12:8"},"16":{"text":"\"Thupipen TOPA nuntakna ka lo hi, a kamciam pelh a, a thuciam uh a palsatpa, amah kumpi tokhom tungah a tusakpa’ gam Babylon ah amah si ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Pharaoh in mi tampi nuntakna siatsak nadingin dum toin kan bawla a thahat a galkap honpite tawh a kuan hangin ama gal a zawhsak tuan kei hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah ciampelin thukhun palsat ahi hi. Thuciamna bawl khin napi hihte khempeuh sem ahi manin a suakta peuhmah kei ding hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:24; Eze 12:13"},"19":{"text":"\"‘Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, ka thuciam a simmawhna le ka thukhun a palsatnate ama lutungah ka tusak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah siahna-in ka len ka zaak dinga ka thangah a awk ding hi. Amah kei tungah muanhuai lo ahi manin Babylon ah paipihin tua lai-ah thu sitin thu ka khen ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A taikek ama galkapte khempeuh namsau in tuk ding uh a, a omlai sunte huih lakah a kithehthang ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA gensate na thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 7:9; Eze 12:14"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in tamtak sangpi dawnngek khat la-in ka suan ding hi; adawn panin angumngeek khat khiaktanin mual sangpi dawn khatah ka suan ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Israel mual sangpente dawnah ka suan ding hi; a hiang meng dinga, agah gahin tamtak lianpi a suak ding hi. Vasa namkim in a tungah bu tom ding uh hi; amaute ahiang liim nuai-ah a om ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Gam sunga sing khempeuh in, keimah TOPA in sing sangte niamsakin, sing niamte ka sansak lam, singhingte keusakin singkeute ka hinsak lam a thei ding uh hi. \"‘Keimah TOPA in ka gensa hi-a ka gen bangin ka sem ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ph 96:12"}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Mi Mawhpa Si Ding"},"2":{"text":"Israel gam tawh kisai-a mite in paunak-a a zat uh: \"‘A pa lenggah thuk nek, a tate ha kim; a cih no mite in bang na cihnopna uh hiam?’ a ci hi.","ref":"Job 21:19"},"3":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in: Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, hih paunak Israel sungah na zang nawn kei ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahang in, a nungta hinna peuhmah kei aa hi a, a pa le a ta a nihin kei aa hikhawm hi. Mawhna a bawlpa mah a si ding hi.","ref":"Ph 49:4; Isa 42:5"},"5":{"text":"\"A thumaan a thutang - a thumaana gamta mi khat om ci ni."},"6":{"text":"Amah in mualtung biakbukno ah ne loin Israel innkuante milimte zong a en kei hi. A vengte zite zong buahsak loin a nin nei kimlai numei zong a luppih kei hi.","ref":"Eze 6:2; Tp 4:19; Eze 6:2"},"7":{"text":"Kuamah nengniam loin sum leitawite vankhapte pia kik zaw hi. Amah in kuama aa sut loin gilkialte an pia zaw a, puan nei lote puan a guanzaw hi.","ref":"Pk 22:26; Tp 15:11"},"8":{"text":"A met deihna bekin kuamah sum leitawi lo a, a met a tam lua zong a la kei hi. Khialhna bawl khak loh nadingin a khut dek tentan a, khat le khat kikalah a kilawmin thu khen hi.","ref":"Jer 22:3"},"9":{"text":"Ka thukipte zui-a ka thukhamte muanhuaitakin a tang hi. Tua bang mi a thumaan hi a, a nungta taktak ding hi; Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Sp 19:37; Hab 2:4"},"10":{"text":"\"Amah a ngongtat tapa khat hi zenzen henla, mi sisan luangsakin hih na b dangte khatpeuh sem kha leh"},"11":{"text":"(a pa in lah tuate khat beek sem kha kei leh): \"Amah in mualtung biakbuknote ah a ne hi. A vengte zite buahsak hi.","ref":"Pk 21:12; Eze 22:6; Eze 22:9"},"12":{"text":"Mizawngte le a tasamte nuainet hi. Mi na a mawkna-in sut hi. Sum leitawi tanga a vanlakte pia kik nawn lo hi. Milimte lam nga hi. A kihhuai nate sem hi.","ref":"Pk 22:22; Pk 22:27"},"13":{"text":"A met bek lametna-in mite sum leitawisak a, a met tampipi la hi. Tua bang mi nungta ding ahi hiam? A nungta kei ding hi! Bang hang hiam cih leh hih a kihhuai nate khempeuh sem khin hi. Amah sihsak taktak ding hi-a a sisan ama lutung mah ah tu ding hi.","ref":"Pk 22:25"},"14":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin hih tapa in tapa mah nei henla, a pa mawhna bawl teng mu a amuh hangin tuate sem kei leh:","ref":"2Kh 34:21"},"15":{"text":"\"Amah in mualtung biakbukno te ah ne loin, Israel innkuante milimte lam a nga kei hi. A vengte zi buahsak lo hi.","ref":"Ph 24:4"},"16":{"text":"Kuamah nengniam loin sum leitawina ah vanlak a nei kei hi. Kuama na zong sut loin gilkialte an pia zaw a, puan nei lote puan guan hi.","ref":"Isa 58:7; Ph 41:1"},"17":{"text":"Mawhna bawl kha lo dingin c a khut dek tentan a, tangpi van la loin a met tam lua zong a ngen kei hi. Ka thukhamte tangin ka thukipte zui hi. A pa’ mawhna hangin a si kei ding hi; a nungta taktak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 1:2"},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin a pa in mi zawhthawh bawlin, a sanggampa na sutin mite lakah khialhna bawl ahi manin a mawhna hangin a si ding hi."},"19":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi, ‘Bang hangin a pa mawhna a tapa in thuak kha lo ding hiam?’ ci-in nong dong uh hi. A tapa in thumaan thutang semin ka thukipte khempeuh limtakin a zuih nungsang, a nungta taktak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mawhna a bawlpa a si ding hi. Tapa in a pa’ mawhna thuak kha lo dinga, pa in zong tapa mawhna a thuak kha tuan kei ding hi. A thumaan mi in a thumaanna thaman sang dinga, migilote a gitlohna amah kithuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Pk 20:5; Ms 15:31"},"21":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin migilo khat a mawhna bawlnate panin kihei-a, ka thukipte zui-in thumaan thutangin a gamtat leh a nungta taktak ding hi; a si kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"A hihsate khempeuh kiciamteh nawn loin kimaisak ding hi. A maana a gamtatnasa hangin a nungta ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Migilo khat sihna hangin nuam ka hi hiam? Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Nuam lo tham loin kisikin a nuntak ciangin nuam zaw hi lo ka hi hiam?","ref":"Jer 18:8"},"24":{"text":"\"Ahi zongin a thumaan mi khat thumaan nawn loin migilo khat sep ahi a kihhuai mawhna a bawl leh a nungta ding hiam? Ama thumaan-nasate khat beek a kiciaptehsak kei ding hi. A muanhuai lohna hangin a mawh hi-a, a bawlsa mawhna hangin a si ding hi.","ref":"Pn 21:16; Jer 34:16"},"25":{"text":"\"Tua hi napi, ‘Topa hihzia thutang lo hi,’ na ci uh hi. Israel innkuante aw, za un: Ka hihzia thutang lo ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"A thumaan mi khat in a thumaanna lehngatsanin mawhna a bawl leh tua hangin a si ding hi; amah a bawlsa mawhna hanga si hi ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ahi hangin migilo khat in a gitlohnasa lehngatsanin thumaan thutangin a gamtat leh a nuntakna a hon ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Amah in a mawhnasa khempeuh ngaihsun thei-in lehngatsan ahi manin a nungta taktak ding hi; amah a si kei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua hi napi Israel innkuante in, ‘Topa hihzia a thutang kei hi,’ ci uh hi. Israel innkuante aw, ka hihzia thutang lo ahi hiam? A thutang lo no hihzia hizaw lo ahi hiam?","ref":"Isa 55:7; Jer 2:29"},"30":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel innkuante aw, nomau hihzia tawh kizui-in no tungah thu kong khen ciat ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Kisik un! Na gamtatnasa uh lehngatsan un tua ciangin na mawhna uh hangin na puk nawn kei ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Na gamtatnasa khempeuh panun kikhel unla, lungsim thak le kha thak nei un. Israel innkuante aw, bang hang si ding na hi uh hiam?"},"32":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh sihna ah ka lungdam kei hi. Kisikin nungta un! Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 1:27; 55:7"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Israel uliante taamlawh inla:","title":"Israel Uliante ading Tamlawhna","ref":"2Ku 24:6"},"2":{"text":"\"Na nu uh humpinelkaite lakah humpinelkai pi a bang hi! Gam-ukte ciangkhut dinga hoih a hiang khauh a om nawn kei hi, ci in,’ Hih in tamlawhna khat hi-a, tamlawhna-a kizang ding khat ahi hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 15:4"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sagihna kum a kha ngana a nisawm ni-in Israel upate pawlkhat TOPA tungah thudong dingin hong pai uh a ka mai-ah tu uh hi.","title":"A Lehdo Israel","ref":"Pc 25:22"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"3":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel upate hopih inla, amaute kiangah: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA thugen ahi hi: Thu hong dong dingin hong pai na hi uh hiam? Khut laamtosa in amaute kiangah, \"Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi,\" ka ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ni-in amaute tungah, Egypt panin paikhiatpih in amaute adingin ka zonsaksa gam khempeuh lakah a kilawmpen bawngnawi le khuaizu luanna gam tunpih dingin ka kiciam hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute kiangah \"A kuamahpeuh in mitkhah lo-a na et uh a muhthadahhuai milimte paikhiamang unla Egypt milimte tawh no le no kininsak nawn kei un. Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Eze 6:9; 16:2"},"8":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin amaute in kei hong lehdo uh a, ka thu a ngai kei uh hi; mitkhah lo-a a et uh a muhthadah-huai milimte paikhia lo tham loin Egypt milimte a paikhia tuan kei uh hi. Tua ciangin ka thangpaihna amaute tungah bua in, ka hehna, Egypt ah amaute tunga a zat dingin ka gen hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute in a tenpih uh minamte mai-ah ka min a daisak loh nadingun ka min hangin ka thuciam ka tungsak kei a, Israel mite muhin kei mahmah kilaakin Egypt panin amaute ka paikhiatpih hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Egypt pan ka pikhia a, sehnel gamah ka tun hi."},"11":{"text":"Keimah in ka thukipte amaute ka pia a, ka thukhamte ka theisak hi; ahang in, tuate a zuite in nuntakpih ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Eite kikalah lim ahi dingin ka Sabbath-te zong ka pia hi. Amaute in ka thukipte zui loin ka thukhamte nial uh a - tuate zui-in gamta-a nungta ding hi na pi - ka Sabbath-te a ninsak gawp uh hi. Tua ahi manin amaute tungah ka thangpaihna ka bua dinga sehnel gamah amaute ka susia ding hi, ka ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute ka paikhiatpih a mu minamte mai-ah ka min a dai loh nadingin ka min ka khualna-in bangmah ka cih kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua tham loin amaute ka piaksa gam khempeuh laka a hoih pen bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna ka tunsak loh ding, sehnel-gama amaute tungah khut laamto a ka ciamsa zong ahi hi -"},"16":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thukhamte nial uh a, ka thukipte zui loin ka Sabbath-te a tang kei uh hi. Ahang in, a lungsim un milim biak ding bek a ngaihsun uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hi napi ka hehpih a sehnel-gamah susia loin ka maimangsak tuan kei hi."},"18":{"text":"A tate uh tungah, \"Na pate uh bawl ngeinate zui loin amau thukhamte tang kei unla, milimte in kibuahsak kei un."},"19":{"text":"Keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hi hi; ka thukipte zui unla ka thukhamte zui un."},"20":{"text":"I kikal ah lim ahi theih nadingin ka Sabbath-te siangthosak un. Tua hileh keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hilam na thei ding uh hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Ph 78:40; Jer 17:22"},"21":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin a tate un kei hong lehdo uh hi; ka thukipte zui lo uh a - ka thukhamte limtakin zui loin - tuate a zuite in nuntak lawh ding uh hi napi - ka Sabbath-te a buahsak uh hi. Tua ciangin sehnel gamah amaute tungah ka thangpaihna sungin ka hehna kong zang ding hi, ka ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Ahi hangin amaute ka paikhiatpih a mu minamte mai-ah ka min a dai loh nadingin ka min ka khualna-in ka khut ka tonkiksak hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua tham loin sehnel gamah ka khut laamto in, minamte lakah amaute delhkekin gam citengah ka thehthang ding ka kiciam zo hi,"},"24":{"text":"bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thukhamte mang nuam lo uh a, tua tham loin ka thukipte nialin ka Sabbath-te buahsak uh a, a pate uh milimte mah a mitsuan tentan lai uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Kei zong a hoih lo ngeina le a nuntakpih loh ding uh thukhamte ah ka ngawhngatsan hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute in cikzia-in keimah TOPA ka hilam a theih nadingun a letsongte uh - biakna-a a piak uh tacilte a tungtawnin amaute ka buahsak ding hi,’ ka ci hi.","ref":"2Ku 17:17; Jer 7:26"},"27":{"text":"\"Tua ahi manin mihing tapa aw, Israel mite hopih inla amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Na pate un kei hong taisanna uh tawh zong hong daisak uh hi:"},"28":{"text":"Amaute piak dinga ka ciamsa gamah ka paipih ciangin mualsang peuh, singtehpha peuh mu uh a, tuate ah a biakna uh pia-in, a gimnamtuite uh tawh bia in dawn theih-a biaknate sung uh a, a biakpiaknate un kei hong hehsak hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute tungah: Na paina uh hih munsangte bang hi lel hiam? ka ci hi. (Tuate tuni dongin Bamah b kici hi.)","ref":"Ph 78:57; Eze 16:16"},"30":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin Israel innkuante tungah gen in: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Na pate uh gamtatsa bangin no le no kibuahsakin amaute milim kihhuaite mah lunggulh lailai ding na hi uh hiam?"},"31":{"text":"Na letsongte uh pia in - biakna-in na tate uh mei-in c na hal uh ciangin tuni mahmah dong no le no na milimte uh hangin a kibuahsak na hi uh hi. Israel innkuante aw, thu hong kidongsak ding ka hi hiam? Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, note thudotin ka om peuhmah kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in ci hi.","title":"Thukhenna le Angei Batsakna","ref":"Jer 16:12"},"32":{"text":"\"‘Note in, \" Leitung mi sing le suang a bia minamte i bang nuam hi,\" na ci uh hi. Ahi hangin na lungsim ngaihsut bangun a piang ngei kei ding hi."},"33":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in ‘Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, ka khut thahat le ka zankhiat ka ban le ka thangpaihna sunkhiatna tawh kong uk ding hi,’ ci hi."},"34":{"text":"Keimah in a thahat ka khut, ka zankhiat ka ban le ka thangpaihna sungkhiain kong thehthangna gamdanga minamte lak panin kong kaikawm kik ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Minamte omna sehnel gamah kong puak dinga tua lai-ah note tawh maitang kituahin thu kong khensiang ding hi."},"36":{"text":"Egypt gama sehnel gamah na pate uh tunga thu ka khen bangin no tungah zong kong khen ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"37":{"text":"Ka ciangkhut nuai-ah hong lutsakin kong ciamteh dinga thukhunin kong khih ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Note lak panin kei hong langpana kei hong lehdote ka siaksiang ding hi. Amaute tenna gam panin ka paikhiatpih hangin Israel gamah a lut kei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin note in keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding uh hi.","ref":"2Co 6:17"},"39":{"text":"\"‘Israel innkuante aw, hih in note adingin TOPA thugen ahi hi: Note a kuamapeuh in na milimte uh na sem un! Ahi hangin mailam hunah pel loin ka thu nong ngai ding uh a, na letsongte uh le na milimte uh tawh ka min siangtho na daisak nawn kei ding uh hi."},"40":{"text":"Ahang in, ka mual siangtho tung, Israel mual sang munah Israel innkuan khempeuh in ka na sem ding uh a, tua lai-ah amaute ka sang ding hi; Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Tua lai-ah biaknate le note deihtel letsongte a a siangtho biakpiaknate tawh kong ngen khawm ding hi."},"41":{"text":"Na kithehthangna gam panun hong kaikhawmin minamte lakpan kong lakkhiat ciangin note gimnamtui bangin kong sang dinga minamte mai-a note lakah kei ka sianthona kong kilak ding hi."},"42":{"text":"Tua ciangin khut laamtosa-a na pate uh tungah piak dinga ka ciamsa gam, Israel gamah kong tunpih ciangin note in keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding uh hi."},"43":{"text":"Tua lai-ah na gamtatnasate uh, no le no na kinitsaknate khempeuh uh hanga no le no na kikih nadingte uh na phawk ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"Israel innkuante aw, note gitlohna le na gamtatsiatnate uh tawh kizui-in ka min hangin note tungah thu kong khen ni ciangin note in keimah TOPA ka hilam na thei ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ph 109:21; Jer 44:25"},"45":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"46":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, leitaw lam nga in; leitaw-lam siat ding thu hilh inla, leitaw-lam gama tulak siat nading genkhol in.","title":"Leitaw-lam Siat nading Genkholhna"},"47":{"text":"Leitaw-lam tulak tungah, ‘ TOPA kammal za in. Meikuang kiphelh zo lo dinga, leilu pan leitaw dong maitang peuhmah tua mei hangin hulkhin ding hi."},"48":{"text":"A kuamapeuh in keimah TOPA hal a hilam thei ding uh hi; a kiphelh zo kei ding hi.","ref":"Jer 7:20; Eze 4:3"},"49":{"text":"Tua ciangin, \"Ah, Thupipen TOPA ! Amaute in kei, ‘Amah gentehnate zanga thugen himawk lo maw?’ hong ci ding uh hi,\" ka ci hi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Babylon Pasian Thukhenna Namsau"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, na maitang Jerusalem lam ngat inla munsiangtho langah thu hilh in. Amaute mai-ah dah lua-in lungsim tamkhamin thum in."},"7":{"text":"Amaute in nang kiangah, ‘Bang dinga thum na hi hiam?’ ci-a hong dot uh ciangin, ‘Kei tunga hong tung thuthakte hang ahi hi. Lungtang khempeuh tuisuak dinga, khut peuhmah kha dakdakin, lungsim khempeuh bei dinga khuk khempeuh tui bangin a neem ding hi,’ ci-in gen in. Tua hun hong tung ta ding hi! Namsau in tua bang ciangkangte a thusim kei hi.","ref":"Ph 110:5-6"},"11":{"text":"\"‘Namsau nawtngil pen khuta zatpah lian dinga sehsa ahi hi; tathiamsa le nawtngilsa hi-a, mi that ding pa zat dingin a mansa ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 46:4"},"12":{"text":"Mihing tapa aw, hih in ka mite thuak ding ahi manin kikokhia inla tau in; tua in Israel gam-ukte khempeuh thuak ding ahi hi. Amaute in ka mite khempeuh tawh namsau thuak khawm ding uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin na awm tum in."},"13":{"text":"\"‘Zia-etna hong tung taktak ding hi. Namsau in a thusim loh Judah kumpi ciangkhut kizom suak kei leh e! Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci hi."},"14":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin mihing tapa aw, na khutte gel tum inla mailam thu genkhol in. Tua namsau nihvei tham lo thumvei nangawn kivat hen. Tua in kigawhna namsau - a ning kim panin nehtuah a tampitak gawhna namsau ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 24:10; Eze 6:11"},"15":{"text":"Lungsim tuisuak nading le tampi a puk nadingin thahna a namsau, amaute kongpi khempeuh ah ka pangsak khin hi. Khuaphia bangin kiteesak zalzal a, a go dingin a len cinten hi,"},"16":{"text":"Namsau aw, na veilam le na taklam, na vat manna peuhpeuh vat in."},"17":{"text":"Kei zong ka khutte gel ka tum dinga tuateh ka thangpaihna a kiam ding hi. Keimah TOPA in ka gensa ahi hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 22:13"},"18":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga,"},"19":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Balylon kumpipa namsau, gam khat pan a kibang lam niha a kipat theih nadingin lampi nih ciamteh in. Tua khuapi lam zuatna lampi a katna munah ciaptehna khuam khat phut in."},"20":{"text":"Namsau in Ammon mite khua Rabbah a vat nadingin lampi khat ciamteh inla Judah le kulha ki-um Jerusalem vat nadingin adang khat hisak in."},"21":{"text":"Ahang in, Babylon kumpipa lampi nih kituahna lamka lai-ah khawlin ai san phot dinga: A thaltangte tawh aisanin, a milimte dongin sasin a vel ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Molh-tumpi-a kulh sukkhap nading mun ahi zongin vat un, cih thupiak nading ahi zongin, galsim ta un ci-a kiko nading ahi zongin molh-tumpi-a kongpi sukhap nading ahi zongin, lei sunvum nading ahi zongin, umcih nading ahi zongin Jerusalem adingin a khut taklam sungah ai hong om ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Ama tunga kiciamte adingin ai a pha lo tawh a kibang ding hi. Ahi hangin amaute khialhna phawksakna le sal-a a kikaih nading ahi hi."},"24":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘No mihingte in lungsim sunga ciamteh dingin thei gige mahin na lehdona uh hangin na hihna khempeuh uhah na mawhna uh na pholak uh hi - hihte na hihna uh hangin salin hong kikai ding hi.","ref":"Ms 32:23"},"25":{"text":"\"A ni tungta in, a dan thuak ding hun khengval ta a, a thanghuai a gilo Israel gam-ukpa aw,"},"26":{"text":"hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Na dialkhip lakhia in, na kumpi lukhu suahkhia in. Nidang lai-a bang hi nawn lo ding hi. Miniamte kitawisang dinga, a kitawisangte kiniamsak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Kisiagawp! Kisiagawp! Ka siasak gawp ding hi! A neipa taktak hong pai mateng a kipia kik kei ding hi; amah ka pia ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Eze 22:4"},"28":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin mihing tapa aw, thu genkhol inla, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA in Ammon-te le a simmawhte tawh kisai-a a gen ahi hi: \"‘Namsau khat, namsau khat, gawhlup nadinga kidokkhiasa a nawmvalh ding le khuaphia banga tee zalzal dinga kinawt ngilsa namsau khat!","ref":"Pc 19:38; Zep 2:8"},"29":{"text":"Nang tawh kisai a man lo mangmuhna le zuau ai sannate tangin a ni tunga a dan thuak ding hun a khengval ta, thahlup ding mi gilote ngawng ah kinga ding hi.","ref":"Jer 27:9"},"30":{"text":"Namsau a paai-ah siat kik un. Nang hong kibawlna mun; na pu na pate uh gamah thu kong khen ding hi.","ref":"Jer 47:6"},"31":{"text":"Note tungah ka thangpaihna sungin ka hehluatna husa-in kong mut ding hi. Siatsakzia a siam, a cikzia lo mite tungah kong pia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 79:6"},"32":{"text":"Note mei-ah hong kikhul dinga, na sisan uh na gamuah kiluangsakin hong kiphawkkha nawn kei ding hi; hih thu keimah TOPA in ka gensa ahi hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 25:10"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tung a,","title":"Jerusalem Mawhnate"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, tuanu thu na khensak ding hiam? Hih khuapi sisan luansakna thu na khen ding hiam? Tuateh a kihhuai a gamtatna khempeuh maitangsalh gawp inla:"},"3":{"text":"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Na sunga sisan luanna hangin nang le nang kisiattut a, na milim bawlna hanga a kibuahsak nang khuapi aw,"},"4":{"text":"na luansaksa sisan hang le na bawlsa milimte hanga na kibuah-sakna hangin nang hong kimawhsak zo hi. Na nite na beisaka, na kumte a beita hi. Tua ahi ciangin minamte simmawh le gamdangte khempeuh ciamnuih bawlna kong suaksak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"A minsia-a buaina tawh kidim khuapi aw, nang tawh kinaite le nang tawh kigamlate in nang hong simmawh ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 22:2; Eze 24:6"},"6":{"text":"\" ‘Na sunga om Israel gam-ukte in amaute thuneihna sisan luansakna-in a zat uh mu in."},"7":{"text":"Na sungah nute le pate kisimmawh hi; na sungah pemtate, meigongnute le pa nei lote kinengniam gawp hi."},"8":{"text":"A siangtho ka vante kithusim lo a, ka Sabbath-te kitang lo hi."},"9":{"text":"Na sungah mihing sisan luangsak dingin mihekte, mualtung a biakbukno a nete le ahuuklua alan lua-a gamtate om uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Na sungah a pa lupna a zahtak lo om a, nang sungah numei nin neih hun - thukham in a phal loh hun a tang lo a om hi."},"11":{"text":"Na sungah a vengte zi tawh a kihhuai-a gamta om-a, adang khat in a mo zumhuaipi in buahsak a, adang khat in a sanggamnu, ama pa’ tanu tektek a buan hi."},"12":{"text":"Na sungah mite in sisan suahsak nadingin golhsum la uh hi. Amaute tungah phu ka lak ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 31:3; Jos 13:3"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna tua kha a ni masapen ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Tyre Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Tyre in Jerusalem tung ah, ‘Awi bek si’ng! Nang langkhatah minamte tampi ka pangsak dinga tuipi hual khang a bang ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Amaute in Tyre kulhte susia in a tausangte kaipuk ding uh hi. A leisek tangte nilkhia-in suang gawtak bek ka dawksak ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keimah Thupipen TOPA in ka gensa ahi manin tuipi pua-a len phona mun a suak ding hi. Tuanu minamte galmat suak dinga,"},"6":{"text":"a munpi-a a tensakte namsau in kivatmang ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi."},"7":{"text":"\"Bang hang hiam cih leh hih in, Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Tyre a kumpite kumpipa Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar a sim dingin leilu-lam panin galkap tampi, sakol, sakolleng le sakol galkapte tawh ka kuansak ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in a munpi-a a tensakte namsau-in a vatmang ding hi; nang hong umcih nading bawlin na kulh banin phung ciang ding uh a, hong doin lum tawh kidal ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amah in na kulhte molh-tumpi in khawhkham dinga, a galhiamte in na tausangte a phukmai ding hi."},"10":{"text":"A sakolte tam lua mahmah dinga leivui in nang hong tuamcip ding hi. Kulh kiphuvang a mi a lut henhan bangin na kongpi-ah amah a lut ciangin sakol galkap, van pua lengte le sakol-leng huging in na kulh a lingsak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"A sakolte in na kong zing khempeuh tuancil khin ding uh hi; na mite namsau in that dinga, a khauh mahmah na khuampite lei-ah puk ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Na hauhna hong puakmangsak ding uh a, na sum-buk van a la mang ding uh hi; na kulhte satkham ding uh a, a hoih mahmah na innte phelgawpin suangte, inn singte le leiseek-tangte tuipi sungah a pai ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Lasa-a gamlumna ka beisak dinga na harp tumging-te uh a kiza nawn kei ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Suang gawtak lak kong suaksak dinga nga betna lente kiphona mun na suak ding hi. Keimah TOPA in ka gensa ahi manin nang hong kilam kik ngei nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in ci khia hi."},"15":{"text":"\"Hih in Tyre tungah Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Nang sungah mi kithatin aliamte a tau hun ciangin na pukna awging in tuipi gei-a gam teng lingsak ding hilo ahi hiam?"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuipi gei-a gam-ukte khempeuh a kumpi tokhom panun tuakkhia ding uh a, a puantualpite uh koihkhia in a kizepna thupite uh a suahkhia ding uh hi. Patauhna bek silhin lei lakah tu ding uh a, a paisuk a paitohna-uah nang hong gimneihin lingling ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin nang tamlawhna in hong nei ding uh a, nang tungah: \"‘Tuipi gei-a mite omna a minthang khuapi aw, kinak siat na lawmlawm cia! Nang le na sunga tengte, tuipi tunga vang neite in tua lai-a tengte khempeuh na lausak uh hi.","ref":"Eze 26:36; Isa 41:5"},"18":{"text":"Na pukni-in tuipi gei-a gamte ling uh a, na kicipna in tuipi sunga tuikulhte lausak hi,’ hong ci ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 23:5; Eze 27:35"},"19":{"text":"\"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in kuama ten nawnloh nading gamsimtham kong suahsak ciang le tuipi thukpi nang kong tuupsak ciang, tuihualpite in nang hong tuam ciangin,"},"20":{"text":"lei nuai-ah a paisate tawh tanglai peka a paisate kiangah, nang kong puak ding hi. Tangkum a kisiasa lei nuai-a a paisate tawh kong tengkhawmsak dinga, a nungtate tenna lei tungah hong kilehin mun a na ngah kik nawn kei ding hi."},"21":{"text":"A lipkhaphuai mahmah in kong beisak dinga na om nawn kei ding hi. Nang hong kizongzong dinga ahi hangin hong kimukik nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" hong ci hi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Tyre Kitamlawhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Tyre taamlawh in."},"3":{"text":"Tuipi zuatna kongpi ah tengin tuipi gei mun tuamtuam pana sumbuk bawlte kisuktuahna-a teng Tyre tungah gen in: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Tyre aw, nang in, \"Mel hoihna khempeuh ka cin hi,\" na ci hi.","ref":"Ph 83:7; Eze 19:1"},"4":{"text":"Na ukna gam tuipite umcihna sung hi a; nang hong lamte in hoihna kima hong zep uh ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in hong lamna uh singte khempeuh Senir b pana takkungte ahi hi. Na puankhai khuam dingin Lebanon panin tamtak sing a la uh hi.","ref":"Isa 2:13"},"6":{"text":"Nang hong kihawhna-khe dingin Bashan pana tawsaw sing a bawl uh hi. Cyprus c gei panin cypress d taksan la-in, na sual dingin phah uh a, saihapakin a zem uh hi.","ref":"Ms 21:33; Pc 10:4"},"7":{"text":"Na puankhai pen hoihtaka kizem Egypt pana saihadial puan hi-a na dialkhai-in kizang hi. Na tungkhuh adum le adupsan-te Elishah dung pan ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 25:4"},"8":{"text":"Nang hong hotte Sidon-te le Avad a tengte ahi uh hi; Tyre aw, na misiamte mah in nang hong hawl uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 9:27"},"9":{"text":"Gebal e panin tanglai khutsiamte hong tuanga tembawpi hong lem uh hi. Tuipi tunga tembaw khempeuh le a hawlte nang tawh kidawlsawn dingin hong zuan uh hi.","ref":"Jos 13:5; Ph 104:26"},"10":{"text":"\"‘Persia, Lydia le Put mite in na galkap na sem uh hi. Amaute in a lum uh le a sik lukhu uh na kawm tungah khai uh a, nang hong thupisak uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:20"},"11":{"text":"Avad le Helech mite in na kulh kimkotah cing uh a, Gamad-te na tausangah om uh hi. Amaute in na kulh kimkotah a lumte uh khai uh a; na mel hoihna kimsak uh hi."},"12":{"text":"\"‘Van hau lua mahmah na hi manin Tarshish in nang tawh sumbuk bawlkhawm hi; na sumbuk vante ngun, sik, daal le haknaw in hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:4"},"13":{"text":"\" ‘Greece-te, Tubal-te le Meshech-te in nang tawh sum a bawl khawm uh hi. Amaute in silate, sumngo a kibawl vante in na vante hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Joel 3:6"},"14":{"text":"\" ‘Beth Togarmah mite in van pua sakolte, sakol galkapte, le laate-in na sumbuk van hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:3"},"15":{"text":"\" ‘Rhodes f mite in nang tawh kizomin sumbawl uh a, tuipi gei-a om gam tampite in nang hong dawl uh hi; amaute in saihapak le ningsing hong pia uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:7; 1Ku 10:22"},"16":{"text":"\" ‘A piang na tampi nei na hi manin Aram-te g in nang tawh sum bawlkhawm uh hi. Amaute in na sumbuk vante turquoise, puan dupsan, puan kizemte, saihadial hoihte, suang khi le ruby-te in hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Thk 10:6"},"17":{"text":"\"‘Judah le Israel in nang tawh sum bawlkhawm uh a, na vanzatte, Minith pana piang mangbuh, moh namkim h khuaizu, sathau le sing namtui tuamtuamin hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 5:9; Ns 12:20"},"18":{"text":"\"‘A piang na tampi hang le van na hauh mahmah manin Damascus in nang tawh sum bawlkhawm a, Helbon pana zu le Zahar pana samulte hong zong uh hi.","ref":"Pc 14:15"},"19":{"text":"\"‘Uzal pana Dan-te le Greek-te in na sumbuk vante hong lei uh hi; amaute in sik huansa, thaksing le thalsingte-in na vanzatte hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:2; Pk 30:24"},"20":{"text":"\"‘Dedan-te in sakol dapphah puante sum bawlna in hong nei uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:7"},"21":{"text":"\"‘Arabia-te le Kedar gam-ukte khempeuh na van hong leite ahi uh hi; amaute in tuuno, tuutal le keel in hong lei uh hi.","ref":"2Kh 9:14"},"22":{"text":"\"‘Sheba le Raamah sumbukte in nang tawh sum a bawl uh hi; na sumbuk vante a hoih penpen sing namtui nam khempeuh le suang manpha le khamin hong kheng uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:7,28; Kil 18:12"},"23":{"text":"\"‘Haran, Canneh le Eden le Sheba, Asshur le Kilmad sumbukte in nang tawh sum bawl uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Na sumbuk-zawn ah puan melhoihte, puandum, puan kizemte, limtaka kiphek sualphah puan mel tuamtuam le ciiptaka kihek bikbek khauhualte hong zuak uh hi.","ref":"Pc 11:26; Ms 24:24"},"25":{"text":"\"‘Na vanzatte Tarshish tembawte in a pua uh hi. Tuipi laizangah van gik pipi tawh na kidim hi.","ref":"Pc 10:4; Kil 18:3"},"26":{"text":"Nang hong hotte in tuipi thuk tungah hong hot uh hi. Ahi hangin nisuahna huih in tuipi laizangah nang hong kitamnensak ding hi.","ref":"Pc 41:6"},"27":{"text":"Na tembaw a kisiat ni ciangin na hauhna, na sumbuk vante le na vanzatte, na tembaw hawlte, na tembaw nasemte, tembaw lemte, na sumbukpa-te, na galkapte khempeuh le tembaw tunga tuangte peuhmah tuipi sungah a tum ding uh hi.","ref":"Pn 11:4; Eze 28:8"},"28":{"text":"Na tembaw nasemte awng ding uh a, tuipi gei teng a ling ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Tembaw hawhna lente khempeuh in a tembaw uh taisan ding uh hi; a hawlte le a nasemte khempeuh tui gei-ah a ding diing uh hi."},"30":{"text":"A aw uh sangsakin nakpi-in nang hong kah ding uh a, amaute lutungah leivui thehin vut lakah a kikhuk ding uh hi.","ref":"Jos 7:6; Jer 6:26"},"31":{"text":"Nang hangin a lu uh mettol ding uh a, ippi puan a silh ding uh hi. Khasia lua-in nang hong kah ding uh a, thumthum ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 13:40"},"32":{"text":"Amaute in nang hong kahin a thum kawmun nang hong kahtapin: \"Tuipi in a umcih Tyre banga gamdai kua om ngei tam?\" ci-in taamlo ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 19:1"},"33":{"text":"Na sumbuk vante tuipi tungah a paikhiat ciangin minam tampi tangsapna cingsak a; na hauh mahmahna le na vanzatte in leitunga kumpite a hausak hi.","ref":"Eze 28:4-5"},"34":{"text":"Tu-in tuipi in tuipi thuk sungah nang hong kitamzansaka na vanzatte le na mite khempeuh nang tawh na tum khawm uh hi."},"35":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a tengte khempeuh in mulkimhuai hong sa in a kumpite uh pumlin ding uh a, lau in mengawp ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 26:32; Eze 26:17-18"},"36":{"text":"Sumbukte in minamte lakah nang hong phitsan in, lauhuaipi in na bei dinga, na om kik nawn kei ding hi,’ ci-in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ph 37:10"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Tyre kumpite Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Tyre ukpa tungah gen in, Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Na lungsim sungah kiphasakin, \"Kei pasian khat ka hi hi; tuipi laizang a pasian tokhom tungah ka tu hi,\" na ci hi. Nang pasian khat zaha pilin na kingaihsut hangin pasian na hi kei a, mihing lel khat na hi hi.","ref":"Isa 13:11; Pc 3:5"},"3":{"text":"Nang Daniel a sangin pilzaw na hi hiam? Na theih loh om lo ahi hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Na pilna le na theihna hangin neihsa na hau mahmah a, na sumkholna ah ngun le kham tampi na khol hi.","ref":"Isa 10:13"},"5":{"text":"Sumbawl na siamna hangin na hauhna kibehlap toto a, na hauhna na kisaktheihpih hi.","ref":"Jer 9:23; Job 31:25"},"6":{"text":"\" ‘Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \" ‘Pasian khat bangin ka pil hi, ci-in kingaihsun na hi manin,"},"7":{"text":"a cikzia het lo gamdang mite kong simsak ding hi; amaute in na melhoihna na pilna do dingin a namsaute uh dok ding uh a, a tee zaizai na thupina a sunlet ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 30:11; Jer 9:23; Eze 7:24"},"8":{"text":"Amaute in leihawm sungah hong khia ding uh a, tuipite laizangah sihsia-in na si ding hi.","ref":"Ph 55:23; Kil 18:7"},"9":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin hong thatte omlai mahin, \"Kei pasian khat ka hi hi,\" ci ngam lai ding na hi hiam? Nang hong thatte khut sungah pasian hi nawn loin mihing khat mah na hi lel hi.","ref":"Eze 16:49; Isa 31:3"},"10":{"text":"Gamdang mite khut sungah vun-at lote sih bangin na si ding hi. Ka gensa ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’\" hong ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 14:6"},"11":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"12":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Tyre kumpipa tawh kisai-in taamlo inla, ama kiangah ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Nang pen pilna le melhoihna kim tawh a kidim, kicinna ettehna na hi hi.","ref":"Eze 27:16"},"13":{"text":"Pasian huan sung Eden ah na om a; suangmanpha citeng: ruby, topaz, le emerald, chrysolite, onyx, le Jasper, sapphire, b turquoise le beryl c -te in na kizem hi. Na dinna le na kawmhekte d khama kibawl hi-a, tuate nang hong kipiansak ni-in kibulh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:11"},"14":{"text":"Cherub khat bangin nang sathau hong kinilh a, tua hangin nang kong kipsak hi. Pasian mual siangtho tungah na om a, meisuangte lakah na vak hi.","ref":"Pk 30:26"},"15":{"text":"Nang hong kipiansak a kipan na tungah gitlohna a kimuh dong na gamtatna ah mawhsakna a om kei hi."},"16":{"text":"A zai mahmah na sumbawlna hangin ngongtat-in na mawh hi. Tua ciangin hong hehpih loin Pasian mual panin kong hawlkhia a, a kem cherub aw, meisuang lak panin nang kong hawlkhia hi.","ref":"Pc 6:11; Pc 3:24"},"17":{"text":"Na mel hoihna na kisaktheihpih a, na thupina hangin na pilna na siasak hi. Tua ciangin leitung kong denna-a, kumpite mai-ah pawi-et-a et kong suaksak hi.","ref":"Eze 19:12"},"18":{"text":"Aman lo-a na sumbawlna le na mawhnate tawh na munsiangthote na ninsak zo hi. Tua ciangin nang panin mei ka kuangkhiasak a, tua in nang hong kangtumin nang hong vilgige-te muhna leilakah vut kong suaksak hi.","ref":"Ob 18; Zec 9:2-4; Mal 4:3"},"19":{"text":"Nang hong theisa minamte khempeuh in hong lipkhap uh hi; na beina a lauhuaipi hi-a, na om kik nawn kei ding hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Sp 26:32; Jer 51:64"},"20":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"21":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Sidon lam nga-in a siat nading genkhol inla","title":"Sidon Siat ding Genkholhna"},"22":{"text":"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Sidon aw, nang langah ka panga, nang hangin minthanna ka ngah ding hi. Tuanu tungah ka sianthona laka amah dan ka thuaksak ciangin, amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 39:13; Sp 10:3; Eze 30:19; Eze 5:17"},"23":{"text":"A tungah pulpi ka tungsak dinga, kongzing tengah sisan ka luangsak ding hi. Na kimkot panin namsau tawh hong kuan ding uh a, na sungah mi kithat a om ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi."},"24":{"text":"\"‘Israel-te in a nasak thei lingte le a linghiam lingkung ahi a muhdah uh gamvengte a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah Thupipen TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 5:6; Eze 2:6"},"25":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Minamte lakah a kithehthangna panun Israel mite ka khop ciangin minamte muhin amaute lakah ka siangthona ka lak ding hi. Tua ciangin ka nasempa Jacob tunga ka piaksa amau leitangah a teng ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua munah lungmuangin teng ding uh a, inn lamin lenggui suan ding uh hi; amaute a khelbawl a gamvengte dan ka thuaksak hun ciangin amaute lungmuangtakin a teng ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA amaute Pasian ka hilam a thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Tp 20:6"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawmna, a kha sawmna ni sawm le ni nih ni-in kei tungah TOPA thu hong tunga:","title":"Egypt Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh lam nga inla Egypt-te khempeuh le ama kisiat nading genkhol in."},"3":{"text":"Amah hopih inla: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh aw, nang na luite sunga a bok ganhing lianpi na hi a, nang langah ka pang hi. Nang in, \"Nile kei aa ahi hi; keima adinga ka bawlsa ahi hi,\" na ci hi.","ref":"Isa 19:1-17; Eze 26:1; Jer 44:30; Jer 46:8"},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin na khaguh ah sikkawi ka phut dinga, na lui sunga om ngasate nang tungah ka belhsak ding hi. Na luite sung panin na tunga belhte khempeuh tawh nang hong kikaikhia khawm ding hi.","ref":"2Ku 19:28; Eze 38:4"},"5":{"text":"Nang le na luite sunga om ngasa khempeuh sehnel-gamah kong hici nusiat ding hi. Lopaang lakah na kia dinga kuamah in hong khawm lo-in hong tawm kei ding hi. Leitung ganhingte le huihlak vasate an dingin kong pia ding hi.","ref":"Jer 8:2"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin Egypt-a tengte khempeuh in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi. \"‘Nang Israel-te pumpeng ciangkhut na suak hi."},"7":{"text":"A khutun hong mek uh ciangin paa na hi manin kitamin a liangko uh na at a, nang tungah hong kingap uh ciangin na kitana a nung uh a hek a uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 18:21; Isa 36:6"},"8":{"text":"\"‘Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Nang kiangah namsau khat kong kuansak dinga na mite le a ganhingte uh ka thatsak ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Egypt-te a kinusia gamval a suak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi. \"‘Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in, \"Nile kei aa hi a; keima bawlsa ahi hi,\" na ci hi.","ref":"Eze 25:13"},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin keimah nang le na luite langah ka pang hi, Egypt leitang ka siasak dinga Migdol panin Aswan ciang, Cush b gamgi dong gamtul gam simtham ka suaksak ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Mihing khe ganhing khe in tawn lo dinga; tua lai-ah kum sawmli sung kuamah a teng kei ding hi."},"12":{"text":"A kisiagawpte lakah Egypt leitang gamkhing ka suaksak dinga khuapi kisiate lakah gamkhingin a om ding hi. Minamte lakah Egypt mite ka delhzak dinga gam tuamtuam ah ka thehthang ding hi.","ref":"Jer 21:13"},"13":{"text":"\"‘Tua khit ah hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi. Kum sawmli a cin ciangin a kithehthangna uh minamte lak panin Egypt mite ka kaikhawm ding hi."},"14":{"text":"A saltanna panun amaute ka paikhiatpih kik dinga a pute a pate uh Egypt a saklam ah a ciah kik ding uh hi. Tua lai-ah kumpi gam gina lo khatin a om ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Kumpi gamte lakah a gina lo pen hi ding uh a, minam dangte tungah a suak kik zo nawn kei ding uh hi. Ginasak lo lua ding ka hi manin minamte khat beek a uk zo ngei nawn kei ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel mite adingin Egypt-te a muan bulpi uh ahi ngei nawn kei ding hi. Ahi hangin a huh ding deih ama lam a nga peuhmah adingin mawhna phawksakna hi ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah Thupipen TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:11"},"17":{"text":"A kum sawmnih le sagihna a kha masa, a ni masa ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tung hi."},"18":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in a galkapte nakpi-in hanciamsak a Tyre a sim hi. A vek un a sam uh pulhin a lu uh tol a, a liangko uh a vun kolhkhia hi. Tuaci zawzen napi Tyre a simna uh hangin amah le a galkapte in bangmah pahtakman a ngah kei uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA thugen ahi hi: Keimah in Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar tungah Egypt ka pia dinga a hauhnate a puakhia mang ding hi. A galkapte khasum dingin a leitangte matsakin a laksak ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah le a galkapte in ka na sem uh ahi manin a hanciamna ka thukna-in pahtakman in amah Egypt ka piak ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Isa 43:3; Eze 24:1"},"21":{"text":"\"Tua ni ciangin Israel innkuante adingin ki b khat ka khangkhiasak dinga, amaute lakah na kam ka hong ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Lk 1:69"}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga;","title":"Egypt Kitamlawhna"},"2":{"text":"\"‘Mihing tapa aw, thu genkhol inla, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Kah-ot inla, ‘Tua ni aw, tazen aw!’ ci in.","ref":"Isa 13:6"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, a ni naita a, minamte siat nading lungkham meiipizin ding - TOPA ni nai ta hi.","ref":"Eze 7:7; Eze 7:12"},"4":{"text":"Egypt-te sim dingin namsau khat kuan dinga, Cush c tungah lunggimna tung ding hi. Egypt ah mi a kithah ciangin a hauhnate kipuamang dinga a bulkipte kiphukpai ding hi.","ref":"Jer 25:19; Pc 10:6; Eze 29:19"},"5":{"text":"Cush le Put, Lydia d le Arabia khempeuh, Libya le thukhun leitang mite khempeuh Egypt tawh namsau in a pukkhawm ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"\"‘Hih in TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Egypt a panpihte puk dinga a kisaktheihpih a hatna beita ding hi. Ama sunga om namsau-in Migdol pan Aswan dong puk ding uh hi; Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Eze 29:10"},"7":{"text":"\"‘Gamkhingte lakah amaute gamkhing khat suak ding uh a, khuapi kisiate lakah amaute khuapi kihel ding hi.","ref":"Eze 29:12"},"8":{"text":"Keimah in Egypt mei-in hala a panpih khempeuh ka kituatzan ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 29:9"},"9":{"text":"\"‘Tua ni ciangin ngaihmuanga om Cush-te a lausak dingin kei kiang pan tembaw in kamtai ka sawl ding hi. Egypt a siat ni ciangin nak buai mahmah ding hi; a tung pelmawh ding lah ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 10:6; Isa 23:5"},"10":{"text":"\"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Keimah in Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar khut zangin Egypt mihonte ka beisak ding hi.","ref":"Jer 39:1"},"11":{"text":"Amah le a galkapte - minam kheltat pente - a gam uh susia dingin ka kuansak ding hi. Amaute in Egypt do dingin namsau dok ding uh a, a gam uh misi a dim ding hi.","ref":"Eze 28:7"},"12":{"text":"Nile sunga tung lui khempeuh ka kangsak dinga a leitang uh migilote tungah ka zuak ding hi; a gam uh le a sunga om na khempeuh gamdang mite susiasakin gamval ka suaksak ding hi. Keimah TOPA in ka gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 19:6; Eze 19:7"},"13":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Milimte ka susia dinga, Memphis e a pasian limte ka beisak ding hi. Egypt ah kumpitapa om nawn lo dinga a gam khempeuh uh launa ka tungsak ding hi.","ref":"Zec 10:11"},"14":{"text":"Keimah in Zoan haltum in Egypt f saklam ka maimangsak dinga, Thebes g dan ka thuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Ms 13:22; Eze 29:14; Jer 46:25"},"15":{"text":"Egypt-te kulh muanhuai Pelsium a tungah ka thangpaihna ka sung dinga, Thebes mihonte a khaktan ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Egyp-te mei-in ka hal dinga, gimna lianpi-in Pelsium ka nuai ding hi. Ngongtatna tawh Thebes kila dinga, Memphis lungdong den ding hi.","ref":"Jos 7:15; Isa 9:13"},"17":{"text":"Heliopolis b le Bubastis c a khangnote, namsau in puk ding uh a, a khuapite uh amau le amau galmatin pai ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 41:45"},"18":{"text":"Egypt hakkol ka kuaihtan ciangin Tahpanhas ah khimzing dinga; tua ciangin a kisaktheihpih a hatna beita ding hi. Tuanu meiipi in tuam dinga a khuaneute galmat a suak ding hi.","ref":"Sp 26:13; Jer 43:7"},"19":{"text":"Tua bangin Egypt dan ka tuahsak ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 28:22"},"20":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna a kha masa, a ni sagihna ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"21":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh’ ban langkhat ka kuaitan khin hi. Namsau tawi zo zah dinga khauh dingin a dam zawh nadingin kituamin kibawlsak lo hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh ka do hi. A ban adam lam le a kitansa lam tawh ka kuaitan khawm dinga a namsau tawilai ka kiasak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamte lakah Egypt ka thehzak dinga, gam citeng ah ka thehthang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa bante ka khauhsak dinga a khutah ka namsau ka koih ding hi, ahi hangin Pharaoh bante ka kuaitan dinga, nakpitaka liam mi khat bangin a mai-ah a humham ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Babylon kumpipa bante ka khauhsak dinga, Phraoh bante a zawcip ding hi. Babylon kumpipa khutah ka namsau ka koih a, amah in Egypt langkhatah a liik ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi."},"26":{"text":"Keimah in minamte lakah Egypt mite ka delhzak dinga gam citengah ka thehthang ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 21:12; Eze 26:1"}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm le khatna, a kha thumna a ni masa ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Lebanon ah Tamtaksing Khat"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh le a mipihte kiangah: \"‘Na thupina kua tawh kiteh thei ding hiam?","ref":"Jer 52:5; Eze 30:20"},"3":{"text":"Khatvei lai-a Lebanon ah tamtak sing ahi, a teh tawh kilawm mahmah in, aliim in tulak a sung, sangpi-ah a hiang zau a, a teh a pha mahmah tunga a dawn dawk Assyria ngaihsun in.","ref":"2Ku 19:23; Isa 10:34"},"4":{"text":"Tui in an vaka a thukna-a tuiphulte in sangpi in khangsak a; a bulpi kimkot khempeuh ah a luite luanga a hawkguamte in lo sunga singkung khempeuh zong a puak hi.","ref":"Eze 17:7"},"5":{"text":"Tua hangin lo sunga singkung khempeuh sangin sangzaw a, a paipi khangin kicingtakin tui ngah ahi manin a hiangte sau in zaam hi.","ref":"Ms 24:6"},"6":{"text":"Huih lak vasate in a dawn ah bu tom uh a, a hiang zaam nuai-ah gam sung ganhing khempeuh in ta suahna-in nei uh hi; minam liante khempeuh a liim nuai-ah teng uh hi.","ref":"Pc 31:7-9; Eze 17:23"},"7":{"text":"A zungte in tui kicinna mun bansak ahi manin a hiangzau tawh kilawmin melhoih mahmah hi.","ref":"Job 14:9"},"8":{"text":"Pasian huana tamtaksingte tua zahin hoih lo-a, takkung hiangte zong tua zahin hoih loin, a hiangte zong taksing hiang tawh tehkak theih ding hi lo-a - Pasian huan sunga singkungte tawh a melhoihna teh theih ding ahi kei hi.","ref":"Ps 80:10; Pc 30:37; Pc 13:10"},"9":{"text":"Keimah in Pasian huan Eden sunga singkungte khempeuh en’ dingin kicingtakin ahiang ka phasak a, a mel ka hoihsak hi."},"10":{"text":"\"‘Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"A tehphate tung pekah a dawn khangto in a sanna a kisaktheihpihna hangin"},"11":{"text":"ama gitlohna tawh kizui-in a thuaksak dingin minamte gam-ukte tungah amah ka pia hi. Amah ka pampaih a,"},"12":{"text":"bangmah a khual lo gamdang minamte in phukpai-in nusia uh hi. A paipite mualte tung le guam sung khempeuh ah a tuk ding uh hi; a hiangte kitangawpin tua gam kuam thuk khempeuh ah kiseng hi. A liim beel leitung minamte khempeuh paikhia-in nusia uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua a puksa singkung ah huih lak vasa khempeuh giak uh a, a hiang kawmah gam sunga ganhingte khempeuh a om uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tui gei-a po singkung dang peuhmah in a tehpha tungah a dawn khangtoin a sanna uh a kisak-theihpih kei ding uh hi. Hoihtaka tui a kibuak singkung dang khat beek tua tanin a sang ngei kei ding hi. Amaute leinuai-a kawkhuka a paisa mite lakah a sih ding uh sehsa ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 2:11"},"15":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Tua singkung hankhuk d sungah a kikhiatsuk ni-in tuithukpite thumna tawh amah ka tuam hi; a luite ka lehluansak a, a kicing mahmah ama tuite a kang hi. Tua singkung hangin Lebanon maikhinga, gamsunga singkung khempeuh a kungkeu hi."},"16":{"text":"Kawkhuk a paisukte tawh hankhuk-a ka khiatsuk ciangin ama pukna ging hangin minamte ka lingsak hi. Tua ciangin Eden a singkungte khempeuh Lebanon a, ahoih penpena a kitengkhiate, hoihtaka tui kibuak singkungte khempeuh leinuai-ah a kihehnem ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ama limnuai-a a teng minamte laka a beelte zong namsau-a kithatte tawh kipawlin han sungah a tumsuk khawm uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 1:21"},"18":{"text":"\"‘Eden sunga singkungte na ginatna le na thupina tawh a kiteh thei ding koipen om ahi hiam? Tua hi napi nang nangawn Eden singkungte tawh leinuai-ah hong kikhiasuk dinga; namsau-a kithat vun at lohte lakah na kisial ding hi. \"‘Hih in Pharaoh le ama mipihte khempeuh ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci-in gen hi,’ hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 9:26"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kum sawm le nihna, a kha sawm le nih a ni masapen ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Pharaoh Kitamlawhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Egypt kumpipa Pharaoh tawh kisai-in taamlo inla ama kiangah: \"‘Nang minamte lakah humpinelkai tawh na kibang hi; nang in ama omna luite sung tuancil gawpin a khe in tuilak tokgawp a, luite buantui a suaksak tuipi ganhing lianpi tawh na kibang hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:1; Job 3:8"},"3":{"text":"\"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Mihon tampitak tawh ka len in kong khuh dinga, amaute in ka len sungah nang hong talkaihgawp ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 12:13"},"4":{"text":"Gamsungah hong lawnin gamlak kong denna ding hi. Leitunga huih lak vasate khempeuh nang tungah hong kikhawm ding uh a, leitunga gamsa khempeuh in hong kham thei loin hong nene ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 18:6"},"5":{"text":"Mualtung ah na sa ka thehthang dinga, a omlai teng guam sung ka dimsak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Na sisan luang tawh leitung tenga mualtung paina lampi teng ka kawtsak dimdem dinga, kuam thukpite na sa tawh ka dimsak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:3; Eze 31:12"},"7":{"text":"Nang kong mutmit ciangin vante ka khuhcip dinga a aksite ka mialsak ding hi. Meii-in ni ka khuh dinga kha a tang kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 13:10"},"8":{"text":"Vante a, atang thei khempeuh nang tungah ka mialsak dinga; na gam sung tengah khua ka mialsak ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Job 9:7"},"9":{"text":"\" ‘Minamte lak le na theih loh gamte lakah a nang kong siatsak ciangin mi tampite lungsim ka patausak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Nang hangin mi tampi ka lauthawngsak dinga ka namsau amaute mai-ah ka leh ciangin nang hangin a kumpite uh lau-in kigaih ding uh hi. Na puk ni-in a nuntak hangun a tatna peuhpeuhuah a ling ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 30:32"},"11":{"text":"\"‘Ahang in, hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"‘Nang mah hong do dingin Babylon kumpipa namsau hong kuan ding hi.","ref":"Isa 19:4; Eze 21:19"},"12":{"text":"Minamte khempeuh lakah a cikze lopen - mithatte’ namsau-in na mipite ka puksak ding hi. Amaute in Egypt-te kiphatsakpihte le a mipite a lawnthal ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 28:7; Eze 31:11-12"},"13":{"text":"Keimah in tui kicing mahmah gei-a a ganhonte uh ka susia dinga, mihing khe in ngapin tui nin nawn lo donga, ganhon khe-in zong a buan nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Eze 29:8"},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tuite ka luangsak dinga a luite sathau bangin ka luangsak ding hi. Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Egypt, gam-simtham suaksak a, a gam sunga omte khempeuh ka hawkkhiat mang ciang le tua lai-a tengte khempeuh ka satpuk ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Pk 7:5"},"16":{"text":"\"Hih in amaute in amah a kah taamlawh nading uh ahi hi. Minamte’ tanute taamlo ding uh hi; ahang in, Egypt le a mipite a kahtap ding uh hi,\" Thupipen TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Pc 50:10; Eze 19:1"},"17":{"text":"A kum sawm le nihna tua kha ni sawm le nga ni-in TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"18":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Egypt le a mipite adingin thum inla a hat minamte, leinuai-a a paisate tawh kahtap khawm in."},"19":{"text":"Amaute tungah, ‘Midangte sangin nang hong ki-angvan zaw ahi hiam? Paisuk inla vun at lote tawh kisial khawm in,’ ci in."},"20":{"text":"Namsau-a kithatte lakah amaute a puk ding uh hi. Namsau kidok khin ta hi; amah le a mipite kaigawpsak un."},"21":{"text":"Han khuk b sung panin Egypt le amah a panpihte tungah a makai uh a thahatte in, ‘Amaute hong kumsukin vun at loh namsau-a kithatte tawh a kisial khawm uh hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ama galkap khempeuh tawh Assyria tua lai-ah om hi; namsau-a puksa ama misite khempeuh’ hankhuk in amah a umcih hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute hante kawkhuk thukpi sungah om a, ama han kimkotah ama galkapte kisial hi. Tuate a vekpi un, amau gam sunga a nungta khempeuh a kithah huna namsau-a pukte ahi uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:15"},"24":{"text":"\"Elam zong a han kimkot-a a mipite tawh tua lai-ah om hi. Amaute khempeuh namsau-in puka site ahi uh hi. Amaute khempeuh a nungtate a lausak, gam sungah kithehthangsakin vun at lohte tawh lei nuai-a a paisukte ahi uh hi. Amaute kawkhukpi sunga a paite tawh a maizum khawm ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ama han kimkotah a mipite han om a, a kithatte lakah ama ading lupna khat kibawl hi. A vekpi un namsau-a kithat vun at loh vive ahi uh hi. Amaute launa in a nungtate gamah a kithehthangsak manin kawkhukpi sunga a paisate tawh a maizum khawm uh hi; a kithatte lakah amaute kisial hi.","ref":"Pc 10:22; Eze 28:10"},"26":{"text":"\"Meshech le Tubal zong amaute han kimkot-a a mipite uh tawh tua lai-ah a om uh hi. A vekpi un vun at loh hi uh a, a nungtate gamah a milausakna uh hangin namsau-a kithatte ahi uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Amaute, gal sunga a zat uh galvante tawh a paisuk khawm vun at loh galhangte tawh a kisial khawm loh hangin a namsaute uh lukhamin kineisak hi lo hiam? Hih galhangte in a nungtate gam khempeuh a lausak uh hangin amaute mawhna dan amau guh tungah a belh hi.","ref":"Eze 27:13; 28:10"},"28":{"text":"\"Pharaoh aw, nang zong a kiteisa in namsau a kithat vun at lohte lakah hong kisial ding hi."},"29":{"text":"\"Tua lai-ah Edom a kumpite le a gam-ukte khempeuh tawh om uh a, vanglian nawn loin namsau-a kithatte tawh a kisial khawm uh hi. Amaute kawkhuk sunga paisa vun-at lohte tawh a kisialkhwm uh hi"},"30":{"text":"\"Leilu lama kumpitapate khempeuh le Sidon-te khempeuh tua lai-ah om uh hi. Amaute vangliatna in mi lausak ngei napi a kithatte tawh a tonsuk khawm uh hi. Namsau-a kithat vun at lohte tawh kisial khawm a, kawkhukpi sunga a paisukte tawh a maizum khawm uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:31; Jer 25:26"},"31":{"text":"\"Pharaoh in - amah le a galkapte khempeuh tawh amaute mu dinga namsau-a kithat a mipite in amah hehnem ding uh hi. Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"32":{"text":"A nungtate gamah ama hangin mi ka lausak bangin namsau-a kithatte tawh Pharaoh le a mipite khempeuh vun at loh-te lakah a kisial ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Sp 26:25; Eze 14:22"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Galvilpa Ezekiel"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, na gammite hopih inla - amaute kiangah, ‘Gam khat a sim dingin namsau ka kuansak ciangin tua gam mite in amau mi khat galvil dingin a teel uh a,"},"3":{"text":"amah in tua gam sim dinga kuan namsau a muh ciangin a gam mite vauhilhna-in pengkul mutin"},"4":{"text":"a kuamahpeuh in za napi a kiginkholh kei a, namsau in a sih leh ama sisan a lutung ah tu ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Pengkul kimut za napi amah kigingkhol lo ahi manin ama sisan ama tunga tu ahi hi. Amah a na kiginkholh leh amah le amah kihon ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin galvilpa in namsau hong kuan mu napi-in mite vauhilhna pengkul a mut kei a, amaute lakah khatpeuh nuntakna a bei leh tua mipa ama mawhna hangin kipuakhiamang dinga ahi zongin ama sisan galvilpa tungah ka siik ding hi.","ref":"Zec 1:4"},"7":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel adingin nang galvil kong suaksak hi; tua ahi ciangin ka thugen za inla amaute ka vauhilhna gen in."},"8":{"text":"Mi gilo khat tungah, ‘Migilopa aw, na si taktak ding hi,’ ka cih a, a gitloh nawn loh nadingin zola na gen keileh tua gilopa amawhna hangin a si dinga ama sisan nang tungah kong siik ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ahi zongin tua gilopa a kikhel nadingin na vauhilh a, hong man nop keileh a mawhna hangin amah si dinga ahi hangin nang le nang na kihonkhia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 7:12; Isa 52:8"},"10":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel innkuante tungah, ‘Hih thu gen in. \"Ka mawhnate uh le ka tatkhialhnate un hong nengcip a, tuate hangin b ka hingkiam ta uh hi. Bangci nuntak thei ding ka hi uh hiam?’ na ci uh hi,\" ci-in gen in."},"11":{"text":"Amaute tungah, \"Thupipen TOPA in, ‘Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, migilo khat sihna ah ka lungdam kei a ahi hangin kikhela a nuntak ding ka deihzaw hi. Kihei in! Na gamtatna hoih lote lehngatsan in! Israel innkuan aw, bang hangin si zenzen ding na hi hiam?’ ci hi.","ref":"Sp 26:16; Ta 3:33"},"12":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin mihing tapa aw, na gam mite uh tungah, ‘a thumaan mi in thu a man’ keileh ama thumaanna in amah a hon kei ding hi; migilo khat a gitlohna pan a kikhel leh ama gitlohna in amah a puksak kei ding hi. Thumaan mi khat a mawh leh ama thumaannasa hangin a nungta tuan kei hi."},"13":{"text":"A thumaan mi khat a nungta taktak ding hi, ka cih hangin amah in a thumaanna muangin a git kei leh a hihsa thumaanna khat beek a kiphawksak kei ding hi; a gamtatnasa gitlohna hangin amah a si ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in migilopa tungah, ‘Na si taktak ding hi,’ ka cih a, ahi hangin amah in a mawhna lehngatsanin thumaan thutangin a gamtat leh -"},"15":{"text":"amah in a leitawipa tungah a laksa khapna ante a piak kik a, a guksate pia kikin, nuntakna a tun thukipte a zuih a, a gitloh gamtat nawn kei leh, a nungta taktak ding hi; amah si lo ding hi.","ref":"1Kh 7:14; Jer 50:20"},"16":{"text":"A bawlsa mawhnate khat beek a kiciamtehsak kei ding hi. Amah thumaan thutang a gamta ahi hi; a nungta taktak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua hi napi na gam mite in. ‘Topa hihzia a thutang kei hi ci uh hi. Ahi hangin a thutang lo amau hihzia hi zaw hi."},"18":{"text":"A thumaan mi khat thumaan loin a gamtat leh tua hangin si ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tuateh migilo khat in a gitlohna lehngatsanin thumaan thutangin a gamtat leh tua banga a gamtat manin a nungta ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua hi napi Israel innkuante aw, ‘Topa hihzia a thutang kei hi,’ na ci uh hi. Ahi hangin note tungah na hihzia bang ciatun thu kong khen ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jer 18:10"},"21":{"text":"I saltan zawh a kum sawm le nihna, a kha sawmna a ninga ni-in Jerusalem pan a suakta mi khat kei kiangah hong pai hi. Amah in, \"Khuapi puk ta!\" hong ci hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua mipa hong tunma a nitak in TOPA thu ka tungah hong kinga a; a zingsang ciangin amah in ka kiangah hong pai mipa mai-ah ka kam hong honsak hi. Tua ciangin ka kam kihong a tua-a kipan ka dai nawn kei hi.","title":"Jerusalem Pukna Thu","ref":"Lk 1:64"},"23":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"24":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, a kisiasa Israel gama teng mite in, ‘Abraham khat bekbek hi napi hih leitang ama aa ahi hi. Ahi hangin eite tampi i hi hi. Eite tanh dingin hong kipia taktak hi,’ ci uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Sa sungah sisan om laipi ne-in, na milimte uh enin sisan na luansak nungsangun gam nei ding na hi uh hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Na namsau uh na suang uh a, a kihhuai-in gamta-in na vengte uh zite na buansak uh hi. A tuacipi mah in gam neih sawm na hi uh hiam?’ ci in.","ref":"Eze 36:4"},"27":{"text":"\"Amaute kiangah hih thu gen in: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, a kisiasa gam sunga a kinusiate namsau in a puk ding uh hi; khuaneu-a omte gamsa gilote nek dingin ka pia dinga, suanghawm sung le kulh muanhuai sunga omte pulpi in a si ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Keimah in a gam uh kimanna a nei lo gamkhing ka suaksak dinga, a kisaktheihpih uh thahatna bei-in Israel mualte kuamah in a kantan loh nadingin gamkhing a suak ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute in a kihhuai na khempeuh a sep manun a gam uh gamkhing ka suahsak ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"1Sa 13:6"},"30":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, nang tawh kisai-in kawm phung le inn kongkhakte ah na gam mite khat le khat nang thu kikum uh a, ‘Hong pai-in TOPA kiang pana hong tung thu za un,’ kici uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Ka mite a ngeina bangin na kiangah hong pai uh a, na thugen ngai-in na mai-ah tu uh hi; ahi hangin na gen bangin gamta lo uh hi. Amaute a kam-un ki-ap uh a, ahi hangin amaan lo-a ngah nadingin a huaiham uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Amaute adingin nang, aw khum mahmah in zawllate sa a, aw kihual mahmah in tumtheih a tumpa sangin na kiman zawkna a om kei hi; ahang in, na kammalte za napi na gen bangin a gamta kei uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 4:32; Eze 8:1"},"33":{"text":"\"Hihte khempeuh tunga - amaan takpi ciangin - amaute in amaute lakah kamsang khat om zo ahilam a thei ding uh hi.","ref":"1Sa 3:20"}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Tuucingte le Tuute"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel tuucingte langkhatah thu genkhol in; thu genkhol inla amaute tungah: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Amaute kia bek a kidon Israel tuucingte in gimna nak thuak na uncia! Tuucingte in tuuhonte a cin ding uh hi lo ahi hiam?"},"3":{"text":"Note in nawithau na ne uh a, a mul puanin silhin, ganhing limcite na go uh hi, ahi hangin gan honte na kem kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A zawngkhalte na khoi kei uh a, a cinate kem loin a liamnate na bawlsak kei uh hi. Lamkhialte na khiang kei uh a, a mangte na zong kei uh hi. Amaute ngeh gawpgawpin khelbawlin na uk uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A cing om lo ahi manin kithehthang uh a, a kikhenthang uh ciangin gamsa gilo khempeuh an a suak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Mual lian khempeuh tung le mual sang neu citeng tungah ka tuute vakzau uh hi. Amaute leitung bupah kithehthang uh a, kuamah in zongin a kan kei hi.","ref":"Ph 78:70-72; Jer 50:6"},"7":{"text":"\"’Tua ahi ciangin no tuucingte aw, TOPA kammal za un:"},"8":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA in, ka nuntakna ka lo hi, ka tuute in a cing nei loin hih bangin kikaimang a, ganhing gilote khempeuh an a suahna uh le ka tuucingte in ka tuuhonte zong loin tuuhonte a kep tangun amau le amau kikem uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin tuucingte aw, TOPA kammal za un!"},"10":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah tuucingte langah ka panga ka tuuhonte hangin ka thuaksak ding hi. Tuucingte amau le amau a kivak theih nawn loh nadingun ka tuute a omna panun ka hemkhia ding hi, amaute kamsung panin ka tuute ka hukhia dinga amaute an a suak nawn kei ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"\"’Ahang in, hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimahmah in ka tuute zongin ka kem ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tuucingpa khat in a kithehthang ama tuute a cin bangin ka tuute ka cing ding hi. ‘Meiipi lak, khuamial lakah a kithehthang hun uh cingin amaute omna munmun ah ka hukhia ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Minamte panin ka samkhia dinga, gam tuamtuam pan kaikhawmin amaute neihsa gamah ka puak ding hi. Israel mualte tung le kuam sung, mite tenna khempeuh ah ka gamtasak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute lonona munah ka cing dinga Israel mualsangte a gamtatna mun uh hi ding hi. Gamtatna mun hoih ah lum ding uh a, Israel mualte tung lonona mun tua lai-ah ka kigamtasak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Keimah in ka tuute ka cing dinga amaute ka lumsak ding hi. Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"16":{"text":"A mangte ka zong dinga lam khialte ka kaikhawm ding hi; a liamnate ka tunsak dinga a zawngkhalte ka khoi ding hi. Ahi hangin athau a hatte ka susia ding hi. Ka tuuhonte thutangin ka cing ding hi.","ref":"Lk 19:10"},"17":{"text":"\"’Ka tuuhonte aw, hih in note adingin Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Tuute khat le khat kikal le tuutalte le keeltalte kikal ah thu ka khen ding hi."},"18":{"text":"Lonona munah an hong kivak ciangin tua tawh lungkim zo nai lo na hi uh hiam? Na nek loh teng uh zong tuancil lai hi lo na hi uh hiam? Tui siangtho na dawn uh tawh lungkim zo nai lo na hi uh hiam? Na dawn loh teng uh na khe un tuanbuan hi lo na hi uh hiam?"},"19":{"text":"Na tuatcilsate uh le na tuat buansate uh tawh keima tuuhonte kivak kul hi lo hiam?","ref":"Pc 30:15"},"20":{"text":"\"’Tua ahi ciangin amaute tungah Thupipen TOPA in hih thu a gen hi: Keimah in ka tuu gawngte tung le ka tuu thaute tungah thu ka khen ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh na pang uh le na liangdaak un tuu gina lote khempeuh phu in na hawlkhiat zawh matengun na ki uh tawh na pik uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Ka tuuhonte ka hon dinga amaute kikaikhiamang nawn lo ding hi. Ka tuute khat le khat kikal ah thu ka khen ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute a uk ding tuucing khat ka nasempa David ka koih dinga amah in amaute a vak ding hi; amah in amaute vakin amaute a cingpa hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Keimah TOPA a Pasian uh ka hi dinga, amaute lakah ka nasempa David a ukpa uh hi ding hi. Keimah TOPA in ka gensa ahi hi.","ref":"Mt 25:32"},"25":{"text":"\"Amaute gamsimtham ah tenga, lungmuangtakin tulakah a lup theih nadingun amaute tawh kilemna thukhun ka bawl ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute le ka mual a kimkot munte thupha ka pia ding hi. A khuahun zui-in guah ka zusak dinga; thupha guah ka zusak ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Lo sunga singkungte gah ding uh a, leitang in an tampi piangsakin mite amau leitang ciatah nuamtakin a teng ding uh hi. A hakkol zawlte uh kuaihtansak a, sila a, khawite khut pan ka hutkhiat ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Minamte in amaute galmatin kai nawn lo ding uh a, gamsate an a suak nawn kei ding uh hi. Lungnuamtakin teng ding uh a, kuamah in a lausak kei ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute an pianna a minthang gam khat ka pia dinga a gam-uah kialpi tung nawn lo dinga minamte in zong a simmawh nawn kei ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah TOPA amaute Pasian amaute tawh a omkhawm ka hilam thei in amau Israel innkuante ka mite hi ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"31":{"text":"No ka tuute, ka lonona-a gamta ka tuute, ka mite na hi uh a, keimah note Pasian ka hi hi,’ Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi, ci in,\" hong ci hi."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Edom Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Seir Vum lam nga inla, a siat nading genkhol in:"},"3":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Seir Vum aw, nang langkhatah ka pang hi. Nang langah ka khut ka zan dinga, bangmah a kimang lo gam simtham kong suaksak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khuapite ka siasak dinga gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi.
