Tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 14:6; Jer 44:2"},"5":{"text":"\"’Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in tang lai-a kigalneihna na ciamteh gige-a Israel-te dan thuak ding hun nunung pen a tun laitak, a lungkham laitakun amaute namsau-a thah dingin na piakhia hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin ka nuntakna ka lo hi, TOPA in cikhia a, na sisan ka luangsak dinga tua in nang hong sulzuih ding hi. Sisan luansakna na muhdah loh nungsangin sisan luanna in nang hong sulzuih ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Bangmah a kimang lo Seir Vum gamkhing ka suaksak dinga, tua lai-a a ciah a kuante ka khaktan ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na mualliante misi tawh ka dimsak dinga, na mualneute tung, na kuam sung le na kuam thukpite sungah namsau-a kithatte a puk ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Gamkhing kong suaksak den dinga; na khuapite ah a kiteng kei ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 63:10; Ob 10"},"10":{"text":"\"’Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in keimah TOPA ka om nangawnin, \"Hih minam nihte le a gamte uh ei ading ahi hi; amaute ei tanh dingin i la ding hi,\" na ci khin hi,"},"11":{"text":"tua ahi ciangin Thupipen TOPA in ka nuntakna ka lo hi, nang tungah thu kong khen ciangin amaute na muhdah mana na hazatna le na hehna tawh kizui-in nang kong thuk dinga, amaute lakah kei ka kitheisak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mualte langkhat ah a zakdahhuai na gente keimah TOPA in ka zak khit lam na thei ding hi. Nang in, \"Amaute a kikoihdak hi a, i nawmvalh dingin ei hong kipia ahi hi,\" na ci hi."},"13":{"text":"Kei langkhat ah kiliansakin kidawm het loin kam na pau a, keimah in ka za zo hi."},"14":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Leitung buppi a lungdam laitakin nang gamkhing kong suaksak ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel innkuante gouluah gamkhing a kisuahsak laitakin nang na lungdam hi; nang zong a tuaci-in kong bawl ding hi. Seir Vum aw, nang le Edom-te khempeuh gamkhing hong kisuaksak ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel mualliante kiangah thu genkhol inla, ‘Israel mualliante aw, TOPA thugen za un.","title":"Israel Mualliante tunga Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Galte in note tungah, \"Leltak! Tanglai-a munsangte eite neihsa suak zo hi,\" ci uh hi,’ ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin thu genkhol inla, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: A om lai minamte neihsa na suah nadingun na kimkot panun amaute in hong bengin hong siasakmang uh a, na thuaksak mite un hong elko in hong gensia uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel mualliante aw, Thupipen TOPA thugen za un: Hih pen Thupipen TOPA in mualliante le mualneute tung, kuamte le kuamthukpite tung, a kisiasa gamkhingte le galte laksa khuapi siasate le na kimkota minam om laisunte in ciamnuihna-a hong neite tunga hong gen ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA thugen in: Ka hazatluatna hangin minam om laisunte le Edom langkhatah thu ka gen khin hi, ahang in, amaute lungsimah hazatna le muanna tawh a gama lonona munte a suh theih nadingun ka gam teng amau neihsa a suah uh hi,’ci hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel gam tawh kisai-in thu genkhol inla mualliante le mualneute tung, kuamte le kuamthukpite tungah: \"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Note in minamte simmawhna thuak khin na hi manun ka aamna thangpaihna tawh ka pau hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka khut lamto-a ka kiciam inah note kimkot-a minamte in zong simmawhna a thuak ding uh hi.","ref":"Ms 14:30; Eze 17:22"},"8":{"text":"\"’Ahi hangin no Israel mualliante aw, na hiangte uh zaamin ka mi Israel-te adingin gah na gah ding uh hi, ahang in, amaute inn ah hong ciah baih ta ding uh hi."},"9":{"text":"No lamah ka panga kong angvan ding hi; note hong kitovuungin, hong kivawh dinga"},"10":{"text":"note tung le Israel innkuan tung nangawnah mi ka kibehlapsak ding hi; khuapite ah mite tung kikin a siasate kilam kik ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Note tungah mihing ganhing ka khangsak dinga amaute gahpha mahmahin tampitak a pha ding uh hi. A beisa huna bangin na tungah mi ka tengsak dinga, a beisa hun sangin kong daupaisak zaw ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Note tungah mi, ka mi Israel-te ka vaksak ding hi. Amaute in nang hong nei ding uh a, nang amaute’ gouluah na hi ding hi; nang in amaute tate na sutkhia ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 4:2; Zec 10:8"},"13":{"text":"\"’Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Mite in nang tungah, \"Mite na nawmvalh a, na minamte’ tate na sutkhia hi,\" hong ci uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin mi na nawmvalh nawn kei dinga na minamte ta nei loin a om nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"15":{"text":"Minamte hong engkona hong zasak nawn loin, mite kong simmawhbawlsak nawn kei dinga na minam ka puksak nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Ms 13:32; Isa 54:4"},"16":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tung kik a:"},"17":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel mite amau gamah a ten lai-un amaute gamtatna le a nasepnate-un a gam uh ninsak uh hi. Kei muhna ah amaute gamtatna, khasima numeite’ nin tawh kibang hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amau gamah mihing sisan a luansakna uh le a gam uh milimte-in ninsak uh ahi manin amaute tungah ka thangpaihna ka sungkhia hi."},"19":{"text":"Minamte lakah ka delhzaka, gam citengah kithehthang uh hi. Amaute gamtatna le a nasepnate uh tawh kizui-in amaute tungah thu ka khen hi."},"20":{"text":"Minamte laka a paina peuhpeuh uah ka min siangtho a daisak uh hi, tua hangin amaute tawh kisai-in, ‘Hihte TOPA mite hi napi ama gam a nusia uh hi,’ kici hi."},"21":{"text":"Israel innkuante in a paina peuhpeuh uh minamte laka a daisak uh ka min siangtho ka khual hi."},"22":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin Israel innkuante tungah: Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘Israel innkuante aw, hih ka bawl ding nate note kong khualna-a ka bawl hi lo hi. Note in minamte laka na paina peuhuah na daisak uh ka min siangtho ka khualna ahi hi."},"23":{"text":"Minamte laka na daisak uh, amaute laka na daisak uh ka min alian mahmah ka min a sianthona kong lak ding hi. Note tungtawnin amaute mai-ah keimah ka sianthona kong kilah ciangin minamte in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"24":{"text":"\" ‘Ahang in, minamte lak panin kong lakhia ding hi; gam khempeuh panin kong khawm dinga nomau gamah kong puak kik ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Note tungah tui siangtho kong theh dinga na siang ding uh hi; na siantho lohna khempeuh uh ahi na milimte khempeuh panun kong siangsak ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Note lungsim thak kong guan dinga; na sunguah kha thak ka guang ding hi. Na suang lungtang uh ka lakhia dinga satak lungtang kong guan ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Note sungah ka Kha ka guang dinga ka thukipte hong zuisakin ka thukhamte limtakin kong tangsak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Na pute uh ka piaksa gam sungah na teng ding uh hi; note keima mi na hi ding uh a, keimah note Pasian ka hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Na siantholohna khempeuh panun kong honkhia ding hi. An ka sam dinga tampi phasakin kialpi hong tung nawn kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Kialpi hangin minamte lakah na maimawl nawn loh nadingun na singgahte uh gahphasakin na lo-uah an tampi ka piangsak ding hi."},"31":{"text":"Tua ciangin na gamtat hoihlohna uh le na gitlohna uh na phawk ding uh a, na mawhnate uh le a kihhuai na gamtatnate uh hangin no le no na kikih ding uh hi."},"32":{"text":"Keimah in note kong khualna-a ka hih loh ahilam na theih ding uh ka deih hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Israel innkuante aw, maizum unla na gamtatnasate uh hangin maimawl un!"},"33":{"text":"\"’Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Na mawhnate khempeuh panun kong siansak ni-in na khuapite uah kong tengsak kik dinga a siate a kilampha ding hi."},"34":{"text":"A tawnkhate muhna ah gamval a suak gamte gamval hi nawn loin kikho ta ding hi."},"35":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Hih a kimawk nusiat gam, Eden huan bang ta hi; a kisusia gamkhinga om a kisia khuapite tu-in mi tenga kulhin ki-um ta hi,\" ci ding uh hi."},"36":{"text":"Tua ciangin note kima om minamte in, keimah TOPA in a kisusiate lam kikin gamkhing teng a kikhosak kikpa ka hilam a thei ding uh hi. Keimah TOPA in ka gensa hi a, ka sem ding hi,’ ci hi."},"37":{"text":"\"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Israel innkuante ngetna ka mang kik dinga amau adingin hih ka sem ding hi: a mite uh tuu zahin"},"38":{"text":"Jerusalem-a a kisehsa pawite a biakna ding tuuhonte zahin ka tamsak ding hi. Tua ciangin a kisiasa khuapite ah mihing honpi dim ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi,\" a ci hi."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA khut ka tungah hong kinga a, TOPA Kha in kei hong paikhiatpihin kuam laizang khatah hong omsak hi; tua kuam ah guhsia bekbek a om hi.","title":"Guhkeu Kuam"},"2":{"text":"Amah in tuate lakah kei hong vakpih kawikawi a, tua kuam sungah guh tampitak kiphah ziahzuahin tua guhte a keu giugeu hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, hih guhte a nungta thei ding hiam?\" ci-in hong dong hi. \"Thupipen TOPA aw, nang bek in na thei hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Tp 32:39"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei kiangah, \" Hih guhte tungah thu genkhol inla amaute kiangah, ‘Guhkeute aw, TOPA gen za ta un!"},"5":{"text":"Hih guhte tunga Thupipen TOPA thugen hih ahi hi: Na sungah huu a ka lutsak dinga na nungta ding uh hi"},"6":{"text":"Note tungah thagui ka thuah dinga satak dimsakin vunin kong tuam ding hi; note sungah huu ka lutsak dinga tua ciangin na nungta ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 6:2; Jer 22:29"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin hong kisawl bangin thu ka genkhol hi. Ka thugen hun sungin a gamlum khat hong om a kitat luapluapin guhte amau mun ciatah a kithuah uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka et leh tuate tungah thagui le satak hong kithuah a, vun in a tuam hi, ahi hangin amaute sungah huu a om nai kei hi.","ref":"Eze 38:19"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei kiangah, \"Huu tungah thu gen in, mihing tapa aw, thu gen inla tua tungah,’ Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Huu aw, huih kiuli panin hong pai inla hih a sisate a nuntak theih nadingin a sungah lut in,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama hong sawl bangin thu ka gena amaute sungah huu a lut hi. Amaute nungta uh a, a khe-un a ding uh hi- galkap honpi khat ahi hi.","ref":"Ph 104:30; Eze 12:7"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah: Mihing tapa aw, hih guhte Israel innkuan bup ahi hi. Amaute in, ‘Ka guhte uh keugaw a, ka lametna uh beita hi; kote hong kikhenkhia ta hi,’ ci uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin thu gen inla amaute tungah: Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka mite aw, na hankhukte uh ka hong dinga tuate panin kong lakhia to ding hi; note Israel gamah kong puak kik ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Na hankhukte uh honga kong lakkhiattoh ciangin keima mi note in keimah TOPA ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka Kha note sungah ka koih dinga nungta-in na gamuah kong tengsak ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah TOPA in ka gensa a sem ka hilam nong thei ding uh hi, TOPA in cikhia hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 6:2; Job 17:15"},"15":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:"},"16":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, ciang khat la inla a tungah, ‘Ama kipawlpih Judah le Israel mite aa’ ci-in gelh in. Tua ciangin ciang dang khat la leuleu inla a tungah, ‘Ephraim ciang, ama kipawlpih Joseph le Israel innkuante khempeuh aa,’ ci-in gelh in.","title":"Kumpi Khat Ukna Nuai-ah Minam Khat"},"17":{"text":"Na khut sungah ciang khat a suak dingin ciang khat tungah a khat zom in.","ref":"1Ku 12:20; Isa 11:13"},"18":{"text":"\"Na gam mite in na kiangah,’ Hih a deihna bang hiam?’ ci-a hong dot uh ciangin"},"19":{"text":"amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ephraim khut sunga om - amah tawh kipawl Israel behte - Joseph’ ciang ka la dinga Judah ciang tawh zomin tuate gel ciang khat ka suah dinga, kei khut sungah khat a suak ding uh hi,’ ci in."},"20":{"text":"A tunga lai na gelhsa ciangte amau muhin tawi inla"},"21":{"text":"amaute kiangah, ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in Israel mite a tunna mun uh minamte lak panin ka lakhia ding hi. A omna munmun panun amaute ka kaikhawm dinga amaute gamah ka puak kik ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Keimah in Israel mualliante tungah amaute minam khat ka suaksak ding hi. Amaute khempeuh a uk kumpi khat omin minam nih suak ngei nawn lo ding uh a, kumpi-gam nihin a kikhen ngei nawn kei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Keimah in a nungtolhna a uh mawhnate panin honkhia-in siangsak ding ka hi manin amaute milim, a kihhuai milimte le a tatkhialhnate uh tawh a kininsak nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute keima mi suak ding uh a, keimah amaute Pasian ka hi ding hi.","ref":"Eze 24:19"},"24":{"text":"\"’Ka nasempa David amaute kumpi hi dinga, amaute khempeuh a cing ding tuucing khat ahi ding hi. Ka thukhamte zui ding uh a, ka thukipte limtakin a tang ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"Ka nasempa Jacob ka piaksa na pate uh tenna gamah amaute a teng ding uh hi. Amaute le a tate uh le a tute uh tua lai-ah teng tawntung ding uh a, ka nasempa David a ukpa uh hi tawntung ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute tawh kilemna thukhun ka bawl dinga, tua pen tawntung thukhun hi ding hi. Amaute kipsakin ka pungsak dinga, amaute lakah ka munsiangtho a tawntungin ka koih ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Ka tenna mun amaute tawh a om ding hi; keimah amaute Pasian ka hi dinga, amaute ka mite hi ding uh hi."},"28":{"text":"Amaute lakah ka munsiangtho a om den ciangin minamte in Israel-te a siangthosak keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi,’ ci in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Pk 31:13; Isa 55:4"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"TOPA thu kei tungah hong tunga:","title":"Gog Siat ding Genkholhna"},"2":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Magog gama Gog, Meshech le Tubal ukpipa b lam nga inla ama langah thu genkhol in:"},"3":{"text":"‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Meshech le Tubal ukpipa c Gog aw, nang langah ka pang hi."},"4":{"text":"Na khaguh ah sikkawi thuahin nang kong pumpei dinga, na galkap buppi, na sakolte, galhiam kimtaka a nei na sakol tuangte, lumneu lumlian a tawi mipite, a vekpi-un a namsau uh a teesak zuahzuahte tawh kong kaikhia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Persia, Cush d le Put-te in amau tawh kopin lum le sik lukhu nei ciat uh hi;"},"6":{"text":"Gomer a galkap khempeuh tawh, leilu-lam pek panin Beth Togarmah a galkapte tawh - minam tampi nang tawh a kop uh hi."},"7":{"text":"\"’Kithawi un! Nang le nang kianga hong kikhawm mipi khempeuh kigingsa-in om unla amaute uk in."},"8":{"text":"Ni tampi khit ciangin galhiam hong kitawisak ding hi. Sawtpi hun lai-a gamkhing a suaksa Israel mualliante tunga om minamte pana kikaikhawm gal sunga a suaktate’ gam khat mailam hun ciangin kong simsak ding hi. Amaute pen minamte lak pana kikaikhia hi uh a, tu-in a vekun lungmuangtakin teng uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Nang le na galkap khempeuh le nang tawh a omkhawm minam tampite huihpi nung bangin na kuanto ding uh hi; meiipi in leitung a tuam tawh na kibang ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 8:9"},"10":{"text":"\"’Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Tua ni ciangin na lungsim ah ngaihsutnate hong suak dinga, a hoih lo khat na sawm ding hi."},"11":{"text":"\"Kulh-a ki-um lo khuanote omna gam khat ka sim ding hi; bangmah a phawk lo lungmuangtaka om - kulh-a ki-um lo, kongpi le kongpi kalhna a nei lo mite ka sim ding hi;"},"12":{"text":"a kisiasa muna a lalkik minamte pana kikaikhawm, ganhing le van a hau, gam laizanga tengte langkhatah ka khut ka liik dinga luhgawpin a nate uh ka laksak ding hi,\" na ci ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Sheba, Dedan, Tarshish sumbukte le a khuaneute e khempeuh in nang tungah, \"Van hong laksak dinga hong pai na hi hiam? Van hong laksak ding, ngun le khamte a puakhia ding, ganhingte le vante a puakhiamang ding le tampitak a man dingin na mipite hong kaikhawm na hi hiam.?\" hong ci ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Jer 17:10"},"14":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin mihing tapa aw, tua thu genkhol inla Gog tungah: Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka mi Israel-te lungmuangtaka a ten uh tua ni ciangin phawkkha lo ding na hi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Na omna mun leilu-lam gamla pek panin hong pai-in minam tampite nong tonpih dinga, a vekpi un sakol tunga tuang a thahat galkap hon tampitak hi ding uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Meii in leitung a tuam bangin ka mi Israel-te sim dingin na kuan ding uh hi. Gog aw, hong tung ding nite ah ka sianthona hong kitheih nadingin minamte mitmuhin nang tungtawna ka kilah theih nadingin ka gam sim dingin kong puak ding hi."},"17":{"text":"\"’Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka nasem Israel kamsangte zanga sawtpek lai-a ka genpa nang hi lo na hiam? Tua hun lai-in amaute sim dingin nangmah kong kuansak nading amaute in kum tampi sung a genkhol uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin hih bangin a piang ding hi: Gog in Israel gam a sim ciangin a sa mahmah ka hehna a kuangkhia ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"19":{"text":"Ka aamna le ka thangpaihluatna hanga ka cihinah tua hun ciangin Israel gamah zin nakpi-in ling ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Keima maitang ah, tuipi ngasate, huihlak vasate, gamsung ganhingte, leithama vak ganhing khempeuh le lei maitanga om mihing khempeuh ling ding uh hi. Mualliante pukin keente cim ding uh a, kulh peuhmah leilakah a puk ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka mualliante khempeuh tunga om Gog sim dingin namsau khat ka sam ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Mite khempeuh in a sanggampa namsau in do ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Pulpi le sisan luanna tawh ama tungah thu ka khen ding hi; amah le a galkapte tung le amah tawh a omkhawm minamte tungah guahsiapi, gialpi, kaat kuanglai ka buaksuk ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua bangin ka liatna le ka sianthona ka lak dinga minam tampite muhin kei le kei ka kitheisak ding hi. Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi,\" ci hi.","ref":"Isa 24:18; Eze 20:42"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Gog siat ding genkhol inla: ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Meshech le Tubal ukpipa a Gog aw, nang langah ka pang hi."},"2":{"text":"Kong pingpei dinga kong talkaihgawp ding hi. Leilu-lam gamlapi panin kong lakhia dinga Israel mualliante kong simsak ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin na veilam khuta na thal ka bengkhia dinga, na taklam khuta na thaltang ka kiasak ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Israel mualtung ah nang le na galkapte khempeuh, nang tawh a kop minamte khempeuh a puk ding uh hi. Vasa nam khempeuh le gamsa khempeuh an dingin nang kong pia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Keimah in ka gensa ahi manin gam sungah na puk ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"6":{"text":"Magog le tuipi gei-a lungmuangtaka tengte mei-in ka hal dinga tua ciangin keimah TOPA ka hilam a thei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 30:8; Kil 20:8"},"7":{"text":"\"’Ka mi Israel lakah ka min a sianthona ka kitheisak ding hi. Ka min siangtho ka daisak nawn kei dinga, minamte in Israel gam sunga keimah TOPA Siangtho Pa ka hilam a thei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua hun hong tung ta hi! A piang takpi ding ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi. Ka gensa ni hih ni ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"\"’Tua ciangin Israel khuapi sunga tengte paikhia-in galvante - lumlian lumneute, thal le thaltangte, gal khetbukte le teipite mei-in cihin a haltum ding uh hi. Ansing dingin tuate kum sagih sung a khom ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in gamlakah sing tom loin sing phuk a kul kei ding hi. Ahang in, galhiamte singin a cih ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in amau van a laksakte’ van laksak ding uh a amau na a sutte’ na a sut ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Ph 76:3; Hab 2:8"},"11":{"text":"\"’Tua ni ciangin Israel gam sungah Gog han mun dingin Tuipi b lam zuatna nisuahna lama c khualzinte paina kuam mun khat ka pia ding hi. Gog le a mipite khempeuh tua lai-ah kivui ding uh ahi manin khualzinte lampi a khaktan ding hi. Tua ciangin tua mun Hamon Gog d Kuam kici ding hi.","ref":"Isa 34:3; Eze 38:2"},"12":{"text":"\"’Israel innkuante in a gamsung uh a hahsiang nadingun kha sagih sung amaute a vui khop ding uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua gam mite in amaute vui ding uh a, amau adingin kei hong kiminthansak ni, a kiphawk den ni khat a suak ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Tp 21:23; Eze 28:22"},"14":{"text":"\"’Leitang hahsiang dingin ahunhunin mi kicial ding hi. Pawlkhatte in gamsung khempeuh zong ding uh a, tuate banah adangte in leitunga omte a phum ding uh hi. Kha sagih a cin ciangin a zong dingin a kipan ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Gam sung teng a zonna uah mi khat in misi guh khat a muh leh khul tote in Hamon Gog Kuam ah a vui khit mateng a kiangah ciamtehna khat a phut ding hi."},"16":{"text":"(Tua lai-ah Hamonah e kici khua khat zong a om ding hi.) Tuaci bangin gamsung a hahsiang ding uh hi,’ ci in."},"17":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Vasa namkim le gamsa khempeuh sam inla, ‘Hong kikhawm un, Israel mualtunga alian mahmah biakpiakna - no adinga kibawl biakpiakna kimkot ah hong kikhawm un. Tua lai-ah sa ne-in sisan na dawn ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Note in tuutal le tuuno, keeltal le bawngtal tawh kibang mi thahatte sa ne-in, gam-ukte si na dawn ding uh hi - amaute a vekpi un Bashan a kivakthau ganhingte vive ahi uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua biakpiakna no adingin ka bawl hi-a, a thau na duh zahzah uh ne-in a sisan na khamgawp dong uh na dawn ding uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Note in ka sabuai ah sakolte le a tunga tuangte, mi thahatte le galkap namkimte khamtakin na ne ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"21":{"text":"Minamte lakah ka minthanna ka lak dinga, minamte khempeuh in amaute tungah ka khut liikin dan ka tuahsakna a mu ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ni-a kipan mailam ah Israel innkuante in keimah TOPA amaute Pasian ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Kei tungah ‘Israel mite muanhuai lo uh ahi manin amaute mawhna hangin sal-a kikai ahilam minamte in a thei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute muh loh dingin ka maitang ka seel a, a galte uh khutah pia-in amaute namsau-in a puk uh hi."},"24":{"text":"Amaute siantholohna le a gitlohna uh tawh kituakin ka thuaksaka amau muh loh dingin ka maitang ka seel hi.","ref":"Pk 9:16 2Ku 17:23"},"25":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Keimah in Jacob a saltanna a panin ka paikhiatpih dinga Israel mite khempeuh khuatuahin ka min siangtho ka aam ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute a gam uah omin kuamah in a lauthawngsak loh hun ciangin kei tunga a bawl uh a muanhuai lohnate uh le maizumhuainate mangngilh ta ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Minamte lak pan kaikhawm kika, a galte uh gam pan ka khop kik ciangin amaute tungtawnin minam tampite mai-ah ka sianthona ka kilak ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in keimah TOPA amaute Pasian ka hilam hong thei ding uh hi; ahang in, minamte lakah amaute sal-in ka kikaihsak hangin, khat beek nusia loin amau gamah ka kaikhawm kik ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Israel innkuante tungah ka Kha buakhia ding ka hi manin amaute kiang panin ka maitang ka seel nawn kei ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Tp 31:17; Jer 33:17"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khuapi a puk zawh a kum sawm le lina kum, sal-a hong kikaih a kum sawm nih le ngana kum kipat tung tua kha a ni sawm ni - tua ni tektekin TOPA khut ka tungah hong tunga, tua lai-ah kei hong puak hi.","title":"Biakinn Thak Huang"},"2":{"text":"Pasian mang ka muhna ah, Israel gamah hong paipih a mual sangpi dawn khatah hong koih hi; tua mual leitaw-lam pangah khuapi tawh a kibang inn lianpipi omna khat a om hi."},"3":{"text":"Amah in tua lai-ah kei hong tuna a mel puakzia sumngo tawh a kibang mi khat ka mu hi. Tuapa in a khutah pikhau le piciang tawi-in kongpi laizangah na ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Mipa in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, na mitin en inla, na bilin za-in, kong lah dingte khempeuh limtakin thudon in, ahang in, tua dingin nang hih lai-ah hong kipuak ahi hi. Na muh khempeuh Israel innkuante tungah gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Tp 6:6; 2Ku 25:7"},"5":{"text":"Biakinnpi huang a umcih bikbek kulh khat ka mu hi. Mipa khuta tehna pen a sauna tong guk hi a, tong khat pen tong b khat le zapek c ahi hi. Amah in kulh teh a; kulh a sahna piciang khat hi-in, piciang khat mah sang hi.","ref":"Eze 42:20"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin nisuahna-lam nga kongpi ah a pai hi. Kahleite ah kahto in kongpi lutna teh a, piciang tun khat a thuk d hi.","title":"Nisuahna Kongpi Pan Apualam Tual"},"7":{"text":"Galvilte galvil bukte piciang khat sau-in, piciang khat a zai a, galvil buk khat le khat kawmna kulhte zong tong nga mah a sah hi. Biakinnpi lam nga talaap zoma kongpi vang zong piciang khat mah a thuk hi.","ref":"Eze 8:16"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin kongpi talaap a teh hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua e pen tong giat thukin a kongnangte tong nih a sah hi. Kongpi a talaap pen biakinnpi lam nga hi."},"10":{"text":"Nisuahna kongpi sunglam lang tuakah galvil buk thum tuak om a; a thumin kikima a kikala kawm sahna zong a kikim hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin lutna kongpi zaina a teh hi; tua pen tong sawm hi-a tong sawm le thum a sau hi."},"12":{"text":"Galvil bukte mai ciatah tong khat a sah kawm om a, a galvil bukte tongguk ningkim ahi hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin galvil buk kawm nunglam ah a gala galvil buk kawm nunglam dong galdal-kulh teh a; galvilbuk khat pan a gal-a khat dong tong sawmnih le tong nga a pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah in kulh tung zui-in kongpi sungnung teh a, - tong sawmguk a pha hi. A tehna pen inntual f lam a nga talaap g dong a teh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tumna kongpi panin a talaap mongdawn dong tong sawmnga a pha hi."},"16":{"text":"Lutna kongpi sunglam a, kulh khuam le galvil bukte a kimkot kihonga talaap tawh a kibangin vangneu a kineisak ciat hi. Tua khuam pang khempeuh nisuh kungin kizem hi.","ref":"Pk 27:9"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin a pualam tualah hong paipih hi. Tua lai-ah inn dei pawlkhat le inntual kimkota suangphah ka mu a; tua suangphah kimkot ah inndei sawm thum a om hi."},"18":{"text":"Suangphah pen kongpi khat pan kongpi khat bana kiphah hi-a, a zaina le a sauna a kikim suak hi; hih pen suangphah niamzaw ahi hi.","title":"A Pualam Tual"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin kongpi niamzaw pena kipan huang sungnung pen pualam dong teh a, nisuahna-lam le leilu-lam kikimin tong zakhat tuak a pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in a pualam tual paina leilu-lam maingatin asauna a teh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tua a masa kongpi mah bangin a pang kimkota galvil buk thum ciatte - a kulh khuamte le a innmengte a phacia kikim hi. Tua kongpi paina pen tong sawmnga sau-in tong sawmnih le nga a zai hi.","title":"Leilu-lam Kongpi"},"22":{"text":"A vangte, a inn mengte, nisuh kunga zepnate, nisuahna-lam a maingat kongpi-a tawh kikim hi. Tua lampi matna kahlei cial sagih pha khat om a, tuate tawh kigalsai-ah innmeng a om hi."},"23":{"text":"Nisuahna-lam panga om bang tektekin leilu-lam kongpi maingatin a tual sungnung kongpi a om hi. Amah in a kigalsaipih kongpi pen tawh a kikal teh a; tong zakhat a pha hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in leitaw-lam pangah hong paipih a, leitaw-lam a maingat kongpi khat ka mu hi. Amah in a kong nangte le a talaap teh a, a dangte tawh a kikim hi."},"25":{"text":"Kongpi lampi le innmeng in adangte neih mah bangin kong vangneu a nei ciat hi. Tua lampi pen tong sawmnga sau a, tong sawmnih le tong nga mah a zai hi.","title":"Leitaw-lam Kongpi"},"26":{"text":"Tua lampi mat nading kahlei cial sagih mah om a, tua tawh kigalsai-in innmeng a om hi; a kulh khuampang maitang khempeuh nisuh kungin kizem ciat hi."},"27":{"text":"A sungnung tual in zong leitaw-lam nga kongpi khat mah nei a, amah in tua kongpi panin leitaw-lam pang a pualam tual dong a teh hi; tong zakhat a pha hi."},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in leitaw-lam kongpi tawnin a sungnung tual ah kei hong paipih a leitaw-lam kongpi a teh hi. Tua zong adangte mah tawh kikim hi."},"29":{"text":"A galvil bukte a kulh khuamte le a innmengte adangte cia mah pha kim hi. A kongpi lampi le a innmengte in a kimkotah vangte a nei hi. Tua lampi tong sawm nga sau a, tong sawmnih le nga a zai hi.","title":"A Sunglam Tual Paina Kongpi"},"30":{"text":"(Tual sungnung kimkota kongpi lampi-a innmengte tong sawmnih le nga zai-in tong nga thuk hi.)"},"31":{"text":"A talaap tual puanung lam a nga hi; a kong nangte nisuh kungin kizema tua lampi mat nadingin kahlei cial giat a om hi."},"32":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in tual sungnung nisuahna-lam pangah hong puak a, kongpi lampi a teh hi."},"33":{"text":"A galvil buk, a kulhkhuam le a talaapte zong a dangte mah tawh kikim hi. A kongpi lampi le talaap in a kimkotah a vangneu a nei hi. Tua lampi tong sawmnga sau a, tong sawmnih le nga a zai hi."},"34":{"text":"A talaap in tual puanung lam maingat hi. Kong nangte pang nisuh kungin kizem ciat a, lampi mat nading kahlei cial giat a om hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin leilu-lam kongpi ah kei hong paipih a, kongpi a teh hi. Tua zong adangte mah tawh kikim a,"},"36":{"text":"galvil bukte, kulh khuamte le talaap zong tua mah bang hi-a a kimkot ah a vangte zong a nei hi. Tua lampi tong sawmnga sau-in tong sawmnih le nga a zai hi."},"37":{"text":"A talaap a inntual puanung lam a nga hi; apang teng nisuh kungin kizem hi; tua lampi mat nadingin kahlei cial giat a om hi.","ref":"Eze 44:4"},"38":{"text":"Tual sungnung pen kongpi lampi kima talaap zomah kongvang a nei meihal biaknate sawpna inndei khat a om hi."},"39":{"text":"Talaap sunga kongpi lampi lang tuakah meihal biakna, mawhna hanga biakna, le khialhna hanga biaknate gawhna sabuai nih tuak a om hi.","title":"Biakpiak nading Kithawina Inndeite"},"40":{"text":"Kongpi lampi-a talaap kawm pualam, leilu-lam kongpi lampi lutna kahlei gei-ah sabuai nih om a, a kahlei lang tuakah nih mah a om hi."},"41":{"text":"Tua ciangin kongpi lampi langkhat ah sabuai li om a, a vekin sabuai giat pha in - tuate tungah biak piaknate kigo hi."},"42":{"text":"Meihal biakna-a piak dingte semna a kiseek suang sabuai li zong a om hi. Khat ciangin tong khat le a lang sau a, tong khat le a lang mah zai-in tong khat a sang hi. Tuate tungah meihal biakna le adang biakna dingte a kigawh ciangin van zat dingte kikoih hi."},"43":{"text":"A gei kimkot tungah zapek tan asau ka li nei sikkawite kibulh hi. Tua sabuaite biakna-a kipia sate koh nading ahi hi.","ref":"Pk 20:25; 2Kh 4:8"},"44":{"text":"Tual sungnung kongpi pua-ah inndei nih om a, khat leilu-lam kongpi lam pangah omin b leitaw-lam a nga hi; adang khat leitaw-lam kongpi lam pangah c omin leilu-lam a nga hi."},"45":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Leitaw-lam a nga inndei pen biakinnpi a nasem siampite ading hi a,","title":"Siampite Inndeite"},"46":{"text":"leilu-lam a nga inndei pen biakna-tau a nasem siampite ading ahi hi. Hihte pen TOPA kiang a nai thei, ama mai-ah na sem thei ding Zadok tapate - Levi-te bek ahi uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 42:13"},"47":{"text":"Tua ciangin a inntual teh a: Ningkim in - tong zakhat sau in tong zakhat a zai hi. Biakinnpi mai-ah biakna-tau a om hi.","ref":"Eze 41:13-14"},"48":{"text":"Amah in biakinnpi talaap ah kei hong paipih a talaap kong nangte a teh hi; a langnih tuakin tong nga a zai hi. A sunga tumna tong sawm le li zai-a a kulh khuamte d apang tong thum tuak a zai hi."},"49":{"text":"A talaap tong sawmnih zai-a amai pan anung dong tong sawm le nih e a pha hi. Tua in kahlei f ciang bana kong nang pang tuakah khuampi a po hi.","title":"Biakinnpi","ref":"2Ku 6:2"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in mun siangtho pualam ah kei hong paipih a kong nangte a teh hi. Kong nangte pang tuak g tong guk h tuak a pha hi."},"2":{"text":"A sung lutna tong sawm zai-in apang tuaka kawm tong nga a zai hi. Amah in munsiangtho puanung zong a teh hi; adung tong sawmli pha a, avai tong sawmnih a pha hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin munsiangtho sunglam ah pai-a, asung lutna kong nangte a teh hi, khat tong nih ta a zai hi. A sung lutna kong tong guk zai-a, a sung lutna kong pang tuaka kawmte a sahna tong sagih ahi hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin munsiangtho sung adung lam a teh hi; tong sawmnih pha a, munsiangtho pualam mong khat le mong khat a vailam tong sawmnih mah a pha hi. Amah in kei kiangah, \"Hih in Mun Siangtho Pen ahi hi,\" hong ci hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinnpi kawm a teh hi; tong guk sah a, biakinnpi pang kimkota inndei omte tong li a zai hi.","ref":"1Ku 6:20; Heb 9:3-8"},"6":{"text":"A panga inndeite dawl thum pha a, khat tungah khat kisuang-sawnin dawl khatah inndeino sawmthum a om hi. Biakinnpi sungah a nang ding phuh a kul lo dingin biakinnpi kimkota inndeite a nang dingin a kawm kimkot ah tawitawm a om suak hi."},"7":{"text":"Biakinnpi kimkota inndeinote adawl sanna tawh kizui-in zai semsem hi. Biakinnpi kimkot a kilamzia a sanna tawh kizui-in a inndeite a zai semsema kilam ahi hi. A sual niampen panin a sual laita kantanin a sual sangpen dong kahlei kidawh to hi.","ref":"Eze 40:17"},"8":{"text":"Biakinnpi kimkot teng a lei kitawisang tuama, a kimkot-a inndeite bulpi a suak hi. Tua a sangtuam pen tehna ciang-a tehin tong guk sang hi."},"9":{"text":"A panga inndeite a pualam sahna tong nga ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Biakinnpi kimkota inndeite le siampite inndeite kikal mun-awng tong sawmnih a zai hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua mun-awng panin a kima inndeite-a tumna leilu-lam pan khat om a, leitaw-lam panin khat a om hi; a kimkot a mun-awng tawh kizopna bulpi tong nga a zai hi.","ref":"Eze 40:5"},"12":{"text":"Nitumna-lam panga biakinnpi tual lam a nga innpi a vailam tong sawm sagih a zai hi. Tua innpi kimkot kawm tong nga sahin tong sawmkua a sau hi.","ref":"Eze 42:1"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinnpi a teh hi; a dung tong zakhat pha a biakinnpi tual le inn kikal tong zakhat mah a pha hi."},"14":{"text":"Nisuahna lama biakinnpi mai tawh kigawmin biakinnpi tual tong zakhat mah ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 40:47"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinnpi nunglam, a tual lam nga-in a dunglam teh a, a pangtuaka lamneu tawh tong zakhat a pha hi. Munsiangtho pualam, mun siangtho sunglam le a inntual lam nga talaap,","ref":"Eze 42:3"},"16":{"text":"kongpite, tawhlet neute, tuate kimkota lamneu thumte - na khempeuh, a kongpi ciang dong tawh singpekin kituam khin hi. A sual, tawhlet ciang dong a kawm le tawhlet-te zong singpek in a kituam hi."},"17":{"text":"A pualam kongpi tung dong, munsiangtho sunglam le mun siangtho asung apua a awnna mun khempeuh ah"},"18":{"text":"cherub-te le nisuh kungte kikhuak hi. Nisuh lim le cherub lim a kikal helh hi. Cherub khat in maitang nih nei a;"},"19":{"text":"mihing maitang a bang lam nisuh kung lam nga-in a pang khata nisuh kung lamah humpinelkai maitang lam a nga hi. Tuate biakinnpi kimkot ah a kikhuak suak hi."},"20":{"text":"A sual panin a kongpi tunglam dong munsiangtho pualam kawm tung khempeuh ah cherub-te le nisuh kung bekbek kikhuak hi."},"21":{"text":"Munsiangtho pualam kongpi khuamte a sikkim vive hi a, Mun Siangtho Pen mailam panga tawh kibang linlian hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua lai-ah tong thum a sang, tong nih ningkim a singpek kibawl biakna-tau khat a om hi; akiute, abul b le apangte singa kibawl ahi hi. Mipa in kei kiangah, \"Hih in TOPA mai-a sabuai ahi hi,\" hong ci hi."},"23":{"text":"Munsiangtho puanung le Mun Siangtho Pen in kongkhak thuap nih a nei tuak hi."},"24":{"text":"Kong khakpite khat singpek nihta-a kibawl hi a, kongpi khatah tua kongpite nih ta kithuah hi."},"25":{"text":"Tua ciangin mun siangtho puanung pen tunga kawm tunga kikhuak bangin cherub le nisuh kung kikhuak a, talaap mai lamah singpek tawh liimsun khat kibawl hi."},"26":{"text":"Talaap kawm tunga tawhlet neute a langnih ah nisuh kung lim kikhuak hi. Biakinnpi panga inndeite in zong liimsun a nei ciat uh hi.","ref":"Pk 30:1"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in a tual puanung pen sung leilu-lam ah hong paipih a, biakinnpi tual le leilu lam panga kawm puanung tawh kigalsaina-a inndeite omna hong tun hi.","title":"Siampite ading Inndeite"},"2":{"text":"A kong leilu-lam nga innpi pen adung tong c zakhat hi-a avai tong sawmnga ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"A tual sungnung zaw panin alangnih tuakin tong sawmnih hi-a, apuanung tual lama suangphah tawh kigalsai-in oma adawl thumin lam neu le lam neu a kimaingat dimdiam hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua inndeite mai sanah adung tong zakhat avai tong d sawm a pha lampi sungnung zaw a om hi. A kongkhakte leilu lamah a om hi."},"5":{"text":"A nuainung le a laita sualte sangin lamneute in munza khakzaw ahi manin a tungnungpen inndeite a neuzaw hi."},"6":{"text":"Dawl thumna-a inndeite in a tualte neih bangin khuampi a nei kei hi. Tua ahi ciangin a nuainung le a laita sangin a sual toizaw hi."},"7":{"text":"A puanung tual le inndeite tawh kitangin kawm puanung pen paikhawm hilhel a inndeite mai-ah om phei-in tong sawmnga mah a pha hi."},"8":{"text":"Apualam inntual zoma inndei kizom diudeute adung tong sawmnga a sau mah bangin munsiangtho tawh kinai pen panga kigualte tong zakhat a sau hi."},"9":{"text":"Inndei nuainungte in a pualama lutna tawh kibangin nisuahna lampang ah lutna khat a nei hi.","ref":"Pk 27:9; Eze 44:5"},"10":{"text":"Leitaw-lam pangah tual puanung e pen kawm dungzui-in biakinnpi tual le a pualam tual kawm ah a kigalsai-in inndeite om a,"},"11":{"text":"amai santak ah paikhiatna lampi a om hi. Hihte pen leilu-lam inndeite tawh kibang hi; adung avai kikima a phacia zong a kikim hi. Leilu lama kongkhakte"},"12":{"text":"leitaw lama inndeite kongkhakte tawh kibang hi. Paikhiatna lampi bulah nisuahna lampanga kawm pai pen tawh a kibangin kongkhak khat om a, tua panin inndeite ah kilut hi.","ref":"Eze 41:12-14"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, \"Leilu-lam le leitaw lama biakinnpi tual lam a nga inndeite, siampite ading ahi hi. TOPA omna-a lut ding siampite in a siangthopen biaknate tua lai-ah a ne ding uh hi. Tua lai munsiangtho ahi manin an-a biakna, mawhna hanga biakna, khialhna hanga biakna-te a kipia a siangthopen biaknate tua lai-ah a koih ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Hihte a siangtho ahi manin siampite tua munsiangtho ah khatvei a lut khit uh leh biakna a piak sungua a silh uh puante tua lai-ah nusia ding uh a, tua khit ciangin a puanung tualah pai thei pan ding uh hi. Mipite om nading munah a pai ma-un puan dang silh ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Sp 16:23; Eze 40:46"},"15":{"text":"Biakinnpi sunglam pang a teh a man khit ciangin nisuahna kongpi ah hong paikhiatpih a, a kimkot khempeuh a teh hi."},"16":{"text":"A tehna ciangin nisuahna-lam pang teh a, tong f zanga a pha hi."},"17":{"text":"Leilu-lam pang teh a, a tehna g ciang in tong zanga a pha hi."},"18":{"text":"Leitaw-lam pang teh a; a tehna ciang in tong zanga a pha hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin nitumna-lam pang ah kihei-in teh a, a tehna cianga tehin tong zanga mah a pha hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin apang lite a phacia a teh hi. A kimkotah kawm nei-a, adung tong zanga pha-in avai tong zanga mah a pha hi. Tua pen munsiangtho le mun mawkmawk kikhenna ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 43:1"}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in nisuahna lam pang a nga kongpi ah kei hong paipih a,","title":"Biakinnpi ah Minthanna Ciahkik"},"2":{"text":"nisuahna-lam pana hong tung Israel-te Pasian minthanna ka mu hi. Ama awging tuizeu hawk tawh kibanga a minthanna in leitung a taan hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka mangmuhna pen khuapi a a suksiat ding lai-a, le Kebar Gunpi gei-a ka muhte tawh kibanga ka khupbawh suk hi."},"4":{"text":"Nisuahna-lam nga kongpi tawnin TOPA minthanna biakinnpi sungah a lut hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kha in kei hong khaangto-in tual sungnungah hong lutpih a, TOPA minthanna biakinnpi a dim hi.","ref":"1Kh 9:18"},"6":{"text":"Mipa ka kiangah a din laitakin biakinnpi sunglam panin mi khat in kei hong hopihna ka za hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in, \"Mihing tapa aw, hih mun ka kumpi tokhom hi-a, ka khepek ngakna mun ahi hi. Hih mun in Israel-te laka ka ten tawntung nading mun ahi hi. Israel innkuante - amaute le a kumpite uh a paktatna b uh le amaute munsang ah nuntakna a nei lo kumpite milimte c in ka min siangtho a ninsak ngei nawn kei ding uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute in ka kongpi zomah a kongpi uh koihin, ka kongmung gei-ah a kongmung uh a phuh uh ciangin amaute tawh kawm bek in hong hala a kihhuai gamtatna tawh ka min siangtho a ninsak uh hi. Tua ciangin ka heh suaka amaute ka susia hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in ahileh amaute paktatna le nuntakna a nei lo a kumpite uh milimte ka paikhiasak dinga amaute lakah ka teng tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Sp 26:30; Jer 3:17"},"10":{"text":"\"Mihing tapa aw, Israel mite a mawhna uh hangin a maizum theih nadingun biakinnpi thu a cingin gen inla"},"11":{"text":"a gamtatnasate uh hangin a maizum uhleh biakinnpi a kilamzia - a kigualhzia, tumna le pusuahna, a buppi kigeelzia, a zat dingzia d le thukhamte theisak in. Amaute in a kigeelzia tawh kizui-in a ngeinate khempeuh muanhuai-a a zuih theih nadingun amaute mai-ah gelh in.","ref":"Eze 16:61"},"12":{"text":"\"Biakinnpi tawh kisai thukham hih ahi hi: Mualtung a om huang kimkot khempeuh a siangthopen hi ding hi. Biakinnpi thukham hih bang ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 17:22; 42:20"},"13":{"text":"Hih biakna-tau tong kiteh hi a, tong e khat a kici pen tong khat le zapek f a sau hi. A kingakna tong khat thukin tong khat zai-a, a gei kimkota a geivial khap g khat-a puam nei hi. Tua hi-a hih in biakna-tau sanna ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Lei-a a kingakna pan a vial nuainung ciang tong nih sanga, tong khat zai-in, tawitawm neuzaw pan a zaizaw lama tehin asanna tong li hi-a tong khat a zai hi.","title":"Biakna-tau"},"15":{"text":"Biakna-tau taptung teng a sanna tong li hi-a a taptung kiu ah ki li a poto ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Biakna-tau taptung a ningkim hi-a, adung tong sawm le nih, avai tong sawm le nih mah ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"A sangtuam pen zong a ningkim mah hi a, adung tong sawm le li hi-in avai zong tong sawm le li mah ahi hi. A kimkot ah tong lang a sah geihual le tong khat a pha a ngakna a om ding hi. Biakna-tau kahlei nisuahna-lam a nga hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pk 20:24; Ee 45:19"},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi. Hihte in biakna-tau a kidawh khit ciangin meihal biakna piakna le sisan theh nading ngeinate ahi hi:"},"19":{"text":"Ka kianga hong pai ka mai-a biakna hong pia Levi mi Zadok innkuan pana siampite tungah mawhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal no khat na pia ding uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"20":{"text":"A sisan tawm na la dinga biakna-tau ki lite nuhin a tau tungnungzaw pen kiu lite, a kimkota a geivialte khempeuh na nuh dinga tua bangin biakna-tau thoihdam in kisiangsak ding hi."},"21":{"text":"Mawhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtal khat na la dinga munsiangtho pualam biakinnpi huang sunga tua hih nadinga kisehna munah na hal ding hi.","ref":"Pk 40:29"},"22":{"text":"\"A ni nih ni ciangin kawkbaang lo keeltal khat mawhna hanga biakna-in na pia dinga, bawngtal-a siansuah bangin biakna-tau kisiansuah ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A kisiansuah khit ciangin ganhon lak panin bawngtalno khat le tuutal khat na pia ding hi; a nihin a kawkbaang lo hi ding hi."},"24":{"text":"TOPA mai ah na pia dinga, siampite in tuate tungah ci thehin TOPA tungah meihal biakna-in a pia ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"\"Ni sagih sung mawhna hanga biakna-in nisimin keeltal na zang ding uh hi. Ganhonte lak pan bawngtalno khat le tuutal khat na pia ding uh a, a nihin kawkbaang lo hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Amaute in ni sagih sung biakna-tau siansuahna bawl ding uh a, siangsak ding uh hi; tua bangin biakna-tau ap ding uh hi."},"27":{"text":"Hih nite a bei khit a nigiat ni-a kipanin siampite in meihal biakna le kilawmtakna biaknate h biakna-tau tungah pia ding uh hi. Tua ciangin note kong sang ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Sp 8:33"}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in nisuahna lam a nga munsiangtho puanung kongpi ah hong paipih kik a, a kikhak hi.","title":"Gam-ukpa, Levi-te le Siampite"},"2":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Hih kongpi a kikhakcip ding ahi hi; a kihong peuhmah kei ding hi; tua lai tawnin kuamah a lut thei kei ding hi. TOPA Israel-te Pasian tua kongpi tawnin tum khin ahi manin kikhakcip den ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua kongpi sung TOPA omna munah gam-ukpa bek an ne dingin tu thei ding hi. Amah talaap omna lampi panin tum dinga tua lam mah ah a pusuakkhia ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 43:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in leilu-lam kongpi tawnin biakinnpi mailam ah hong paipih hi. Ka et leh TOPA biakinnpi sungah TOPA minthanna a dim ka mu a, ka khup lamin ka boksuk hi.","ref":"Eze 40:35; Da 8:17"},"5":{"text":"TOPA in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, limtakin enin ngai gige inla, TOPA biakinnpi tawh kisai-in kong gen ding ngeinate le na khempeuh thupi sim in. Biakinnpi sunga lutnate le munsiangtho a pusuahnate khempeuh thupi sim in."},"6":{"text":"A lehdo Israel innkuante tungah, \"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Israel innkuante aw, a kihhuai na gam-tatnate uh kicing ta hi."},"7":{"text":"A kihhuai na gamtatna khempeuh uh na behlapna un ka munsiangtho sungah lungtang le silesa a vun at loh gamdang mite na tumpih uh a an, sathau le sisan nong piak laitakun ka biakinnpi buahsakin ka thukhun na palsat uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka van siangthote kemin na sep dingte uh na sep sangsik un, ka mun siangtho sung midang na uksak uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Ka munsiangtho sungah lungtang le silesa-a vun at loh gamdang mite a tum thei kei ding uh hi. Israel-te laka teng gamdang mite nangawn a tum thei kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 42:9; Joel 3:17"},"10":{"text":"\" ‘Kei kiang panin taikhia-a a milimte uh nung a zui Levi-te in amaute mawhna a banbanin a thuak ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in ka munsiangtho ah na sem thei ding uh a, biakinnpi kong cingin a sungah na a sem ding uh hi; meihal biakna gante go thei ding uh a, mite ading biakna-in pia-in mite mai-ah dingin amaute na a sem thei ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi zongin amaute in milimte mai mah ah na sem uh a, Israel innkuante mawhna sungah puksak uh ahi manin a mawhnate uh a thuak ding uh ka khut lamto in ka kiciam hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute siampi nasem ding ahi a, a siangtho nate khatpeuh kiang nai-ah hong pai ding ahi a, ka biakna siangtho pente tawh ahi zongin kei kiangah hong pai kei ding uh hi; amaute kihhuai gamtatnasate uh hangin a maizum ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua hi napi biakinnpi sunga nasemte ka uksak dinga sep ding khempeuh a sem ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Ahi hangin Israel-te kei kiang pan a manthan hun sung teng Levi-te le Zadok suan siampite in ka munsiangtho a nasepte muanhuaitakin sem ding uh a, ka mai-a nasem dingin ka kiangah hong pai-in biakna-a kipia sathaute le sisante pia-in ka mai-ah a ding diing uh hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Ka munsiangtho sungah amaute bek tum thei ding uh a, ka sabuai kiangah ka na sem dingin amaute bek ka mai-ah hong pai thei ding uh hi.","ref":"2Sa 8:17; Eze 41:22"},"17":{"text":"\" ‘Tual sungnung ah amaute a lut uh ciangin saihadial puan silh ding uh a, huang sungnung ahi a biakinnpi sung ahi zongin kongpite ah na a sep uh ciangin samul puan khatpeuh a silh peuhmah kei ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"A lu uah saihadial puan khimin a puan tualpi nuai-uah sahadial puan a teng ding uh hi. A khua-ul uh a suaksak thei ding na khatpeuh a silh kei ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Mipite omna apua lam tual ah a paikhiat uh ciangin a sunga a nasep lai-ua a silh uh puante suahkhia-in inndei siangtho sungah nusia ding uh a, amau puansilh tawh mite a siansuah theih loh nadingun puan dang a silh ding uh hi.","ref":"Kil 19:8"},"20":{"text":"\" ‘Amaute in a sam uh sausak loin lah a mettol kei ding uh hi; ahi hangin a sam uh a theu ding uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Tual sungnunga lut ding siampi peuhmah in zu a dawn kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Meigong numei le a pasal tawh kikhensa numeite a tenpih kei ding uh hi; Israel suan nungak bitte le siampite zi meigongte bek tenpih thei ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Amaute in ka mite a siangtho le mawhnate hilh ding uh a, asiang le anin bangci khen ding cih lak ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 13:50; Eze 5:1"},"24":{"text":"\" ‘Siampite in kisiatna khatpeuh ah thu khen ding uh a, ka khunsa ngeina zui-in thu a khensat ding uh hi. A kisehsa pawi khempeuh ah ka thukhamte le ka thukipte zui ding uh a, ka Sabbath-te siangthosak ding uh hi."},"25":{"text":"\" ‘Siampi khat misi kiangah a paina hangin a kininsak kei ding hi. Ahi zongin a misi pen a nu, a pa, a tanu, a tapa, a kimokhak nai lo a sanggamnu ahileh kininsak thei hi."},"26":{"text":"Amah a kisiansak khit nung ni sagih a ngak pelmawh ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Mun siangtho ah nasem dingin mun siangtho-a tual sungnung ah a lut ni-in amahmah adingin mawhna hanga biakna a pia ding hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Sp 21:14; Ms 3:28"},"28":{"text":"\" ‘Siampite in a luah uh kei bek ka hi hi. Israel gamah neihsa bangmah na pia kei ding uh hi. Amaute neihsa keimah ka hi ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Amaute in an-a biaknate, mawhna hanga biaknate le khialhna hanga biaknate ne ding uh a, Israel gam sunga TOPA tunga ki-ap peuhmah a tang ding uh hi."},"30":{"text":"\"’Gahmasa khempeuh laka a hoihpente le a tuam vilvel a na piakte uh siampite in tang ding uh hi. No innkuan sungah thupha khat a om theih nadingin lei pana na ngah uh ante lak panin a khen masa amaute na pia ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"Siampite in a sisa-a kimu le gamsate nekbaang vasate le gamsate a ne peuhmah kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Ms 18:20"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"’Luah dinga leitang na hawm uh ciangin TOPA tungah gamkhen siangtho dingin adung tong 25,000, avai tong 20,000 b a pha leitang tanh khat na pia ding uh hi. Tua huam sung peuhmah a siangtho hi ding hi.","title":"Leitang Hawmna"},"2":{"text":"Hih sung pan tong 500 ningkim munsiangtho ding hi dinga a kimkot ah tong 50 mun-awng hi ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Gamkhen siangtho sung panin adung tong 25,000 c avai tong 10,000 d tehkhia in. Tua mun siangtho sung tengah Mun Siangtho Pen a om ding hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua mun pen TOPA mai a naih, munsiangtho a nasem siampite ading a siangtho tuam mun hi ding hi. Tua mun ah munsiangtho a nasem siampite le TOPA mai-a nasem dinga a naite a om ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Biakinnpi sunga nasem Levi-te in khuapi sungah a ten nadingun e mun aliatna adung tong 25,000, avai tong 10,000 a nei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 48:8-9,29"},"6":{"text":"\" ‘Munsiangtho huam sung tawh kizomin avai tong 5,000, adung tong 25,000 munsiangtho tawh kimat dingin na pia ding uh a, tua pen Israel innkuanbup neihsa hi ding hi.","ref":"Eze 48:15-18"},"7":{"text":"\" ‘Gam-ukpa in a siangtho gamkhen le khuapi tanhna mun tawh kigizawngin leitang nei ding hi. Ka mite nawlkhin nawn kei un, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"10":{"text":"Tehna maan, ephah a maan le bath b maan na zang ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Ephah le bath a liatna kikim dinga, bath khat ciangin homer c khat sehsawm suah seh khat ta dinga; ephah khat ciangin homer khat sehsawm suah seh khat ta ding hi; a nihin homer a kiteh hituak ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Shekel d khat in gerah sawmnih khai ding hi. Shekel sawmnih a gawmna shekel sawmnih le nga a gawmna shekel sawm le nga ciangin mina e khat tawh kikim ding hi.","ref":"Ms 3:47; Ph 12:5"},"13":{"text":"\" ‘Hih in biakna-a na piak ding uh a tuam vilvel letsong hi a: mangbuh homer khat simin epha khat sehguk suah seh khat le mangbuh-ham homer khat simin epha khat sehguk suah seh khat ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Sathau piakzia ding sehna ah, bath in kiteh dinga cor khat simin (bath sawm ciangin homer khat tawh kikim ahi manin bath sawm ta ahikeh homer khat), bath khat sehsawm suah seh khat hi ding hi.","title":"Biaknate le Nisiangthote"},"15":{"text":"Israel gam lohing ngi-ingeina muna kikhawi tuuhonte zanih ciangin tuu khat ta na pia ding uh hi. Hihte mite ading thoihdam nading hi-a, an-a biakna, meihal biakna le kilawmtakna biakna f -a zat ding ahi hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Israel gam-ukpa zat dingin gam mite khempeuh in hih a tuam vivel piakna a pia ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Israel innkuan sunga a kisehsa pawite khempeuh - meihal biakna, an-a biakna le dawntheih-a biakna pawite, Khathak pawi le Sabbath-te ah gam-ukpa in a sik ding ama tavuan ahi hi. Amah in Israel innkuante thoihdam nading mawhna hanga biakna, an-a biakna, meihal biakna le kilawmtakna biaknate a sik ding hi.","ref":"Sp 1:4; Ms 10:10"},"18":{"text":"\" ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: A kha masa a ni masapen ni-in kawkbaang lo bawngtalno khat paipihin munsiangtho na siansuah ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna sisan tawmkha la dinga biakinnpi kongkhak khuam, biakna-tau a tungnungpen kiu lite le tual sungnung kongpi khuamte nuh ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh sawm khol lopi-in mawh a, a thusim kei khak leh cihna-in tua kha a ni sagih ni-in tua mah bangin na hih ding uh hi; tua bangin biakinnpi thoihdamna na bawl ding uh hi.","ref":"Pk 12:2"},"21":{"text":"\" ‘A kha masa sung a ni sawm le li ni-in Paisan Pawi na bawl ding uh hi; ni sagih sung sawt dinga tua sungin silngo kisawh lo anlum na ne ding uh hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ni-in gam-ukpa in amah le gam mite khempeuh ading mawhna hanga biakna ding bawngtal khat a pia ding hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua Pawi kibawl ni sagih sung teng TOPA tungah meihal biakna dingin amah in kawkbaang lo bawngtal sagih pia dinga mawhna hanga biakna dingin keeltal khat a pia ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in keeltal khatah an-a biakna dingin ephah khat le tuutal khatah ephah khat mah, ephah khat ciangin sathau hin g khat a zuisak ding hi."},"25":{"text":"A kha sagihna a ni sawm le nga ni-a kipan Pawi kibawl ni sagih sungin mawhna hanga biakna, meihal biakna, an-a biakna le sathau tua zah mah a pia ding hi.","ref":"Sp 23:34-43; Tp 16:13"}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\" ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Nisuahna-lam nga tual sungnung kongpi, na kisep ni guk sung kikhak ding hi, ahi zongin Sabbath ni le Kha Thak ni-in kihong ding hi."},"2":{"text":"Gam-ukpa a pua panin talaap omna kongpi zui-in lut dinga kongpi khuam kiangah a ding diing hi. Siampite in meihal biakna le kilawmtakna biakna h pia ding uh hi. Amah in lutna kongpi panin bia dinga, tua khit ciangin paikhia ding hi; ahi hangin tua kongpi nitak dong kikhak lo ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Sabbath nite le Kha Thak nite in gam mite in kongpi lutna pan TOPA mai ah bia ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Gam-ukpa in Sabbath ni-in meihal biakna dingin kawkbaang lo tuuno guk le tuutal khat a pia ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuutal tawh piakkhawm ding an-a biakna pen ephah i khat hi dinga tuuno tawh piakkhawm ding an-a biakna pen ama lungkimna zahzah le ephah khat simin sathau hin j khat ta pia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kha Thak ni simin a vekin kawkbaang lo bawngtalno khat, tuuno guk le tuutal khat hi ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in bawngtal tawh an-a biakna ephah khat pia dinga, tuutal tawh ephah khat mah pia-in, tuuno tawh a piak nop zahzah pia dinga ephah khat simin sathau hin khat ta piakhawm ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Gam-ukpa a sungah a lut ciangin talaap omna kongpi zui-in lut dinga tua lai mah zui-in pusuak ding hi.","ref":"Eze 40:19; Lk 1:10"},"9":{"text":"A kisehsa pawite ah gam mite TOPA mai-ah a pai uh ciangin a bia dinga leilu-lam kongpi a lutte peuhmah leitaw-lam kongpi ah pusuak ding uh hi. Leitaw lam kongpi-a lutte peuhmah leilu-lam kongpi ah pusuak ding uh hi. Ama tumna kongpi ah kuamah pusuak kik lo dinga, ahi hangin ama tum lohna kongpi ah a pusuakkhia ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Gam-ukpa zong amaute lakah a tum leh tumkhawm dinga a pusuah leh pusuakkhawm ding hi.","ref":"Pk 23:14"},"11":{"text":"\" ‘Pawi mawkmawkte le a kisehsa pawite ah bawngtal khat le an-a biakna ephah khat kipiakhawm dinga, tuutal tawh ephah khat mah kipia-in tuuno tawh, a piate in a lungkimna zahzah tawh pia dinga ephah khat simin sathau hin khat ta kipiakhawm ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gam-ukpa in utthu-a biakna-in TOPA tungah - meihal biakna ahi a, kilawmtakna biaknate ahi zongin a piak ciangin nisuahna-lam nga kongpi amah kihon ding hi. Amah in meihal biakna ahi a, kilawmtakna biaknate ahi zongin a piak ciangin Sabbath ni-a bangin pia ding hi. Tua ciangin amah paikhia dinga, a paikhiat khit ciangin kongpi kikhak ding hi."},"13":{"text":"\" ‘ TOPA tungah meihal biakna dingin nisimin kum khat apha tuuno khatta na pia ding uh a; zingsang simin na pia ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Zingsang simin tuate tawh an-a biakna ephah khat sehguk suah seh khat le annel a neelsak dingin sathau hin khat sehthum suah seh khat helkhawmin na pia ding uh hi. Hih TOPA tunga an-a biakna pen ngeina kip hi ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua bangin tuuno le an-a biakna le sathaute meihal biakna dingin zingsang simin ahun manin kipia den ding hi.","ref":"Ph 5:3; Da 8:11"},"16":{"text":"\" ‘Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Gam-ukpa in a tapate tungah a gouluahte panin letsong a piak leh ama suante tawh kisai ahi hi. Tua a piak pen amaute luah a neihsa uh suak hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahi zongin a gouluahte sung panin a nasemte khatpeuh a piak leh nasempa in a suahtak kum mateng kem thei dinga; tua khit ciangin gam-ukpa tungah kipia kik ding hi. Ama gouluahte a tapate bek tawh kisai hi; tuate amau aa ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Gam-ukpa in gam mite hawlkhia-in a van uh ahi a, a leitang uh ahi zongin a goutanh uh a laksak peuhmah kei ding hi. Ka mite khatbeek amau neihsa tawh a kikhenkhiat loh nadingin amaute tate tungah piaksak ding hi, ci hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 21:3"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in siampite tawh kisai leilu-lam nga inndei siangthote lampanga tumna kong zui-in kei hong paipih a nitumna-lam monga om mun khat hong lak hi."},"20":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Hih munah siampite in khialhna hanga biakna le mawhna hanga biaknate huanin, an-a biaknate em ding uh a, a puanung tualah paipih loin mipite apna-in a nei kei ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Sp 6:27; Eze 42:9"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin a tual puanung ah kei hong paipih a, akiu li tengah hong paipih kawikawi in, a kiu simah tual khat ciat ka mu hi."},"22":{"text":"A tual puanung kiu li-a tual neute a sung a ah om a, adung tong sawmli hi-in avai tong sawmthum ahi hi; akiu li-a om tual neute kikim ciat hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua tualneu lite kimkotah a sangtuamin suang kicianga, tua a sangtuamte nuai-ah mei cih nading thuk kibawl hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Hihte pen biakinnpi-a Pasian nasemte in mite biaknate a huan nading uh anhuan bukte ahi hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 44:1"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mipa in biakinnpi sung tumna ah kei hong paipih kik a, biakinnpi sung lutna kongpi mai pan nisuahna-lam manawha tui phulkhia ka mu hi,(biakinnpi pen nisuahna-lam a ngat hang ahi hi). Tua tui pen biakinnpi leitaw-lam, biakna-tau leitaw-lam pang pana luangsuk ahi hi.","title":"Biakinnpi pan Gunpi"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin mipa in leilu-lam kongpi tawnin hong paikhiatpih a, nisuahna-lam nga kongpi pua-ah hong paipih hi. Tua hi-a tui pen leitaw-lam pang pana luang ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 55:1; Eze 40:35"},"3":{"text":"Tehna ciang tawisa in mipa nisuahna-lam mawnawhin pai-a tui dung tong b tul khat dong a teh hi; tua ciangin kei hong ngahtanpih a siakmit ciang a tum hi."},"4":{"text":"Amah in tong tulkhat teh kik leuleu a, kei hong ngahpih in khuk ciang a tum hi. Tul khat teh kik lai-a kei hong ngahpih in kawng ciang a tum hi."},"5":{"text":"Tul khat tehbeh leuleu a tuatak ciangin gunpi hita ahi manin kingaptan zo nawn lo hi, bang hang hiam cih leh pek khop ding zah hi a - kuama kantan zawh loh ding gunpi a suak hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, hih na mu hiam?\" hong ci hi. Tua ciangin gun gei-ah hong paipih kik hi.","ref":"Eze 40:3; Hab 2:14"},"7":{"text":"Tua lai ka tun ciangin gunpang tuaka po singkung tampitak ka mu hi."},"8":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Hih tui nisuahna gam lam manawhin luanga, Arabah c ah luangsukin tua lai ah tuipi d sungah a lut hi. Tuipi e sungah a luan ciangin tua sunga tui a siang suaksak hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua gun a luanna peuhpeuh ah ganhinghonte in omna-in a nei ding uh hi. Ngasa tampitak a om ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh hih tui luang in tuipi tui-al a peengsak ding hi, tua mah bangin hih gun a luanna mun peuhpeuha nate khempeuh adingin nuntakna hi ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Adung tengah ngabengte a ding diing uh hi; En Gedi panin En Eglaim dong len phona phual a suak ding hi. Tuipi lian f tawh kibang dinga - ngasa nam tampitak a om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin nawngte le bualte a siangtho tuan kei ding hi; tuate ci-al dingin a tuaci om ding hi."},"12":{"text":"Gunpi pang tuakah singgah kung nam khempeuh a po ding hi. A tehte uh vul ngei lo dinga gah loh hun a nei kei ding hi. Tua tui munsiangtho panin amaute phungah luang ahi manin kha simin gah uh hi. Singahte an-in kinei dinga singtehte damna in kimang ding hi, ‘hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 36:8; Kil 22:2"},"13":{"text":"Hih in Thupipen TOPA gen ahi hi: Joseph ading tanh nih le Israel beh sawm le nihte laka a luah ding uh leitang na hawm nading gamgite hihte ahi hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute lakah a kikim dimdiamin na hawm ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in ka khut laamto in na pute uh tunga ka ciamsa hi-a, hih leitang na luah ding uh ahi hi.","title":"Leitang Gamgite","ref":"Pc 12:7; Ms 34:2-12"},"15":{"text":"\" Hih in leitang kigi hi ding hi: \"Leilu-lam pangah Tuipi Lian pan kikhungin Hethlon lampi zui-a Lebo g Hamath ah Zedad dong,","ref":"Ms 34:2"},"16":{"text":"Berothah h le Sibraim (tua pen Damascus le Hamath kikal gamgi a om), Hauran gamgi a om Hazer Hatticon dong ban ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Tuipi panin Hazar Enan a dong gamgi kikhungin Damascus gamgi saklam dongah pai-in leilu lamah Hamath gamgi a man ding hi. Hih in leilu lam gamgi ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"\" Nisuahna-lam pang gamgi pen Hauran le Damascus kikalah pai dinga Jordan dung zui-in Israel gam le Gilea b kikal tawnin nisuahna tuipi ah Tamard dong a ban ding hi. Hih in nisuahna lam gamgi ahi hi.","ref":"Eze 27:18"},"19":{"text":"\"Leitaw lam pangah Tamar pan kipan dinga Meribah Kadesh dong banin tua ciangin Egypt Wadi dungah Tuipi Lian a sun ding hi. Hih in nitumna-lam gamgi ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Nang in Israel behte zui-in na hawm ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Note le note laka hong pemte le a tate uh adingin na luah na ngak ding uh, na tanh ding uh ahi hi. Note in note laka hong pemte Israel behte laka a luah ding na piakte uh Israel mi taktak mah in na sim ding uh hi."},"23":{"text":"Note kiangah bang beh bang beh hong lal zongin a luah ding uh na pia ding uh hi,\" kong ci hi, Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Tp 10:19: Eze 36:12"}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Hihte a min zui-a kigual behte ahi hi: Leilu-lam pangah Dan in tanh khat tang ding hi.
