Tua pen a vai tong e 25,000 hi dinga, adung pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna-lam dong beh khat tanh tawh kikim ding hi; a laizangah munsiangtho om ding hi."},"9":{"text":"\"A tuam mahmah a TOPA na piak ding uh tanh khat pen adung tong f 25,000, avai tong 10,000 pha ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih in a siangtho siampite tanh ding ahi hi. Tua in leilu-lam pang adung tong 25,000 pha dinga, nitumna-lam pang avai tong 10,000 pha dinga nisuahna-lam pang avai tong 10,000 mah pha in leitaw-lam pangah adung tong 25,000 pha ding hi. Tua mun laizang takah TOPA munsiangtho a om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Hih munin Israel-te a manthan hun lai-a gammang Levi-te banga a mang lo muanhuai-a ka na a sem Zadok mite - a kisiansuah siampite ading ahi hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua in a siangtho leitang tanh khat tang, a siangthopen tanh khat tang a tuam mahmah a kipia tuam hi dinga Levi-te tawh kigizawng ding hi.","ref":"2Sa 8:17; Eze 45:1"},"13":{"text":"\"Siampite aa tawh kigizawngin Levi-te in mun-awng khat nei ding uh a, adung tong 25,000, avai tong 10,000 pha ding hi. Adung vekpi sauna tong 25,000 pha in, a zaina tong 10,000 pha ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in zuak loin na khatpeuh tawh zong a khek peuhmah kei ding uh hi. Hih mun a hoih pen leitang hi-a, TOPA tungah a siangtho-a kipia ahi manin kuama khut tungah a piasawn thei peuhmah kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Sp 25:34; Eze 45:5"},"15":{"text":"\"A om lai a vai tong 5,000 pha a, a dung tong 25,000 a pha pen inn lam nading le gankhawk ding - khuapi ai dingin kizang ding hi. Khuapi a laizangah om dinga"},"16":{"text":"hih-a kilak cia huang a nei ding hi. Leilu- lam pang tong 4,500, leitaw-lam pang tong 4,500 nisuahna-lam pang tong 4,500. nitumna-lam pang tong 4,500 pha kim ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuapi gankhawk ding leilu lamah tong 250, leitaw lamah tong 250, nisuahna lamah tong 250, nitumna lamah tong 250 hi ding hi."},"18":{"text":"A awng lai mun teng a siangtho tanh tawh kigizawngin a sauna tantan nisuahna- lam pang zong tong 10,000 mah pha ding hi. Tua sunga piang peuhmah khuapi sunga nasemte kivakna an hi ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua khuapi sunga nasem lokho peuhmah Israel behte pan hi ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Hih a kisehtuam leitang buppi a ningkimin tong 25,000 pha ding hi. Khuapi neihsa tawh a siangtho tanh khat tuam koihin a tuam mahmah in na piakhia ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 45:6; Kil 21:16"},"21":{"text":"\"Khuapi huam sung le a siangtho tanh khat na sehkhiat khit uh ciangin a om lai a pangtuaka mun-awng teng gam-ukpa ading ahi hi. Tua mun pen nisuahna-lam manawhin a siangtho tanh banah gamgi dong tong 25,000 hi dinga, nitumna-lam manawhin nitumna-lam pang gamgi dong tong 25,000 hi ding hi. Hih a langnih tuaka mun-awngte gel minam neute tanh ciacia gam-ukpa ading hi-a, a siangtho tanh le biakinnpi munsiangtho, tuate laizangah a om ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua bangin Levi-te neihsa le khuapi neihsa, gam-ukpa tanh mun-awngte kikal laizangah a om ding hi. Tua gam-ukpa tanh mun pen Judah gamgi le Benjamin gamgi kikalah a om ding hi.","ref":"Eze 45:7"},"23":{"text":"\"A omlai behte ading; Benjamin in tanh khat tang ding hi; tua pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna-lam manawh in kikhung ding hi.","ref":"Jos 18:11-28"},"24":{"text":"\"Simeon in tanh khat tang ding hi; tua pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna- lam ah Benjamin tawh kigizawng ding hi."},"25":{"text":"\"Issachar in tanh khat tang ding hi; tua pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna lamah Simeon tawh kigizawng ding hi."},"26":{"text":"\"Zebulun in tanh khat tang ding hi; tua pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna lamah Issachar tawh kigizawng ding hi."},"27":{"text":"\"Gad in tanh khat tang ding hi; tua pen nisuahna-lam pan nitumna lamah Zebulun tawh kigizawng ding hi."},"28":{"text":"Gad-te leitaw-lam gamgi pen Tamar pan leitaw lamah kikhung-sukin Meribah Kadesh tui ciang dong ban dinga, tua ciangin Egypt Wadi zui-in Tuipi Lian a dong hi ding hi.","ref":"Pc 14:7"},"29":{"text":"\"Hih in Israel behte in a luah den dingun a kipia leitang hi-a, amaute tanh ding ahi hi, kong ci hi, \"Thupipen TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Eze 45:1"},"30":{"text":"\"Khuapi pana pusuahna hih bang ahi hi: Leilu-lam pang pan kipanin tong 4,500 sau-a,"},"31":{"text":"a kongpite min Israel behte min kitamsak ding hi. Leilu-lam panga kongpi thumte Reuben kongpi, Judah kongpi le Levi kongpi hi ding hi.","title":"Khuapi Kongpite","ref":"Kil 21:12"},"32":{"text":"\"Nisuahna-lam pang tong 4,500 sau-in, kongpi thum om dinga: Joseph kongpi, Benjamin kongpi le Dan kongpi hi ding hi."},"33":{"text":"\"Leitaw-lam pang tong 4,500 sau-in, kongpi thum om dinga; Simeon kongpi, Issachar kongpi le Zebulun kongpi hi ding hi."},"34":{"text":"\"Nitumna-lam pang tong 4,500 sau-in, kongpi thum om dinga; Gad kongpi, Asher kongpi le Naphtali kongpi hi ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 4:4; Kil 21:12-13"},"35":{"text":"\"A kimkot khempeuh a gamlatna tong 18,000 a pha hi. \"Tuateh tua huna kipan khuapi min: TUA LAI-AH TOPA OM HI kici ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 12:6"}}}}},"27":{"info":{"name":"Daniel","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah zawh a kum thumna kumin Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar va kuana Jerusalem a umcih hi.","title":"Babylon a Daniel Kipattahna"},"2":{"text":"Topa in tuapa khut sungah Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim le Pasian biakinnpi-a vante pawlkhat a pia hi. Amah in tuate Babylonia a a, a pasian biakinn ah tunin a pasian goukholna sungah a koih hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:13; Jer 46:2"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in a zum sunga ulianpipa Ashpenaz kiangah kumpi innkuan sung pan le a nampite panin -"},"4":{"text":"a khangmoi a pumpi ah poina a nei lo, a mel hoih a navak, na khempeuh a kiva, na a thei baih, kumpi inn sungah nasem dinga a cin Israel-te pawlkhat hong sawl in, ci-in thu a pia hi. Amah pen Babylon-te b pau le lai a hilh ding ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in ama sabuai pan tuate nisim annek ding le zu dawn ding a pia hi. Amaute kum thum sung kipantah dinga tua khit ciangin kumpipa na sem ding uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 20:18; Est 2:9"},"6":{"text":"Tuate lakah Judah-te pawlkhat: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah-te kihel uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Zum ukpipa in amaute minthak phuah a: Daniel min Belteshazzar; Hananiah min Shadrach; Mishael min Mashach, le Azariah min Abednego a phuak hi.","ref":"Eze 14:14; Da 2:26"},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin Daniel in kumpipa an le kumpipa zu-in a kithanghuaisak loh ding tum-a, zum ukpipa tungah tua banga amah le amah a kithanghuaisak loh nadingin phalna a ngen hi."},"9":{"text":"Tu-in Pasian in Daniel tungah angvanna le hehpihna laksaka,"},"10":{"text":"ahi zongin ulianpa in Daniel kiangah, \"Na c annek ding uh le na dawn ding uh hong sehsak ka topa kumpipa ka kihta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in note kum kikimpih khangmoi dangte sangin a gina lo zaw-in hong mu zenzen ding ahi hiam? Tua hileh kumpipa in note hangin ka lu hong tan ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 39:21; Eze 4:13-14"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel, Hananiah, Mashael le Azariah cing dinga zum ukpipa in a koihpa kiangah Daniel in,"},"12":{"text":"\"Nong hehpihna-in ko na nasemte ni sawm sung hong zia-et phot dih in: Ka nek ding uh anteh singgah le ka dawn ding uh tuisik longal hong pia kei in."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa an ne tua khangnote tawh hong enkak inla na nasemte nong muhna tawh kizui-in hong bawl in,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah thukim a, ni sawm sung a zia-et phot hi."},"15":{"text":"Ni sawm a cin ciangin kumpipa an nete sangin cidamsuakzaw uh a, a ci a sa uh zong a hoihzaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin a cingpa in an limcite leh a dawn ding uh zute lakhia-in tuate tangin anteh-singgah bek a pia hi.","ref":"Pk 23:25"},"17":{"text":"Hih khangno lite tungah Pasian in theihna le lai nam khempeuh theihtelna le laisiamna a guan hi. Tua banah Daniel in mangmuhna le mangnamte khempeuh a theitel thei hi.","ref":"Job 12:13"},"18":{"text":"Kumpipa in amaute lah dinga a sehsa hun a cin ciangin zum ukpipa in amaute Nebuchadnezzar a lak hi."},"19":{"text":"Kumpipa in amaute hopih a, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah-te tawh a kibang kuamah a mu kei hi. Tua ahi ciangin amaute kumpipa nasemin a lut uh hi."},"20":{"text":"Pilna nam tuamtuam le a thudotnate ah kumpipa in a kumpi gam sung khempeuh-a mitphial siamte le aisan siamte zah sawmin a siam zawk lam uh a mu hi.","ref":"Pc 41:46"},"21":{"text":"Tua hi-a, Kumpipa Cyrus kumpi a suah zawh a kum masapen dong tua lai-ah Daniel a om hi.","ref":"2Kh 36:22; Da 6:28"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in kumpi a suah zawh a kum nihna kumin mang khat a man hi; a lungsim lauthawnga a ihmu thei kei hi.","title":"Nebuchadnezzar’ Mang"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama mangmat gen dingin mitphial siamte, aisan siamte, mibum-theite le aksi-en siamte a a samsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute a sungah tumin kumpipa mai-ah a din uh ciangin kumpipa in, \"Hong patausak mang khat ka man hi, bang a cih nopna hiam ka thei nuam hi,\" b a ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin aksi-en siamte in Aram pau in, c \"Kumpipa aw, khansawt ta in! Na nasemte tungah na mang hong gen in, tua hileh a khiatna kong gen ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 4:7; Ne 2:3"},"5":{"text":"Kumpipa in aksi-en siamte kiangah, \"Kiptak a ka khensat thu hih ahi hi: Ka mang hong genin a khiatna nong gen theih kei uh leh kong atnen dinga na innte uh nin kholna ka suaksak ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin mang nong gen theih uh a, a khiatna nong gen theih uh leh kei tung panin letsong, pahtakman le pahtawina lianpi na ngah ding uh hi. Tua ahi ciangin ka mang hong gen unla hong khiatsak un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 41:32"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in, \"Kumpipa aw, na nasemte tungah na mang hong gen in, tua ciangin a khiatna kong gen ding uh hi,\" ci-in khatvei a dawng kik uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in, \"Ka lungsim khentatnasa teng tel khin ka hi manin a hun sawt theihtheih nading a zong lel na hilam uh teltakin ka thei hi."},"9":{"text":"Mang nong gen theih kei uh leh na thuak ding uh dan khat bek a om hi. Lungsim kikhatin thukawng hekhek leng a ngaihsutna khel ding hi, ci-a a lamen na hi uh hi. Tua ahileh ka mang hong gen le uh cin a khiatna zong nong gen theih ding lam uh ka thei ding hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Est 4:11; Isa 41:22-24"},"10":{"text":"Aksi-en siamte in kumpipa kiangah, \"Kumpipa dotna a hih thei leitungah khat beek a om kei ding hi! Bangzah in lianin thahat taleh kumpi khat beek in mitphial siamte, aisan theite le aksi-en siamte tungah tua bang dotna a dong ngei kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, nong thudot haksa lua mahmah hi. Pasiante longal kuamah in kumpipa tungah a pulaak thei kei ding hi, tua bang mi zong leitung mite lakah a teng kei hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Da 3:8; 4:7"},"12":{"text":"Hih thu in kumpipa hehsak mahmah a, Babylon mipilte khempeuh thah dingin thu a pia hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua bangin mipil khempeuh thah nading thukip a om ciangin Daniel le a lawmte zong thah dingin mite kizongsak hi.","ref":"Da 3:13"},"14":{"text":"Babylon a mipil khempeuh that dingin kumpi cingte ukpa Arioch a paikhiat ciangin Daniel in pilvangtak le kidawmtakin amah a hopih hi."},"15":{"text":"Amah in kumpipa ulianpa kiangah, \"Bang dinga kumpipa in hizah a kinawh thukip suaksak hi ding hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Arioch in Daniel kiangah thupiang teng teltakin a hilh hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua tak ciangin kumpipa kiangah Daniel tuma mang khiatna a gen theih nadingin hun a ngen hi.","ref":"Jer 52:12,14"},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel a inn ah ciah a, a lawmte Hananiah, Mishael le Azariah-te kiangah thupiang teng a gen hi."},"18":{"text":"Amah in Babylon a mipil dangte tawh amah le a lawmte a kithahkhawm loh nadingin thuthuk tawh kisai-in van a Pasian tungah lainatna a nget dingun amaute a kun hi."},"19":{"text":"Zan laitakin Daniel in mangmu a tua thuthuk a kilaak hi. Tua ciangin Daniel in vana Pasian phat in:"},"20":{"text":"\"Pasian min a tawntungin kiphat den ta hen; pilna le vangliatna ama aa ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Amah in hun le khuahunte a khel hi; kumpite koiha zong a hemkhia hi. Amah in mipilte tungah pilna guana theihsiamna neite tungah theihna a guan hi.","ref":"Da 7:25; Da 4:17; 2Sa 14:17"},"22":{"text":"Amah in thuthukpi-a a kisel nate laakkhia a; khuamial sunga kikoihte thei-in, amah tawh khuavak a teng hi.","ref":"Pc 40:8; Job 12:22"},"23":{"text":"Ka pate Pasian aw, ka lungdamin nang kong phat hi. Pilna le vangliatna nong pia khin a, nang kong dot uh kei tungah nong theisak zo hi. Kumpipa mang kote nong theisak khin hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Da 1:17; Eze 28:3"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Babylon mipilte that dinga a sehpa Arioch kiangah, Daniel pai a, \"Babylon mipilte that kei in. Kumpipa kiangah kei hong paipih in, a mang ka khiatsak ding hi,\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Arioch in kumpipa kiangah Daniel paipih pah a, \"Judah saltangte lak panin na mang khiatna a thei ding mi khat ka mu hi,\" a ci hi.","title":"Daniel in Mangkhiatna Gen"},"26":{"text":"Kumpipa in (Belteshazzar zong a kici) Daniel kiangah, \"Ka manga ka muh le a khiatna hong gen thei ding na hi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi.","ref":"Da 1:7"},"27":{"text":"Daniel in, \"Kumpipa in nong dot thuthuk a gen thei dingin mipil, aisan-siam, mitphial siam, khongkhai thei kuamah a om kei hi;"},"28":{"text":"ahi hanign thuthukte a laakkhia vantungah Pasian khat a om hi. Amah in Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar tungah mailam huna thu piang ding hong lak khin hi. Na mang le lupna tungah na lup laitaka na lungsim sunga na mangmuhte hihte ahi hi:","ref":"Pc 41:8; Am 4:13"},"29":{"text":"\"Kumpipa aw, tua muna na lup laitakin mailam a piang ding thu na ngaihsun hi; thuthukte a lakkhiapa in a piang ding thu hong lak hi."},"30":{"text":"Kei midangte sanga ka pilzawk man hi loin nang kumpipa mahmah in hih thuthuk a khiatna na theih nading le na lungsim tawna hong paite na theihtel nadingin kei tungah hong kilaak ahi hi.","ref":"Pc 41:25; Isa 45:3"},"31":{"text":"\"Kumpipa aw, na en a, na mai-ah milim lianpi khat a ding hi - tua milim gol pha mahmah a tee daldal in kihtakhuai hi."},"32":{"text":"Milim lutang teng kham hi-a, a awm le a bante ngun hi-in a gilpi le a pheite sumngo hi-a,"},"33":{"text":"a khete sik hi-in, a khepekte sik le buan ki-em ahi hi."},"34":{"text":"Na vil gige laitakin mihing khuta kikhuk lo suangtum khat hong tuksuk hi. Tua in sik le buan kihel milim khepek a khazan hi."},"35":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua sik, tua buan, tua sumngo, tua ngun le tua kham-te thakhatin kitamzan a, khuakhal lai-a ancilna-a ansi leng tawh kibang hi. Huih in mutmang a, amel-amang kimu nawn lo hi. Ahi hangin tua milim a dengkham suangtum mual lian mahmah khat suaka leitung buppi a dim hi.","ref":"Ph 1:4"},"36":{"text":"\"Na mang hih ahi hi, tu-in a khiatna kong gen ding uh hi."},"37":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, nang kumpite kumpipa na hi hi. Vantunga Pasian in nang tungah kumpi-gam, vangliatna, thahatna le minthanna hong pia khin hi;"},"38":{"text":"na khut sungah mihing le leitung ganhing le huih lak vasate hong pia khin hi. Tuate a tenna peuhpeuh ah nangma uk a suaksak hi. Nang in tua kham lutang na hi hi.","ref":"Pc 40:12; Jer 27:6"},"39":{"text":"\"Nang nungah nang sanga a gina lo zaw kumpi-gam dang khat a khang ding hi. Tua zomah sumngo kumpi a thumna khang dinga leitung buppi a uk ding hi."},"40":{"text":"A nunungpenin, sik banga thakhauh a lina kumpi khat a khang ding hi - sik in na khempeuh sukhamin zansak zo hi. Tua hi-a sik in nate a suknen bangin tua pen in adang khempeuh sukhamin zansak ding hi."},"41":{"text":"A khepekte le a khemete khenkhat sik hi-in, khenkhat tungman ki-em-a na muh bang tektekin kumpi-gam kikhenkham ding hi; tua hi napi, tungman le sik kihel na muh bangin tua hun nangawnin sik khauhna zah pawlkhat mah a nei lai ding hi."},"42":{"text":"A khemete khenkhat sik hi-in khenkhat tungman ahi mah bangin kumpi-gam zong khenkhat khauhin khenkhat a nem ding hi."},"43":{"text":"Sik le tungman kihel khawm na muh bang tektekin mite kihelzau dinga kipawl thei loin sik le tungman mah a bang ding uh hi."},"44":{"text":"\"Tua kumpite hun sungin vantunga Pasian in a kisusia zo lo ding, midangte zong a kiluahsak lo ding kumpi-gam khat a phut ding hi. Tua in tua huna kumpi-gamte khempeuh suzan dinga bei mangsak ding hi; ahi hanign tua gam a kip tawntung ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Hih in mihing khuta kisukha lo mualtung pana tuksuk suangtumpi khiatna hi a - tua suangtum pen sik, sumngo, tungman, ngun le kham a khazan pen ahi hi. \"Mai lama thupiang ding a lian Pasian in kumpipa tungah hong lak khin zo hi. Tua mang thumaan hi-a, a khiatna zong muantak hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Pc 27:29; Isa 28:16; Pc 41:25; Kil 22:6"},"46":{"text":"Tua ciangin Daniel mai-ah Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar a khup lamin bok a, ama pahtawi-in biak-piakna le gimnamtui-a biakna a piak dingin thu a pia hi."},"47":{"text":"Kumpipa in Daniel kiangah \"Na Pasian, pasiante’ Pasian hitakpi-in kumpite’ Topa hi a, thuthuk a laakkhiapa ahi hi; ahang in, note in hih thuthuk nong laakkhia thei tazen uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Da 8:17"},"48":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Daniel zalianpi in koih a, letsong tampitakin pahtawi lai hi. Amah in Babylon gamkhen khempeuh uksak a, tua gam sunga mipil khempeuh ukpipa-in a koih hi."},"49":{"text":"Tuate banah Daniel ngetsakna hangin kumpipa in Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te Babylon gamkhente ukin a koih hi. Daniel ahileh kumpi zumah a om lai hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in pi sawmkua asang, pi kua a azai kham milim khat bawl a, Babylon gamkhen sung Dura zanglai ah a phut hi.","title":"Kham Milim le Pummei"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin khawk-ukte, uliante, ukpite, thu dotte,sumkemte, thukhente, thu-khen mangte le a gamgama uliante khempeuh tua a phuhsa milim apna ah pai dingin a samsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin khawk-ukte, uliante, ukpi-te, thudotte,sumkemte, thukhente, thu-khen mangte le a gamgama uliante khempeuh Nebuchadnezzar phuhsa milim apna ah kikhawm uh a, tua mai-ah a ding uh hi.","ref":"Est 1:1; Da 6:7"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin tangkopa in angaih mahmahin tangko-a, \"Mite aw, minamte aw, pau namkimte aw, hih in na hih dingua hong kisawl ahi hi:"},"5":{"text":"Saki, tamngai, zither, lyre, harp, gawsem le tumtheih nam khempeuh ging na zak phetun boksukin Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar phuhsa kham milim na bia ding uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Boksuk-a a bia lo peuhmah pummei kuanglai sungah kilawn ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 29:22; Da 4:1"},"7":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amaute in saki, tamngai, zither, lyre, harp le tumtheih namkim ging a zak phetun mi khempeuh, minamte, pau nam khempeuh boksukin Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar phuhsa kham milim a bia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Hih hunin aksi-ensiamte b pawlkhat in mipi mai-ah pai-in Jew-te a hek uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar kiangah, \"Kumpipa aw, khansawt in!"},"10":{"text":"Kumpipa aw, saki, tamngai, zither, lyre, harp, gawsem le tumtheih namkim kitum a za mi peuhmah boksukin kham milim bia dinga"},"11":{"text":"boksuk lo-a a bia lo peuhmah pummei kuanglai sungah kilawn ding hi, ci-in thukip khat na pia khin hi."},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin Babylon gamkhen-uk dinga na koih Jew mi pawlkhat - Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te in a thusim kei uh hi, kumpipa aw. Amaute in na pasiante na sem loin na phuhsa kham milim zong a bia nuam kei uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Isa 19:3; Da 2:49"},"13":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar nak heh lua mahmah a, Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te a samsak hi. Tua ciangin tua mite kumpipa mai-ah kipuak a,"},"14":{"text":"Nebuchadnezzar in amaute kiangah, \"Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego, ka pasiante na sem loin ka phuhsa kham milim na biak loh uh a man mah ahi hiam?"},"15":{"text":"Tu-in saki, tamngai, zither, lyre, harp gawsem le tumtheih nam khempeuh ging na zak uh ciangin ka bawlsa milim bia-in na boksuk uh leh hoih mahmah hi. Ahi zongin na biak kei uh leh note pummei kuanglai sungah hong kilawnpah ding hi. Tua ciangin ka khut sung pan bang pasian in note hong hukhia zo ding ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Kh 32:15; Da 2:12"},"16":{"text":"Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te in kumpipa kiangah, \"Nebuchadnezzar aw, hih thu tawh kisai nang mai-ah ka kihut ding uh kisam lo hi."},"17":{"text":"Pummei kuanglai sungah hong kikhul leh tua panin a na ka sep uh Pasian in kote hong honkhia zo dinga nang khut panin hong hukhia ding hi, kumpipa aw."},"18":{"text":"Ahi zongin hong hutkhiat kei zenzen leh zong nang pasiante na ka sem kei ding uh a, na phuhsa kham milim zong ka biak loh ding lam uh thei in,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Jos 24:15; Da 1:7"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nebuchadnezzar heh mahmah a Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te tungah a ngaihsutna a kilaih hi. Amah in pummei a sat ngeina zah sangin a zah sagihin a satsak zawk nadingun thu pia a,"},"20":{"text":"a galkapte lakah a thahatpente, Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te hencipsakin amaute pummei kuanglai sungah khul dingin thu a pia hi."},"21":{"text":"Puantualpite a silh, pheituamtual a teng, dial khim-a, puan dangte a silh hih mite kihencip a pummei kuanglai-ah kilawn hi."},"22":{"text":"Kumpipa thupiakna kinawh lua mahmah a, pummei lah sa lua mahmah ahi manin meikuang in Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te a lawn galkapte hullum a,"},"23":{"text":"hih mi thumte a kihen bikbeksa-in pummei kuanglai sungah a kiasuk uh hi.","ref":"Da 1:7"},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin Kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in lamdang sa lua-in diangvat a, a thudotte kiangah, \"Hencip-a meikhuk sunga i lot mi thum hi lo hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, \"Himah hi, kumpipa aw,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi.","ref":"Mt 13:54"},"25":{"text":"Amah in, \"En dih un! Mei kuang sungah mi li a vak kawikawi ka mu hi, kihen loin zong liam lo uh hi; a linapa hoh pasiante tapa khat sun!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 43:2"},"26":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nebuchadnezzar in pummei kuanna vang lam manawh in, \"Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego no Sangpen Pasian nasemte aw, hong paikhia un! Hih lai-ah hong pai un,\" ci-in a awng hi. Tua ciangin Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te meikuang lak panin paikhia uh a,"},"27":{"text":"gamkhen-ukte, uliante, ukpite le kumpipa thudotte in amaute a umcih uh hi. A pumpi uh mei in a kat loh lam mu tek tham loin a lu ua samzang a hulkhakna lim nangawn a mu kei uh hi; a puantualpite uh zong kangdeu loin meigim nangawn anam kei uh hi.","ref":"Ph 91:3-11; Da 6:7"},"28":{"text":"Tua ciangin Nebuchadnezzar in, \"Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te’ Pasian, a vansawltak sawl-a, a nasemte a hukhiapa kiphat ta hen! Amaute in amah muang uh a, kumpipa thupiak nialin amau Pasian longal Pasian dangte na sep ding le biak ding sangin singam zaw uh hi."},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin minam khatpeuh paunam khatpeuh sunga mite in Shadrach, Meshach le Abednego-te Pasian langpanna khatpeuh a gen leh ki-atnen dinga a innte uh nin buakna mun a suak ding hi, cih thukip kong pia hi, ahang in, hih bangin pasian dangte in a honkhia zo kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 34:7"},"30":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpipa in Shadrach Meshach le Abednego-te Babylon gamkhen ah a za uh a khangsak hi.","ref":"Da 2:49"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpi Nebuchadnezzar, Mite, minamte le kam tuamtuama pau leitung khempeuh a tengte tungah: Daupaina lianpi tung ta hen!","title":"Nebuchadnezzar in Singkung khat Mangman"},"2":{"text":"A Sang Pen Pasian in kei tungah lim le a lamdang hong lahte note tungah kong gen nuam hi.","ref":"Ph 74:9"},"3":{"text":"Hong lah ama limte lian lua a, ama nalamdangte thahat na lawmlawm e! Ama kumpi-gam a kip tawntung kumpi-gam hi a; ama ukna khang khat khit khang khat kizomsuak hi.","ref":"Da 2:44"},"4":{"text":"Keimah Nebuchadnezzar ka kumpi inn sunga ka inn ah, nuamsa in ka om hithiat hi."},"5":{"text":"Kei hong patausak mang khat ka man hi. Ka lupna tungah ka lup hithiat laitakin ka lungsim ah milimte le mangmuhnate hong suaka kei hong dipkuasak hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka mang hong khiatsak dingin Babylon a mipilte khempeuh ka mai-ah hong puak nadingun thu ka pia hi."},"7":{"text":"Mitphial-siamte, aisan-siamte, aksi-en siamte a le khong-khai siamte hong pai uh a, ka mang ka gen hi. Ahi zongin kuamah in hong khiatsak thei lo uh hi."},"8":{"text":"A nunung penin ka omna ah Daniel hong pai-a ka mang ka gen hi. (Amah pen ka pasian min tamin, a siangtho pasiante’ kha ama sungah om cihna-in Belteshazzar kici ahi hi.)","ref":"Ph 30:6"},"9":{"text":"Keimah in, \"Mitphial siamte makaipa Belteshazzar aw, nangma sungah a siangtho pasiante kha omin nang adingin thuthuk a theih hak lua a om loh lam ka thei hi. Ka mangmat hih ahi hi, hong khiatsak dih in,"},"10":{"text":"ka lupna tungah ka lup hithiat kawma ka mangmuh hihte ahi hi: Ka khuadak leh leitung laizanga singkung khat a po ka mai-ah na om hi. Tua singkung sang mahmah hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua singkung khangin gol mahmah a khauhin adawn in van a ban hi; leimongte panin kimu thei hi."},"12":{"text":"A tehte melhoih a, gah pha mahmahin mi khempeuh in an-in a nei uh hi. Thukhen zum ah kitu a, tua ciangin laibute a kilem hi.","ref":"Tp 33:2; Pk 32:32"},"11":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin tua ki in kiphatsakna kammalte pau ahi manin ka vil gige hi. Tua Gamsa kithatin a pumpi kisusia a meikuang sungah a kikhul dong ka en gega hi."},"12":{"text":"(Gamsa dangte a thuneihna uh kilakkhiatsak a, ahi hangin hun khat sung a nuntak ding uh kiphal hi.)","ref":"Pk 13:5-6; 19:20"},"13":{"text":"\"Zana ka mangmuhna ah ka et leh ka mai-ah mihing tapa tawh kibang khat vana meii tungah tuangin hong pai hi. Amah in Tangkum Pu lam manawh a, ama omna munah kipaipih hi."},"14":{"text":"Amah thuneihna, minthanna le alianpipen vangliatna kipia hi; mite, minamte le pau nam khempeuh in amah a bia uh hi. Ama ukna bei ngei loin a kisia ngei kei ding hi; ama kumpi-gam kuamah in a susia kei ding hi."},"15":{"text":"\"Keimah Daniel, ka lungsim tawna hong suak ka mangmuhnate in hong linglawngsakin ka lungsim a patausak hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua lai-a dingte khat kiang ka zuan a, hihte khempeuh a khiatna maan ka dong hi. \"Tua ciangin amah in hong genin, hihte khiatna hong hilha:","title":"Tua Mang Khiatna","ref":"Job 4:15; Da 4:19"},"17":{"text":"‘Gamsa lite, leitunga hong khang ding kumpi li ahi hi."},"18":{"text":"Ahi hangin Sangpen Pa misiangte in kumpi-gam ngah ding uh a, a nei tawntung ding uh hi - hihi a tawntungin nei den ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Da 8:16; Zec 1:9"},"19":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin adangte khempeuh tawh a kibang lo a kihtak huai pipen, a sik ha le a sumngo khecin tawh - nek a neih ciangin haizan-a valh-in a khamval teng a tuancilgawp tua gamsa pen a khiatna maan ka thei nuam hi."},"20":{"text":"Keimah in a lutunga ki sawm le tua lakah thumte kiakhia a, adang hong poto - ki dangte sang thupizaw tham leh a kilawm, mittang nei-in kiphatsakna a pau kam a neite thu zong ka thei nuam hi."},"21":{"text":"Ka et laitakin hih ki in misiangte gal in do a,"},"22":{"text":"Tangkum Pu hong pai-in Sang Penpa misiangte angvanin thukhenna gena kumpi-gam a neih ding hun uh a tun masiah amaute a zo hi."},"23":{"text":"\"Amah in hih bangin hong telgen hi: ‘Gamsa a lina in, leitunga om ding kumpi-gam lina ahi hi. Tua in kumpi-gam dang khempeuh tawh kibang lo dinga, leitung buppi valhtumin, suzanin a tuancil ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ki sawmte hih kumpi-gam pana piang kumpi sawm ahi hi. Tuate nungah kumpi khat khang dinga, a mai-ate tawh kilamdang ding hi; amah in kumpi thum a nuaisiah ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in Sang Penpa langdona kam pau dinga a misiangte nengniamin a kisehsa hun le upadite khek ding a hanciam ding hi. Ama tungah hun khat le hun lang b sung misiangte a kipia ding hi."},"26":{"text":"\"‘Ahi hangin thukhen hun kipan ta dinga, ama vangliatna kilakkhiat-sak mangin a tawntungin a kisia dikdek ding hi."},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin van kikupsin nuai-a kumpigam thupi-penna, vangliatna le liatnate Sang Penpa mi misiangte tungah ki-ap ding hi. Ama kumpi-gam in tawntung kumpi-gam hi dinga gam-ukte khempeuh in amah bia-in a thu a mang ding uh hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2"},"28":{"text":"\"Hih in hih thu a beina ahi hi. Keimah Daniel ka ngaihsutna in hong lauthawngsak mahmah a ka mai a daang hi, ahi zongin hih thu kei guak theihin ka im khinkhian hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 21:3"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Belshazzar kumpi a suah zawh a kum thumna kumin keimah Daniel in kei tunga hong kilaksa banah mang khat ka muh beh lai hi.","title":"Daniel in Tuutal le Keeltal Mangin Mu"},"2":{"text":"Ka mangmuhna ah Elam gamkhen sung Susa khuapi ah ka om hi; ka mangmuhna ah Ulai hawkguam gei-ah ka om hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka ettoh leh ka mai-ah ki nih a nei tuutal khat tua hawkguam gei-ah na dinga a kite a sau hi. A ki khat a khat pen sangin po hakzaw napi a sauzaw hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua tuutal ka et gige leh nitumna lam, leilu-lam le leitaw-lam a si kawikawi hi. Amah a zo zo ganhing om lo a, ama vangliatna panin kuamah in a hukhia zo kei hi. Ama lungkim bangin gamta-a, a lian mahmah hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih thu ka ngaihsutsut laitakin thakhatin a mitte gel kikal a kilang ki khat a nei keeltal khat leitung buppi kantanin nitumna-lam pan leitung sikkha lo liangin hong tai veva hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah hawkguam gei-a ding ki nih a nei tuutal lam manawhin pai-a nakpi-in a si hi."},"7":{"text":"Tuu bawhgawp a, sii-in a kite gel a siktansak ka mu hi. Tuutal in a nan zawh nadingin hatna a nei kei hi; keel in lei lakah sipai a, tuancilgawp in tuutal a hukhia zo kuamah a om kei hi."},"8":{"text":"Keeltal lian mahmah hi, ahi hangin a hatpen hun laitakin a ki lianpi kitan a, a ki pona munah a kilang ki li, van huih lite lamah a khangto hi.","ref":"2Kh 26:16-21"},"9":{"text":"Tuate laka khat tungah ki dawng khat mengsawn a, a men tungin neu napi leitaw-lam, nisuahna-lam le Gam Melhoih lamah a vanglian hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ki vantungte galkap honte a bat dongin khang a, aksi galkap honte pawlkhat leitungah khiasuk a, a tuancilgawp hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah le amah mihonte Kumpipa zaha lianin kikoih hi; nisima ama biakpiaknate beisakin a munsiangtho zong a niamkhiat hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua lehdona hangin misiangtho honpite a le nisim biakpiakna tua ki tungah kipia hi. A hihna peuhpeuh ah lawhcing-a leitungah thumaan a kilawnsuk hi.","ref":"Da 7:8"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin a siangthopa khat kiko ka za a, a siangthopa khat mah in kei kiangah, \"Hih mangmuhna - nisim biak piakna, a hawmmangsak lehdona, munsiangtho le mihonte a kituatcilna mangmuhnate a tangtun ding hun bang tanvei sawt lai ding hiam?\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Tp 33:2; Da 12:6"},"14":{"text":"Amah in kei kiangah, \"Zingsang, nitak 2,300 sawt ding hi; tua ciangin munsiangtho a kisiansuah kik ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Da 12:11-12"},"15":{"text":"Keimah Daniel in mangmuhna a khiatna theih ding hanciamin ka et gega laitakin ka mai ah mi tawh a kibang khat hong ding hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Ulai panin mihing aw khat ka za a, \"Gabriel aw, hih mipa tungah mangmuhna a khiatna gen in,\" a ci hi.","title":"Mangmuhna a Khiatna","ref":"Eze 2:1; Da 9:21"},"17":{"text":"Ka dinna geiah amah hong pai-a laulua in ka khup bawhsuk hi. Amah in kei kiangah, \"Mihing tapa aw, na mangmuhna hun tawpna tawh kisai ahilam thei in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Eze 1:28"},"18":{"text":"Amah in kei hong hopihpih laitakin khupbawksa in ka ihsip hi. Tua ciangin hong lawnga ka khe-in hong dingsak hi.","ref":"Eze 2:2; Da 10:9"},"19":{"text":"Hih mangmuhna pen beina hun kiciangtanna b tawh kisai ahi manin mailama thangpaihna hun ciangin bang piang ding hiam, cih kong gen ding hi."},"20":{"text":"Ki nih a nei tuutal khat na muh pen Media le Persia kumpite ahi hi."},"21":{"text":"Keel mulphapi pen Greece kumpipa hi-a, a mitte gel kikala ki golpi in kumpi masapen ahi hi."},"22":{"text":"Ki khat a kitan khit cianga tua muna po ki lite, a minam zui-in kumpi-gam li piang ding cihna hi a, ahi zongin a vangliatna uh a kikim kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 10:25; Da 10:20"},"23":{"text":"Amaute kumpi a suah zawh uh a nunung lamah lehdote a gitloh luat mahmah uh ciangin kumpi khauh mahmah, zuauphuah siam mahmah khat khang ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Amah hat mahmah dinga, ahi hangin ama hatna ahi kei ding hi. A dipkuathuai piangsakin a hihna peuhpeuh a zo ding hi. Amah in mi thahatte le misiangte a susia ding hi."},"25":{"text":"Amah in zuauthu khangsak dinga amah le amah a kiliansak ding hi. Amaute a lung muan uh ciangin amah in tampi that dinga uliante Ukpa langah pang ding hi. Amah a tua cih hangin mihing thahatna kizang loin a kisusia ding hi.","ref":"vDa 7:25; 11:23"},"26":{"text":"Na mangmuhna-a nang hong kimusak zingsang le nitakte a maan ahi hi, ahi hangin mailam hun sawtpi cianga tung pan ding ahi manin imcip phot in,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 8:16; Da 10:1"},"27":{"text":"Keimah Daniel, ka tha bei lua a, ni tampi sung ka ci a na hi. Tua ciangin ka tho a ka kumpi nasep sem dingin ka kuan hi. Ka mangmuhna in hong lauthawngsak lua-a theihtel zawh hi lo hi.","ref":"Isa 21:3; Da 10:8"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Xerxes c (Mede suante khat) tapa Darius, Babylon-te d gam ukpa a a kikoih, a kum masapen kum -","title":"Daniel Thungetna"},"2":{"text":"kumpi a suah zawh a kum masapen kumin, keimah Daniel in, Laisiangtho sunga TOPA in kamsangpa Jeremiah tunga a piak, Jerusalem a siatmang nading kum sawm sagih a sawt ding hi, a cih tawh kizui thu ka telcian hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa Pasian lam ka nga-a an tangin ippi puan silh-in vut kibuakin thungetna le thumna tawh ka kun hi.","ref":"2Kh 20:3; Da 5:31"},"4":{"text":"TOPA ka Pasian tungah mawh-na pulakin thu ka ngen a: \"Alian a kihtakhuai Pasian, amah it a, a thukham a zuite khempeuh tungah a itna thukhun a kiplet Topa aw,","ref":"1Ku 8:30"},"5":{"text":"kote gamtakhialin ka mawh zo uh hi. Giloin kong lehdo uh hi; na thupiakte le na thukhamte ka lehngatsan ta uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Kote in, ka kumpite uh, ka uliante uh le ka pate uh, le ka gamua mite khempeuh tungah na mina thugen, na nasem kamsangte thu ka ngai kei uh hi.","ref":"Jer 8:14"},"7":{"text":"Topa aw, nang na thumaan a, ahi hangin Judah mite le Jerusalem-a mite le anai agamla a om Israel-te khempeuh nang tungah ka muanhuai loh manun nong thehthangna gam khempeuh ah - tuni-in kote maizumna tawh ka kituam uh hi."},"8":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang tungah hong mawh zo ka hi manun ko le ka kumpite, ka uliante uh le ka pate uh maizumna tawh ka kituam uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Topa kote Pasian lainatna tawh kidim a amah ka lehdo uh hangin ka mawhna uh hong maisak lai hi;"},"10":{"text":"TOPA kote Pasian thu mang loin ama nasem kamsangte tungtawna hong piak thukhamte ka zuih loh uh hangin hong hehpih lai hi."},"11":{"text":"Israel-te khempeuh in na thu hong mang nuam lo uh a, na thukhamte palsatin nang hong lehngatsan uh hi. \"Tua ahi ciangin nang tungah kote mawh khin ka hi manun Pasian nasem Moses Thukham sunga kigelhsa hamsiatna le ciamsiatna thukhennate ko tungah hong kisung khin hi.","ref":"Ezr 9:15"},"12":{"text":"A kigensate na tangtunsakna-in kote le ka gam-ukte uh tungah siatna lianpi na tungsak zo hi. Jerusalem tungah a tungsa thu bangin vantung buppi nuai-ah khatvei beek a tung ngei nai kei hi."},"13":{"text":"Moses thukham sunga kigelhsa bang tektekin hih siatnate ko tungah hong tung napi ka mawhna uh kisikin TOPA kote Pasian kong zong tuan kei uh a, na thumaan ka thusim tuan kei lai uh hi."},"14":{"text":"TOPA kote Pasian a sepna peuh ah thumaan ahi manin kote tungah siatna hong tun ding TOPA in haksa a sa kei hi; tua hi napi a thu lah ka mang tuan kei uh hi.","ref":"Tp 4:29"},"15":{"text":"\"Tu-in a mite Egypt pan a khut thahat tawh a lakhia tuni dongin a min a kipsak den Topa Pasian aw, kote mawh in ka khial zo uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Topa aw, amaan na nasepna khempeuh tawh a kituah hangin na khuapi, na mual siangtho Jerusalem tungah hehin thangpai kei in. Kote mawhnate le ka pate uh khialhnate hangin ka kim ka pam-ua mi khempeuh in Jerusalem le na mite hong simmawh uh hi."},"17":{"text":"\"Kote Pasian aw, tu-in na nasempa thungetna le thumnate hong za in. Topa aw, nang adinga kilam, a kisiasa na mun siangtho hong angvansak in."},"18":{"text":"Pasian aw, na bil hong ngat inla hong za in; hong en inla nangma Min a pua khuapi a siatna mu in. Kote thumaanna suang hi loin a lian mahmah nangma lainatna muangin kong ngen uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Topa aw, kong ngetna hong za in; Topa aw, hong maisak in! Topa aw, hong za inla na hong sem in! Ka Pasian aw, na khuapi le na mite in nangma Min pua ahi manin nangmah na kikhualna-in hong ziakai kei in,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Ms 6:24-26"},"20":{"text":"Keima mawhna le ka mipih Israel-te mawhna pulaka pau in thu ka nget laitak le TOPA ka Pasian tungah a mual siangtho ading ka thum laitak -"},"21":{"text":"thu ka ngetnget laitak, nitak biak piak hun pawlin ka mangmuh masak a ka muhsa mipa, Gabriel ka kiangah hong leng vingveng hi.","title":"Sawm Sagih \"Sagihte\""},"22":{"text":"Amah in lam hong lakin ka kiangah, \"Daniel aw, thutawng-muhna le theihtelna hong pia dingin kong pai hi."},"23":{"text":"Thu na nget phetin, nang hong kisang koih ahi manin tu-a kong gen ding tawh nang hong kidawng pah hi. Tua ahi manin hong kipuak thu ngaihsunin mangmuhna theitel in.","ref":"Ezr 10:11"},"24":{"text":"\"Na mite le na khuapi siangtho in khialhna beisak a nading, mawhna beisak nading, gitlohna thoihdam nading, tawntung thumaanna a tun nading mangmuhna le kamsanna imcip nading le siangthopen b sathau nilh nadingin \"Sawm sagih ‘sagihte’ c thukip hi khin hi."},"25":{"text":"Hih thu thei inla telcian in: Thukip d a kipiaka kipan Jerusalem a ngei bangin a kilam kik dong sagih ‘sagihte’ hi dinga, Jerusalem kilam kika kipan Sathau-kinilh Pa e , ukpa hong pai dong, sawmguk lenih ‘sagihte’ hi ding hi. Kongzing lampite le guampi nei-in kilam kik dinga, ahi hangin lungkham hun sung hi ding hi."},"26":{"text":"Sawmguk le nih ‘sagihte’ khit ciangin Sathau-kinilh Pa kithat dinga, bangmah f a nei kei ding hi. Hong pai ding gam-ukpa’ mite in khuapi le munsiangtho a susia ding uh hi. Tuikhang bangin a beina tungin: A bei dongin gal kido ding hi, siatmang ding thukip a kisehsa ahi hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in mi tampi tawh ‘sagih’ g khat sung thukhun bawl dinga, ahi hangin tua ‘sagih’ h kimtan ciangin biakpiakna le biakna a beisak ding hi. Tua ciangin amah in ama tungah a beina thukip a kisunkhiat mateng biakinnpi meng khat tungah a hawmmangsak kihhuaina a koih ding hi,\" i hong ci hi. j","ref":"Isa 28:2"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia kumpipa Cyrus kumpi a suah zawh kumthumna kumin (Belteshazzar zong a kici) Daniel tungah kilaakna khat a tung hi. Tua thu kipuak thumaan hi-a, gal k lianpi tawh kisai ahi hi. Tua thu teng a theihtel nadingin mangmuhna khat a tungah tung hi.","title":"Daniel in Pasal khat Mangin Mu","ref":"Da 1:21; 8:26"},"2":{"text":"Tua hunin keimah Daniel nipi thum sung ka thum hi."},"3":{"text":"An lim ka ne kei hi; sa le zu ka mukah ka tah kei hi; nipi thum sung khit mateng kizutna ka zang peuhmah kei hi.","ref":"Ezr 9:4"},"4":{"text":"A kha masa ni sawm nih le li ni-in tua gunpi lian Tigris gei-ah ka dinkawmin,"},"5":{"text":"ka dakto a ka mai-ah saihadial puan silhin a kawngah kham hoih pente konggak gak-a om pasal khat ka mu hi."},"6":{"text":"A pumpi chrysolite tawh kibangin a maitang khuaphialep tawh kibanga, a mitte meisel kuanglai bangin, a bante le a khete sumngo nawtngilsa bangin tee a, a aw mihonpi pau a bang hi."},"7":{"text":"Keimah Daniel guak in tua mangmuhna ka mu hi; ka ompihte in a mu kei uh hi; ahi hangin tua a lauhuai hangin amaute linglawng uh a tai-in a bu uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei kia hong kinusia a, hih a thupi mangmuhna ah kei kia bekin ka en gega hi. Ka tha hawmgawp a ka maitangah si teng loin daanga ka cimawh gawp hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin ama pau za a, a thugen ka ngaih kawmin; lei ah ka khupbawhsa in ka ihsip hi.","ref":"2Ku 6:17-20"},"10":{"text":"Khut khat in kei hong lawngin ka khut le ka khukte kilingsak hi."},"11":{"text":"Amah in, \"Hong kipingaihsut mahmah Daniel aw, nang tunga kong gen ding thute limtakin ngaihsun inla dingto in, nang kiangah kei hong kisawl hi,\" hong ci hi. Hih thu kei tungah hong gen ciangin ling kauhkauhsa in ka dingto hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thugen zomlai a, \"Daniel aw, lau kei in. Pasian mai-ah kiniamkhiat ding le theihtel nopna lungsim neih na sawm masak pen ni-a kipan na kammalte hong kiza zo ahi manin tuate dawng kik dinga hong pai ka hi hi."},"13":{"text":"Ahi hangin Persia-te kumpi gam-ukpa in ni sawmnih le khat sung hong dal hi. Tua ciangin kei hong huh dingin ukpi lakah khat ahi Michael hong kuan hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Persia kumpipa kiangah ka tham niloh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tu-in na mangmuhna mailam hun tawh kisai ahi manin, mailam hun ciangin na mite tungah bang thu piang lai ding hiam cih a hilhcian dinga hong pai ka hi hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Da 9:22; Mt 14:27"},"15":{"text":"Hih thu kei tungah hong gen laitakin pau thei loin leilam nga-in ka kun dedu hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin mi khat a tawh a kibang pa in ka muk hong lawnsak a, ka kam ka-in thu ka gen hi. Ka mai-a dingpa kiangah, \"Topa aw, ka mangmuhna in ka pumtangin hong zen ahi ciangin ka cih nading ka thei kei hi."},"17":{"text":"Na nasempa keimah nang tawh bangci kiho theih ding ka hi hiam, topa aw? Ka tha khempeuh bei-in a nak zo liailiai bek ka hi hi,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Eze 24:27"},"18":{"text":"Mi khat tawh a kibang tuapa in kei hong lawng kika tha hong guan hi."},"19":{"text":"\"A kithupi sim mahmah mipa aw, lau kei in, lungnuam in! Kihatsak in; tu-in kihatsak in,\" hong ci hi. Amah in kei hong hopih ciangin ka tha hat a, \"Nong hatsak khin hi topa aw, thu hong gen ta in,\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Da 8:18; Jos 1:9; Da 9:23"},"20":{"text":"Tua ciangin, \"Nang kianga kong paina ahang na thei hiam? Persia gam-ukte sim dingin ka kileh kik pah dinga, ka pai ciangin Greek-te gam-ukpa hong pai ding hi;"},"21":{"text":"ahi hangin a masapenin thumaan Laibu sunga kigelh thu kong gen ding hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"(Na gam-ukpa uh Michael longal kuamah in kei hong panpih lo hi. Kei in Mede mi Darius a kum khatna kumin amah panpih in ka dal hi.)","ref":"Da 5:31"},"2":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin, tu-in thutak kong geninah: Persia ah kumpi dang thum hong khang dinga, tua khit ciang adang khempeuh sangin a hauzaw tham ding alina hong khang ding hi. Ama hauhna hangin a vangliat ciangin Greece kumpi-gam langpang dingin mi khempeuh a tokbuai ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thahat kumpi khat khang dinga, tuapa vanglian mahmah in a ut bangbangin gamta ding hi.","title":"Leilu-lam le Leitaw-lam Kumpite"},"4":{"text":"Amah a liat khit ciangin a gam kikhenkham dinga vantung huih lite manawhin kikhenthang ding hi. Ama suante in luah lo tham loin a zatsa a vangliatna zong a nei kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ama ukna gam kibulkalh dinga midangte kipia ding hi.","ref":"Da 7:2; 10:21"},"5":{"text":"\"Leitaw-lam kumpipa thahat dinga, ahi hangin ama galkap mang liante khat amah sang thahatzaw-in ama aituam kumpi-gam alian vangliatna tawh a uk ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Kum sawtsim khit ciangin amaute kipawlkhawm ding uh hi. Leitaw-lam kumpipa tanu, kipawlna bawl dingin leilu-lam kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hi; ahi hangin tuanu in a vangliatna lensuak lo dinga, tuapa le a vangliatna b zong a kip kei ding hi. Tua ni ciangin tuapa le a tonpih amah a cingte a pa c le amah a huh peuhmah tawh a ki-apkhawm ding hi."},"7":{"text":"\"Ama muna om dingin ama gui pana piang khat a khangkhia ding hi. Amah’n Bethel ah amah mu-a, tua lai-ah amah hopih hi -"},"5":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA Pasian ama min TOPA in kithei hi!","ref":"Pk 3:15"},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin Pasian kiangah note na kihei pelmawh ding uh hi; itna le thutangin zom unla, a tawntungin note Pasian ngak un.","ref":"Isa 19:22; Hos 6:1-3; 10:12"},"7":{"text":"Sumbukpa in tehna maan lo zang hi; a maan lo-a sumngah nuamsa hi.","ref":"Am 8:5"},"8":{"text":"Ephraim kiphasak a, \"Ka hau mahmah hi; mihau ka suak zo hi. Ahi hangin amah in Baal a biakna hangin khiala a si hi.","title":"Israel Tunga Hehna","ref":"Thk 12:1"},"2":{"text":"Tu-in amaute in mawhna a bawl thuahthuah uh hi; amau ngun panin amau mah in milimte bawl uh a, piltakin limsuaite zem uh hi; tuate khempeuh khutsiamte bawl ahi hi. Na khuapi khempeuh ua ukpite, \"Kumpi khat le thukhente kei hong pia in,\" na cihte uh koi-ah om ahi hiam?","ref":"2Ku 17:4; Hos 8:4"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka heh suakin kumpi khat kong pia-a, thangpaisa-in amah ka lakhiamang hi.","ref":"1Ku 14:10; Hos 10:7"},"12":{"text":"Ephraim khialhna kikhol khawma, ama mawhnate kiciamteh hi."},"13":{"text":"Ama tungah numei nausuah nat bangin tunga, ahi hangin amah pilna a nei lo naupang khat ahi hi; a hunin a tut ciangin naubu kihong napi a paikhia kei hi."},"14":{"text":"\"Hankhuk e vangliatna panin amaute tatna sum ka pia ding hi; sihna panin amaute ka tankhia ding hi. Sihna aw, na gimna koi-ah om hiam? Hankhuk f aw, na siatsakna koi-ah om hiam?","ref":"Isa 25:8; 1Cor 15:55*"},"15":{"text":"\"Ama sanggamte lakah a khanpha pen zawzen zongin ka khuatuah kei ding hi. Ama vankholna inn kiluhin a goute khempeuh kisutmang ding hi.","ref":"Eze 19:12; Jer 51:36; Jer 20:5"},"16":{"text":"Samaria mite in Pasian langah lehdo uh ahi manin amau khialhna thuak ding uh hi. Amaute namsau in puk ding uh hi; a ta ngekte uh leilak kidenna-in, a numei gaite uh kikuikham ding hi\" ci hi.","ref":"Hos 7:14; Hos 10:2; 2Ku 15:16"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel aw, TOPA na Pasian lamah kihei in. Nang mawhnate in na pukna ahi hi.","title":"Kisikna in Thupha Puak","ref":"Jer 3:12; Hos 5:5"},"2":{"text":"Kammalte keng inla TOPA kiangah kihei in. Ama kiangah: \"Ka mawhna khempeuh uh hong maisak inla ka muk a gahte uh nang kong piak theih nadingun, nong hehpihna-in kote hong sang in.","ref":"Heb 13:15"},"3":{"text":"Assyria in kote hong hon thei lo hi. gal sakol tungah ka tuang kei ding uh hi. Pa nei lote in nang tung pan khuatuahna mu uh ahi manin kote in ka khut uh tawh ka bawlte uh tungah ‘Kote pasiante’ ka ci nawn kei ding uh hi.\" ci un.","ref":"Isa 31:1; Ph 10:14; 68:5; Hos 8:6"},"4":{"text":"\"Amaute tungah heh nawn lo ka hi manin amaute lampialna ka damsak dinga, man ngen loin ka it ding hi.","ref":"Job 13:16"},"5":{"text":"Israel-te tungah keimah daitui ka bang dinga, amah unok pak bangin a pak ding hi. Ama thupina olive kung khat bang dinga, ama namtuina Lebanon tamtak kung khat a bang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 52:8; Jer 11:16; Zaila 4:11"},"7":{"text":"Ama liim ah mite teng kik ding uh a, ankung bangin amah khanpha ding hi. Amah ka dawng dinga, amah ka don ding hi. Keimah taksing hing ka bang hi; na gahphatna kei tung pan ahi hi.\""},"9":{"text":"A pil kua ahi hiam? Amah in hih nate thei ding hi. TOPA lampite maan hi; thumaante in tuate tawn uh hi, ahi hangin a lehdote tuate ah a kimuktu uh hi.","ref":"Ph 107:43; Pn 10:29; Ph 111:7-8; Zep 3:5"}}}}},"29":{"info":{"name":"Joel","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pethuel’ tapa Joel tungah TOPA kammal a tung hi."},"2":{"text":"No upate aw, za un; gamsunga teng khempeuh aw, ngai un. Ahawng teng kheuhkhia-in lawnmang uh a, a hiang kang sengsang bek nusia uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Nungakbit b khat in a khangno lai-a a pasal c a kah bangin puan hampi silhin kap un.","ref":"Isa 22:12; Am 8:10"},"9":{"text":"TOPA inn ah an-a biakna le dawntheih-a biak nading om nawn lo hi. TOPA mai-ah nasem siampite thum uh hi.","ref":"Hos 9:4; Joel 2:14,17"},"10":{"text":"Lote kisia khin a leitang keucipin d lo-a ante kisusia-a, zuthak kangta in, sathau a om nawn kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Lokhote aw, dah un; lenggui cingte aw, thum un; mangbuh le mangbuh-ham cingte aw, dah un; bang hang hiam cih leh lo-a an lak ding khempeuh kisia ta hi.","ref":"Isa 17:11"},"12":{"text":"Lengguite keugaw a, theikungte kungkeu hi. Mihing lungnopna khempeuh beimang ta hi."},"13":{"text":"Biakna-tau mai-a nasem no siampite aw, puan hampi silhin thumin tau un. Ahang in, an-a biakna le dawntheih-a biaknate note Pasian inn ah kibansam ta hi.","title":"Kisik dinga Sapna","ref":"Jer 4:8; Joel 2:17"},"14":{"text":"A siangtho antan sawmin a siangtho kikhop khat sam un. TOPA note Pasian inn ah upate le gama teng mite khempeuh khawm unla TOPA tungah kikokhia un.","ref":"2Kh 20:3"},"15":{"text":"Tua ni aw, tazen aw! Ahang in, TOPA ni nai ta hi. Thahatpenpa a suksiat bangin hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Jer 30:7; Joel 2:1,11,31"},"16":{"text":"Ei mitmuh mahmah in i Pasian inn ah ante - lungnopna le lungdamnate kibansam ta hi lo hiam?"},"17":{"text":"Khaicite leikhal b nuai-ah thangbugamh ta! Saala koih ding an om nawn loin an-saalte kisiagawp ta hi."},"18":{"text":"Ganhonte hamham ta! Ganhonte lopa mu zo loin cimawh uh hi. Tuuhonte nangawn in gimlawh uh hi.","ref":"Jer 9:10"},"19":{"text":"TOPA aw, nang kong ko hi, lonona mun teng mei in hultum a, gam sunga sing khempeuh meikuangin kangtum hi.","ref":"Jer 9:10"},"20":{"text":"Luitui khempeuh kangcipa, lonona munte mei in hultum ahi manin gamsate nangawn husam uh hi.","ref":"1Ku 17:7; Ph 104:21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mut un; ka mual siangtho tungah patau kohna gingsak un. TOPA ni tungta ahi manin gama teng mi khempeuh lingsak ta hen -","title":"Kauphe Galkapte","ref":"Pk 15:17; Zep 1:14-16"},"2":{"text":"lungzin ni le khuamial ni, khuamial ni le meiikai ni nai mahmah ta hi. Ni suaktung vaang mualtung tengah a kiphah bangin a thahat a tam mahmah galkapte hong pai uh hi; tangtawng pana kimu ngei nai lo mailam huna zong a om ngei nawn lo ding ahi hi.","ref":"Da 9:12; Am 5:18; Kil 9:2; Joel 1:6"},"3":{"text":"Amaute mai-ah mei in hula, amaute nungah mei kuang hi. Amau ma-ah leitung teng Eden huan banga, amau nungah bangmah suakta loin sehnel-gam keu a suak hi.","ref":"Ph 105:34-35"},"4":{"text":"Amaute sakol tawh kisun uh a; sakol galkapte bangin koptai uh hi.","ref":"Kil 9:7"},"5":{"text":"Mual tungah a tuan zuahzuah laitakun sakolleng ging banga, mei kanga puak zuahzuah tawh kibangin, galsim dinga kithawi galkap honpi tawh kibang uh hi.","ref":"Kil 9:9; Isa 5:24; 30:30"},"6":{"text":"Amaute a kimuh ciangin minamte lau lua uh hi; maitang khempeuh daanggawp hi.","ref":"Isa 13:8; Na 2:10"},"7":{"text":"Galhangte bangin galsim uh hi; galkapte bangin kulh tungah kah uh hi. A vekun a gualgualin pai uh a, a pialkhia tuam cih bang om lo hi.","ref":"Isa 5:27"},"8":{"text":"Kuama mai kitotsak lo uh a, amau maitek tangtakin nawt uh hi. Nipi le khapi mial a, aksite a tang nawn kei hi.","ref":"Mt 24:29; Isa 13:10; Eze 32:8"},"11":{"text":"A galkapte mai-ah TOPA hawk hi; sim zawh loh galkapte le a thahatte in a thu mang uh hi. TOPA ni thupi mahmah hi-in lauhuai lua mahmah hi. Kua in thuak zo peuhmah ding hiam?","ref":"Joel 1:15; Eze 22:14"},"12":{"text":"Tu nangawnin TOPA in, ‘Lungsimtakpi-in kisik unla, an tangin kap unla thumin kei hong zuan kik un,’ cikhia hi.","title":"Na Lungsim Tamzansak In","ref":"Jer 4:1; Hos 12:6"},"13":{"text":"Puansilh bek hi loin na lungsim uh tamzansak un. TOPA note Pasian lam zuan kik un, ahang in, amah migi-in mi khuatuahpa hi a, lungduai-in it na dim a mawhna liante maisak nuam tawntung hi.","ref":"Isa 57:15; Tp 4:31; Pk 34:6; Jer 18:8"},"14":{"text":"A lungsim khelin hong hehpih kha thei lo ding hiam? An-a biaknate le dawntheih-a biakna ding TOPA note Pasian piak dingin a thupha hong nusiat mawh ding hiam?","ref":"Jer 26:3; Joel 1:13; Hag 2:19"},"15":{"text":"Zion ah pengkul mutin antan nading thu pia unla, kikhopna siangtho khat sam un.","ref":"Jer 36:9"},"16":{"text":"Mite kikhawmsak unla mipite siansuah un. A upate sam unla naupangte le nawi ne naungekte kikhawmsak un. A kitengtung zineipa le mo in a lupna inndei nusia-in pai uhhen.","ref":"Ph 19:5"},"17":{"text":"TOPA mai-a nasem siampite, biakbuk innliim le biakna-tau kikal ah kapin thu ngen uh hen. Amaute in \" TOPA aw, na mite hong hawilai in; nang hong nuihsante na gou luahsak loin mi namdangte lakah, ‘A Pasian uh koi-ah om hiam?’ cisak peuhmah kei in,\" cisak un."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in ama gam aam dinga a mite a hehpih ding hi.","title":"Dawnna","ref":"Zec 1:14"},"19":{"text":"TOPA in amaute dawng a dinga, \"Keimah in an, lenggah zuthak le sathau kong puak hi; na khamtakua na nek dingun kicing ding hi. Minam dangte nuihsatin na om nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 31:12; Eze 34:29"},"20":{"text":"\"Leilu-lam galkapte no kiang pan gamlapi-ah hawlkhia-in leigawtak keugaw gamah ka sawngawp dinga, a madawkte nisuahna tuipi b sungah khia-in a nungdalte nitumna tuipi c sungah ka khia ding hi. Tuate uihin a gimnam lansia mahmah ding hi,\" a ci hi. Amah in na lianpite d bawl khin takpi hi.","ref":"Jer 1:14-15"},"21":{"text":"Leitang aw, lau kei in; nuamin kipak in. TOPA in na lianpite sem khin takpi hi.","ref":"Isa 54:4; Ph 9:2; Ph 126:3"},"22":{"text":"Gamsate aw, lau kei un; gamsung tengah lo no ta hi; singkungte in gah gah ta a, theikungte le lengguite gah pha mahmah ta hi.","ref":"Ph 65:12"},"23":{"text":"Zion mite aw, kipak un; amah in a thumaanna e sikhiau guah hong pia ahi manin TOPA note Pasian tungah lungdam un. Amah in kum dangte bangin khuapi guah zusakin tuk guah le sikhiau guahte hong zusak hi.","ref":"Eze 34:26; Sp 26:4"},"24":{"text":"Ancilna phualah antang dim dinga, na beelpite uh lenggah zuthak le sathau tawh kidimlet ding hi.","ref":"Am 9:13"},"25":{"text":"\"Note lakah kong sawl ka galkap tampi - kauphe honpi le kauphenote, kauphe tuante le kauphe dangte f - kauphete hong neksak kum sunga piang teng kong din kik ding hi.","ref":"Joel 1:6"},"26":{"text":"Nek ding tampi nei-in na hau ding uh a, no adingin nalamdang a sem TOPA note Pasian min na phat ding uh hi; ka mite a kimaizumsak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 25:1; Isa 29:22"},"27":{"text":"Tua ciangin Israel mite lakah kei ka om dinga keimah TOPA note Pasian ka hina le Pasian dang a om loh lam na thei ding uh hi; ka mite a maizum kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Zep 3:11"},"28":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh tungah ka kha ka bua ding hi. Na tanu na tapate un thu hilh ding uh a, na khanghamte un mang manin, na khangnote un mang a mu ding uh hi.","title":"Ni","ref":"Eze 39:29; 1Sa 19:20; Jer 23:25"},"29":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin ka nasem numei le ka nasem pasalte tung nangawn ah ka Kha ka bua ding hi.","ref":"Eze 36:27"},"30":{"text":"Leitung le vante ah a lamdangte sisan, meii le meikhu lompi ka lak ding hi.","ref":"Lk 21:11; Mt 13:24-25"},"31":{"text":"A lauhuai mahmah tua TOPA ni a tun ma-in ni khuamial kisuaksakin, khapi sisan kisuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Mt 24:29; Isa 13:9-10"},"32":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA min a lo khempeuh kihonkhia ding hi; ahang in, TOPA gensa bangin Zion Vum le Jerusalem a, a nungta lai sunte lakah TOPA sap mite kihonkhia ding hi.","ref":"Ro 10:13*; Isa 46:13; Mic 4:7; Ns 2:39"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Tua ni tua hun ciangin Judah le Jerusalem, a nidang hun uh ka bangsak dinga,","title":"Minamte Thu Kikhen"},"2":{"text":"Minam khempeuh khawmin Jehoshaphat g Kuam ah ka paipih suk ding hi. Tua lai-ah ka gouluah, ka mi Israel-te a langbawlna hangun amaute thu ka khen ding hi; ahang in, amaute in ka mite, minamte lakah thehthang uh a, ka gam a hawm uh hi.","ref":"Zep 3:8"},"3":{"text":"Ai sanin, ka mite metbawlin sumzonna-in nei uh a, a zu dawn nadingun numeinote a zuak uh hi.","ref":"Am 2:6"},"4":{"text":"Tyre, Sidon le Philistia kualte khempeuh aw, tu-in kei bang hong cih nuam lai na hi uh hiam? Ka gamtatnasa khatpeuh hong thuk kik na hi uh hiam? Hong thuk kik na hi uh leh kei zong no hong sepsate manlangtakin kong thuk kik pah ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Ka kham, ka ngun le ka gou hoihpente la-in note biakinnpi sungah na puak uh hi."},"6":{"text":"Amau leitang tawh a kigamla theithei dingin Judah le Israel mite Greek-te tungah na zuak uh hi."},"7":{"text":"\"Na en un, amaute na zuakna mun panun ka thosak dinga na gamtatnasate uh no lutang ah hong tu kik ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Na tanu na tapate uh Judah mite tungah ka zuak dinga, amaute in gamlapi-a om Sabea minamte tungah a zuaksawn ding uh hi,\" TOPA in genkhia khin hi.","ref":"Isa 43:5-6; Jer 23:8"},"9":{"text":"Midangte tungah hih thu tangko un: Gal sim dingin kithawi un! Galhangte hansuah un! Galsiam mite galdo dingin naihsak un.","ref":"Isa 8:9; Jer 46:4"},"10":{"text":"Lo khawhna tute namsau-in sek unla, heuhna temte teipi in sek un. A hat lo mite, \"Ka hat hi,\" cisak un.","ref":"Isa 2:4; Mic 4:3; Zec 12:8; Jos 1:6"},"11":{"text":"Minam khempeuh aw, mun khempeuh pan manlang takin hong kuan unla, tua lai-ah kikhawm un. TOPA aw, na galhangte hong puaksuk in.","ref":"Isa 13:3"},"12":{"text":"\"Minamte kithawisak un; Jehushaphat Kuam hong simsuk uh hen. Ahang in, mun khempeuh a minamte thukhen dingin tua lai-ah ka tu ding hi.","ref":"Isa 2:4"},"13":{"text":"An lak hun ta ahi manin na phiaukawi uh vaan un. Amaute gilo lua mahmah uh ahi manin hong pai unla lenggah cilna kuang sunga a dim lenggah bangin cilin lenggah tui dawhna dimletsak un.","ref":"Hos 6:11; Mk 4:29"},"14":{"text":"Thukhenna Kuam sunga mihonpite, mihonpite! Ahang in, thukhenna Kuam ah TOPA thukhenna nai ta hi."},"15":{"text":"Nipi le khapi kimialsak dinga, aksite a tang nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Eze 32:7"},"16":{"text":"Zion panin TOPA hawk dinga, Jerusalem panin kek kia ding hi; lei le van kiling ding hi. Ahi hangin TOPA a mite bukna suak dinga, Israel mite mun muanhuai ahi ding hi.","ref":"Eze 38:19; Ph 46:1; Jer 16:19"},"17":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin keimah TOPA note Pasian, ka mual siangtho Zion ah ka ten lam na thei ding uh hi. Jerusalem siangtho dinga gamdang mite in a zo kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi.","title":"Pasian Mite Thuphate","ref":"Jer 31:40; Isa 52:1"},"18":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mualliante pan lenggahzu thak taak dinga, mualneute ah bawngnawi luang ding hi. Judah gam sunga hawkguam khempeuh ah tui a luang ding hi. Hih in Edom tawh kisai Thupipen TOPA thugen ahi hi - TOPA tung pan thupuak ka za khin uh hi: Minamte tungah palai khat kisawl khin a, \"Kithawi un, amah do dingin kuan ni,\" - kicisak hi.","ref":"Jer 49:7-22; Isa 18:12; Jer 6:4-5"},"2":{"text":"\"En un, minamte lakah note kong neusak dinga, hong kisimmawh mahmah ding hi."},"3":{"text":"Suangpi a kitamte sungah tenga, asanna munte ah inn lamin, ‘Kua in leitungah hong kaikhiasuk zo ding hiam?’ a ci note aw, na lungsim kiphatsakna un note hong khem khin zo hi.","ref":"Isa 14:13-15; Isa 16:6"},"4":{"text":"Muvanlai bangin sangpi ah laamtoin aksite lakah bu na tom hangin tua panin kong kaikhiasuk veve ding hi\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Hab 2:9; Jer 49:14-16; Isa 14:13"},"5":{"text":"\"Zanin na kiangah gutate le misuamte hong pai-in - supna lianpi na thuak hangin - amaute deihzah bek hong guksak ding hi lo hiam? Nang in mi hehpih thei-in, mi a khuatuah Pasian, heh hakin itna lungsim a nei Pasian, siatna tunsak nading a khel theipa na hilam ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Tu-in TOPA aw, ka nuntak ding sangin ka sih ding hoihzaw ahi manin ka nuntakna lakhia in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Ku 19:4; Ph 86:5,15"},"4":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in, \"Heh theih nading thu nei na hi hiam?\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"5":{"text":"Jonah paikhia-a khuapi nisuahna lam mun khatah a tu hi. Amah in, \"Ka nei hi, sih na ding khopin ka heh hi,\" a ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Ahi hangin TOPA in, \"Nang posak loh, nang gimpih loh hih lenggui na awlmawh hi. Zan khat thu-in khanga, zan khat mahin a si hi."},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin Nineveh in avei le atak a gen thei lo mihing tulza le tul sawmnih tham lo ganhing tampi a nei zaw hi. Keimah in tua a lian mahmah khuapi awlmawh zaw lo ding ka hi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jnh 1:2; 3:10"}}}}},"33":{"info":{"name":"Micah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpi in Jotham, Ahaz le Hezekiah-te aman laitak, Moresheth mi Micah tungah TOPA thupiak - Samaria le Jerusalem tawh kisai a mangmuhna ahi hi.","ref":"Jer 26:18"},"2":{"text":"No mihingte khempeuh aw, ngai unla za un; leitung le a sunga omte khempeuh aw, Topa Thupipen TOPA in a biakinnpi siangtho panin note langkhatah teci a pang hi.","ref":"Jer 6:9; Ph 11:4"},"3":{"text":"En un! A tenna mun panin TOPA hong pai hi; hong paisuka leitunga munsangte a siksuk hi.","title":"Samaria le Jerusalem Langah Thukhenna","ref":"Am 4:13"},"4":{"text":"Ama mai-ah mualliante tuisuak in, guamte kikhenkham dinga mei gei-a khuainun koih le ken-a tui luangsuk abang ding hi.","ref":"Ph 46:2,6"},"5":{"text":"Hihte khempeuh Jacob khialhna hang, Israel innkuante mawhna hang ahi hi. Hih bang thute gen huai lo hi; tua bangte in ko hong minsiasak zo kei ding hi,\" a ci uh hi.","title":"Kamsang Zuaute","ref":"Am 2:12; Mic 6:16"},"7":{"text":"Jacob innkuante aw, \" TOPA Kha heh ahi hiam? A kumpipa uh amaute mai-ah pai-in TOPA amaute mai-ah a masa ding hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin keimah in, \"No Jacob makaite, Israel innkuan gam-ukte aw, ngai un. Thutang thei lo ding na hi uh hiam?\" ka ci hi.","ref":"Zep 3:3; Job 24:14; Eze 11:7"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute TOPA tungah kiko ding uh a, ahi hangin a dawng kei ding hi. Eite tungah siatna hong tung kei ding hi,\" ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 7:4"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin nangma hangin Zion khua sung lo bangin kikho dinga, Jerusalem ninkholnapi suakin, biakinnpi omna mual gammang lak a suak ding hi.","ref":"Jer 26:18"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nunung ni ciangin mualliante lakah TOPA biakinnpi mual a lianpenin kikoih ding hi; mualneute tungah kilaamto dinga, mite in a zuan ding uh hi.","title":"’ Mual","ref":"Zec 8:3"},"2":{"text":"Minam tampite pai-in, \"Hong pai un, Jacob innkuante’ Pasian’ inn omna TOPA mualtungah kahto ni, ama lampi i tot theih nadingin a lampi hong hilh ding hi,\" ci ding uh hi. Tua ni-a kipan Zion mual tungah TOPA in a uk tawntung ding hi.","ref":"Mic 2:12"},"8":{"text":"Tuuhon cinna tausang aw, Zion tanu’ mun muanhuai a aw, na kumpi-gam uh no hong kipia kik ding hi; Jerusalem tanu kumpi hi ding hi.","ref":"Isa 1:26"},"9":{"text":"Bang hangin nakpi-a kap na hi hiam - kumpi nei lo na hi hiam? Amaute in molhtumin Israel gam-ukpa biang sat ding uh hi.","title":"Bethlehem Pan Ukpa Kamciam"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin nang Bethlehem Ephrathah aw, Judah bawng’te b sung pan aneu na hi hangin nang sungah Israel ukpa ding khat kei adingin a piangkhia ding hi; amah tanglai hunte pan c tangtawng pek pana d omsa ahi hi.","ref":"Jn 7:42; Pc 48:7; 1Sa 13:14; Mt 2:6*"},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin numei in nausuah hun khempeuh a khit hun mateng Israel kinusia phot dinga, a omlaisun a sanggamte, Israel mite pawl dingin a ciah kik ding uh hi."},"4":{"text":"TOPA hatna sungah amah dingkipin, TOPA ama Pasian min thupi sungah a tuuhonte a cing ding hi. Tuanu kisiatna ka mitin ka mu ding hi; tu nangawnin lam lian a buandim bangin khe tawh a kituancil ding hi.","ref":"Ph 35:26"},"11":{"text":"Na kulh uh cian kik ding ni le na gamgite uh a kikhan ni hong tung ding hi.","ref":"Isa 54:11"},"12":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin mite Assyria pan le Egypt khuapite pan, Egypt pan Eupharates ciang dong nangawn le tuipi pan tuipi dong le muallian pan muallian dongin na kiangah hong pai ding uh hi.","ref":"Isa 19:23-25"},"13":{"text":"A tunga teng mite gamtatnasa hangin leitung gamkhing a suak ding hi."},"14":{"text":"Lei hoiha lonona mun tulaka a amau le amau a teng na innluah ding na mite, nangma tuuhonte na ciangkhutin cing in.
