Tua hi taleh ko hong simgawp minamte tungah kisiat ding ni lungduaitakin ka ngak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 37:7"},"17":{"text":"Theikungte a pak kei zongin, lenggui ah lenggah gah loin, olive a gah kei zongin, lote ah an piang loin, tuubuk sungah tuu khatbeek a om kei zongin gankholna khempeuh hawm khin ta leh,","ref":"Joel 10:1-12"},"18":{"text":"TOPA sungah ka lungnuam lai veve dinga, ka Pasian kei hong Honpa sungah ka lungnuam veve ding hi.","ref":"Pk 15:2"},"19":{"text":"Thupipen TOPA keima thahatna hi; ka khepekte sazukpi khe bangsaka, asanna munte ah hong paizosak hi. Tumtheih makaipa ading. Ka khausai tumging pan ahi hi.","ref":"Tp 33:29; Tp 32:13"}}}}},"36":{"info":{"name":"Zephaniah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah kumpipa Amon tapa Josiah in kumpi a sep hun laitakin Hezekiah tapa Amariah tapa Gedaliah tapa Cushi tapa Zephaniah tungah TOPA thu tung a:","ref":"2Ku 22:1; 1Kh 3:14"},"2":{"text":"\"Lei maitang panin na khempeuh ka phiatmai ding hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","title":"Siatna Tun ding Vauhilhna"},"3":{"text":"\"Mihing ganhing ka phiatmai khawm dinga; huihlak vasate le tuipi sunga ngasate ka phiatmai ding hi. Lei maitang panin mite ka khenkhiat ciangin migilote in van sia lomtang a bek a nei ding uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi.","ref":"Jer 50:3; Jer 4:25; Hos 4:3"},"4":{"text":"\"Judah langkhat le Jerusalem a tengte khempeuh tungah ka khut ka zankhia ding hi. Hih mun panin Baal them om lai sunte le lawkite minte le milimte biakna-a siampite-","title":"Judah Langah","ref":"Jer 6:12"},"5":{"text":"innkhum tungah kah a, aksi honte bia-a kunte, TOPA tawh kiciama a kunte le Molech b tawh a kiciamte zong,","ref":"Sp 18:21"},"6":{"text":"TOPA zuihna panin a kilehheite le TOPA zong lo-a a kan lote khempeuh ka khenkhia ding hi.","ref":"Hos 7:7"},"7":{"text":"TOPA ni nai ta ahi manin Thupipen TOPA mai-ah daitakin om un. Biakna pia dingin TOPA kithawi khin hi; a sapsate siansuah khin hi.","ref":"Isa 13:6; Isa 41:1; Sp 3:9"},"8":{"text":"TOPA biakna piak ni-in kumpi uliante, kumpi tapate le gamdang puana kizemte dan ka tuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Jer 39:6"},"9":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin kongpi c pela paikhia khempeuh ngongtatna le khemna tawh amau pasiante’ biakinn a dimsakte dan ka pia ding hi.","ref":"1Sa 5:5"},"10":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Tua ni ciangin Ngasa Kongpi ah kahna aw ging dinga, Vengthak panin thumna le mualneute tung panin a ngaih mahmah kisukna kiza ding hi.","ref":"2Kh 33:14; Am 5:16"},"11":{"text":"No sumbuk venga omte thum un; na sumbuk khempeuh uh kiphiatmang d dinga, ngun e a sum zong peuhmah kisia ding uh hi.","ref":"Jas 5:1; Hos 9:6"},"12":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin meivak zangin Jerusalem ka zong dinga, amah bek nuam a sate, lenggah zu tawdat banga, \" TOPA in a sia a pha bangmah bawl lo hi,’ a cite dan ka tuaksak ding hi.","ref":"Am 6:1; Jer 48:11; Job 22:13; 2Ku 21:16"},"13":{"text":"A hauhna uh kilaksak dinga, a innte uh a kisiagawp ding hi. Amaute in inn a lam uh hangin a sungah teng lo ding uh hi; lenggui a suan uh hangin a zu a dawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"2Ku 24:13"},"14":{"text":"\" TOPA ni lianpi ni nai ta - nai ta a, manlangin a tung ding hi. Ngai un! TOPA ni-a kahna, galhangte kikona nasia mahmah ding hi.","ref":"Eze 7:7","title":"’ Ni Lianpi Ni"},"15":{"text":"Tua ni pen thangpaih ni, lungdon ni le dah ni, patauh ni le kisiat ni, khuamial ni le lungzin ni, meiipi kai-a khuamial ni,","ref":"1Sa 2:9; Isa 22:5"},"16":{"text":"pengkul ni le kulha ki-um khuapite le a kiu-a tausangte sima galkapte a ot ni hi ding hi.","ref":"Jer 4:19; Tp 28:52"},"17":{"text":"Mite tungah lungdonna ka tungsak dinga, amaute mittaw lampai bang ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute TOPA tungah a mawh zo uh hi. A sisante uh leivui bangin kisungkhia dinga, a gilzangte uh nin kihhuai a bang ding hi.","ref":"Isa 59:10; Ph 79:3"},"18":{"text":"TOPA thangpaihna ni ciangin a ngun a khamte un amaute a honkhia thei kei ding hi. Amah in thakhatin a tawpna tungsak ding ahi manin ama aamluatna mei in leitung buppi le leitanga teng khempeuh a kangtum ding hi,\"","ref":"Job 20:20; Zep 3:8"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A zumhuai minamte aw, na vekun kikhawm un;","ref":"Jer 3:3; 2Kh 20:4"},"2":{"text":"ansi bangin hong kizapkhiat ni ding kiciangtan ni a tun ma, TOPA hehluatna no tungah hong tun ma, TOPA thangpaihna ni no tungah hong tun ma-in na vekun kikhawm un.","ref":"Isa 17:13"},"3":{"text":"Leitung ah kiniamkhiatin ama thupiak banga gamta note khempeuh aw, TOPA zong un.Thumaanna zong unla kiniamkhiatna zong un; tua hileh TOPA hehna ni ciangin note hong kiliah kha thei ding hi.","ref":"Ph 45:4; Ph 57:1"},"4":{"text":"Gaza kitaisanin Ashkelon a siasa-in kinusia ding hi. Suntangpi-in Ashdod hawmmang dinga, Akron kibulkalh ding hi.","title":"Philistia Langah"},"5":{"text":"No Kereth mite aw, no tuipi gei-a tengte aw, gimna nak thuak na nucia! Philistia-te tenna nang Canaan aw, nang langkhatah TOPA in thu gen zo hi. \"Nang kong susia dinga, kuamah a kinusia nawn kei ding hi,\"","ref":"1Sa 30:14; Sp 26:31"},"6":{"text":"Tuipi gei-a leitang, Kereth-te a tenna teng, tuucingte om nading le tuuhuang ding ahi hi.","ref":"Isa 5:17"},"7":{"text":"Judah innkuan a omlaisunte in tuate a tang ding uh hi; tualai lonona munin a zang ding uh hi. Nitak ciangin amaute Asklon-te inn sungah a lum ding uh hi. TOPA amaute Pasian in kem dinga, a mailam hun b uah angei a bangsak ding hi.","ref":"Tp 30:3"},"8":{"text":"\"Moab-te in ka mite a simmawhna le Ammon-te in a selnohna uh, a gamte uh sutin a elpaunate uh ka za khin hi.","ref":"Jer 48:27; Eze 21:28; Ta 3:61","title":"Moab le Ammon Langah"},"9":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin Israel-te Pasian Thahatpen TOPA in, \"Ka nuntakna ka lo hi, Moab pen Sodom tawh kibangin, Ammon-te Gomorrah bang tektek ding uh a- a gam uh bangmah a kimang lo lopa bek pona cikhuk a suak den ding hi. A baanglai ka mite in amaute manmang ding uh hi; a omlai ka minamte in amaute gam a luah ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 23:6; Jer 49:1-6; Isa 11:14"},"10":{"text":"Thahatpen TOPA mite simmawhin ciamnuih bawl uh ahi manin amaute kiphatna thamanin hihte a ngah ding uh hi.","ref":"Ph 9:6"},"11":{"text":"TOPA in amaute gama pasiante a suksiat ciangin amaute a lausak mahmah ding hi. Tuipi mong khempeuh a minamte in amau leitang ciat panin amah bia ding uh hi.","ref":"1Kh 19:1; Joel 2:11; Ph 86:9"},"12":{"text":"\"Cush-te c aw, note zong ka namsau in hong kithat ding hi.\"","title":"Cush Langah"},"13":{"text":"Amah in leilu-lam langkhatah a khut zankhia dinga Assyria susia-in Nineveh nusiacip dinga sehnel-gam bangin a keu ding hi.","title":"Assyria Langah","ref":"Isa 10:5; Pc 10:11"},"14":{"text":"Tuuhonte, bawnghonte le ganhing namkim tua lai-ah a lum ding hi. Sehnel-gam simbu le simbu awngaihte in inn khuampi dawn giahna-in nei ding uh hi. A khuan un kongvangneu ah thawnkhia-in kongkalai-ah leisek tawng om dinga, innkam a kikhung tamtak singte a kidawkkhia ding hi.","ref":"Isa 5:17; Isa 14:23"},"15":{"text":"Bangmah a awlmawh lo lungmuangtaka tenna khuapi hizahta a suak hi. Tuanu amah le amah, \"Keimah bek, kei bang kuamah om kei,\" kici hi. Tua khua nak siat nah e, gamsate omna lah a suak tazen a! Tua lai a tawnkha peuhmah in selpho-in a khut uh lehsan uh hi.","ref":"Isa 32:9; Eze 28:2; Jer 49:33; Eze 27:36"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mite nengniamin a lehdo a kihhuai khuapi, gimna nak thuak na nicia!","title":"Jerusalem Mailam Hun","ref":"Jer 6:6"},"2":{"text":"Amah in kuama thu mang loin kuama bawlphat ding a ut kei hi. Tuanu in TOPA muang loin a Pasian kiang a naih nuam kei hi.","ref":"Jer 22:21; Tp 1:32; Ph 73:28"},"3":{"text":"A uliante humpinelkai hawk hi uh a, a gam-ukte a zing-an ding bangmah a nei lo khuamial kuana keivomte ahi uh hi.","ref":"Mic 3:3; Pc 49:29"},"4":{"text":"A kamsangte uh ki-uangsakin zuautat mi hi uh hi. A siampite in mun siangtho thanghuaisak uh a, thukham tungah a ngongtat uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tuanu sungah TOPA thumaan a, khialhna a bawl kei hi. Zingsang khat khit zingsang khat a thutangna zekkhia a, nisimin a zekkhia lo ngei kei hi. Tua hi napi thumaan lote in zumna mel a thei kei uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 9:15; Tp 32:4; Jer 3:3"},"6":{"text":"\"Minamte ka khenkhia khin hi; a panmun muanhuaite uh kisumang khin hi. A kongzingte uh kuama tot loh dingin ka kinusiacipsak hi; a khuapite uh kisia khin hi; kuamah kinusia loin-kuamah a om peuhmah kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Khuapi kiangah, ‘Kei hong kihta in hong kibawlphatnate sang nuam ta niteh maw!’ ka ci hi. Tua ciangin ama sunga teng mite kikhenkhia nawn lo dinga, a tungah ka dan piaknate khempeuh zong a tung kei ding hi. Ahi hangin a sep ngeite uh sep ding a lawp lai veve ding uh hi.","ref":"Jer 7:28; Hos 9:9"},"8":{"text":"TOPA in cikhia hi, \"Tua ahi ciangin ka mawhsak a ding ni na ngak un; ka hehluatna khempeuh- amaute tunga ka thangpaihna a thuak dingin minamte kumpi-gamte tawh kaihkhop ding ka lungsim ka khentat khin zo hi. Haza a ka hehluatna meikuang in leitung buppi a kangtum ding hi.","ref":"Ph 27:14; Jer 10:25; Ph 79:6; Isa 2:3; Zep 1:18"},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh in TOPA min lo in liangko kinawkin a na a sep theih nadingun mite muk ka siangthosak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 19:18"},"10":{"text":"Cush b gunpite gal panin keimah biakna hong piate, ka thehthang mite in biakna hong puak ding uh hi.","ref":"Pc 10:6"},"11":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin kei tunga nong khialhna khempeuh hangin kong maizumsak kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh hih khuapi panin amau kiphatsakna nuam a sate ka lakhia ding hi. Ka mual siangtho tungah nang na kiphasak nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Pc 50:15; Ph 59:12; Pk 15:17"},"12":{"text":"Ahi hangin note lakah TOPA min a muang a kiniamkhiatte le a lungnemte ka nusia ding hi.","ref":"Jer 29:12"},"13":{"text":"Israel a baanglaite in khialhna a bawl nawn kei ding uh hi; zuauthu gen lo ding uh a, a kam uah khemna kimu nawn lo ding hi. Amaute in an ne in lum hithiat ding uh a, kuamah in a lausak nawn kei ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:21; Job 16:17; Eze 34:15"},"14":{"text":"Zion Tanu aw, la sa in; Israel aw, kikokhia in! Jerusalem Tanu aw, na lungsim neihzahin lungdamin nuam in!","ref":"Ph 9:2"},"15":{"text":"TOPA in na dan thuak ding tawh hong kipelhsak khin hi; na galte hong kilehhawlsak zo hi. TOPA Israel-te Kumpipa, note tawh omkhawm khin hi; note in kisiatna peuhmah na kihta ngei nawn kei ding uh hi.","ref":"Eze 37:26-28; Zec 9:9"},"16":{"text":"Tua ni ciangin amaute in Jerusalem tungah, \"Zion aw, lau kei in; na khutte zawsak kei in.","ref":"2Ku 19:26"},"17":{"text":"TOPA na Pasian in hong ompih hi, nang hong hon dingin amah thahat hi. Amah nang tungah lungkim mahmah dinga, ama itna tawh daitakin hong omsakin no tungah lungnuamin la sa ding hi,\"","ref":"Isa 63:1; Tp 28:63; Hos 14:4; Isa 40:1"},"18":{"text":"\"A kisehsa pawi hanga na dahnate uh kong lakkhiatsak ding hi; tuate in note adingin vangikpi le mawhsakna ahi hi. c"},"19":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin nang hong nengcipte khempeuh dan ka pia dinga, khebaite hu-in a kithehthangte ka kaikhawm ding hi. Amaute omna gam peuhpeuh ah, a maizumna uh phatna le pahtawina ka suaksak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 14:2; Eze 34:16; Isa 60:18"},"20":{"text":"Tua hun ciangin nang kong khawm dinga; tua hun ciangin inn ah nang kong ciahpih ding hi. Na mailam hun a ka hoihsak ciangin note mitmuh tektekin leitung mite lakah hong pahtawi-in kong phat ding hi,\" TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Jer 29:14; Joel 3:1; Isa 56:5"}}}}},"37":{"info":{"name":"Haggai","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kumpipa Darius in a uk a kum nihna kum, a kha gukna a ni masa ni-in kamsangpa Haggai tungtawnin TOPA in, Judah gam-ukpa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel tung le tulpipa Jehozadak tapa Joshua a tungah thu a gen hi:","title":"Inn Lam dinga Sapna","ref":"Ezr 4:24"},"2":{"text":"Hih in Thahatpen TOPA thugen ahi hi: \"Hih mite in ‘ TOPA inn lam ding hun tung nai lo hi,’ ci uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 13:4; 29:13"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin kamsangpa Haggai tungtawnin TOPA kammal tunga:"},"4":{"text":"\"Hih inn kisiagawpsa-a a om laitakin note inn nopci mahmah ah na om uh kilawm ahi hiam?\" a ci hi.","ref":"Ezr 5:1"},"5":{"text":"Tu-in Thahatpen TOPA in, \"Na omzia uh lim ngaihsut dih un."},"6":{"text":"Tampitak na suan uh hangin tawmkha bek na at uh hi. Na nek uh hangin na gil uh a vah kei hi. Na dawn uh hangin na duhna uh a kam zo kei hi. Puan na silh uh a na khua uh a lum kei hi. Sum na thalawh uh a sum-ip tawvang khata koih bang lel thaman na ngah uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Sp 26:10; Ta 3:40"},"7":{"text":"Hih in Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: \"Na lampi uh lim ngaihsut dih un."},"8":{"text":"Mualtungah kuanto unla singbeu va pua un, keimah a sungah omin nuamtak tengin hong kipahtawi theih nading inn lam un,\" TOPA in ci hi."},"9":{"text":"\"Note in tampitak na lamet uh hangin tawmcik bek pha mawk hi. Inn a na tutsate uh ka mutmang hi. Bang hang hiam?\" Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi. \"Tua pen note khempeuh na inn ding ciat uh lamin na manlah uh a, kei inn a siasa-a a om hang ahi hi."},"10":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin note hangin vante in daitui kangsaka, leitang in gah a gahsak kei hi."},"11":{"text":"Keimah in lote le mualliante tung, ankungte tung, lenggui thak, sathau le lei pana piangte peuhmah, mihingte le ganhonte le khuta na sep uh nate khempeuh tungah guah ka haang hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"1Kh 14:1"},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel, tulpipa Jehozadak tapa Johua le a baanglaite khempeuh in TOPA amaute Pasian thu le kamsangpa Haggai thupuak a mang uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh TOPA amaute Pasian in amah a sawl ahi hi. Tua hi-a mite in TOPA a kihta uh hi.","ref":"Isa 1:9; Hag 2:2"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA kamtaipa Haggai in mite tungah hih TOPA thugente puaka TOPA in, \"‘Note kong ompih hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin TOPA in Judah gam-ukpa Shealtiel tapa Jerubbabel lungsim, tulpipa Jehozadak tapa Joshua lungsim le a baanglai mite lungsim a phonglo hi. Amaute in amau Pasian Thahatpen TOPA inn lam a kipan uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ni pen Kumpi Darius in a uk zawh a kum nihna kum a kha gukna a ni sawmnih le li ni ahi hi.","ref":"Ms 27:21"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kha sagihna a ni sawmnih le khatna ni-in kamsang Haggai tungah TOPA thu tunga:","title":"Inn Thak Minthanna Kamciam"},"2":{"text":"\"Judah gam ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Jerubbabel, tulpi Jehozadak tapa Joshua, le a baanglai mite hopih inla amaute kiangah,"},"3":{"text":"\"A masa inn thupina a mu no lakah na om uh hiam? Tu-a pen tawh bang na ci muh uh hiam? No muhna ah bangmah man lo abang hiam?"},"4":{"text":"Ahi zongin tu-in Jerubbabel aw, kihatsak in, ‘ TOPA in ci hi.’ Jehozadak tapa tulpi Joshua aw, kihatsak in, no gamsunga tengte khempeuh aw, kihatsak unla na sem un, ‘ TOPA in cikhia hi. Ahang in, keimah in kong ompih hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"5":{"text":"Hih in Egypt pana na paikhiat lai-un note tawh ka thukhun ahi hi. Tua hi-a keima Kha note lakah om lai hi. Lau kei un,’ ci hi.","ref":"Sp 23:34"},"6":{"text":"\"Thahatpen TOPA in hih hong ci hi: ‘ A sawt loin vantungte le leitung tuipi le leikeu, khat vei ka lok kik ding hi."},"7":{"text":"Minam khempeuh ka lok dinga minam khempeuh deihna hong tungin hih inn minthanna tawh a kidim ding hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in ci hi."},"8":{"text":"Ngunte keima aa hi a, khamte zong keima aa mah ahi hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi."},"9":{"text":"‘A masa inn minthanna sangin tu laitaka inn a minthangzaw ding hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in ci hi. ‘Tua hi-a hih munah kilemna ka pia ding hi.’Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 10:25"},"10":{"text":"Darius in a uk a kum nihna kha kua kha a ni sawmnih le lina ni-in kamsang Haggai tungah TOPA thu tunga:"},"11":{"text":"\"Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi, ‘Thukham genna siampite dong in:","title":"A Buahsa Mite’ Thuphate"},"12":{"text":"Mi khat in a ki-apsa sa them khat a puan kikhep kawmah pua henla, tua a puantualpi kikhepna in anlum pawlkhat ahikeh a kihuan an, lenggahzu pawlkhat, sathau ahikeh an dang khatpeuh sukha leh tua a sukkhak pen a ki-apsa an a suak ding hiam,’ ci in,\" a ci hi. Siampite in, \"Suak lo hi,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi.","ref":"Sp 10:10-11; Hag 1:15; Sp 22:4-6"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin Haggai in, \"Mi khat misi tawh a kisukkhaka a nin a suah khit ciangin hih nate khatpeuh a lawn leh tua a lawn pen anin a suak ding hiam?\" a ci hi. Siampite in, \"Hihi, anin a suak hi,\" ci-in a dawng uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua ciangin Haggai in, \"Hih mite le hih minamte kei muhna ah tua tawh kibang uh hi,\" TOPA in cikhia hi. ‘A sep peuhpeuh, a piak peuhpeuh uh anin ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"\"‘Tu-in, tuni tekteka kipan a hih thu limtakin ngaihsun un. TOPA biakinnpi ding suang a kician ma-in nate bangci om hiam, cih ngaihsun un."},"16":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh tehna sawmnih a vum omna ah a pai ciangin tehna sawm bek na om hi. Mi khatpeuh lengahzu tehna beelpi sawmnga omna ah a pai ciangin tehna sawm nih bek a pha hi."},"17":{"text":"Khuta na sepsate khempeuh uh cinghteeksak, maaibuaksakin, gialpi ka densak hangin kei lamah nong kihei nai kei uh hi,’ TOPA in ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tuni-a kipan mailam ah tu-a khakua na kha ni sawmnih le li ni TOPA biakinnpi bulpi a kiphuh ni-a kipan limtakin ngaihsun un. Limtakin ngaihsun un:"},"19":{"text":"Na saal sunguah anci om nawn lo ahi hiam? Tuhun dong lenggui le theikung, mang kawlsing le olive kungte gah nai lo hi. \"‘Tuni-a kipan note thupha kong pia ding hi,’ci hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 28:22; Hag 1:5; Pc 12:2; Sp 25:21"},"20":{"text":"Tua kha a ni sawmnih le li ni-in Haggai tungah TOPA thu a nihveina tunga:"},"21":{"text":"\"Judah ukpipa Zerubbabel tungah vante le leitung ka lok nading thu gen in.","title":"Seal Zungbuh Zerubbabel"},"22":{"text":"Keimah in kumpi tokhomte lumletin, gamdang kumpi-gamte’ vangliatna ka beisak ding hi. Sakollengte le a hawlte ka lawnthal ding hi; sakolte le a tunga tuangte ama sanggampa namsau mahin a tuk ding uh hi.","ref":"Ezr 5:1; Job 2:13"},"23":{"text":"\"Thahatpen TOPA in, ‘Tua ni ciangin ka nasempa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel aw, nang kong la ding hi,’ TOPA in cikhia hi. ‘Nang hong teel khin ka hi manin ka seal zungbuh bangin kong bawl ding hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia hi, ci in,\" a ci hi."}}}}},"38":{"info":{"name":"Zechariah","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Darius uk a kum nihna a kha giatna kha-in Iddo tapa Berekiah tapa kamsangpa Zechariah tungah TOPA thu tunga:","title":"Lamah Kihei dinga Sapna","ref":"Ezr 4:24"},"2":{"text":"\"Na pu na pate uh tungah TOPA heh mahmah hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin mite tungah gen in: Thahatpen TOPA gen hih ahi hi: ‘Kei lamah hong kihei un, Thahatpen TOPA in cikhia a, ‘tua teh no lamah kong kihei ding hi,’ Thahatpen TOPA in ci hi."},"4":{"text":"Na pu na pate uh bang kei un; kamsang masate in amaute tungah tangko uh a, Hih in Thahatpen TOPA gen ahi hi: ‘Na gitlohna uh le na gitloh gamtatna panin kihei un,’ ci hi. Ahi hangin amaute in a thu ngai loin, kei hong thusim lo uh hi, TOPA in cikhia hi."},"5":{"text":"Tu-in na pu na pate uh koi-ah om hiam? Kamsangte e leh, amaute nungta den uh ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka nasem kamsangte tunga ka thupiak thute le thukipte, na pute uh tungah tung lo ahi hiam? \"Tua ciangin amaute kisik uh a, ‘Hih dinga a geelsa bang tektekin i gamtatna tawh kizui-in eite tungah Thahatpen TOPA in hong sem ta hi,’ ci-in gen in,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 12:14-17"},"7":{"text":"Darius in a uk a kum nihna sung, kha sawm le khatna Shebat kha ni sawmnih le li ni-in Iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa kamsangpa Zechariah tungah TOPA thu a tung hi."},"8":{"text":"Zan laitakin mang ka mu a - ka mai-ah mi khat sakol san tungah a tuang hi! Amah kuam thukpi sung khata mui singkung lakah a ding hi. A nungah sakol asan, apuang le akangte a om uh hi.","title":"Mui Singkung Lakah Mi","ref":"Zec 6:2-7; Kil 6:4"},"9":{"text":"Keimah in, \"Ka topa aw, hihte bang ahi hiam?\" ci-in ka dong hi. Siampite aw, ka min a simmawh note na hi uh hi. \"Ahi hangin, ‘Na min bangci simmawh ka hi uh hiam?’ ci-in nong dong uh hi.","ref":"Sp 20:9; Lk 6:46","title":"A Kawkbaang biakpiaknate"},"7":{"text":"\"Ka biakna-tau tungah an ninsa na koih uh hi. \"Ahi hangin,’Bang hong ci nitsak ka hi uh hiam?’ ci-in nong dong uh hi. \" TOPA sabuai simmawhhuai na ci uh hi.","ref":"Sp 21:6"},"8":{"text":"Biakpiakna dingin ganhing mittaw nong ken uh ciangin khialhna hi lo ahi hiam? Hong sang na diam?\" Thahatpen TOPA in ci hi.","ref":"Sp 1:3"},"9":{"text":"\"Tu-in Pasian in note hong hehpih theih nadingin thum un. Mihing Tapa hong pai ciangin zong tua mah bang hi ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Lo khokhawm mi nih, khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"41":{"text":"An gawi khawm numei nihte khat kila-in khat kinusia ding hi."},"42":{"text":"\"Tua ahi ciangin na Topa uh hong pai ding hun thei lo na hi manun na kigalging un."},"43":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in hih thu na theitel un: Inn neipa in zan lai bang hunin gutate pai ding hiam, cih theikhol hileh na kigalging dinga, a inn a kiluhsak kei ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Tua hi-a na lamet loh laitakun Mihing Tapa hong pai ding ahi manin kigingsa in om den un."},"45":{"text":"\"Tua ahileh ama inn sunga nasem dangte ukin, amaute a hunhunin an a pia dinga a pu in a koih a muanhuai a pil nasempa kua ahi hiam?"},"46":{"text":"A pu a ciah kik ciangin tua banga a sep laitak a tuah nasempa a hampha ding hi."},"47":{"text":"Thutak kong geninah, a pu in tuapa a neihsa khempeuh a saisak ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi hangin tua nasempa mi tatsia khat hi henla, ‘Ka pu sawt veipi hong tam ding hi,’ ci-in"},"49":{"text":"a naseppihte satin, zu khamkhamte tawh ne-in dawnkhawm leh a,"},"50":{"text":"tua nasempa a pu a upmawhloh ni le a khuadon loh hun laitakin tung leh,"},"51":{"text":"tua nasempa a pu in atnenin, kahna le hagawina a omna munah kineihsiamte tawh a koihkhawm ding hi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Tua hun ciangin vantung gam in a meivakte uh kengin zineipa dawn dinga kuankhia nungak bit sawmte tawh kibang ding hi.","title":"Nungak Bit Sawmte Gentehna"},"2":{"text":"Tuate lakah nga hai-a nga a pil hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua a hai teng in meivak keng napi, meitui a keng kei uh hi."},"4":{"text":"A pilte in ahileh a meivak uh leh thawl sungah meitui a keng uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Zineipa tung hak lua ahi manin a vekun ihmut suakin a ihmu uh hi."},"6":{"text":"\"Zankim laitakin, ‘Zineipa hong tung ta hi! Hih kong genna pen Beelzebub suangin dawite hawlkhia nong cih man uh ahi hi."},"19":{"text":"Tu-in ken Beelzebub suangin dawite hawlkhia ka hileh, na nungzuite un kua suangin dawite hawlkhia uh ahi hiam? Tua mipa nuntakzia a nunung in, a masa sangin a siazaw hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"2Pe 2:20"},"27":{"text":"Jesu in hih thute a gen laitakin mihonpite lak pan numei khat in, \"Nang ta-a hong nei hong don nu, thupha ngah ahi hi,\" a gal cih hi.","ref":"Lk 23:29"},"28":{"text":"Amah in, \"Pasian thu za-a a mangte, thupha ngah hizaw hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Heb 4:12,13"},"29":{"text":"Mihonte a tam semsem ciangin Jesu in, \"Hihte, a tatsia khangmite ahi hi. Amaute in lim lamdang hong nget uh hangin Jonah lim longal lim khat beek a kilak kei ding hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahang in, Nineveh-te adingin Jonah, lim a suah bangin Mihing Tapa zong hih khang mite adingin lim hi ding hi.","title":"Jonah Lim"},"31":{"text":"Solomon pilna ngai dingin leitaw lam Kumpinu lei mong panin va pai to ahi manin amah in thukhen ni ciangin hih khang mite tawh dingin amaute a mawhpaih ding hi.Tu-in hih lai-ah Solomon sanga lianzaw khat j a om hi."},"32":{"text":"Thukhen ni ciangin Nineveh khua mite, hih khang mite tawh ding khawmin amaute a mawhpaih ding uh hi. Tu-in hih lai-ah Jonah sanga lianzaw khat a om hi.","ref":"Jnh 1:17"},"33":{"text":"\"Kuamah in, meivak vakin a kimuh loh nading mun ahikeh kuangkum nuai-ah a koih kei hi. Tua ciangin amah pai-in sabuai ah a kingam hi."},"38":{"text":"Ahi hangin an a nek ma-in Jesu a kisil masak loh lam tua Pharisee-pa in a theih ciangin lamdang a sa hi.","title":"Gimna Gukte","ref":"Mk 7:3-4"},"39":{"text":"Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, \"Ahileh no Pharisee-te in hai le kuangte a pualam na silsiang uh hangin na sunglam uh huaihamna le tatsiatna tawh a kidim hi."},"40":{"text":"No mihai honte! Tua hileh note adingin na khempeuh a siang ding hi."},"42":{"text":"\"No Pharisee-te aw, note in mint, rue le huan antehhing nam khempeuh sawmah khat na piak uh hangin Pasian’ itna le thutang thudon lo na hi manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Hihte gel a masa pen hih lo tuan loin a nunung pen na hih ding uh ahi hi.","ref":"Lk 18:12"},"43":{"text":"\"No Pharisee-te aw, synagogue-te sunga tutna thupipente ah tu nuam diakin, van zuakna munte ah pibawl ding ut diak na hi manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi.","ref":"Mt 23:6; Lk 14:7"},"44":{"text":"\"Mite in thei kha loin, atung a tot uh ciamtehna om lo hante tawh kibang na hi manun note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi\" a ci hi.","ref":"Mt 23:27"},"45":{"text":"Thukham siamte khatin, \"Sia aw, hih thute na gen ciangin kote zong hong selpho na hi hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi."},"46":{"text":"Jesu in, \"No thukham siamte aw, mite tungah a puak zawh loh ding uh vante na suan uh a tua ciangin amaute na huh nading un na khutme nangawn uh khat beek tangsak lo na hi manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi."},"47":{"text":"\"Note in na pu na pate uh thah kamsangte han bawl na hi manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi."},"48":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na pu na pa-te uh hihnate na thukimpihna uh teci a pang na suak uh hi. Amaute in kamsangte that uh a, amaute hante note in na bawl uh hi."},"49":{"text":"Hih thu hangin Pasian in ama pilna tawh, ‘Amaute kiangah kamsangte le sawltakpite ka paisak dinga, amaute in tuate pawlkhat thatin, pawlkhat a bawlsia ding uh hi,’ ci hi."},"50":{"text":"Tua ahi manin leitung piancila kipan kamsangte khempeuh sisan ahi zongin,"},"51":{"text":"Abel sisan a kipan biakna-tau le mun-siangtho kikala kithat Zechariah sisan dong, a luangkhia khempeuh hih khang mite mawhna in kisim ding hi. Hi hi, ken kong geninah amah na kihta un."},"6":{"text":"Kawlgit nga ciangin penny b nih in kizuak hi lo ahi hiam? Tua hi napi Pasian in kawlgit khat zong a mangngilh kei hi."},"7":{"text":"Na samzangte khempeuh uh kisim khin takpi hi. Ka salte phelkhia-in a lianzaw ka lam dinga, tua lai-ah ka ante khempeuh le ka vante ka koih ding hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin, ‘Kum tampi man ding na hoih tampi ka koih khin zo hi. Nuntakna nopzatin, nene-in dawndawnin gualnuam in, ka kici ding hi,’ ci hi."},"20":{"text":"\"Ahi hangin Pasian in ama kiangah, ‘Nang mihaipa! Tua hileh nang adinga na koihkholhte kua in tang ding ahi hiam?’ ci hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Pasian lamah hau lo a, ama adinga na a kholte peuhmah tua bang hi ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Thn 11:9"},"22":{"text":"Tua caingin Jesu in a nungzuite kiangah, ‘Tua ahi ciangin ken kong geninah na nuntak nading, na nek ding ahi zongin, na silh na ten ding ahi zongin na pumpi uh ading bangmah lunghimawh kei un."},"23":{"text":"An sangin nuntakna thupizaw a, puan sangin pumpi thupizaw hi.","title":"Lunghimawh Kei Un"},"24":{"text":"Va-akte na ngaihsun dih un: Tuate in vawh lah vawh lo, at lah at lo, gawdam ahi zongin sal ah ahi zongin a khol kei uh hi. Tua hi napi Pasian in tuate a vak hi. Vasate sangin note na manpha zawtham pek uh hi!"},"25":{"text":"A lunghimawh manin a nuntak hun nai khat bek nangawn a sotto a thei note lakah kua om ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Hih bang thu neucik khat nangawn na hih theih loh khit nungsangun adangte bang lunghimawhna na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Ph 147:9"},"27":{"text":"\"Unokte khanzia na ngaihsun un. Tua hi napi Solomon nangawn a thupina khempeuh tawh a kizep laitakin, hihte zahin zong a kizem zo kei hi."},"28":{"text":"Upna neu mite aw, tuni-in hih lai-ah om a, zing ciangin mei-a kikhul ding lopa kung khat, Pasian in tua zahin zem ahileh amah in note puan hong guan zaw tham ding hi!"},"29":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin na nek na dawn ding uh ngaihsut penin nei kei un; tuate na lunghimawh kei un."},"30":{"text":"Hih nate khempeuh leitung lawkite in zon penin a nei uh hi. Hih nate na kisap lam uh na Pa un a thei hi."},"31":{"text":"Ahi zongin Pasian gam na zong un, tua hileh hih nate khempeuh hong piathuah ding hi."},"32":{"text":"\"Tuu hon tawmkhate aw, na Pa un note gam hong piak ding lungkim khin ahi manin na lau kei un."},"33":{"text":"Na neihsate uh zuak unla mizawngte na pia un. A patvang thei lo sumbawm no le no na kiguan unla, a bei thei lo, gutate in a naih theih loh le nget nek theih lohna mun vantungah na gou uh khol un."},"34":{"text":"Ahang in, na gou omna munah na lungsim zong om ding hi.","ref":"Jas 5:2"},"35":{"text":"\"Na sem dinga kisa kholsa in om unla, meivak kuangsa-in om un;"},"36":{"text":"mopi powi sima hong ciah kik, kong a kiuh pheta a honpah thei dinga a pu uh a ngakte bangin om un.","title":"Kigalginna"},"37":{"text":"A pu uh a pai ciangin tua banga a ngak laitak a tuah nasemte hampha ding uh hi. Thutak kong geninah, an vak dingin amah kithawi-a, a nasemte sabuai ah kingamsakin amaute ankuang a lui ding hi."},"38":{"text":"Zan, vil nihna ahi zongin, vil thumna ahi zongin a pu a pai cianga, a pu in kigingsa-a om a tuah nasemte a hampha ding uh hi."},"39":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in hih thu na theitel un: Inn neipa in zanlai bang hunin gutate pai ding hiam cih theikhol leh a inn kiluhsak lo ding hi."},"40":{"text":"Na muanmawh loh hun laitakun Mihing Tapa hong pai ding ahi manin note zong pel loin kigingsa in om un,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Mt 24:42,46"},"41":{"text":"Peter in, \"Topa aw, hih gentehna ko tung beka gen na hi hiam, ahikeh mikim tunga gen na hi hiam?\" ci-in a dong hi."},"42":{"text":"Topa in, \"Tua ahileh ama inn sunga nasem dangte ukin, amaute a hunhuna an a pia dinga a pu in a koih, a muanhuai a pil sungtapipa kua ahi hiam?"},"43":{"text":"A pu a ciah kik cianga tua banga a sep laitak a tuah nasempa hampha ding hi."},"44":{"text":"Thutak kong geninah, a pu in tuapa a neihsa khempeuh a uksak ding hi."},"45":{"text":"Ahi hangin tua nasempa in, ‘Ka pu sawtveipi hong tam na inteh,’ ci-in nasem-numei le nasem-pasalte satgawp henla, an ne in zu dawnin zu na kham leh,"},"46":{"text":"a lamet loh ni le a khuadon loh hun laitakin a pu tung dinga, tua nasempa a pu in atnenin thu um lote tawh mun khatah a koihkhawm ding hi."},"47":{"text":"\"A pu deihna thei napi-in, a pu deihna banga gamta lo-a, kigingkhol lo tua nasempa tam veipi a kisat ding hi."},"48":{"text":"Ahi hangin bangmah thei lo-a gawtna thuak nadinga kilawm nate a hihpa ahileh tawm vei kisat ding hi. Tua mei a kuang khin hileh ut sing!"},"50":{"text":"Ahi hangin ka thuak ding baptisena khat oma, tua a kizawh siang mateng ka lungdong mahmah hi!","title":"Kilemna hi lo Kikhenna"},"51":{"text":"Leitung ah kilemna puak dingin hong pai hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun kha uh hiam? Hi lo hi, ken kong geninah kikhenna khah dinga hong pai ka hi hi."},"52":{"text":"Tu-a kipanin innkuan khat mi nga a phate, thum lang ah nih, nih langah thumin khat le khat kilangpang ciat ding uh hi."},"53":{"text":"A tapa langah a pa, a pa langah a tapa, a tanu langah a nu, a nu langah a tanu, monu langah teknu, teknu langah monu kilangpan ciatin amaute a kikhen ding uh hi,\" ci-in a dawng hi.","ref":"Mt 10:21,22"},"54":{"text":"Amah in mihonpite kiangah, \"Nitumna-lam panin meii hong kai na muh uh ciangin, ‘Guah zu ding hi,’ na ci thei pah uh a, guah lah a zu takpi hi."},"55":{"text":"Leitaw-lam pana huih a nun ciangin, ‘Khua lum ding hi,’ na ci uh a, a lum takpi hi.","title":"Hunte Khiatna"},"56":{"text":"Kineihsiamte! Amah in amaute kiangah,","title":"Kong Kawcik","ref":"Lk 9:51"},"24":{"text":"\"Kong kawcik-a lut ding na hahkat un. Nong hehpihna-in hong pengsak in,’ ci hi."},"19":{"text":"\"Adang khat in, ‘Bawng kap nga a lei khin phet ka hi-a tuate sin dingin a pai kimlai ka hi hi. Nong hehpihna-in kei hong pengsak in,’ ci hi."},"20":{"text":"\"Adang khat leuleu in, ‘Zi nei khin phet ka hi hi, tua ahi ciangin kong pai thei kei ding hi,’ ci hi."},"21":{"text":"\"Nasempa ciah kika, a pu kiangah hih thute a zasak hi. hi."},"22":{"text":"\"Nasempa in ‘Pu aw, nong thupiak bangin kihih khin zo hi, ahi hangin mun awng lai hi,’ ci hi."},"23":{"text":"\"Tua ciangin a pu in nasempa kiangah, ‘Lamliante le lamneute ah va pai inla, ka inn a dim nadingin amaute hong lutsak in."},"24":{"text":"Ken kong geninah, a kikhosate khat beek in ka anvak a ciam kha kei ding uh hi,’ ci hi,\" a ci hi."},"25":{"text":"Mihon tampi tawh Jesu a paikhawm laitakin amaute lam nga in,"},"26":{"text":"\"Kei kianga hong pai mi khatpeuh in a nu, a pa, a zi a tate le a sanggampate, a sang gamnute tham lo ama nuntakna nangawn a muhdah kei 10:37-38"},"28":{"text":"\"Gentehna-in note lakah tausang dawh nuam khat om leh a tua tausang a dawh zawh nading sum a kicing ding a nei hiam, cih thei dingin tu-in aman ding tuat masa lo ding ahi hiam?"},"29":{"text":"Ahang in, amah in a bulpi pan khin napi, zosiang zo kei leh a mu khempeuh in nuihsan dinga,"},"30":{"text":"‘Hih pa in tausang dawh kipan khin napi a zosiang kei hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"31":{"text":"\"Ahikeh gentehna in kumpipa khat in kumpi dang khat sim dingin kithawi leh mi tul sawmnih tawh a kuanpa, mi tul sawm tawh a nang zo ding hiam, cih tu photin, ngaihsun masa lo ding a nekhawm hi,\" ci-in a phunsan uh hi.","ref":"Lk 5:29"},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute kiangah gentehna gen a,"},"4":{"text":"\"Note lakah khat in tuu zakhat nei a, tuate lakah khat mansuah Tua ciangin amah in a lawmte le a vengte samkhawm a, ‘Kei hong nuampih un; ka tuu mang ka mu zo hi,’ ci hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua mah bangin kisik a kul lo a thumaan mi sawm kua le kua-te sangin mawh nei khat a kisik na hangin vantung ah nuamna a lianzaw ding hi, cih kong hilh hi.","ref":"Eze 34:11-16"},"8":{"text":"\"Ahikeh gentehna-in numei khat in nguntang a sawm nei in khat mansuah leh tuanu in mei vaka a inn phiatin a muh mateng limtakin zong lo ding ahi hiam?"},"9":{"text":"A muh ciangin a lawmte le a vengte samkhawm in, ‘Kei hong nuampih un; ka sum mang ka mu zo hi,’ ci hi.","title":"Sumtang Mang tawh Gentehna"},"10":{"text":"Tua mah bangin ken kong geninah, mawhnei mi khat a kisikna hangin Pasian vansawltakte omna ah nuamna a om hi,\" a ci hi."},"11":{"text":"Jesu in a thugen zomlai a, \"Tapa nih a nei mi khat a om hi."},"12":{"text":"A nauzawpa in a pa kiangah, ‘Pa aw, i goute sung pan kei tanh ding hong khenkhia in,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a neihsate amau gel a hawmsak hi.","title":"Tapa Mang tawh Gentehna","ref":"Tp 21:17"},"13":{"text":"\"Tua khit a sawt loin a nauzawpa in a neih khempeuh kaikhawmin, gamlapi ah pai-a noptatna-in a sum neih teng a zangbei hi."},"14":{"text":"A neih khempeuh a zat bei khit ciangin tua gambup ah kialpi tunga, amah a kitasam hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah tua gam mite khat kiangah sum thalawh dingin pai-a, tuapa in amah a lo ah vok-an pia dingin a sawl hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in vokte nek begapte duhgawh mahmah a, ahi hangin kuamah in bangmah a pia kei hi.","ref":"Sp 11:7,8 Lk 16:1"},"17":{"text":"\"Amah le amah a kiphawkkhiat ciangin, ‘Ka pa inn a sum thalawhte tampi in an khamval nei ding uh a, kei lah hih lai-ah ka puksi dektak hi!"},"18":{"text":"Kei dingkhia ning ka pa kiangah ciah kikin: Pa aw, vantung le nangma tungah ka mawh zo hi."},"19":{"text":"Nang ta cih dingin ka kilawm nawn kei hi; na sum thalawhte khat bangin hong koih in ka ci ding hi,’ ci hi."},"20":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amah tho-a, a pa kiangah a ciah hi. \"Ahi hangin inn pan gamlapi-a a om laitakin a pa in na galmuh-a, amah khuatuah mahmah ahi manin, a tapa delha pumkawi-in a nam hi.","ref":"Sp 26:40-42; Pc 46:29"},"21":{"text":"\"A tapa in ama kiangah, ‘Pa aw vantung le nangma tungah ka mawh zo hi. Inn kiang a tun ciangin tumging le lamna a za hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amah in nasemte khat sama, ‘Bang kihih ahi hiam?’ ci-in dong hi."},"27":{"text":"Amah in, ‘Na sanggampa hong ciah ta a, cidam ludamtakin na pa kiang hong tung kik ahi manin na pa in amah bawngno vakthau pen gawh hi,’ ci hi."},"28":{"text":"\"A u pa heh a inn sungah a lut nuam kei hi. Tua hi napi ka lawmte tawh ka lop nadingin keelno khat nangawn nong pia ngei kei hi."},"30":{"text":"Ahi hangin na neihsa teng numei kizuakte tawh a zatmang khit cianga inn hong zuan hih na tapa, bawngno vakthau pen na gawh tazen hi!’ ci hi."},"31":{"text":"\"A pa in, ‘Ka ta aw, nang le kei i omkhawm dena, ka neih khempeuh nang aa ahi hi."},"32":{"text":"Ahi hangin na sanggampa a si khinsa tu-in hong hing kika, a mangsa tu-in kimu kik ahi manin nuamin i lop a kul hi,’ ci hi,\" ci-in a gen hi.","ref":"Mal 3:17"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesu in a nungzuite kiangah, \"Khatvei mihau khat om a, sungtapipa in a pu neihsa teng a zat beisak hi, ci-in kingawh hi.","title":"A Pilvang Sungtapipa tawh Gentehna"},"2":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin a pu in amah sama, ‘Nang thu ka zak bang thu ahi hiam? Ahang in, khuavak sunga om mite sangin hih leitung mite in amaute kibatpihte tawh kizop zia ah a geelsiam zaw uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Ken kong geninah, leitung hauhnate lawm ngah nadingin na zang un; tua hileh a bei ciangin tawntung tenna ah note hong kimuak ding hi.","ref":"Ph 17:14"},"10":{"text":"\"Tawmcik tunga muanhuaite tampi tungah kimuang thei dinga, tawmcik tunga muanhuai lote tampi tungah zong a muanhuai kei ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin note leitung hauhna kem dingin na muanhuai kei uh leh hauhna taktak kem dingin kua in hong muang ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Midang khatpeuh neihsa tungah na muanhuai kei uh leh no neihsa ding kua in hong pia ding ahi hiam?","ref":"Mt 25:21,23; Lk 19:17"},"13":{"text":"\"Kuamah in to nih na a sem khawm thei kei hi. Tua khita kipan, Pasian gam lungdamna-thu kihilhin, tua sungah thahatthu-in mikim a lut gawp hi."},"17":{"text":"Thukham panin a mal themcik khat a mawk maiman sangin van le lei a mawk maiman ding a baihzaw ding hi.","title":"Thuhilh-behnate"},"18":{"text":"\"A zi ma a numei dang khat a tenpih peuhmah, angkawmpa suak a, a kimasa numei a tenpih peuhmah angkawmpa a suak hi."},"19":{"text":"\"Khatvei sumhaupa khat a om hi; tuapa in puan dupsan le saihadial puan silh a, nisimin noptatin a om hi."},"20":{"text":"A kongpi gei-ah meima in a pumtuam Lazarus min nei khutdawh-a ngen khat kikoih hi.","title":"Sumhaupa le Lazarus"},"21":{"text":"Amah in sumhaupa sabuai pana kia an-nengte a lunggulh hi. Uite nangawn pai-in ama meimate a liahsak uh hi.","ref":"Eze 16:49"},"22":{"text":"\"Tua khutdawh-a ngenpa a sih ciangin vansawltakte in Abraham kiangah a puak uh hi. Sumhaupa zong si-a, a kivui hi."},"23":{"text":"Amah gentheipi-a a omna mun hell a khuk sung pan a khuadak leh agal pekpekah Abraham le a kianga om Lazarus a mu hi."},"24":{"text":"Tua ciangin amah sama, ‘Pa Abraham aw, kei hong hehpih in. Ahi hangin tu-in amah hih lai-ah nuamsa a, nang na hileh gimna na thuak hi."},"26":{"text":"Tua banah eite kikalah guam thukpi khat om a, tua kantanin hih lai pan tua lai-a pai nuamte a pai thei kei uh hi; tua lai pan hih lai ko kianga hong pai nuamte a pai thei kei uh hi,’ ci hi."},"27":{"text":"\"Amah in, ‘Tua ahileh pa aw, ka pa inn ah Lazarus nong sawlsak ding kong thum hi."},"28":{"text":"Ahang in, sanggam pasal nga ka nei hi. Hehpihna nang tawh om ta hen.","ref":"2Ti 1:12; 2:16"}}}}},"55":{"info":{"name":"2 Timothy","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Christ Jesu sunga om nuntakna kamciamsa tawh kizui-a Pasian deihna hanga Christ Jesu sawltakpi Paul in.","ref":"1Co 1:1"},"2":{"text":"Ka tapa it Timothy tungah: Pa Pasian le i Topa Christ Jesu tung pana hehpihna, lainatna le lemna om ta hen."},"3":{"text":"Ka thungetnate ah sun le zanin nang kong phawk tawntung a, ka pu ka pa-te hihsa bangin lungsim kitheihna siang tawh a na ka sep Pasian tungah lungdam ka ko hi."},"4":{"text":"Lungnopna tawh ka kidim theih nadingin na khituite phawk kikin nang kong muh ding ka lunggulh mahmah hi.","title":"Muanhuai ding Hanthawnna"},"5":{"text":"Na up taktakna ka phawka, tua thu-upna, na pi Lois sungah nungta masa-in, tua khitteh na nu Eunic sungah nungta a, tu-in nang sungah zong nungta hi cih teltakin ka taksang hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih thu hangin nang tunga ka khut kong ngakna tungtawna, nang sunga om Pasian letsong pen na zapkuang den ding kong phawksak kik hi."},"7":{"text":"Ahang in, Pasian in eite, zahkaina kha hong pia loin, vangliatna, itna le ei le ei ki-ukzawhna kha hong piazaw hi.","ref":"Isa 11:2"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin i Topa thu na genkhiat ding maizum kei inla, ama thongkia ka hina zong maizumpih tuan kei in. Heb 5:6"},"11":{"text":"Levi-te siampi nasepna tungtawnin kicinna kingah hileh (ahang in, tua hihna kibulphuh in mite tungah thukham a kipia ahi hi.) bang hanga Aaron gui ahi lo, Melchizedek gui siampi dang hong pai kul lai ding ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Ahang in, siampi hina kilaihna a om bangin thukham zong laih pelmawh a kul hi.","title":"Melchizedek bang Jesu"},"13":{"text":"Hih nate a kigenna pa ahileh beh tuam mi khat hi-a, tua beh panin kuamah biakna-tau ah nasem ngei a om kei hi."},"14":{"text":"Ahang in, eite Topa lah Judah suan le khak ahilam kitel zo a, tua beh tawh kisai-in Moses in siampite thu bangmah a gen kei hi."},"15":{"text":"Melchizedek bang siampi dang khat hong kilang ahi ciangin thugen hong kitelzaw semsem a,"},"16":{"text":"tua siampi hong suakpa pen a pu a pa ua ngeina tawh hong suak hi loin, a kisia thei lo nuntakna’ vangliatna pansanin siampi hong suak ahi hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, \"Nang, Melchizedek gui zui-in tawntung siampi na hi hi,\" d ci-in kipulak hi."},"18":{"text":"Ngeina masa pen thanemin kiman na nei lo ahi manin kinawlkhin a,"},"19":{"text":"(ahang in, thukham in bangmah a hoih kimsak kei hi.) a hoihzaw lametna hong kipia in, tua tungtawnin Pasian kiang i nai hi.","ref":"Ro 8:3"},"20":{"text":"Tua nangawn zong kiciamna lo tawh hi peuhmah lo hi! Amah a nungtolh leh ama tungah ka lungkim kei ding hi,\" d"},"39":{"text":"Eite i hileh nungtolh-a kisiate laka i hi kei a, ahi hangin uma kihonkhiate i hizaw hi.","ref":"Ns 16:30; 2Pe 2:20"}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tu-in upna pen, i lamette tel cianna le i muh lohte theihtelna ahi hi.","title":"Upna Hangin"},"2":{"text":"Tanglai mite a kiphatna hihte hang ahi hi.","ref":"2Co 4:18"},"3":{"text":"A kimu theite a kimu thei pana kibawl hi loin, khuavannuai, Pasian thupiaka piang ahi hi, cih upna-in i theitel hi."},"4":{"text":"Abel in upna hangin Cain sangin biakpiakna hoihzaw Pasian tungah a pia hi. Amen.","ref":"2Co 9:8; Php 2:13"},"22":{"text":"Sanggamte aw, laikhak tomno khata kong gelh ahi manin kong hanthawnnate nong thuakzawh ding uh kong thum hi."},"23":{"text":"I sanggampa Timothy kikhah khia zo, cih na theih ding uh ka deih hi. Thu banga a gamtate na hi un."},"23":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in thu za napi in thu bangin a gamtat kei leh, a maitang limlangin en a,"},"24":{"text":"a ki-et khit ciangin paikhia a, amah bang tawh kibang hiam cih a mang ngilhpahte tawh kibang ahi hi."},"25":{"text":"Ahi hangin suahtakna a pia thei a hoihkim thukham limtakin en-a, thu bangin gamta-a a zaksate mangngilh loin a sempah mi, ama sepna ah thupha kipia ding hi.","ref":"Ph 19:7; Mt 7:21"},"26":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh, amah le amah biakna uukmi in kingaihsun napi, a leii a kep zawh kei leh amah le amah a kikhem suaka, ama biakna kimanna a om kei hi."},"27":{"text":"Eite Pa Pasian in khialhna nei lo le a sianga a san biakna in: tagahte le meigong numeite a lungdon ciangin don-a leitung nitsakna pana kikepna ahi hi.","ref":"Ps 34:13; Mt 25: 34-36"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, a minthang i Topa Jesu Christ sunga thu-umte na hi uh bangin angvan tuam nei kei un.","title":"Deidanna Kikham"},"2":{"text":"Gentehna in note kikhopna sungah kham zungbuh bunin puan hoih silh khat hong lut a, mizawng puansia nemnam silh khat zong hong lut hi."},"3":{"text":"Note in puan hoih silh pa tuam bawlin, \"Hih lai-ah tutphah nuam om hi,\" na ci uh a, ahi hangin mizawng pa tungah, \"Hua lai-ah na ding in,\" ahikeh, \"Ka khephung sual tungah na tu in,\" ci-a thudon tuam na neih uh leh"},"4":{"text":"mi deidan tuamin no le no sungah ngaihsutna hoih lo tawh thu a khen suak lo ding na hi uh hiam?","ref":"Tp 1:17; Jn 7:24"},"5":{"text":"Kong it ka sanggamte aw, ngai un: Pasian in upna ah ahau ding le amah a itte a kamciam, ama gam a luah dingin leitung mite muhna-a a zawngte teel hi lo ahi hiam?"},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin note in a zawngte na zahlaksak uh hi. Ang na kawm loh hangin, tual na thah leh, thukham a palsat mah na hi hi.","ref":"Mt 5:19"},"12":{"text":"Suahtakna a pia thukham in thu a khen ding mite bangin thugenin gamta un."},"13":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh lainatna a nei lo mi peuhmah tungah lainatna om loin thu a kikhen ding hi. Thukhenna tungah lainatna a gualzo hi."},"14":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, mi khat in upna ka nei hi, a cih hangin gamtatkhiatna a neih kei leh bang phatuam ahi hiam? Dawite nangawn in tua mah umin lau-in a ling uh hi.","ref":"Mt 8:29; Ro 3:28"},"20":{"text":"Nang mihaipa aw, gamtatna loin upna a kimanna om lo d hi cih a kitelna na thei nuam hiam?"},"21":{"text":"I pu Abraham in a tapa Isaac biakna-tau tungah a piak ciangin ama nasepsa thumaanin kisimsak hi lo ahi hiam?"},"22":{"text":"Ama upna le a gamtatnate in semkhawm a, ama sepna in a upna bucingsak hi cih na thei hi."},"23":{"text":"Tua hi a, Laisiangtho in, \"Abraham in Pasian um a, tua ama upna ama thumaanna-in kisimsak hi,\" e a cih tangtunga, amah Pasian lawmpa kici hi."},"24":{"text":"Mi khat a upna guak hi loin ama sepna in dik tangsak ahilam na thei hi.","ref":"1Th 1:3; Heb 11:17"},"25":{"text":"Tua mah tawh kibangin numei kizuak Rahab nangawn in thukansimte zin tungsak a, lampi tuam ah a khakkhiat ciangin ama gamtatnasa hangin thu maan suak hi lo ahi hiam?"},"26":{"text":"Kha a om lo pumpi a si ahi bangin gamtatna om lo upna a si ahi hi."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, sia a sem kote in a khauhzaw thukhenna thuak ding ka hi manun note a tampi sia suah na sawm kei un.","title":"Leii Zualsakna"},"2":{"text":"Eite i vekpi in lam tampi-ah i muktu hi. Mi khatpeuh in a kam pauna ah khialhna a neih kei leh amah mi picing khat hi-a, ama pumpi bup a kemcing thei mi zong ahi hi."},"3":{"text":"Sakolte in thu a man nadingin a kam sungah kamkaih i bulh khit ciangin tua ganhing a buppi-in i hei thei hi."},"4":{"text":"Ahi kei leh tembawpi gentehna in nei ni. Ka sanggamte aw, hih bang ding hi lo hi."},"11":{"text":"Tuinak khat panin tuisiang le citui f luangkhia khawm thei ahi hiam?"},"12":{"text":"Ka sanggamte aw, theikung in olive gah, gah thei ahi hiam, ahikeh lenggui in theigah, gah thei ahi hiam? Ama nuntak hoihna le a pilna pana hong piangkhia kiniamkhiatna sungah a gamtatna-in lak ta hen."},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin note lungtang sungah enna khaa le huaiham tupna na selsiah uh leh tua hangin kisialh ding hi lo a, thutak a nial na hizaw uh hi.","title":"Pilna Nam Nihte"},"15":{"text":"Tua bang \"pilna\" vantung pana hong paisuk hi loin leitung pilna, khamilohna le gilopa aa hizaw hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahang in, enna le huaiham tupna a omna peuhah kilemlohna le gitloh gamtatna vive a om hi.","ref":"Jas 2:18; 1Pe 2:12"},"17":{"text":"Ahi hangin vantung pana pilna ahileh a masa penin siangtho a, lemna deih in, midangte khual a, kiniamkhiat in, lainatna le gah hoih tawh dima, khentuam nei loin citak hi."},"18":{"text":"Lemna a vawh lemgente in thumaanna a at uh hi.","ref":"Mt 5:9; 1Co 2:6"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Note lakah kitotna le kidona bang in piangsak ahi hiam?
