adangte tungah a sa thanghuai banna puansilh nangawn kihin lau kawmin lainat siamna na nei un."},"24":{"text":"A puk lo dinga note hong kem thei, khialhna om lo-a, lungnopna lianpi tawh a minthanna ama om na-a note hong puak theipa -"},"25":{"text":"eite Honpa Pasian khat bek tungah i Topa Jesu Christ tungtawnin minthanna, thupina, vangliatna le thuneihna, khang hun khempeuh ma, tu laitak le a tawntung in om ta hen! Amen.","title":"Pasian Phatna"}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Kilaakna","shortname":"","abbr":[],"desc":""},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pasian in a sawt lo-a tung pah dingte a nasemte tungah lak dingin amah a piak Jesu Christ kilaakna ahi hi. Amah in ama vansawltakte sawlin ama nasem John tungah theisak a,","title":"Thupatna"},"2":{"text":"John in Pasian thu le Jesu Christ thu teci panna a muh khempeuh teci a pang hi."},"3":{"text":"Hih genkholhna thute a sim mi thupha ngah hi-a, a sunga kigelhte za-a, a lungtanga a kemte thupha ngah ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a hun hong nai ta hi.","ref":"Lk 11:28"},"4":{"text":"John in, Asia gama pawlpi sagihte tungah: Tu laitaka om, a omsa le hong pai ding pa le ama kumpi tokhom mai-a kha a sagihte pan,","title":"Hopihnate le Pasian Phatna"},"5":{"text":"le a muanhuai teci pa, misi pana a suak masa pen, le leitung kumpite a ukpa, Jesu Christ tung panin hehpihna le lemna no tungah om ta hen. Eite hong it a, ama sisan hanga i mawhnate pan hong suaktasak,"},"6":{"text":"ama Pasian le Pa nasem dinga kumpi-gam le siampi hong hisak ama tungah minthanna le vangliatna a tawntungin om den ta hen! Amen.","ref":"1Pe 2:5; Kil 5:10"},"7":{"text":"En un, meiipi tawh amah hong pai hi, mit khempeuh in amah mu dinga amah a sunlette nangawn in a mu ding uh hi; leitung a mite khempeuh ama hangin thum ding uh hi. Tua bang hi takpi ding hi! Amen.","ref":"Da 7:13; Zec 12:10"},"8":{"text":"Topa Pasian in, \"Keimah, Alpha le Omega, tu laitak a om, a omsa le hong pai ding pa, Thahatpen ka hi hi,\" a ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Jesu sunga eite tanh thuakna, kumpi-gam le sikdotaka na thuakpih pa uh, na sanggampa uh le na pawlpa uh keimah John, Pasian thu hang le Jesu thu teci panna hangin Patmos tuikulh ah ka om hi."},"10":{"text":"Topa’ Ni-in Kha sungah ka om hi, ka nunglam ah pengkul bangin aw ngaih mahmah khat ka za a:","title":"Mihing Tapa tawh Kibang Khat"},"11":{"text":"\"Na muh teng laizial tung khatah gelh inla pawlpi sagih: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia le Laodicea-te tungah khak in,\" hong ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua kei hong hopih aw en dingin ka kihei hi. Ka kihei khit ciangin kham meivak tunna sagihte ka mu-a,"},"13":{"text":"tua meivak tunnate lakah \"mihing tapa tawh kibang khat\" a a khepek ciang a bansuk puantualpi khat silhin a awm ah kham awmgak a gak mi khat ka mu hi."},"14":{"text":"A lu le a samte samul bangin ngo in, vuk bangin pak a, a mitte meikuanglai bang hi."},"15":{"text":"A khepekte pummei sunga sumsan hal-am tawh kibang a, a aw tuizeupi ging tawh kibang hi."},"16":{"text":"A taklam khutah aksi sagihte tawi-a, a kam panin a langniha hiam tuak namsau khat hong dawkkhia hi. A maitang, ni a tan pen laitak tawh kibang hi.","ref":"Pk 25:31-40; Kil 2:1"},"17":{"text":"Amah ka muh ciangin a khephung ah a si bangin ka puk hi. Tua ciangin aman a taklam khut ka tungah nga a: \"Lau kei in, keimah, a Masa pen le a Nunung pen ka hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Keimah a Nungta Pa ka hi hi. Ka si zo a, en in a tawntungin ka nungta den hi! Keimah in sihna leh Gawtmun tawhtangte zong ka tawi hi.","ref":"Eze 1:28; Ro 6:9"},"19":{"text":"\"Tua ahi manin na muhsate, tu laitak a om le tu nung cianga hong om dingte gelh in."},"20":{"text":"Ka taklam a na muh aksi sagihte le kham meivak sagihte’ thuthuk hih ahi hi: Aksi sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte’ a kem vansawltakte b hi-a, meivak tunna sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte ahi hi.","ref":"Heb 2:2; Mt 5:14"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Ephesus a pawlpi vansawltak c tungah gelh in: Hihte in a khut taklam-a aksi sagihte tawi-a, kham meivak tunna sagih laka a vakpa kammal ahi hi:","title":"Ephesus Pawlpi Tungah"},"2":{"text":"Na nasepte na hahkatna le na sikdonate ka thei hi. A tatkhel mite na thuak thei kei-a a hi lopi sawltakpi banga kibawlte na sittel a, amaute a zuau ahilam na mu cih ka thei hi."},"3":{"text":"Na sikdo a, ka min hangin haksatna na thuaka na cimtak kei hi.","ref":"1Jn 4:1"},"4":{"text":"Tua hi napi kong mawhsakna om veve hi: Na itna masa pen na nusia hi."},"5":{"text":"Na kiatna a sannazia phawk in! Kisik inla na hih masak nate hih kik in. Na kisik kei leh na kiangah kong pai dinga, na meivak tunna a omna pan ka khinkhia ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Ahi hangin na pahtakhuaina khat a om hi: Kei zong ka muhdah Nicolas pawlte gamtatna, na mudah hi.","ref":"Jer 2:2; Kil 3:3"},"7":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen. A gualzo pa tungah Pasian paradise-a om nuntakna singkung pan a nek theih nading thu ka pia ding hi.","ref":"Kil 22:2, 14, 19"},"8":{"text":"\"Smyrna a pawlpi vansawltak tungah gelh in: Hihte, a Masa pen le a Nunung pen, si-a a nungta kik pa kammalte ahi hi.","title":"Smyrna Pawlpi Tungah"},"9":{"text":"Na zawnna le na thuaksiat nate ka thei hi; tua hi napi na hau hi! Hi lo napi Jew mi a kici mi gensiate ahi hanga lah Satan synagogue a hite ka thei hi."},"10":{"text":"Na thuak dingte kihta kei in. Nang hong zia-et dingin dawimangpa in kimkhat thong sungah hong khum dinga, ni sawm sung bawlsiatna na thuak ding uh kong hilh hi. Sih dongin muanhuai un, tua hileh nuntakna lukhu kong pia ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen. A gualzo mi, a nihna sihna in a nasak kei ding hi.","ref":"Kil 20:6, 14; 21:8"},"12":{"text":"\"Pergamum a pawlpi vansawltak tungah gelh in: Hihte in a langnih-a, hiam tuak namsau nei pa kammalte ahi hi:","title":"Pergamum Pawlpi Tungah"},"13":{"text":"Satan in a tokhom a koihna mun - na tenna mun ka thei hi. Tua hi napi ka min tungah na muanhuai lai hi. Satan tenna mun na khuapi sunga ka teci muanhuai a kithatpa Antipas nite nangawnin kei nong upna na tawpsan kei hi.","ref":"Kil 14:12"},"14":{"text":"Ahi hangin kong mawhsakna tawm no a om hi: Milim thoihna ante nek ding ahi zongin numei-pasal paktat ding ahi zongin, a hih dinga Israel-te khem dingin Balak in a hilh Balaam thuhilhna a zui mi pawlkhat na nei hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua mah tawh kibangin Nicolas pawlte thuhilhna a zuite zong na nei hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi manin kisik in! Ahi kei leh nang kiangah kong paipah dinga, ka kama namsau tawh amaute ka do ding hi.","ref":"Ns 15:20; 2Pe 2:15"},"17":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen. A gualzopa tungah a kisel manna pawlkhat ka pia ding hi. Amah a tunga minthak om suangkang khat zong ka pia ding a, tua min a ngah pa bekin a thei ding hi."},"18":{"text":"\"Thyatira a pawlpi vansawltak tungah gelh in: Hihte, a mitte meikuanglai a bang, a khepekte sumngo nawtngilsa a bang, Pasian Tapa kammalte ahi hi:","title":"Thyatira Pawlpi Tungah"},"19":{"text":"Na nasepte, na itna le na upna, na nasepnate le na sikdonate ka thei-a na sep masa sangin tam na semzaw hi."},"20":{"text":"Ahi zongin nang tungah hih mawh sakna kong nei hi: Amah le amah kamsang a kici numei Jezebel na thuak zo uh hi. Ama hilhna in ka nasemte, numei-pasal paktatna le milim thoihna anneknate ah a makaih khial hi."},"21":{"text":"Tuanu a paktatna pan a kisik nading hun ka piak hangin a ut kei hi."},"22":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin amaute tuanu gamtatnate pan a kisik kei uh leh gimthuakna lupna tungah amah lawnin ama angkawmpihte nakpitakin ka thuaksak ding hi."},"23":{"text":"A tate ka satlum ding hi. Tua ciangin pawlpi khempeuh in lungtang le lungsim zong a pheklekpa ka hilam hong thei ding uh a, note khempeuh na gamtatna bangun kong thuk ding hi."},"24":{"text":"Tu-in Thyatira a tuanu hilhna a zui lote le thuthuk kici Satan thusimte a sin lote tungah: (vangik dang peuhmah kong suan kei ding hi.)"},"25":{"text":"Kong pai matengin na neihsa uh lenkip den un kong ci hi."},"26":{"text":"A tawp donga ka deihna ahi gualzo pa tungah minamte tunga thuneihna ka pia dinga,-","ref":"Mt 10:22; Jn 16:33"},"27":{"text":"\"‘Amah in amaute tungah sikciang tawh uk dinga; leibeel bangin amaute a satzan ding hi’ a - tua in ka Pa tung pana thuneihna ka ngah bang tektek ahi hi.","ref":"Kil 12:5"},"28":{"text":"Tua zingsol zong amah ka pia ding hi."},"29":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"\"Sardis a pawlpi vansawltak b tungah gelh in: Hihte, Pasian kha c sagihte le aksi sagihte a tawipa kammalte ahi hi: Na nasepte ka thei-a, a nungta-a na than hangin a sisa na hi hi.","title":"Sardis Pawlpi Tungah"},"2":{"text":"Ka Pasian mitmuh ah na nasepte a mansiangin mu nai lo ka hi manin, khanglo in! A om lai a si dekdekte thahatsak in."},"3":{"text":"Tua ahi manin na ngahsa le na zaksate ciamteh in; a thu mang inla kisik in. Ahi hangin na khanlawh kei leh guta bangin kong pai dinga, nang kianga kong pai ding a hun na thei kei ding hi.","ref":"Lk 12:39, 40; Rev 2:5"},"4":{"text":"A puansilh uh a buahsak lo, Sardis ah mi tawm no na nei lai hi. Amaute santham ahi manin puanpak silhin kei tawh a tonkhawm ding uh hi."},"5":{"text":"A gualzopa in amaute tawh kibangin puanpak a silh ding hi. Nuntakna laibu panin a min ka phiat ngei kei dinga, ka Pa le ama vansawltakte mai-ah a min ka pulak zaw ding hi."},"6":{"text":"Pawlpite tungah Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen.","ref":"Jn 16:33; Jude 23"},"7":{"text":"\"Philadelphia a pawlpi vansawltak tungah gelh in: Hihte, a siangtho le a thumaan-pa, David tawhtang tawipa kammalte ahi hi. Ama honsa kuamah in khak thei lo a, ama khaksa kuamah in a hong thei kei hi.","title":"Philadelphia Pawlpi Tungah"},"8":{"text":"Na nasepte ka thei hi. En in, na mai ah kuama khak theih loh kong honsa khat ka koih hi. Thahatna tawmkha bek na neih lam ka thei hi. Tua hi napi ka thu na kembita ka min na nial kei hi."},"9":{"text":"Satan synagogue ahite, Jew mi hi lo napi Jew mi a kici, ahi hanga zuauphuakte, hong paisakin na khephungah ka puksak dinga nang kong it lam ka theisak ding hi."},"10":{"text":"Lungduaitaka thuak dingin kong thupiak na man nungsangin, leitang tunga tengte zia-et nadingin leitung bupa hong tung ding bawlsiatna hun panin, ken zong nang kong peng khiasak ding hi.","ref":"Isa 22:22; 2Pe 2:9"},"11":{"text":"Kong paipah ding hi. Na kumpi lukhu kuamah in hong suh loh nadingin na neihsa lenkip den in."},"12":{"text":"A gualzopa, ka Pasian biakinnpi sungah khuampi ka suaksak ding hi. Amah in tua a nusia ngei nawn kei ding hi. Ama tungah ka Pasian min le ka Pasian pana vantung a hong kumsuk ka Pasian khuapi, tua Jerusalem thak min ka gelh ding hi. Ama tungah ka min thak zong ka gelh ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen.","ref":"Mt 16:27; Kil 22:4"},"14":{"text":"\"Laodicea a pawlpi vansawltak tungah gelh in: Hihte, Pasian piansakte a ukpa, a muanhuai le a thutak Amen kam malte ahi hi.","title":"Laodicea Pawlpi Tungah"},"15":{"text":"Na nasepte ka thei hi, vot lah vot loin sa lah na sa kei hi. Khat zawsang na hi ding kong deih hi!"},"16":{"text":"Tua ahi ciangin vot lah vot lo, sa lah sa loin lum milmial na hi manin ka kam panin kong siakhia dektak hi."},"17":{"text":"‘Ka hau a, neih le lam ka cin hi, khat beek ka sam kei hi,’ na ci hi. Ahi hangin a genthei, a hehpihhuai, azawng, a mittaw le guaktang na hilam a phawk lo na hi hi."},"18":{"text":"Na hauh theih nadingin kei kiang panin mei-a halsiangsa kham; guaktang zumhuaina na sel nadingin na silh ding puanpak; khua na muh theih nadingin na nuh ding mitza, na lei ding kong thuhilh hi.","ref":"Hos 12:8; Kil 16:15"},"19":{"text":"Ka it mite tai-in ka sek hi. Tua ahi ciangin citak inla kisik in."},"20":{"text":"Hih lai-ah ka om hi! Kongkhak ah dingin ka kiu hi. Mi khatpeuh in ka aw za a, kongkhak hong hon leh ka lut dinga, amah tawh an nekhawm in, amah in kei tawh a nekhawm ding hi.","ref":"Tp 8:5"},"21":{"text":"Kei gualzo-in ka Pa tawh ama kumpi tokhom tungah ka tut bang tektek in, a gualzopa, kei tawh ka kumpi tokhom tungah a tut theih na ding thu ka pia ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Pawlpite tunga Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za ta hen,\" a ci hi."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin ka et leh vantung ah kong kihongsa khat ka mai-ah ka mu hi. Ka aw zak masak pen in pengkul bangin kei tungah, \"Hih lai-ah hong paito in, hih khit cianga a tung pelmawh ding kong lak ding hi,\" hong ci hi.","title":"Vantung-a Kumpi Tokhom"},"2":{"text":"Thakhatin Kha-in ka om pah a, ka mai-ah a tunga kua hiam khat a tu kumpi tokhom khat vantung a om ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua lai-a tupa in jaspar le carnelian mel a sun hi. Emeral mel tawh a kibang sakhituihup khat in kumpi tokhom a kualkhum hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua kumpi tokhom, a dang kumpi tokhom sawmnih le li in umcih a, tuate tungah upate sawmnih le li a tu uh hi. Amaute a pakin kizem uh a, amau lutung ah kham kumpi lukhu a khu ciat uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua kumpi tokhom panin khua phia zalzal a, kek kia daldal in van a ging damdam hi. Tua kumpi tokhom mai-ah meivak sagih a kuang hi. Hihte Pasian kha d sagihte ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Kumpi tokhom mai-ah crystal banga siang, limlang tuipi tawh a kibang khat zong a om hi. A laizang takah kumpi tokhom kimkotin a nung le a mai-ah mitin a tuam, a nungta ganhing lite a om uh hi.","ref":"Kil 15:2"},"7":{"text":"A nungta ganhing masa pen humpinelkai tawh kibanga, a nihna bawngtal tawh kibangin, a thumna in mi bangin maitang nei-a, a lina, muvanlai lenglai a bang hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua a nungta ganhing lite in kha guk nei ciat uh a, a pumtangun a kha nuai nangawn mit-in a tuam hi. Amaute in sun le zan khawl loin: \"A omdensa, tu laitaka om le hong pai ding, Thahatpen Topa Pasian, Siangtho, Siangtho, Siangtho hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Isa 6:3"},"9":{"text":"Tua a nungta ganhingte in tua kumpi tokhom-a tu, a tawntung a nungta den pa tungah minthanna, pahtawina le lungdam thu a puak peuhpeuh uh ciangin"},"10":{"text":"tua upa sawmnih le lite, kumpi tokhom tunga tupa mai-ah bok uh a, a tawntunga nungta den pa a bia uh hi. Tua kumpi tokhom mai-ah a kumpi lukhute uh nga uh a:","ref":"Tp 33:3; Ph 47:8"},"11":{"text":"\"Kote Topa le Pasian aw, nangin na khempeuh na piangsak-a nangma deih bangin amaute kipiangsakin nungta uh ahi manin, minthanna, pahtawina le vangliatnate a ngah dingin na kilawm hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Ns 14:15; Kil 1:6"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin kumpi tokhom tunga tupa taklam ah a langniha kigelh ciamtehna sagiha kiciamteh laizial khat ka mu hi.","title":"Laizial le Tuuno"},"2":{"text":"Tuateh a thahat vansawltak khat in, \"Ciamtehna phela, laizial zal dingin kua cing ahi hiam?\" ci-a ngaihtaka kitangko ka mu hi."},"3":{"text":"Ahi hangin vantung ahi zongin, leitung ahi zongin, leinuai ahi zongin, laizial a zal gen loh a sung nangawn a en thei kuamah a om kei hi."},"4":{"text":"Laizial a zal ding ahikeh a sung en dinga a cing nangawn kuamah a kimuh loh manin kah cihtakin ka kap hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua upate khat in kei kiangah, \"Kap kei in! En in, Judah beh a Humpinelkai, David Zungpi gualzo ta hi. Amah in tua laizial le a ciamtehna sagihte a hong thei hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Isa 11:1,10; Kil 4:2"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin a kigosa hileh kilawm Tuuno khat, tua kumpi tokhom laizangah dinga, a nungta ganhing lite le upate in a kualkhum uh ka mu hi. Amah in ki sagih le mit sagih nei a, tuate, leitung khempeuh a kisawlkhia Pasian kha a sagihte ahi hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah pai-in kumpi tokhom tunga tupa taklama laizial a la hi."},"8":{"text":"A lak khit ciangin tua a nungta ganhing lite le upa sawmnih le lite, Tuuno mai-ah a boksuk uh hi. Amaute in harp khat ciat nei uh a, misiangte thungetna ahi, gimnamtui tawh a dim kham kuangkumte a tawi uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute in lathak khat, \"Nang hong kigo zo a, na sisan tawh Pasian ading mi, beh kim, pau kim, mi kim, nam kim pan lei khin zo na hi manin tua laizial la a, a ciamtehna phel dingin na kilawm hi.","ref":"Ph 141:2; Jn 1:29; Kil 13:7"},"10":{"text":"Nangmah in amaute kumpi-gam khat le kote Pasian nasem ding siampi-in na bawl khin zo a, amaute in leitung a uk ding uh hi,\" ci-in a sa uh hi.","ref":"1Pe 2:5; Kil 3:21"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka en a, vansawltak tampi, tul mun tul tampi le tulsawm mun tulsawm tampite aw ka za hi. Amaute in tua kumpi tokhom le a nungta ganhingte le upate a umcih uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Amaute in, \"A kigosa Tuuno, vangliatna, hauhna, pilna, hatna, pahtawina, minthanna le phatna ngah dingin kilawm hi,\" ci-in ngaihtakin a sa uh hi.","ref":"Da 7:10; Kil 1:6; 4:11"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung, leitung, leinuai, tuipi tung le tuate sunga om a kipiang sakte khempeuh in: \"Kumpi tokhom tunga tupa le Tuuno tungah phatna, pahtawina, minthanna le vangliatna a tawntungin om den ta hen!\" ci-in la a sak uh ka za hi.","ref":"1Kh 29:11"},"14":{"text":"A nungta ganhing lite in, \"Amen,\" ci uh a upate in bokin a bia uh hi.","ref":"Kil 4:6,9"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuuno in ciamtehna sagihte a masa pen a hon laitak ka en hi. Tua ciangin a nungta ganhing lite khat in kek kia ging bangin, \"Hong pai in!\" a cih ka za hi.","title":"Ciamtehnate"},"2":{"text":"Ka en-a, ka mai-ah sakol kang khat a na om hi! A tunga tuangpa in thal khat tawi a, amah kumpi lukhu khat kipia in, gual zawh a sawm gualzopa bangin a kuan khia hi.","ref":"Kil 5:6"},"3":{"text":"Tuuno in ciamtehna nihna a hon ciangin a nungta ganhing nihna in, \"Hong pai in!\" a cih uh ka za hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin meikuang banga san sakol khat hong pusuakkhia hi. A tunga tuangpa, leitung pan lemna lakkhiat theihna le mite khat le khat kithahsak theihna vang kipia hi. Amah namsau lianpi khat kipia hi.","ref":"Zec 1:8; Kil 4:7"},"5":{"text":"Tuuno in ciamtehna a thumna a hon ciangin, a nungta ganhing a thumna in, \"Hong pai in!\" a cih ka za hi. Ka en a, ka mai-ah sakol vom khat a na om hi! A tunga tuangpa in, tawi tehna kop khat a khutah a tawi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungta ganhing lite lakah aw khat tawh a kibang khat in, \"Ni khat thaman b dingin mangbuh quart c khat le ni khat thaman dingin mangbuh-ham quart d thum hi; ahi zongin lenggahzu le sathau siasak kei in!\" a cih ka za hi.","ref":"Zec 6:2"},"7":{"text":"Tuuno in ciamtehna lina a hon ciangin a nungta ganhing a lina in, \"Hong pai in!\" a cih aw ka za hi."},"8":{"text":"Ka en a, ka mai-ah sakol daang khat a na om hi! A tunga tuangpa min Sihna kici hi-a, Gawtmun in a nung mahmah ah a zui hi. Amaute in leitung seh li suah seh khat, namsau, kialpi, pulpi le leitung gamsate-a a thah theih nadingin vang liatna kipia hi.","ref":"Jer 24:10, Zec 6:3, Kil 20:13,14"},"9":{"text":"Amah in ciamtehna ngana a hon ciangin, Pasian thu hang le citaka teci a pannasate uh hanga kithatte khate biakna-tau nuai-ah ka mu hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute in, \"A siangtho le a thumaan Thuneipipen Topa aw, leitunga tengte thu na khen ding le kote sisan phu na lak ma bang tan sawt lai ding hiam?\" ci-in nakpi in a kiko uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute puantual pak khat ciat kipia-a, amaute in a naseppih a sanggamte uh a kithat lai dingte a kim masiah a na ngak lai zek dingun kigen hi.","ref":"Ph 79:10; Rev 20:4"},"12":{"text":"Amah in ciamtehna a gukna a hon laitak ka en hi. Tua laitak, nakpitakin zin a ling hi. Ni, kelmul kigan ippi vom bangin vom a, khapi a bupin sisan bangin san hi."},"13":{"text":"Thei a gah nunungte huihkhauh in a mutpulh bangin vana aksite lei-ah a kia hi."},"14":{"text":"Laizial zial bangin vanpi kizial a, mualpi le tuikulh khempeuh a omna mun pan kikhinkhia uh hi.","ref":"Ph 97:4; 2Pe 3:10"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin leitunga kumpite, uliante, galkap mangte, mihaute, thahatte, sila le sila lote khempeuh leihawm sung le mualtung suangpi lakah a bu uh hi."},"16":{"text":"Amaute in mualpi le suangpite kiangah, \"Hong vuknelh unla, kumpi tokhom tunga tupa maitang pan le Tuuno thangpaihna panin hong sel un!"},"17":{"text":"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thangpaihna ni thupi hong tung hi, kua in thuak zo ding hiam?\" ci-in a sam uh hi.","ref":"Joel 1:15; Mal 3:2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin lei kiu li-a ding vansawltak li ka mu a, amaute in leitung ahi zongin, tuipi tung ahi zongin, singkung khatpeuh tung ahi zongin a nung lo dingin leitung huih lite a lencip uh hi.","title":"Ciamtehsa 144,000"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungta Pasian ciamtehna a nei vansawltak adang khat nisuahna lam pan a paito ka mu hi. Amah in leitung le tuipi a suksiat theih nading vangliatna a kipiasa vansawltak lite tungah:"},"3":{"text":"\"Kote Pasian’ na a semte taltang tungah ciamtehna ka koih khit matengun, leitung ahi zongin, tuipi ahi zongin, singkungte ahi zongin susia kei un,\" ci-in nakpi-in a kikokhia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin a ciamtehsate a phazah ka za a Israel behte khempeuh panin 144,000 ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Judah beh panin 12,000, Reuben beh panin 12,000, Gad beh panin 12,000,"},"6":{"text":"Asher beh panin 12,000, Naphtali beh panin 12,000, Manasseh beh panin 12,000,"},"7":{"text":"Simeon beh panin 12,000, Levi beh panin 12,000, Issachar beh panin 12,000,"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun beh panin 12,000, Joseph beh panin 12,000, Benjamin beh panin 12,000, ciamtehsa ahi hi."},"9":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin ka en a, ka mai-ah kuama sim theih loh minam khempeuh pan, beh khempeuh pan, micih pan le pau khempeuh panin mihon tampitak, kumpi tokhom le Tuuno mai-ah a om uh hi. Amaute in puantual pak silh uh a, a khutuah nisuh hiangte a tawi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Amaute nakpi in awng uh a, \"Hotkhiatna, kumpi tokhom tunga tupa I Pasian le Tuuno pan ahi hi,\" a ci uh hi.","title":"Puantual Pak Silh Mihon Tampi","ref":"Ph 3:8; Kil 12:10"},"11":{"text":"Vansawltak khempeuh, kumpi tokhom le upate, a nungta ganhing lite kimkotah ding uh hi. Kumpi tokhom mai-ah kunsuk uh a, Pasian bia-in:"},"12":{"text":"\"Amen! I Pasian tungah phatna, minthanna, pilna, lungdamna, pahtawina, vangliatna le hatna a tawntungin om den ta hen. Amen!\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Ro 11:36; Kil 5:12-14"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin upate khat in kei kiangah, \"Hih puantual pak silhte kua hi-a, koi pana hong pai uh ahi hiam!\" ci-in hong dong hi."},"14":{"text":"\"Pu aw, nang na thei hi,\" ci-in ka dawng hi. Tua ciangin amah in, \"Hihte gimna lianpi pana hong pusuakkhiate ahi uh hi. Amaute in a puantualte uh Tuuno sisan ah sawpin a paksakte ahi uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ahi manin, \"Amaute Pasian kumpi tokhom mai-ah omin sun le zanin ama biakinnpi sungah ama na a sem uh hi; tua hi-a, kumpi tokhom tunga tupa in, amau tungah a puanbuk a zak ding hi.","ref":"Kil 22:3"},"16":{"text":"Amaute gilkial kik ngei nawn lo ding uh a, a dangtak kik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute nisa in sal kha nawn lo dinga, nisapi in zong a kangkha kei ding hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, kumpi tokhom laizanga Tuuno, amaute cingpa hi ding hi; amah in amaute a nungta tuinakte ah paipih ding hi. Tua ciangin Pasian in amaute mit pan, khitui khempeuh a nulkeu ding hi,\"hong ci hi.","ref":"Jn 10:11; Jn 4:10; Isa 25:8; 35:10"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah in ciamtehna sagihna a hon laitakin nai lang sung ding khawng vantung a sip dide hi.","title":"Ciamtehna Sagih le Gimnamtui Halna Kham Kuang"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian mai-a ding van sawltak sagihte ka mu-a, amaute pengkul sagih kipia hi.","ref":"Kil 9:1,13; 11:15"},"3":{"text":"Gimnamtui halna kham kuang tawi vansawltak dang khat hong pai-in biakna-tau ah a ding hi. Misiangte khempeuh thungetna tawh kumpi tokhom mai-a kham biakna-tau tunga piak dingin gimnamtui tampitak kipia hi."},"4":{"text":"Vansawltak khut panin misiangte thungetna tawh gimnamtui khu Pasian mai-ah a tungto hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin vansawltak in gimnamtui kuang la a, biakna-tau pana mei-am tawh a dip khit ciangin leitung a denna suk leh khua phia zalzalin, kek kia-a van ging damdam in zin a ling hi.","ref":"Sp 16:12; Kil 5:8"},"6":{"text":"Tua ciangin pengkul sagih tawi vansawltak sagihte pengkul mut dingin a kithawi uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Vansawltak a khatna in a pengkul mut a, sisan tawh kihel gial le mei hong omin leitung ah kibuasuk hi. Leitung seh thum suah seh khat kangtum a, sing kungte seh thum suah seh khat kang tumin lopa hing khempeuh a kangtum hi.","title":"Pengkulte"},"8":{"text":"Vansawltak a nihna in a pengkul mut a, a nak liat mahmah a pumkuan zuaizuai mualpi bang khat tuipi sungah kilawnsuk hi. Tuipi seh thum suah seh khat sisan suak-a,"},"9":{"text":"tuipi sunga a nungta ganhingte seh thum suah seh khat si-in, tembawpite seh thum suah seh khat a kisia hi.","ref":"Jer 51:25"},"10":{"text":"Vansawltak a thumna in a pengkul mut a, meilah kuanglai tawh kibang aski lianpi khat van panin kiasuk-a, gunte, tuinakte, seh thum suah seh khat tungah a tu hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua aksi min Gamsaia ahi hi. Tuite seh thum suah seh khat tuikha a suak-a, tua tuikhaa hangin mi tampi a si uh hi.","ref":"Isa 14:12; Jer 9:15"},"12":{"text":"Vansawltak a lina in a pengkul mut a, ni seh thum suah seh khat, kha seh thum suah seh khat le aksi seh thum suah seh khat tuate seh thum suah seh khat a mial tek nadingin a satkhia hi. Sun seh thum suah seh khat le zan seh thum suah seh khat khua a vak kei hi.","ref":"Pl 10:21-23; Kil 6:12-13"},"13":{"text":"Ka et laitakin vankimlai-a leng muvanlai khat in: \"Adang vansawltak thumte mut ding pelkul gingte hangin: leitung a tengte tungah Gimna! Gimna! Gimna!\" ci-a nakpi-a a ham ka za hi.","ref":"Kil 9:12"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vansawltak a ngana in a pengkul mut-a, van pan leitung ah a kia aksi khat ka mu hi. Tua aksi Kawhawmpi vang honna tawhtang kipia hi."},"2":{"text":"Amah in Kawhawmpi a hon ciangin tua sung panin pummei phualpi khu bangin meikhu a suakkhia hi. Tua Kawhawmpi pana meikhu in ni le van a mialsak hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin meikhu lak panin kauphete leitung ah tuaksuk uh a, leitunga aikam vangliatna bang vangliatna amaute kipia hi."},"4":{"text":"Tuate tungah, leitunga lopate, ankung khatpeuh ahikeh singkung susia loin, a taltang tunga Pasian ciamtehna a nei lote bek a suksiat dingun kihilh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute in a thah nading uh vangliatna kipia lo-a, ahi hangin kha nga sung gawt thei bek ding uh hi. Tua a thuak uh gimna in, aikam in mi a deh cianga a nat bang ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Tua hun laitakin mite in sihna zong ding uh a, ahi hangin a mu kei ding uh hi; amaute a si nuam ding uh a, ahi hangin sihna in amaute a pel ding hi.","ref":"Job 3:21; Pk 8:10"},"7":{"text":"Tua kauphete, galsim dinga kithawi sa sakolte tawh kibang hi. Amaute lutungah kham kumpi lukhu tawh kibang khu uh a, a maitang un mihing maitang a sun hi."},"8":{"text":"A sam uh numeite sam banga, a hate uh humpinelkai ha a bang hi."},"9":{"text":"Sik awmdal bang awmdal nei uh a, a kha ging uh, galsimna-a sakolleng tampi tai henhan ging a bang hi."},"10":{"text":"Mei nei uh a, aikam bangin a deh uh hi. A mei-uah mite kha nga sung a thuaksiatsak theih nading uh vangliatna a nei uh hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute in Kawhawmpi vansawltak, kumpi-in a nei uh hi. Ama min Hebrew pau in Abaddon hi a, Greek pau in Apollyon b ahi hi.","ref":"Joel 2:4"},"12":{"text":"A masa pen gimna bei zo a, gimna adang nih tung lai ding hi."},"13":{"text":"Vansawltak a gukna in a pengkul mut a, Pasian mai-a kham biakna-tau kite c panin awging khat ka za hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua in pengkul tawi vansawltak a gukna kiang ah, \"Euphrates gunpi-a kihen vansawltak lite khahkhia un,\" a ci hi."},"15":{"text":"Hih nai, hih ni, hih kha, hih kum lian adingin a kigingsa-a kikoih tua vansawltak lite, leitung mi seh thum suah seh khat a that dingin kikhahkhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Sakol tungtuang galkapte awn zanih a pha hi. Amaute a phazah ka za hi.","ref":"Kil 7:1"},"17":{"text":"Ka mangmuhna-a ka muh sakolte le a tuangte hih bang ahi hi: A awmdalte uh meikuang bangin a san, a ciipdum le kaat banga eng tawh ahi hi. Sakolte lutangte humpinelkai lutang tawh kibang a, a kam panun mei, meikhu le kaat a suakkhia hi."},"18":{"text":"Amaute kam pana suak khia mei, meikhu le kaat gimna nam thumte in, mihingte seh thum suah seh khat a thatlum hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua sakolte a kam sung uh le a mei uhah vangliatna a om hi; a meite uh gul bang, lutang nei-in tua tawh mi a liamsuah uh hi.","ref":"Kil 11:5"},"20":{"text":"Hih pulpite in a thah baang a om lai leitung mite, a khut uh tawh a sep uh nate panin a kisik nai kei uh hi; amaute in dawite, kham, ngun, sumngo, sing le suang milimte - khua mu thei lo, khua za thei lo, lam pai thei lo milimte a biak uh a tawp tuan kei uh hi."},"21":{"text":"Amaute in tualthahnate, aisannate, numei-pasal paktatnate le a guktaknate uh zong a kisik tuan beek kei uh hi.","ref":"Kil 2:21"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thahat vansawltak dang khat vantung pan a kumsuk ka mu hi. Meiipi, puantualin silh-a, a lutung san ah sakhituihup khat a om hi; a maitang ni tawh kibanga, a khete meikuang khuampi a bang hi.","title":"Vansawltak le Laizial Neu"},"2":{"text":"Amah in a khut sunga kizalsa laizial neu khat a tawi hi. A taklam khe-in tuipi tung sik-a, a veilam khe-in leitung a sik hi."},"3":{"text":"Humpi nelkai hawk bangin ngaihtakin a kiko hi. Amah a kiko ciangin kek kia ging sagihte in thu a gen uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Kek kia ging sagihte in thu a gen uh ciangin a gelh dingin ka kithawi hi; ahi hangin vantung panin aw khat in, \"Kek kia ging sagihte thugen gelh kei inla imcip in,\" hong cih ka za hi.","ref":"Da 8:26"},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka muhsa tuipi tung le leitunga ding vansawltak in a taklam khut vantung lamah a lamto hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah a tawntung a nungta den pa, vantungte le a sunga omte khempeuh lei le a tunga omte khempeuh le tuipi le a sunga omte khempeuh a piangsakpa lo-in kiciam a, \"A ziakai nawn kei ding hi!"},"7":{"text":"Ahi hangin vansawltak a sagihna in a pengkul a mut kuan laitakin, ama nasemte ahi kamsangte tunga a zaksak bang tektek in, Pasian thuthukte a tungkim ta ding hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Tp 32:40; Am 3:7"},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung pan a ka zak tua aw in khat vei hong genbeh lai a: \"Pai inla, tuipi tung le leitung ading vansawltak khut sunga zalsa a om laizial la in,\" hong ci hi."},"9":{"text":"Tua ciangin vansawltak kiangah pai-in tua laizial neu hong piak dingin ka ngen hi. Amah in, \"La inla ne in. Na gilpi thuksak dinga, ahi hangin na kam ah khuaizu bangin a khum ding hi,\" hong ci hi."},"10":{"text":"Vansawltak khut panin tua laizial neu la in ka ne hi. Ka kam sungah khuaizu khum bangin khuma, ahi hangin ka nek khit ciangin ka gilpi a thuksak hi."},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin kei tungah, \"Nang in mi tampite, minamte, pau tuamtuamte le kumpite tawh kisai, genkholhnate na gen kik pelmawh ding hi,\" hong kici hi."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tehna ciang tawh kibang pumpeng khat kei hong kipia a, \"Pai inla Pasian biakinnpi le biakna-tau tehin, tua lai-a om a biate sim in.","title":"Teci Nihte"},"2":{"text":"Ahi hangin a tual puanung pen Gentile-te tunga kipiasa ahi manin teh lohin nusia in. Amaute in tua khuapi siangtho kha 42 sung a tuancil ding uh hi."},"3":{"text":"Ka teci nihte vangliatna ka pia dinga, amaute in ippi puan silhin, ni 1,260 sung gen kholhna a gen ding uh hi,\" ci-in hong kigen hi."},"4":{"text":"Hihte, leitung Topa mai-a a ding olive kung nihte le meivak tunna nihte ahi hi."},"5":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh in tuate natsak a sawm leh amaute kam panun meikuang pusuakkhia-in a galte uh valhtum hi. Hih in amaute a nasak nuam peuhpeuh sih pelmawh nading zia ahi hi."},"6":{"text":"Hih mite in amaute thugenkholh hun sung teng guah a zuk loh nadingin van khakcip theih nading vangliatna a nei uh hi. Tua banah amaute in tui sisan suaksak theihna le amaute deih hunhun-a pulpi tawh leitung a thuaksak theih nading uh vangliatna a nei uh hi.","ref":"Eze 40:3"},"7":{"text":"Amaute in a teci panna uh a man khit uh ciangin Kawhawmpi pana hong paito gamsa in amaute do ding a, zo-in a that ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Amaute luang, a Topa uh zong a kilhlupna mun Sodom le Egypt ci-a tehpih a kinei khuapi lian sung, lam lian lai-ah a lum ding hi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum le alang sung mite, beh, pau le minam khempeuh pana mite in tua misi luangte vuisak loin a enen ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Hih kamsang nihte in leitunga teng mite thuaksiasak ngei zo uh ahi manin leitung a teng mite kigual zosakin ai ding uh a, khat le khat letsong a kipia ding uh hi.","ref":"Kil 13:1-4"},"11":{"text":"Ahi hangin ni thum le ni lang sungin amaute sungah Pasian tung pana nuntakna huu lutin, a khe un ding ding uh a, amaute lau mahmah ding uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in vantung panin, \"Hih lai ah hong paito un,\" a ci aw khat a za uh hi. A galte un amaute a et zuizui lai mah un meii kawm lakah a paito uh hi.","ref":"Eze 37:5,9"},"13":{"text":"Tua laitak tektekin zin nakpi-in linga, khuapi seh sawm suah seh khat a kicim hi. Tua zinling ah mi tul sagih si-a, a nungta lai mite lau lua mahmah in van a Pasian a minthangsak uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Gimna a nihna bei khin zo-a, gimna thumna a tung pah ding hi."},"15":{"text":"Vansawltak a sagihna in a pengkul muta, vantung ah aw ngaih mahmah in: \"Leitung gam teng i Topa gam le ama Christ gam suak zo a, amah in a tawntung in uk den ding hi,\"a ci hi.","ref":"Kil 16:17; 19:1; Kil 12:10; Ph 145:13","title":"Pengkul a Sagihna"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian mai-a amau kumpi tokhoma tu upa sawmnih le lite in bokin bia uh a:"},"17":{"text":"\"A om densa, tu laitaka om, Thahatpen Topa Pasian aw, a lian mahmah na vangliatna na la zo a, gam uk dingin kipan khin na himanin nang tungah lungdamna kong puak uh hi.","ref":"Kil 1:4; Kil 4:4,10"},"18":{"text":"Minamte heh uh a; na thangpaihna hong tung zo hi. Misite tunga thukhen ding hun le na nasem kamsangte, na min a zahtak na misiangte aneu alian - in pahtakman piak ding hun le leitung a susiate suksiat ding hun, hong tung zo hi,\"a ci uh hi.","ref":"Ph 2:1; Kil 20:12; Kil 19:5"},"19":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantunga Pasian biakinnpi kihong a, ama biakinnpi sungah ama thukhun singkuangpi kimu hi. Tua mun ah kek kia in khua phia zalzala, van ging damdam in zin linga, gialpi a kia hi.","ref":"Kil 15:5,8"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantungah a lian a lamdang limte kilang a: numei khat in ni silhin a khepek nuai-ah khapi sik-a, aksi sawm le nih lukhu in a nei hi.","title":"Numei le Gulpi-sikhiam"},"2":{"text":"Amah a gai hi-a, nau suak dektak bangin nasa-in a kiko hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung ah lim lamdang khat kilang a: agol pha mahmah gulpi-sikhiam san khat in, lutang sagih nei-a, ki sawm nei-in, a lutungah kumpi lukhu sagih a khu hi."},"4":{"text":"A mei in aksite seh thum suah seh khat van pan vatkhia a, tuate lei ah a kia hi. A suak dektak numei mai-ah a suah pheta, a ta a nawmvalh theih pah nadingin gulpi-sikhiam a ding hi."},"5":{"text":"Numei in minam khempeuh sikciang tawh a uk ding tapa pasalno khat a nei hi. A ta kibawhpah in Pasian kianga kumpi tokhom ah kikoihto pah hi."},"6":{"text":"A numei pen Pasian in ama adinga a bawlsaksa gamlak ah ni 1,260 kikem dingin a tai hi.","ref":"Ph 2:9; Da 7:7,20"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung ah gal kidona a om hi. Michael le a vansawltakte in tua gulpi-sikhiam do uh a, gulpi-sikhiam le a vansawltakte in a do thuk uh hi."},"8":{"text":"Ahi hangin a do zo dingin thakhauh lo ahi manin vantunga a mun uh a tan uh hi."},"9":{"text":"Gulpi-sikhiam kilawnsuk a - tua dawimangpa ahikeh Satan kici leitung buppi lampialsakpa tua tanglai gulpi ahi hi. Amah ama vansawltakte tawh lei-ah kilawnkhia suk hi.","ref":"Pc 3:1-7; Jude 9"},"10":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung ah aw ngaih taka kiko khat ka za a: \"Tu-in eite Pasian hotkhiatna, a vangliatna, a gam le ama Christ thuneihna hong tung zo hi. Ahang in, eite Pasian mai-ah sun le zanin i sanggamte ngawhin a mawhsakpa kilawnkhia zo hi.","ref":"Kil 7:10; Job 1:9-11"},"11":{"text":"Amaute in, Tuuno sisan hang le amaute teci panna thu hangin amah a zo uh hi; amaute in sihna thuak ngam zahin a nuntakna uh a it kei uh hi.","ref":"Kil 6:9"},"12":{"text":"Tua ahi manin no vantungte le tuate sunga tengte khempeuh aw, nuam un! Ahi hangin leitung le tuipi aw, nang tungah dawimangpa hong tuaksuk zo ahi manin gimna nak thuak na nicia! Amah in ama hun a tom lam thei ahi manin, lungsona tawh kidim hi,\"a ci hi.","ref":"Ph 96:11; Kil 8:13"},"13":{"text":"Gulpi-sikhiam in amah leitung ah kilawnkhia ahilam a theih ciangin, tua tapa nei numei a delh hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua numei gulpi phak zawh lohna gam ah, hun khat, hunte le hun khat lang a kikep nadinga kibawlsa mun ah a len theih nadingin a lian mahmah muvanlai kha nihte kipia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin gulpi in, tua numei pha-a tuizeupi taisak dingin a kam panin gun bangin tui a phitkhia hi."},"16":{"text":"Ahi hangin leitung in tua numei huh a, gulpi-sikhiam in a kam pana a phitkhiat gun, a kamka in a na valhtum hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua numei tungah gulpi-sikhiam thangpai a, Pasian thupiak mangin, Jesu teci panna a len a om lai tua numei tate sim dingin a kuankhia hi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin gulpi-sikhiam a tuipi gei sehtak tungah a ding hi. Tua ciangin tuipi pana pusuakkhia gamsa khat ka mu hi. Amah in ki sawm, lutang sagih, a ki tungah kumpi lukhu sawm, a lutunga Pasian gendaina min a tuang ciat a nei hi.","ref":"Pc 3:15"},"2":{"text":"Ka muh gamsa pen kamkei tawh kisun-a, ahi hangin a khepekte vompi aa tawh kibangin, a kam, humpinelkai kam a bang hi. Gulpi-sikhiam in ama vang liatna, a kumpi tokhom le a lian a thuneihna tua gamsa a pia hi.","title":"Tuipi pana Gamsa"},"3":{"text":"Tua gamsate lutangte khat ah sihna khop zah liamma nei a, ahi hangin tua liamma a dam ta hi. Leitung bup in lamdang sa in tua gamsa a zui uh hi."},"4":{"text":"Gulpi-sikhiam in tua gamsa tungah thu-neihna pia ahi manin mite in gulpi-sikhiam a bia uh hi. Amaute in tua gamsa zong bia uh a, \"Tua gamsa bang kua om hiam? Amah kua in langdo thei ding hiam?\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Da 7:1-6"},"5":{"text":"Tua gamsa tungah a kiphatsakna kam pau nading le gendai nading kam khat kipia-a, a thuneihna a zat hun ding kha sawmli le nih sung kipia hi."},"6":{"text":"Amah in Pasian gendai ding, a min, a tenna mun le vantung a tengte gendaina-in a kam a ka hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in, misiangte doin a zawh nading vangliatna kipia hi. Ama tungah beh peuhmah, mite, paute le minamte tunga thuneihna kipia lai hi."},"8":{"text":"Leitung kipiansaka kipan a kigosa Tuuno nuntakna laibu sunga a min a kigelh lote khempeuh - leitunga a tengte khempeuh in tua gamsa bia ding uh hi. b","ref":"Da 7:8,11"},"9":{"text":"Bil nei peuh in za ta hen."},"10":{"text":"Mi khatpeuh saltaang ding ahileh sal taang ding hi. Mi khatpeuh namsau a thah ding ahileh namsau in kithat c ding hi. Hih in misiangte lungduai-a thuakna le muanhuaina a kal hi.","ref":"Jer 15:2; 43:11; Kil 14:12"},"11":{"text":"Tua ciangin lei pana pusuakkhia gamsa adang khat ka mu hi. Tua in tuuno bangin ki nih nei-a, ahi hangin gulpi-sikhiam bangin a pau hi."},"12":{"text":"Amah in a masa gamsa tangin ama thuneihna khempeuh zanga, leitung le a sunga tengte, tua sihna khopa liamma a nei a damsa gamsa masa pen a biasak hi.","title":"Lei pana Gamsa"},"13":{"text":"Amah in alian a lamdang limte bawla, mi khempeuh muhin vantung pan lei-ah mei nangawn a kiasak hi."},"14":{"text":"Tua limte hangin a masa gamsa tangin vangliatna kipia-a, leitunga tengte a khem hi. Amah in amaute tungah namsau ma tawh liam napi-a, a nungta lai gamsa pahtawina milim khat a bawl ding uh thu a pia hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua a masa gamsa lim tungah huu kipia a, pau thei-in tua milim a bia nuam lote a thah theih nadingin ama tungah vang liatna kipia hi."},"16":{"text":"Amah in mi khempeuh, aneu alian, azawng ahau, sila le sila lote in a taklam khut ahikeh a taltang ah thatang hatthu-in ciamtehna a neisak hi."},"17":{"text":"Tua ciamtehna, gamsa min ahikeh a min nambat ahi ciamtehna a nei lote in lei thei loin, zuak thei lo ding uh hi."},"18":{"text":"Hih in pilna a kal hi. Tua in mihing nambat ahi manin, theihna a nei peuh in tua gamsa nambat tuat ta hen. Ama nambat 666 ahi hi.","ref":"Kil 15:2; 17:9"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin ka et leh ka mai ah a taltang tung-ua ama min le a Pa min a kigelhsa 144,000-te tawh Zion Vum tunga ding Tuuno a na om hi.","title":"Tuuno le tua 144,000"},"2":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung pan a ngaih mahmah kekbaak kia ging le tuizeu hawk tawh a kibang aw khat ka za hi. Ka zak aw pen harp tumte tumging tawh kibang hi."},"3":{"text":"Amaute in kumpi tokhom mai le a nungta ganhing lite le upate mai-ah lathak khat a sa uh hi. Lei pana kitankhiasa tua 144,000-te longal kuamah in tua la a sin thei kei hi."},"4":{"text":"Hihte in amau le amau a sianga a kikep manun, amau le amau numei tawh a kibuahsak lote ahi uh hi. Amaute in Tuuno paina peuhpeuh ah a zui uh hi. Amaute, mite lak pana kileisa hi uh a, Pasian le Tuuno tungah gahmasa banga piakte ahi uh hi."},"5":{"text":"Amaute kam panin zuauthu kimu loin kawk baang lo uh hi.","ref":"Ph 2:6; Zep 3:13"},"6":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin vansawltak dang khat van kimlai-a leng ka mu-a amah in, minam khempeuh, beh khempeuh, pau khempeuh le mi khempeuh tunga tangko ding, tawntung lungdamna-thu a nei hi."},"7":{"text":"Amah in, \"Ama thukhen ding hun hong tung zo ahi manin Pasian kihta unla, amah minthanna pia ta un. Vantungte, leitung, tuipi le tuinakte a bawlpa amah bia un,\" ci-in aw ngaihtakin a gen hi.","title":"Vansawltak Thumte","ref":"Ph 34:9; Kil 15:4"},"8":{"text":"Vansawltak a nihna in a nung zui-a, \"A angkawmnate, a haisakna leng gahzu minamte khempeuh a dawnsaknu puk ta! A Lian Babylon puk ta!\" a ci hi.","ref":"Isa 21:9"},"9":{"text":"Vansawltak a thumna in amaute nung zui-a, aw ngaihtakin, \"Mi khatpeuh in gamsa le ama lim bia a, ama ciam tehna a taltang tung ahikeh a khut tungah a ngah leh"},"10":{"text":"amah in zong Pasian thangpaihna hai sunga kisungsa a lungsona a khauh mahmah lenggahzu a dawn ding hi. Amah a siangtho van sawltakte le Tuuno mai-ah kaat kuang tawh kigawt ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Amaute kigawtna meikhu a tawntungin khu den hi. Tua lai-ah gamsa le a lim a biate, ahikeh ama min ciamtehna a ngah peuhmah asun azan tawlngak hun a om kei hi,\" a ci hi."},"12":{"text":"Hih in Pasian thupiakte a mangte le Jesu tunga a muanhuai lai misiangte lungduai-a thuakna a kal hi.","ref":"Jn 14:15"},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung panin aw, khat in, \"Gelh in: Tu-a kipan Topa sunga site thupha ngah ahi hi,\" a ci hi. Kha in, \"Hihi, a sepnate un, amaute zui ding ahi manin, amau nasep gimna pan a tawlnga ta ding uh hi,\" a cih ka za hi.","ref":"1Th 4:16"},"14":{"text":"Ka et leh ka mai-ah meiipi kang khat na kaii-a, meiipi tunga tupa \"mihing tapa banga\" a a lutung ah kham lukhu khat khu-in a khut ah phiaukawi hiam khat a tawi hi."},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinnpi sung pan vansawltak dang khat hong paikhia in, meiipi tunga tupa nakpi in sama, \"Leitunga ante min khin ta ahi manin, an lak hun tung zo hi, na phiaukawi la inla at in,\" a ci hi.","title":"Leitung Anlakna"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua meiipi tunga tupa in, a phiaukawi leitung ah van kawikawi a, leitung an laksa a suak hi.","ref":"Jer 51:33"},"17":{"text":"Vantung a biakinnpi sung pan vansawltak adang khat hong paikhia a, amah in zong phiaukawi hiam khat mah a tawi hi."},"18":{"text":"Mei a uk vansawltak dang khat biakna-tau panin hong paikhia lai-a, phiaukawi hiam tawipa nakpi in sama, \"Lenggahte min khin ahi manin na phiaukawi hiam la inla, leitung lenggah gui panin lenggah bawkte khawm in,\" a ci hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua vansawltak in leitung ah phiaukawi van kawikawi-a, lenggahte khawmin Pasian thangpaihna lenggah suknapi sungah a lawn hi."},"20":{"text":"Amaute khuapi pua-a lenggah-sukna sungah kicil-a, tua lenggah-sukna pan sisan luangin stadia b 1,600 gamla dong sakol kamkaih ciang banin a luangkhia hi.","ref":"Isa 63:3; Joel 3:13"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vantung ah alian a piandang lim khat ka mu a: vansawltak sagih in a nunung gimna sagihte a tawi uh hi - a nunung ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian thangpaihna a kimna hi ta hi.","title":"Vansawltak Sagihte, Gimna Sagih Tawh"},"2":{"text":"Limlang tuipi le mei kigawm tawh kibang khat le gamsa le ama min le ama min nambat tunga gualzote, tuipi kianga ding ka mu hi. Amaute in Pasian piak harpte tawi uh a,"},"3":{"text":"Tuuno la le Pasian nasem Moses la sa in: \"Thahatpen Topa Pasian, nangma nasepte lian in, piandang hi. Khanghunte kumpipa aw, na lampite thumaanin thutang hi.","ref":"Pk 15:1; Kil 1:8; Ph 111:2; Ph 145:17"},"4":{"text":"Topa aw, kua’n nang hong kihta loin, na min thangsak lo ding hiam? Ahang in, nangmah bek na siangtho hi. Amaan nangma sepnate, kilaak khin zo ahi manin, minam khempeuh hong pai-in, na mai-ah hong bia ding uh hi,\" a ci uh hi.","ref":"Jer 10:7; Ph 86:9"},"5":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin ka et leh, vantungah teci panna biakbuk ahi, biakinnpi honsa in a om hi."},"6":{"text":"Vansawltak sagihte biakinnpi pua-ah gimna sagih tawh hong paikhia uh hi. Amaute in puansiang le a tang saihadial puan silh uh a, a awm uhah kham dialpek a baat uh hi."},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin a nungta ganhing lite khat in, vansawltak sagihte tungah a tawntunga nungta den pa, Pasian thangpaihna tawh a dim kham kuangkum sagih a pia hi."},"8":{"text":"Tua ciangin Pasian minthanna le ama vangliatna pana meikhu, biakinnpi sung tengah dim a, gimna sagihte a kim khit matengin vansawltak sagihte tua biakinnpi ah khatbeek a lut thei kei uh hi."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tua ciangin biakinnpi pan vansawltak sagihte tungah, \"Pai unla Pasian thangpaihna kuangkum sagihte leitung ah sung ta un,\" a ci aw ngaih khat ka za hi.","title":"Pasian Thangpaihna Kuangkum Sagihte","ref":"Zep 3:8"},"2":{"text":"A masa pen vansawltak pai-in leitang tungah a kuangkum sunga, gamsa ciamtehna a nei le ama lim a bia mite tungah a cikziathuai a na mahmah meimate a tung hi."},"3":{"text":"Vansawltak a nihna in tuipi tungah a kuangkum sunga, misite’ sisan tawh kibangin, tuipi sunga nuntakna a nei na khempeuh a si hi."},"4":{"text":"Vansawltak a thumna in, gunte le tuinakte tungah a kuangkum sunga, tuate sisan a suak hi."},"5":{"text":"Tua ciangin tuite a uk vansawltak in: \"Nang, tu laitaka om, a om densa, a Siangtho Pa aw, hih banga thu khen na hi manin na thukhennate ah na thutang hi;","ref":"Pk 7:17-21; Kil 15:3; Kil 6:10"},"6":{"text":"Ahang in, amaute in na misiangte le na kamsangte sisan luangsak zo uh a, amaute thuak dinga kilawm bangin amau dawn ding sisan na pia zo hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Lk 11:49-51; Isa 49:26"},"7":{"text":"Tuateh biakna-tau in na dawnga: \"Hihi, a Thahatpen Topa Pasian aw, na thukhennate thumaanin thutang hi,\" a cih ka za hi.","ref":"Kil 1:8; 15:3"},"8":{"text":"Vansawltak a lina in ni tungah a kuangkum sunga, mite mei tawh haldulh nading, ni tungah vangliatna kipia hi."},"9":{"text":"Amaute a sa mahmahin kihal-a, amaute in hih gimnate a uk Pasian min samsia uh a, ahi hangin kisik nuam loin amah a minthansak ding a nial uh hi.","ref":"Kil 2:21"},"10":{"text":"Vansawltak a ngana in gamsa kumpi tokhom tungah a kuangkum sunga, ama gam teng khuamial in a tuamcip hi. Mite in na sa lua-in a leii uh cip tentan uh a,"},"11":{"text":"a meimate uh na a sak manun vantunga Pasian a hamsiat uh hi; ahi hangin a hihnasate uh hangin a kisik nuam kei uh hi."},"12":{"text":"Vansawltak a gukna in, Euphrates gun lianpi tungah a kuangkum sung a, Nisuahna pana kumpite lampi sial dingin tua tui a kang hi."},"13":{"text":"Tua ciangin ukeng tawh a kibang kha gilo a thum ka mu hi. Amaute, gulpi-sikhiam kam pan, gamsa kam pan le kamsang-zuau kam sung pana pusuakkhiate ahi uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute, a lamdang limte a lak thei dawite kha hi uh a, leitung bupa kumpite kiangah pai-in, Thahatpen Pasian ni lian ni-a galdo dingin amaute a kaikhawm dinga kuan khia uh ahi hi."},"15":{"text":"\"Ngai in, guta bangin kong pai hi! Amah guaktang le zumhuaitakin pholaka a om loh theih nadingin hak gige sa-in puansilh-a om pa thupha ngah ahi hi.\"","ref":"Lk 12:39"},"16":{"text":"Tua ciangin amaute in Hebrew pau a Armageddon a cihna munah kumpite a khawm uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Vansawltak a sagihna in huih lakah a kuangkum sunga, kumpi tokhom panin, aw ngaih mahmah khat in biakinnpi pualam ah, \"Kizo ta hi!\" a ci hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua munah kek kia in, khua phia zalzal a, van ging damdam in nakpi-in zin a ling hi. Tua zinling nasia lua mahmah a, leitung a mi a om nungsang tua banga zinling a om ngei nai kei hi."},"19":{"text":"Tua khuapi lian phel thumin kiphelkhap a, minamte khuapite a kicim hi. Pasian in a Lian Babylon phawk gige a, ama lungsona lenggahzu tawh a dim ama thangpaihna hai a pia hi."},"20":{"text":"Tuikulh peuhmah mangthang a mualpite a kimu zo nawn kei hi."},"21":{"text":"Van panin mite tungah a lian mahmah gialtangte, tang khat pound za khat bang a gik a kia hi. Tua ciangin tua gimna lauhuai lua mahmah ahi manin gial gimna hangin amaute in Pasian a samsia uh hi.","ref":"Eze 13:13; Kil 14:8"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kuangkum sagih a tawi vansawltak sagihte laka khat hong pai-in ka kiangah, \"Hong pai in, tui tampi tunga tu a lian numei kizuaknu gawtna kong lak ding hi.","title":"Gamsa tunga Numei"},"2":{"text":"Leitung kumpite in amah tawh angkawm uh a, leitunga tengte in ama angkawmna zu a kham uh hi,\" hong ci hi."},"3":{"text":"Tua khit ciangin vansawltak in Kha-in kei gamlakah hong puamang hi. Tua lai-ah lu sagih le ki sawm nei a, gendaina minte in a pumtuam a dupsan gamsa tungah numei khat a tu ka mu hi."},"4":{"text":"Tua numei in adupsan le a-ausan puante silh-a kham, suang manpha, le kep manphate tawh kizemin a tee siasua hi. Tuanu in a kihhuai nate le a angkawmna nin tawh a kidim kham hai khat a khut sungah a tawi hi."},"5":{"text":"A taltang ah: THUTHUK ALIAN BABYLON NUMEI KIZUAKTE LE LEITUNG KIHHUAINATE’ NU ci-in a min kigelh hi.","ref":"Kil 14:8; Kil 14:8"},"6":{"text":"Tua numei in, misiangte le Jesu thu teci a pang mite sisan khamgawp-a om ka mu hi. Tuanu ka muh ciangin lamdang ka sa lua mahmah hi.","ref":"Kil 16:6"},"7":{"text":"Tua ciangin tua vansawltak in ka kiangah, \"Bang dinga lamdang sa lua na hiam? Tua numei le lu sagih le ki sawm a nei ama tuanna gamsa, a thuthuk kong hilhcian ding hi."},"8":{"text":"Khat vei lai-a na muhsa tua gamsa, tu-in a om nawn kei hi. Kawhawmpi sung pan hong pusuakkhia-in ama kisiatna ah a pai ding hi. Lei kipiansak cila kipan, nuntakna laibu sunga a min kigelh nai lo leitunga teng mi khempeuh in, tua gamsa a muh uh ciangin, khat vei a om khin, tu-in om nawn lo napi hong pai ding ahi manin lamdang a sa mahmah ding uh hi.","ref":"Lk 8:31"},"9":{"text":"\"Hih thu in lungsim pilna a kal hi. Lutang sagihte in numeinu tutna mual sagihte ahi hi. Amaute kumpi sagihte zong ahi uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Nga puk zo a, khat a om laitak hi-in, adang khat a om nai kei hi; ahi hangin hong pai ciangin tawm vei sung bek a om ding hi."},"11":{"text":"Khat vei a omsa tu-a om lo gamsa pen, kumpi a giatna ahi hi. Amah tua sagihte aa ahi manin a kisia ding hi."},"12":{"text":"\"Na muh ki sawmte, kumpi gam a ngah nai lo kumpi sawmte hi-a, ahi hangin amaute tua gamsa tawh nai khat sung kumpi banga thuneihna a ngah dingte ahi uh hi."},"13":{"text":"Amaute in ngimnasa khat nei uh a, a vangliatna uh le a thuneihnate uh gamsa tungah a pia ding uh hi."},"14":{"text":"Amaute in Tuuno va do ding uh hi, ahi hangin kumpite’ Kumpipa le tote’ Topa tua Tuuno in amaute zo dinga, a sapsa a teelsa le a muanhuai ama nungzuite tawh a omkhawm ding uh hi,\" hong ci hi.","ref":"Jn 16:33"},"15":{"text":"Tua ciangin vansawltak in, \"Tua na muh numei kizuaknu tutna tui pen, mite, mihonpite, minamte le kampaute ahi hi."},"16":{"text":"Tua na muh gamsa le ki sawmte in tua numei kizuaknu a mudah ding uh hi. Amaute in tuanu a siatsak khit uh ciangin, a guaktangin nusia ding uh a, a sa ne in mei-in a hal ding uh hi."},"17":{"text":"Ahang in, Pasian kammalte a tangtun masiah amaute vangliatna tua gamsa tungah a uk dingin a piak ding uh thukimna tawh Pasian in ama ngimna a zawhsiang nading amau lungtang sungah koih khin zo hi."},"18":{"text":"Tua na muh numei in leitunga kumpite a uk khuapi lian ahi hi,\" ci-in hong gen hi."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin vansawltak adang khat, vantung pan hong paisuk ka mu hi. Amah in thuneihna lianpi nei-a, a thupina in leitung a tangsak hi.","title":"Babylon Pukna"},"2":{"text":"Amah in nakpi takin: \"Puk ta! A Lian Babylon puk ta! Tuanu dawite kua suaka, kha gilote a le a nin, a huathuai vasate zualna mun, suak zo hi.","ref":"Kil 14:8; Kil 16:13"},"3":{"text":"Ahang in, minamte khempeuh in a angkawmnate-a mi a haisak zu dawnin kham ta uh hi. Leitung kumpite in amah tawh angkawm uh a, leitung sumbawlte in ama noptatluatna a hauhlawh uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Kil 14:8; Kil 17:2"},"4":{"text":"Tua ciangin vantung panin aw dang khat in: \"Ka mite aw, ama mawhnate ah na kihel khak loh nadingun, ama gimnate na thuak khak loh nadingun tuanu sung pan hong paikhia un;","ref":"Pc 19:15; Isa 48:20"},"5":{"text":"ahang in, a mawhnate, van banin kicianga, Pasian in a gamtat khialhnate ciamteh zo hi,","ref":"2Kh 28:9; Kil 16:19"},"6":{"text":"Ama piaksa bangin amah pia kik un; ama hihsa zah nih amah pia kik un. Ama hai pan mah in a zah nih leihbeh un.","ref":"Kil 14:10"},"7":{"text":"Noptatna le minthanna amah le amah a kipiak zahzah, gawtna le dahna amah pia un. A lungtang ah amah kisathei a, ‘Kumpinu-in ka tu hi; meigong ka hi kei a, ka thum ngei kei ding hi,’ ci hi.","ref":"Eze 28:2-8; Ph 10:6"},"8":{"text":"Tua ahi manin ni khat sungin ama gimnate ahi: sihna, thumna le kialpi-te in tuanu a khuplet ding hi. Ama tunga thukhen Topa Pasian thahat ahi manin tuanu, mei-ah kikhultum ding hi.","ref":"Isa 9:14; Kil 17:16"},"9":{"text":"\"Amah tawh angkawm-a, ama nop tatna a zangkhawm leitung kumpite in tuanu kihalna meikhu a muh uh ciangin amah kah in a thum ding uh hi."},"10":{"text":"Ama thuaksiatna kihta in a gamlapi ah ding ding uh a: \"‘Gimna! Gimna! O khuapi lian, O vangliatna khuapi Babylon! Nai khat sungin na siatna hong tung veh!’ci-in kap ding uh hi."},"11":{"text":"\"Leitung sumbawlte kapin a thum ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau sumbuk van:"},"12":{"text":"kham, ngun, suang manpha le kep manphate; saihadial hoih, a-ausan, nai le a dupsan puante, sing namtui namkim le saiha tawh kibawl na namkim, sing manpha, sumngo, sik le suangngo;"},"13":{"text":"sumbuk van, singzungthak, masala, gim namtui paknamtui khaa le sathau namtui, lenggahzu le olive thau, annel limci le mangbuh; ganhon le tuuhon; sakolte le lengte le mihingte pumpite le khate, kuamah in a lei nawn kei hi.","ref":"Eze 27:12-31"},"14":{"text":"\"Amaute in, ‘Na lunggulh mahmah gah in nang hong nusia ta hi. Na hauhna le na thupina khempeuh in mual khum-a, a kimu kik nawn kei ding hi,’ ci ding uh hi."},"15":{"text":"Tuanu tungah hih nate zuaka, a hauhna uh a ngah sumbawlte, ama thuaksiatna kihta in a gamla pekah a ding ding uh hi. Amaute thumin kap ding uh a:"},"16":{"text":"\"‘Gimna! Gimna, O khuapi lian, saihadial hoih, a-ausan le adupsan tawh kizem a, kham, suang manpha le kep manpha tawh a tee siasua!","ref":"Kil 17:4"},"17":{"text":"Nai khat sungin tua bang hauhna lianpi kisia tazen maw!’ ci-in a kapkhia ding uh hi. \"Tembaw ukte khempeuh, tembaw-a khualzinte khempeuh, tembaw nasemte le tuipi pana kivak nading a zongte khempeuh a gamlapi pekah a ding ding uh hi.","ref":"Kil 17:12,16"},"18":{"text":"Tuanu a katna meikhu a muh uh ciangin amaute in, ‘Hih khuapi lian bang, khuapi om ngei hiam?’ cikhia ding uh hi."},"19":{"text":"Amaute in a lutung uhah leivui lawn ding uh a, thumin kapin: \"‘Gimna! Gimna, O khuapi lian, tuipi tunga tembaw nei khempeuh in a hauh lawh! Tuanu hauhna nai khat sungin kisia zo tah!","ref":"Kil 17:18; Kil 17:16"},"20":{"text":"Vantung aw, ama hangin nuam in! Misiangte, sawltakpite le kamsangte aw, nuam un! Amah in note hong bawlsiatna hangin Pasian in ama tungah thu khen zo hi,’ ci ding uh hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Jer 51:48"},"21":{"text":"Tua ciangin a thahat vansawltak khat in an gawina suang lian cia a pha suangmai khat tawma tuipi sungah lawn in: \"Babylon khuapi lian hih bangin ngong bawlin kisusia dinga, a kimu kik nawn kei ding hi."},"22":{"text":"Harp tumte le lasiamte, tamngai mutte le pengkul mutte awging nang sungah kiza kik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Nang sungah khutsiam kuamah kimu kik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Nang sungah angawina suang ging a kiza kik ngei nawn kei ding hi.","ref":"Isa 24:8; Jer 25:10"},"23":{"text":"Nang sungah meivak khat zong kivak kik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Nang sungah mopipa le mo aw kiza kik ngei nawn lo ding hi. Na sumbawlte, leitung miliante vive ahi hi. Nang bumna in leitung minam khempeuh lam pialsak khin hi","ref":"Jer 7:34; Isa 23:8"},"24":{"text":"Ama sungah kamsangte, misiangte le leitang tunga kithatsate khempeuh sisan kimu zo hi,\" a ci hi.","ref":"Kil 16:6; 17:6; Jer 51:49"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hih teng khit ciangin vantungah mihon tampi awng tawh kibang aw khat in: \"Hallelujah! Hotkhiatna, minthanna le vangliatna eite Pasian aa ahi hi,","title":"Hallelujah!","ref":"Kil 4:11; 7:10"},"2":{"text":"ahang in, a thukhenna thumaanin thutang hi. Amah in angkawmna tawh leitung a siasak numei kizuaknu, mawhpaih zo hi.
